Automatic Invoice Reminders

Automatic Invoice Reminders
===========================

Updated over 6 months ago

Table of contents

[Preparing an Email Template for Invoice Reminder](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10795870-automatic-invoice-reminders#h_9e47c11eda)

[Enabling Automatic Invoice Reminders](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10795870-automatic-invoice-reminders#h_be372826a9)

[General Invoice Reminder Settings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10795870-automatic-invoice-reminders#h_00525bf7b2)

[Default Template and Template Overrides](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10795870-automatic-invoice-reminders#h_291e5f4d0f)

[Invoice Merge Fields](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10795870-automatic-invoice-reminders#h_9e73c5e4d2)

[Invoice Reminder Exclusions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10795870-automatic-invoice-reminders#h_4e61ce4d82)

[Disabling Invoice Reminders for a Patient or Payer](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10795870-automatic-invoice-reminders#h_307b62a330)

[Default Invoice Reminder Preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10795870-automatic-invoice-reminders#h_0fcdab89b6)

Schedule email reminders to be sent as an invoice approaches the due date and when an invoice becomes overdue by a specific number of days.

Preparing an Email Template for Invoice Reminder
================================================

Go to [Settings > Templates > Email Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/email)
.

Click **Add Template.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1655943207/7ef9fef81dd0c0df9dd720c142e3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddf586a1a60d294bafb8628b1353c25d91ca2430ed9aa642ac0778c3bdb87c7b&req=dSYiE8B6noNfXvMW1HO4zZigEdVxiq050bt3GhcpW3Ee7Oa6XMwBTSi0Izxr%0Aznef5moTCmQp0DdcsLE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1655943207/7ef9fef81dd0c0df9dd720c142e3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddf586a1a60d294bafb8628b1353c25d91ca2430ed9aa642ac0778c3bdb87c7b&req=dSYiE8B6noNfXvMW1HO4zZigEdVxiq050bt3GhcpW3Ee7Oa6XMwBTSi0Izxr%0Aznef5moTCmQp0DdcsLE%3D%0A)

Enter a suitable **Description** and **Subject** for your email template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1655958114/7aec6273f380bce145558e7dc92e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e178f75d2528141e83884a6fbcb04076f667e289726fa638baaf16a7d84b71a8&req=dSYiE8B7lYBeXfMW1HO4zTOjEbkT32%2FPx6u%2FAlIIjMxkYdd2igfuAoU8TJX7%0ABu%2FzuIAFYNUHAlb7gXw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1655958114/7aec6273f380bce145558e7dc92e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e178f75d2528141e83884a6fbcb04076f667e289726fa638baaf16a7d84b71a8&req=dSYiE8B7lYBeXfMW1HO4zTOjEbkT32%2FPx6u%2FAlIIjMxkYdd2igfuAoU8TJX7%0ABu%2FzuIAFYNUHAlb7gXw%3D%0A)

In the **Message** field, create a suitable email to be sent to patients as an invoice reminder. An example can be seen below, using _merge fields_ from the Invoice menu.

Hi <<FirstName>>,

This is a friendly reminder that invoice **#<<InvoiceNo>>** is currently outstanding.

*   **Due Date:** <<InvoiceDueDate>>
    
*   **Amount Due:** $<<InvoiceOutstanding>>
    

If payment has already been made, please disregard this message. Otherwise, we’d appreciate it if you could arrange payment at your earliest convenience.

Let us know if you have any questions or need a copy of the invoice.

Best regards,

<<BusinessName>>

  
This can be customised to meet your specific business needs. We recommend using the merge field found in the **Invoice** drop-down to populate the invoice information.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1655955003/75a77a179d1784fdd561d978d97f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5652a78c10b6b9612f687ab9d85cb26c95021908cc25837c5d169086e964687b&req=dSYiE8B7mIFfWvMW1HO4zQ57bIZVzGjrR3Yl3bsqDlZxKJ%2Ba2Uo1mLy388Al%0AWEhZZEk78F54VKCf0Kc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1655955003/75a77a179d1784fdd561d978d97f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5652a78c10b6b9612f687ab9d85cb26c95021908cc25837c5d169086e964687b&req=dSYiE8B7mIFfWvMW1HO4zQ57bIZVzGjrR3Yl3bsqDlZxKJ%2Ba2Uo1mLy388Al%0AWEhZZEk78F54VKCf0Kc%3D%0A)

  
​

Enabling Automatic Invoice Reminders
====================================

Go to [Settings > Billing > Invoice Reminders](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/invoicereminders)
.

Select **Add Email Reminder** to begin the process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1496983317/ea1d0fa91b29b883d0cb2da461ce/CleanShot%2B2025-04-28%2Bat%2B12_05_33.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7c66a5ccfb105fe385e2e608082a4338aa8f05a13a53b9c9edcebbe7f59876a&req=dSQuEMB2noJeXvMW1HO4zTHJIK%2B5%2Bi84666Mc3oY78lV2NKB2Ig9R4Zegxmt%0A7c%2FqkNjGhr4ZRAhWeWU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1496983317/ea1d0fa91b29b883d0cb2da461ce/CleanShot%2B2025-04-28%2Bat%2B12_05_33.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7c66a5ccfb105fe385e2e608082a4338aa8f05a13a53b9c9edcebbe7f59876a&req=dSQuEMB2noJeXvMW1HO4zTHJIK%2B5%2Bi84666Mc3oY78lV2NKB2Ig9R4Zegxmt%0A7c%2FqkNjGhr4ZRAhWeWU%3D%0A)

Note that you can create as many invoice reminders as you require. For example, you may create reminders for:

*   Invoice due in 1 day
    
*   Invoice overdue by 7 days
    
*   Invoice overdue by 14 days
    
*   Invoice overdue by 21 days
    

Repeat the steps below as many times as required.

General Invoice Reminder Settings
=================================

When setting up invoice reminders, you'll need to configure the following settings:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1496984532/4fe540b67191668f8de9ba2077d7/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+12_07_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2cfd2219d4a7d0243fa00fe015e61ca076d20191e639c6002533360ee2866ef1&req=dSQuEMB2mYRcW%2FMW1HO4zaIlTXrknElhWGqMnDazwkLlPHiP%2Fp5CvICEY7Ey%0ASGrCdRnf%2FtiBNQ0U4J8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1496984532/4fe540b67191668f8de9ba2077d7/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+12_07_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2cfd2219d4a7d0243fa00fe015e61ca076d20191e639c6002533360ee2866ef1&req=dSQuEMB2mYRcW%2FMW1HO4zaIlTXrknElhWGqMnDazwkLlPHiP%2Fp5CvICEY7Ey%0ASGrCdRnf%2FtiBNQ0U4J8%3D%0A)

*   **Name -** Enter a **name** for your reminder - e.g. Private invoice due in 1 day
    
*   **Time to send -** Choose whether to send if an invoice is **overdue by** or **due in** a specific number of days, as well as the **time** the email reminder should be sent.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1497095873/a6613eeb747b1caf25828da57fe3/CleanShot%2B2025-04-28%2Bat%2B12_11_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=76ebffa8a5666b6c647f236ed38c823f7be647014ce5925ba47155b8e3f36448&req=dSQuEcl3mIlYWvMW1HO4zSCtXj%2FkrgAqq7RpBkbM%2BkESurQWz%2FWJAIkLCWfg%0APfOK23jIyhFhY2UFqSo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1497095873/a6613eeb747b1caf25828da57fe3/CleanShot%2B2025-04-28%2Bat%2B12_11_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=76ebffa8a5666b6c647f236ed38c823f7be647014ce5925ba47155b8e3f36448&req=dSQuEcl3mIlYWvMW1HO4zSCtXj%2FkrgAqq7RpBkbM%2BkESurQWz%2FWJAIkLCWfg%0APfOK23jIyhFhY2UFqSo%3D%0A)

*   **Do not send if the owing amount is less than -** If the amount owing on an invoice is less than a certain value, reminders won't be sent.
    
*   **Reply Email Address -** The sender email and reply email address for the email reminder.
    

Default Template and Template Overrides
=======================================

Choose your Default Email Reminder template that covers the vast majority of invoicing scenarios.

You can also add overrides to send reminders using different email templates for specific Businesses, Fee Categories, and Payers.

Select **Add** to configure email template overrides.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1496986308/6bed7ebfe8da7b4e275904b4f955/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+12_08_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=05a56f9f2c1d66b2c09cb5f5347af6a72d6efb89a9c1fd39686cf9e83a4549b4&req=dSQuEMB2m4JfUfMW1HO4zb6Hvep2Oe61RBRC13QHFYZoAF1m4ZcEfvJ%2BfVS0%0AIKhEoN%2BeMq%2F04k5Iw3c%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1496986308/6bed7ebfe8da7b4e275904b4f955/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+12_08_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=05a56f9f2c1d66b2c09cb5f5347af6a72d6efb89a9c1fd39686cf9e83a4549b4&req=dSQuEMB2m4JfUfMW1HO4zb6Hvep2Oe61RBRC13QHFYZoAF1m4ZcEfvJ%2BfVS0%0AIKhEoN%2BeMq%2F04k5Iw3c%3D%0A)

Template overrides only apply if **all** items on the invoice match the Fee Category overrides. In Third-Party Payer invoicing scenarios, it's possible for invoices to contain items for different Fee Categories. If the invoice contains items with different Fee Categories, the **Default Email Reminder Template** will be used.

Invoice Merge Fields
--------------------

When creating your invoice templates, you can use merge fields from the invoice menu to populate key information like due dates, invoice numbers and outstanding amounts.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498980222/d551c6304b9784ee058f1fa65a96/CleanShot+2025-04-29+at+11_12_12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c285d27df8715350dd7e3b61f29c85c9fa8143a62f2de871608702589cab5a4d&req=dSQuHsB2nYNdW%2FMW1HO4zdmwb4E8Z7fKwB%2Ba%2BseJTzE55TY55fTyjHOGGSYK%0AQ0OncfJVFPYUERDwrLo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498980222/d551c6304b9784ee058f1fa65a96/CleanShot+2025-04-29+at+11_12_12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c285d27df8715350dd7e3b61f29c85c9fa8143a62f2de871608702589cab5a4d&req=dSQuHsB2nYNdW%2FMW1HO4zdmwb4E8Z7fKwB%2Ba%2BseJTzE55TY55fTyjHOGGSYK%0AQ0OncfJVFPYUERDwrLo%3D%0A)

Invoice Online Payment Links allow you to send patients an email or SMS with a link to pay their invoice online with Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay and Google Pay. It's also possible to display an optional QR code on the invoice for the patient to scan to pay their invoice online.

Once a patient clicks an invoice link, they will see an itemised invoice and the option to pay with a debit card or credit card powered by Tyro Health Online. Once paid, they will be able to view and download their receipt.

Once paid, the invoice will automatically be paid off in PracSuite without needing to manually reconcile the payment.

[Learn More About Invoice Payment Links](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10694263-invoice-online-payment-links)

Invoice Reminder Exclusions
===========================

If invoice reminders should not be sent in certain scenarios, you have the option to exclude invoice reminders from being sent for specific Businesses, Practitioners, Payers and Fee Categories.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1496985405/7b6d3393d71a577fc79d697b9134/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+12_08_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d83ac26644d70a8f21ae900e97ab464e93bc60b062ab645f30dd0c3413ffdbc0&req=dSQuEMB2mIVfXPMW1HO4zWGQDKTecq6QWeGCAFTCdcVHH22woDhM10xBbBdF%0AT4z3qKPEt3K%2BQxV5UXI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1496985405/7b6d3393d71a577fc79d697b9134/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+12_08_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d83ac26644d70a8f21ae900e97ab464e93bc60b062ab645f30dd0c3413ffdbc0&req=dSQuEMB2mIVfXPMW1HO4zWGQDKTecq6QWeGCAFTCdcVHH22woDhM10xBbBdF%0AT4z3qKPEt3K%2BQxV5UXI%3D%0A)

Exclusions will apply if **any** items on the invoice match the exclusion conditions. For example, if you have an invoice with multiple practitioners and one practitioner is on the exclusions list, no reminders will be sent for that invoice.

Once you're happy with your reminder preferences, select **Save** to finalise your changes.

When you're ready, you can enable the top-level switch '**Automatically Send Email Reminders**'.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1497085008/67bdfdc7bc2908d8a99521a18a60/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+14_23_03.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d867ed582e9f04dba279eaf0e31d0f6edadfe01d1fd16a194645cb12dcc07857&req=dSQuEcl2mIFfUfMW1HO4zah3vb3SviZCdd%2B2Fl5bXOflNrBsYeMhSfqeP3hO%0A76TbmpxxbPMbIy3nrJs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1497085008/67bdfdc7bc2908d8a99521a18a60/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+14_23_03.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d867ed582e9f04dba279eaf0e31d0f6edadfe01d1fd16a194645cb12dcc07857&req=dSQuEcl2mIFfUfMW1HO4zah3vb3SviZCdd%2B2Fl5bXOflNrBsYeMhSfqeP3hO%0A76TbmpxxbPMbIy3nrJs%3D%0A)

Disabling Invoice Reminders for a Patient or Payer
==================================================

It's possible to disable invoice reminders at a patient account level. From the **Accounts** tab, uncheck '**send invoice reminders**'. You may need to repeat this if a patient has multiple accounts.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1497086249/e59fecfebc17e7cf5aaf1525d4a3/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+14_24_58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5485f88d1322af95db9762a8cd618944d196e92ffd94c24cbc7bb9a7a931f1e8&req=dSQuEcl2m4NbUPMW1HO4zbPlilElQZ4nleknDwlur%2FSA9KZ6msujlLzG2W%2Fr%0ALBZfRtgZTN1kEKKhKAk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1497086249/e59fecfebc17e7cf5aaf1525d4a3/CleanShot+2025-04-28+at+14_24_58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5485f88d1322af95db9762a8cd618944d196e92ffd94c24cbc7bb9a7a931f1e8&req=dSQuEcl2m4NbUPMW1HO4zbPlilElQZ4nleknDwlur%2FSA9KZ6msujlLzG2W%2Fr%0ALBZfRtgZTN1kEKKhKAk%3D%0A)

Third-party payers will also have the same settings on the Accounts tab of the payer file, though you can also add them to the exclusions list as outlined above.

Default Invoice Reminder Preferences
====================================

You can configure the default invoice reminder preference for new patient accounts in [Settings > General > Patient Defaults.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/clientdefaults)

Select a Default Account and review the invoice reminder preference.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1499119440/8dde8e427afa2ed4f1410e384430/CleanShot+2025-04-29+at+13_45_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6666965ebad6763bcc30108ea115502023fdff0d3b300a68cdc3b2b015052704&req=dSQuH8h%2FlIVbWfMW1HO4zVCCwwAz1nc%2B15kR7t8TTk75G9e4MsuBtpxMi2XM%0A%2Fw9s5dJ5YLKunQ3mX1g%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1499119440/8dde8e427afa2ed4f1410e384430/CleanShot+2025-04-29+at+13_45_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6666965ebad6763bcc30108ea115502023fdff0d3b300a68cdc3b2b015052704&req=dSQuH8h%2FlIVbWfMW1HO4zVCCwwAz1nc%2B15kR7t8TTk75G9e4MsuBtpxMi2XM%0A%2Fw9s5dJ5YLKunQ3mX1g%3D%0A)

After reviewing the invoice reminder preference, you can update existing patient accounts.

How to Find Inactive Patients via the Active / Inactive Patients Report

How to Find Inactive Patients via the Active / Inactive Patients Report
=======================================================================

Updated over 6 months ago

Table of contents

[Setting the Criteria](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10895929-how-to-find-inactive-patients-via-the-active-inactive-patients-report#h_476f4582d9)

[Results](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10895929-how-to-find-inactive-patients-via-the-active-inactive-patients-report#h_59e1890515)

The [Active/Inactive Patients](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/active)
 report is designed to find patients that have been **Active**, **Inactive,** or a combination of both within specified date ranges. This is accomplished by defining when patients had, or did not have appointments or transactions.

This report can be found by going to **[Reports > Patients > Active/Inactive Patients](https://test2.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/active)
**.

Setting the Criteria
--------------------

By using the **Active** and **Inactive Criteria**’s date ranges, this report will search for patients that were Active (had an appointment/transaction) in the Active Date Range and/or were Inactive (didn’t have an appointment/transaction) during the Inactive Date Range. You can use these options individually or combine them to find patients that fit both criteria, for example: patients that had appointments last year (Active Criteria) but haven’t had any this year (Inactive Criteria).

Note: The words Active & Inactive are used in two different ways in this report. The Active/Inactive Criteria refers to when the patient had either an appointment or transaction. The Patient filter refers to the status of the patient’s file, whether they're marked as Active or Inactive. You can find more information in this article: **[Making a Patient File Inactive](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531174-making-a-patient-file-inactive)
.**

### Search by

Set whether you want to search for patients by when they had an appointment or transaction.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437244901/7db8e1eacc04e285ef6c7c6528a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26a02de61f72faa63ad53d1022109a3172fa20c78f3187acabf0a502a3440fc7&req=dSQkEct6mYhfWPMW1HO4zRHMvBDpz%2FI6H0NPxU%2FqfsA%2BF24d7VAfBpllSQxa%0ANdmhwQwFoTYfjDVHXjs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437244901/7db8e1eacc04e285ef6c7c6528a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26a02de61f72faa63ad53d1022109a3172fa20c78f3187acabf0a502a3440fc7&req=dSQkEct6mYhfWPMW1HO4zRHMvBDpz%2FI6H0NPxU%2FqfsA%2BF24d7VAfBpllSQxa%0ANdmhwQwFoTYfjDVHXjs%3D%0A)

### **Active Criteria**

Set the **Date Range** for when patients had an appointment or transaction. You can also specify Appointment Types, Item Codes and who the appointment or transaction was with.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652196659/1ecda764c063fa83a223de829191/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80c1821524fec111b93b54107fa5443ae90b958c4c94248eac722ab4d40a8125&req=dSYiFMh3m4daUPMW1HO4zfs6Lhi5fZf7i5FKLH8Zo%2BGdBBq%2FEoqbS0p%2F9Xh4%0AF8uK9rfmWJnKEJJQFAw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652196659/1ecda764c063fa83a223de829191/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80c1821524fec111b93b54107fa5443ae90b958c4c94248eac722ab4d40a8125&req=dSYiFMh3m4daUPMW1HO4zfs6Lhi5fZf7i5FKLH8Zo%2BGdBBq%2FEoqbS0p%2F9Xh4%0AF8uK9rfmWJnKEJJQFAw%3D%0A)

  
We recommend setting this filter even if you're just looking for patients that have been Inactive, this is to prevent patients that haven't been active for years from showing in the results. The last 1-2 years is a good choice if you're unsure.

### Inactive Criteria

Set the **Date Range** for when the patients did **not** have an appointment or transaction.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437258910/d13afc46475ef9cfa3d43d4967a0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f06ee37711ae72d40af67246ca3175a50675e1db42c57cf6af5efd15a8a4d4a&req=dSQkEct7lYheWfMW1HO4zRkHYuFOBEh7ZBrqqo00WgjXIrt4iHKkGyo8aII%2F%0Adi13dQQoBTVlhSeuicI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437258910/d13afc46475ef9cfa3d43d4967a0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f06ee37711ae72d40af67246ca3175a50675e1db42c57cf6af5efd15a8a4d4a&req=dSQkEct7lYheWfMW1HO4zRkHYuFOBEh7ZBrqqo00WgjXIrt4iHKkGyo8aII%2F%0Adi13dQQoBTVlhSeuicI%3D%0A)

Avoid overlapping the Date Ranges when setting the Active & Inactive Criteria as this will cause any patients that fall with the overlapping date ranges to not appear in the results. (A patient can't be both Active & Inactive at the same time)

### Summary

Once you've set your filters, check the Summary for a breakdown of what patients will be included. If you're happy with the summary, all that's left to do is click Generate Report. If not, adjust the filters until the summary reflects what you're looking for.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437269392/110604f37741011835a418198e56/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efd5de9739bb054ebabcfa87771d5474ccb66ef34c329c29395ae95d5dcd3723&req=dSQkEct4lIJWW%2FMW1HO4zcd9h349iUurqQFXoFv%2FyeOayO7iuIUP4LkclblD%0ARmWRJ38mibnKZS8U6Zc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437269392/110604f37741011835a418198e56/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efd5de9739bb054ebabcfa87771d5474ccb66ef34c329c29395ae95d5dcd3723&req=dSQkEct4lIJWW%2FMW1HO4zcd9h349iUurqQFXoFv%2FyeOayO7iuIUP4LkclblD%0ARmWRJ38mibnKZS8U6Zc%3D%0A)

Results
-------

Once generated, you'll have a list of patients that fit your criteria. You can then decide what to do with the results by using the buttons at the top of the Results section.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437265905/e86b22d0c724df186b9eea473a97/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=751daa8854fed840a7433ca0ba14b0f8b6e3267a2e861af1483a2002d9518243&req=dSQkEct4mIhfXPMW1HO4zcGUKf2gmC6LqpkM3TP0Bpy8nfFb%2BOjyZ0fH1iTn%0Al6b9VkfdIdN9X%2BejSGY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437265905/e86b22d0c724df186b9eea473a97/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=751daa8854fed840a7433ca0ba14b0f8b6e3267a2e861af1483a2002d9518243&req=dSQkEct4mIhfXPMW1HO4zcGUKf2gmC6LqpkM3TP0Bpy8nfFb%2BOjyZ0fH1iTn%0Al6b9VkfdIdN9X%2BejSGY%3D%0A)

## Document 11 — How to Move a Credit/Payment to a Different Account | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-11}

How to Move a Credit/Payment to a Different Account

How to Move a Credit/Payment to a Different Account
===================================================

Updated over 6 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10897357-how-to-move-a-credit-payment-to-a-different-account#h_09bbc1c018)

[1) Refund Payment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10897357-how-to-move-a-credit-payment-to-a-different-account#h_15c25ca759)

[2) Re-create the Payment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10897357-how-to-move-a-credit-payment-to-a-different-account#h_3af12edaa0)

Overview
========

Payments can't be moved directly between different accounts, they need to be refunded or deleted first and then re-added onto the desired account.

This article goes over the steps needed to accomplish this for non-Tyro Health EFTPOS payments. Please follow [this article](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6885506-how-to-add-a-refund-in-pracsuite-when-the-refund-has-already-been-processed-manually-via-tyro-health-eftpos)
 for how to refund a Tyro Health EFTPOS payment without sending the money back to the patient, then come back to this article for steps on re-creating the payment

Note: To avoid issues with reconciliation we strongly suggest that you make a note of the payments details (payment method, amount, date etc.) as they will be needed to recreate the payment.

1) Refund Payment
-----------------

The first step is to refund the original payment.

#### **Step 1:**

Navigate to the Patient's File and select Invoices on the left.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502695621/3e0e1ef40aade045f2b7a6e5f01c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cca952b4b97a330f89471a5e7e489b3458ab5102d559beefb35472366cb45f9f&req=dSUnFM93mIddWPMW1HO4zTP20el2ch5%2FO3X%2FTMXkJAAiqZJX1jipL9PfMeNg%0As3EH97ADjWRDDca95nI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502695621/3e0e1ef40aade045f2b7a6e5f01c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cca952b4b97a330f89471a5e7e489b3458ab5102d559beefb35472366cb45f9f&req=dSUnFM93mIddWPMW1HO4zTP20el2ch5%2FO3X%2FTMXkJAAiqZJX1jipL9PfMeNg%0As3EH97ADjWRDDca95nI%3D%0A)

#### **Step 2:**

Select the Payments tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502685675/175733a4566a82c9e14b410fa91d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=77da4de3620848bad6ce8161f123ec231da356507e89b897397ce7caed43cabe&req=dSUnFM92mIdYXPMW1HO4zVV4MiHeMsCW7mWWoS762dRmHRXMzAQamea3YdCj%0An6mdog06522LzeyVJuo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502685675/175733a4566a82c9e14b410fa91d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=77da4de3620848bad6ce8161f123ec231da356507e89b897397ce7caed43cabe&req=dSUnFM92mIdYXPMW1HO4zVV4MiHeMsCW7mWWoS762dRmHRXMzAQamea3YdCj%0An6mdog06522LzeyVJuo%3D%0A)

#### **Step 3:**

Check the box for the payment you want to refund and then click on the **Refund** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502686448/7509611a275cf46930614130857f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=66ae2b63bd46833c9fe1d7ce32f8d4245232a36bce1fddacd79d08a538385adb&req=dSUnFM92m4VbUfMW1HO4zUzVFzbzhbD9wzCeiKZuuX5hw2vzjOatyJJQlHm2%0A%2Fn%2BZ2K31n4rJhcX6KO0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502686448/7509611a275cf46930614130857f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=66ae2b63bd46833c9fe1d7ce32f8d4245232a36bce1fddacd79d08a538385adb&req=dSUnFM92m4VbUfMW1HO4zUzVFzbzhbD9wzCeiKZuuX5hw2vzjOatyJJQlHm2%0A%2Fn%2BZ2K31n4rJhcX6KO0%3D%0A)

#### **Step 4:**

In the window that opens, enter the full amount amount of the payment into the refund box.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437425788/042c13a9af5fd477fc0fce7dcc37/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27c130f03b2bb758721745860d5e442abb15f23769388b2be2470090d11ab0fa&req=dSQkEc18mIZXUfMW1HO4zWAiObeUa30uifDJk8XzUhQCGY1W87WrvAlUaCEj%0AcLg%2BB6xDo%2B5BFM2HBt0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437425788/042c13a9af5fd477fc0fce7dcc37/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27c130f03b2bb758721745860d5e442abb15f23769388b2be2470090d11ab0fa&req=dSQkEc18mIZXUfMW1HO4zWAiObeUa30uifDJk8XzUhQCGY1W87WrvAlUaCEj%0AcLg%2BB6xDo%2B5BFM2HBt0%3D%0A)

#### **Step 5:**

Enter a reason into the **Reason for Refund** box.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437426907/abc094d15d12d705d07eb50fd419/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09ea9b33fa166e0cdc4233cef19c015058cbb7f2c1d876a12aa42b5ce61a79ab&req=dSQkEc18m4hfXvMW1HO4zdsf4j89Fd6gCVxKzlZBeoBWKEql7eyYm2X%2BPRDo%0A3FegdlrDS0GdBmqpJE0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437426907/abc094d15d12d705d07eb50fd419/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09ea9b33fa166e0cdc4233cef19c015058cbb7f2c1d876a12aa42b5ce61a79ab&req=dSQkEc18m4hfXvMW1HO4zdsf4j89Fd6gCVxKzlZBeoBWKEql7eyYm2X%2BPRDo%0A3FegdlrDS0GdBmqpJE0%3D%0A)

#### **Step 6:**

Select a Refund method. If unsure, select Cash.

**Note**: This won't refund any money to the patient and is only for record keeping within PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437429775/94f68152abe330a575892b917a83/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ecc025a856ab388a5be69d49a5aebc7ef29cc01c99093803c8f205e76a28a71&req=dSQkEc18lIZYXPMW1HO4zeIFaSIbYQS46iMKlQR8fa%2FivVmMXxrS1z%2Fshu1W%0Ag%2B%2Bu0jKBz2eU%2BxOydNM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437429775/94f68152abe330a575892b917a83/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ecc025a856ab388a5be69d49a5aebc7ef29cc01c99093803c8f205e76a28a71&req=dSQkEc18lIZYXPMW1HO4zeIFaSIbYQS46iMKlQR8fa%2FivVmMXxrS1z%2Fshu1W%0Ag%2B%2Bu0jKBz2eU%2BxOydNM%3D%0A)

#### **Step 7:**

Click **Next** to move on to the Summary window. To finalise, click on **Confirm**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437435713/070f43ff33e0d1bc9d0007043306/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fde7da945d36375d8bd94d4789ca34aa8663e444864c3fc03846cbf6387cd43e&req=dSQkEc19mIZeWvMW1HO4zTkPrrtqLUVD7%2FUEjT46OgDiN%2BWeB3LYYB0ByRZO%0A2p3ojIqnY7x1Fp2wXEg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437435713/070f43ff33e0d1bc9d0007043306/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fde7da945d36375d8bd94d4789ca34aa8663e444864c3fc03846cbf6387cd43e&req=dSQkEc19mIZeWvMW1HO4zTkPrrtqLUVD7%2FUEjT46OgDiN%2BWeB3LYYB0ByRZO%0A2p3ojIqnY7x1Fp2wXEg%3D%0A)

2) Re-create the Payment
------------------------

Now that the payment has been refunded, it's time to re-create the payment on the second account.

#### **Step 1:**

Navigate to the destination Patient's File and select Accounts on the left.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502700301/a990637f4932fa03d5841c7f0322/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a2af886b90d6873b9b63644641afc5d49392b2f189c98935104850cd33e788f&req=dSUnFM5%2BnYJfWPMW1HO4zeAtCCIaJp23FO3U1I6A6aIExRd9bS5n65RJkrVP%0AMSppMwVwKhM3j0WPe5g%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502700301/a990637f4932fa03d5841c7f0322/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a2af886b90d6873b9b63644641afc5d49392b2f189c98935104850cd33e788f&req=dSUnFM5%2BnYJfWPMW1HO4zeAtCCIaJp23FO3U1I6A6aIExRd9bS5n65RJkrVP%0AMSppMwVwKhM3j0WPe5g%3D%0A)

#### **Step 2:**

Select the Account to add the Payment to.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502700778/3c354017a9c245f218c5b516f7d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=195fb8c2d67f72d5a5699985e7385cb37c205b9910f9d7669263765a7d0b7ac3&req=dSUnFM5%2BnYZYUfMW1HO4zeFjqTRgAKU9bvFU2sauIhp760FvVOahTZYqcb2F%0ARlcQuLEqJPT9WE0x07Y%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502700778/3c354017a9c245f218c5b516f7d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=195fb8c2d67f72d5a5699985e7385cb37c205b9910f9d7669263765a7d0b7ac3&req=dSUnFM5%2BnYZYUfMW1HO4zeFjqTRgAKU9bvFU2sauIhp760FvVOahTZYqcb2F%0ARlcQuLEqJPT9WE0x07Y%3D%0A)

#### **Step 3:**

Click on the Payment button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502747737/c43ffdfde8bf3a89fffac317d6c2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cd3c59dba2a94de0676eafa8381aa73e7f1212d51976db27e23f32b8f29c2bef&req=dSUnFM56moZcXvMW1HO4zbTbOdAxvuDZ8RE5xc0SGIbgdD27SQv%2FqmNRgVu1%0AzpAhuN2BxPmQ%2BsjV26s%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502747737/c43ffdfde8bf3a89fffac317d6c2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cd3c59dba2a94de0676eafa8381aa73e7f1212d51976db27e23f32b8f29c2bef&req=dSUnFM56moZcXvMW1HO4zbTbOdAxvuDZ8RE5xc0SGIbgdD27SQv%2FqmNRgVu1%0AzpAhuN2BxPmQ%2BsjV26s%3D%0A)

#### **Step 4:**

Enter the Payment amount into the appropriate payment field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502750591/0d9f33df7a074f8ac1397ae1feb7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ffb0651845eb9b947da36e36c86a2828ada475c2f55725262701c9b7ea348307&req=dSUnFM57nYRWWPMW1HO4zWLx%2BKR00jrVlFkhH%2FeIWSmUJzB3W474pRuedT18%0AtXqAYGjF9hd0d8S7yUU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502750591/0d9f33df7a074f8ac1397ae1feb7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ffb0651845eb9b947da36e36c86a2828ada475c2f55725262701c9b7ea348307&req=dSUnFM57nYRWWPMW1HO4zWLx%2BKR00jrVlFkhH%2FeIWSmUJzB3W474pRuedT18%0AtXqAYGjF9hd0d8S7yUU%3D%0A)

#### **Step 5:**

Edit the payment details to match the original payment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502752795/3a9b7b5b54a822615c1fb957df1f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=992346b36c3fa9140c12220aefc755fcf35c01f64f424c2adc5cc32ad9d35717&req=dSUnFM57n4ZWXPMW1HO4zXqJJvu5L6vB%2BDqdTcbc8nnv6FYvTiH4ULxgSFrs%0AgZh5f0eLRzYQ%2BvxaJZk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502752795/3a9b7b5b54a822615c1fb957df1f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=992346b36c3fa9140c12220aefc755fcf35c01f64f424c2adc5cc32ad9d35717&req=dSUnFM57n4ZWXPMW1HO4zXqJJvu5L6vB%2BDqdTcbc8nnv6FYvTiH4ULxgSFrs%0AgZh5f0eLRzYQ%2BvxaJZk%3D%0A)

#### **Step 6:**

If there are outstanding Items, the payment will be automatically allocated to them. If you don't want this, i.e. you want to add a credit to the patient's file, you'll want to change the Allocation column to Unallocated.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437464749/1eb939d3379ed70bed7d61b34ed3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cbeddbe2aef3b5400408da9b0a7b1385108e866c796f8265a3d335673d4dfb6e&req=dSQkEc14mYZbUPMW1HO4zZ2CQbNmvOoD9JwHZBfAGnDuUMisxkFqGonrBnWJ%0AWJd6rTbqbCgXqLmeOTs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437464749/1eb939d3379ed70bed7d61b34ed3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cbeddbe2aef3b5400408da9b0a7b1385108e866c796f8265a3d335673d4dfb6e&req=dSQkEc14mYZbUPMW1HO4zZ2CQbNmvOoD9JwHZBfAGnDuUMisxkFqGonrBnWJ%0AWJd6rTbqbCgXqLmeOTs%3D%0A)

#### **Step 7:**

Click Save to finalise the payment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502763092/7e2eb24fbee082d7a4b8d0b2b8dc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23a6ab11816c59b04d25190f2f258f32c63fb15c883c79bd8f274ad6e22140b3&req=dSUnFM54noFWW%2FMW1HO4zSjhwDazhfKBkVtirgqIo%2FYHgf%2FfXeusk9vJxlm2%0Aw14JXkhO0aVMm9Ae7ys%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502763092/7e2eb24fbee082d7a4b8d0b2b8dc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23a6ab11816c59b04d25190f2f258f32c63fb15c883c79bd8f274ad6e22140b3&req=dSUnFM54noFWW%2FMW1HO4zSjhwDazhfKBkVtirgqIo%2FYHgf%2FfXeusk9vJxlm2%0Aw14JXkhO0aVMm9Ae7ys%3D%0A)

Online Booking Confirmations

Online Booking Confirmations
============================

Updated over 6 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10911317-online-booking-confirmations#h_1bbbabe37b)

[How to Configure Online Booking Confirmations](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10911317-online-booking-confirmations#h_4b885f1241)

Overview
========

Automatic Appointment Confirmations for Online Bookings are set per appointment type and, unlike Reminders, they don't use the existing confirmation settings found on the [Settings > Appointment Book > Confirmations](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/confirmations)
 page.

How to Configure Online Booking Confirmations
---------------------------------------------

#### **Step 1:**

Go to the [Settings > Online Booking > Services](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/services)
 page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1439337120/78df0abc034587764bb337fab3da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c4ffbb4427db04102b44e2380e39a6c6e51d0146cea4ba1474902271705bc82&req=dSQkH8p9moBdWfMW1HO4zdpreRBHTnCG5whjwSNdIdRZhqa5K%2FE%2Bjz1IQLVa%0AMUvXqF%2F9UbljdsSh98E%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1439337120/78df0abc034587764bb337fab3da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c4ffbb4427db04102b44e2380e39a6c6e51d0146cea4ba1474902271705bc82&req=dSQkH8p9moBdWfMW1HO4zdpreRBHTnCG5whjwSNdIdRZhqa5K%2FE%2Bjz1IQLVa%0AMUvXqF%2F9UbljdsSh98E%3D%0A)

#### **Step 2:**

Select the Service that you want to edit by clicking on it's name.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652089445/ecca286dcdc37bd57e741ade278a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee72299448490de7cf0c2994d3a71b993fea4b771eb4f2da83fd6bd74d05f990&req=dSYiFMl2lIVbXPMW1HO4zebt9Wg7%2BRINLLPm9dot5ZPzsTC97TTdMgzr35wS%0AbzrnP3yYsSmkhxs2EI8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652089445/ecca286dcdc37bd57e741ade278a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee72299448490de7cf0c2994d3a71b993fea4b771eb4f2da83fd6bd74d05f990&req=dSYiFMl2lIVbXPMW1HO4zebt9Wg7%2BRINLLPm9dot5ZPzsTC97TTdMgzr35wS%0AbzrnP3yYsSmkhxs2EI8%3D%0A)

#### **Step 3:**

Click on an Appointment Type.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652090997/037b0e952ec4ceb829cd99afc252/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c63c173b10a04c63e4eee8269548e66d0c5dd3d33702a5dca43100e84706cbd&req=dSYiFMl3nYhWXvMW1HO4zYxMVtvev8jAN87MtDEtWdIGgkAISosCjyZhQNGA%0Arckbqh3yQPpxKl%2BSQfk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652090997/037b0e952ec4ceb829cd99afc252/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c63c173b10a04c63e4eee8269548e66d0c5dd3d33702a5dca43100e84706cbd&req=dSYiFMl3nYhWXvMW1HO4zYxMVtvev8jAN87MtDEtWdIGgkAISosCjyZhQNGA%0Arckbqh3yQPpxKl%2BSQfk%3D%0A)

#### **Step 4:**

Click Edit at the top of the page.

#### **Step 5:**

Enable or Disable Confirmations for Email and/or SMS confirmations using the toggles.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652094924/24c4f86d3015e1c49f30d550de9b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bf70f2980e346f8961894e4fc81689a1d9e8033cbc4a154ec7efb0fee8b3654b&req=dSYiFMl3mYhdXfMW1HO4zS8XwqZCkz2lCvFDPS4dl5HMTSjWmzNpH7fX1fQz%0AntFxIqs6OIiS2eoeSqo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652094924/24c4f86d3015e1c49f30d550de9b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bf70f2980e346f8961894e4fc81689a1d9e8033cbc4a154ec7efb0fee8b3654b&req=dSYiFMl3mYhdXfMW1HO4zS8XwqZCkz2lCvFDPS4dl5HMTSjWmzNpH7fX1fQz%0AntFxIqs6OIiS2eoeSqo%3D%0A)

Select the Template that you would like to use.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652095437/7ea488e699d7e7bf240046bef9cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4439d025a305a7d32245d1731c99e65accbcff472f0e94fdc2b17d9e3d5531b0&req=dSYiFMl3mIVcXvMW1HO4zT2sO9UOOZ8%2BL6%2BDU%2FmNCNGLzFHg5j9Exzi1%2B%2FBA%0A2HvI5AjpUgSNwmNbZ3A%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652095437/7ea488e699d7e7bf240046bef9cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4439d025a305a7d32245d1731c99e65accbcff472f0e94fdc2b17d9e3d5531b0&req=dSYiFMl3mIVcXvMW1HO4zT2sO9UOOZ8%2BL6%2BDU%2FmNCNGLzFHg5j9Exzi1%2B%2FBA%0A2HvI5AjpUgSNwmNbZ3A%3D%0A)

Click Save.

How to Invoice a Patient

How to Invoice a Patient
========================

How to generate an invoice for patients via the Appointment Book and their file

Updated over 5 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10996798-how-to-invoice-a-patient#h_5689d36f65)

[1) Invoicing From the Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10996798-how-to-invoice-a-patient#h_42c0f07183)

[2) Invoicing From the Patient's File](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10996798-how-to-invoice-a-patient#h_10b82d5661)

Overview
========

There are two ways to generate an invoice, each with its advantages.

1) Invoicing From the Appointment Book
--------------------------------------

Invoicing from the Appointment Book is the most common approach.

### Advantages

The main advantages of generating an invoice from the Appointment Book are:

*   The invoice will be automatically linked to the appointment.
    
*   The status of the appointment will automatically be changed to complete.
    
*   This workflow keeps the user on the Appointment Book, ready to process the next patient or make the next appointment.
    

### How to Invoice From the Appointment Book

#### Step 1:

Click on the appointment, then click on the **Invoice** button.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1449681828/56b7e9d29f2b2807b535a12aa865/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fcdade54112f677c53fccb84ecbb65d048319d0e1c347234138da59cdf601ca4&req=dSQjH892nIldUfMW1HO4zXU%2FPM9dABU5pZbZAgM8Mj5lM3VYImP6yv3DEClk%0AzvcgGwMkIi6my%2B119P0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1449681828/56b7e9d29f2b2807b535a12aa865/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fcdade54112f677c53fccb84ecbb65d048319d0e1c347234138da59cdf601ca4&req=dSQjH892nIldUfMW1HO4zXU%2FPM9dABU5pZbZAgM8Mj5lM3VYImP6yv3DEClk%0AzvcgGwMkIi6my%2B119P0%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select the **Practitioner** associated with this service/purchase, along with the **Item Code** being invoiced. Ensure the **Fee**, **Discount,** and totals are correct.

In most cases, these details will be automatically populated based on the appointment settings.

Click **Add Item** to enter additional items.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451438277/9ffa7bd2596f7b8cdba1ef35940d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4e4c6d5fb8d215c24909ddd71aafe8af20b8b6522e12020ea7db59d7e5defa8b&req=dSQiF819lYNYXvMW1HO4zWPUHcFFpGXi2f1qkXwOwrD96i23p60%2F8bQkOo2A%0AQeB6qE02CGS3o0XXqLM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451438277/9ffa7bd2596f7b8cdba1ef35940d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4e4c6d5fb8d215c24909ddd71aafe8af20b8b6522e12020ea7db59d7e5defa8b&req=dSQiF819lYNYXvMW1HO4zWPUHcFFpGXi2f1qkXwOwrD96i23p60%2F8bQkOo2A%0AQeB6qE02CGS3o0XXqLM%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

If a payment is being made, enter the amount against the appropriate Payment method below, then click **Add Payment**.  
​  
Alternatively, if you have integrated with other payment systems such as Tyro Online, click the appropriate button to make a payment and/or submit a claim.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451438587/80e3ff49bc96605e0a8241ff32e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=18bf0286ef4692a1b786eecbd7d53068633608cacb9dff5c16156fe7dede6b2f&req=dSQiF819lYRXXvMW1HO4zajDlacf%2FPNyC5Dh1fo8uwDqx4wFUymges%2BVTGHp%0AfbbRxI971VH9C3GTmcc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451438587/80e3ff49bc96605e0a8241ff32e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=18bf0286ef4692a1b786eecbd7d53068633608cacb9dff5c16156fe7dede6b2f&req=dSQiF819lYRXXvMW1HO4zajDlacf%2FPNyC5Dh1fo8uwDqx4wFUymges%2BVTGHp%0AfbbRxI971VH9C3GTmcc%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

Click on the **Save** button to finalise the invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451469872/6d55d7763ee3c77245ad2397d1b9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=71cc0e850a2edf1237c9db7fd147d9d4a847320cd685d40aaceacb24d675bb3b&req=dSQiF814lIlYW%2FMW1HO4zVDCm0eIDvn8%2BlqBxad1mQfv1NsS2wLvo0Tayb%2Fe%0AammrJNxnM7qic0wQqSY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451469872/6d55d7763ee3c77245ad2397d1b9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=71cc0e850a2edf1237c9db7fd147d9d4a847320cd685d40aaceacb24d675bb3b&req=dSQiF814lIlYW%2FMW1HO4zVDCm0eIDvn8%2BlqBxad1mQfv1NsS2wLvo0Tayb%2Fe%0AammrJNxnM7qic0wQqSY%3D%0A)

* * *

2) Invoicing From the Patient's File
------------------------------------

Invoicing from the patient file is less common, but can still be useful in certain workflows:

### Advantages:

*   Allows an invoice to be created without an appointment, which is useful for product sales or services that don't require a booking.  
    ​
    
*   Allows an invoice to be created without it being associated with the appointment, which would otherwise make the appointment appear ''complete'' (updating the status).
    

**Note**: If you open the patient file **_from_** an appointment, by clicking an appointment and using the ''Patient File'' button, any corresponding invoice will still be associated with that appointment automatically.

### How to Invoice From the Patient's File

#### Step 1:

Open the Patient's file and click the **Invoice** button at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451541655/f1161c1b74cd892d5b34bc9f27d8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=60a8859fced32dbb34d9691f672ecef73eda30927943f8646bc20c8aa61e3cad&req=dSQiF8x6nIdaXPMW1HO4zbyd4hIf3EZJ9WIhUDCAztazh7M9klAjvgbxHnUv%0AlhH4MLZWCIbP3bVVWQA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451541655/f1161c1b74cd892d5b34bc9f27d8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=60a8859fced32dbb34d9691f672ecef73eda30927943f8646bc20c8aa61e3cad&req=dSQiF8x6nIdaXPMW1HO4zbyd4hIf3EZJ9WIhUDCAztazh7M9klAjvgbxHnUv%0AlhH4MLZWCIbP3bVVWQA%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select the **Practitioner** associated with this service/purchase, along with the **Item Code** being invoiced. Ensure the **Fee**, **Discount,** and totals are correct.

Click **Add Item** to enter additional items.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451546641/c89f8d1e2e01728537ca5b8e61d1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=159c67e474aacb0be9af4bf08e3e4c0290e63e0ed496b03402ceb9d8ce4a222f&req=dSQiF8x6m4dbWPMW1HO4zWqEyP0zr6Op1IdR7APRRVL7fpp%2B3tZ6hHtciid7%0AJjAcJ1RnFsUpY9bMYrY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451546641/c89f8d1e2e01728537ca5b8e61d1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=159c67e474aacb0be9af4bf08e3e4c0290e63e0ed496b03402ceb9d8ce4a222f&req=dSQiF8x6m4dbWPMW1HO4zWqEyP0zr6Op1IdR7APRRVL7fpp%2B3tZ6hHtciid7%0AJjAcJ1RnFsUpY9bMYrY%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

If the patient has multiple accounts, ensure the correct account is selected.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451547302/b053b57655662126be4dc855d333/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=95370e64a90f6d06a790df17faa73b2292cb185094a062fa301dda9833927194&req=dSQiF8x6moJfW%2FMW1HO4zZwwcjRHs8ctz689Wr0JtNlu5kZy5rSTVPdHgFLf%0Aa9aQfy3fPRBBFCyox6Y%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451547302/b053b57655662126be4dc855d333/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=95370e64a90f6d06a790df17faa73b2292cb185094a062fa301dda9833927194&req=dSQiF8x6moJfW%2FMW1HO4zZwwcjRHs8ctz689Wr0JtNlu5kZy5rSTVPdHgFLf%0Aa9aQfy3fPRBBFCyox6Y%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

If a payment is being made, enter the amount against the appropriate Payment method below, then click **Add Payment**.  
​  
Alternatively, if you have integrated with other payment systems such as Tyro Online, click the appropriate button to make a payment and/or submit a claim.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451547676/5e4b3e82a7da2d119d90b1b7e0ee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bea92119fdfe6c27ce980ce4d68dac1df69cb4bd971ed59237593924c9d46760&req=dSQiF8x6modYX%2FMW1HO4zfCZQMmnvujNqjejG6xj%2FfMtvGptG85lXgT3ayL1%0Ay2tWI%2Bd7fSn2Bsxnymg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451547676/5e4b3e82a7da2d119d90b1b7e0ee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bea92119fdfe6c27ce980ce4d68dac1df69cb4bd971ed59237593924c9d46760&req=dSQiF8x6modYX%2FMW1HO4zfCZQMmnvujNqjejG6xj%2FfMtvGptG85lXgT3ayL1%0Ay2tWI%2Bd7fSn2Bsxnymg%3D%0A)

Using PracSuite AI for Telehealth Consultations

Using PracSuite AI for Telehealth Consultations
===============================================

Updated over 10 months ago

Table of contents

[Recommended Workflow for Telehealth](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11005503-using-pracsuite-ai-for-telehealth-consultations#h_6a2c0416ef)

[Obtaining a Transcript from Your Telehealth Provider](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11005503-using-pracsuite-ai-for-telehealth-consultations#h_c9f0e5b16b)

[Creating the Clinical Note in PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11005503-using-pracsuite-ai-for-telehealth-consultations#h_0a9c8aa4b2)

To use PracSuite AI’s transcription feature, your microphone must be able to clearly capture both your voice and your patient's. This is usually straightforward during in-person consultations or when dictating notes, but it can be more challenging during a Telehealth consultation conducted via video or voice call.  
​

Recommended Workflow for Telehealth
===================================

Instead of relying on PracSuite AI to transcribe audio during a Telehealth session, we recommend generating a transcript using your Telehealth platform (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, or Google Meet). You can then paste this transcript into the **AI Notepad** within PracSuite to create a clinical note.  
​

Obtaining a Transcript from Your Telehealth Provider
====================================================

Each of PracSuite’s integrated Telehealth providers includes a native transcription feature. In our testing, we found that Teams has the best workflow as you are given the transcript once you end the meeting. Follow the links below for detailed instructions from each platform:

*   [Google Meets transcribe instructions](https://support.google.com/meet/answer/12849897?hl=en#zippy=%2Clearn-which-google-workspace-editions-have-transcripts)
    
*   [Microsoft Teams transcribe instructions](https://support.microsoft.com/en-au/office/view-live-transcription-in-microsoft-teams-meetings-dc1a8f23-2e20-4684-885e-2152e06a4a8b)
    
*   [Zoom transcribe instructions](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0064927)
    

**Note:** Smartsoft does not provide support for transcription setup or troubleshooting outside of PracSuite. Please refer to your Telehealth provider for assistance.

Your organisation should review the **privacy policies** and **terms of use** of any transcription service to ensure it is appropriate for clinical use.

Alternatively, you may choose to use a third-party tool such as [Fathom](https://fathom.video/)
 to generate a transcript from your Telehealth session.

Creating the Clinical Note in PracSuite
=======================================

Once you have your transcript:

Navigate to the **Clinical Notes** tab in the patient file. Select **AI Clinical Notes**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451649351/d0d17247d3f661fdb95f08fb7ebd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b6a54c6cbb3af128a525020fa8c7f08f9555a79e2edd63027161c441b16ae00b&req=dSQiF896lIJaWPMW1HO4zXvEAV%2FLU59n8ZgANfZm1oVkQxtqOoF%2FpzWydFDr%0AwYP3yUrESRrKcMyV4AA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451649351/d0d17247d3f661fdb95f08fb7ebd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b6a54c6cbb3af128a525020fa8c7f08f9555a79e2edd63027161c441b16ae00b&req=dSQiF896lIJaWPMW1HO4zXvEAV%2FLU59n8ZgANfZm1oVkQxtqOoF%2FpzWydFDr%0AwYP3yUrESRrKcMyV4AA%3D%0A)

Then select the **Notepad** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451650263/65a889cd3befa7247f8394ea271d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8a36ea8f849a0a62472b3d36d7f9207ef616d0d9c6084cabe40f0b13efb49c2&req=dSQiF897nYNZWvMW1HO4zQVV5UxRSfG%2F2l2OIHOWA%2BFLGT4pmQDyVKqdpd%2Bl%0AJURmAJ0G20RjzEAX3vs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451650263/65a889cd3befa7247f8394ea271d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8a36ea8f849a0a62472b3d36d7f9207ef616d0d9c6084cabe40f0b13efb49c2&req=dSQiF897nYNZWvMW1HO4zQVV5UxRSfG%2F2l2OIHOWA%2BFLGT4pmQDyVKqdpd%2Bl%0AJURmAJ0G20RjzEAX3vs%3D%0A)

Paste the transcript from your Telehealth session into the Notepad. Select **Generate Note** or use the dropdown menu to choose your preferred template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451650700/15a24f9971c62c60f5b2baeb02a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=60894e691f13732a299c6127e9022b70b8d4d353150f5855ac8b6b92b1ad229a&req=dSQiF897nYZfWfMW1HO4zYrCIi9lWQYTZ7RkCQXDUs0kx2Rog8P89bHSWZPN%0Ag8Ev%2B1rDF8fsv0oRSWY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1451650700/15a24f9971c62c60f5b2baeb02a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=60894e691f13732a299c6127e9022b70b8d4d353150f5855ac8b6b92b1ad229a&req=dSQiF897nYZfWfMW1HO4zYrCIi9lWQYTZ7RkCQXDUs0kx2Rog8P89bHSWZPN%0Ag8Ev%2B1rDF8fsv0oRSWY%3D%0A)

PracSuite AI will then create a clinical note as if the consultation had occurred in person.

Addressing Invoices to Patients 'care of' a Third-Party

Addressing Invoices to Patients 'care of' a Third-Party
=======================================================

Updated over 10 months ago

Some third-party payers, in particular NDIS plan managers, may request that invoices be addressed to the patient _care of_ the payer rather than being addressed to the third-party payer directly.

PracSuite includes an option per third-party payer file to handle this.

From the Contacts menu at the top of PracSuite and select third-party payers.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1462191362/3e663ec12494c86ea122da2805d9/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+14_52_40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4449d3d4cf8a984141875f2bcfc8a42cf56b2647c527de50640309280e43e082&req=dSQhFMh3nIJZW%2FMW1HO4zXNx9ryIK2Tvt8ENyY7mtC6ZtZqlEW%2Bqg5Qt8nxT%0AL7hfnOLwVHpqURYVpi4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1462191362/3e663ec12494c86ea122da2805d9/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+14_52_40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4449d3d4cf8a984141875f2bcfc8a42cf56b2647c527de50640309280e43e082&req=dSQhFMh3nIJZW%2FMW1HO4zXNx9ryIK2Tvt8ENyY7mtC6ZtZqlEW%2Bqg5Qt8nxT%0AL7hfnOLwVHpqURYVpi4%3D%0A)

Select the payer in the list.

Go to the **Accounts** tab of the payer file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1462192607/02c5361af8870146435cd8a8ae81/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+14_54_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ff70bbfd6326be31d1a9d69dfbcc21113f383da81309f636086dfc336879f3dd&req=dSQhFMh3n4dfXvMW1HO4zYzNl3cg1Q%2FU9%2BpnBbLw2Z4AoRwckkmtGU2i3B0M%0AGEBrazPFGLC62w%2BWDR0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1462192607/02c5361af8870146435cd8a8ae81/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+14_54_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ff70bbfd6326be31d1a9d69dfbcc21113f383da81309f636086dfc336879f3dd&req=dSQhFMh3n4dfXvMW1HO4zYzNl3cg1Q%2FU9%2BpnBbLw2Z4AoRwckkmtGU2i3B0M%0AGEBrazPFGLC62w%2BWDR0%3D%0A)

Enable the **Address single-patient invoices to patient "c/o" payer** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461990492/0b31c450e864217f0e98f1cd575b/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_46_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e5c3a13cc3ccae05ed89db9057357c2a97d22b4fb82760f509f598123faf188c&req=dSQhF8B3nYVWW%2FMW1HO4zbsJUWKWWPNr4GZKie576oI0MLwowFBYGr26zibr%0A9qD5Rikk2NURkAfMA0A%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461990492/0b31c450e864217f0e98f1cd575b/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_46_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e5c3a13cc3ccae05ed89db9057357c2a97d22b4fb82760f509f598123faf188c&req=dSQhF8B3nYVWW%2FMW1HO4zbsJUWKWWPNr4GZKie576oI0MLwowFBYGr26zibr%0A9qD5Rikk2NURkAfMA0A%3D%0A)

When printing or emailing invoices for patients linked to this payer, the invoice will be addressed to the patient care of the payer, as shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461991555/b56745ac72dc6a91c89a057c678b/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_48_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e7c4393b0389c6e1d38e50e8a4baa7921fb58d4b199c3a9101a15ff44f2683a0&req=dSQhF8B3nIRaXPMW1HO4zb%2BW3K3MywvanQXZGJMrAC31q%2FM8ncz%2FQKjJjv0w%0AI99pdIGaw8M%2FdAKgwiU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461991555/b56745ac72dc6a91c89a057c678b/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_48_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e7c4393b0389c6e1d38e50e8a4baa7921fb58d4b199c3a9101a15ff44f2683a0&req=dSQhF8B3nIRaXPMW1HO4zb%2BW3K3MywvanQXZGJMrAC31q%2FM8ncz%2FQKjJjv0w%0AI99pdIGaw8M%2FdAKgwiU%3D%0A)

PracSuite allows you to create a list of standard reasons to select from when cancelling or rescheduling appointments to help maintain consistency across your team.

Managing Standard Cancellation Reasons
======================================

Go to [Settings > Appointment Book > Cancellation Reasons.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/reasons)

Under the **Cancellation Reasons** heading, select **Add** to create new options in the list.

Use the drag handle to drag and drop items to reorder the list as needed.

When cancelling appointments, your standard cancelation reasons will be available to select. Additional information can be added to the notes field.

Stripe Integration

Stripe Integration
==================

Updated over 9 months ago

Table of contents

[Enabling the Stripe Integration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11091461-stripe-integration#h_5e762de4a3)

[Processing Card Payments Via Stripe](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11091461-stripe-integration#h_4fa7d77757)

[Configuring Online Booking and Online Invoice Payments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11091461-stripe-integration#h_d7d9d119be)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548042517/59c9f12049138290d0281cb4711c/Stripe%2Bwordmark.png?expires=1771821900&signature=748b2eb37517d4659b0c5f3bb128d1b769eda50b3c9ed6602a6f6ebb6c51a6bf&req=dSUjHsl6n4ReXvMW1HO4zScPfRhvrwEJfC%2BEcc4wyckQnrk%2B5MEjM3%2BVTllM%0ACsTJ5XsiXhju%2FM7hSCE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548042517/59c9f12049138290d0281cb4711c/Stripe%2Bwordmark.png?expires=1771821900&signature=748b2eb37517d4659b0c5f3bb128d1b769eda50b3c9ed6602a6f6ebb6c51a6bf&req=dSUjHsl6n4ReXvMW1HO4zScPfRhvrwEJfC%2BEcc4wyckQnrk%2B5MEjM3%2BVTllM%0ACsTJ5XsiXhju%2FM7hSCE%3D%0A)

[Stripe](https://stripe.com/)
 is a widely used online payment platform known for its flexibility, ease of setup, and support for secure credit and debit card transactions. It’s used by businesses around the world to accept payments online quickly and reliably.

Stripe integration in PracSuite can be used to:

*   Process payment during the online booking process
    
*   Allow patients to pay their invoices online
    
*   Allow staff to process card payments and store card details without a terminal
    

[Transaction fees are applicable for transactions processed via Stripe](https://stripe.com/pricing)
 and will be passed on to you by Stripe. Note that Stripe integration is an alternative to Tyro Health Online for Australian users[, though note that Tyro offers lower transaction fees for Australian users than Stripe.](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/4964000-tyro-health-online-pricing-for-pracsuite)

To enable online payments in PracSuite, you will need to:

1.  Familiarise yourselves with the [transaction fees for Stripe](https://stripe.com/pricing)
    
2.  Create a [Stripe](https://stripe.com/)
     account
    
3.  Configure Stripe integration in PracSuite following the guide below
    

Enabling the Stripe Integration
===============================

Go to [Settings > Integrations > Stripe](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/stripe)
.

Enable the integration and select **Add** to begin connecting PracSuite with a new Stripe account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548043347/e71bb8aaaab4b6297e2e1c75c994/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+15_56_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d5d96ca31ada90df16b5f5649e4e80724be324fad654860853b7711ae8eb595f&req=dSUjHsl6noJbXvMW1HO4zSIFIlXzWDGZST3VsyaMSh%2FB9unV4olmExtgaz%2FG%0AB1gFiilWqcKmuasFoHg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548043347/e71bb8aaaab4b6297e2e1c75c994/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+15_56_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d5d96ca31ada90df16b5f5649e4e80724be324fad654860853b7711ae8eb595f&req=dSUjHsl6noJbXvMW1HO4zSIFIlXzWDGZST3VsyaMSh%2FB9unV4olmExtgaz%2FG%0AB1gFiilWqcKmuasFoHg%3D%0A)

Select **Continue** to proceed to Stripe.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548043598/0fc369d010267b4ea5217318c6f9/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+15_57_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=76ef35d28a56781161eeb45644314350fc3438c0bfbb2ce377d7e0da6e9a3755&req=dSUjHsl6noRWUfMW1HO4zQgkCxQJvi%2FuzYzIbN7RNNvvvmM8bA5rbDwQs7Nr%0AHWGmQgK%2FW9NTYLCixto%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548043598/0fc369d010267b4ea5217318c6f9/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+15_57_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=76ef35d28a56781161eeb45644314350fc3438c0bfbb2ce377d7e0da6e9a3755&req=dSUjHsl6noRWUfMW1HO4zQgkCxQJvi%2FuzYzIbN7RNNvvvmM8bA5rbDwQs7Nr%0AHWGmQgK%2FW9NTYLCixto%3D%0A)

You'll be directed to Stripe to log in with your existing Stripe account. If you don't have a Stripe account, you can also sign up here.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548044580/09333b5357a84c4a12e79e4cd2cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1b08e4ad4fb6ac72e14133bfcf8f31a0a595ca177a824bec0a3f3165103f576&req=dSUjHsl6mYRXWfMW1HO4zYqoA%2FYMHNoqGHsfqWxXhzUoxKl7BctBxBtM8Lcq%0A%2B7zNPTBGIqyH2tCMyTc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548044580/09333b5357a84c4a12e79e4cd2cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1b08e4ad4fb6ac72e14133bfcf8f31a0a595ca177a824bec0a3f3165103f576&req=dSUjHsl6mYRXWfMW1HO4zYqoA%2FYMHNoqGHsfqWxXhzUoxKl7BctBxBtM8Lcq%0A%2B7zNPTBGIqyH2tCMyTc%3D%0A)

Follow the prompts on the Stripe website to complete the process.

Once you have successfully connected Stripe, you will be returned to PracSuite to complete the rest of the process.

You will need to select which business this Stripe account should be used for.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548058045/f848d2966aef6518a9ec56d46af2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=043169491ce2ed5887d3fd298f4bd822ebadaaf3ff1f26daeb09b3148073365b&req=dSUjHsl7lYFbXPMW1HO4zUBLzizc%2BphnxxpklAicjwwVlSTCNwag1x61NoZb%0ACWZXD58gaiBPxWSZ8XU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548058045/f848d2966aef6518a9ec56d46af2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=043169491ce2ed5887d3fd298f4bd822ebadaaf3ff1f26daeb09b3148073365b&req=dSUjHsl7lYFbXPMW1HO4zUBLzizc%2BphnxxpklAicjwwVlSTCNwag1x61NoZb%0ACWZXD58gaiBPxWSZ8XU%3D%0A)

If you have multiple Stripe accounts to connect with PracSuite, you can repeat the steps above.

In PracSuite accounts where both Tyro Health Online and Stripe are connected, you can confirm which integration is being used for online payments in Settings > Businesses and scroll to the Invoice Payment options section shown below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548058428/3aa74225aaa80f3f6dcc0bc2e431/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_12_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1e097ec1dc6fd43dad80730f6445c98b6ff310535a5b5234bb9e9cb80f99a0d7&req=dSUjHsl7lYVdUfMW1HO4zQ8YAQjNi2R90n6nHv5FROZJ1kKt1PMU3Ii%2Bns3M%0A9gSyhkEr%2FjLwPQtuIRE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548058428/3aa74225aaa80f3f6dcc0bc2e431/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_12_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1e097ec1dc6fd43dad80730f6445c98b6ff310535a5b5234bb9e9cb80f99a0d7&req=dSUjHsl7lYVdUfMW1HO4zQ8YAQjNi2R90n6nHv5FROZJ1kKt1PMU3Ii%2Bns3M%0A9gSyhkEr%2FjLwPQtuIRE%3D%0A)

This completes the process of connecting PracSuite with Stripe.

Processing Card Payments Via Stripe
===================================

Once Stripe has been connected with PracSuite, you will be able to process a payment via Stripe from the invoice screen.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548051979/8ee1b305af41b6ac7c2611eb8d53/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_05_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=857aab4f5ad1df195e3c42e719082500208b37d142a80914ac9e97592e15ff95&req=dSUjHsl7nIhYUPMW1HO4zUY9GcaOtAuzidRVO%2BtNwK8o%2FkNn268%2Fi%2BblD9uQ%0ASou6ohVHLkZV57HPlYU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548051979/8ee1b305af41b6ac7c2611eb8d53/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_05_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=857aab4f5ad1df195e3c42e719082500208b37d142a80914ac9e97592e15ff95&req=dSUjHsl7nIhYUPMW1HO4zUY9GcaOtAuzidRVO%2BtNwK8o%2FkNn268%2Fi%2BblD9uQ%0ASou6ohVHLkZV57HPlYU%3D%0A)

Type in an amount to the Stripe payment field or select the quick pay icon to pay the invoice balance via Stripe.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548053192/cbe0fe52d1c4dfb558c2e2128625/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7dc8aca965ebbcc1d833edc143b8b705d55c8d25fe447c86d5871510cb65e929&req=dSUjHsl7noBWW%2FMW1HO4zaGnNRkPf7d%2BEc0uCEvEamz6eWr4T%2FK1ObH6EtIM%0A4v9lJ8A8t2%2B9PITbrPc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548053192/cbe0fe52d1c4dfb558c2e2128625/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7dc8aca965ebbcc1d833edc143b8b705d55c8d25fe447c86d5871510cb65e929&req=dSUjHsl7noBWW%2FMW1HO4zaGnNRkPf7d%2BEc0uCEvEamz6eWr4T%2FK1ObH6EtIM%0A4v9lJ8A8t2%2B9PITbrPc%3D%0A)

If a patient does not have any payment methods saved in Stripe, you will need to enter these details.

Select **Securely save card details via Stripe** if you wish to save this card for future use.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548054009/18fbfeb0b6c6162112425b6de89a/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_07_50.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d1013205a7d69a821f95f6e155ded1de0d46114bd8bb3915b2f4bcb4d32af64&req=dSUjHsl7mYFfUPMW1HO4zQtzwpP21RLJcgbm3XnRTD6ykdRRgefc6Rj2KN6J%0AAIy5sptyvlSGzlbH%2FOU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548054009/18fbfeb0b6c6162112425b6de89a/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_07_50.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d1013205a7d69a821f95f6e155ded1de0d46114bd8bb3915b2f4bcb4d32af64&req=dSUjHsl7mYFfUPMW1HO4zQtzwpP21RLJcgbm3XnRTD6ykdRRgefc6Rj2KN6J%0AAIy5sptyvlSGzlbH%2FOU%3D%0A)

If a patient's card has been saved, it will appear in the Stripe payment pop-up. You can choose to process the payment with the existing saved card or to pay with a new card.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548054611/0be4054a8b418a6dd9c1192be1e4/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_08_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9bcf3cd8b661eb03f5e911e27442e145acc6246b11c1d08dbaef8f59c583c237&req=dSUjHsl7mYdeWPMW1HO4zaTiAbIXbEcJRVxd5z1poPeAt%2Bh3dhyX7jJaXaHm%0AXaMj%2F8QuzePz3akwL8M%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548054611/0be4054a8b418a6dd9c1192be1e4/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_08_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9bcf3cd8b661eb03f5e911e27442e145acc6246b11c1d08dbaef8f59c583c237&req=dSUjHsl7mYdeWPMW1HO4zaTiAbIXbEcJRVxd5z1poPeAt%2Bh3dhyX7jJaXaHm%0AXaMj%2F8QuzePz3akwL8M%3D%0A)

The Stripe payment reference will be displayed on successful payment. You can click the reference to via the payment in Stripe.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548054876/e5dbb2f27300b9c50b5722b919f8/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_08_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a2542d5238834da66151286664b07e9162a17616153d5ea8aa091b9cce17a8eb&req=dSUjHsl7mYlYX%2FMW1HO4zdS%2FWrtcfFNvjfHKuavWwSgNwIlnwX%2Bd5udt0NiU%0AeX5thHkq6Dntf0MUfpQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548054876/e5dbb2f27300b9c50b5722b919f8/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_08_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a2542d5238834da66151286664b07e9162a17616153d5ea8aa091b9cce17a8eb&req=dSUjHsl7mYlYX%2FMW1HO4zdS%2FWrtcfFNvjfHKuavWwSgNwIlnwX%2Bd5udt0NiU%0AeX5thHkq6Dntf0MUfpQ%3D%0A)

Stripe payment references can also be found in the info tooltip on the **Payments tab** of patient and payer files.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548055467/c5f934a6d95ea100e6d16d6f5518/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_09_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9519d1ea17bd625301e909cf55eac4444e1e6418492944725ca674eea33368f6&req=dSUjHsl7mIVZXvMW1HO4zRFudITd0srWyhSgZXYQSObX6SXoXIEVAjQaloJl%0AsbefICFESCs2pkVcIW8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548055467/c5f934a6d95ea100e6d16d6f5518/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_09_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9519d1ea17bd625301e909cf55eac4444e1e6418492944725ca674eea33368f6&req=dSUjHsl7mIVZXvMW1HO4zRFudITd0srWyhSgZXYQSObX6SXoXIEVAjQaloJl%0AsbefICFESCs2pkVcIW8%3D%0A)

Appointment Book Keyboard Shortcuts

Appointment Book Keyboard Shortcuts
===================================

Updated over 9 months ago

There are a number of keyboard shortcuts that can be used to speed up common appointment book functions.

The following shortcuts are usable while viewing the Appointment Book.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Function** | **Shortcut** |
| Show Shortcuts | ? or Shift + / |
| Day View | d   |
| Week View | w   |
| Hide Names | Shift + h |
| Today/This Week\* | t   |
| Find Times | f   |
| Back 1 Day/Week\* | Left Arrow |
| Forward 1 Day/Week\* | Right Arrow |
| Jump Ahead 1-9 Weeks | 1-9 |

\*These shortcuts will behave differently in Day and Week view.

**Hover your mouse cursor** **over an appointment** to use the following shortcuts:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Function** | **Shortcut** |
| Open Appointment Details | e   |
| Invoice Appointment | i   |
| Set Arrived Status | a   |
| Set Missed/DNA Status | m   |
| Open Patient's File | o   |
| Reschedule Appointment | r   |
| Make Next Appointment | n   |
| Delete (Cancel) Appointment | Delete or Backspace |

Creating an N/A Roster

Creating an N/A Roster
======================

Updated over 6 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11153434-creating-an-n-a-roster#h_5ad216aa79)

Overview
========

Rosters are used to set the available hours of a Practitioner. If no Roster is assigned to a Practitioner, they will inherit the open hours of the Business.  
​

This article goes over the process of creating a roster that makes a Practitioner **Not Available** for bookings. This is useful for preventing bookings with a Practitioner before their proper roster starts or after they have finished working at the Practice.

#### **Step 1:**

Navigate to the Settings > Practitioners > Rosters page

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1501118689/b4a8745fe1a371a34ba24f7c4f46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eb5e8fe70e1f868de530069795ab84f7ffe28dad65feda537f154e62b05937a8&req=dSUnF8h%2FlYdXUPMW1HO4zUNouEE35v%2Fge0bW8jNGf4MnYxkhX4nzXUecB0FF%0Axy2vvYJ7mLb0iPso%2FZc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1501118689/b4a8745fe1a371a34ba24f7c4f46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eb5e8fe70e1f868de530069795ab84f7ffe28dad65feda537f154e62b05937a8&req=dSUnF8h%2FlYdXUPMW1HO4zUNouEE35v%2Fge0bW8jNGf4MnYxkhX4nzXUecB0FF%0Axy2vvYJ7mLb0iPso%2FZc%3D%0A)

#### **Step 2:**

Click **Add** at the top of the page to create a new Roster.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1501117686/431dc65232b6d2dc94bd86f90f65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ad2f8430d7b45e7668c682ddaaa8b83b8cc2c125d4c2f83f7b03e527784ba1e&req=dSUnF8h%2FmodXX%2FMW1HO4zdLBR5c27Z2jEQEJU%2BhIeF%2BAyPhpkZIxe4TAxrN1%0A3bT06LRClercNLPm2I8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1501117686/431dc65232b6d2dc94bd86f90f65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ad2f8430d7b45e7668c682ddaaa8b83b8cc2c125d4c2f83f7b03e527784ba1e&req=dSUnF8h%2FmodXX%2FMW1HO4zdLBR5c27Z2jEQEJU%2BhIeF%2BAyPhpkZIxe4TAxrN1%0A3bT06LRClercNLPm2I8%3D%0A)

#### **Step 3:**

Enter N/A into the Description field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502664403/61424b618321523518281fc652b3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bdeec910d479c28aa6b75b74037040dd6dd6c87abba979a5b4475375c6435136&req=dSUnFM94mYVfWvMW1HO4zdrqWsLlMjOJeKOHNKe%2Bl52wQpanrcg0s9gkoRUp%0ASjSHnuShrYtm9ULnolk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502664403/61424b618321523518281fc652b3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bdeec910d479c28aa6b75b74037040dd6dd6c87abba979a5b4475375c6435136&req=dSUnFM94mYVfWvMW1HO4zdrqWsLlMjOJeKOHNKe%2Bl52wQpanrcg0s9gkoRUp%0ASjSHnuShrYtm9ULnolk%3D%0A)

#### **Step 4:**

Uncheck the boxes for all of the days.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1501063232/b0449ea2f0eb2a3c071cf4ce3fd1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32aee79065ea2ce1380e99e626630080fde1a6cbf3642095b25ed205d45c342d&req=dSUnF8l4noNcW%2FMW1HO4zQ0qEy3YZ6aVXyPTEV3kLTvsrQZY2V%2FWZAiVIFH7%0ACO1j%2FGvryz9ZaIVrjT4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1501063232/b0449ea2f0eb2a3c071cf4ce3fd1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32aee79065ea2ce1380e99e626630080fde1a6cbf3642095b25ed205d45c342d&req=dSUnF8l4noNcW%2FMW1HO4zQ0qEy3YZ6aVXyPTEV3kLTvsrQZY2V%2FWZAiVIFH7%0ACO1j%2FGvryz9ZaIVrjT4%3D%0A)

#### **Step 5:**

Click Save

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502665567/126cdf2f73b49d83c059e748a3d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5d9f1fb5570980d4138d50018e4f83c8ffd4f94bec691ee6e051cdbb67dc43a5&req=dSUnFM94mIRZXvMW1HO4zSHUGvEtHEFrxOk3CtocvUE2hOEp6zYa3CJjvNbj%0Af5xtmceEkR9brD3t9hQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502665567/126cdf2f73b49d83c059e748a3d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5d9f1fb5570980d4138d50018e4f83c8ffd4f94bec691ee6e051cdbb67dc43a5&req=dSUnFM94mIRZXvMW1HO4zSHUGvEtHEFrxOk3CtocvUE2hOEp6zYa3CJjvNbj%0Af5xtmceEkR9brD3t9hQ%3D%0A)

Once the roster has been saved it will need to be assigned to a Practitioner by following this article: [Assigning a Roster to a Practitioner](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183072-assigning-a-roster-to-a-practitioner)

### Default Roster for New Practitioners

This roster can be assigned to new practitioners automatically by selecting it as the Default on the Settings > Practitioners > Rosters page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1659835614/d28146350086e987700f285d8b26/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4dee52903c9b47200008ff282c4dd698484d706e5bea718a1e02b151b1da255&req=dSYiH8F9mIdeXfMW1HO4zRU2BEdUIxwm8lE4zsD1KCSCN%2BS3EsMwKOA3ocFH%0AXR8KHJ1Uecn7CE%2FLWRI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1659835614/d28146350086e987700f285d8b26/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4dee52903c9b47200008ff282c4dd698484d706e5bea718a1e02b151b1da255&req=dSYiH8F9mIdeXfMW1HO4zRU2BEdUIxwm8lE4zsD1KCSCN%2BS3EsMwKOA3ocFH%0AXR8KHJ1Uecn7CE%2FLWRI%3D%0A)
