Sending Appointment Reminders Early for Public Holidays

Sending Appointment Reminders Early for Public Holidays
=======================================================

Updated over 4 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11154055-sending-appointment-reminders-early-for-public-holidays#h_95839a8015)

[1) Enabling Hold App. Reminders](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11154055-sending-appointment-reminders-early-for-public-holidays#h_77a0972f7c)

[2) Copy an Existing Reminder](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11154055-sending-appointment-reminders-early-for-public-holidays#h_b6075d0044)

[3) Configuring the Reminder](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11154055-sending-appointment-reminders-early-for-public-holidays#h_4f41fcd647)

[4) Disabling the Reminder](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11154055-sending-appointment-reminders-early-for-public-holidays#h_da153283e4)

Overview
========

This article goes over the process of sending Reminders early. This is useful in instances such as Public Holidays.

1) Enabling Hold App. Reminders
-------------------------------

Before setting up a new Reminder it is strongly advised to enable the **Hold App. Reminders** option for the Reminder Sent status. This will prevent multiple/duplicate reminders from being sent for a single appointment.

After the Public Holiday has passed, you can re-enable this setting if needed.

#### **Step 1**:

Navigate to the **[Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Book](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook)
** page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502940672/43f399d91d90aa0d4d453341cab8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=048d083cf47a63f1d51bb616a498d3019914f03516de22e7110524724d071640&req=dSUnFMB6nYdYW%2FMW1HO4zemGE4xnZlyId6SoNZGhHhPGCjr%2BQM9xOeD9gShD%0AHyRju9BJYu4JV2UOGCQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502940672/43f399d91d90aa0d4d453341cab8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=048d083cf47a63f1d51bb616a498d3019914f03516de22e7110524724d071640&req=dSUnFMB6nYdYW%2FMW1HO4zemGE4xnZlyId6SoNZGhHhPGCjr%2BQM9xOeD9gShD%0AHyRju9BJYu4JV2UOGCQ%3D%0A)

#### **Step 2:**

Scroll down to the **Appointment Statuses** section and enable the **Hold App. Reminders** option for the **Reminder Sent** status.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498862857/4f9ba522743288b2feac6462a17a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a66fa23fd7a49f4dd8edd9b2673c292b783c815e834bcba30e6916ae2151bb24&req=dSQuHsF4n4laXvMW1HO4zSODWw9lonBM90h7DhhAavwnF0ato1Fsh96b4bSd%0AzEM%2Bgq4r%2BTaDt4Olk%2BY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498862857/4f9ba522743288b2feac6462a17a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a66fa23fd7a49f4dd8edd9b2673c292b783c815e834bcba30e6916ae2151bb24&req=dSQuHsF4n4laXvMW1HO4zSODWw9lonBM90h7DhhAavwnF0ato1Fsh96b4bSd%0AzEM%2Bgq4r%2BTaDt4Olk%2BY%3D%0A)

**2) Copy an Existing Reminder**
--------------------------------

The next thing to do is to create a copy of your existing appointment reminders and configure them to go out earlier than normal.

#### **Step 1**:

Navigate to the **[Settings > Appointment Book > Reminders](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/reminders)
** page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502961185/5ac2881cbbbf2dc2d7ad9272fbd1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61db97bbb8d946464acfb5f9388f92f7eb09615958f8c1ebd607c3ea60f6b74e&req=dSUnFMB4nIBXXPMW1HO4zaMyA2kDY%2FUiGqo0BXx5LandHd7478lHGXt6qi8X%0AEaBJjqq1D2lSm7KkOiM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502961185/5ac2881cbbbf2dc2d7ad9272fbd1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61db97bbb8d946464acfb5f9388f92f7eb09615958f8c1ebd607c3ea60f6b74e&req=dSUnFMB4nIBXXPMW1HO4zaMyA2kDY%2FUiGqo0BXx5LandHd7478lHGXt6qi8X%0AEaBJjqq1D2lSm7KkOiM%3D%0A)

#### **Step 2:**

Select the reminder that you would like to send early by clicking on it's name.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498875688/ab2ac676db144bb1a8f0d442fbef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=492383e3890aec414b6a3e160aace48045aada9551931dee0964ee312f5deff7&req=dSQuHsF5mIdXUfMW1HO4zQXZtebubfCZy9aZMLmxUo140eLQ1e%2FY9foT2KYq%0AbzsDMTZ3y8x5ckmACl4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498875688/ab2ac676db144bb1a8f0d442fbef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=492383e3890aec414b6a3e160aace48045aada9551931dee0964ee312f5deff7&req=dSQuHsF5mIdXUfMW1HO4zQXZtebubfCZy9aZMLmxUo140eLQ1e%2FY9foT2KYq%0AbzsDMTZ3y8x5ckmACl4%3D%0A)

#### **Step 3:**

Click on the Cog icon at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498899643/bb971915564d2095f318e4eba2a5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a524b9bdb9f7fb0be914e7ebe7e28a7f5c2728f4b1907766b7a4f23acb0c6fe&req=dSQuHsF3lIdbWvMW1HO4zSuX%2FMiMDye8YzKNWleq1CtndLbfhGpHj5%2B7F%2Fei%0Aae03Fcl3BNaQOkPPUkQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498899643/bb971915564d2095f318e4eba2a5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a524b9bdb9f7fb0be914e7ebe7e28a7f5c2728f4b1907766b7a4f23acb0c6fe&req=dSQuHsF3lIdbWvMW1HO4zSuX%2FMiMDye8YzKNWleq1CtndLbfhGpHj5%2B7F%2Fei%0Aae03Fcl3BNaQOkPPUkQ%3D%0A)

#### **Step 4:**

Click **Copy Appointment Reminder**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498891767/811e6fe23538f882f29d15e50b93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6e53d94f61375f200506540d18fa581fe80c5ee3c57603ee51ff93cb1087a2a8&req=dSQuHsF3nIZZXvMW1HO4zbqyL%2B0UcyHm1LIh8gMkJgPiLqAEYrHXBXs7gg5w%0AgFQL%2F6TGqY5BOBIMueE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1498891767/811e6fe23538f882f29d15e50b93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6e53d94f61375f200506540d18fa581fe80c5ee3c57603ee51ff93cb1087a2a8&req=dSQuHsF3nIZZXvMW1HO4zbqyL%2B0UcyHm1LIh8gMkJgPiLqAEYrHXBXs7gg5w%0AgFQL%2F6TGqY5BOBIMueE%3D%0A)

**3) Configuring the Reminder**
-------------------------------

Now that we have a copy of your existing reminder, it needs to be configured to go out early.

#### **Step 1:**

Enter a name for this Reminder.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502988547/8ec8c5b76bb0d2a2602ba490b43f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=00f67542ddba7d2b22675b3b42fe4efb3d5f9c0b191882bd6d1d186b3f5a1a5e&req=dSUnFMB2lYRbXvMW1HO4zUZHv4E7NokgLrpRnstAWex4PB1FqTD9gYIJjAYg%0A2MJQVr3uiJrXe4%2BCs28%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502988547/8ec8c5b76bb0d2a2602ba490b43f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=00f67542ddba7d2b22675b3b42fe4efb3d5f9c0b191882bd6d1d186b3f5a1a5e&req=dSUnFMB2lYRbXvMW1HO4zUZHv4E7NokgLrpRnstAWex4PB1FqTD9gYIJjAYg%0A2MJQVr3uiJrXe4%2BCs28%3D%0A)

#### **Step 2:**

If enabled, disable the **Do not send reminders on** setting.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502989076/0e6e8c87a7e6beb5b67bfbda94d0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61ae463649c7f3eff1973cba2a233ce3634c40911a239ce2db12a53cf21dd8fe&req=dSUnFMB2lIFYX%2FMW1HO4zfyIeGGqQh7j5jXILTnavrvBLqFglbyNFpPWh0Uy%0AZeqfprKwWerhnWtk79I%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502989076/0e6e8c87a7e6beb5b67bfbda94d0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61ae463649c7f3eff1973cba2a233ce3634c40911a239ce2db12a53cf21dd8fe&req=dSUnFMB2lIFYX%2FMW1HO4zfyIeGGqQh7j5jXILTnavrvBLqFglbyNFpPWh0Uy%0AZeqfprKwWerhnWtk79I%3D%0A)

#### **Step 3**:

Set the **Send Reminders** setting to the number of days before the appointment these Reminders should be sent and the time at which to send them.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502991210/6c8e8bf5db51228d99ac679db844/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2829f1c77009116c99699981da237c38d3e1663e2e5ec32a275fac618541d3ff&req=dSUnFMB3nINeWfMW1HO4zT3OJSybCebn2OoYeoamMfopo40PlVPAjpqXqEGF%0AE%2BuBrsFL2uTGdTfiXmU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502991210/6c8e8bf5db51228d99ac679db844/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2829f1c77009116c99699981da237c38d3e1663e2e5ec32a275fac618541d3ff&req=dSUnFMB3nINeWfMW1HO4zT3OJSybCebn2OoYeoamMfopo40PlVPAjpqXqEGF%0AE%2BuBrsFL2uTGdTfiXmU%3D%0A)

#### **Step 4:**

Click Save.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502998014/515a0c0461da75f7fc13d3b823e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eeb6e2baee3641909a38b59ee82e11f0be13591d05409f19fea0279d8c20f7ad&req=dSUnFMB3lYFeXfMW1HO4zexMomVTIpQVyVMVQC7X8R4CQiHLEDewpUYiytJm%0A%2Bmnjfay4802JLEu3XN4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502998014/515a0c0461da75f7fc13d3b823e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eeb6e2baee3641909a38b59ee82e11f0be13591d05409f19fea0279d8c20f7ad&req=dSUnFMB3lYFeXfMW1HO4zexMomVTIpQVyVMVQC7X8R4CQiHLEDewpUYiytJm%0A%2Bmnjfay4802JLEu3XN4%3D%0A)

**4) Disabling the Reminder**
-----------------------------

The next step depends on whether the reminders are to be sent today or for a future date.

**If the reminders are to be sent today**:

Wait until the reminders have been sent then Mark the Reminder as Inactive. Do this by selecting the Reminder and clicking on the Cog icon at the top of the page, then selecting Mark Appointment Reminder as Inactive.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502999885/72d73a81e129f5f8a8bbea9b302a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0373349ac4a70e8d304240e93affc6dbf490acca708e668cbc2d7c09fce78458&req=dSUnFMB3lIlXXPMW1HO4zeO4zO0R155DofALKPjSPqhWtQ4sSX2OWaS3by9p%0AKNto494tx29p4aU9w00%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502999885/72d73a81e129f5f8a8bbea9b302a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0373349ac4a70e8d304240e93affc6dbf490acca708e668cbc2d7c09fce78458&req=dSUnFMB3lIlXXPMW1HO4zeO4zO0R155DofALKPjSPqhWtQ4sSX2OWaS3by9p%0AKNto494tx29p4aU9w00%3D%0A)

  
​

**If the reminders are to be sent in the future**:

Mark the Reminder as Inactive by selecting the Reminder and clicking on the Cog icon at the top of the page, then selecting Mark the Reminder as Inactive (See image above).

Follow the same process to Mark the Reminder as Active on the day that you want the Reminders to be sent. Once they have been sent, Mark the Reminder as Inactive again.

This Reminder can be re-used each time there is a public holiday by following these steps as needed.

Appointment Book Names Show as 'Private'

Appointment Book Names Show as 'Private'
========================================

If patient names on your appointment book appear as private, the 'Hide Names' privacy feature is active.

Updated over 4 months ago

If patient names on your appointment book appear as _private_, the 'Hide Names' privacy feature is active.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502671827/3fac048d6a43f85ae29f7aae17da/CleanShot%2B2025-05-01%2Bat%2B09_40_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d08a8527def247f56b74c3901c0fd3bc81bf5291467b2a2144bb8e435931e192&req=dSUnFM95nIldXvMW1HO4zU1TojQbzSZWMWB6g%2B4TtsQR7PDafGs8SvcyueUq%0AIz0F6KpLAkJowgLZP6k%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502671827/3fac048d6a43f85ae29f7aae17da/CleanShot%2B2025-05-01%2Bat%2B09_40_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d08a8527def247f56b74c3901c0fd3bc81bf5291467b2a2144bb8e435931e192&req=dSUnFM95nIldXvMW1HO4zU1TojQbzSZWMWB6g%2B4TtsQR7PDafGs8SvcyueUq%0AIz0F6KpLAkJowgLZP6k%3D%0A)

You can toggle the hide names privacy feature using the 'h' key while holding down the 'shift' key on your keyboard. A full list of [appointment book keyboard shortcuts can be found here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11118057-appointment-book-keyboard-shortcuts)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1774623824/2a55ab5192b361e478d27fda4ed6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=564db4887469e0a4a7843ec8359324cf048f2a5f9d52aee348ae9fb8bb5c8471&req=dScgEs98noldXfMW1HO4zc08Cjth6CSxAj1qCV9jfptsFby0uGaUKwYSVc04%0A3%2FTUPIl%2B8xDlZ3fKCEE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1774623824/2a55ab5192b361e478d27fda4ed6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=564db4887469e0a4a7843ec8359324cf048f2a5f9d52aee348ae9fb8bb5c8471&req=dScgEs98noldXfMW1HO4zc08Cjth6CSxAj1qCV9jfptsFby0uGaUKwYSVc04%0A3%2FTUPIl%2B8xDlZ3fKCEE%3D%0A)

You can also go to the settings icon in the bottom left of the appointment book and manually toggle the hide names feature as shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502671329/df993ffc6cac82aefb00a7c33f8d/CleanShot+2025-05-01+at+09_41_29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=daf50b7eef72c300c8eef1c2791150b7a8930f6ca154e9c3ba861a3a96c83c39&req=dSUnFM95nIJdUPMW1HO4zW3WKdE8JKbJyYORxdj7eaSaXMPDKXGHaqzQ8lRi%0AEfgrj%2FV%2BPH7QRau14nI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1502671329/df993ffc6cac82aefb00a7c33f8d/CleanShot+2025-05-01+at+09_41_29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=daf50b7eef72c300c8eef1c2791150b7a8930f6ca154e9c3ba861a3a96c83c39&req=dSUnFM95nIJdUPMW1HO4zW3WKdE8JKbJyYORxdj7eaSaXMPDKXGHaqzQ8lRi%0AEfgrj%2FV%2BPH7QRau14nI%3D%0A)

Email & SMS Statuses

Email & SMS Statuses
====================

Updated over 5 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11196175-email-sms-statuses#h_f2dd6d3906)

Overview
========

When sending emails and SMS from PracSuite, there are four possible statuses that can be assigned to the message.

### Scheduled - ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1540893704/fe6279734845634a5199f021022b/image.png?expires=1771902000&signature=9f789fa3217b2a79e5eeb16810daedcee7750a93d5d13cebd21d5d3809ceb991&req=dSUjFsF3noZfXfMW3Hu4gSMP517uoLPAotgDvYDJ%2BA4ia07XsKwGsBI%2Btn8%2B%0AAw%3D%3D%0A)

The message has been scheduled to send at a future date/time. These messages can be found on the [Tools > Email > Scheduled Emails](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/email)
 and [Tools > SMS > Scheduled SMS](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/scheduledsms)
 pages or on the Messages tab of the recipient.

### Sent - ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1540894239/c2f1b1d7d9988045e85846ffb474/image.png?expires=1771902000&signature=773517357c3c139470cea4169a17a03294220895b850d0eab5c6348fd9f27ff5&req=dSUjFsF3mYNcUPMW3Hu4gW2ut4QFQQmOekm2JN%2FHBrQez0kAvPRbgt%2BndzR6%0Arg%3D%3D%0A)

The message has been successfully sent from PracSuite but a delivery receipt has yet to be received.

### Delivered - ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1722065473/3b02b2134b1f40f5b7a4a1ffeb02/image.png?expires=1771902000&signature=60b3788707bb6319db0a09fcabbade8f061f53eefaf7a635f413b4bead2a89f6&req=dSclFMl4mIVYWvMW3Hu4gaiT2%2FZyoijscEUl3JNEvItXjMXFl%2FFuvE64ITYN%0AKw%3D%3D%0A)

The message has been successfully delivered to the recipient. This status is only assigned once a delivery receipt has been received from the recipient.

### Failed - ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652193561/bf37fcedae910ce9feb475d5cf51/image.png?expires=1771902000&signature=8827fd5b8448f8a69765984edf9cb090ae30410241da089ccb180b62136ca85a&req=dSYiFMh3noRZWPMW3Hu4gZ%2BURfl%2BaSd%2FrnvVJA7N0YOKDkfp1H4KIbMnje3C%0AZg%3D%3D%0A)

The message has failed to be sent to the recipient. Please reach out to PracSuite Support for assistance.

How to Download Files

How to Download Files
=====================

Updated over 6 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11202275-how-to-download-files#h_8d49bf7a2b)

**Overview**
============

Any files that have been created or uploaded to PracSuite can be downloaded again either individually or in bulk.

#### **Step 1:**

Navigate to the Files tab of a Patient, Third Party Payer or to your [My Files](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/myfiles)
 page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1552802451/92ae637e489aac14b10e1c717f43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6553b9c68eb27dd29210cf2d0f63df9a3a46d04df9654d0267ba154e0bb02e45&req=dSUiFMF%2Bn4VaWPMW1HO4zV1ybxssX93h1RyJvaYsjVfNi2MPvpBkJnTqOLVZ%0AxtfRMxjmhMnU8INj3Fg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1552802451/92ae637e489aac14b10e1c717f43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6553b9c68eb27dd29210cf2d0f63df9a3a46d04df9654d0267ba154e0bb02e45&req=dSUiFMF%2Bn4VaWPMW1HO4zV1ybxssX93h1RyJvaYsjVfNi2MPvpBkJnTqOLVZ%0AxtfRMxjmhMnU8INj3Fg%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1556649006/3ff620f497702cb4388967a86604/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4da932a88abfcafe66dfffa4d4c3740aeb698db8f495f6d0c03a4ebf796d28ca&req=dSUiEM96lIFfX%2FMW1HO4zfhLwdaTXxjCZg2dLG3rNoskQwd1fj5wbSKIwMFy%0AD0xsNcYaSPka1Pnuh6s%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1556649006/3ff620f497702cb4388967a86604/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4da932a88abfcafe66dfffa4d4c3740aeb698db8f495f6d0c03a4ebf796d28ca&req=dSUiEM96lIFfX%2FMW1HO4zfhLwdaTXxjCZg2dLG3rNoskQwd1fj5wbSKIwMFy%0AD0xsNcYaSPka1Pnuh6s%3D%0A)

#### **Step 2:**

Select the files that you want to download by checking the box. You can select all files by checking the box at the top of the list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1552804094/a1ca54b724b610ca4b7b4af7f405/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=741df148d98893ab7f7bb06e31525f17f3b37994fa21789b54d633fb4d3a96fa&req=dSUiFMF%2BmYFWXfMW1HO4zQeDxLJY6ilnXd1jP0NlulJ7pXFc3nBJ4rhwq4cA%0A9pZRHzFRAjliisclHX8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1552804094/a1ca54b724b610ca4b7b4af7f405/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=741df148d98893ab7f7bb06e31525f17f3b37994fa21789b54d633fb4d3a96fa&req=dSUiFMF%2BmYFWXfMW1HO4zQeDxLJY6ilnXd1jP0NlulJ7pXFc3nBJ4rhwq4cA%0A9pZRHzFRAjliisclHX8%3D%0A)

#### **Step 3:**

Click on the Download button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1556634473/4cccfe658e7f287cc33ff989d2c3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e677203eecc14028475912afc3ccd8c03ca0d7f3dc4ec4ea8aa317245e55e5f9&req=dSUiEM99mYVYWvMW1HO4zZDXJ0tcmur%2Buv6sjflli22IACUIYeuFz9pVcuu3%0Ahl3%2Fq69OxVHV5%2F6uAF0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1556634473/4cccfe658e7f287cc33ff989d2c3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e677203eecc14028475912afc3ccd8c03ca0d7f3dc4ec4ea8aa317245e55e5f9&req=dSUiEM99mYVYWvMW1HO4zZDXJ0tcmur%2Buv6sjflli22IACUIYeuFz9pVcuu3%0Ahl3%2Fq69OxVHV5%2F6uAF0%3D%0A)

The selected files should now download and can be viewed by clicking on the Download arrow in the top right corner of your browser.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1556644756/df4c2ef0c4bd0d11986606cbae11/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=604819174767559c3e6d85f85ccd99f07ae3e3deb3b69b56d9cade9454310418&req=dSUiEM96mYZaX%2FMW1HO4zRw6g14O0bFnOsPbJF5vcO%2B9%2F34GZHZtwTp6S0J2%0AIHT5igB8pdYgPBRCr5Y%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1556644756/df4c2ef0c4bd0d11986606cbae11/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=604819174767559c3e6d85f85ccd99f07ae3e3deb3b69b56d9cade9454310418&req=dSUiEM96mYZaX%2FMW1HO4zRw6g14O0bFnOsPbJF5vcO%2B9%2F34GZHZtwTp6S0J2%0AIHT5igB8pdYgPBRCr5Y%3D%0A)

Note: Your browser may prevent you from downloading multiple files at once. You can resolve this by following the steps in this [Article](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5837954-browser-pop-ups-are-not-appearing-e-g-print-dialogs-and-tyro-health-online-claiming)
.

Adding Notes to the Appointment Book

Adding Notes to the Appointment Book
====================================

Updated over 9 months ago

Table of contents

[Quick Notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11203185-adding-notes-to-the-appointment-book#h_d149ba3ad3)

[Adding a single note](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11203185-adding-notes-to-the-appointment-book#h_ffc3f0b26e)

[Adding a recurring schedule of notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11203185-adding-notes-to-the-appointment-book#h_6fb71a7886)

Notes can be added to a practitioner's appointment book column for ad-hoc events that aren't related to a patient, such as meetings and catch-up time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509893334/86bf44d299d3981ea6b43e034d22/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_49_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a2e5b9c50bbb92a03a7dc5612732b22e0bc8407c6cf24145a8cc927a2964be4e&req=dSUnH8F3noJcXfMW1HO4zTkSdGUDvONSwviYxyVEgScjd3pY%2F13m7Wu7%2FOGb%0ALtIXbhdbvHFBcu3QKbs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509893334/86bf44d299d3981ea6b43e034d22/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_49_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a2e5b9c50bbb92a03a7dc5612732b22e0bc8407c6cf24145a8cc927a2964be4e&req=dSUnH8F3noJcXfMW1HO4zTkSdGUDvONSwviYxyVEgScjd3pY%2F13m7Wu7%2FOGb%0ALtIXbhdbvHFBcu3QKbs%3D%0A)

Quick Notes
===========

When adding a **Note** on the Appointment Book, a selection of the _most used_ notes for your business will be available to select as **Quick Notes**. Alternatively, you can create a list of custom Quick Notes for each business, replacing the most used quick notes with your custom list.

To manage the list of custom Quick Notes, go to [Settings > Appointment Book > Quick Notes.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/quicknotes)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890080/1dffa5a76d04989511ffa9a04e20/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_44_58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=34b8f9a1345d830866041ba7cbc3c9c008a136d4dc0f4f7400524de3b43755f3&req=dSUnH8F3nYFXWfMW1HO4zS9VjlqB85ZV4cMktw8L4j7CKeGTkFA56nGp2lnq%0AP6qGzXr%2FRai7zeLY2DM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890080/1dffa5a76d04989511ffa9a04e20/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_44_58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=34b8f9a1345d830866041ba7cbc3c9c008a136d4dc0f4f7400524de3b43755f3&req=dSUnH8F3nYFXWfMW1HO4zS9VjlqB85ZV4cMktw8L4j7CKeGTkFA56nGp2lnq%0AP6qGzXr%2FRai7zeLY2DM%3D%0A)

Adding a single note
====================

Select an available time on the appointment book and then select the **Note** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890524/bfa7046114fc9935008833e05e14/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_45_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b762bf84848b1d5cafb567054547c874eacc5800bd2e02605fc7fab70d9a3251&req=dSUnH8F3nYRdXfMW1HO4zeYRhDcb%2B2GplAqyHfVwfZ0N1ho8XnW5%2FlMXG76r%0A%2FU7E2FXAykH3ZiPSpqc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890524/bfa7046114fc9935008833e05e14/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_45_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b762bf84848b1d5cafb567054547c874eacc5800bd2e02605fc7fab70d9a3251&req=dSUnH8F3nYRdXfMW1HO4zeYRhDcb%2B2GplAqyHfVwfZ0N1ho8XnW5%2FlMXG76r%0A%2FU7E2FXAykH3ZiPSpqc%3D%0A)

Select from your **Quick Note** descriptions, or enter a custom description and colours. You can also modify the duration and add additional **notes** and **resources** to the booking.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890758/dd6f6f9eff60cfc1322cc2a73818/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_45_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5aed476e48bdcab666bd9d35f7d2a58eb3220c7ad47ccf635fdac98bafbbcac6&req=dSUnH8F3nYZaUfMW1HO4zVuXyUQnwdhWO5zyGy2vf8PXgHG1MH7AuFDERd%2Bd%0AxgyACtI3JGwan%2FnkhlI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890758/dd6f6f9eff60cfc1322cc2a73818/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_45_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5aed476e48bdcab666bd9d35f7d2a58eb3220c7ad47ccf635fdac98bafbbcac6&req=dSUnH8F3nYZaUfMW1HO4zVuXyUQnwdhWO5zyGy2vf8PXgHG1MH7AuFDERd%2Bd%0AxgyACtI3JGwan%2FnkhlI%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Adding a recurring schedule of notes
====================================

Select an available time on the appointment book and then select the **Note** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890538/5d4108f3847e737a194791a931f0/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_45_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e0ec5d9f38a86eca07a5abe2dd2eaf8ea51d459ac28485dfe5c5b106277fd886&req=dSUnH8F3nYRcUfMW1HO4zQ5LouYnDU4zgzZXCcmdWcICEI%2Bbr%2B%2Bo6ERomGCI%0AQBg3s1IHDntUlm4KRyU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890538/5d4108f3847e737a194791a931f0/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_45_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e0ec5d9f38a86eca07a5abe2dd2eaf8ea51d459ac28485dfe5c5b106277fd886&req=dSUnH8F3nYRcUfMW1HO4zQ5LouYnDU4zgzZXCcmdWcICEI%2Bbr%2B%2Bo6ERomGCI%0AQBg3s1IHDntUlm4KRyU%3D%0A)

Select the **Schedule** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890975/69e31b51198b0928c1ad1707f2b4/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_46_14.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06480f0784dfd2dfbeac44892229ae2aa08b1018ac21e3141bc1a1f6fd00dcbd&req=dSUnH8F3nYhYXPMW1HO4zQrHd4AbjWzBcSO8htiyN2lREH%2BM%2BVtw%2BDTbTEBJ%0AaFYdCySAwEeyrz%2FFZ5o%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509890975/69e31b51198b0928c1ad1707f2b4/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_46_14.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06480f0784dfd2dfbeac44892229ae2aa08b1018ac21e3141bc1a1f6fd00dcbd&req=dSUnH8F3nYhYXPMW1HO4zQrHd4AbjWzBcSO8htiyN2lREH%2BM%2BVtw%2BDTbTEBJ%0AaFYdCySAwEeyrz%2FFZ5o%3D%0A)

Select from your **Quick Note** descriptions, or enter a custom description and colours. You can also modify the duration and add additional **notes** that will be applied to all bookings in the schedule.

Review the Recurrence pattern for the note and the practitioners to whom the note should be applied.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509891309/3f044ca68a8f308903ddfd6fa429/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_46_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef791f6f01478192e25a23aae01f55de5b56e949068e6d4306c76555baa23774&req=dSUnH8F3nIJfUPMW1HO4zdNPI7hdJB7ns3gCsnFQj1%2BqK37NfNJm%2Fgm7mM%2B%2B%0AibKqpNENrADqPz62zVQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509891309/3f044ca68a8f308903ddfd6fa429/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_46_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef791f6f01478192e25a23aae01f55de5b56e949068e6d4306c76555baa23774&req=dSUnH8F3nIJfUPMW1HO4zdNPI7hdJB7ns3gCsnFQj1%2BqK37NfNJm%2Fgm7mM%2B%2B%0AibKqpNENrADqPz62zVQ%3D%0A)

Select **Generate Schedule.**

You'll see an overview of the schedule. Use the drop down menus in the schedule grid to customise the date, time, practitioner, resources and duration as required.

Once you've reviewed the schedule, select **Check & Reserve Times.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509891589/f3e3f7d69238d8a9e8b3a1355244/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_47_03.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2eb0f51ae97a0fb3306a7951a323a5aaf9466e929a3b93159c6f5e08e3fe1bbd&req=dSUnH8F3nIRXUPMW1HO4zZEWR60qukuYvbvIAc1QLiyzzwENGtJdZQ7kmjp8%0A2Nf%2F%2Fe5%2FbkHHfmGgqNY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509891589/f3e3f7d69238d8a9e8b3a1355244/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_47_03.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2eb0f51ae97a0fb3306a7951a323a5aaf9466e929a3b93159c6f5e08e3fe1bbd&req=dSUnH8F3nIRXUPMW1HO4zZEWR60qukuYvbvIAc1QLiyzzwENGtJdZQ7kmjp8%0A2Nf%2F%2Fe5%2FbkHHfmGgqNY%3D%0A)

You will need to review any detected conflicts where the time is not available for that specific practitioner. You can change the time or remove that instance from the schedule.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509891835/930277de55033ebbf80fd4e975f0/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_47_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd631329427a0c9bc9e6e7e42602d5f787f144be3a1cebb120ee96ba0aff8fee&req=dSUnH8F3nIlcXPMW1HO4zae9r9ccZ1z%2BaqwrTJR9%2F1okopN4dFESf1ArD2ck%0AsXrP3Io8M9AmXfprnZA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509891835/930277de55033ebbf80fd4e975f0/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_47_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd631329427a0c9bc9e6e7e42602d5f787f144be3a1cebb120ee96ba0aff8fee&req=dSUnH8F3nIlcXPMW1HO4zae9r9ccZ1z%2BaqwrTJR9%2F1okopN4dFESf1ArD2ck%0AsXrP3Io8M9AmXfprnZA%3D%0A)

After addressing all the conflicts, select **Book Schedule** to finalise the process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509892105/9aff13d0e7b7ab845c809bf4c86c/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_48_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=785294a76deb25cfcfb57c25fcaa17211f901b057a41221cc31c212ad2d71120&req=dSUnH8F3n4BfXPMW1HO4zSW12A9kEFswnbF7qYT%2FQTAgANFW%2BtPd0tb%2FNTO3%0AswO1z6A1PfJMa1pkfpk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509892105/9aff13d0e7b7ab845c809bf4c86c/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_48_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=785294a76deb25cfcfb57c25fcaa17211f901b057a41221cc31c212ad2d71120&req=dSUnH8F3n4BfXPMW1HO4zSW12A9kEFswnbF7qYT%2FQTAgANFW%2BtPd0tb%2FNTO3%0AswO1z6A1PfJMa1pkfpk%3D%0A)

To edit a schedule, select a single recurrence and select **Edit Schedule**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509892312/691a350fc540ab0dbf49fdfee349/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_48_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c67fccde72910019f84818629165c4dc38fdd340a6580d41106ceaee2924cf4&req=dSUnH8F3n4JeW%2FMW1HO4zeytdfkiyinZnQwvZm81ukPiaTnYFzMeO2%2BxrIvs%0AhybM1Yz398b5t68Hpdw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1509892312/691a350fc540ab0dbf49fdfee349/CleanShot+2025-05-06+at+13_48_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c67fccde72910019f84818629165c4dc38fdd340a6580d41106ceaee2924cf4&req=dSUnH8F3n4JeW%2FMW1HO4zeytdfkiyinZnQwvZm81ukPiaTnYFzMeO2%2BxrIvs%0AhybM1Yz398b5t68Hpdw%3D%0A)

Edit and modify the schedule as required.

Payment Methods

Payment Methods
===============

Updated over 9 months ago

PracSuite includes the following default payment methods for Australian users, which cater for the majority of practice needs:

*   Cash
    
*   Credit Card
    
*   EFTPOS
    
*   Health Fund
    
*   Cheque
    
*   Bank Transfer
    
*   Gift Card
    
*   Medicare/DVA
    

If you require additional methods for payments that you process through external platforms, you can customise the list of payment methods in [Settings > Billing > Payment Methods.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/paymentmethods)

On this page, you can:

*   Use the **active** checkbox to hide payment methods
    
*   Select **Add** to add new payment methods.
    
*   To reorder payment methods, click and hold the drag handle to the left of a payment method, then use your mouse to move it and change the order.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548067886/c7a4721450adf4249620f0ecddb3/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_24_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2990a9d31c1a7b9fda0e3f10c43e3f2bfb867fd681d7935d0cdc32ce14bcd78e&req=dSUjHsl4molXX%2FMW1HO4zYxulMZLJRJrLE6h4gZRE7sNSLy95GGi%2B3rIFXbS%0A80bet8uf4FnbyRUJ4%2B4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1548067886/c7a4721450adf4249620f0ecddb3/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+16_24_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2990a9d31c1a7b9fda0e3f10c43e3f2bfb867fd681d7935d0cdc32ce14bcd78e&req=dSUjHsl4molXX%2FMW1HO4zYxulMZLJRJrLE6h4gZRE7sNSLy95GGi%2B3rIFXbS%0A80bet8uf4FnbyRUJ4%2B4%3D%0A)

[Prompt Instructions: How to Guide the AI](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11506800-using-previous-clinical-history-in-ai-clinical-notes-letters#h_f49e7f45ab)

[Letter Template Examples](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11506800-using-previous-clinical-history-in-ai-clinical-notes-letters#h_78dd97687d)

[Clinical Note Template Examples](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11506800-using-previous-clinical-history-in-ai-clinical-notes-letters#h_ba501f945c)

[Forms and Outcome Measure Examples](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11506800-using-previous-clinical-history-in-ai-clinical-notes-letters#h_24c23acc79)

[Best Practices](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11506800-using-previous-clinical-history-in-ai-clinical-notes-letters#h_b200698130)

When generating AI-assisted clinical notes or letters, you can include a patient’s previous clinical history to provide context and improve the quality of the output. This history might include past notes, referral letters, diagnostic reports, intake forms, and outcome measures.

Providing this information helps the AI understand the patient’s background, treatment journey, and current needs, resulting in more accurate, relevant, and personalised documentation.

* * *

**What Can Be Included as Clinical History?**
---------------------------------------------

You can include:

*   Previous clinical notes
    
*   Referral letters and reports
    
*   Uploaded PDFs or Word documents
    
*   Forms, such as intake forms with presenting complains, and outcome measures (e.g. DASS-21, Örebro)
    

This information is used by the AI to enhance the generated content, especially when it’s referenced or summarised via prompt instructions.

* * *

**How to Select Previous Clinical History**
-------------------------------------------

**For AI Clinical Notes**: Use the **‘Previous Clinical History’** button to choose which documents, notes or forms you’d like to include. This gives you control over the context the AI considers during generation.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1554730624/fb6a6ef9b21107d779732a21789a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1cd74e6ad7be9da896c4f08e68b2a2d460921a85589d38589fc7d02db6ebdb2f&req=dSUiEs59nYddXfMW1HO4zT9C3u89iiX5J3Et3ylZJ7mkcG7%2F1BQxs2Kzzrt%2B%0Aw2fUVxwf%2FS5c%2BtyNUHI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1554730624/fb6a6ef9b21107d779732a21789a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1cd74e6ad7be9da896c4f08e68b2a2d460921a85589d38589fc7d02db6ebdb2f&req=dSUiEs59nYddXfMW1HO4zT9C3u89iiX5J3Et3ylZJ7mkcG7%2F1BQxs2Kzzrt%2B%0Aw2fUVxwf%2FS5c%2BtyNUHI%3D%0A)

**For AI Letters**: You’ll be prompted to select relevant previous history before generating the letter. This may include intake forms, referral letters, diagnostic reports, or other supporting documents.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1554731056/495745941aa6a8d741aa9d64b1aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dbca86cc73bb3fafc0584b785ed84069d4a80800fdd3b004e28754d8e9dc55a&req=dSUiEs59nIFaX%2FMW1HO4zbbNL9U%2FErKlAjz5D3XDBjmg9rnGl5SfPEvd7ucA%0A4SdHuxBb0ZTOUebbsQs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1554731056/495745941aa6a8d741aa9d64b1aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dbca86cc73bb3fafc0584b785ed84069d4a80800fdd3b004e28754d8e9dc55a&req=dSUiEs59nIFaX%2FMW1HO4zbbNL9U%2FErKlAjz5D3XDBjmg9rnGl5SfPEvd7ucA%0A4SdHuxBb0ZTOUebbsQs%3D%0A)

* * *

**Prompt Instructions: How to Guide the AI**
--------------------------------------------

To ensure the AI uses the provided history appropriately, it’s important that your AI note and letter templates include specific, task-oriented instructions. These should explain what to do with any included clinical notes, documents, forms or reports.

**Letter Template Examples**
----------------------------

*   “Refer to the patient’s presenting complaints in the intake form and describe any changes in their condition since that time.”
    
*   “Summarise relevant findings from radiology reports or referral letters where provided.”
    
*   “Include a brief history of treatment to date based on previous clinical notes.”
    

Further reading: [Creating PracSuite AI Letter Templates](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862594-pracsuite-ai-letter-templates)

**Clinical Note Template Examples**
-----------------------------------

*   “Compare today’s symptoms to the last consultation and describe any improvement or deterioration.”
    
*   “Carry forward ongoing concerns or treatment goals and update their progress.”
    
*   “Summarise previous medication or treatment plans if referenced in earlier notes.”
    

Further reading: [Creating PracSuite AI Clinical Notes Templates](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862593-pracsuite-ai-clinical-note-templates)

**Forms and Outcome Measure Examples**
--------------------------------------

*   “Highlight changes in outcome scores compared to previous submissions (e.g. DASS-21, Örebro).”
    
*   “Summarise self-reported improvement or deterioration based on recent forms.”
    
*   “Identify any high-risk responses or patterns from repeated form data.”
    

* * *

**Best Practices**
------------------

*   Be specific in your prompts — clearly state how past content should be used.
    
*   Keep instructions short and task-focused.
    
*   Only select relevant history to avoid overloading the AI with unnecessary information.
    

Including previous clinical history enables richer, more contextualised AI-generated content, whether for patient letters or clinical documentation. When used with well-crafted prompts, it’s a powerful tool to streamline workflow while maintaining clinical accuracy and depth.

* * *

Taking an over the phone payment using Tyro EFTPOS

Taking an over the phone payment using Tyro EFTPOS
==================================================

Updated over 6 months ago

If you have a Tyro EFTPOS terminal integrated with PracSuite, you can process an over-the-phone payment via the integration by following the steps below:

1.  Initiate the Tyro EFTPOS card payment from the invoice screen in PracSuite as usual
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1648530533/15ca51ed49aecffd90186978387b/CleanShot%2B2025-08-01%2Bat%2B14_30_57.png?expires=1771821900&signature=65626fba85af2bf5b59713a4a01397e1eae7eb1fa303e20afd4c8b7247600b35&req=dSYjHsx9nYRcWvMW1HO4zYOWSmCsZ%2Bh%2FHR052t3mPVhPHoiets4b3RhetWdF%0AN19z%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1648530533/15ca51ed49aecffd90186978387b/CleanShot%2B2025-08-01%2Bat%2B14_30_57.png?expires=1771821900&signature=65626fba85af2bf5b59713a4a01397e1eae7eb1fa303e20afd4c8b7247600b35&req=dSYjHsx9nYRcWvMW1HO4zYOWSmCsZ%2Bh%2FHR052t3mPVhPHoiets4b3RhetWdF%0AN19z%0A)
    
2.  The transaction amount will be displayed on the Tyro EFTPOS terminal. On the terminal, press the **Menu** button
    
3.  This will display the **MOTO** option on screen, so press **MOTO**.
    
4.  Back in PracSuite, select the '**Allow MOTO**' option displayed on screen
    
5.  On the Tyro terminal, enter the transaction amount.
    
6.  Select **Telephone Order**. Telephone Order requires the card number, expiry date, and CVV.
    
7.  Follow the prompts to enter the required details and press OK
    
8.  The transaction will complete as normal in PracSuite
    

* * *

Tracking Online Bookings with Meta Pixel
========================================

Updated over 6 months ago

Select **Settings**.

In the **Data Sources** section**,** select **Datasets and Pixels.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1678600079/fab5aad92c88bdec29ea30066e8c/CleanShot+2025-08-20+at+14_16_06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7d8ca73cb6899c108131312ecb754056cded2e1c5d1f967c7c693576766b1337&req=dSYgHs9%2BnYFYUPMW1HO4zdN251isoLkpgLPtttPDzqMSXrg3eCuQq35RHz6Z%0AIWWfeNCKZYqnIvt%2B0VM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1678600079/fab5aad92c88bdec29ea30066e8c/CleanShot+2025-08-20+at+14_16_06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7d8ca73cb6899c108131312ecb754056cded2e1c5d1f967c7c693576766b1337&req=dSYgHs9%2BnYFYUPMW1HO4zdN251isoLkpgLPtttPDzqMSXrg3eCuQq35RHz6Z%0AIWWfeNCKZYqnIvt%2B0VM%3D%0A)

Enter your Meta Pixel ID into PracSuite in [Settings > Online Booking > Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
.

You'll be taken to your online booking site to configure the events you wish to trigger based on activity on your PracSuite booking site.

For the example below, we are going to fire a **Purchase event** on the final 'booking confirmed' screen.

When you reach the last page, in the **Meta event setup tool** select **Track a URL.**

How to Generate an Invoice Adjustments Report

How to Generate an Invoice Adjustments Report
=============================================

Updated over 5 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12133991-how-to-generate-an-invoice-adjustments-report#h_5874d8c19f)

[How to Use](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12133991-how-to-generate-an-invoice-adjustments-report#h_6f18a09929)

[Results](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12133991-how-to-generate-an-invoice-adjustments-report#h_df455fd60e)

Overview
========

The Invoice Adjustments Report provides a comprehensive list of items invoiced before a specified date ('item dated before') and tracks modifications made within a defined adjustment period ('adjustments made').

This is useful for determining what changes were made to invoices on specified dates and is typically used to track down invoice adjustments made after reconciling.

How to Use  

-------------

#### 1) Setting the Adjustments Made filter

The date range selected here defines the adjustment period, with all modifications made to the selected Items in that range being shown.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1706108540/5b6f17c86fdf5994aa60a7a2ddf9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b83627a4384390928e81d95b3b4082a8e16385e27f9c255366ab9d73db154ed&req=dScnEMh%2BlYRbWfMW1HO4ze7q9ksIt%2BmwrQILHbYf9C0kWYkEQ7pe2n5zI4V0%0A%2BJycq7z51VFst8hdsWI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1706108540/5b6f17c86fdf5994aa60a7a2ddf9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b83627a4384390928e81d95b3b4082a8e16385e27f9c255366ab9d73db154ed&req=dScnEMh%2BlYRbWfMW1HO4ze7q9ksIt%2BmwrQILHbYf9C0kWYkEQ7pe2n5zI4V0%0A%2BJycq7z51VFst8hdsWI%3D%0A)

Example: Setting this to **Today** will show all adjustments that were made **today,** for the selected Items. Setting a range will include all adjustments made between the two dates.

####   
2) Setting the Items Dated Before filter

The date selected here sets the cut-off for which items will be included based on the item's date, with all items invoiced before the selected date being included.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1706108154/8f46ce4497c71f35c8b9adb36047/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9018f3ee13bb6ce267c0fc9084226e006d1fbb6e7e4c215ac2a867d14d45220d&req=dScnEMh%2BlYBaXfMW1HO4zRB8qi1Xfj98QdCr%2FX2SyK9s46jVTa%2Fv7hPiLXg6%0At8X%2BaxQeaRYuSazg%2Ftk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1706108154/8f46ce4497c71f35c8b9adb36047/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9018f3ee13bb6ce267c0fc9084226e006d1fbb6e7e4c215ac2a867d14d45220d&req=dScnEMh%2BlYBaXfMW1HO4zRB8qi1Xfj98QdCr%2FX2SyK9s46jVTa%2Fv7hPiLXg6%0At8X%2BaxQeaRYuSazg%2Ftk%3D%0A)

Example: Setting this to the **1/1/2025** will show items that were invoiced before that date and the adjustments made to them in the adjustment period.

#### 3) Select a Business / Practitioner

This filter allows for only items invoices to select businesses and/or practitioners to be shown. For all adjustments, leave this unchecked.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1706108938/a6cf9ee4d8740a7fe79f8dd547d9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96914a07aa9f68f3c81c75ba70be7c8ede2048596cfc162efff1a21e055cba5c&req=dScnEMh%2BlYhcUfMW1HO4zaWpDNhL7DscoeaCzImWMaCzNYInFw0jpzK9A5px%0A2HkLIepwbtfCJoKPaMM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1706108938/a6cf9ee4d8740a7fe79f8dd547d9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96914a07aa9f68f3c81c75ba70be7c8ede2048596cfc162efff1a21e055cba5c&req=dScnEMh%2BlYhcUfMW1HO4zaWpDNhL7DscoeaCzImWMaCzNYInFw0jpzK9A5px%0A2HkLIepwbtfCJoKPaMM%3D%0A)

#### 4) Set your Group by preference

These options enable the results to be grouped by the business and/or the practitioner that they were invoiced against.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1706109261/90277d775ac18760eb682a92e202/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c7f8a905ab9763bb3dba6795039966ad4b7976ccfc071296fea3cb8a32e22a27&req=dScnEMh%2BlINZWPMW1HO4zY9dwiQeA6e%2FkN64gIIpEKL6%2FnFip0K%2FctCv75V7%0ApxdYAiN0N7Aj7G6eWcc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1706109261/90277d775ac18760eb682a92e202/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c7f8a905ab9763bb3dba6795039966ad4b7976ccfc071296fea3cb8a32e22a27&req=dScnEMh%2BlINZWPMW1HO4zY9dwiQeA6e%2FkN64gIIpEKL6%2FnFip0K%2FctCv75V7%0ApxdYAiN0N7Aj7G6eWcc%3D%0A)

Once your preferred filters have been set, click **Generate Report**.

* * *

Results
-------

The results section will show all of the adjustments that were made based on the filters set, including the actions performed, any details that were adjusted, the user responsible, and more.

Note: The patient name and invoice number are clickable and will take you to the patient's file and invoice respectively.

* * *

NDIS Funding Periods

NDIS Funding Periods
====================

Using Treatment Plans to track funding periods

Updated over 4 months ago

Table of contents

[Enabling NDIS Funding Periods](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods#h_6019f51350)

[Managing Funding Periods on a Patient File](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods#h_d5f7c61344)

[Quickly Inserting Preconfigured Funding Periods onto a Patient Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods#h_d73ee44f0c)

[Reporting on Funding Period Status](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods#h_0711ec5c03)

PracSuite offers optional features designed to manage **funding periods** for NDIS patients through the [existing Treatment Plan feature.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4841280-managing-treatment-plans)

If you’re not familiar with NDIS funding periods, you can learn more on the [NDIS website](https://www.ndis.gov.au/)
.

The Funding Period features allow you to:

*   Split a whole Treatment Plan into up to 12 individual funding periods
    
*   View and track invoiced amounts per funding period
    
*   Automatically roll over unused funds from earlier funding periods into later ones
    
*   Clearly see how much funding is available at the current point in time
    
*   Prevent new invoices from being generated when funding period or treatment plan limits have been reached
    
*   Include future appointments in calculations to provide forward predictions
    
*   Use the Treatment Plan Report to view the status of funding periods across multiple patients
    

Enabling NDIS Funding Periods
=============================

Funding periods must first be enabled at the system level:

1.  Go to **[Settings > Billing](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/list)
    **
    
2.  Enable **NDIS Funding Periods on Treatment Plans**
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743123177/0c0c3ca345176fdfd1b0ec212497/CleanShot+2025-09-25+at+08_56_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ed61034c77a444dcbaf555aeefc661f8d8e3101848282147a11289ede22d7c0&req=dScjFch8noBYXvMW1HO4zbTbK9miCF3KHOrwNoc6AVDgxRPuksXn7g52637W%0A7lh4cs3bpo3pV6qDo5w%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743123177/0c0c3ca345176fdfd1b0ec212497/CleanShot+2025-09-25+at+08_56_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ed61034c77a444dcbaf555aeefc661f8d8e3101848282147a11289ede22d7c0&req=dScjFch8noBYXvMW1HO4zbTbK9miCF3KHOrwNoc6AVDgxRPuksXn7g52637W%0A7lh4cs3bpo3pV6qDo5w%3D%0A)

Once enabled, funding period management will be available on individual patient accounts.

* * *

Managing Funding Periods on a Patient File
==========================================

To manage funding periods for a patient:

1.  Open the **Patient File**
    
2.  Go to the **Accounts** tab
    
3.  Select **Edit**
    
4.  Scroll down to the **Treatment Plans** section
    
    *   Edit an existing plan, or
        
    *   Select **Add** to create a new plan
        
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743270166/659ac1f8107630eddb9f369c8023/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=86248c4adcfb7e9415bb0aee8dcf68f862c6799f512af40e7e6fe0b3aa50d765&req=dScjFct5nYBZX%2FMW1HO4zXjPXQOcl5APfCLMg3yLyN8t8fVExJWgMs0%2FP%2BgG%0APqCH2bpj1GQ7U6kdQuA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743270166/659ac1f8107630eddb9f369c8023/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=86248c4adcfb7e9415bb0aee8dcf68f862c6799f512af40e7e6fe0b3aa50d765&req=dScjFct5nYBZX%2FMW1HO4zXjPXQOcl5APfCLMg3yLyN8t8fVExJWgMs0%2FP%2BgG%0APqCH2bpj1GQ7U6kdQuA%3D%0A)

Within the plan:

*   Tick **Enable Funding Periods**
    
*   Choose how many periods to split the plan into (between 2 and 12)
    
*   Enter the **Start Date** and **End Date** for each period
    
*   Set the **Funding Limit** for each period
    
*   Set an **Alert Value** – PracSuite will begin showing alerts once this value is reached
    

You also have the option to:

*   **Prevent invoicing if plan or funding period limit has been reached**
    
    *   This ensures no new invoices can be created once the limit is reached
        
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743270169/8cd7d0ecc5bb95d5542e4a816cc0/CleanShot%2B2025-09-25%2Bat%2B11_10_49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0809d3948ec36752c960ec1fc859dcd1b908bf9fa784fdb8d21c47edca80a626&req=dScjFct5nYBZUPMW1HO4zdTsDTDYDR%2BGnuBXAxnVgKFX8wh8840dsi4peEYC%0AwoTbW2O2NblEd3c6gcY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743270169/8cd7d0ecc5bb95d5542e4a816cc0/CleanShot%2B2025-09-25%2Bat%2B11_10_49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0809d3948ec36752c960ec1fc859dcd1b908bf9fa784fdb8d21c47edca80a626&req=dScjFct5nYBZUPMW1HO4zdTsDTDYDR%2BGnuBXAxnVgKFX8wh8840dsi4peEYC%0AwoTbW2O2NblEd3c6gcY%3D%0A)

The Accounts tab of the patient file displays Treatment Plans with their Funding Periods.

In the example below, a yearly plan has been divided into four quarterly funding periods. Each period is shown in a different colour, making it easy to see how rollover amounts are carried from one period to the next.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743270168/d98d399604375c1a3ca5ca24cd6e/CleanShot-2B2025-09-25-2Bat-2B11_06_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=182f5d8551e48b727b4c0ccbfb0a600b331c65d9f86af3bb29946aeee6b60edc&req=dScjFct5nYBZUfMW1HO4zZwLjJ8YDL%2B09CiuOEJ%2F8P4nVGTndv76ey7ksm3Y%0A9%2BNdNlN1kPESn3grqMs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743270168/d98d399604375c1a3ca5ca24cd6e/CleanShot-2B2025-09-25-2Bat-2B11_06_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=182f5d8551e48b727b4c0ccbfb0a600b331c65d9f86af3bb29946aeee6b60edc&req=dScjFct5nYBZUfMW1HO4zZwLjJ8YDL%2B09CiuOEJ%2F8P4nVGTndv76ey7ksm3Y%0A9%2BNdNlN1kPESn3grqMs%3D%0A)

Treatment Plan and Funding Period status also display in Treatment Plan alerts and at the bottom of the Invoice screen. These areas focus on the funding periods relevant to the dates of items added to that invoice.

Quickly Inserting Preconfigured Funding Periods onto a Patient Account
======================================================================

To speed up adding common funding period setups to patient accounts, you can create **Default Treatment Plans**. This allows you to quickly insert preconfigured settings (e.g., a default yearly plan with 4 funding periods, or one with 12).

[Learn more about creating Default Treatment Plans](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods#)
.

When on the Accounts tab of a patient file, use the drop down menu next to the **Add** button to select which Default Account to add.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743270172/c80af6a35565e422ff5cad9abc25/CleanShot%2B2025-09-25%2Bat%2B11_32_10.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44cbf026555cf508b9a8dfcb8b8b3ea6ed60722eb4bdebf6ae4cf02ec0a0f7e5&req=dScjFct5nYBYW%2FMW1HO4zWXaqVy8doCJ60n5%2FODUcUXQU%2BKPs7A6bZO6OHWw%0A2HVD9x7X2Q2WRpUypDs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1743270172/c80af6a35565e422ff5cad9abc25/CleanShot%2B2025-09-25%2Bat%2B11_32_10.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44cbf026555cf508b9a8dfcb8b8b3ea6ed60722eb4bdebf6ae4cf02ec0a0f7e5&req=dScjFct5nYBYW%2FMW1HO4zWXaqVy8doCJ60n5%2FODUcUXQU%2BKPs7A6bZO6OHWw%0A2HVD9x7X2Q2WRpUypDs%3D%0A)

How to Email, Print or Download Completed Forms

How to Email, Print or Download Completed Forms
===============================================

Updated over 4 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12544748-how-to-email-print-or-download-completed-forms#h_f0337955a0)

Overview
========

Once a Form has been completed by a patient, it can be emailed, printed or downloaded by following these steps.

#### Step 1:

Open a patient's file and navigate to the Forms tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768859051/fc9904021559e5c2bb43406291d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5caf91fe2008a56adbac8026a97dcd6c04594cfcc31b2a5d412185725da57b2f&req=dSchHsF7lIFaWPMW1HO4zf63GeZzTJQ7SUsC2r4YjeCHFLKBtMLYLNbjOUqS%0A%2BlE4k1uY9iFg7e%2BuESc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768859051/fc9904021559e5c2bb43406291d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5caf91fe2008a56adbac8026a97dcd6c04594cfcc31b2a5d412185725da57b2f&req=dSchHsF7lIFaWPMW1HO4zf63GeZzTJQ7SUsC2r4YjeCHFLKBtMLYLNbjOUqS%0A%2BlE4k1uY9iFg7e%2BuESc%3D%0A)

####   
Step 2:

Hover your cursor over a Form and click on either Email or Print.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768912591/8a54d2936282a365a6fe2d35e5c8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26e501b77ede31fd0c3879a3b6c1d84ebcd3c443f789bca40e7f534f6197f5b2&req=dSchHsB%2Fn4RWWPMW1HO4zQNBAzeMePqw5FsWPi%2B9VjdPRC2uHfce1I7Wi6bt%0AGFM8BlSo7TI8Wvzjdb4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768912591/8a54d2936282a365a6fe2d35e5c8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26e501b77ede31fd0c3879a3b6c1d84ebcd3c443f789bca40e7f534f6197f5b2&req=dSchHsB%2Fn4RWWPMW1HO4zQNBAzeMePqw5FsWPi%2B9VjdPRC2uHfce1I7Wi6bt%0AGFM8BlSo7TI8Wvzjdb4%3D%0A)

####   
Step 3:

Select the Business Header that you would like to use on this Form and finally select from the three options of Print, Email and Download.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768927069/8d732f2c5d67527163a499f9334d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4e635a4cde904253e5691aba83896c3f9b5a7e95522b1cb774d297dee3e3c9f5&req=dSchHsB8moFZUPMW1HO4zRZRLv9ZtnpKslBrx96%2B2ECOCluMEN5z6ZiWc6Tz%0AAOIF7sDASKa8KH3aTKs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768927069/8d732f2c5d67527163a499f9334d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4e635a4cde904253e5691aba83896c3f9b5a7e95522b1cb774d297dee3e3c9f5&req=dSchHsB8moFZUPMW1HO4zRZRLv9ZtnpKslBrx96%2B2ECOCluMEN5z6ZiWc6Tz%0AAOIF7sDASKa8KH3aTKs%3D%0A)

  
​  
Repeat this process for each Form you would like to download.  
​

Viewing PracSuite AI Transcripts

Viewing PracSuite AI Transcripts
================================

Updated over 4 months ago

When using PracSuite AI to record clinical note dictations and conversations, recordings are transcribed to text. A copy of the audio recording is never saved, and is only available for a short window before choosing to save the clinical note, including saving it as a draft.

If you want to view the transcript of a previous PracSuite AI Dictation or Conversation recording, follow the instructions below.

Firstly, the following options must be enabled in [Settings > PracSuite Account > AI](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/ai)
 if you wish to store transcripts. If these options are disabled, transcripts will never be saved.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1774633007/6a2e66de3994f0ba58109d7257bb/CleanShot%2BX%2B2025-10-13%2B08_44_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0e0c284c0720db96d6e7b1bba8eda23c50a00f1cc659dd632abdfd8f94ebf496&req=dScgEs99noFfXvMW1HO4zUNf%2FvSAHZnGUNyQlkRJ8T8WmzPQi3eI2V4Gads5%0AdOIwkprA0kG2XtbFEYc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1774633007/6a2e66de3994f0ba58109d7257bb/CleanShot%2BX%2B2025-10-13%2B08_44_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0e0c284c0720db96d6e7b1bba8eda23c50a00f1cc659dd632abdfd8f94ebf496&req=dScgEs99noFfXvMW1HO4zUNf%2FvSAHZnGUNyQlkRJ8T8WmzPQi3eI2V4Gads5%0AdOIwkprA0kG2XtbFEYc%3D%0A)

To access a saved transcript, go to the clinical note and select the green edit icon on the right-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1774632650/1d03b166e690f05a24dff68fc91b/CleanShot-2B2025-02-17-2Bat-2B10_05_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=270f910f38161fbdf5e2dc649bca0238ad34aacd628c8c33e480c751e4793a3b&req=dScgEs99n4daWfMW1HO4zQN%2BFCn%2B7milzalDNznWByrvyWcci73ISek5dwL4%0AyLMYBlYKmIPGtLvO4O0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1774632650/1d03b166e690f05a24dff68fc91b/CleanShot-2B2025-02-17-2Bat-2B10_05_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=270f910f38161fbdf5e2dc649bca0238ad34aacd628c8c33e480c751e4793a3b&req=dScgEs99n4daWfMW1HO4zQN%2BFCn%2B7milzalDNznWByrvyWcci73ISek5dwL4%0AyLMYBlYKmIPGtLvO4O0%3D%0A)

When in edit mode, select the 'Show Transcript' button.  
​﻿

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1774632652/e3480eb21a2194d07ed27c3bbec4/CleanShot-2B2025-01-29-2Bat-2B11_48_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4938f956c12906cd35971630a8359b6baa70b23cedd4007019e7c336f61f05ef&req=dScgEs99n4daW%2FMW1HO4zYMpkfBGqzYtWQxSTTa7l31zAfcuXry3AgYtjjlI%0ATupbv6aI5HmupbLwe4Q%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1774632652/e3480eb21a2194d07ed27c3bbec4/CleanShot-2B2025-01-29-2Bat-2B11_48_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4938f956c12906cd35971630a8359b6baa70b23cedd4007019e7c336f61f05ef&req=dScgEs99n4daW%2FMW1HO4zYMpkfBGqzYtWQxSTTa7l31zAfcuXry3AgYtjjlI%0ATupbv6aI5HmupbLwe4Q%3D%0A)

Appointment Statuses

Appointment Statuses
====================

Updated over 3 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12566632-appointment-statuses#h_625877ba72)

[Appointment Status Options](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12566632-appointment-statuses#h_8fc2eeb1b2)

[Creating a Custom Appointment Status](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12566632-appointment-statuses#h_d9eb478d42)

Overview
========

Appointment Statuses are designed to indicate what stage of an appointment a patient is at. The Appointment Status is reflected on the left-hand side of an appointment, and can be changed from the appointment menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825948580/177c4dc1860fcf9188ca12598967/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+15_35_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f8b55e1c8729158cdcea328c8a1b1ca88ff9d8a2cbddd7a4087a444cbf2002e0&req=dSglE8B6lYRXWfMW1HO4zXSdRScyCg1YJXc2HSnY4pHFA%2BnD6K79zw%2FGtGYR%0Aa9Cgs%2F%2FO0XkLbfOHAU4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825948580/177c4dc1860fcf9188ca12598967/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+15_35_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f8b55e1c8729158cdcea328c8a1b1ca88ff9d8a2cbddd7a4087a444cbf2002e0&req=dSglE8B6lYRXWfMW1HO4zXSdRScyCg1YJXc2HSnY4pHFA%2BnD6K79zw%2FGtGYR%0Aa9Cgs%2F%2FO0XkLbfOHAU4%3D%0A)

Appointment Statuses are managed in [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Book](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook)
.

The default statuses include:

*   **Booked -** All new appointments begin with this status.
    
*   **Reminder Sent -** Automatically set once automatic reminders have been sent out.
    
*   **Confirmed -** Used to indicate that a patient has confirmed their appointment. Can be automatically sent using Standard SMS Reply phrases explained below.
    
*   **Arrived -** Used when the patient arrived in the waiting room and to display the patient in the practitioner queue.
    
*   **In Session -** Used when the patient enters the practitioner's room and to display the patient in the practitioner queue.
    
*   **Completed -** Used when there are no further actions required for an appointment.
    
*   **Missed/DNA -** Used when the patient misses or does not attend the appointment.
    

It is not possible to hide or remove these default statuses.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825959329/9b61a9e221265e972ebae71e8c4a/CleanShot-2B2025-11-12-2Bat-2B15_43_35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c098f0dec9fe8c62f0a9856b37bf45215bd0f76817974f284da93d9d0b238a25&req=dSglE8B7lIJdUPMW1HO4zYrirqEJrND%2FXSsk%2F5b5Z4cjw8V2hfXMRGrwcxa3%0AVbHhVuzUs7a7K2XmN7U%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825959329/9b61a9e221265e972ebae71e8c4a/CleanShot-2B2025-11-12-2Bat-2B15_43_35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c098f0dec9fe8c62f0a9856b37bf45215bd0f76817974f284da93d9d0b238a25&req=dSglE8B7lIJdUPMW1HO4zYrirqEJrND%2FXSsk%2F5b5Z4cjw8V2hfXMRGrwcxa3%0AVbHhVuzUs7a7K2XmN7U%3D%0A)

Appointment Status Options
==========================

The following options are available for Appointment Statuses:

*   **Practitioner Queue -** Appointments with this status will appear in the practitioner queue.
    
*   **Hold Appointment Reminders -** Appointment reminders will not be sent for appointments with this status.
    
*   **Standard SMS Replies -** Choose phrases in SMS reminder replies that should trigger the appointment to update to this specific status.
    
*   **Auto-clear SMS Replies -** Choose whether SMS reminder replies with standard SMS reply phrases should be cleared automatically. This can avoid clutter when SMS replies come through..
    

You also have the option to control the following:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825964633/6ced806d1b632f453892916a7f1a/CleanShot%2B2025-11-12%2Bat%2B15_43_27.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2a10b02a8a6ddc636463bdb5d4a52ddcc4d3dd55a15c8c821bd7957b2fc19487&req=dSglE8B4mYdcWvMW1HO4zYtvEo4m%2FMgIAUj4gsxSInNh5H7ngBHY9qHR904R%0ACarJyIkNaxWrQuTnskA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825964633/6ced806d1b632f453892916a7f1a/CleanShot%2B2025-11-12%2Bat%2B15_43_27.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2a10b02a8a6ddc636463bdb5d4a52ddcc4d3dd55a15c8c821bd7957b2fc19487&req=dSglE8B4mYdcWvMW1HO4zYtvEo4m%2FMgIAUj4gsxSInNh5H7ngBHY9qHR904R%0ACarJyIkNaxWrQuTnskA%3D%0A)

*   Appointment Statuses are reset back to 'Booked' when rescheduling. Critical for appointment reminder processes to be reset.
    
*   Controlling whether the Appointment Status is updated to Completed after invoicing an appointment. This can be disabled entirely or set to a specific Appointment Status.
    

Creating a Custom Appointment Status
====================================

In addition to the standard Appointment Statuses, you can create custom statuses.

1.  Go to [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Book](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook)
     page and click Edit.
    
2.  Scroll to the **Appointment Statuses** section.
    
3.  Click **Add**
    
4.  Enter the name of the Status and choose a colour for this status
    
5.  Review the status options that you'd like to apply
    
6.  Click Save to finalise your changes.

Sending an email when a form is submitted

Sending an email when a form is submitted
=========================================

Updated over 4 months ago

Table of contents

[How to Set Up Email Notifications for Submitted Forms](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12624847-sending-an-email-when-a-form-is-submitted#h_86aeac4b22)

_This article assumes you are familiar with and using the Forms features in PracSuite. [Click here to learn more.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789041-forms-overview)
_

PracSuite can automatically send an email when a form is submitted online.

Emails can be sent to:

*   The patient who completed the form
    
*   A contact listed within the form
    
*   A custom address, such as your clinic’s main email
    

You can also choose to include a PDF copy of the completed form as an attachment, including options to hide or show confidential responses.

This feature is ideal for clinics that want to:

*   Notify practice staff when a form has been submitted
    
*   Send confirmation emails back to patients, outlining next steps
    
*   Prompt patients or contacts to complete additional forms as part of your intake or treatment workflow
    

Continue reading to learn how to set up this feature.

* * *

**How to Set Up Email Notifications for Submitted Forms**
=========================================================

1.  Go to **[Settings > Forms > Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/forms/templates)
    **
    
2.  Select the form template you want to enable email functionality for
    
3.  Open the **Form Automations** tab  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1790180250/15c3b4c01b6201af2d10ceaa7d2c/CleanShot%2B2025-10-22%2Bat%2B12_15_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=66f86c84dba0dc925d16d89018965544afbb21cec916dde65cc0ce5e1964f1fb&req=dScuFsh2nYNaWfMW1HO4zcG40dH%2BKJBoSArjqr%2Ffgd%2BvUeIY9MVzKotKdtK4%0ApaYj%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1790180250/15c3b4c01b6201af2d10ceaa7d2c/CleanShot%2B2025-10-22%2Bat%2B12_15_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=66f86c84dba0dc925d16d89018965544afbb21cec916dde65cc0ce5e1964f1fb&req=dScuFsh2nYNaWfMW1HO4zcG40dH%2BKJBoSArjqr%2Ffgd%2BvUeIY9MVzKotKdtK4%0ApaYj%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
4.  Enable **Send email when form is submitted**  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1790180440/3e5f0c8daa19364626e516034e10/CleanShot%2B2025-10-22%2Bat%2B12_19_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6e0de28d3bd4101a34a85866a0c2b28970cc20d220e0d91fd70d333a567effe8&req=dScuFsh2nYVbWfMW1HO4zWS%2FhW%2Fonwc3mUfUl%2F5PQ4fOvug10SzXO86%2FHq6J%0AV15P%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1790180440/3e5f0c8daa19364626e516034e10/CleanShot%2B2025-10-22%2Bat%2B12_19_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6e0de28d3bd4101a34a85866a0c2b28970cc20d220e0d91fd70d333a567effe8&req=dScuFsh2nYVbWfMW1HO4zWS%2FhW%2Fonwc3mUfUl%2F5PQ4fOvug10SzXO86%2FHq6J%0AV15P%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
5.  Click **Add** to configure who should receive the email
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1790152321/93945ad4ea6cbdad250274825e73/CleanShot+2025-10-22+at+12_20_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eec343bf2467df1994ba91e137ed0b386145d898db6fb7969481b7c8a1b4e96a&req=dScuFsh7n4JdWPMW1HO4zTIaBtq6858K%2FjO7o8fs%2BvBtsP9%2Bahk6XcmzE1wN%0AJyyOg%2BNsWEYIl2F9VCY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1790152321/93945ad4ea6cbdad250274825e73/CleanShot+2025-10-22+at+12_20_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eec343bf2467df1994ba91e137ed0b386145d898db6fb7969481b7c8a1b4e96a&req=dScuFsh7n4JdWPMW1HO4zTIaBtq6858K%2FjO7o8fs%2BvBtsP9%2Bahk6XcmzE1wN%0AJyyOg%2BNsWEYIl2F9VCY%3D%0A)

You can configure the following options:

### **Send to**

Choose who should receive the email. You can select from:

*   **Patient** – Sends the email to the address entered in the _Patient Contact Details_ section of the form.
    
    *   If this element isn’t present, the email address on the patient’s file is used instead.
        
    *   If there’s no patient email and the form was submitted via the public form link (not linked to a patient), no email will be sent.
        
    
*   **Contact** – If your form template includes a _Patient Contact_ element, you can choose from those contacts. You can add a Patient Contact element to you from from Add to Form > Patient File Fields > Contact Details as shown below:  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1791867844/3b4754d53f8143e315ac0ccd3d2c/CleanShot+X+2025-10-23+09_13_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c765bb4593383eb7205fd3c69bf71ffbb725469954c6b6d945097a534c38c4e6&req=dScuF8F4molbXfMW1HO4zXp0Z8AnFkjaamncn0BubF8Mv1kb6UaJ4%2FldjnqX%0AWxHy%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1791867844/3b4754d53f8143e315ac0ccd3d2c/CleanShot+X+2025-10-23+09_13_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c765bb4593383eb7205fd3c69bf71ffbb725469954c6b6d945097a534c38c4e6&req=dScuF8F4molbXfMW1HO4zXp0Z8AnFkjaamncn0BubF8Mv1kb6UaJ4%2FldjnqX%0AWxHy%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
*   **Custom** – Allows you to enter a fixed email address. This is ideal for sending alerts to a clinic or office email address.
    

### **Email Template**

Choose the email template that you want to be sent automatically to the recipient(s).

### **Attach PDF**

Choose whether to attach a PDF of the completed form to the email. You can choose the following options.

*   Do not attach
    
*   Attach, showing confidential answers
    
*   Attach, hiding confidential answers
    

### **Business Header on PDF**

Choose whether to include your business header on the PDF. You can choose the following options:

*   **Fixed -** Always uses the selected business header on the PDF.
    
*   **Dynamic -** When enabled, PracSuite will dynamically select the business header based on the appointment associated with the form. If there is no appointment associated with the form, or the form is completed from the generic public URL, the fallback business header will be used instead.
    

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Enabling Automatic SMS Appointment Confirmations

Enabling Automatic SMS Appointment Confirmations
================================================

Updated over 4 months ago

Table of contents

[Creating a Confirmation](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12626048-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-confirmations#h_8b10b6756f)

[Configuring the Confirmation](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12626048-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-confirmations#h_8ffab45e7e)

[Preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12626048-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-confirmations#h_8b61ff94a0)

Appointment Confirmations can be used to send patients an SMS at the time their appointment is made in PracSuite. SMS templates for Appointment Confirmations can be configured per business, profession and appointment type.

Creating a Confirmation
-----------------------

#### Step 1:

Go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Confirmations](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/confirmations)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788178875/ecae811a085b073c5f9d1793e0e4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efd037499b317d967225b68a4bedcb8ca2c7cfef06362009249e7b368bef26cc&req=dScvHsh5lYlYXPMW1HO4zeeQuddvq2uWWL2ZAxpK8%2FuDtdW9T3uSXXUYR1Js%0AcPnrkMPCb%2Bsa48Q%2BuuU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788178875/ecae811a085b073c5f9d1793e0e4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efd037499b317d967225b68a4bedcb8ca2c7cfef06362009249e7b368bef26cc&req=dScvHsh5lYlYXPMW1HO4zeeQuddvq2uWWL2ZAxpK8%2FuDtdW9T3uSXXUYR1Js%0AcPnrkMPCb%2Bsa48Q%2BuuU%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select **SMS** confirmation.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788180654/a6bb6b47d492160ce709e2baec8d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c051c7304db92bc869725bcf0fa65bd0d38d5aa6f01b6d76c72493e7e7c9dd10&req=dScvHsh2nYdaXfMW1HO4zQDnpXZZFYNJJ5GVQckqBzowPlnc6doSFxvglAbK%0ALARqxq17vv8%2B0xVrCq8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788180654/a6bb6b47d492160ce709e2baec8d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c051c7304db92bc869725bcf0fa65bd0d38d5aa6f01b6d76c72493e7e7c9dd10&req=dScvHsh2nYdaXfMW1HO4zQDnpXZZFYNJJ5GVQckqBzowPlnc6doSFxvglAbK%0ALARqxq17vv8%2B0xVrCq8%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Select the toggle to enable Appointment Confirmations.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788182326/466c6c270cb828dc2a43f6a6a247/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f01288f5002577c95e23210152b20759f2e33c9a8f8adc7c7af16575fdacad1&req=dScvHsh2n4JdX%2FMW1HO4zZkxfMUnPA1SiYKDCLJVRMAmHjxHKAwEPTwVgwDs%0APvMKbbOligVI0ZQHs%2F8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788182326/466c6c270cb828dc2a43f6a6a247/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f01288f5002577c95e23210152b20759f2e33c9a8f8adc7c7af16575fdacad1&req=dScvHsh2n4JdX%2FMW1HO4zZkxfMUnPA1SiYKDCLJVRMAmHjxHKAwEPTwVgwDs%0APvMKbbOligVI0ZQHs%2F8%3D%0A)

Configuring the Confirmation
----------------------------

#### Step 1:

Set whether you want to disable confirmations if an appointment is booked on, for example: the same day as the appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788196221/bba1ab9dc234b9e0adcb48f37cd4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=096f643a8ab8cc21875e6bf8b94884dbe20666c6febeef29972f15d2dcdf7c28&req=dScvHsh3m4NdWPMW1HO4zR57Y9jdGoKayHXif2ulBFSRQqeUta00lxrsOca1%0A0PRrGGifHLegR4aKJTM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788196221/bba1ab9dc234b9e0adcb48f37cd4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=096f643a8ab8cc21875e6bf8b94884dbe20666c6febeef29972f15d2dcdf7c28&req=dScvHsh3m4NdWPMW1HO4zR57Y9jdGoKayHXif2ulBFSRQqeUta00lxrsOca1%0A0PRrGGifHLegR4aKJTM%3D%0A)

Note: If you send important information in your confirmation you may want to leave this option disabled.

#### Step 2:

Replies to SMS appointment confirmations will be [visible within PracSuite in several places.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4702551-viewing-sms-replies)
 You can also opt to receive patient **SMS replies via Email** to the respective business email address, or to specific email addresses.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788196584/546f10f5f480cad03a4b24b82b5c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ac4548e63b4ef4c05e2109360c1a22b98a6ba2e0efef6d0b84c028cdc5c68f6&req=dScvHsh3m4RXXfMW1HO4zafxtzrC9K6m1ZVAbg0J7LPmCJHX1mauRTn5va7r%0A33EiuutvzS7MEuCi5jA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788196584/546f10f5f480cad03a4b24b82b5c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ac4548e63b4ef4c05e2109360c1a22b98a6ba2e0efef6d0b84c028cdc5c68f6&req=dScvHsh3m4RXXfMW1HO4zafxtzrC9K6m1ZVAbg0J7LPmCJHX1mauRTn5va7r%0A33EiuutvzS7MEuCi5jA%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

You can opt to enable an **SMS Sender ID**, which will be displayed on the patient's mobile phone when receiving SMS reminders. **Note: Patients will not be able to reply to SMS messages sent with an SMS Sender ID.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788196861/3f8e7578e775fbb6015cdd25cc0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b428c43c727e6c7e6e5f068740e103707b20a5eb0964522d16cb8b87cdfb7761&req=dScvHsh3m4lZWPMW1HO4zbDwxEC1cLCq1PhZ5M0Pq8NR3e8IlhJu45XaVELT%0AD01xlBJFwHgtdI5iHe0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788196861/3f8e7578e775fbb6015cdd25cc0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b428c43c727e6c7e6e5f068740e103707b20a5eb0964522d16cb8b87cdfb7761&req=dScvHsh3m4lZWPMW1HO4zbDwxEC1cLCq1PhZ5M0Pq8NR3e8IlhJu45XaVELT%0AD01xlBJFwHgtdI5iHe0%3D%0A)

### **Setting SMS Templates**

#### Step 1:

Set the **Default [SMS Confirmation Template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317983-creating-sms-templates)
** to be used. This will be used for all appointments unless there is an override set.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788204595/4c48c907b7b866310eb81b61ff53/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=445524d68ccb3fcff498f66cb676949b48a8290fe1e6f8ab51fad2074744fa81&req=dScvHst%2BmYRWXPMW1HO4zXFX7irO5DeE52r4b1JaDAlqdJW8YRHDgeAj2UTB%0AfY3Io68ejokwdE6wmPI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788204595/4c48c907b7b866310eb81b61ff53/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=445524d68ccb3fcff498f66cb676949b48a8290fe1e6f8ab51fad2074744fa81&req=dScvHst%2BmYRWXPMW1HO4zXFX7irO5DeE52r4b1JaDAlqdJW8YRHDgeAj2UTB%0AfY3Io68ejokwdE6wmPI%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select **Add** to configure override templates if you wish to send different SMS templates for appointments with a particular Business, Profession, Practitioner or Appointment type.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788207406/6ea217cf916ec5ad711dfc302982/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5c2ac6a5af41224ece8e66af98b87addefb8d4d6d95cd7c96ba5f3b50b12aaad&req=dScvHst%2BmoVfX%2FMW1HO4ze3lCMg6HO52yk0fWL7EFoEdQmh%2FCoUhnX%2B9SRSq%0AwCr1AGqhgis9tQSgreY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788207406/6ea217cf916ec5ad711dfc302982/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5c2ac6a5af41224ece8e66af98b87addefb8d4d6d95cd7c96ba5f3b50b12aaad&req=dScvHst%2BmoVfX%2FMW1HO4ze3lCMg6HO52yk0fWL7EFoEdQmh%2FCoUhnX%2B9SRSq%0AwCr1AGqhgis9tQSgreY%3D%0A)

Set an override for each case that requires a different template.

Note: Overrides higher in the list take priority over those lower in the list. Because of this, make sure the more specific overrides are put closer to the top of the list. You can re-organise the overrides by hovering your cursor over an entry and using the **||** symbol to drag-and-drop them into the desired order.

### Exclusions

If required, you can also prevent/exclude Appointment Confirmations from being sent for particular Businesses, Practitioners and Appointment Types.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788211704/5fea132e7a811e3445c219751790/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7b21c931e3d7cb4fda08a94fe7e50e285e886398f8dd7b3e70217655ca5b2e22&req=dScvHst%2FnIZfXfMW1HO4zUQGruhGr4fFAPBJ6nwboGqJhNMuysqlQPUwtLvq%0Ar2UVJ5Mskexhra5fpLU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788211704/5fea132e7a811e3445c219751790/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7b21c931e3d7cb4fda08a94fe7e50e285e886398f8dd7b3e70217655ca5b2e22&req=dScvHst%2FnIZfXfMW1HO4zUQGruhGr4fFAPBJ6nwboGqJhNMuysqlQPUwtLvq%0Ar2UVJ5Mskexhra5fpLU%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to confirm your changes.

Preferences
-----------

Appointment confirmations will be sent to patients according to the Confirmations preferences set on their patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788219655/ac368f6cb403967ad8af59f8d851/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b48b500ca40f672061f4cd65c8d4db6ff301134833073a736e584269c76cd71&req=dScvHst%2FlIdaXPMW1HO4zeGLdny%2Fos%2FieUzE0JJqm%2F49m4V6Msg4xIjTjNqZ%0AUaeJOS4R%2BeHObBq2K1Q%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788219655/ac368f6cb403967ad8af59f8d851/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b48b500ca40f672061f4cd65c8d4db6ff301134833073a736e584269c76cd71&req=dScvHst%2FlIdaXPMW1HO4zeGLdny%2Fos%2FieUzE0JJqm%2F49m4V6Msg4xIjTjNqZ%0AUaeJOS4R%2BeHObBq2K1Q%3D%0A)

When booking or rescheduling appointments, confirmation SMS messages will be sent according to your preferences. You can set whether Confirmations are re-sent when rescheduling appointments on the [main Confirmations page](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/confirmations)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788292244/329bc88ce2e3fd4146c13237f029/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3891b4e87a0a43e5eaa35210381e1cbe082cfce5166f12b2553ac0ce1781cb01&req=dScvHst3n4NbXfMW1HO4zRzD14ktTiYhJ8B3DlcOEShpuWBLF04ohgGMmrX8%0AmzZEzNago3dD6h4iPeI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788292244/329bc88ce2e3fd4146c13237f029/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3891b4e87a0a43e5eaa35210381e1cbe082cfce5166f12b2553ac0ce1781cb01&req=dScvHst3n4NbXfMW1HO4zRzD14ktTiYhJ8B3DlcOEShpuWBLF04ohgGMmrX8%0AmzZEzNago3dD6h4iPeI%3D%0A)

Appointment confirmations are not currently supported for booking [appointment schedules](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059210-how-to-book-multiple-appointments)
.

When booking new appointments in particular, use the drop-down arrow to book the appointment without sending a confirmation SMS or email.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788178884/872b0a814fc12596fd89b82f963e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9d7124179a1e8fe35cb7ac3604ac1be8ac04c1ec1422ce35947e66356db2b71&req=dScvHsh5lYlXXfMW1HO4zVh2HyvN1vGgQnrjRXKgLt7aWYie3dwGI7u44VOx%0Ac4VimQ2zKJwpaZnOh24%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788178884/872b0a814fc12596fd89b82f963e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9d7124179a1e8fe35cb7ac3604ac1be8ac04c1ec1422ce35947e66356db2b71&req=dScvHsh5lYlXXfMW1HO4zVh2HyvN1vGgQnrjRXKgLt7aWYie3dwGI7u44VOx%0Ac4VimQ2zKJwpaZnOh24%3D%0A)

For Online Booking Confirmation configuration, please see this article: [Online Booking Confirmations](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10911317-online-booking-confirmations)

Form Triage
===========
