_This article assumes you are familiar with and using the Forms features in PracSuite. [Click here to learn more.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789041-forms-overview)
_

Overview
========

Form Triage brings all your patient form submissions together in one clear, actionable view. It allows your team to **screen completed forms in bulk**, **view patient responses to key questions in bulk**, and **update triage statuses** as patients move through your intake process.

From a single page, you can **identify new patient requests**, **assess suitability**, and **communicate with patients in bulk**, keeping your intake workflow efficient, organised, and easy to manage.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805834117/2e961ef0407ee0482cf78f04f8b2/CleanShot+2025-10-31+at+11_16_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b709c51e4c1e61a21367029850dc3e40402a0f6f6787da87085c6f3917610462&req=dSgnE8F9mYBeXvMW1HO4zZQZnH2xWfOuILaNNpjKEkcZZOxpF18BJh8Df2GX%0AvwSCDAU0ZfeOkm%2F0xoM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805834117/2e961ef0407ee0482cf78f04f8b2/CleanShot+2025-10-31+at+11_16_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b709c51e4c1e61a21367029850dc3e40402a0f6f6787da87085c6f3917610462&req=dSgnE8F9mYBeXvMW1HO4zZQZnH2xWfOuILaNNpjKEkcZZOxpF18BJh8Df2GX%0AvwSCDAU0ZfeOkm%2F0xoM%3D%0A)

From the **[Tools >](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/formtriage)
** [**Form Triage**](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/formtriage)
 page, you can:

*   View all completed forms (with triage enabled) and their responses in a single grid
    
*   Filter forms by triage status, date, or key question responses
    
*   Update triage statuses individually or in bulk (e.g. in review, awaiting callback,
    
*   Send bulk messages to patients as they move through your intake process
    

This feature is especially useful for practices that receive new patient or referral requests through online forms and need to screen and manage them quickly.

### Use cases

Form Triage has been designed for clinics that manage **high patient demand**, particularly those supporting **NDIS participants with extensive waiting lists**. It helps practices **screen new patient enquiries more effectively**, reviewing key responses in bulk to assess suitability and prioritise next steps.

Form Triage can be used for a range of administrative and clinical workflows, including:

*   Screening **new patient intake forms** before creating records
    
*   Reviewing **pre-consult questionnaires** to determine suitability
    
*   Tracking **multi-step onboarding** processes
    
*   Managing **referrals or requests** that require approval before booking appointments
    
*   Sending **confirmation or rejection emails** in bulk
    

Choosing Form Questions to Display in Triage
============================================

To make form responses visible and filterable in the Triage view, the relevant form questions must be configured for triage.

1.  Go to **Settings > Forms > Templates**.
    
2.  Open the form template you want to include in Triage.
    
3.  Select the **Form Triage** tab.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803861930/42bd1a454c54e83344bd3117ef0d/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+11_15_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1062197eeaa3fe6dc09db99d132a306a2cc0aa19a30fbb83e79c759f7bf6263c&req=dSgnFcF4nIhcWfMW1HO4zRe%2B%2FNS3JUP5dBVB0I%2F2Xq78fhZS3Cn34r7oV37s%0Aar9P%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803861930/42bd1a454c54e83344bd3117ef0d/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+11_15_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1062197eeaa3fe6dc09db99d132a306a2cc0aa19a30fbb83e79c759f7bf6263c&req=dSgnFcF4nIhcWfMW1HO4zRe%2B%2FNS3JUP5dBVB0I%2F2Xq78fhZS3Cn34r7oV37s%0Aar9P%0A)
    
4.  **Enable Form Triage** on this form template  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803862565/fba14d2244e0216945b4be7f2584/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+11_16_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fae4c0f4571d39f7167f0aa6cd3379cd80aa70bc4cdef93289ffa4e7968de47d&req=dSgnFcF4n4RZXPMW1HO4zSb7lOFmSL88nuFUUpHApG8tv2sTvHLmFMJaxBBj%0AXxO5%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803862565/fba14d2244e0216945b4be7f2584/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+11_16_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fae4c0f4571d39f7167f0aa6cd3379cd80aa70bc4cdef93289ffa4e7968de47d&req=dSgnFcF4n4RZXPMW1HO4zSb7lOFmSL88nuFUUpHApG8tv2sTvHLmFMJaxBBj%0AXxO5%0A)
    
5.  Head back to the **Form Builder** tab.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803866196/3262e43d37d26593caa7ae5d5ac2/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+11_20_59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1387d53574dcc66bf8a790c44e8c41cd17eb14755029a000caabc3cffa3e29c8&req=dSgnFcF4m4BWX%2FMW1HO4zUC7wxtcnzfxX3hKCnDk7ls33jrj5QQFk2ObF%2FiX%0AhSEw%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803866196/3262e43d37d26593caa7ae5d5ac2/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+11_20_59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1387d53574dcc66bf8a790c44e8c41cd17eb14755029a000caabc3cffa3e29c8&req=dSgnFcF4m4BWX%2FMW1HO4zUC7wxtcnzfxX3hKCnDk7ls33jrj5QQFk2ObF%2FiX%0AhSEw%0A)
    
6.  Identify the questions you want to appear as columns in the Triage grid and enable **Form Triage** for each of these questions.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803867127/27d4bed19ec1ad79d7a6c1c61c2d/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+11_22_14.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a15c68b0c21bff04d8184cbffa919563d1557f81c9ddf45bb54342e037ae5be&req=dSgnFcF4moBdXvMW1HO4zUBWLTr6GAildTavaKP%2F8i7srDCEfag9JBW1QUcB%0AggjL%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803867127/27d4bed19ec1ad79d7a6c1c61c2d/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+11_22_14.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a15c68b0c21bff04d8184cbffa919563d1557f81c9ddf45bb54342e037ae5be&req=dSgnFcF4moBdXvMW1HO4zUBWLTr6GAildTavaKP%2F8i7srDCEfag9JBW1QUcB%0AggjL%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
7.  Once you've enabled the Tirage option on the relevant questions, head back to the **Form Triage tab**.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803867895/dafc537fb7f320cad38f155f7ef7/CleanShot%2B2025-10-30%2Bat%2B11_23_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9b291f02472a705d80d2ce331b79b2e7f3baa6c64d82edf591623bbeaf0e196&req=dSgnFcF4molWXPMW1HO4zdsX7%2FsTJz9JeLjQ%2F8YK7YDfHmek2P3Ial013JU%2B%0Am%2FRv%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1803867895/dafc537fb7f320cad38f155f7ef7/CleanShot%2B2025-10-30%2Bat%2B11_23_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9b291f02472a705d80d2ce331b79b2e7f3baa6c64d82edf591623bbeaf0e196&req=dSgnFcF4molWXPMW1HO4zdsX7%2FsTJz9JeLjQ%2F8YK7YDfHmek2P3Ial013JU%2B%0Am%2FRv%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
8.  Under the **Form Triage Elements** section, you will see all questions within the form that have triage enabled.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804095737/ab27ebd4ca228691ff8323cc405a/CleanShot%2B2025-10-30%2Bat%2B11_23_28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=574e6e4c46d31416996655bc0ddf7cd46ad8df19ecb57aed7ed8686d7bf21a20&req=dSgnEsl3mIZcXvMW1HO4zYKNEZnFzbQRuId8BhVLMta8MNY7b7ChNZIEYj6C%0A71Zd%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804095737/ab27ebd4ca228691ff8323cc405a/CleanShot%2B2025-10-30%2Bat%2B11_23_28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=574e6e4c46d31416996655bc0ddf7cd46ad8df19ecb57aed7ed8686d7bf21a20&req=dSgnEsl3mIZcXvMW1HO4zYKNEZnFzbQRuId8BhVLMta8MNY7b7ChNZIEYj6C%0A71Zd%0A)
    
      
    The order of these questions will map to the order of the columns in the form triage page. You can use the arrow icons to reorder questions as required.
    

  
Customising How Responses Are Displayed In Triage Grid
---------------------------------------------------------

Some triage questions have additional configuration options that can be managed using the cog menu when hovering over a question in the Form Triage Elements grid.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804097490/0fadd8585dda26841c33b7a82240/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_28_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7de2d879479a5a8c1c885d846536c86eb99efcea78876eb5215050374a7d1007&req=dSgnEsl3moVWWfMW1HO4zUPbfooAnmTRss6r4VzqzeVOoo8kfkfnIoqZy1cs%0AOrID0bpLnDonkIpAI4M%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804097490/0fadd8585dda26841c33b7a82240/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_28_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7de2d879479a5a8c1c885d846536c86eb99efcea78876eb5215050374a7d1007&req=dSgnEsl3moVWWfMW1HO4zUPbfooAnmTRss6r4VzqzeVOoo8kfkfnIoqZy1cs%0AOrID0bpLnDonkIpAI4M%3D%0A)

In the example below, we can customise how the colour of each response to this multiple-choice question from the form is displayed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804097908/88e0a9fd5eeada605f0f59bfe1a3/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_29_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab2f92167c8bf63af8e343c3e29ca175d6207ad59f998e6e7362fb709a95f594&req=dSgnEsl3mohfUfMW1HO4zSdOoHHylz2kIn4EdMjWh6NA1Zi6nqErEkVda20G%0Ak93cCbtsX0r56AGMqeQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804097908/88e0a9fd5eeada605f0f59bfe1a3/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_29_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab2f92167c8bf63af8e343c3e29ca175d6207ad59f998e6e7362fb709a95f594&req=dSgnEsl3mohfUfMW1HO4zSdOoHHylz2kIn4EdMjWh6NA1Zi6nqErEkVda20G%0Ak93cCbtsX0r56AGMqeQ%3D%0A)

  
Once configured, new responses to this form will automatically appear in Form Triage page with those fields visible.

Managing Triage Status
======================

Each form submission includes a triage status that reflects where the patient is in your intake process. Updating the triage status helps your team track the patient’s progress and ensures consistent follow-up communication.

Common examples include:

*   **Awaiting Review:** New forms that have come back that are yet to be processed
    
*   **In Review:** Currently being assessed
    
*   **Eligible:** Approved and ready to book
    
*   **Rejected:** Patient is not suitable for services at your clinic
    
*   **Complete:** The patient has completed your intake flow and no longer needs to appear in the triage page.
    

PracSuite offers a selection of default form triage statuses; however, you can customise these statuses for each form template in the Triage tab.

The default triage status is assigned to all newly submitted forms.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804100328/927536f030ca97434f0fc9e8b214/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_31_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a9441946318b586a6f8395fe2912b3072d2acc007c4ace330e7ecada8622b4d&req=dSgnEsh%2BnYJdUfMW1HO4zQV2wsBafSCcWY1kVofYokzM54X6iE2fBeNhXCd1%0A%2Fu6KHLmGXjZbGwi%2BWZ0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804100328/927536f030ca97434f0fc9e8b214/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_31_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a9441946318b586a6f8395fe2912b3072d2acc007c4ace330e7ecada8622b4d&req=dSgnEsh%2BnYJdUfMW1HO4zQV2wsBafSCcWY1kVofYokzM54X6iE2fBeNhXCd1%0A%2Fu6KHLmGXjZbGwi%2BWZ0%3D%0A)

These statuses can be updated for a specific form submission from the Form Triage page, as shown below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804103822/c93c600a5c758305ccc3e436065a/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_34_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8f306e45c51f5efde72efa520588181a8de65a244767a2883a88c83826375f68&req=dSgnEsh%2BnoldW%2FMW1HO4zWW8lcJ3CbenANFlmLQ7%2F%2F7RNsZPBwqI6%2FBwdhPM%0AWIEAngDS7RHFuTqxrvE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804103822/c93c600a5c758305ccc3e436065a/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_34_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8f306e45c51f5efde72efa520588181a8de65a244767a2883a88c83826375f68&req=dSgnEsh%2BnoldW%2FMW1HO4zWW8lcJ3CbenANFlmLQ7%2F%2F7RNsZPBwqI6%2FBwdhPM%0AWIEAngDS7RHFuTqxrvE%3D%0A)

The triage status can also be managed from the Forms tab of that patient file. Hover over the triage checkbox to see the current status and any triage comments, or use the Manage Form Triage button to make changes to triage status and comments.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805754014/388b377d8b7b1477bf6abf7dee26/CleanShot+X+2025-10-31+08_44_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dc4f113486bd23a2c725c9bb3d1e0013d3299bbd4fda4509f27717605052fe1&req=dSgnE857mYFeXfMW1HO4zVAnpT9DS1Apl8TAm0JSONvJIDBEocxX%2Fb0%2BwCX9%0AYb6fEIQygC%2B75ruD7go%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805754014/388b377d8b7b1477bf6abf7dee26/CleanShot+X+2025-10-31+08_44_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dc4f113486bd23a2c725c9bb3d1e0013d3299bbd4fda4509f27717605052fe1&req=dSgnE857mYFeXfMW1HO4zVAnpT9DS1Apl8TAm0JSONvJIDBEocxX%2Fb0%2BwCX9%0AYb6fEIQygC%2B75ruD7go%3D%0A)

Using the Form Triage Tool
==========================

To view form submissions:

1.  Go to **[Tools > Form Triage](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/formtriage)
    **
    
2.  Select a form from the dropdown menu
    
3.  Select the form status you want to review
    
4.  Select Load Forms.
    
5.  The Triage grid will display all completed responses for that form.
    

Each row represents a single form submission and displays:

*   Patient name
    
*   Current triage status
    
*   Responses to the selected triage questions
    

You can resize the column widths, and your preferences will be remembered per form template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804107362/fd217a5629d7ba592d1e4e5ea6e6/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_36_54.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=02221e75bd7c4bf7c90fc063a05a9a36679504a5e96889505e4a6d5c7ea73274&req=dSgnEsh%2BmoJZW%2FMW1HO4ze7tOjMU7Q37bkJ26XRQFcZ0eHxvPBzZpZ%2FOAi68%0AZET551amR9%2FDiPAzNvo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804107362/fd217a5629d7ba592d1e4e5ea6e6/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+15_36_54.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=02221e75bd7c4bf7c90fc063a05a9a36679504a5e96889505e4a6d5c7ea73274&req=dSgnEsh%2BmoJZW%2FMW1HO4ze7tOjMU7Q37bkJ26XRQFcZ0eHxvPBzZpZ%2FOAi68%0AZET551amR9%2FDiPAzNvo%3D%0A)

Filtering Results
=================

Within the Form Triage page, use the filter icon in the column headers to filter the results with the selected filters. Multiple filters can be combined to narrow down results.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804007509/cd96da57522d47c88968edf32e95/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+13_58_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8eca87e0e5403448d4896037a5d01f584fdff4b1099f185030643147b158beb8&req=dSgnEsl%2BmoRfUPMW1HO4zd7pLexpbb1slXbKkbEfJQzlL%2FdPimZIkWIcJbPC%0AHjSAfw7854OnzcdKAvc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804007509/cd96da57522d47c88968edf32e95/CleanShot+2025-10-30+at+13_58_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8eca87e0e5403448d4896037a5d01f584fdff4b1099f185030643147b158beb8&req=dSgnEsl%2BmoRfUPMW1HO4zd7pLexpbb1slXbKkbEfJQzlL%2FdPimZIkWIcJbPC%0AHjSAfw7854OnzcdKAvc%3D%0A)

Click **Clear Filters** to reset the view.

Actions within the Form Triage
==============================

From the Triage grid, you can:

*   **View Entire Form:** Open the complete form submission.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805825585/07812e58b30764fd3fb359bded54/CleanShot+2025-10-31+at+11_05_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f82756f303c66c99e37c852fc0e34ca9869e2bcb6530b0d8b34f29ea47ef8323&req=dSgnE8F8mIRXXPMW1HO4zUKvzPQiKPQlQR5Oekg22vAdOblWh1AX7ya7rSh7%0AlGSV%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805825585/07812e58b30764fd3fb359bded54/CleanShot+2025-10-31+at+11_05_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f82756f303c66c99e37c852fc0e34ca9869e2bcb6530b0d8b34f29ea47ef8323&req=dSgnE8F8mIRXXPMW1HO4zUKvzPQiKPQlQR5Oekg22vAdOblWh1AX7ya7rSh7%0AlGSV%0A)
    
*   **Patient Quick Actions:** Access common tools for that patient's file.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805826231/4761c34d7c49722824d007d24123/CleanShot+2025-10-31+at+11_06_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a378e0142d3e441fb8acd0f25cf9ab887e59c13e3d545b64e0a1aa496b1b730e&req=dSgnE8F8m4NcWPMW1HO4zbqi9Djn7xysVJOkQtzJkWY3ZytvpkhORZHarP7o%0AxiWW%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805826231/4761c34d7c49722824d007d24123/CleanShot+2025-10-31+at+11_06_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a378e0142d3e441fb8acd0f25cf9ab887e59c13e3d545b64e0a1aa496b1b730e&req=dSgnE8F8m4NcWPMW1HO4zbqi9Djn7xysVJOkQtzJkWY3ZytvpkhORZHarP7o%0AxiWW%0A)
    
*   **Update Status:** Change the triage status for that submission.
    
*   **Triage Comments:**
    

Updating Triage Status in Bulk
------------------------------

To update multiple submissions at once:

1.  Select the forms you want to update using the checkboxes on the left.
    
2.  Click **Update Triage Status**.
    
3.  Choose the new triage status and confirm.
    

All selected forms will be updated simultaneously, making it easy to manage large volumes of submissions.

Send Message In Bulk
--------------------

You can also send messages to multiple patients at once, such as:

*   Confirming new patient acceptance
    
*   Advising next steps in the intake process
    
*   Notifying patients that you’re unable to accept them at this time
    

To do this:

1.  Select the relevant submissions.
    
2.  Click **Send Message**.
    
3.  Choose an existing **Message Template**, or compose a custom email.
    
4.  Review and send.
    

Forms Completed Before Enabling Triage on a Template
====================================================

Only forms **submitted after Triage has been enabled** on a form template will appear in the Form Triage page. Forms that were **completed before Triage was introduced**, or before it was **enabled on the relevant template**, will not be displayed by default.

If you need to include one of these earlier submissions in Triage, you can do so manually:

1.  Go to the **Forms** tab within the patient’s file.
    
2.  Hover over the completed or processed form.
    
3.  Click **Manage Form Triage** to add that form to the Triage view.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805694822/35c1d4f67ef008328f8021d9e3aa/CleanShot+2025-10-31+at+08_44_02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8a8ef57726ce05a70c5be7df97593e862165f484819f1939d8bcff088b1e4922&req=dSgnE893mYldW%2FMW1HO4zeoQVeKFemEqv6s118NUXcK6ll3bkQD49fvjntZK%0A6VUitzRh7%2F8rYOqjkW8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1805694822/35c1d4f67ef008328f8021d9e3aa/CleanShot+2025-10-31+at+08_44_02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8a8ef57726ce05a70c5be7df97593e862165f484819f1939d8bcff088b1e4922&req=dSgnE893mYldW%2FMW1HO4zeoQVeKFemEqv6s118NUXcK6ll3bkQD49fvjntZK%0A6VUitzRh7%2F8rYOqjkW8%3D%0A)

**Note:** Data shown in the Form Triage page is based on the **current version** of the form template. If older form responses don’t align with the current question set, only the matching responses will appear in Triage.

Parchment Integration

Parchment Integration
=====================

Integrating with medical prescription software Parchment

Updated over a month ago

Table of contents

[Enabling the Parchment integration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12865300-parchment-integration#h_4e9a69c274)

[Linking Prescribers with PracSuite Practitioner Files](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12865300-parchment-integration#h_30acacdbf4)

[Using Parchment features from the Clinical Notes tab in PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12865300-parchment-integration#h_5df809809d)

Connect your Parchment subscription to allow authorised prescribers to open Parchment patient profiles from within PracSuite. Once linked, practitioners can:

*   Create new Parchment patient profiles
    
*   Open Parchment patient profiles to create new medical prescriptions, including escripts
    
*   View existing prescriptions for a patient within PracSuite
    

This integration requires a subscription to Parchment. Click below to view their guide to setting up a Parchment account.

The setup will involve creating prescriber profiles for any practitioners who wish to use the Parchment integration features in PracSuite.

[Getting Started With Parchment](https://help.parchment.health/en/articles/10843014-setting-up-a-new-account-organisation)

Enabling the Parchment integration
==================================

Once you've completed the setup of your Parchment account, you can start the process of integrating with PracSuite.

1\. In PracSuite, go to [Settings > Integrations > Parchment.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/parchment)

2\. Enable the integration and select **Add Organisation.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845624123/93aca24c317f8bf895d8cc2adbf7/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_09_15.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f4d60868286438f5f539317fda602d01f0e4ef4cf68b471cc524530c8ebdcdaf&req=dSgjE898mYBdWvMW1HO4zVpiYEE2Ap0ftdZ5vHfC7IPNDdsffX7HPUon62Bo%0AVtgkC%2FVXsNpnsXJC2T8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845624123/93aca24c317f8bf895d8cc2adbf7/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_09_15.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f4d60868286438f5f539317fda602d01f0e4ef4cf68b471cc524530c8ebdcdaf&req=dSgjE898mYBdWvMW1HO4zVpiYEE2Ap0ftdZ5vHfC7IPNDdsffX7HPUon62Bo%0AVtgkC%2FVXsNpnsXJC2T8%3D%0A)

3\. Next, log in to your Parchment account and go to the **Onboarding** tab

4\. Select **Integrate Your Practice Management System**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845659990/0c4d20b125a2fd7ad1173b5e5083/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_57_10.png?expires=1771821900&signature=43b825cfc138bad56a9913cd1d9c2193e811a45d95a0da48cdb16de4dbc483cf&req=dSgjE897lIhWWfMW1HO4zahmaWmpZHs%2BTjrHqL8mHwE73MYGg70uNrMK%2F3Je%0AGw4Amv9cJoUx%2FpQJc3o%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845659990/0c4d20b125a2fd7ad1173b5e5083/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_57_10.png?expires=1771821900&signature=43b825cfc138bad56a9913cd1d9c2193e811a45d95a0da48cdb16de4dbc483cf&req=dSgjE897lIhWWfMW1HO4zahmaWmpZHs%2BTjrHqL8mHwE73MYGg70uNrMK%2F3Je%0AGw4Amv9cJoUx%2FpQJc3o%3D%0A)

5\. Scroll down to PracSuite and select **Manage**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845660142/5121d747d8d04298cdb52027e547/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_57_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d5572f9d2b5aa9b8d7b50e4f8386be11db06f1effffb68aa496539ae54f2e051&req=dSgjE894nYBbW%2FMW1HO4zbW3lBKyPJQHqY49VW5nEcGnkeTqcMT%2FTkVD9JvD%0AnlrF%2F20eA%2BF02HKrNdY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845660142/5121d747d8d04298cdb52027e547/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_57_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d5572f9d2b5aa9b8d7b50e4f8386be11db06f1effffb68aa496539ae54f2e051&req=dSgjE894nYBbW%2FMW1HO4zbW3lBKyPJQHqY49VW5nEcGnkeTqcMT%2FTkVD9JvD%0AnlrF%2F20eA%2BF02HKrNdY%3D%0A)

6\. Select **Generate Credentials**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845660664/f5f49a45f5fe363a921017943b79/CleanShot%2B2025-11-24%2Bat%2B08_56_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b43373928563369611fabeb64f42edd98c90d8e586cb01dabf0fe04ec3b52af2&req=dSgjE894nYdZXfMW1HO4zccifY%2FTfmjUP5zxqEiR9fus5ybqnqfmLevYaTi7%0AY3m2d7S4CrAAzA2NXAA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845660664/f5f49a45f5fe363a921017943b79/CleanShot%2B2025-11-24%2Bat%2B08_56_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b43373928563369611fabeb64f42edd98c90d8e586cb01dabf0fe04ec3b52af2&req=dSgjE894nYdZXfMW1HO4zccifY%2FTfmjUP5zxqEiR9fus5ybqnqfmLevYaTi7%0AY3m2d7S4CrAAzA2NXAA%3D%0A)

7\. You will be shown an Organisation ID and Organisation Secret. Copy your Organisation ID and Organisation Secret into PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845625991/8b8eabc0d23ab5a52eee57b8fe18/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_11_29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0f9375304dcaa29ffda60eda4ea769b1be7534f6e306b644b517f61da4d96584&req=dSgjE898mIhWWPMW1HO4zeK%2FaJq0YQ9IZBrjHiYVfVKzPiQtbfS0O22cLmVq%0A4SABmkdi4w%2FTyPgV4HU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845625991/8b8eabc0d23ab5a52eee57b8fe18/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_11_29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0f9375304dcaa29ffda60eda4ea769b1be7534f6e306b644b517f61da4d96584&req=dSgjE898mIhWWPMW1HO4zeK%2FaJq0YQ9IZBrjHiYVfVKzPiQtbfS0O22cLmVq%0A4SABmkdi4w%2FTyPgV4HU%3D%0A)

Linking Prescribers with PracSuite Practitioner Files
-----------------------------------------------------

You will also need to associate each PracSuite practitioner with their corresponding Parchment User ID.

1\. You can find a prescriber's Parchment User ID within Parchment in [Settings > Users](https://portal.dev.parchment.health/dashboard/settings/users)

2\. In PracSuite, select **Add User.**

3\. Enter the associated Parchment User ID for the associated practitioner

4\. Select **Save** to finalise you're changes.

If you've entered the correct Parchment Organisation credentials, you should see a verified badge.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845626391/e9731e23f566bfdb74af2034707f/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_12_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee6207c8086805fbc3bc6ecc78625cf02ac10f11fef036d47c16c265aa998c7c&req=dSgjE898m4JWWPMW1HO4zahb0ngVvj5eU7rRDfhbBPukaJFn%2BWkENtzWzKUf%0A%2BhgKLtGU5mTjO3MrZDI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845626391/e9731e23f566bfdb74af2034707f/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_12_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee6207c8086805fbc3bc6ecc78625cf02ac10f11fef036d47c16c265aa998c7c&req=dSgjE898m4JWWPMW1HO4zahb0ngVvj5eU7rRDfhbBPukaJFn%2BWkENtzWzKUf%0A%2BhgKLtGU5mTjO3MrZDI%3D%0A)

Using Parchment features from the Clinical Notes tab in PracSuite
=================================================================

Only users with a linked practitioner file can access the Parchment integration features. If you are not a practitioner, or your PracSuite user account is not linked to your practitioner file, Parchment features will not be available.

[Learn how to link a user to a practitioner file here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5258078-marking-a-user-as-a-practitioner)

From the Clinical Notes tab of a patient file, you will find options to:

**Create In Parchment -** Creates a new patient file in Parchment

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845808976/cf2a4614594087a5dc153c07c608/CleanShot%2B2025-11-24%2Bat%2B08_32_29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c5b6731620492af9433b1d1d692b69cec78e3ff204362069b0a0c372d639ffa4&req=dSgjE8F%2BlYhYX%2FMW1HO4zdfRPSEF05B2nGiWnl082eKIhVXkYdyZwZSaEqNW%0ALY3kzxaxwYtNFmrOaVY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845808976/cf2a4614594087a5dc153c07c608/CleanShot%2B2025-11-24%2Bat%2B08_32_29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c5b6731620492af9433b1d1d692b69cec78e3ff204362069b0a0c372d639ffa4&req=dSgjE8F%2BlYhYX%2FMW1HO4zdfRPSEF05B2nGiWnl082eKIhVXkYdyZwZSaEqNW%0ALY3kzxaxwYtNFmrOaVY%3D%0A)

PracSuite will pass the following patient information to Parchment:

*   First Name (required)
    
*   Middle Name
    
*   Last Name (required)
    
*   Date of Birth (required)
    
*   Sex (required)
    
*   Full Address (required)
    
*   Phone
    
*   Email
    
*   Medicare Card Number
    
*   DVA Card Number
    

**Open In Parchment -** You'll see this button if a PracSuite patient file has already been linked with a Parchment patient profile.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845802642/440d26e6cb068803f20b187f5e99/CleanShot%2B2025-11-24%2Bat%2B08_17_22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=75e6ac01a2fadf03a3e4d5009d21a55740761392af5517b2ee92c222aeb9226c&req=dSgjE8F%2Bn4dbW%2FMW1HO4zdNjbGuve%2BmyH85aPdR8Pc6OWY%2FI0ObvOI0IpR4i%0AfwNou8NS1iGu%2FcRIJY0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845802642/440d26e6cb068803f20b187f5e99/CleanShot%2B2025-11-24%2Bat%2B08_17_22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=75e6ac01a2fadf03a3e4d5009d21a55740761392af5517b2ee92c222aeb9226c&req=dSgjE8F%2Bn4dbW%2FMW1HO4zdNjbGuve%2BmyH85aPdR8Pc6OWY%2FI0ObvOI0IpR4i%0AfwNou8NS1iGu%2FcRIJY0%3D%0A)

**Viewing Existing Prescriptions -** After starting a new clinical note, select the **Parchment** tab in the history pane on the right to view existing prescriptions for this patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845627590/27534907703e413f2a909a7396cf/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_14_03.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09556e140c2daa3cde89c0f2721574e71500cb2be004403d4705efb58d952484&req=dSgjE898moRWWfMW1HO4zYlHdz2KPlNmPabMmD%2FKnQdRg%2BK410LKs7iTdmXx%0A4Bol25NILJFLo3Pi4so%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845627590/27534907703e413f2a909a7396cf/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+08_14_03.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09556e140c2daa3cde89c0f2721574e71500cb2be004403d4705efb58d952484&req=dSgjE898moRWWfMW1HO4zYlHdz2KPlNmPabMmD%2FKnQdRg%2BK410LKs7iTdmXx%0A4Bol25NILJFLo3Pi4so%3D%0A)

The Collapse All/Expand All button can help view a full history of a patient's prescriptions. You can also use the refresh icon to refresh the list after creating a new prescription.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845789080/e6cf1be17e2701b41caabfce6649/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+11_36_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e5c16a5898b9935a1d33a8697a221ccce6ec32c0bd23e0ffe054b08d4a828e1&req=dSgjE852lIFXWfMW1HO4zYL%2F9q7wWhYGXho3e4BK9VN%2BNyNEZqiONpWni0cA%0AYipbGFb8GAkqi5mnq88%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1845789080/e6cf1be17e2701b41caabfce6649/CleanShot+2025-11-24+at+11_36_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e5c16a5898b9935a1d33a8697a221ccce6ec32c0bd23e0ffe054b08d4a828e1&req=dSgjE852lIFXWfMW1HO4zYL%2F9q7wWhYGXho3e4BK9VN%2BNyNEZqiONpWni0cA%0AYipbGFb8GAkqi5mnq88%3D%0A)

Using pivot tables in Excel: An example in finding patients with the most appointments

Using pivot tables in Excel: An example in finding patients with the most appointments
======================================================================================

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Example scenario: Identifying which patients have had the most appointments in a specific period.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12999038-using-pivot-tables-in-excel-an-example-in-finding-patients-with-the-most-appointments#h_6771b7f8c6)

[Success!](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12999038-using-pivot-tables-in-excel-an-example-in-finding-patients-with-the-most-appointments#h_959a9c4a34)

Pivot tables help you quickly summarise and explore large sets of data in Excel without needing complex formulas.

You can drag fields into rows, columns, and values to regroup the information in different ways, such as totals by category or averages by date. They make it easy to filter, sort, and drill into the details, so you can spot patterns or answer questions about your data with just a few clicks.

Most reports in PracSuite include an Export option, so you can take advantage of this feature in various ways. To get you started, this article covers one common scenario in using Pivot Tables from an PracSuite export.

**Please note:**  
Excel is a third-party application and sits outside the scope of our PracSuite support. We’ve put this guide together to help you get started, but we can’t provide troubleshooting or training for Excel features.

If you need further help, Microsoft’s support resources or online Excel tutorials are your best next step.

* * *

**Example scenario:** Identifying which patients have had the most appointments in a specific period.
=====================================================================================================

1) Go to **Reports > Appointment > Appointment**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864389635/d820c0dff7d0e3f39dd79f6b6201/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1438f81ae1ad7305c1f781a8e12f5901a01a0f95d7a03bf1b96b6a7432e8db5&req=dSghEsp2lIdcXPMW1HO4zeAKoLXBsNLHHoIV%2BFhw2AjQ6bIhPLB%2FuxC4sE84%0AO%2FCIvBXENB81P0Pg80E%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864389635/d820c0dff7d0e3f39dd79f6b6201/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1438f81ae1ad7305c1f781a8e12f5901a01a0f95d7a03bf1b96b6a7432e8db5&req=dSghEsp2lIdcXPMW1HO4zeAKoLXBsNLHHoIV%2BFhw2AjQ6bIhPLB%2FuxC4sE84%0AO%2FCIvBXENB81P0Pg80E%3D%0A)

2) Using the report filters available, capture the range of appointments you want to summarise or group in Excel.  
​  
​**For example you can specify things like:**  
\- Date Range  
\- Appointment with (Practitioner)  
\- Appointment Type  
\- Appointment Status  
​  
In this example, we are interested in ''Completed'' appointments that are dated within ''This Month''.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864392903/9fe9a290485e34a4adeab24e8b44/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c3aee1b23fd93aaecf5c78fd8a434c211ce619787b9eb25751a6fdfe455ea8f1&req=dSghEsp3n4hfWvMW1HO4zeFRAWn7ntQ8MfRijwzCh285fo97ureEaqZkC%2FF6%0AdHmL1qGGzQYf20qrV2Y%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864392903/9fe9a290485e34a4adeab24e8b44/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c3aee1b23fd93aaecf5c78fd8a434c211ce619787b9eb25751a6fdfe455ea8f1&req=dSghEsp3n4hfWvMW1HO4zeFRAWn7ntQ8MfRijwzCh285fo97ureEaqZkC%2FF6%0AdHmL1qGGzQYf20qrV2Y%3D%0A)

Since we are looking for **patients** with the largest number of appointments, we also want to keep the report type as ''Patient''.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864393708/57aa3cc64a324eb560455445a2d7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd91d4c367c09d1071678fb969e7f3d71bd65fadc59834ce3ef07a9e72d97a6f&req=dSghEsp3noZfUfMW1HO4zcxPn%2Bjz%2BRrqL8bz1Y7ipuup7dV396Y%2F3d4EZ%2F81%0AvQUQa43HDrkf%2FT%2FjE50%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864393708/57aa3cc64a324eb560455445a2d7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd91d4c367c09d1071678fb969e7f3d71bd65fadc59834ce3ef07a9e72d97a6f&req=dSghEsp3noZfUfMW1HO4zcxPn%2Bjz%2BRrqL8bz1Y7ipuup7dV396Y%2F3d4EZ%2F81%0AvQUQa43HDrkf%2FT%2FjE50%3D%0A)

3) Click **Generate Report**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864395166/7ed9e5776620c765d9dfd3caf88b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de693db76ad4cf09f32ccfe54929c8d967606e9c5cd3c49ab24d7ffddd58073d&req=dSghEsp3mIBZX%2FMW1HO4zaq%2FOtIBKDr7kT98NPqL0oBI98F6xTLZAgPiaNLI%0AiKykrFkeo3%2BxVdyaYiE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864395166/7ed9e5776620c765d9dfd3caf88b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de693db76ad4cf09f32ccfe54929c8d967606e9c5cd3c49ab24d7ffddd58073d&req=dSghEsp3mIBZX%2FMW1HO4zaq%2FOtIBKDr7kT98NPqL0oBI98F6xTLZAgPiaNLI%0AiKykrFkeo3%2BxVdyaYiE%3D%0A)

4) Click the **Export** option, and open the resulting file using Excel.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864401253/55c6a1821758215841ce334cfcf0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06eaa35ee3b7df38083b7c47f8d228487e6c8760ea80e9ca29513dee93f00981&req=dSghEs1%2BnINaWvMW1HO4zbssYgGAmn0VTjrlYd6fqDOWu%2BuLPtRtl3FMVbSn%0AB4LhIjF0ok7Zcm4bnyQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864401253/55c6a1821758215841ce334cfcf0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06eaa35ee3b7df38083b7c47f8d228487e6c8760ea80e9ca29513dee93f00981&req=dSghEs1%2BnINaWvMW1HO4zbssYgGAmn0VTjrlYd6fqDOWu%2BuLPtRtl3FMVbSn%0AB4LhIjF0ok7Zcm4bnyQ%3D%0A)

5) In Excel, go to the **Insert** menu and select **Pivot Table.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864404150/d27d7e98786e85105f561012404f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3350c2a220b5c53877868c2e0f00f6e7e630ea49a35436c9fd8855ede8eee4da&req=dSghEs1%2BmYBaWfMW1HO4zRqyYkvDW9XAITcIAcwE8jxeAlkBTHB1Lnn8fWfo%0Asv9inwxq212KyOyjvCQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864404150/d27d7e98786e85105f561012404f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3350c2a220b5c53877868c2e0f00f6e7e630ea49a35436c9fd8855ede8eee4da&req=dSghEs1%2BmYBaWfMW1HO4zRqyYkvDW9XAITcIAcwE8jxeAlkBTHB1Lnn8fWfo%0Asv9inwxq212KyOyjvCQ%3D%0A)

**Note**: Depending on your goal, it is often easier to select the relevant columns in Excel and use the ''**Recommended Pivot Tables**'' option, which will suggest various breakdowns of the selected data.  
​  
In this example, we are going to setup the pivot table manually to get the result we're looking for.

  
6) When prompted to select from table or range, this can be left as the entire document.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864413006/d8861f3ac09b7edfc8c060ae2872/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9b7d267bd106e7ce1c7b488d9a40afdeb5de270d704c249ba53742ce09464abe&req=dSghEs1%2FnoFfX%2FMW1HO4zatCKFD8ni%2F5beD92ZpKvkJsDz2f4X5FTs81c%2FNC%0A%2FcrFfkB0tqMW5ojpuhA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864413006/d8861f3ac09b7edfc8c060ae2872/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9b7d267bd106e7ce1c7b488d9a40afdeb5de270d704c249ba53742ce09464abe&req=dSghEs1%2FnoFfX%2FMW1HO4zatCKFD8ni%2F5beD92ZpKvkJsDz2f4X5FTs81c%2FNC%0A%2FcrFfkB0tqMW5ojpuhA%3D%0A)

  
Click **OK** to proceed, which will start a new sheet in Excel with your pivot table.  
​  
7) In the **PivotTable Fields** area, we can now select which fields are being added to the report.  
​  
​**In this case, we want to add the following in order:**  
​  
Client ID (as a row)

Patient (as a row)  
Appointment Date (as a value)  
​  
To achieve this, **right-click** these values and choose where it should be added:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864434220/1cddce5e6b43375f4ad7f302ef71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af85f55d89ac134ee7972a96c46c29fa218ec9432402b667f87a0720ef5cf8e1&req=dSghEs19mYNdWfMW1HO4zURK1iDXUsNZ%2FUfh3rGkD9q6Ta294NSNbay2THmm%0AZ5wYvDzNSIQwMQw3YLA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864434220/1cddce5e6b43375f4ad7f302ef71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af85f55d89ac134ee7972a96c46c29fa218ec9432402b667f87a0720ef5cf8e1&req=dSghEs19mYNdWfMW1HO4zURK1iDXUsNZ%2FUfh3rGkD9q6Ta294NSNbay2THmm%0AZ5wYvDzNSIQwMQw3YLA%3D%0A)

When done correctly, you should start seeing a table populate that looks like this:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864434517/d36becf5702bbb8fedd8d4c8c874/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=01ef06391bfd5f9c4ce230a6c8bfdcf70d2dca5c4f9f27b3061d5e7fe5709d98&req=dSghEs19mYReXvMW1HO4zTVn2cYECDq4Us4yyvci861AVMDSIE5fQXUUdbsy%0AtroC0RqheJW6oJgY11k%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864434517/d36becf5702bbb8fedd8d4c8c874/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=01ef06391bfd5f9c4ce230a6c8bfdcf70d2dca5c4f9f27b3061d5e7fe5709d98&req=dSghEs19mYReXvMW1HO4zTVn2cYECDq4Us4yyvci861AVMDSIE5fQXUUdbsy%0AtroC0RqheJW6oJgY11k%3D%0A)

  
​**Where we can see:**

*   The client ID (to account for patients with the same name)
    
*   The patient name
    
*   The total number of appointments per patient or client ID.
    

You could also add additional data into the Rows section, such as the Address, so you can see more identifying information.

8) The last step is to **Sort** this data.

In this example, we want to see which patients have had the most appointments, so we can:  
​  
a) Click on the **filter** drop-down

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864438642/a245e31d61e397b44773a552de1f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0159559d07c91d8c85ade675b8adba9e93abd8baef662142c00cd8290aa77b03&req=dSghEs19lYdbW%2FMW1HO4zaK2JELO11hONtw6YXE7ye%2FFVfB7qqSsOwRG%2BJVk%0AZlZ37pbvXec2M3t6vRc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864438642/a245e31d61e397b44773a552de1f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0159559d07c91d8c85ade675b8adba9e93abd8baef662142c00cd8290aa77b03&req=dSghEs19lYdbW%2FMW1HO4zaK2JELO11hONtw6YXE7ye%2FFVfB7qqSsOwRG%2BJVk%0AZlZ37pbvXec2M3t6vRc%3D%0A)

b) Select **More Sort Options...**  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864427289/df7f4113cea8eddeb4d52249e6f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7ff35ceec55d244ad661869e4cef1c233361e91ccd2e329a8a40bc6b49f1c27f&req=dSghEs18moNXUPMW1HO4zVdBfhIWiyq5oSsViLjgg5mqwDIAhMQ0mLwrlqeV%0AmS9H3DsYVHzjacNk9N0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1864427289/df7f4113cea8eddeb4d52249e6f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7ff35ceec55d244ad661869e4cef1c233361e91ccd2e329a8a40bc6b49f1c27f&req=dSghEs18moNXUPMW1HO4zVdBfhIWiyq5oSsViLjgg5mqwDIAhMQ0mLwrlqeV%0AmS9H3DsYVHzjacNk9N0%3D%0A)

When exporting reports from PracSuite, this same process can be applied to breakdown your data in different ways:

  
e.g.  
​

**1) Patient List (Reports > Patients > Patient List)**

*   Patients by Suburb.
    
*   Patients by Age.
    
*   Patients by Health Fund
    
*   Patients by Occupation
    
*   Patients by Gender
    

**2) Billing Report (Reports > Billing > Billing)**

*   Patients by largest Billed
    
*   Patients by largest Owing
    

Effectively, anything you can think of where you want a different grouping, if it isn't already offered in PracSuite and the data is available.

Adding Rule Outs to the Appointment Book

Adding Rule Outs to the Appointment Book
========================================

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13048869-adding-rule-outs-to-the-appointment-book#h_ccafbb2c72)

[Adding a Rule Out](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13048869-adding-rule-outs-to-the-appointment-book#h_645357624a)

[Removing a Rule Out](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13048869-adding-rule-outs-to-the-appointment-book#h_cab34e6cfc)

Overview
========

Rule Outs can be added to the Appointment Book to make specific times unavailable to bookings on a one-off basis.

Adding a Rule Out
-----------------

#### Step 1:

Highlight the slots that you would like to add the Rule Out to by clicking and dragging your cursor.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1872654977/aee95b2831c9889d580bbedec133/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=951fcaec6b7cd91a4a23d82096dda7bdcfb783ef0fb5b5054541c3bfbcec20a3&req=dSggFM97mYhYXvMW1HO4zezP%2F1vb5T5c6fQu60iA4CQNGdY%2FJN2e2qY91oQA%0A6YVGw4z%2Fwu6%2FyRLarr4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1872654977/aee95b2831c9889d580bbedec133/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=951fcaec6b7cd91a4a23d82096dda7bdcfb783ef0fb5b5054541c3bfbcec20a3&req=dSggFM97mYhYXvMW1HO4zezP%2F1vb5T5c6fQu60iA4CQNGdY%2FJN2e2qY91oQA%0A6YVGw4z%2Fwu6%2FyRLarr4%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click on the Rule Out button in the side-pane that opens.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1872656935/d20bd91cfaf8cbd2f65556b454d5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8ac3cb8d2b9fb46ccbf74601f961b84154197eb6e8718c132678dde000d4fad&req=dSggFM97m4hcXPMW1HO4zepoiKQAUu6RyygrnNWlFEWODKxUeEeU8qEoNYtI%0AB5sPAbampFk30voF1tk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1872656935/d20bd91cfaf8cbd2f65556b454d5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8ac3cb8d2b9fb46ccbf74601f961b84154197eb6e8718c132678dde000d4fad&req=dSggFM97m4hcXPMW1HO4zepoiKQAUu6RyygrnNWlFEWODKxUeEeU8qEoNYtI%0AB5sPAbampFk30voF1tk%3D%0A)

A Rule Out will be added to the selected slots making them unavailable for bookings.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1872657555/82a2a3117bd77f64252119bd48de/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=244b5a7477bd143c6d43658628b390d8ed75b2050cfb8ebaa3d029db9dae780f&req=dSggFM97moRaXPMW1HO4zatHOXW8u%2F5QcYXW76GnQs9r2dr%2Frc2E1QKwF6hU%0AmdBhIehNSf0oRmVmU5k%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1872657555/82a2a3117bd77f64252119bd48de/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=244b5a7477bd143c6d43658628b390d8ed75b2050cfb8ebaa3d029db9dae780f&req=dSggFM97moRaXPMW1HO4zatHOXW8u%2F5QcYXW76GnQs9r2dr%2Frc2E1QKwF6hU%0AmdBhIehNSf0oRmVmU5k%3D%0A)

Removing a Rule Out
-------------------

Removing a Rule out is as simple as clicking on the Rule Out that you would like to remove, and clicking Delete.

Including linked appointment details when printing or emailing third-party invoices
===================================================================================

Updated over 2 months ago

Some third-party payers require additional information on their invoices, which can include the **date, time** and **duration** of the appointment.

To include this information on third-party invoices, please follow these steps:

1) Go to **[Contacts > Third-party Payers](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/payers)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886730600/bd15d48d0345eb0a987eae8c0298/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=534884a116cb2eb2f51a74d6b91dfaf93629e91c2da60b73607cb5a479bed95b&req=dSgvEM59nYdfWfMW1HO4zVxAXYIkOH8QuKnCHwGOmVwX%2FsYhMyQsplw2BfM8%0A1pL9milmo8riqP45M%2F8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886730600/bd15d48d0345eb0a987eae8c0298/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=534884a116cb2eb2f51a74d6b91dfaf93629e91c2da60b73607cb5a479bed95b&req=dSgvEM59nYdfWfMW1HO4zVxAXYIkOH8QuKnCHwGOmVwX%2FsYhMyQsplw2BfM8%0A1pL9milmo8riqP45M%2F8%3D%0A)

2) Click on the **Payer** to open their file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886732848/579b64a745000c8ba0a6ddb37888/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13bc9e9b4397d1f4b2804b7ba90705d688c08395f8f4c9f012ede7259fd76063&req=dSgvEM59n4lbUfMW1HO4zYGssPAIS3iucCh7OnfBX3YuimaHNfMnA%2BelDnCF%0Abq3lq3ytYdi8QEmiLVY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886732848/579b64a745000c8ba0a6ddb37888/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13bc9e9b4397d1f4b2804b7ba90705d688c08395f8f4c9f012ede7259fd76063&req=dSgvEM59n4lbUfMW1HO4zYGssPAIS3iucCh7OnfBX3YuimaHNfMnA%2BelDnCF%0Abq3lq3ytYdi8QEmiLVY%3D%0A)

3) Go to the **Accounts** tab and click **Edit**.

You can now enable the option '**Include Linked Appointment details on Print / PDF**'

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886734121/1519cf5cb7427dddc0605f7c6779/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7016f999b54fedf692584a803427ec6b4197c309b13937e5c7f65bf85fce270f&req=dSgvEM59mYBdWPMW1HO4zTjAsZTnH73TGqEQusl4AI2fCd%2FKpeJnVnSHr341%0Ao2R9VY65jRUq056bw70%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886734121/1519cf5cb7427dddc0605f7c6779/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7016f999b54fedf692584a803427ec6b4197c309b13937e5c7f65bf85fce270f&req=dSgvEM59mYBdWPMW1HO4zTjAsZTnH73TGqEQusl4AI2fCd%2FKpeJnVnSHr341%0Ao2R9VY65jRUq056bw70%3D%0A)

4) When invoices within this file are **printed** or **emailed**, this will now include the linked appointment information below each item/service.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886739257/bfd8343016def54877f6f6acad50/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e96e51257b59e5511b3e755cf54b44b0d96daefd6596d3db79d757ca6025d62f&req=dSgvEM59lINaXvMW1HO4zdn%2B%2F4KE%2FgoNaI4UI7NcOAIAXAcp1eniJne2gFDt%0AByGvnhXg%2FBpK7zQZ94w%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886739257/bfd8343016def54877f6f6acad50/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e96e51257b59e5511b3e755cf54b44b0d96daefd6596d3db79d757ca6025d62f&req=dSgvEM59lINaXvMW1HO4zdn%2B%2F4KE%2FgoNaI4UI7NcOAIAXAcp1eniJne2gFDt%0AByGvnhXg%2FBpK7zQZ94w%3D%0A)

Why are some PracSuite Emails viewed as Spam or are Blocked?

Why are some PracSuite Emails viewed as Spam or are Blocked?
============================================================

Updated this week

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13557741-why-are-some-pracsuite-emails-viewed-as-spam-or-are-blocked#h_78005c7d7e)

[Why do emails get blocked, or sent to spam?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13557741-why-are-some-pracsuite-emails-viewed-as-spam-or-are-blocked#h_4eccbcdbc8)

[What can we do to help our PracSuite emails?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13557741-why-are-some-pracsuite-emails-viewed-as-spam-or-are-blocked#h_3571572d01)

[What can I do if a mail provider has blocked our email address?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13557741-why-are-some-pracsuite-emails-viewed-as-spam-or-are-blocked#h_20db03ea71)

**Overview**
------------

There are several ways PracSuite can send emails on behalf of your business, including the option to send emails "via PracSuite". When emails are sent this way, they are delivered using the PracSuite domain and a unique email address linked to your account.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2003018951/91a741efe6ccf2819098d8ba505e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=05ceb2ffb515d9c30872831a1a7c4e919da34be0e3157173c88279bb419f53d2&req=diAnFcl%2FlYhaWPMW1HO4zSThM9ydYSUTpAiRudIX9FYX%2FJQDEDhhOnWouitK%0AJdr48MOcLf1docf4dDQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2003018951/91a741efe6ccf2819098d8ba505e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=05ceb2ffb515d9c30872831a1a7c4e919da34be0e3157173c88279bb419f53d2&req=diAnFcl%2FlYhaWPMW1HO4zSThM9ydYSUTpAiRudIX9FYX%2FJQDEDhhOnWouitK%0AJdr48MOcLf1docf4dDQ%3D%0A)

  
Your **Sender Name** and **Reply Email** address are applied to these messages, so they appear to come from your business and replies go directly to you.

This is a common and perfectly valid approach used by many web applications. However, some email providers may treat these messages as slightly higher risk than emails sent directly from your own domain. As a result, there is a small chance they may be filtered to spam or, in rare cases, blocked altogether.

Email delivery is influenced by many factors outside our control, including the policies and filtering rules of receiving mail providers. In recent years, email providers have enforced increasingly strict spam and security policies.

* * *

**Why do emails get blocked, or sent to spam?**
-----------------------------------------------

**1) Sender reputation**  
We do everything we can to protect the reputation of the PracSuite domain. This includes maintaining the correct authentication records required for reliable email delivery.

However, your individual sending address (for example, [client.1234@send-via.pracsuite.com](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13557741-why-are-some-pracsuite-emails-viewed-as-spam-or-are-blocked)
) also builds its own reputation over time. Sending large volumes of marketing-style emails, or messages that recipients mark as spam, can negatively impact this reputation. Each rejected, bounced, blocked, or spam-reported email lowers your sender reputation. As this happens, more mail providers may start rejecting your emails, and in some cases your sending address may be blocked entirely by some recipients.

To protect your sender reputation, we use a **Suppression List** to prevent emails being sent to invalid addresses multiple times. For more information on the suppression list and how it works, please see [this article](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9575181-email-address-on-the-suppression-list-i-e-blocked-from-sending-via-pracsuite)
.

**2) Recipient policies**  
Each receiving mail provider applies its own spam and security policies. These systems use complex algorithms to detect spam or potentially harmful messages and may block or redirect emails automatically.

In some cases, the content of your emails, such as wording, formatting, links, or attachments, may trigger these filters and cause messages to be sent to spam or blocked before reaching the recipient’s inbox.

* * *

**What can we do to help our PracSuite emails?**
------------------------------------------------

The first step is to make your emails appear as legitimate and trustworthy as possible. You can help by following these best practices:

1.  Use a clear, relevant subject line that reflects the content of the email.  
    ​
    
2.  Avoid common marketing language, exaggerated claims, or click-bait style wording.  
    ​
    
3.  Address the recipient by name whenever possible (for example, "Hi Tom") and avoid generic placeholders like "Dear Customer".  
    ​
    
4.  Sign off professionally and clearly identify your business (for example, "Kind regards, Smartsoft Health").  
    ​
    
5.  Keep emails simple by minimising the use of links, images, and attachments.  
    ​
    
6.  If appropriate, ask recipients to add your sending address to their contacts, which can help mail providers trust future emails.  
    ​
    
7.  Monitor bounce and rejection messages. These messages often explain why an email failed, and whether the issue is temporary, content-related, or a hard block.  
    ​
    
8.  Minimise sending large volumes of marketing emails through your PracSuite email system, as emails can be flagged as spam or blocked by recipients, together with lowering your email domain reputation. This may affect your ability to deliver important transactional emails like appointment reminders or invoices at a later time with more emails being blocked or going into spam. Instead, consider using an alternate marketing platform such as Mailchimp for promotional communications, while protecting the reputation of your transactional email system for delivery of important emails.  
    ​​​
    

Even when these guidelines are followed, it’s normal for some emails to fail or be rejected. When sending a high volume of emails across many providers, a 100% delivery rate is unlikely.

* * *

**What can I do if a mail provider has blocked our email address?**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

If your emails are being rejected and it appears the receiving mail provider is responsible, there are a few steps you can take:

1.  If the recipient is known to you, such as a third-party payer or partner, contact them and ask if they can whitelist your PracSuite sending address.
    
2.  Review the email best practices above and adjust your content to make messages appear more legitimate and trustworthy to spam filters.  
    ​
    
3.  Consider using [Outlook integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration)
     or [Gmail integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration)
     to as an alternative to sending emails directly from your own business email system and email domain.
    

These options usually resolve most delivery issues, especially when sending to strict or highly filtered mail providers.

* * *

Please note this guide applies only to emails sent using the "via PracSuite" method, which is configured under [Settings > Businesses](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/businesses)
. If you are already sending emails using **Outlook** or **Gmail integration**, any delivery issues will need to be investigated through those platforms directly.

* * *

Finding Appointments for an Inactive Practitioner

Finding Appointments for an Inactive Practitioner
=================================================

Updated over 2 weeks ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13624705-finding-appointments-for-an-inactive-practitioner#h_6e32c7a6c5)

[Reporting on Appointment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13624705-finding-appointments-for-an-inactive-practitioner#h_01aae24cd9)

Overview
========

Marking a Practitioner's file as Inactive will remove their column from the Appointment Book. This article will go over how to see those appointments via reports.

Reporting on Appointment
------------------------

A list of appointments or patients with appointments belonging to an Inactive Practitioner can be obtained via multiple reports, below you'll find the steps on using a couple of these.

### Appointments

For a list of appointments that are booked with the inactive practitioner, please follow these steps:

#### Step 1:

Navigate to the **[Reports > Appointment > Appointments](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/appointment/appointments)
** page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2029110095/b958c3290cb5d768eb5949014905/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f969ece1b8148aca61e08a6a7aca116b343e057154e40fbce3b95fee01cd1fa&req=diAlH8h%2FnYFWXPMW1HO4zb%2F0a%2FwiAzyfHYuLpyjsfZqafU6TkfIn8g8T16Iq%0A29D8vytXc%2FWaBEuwqKY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2029110095/b958c3290cb5d768eb5949014905/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f969ece1b8148aca61e08a6a7aca116b343e057154e40fbce3b95fee01cd1fa&req=diAlH8h%2FnYFWXPMW1HO4zb%2F0a%2FwiAzyfHYuLpyjsfZqafU6TkfIn8g8T16Iq%0A29D8vytXc%2FWaBEuwqKY%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select the Practitioner in the **Appointment with** filter. You can select inactive practitioners by selecting **Inactive** in the pop-up window.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2029120147/b7c539ed2c69262d8d36d49afd93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3a89344e3d37a5fb1437899d9136ecfc5879dd5e156aa8cca2b1ab402961f75a&req=diAlH8h8nYBbXvMW1HO4zVkFPNItTNM19VXdlNowkHT3QjB71MrowL0KXHBF%0A2QGNPolZXrO0O%2FIhNCU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2029120147/b7c539ed2c69262d8d36d49afd93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3a89344e3d37a5fb1437899d9136ecfc5879dd5e156aa8cca2b1ab402961f75a&req=diAlH8h8nYBbXvMW1HO4zVkFPNItTNM19VXdlNowkHT3QjB71MrowL0KXHBF%0A2QGNPolZXrO0O%2FIhNCU%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Set the other filters on the report as needed, such as the Appointment Date Range.

#### Step 4:

Once you're happy with the filters, click Generate. You will now have a list of appointments that match the selected filters.

### Patients

For a list of patients that have appointments with the inactive practitioner, please follow these steps:

#### Step 1:

Navigate to the **[Reports > Patients > Patient List](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/list)
** report.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2029064792/2492b3eafe131e9f2ac43cdcfe14/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6a7823e5cc1a4d9c956909f684b257326e8c4720ea6fb50ae4c9e2319ceb4441&req=diAlH8l4mYZWW%2FMW1HO4zbkrpB8aO%2Fdht%2FNt%2Ba595fK%2Fzxv%2BWekS6PAYQrtC%0Ad5R%2FfqwGB1Cl6goqMXo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2029064792/2492b3eafe131e9f2ac43cdcfe14/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6a7823e5cc1a4d9c956909f684b257326e8c4720ea6fb50ae4c9e2319ceb4441&req=diAlH8l4mYZWW%2FMW1HO4zbkrpB8aO%2Fdht%2FNt%2Ba595fK%2Fzxv%2BWekS6PAYQrtC%0Ad5R%2FfqwGB1Cl6goqMXo%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select the Practitioner in the **Appointment with** filter. You can select inactive practitioners by selecting **Inactive** in the pop-up window.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2029071438/3b2ce9c4916435d2e87c8aea89e4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=68c8cbd9b572c28ba1211be7a6fead3b543b137c0159bf48879b8005a79df4bd&req=diAlH8l5nIVcUfMW1HO4zQgXXaqoJuWu69tylMB45muWU7Rj0qyWeohBpgHK%0AeaYzdiSFOaeY%2Fl7f7%2BU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2029071438/3b2ce9c4916435d2e87c8aea89e4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=68c8cbd9b572c28ba1211be7a6fead3b543b137c0159bf48879b8005a79df4bd&req=diAlH8l5nIVcUfMW1HO4zQgXXaqoJuWu69tylMB45muWU7Rj0qyWeohBpgHK%0AeaYzdiSFOaeY%2Fl7f7%2BU%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Set the other filters on the report as needed, such as the Appointment Date Range.

#### Step 4:

Once you're happy with the filters, click Generate. You will now have a list of patients that match the selected filters.

## Document 43 — Moving your two factor authentication between devices | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-43}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13694256-moving-your-two-factor-authentication-between-devices](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13694256-moving-your-two-factor-authentication-between-devices)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/13694256-moving-your-two-factor-authentication-between-devices#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Users & Security](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2419428-users-security)

Moving your two factor authentication between devices

Moving your two factor authentication between devices
=====================================================

Updated over a week ago

If you have a new phone, you will likely need to transfer the authenticator codes from your old device to the new one.  
﻿​  
﻿Depending on the authenticator you use, this may happen automatically after you **sign-in** on the new device. If not, there should be an option to **_Export_** the authenticator codes from your old device and then an **_Import_** _option_ on the new device.  
﻿​  
﻿Unfortunately, the exact steps depend on your device and the specific authenticator you use, so we cannot provide instructions on how to do this. If you are having trouble, a quick Google search like ''_How to transfer XYZ Authenticator to a new phone_'' should give appropriate results.﻿​

If you still have access to your old phone, you should still be able to open the _Authenticator_ on your original device and use this to login to PracSuite.

If your original authenticator codes are not available or cannot be transferred, please see below.

  
﻿----------------------------------------

  
﻿​﻿**How to reset a users two factor authentication:**  
​

If the original Authenticator codes are lost or cannot be transferred, a **System Administrator** at Company name will need to reset your two factor authentication.  
﻿​﻿  
﻿Please see the following article for more instructions:﻿​﻿  
​**[How to Reset Two Factor Authentication](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4229484-how-to-reset-two-factor-authentication)
**

  
﻿In short, a System Administrator will need to:  
​  
1) Go to **[Settings > Users & Security > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)
.**  
​  
2) Click on the User in question to open their file.  
​  
3) Click the '**Reset Two Factor Authentication**' button at the top of the page.

Please note this will immediately invalidate any previous two factor authentication codes stored on their devices.

When this user next login to PracSuite, they will be prompted to re-configure their two factor authentication on a new device.  
​  
They will also be able to **skip** the two factor authentication requirement up to 5 times, if needed. We recommend the user reconfigure their 2FA at the next earliest opportunity for added security.  
﻿​﻿

How to Book an Appointment
==========================

Updated over 2 months ago

#### Step 1:

Updated over 4 months ago

When accessing your PracSuite account for the first time, you will need to configure settings that relate to your organisation.

**1\. Go to [Settings > General > General](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396934485/c7b3f4c79c5b72304c925bee8805/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+12_47_02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=20df04a328337d0e7a9fffea8fb59ce20d8a43be76d4362bb34ba1dde988779e&req=dSMuEMB9mYVXXPMW1HO4zaXLrHKHrYsZG6WTF0uN93NwWCzf0sCaeEhvSajK%0AgfZd%2FC2TZMRiNNQxR6w%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396934485/c7b3f4c79c5b72304c925bee8805/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+12_47_02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=20df04a328337d0e7a9fffea8fb59ce20d8a43be76d4362bb34ba1dde988779e&req=dSMuEMB9mYVXXPMW1HO4zaXLrHKHrYsZG6WTF0uN93NwWCzf0sCaeEhvSajK%0AgfZd%2FC2TZMRiNNQxR6w%3D%0A)

PracSuite Account
=================

The contact information entered on this page identifies the entity that is subscribing to PracSuite and contact information for key individuals at the business. This information is not patient-facing or accessible to patients.

*   **Company Name -** Company name for your records with Smartsoft.
    
*   **Primary Contact -** The main subscriber and PracSuite account holder. Typically, the business owner or director.
    
*   **Billing Contact -** Contact information for the individual responsible for managing payment of the PracSuite subscription and recipient of Smartsoft receipts/invoices.
    
*   **Technical Contact -** Contact information for the individual responsible for managing IT and other technical matters for the business.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633133419/c37c490c900ecc3edcae6521/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4ef66beedecff02e2c36b6a93286e3f3d05d5955f52add32942ff817fea3631&req=ciMkF8p9mYBWFb4f3HP0gDszKUZ2yeWXPmR877xs8liTCzQqR9hjOR5RIT5R%0A4xj%2B%2BSwJ7X22uzCskw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633133419/c37c490c900ecc3edcae6521/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4ef66beedecff02e2c36b6a93286e3f3d05d5955f52add32942ff817fea3631&req=ciMkF8p9mYBWFb4f3HP0gDszKUZ2yeWXPmR877xs8liTCzQqR9hjOR5RIT5R%0A4xj%2B%2BSwJ7X22uzCskw%3D%3D%0A)

Main Settings
=============

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396924120/e2c16350b77b491ac188da954156/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=05f218238d8020881145974c7603fba8fe596130c5a0954b61297decfbd37f6a&req=dSMuEMB8mYBdWfMW1HO4zTa0VjzfPtyhhM%2Boz4feRTe5b15GU47C1IZP2zRn%0Ag63MU3S6yeDV%2B004dYs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396924120/e2c16350b77b491ac188da954156/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=05f218238d8020881145974c7603fba8fe596130c5a0954b61297decfbd37f6a&req=dSMuEMB8mYBdWfMW1HO4zTa0VjzfPtyhhM%2Boz4feRTe5b15GU47C1IZP2zRn%0Ag63MU3S6yeDV%2B004dYs%3D%0A)

The main settings area in PracSuite controls some general system settings, including:

*   **Client Descriptor** \- Choose the term that describes your clients (patients, clients or customers)
    
*   **Country -** Select the country in which your business operates.
    
*   **Time Zone -** Select the time zone that applies to your business operations. This will control how times are displayed throughout PracSuite. Only a single time zone can be set for a PracSuite account.
    
*   **Name Display Order -** Controls how patient names are displayed on patient files.
    
*   **Tax Label -** Controls how tax is displayed throughout the system.
    
*   **Tax Rate -** Control the tax rate of tax-enabled items.
    
*   **SMS Marketing Defaults -** Controls the default SMS marketing status for new patient files.
    
*   **Email Marketing Defaults -** Controls the default email marketing status for new patient files.
    
*   **Extended Gender List -** Expands the list of genders on patient files. [Click here for further details.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8615642-patient-sex-gender-and-pronouns-in-pracsuite)
    
*   **Show Country In Addresses -** Controls displaying the country wherever the address is shown.
    
*   **Store Time Zone Per Patient -** Allows you to record the time zone of a patient if they reside in time zone different to the main system time zone. [Click here for more information.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6516678-patient-time-zones)
    
*   **Set Business at Login -** For multibusiness environments where staff move between locations. [Click here for more information.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4853918-setting-your-business-when-logging-into-pracsuite)
    

Letter Tag Formats
==================

The below settings control the date and time formats when using date and time merge fields on your SMS, Email, Letter and Clinical Note templates.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633133766/19f6002e446f662423cd5c70/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9375559874ce2cafc36e06aedd38231cb924c2fe04f09fc332993c09cf1e860e&req=ciMkF8p9modZFb4f3HP0gNrueV4exSS6h6yy%2FnpSEKHWz9LsR12%2FobdQLBnl%0A8IG5n%2FjUX68GdS8Akw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633133766/19f6002e446f662423cd5c70/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9375559874ce2cafc36e06aedd38231cb924c2fe04f09fc332993c09cf1e860e&req=ciMkF8p9modZFb4f3HP0gNrueV4exSS6h6yy%2FnpSEKHWz9LsR12%2FobdQLBnl%0A8IG5n%2FjUX68GdS8Akw%3D%3D%0A)

Settlement Accounts
===================

Updated over 6 months ago

Settlement accounts are used for depositing of incoming fees and are assigned to a Business. Multiple Businesses can share a Settlement Account if they bank to the same account to allow reporting on financial data in PracSuite and for use for bank reconciliation purposes.

To create a Settlement Accounts, go to **[Settings > Businesses > Settlement Accounts](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/businesses/accounts)
**

Click **Add**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633129939/976ce941371b276656a77b25/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=033f413199d505e5d88068c40812d89feaeb1f9d59b1a6473f73e4dd8708d6f7&req=ciMkF8t3lIJWFb4f3HP0gI1RtPIRxFqUNkEFy8IVT93ip%2FDmNXLEvAUnvXaR%0AcIW4MhVZ9tVt0OyYmQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633129939/976ce941371b276656a77b25/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=033f413199d505e5d88068c40812d89feaeb1f9d59b1a6473f73e4dd8708d6f7&req=ciMkF8t3lIJWFb4f3HP0gI1RtPIRxFqUNkEFy8IVT93ip%2FDmNXLEvAUnvXaR%0AcIW4MhVZ9tVt0OyYmQ%3D%3D%0A)

Appointment Book
================

The settings under the Appointment Book header are the absolute limits/boundaries of time displayed on the Appointment Book for this business. You will not be able to schedule appointments outside of these days and times.

Individual practitioner availability, including online booking availability, is defined on a roster that you create per practitioner. [Click here to learn more about rosters.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides)

*   **Start Time -** The start time of the appointment book. You will not be able to interact with the appointment book before this time.
    
*   **End Time -** The end time of the appointment book. You will not be able to interact with the appointment book after this time.
    
*   **Interval -** This setting determines the time increments available in the appointment book. You can choose from 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, or 60-minute intervals. Appointment book intervals can also be overridden at a practitioner level on their practitioner file.
    
*   **Work Week -** This setting determines what days are available to interact with on the appointment book.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633137755/66a4c50ec3d2164fa203d908/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=825cdfa003d8eee5d0c46de55535610a807adf2b8cf111074281218350b09460&req=ciMkF8p5moRaFb4f3HP0gFo0G%2B0qxPq1ynvL3VAaKFi7gt6z7bEAD0prpL81%0Azr12JsR2kt%2BRu2wQnA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633137755/66a4c50ec3d2164fa203d908/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=825cdfa003d8eee5d0c46de55535610a807adf2b8cf111074281218350b09460&req=ciMkF8p5moRaFb4f3HP0gFo0G%2B0qxPq1ynvL3VAaKFi7gt6z7bEAD0prpL81%0Azr12JsR2kt%2BRu2wQnA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Default Practitioner
====================

All patient files in PracSuite are assigned a default practitioner, which highlights the patient's preferred practitioner or the primary practitioner who is currently treating a patient.

These business settings control who is selected by default when creating a patient file. If booking a new patient appointment from the appointment book, the default practitioner will be assigned to the patient you're booking the appointment with.

When creating a new patient file manually, select your preferred method of assigning a default practitioner:

*   **No default practitioner** \- Manually choose a default practitioner every time
    
*   **Random** - Randomly assign default practitioner
    
*   **Round Robin** \- Default practitioner will be assigned in a rotating order
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633137812/13f478aa4bc2034beb1446cb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e05699a18400266b9ebec911e1b398d76ef4a6126b00f1833d3fa77609f99a88&req=ciMkF8p5lYBdFb4f3HP0gP9dMfSBXR47EmgiO8RSR9yA%2F9St4mCSTkb8vfYW%0A5yaHPXmdwpfg9lDYZA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633137812/13f478aa4bc2034beb1446cb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e05699a18400266b9ebec911e1b398d76ef4a6126b00f1833d3fa77609f99a88&req=ciMkF8p5lYBdFb4f3HP0gP9dMfSBXR47EmgiO8RSR9yA%2F9St4mCSTkb8vfYW%0A5yaHPXmdwpfg9lDYZA%3D%3D%0A)

Invoice Header
==============

The header is displayed in the top right of invoices and reports and includes essential business information.

Display as Text
---------------

By default, all business information is included as text on invoices and reports.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397063879/febb8a436a4b6e99f1f780a31bc2/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_32_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a8cab5d18967bc61e0f11bcbdcfbc27f8bca18a0ac7966364409172ff5dbb5e&req=dSMuEcl4nolYUPMW1HO4zTVyK1%2FFjWpHx0%2FBehTQqAF8xKkjcHPCED5X%2FSZB%0AEHuk1%2Bhl50xQKU7cVmA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397063879/febb8a436a4b6e99f1f780a31bc2/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_32_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a8cab5d18967bc61e0f11bcbdcfbc27f8bca18a0ac7966364409172ff5dbb5e&req=dSMuEcl4nolYUPMW1HO4zTVyK1%2FFjWpHx0%2FBehTQqAF8xKkjcHPCED5X%2FSZB%0AEHuk1%2Bhl50xQKU7cVmA%3D%0A)

Display as Image
----------------

As an alternative to printing the business information as text, you can upload an invoice header to personalise your invoices. **If choosing an image header, you must incorporate all essential business information into the graphic you upload.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397063624/5ca2fc39cad6ed2a52a29ef6954c/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_31_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab2fbf5575e3f5faa9967b3e05bf2dd8c38d12a2b8bce6f5e4b6745924105bb9&req=dSMuEcl4noddXfMW1HO4zSuuXzxm9ikj41wJLGQ7uR13TLkpuv17WJO3rs1l%0AhFQX67G8hD9u7N8IGTU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397063624/5ca2fc39cad6ed2a52a29ef6954c/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_31_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab2fbf5575e3f5faa9967b3e05bf2dd8c38d12a2b8bce6f5e4b6745924105bb9&req=dSMuEcl4noddXfMW1HO4zSuuXzxm9ikj41wJLGQ7uR13TLkpuv17WJO3rs1l%0AhFQX67G8hD9u7N8IGTU%3D%0A)

For the image to display correctly, we recommend:

*   All content in the image is right-aligned
    
*   Include all contact information, including business name, address, phone number, ABN, email and web address.
    
*   Compatible image types include SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics), JPG and PNG. SVG is strongly recommended due to its small size and high quality.
    
*   Recommended width/height ratio 5:1 (width:height)
    

* * *

Invoice Payment Print Options
=============================

When printing invoices with owing amounts, these options control which payment instructions are printed on the invoice.

Direct deposit bank account details are pulled from the settlement account selected on the business.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397066819/b1a7765ac75c7799a772809370bc/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_36_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f38acef0f2f7620e362c6929dc58db688ebc4db9fb22a39e9b77dba674b5f55a&req=dSMuEcl4m4leUPMW1HO4zRzUhxXDzrv%2FOR8NlpsD6svM2%2F4yD8MxGTc6ntWg%0ALrS1Yw54EgwbAHRf3Y0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397066819/b1a7765ac75c7799a772809370bc/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_36_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f38acef0f2f7620e362c6929dc58db688ebc4db9fb22a39e9b77dba674b5f55a&req=dSMuEcl4m4leUPMW1HO4zRzUhxXDzrv%2FOR8NlpsD6svM2%2F4yD8MxGTc6ntWg%0ALrS1Yw54EgwbAHRf3Y0%3D%0A)

*   **Credit Card Tear-Off Slip -** A tear-off slip will be printed at the bottom for the patient to return it the practice.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397065629/5f8f33096f402b47afa7ef9b42f8/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_34_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96ae084fa24fa19760e4150a13f8278e7251858885d94b2048d4417f6d025448&req=dSMuEcl4mIddUPMW1HO4zbpAcIzHnHvtYvAdUtnjKxA%2BkqMwu67pyAkFTXKw%0AAvTF8uCQXk64ggdQmmw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397065629/5f8f33096f402b47afa7ef9b42f8/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_34_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96ae084fa24fa19760e4150a13f8278e7251858885d94b2048d4417f6d025448&req=dSMuEcl4mIddUPMW1HO4zbpAcIzHnHvtYvAdUtnjKxA%2BkqMwu67pyAkFTXKw%0AAvTF8uCQXk64ggdQmmw%3D%0A)

*   **Direct Deposit -** BSB and account number details will be listed on invoices.
    
*   **Include on Statements -** When creating statements (collections of invoices) where there are owing amounts, payment instructions will be included.
    

* * *

Invoice Terms & Conditions
==========================

Terms and Conditions allow you to include a line of text on the various types of invoices that PracSuite generates.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633138858/7653b93674629862b3ff6570/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=303cd7181b70e091835168613fce6f40fd055dd9a05ba62f0ddeea4efc4a4a43&req=ciMkF8p2lYRXFb4f3HP0gLMUMNCGXz6tcUv2CN4OFWA43S3eDxG60xwTUA5z%0A%2F%2BdECg7ID76dBFU5Vg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633138858/7653b93674629862b3ff6570/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=303cd7181b70e091835168613fce6f40fd055dd9a05ba62f0ddeea4efc4a4a43&req=ciMkF8p2lYRXFb4f3HP0gLMUMNCGXz6tcUv2CN4OFWA43S3eDxG60xwTUA5z%0A%2F%2BdECg7ID76dBFU5Vg%3D%3D%0A)

This is included as a simple line of text at the bottom of the invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397078384/7999de20ea5e08cb5d9df62a862c/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_51_45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a42cdb0519b95eb857320d2c718fa1b30928e7f3b84c1ea80228bf02440025e7&req=dSMuEcl5lYJXXfMW1HO4zYBFvE5O%2Fr1s5e%2FRI4V3i%2FjT4F7F%2F%2F25UqI3xHvV%0AQIyBAd2qgQLeX8e0nZM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1397078384/7999de20ea5e08cb5d9df62a862c/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+15_51_45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a42cdb0519b95eb857320d2c718fa1b30928e7f3b84c1ea80228bf02440025e7&req=dSMuEcl5lYJXXfMW1HO4zYBFvE5O%2Fr1s5e%2FRI4V3i%2FjT4F7F%2F%2F25UqI3xHvV%0AQIyBAd2qgQLeX8e0nZM%3D%0A)

Outbound Email Settings
=======================

The Outbound Email Settings control the appearance of the sender name and sender address when emailing from PracSuite.

PracSuite also integrates with Outlook and Gmail to be able to send emails directly through your email account. [Click here to learn more about sending emails through PracSuite.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6150780-understanding-how-emails-are-sent-through-pracsuite)

Customise the default sender email address and sender name for emails sent from PracSuite. You also have the option to override the sender email address and sender name for:

*   **Invoices/Statements -** Apply a different email address when emailing invoices.
    
*   **Appointment Confirmations & Reminders -** Apply a different email address when sending appointment correspondence.
    
*   **Email via Reports -** Apply a different email address when using the bulk email feature on reports and when using the [Campaigns feature](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6591245-creating-email-sms-campaigns)
    .
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633139081/4c258d998743b3a6185d6825/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=99c75e10290c3cb6295f7c7e0d112999da61d512bd4caa40d215c0c6610626b2&req=ciMkF8p3nYleFb4f3HP0gLXu0PQS52ZV%2BzOMMLkU6yr1aR4JJ64pIooILjhU%0AcnWl6XYmB%2FWUyxzQNQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633139081/4c258d998743b3a6185d6825/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=99c75e10290c3cb6295f7c7e0d112999da61d512bd4caa40d215c0c6610626b2&req=ciMkF8p3nYleFb4f3HP0gLXu0PQS52ZV%2BzOMMLkU6yr1aR4JJ64pIooILjhU%0AcnWl6XYmB%2FWUyxzQNQ%3D%3D%0A)
