Creating a Profession

Creating a Profession
=====================

Updated over 3 years ago

Professions are assigned to practitioners and represent the services they provide. A practitioner can have one or more professions. When configuring a practitioner different provider numbers can be set for each business and profession. Professions can also be used to filter the appointment book and reports.

**1\. Go to [Settings > Practitioners > Professions](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners/professions)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633198202/d2f288ed8ecdfbcf94a853b1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9f3006e6f595dc5c6093268673ac17fc8c0936423e0dea7bea843cd6d6b3409b&req=ciMkF8B2n4FdFb4f3HP0gC1%2FrbvKb9yWgKI8a6tkm9rglZkrYyWk253EsCj6%0A7YE6PgFdjsZH38YhBw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633198202/d2f288ed8ecdfbcf94a853b1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9f3006e6f595dc5c6093268673ac17fc8c0936423e0dea7bea843cd6d6b3409b&req=ciMkF8B2n4FdFb4f3HP0gC1%2FrbvKb9yWgKI8a6tkm9rglZkrYyWk253EsCj6%0A7YE6PgFdjsZH38YhBw%3D%3D%0A)

**2\. Select 'Edit'**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633198462/bece03573da1012bebca116c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fa9fad10d2697b509758c1dcdb5d9af83c56d8f768e5fac4a9fe12ad738b29af&req=ciMkF8B2mYddFb4f3HP0gHK%2BEfRE2ORzV%2F97YykirIuwJUgTAX%2BWOQyQ3%2FDr%0AVy%2Bvv0AHq5bxI%2FtWqg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633198462/bece03573da1012bebca116c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fa9fad10d2697b509758c1dcdb5d9af83c56d8f768e5fac4a9fe12ad738b29af&req=ciMkF8B2mYddFb4f3HP0gHK%2BEfRE2ORzV%2F97YykirIuwJUgTAX%2BWOQyQ3%2FDr%0AVy%2Bvv0AHq5bxI%2FtWqg%3D%3D%0A)

**3\. Select 'Add' to add a new profession**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633198577/adc9727e81d85ab8f1316e46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=661519b90910c6356f18cc43836edfcda24ebd0e007d7731a8364dde12d09c4e&req=ciMkF8B2mIZYFb4f3HP0gHwShYJNdP2si2Mu5i1Po3%2F8elxF8pTgqfK64I1Q%0A%2FCOaHlHNK2zcKoM%2B6A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633198577/adc9727e81d85ab8f1316e46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=661519b90910c6356f18cc43836edfcda24ebd0e007d7731a8364dde12d09c4e&req=ciMkF8B2mIZYFb4f3HP0gHwShYJNdP2si2Mu5i1Po3%2F8elxF8pTgqfK64I1Q%0A%2FCOaHlHNK2zcKoM%2B6A%3D%3D%0A)

**4\. Customise the following:**

*   Profession name
    
*   Professional title
    
*   Colour (used to identify the profession on the appointment book)
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633198669/4eb2e21e52ec19ee3018746c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c67db7253e2dcba2cda06c4e732a8ee78add5fa2bd54c69f7a370ad26d95ba1&req=ciMkF8B2m4dWFb4f3HP0gFPWzsPimvth8ehrhoqgjUW2PMh4X2X5%2FZ6ggm%2Ba%0A84uRTjl%2BVXOGspbHAQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633198669/4eb2e21e52ec19ee3018746c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c67db7253e2dcba2cda06c4e732a8ee78add5fa2bd54c69f7a370ad26d95ba1&req=ciMkF8B2m4dWFb4f3HP0gFPWzsPimvth8ehrhoqgjUW2PMh4X2X5%2FZ6ggm%2Ba%0A84uRTjl%2BVXOGspbHAQ%3D%3D%0A)

Creating a Practitioner File

Creating a Practitioner File
============================

Updated over 3 years ago

Practitioner Files are the foundation of being able to book appointments, raise invoices and create clinical notes in PracSuite. They contain practitioner contact details, provider numbers, rosters and individual preferences.

**1\. Go to [Settings > Practitioners > Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)
 and select the 'Add' button**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631942969/75a230747cdf6554643605cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7055e72e2e3bc751c4624a3cfc2cf83ea2df6b60cf576d0b0d21e1422f5b6c9b&req=ciMmH818lIdWFb4f3HP0gAT0YGY9xi1mKlP6Z%2BipuSp1%2Fvb%2FvaslqNNPWEyH%0AIlcyIUg%2Fah62DEoXpg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631942969/75a230747cdf6554643605cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7055e72e2e3bc751c4624a3cfc2cf83ea2df6b60cf576d0b0d21e1422f5b6c9b&req=ciMmH818lIdWFb4f3HP0gAT0YGY9xi1mKlP6Z%2BipuSp1%2Fvb%2FvaslqNNPWEyH%0AIlcyIUg%2Fah62DEoXpg%3D%3D%0A)

**2\. Enter the practitioner's details**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943349/f47b551c7e6acbcbf747a8a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=55d10d29ec6905ea9137c67c0497b230c62c6fd0fdfd1566ec8c7db69b18529d&req=ciMmH819noVWFb4f3HP0gI%2BKCON%2BnJUIVHhcQIn%2FyloBUEvghF24FGopWt8O%0AH79BWLfekPn7VlqEZQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943349/f47b551c7e6acbcbf747a8a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=55d10d29ec6905ea9137c67c0497b230c62c6fd0fdfd1566ec8c7db69b18529d&req=ciMmH819noVWFb4f3HP0gI%2BKCON%2BnJUIVHhcQIn%2FyloBUEvghF24FGopWt8O%0AH79BWLfekPn7VlqEZQ%3D%3D%0A)

**3\. Add the Businesses that this practitioner will be working at to their practitioner file**

Click the '**Add**' button to add multiple businesses/locations to this practitioner's file.

If the practitioner requires multiple columns on the appointment book, enter the desired number of columns. You can also choose to override the appointment book intervals if the practitioner books appointments at different intervals than the main business.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943515/99f5c9b55c2affa1403816d1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c49cdf6af3b9dd763642dd280dc28243244798528a6044188878d2f4e2d077d9&req=ciMmH819mIBaFb4f3HP0gNyMfi%2BQ%2F40GI5%2FYPFUxx9tsB2Kd7lgPuwxRMSjp%0AQBp8jM%2FBcyux1PHEiw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943515/99f5c9b55c2affa1403816d1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c49cdf6af3b9dd763642dd280dc28243244798528a6044188878d2f4e2d077d9&req=ciMmH819mIBaFb4f3HP0gNyMfi%2BQ%2F40GI5%2FYPFUxx9tsB2Kd7lgPuwxRMSjp%0AQBp8jM%2FBcyux1PHEiw%3D%3D%0A)

**4\. Add the Professions that this practitioner works in**

Customise the Professional Title and Qualifications as required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943680/d3d3d3f49bdee9939f1cec26/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=48f2f71fd3161e5034558c16d94c8e85207dd520e8ee8a9101cd55a86245f6cc&req=ciMmH819m4lfFb4f3HP0gB3EUg3jqN4SJci6yyIeYNHXWUXoaVGTn4NCiLDo%0AmsvKkxmf9dtih6UDdA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943680/d3d3d3f49bdee9939f1cec26/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=48f2f71fd3161e5034558c16d94c8e85207dd520e8ee8a9101cd55a86245f6cc&req=ciMmH819m4lfFb4f3HP0gB3EUg3jqN4SJci6yyIeYNHXWUXoaVGTn4NCiLDo%0AmsvKkxmf9dtih6UDdA%3D%3D%0A)

**5\. Enter the provider numbers for all Businesses and Professions for this practitioner**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943762/1725b54cf114de07a61f1a67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=334fa037c497b48bfdca0f344665bc17e66256a95c70fbe659d793de6f05dc62&req=ciMmH819moddFb4f3HP0gK0ceQ%2FmraPU%2F7sMv%2BSg2evJ8gPWCduFXi0FOi9s%0A5R7qh84XWAiVo6q0Dg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943762/1725b54cf114de07a61f1a67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=334fa037c497b48bfdca0f344665bc17e66256a95c70fbe659d793de6f05dc62&req=ciMmH819moddFb4f3HP0gK0ceQ%2FmraPU%2F7sMv%2BSg2evJ8gPWCduFXi0FOi9s%0A5R7qh84XWAiVo6q0Dg%3D%3D%0A)

**6\. Add the practitioner's roster**

Select the roster that applies to this practitioner. The roster start and end date can be customised to note a change in the practitioner's roster. [Learn more about creating a roster.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943863/eca71ae5c07376ccc0f34063/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a202d4b2b72e9ff6d4b6525939fa50a338856b72f4eeb604c3eb7e313ac05118&req=ciMmH819lYdcFb4f3HP0gIjQ7rylwkRSUkvTEjCZl1AwQtPJhQxkMBxSUtVJ%0AHxIYHh2d0wJO8uRing%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631943863/eca71ae5c07376ccc0f34063/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a202d4b2b72e9ff6d4b6525939fa50a338856b72f4eeb604c3eb7e313ac05118&req=ciMmH819lYdcFb4f3HP0gIjQ7rylwkRSUkvTEjCZl1AwQtPJhQxkMBxSUtVJ%0AHxIYHh2d0wJO8uRing%3D%3D%0A)

**7\. Assign the practitioner file to the user account**

The final step is to link the practitioner file to their PracSuite user account.

Go to **[Settings > Users & Security > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)
**

Select the practitioner's user profile.

In the **Database Access** section, enable the '_User is a practitioner_' option and select their practitioner file in the dropdown list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/220094698/1b48f72e9955a15ffc7b9355/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4210bb006a6c49285bc03b7fa73c7265b15e0c08c0741fa1255a821c4dea9446&req=diInFsB6m4hXFb4f3HP0gHxcTObWXOMkmXRtIIFv3g3Y3VK79flXPWBNAtp9%0A3shN%2Bd6E2lDFonzjAQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/220094698/1b48f72e9955a15ffc7b9355/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4210bb006a6c49285bc03b7fa73c7265b15e0c08c0741fa1255a821c4dea9446&req=diInFsB6m4hXFb4f3HP0gHxcTObWXOMkmXRtIIFv3g3Y3VK79flXPWBNAtp9%0A3shN%2Bd6E2lDFonzjAQ%3D%3D%0A)

Creating Rosters and Roster Overrides

Creating Rosters and Roster Overrides
=====================================

Manage practitioner availability.

Updated over 3 months ago

Table of contents

[Rosters](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#rosters)

[Rules](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#rules)

[Copying Rules to Other Days](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#h_c47e9d8860)

[Roster Overrides](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#roster-overrides)

[Creating Overrides via a Roster](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#h_64c5fc487c)

[Creating Overrides via the Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#h_444a224492)

[Roster Override Settings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#h_5dc745b127)

[Deleting an Override](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#h_e14b375622)

[Assigning a Roster to a Practitioner](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#assigning-a-roster-to-a-practitioner)

[Days Off](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#days-off-)

By default, a practitioner's appointment book will be completely available. By using Rosters and Roster Overrides, you can define a practitioner's exact availability and take advantage of advanced tools like the [bulk appointment scheduler](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059210-how-to-book-multiple-appointments)
, [online booking](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4766658-setting-up-online-bookings-in-pracsuite)
, [proactive waiting list](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list)
 and [utilisation report](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6366231-how-to-generate-a-utilisation-report)
.

**Rosters**
===========

Go to **[Settings > Practitioners > Rosters](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)
** and select **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614789381/c32cdbfb28b2b0135fd2ed8a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afd82d6750ac928fba59a4cde9fa8be3cc286ebde3be8daed2f8d15bede0a715&req=ciEjEcF3noleFb4f3HP0gK5ixS%2BFn3TKVUnQNhtmcB6lDLnlrN7Ll3G7H5w%2F%0AAwf7j75NDw2Y08Mopw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614789381/c32cdbfb28b2b0135fd2ed8a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afd82d6750ac928fba59a4cde9fa8be3cc286ebde3be8daed2f8d15bede0a715&req=ciEjEcF3noleFb4f3HP0gK5ixS%2BFn3TKVUnQNhtmcB6lDLnlrN7Ll3G7H5w%2F%0AAwf7j75NDw2Y08Mopw%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **drop-down arrow** next to the Add button to pre-set the roster's hours based on the selected business.

In the **_Roster Availability_** section, customise how available time on the appointment book should be displayed.

*   **Description** - Helps you identify this roster
    
*   **Background colour** - The default colour that will be shown across the practitioner's appointment book
    
*   **Text colour** \- The default colour of any display text entered
    
*   **Display text** (optional) - this text is displayed in every appointment slot on the appointment book
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912018219/455fa2ad044856f5becb1f03/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+15.22.43%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db97cab5782e57b129b046786927104f0198551caa6a18390e8880b07378a296&req=fSElFsh2n4BWFb4f3HP0gOVLLjdOM7mgToqyP%2BDjKAbRInyNs8mnzJc7YRkG%0Ai9p03hTCqRIr24rO7w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912018219/455fa2ad044856f5becb1f03/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+15.22.43%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db97cab5782e57b129b046786927104f0198551caa6a18390e8880b07378a296&req=fSElFsh2n4BWFb4f3HP0gOVLLjdOM7mgToqyP%2BDjKAbRInyNs8mnzJc7YRkG%0Ai9p03hTCqRIr24rO7w%3D%3D%0A)

Choose the types of bookings you wish to permit by default when no rules are present.

*   **Manual Appointments** - Allows staff to book appointments in this time frame
    
*   **Waiting List** - Allows the Waiting List and Appointment Finder to book in this time frame
    
*   **Online Appointments** - Allows Online Bookings in this time frame
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912018352/b7bbf7cc271a2fa6f3d65cd3/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+15.23.00%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=935eb3920e9ce5b05da02210b37bf3867c1ecf18ca45cad1d7cdea22a7e43a80&req=fSElFsh2noRdFb4f3HP0gBXPV8%2B%2Fbn6Bg%2FlAWnh%2FaG6Kzif5eL%2FwM2m7rk%2F0%0A0eToyoWDOTi6Gp5Y7g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912018352/b7bbf7cc271a2fa6f3d65cd3/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+15.23.00%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=935eb3920e9ce5b05da02210b37bf3867c1ecf18ca45cad1d7cdea22a7e43a80&req=fSElFsh2noRdFb4f3HP0gBXPV8%2B%2Fbn6Bg%2FlAWnh%2FaG6Kzif5eL%2FwM2m7rk%2F0%0A0eToyoWDOTi6Gp5Y7g%3D%3D%0A)

Most practitioners begin with a Roster that is completely available, with **Rules** used to specify times when they're unavailable. While this is the most common approach, it's also possible to start with a roster that is completely unavailable, and to use rules to mark time as available.  
​  
Under _'Allowed bookings when no rule is present'_, consider disabling online appointments and waiting list options if you prefer to "rule in" time.

Select which days should be displayed on the appointment book. Note that [Roster Overrides](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#roster-overrides)
 can override these preferences.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614789744/a7d32cb6b4de67e897406d8f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=65afde14188279e5aa330e98e21079a7767de43340a358d65c2348fb40ef32e1&req=ciEjEcF3moVbFb4f3HP0gILDYz5yg%2Bt6fgkczm9SJMMSksQ%2Fjp14nUy7kEJ6%0AIADELbPHVoFnSx95FQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614789744/a7d32cb6b4de67e897406d8f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=65afde14188279e5aa330e98e21079a7767de43340a358d65c2348fb40ef32e1&req=ciEjEcF3moVbFb4f3HP0gILDYz5yg%2Bt6fgkczm9SJMMSksQ%2Fjp14nUy7kEJ6%0AIADELbPHVoFnSx95FQ%3D%3D%0A)

As you scroll down the page, you can now customise the start and end time for the appointment book for each day that you enabled above.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614790683/fac3b388732647178b1d8f2f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13fab9286e2fc1d7d08c97e3b475b9312c8675d0864bf8f962c206b97135559a&req=ciEjEcB%2Bm4lcFb4f3HP0gJ3hklkQQUE1foN8L%2B0neLWayRAPiOVto9VHRk%2FV%0AkYn79jjh%2FCD%2BiZxFsg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614790683/fac3b388732647178b1d8f2f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13fab9286e2fc1d7d08c97e3b475b9312c8675d0864bf8f962c206b97135559a&req=ciEjEcB%2Bm4lcFb4f3HP0gJ3hklkQQUE1foN8L%2B0neLWayRAPiOVto9VHRk%2FV%0AkYn79jjh%2FCD%2BiZxFsg%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Rules**
=========

The examples below will assume that all time is available by default, and rules will be used to specify unavailable time, such as lunch breaks and regular meetings.

Select **Add Rule** for the relevant day.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614794287/b3ead7a1e465e6ca9b8b5f65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1e2d77c9627158570bc21a0132adc7313c0a99489575f66e774193e10296bafa&req=ciEjEcB6n4lYFb4f3HP0gIcGvlbUnXFzPKja4nR%2Fu3%2FCOIa7kWY9TPy557SP%0A7M%2BMoaUk7qvUxyd02A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614794287/b3ead7a1e465e6ca9b8b5f65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1e2d77c9627158570bc21a0132adc7313c0a99489575f66e774193e10296bafa&req=ciEjEcB6n4lYFb4f3HP0gIcGvlbUnXFzPKja4nR%2Fu3%2FCOIa7kWY9TPy557SP%0A7M%2BMoaUk7qvUxyd02A%3D%3D%0A)

Customise the following properties for the Rule:

*   **Display Text** \- Text displayed on the appointment book during this time
    
*   **Start Time** - When this rule should commence
    
*   **End Time** \- When this rule should end
    
*   **Appointment Types** \- Control what types of appointments can be booked during this time, with option to only apply to patients booking online
    
*   **Background Colour** \- The colour that should appear on the appointment book during this time
    
*   **Text Colour** \- The colour of the text if you've added Display Text
    
*   **Booking Types** - What types of booking activity are permitted during this time. Manual (permits staff to book during this time), Online Booking (permits online bookings during this time), Waiting List (this time should be considered as available for the waiting list).
    

If you're adding rules to indicate times that a practitioner is unavailable, then the O (for online booking) and W (for waiting list) should be unchecked to prevent this booking activity.

_An example of the Display Text, Background Colour and Text feature:_

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614794829/caeaaefb7359dc02c0be5aae/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61dfaf98391a14b6d4b42812f1a67e9c53fd5057a228460c567c2bdd3c00370d&req=ciEjEcB6lYNWFb4f3HP0gO6Zghtozjpf6xfxfPcx%2B2FauUxwLZh3%2BwDDMIBM%0Auzi%2BcFt4LXaelokkcw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614794829/caeaaefb7359dc02c0be5aae/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61dfaf98391a14b6d4b42812f1a67e9c53fd5057a228460c567c2bdd3c00370d&req=ciEjEcB6lYNWFb4f3HP0gO6Zghtozjpf6xfxfPcx%2B2FauUxwLZh3%2BwDDMIBM%0Auzi%2BcFt4LXaelokkcw%3D%3D%0A)

Copying Rules to Other Days
---------------------------

If the same Rule applies to multiple days, use the **Copy** button to add it to other days.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614795552/c0893a5dc00d45420a92f728/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e906a1d262da6ff9d945834657e46d70ac8540590b31fa57d22d48a0302cb2ce&req=ciEjEcB7mIRdFb4f3HP0gKb9fU4UDxlKX0MYHrLc0Yv%2Bl20ey4DtWfDJjwBW%0AxQTGSeiktJ2Kups24Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614795552/c0893a5dc00d45420a92f728/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e906a1d262da6ff9d945834657e46d70ac8540590b31fa57d22d48a0302cb2ce&req=ciEjEcB7mIRdFb4f3HP0gKb9fU4UDxlKX0MYHrLc0Yv%2Bl20ey4DtWfDJjwBW%0AxQTGSeiktJ2Kups24Q%3D%3D%0A)

If all Rules added to a particular day also apply to other days, use the **Copy All Rules** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614795921/2c91437f247aacceeb972639/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a788cfd13abb4eec6c687f4c0d740310b207d3e17ea2f76fe47547b8d12189ee&req=ciEjEcB7lINeFb4f3HP0gB07BQB6UvNw4OHr15gue288J6vXC4GZO5pMaUkU%0AQQBrsGWHUmNdRCePdg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614795921/2c91437f247aacceeb972639/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a788cfd13abb4eec6c687f4c0d740310b207d3e17ea2f76fe47547b8d12189ee&req=ciEjEcB7lINeFb4f3HP0gB07BQB6UvNw4OHr15gue288J6vXC4GZO5pMaUkU%0AQQBrsGWHUmNdRCePdg%3D%3D%0A)

Select which date the rule(s) should apply to.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614795673/a5bd63fa497e0fd541328182/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2b9c735992e05b6ea2d102ebf4f438fd73b0bcbad0be5347cb0fde3424ba0d4d&req=ciEjEcB7m4ZcFb4f3HP0gH8Ixejw8%2FGkIx1OErv6kir%2F1rwicXQnSDEnc8y3%0AtrBpOyU%2FKipQyF1uQQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614795673/a5bd63fa497e0fd541328182/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2b9c735992e05b6ea2d102ebf4f438fd73b0bcbad0be5347cb0fde3424ba0d4d&req=ciEjEcB7m4ZcFb4f3HP0gH8Ixejw8%2FGkIx1OErv6kir%2F1rwicXQnSDEnc8y3%0AtrBpOyU%2FKipQyF1uQQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Roster Overrides**
====================

Overrides can be applied for once-off or repeating roster adjustments, such as a practitioner picking up additional shifts, alternating fortnightly schedules and more.

Creating Overrides via a Roster
-------------------------------

Overrides can be created from the top of a practitioner's roster. A quick way to access a practitioner's current roster is by hovering over their name on the appointment book and selecting Roster.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912032526/c02148de69db9a1805b60c37/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+16.07.35%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6fff4e8b64fa1a480d8146acc5384273d266af72eb1eab038203bcb42b3573a7&req=fSElFsp8mINZFb4f3HP0gPufZ%2BaFBmlUo%2FzOpB2vmxMpj4cBYQ7WPMoWRjhu%0ANXeiS6ynAMj9t2OUCw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912032526/c02148de69db9a1805b60c37/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+16.07.35%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6fff4e8b64fa1a480d8146acc5384273d266af72eb1eab038203bcb42b3573a7&req=fSElFsp8mINZFb4f3HP0gPufZ%2BaFBmlUo%2FzOpB2vmxMpj4cBYQ7WPMoWRjhu%0ANXeiS6ynAMj9t2OUCw%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add Override** at the top of the roster. Use **Manage Overrides** to edit all overrides.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912026024/33cbb94219682c4e73cce867/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+15.47.02%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=516e3ae2da92c15821e271f3725ea46c278da80368acc75173506c55b786c8fa&req=fSElFst4nYNbFb4f3HP0gI%2BKSnhGQkevWKz4nYR4uexjZ0Ta8LMR8xEsxp1P%0ArX%2FRkc21vUrfl5GZeA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912026024/33cbb94219682c4e73cce867/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+15.47.02%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=516e3ae2da92c15821e271f3725ea46c278da80368acc75173506c55b786c8fa&req=fSElFst4nYNbFb4f3HP0gI%2BKSnhGQkevWKz4nYR4uexjZ0Ta8LMR8xEsxp1P%0ArX%2FRkc21vUrfl5GZeA%3D%3D%0A)

Creating Overrides via the Appointment Book
-------------------------------------------

Click and drag to select a timeframe on the appointment book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912026966/9c9553c537d392e1c29ff35d/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+15.49.31%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6cfba5734f132090f651904437d50cc9ca0376c8c29430f22cc9e14651dd8f12&req=fSElFst4lIdZFb4f3HP0gF%2FqecJ25CjI35Y2jhvhBFA723MW%2F45A%2FSoJIYLP%0A9mxmO%2BktvaUzW4Mq5A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912026966/9c9553c537d392e1c29ff35d/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+15.49.31%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6cfba5734f132090f651904437d50cc9ca0376c8c29430f22cc9e14651dd8f12&req=fSElFst4lIdZFb4f3HP0gF%2FqecJ25CjI35Y2jhvhBFA723MW%2F45A%2FSoJIYLP%0A9mxmO%2BktvaUzW4Mq5A%3D%3D%0A)

A popup will appear to configure the override settings.

Roster Override Settings
------------------------

Regardless of how you begin creating an override, you will customise the same settings shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614796207/f051e8f149232b5da5f262ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cfcff43178fc36953d1745ed7eae84cc607fb3f8d35c966e659f41f0688f896e&req=ciEjEcB4n4FYFb4f3HP0gNFyMeQvKnujIVAlp3PEyQTSTgLuFqMHZl71iuyO%0AFxYLjJ8HCHC1%2FRfUtA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614796207/f051e8f149232b5da5f262ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cfcff43178fc36953d1745ed7eae84cc607fb3f8d35c966e659f41f0688f896e&req=ciEjEcB4n4FYFb4f3HP0gNFyMeQvKnujIVAlp3PEyQTSTgLuFqMHZl71iuyO%0AFxYLjJ8HCHC1%2FRfUtA%3D%3D%0A)

To configure your Roster Overrides, be sure to select:

*   Repeat frequency
    
*   Start and End dates (optional)
    
*   Display text
    
*   Start and End Time
    
*   Appointment Types
    
*   Background and Text colours
    
*   What column the overrides affect (for multicolumn practitioners)
    

Note that roster overrides are ranked, which will determine which override takes precedence in the case of an overlap. **Overrides ranked higher in the list will take precedence**.

Days Off

Days Off
========

Managing annual leave and public holidays

Updated over a month ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183069-days-off#h_ded2ce5b75)

[Creating Days Off](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183069-days-off#h_8ab0efe23a)

[Deleting Days Off](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183069-days-off#h_2059b6eb02)

Overview
========

Days off can be added to completely rule out a date range and prevent appointment bookings for individual practitioners and an entire business. The practitioner(s) appointment book columns will not be available to add any type of appointments. Common uses for Days Off include employee leave and public holidays.

Creating Days Off
-----------------

#### Step 1:

Go to **[Settings > Practitioners > Days Off](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners/daysoff)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141458/2b5f98792d32d94eb1393c90/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4608a772eb55d71b0229341a86863afe1f5a9c6b82a9bee72307e1123e962373&req=ciMkF81%2FmYRXFb4f3HP0gIgSJpKrpdEpyQkr7rM8mTJbeOmnmsPSuhIti7Po%0ASwU3etNRVofH%2BQ1Yvw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141458/2b5f98792d32d94eb1393c90/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4608a772eb55d71b0229341a86863afe1f5a9c6b82a9bee72307e1123e962373&req=ciMkF81%2FmYRXFb4f3HP0gIgSJpKrpdEpyQkr7rM8mTJbeOmnmsPSuhIti7Po%0ASwU3etNRVofH%2BQ1Yvw%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click **Edit**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141545/fcff692fcabc3270b33c781e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f47d3d54e2491f0935de2b8fda5edd2aa313124f0ac22bf7a4f360aba6a18f4e&req=ciMkF81%2FmIVaFb4f3HP0gD4IfaCa5ZCbMPwYWXiO%2FU%2B%2Bt62P5UyFC1xUzdr9%0Ad85%2BdL19jKkDzoBekA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141545/fcff692fcabc3270b33c781e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f47d3d54e2491f0935de2b8fda5edd2aa313124f0ac22bf7a4f360aba6a18f4e&req=ciMkF81%2FmIVaFb4f3HP0gD4IfaCa5ZCbMPwYWXiO%2FU%2B%2Bt62P5UyFC1xUzdr9%0Ad85%2BdL19jKkDzoBekA%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Select the '**Add**' button to add a new day off

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141610/41765aa5f6de8eaf01483ecd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2c32c9744f62e4140e03fa69815a7e36a26e1f4a271ba53dcee6ba9a24bdb344&req=ciMkF81%2Fm4BfFb4f3HP0gD1UnYMEDcpUKvJ92WnttD8DD4gL6wuSqQmpTnXi%0AYpCF37DFP68H9XiVTg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141610/41765aa5f6de8eaf01483ecd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2c32c9744f62e4140e03fa69815a7e36a26e1f4a271ba53dcee6ba9a24bdb344&req=ciMkF81%2Fm4BfFb4f3HP0gD1UnYMEDcpUKvJ92WnttD8DD4gL6wuSqQmpTnXi%0AYpCF37DFP68H9XiVTg%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

A new row will be added to the bottom of the grid, provide a description that will be shown on the appointment book, as well as start and end dates. Choose the Businesses and/or Practitioners that this Day Off should affect.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141877/42f00dcdb11b5e8c3e62e34e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8f3134a64907d02c0e4b60085bb17f70f2108a3983f3dca2dbef5f91daf7eef&req=ciMkF81%2FlYZYFb4f3HP0gCM3zh3sKpB4Ck%2BslXwLKAMycTH9Ay7OqGSRL3xE%0AjVoKmBYYNtTwEHb67Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141877/42f00dcdb11b5e8c3e62e34e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8f3134a64907d02c0e4b60085bb17f70f2108a3983f3dca2dbef5f91daf7eef&req=ciMkF81%2FlYZYFb4f3HP0gCM3zh3sKpB4Ck%2BslXwLKAMycTH9Ay7OqGSRL3xE%0AjVoKmBYYNtTwEHb67Q%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 5:

Select the '**Save**' button to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141979/0eddd35022c088eafa56a1f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f2ce3cf65304a2a70e5f35a4280680e036518d118f095495264d75cbc9e8bcc0&req=ciMkF81%2FlIZWFb4f3HP0gMiEKEEvpaQwXe7QdskNh5rl%2F%2F7nsPH64Miih%2FN1%0AHIyqB1DluenQEw0a7g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633141979/0eddd35022c088eafa56a1f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f2ce3cf65304a2a70e5f35a4280680e036518d118f095495264d75cbc9e8bcc0&req=ciMkF81%2FlIZWFb4f3HP0gMiEKEEvpaQwXe7QdskNh5rl%2F%2F7nsPH64Miih%2FN1%0AHIyqB1DluenQEw0a7g%3D%3D%0A)

Deleting Days Off
-----------------

#### Step 1:

Select the Day(s) Off that you would like to delete by checking the box on the left.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1920210549/12d39c7798046aedd51f606c2397/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4e386c40bb3ea094ab54680abbbbf38023a9e3ab0b079dc51f9908a4ad60825&req=dSklFst%2FnYRbUPMW1HO4zRlE5PkEkJA4qPNcYdarVH%2BEAGFzfGcc2wqLtgeM%0AJnk0ZW4L7wNBb8kmyyU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1920210549/12d39c7798046aedd51f606c2397/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4e386c40bb3ea094ab54680abbbbf38023a9e3ab0b079dc51f9908a4ad60825&req=dSklFst%2FnYRbUPMW1HO4zRlE5PkEkJA4qPNcYdarVH%2BEAGFzfGcc2wqLtgeM%0AJnk0ZW4L7wNBb8kmyyU%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click on the Delete button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1920210792/1f65e11e5c36a089032dbb1e508b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a0a32ced83606523499e7cc3070dfc7526f35737680f65ba562bcbf5cb913840&req=dSklFst%2FnYZWW%2FMW1HO4zSlRGO%2BNjfD28iL0vpR51jwAJigFG4ekMlRjta8X%0Ar%2Bo4Cts1hB9Z8RKAQfs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1920210792/1f65e11e5c36a089032dbb1e508b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a0a32ced83606523499e7cc3070dfc7526f35737680f65ba562bcbf5cb913840&req=dSklFst%2FnYZWW%2FMW1HO4zSlRGO%2BNjfD28iL0vpR51jwAJigFG4ekMlRjta8X%0Ar%2Bo4Cts1hB9Z8RKAQfs%3D%0A)

The filters along the top can be used to view previous Days Off and to find entries for particular practitioners and businesses. You can also click the column headers to sort by that column.

Assigning a Roster to a Practitioner

Assigning a Roster to a Practitioner
====================================

Updated over 6 months ago

Table of contents

[Setting the Default Roster for New Practitioners](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183072-assigning-a-roster-to-a-practitioner#h_6b9e755da9)

_[Click here for a comprehensive guide to creating a Roster.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides)
_

After creating a Roster, the final step is to assign it to a practitioner file.

Go to **[Settings > Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)** and select the relevant practitioner.

Select the **Edit** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633143344/f215efda5ee028b9d78a9ca3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5dc0adc57c838413aa804666c31b57dbd7840bb21fa2767fd40a2d741240394f&req=ciMkF819noVbFb4f3HP0gAt907pYDH6TQdvHWG02%2FsEz6GV3PkL7y7TGVAjS%0AM1EpgOsnyiayyU2gBw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633143344/f215efda5ee028b9d78a9ca3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5dc0adc57c838413aa804666c31b57dbd7840bb21fa2767fd40a2d741240394f&req=ciMkF819noVbFb4f3HP0gAt907pYDH6TQdvHWG02%2FsEz6GV3PkL7y7TGVAjS%0AM1EpgOsnyiayyU2gBw%3D%3D%0A)

Scroll down to the **Roster** section and select **Add** under the relevant business.

Select the appropriate Roster and start date.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633143559/2c414b363557400a939ea340/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64e0ddb385fef2a3078bfc3323a3b73e82e76cca2e95154d1dd435c3d237e5bd&req=ciMkF819mIRWFb4f3HP0gJjlNQP9H5OOt%2B5phsPaGgruSaU3hY3M3oS4GZa1%0AkTqwaCRf%2F%2BAKP540ew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633143559/2c414b363557400a939ea340/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64e0ddb385fef2a3078bfc3323a3b73e82e76cca2e95154d1dd435c3d237e5bd&req=ciMkF819mIRWFb4f3HP0gJjlNQP9H5OOt%2B5phsPaGgruSaU3hY3M3oS4GZa1%0AkTqwaCRf%2F%2BAKP540ew%3D%3D%0A)

If a practitioner's hours are changing significantly, you can set an end date for the current roster and the start date of the new roster.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633143941/ef0c77bcd7965f992c8dadc5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f2307ab8b5ed279e4c1ccf86bc0b630469946aa0590ad111b4780592c8ddd721&req=ciMkF819lIVeFb4f3HP0gBYkCdBByhtJC78l1Hy8sdUpZZP2UIZNGDP47a1J%0A4co1GOaeyoD0iaHcEQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633143941/ef0c77bcd7965f992c8dadc5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f2307ab8b5ed279e4c1ccf86bc0b630469946aa0590ad111b4780592c8ddd721&req=ciMkF819lIVeFb4f3HP0gBYkCdBByhtJC78l1Hy8sdUpZZP2UIZNGDP47a1J%0A4co1GOaeyoD0iaHcEQ%3D%3D%0A)

This can also be done from within a specific roster. See **[this article](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides#assigning-a-roster-to-a-practitioner)
** for more more information.

* * *

Setting the Default Roster for New Practitioners
================================================

PracSuite allows you to apply a specific roster when creating new practitioner files.

This is ideal if you apply a generic 'unavailable' roster template to ensure a new practitioner's time is completely unavailable until their working hours have been determined.

Once you've created the generic roster template, you can set it as the default roster in [Settings > Practitioners > Rosters](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners/rosters)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912036544/55d74d6ffeb83c6966f74c50/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+16.14.26%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c8cf85afcf58e2cac5ee7f45d6e7218156de5ad28add9621083f013f7cec430a&req=fSElFsp4mIVbFb4f3HP0gCi5gtAQSeGXnHSZ9Wf13p7ua%2Buz9TU2hyDA36qn%0Ae6wpyeAr1lzOq9D2OQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/912036544/55d74d6ffeb83c6966f74c50/CleanShot+2023-12-18+at+16.14.26%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c8cf85afcf58e2cac5ee7f45d6e7218156de5ad28add9621083f013f7cec430a&req=fSElFsp4mIVbFb4f3HP0gCi5gtAQSeGXnHSZ9Wf13p7ua%2Buz9TU2hyDA36qn%0Ae6wpyeAr1lzOq9D2OQ%3D%3D%0A)

Creating a Fee Category

Creating a Fee Category
=======================

Updated over 5 months ago

Table of contents

[Choosing a Patient's Fee Category](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4196739-creating-a-fee-category#h_1939c09301)

[Creating and managing Fee Categories](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4196739-creating-a-fee-category#h_bcc4fd7a75)

Fee Categories are primarily used to identify the funding nature for a patient's services but also have several other benefits, including:

*   Setting different rates for the same Item Code per Fee Category
    
*   Configure Appointment Type default preferences per Fee Category
    
*   Filtering report results by Fee Category
    

Typical Fee Categories in the allied health space include:

*   Private
    
*   Medicare Bulk Bill
    
*   Medicare Fee + Gap
    
*   DVA
    
*   Workcover
    
*   Concession
    
*   Family & Friends
    
*   NDIS Self Managed
    
*   NDIS Plan Managed
    
*   NDIS Agency Managed
    
*   No Charge
    

Choosing a Patient's Fee Category
=================================

A patient's primary Fee Category is set on the main tab of their file, as shown below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725912525/62cd0dbe1cda3fba0fc010149040/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4446d48bc40df3306dc5f26a0bcaa1f60902c04a80d62150263209b4e472c9d7&req=dSclE8B%2Fn4RdXPMW1HO4zW5ptRAHz89AgE3BmwggAkJy5d%2BTxs4lkn9Cv6WJ%0Aj46dgYS4dOOLEwjixNU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725912525/62cd0dbe1cda3fba0fc010149040/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4446d48bc40df3306dc5f26a0bcaa1f60902c04a80d62150263209b4e472c9d7&req=dSclE8B%2Fn4RdXPMW1HO4zW5ptRAHz89AgE3BmwggAkJy5d%2BTxs4lkn9Cv6WJ%0Aj46dgYS4dOOLEwjixNU%3D%0A)

It's also possible for a patient file to have multiple Fee Categories, which is ideal if a patient moves between funding sources. For example, if the patient initially presents with a Medicare referral but moves to private funding once they have used all sessions on their Medicare referral.

In this example, you can enable the Fee Category override within an individual Account on the patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725913066/99f21286419b7048595606cc5cc6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4ac853c767bda98702fdb5e8a42637b66ce0dbd09c56440ea37e01b5a27d5ad6&req=dSclE8B%2FnoFZX%2FMW1HO4zZ7t1RqchpvluyyvKj8btdChXVxgB5L1tm%2Brrejp%0AW1gYI1WVOucP766%2Fssw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725913066/99f21286419b7048595606cc5cc6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4ac853c767bda98702fdb5e8a42637b66ce0dbd09c56440ea37e01b5a27d5ad6&req=dSclE8B%2FnoFZX%2FMW1HO4zZ7t1RqchpvluyyvKj8btdChXVxgB5L1tm%2Brrejp%0AW1gYI1WVOucP766%2Fssw%3D%0A)

A patient's Fee Category is also visible on the Appointment Details screen and on the Invoice screen.

Creating and managing Fee Categories
====================================

#### Step 1:

Go to **[Settings > Billing > Fee Categories](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/feecategories)**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633147793/f75ddc69aa7799cf293851c8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fcac82e8a7d8d13f44f33e199dbfbe7244b86843130fe7e0769761bf399b649d&req=ciMkF815mohcFb4f3HP0gC5vpf8w3Eoq8of%2FkruJ0lGzLUu70XJi6mg%2BqiHd%0AO0fCXgzN10dn9d%2FBtA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633147793/f75ddc69aa7799cf293851c8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fcac82e8a7d8d13f44f33e199dbfbe7244b86843130fe7e0769761bf399b649d&req=ciMkF815mohcFb4f3HP0gC5vpf8w3Eoq8of%2FkruJ0lGzLUu70XJi6mg%2BqiHd%0AO0fCXgzN10dn9d%2FBtA%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select Edit

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633147897/91eba781b6d974fc85426080/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3292ea63924164baae5f0b86908dc182ce7c3d357c218f4622ad6ed8c0e30ec&req=ciMkF815lYhYFb4f3HP0gHYy4OzfGMV7aQh6wSIR67fVQL%2F%2B6oQysAwdP3yE%0A7Q2Cxq2RsM9GVItOrA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633147897/91eba781b6d974fc85426080/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3292ea63924164baae5f0b86908dc182ce7c3d357c218f4622ad6ed8c0e30ec&req=ciMkF815lYhYFb4f3HP0gHYy4OzfGMV7aQh6wSIR67fVQL%2F%2B6oQysAwdP3yE%0A7Q2Cxq2RsM9GVItOrA%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Select Add to add a new Fee Category

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633147977/4aaccf96fe5d614d6e340b95/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dbcfa1fa4d2b0c2485f973145a6747c2452887bcbabc81f74b0945fb61791f3b&req=ciMkF815lIZYFb4f3HP0gOCgwmByjuGaZnCcjrTj4e38zShgl1DtcPFILxtr%0ARvJB9VvLR3YTcK1nmw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633147977/4aaccf96fe5d614d6e340b95/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dbcfa1fa4d2b0c2485f973145a6747c2452887bcbabc81f74b0945fb61791f3b&req=ciMkF815lIZYFb4f3HP0gOCgwmByjuGaZnCcjrTj4e38zShgl1DtcPFILxtr%0ARvJB9VvLR3YTcK1nmw%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

Enter the name of the new Fee Category.

Type the name of the Fee Category into the name field. Enable the Include GST option to automatically add GST to items billed for patients with this Fee Category.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633148240/4f28db0bdcf226f0f228179c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3097a27289f7979f1bf33be40bfcf40ac4f91dca5ca7bf65f0e8cc82d6827548&req=ciMkF812n4VfFb4f3HP0gDvt%2BnbMz%2FQZrLq1J2hIb7IGZVi%2Fg0WdOkrcYPqP%0AuatuBHKLEI2DIyxqig%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633148240/4f28db0bdcf226f0f228179c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3097a27289f7979f1bf33be40bfcf40ac4f91dca5ca7bf65f0e8cc82d6827548&req=ciMkF812n4VfFb4f3HP0gDvt%2BnbMz%2FQZrLq1J2hIb7IGZVi%2Fg0WdOkrcYPqP%0AuatuBHKLEI2DIyxqig%3D%3D%0A)

### GST Override

There are three options that can be set that determine the GST behaviour when billing against the Fee Category:

**Default**: The Include GST setting on the Item Code's page will be respected

**No GST**: No GST will be applied to the Item Code.

**All GST**: All Items will have GST applied.

We generally recommend leaving the GST Override set to Default and set GST on a per Item Code basis.

### Default Fee Category

The Fee Category that will be assigned by default when creating a new patient file will be whichever is at the top of the list. It is a good idea to put the most commonly used Fee Category at the top to minimise how often you need to set it manually.

### Re-ordering Fee Categories

To re-order the Fee Categories, click Edit at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725953914/034d17429a14887038dc350f3ff2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9b231ff6bbb680d05de304a9c570bf8864216a0ec76b42b1ee5db132daec298&req=dSclE8B7noheXfMW1HO4zT2AljKocol8Rqi383D%2Fgcrs5b3iDPqQoWo80a4f%0AXwJl8gU%2B2XcSllZNP84%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725953914/034d17429a14887038dc350f3ff2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9b231ff6bbb680d05de304a9c570bf8864216a0ec76b42b1ee5db132daec298&req=dSclE8B7noheXfMW1HO4zT2AljKocol8Rqi383D%2Fgcrs5b3iDPqQoWo80a4f%0AXwJl8gU%2B2XcSllZNP84%3D%0A)

While in edit mode, mouse over the Fee Category you wish to re-order and use the drag handle on the left-hand side to drag and drop it to your preferred position.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725954617/47c2565d9f5da4a3276a31d41a23/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b13a52d4360ec7580b576707694dfcf6db25bf338e11282968289f512a3ca9e&req=dSclE8B7mYdeXvMW1HO4za2OFOFPoXNYPKlImDoFyjSArn2PF0Q1%2FTGpunaq%0AI%2F2SLtVQjUHHLVOOM9M%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725954617/47c2565d9f5da4a3276a31d41a23/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b13a52d4360ec7580b576707694dfcf6db25bf338e11282968289f512a3ca9e&req=dSclE8B7mYdeXvMW1HO4za2OFOFPoXNYPKlImDoFyjSArn2PF0Q1%2FTGpunaq%0AI%2F2SLtVQjUHHLVOOM9M%3D%0A)

Creating Item Code Schedules

Creating Item Code Schedules
============================

Updated over 3 years ago

An Item Code Schedule is used to categorise Item Codes, for example, to separate Service and Stock/Inventory item codes. Item Codes can only belong to a single Schedule. To add Item Codes into multiple groups for the purpose of reporting, see Item Code Groups.

1\. Go to **[Settings > Billing > Schedules](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/schedules)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633124959/7dc516a4f015872d3bcd5b67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=356c790bc8aed889ea72f98f4284486ddff9e3e530c1319a4b587ac54b4373d5&req=ciMkF8t6lIRWFb4f3HP0gDI6PD80OsljqhTGbNFYvFkP4PV3zYtXB6%2FBxAWh%0AO%2BHErTjK2C4xmmlshw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633124959/7dc516a4f015872d3bcd5b67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=356c790bc8aed889ea72f98f4284486ddff9e3e530c1319a4b587ac54b4373d5&req=ciMkF8t6lIRWFb4f3HP0gDI6PD80OsljqhTGbNFYvFkP4PV3zYtXB6%2FBxAWh%0AO%2BHErTjK2C4xmmlshw%3D%3D%0A)

All PracSuite systems include Service and Non-service schedules, which can be used to separate Item Codes for services from stock items.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125079/737d53b64c3f7145108fa381/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=abb2c98acf0420002dfaeb40a3a22b3b7678d7e07844e25ca1bc876b1b4f0475&req=ciMkF8t7nYZWFb4f3HP0gHgN5tFTkFo7F3J5ZKOf3yAILePb33Go0Rv%2Bc8NK%0AdfY8WGZokvJiFZylJg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125079/737d53b64c3f7145108fa381/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=abb2c98acf0420002dfaeb40a3a22b3b7678d7e07844e25ca1bc876b1b4f0475&req=ciMkF8t7nYZWFb4f3HP0gHgN5tFTkFo7F3J5ZKOf3yAILePb33Go0Rv%2Bc8NK%0AdfY8WGZokvJiFZylJg%3D%3D%0A)

2\. To create a new Schedule, select '**Edit**' and then select the '**Add**' button at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125217/0100ae9dcf811652db4f78af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d1aeb71aa8bd4b3846a333bc02488675e077e6d1d86a6467ae82e964af6044fd&req=ciMkF8t7n4BYFb4f3HP0gJ%2B4kzx9Zi7tpnX0Z28lTNY%2FdxOiFMAO4RjqUBw3%0AyAKeRlPJWQXpOJeZvQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125217/0100ae9dcf811652db4f78af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d1aeb71aa8bd4b3846a333bc02488675e077e6d1d86a6467ae82e964af6044fd&req=ciMkF8t7n4BYFb4f3HP0gJ%2B4kzx9Zi7tpnX0Z28lTNY%2FdxOiFMAO4RjqUBw3%0AyAKeRlPJWQXpOJeZvQ%3D%3D%0A)

3\. Enter the name of the schedule.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125354/8e7ef056750e233ad7d11660/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef5ca554ca0e3a7b92316f7b61b7f42c86307fc7cd2fc6cd75c9e372e3737583&req=ciMkF8t7noRbFb4f3HP0gAbvkM%2FqCMuikIG8kiNRixrjynAo4WNWlfVkA26X%0AnEUMQ4k9aNletm8%2FEA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125354/8e7ef056750e233ad7d11660/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef5ca554ca0e3a7b92316f7b61b7f42c86307fc7cd2fc6cd75c9e372e3737583&req=ciMkF8t7noRbFb4f3HP0gAbvkM%2FqCMuikIG8kiNRixrjynAo4WNWlfVkA26X%0AnEUMQ4k9aNletm8%2FEA%3D%3D%0A)

4\. If you only want to display the Schedule and the item codes it contains for practitioners in a particular profession, you can also select a profession from the drop-down list. When billing, the item code drop-down list will only display Schedules that are relevant based on the practitioner's profession.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125453/1b285cdc9835fea1fa52a4fd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91fa4083c86a1d6fa8143b9f42470ba6a0a2a1cd3af3399a1bd22677cb1937bf&req=ciMkF8t7mYRcFb4f3HP0gK0lMKuK7zaz7rwgFGb8TdUt74oEEevtLTs6vRmp%0ARnFe5W8DJ%2Fm1jS7%2F1A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125453/1b285cdc9835fea1fa52a4fd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91fa4083c86a1d6fa8143b9f42470ba6a0a2a1cd3af3399a1bd22677cb1937bf&req=ciMkF8t7mYRcFb4f3HP0gK0lMKuK7zaz7rwgFGb8TdUt74oEEevtLTs6vRmp%0ARnFe5W8DJ%2Fm1jS7%2F1A%3D%3D%0A)

5\. You can also use the drag handle on the left-hand side to reorder the schedules, which will show in item code lists across PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125555/05d1e6f118347edd331853f3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c5ca4857fc077294fae53acfc97a335a8be98eae6ace9c1fc33e672a792e077b&req=ciMkF8t7mIRaFb4f3HP0gFfKHyKP6ChoSYyyi0oSlz86FwxE39NmTjOV%2BQZR%0A87y7B%2Bui%2BSrNerRc4w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125555/05d1e6f118347edd331853f3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c5ca4857fc077294fae53acfc97a335a8be98eae6ace9c1fc33e672a792e077b&req=ciMkF8t7mIRaFb4f3HP0gFfKHyKP6ChoSYyyi0oSlz86FwxE39NmTjOV%2BQZR%0A87y7B%2Bui%2BSrNerRc4w%3D%3D%0A)

How to Reset Two Factor Authentication

How to Reset Two Factor Authentication
======================================

Resetting Two Factor Authentication (2FA)

Updated over 3 years ago

If a user needs to reset their two factor authentication, they will need to contact a fellow PracSuite user with the System Administrator role who will be able to reset two factor authentication on behalf of the other user.

1.  When logged into PracSuite as a System Administrator, go to **[Settings > Users & Security > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)
    **
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125945/3070304dffc9e62f16aef2c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ce808a52497ea45fe6da92d24f471b9d1b095d078ef9649c097e614b424a6da0&req=ciMkF8t7lIVaFb4f3HP0gDLYZJP1AkMWlgMguyVifELAB3zw4vu6tU2ZgspT%0AUfk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633125945/3070304dffc9e62f16aef2c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ce808a52497ea45fe6da92d24f471b9d1b095d078ef9649c097e614b424a6da0&req=ciMkF8t7lIVaFb4f3HP0gDLYZJP1AkMWlgMguyVifELAB3zw4vu6tU2ZgspT%0AUfk%3D%0A)
    
2.  Select the User in the list
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633126106/74ab730b8c605c0e6bf0ff18/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=052bb7acdeef3e60e82363f511e7e7d73c89fc8e2eab7180f6906e230b8f9e73&req=ciMkF8t4nIFZFb4f3HP0gMTJy%2Fm3yB7GhUTPdlVXIROQa2u80CZJLWx8F8TK%0AbeM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633126106/74ab730b8c605c0e6bf0ff18/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=052bb7acdeef3e60e82363f511e7e7d73c89fc8e2eab7180f6906e230b8f9e73&req=ciMkF8t4nIFZFb4f3HP0gMTJy%2Fm3yB7GhUTPdlVXIROQa2u80CZJLWx8F8TK%0AbeM%3D%0A)
    
3.  At the top of their User profile, you will be able to select **Reset Two Factor Authentication**
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633126267/5e3bfe404d9000ec03b19c9d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b56ad072c60b03c049c10287d3760bb9e1681295abbe8bd5be797d4725566d77&req=ciMkF8t4n4dYFb4f3HP0gC%2Bg%2FS6X%2FMWz%2Ba7hP3BYtsFWwL8LQPbETiHdYLD6%0Aw%2FQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633126267/5e3bfe404d9000ec03b19c9d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b56ad072c60b03c049c10287d3760bb9e1681295abbe8bd5be797d4725566d77&req=ciMkF8t4n4dYFb4f3HP0gC%2Bg%2FS6X%2FMWz%2Ba7hP3BYtsFWwL8LQPbETiHdYLD6%0Aw%2FQ%3D%0A)
    

When the user next signs in to PracSuite, they will be asked to reconfigure two factor authentication.

How to Reset Your Password

How to Reset Your Password
==========================

Updated over 3 years ago

1.  If you have forgotten your password, click the '**Forgot your password**' link on the login screen.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592942030/7e175de625945fe4ce38e8a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35268158184dadd0bcdf16a5d0aea8e1f44b55410c72aff95062b5484a644a96&req=cSklH818nYJfFb4f3HP0gBdYFBRbrxqX1TGAI0mpU7Lbg%2F4uYjYAZqQwkOr3%0An5Mx7vyyAO5MNnYMxQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592942030/7e175de625945fe4ce38e8a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35268158184dadd0bcdf16a5d0aea8e1f44b55410c72aff95062b5484a644a96&req=cSklH818nYJfFb4f3HP0gBdYFBRbrxqX1TGAI0mpU7Lbg%2F4uYjYAZqQwkOr3%0An5Mx7vyyAO5MNnYMxQ%3D%3D%0A)

2\. Enter the email address you use to log into PracSuite

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592942116/455c70acfe41c4b71d1e93d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=01239cf7449e28e62e7a7c81a444de151dc6b57dd488a36bf296c5f40776a0ed&req=cSklH818nIBZFb4f3HP0gMbtAnkOU0P7AwD0C2dGitL79uLhd7%2Fwwj1qiLgR%0AyZwOKhWfffsCditCrg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592942116/455c70acfe41c4b71d1e93d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=01239cf7449e28e62e7a7c81a444de151dc6b57dd488a36bf296c5f40776a0ed&req=cSklH818nIBZFb4f3HP0gMbtAnkOU0P7AwD0C2dGitL79uLhd7%2Fwwj1qiLgR%0AyZwOKhWfffsCditCrg%3D%3D%0A)

3\. If you have entered a valid PracSuite email address, you will be sent an email with a link to reset your password.

Note: If you do not receive an email, please double-check that you entered your email address correctly, or contact your System Administrator to confirm that you have appropriate access to log into PracSuite.

4\. Click the password reset link in the email. You will then be prompted to answer your security questions.

Note: If you have forgotten your security questions, you will need to contact your PracSuite System Administrator and request them to reset your password on your behalf. [Click here to learn more.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242877-how-to-reset-another-user-s-password-as-a-system-administrator)

5\. After successfully answering your security questions, you will be prompted to enter your new password. Select Change Password to finalise this process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/226134059/566c064e6f22e22e3d38583c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fa888a6222feeeb2c3210bb3404b3adc56b651bc0d317dbc900aede7475d765f&req=diIhF8p6nYRWFb4f3HP0gLIDQIkk5lDK8afUAZDaHxJMhj9b3g1sOD%2F2k5Ro%0AqdMPNJZpDCobCxjAHA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/226134059/566c064e6f22e22e3d38583c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fa888a6222feeeb2c3210bb3404b3adc56b651bc0d317dbc900aede7475d765f&req=diIhF8p6nYRWFb4f3HP0gLIDQIkk5lDK8afUAZDaHxJMhj9b3g1sOD%2F2k5Ro%0AqdMPNJZpDCobCxjAHA%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/226133555/5292d2662c92cefba35a5c50/HR.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4315f9fee639b6f7e15c04992e571a1d53fc8af30d413fef051d4075ae314412&req=diIhF8p9mIRaFb4f3HP0gDbWQ1ekSUtesZr%2FXrwAvQVL8N6QptkISRal09Q2%0Az5ET%2FF%2Fkv%2BnIER0aNQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/226133555/5292d2662c92cefba35a5c50/HR.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4315f9fee639b6f7e15c04992e571a1d53fc8af30d413fef051d4075ae314412&req=diIhF8p9mIRaFb4f3HP0gDbWQ1ekSUtesZr%2FXrwAvQVL8N6QptkISRal09Q2%0Az5ET%2FF%2Fkv%2BnIER0aNQ%3D%3D%0A)

If you're logged into PracSuite, you can also change your password from your user menu in the top right-hand corner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592930056/04c14df89d345c7a0e553884/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2d0aa5c0129eeaf510d5fb290420f38caae00ffcec21abd76db785f9a8a281e0&req=cSklH8p%2BnYRZFb4f3HP0gN0OTPGMI7dp%2Bx8HL%2Fu%2FJsyEq3nKkjST51PdSrIa%0A7CHTkL9Y1n0DbB6puQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592930056/04c14df89d345c7a0e553884/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2d0aa5c0129eeaf510d5fb290420f38caae00ffcec21abd76db785f9a8a281e0&req=cSklH8p%2BnYRZFb4f3HP0gN0OTPGMI7dp%2Bx8HL%2Fu%2FJsyEq3nKkjST51PdSrIa%0A7CHTkL9Y1n0DbB6puQ%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 58 — How to Reset Another User's Password as a System Administrator | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-58}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242877-how-to-reset-another-user-s-password-as-a-system-administrator](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242877-how-to-reset-another-user-s-password-as-a-system-administrator)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242877-how-to-reset-another-user-s-password-as-a-system-administrator#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Users & Security](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2419428-users-security)

[Basics](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984773-basics)

How to Reset Another User's Password as a System Administrator

How to Reset Another User's Password as a System Administrator
==============================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

If a PracSuite user is unable to reset their password themselves, PracSuite System Administrators can reset the user's password on their behalf.

1\. Go to **[Settings > Users & Security > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633205202/d6ebeaf1619301520c593a53/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af899fc27aa16f6714b292293fe9d50128ff72bc8d5edad8518e9435e2d9fb3e&req=ciMkFMl7n4FdFb4f3HP0gLGLj9Wz4M8x9vnpvDdJB2Zfn%2B9I%2Fwj0C1gDBtJY%0ANL%2BdXwwSg7CGf45x%2BA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633205202/d6ebeaf1619301520c593a53/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af899fc27aa16f6714b292293fe9d50128ff72bc8d5edad8518e9435e2d9fb3e&req=ciMkFMl7n4FdFb4f3HP0gLGLj9Wz4M8x9vnpvDdJB2Zfn%2B9I%2Fwj0C1gDBtJY%0ANL%2BdXwwSg7CGf45x%2BA%3D%3D%0A)

2\. select the user in the list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633205299/02fba653ac6bebe5e31d7099/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=933bf2760d8142991f2f2f18a7849d2931b02b98bf06ff88cac146659c581fa9&req=ciMkFMl7n4hWFb4f3HP0gLPcWJDhZawBmKzpulwwlqpPMogvxdSfeGlKki8j%0AAkLYEzkxIqrQvJzjeg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633205299/02fba653ac6bebe5e31d7099/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=933bf2760d8142991f2f2f18a7849d2931b02b98bf06ff88cac146659c581fa9&req=ciMkFMl7n4hWFb4f3HP0gLPcWJDhZawBmKzpulwwlqpPMogvxdSfeGlKki8j%0AAkLYEzkxIqrQvJzjeg%3D%3D%0A)

3\. At the top of their user profile, you can select the '**Generate password**' option to reset their password.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633204971/9824214fc18c8addc629f3eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6484c85d4498ec97449e44c61374e5d7ba8b182702af5b71c27ea066d490c2f6&req=ciMkFMl6lIZeFb4f3HP0gAEBFMuFoywZdBHal%2B9gbTvu4DdijloTX%2B3fDf8Z%0AXA0Dr1IRUjZNQ7922Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633204971/9824214fc18c8addc629f3eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6484c85d4498ec97449e44c61374e5d7ba8b182702af5b71c27ea066d490c2f6&req=ciMkFMl6lIZeFb4f3HP0gAEBFMuFoywZdBHal%2B9gbTvu4DdijloTX%2B3fDf8Z%0AXA0Dr1IRUjZNQ7922Q%3D%3D%0A)

3\. You'll be prompted to enter a new password for the user.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633209881/84ccb7b367fff15c713d887c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7adee0a791e4b70d10788049ff789125c3c5a313bc48f530850b5a6f9eb3189a&req=ciMkFMl3lYleFb4f3HP0gOTngaCUEaYz8uO%2BdpsyYWAFxZ6aH5VsFMy0%2BzfI%0AbAsAsbpW%2Fsi%2Fios6Aw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633209881/84ccb7b367fff15c713d887c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7adee0a791e4b70d10788049ff789125c3c5a313bc48f530850b5a6f9eb3189a&req=ciMkFMl3lYleFb4f3HP0gOTngaCUEaYz8uO%2BdpsyYWAFxZ6aH5VsFMy0%2BzfI%0AbAsAsbpW%2Fsi%2Fios6Aw%3D%3D%0A)

4\. You can also choose to email the new password to the user and/or force them to change the new password when they next login.

5\. Select **OK** to finalise this process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633210035/1347b75ac40c69cb9d70ac74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8de7cf0982818c68d0a1bd922f16479b9b35f6ffde76dc711eb64bf68c0ad36a&req=ciMkFMh%2BnYJaFb4f3HP0gJHbklytbP655VoBYvmZ%2BWDnA6lgY80PTbAjZ4XL%0Ap5e7ndo6CDUp%2F0%2Bufw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633210035/1347b75ac40c69cb9d70ac74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8de7cf0982818c68d0a1bd922f16479b9b35f6ffde76dc711eb64bf68c0ad36a&req=ciMkFMh%2BnYJaFb4f3HP0gJHbklytbP655VoBYvmZ%2BWDnA6lgY80PTbAjZ4XL%0Ap5e7ndo6CDUp%2F0%2Bufw%3D%3D%0A)

Note: If a user has forgotten both their password and their security questions, select the 'Send welcome email' option, which will guide them through setting up both their password and security questions again.

Understanding Two-Factor Authentication

Understanding Two-Factor Authentication
=======================================

Updated over 7 months ago

Table of contents

[2FA Token Smartphone Apps](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242927-understanding-two-factor-authentication#h_1b55ceddf7)

[2FA Token Desktop Apps (No Smartphone Required)](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242927-understanding-two-factor-authentication#h_bb27d7de1a)

[PracSuite Security Tokens](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242927-understanding-two-factor-authentication#h_98022dd712)

Two-factor authentication (2FA) provides a strong additional layer of security when logging into PracSuite by requiring users to enter a 6-digit code in addition to their email address and password. **Two-factor authentication is mandatory for all PracSuite users.**

PracSuite users can obtain their two-factor codes from time-based one-time password (TOTP) apps available on smartphones and computers, as well as physical token generators [available for purchase.](https://pracsuite.com/pracsuitesecuritytoken)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386927151/fffe3293afe98333ea867085/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d64a79f8f5f0f4e31ca7ce39f8b274a82b8ee721565e41cc948c22510d4fd66&req=dyghH8t5nIReFb4f3HP0gAeym5L5zw6Q9uQvpR4%2BIcgn%2FDvXQRNI2NegIsrJ%0AM8dbV%2BWsaXsJkskpsg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386927151/fffe3293afe98333ea867085/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d64a79f8f5f0f4e31ca7ce39f8b274a82b8ee721565e41cc948c22510d4fd66&req=dyghH8t5nIReFb4f3HP0gAeym5L5zw6Q9uQvpR4%2BIcgn%2FDvXQRNI2NegIsrJ%0AM8dbV%2BWsaXsJkskpsg%3D%3D%0A)

2FA Token Desktop Apps (No Smartphone Required)
===============================================

If you're unable to use a smartphone app to obtain 2FA codes, web-browser extensions are also available:

*   [Authenticator](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/authenticator/bhghoamapcdpbohphigoooaddinpkbai)
     for Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge
    
*   [Authenticator](https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/auth-helper/)
     for Firefox
    

* * *

PracSuite Security Tokens
=========================

As an alternative to app-based authenticators that require smartphones or computers, Smartsoft also offers physical token generators for sale.

[![](https://pracsuite.intercom-attachments-1.com/i/o/511745883/b30c88a09552ccc710e96674/auth-token-front.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f48172ce712ba341cf430b328485017ebcda1b664fec552483e28e4c4a5e0e9d&req=cSEmEc17lYlcFb4f3HP0gCW%2FccagsOn4qCx0pxKTf4TkyrOdOwNYaOo8NDR4%0AeTzFMezE%2FSlMqIh5cQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://pracsuite.intercom-attachments-1.com/i/o/511745883/b30c88a09552ccc710e96674/auth-token-front.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f48172ce712ba341cf430b328485017ebcda1b664fec552483e28e4c4a5e0e9d&req=cSEmEc17lYlcFb4f3HP0gCW%2FccagsOn4qCx0pxKTf4TkyrOdOwNYaOo8NDR4%0AeTzFMezE%2FSlMqIh5cQ%3D%3D%0A)

These physical security tokens are suited to practice environments where 2FA authenticator apps cannot be installed on users' personal devices, or the use of personal devices is not permitted. Due to the physical nature of these tokens, they can be located at a particular workstation to limit access to PracSuite from where the token is located.

PracSuite Security Tokens are available for a once-off fee of $22 + $11 Express Shipping (costs include GST). [Click here to purchase PracSuite Security Tokens via our website.](https://pracsuite.com/pracsuitesecuritytoken)

Creating Appointment Types

Creating Appointment Types
==========================

Updated over 4 months ago

Table of contents

[Appointment Type Details](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types#h_2268b861f5)

[Default Item Code and Duration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types#h_a8fcc8d4b4)

[Practitioner Overrides](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types#h_e9257f422f)

[Deleting/Marking Appointment Types as Inactive](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types#h_5ed9ea250b)

Go to **[Settings](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
** [> **Appointment Book** > **Appointment Types**](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
 and select Add to create a new Appointment Type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633959400/fef6932468e876c4d2b8996c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7d8fd1136d7d997f74044ea29435ded8627d0e396c472ba3dd877642ebeb29d&req=ciMkH8x3mYFfFb4f3HP0gMAO%2BuwNvFw7GsGF4d20PqiqHzf3uIMLzPvP%2BO9c%0A9HsAbcvoocesZoL7lw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633959400/fef6932468e876c4d2b8996c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7d8fd1136d7d997f74044ea29435ded8627d0e396c472ba3dd877642ebeb29d&req=ciMkH8x3mYFfFb4f3HP0gMAO%2BuwNvFw7GsGF4d20PqiqHzf3uIMLzPvP%2BO9c%0A9HsAbcvoocesZoL7lw%3D%3D%0A)

Appointment Type Details
========================

Choose the Description, Short Description and Colours that will be displayed in your appointment book, as shown in the preview.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633959833/9084a3d9c6d1d676ad5de0f8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26f6714a025d4840ec121a6a4a41669097d9ca477fa9719b72abb9cf3ccb7a1a&req=ciMkH8x3lYJcFb4f3HP0gIFW7C8Nc3bodYFavfLAzoVDgHVUzA%2BJdfzi221I%0AzwVMogIS5ou%2B9w85pw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633959833/9084a3d9c6d1d676ad5de0f8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26f6714a025d4840ec121a6a4a41669097d9ca477fa9719b72abb9cf3ccb7a1a&req=ciMkH8x3lYJcFb4f3HP0gIFW7C8Nc3bodYFavfLAzoVDgHVUzA%2BJdfzi221I%0AzwVMogIS5ou%2B9w85pw%3D%3D%0A)

The following settings can also be configured:

**Default Resources** \- You can also select default [resources](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059413-how-to-create-a-resource)
 if there is particular equipment that must be available and reserved when booking this appointment type.

**Group Appointment** \- If this is a group appointment i.e. a class, enable the switch accordingly and choose the maximum class size.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896709518/e8dd5cf0921256225237e0dc/CleanShot+2023-11-30+at+10.49.09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3f1de45f26aca79a53c84b988cf9874b34fe67c0e0408d88f982c3e2ccaa2882&req=fCkhEcl3mIBXFb4f3HP0gHlw8c7Cx3oZVVPpBX1t0mP%2Ffb28TzIvNR8rL1nc%0AVDM6aFYZRawM7gJ1pQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896709518/e8dd5cf0921256225237e0dc/CleanShot+2023-11-30+at+10.49.09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3f1de45f26aca79a53c84b988cf9874b34fe67c0e0408d88f982c3e2ccaa2882&req=fCkhEcl3mIBXFb4f3HP0gHlw8c7Cx3oZVVPpBX1t0mP%2Ffb28TzIvNR8rL1nc%0AVDM6aFYZRawM7gJ1pQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Requires Clinical Note** - Practitioners will be [reminded to create a clinical note](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548402-using-the-outstanding-clinical-notes-widget)
 for this appointment types.

**Telehealth Appointment** \- Enable this option if you wish to [store telehealth join links](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4790236-managing-telehealth-appointments)
 for this appointment type.

Default Item Code and Duration
==============================

In the **Default Item Code & Duration** section, click **Add** to specify the following default preferences to apply when booking this appointment type:

*   Profession
    
*   Fee Category (we recommend creating one entry with this set to all and additional entries for any specific cases)
    
*   [Item Code](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317932-creating-item-codes)
     or [Item Group](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4610658-creating-item-groups)
    
*   Duration
    
*   Width (i.e. how many columns to book across when a practitioner has multiple appointment book columns)
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633960338/63654a769d5f70dc36c16573/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fef8bef57bf6b212ca526da91e28f7d9dd35f90d9224825014d168753d55d363&req=ciMkH89%2BnoJXFb4f3HP0gJd1lA427S7iD%2BvyRGFKwOMJZ7%2BWL4LXoxU1SIW%2F%0AZMpOFooJqdwwL6s1Lw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633960338/63654a769d5f70dc36c16573/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fef8bef57bf6b212ca526da91e28f7d9dd35f90d9224825014d168753d55d363&req=ciMkH89%2BnoJXFb4f3HP0gJd1lA427S7iD%2BvyRGFKwOMJZ7%2BWL4LXoxU1SIW%2F%0AZMpOFooJqdwwL6s1Lw%3D%3D%0A)

Each profession that will be performing this appointment will need to have a **Default Item Code & Duration**.

Billing at an hourly rate? [Learn more about our Hourly Billing feature here.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8648935-using-the-hourly-billing-feature)

Practitioner Overrides
======================

You can also add **Practitioner Overrides** if an individual practitioner's preferences differ from the defaults for this Appointment Type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896708182/ebc4a69db99d251900b75d5a/CleanShot+2023-11-30+at+10.45.31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7d32564437233d46883efce95b1886c8ec58c6be288c2b138ecc5e7ed05ddece&req=fCkhEcl2nIldFb4f3HP0gCoKSv%2BQ%2B2eOX%2FznB1eNqOv08FSngji%2BVtrz%2FRj%2F%0ACuOEI8hez5VJ0dlW5w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896708182/ebc4a69db99d251900b75d5a/CleanShot+2023-11-30+at+10.45.31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7d32564437233d46883efce95b1886c8ec58c6be288c2b138ecc5e7ed05ddece&req=fCkhEcl2nIldFb4f3HP0gCoKSv%2BQ%2B2eOX%2FznB1eNqOv08FSngji%2BVtrz%2FRj%2F%0ACuOEI8hez5VJ0dlW5w%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Deleting/Marking Appointment Types as Inactive
==============================================

If an appointment type is no longer needed it can be either deleted or marked as inactive. To do this, click on the cog icon at the top of the Appointment Types page and select the appropriate option.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1798026763/d232dd5ea637dc05d22c3880a564/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a75fe1b378bd703750c49305bcd17c7cd30611e3ee1dd319ef55160e41d706ee&req=dScuHsl8m4ZZWvMW1HO4zeO8Iw%2FKmEvgYLiVD11dx%2BrDt%2FaNc7WEAYab4hel%0AYAMVUo081KkAu25oeWM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1798026763/d232dd5ea637dc05d22c3880a564/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a75fe1b378bd703750c49305bcd17c7cd30611e3ee1dd319ef55160e41d706ee&req=dScuHsl8m4ZZWvMW1HO4zeO8Iw%2FKmEvgYLiVD11dx%2BrDt%2FaNc7WEAYab4hel%0AYAMVUo081KkAu25oeWM%3D%0A)

**Note**: If the Appointment Type has been used before you won't be able to delete it and will instead be prompted to mark it as inactive.

Creating Item Codes

Creating Item Codes
===================

What Are Item Codes?
====================

Item Codes represent billable services and stock/products that are added to invoices. Item codes should be created for every unique service or product in your practice.

To create Item Codes, go to **[Settings](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
** [>](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
 **[Billing](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
** [>](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
 **[Item Codes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378134879/489435040ea5e4bda77075456c31/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91a1a358bc197d18ba8eae47a31011293c6580cfdb51111fe88e29d8ec96176b&req=dSMgHsh9mYlYUPMW1HO4zXHMiTTES8TuGHKUP1P6PkkVNOLbvD0lrQc587OR%0AmAWsS6zFrWxOHgPmvOQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378134879/489435040ea5e4bda77075456c31/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91a1a358bc197d18ba8eae47a31011293c6580cfdb51111fe88e29d8ec96176b&req=dSMgHsh9mYlYUPMW1HO4zXHMiTTES8TuGHKUP1P6PkkVNOLbvD0lrQc587OR%0AmAWsS6zFrWxOHgPmvOQ%3D%0A)

Click **Add** to create a new Item Code.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378134997/2024c44242c818182b2b844b5d5f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6a6b06ec46fae3549df68915ff4accf258b0e10c7d45f4ab787fb371ce142d8d&req=dSMgHsh9mYhWXvMW1HO4zR89iEwbuoh2zQhr%2BlCMocJJCFfMIvBuaGJgqn0S%0ACq9R3ILXq4J%2B6MVYcBg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378134997/2024c44242c818182b2b844b5d5f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6a6b06ec46fae3549df68915ff4accf258b0e10c7d45f4ab787fb371ce142d8d&req=dSMgHsh9mYhWXvMW1HO4zR89iEwbuoh2zQhr%2BlCMocJJCFfMIvBuaGJgqn0S%0ACq9R3ILXq4J%2B6MVYcBg%3D%0A)

**Need help with typical private health fund item codes?**

If you're unsure of item codes applicable to patients paying for their services, a good place to start is with the standard item codes for private health fund claiming, which can be found for most professions by [clicking here.](https://www.hicaps.com.au/support/item-codes)

**Setting up Item Codes for the NDIS?**

If you're setting up Item Codes for the NDIS, there are a number of important things to consider. More information is available in our NDIS guide below.

[NDIS Item Code Guide](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5759042-managing-ndis-item-codes)

* * *

Item Code Preferences
=====================

When setting up an Item Code, begin by configuring the following settings:

*   **Item Code -** A unique identifier for this Item Code (7 characters max). This is typically the item exactly as it needs to be printed on an invoice that you would provide to a patient if they were to e.g. submit the invoice to their health fund to claim manually.
    
*   **Description** - A description of the item that is printed on receipts, invoices, and statements.
    
*   **Schedule** - Assigns the Item Code to a [Schedule](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4196769-creating-item-code-schedules)
    , which is used to group and sort items when displayed in lists and reports.
    
*   **Print Code As (Optional)** - If you've chosen a non-standard Item Code, the Print Code As field will be used instead when printing/emailing receipts, invoices and statements. The Item Code becomes an 'internal item code' that clinic staff are familiar with, while the Print Code As option is the 'patient facing' item code.
    
*   **Barcode** **(Optional)** - Allows searching by barcode number on the invoice screen. This is useful when using a barcode scanner to add products to an invoice.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378234763/1ab0a2365042048401de286d8909/CleanShot%2B2025-02-13%2Bat%2B14_58_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe6c0e9aaa869759832fc92c8113876a8b7362b4415782ac9a89900173e1a1ff&req=dSMgHst9mYZZWvMW1HO4zUIKp1goSU%2Ble6aAip%2FEd11m%2FSZ2A5ERCUl78K1g%0Ae2Yn6pqTZiO9cf8L7UM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378234763/1ab0a2365042048401de286d8909/CleanShot%2B2025-02-13%2Bat%2B14_58_08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe6c0e9aaa869759832fc92c8113876a8b7362b4415782ac9a89900173e1a1ff&req=dSMgHst9mYZZWvMW1HO4zUIKp1goSU%2Ble6aAip%2FEd11m%2FSZ2A5ERCUl78K1g%0Ae2Yn6pqTZiO9cf8L7UM%3D%0A)

* * *

Setting Item Fees and GST
=========================

Single Fee for all Patients
---------------------------

If the fee for the item is the same for all patients, enter the fee as required. You can also choose if GST should be applied when adding the item to an invoice.

If you're running a promotion, you can also enter a standard discount to be applied when adding the item to an invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378121066/2deee542108a67230b7c72d0ac53/CleanShot+2025-02-13+at+13_10_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1ee9b5be732fad5af5dbeef06a5e314d999de1cb30923fb884267ba49989070&req=dSMgHsh8nIFZX%2FMW1HO4zc2Unt3UteswZHq2bU9aIa2Bgv6ZDJ3dBKdhUT14%0ACw44ftfCltu8YxPVbOg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378121066/2deee542108a67230b7c72d0ac53/CleanShot+2025-02-13+at+13_10_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1ee9b5be732fad5af5dbeef06a5e314d999de1cb30923fb884267ba49989070&req=dSMgHsh8nIFZX%2FMW1HO4zc2Unt3UteswZHq2bU9aIa2Bgv6ZDJ3dBKdhUT14%0ACw44ftfCltu8YxPVbOg%3D%0A)

Different Fees per Fee Category
-------------------------------

If the item fee varies based on the funding type of the patient, for example, concessions, pensioners and family members pay a lower rate for the same item code, you can set a different fee per [Fee Category](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4196739-creating-a-fee-category)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378121941/9573f2a8080e2f9a091fe554f120/CleanShot+2025-02-13+at+13_12_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d076df6c0ccfbc8c1ffd11b2f168b8359270beec470cd09b5d20167dc364fa5&req=dSMgHsh8nIhbWPMW1HO4zSK%2BLHcvxcbXdbjlBFwsHt2jF4dNesU8J7VZ%2Bg1I%0A0pJ63Fix%2B0purqFHgAw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378121941/9573f2a8080e2f9a091fe554f120/CleanShot+2025-02-13+at+13_12_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d076df6c0ccfbc8c1ffd11b2f168b8359270beec470cd09b5d20167dc364fa5&req=dSMgHsh8nIhbWPMW1HO4zSK%2BLHcvxcbXdbjlBFwsHt2jF4dNesU8J7VZ%2Bg1I%0A0pJ63Fix%2B0purqFHgAw%3D%0A)

* * *

Claiming Options
================

Claiming Options in PracSuite are specifically used when [integrating with third-party claiming systems](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2633444-integrations)
. If your practice does not use these integrations, you can disregard this section.

The **Claiming Override Code** is only required when the standard **Item Code** used for billing is different from the code required for electronic claims. This ensures that the correct code is used when submitting claims, without altering how it appears on invoices or receipts.

For example:

• A podiatry service may have an **Item Code** of **F012**, which needs to appear on invoices for patient records.

• However, for electronic claims, the system may need to submit **012** instead.

• In this case, the **Claiming Override Code** would be set to **012** to ensure smooth processing.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378208287/9b5b8b0bfd03c3d68f6a4467ae88/CleanShot%2B2025-02-13%2Bat%2B14_58_28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67e33ca31afa66e1c4fd90d9f0ceab5ea790aec291f78be25caf12c60801e133&req=dSMgHst%2BlYNXXvMW1HO4zbsl%2BXdyVLV%2BV%2Bk012DavkEKB2F87wOwqJLjzgfL%0AtP0wQnTcVOFJfYimMuM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378208287/9b5b8b0bfd03c3d68f6a4467ae88/CleanShot%2B2025-02-13%2Bat%2B14_58_28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67e33ca31afa66e1c4fd90d9f0ceab5ea790aec291f78be25caf12c60801e133&req=dSMgHst%2BlYNXXvMW1HO4zbsl%2BXdyVLV%2BV%2Bk012DavkEKB2F87wOwqJLjzgfL%0AtP0wQnTcVOFJfYimMuM%3D%0A)

**Important Considerations**

• The **Claiming Override Code** is **not** meant to handle cases where a single **Item Code** needs to support multiple claim types.

• If an item is billed differently depending on the patient’s funding type (e.g., private, Medicare, DVA), separate **Item Codes** should be created for each scenario.

**Example: Physiotherapy Billing**

A physiotherapy practice might have the following **Item Codes** based on funding type:

• **500** – Used for private-paying initial consultations

• **10960** – Used for Medicare billing

• **PH10** – Used for DVA billing

Each of these should be set up as a distinct **Item Code** rather than relying on a **Claiming Override Code**.
