Fee Overrides
=============

If certain practitioners charge more or less for the same Item Code, rather than creating a completely separate Item Code, you can add a Fee Override to that Item Code.

In the Fee Overrides section, select **Add Fee Overrides** to add an override.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631958716/e06ccbba32661c7208e315cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52291244e2f5f0c2f432c62abc1914fef3590566d939f2dbaf0fe119b83df588&req=ciMmH8x2moBZFb4f3HP0gFEZiRhAoD%2FD%2BRwBYveZ8qCM9UJJPzL9VjVrzI3p%0A%2BNJWRRZJ1EbF8ZfloQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631958716/e06ccbba32661c7208e315cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52291244e2f5f0c2f432c62abc1914fef3590566d939f2dbaf0fe119b83df588&req=ciMmH8x2moBZFb4f3HP0gFEZiRhAoD%2FD%2BRwBYveZ8qCM9UJJPzL9VjVrzI3p%0A%2BNJWRRZJ1EbF8ZfloQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631958825/4fb493c54f69653e4a745a48/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d04c70ca29a14963c97056a72a32c8f13671e7b78733815005d2ce8c2786d488&req=ciMmH8x2lYNaFb4f3HP0gJsrQeqetRKgBhfrZ0sFGmmhN9TKdrJPUEr0FnDV%0AaXPjNNR6PpuSa1tPHA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631958825/4fb493c54f69653e4a745a48/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d04c70ca29a14963c97056a72a32c8f13671e7b78733815005d2ce8c2786d488&req=ciMmH8x2lYNaFb4f3HP0gJsrQeqetRKgBhfrZ0sFGmmhN9TKdrJPUEr0FnDV%0AaXPjNNR6PpuSa1tPHA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

How do Item Codes and Appointment Types work together?
======================================================

Item Codes represent the services or products you bill for, while Appointment Types define the structure of bookings. Though they often overlap, their interaction is crucial to ensure accurate billing, especially when different **Fee Categories** apply.

Here’s how they work together:

• **Appointment Types determine the type of service being booked** (e.g., Initial Consultation, Follow-Up, Telehealth).

• **Fee Categories define the funding arrangement for the patient** (e.g., Private, Medicare, DVA, Workcover).

To streamline invoicing, you can configure Appointment Types to automatically select the appropriate **Item Code** based on the patient’s **Fee Category**.

For example:

• You create a **single** Appointment Type called “Initial Consultation.”

• The system applies different **Item Codes** based on the patient’s Fee Category:

• **Private Patient:** Bills Item Code **500**

• **Medicare Patient:** Bills Item Code **10960**

• **DVA Patient:** Bills Item Code **PH10**

• **Workcover Patient:** Bills a Workcover-specific Item Code

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378250716/9dff2a8a2ad95e2890e3ca950b03/CleanShot-2B2025-02-06-2Bat-2B10_13_06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c4730dddb03d980e39a94a8638a99f86136c3147b445b921c58bcf20c9a6e67&req=dSMgHst7nYZeX%2FMW1HO4zdLnyekwc7JUhxVCLQrWJ%2BBnijVkVlsv34j61I%2Bc%0AAXrZdc2YkoJjzMC4KHM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1378250716/9dff2a8a2ad95e2890e3ca950b03/CleanShot-2B2025-02-06-2Bat-2B10_13_06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c4730dddb03d980e39a94a8638a99f86136c3147b445b921c58bcf20c9a6e67&req=dSMgHst7nYZeX%2FMW1HO4zdLnyekwc7JUhxVCLQrWJ%2BBnijVkVlsv34j61I%2Bc%0AAXrZdc2YkoJjzMC4KHM%3D%0A)

This setup ensures that staff don’t need to manually select the correct Item Code each time—they simply book the appointment, and PracSuite applies the correct billing logic automatically.

With this setup, you maintain flexibility while ensuring accurate and efficient billing across different patient funding types.

#### Removing Item Codes

For steps on how to remove an item code, please see this article on [Removing Item Codes](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11382466-removing-item-codes)
.

Creating Email Templates
========================

Updated over 3 years ago

1\. Go to **[Settings](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/email)
** [> **Templates** > **Email Templates**](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/email)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633961007/e877ff9d87f4f9e5c07864ec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=629e84f202c84f95615a7680f8cf0b7cda3654eddb6a4d4a6d4acc3f376fe04e&req=ciMkH89%2FnYFYFb4f3HP0gGwSKgodtmK7W9%2F2BW45OgsaQLG904svYSyU0QXe%0A2f%2BYCNwEZnrwnx4GwQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633961007/e877ff9d87f4f9e5c07864ec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=629e84f202c84f95615a7680f8cf0b7cda3654eddb6a4d4a6d4acc3f376fe04e&req=ciMkH89%2FnYFYFb4f3HP0gGwSKgodtmK7W9%2F2BW45OgsaQLG904svYSyU0QXe%0A2f%2BYCNwEZnrwnx4GwQ%3D%3D%0A)

2\. You can create **folders** to store and categorise your Email Templates. Click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633961218/c53cb6d245daeb916f809d8d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=93469064382e6404df11c92d17b3118a9b20ab1ef120d6dd3631868a681d0647&req=ciMkH89%2Fn4BXFb4f3HP0gK2hRlN0i1eum1P7ncjlszYLvqRxgKE801180f7P%0AA%2Fue%2F65KjbABbedSdg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633961218/c53cb6d245daeb916f809d8d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=93469064382e6404df11c92d17b3118a9b20ab1ef120d6dd3631868a681d0647&req=ciMkH89%2Fn4BXFb4f3HP0gK2hRlN0i1eum1P7ncjlszYLvqRxgKE801180f7P%0AA%2Fue%2F65KjbABbedSdg%3D%3D%0A)

3\. Click **Add Folder** to create a new **Email Template Folder**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633961427/855f302fd18a1d064ce7ddc4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=859094ebd7f6bc8b13f73f666bca68a8e083ed1bf2496f37f28d5d56476a30ff&req=ciMkH89%2FmYNYFb4f3HP0gOkhuWiDqp471ROqRvieZPS3ONcoaNmHqfxleFkd%0Alx%2F4BLGXYhWUImQQ8A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633961427/855f302fd18a1d064ce7ddc4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=859094ebd7f6bc8b13f73f666bca68a8e083ed1bf2496f37f28d5d56476a30ff&req=ciMkH89%2FmYNYFb4f3HP0gOkhuWiDqp471ROqRvieZPS3ONcoaNmHqfxleFkd%0Alx%2F4BLGXYhWUImQQ8A%3D%3D%0A)

4\. Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633961558/4dc92e9fd0807eac6445c576/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=424b9dad04f5ce7ace32d22c738733aed000c2714ab4e6f7c87ba05e64189553&req=ciMkH89%2FmIRXFb4f3HP0gOGzq0ihsTNWcMrsB4YtXl4164YyxE5Xp5vu4lkm%0A4EfAd2wnzbJFr3Nmdw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633961558/4dc92e9fd0807eac6445c576/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=424b9dad04f5ce7ace32d22c738733aed000c2714ab4e6f7c87ba05e64189553&req=ciMkH89%2FmIRXFb4f3HP0gOGzq0ihsTNWcMrsB4YtXl4164YyxE5Xp5vu4lkm%0A4EfAd2wnzbJFr3Nmdw%3D%3D%0A)

5\. Click **Add Template** to create a **New Email Template**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633962314/7c02ca37bfd8dea5f7e3a52d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3bd84266a451d5d0c7a2e21237912a468b81071ce5b78c70955e510c3791f201&req=ciMkH898noBbFb4f3HP0gFaY4bKH2Ux4PG%2B%2BjqNu%2BROFXpsdebawo1d%2BPXnt%0AlUHNp59x8MMg8Z9Bmg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633962314/7c02ca37bfd8dea5f7e3a52d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3bd84266a451d5d0c7a2e21237912a468b81071ce5b78c70955e510c3791f201&req=ciMkH898noBbFb4f3HP0gFaY4bKH2Ux4PG%2B%2BjqNu%2BROFXpsdebawo1d%2BPXnt%0AlUHNp59x8MMg8Z9Bmg%3D%3D%0A)

6\. Give your email template a **Description** and choose which **Folder** you'd like the email template to be saved in.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633962861/ceb43b856e76bd91f37cc863/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f67612acdd675e71f280c8faa67b3ddd8ab118bb74afb660d971dae7ce473422&req=ciMkH898lYdeFb4f3HP0gD91cCis87sCW0gsl1KpvGT%2Fho3%2BL1l2cKHnBVfv%0AMbnU31GClu64htHKvg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633962861/ceb43b856e76bd91f37cc863/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f67612acdd675e71f280c8faa67b3ddd8ab118bb74afb660d971dae7ce473422&req=ciMkH898lYdeFb4f3HP0gD91cCis87sCW0gsl1KpvGT%2Fho3%2BL1l2cKHnBVfv%0AMbnU31GClu64htHKvg%3D%3D%0A)

7\. Give your email a **Subject**. This is the subject line that the recipient of the email will see.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633965977/40f09d9d7ce638babea91767/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=47ae982228a45c01f6c32e42287d9ae89c6c315bedeaabddee8c758aebf1c2dc&req=ciMkH897lIZYFb4f3HP0gDxyLAghuaPAJu4cG3k3G5u3c7tw3R0Oopl9P4na%0AjQ1foZ5OoUYdQ0adfQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633965977/40f09d9d7ce638babea91767/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=47ae982228a45c01f6c32e42287d9ae89c6c315bedeaabddee8c758aebf1c2dc&req=ciMkH897lIZYFb4f3HP0gDxyLAghuaPAJu4cG3k3G5u3c7tw3R0Oopl9P4na%0AjQ1foZ5OoUYdQ0adfQ%3D%3D%0A)

8\. Type the body of your Email in the **Template** section. You can select **Client Fields** from the drop-down menus which you can **copy & paste** into your email template. These fields will be automatically populated when sending emails through PracSuite, such as from the Patient File.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633966261/f2ef43c6ec681640c47442e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d04dce3cc593e03dde02cb5e01275f0d983e52ea833368d6ba369828bff4469e&req=ciMkH894n4deFb4f3HP0gK3kr1fMctOnJR0maDRF3SC6fW7qvCjXiRzrdXaM%0Az1GbCDaR7VVedrSEtA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633966261/f2ef43c6ec681640c47442e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d04dce3cc593e03dde02cb5e01275f0d983e52ea833368d6ba369828bff4469e&req=ciMkH894n4deFb4f3HP0gK3kr1fMctOnJR0maDRF3SC6fW7qvCjXiRzrdXaM%0Az1GbCDaR7VVedrSEtA%3D%3D%0A)

9\. You can use the **menu bar** at the top of the template area to also add **hyperlinks** and **images** to your email templates.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633966780/f5405675a69e8e7a0323c2e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=da5dc95a93a13df610a2a100972506f89ac6b1008e4f212696acdab50994e2e0&req=ciMkH894molfFb4f3HP0gA1vcRLwlx2MdujsqT8Paye0EZuAfkQ3kk6qKmYm%0AiFk0RIUeZfnEQTPwew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633966780/f5405675a69e8e7a0323c2e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=da5dc95a93a13df610a2a100972506f89ac6b1008e4f212696acdab50994e2e0&req=ciMkH894molfFb4f3HP0gA1vcRLwlx2MdujsqT8Paye0EZuAfkQ3kk6qKmYm%0AiFk0RIUeZfnEQTPwew%3D%3D%0A)

10\. You can also include default **attachments** to be included when selecting the email template. Click **Add** to browse for an attachment from your device or drag and drop a file to upload it to PracSuite.

Note: Attachments must not exceed the 20MB email size limit.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633967068/87efd737e3334cd63bb035ea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f1d8f51d04ced9e2bc8c7ca138f1dda314adb4b69dee400c6433635ed3825f8&req=ciMkH895nYdXFb4f3HP0gAL4pvO0LpGQpNfe5jz0H3WlxQKDHW6Hk7IJd5jv%0AE7ocq2UB5umuodYNKg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633967068/87efd737e3334cd63bb035ea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f1d8f51d04ced9e2bc8c7ca138f1dda314adb4b69dee400c6433635ed3825f8&req=ciMkH895nYdXFb4f3HP0gAL4pvO0LpGQpNfe5jz0H3WlxQKDHW6Hk7IJd5jv%0AE7ocq2UB5umuodYNKg%3D%3D%0A)

Creating SMS Templates
======================

Updated over 3 years ago

1\. Go to **[Settings](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/sms)
** [> **Templates** > **SMS Templates**](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/sms)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633190642/763ad20980c0915d6b17ba9d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2cf6c0191ecf241b5f9d29dd7a860b2160158714fb89baf248f440e6f59273a&req=ciMkF8B%2Bm4VdFb4f3HP0gHgiAuYbP1A3c5nO0Jvi1Qulc1kNKzjCgDsErGO0%0Aqtu%2FWqXbbYa6nV1paw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633190642/763ad20980c0915d6b17ba9d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2cf6c0191ecf241b5f9d29dd7a860b2160158714fb89baf248f440e6f59273a&req=ciMkF8B%2Bm4VdFb4f3HP0gHgiAuYbP1A3c5nO0Jvi1Qulc1kNKzjCgDsErGO0%0Aqtu%2FWqXbbYa6nV1paw%3D%3D%0A)

2\. You can create **folders** to store and categorise your SMS templates. **Folders** can be created by clicking **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633190877/d76da2978a75f4fcfc9b8819/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b6d4e0180bf879a0ec8293239de6b0cd2e7f22eaa5a369f15fed675d62d7299&req=ciMkF8B%2BlYZYFb4f3HP0gDxUEqykNs%2FWhABnMD8Xqr3J4dCDmloBTOSS%2F3C8%0AwoLCs595zxKf5vQ06Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633190877/d76da2978a75f4fcfc9b8819/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b6d4e0180bf879a0ec8293239de6b0cd2e7f22eaa5a369f15fed675d62d7299&req=ciMkF8B%2BlYZYFb4f3HP0gDxUEqykNs%2FWhABnMD8Xqr3J4dCDmloBTOSS%2F3C8%0AwoLCs595zxKf5vQ06Q%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add Folder**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633190974/40608f855bd3f68039113f96/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dc2149bda873644de06e6e318a9687141d6a0298bd61c932ba426f923ef7930b&req=ciMkF8B%2BlIZbFb4f3HP0gLd3%2Bt9%2FecprX1GrkPWW3PI4qb57HucKg9Dtbguf%0A6EUdpT54FfBt2g8h2Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633190974/40608f855bd3f68039113f96/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dc2149bda873644de06e6e318a9687141d6a0298bd61c932ba426f923ef7930b&req=ciMkF8B%2BlIZbFb4f3HP0gLd3%2Bt9%2FecprX1GrkPWW3PI4qb57HucKg9Dtbguf%0A6EUdpT54FfBt2g8h2Q%3D%3D%0A)

Type in a name for the folder.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633191240/1223a9654ef06ef303f152d6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4e6ced47e270c2afa27555a4ae7456edb112ebd2717d7d1a644aefe94332ce5f&req=ciMkF8B%2Fn4VfFb4f3HP0gKIz0aL0yjVRxyZDX8PvLPYqzOKhuQ360VMv4hxJ%0AHJ0PQfpK4JDhZahiAQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633191240/1223a9654ef06ef303f152d6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4e6ced47e270c2afa27555a4ae7456edb112ebd2717d7d1a644aefe94332ce5f&req=ciMkF8B%2Fn4VfFb4f3HP0gKIz0aL0yjVRxyZDX8PvLPYqzOKhuQ360VMv4hxJ%0AHJ0PQfpK4JDhZahiAQ%3D%3D%0A)

Then **Save** to confirm your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633191450/599c41a63276b11867d3177f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4511cb07fcb081c65424168ede80805b6845a7938ffb0951d70a233dc2417094&req=ciMkF8B%2FmYRfFb4f3HP0gNfTalof6Ft6%2BdHWNlsKgluSJsCNPnj1w5ErSKrf%0AYnSKQfds7z6ew6biGw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633191450/599c41a63276b11867d3177f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4511cb07fcb081c65424168ede80805b6845a7938ffb0951d70a233dc2417094&req=ciMkF8B%2FmYRfFb4f3HP0gNfTalof6Ft6%2BdHWNlsKgluSJsCNPnj1w5ErSKrf%0AYnSKQfds7z6ew6biGw%3D%3D%0A)

3\. Click **Add Template** to create a new template.

Simply select a field from a drop-down and it will be inserted into your template for use. The relevant information will be populated when sending SMS in PracSuite.

5\. A **preview** of your SMS template is shown to the right. There is also a **character count** below the template area. A single SMS message is **160 characters** in length. Longer SMS Messages can be created but will require multiple SMS credits to send.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633192321/819d95db5ebdf616ade7db43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=542f2356e831588dd526a59f4f7da2dfd4753401a5f73eae17fac061a70878d4&req=ciMkF8B8noNeFb4f3HP0gEjEbVf2ANPaG7czGdGTkjunl%2FBx0SKp%2F8lteOwG%0ATb9VwKASFTeMpWNGHA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633192321/819d95db5ebdf616ade7db43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=542f2356e831588dd526a59f4f7da2dfd4753401a5f73eae17fac061a70878d4&req=ciMkF8B8noNeFb4f3HP0gEjEbVf2ANPaG7czGdGTkjunl%2FBx0SKp%2F8lteOwG%0ATb9VwKASFTeMpWNGHA%3D%3D%0A)

IP Address Barring

IP Address Barring
==================

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Creating IP Addresses](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4343809-ip-address-barring#h_a22a59b06e)

[Assigning IP Addresses](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4343809-ip-address-barring#h_033393cac9)

IP Address Barring is a way to restrict where a PracSuite user can log into PracSuite. This is achieved by creating a whitelist of approved public IP addresses that a user is permitted to log in from.

For example, IP Barring can be enabled for admin staff to prevent them from accessing PracSuite unless they are connected to the practice internet/Wi-Fi connection. In this example, you would create an IP Address group in PracSuite that contains the IP addresses of all practice locations.

**Note**: For IP barring to work as designed, the internet connections you're wanting to whitelist **must have a fixed/static public IP address** to ensure that the IP addresses do not change. Without a fixed/static IP, your public IP address can change several times a day, requiring you to play a game of cat and mouse to keep the IP Address list up to date in PracSuite. **You will need to confirm whether you have a fixed/static IP address with the internet service provider (ISP) for each of your locations.**

Creating IP Addresses
---------------------

Follow the instructions below to create a list of approved IP addresses.

#### Step 1:

Go to **[Settings > Users & Security > IP Addresses](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users/ipaddresses)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636293955/6892b9531d9ac05c1b792fb1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72a1c630c8a0639a16d1669287e961a62eb72f255a6318e9818392ca060dae5f&req=ciMhFMB9lIRaFb4f3HP0gDgPMrfajswuIhv5bgxysKA6S6Wwgj365NCSY89%2F%0A7f%2Bs9Y6wsw17%2FfbSFg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636293955/6892b9531d9ac05c1b792fb1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72a1c630c8a0639a16d1669287e961a62eb72f255a6318e9818392ca060dae5f&req=ciMhFMB9lIRaFb4f3HP0gDgPMrfajswuIhv5bgxysKA6S6Wwgj365NCSY89%2F%0A7f%2Bs9Y6wsw17%2FfbSFg%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636294222/43435730a1ca4f4ba48e5fa2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c8b499008378bfc8f70a649528923a3b757369f7edbfa562016640ba1163a53d&req=ciMhFMB6n4NdFb4f3HP0gILBwTYBwVmEE2jgj3QEcuNnVpA01Vf1Hz%2FMo49R%0AtqRtp3sNosFmlwTE8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636294222/43435730a1ca4f4ba48e5fa2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c8b499008378bfc8f70a649528923a3b757369f7edbfa562016640ba1163a53d&req=ciMhFMB6n4NdFb4f3HP0gILBwTYBwVmEE2jgj3QEcuNnVpA01Vf1Hz%2FMo49R%0AtqRtp3sNosFmlwTE8w%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Name the rule, and enter the IP addresses of the locations that access should be allowed from. You will also see **your location's current IP displayed** **here** for reference. Select the Copy button to copy your current IP address.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636295062/509be7dbdc3f1b42c20e2f85/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3a5ffcf8a18d41a51f88405269baa0320e02d17db2b31631485c9966b53ac7f2&req=ciMhFMB7nYddFb4f3HP0gC2DRhUmg7%2B6MGwHsXxuwlzWy7Rom8GCLc%2Blirnj%0AauajPH%2F%2FBOD6rx3TVQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636295062/509be7dbdc3f1b42c20e2f85/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3a5ffcf8a18d41a51f88405269baa0320e02d17db2b31631485c9966b53ac7f2&req=ciMhFMB7nYddFb4f3HP0gC2DRhUmg7%2B6MGwHsXxuwlzWy7Rom8GCLc%2Blirnj%0AauajPH%2F%2FBOD6rx3TVQ%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636295173/d67110554c25fc8699154266/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b4a939bd618ea4f7a9f4ddda7c31ac1468a771e00b1269ebdbac80a0fa9c479b&req=ciMhFMB7nIZcFb4f3HP0gMrfYT2tsoHfh6A7QEsmbOtFFweVhDCUG4YjShPx%0AQFilq3dK1Clgce5vQw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636295173/d67110554c25fc8699154266/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b4a939bd618ea4f7a9f4ddda7c31ac1468a771e00b1269ebdbac80a0fa9c479b&req=ciMhFMB7nIZcFb4f3HP0gMrfYT2tsoHfh6A7QEsmbOtFFweVhDCUG4YjShPx%0AQFilq3dK1Clgce5vQw%3D%3D%0A)

Assigning IP Addresses
----------------------

You can assign an IP Address Group to a user account from **[Settings > Users & Security > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)
**. Select and edit the user to **assign the IP Barring rule in the security area**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636296088/7b4aff19909ed2201681fb4e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6128f2aea6ff5493d833e94edd1ee62d8c21b77e65db15241d4fc01e976aa0e9&req=ciMhFMB4nYlXFb4f3HP0gCrYa%2FBCo203YEroZli3lviKaDjFp2f%2FwiwlebYn%0At1Nr2zlm41EJFXVDkQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636296088/7b4aff19909ed2201681fb4e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6128f2aea6ff5493d833e94edd1ee62d8c21b77e65db15241d4fc01e976aa0e9&req=ciMhFMB4nYlXFb4f3HP0gCrYa%2FBCo203YEroZli3lviKaDjFp2f%2FwiwlebYn%0At1Nr2zlm41EJFXVDkQ%3D%3D%0A)

Access Schedules

Access Schedules
================

Updated over 3 years ago

Access Schedules can be assigned to PracSuite users to limit their access to the system to certain hours of the day. For example, this can be used to limit access to PracSuite between 8 AM - 6 PM Monday to Friday, but no access after hours or on the weekend.

1\. Go to **[Settings > Users & Security > Access Schedules](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users/accessschedules)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633194034/bb5891dbdcb898822fe07149/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=34866fb517ad3a52bc5a850fe141a9efa9a7755b4bebd5be9e4e5c7e3880aee5&req=ciMkF8B6nYJbFb4f3HP0gFd2HGthZhcT%2BNwJTyqs%2FgS1kZkGgnY2KQmKhWUL%0AEBNcTZcduU%2FNCtZ3AA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633194034/bb5891dbdcb898822fe07149/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=34866fb517ad3a52bc5a850fe141a9efa9a7755b4bebd5be9e4e5c7e3880aee5&req=ciMkF8B6nYJbFb4f3HP0gFd2HGthZhcT%2BNwJTyqs%2FgS1kZkGgnY2KQmKhWUL%0AEBNcTZcduU%2FNCtZ3AA%3D%3D%0A)

2\. Click **Add**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633194500/c0aaa367213862bcc70a75af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c3dbb1367d22a8bebc35fc06d201a8bcbe7763c016f218a31ff3b04b1472fb9&req=ciMkF8B6mIFfFb4f3HP0gMEkqEWFzDwJMHirJpPX31pQ%2FVQnst2y0FsH%2BVnX%0AUfUzW%2F7q2%2BCzf9fPzw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633194500/c0aaa367213862bcc70a75af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c3dbb1367d22a8bebc35fc06d201a8bcbe7763c016f218a31ff3b04b1472fb9&req=ciMkF8B6mIFfFb4f3HP0gMEkqEWFzDwJMHirJpPX31pQ%2FVQnst2y0FsH%2BVnX%0AUfUzW%2F7q2%2BCzf9fPzw%3D%3D%0A)

3\. Name the schedule, specify the hours to allow access, then click **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633194840/15ac240bc3de286ed0d59345/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1aae9297df6ffe9ce42885ed99cd4da54053d2a8cb9fd6d38ef3969cdef4bb8&req=ciMkF8B6lYVfFb4f3HP0gEr4urPRQS3SonAJ0Lh5B9VTorU6DHOZokl190o%2B%0A56Z77hJTmGz8bGbMhA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633194840/15ac240bc3de286ed0d59345/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1aae9297df6ffe9ce42885ed99cd4da54053d2a8cb9fd6d38ef3969cdef4bb8&req=ciMkF8B6lYVfFb4f3HP0gEr4urPRQS3SonAJ0Lh5B9VTorU6DHOZokl190o%2B%0A56Z77hJTmGz8bGbMhA%3D%3D%0A)

4\. To assign the Access Schedule to a user account, Go to **[Settings > Users & Security > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)
** **\> Select a user > Edit the user >** then assign the Access Schedule in the **Security** Section. This user will only be able to access PracSuite during the times set in their assigned Access Schedule.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633195643/886b674c34684d32db7e5f95/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddb17e9f1c6e5d85a6923c771af719d3cb3e84b03abc2e41b285b2175718874e&req=ciMkF8B7m4VcFb4f3HP0gD1U5U6e%2Fbm%2F3MLZGl80YlCq5bTB2ZIvZf%2Fg1xCm%0Abdgw7PAaZiBeX3UudQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633195643/886b674c34684d32db7e5f95/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddb17e9f1c6e5d85a6923c771af719d3cb3e84b03abc2e41b285b2175718874e&req=ciMkF8B7m4VcFb4f3HP0gD1U5U6e%2Fbm%2F3MLZGl80YlCq5bTB2ZIvZf%2Fg1xCm%0Abdgw7PAaZiBeX3UudQ%3D%3D%0A)

Creating Roles
==============

Updated over 3 months ago

Roles define the areas and features a PracSuite user has permission to access when logged in.  
​

1\. Go to **[Settings](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users/roles)** [\> **Users & Security** \> **Roles**](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users/roles)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633196173/d324ceef206bf42a80839737/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13f01bab0e8b7bdbe0a878d7464d39b2d4bf57dfbce9c49ae45c1f89f8a8bfd6&req=ciMkF8B4nIZcFb4f3HP0gEmdfUpbCT0cPCRiQp3dT3qiPUvQCcawhLqK2VgG%0AziOc%2B6BKdeljxNJGJQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633196173/d324ceef206bf42a80839737/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13f01bab0e8b7bdbe0a878d7464d39b2d4bf57dfbce9c49ae45c1f89f8a8bfd6&req=ciMkF8B4nIZcFb4f3HP0gEmdfUpbCT0cPCRiQp3dT3qiPUvQCcawhLqK2VgG%0AziOc%2B6BKdeljxNJGJQ%3D%3D%0A)

2\. Click **Add** to create a new **Role**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633196262/d094aa51eda6a2d995a2e490/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=058bf9843192014121ac3065d8f85ffda3d25cde627b6ef089c6d962ed7e66c0&req=ciMkF8B4n4ddFb4f3HP0gPNYTYOJUu1qz0V3xMs4MMcCgQkvej1pebHdnSQv%0ATujXOfBVdFdKUevytg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633196262/d094aa51eda6a2d995a2e490/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=058bf9843192014121ac3065d8f85ffda3d25cde627b6ef089c6d962ed7e66c0&req=ciMkF8B4n4ddFb4f3HP0gPNYTYOJUu1qz0V3xMs4MMcCgQkvej1pebHdnSQv%0ATujXOfBVdFdKUevytg%3D%3D%0A)

4\. Toggle on / off the features that this role will require access to

Setting Up a PracSuite User Account

Setting Up a PracSuite User Account
===================================

Updated over a month ago

Table of contents

[Creating a User Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_d2dae01b4c)

[Roles and Data Access](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_fe08f0520f)

[Roles](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_66c59bd3a5)

[User is a Practitioner](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_199897abb8)

[Data Access](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_a88bd6e0fd)

[Optional Security Restrictions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_0737002e32)

[IP Barring](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_b71d8c6f1f)

[Access Schedules](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_fa7f4390a9)

[Welcome Email and Setup](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_51bbc614c1)

[Two Factor Authentication Setup (2FA)](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account#h_531d1004a7)

All PracSuite subscriptions allow you to create unlimited user logins for your staff at no additional cost, as PracSuite subscriptions are based on the number of practitioner files in your system.

All users should have their own user login. Please **do not share user accounts**, as this will impact the security of your PracSuite system, including the ability to accurately track user activity using the Audit Log report.

Creating a User Account
=======================

1\. Go to **[Settings > Users & Security > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633199112/54b814310392338bf4ed5b99/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ec8625df6b65757a63848be3baa23964af92c791584359aed3ab5f0ad9d848bf&req=ciMkF8B3nIBdFb4f3HP0gFzTAzVAx3hM44JhzFZ6IUJ3150x%2B7juyxQpe1%2F4%0AOrS4PO5%2FZvP0MfnuvQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633199112/54b814310392338bf4ed5b99/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ec8625df6b65757a63848be3baa23964af92c791584359aed3ab5f0ad9d848bf&req=ciMkF8B3nIBdFb4f3HP0gFzTAzVAx3hM44JhzFZ6IUJ3150x%2B7juyxQpe1%2F4%0AOrS4PO5%2FZvP0MfnuvQ%3D%3D%0A)

2\. Click **Add** to begin the process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633199215/78debea805069fa8c7e75958/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8886400adef908fc98a8729c8f8067fdcb08e3ca18e7e7eb3449d87bc80a9ab0&req=ciMkF8B3n4BaFb4f3HP0gAyLgmO4o3sYazdvTIvKv%2Bd554J6RYoOo2%2Bb3mta%0AMOxkVXJ%2F6usGYDRc3Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633199215/78debea805069fa8c7e75958/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8886400adef908fc98a8729c8f8067fdcb08e3ca18e7e7eb3449d87bc80a9ab0&req=ciMkF8B3n4BaFb4f3HP0gAyLgmO4o3sYazdvTIvKv%2Bd554J6RYoOo2%2Bb3mta%0AMOxkVXJ%2F6usGYDRc3Q%3D%3D%0A)

All users should have their own user login. Please **do not share user accounts**, as this will impact the security of your PracSuite system, including the ability to accurately track user activity using the Audit Log report.

3\. Enter the **User's Details**.

The Email Address and Display Name are the two required fields. Other contact details and a user photo are optional.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396871530/f7221be9d48b4ec4b93c8f856bdc/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+11_27_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be93af7ed8a46e33f4254b48e1467a36b51cb1327902facad33888c9c471ee6f&req=dSMuEMF5nIRcWfMW1HO4zX55OkE%2BNHxT0GYVDIjRO7z%2B8r8bGv5gH4ZHTMVq%0AHSGOiOae12OeKppzym4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396871530/f7221be9d48b4ec4b93c8f856bdc/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+11_27_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be93af7ed8a46e33f4254b48e1467a36b51cb1327902facad33888c9c471ee6f&req=dSMuEMF5nIRcWfMW1HO4zX55OkE%2BNHxT0GYVDIjRO7z%2B8r8bGv5gH4ZHTMVq%0AHSGOiOae12OeKppzym4%3D%0A)

Roles and Data Access
=====================

Roles
-----

Assign a **Role** to the user. Roles specify what areas of PracSuite a user can access, as well as what functions they can perform in the System.

For full details on creating Roles, see our **[Setting Up Roles article](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353460-creating-roles)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396879741/4c1cad00a9e876b5876a4af24258/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+11_38_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5c58d6d0a3833f6b67be988ff5fb44b02bbd0e890474c6a6cf50e843a266b0b6&req=dSMuEMF5lIZbWPMW1HO4ze8qWL7GeyHxkdCEVN3tHuHAw7xjVL2QBHJY7RIL%0AHGgHLVyUsS%2BomLFIzwo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396879741/4c1cad00a9e876b5876a4af24258/CleanShot+2025-02-26+at+11_38_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5c58d6d0a3833f6b67be988ff5fb44b02bbd0e890474c6a6cf50e843a266b0b6&req=dSMuEMF5lIZbWPMW1HO4ze8qWL7GeyHxkdCEVN3tHuHAw7xjVL2QBHJY7RIL%0AHGgHLVyUsS%2BomLFIzwo%3D%0A)

User is a Practitioner
----------------------

When creating user accounts for practitioners, it is important to link the user account to the corresponding practitioner file so that the practitioner can access the following PracSuite features:

*   [Practitioner Queue](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4593949-using-the-practitioner-queue)
    
*   [Receive appointment alerts](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5193442-enabling-appointment-alerts-for-practitioners)
    
*   [Add the Performance widget to their home screen](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10480298-practitioner-performance-dashboard)
    
*   [Physitrack integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration)
    
*   [VALD integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8244563-vald-integration)
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396875552/4970e7f9f1bb4acfc926c4e1a5d1/CleanShot%2B2025-02-26%2Bat%2B11_30_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2171af0686194d6fa6969551d1a1b27ffe8bcd9b5e5665969aaec6968cfb2065&req=dSMuEMF5mIRaW%2FMW1HO4zX2YnxZ2jKRvB1foTRAUMl9EduE5Oz%2F%2BB63UruJm%0AbGobHljOVZn04%2BgH55Y%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396875552/4970e7f9f1bb4acfc926c4e1a5d1/CleanShot%2B2025-02-26%2Bat%2B11_30_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2171af0686194d6fa6969551d1a1b27ffe8bcd9b5e5665969aaec6968cfb2065&req=dSMuEMF5mIRaW%2FMW1HO4zX2YnxZ2jKRvB1foTRAUMl9EduE5Oz%2F%2BB63UruJm%0AbGobHljOVZn04%2BgH55Y%3D%0A)

Data Access
-----------

PracSuite has three general categories of data that you can restrict a user from accessing, which are outlined below:

*   **General & Appointment Book** \- If a user's Role permits them to access the Appointment Book, these settings control what businesses, professions or practitioners this user will see when they visit the Appointment Book.
    
*   **Reports** \- If the user's role permits them to access reports, these settings control which businesses, professions, or practitioners this user can view report data for.
    
*   **Clinical Notes** - If the user's Role permits them to access the Clinical Notes tab of the patient file, these settings control whose clinical notes this user can view globally across all patient files. A user can always view the clinical notes of the practitioner file linked with their user account.
    

Note that the above settings are global rules for all patient files. Separate to these settings, [clinical note sharing tools at the patient file level](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6382092-using-the-share-notes-feature)
 are available where providing access to practitioner's clinical notes across all patient files is inappropriate.

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633200352/7b10e1beadb94036e9d86507/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a901a44430d76fb787036ccb9175a9ab5f14f20e08bc1394803ea8b0e5588c0e&req=ciMkFMl%2BnoRdFb4f3HP0gBvfRJG6TJ3MnXAPF8P%2F6CkqQU5EX2oNDF5whmWF%0AiUEGEi96ZM3QeQYhbA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633200352/7b10e1beadb94036e9d86507/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a901a44430d76fb787036ccb9175a9ab5f14f20e08bc1394803ea8b0e5588c0e&req=ciMkFMl%2BnoRdFb4f3HP0gBvfRJG6TJ3MnXAPF8P%2F6CkqQU5EX2oNDF5whmWF%0AiUEGEi96ZM3QeQYhbA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Optional Security Restrictions
==============================

IP Barring
----------

**IP Barring** can be used to restrict which internet connections a user can log in to PracSuite from. For example, it can limit the user to only log in from your practice locations, and not from home. For details, refer to the **[Setting Up IP Barring Rules](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4343809-ip-address-restrictions)
** article.

Access Schedules
----------------

**Access Schedules** can restrict **when** a user can log in to PracSuite, and can be used to prevent or allow access outside of your business hours. For details, refer to the **[Setting Up Access Schedules](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353454-access-schedules)
** article.

* * *

Welcome Email and Setup
=======================

After you've created and saved a new user account, you will receive a prompt regarding whether you wish to email the user their welcome email so they can begin the account setup process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396854736/a8753ac2d362243ddc89a336cd2c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7748ce72bdc997825c9af560abd51263fecdd7860149a53c72de1412cdbac840&req=dSMuEMF7mYZcX%2FMW1HO4zSF8J%2BBuC1kWxHB7bHq9c9FhxQbMTKwsX8ZxB9dl%0A2TLDk3vbmo7GxvcSMA8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396854736/a8753ac2d362243ddc89a336cd2c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7748ce72bdc997825c9af560abd51263fecdd7860149a53c72de1412cdbac840&req=dSMuEMF7mYZcX%2FMW1HO4zSF8J%2BBuC1kWxHB7bHq9c9FhxQbMTKwsX8ZxB9dl%0A2TLDk3vbmo7GxvcSMA8%3D%0A)

Select **Yes** if you're ready for the user to begin setting up their account and accessing your PracSuite system.

Welcome invites for PracSuite expire 24 hours after they're sent.

If needed, the welcome email can be resent from the top of the user's profile.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396854737/57c16c19e112ae471441d1740c67/CleanShot%2B2023-09-27%2Bat%2B12_34_27.png?expires=1771821900&signature=457f749e3b7352f0fc4aad574c122205dc460a97f956d462a3ec0f09f0572ea7&req=dSMuEMF7mYZcXvMW1HO4zQ4pL9um9iTlgWyQlHFSom1OeZfl5ZqeE%2BjrMkZd%0A3FKKNA79NUcR5Qiyjls%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396854737/57c16c19e112ae471441d1740c67/CleanShot%2B2023-09-27%2Bat%2B12_34_27.png?expires=1771821900&signature=457f749e3b7352f0fc4aad574c122205dc460a97f956d462a3ec0f09f0572ea7&req=dSMuEMF7mYZcXvMW1HO4zQ4pL9um9iTlgWyQlHFSom1OeZfl5ZqeE%2BjrMkZd%0A3FKKNA79NUcR5Qiyjls%3D%0A)

Once the user receives their welcome email, they can begin the account setup process, which will involve setting up their password, security questions and two-factor authentication.

The instructions below a for the new user setting up their account:

1\. Click the **Get Started** button to verify their email address and **set up their password** for PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/237200896/e9c0235c8fdd7bcd7601e88b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0fe98c7110b003ae8523aed0170d4cc6e62aa498261d0702896605adac677c31&req=diMgFMl%2BlYhZFb4f3HP0gA6HTwKlMz8lSyHRStaaGQZd%2BSVuJYQHOz64xmtm%0AsnxH44nATrBJ7Bu2KA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/237200896/e9c0235c8fdd7bcd7601e88b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0fe98c7110b003ae8523aed0170d4cc6e62aa498261d0702896605adac677c31&req=diMgFMl%2BlYhZFb4f3HP0gA6HTwKlMz8lSyHRStaaGQZd%2BSVuJYQHOz64xmtm%0AsnxH44nATrBJ7Bu2KA%3D%3D%0A)

2\. The user will need to set up a password that meets the following **password criteria**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633201140/34a0115ff144f5477303873f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5b859d59ed1388a22a290c9024cf36dff6be80300c67b381aeb69b53c1b128a&req=ciMkFMl%2FnIVfFb4f3HP0gFeV9Uv5fNGYEtHpeBUG6AhKeeSus5KXMARJ02FQ%0Ak5VMSfP99YwHLRVkMQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633201140/34a0115ff144f5477303873f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5b859d59ed1388a22a290c9024cf36dff6be80300c67b381aeb69b53c1b128a&req=ciMkFMl%2FnIVfFb4f3HP0gFeV9Uv5fNGYEtHpeBUG6AhKeeSus5KXMARJ02FQ%0Ak5VMSfP99YwHLRVkMQ%3D%3D%0A)

3\. Users will also need to set up **security questions**. These are used to verify the user in the event a password reset is attempted.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633201274/835ccfcbaf639a35be986065/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c6ba7a87bb88e9c1079a65c90c723290f62efa3a9676f5ee627f9ef1d465968d&req=ciMkFMl%2Fn4ZbFb4f3HP0gEmYRRyo1OyJ6MnCpBhl9q87z8zwnG%2BDG7Ppootw%0AFFPVilkYoy3zlaYscw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633201274/835ccfcbaf639a35be986065/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c6ba7a87bb88e9c1079a65c90c723290f62efa3a9676f5ee627f9ef1d465968d&req=ciMkFMl%2Fn4ZbFb4f3HP0gEmYRRyo1OyJ6MnCpBhl9q87z8zwnG%2BDG7Ppootw%0AFFPVilkYoy3zlaYscw%3D%3D%0A)

4\. The user will then be prompted to return to the login screen

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633201402/518fac7fee7e552b2486dac5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=16c5eda53522db3abe7ce5001f2730588781a6e46246acfc7de20a08788150a2&req=ciMkFMl%2FmYFdFb4f3HP0gCpTYLckF27glrjgwMev144xHqmQrDXsYMXN65KL%0AkVEi1YBqBz5qbPXfAA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633201402/518fac7fee7e552b2486dac5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=16c5eda53522db3abe7ce5001f2730588781a6e46246acfc7de20a08788150a2&req=ciMkFMl%2FmYFdFb4f3HP0gCpTYLckF27glrjgwMev144xHqmQrDXsYMXN65KL%0AkVEi1YBqBz5qbPXfAA%3D%3D%0A)

5\. The user will now be able to **login** to PracSuite with their email address and password they specified.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633201551/17876acf73e0bda6d1c8f53c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85244d39cb3df9a6c19d6622ce745d84a78e134558db9cc44d1834a00530a921&req=ciMkFMl%2FmIReFb4f3HP0gMG12QCSzbBqJ75wciBKm%2BUsHC5ymBln%2BtGkVffz%0AwmqTf36Eisnb8sLYbA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633201551/17876acf73e0bda6d1c8f53c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85244d39cb3df9a6c19d6622ce745d84a78e134558db9cc44d1834a00530a921&req=ciMkFMl%2FmIReFb4f3HP0gMG12QCSzbBqJ75wciBKm%2BUsHC5ymBln%2BtGkVffz%0AwmqTf36Eisnb8sLYbA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Two Factor Authentication Setup (2FA)
=====================================

Two Factor Authentication (2FA) is mandatory for all PracSuites using time-based one-time password (TOTP) apps available on smartphones and computers, as well as physical token generators [available for purchase.](https://pracsuite.com/pracsuitesecuritytoken)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396860071/91f073f3ed630291be9b14ade58b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4867073f943960e7b6d1e74cfbdd760b31ae4b464a7e3619837072ed2d4a2f6c&req=dSMuEMF4nYFYWPMW1HO4zWdlETxSaPKcUYPhmKDet%2Bo5kJBl%2F6rnTQNbscqo%0AB6JxXwlw5mBMow7mkVI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396860071/91f073f3ed630291be9b14ade58b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4867073f943960e7b6d1e74cfbdd760b31ae4b464a7e3619837072ed2d4a2f6c&req=dSMuEMF4nYFYWPMW1HO4zWdlETxSaPKcUYPhmKDet%2Bo5kJBl%2F6rnTQNbscqo%0AB6JxXwlw5mBMow7mkVI%3D%0A)

For this article, we will assume you're using the Google Authenticator app to obtain your 2FA code. [Further information regarding 2FA app options, including links to the App Store listings, can be found here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242927-understanding-two-factor-authentication)

When initially logging into PracSuite, the user will be prompted with the following screen. The user can skip this step **up to 5 times**, after which they will be required to set up 2FA to login.

Select **Next** to continue the 2FA setup process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/839767928/d70f9b02027a273230daff21/CleanShot+2023-09-27+at+12.39.45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=22060f6dcd3903b0aa56e8d5f68914575ee95d8bf473caf5fa5083aea01457ab&req=fCMuEc95lINXFb4f3HP0gISYbNWr1CzyZJzxCksZwkhNlbb7D41KVyOz5XWt%0AaiSE1FQJFf8j95UgdQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/839767928/d70f9b02027a273230daff21/CleanShot+2023-09-27+at+12.39.45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=22060f6dcd3903b0aa56e8d5f68914575ee95d8bf473caf5fa5083aea01457ab&req=fCMuEc95lINXFb4f3HP0gISYbNWr1CzyZJzxCksZwkhNlbb7D41KVyOz5XWt%0AaiSE1FQJFf8j95UgdQ%3D%3D%0A)

A QR code will be displayed on screen.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396862062/f303bdf74b6c1ffcf79adfc8318c/CleanShot%2B2023-09-27%2Bat%2B12_42_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7955179131c5e7c28e092cad76edc13440ba8b32ddb47e7f7fcd7d9b3b73c348&req=dSMuEMF4n4FZW%2FMW1HO4zXdVoUm4KvSKE7cVi%2FLx0PTupUPvEZy%2BFFva2V2g%0Al15oOrGaUZ%2BFtHfFzY4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1396862062/f303bdf74b6c1ffcf79adfc8318c/CleanShot%2B2023-09-27%2Bat%2B12_42_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7955179131c5e7c28e092cad76edc13440ba8b32ddb47e7f7fcd7d9b3b73c348&req=dSMuEMF4n4FZW%2FMW1HO4zXdVoUm4KvSKE7cVi%2FLx0PTupUPvEZy%2BFFva2V2g%0Al15oOrGaUZ%2BFtHfFzY4%3D%0A)

**Do not scan the QR code displayed on screen with your camera app.** Instead, open the Google Authenticator app (or your app of choice) and select the option to add a new code.

Select the **Add** button shown in the Google Authenticator app, then **scan** the QR Code displayed on screen in PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/237200980/f168d112be9ffca0d229426c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab56e04f9ed2eac175cc6804792a2395d3c4142cabccccf5a0c801f90c85efd2&req=diMgFMl%2BlIlfFb4f3HP0gFop9j%2FT799sy3j9pxbTbSpN28fzksXz41aMLVFm%0ALMdJ5sS0rNV2liNUyg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/237200980/f168d112be9ffca0d229426c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab56e04f9ed2eac175cc6804792a2395d3c4142cabccccf5a0c801f90c85efd2&req=diMgFMl%2BlIlfFb4f3HP0gFop9j%2FT799sy3j9pxbTbSpN28fzksXz41aMLVFm%0ALMdJ5sS0rNV2liNUyg%3D%3D%0A)

Your authentication app should now display a randomly generated 2FA code that changes every 30 seconds.

Enter the code into PracSuite to complete the 2FA setup process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633202687/95cac80a2430e04d7676f98b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f6e6ad8c9fa9f0034aef82e366ea39ee6aaafb51dc88fb471eb917edbff47674&req=ciMkFMl8m4lYFb4f3HP0gOZyn6MgmTgcnQS0Z%2F2S%2F86CtOYUMbZZUp9v%2Fqud%0A0r5wPEZAJFjzG6U9lQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633202687/95cac80a2430e04d7676f98b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f6e6ad8c9fa9f0034aef82e366ea39ee6aaafb51dc88fb471eb917edbff47674&req=ciMkFMl8m4lYFb4f3HP0gOZyn6MgmTgcnQS0Z%2F2S%2F86CtOYUMbZZUp9v%2Fqud%0A0r5wPEZAJFjzG6U9lQ%3D%3D%0A)

If the verification fails, double-check that the time on your smartphone and computer are correct and in sync. Verification will fail if the time is not in sync.

Each time the user logs in, they will be prompted for their **2FA code**.

If you are logging in from a trusted device, tick the **Trust this device for 7 days** option, and subsequent logins from this device will not require a 2FA code for the next 7 days.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633203025/e3647576d92838da4b86711d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52b398a48308bf14d1ef88c13c41c6f1231f72b9285371013079a67cc2381369&req=ciMkFMl9nYNaFb4f3HP0gGGnhk4QZtIYIyHThkchWw07oK1gL9Le55KCYEY2%0A8EaE9NwSwNhNY0T%2BHA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633203025/e3647576d92838da4b86711d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52b398a48308bf14d1ef88c13c41c6f1231f72b9285371013079a67cc2381369&req=ciMkFMl9nYNaFb4f3HP0gGGnhk4QZtIYIyHThkchWw07oK1gL9Le55KCYEY2%0A8EaE9NwSwNhNY0T%2BHA%3D%3D%0A)

Auto-Complete Keyboard Shortcuts

Auto-Complete Keyboard Shortcuts
================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Auto-Complete shortcuts allow shorthand phrases to be typed into clinical notes, letters, email and SMS, which expand to full terminology, providing a convenient way to minimise typing.

To configure Auto-Complete shortcuts, go to **[Settings > Templates > Auto-Completes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/autocompletes)
**

Before configuring Auto-Complete shortcuts, choose whether they should be case-sensitive.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613264736/c65f257be65334a25939343d/CleanShot+2022-11-09+at+17.11.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f0db0d1942f8c038aa2f1094ef96143a130371adf02eb955503228f77737cf53&req=ciEkFM96moJZFb4f3HP0gFZz0D7vDQBbqYcLIyax0sAZHzfaJZ79Vq408mGk%0AVVrc3Sd%2F1%2BtPk%2BGlkw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613264736/c65f257be65334a25939343d/CleanShot+2022-11-09+at+17.11.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f0db0d1942f8c038aa2f1094ef96143a130371adf02eb955503228f77737cf53&req=ciEkFM96moJZFb4f3HP0gFZz0D7vDQBbqYcLIyax0sAZHzfaJZ79Vq408mGk%0AVVrc3Sd%2F1%2BtPk%2BGlkw%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Add** button to add new Auto-Complete shortcuts, and choose which areas in PracSuite these shortcuts should take effect in.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613264966/bfca1407ef3f8a706ac5c73d/CleanShot+2022-11-09+at+17.12.35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1dd86cebf1b01d5f9fa22a9a65b3378b88ede06ce96ce59eaac4487e264ebb1a&req=ciEkFM96lIdZFb4f3HP0gCAsSwaScf%2BRAlTP9D%2FGiwA5O7VCQQ4A7pgqOFah%0AOoHyhQI6UxTNAsXncA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613264966/bfca1407ef3f8a706ac5c73d/CleanShot+2022-11-09+at+17.12.35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1dd86cebf1b01d5f9fa22a9a65b3378b88ede06ce96ce59eaac4487e264ebb1a&req=ciEkFM96lIdZFb4f3HP0gCAsSwaScf%2BRAlTP9D%2FGiwA5O7VCQQ4A7pgqOFah%0AOoHyhQI6UxTNAsXncA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Marketing Sources

Marketing Sources
=================

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375675-marketing-sources#h_bb76a5604c)

[Adding a Marketing Source](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375675-marketing-sources#h_40b4338749)

Overview
========

Marketing Sources allow for reporting and tracking of how patients have found you or your business via the [Reports > Patients > Referrals](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/referrals)
 report.

Adding a Marketing Source
-------------------------

#### Step 1:

Go to **[Contacts > Marketing](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/marketing)
**  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633149107/8f8ecd379714b5751892bff7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f6f971bdf766d2f08ea3580291ab16dbf8b9222513bb336249b908d66d3b2b24&req=ciMkF813nIFYFb4f3HP0gMNui6WgUQSelnkr6MES0z8i0CFkmTHqDK2uhrC%2B%0AJfq6i6%2FoANTSz2cyaw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633149107/8f8ecd379714b5751892bff7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f6f971bdf766d2f08ea3580291ab16dbf8b9222513bb336249b908d66d3b2b24&req=ciMkF813nIFYFb4f3HP0gMNui6WgUQSelnkr6MES0z8i0CFkmTHqDK2uhrC%2B%0AJfq6i6%2FoANTSz2cyaw%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click **Add**  
​

#### Step 3:

Specify the **name** of the marketing source and add a description to the **notes** section. Click **Save** to finalise your changes.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633149409/581e1caf09dec243933c693e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d4631df2d3f0e22665d7d5827df3f5250eff7589d40d95003352bf4375012c3&req=ciMkF813mYFWFb4f3HP0gJ34LFS9K5Cvq65Q7zp%2Bd%2BiUR7gDMs%2BuFlDyXe2C%0Al4SwYO%2BqHG4tV7NTdw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633149409/581e1caf09dec243933c693e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d4631df2d3f0e22665d7d5827df3f5250eff7589d40d95003352bf4375012c3&req=ciMkF813mYFWFb4f3HP0gJ34LFS9K5Cvq65Q7zp%2Bd%2BiUR7gDMs%2BuFlDyXe2C%0Al4SwYO%2BqHG4tV7NTdw%3D%3D%0A)

Adding a Marketing Source to a Patient's File
---------------------------------------------

When creating a new client file, you can specify the marketing source in **Client Details > Additional** to track how clients discovered your business.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633149686/f760edc2ff30a442c6204597/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5412ed0d6e1dd1919b1bd30a462138a7fd2ca568b8c0a29c81174637155cebac&req=ciMkF813m4lZFb4f3HP0gK99tQaLVv2dFAM1AEHadel%2FDP4RBu1g27yEC5Sz%0A453%2Fhv97Vfz%2BjqmjBQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633149686/f760edc2ff30a442c6204597/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5412ed0d6e1dd1919b1bd30a462138a7fd2ca568b8c0a29c81174637155cebac&req=ciMkF813m4lZFb4f3HP0gK99tQaLVv2dFAM1AEHadel%2FDP4RBu1g27yEC5Sz%0A453%2Fhv97Vfz%2BjqmjBQ%3D%3D%0A)

------------------------------------------

 page.

Organisations

Organisations
=============

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375697-organisations#h_d2bbd9ea3e)

[Adding Organisations](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375697-organisations#h_46b099e658)

[Linking an Organisation to a Referring Doctor](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375697-organisations#h_364682fe69)

[Deleting, Merging & Marking Organisations as Inactive](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375697-organisations#h_578f9c951a)

Overview
========

Organisations allow for the grouping of Referring Doctors based on the organisation they are from. This enables populating these details (address, phone, website etc.) automatically, saving you the time it would take to enter them manually.

You can add and manage them by going to the **[Contacts > Referrers > Organisations](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/referrers/organisations)** page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1727981308/3221cfa9cc0431417c96f91c4e96/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e636b4158ac61715c8e130bcb7a3c6df5f06b4df044e7bd9af0e9d496faafaff&req=dSclEcB2nIJfUfMW1HO4zRxVxl%2Bg0AMQjwS0rirpExIUR7Sd28dMbk2UOOIF%0AWZ0OESrV0rwAU7P2zEQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1727981308/3221cfa9cc0431417c96f91c4e96/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e636b4158ac61715c8e130bcb7a3c6df5f06b4df044e7bd9af0e9d496faafaff&req=dSclEcB2nIJfUfMW1HO4zRxVxl%2Bg0AMQjwS0rirpExIUR7Sd28dMbk2UOOIF%0AWZ0OESrV0rwAU7P2zEQ%3D%0A)

Adding Organisations
--------------------

#### Step 1:

Click **Add**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633154497/56c438828e0564ff207bdb71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2437bd183f247ea933c2c838d70252f3f71de3ac05c68fdfab9c6d87035f652&req=ciMkF8x6mYhYFb4f3HP0gHxKm4Rx9MAVXxc5XGBWD%2B60%2FKXUkP3gjtUgp8yw%0At0Rij2tze0FAC8JOmQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633154497/56c438828e0564ff207bdb71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2437bd183f247ea933c2c838d70252f3f71de3ac05c68fdfab9c6d87035f652&req=ciMkF8x6mYhYFb4f3HP0gHxKm4Rx9MAVXxc5XGBWD%2B60%2FKXUkP3gjtUgp8yw%0At0Rij2tze0FAC8JOmQ%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Enter the **info** for the organisation.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633154748/f7855cc1f7d175cac41ee533/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d97f092c0216b2652a31ec598168764f7a2f13706b5cadd15f856bbc603a01c9&req=ciMkF8x6moVXFb4f3HP0gPVxa0E8guCy4WZKqBONap8c15wHPDNBH6RARWRS%0ADSs4S32TrPQKUd0U2w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633154748/f7855cc1f7d175cac41ee533/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d97f092c0216b2652a31ec598168764f7a2f13706b5cadd15f856bbc603a01c9&req=ciMkF8x6moVXFb4f3HP0gPVxa0E8guCy4WZKqBONap8c15wHPDNBH6RARWRS%0ADSs4S32TrPQKUd0U2w%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Click **Save** to finalise the creation of the organisation.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1727969998/64b247da26c609b13962c1dea22d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8ea4be1f5da01c8a231fead67e242e12ab18b28a330772015ebb72c806f75bfe&req=dSclEcB4lIhWUfMW1HO4zQWGCf2q4ELpp16SsI8VK1tttkZp5RlGWQxUC2Eu%0AwoWWUtds4qHH1dJhqQ8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1727969998/64b247da26c609b13962c1dea22d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8ea4be1f5da01c8a231fead67e242e12ab18b28a330772015ebb72c806f75bfe&req=dSclEcB4lIhWUfMW1HO4zQWGCf2q4ELpp16SsI8VK1tttkZp5RlGWQxUC2Eu%0AwoWWUtds4qHH1dJhqQ8%3D%0A)

Linking an Organisation to a Referring Doctor
---------------------------------------------

You can link the organisation to a referring doctor in **[Contact > Referrers > Referring Doctors](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/referrers/doctors)
**.

Select the Referring Doctor from the list, click **Edit** and select the Organisation under the Organisation field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633154968/24470c3b70d5ed255225952d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9722a5d56c669bd670714902306f0c9deb0c13900bf3556ac59b6beded5b0846&req=ciMkF8x6lIdXFb4f3HP0gOLxt6DOnvlm2z13QSzjQ6tUYjGLXAj5soBq3OhB%0AlZhZA%2FoHLdTZK%2FvZdg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633154968/24470c3b70d5ed255225952d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9722a5d56c669bd670714902306f0c9deb0c13900bf3556ac59b6beded5b0846&req=ciMkF8x6lIdXFb4f3HP0gOLxt6DOnvlm2z13QSzjQ6tUYjGLXAj5soBq3OhB%0AlZhZA%2FoHLdTZK%2FvZdg%3D%3D%0A)

  
​  
​

Deleting, Merging & Marking Organisations as Inactive
-----------------------------------------------------

While viewing an Organisation's file, you may notice a **Cog** icon at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1727987673/c025de5ef3c95f13806bacadb05f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b414805c218414a30e16525dd6a0b2dbacda0ae160928070e46f21a4b639a94a&req=dSclEcB2modYWvMW1HO4zXy6PPy5UbRH%2Ba7rhutsjjCv4Nb4LLejPCME4L4d%0A1gVl1kIo5X9rlJ1FYxo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1727987673/c025de5ef3c95f13806bacadb05f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b414805c218414a30e16525dd6a0b2dbacda0ae160928070e46f21a4b639a94a&req=dSclEcB2modYWvMW1HO4zXy6PPy5UbRH%2Ba7rhutsjjCv4Nb4LLejPCME4L4d%0A1gVl1kIo5X9rlJ1FYxo%3D%0A)

Clicking on the Cog will give you a number of options:  
​  
​**Mark Organisation as Inactive**  
If the Organisation is no longer needed, but you don't want to delete it. This will remove it from the list of Active Organisations.  
​

**Delete Organisation**:  
When an Organisation is no longer needed at all.  
​

**Organisation Audit Log**:  
See a Log of the actions performed on this Organisations file.  
​

**Merge Organisation**:  
Merge the Organisation with another. Useful for instances were a duplicate file has been created.  
​

For more information on referring doctors, please see this article on [Referring Doctors](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375704-referring-doctors)
.

Referring Doctors
=================

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375704-referring-doctors#h_efd2173128)

[Adding a Referring Doctor](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375704-referring-doctors#h_8f7a74a873)

Overview
========

Referring Doctors allow for the tracking and reporting of Referrals via the [Reports > Patients > Referrals](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/referrals)
 report. It also allows for quickly adding them as a referrer on to patient files, you can find more information on this in the article: **[Adding a Referring Doctor to an Account](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590929-adding-a-referring-doctor-to-an-account)
**

Adding a Referring Doctor
-------------------------

#### Step 1:

Go to **[Contacts > Referrers > Referring Doctors](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/referrers/doctors)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633156464/fdc2f11e92c44461415375ca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7ba684b44b46550bbfa8765ab5d1032ce3a41a96ab2f960eef9b0f34f1f34b7e&req=ciMkF8x4mYdbFb4f3HP0gCsPPuqwA4zINK%2BVtSV1FqylsOKVzyP6A2BASx3N%0AKeSlOqB%2Bw7cqoG%2B%2FQA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633156464/fdc2f11e92c44461415375ca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7ba684b44b46550bbfa8765ab5d1032ce3a41a96ab2f960eef9b0f34f1f34b7e&req=ciMkF8x4mYdbFb4f3HP0gCsPPuqwA4zINK%2BVtSV1FqylsOKVzyP6A2BASx3N%0AKeSlOqB%2Bw7cqoG%2B%2FQA%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click **Add**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633161635/072476f6b0f578f43c1ebe0d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee6a8ed353b764c448fd1fa67ff4a0041c5fd3d3ad778328c744262ce19f37da&req=ciMkF89%2Fm4JaFb4f3HP0gAkOaEk8RYlSyooMAPpBLQ9AlRg1iQW1HXGgbdhE%0AqbMC9BGjKVFB4zkCdA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633161635/072476f6b0f578f43c1ebe0d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee6a8ed353b764c448fd1fa67ff4a0041c5fd3d3ad778328c744262ce19f37da&req=ciMkF89%2Fm4JaFb4f3HP0gAkOaEk8RYlSyooMAPpBLQ9AlRg1iQW1HXGgbdhE%0AqbMC9BGjKVFB4zkCdA%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Specify the general **info** for the new referrer

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633161826/e489435cefe375db6c61d859/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae2c18aaf7d73f0d9107be2201bf04f93d36b9b83918197fe4c850b1b0c03900&req=ciMkF89%2FlYNZFb4f3HP0gIEUCC1Upvz7gZpnhuqvlhJP3zEyuhpIPdZ14otu%0AUBM1HrOLJ0xCbn32fQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633161826/e489435cefe375db6c61d859/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae2c18aaf7d73f0d9107be2201bf04f93d36b9b83918197fe4c850b1b0c03900&req=ciMkF89%2FlYNZFb4f3HP0gIEUCC1Upvz7gZpnhuqvlhJP3zEyuhpIPdZ14otu%0AUBM1HrOLJ0xCbn32fQ%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

If the referrer belongs to an organisation, select their organisation from the drop-down list. Alternatively, click the **+** button to create a new organisation if required. You can read more on organisations in our **[Creating Organisations article.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375697-creating-organisations)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633161892/c2a1dde5fad783d473c8b14f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=62e7cb1ce90670f070e5e075c263bc08363398da0b89e8a49ad36e43eda39e1b&req=ciMkF89%2FlYhdFb4f3HP0gFJcUpgXru%2B1RKS18pVulO61Khy4MXCTRuAPUvUF%0AmNokEkvEWv0PGiyw0Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633161892/c2a1dde5fad783d473c8b14f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=62e7cb1ce90670f070e5e075c263bc08363398da0b89e8a49ad36e43eda39e1b&req=ciMkF89%2FlYhdFb4f3HP0gFJcUpgXru%2B1RKS18pVulO61Khy4MXCTRuAPUvUF%0AmNokEkvEWv0PGiyw0Q%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 5:

Assign a profession and specify the provider number for the referrer.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633162006/f9c08923a0dbf016a02a1e70/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2f78ad0852d2ffd19e49f05d9dde901baf0a1fbc3c48358fb70e0e3ff4f00e4&req=ciMkF898nYFZFb4f3HP0gAzNyt%2BSctP7ZjymVc5Cui1hU9irAzhqhUD9cf%2FF%0A7aG63VdQeDtGr0KDdA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633162006/f9c08923a0dbf016a02a1e70/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2f78ad0852d2ffd19e49f05d9dde901baf0a1fbc3c48358fb70e0e3ff4f00e4&req=ciMkF898nYFZFb4f3HP0gAzNyt%2BSctP7ZjymVc5Cui1hU9irAzhqhUD9cf%2FF%0A7aG63VdQeDtGr0KDdA%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 6:

Click **Save** to finalise your changes

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633162093/1921f02720e752903091d476/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b77738d530184c445668a06ae555de1b1bc631a9060de6e42cd67a0c52fbdffe&req=ciMkF898nYhcFb4f3HP0gNOQw4k%2Fog94BC8Y8kcWeTRozlM5E3pl9HhehFFL%0AOqPwcCFk7fSPcvLF9g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633162093/1921f02720e752903091d476/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b77738d530184c445668a06ae555de1b1bc631a9060de6e42cd67a0c52fbdffe&req=ciMkF898nYhcFb4f3HP0gNOQw4k%2Fog94BC8Y8kcWeTRozlM5E3pl9HhehFFL%0AOqPwcCFk7fSPcvLF9g%3D%3D%0A)

iCalendar Integration for Practitioners

iCalendar Integration for Practitioners
=======================================

Subscribe to a feed of your appointments in your calendar app

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Enabling iCalendar integration per practitioner](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4379561-icalendar-integration-for-practitioners#h_03920d8d46)

[Subscribing to your iCalendar feed](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4379561-icalendar-integration-for-practitioners#h_bfa21feabd)

[Setting up iCalendar on iPhone](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4379561-icalendar-integration-for-practitioners#h_836d9d4723)

[Setting up iCalendar in Outlook](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4379561-icalendar-integration-for-practitioners#h_97a74632d9)

iCalendar integration allows appointments in PracSuite to display within external calendar apps on smartphones as well as in applications like Microsoft Outlook and Apple Calendar.

**Using Android or Google Calendar?**

Google Calendar only refreshes subscribed iCalendar feeds periodically at random intervals. Unfortunately, Google does not provide any options to control the refresh frequency of your PracSuite iCalendar feed.  
​  
If you're using Google Calendar, we recommend our direct Google Calendar integration, which will reflect PracSuite appointment book changes in Google within seconds. [Learn more about our Google Calendar integration.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7948131-google-calendar-integration)

_An example of an iPhone showing PracSuite appointments in the Calendar app._

[![ An example of an iPhone showing PracSuite appointments in the Calendar app.](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/520065330/e4271ec6474094dbe5374c34/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee4fc712fd63cd82b68f84b3bf3d3b950219f3e45b02ba84cb0497ad054ab6af&req=cSInFs97noJfFb4f3HP0gDq4PIFGQ%2FTW0tT9I2l2IOU9Bh%2FeFiay%2FDaywK6A%0AjTSy%2Ff%2B0RQNbNbB9DA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/520065330/e4271ec6474094dbe5374c34/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee4fc712fd63cd82b68f84b3bf3d3b950219f3e45b02ba84cb0497ad054ab6af&req=cSInFs97noJfFb4f3HP0gDq4PIFGQ%2FTW0tT9I2l2IOU9Bh%2FeFiay%2FDaywK6A%0AjTSy%2Ff%2B0RQNbNbB9DA%3D%3D%0A)

Enabling iCalendar integration per practitioner
===============================================

Practitioners can manage their calendar integrations from the User menu in the top right corner of PracSuite and selecting **Manage Calendar Integrations**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137201337/d997b0fb520694c0bc86acca/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+12_05_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f777ee22612e2de1b92237045d2db0165ed61254c34bd9df326ecb47613dae77&req=dSEkEct%2BnIJcXvMW1HO4zbTiPEViCHzz3Sb2aNxjSmx0qCPi%2Be7JLKbmDx%2BJ%0AKkeXhV6Mz3694c%2FvveA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137201337/d997b0fb520694c0bc86acca/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+12_05_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f777ee22612e2de1b92237045d2db0165ed61254c34bd9df326ecb47613dae77&req=dSEkEct%2BnIJcXvMW1HO4zbTiPEViCHzz3Sb2aNxjSmx0qCPi%2Be7JLKbmDx%2BJ%0AKkeXhV6Mz3694c%2FvveA%3D%0A)

If other users are setting up iCalendar feeds on behalf of practitioners, go to **[Settings](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)** [\> **Practitioners > Practitioners**](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)
.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276500/22e1873b0624afaf6f796123/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a9efb7a127fe69d276f7acf6acaa069432b41040adeff633f870c834cc52f0e&req=ciMhFM54mIFfFb4f3HP0gANtlXN7U%2FlDw1MT6PuTCWA00OIgNeUv3Qkj5ZuP%0A0Xd%2FNl7zeQ%2FjI4%2BquQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276500/22e1873b0624afaf6f796123/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a9efb7a127fe69d276f7acf6acaa069432b41040adeff633f870c834cc52f0e&req=ciMhFM54mIFfFb4f3HP0gANtlXN7U%2FlDw1MT6PuTCWA00OIgNeUv3Qkj5ZuP%0A0Xd%2FNl7zeQ%2FjI4%2BquQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click on a practitioner to configure their iCalendar settings.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276696/19a3e832417f7f561ad6262e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=69c14719890128c922ee59a9ea04f6f9f5fa4b1b1487ab9bca77e6bebbf5801c&req=ciMhFM54m4hZFb4f3HP0gI1IwEs4WMlDwgUdlL0kvunXZGISHF6ztR5cEjkr%0ARYsgeUWwK70wp%2BKzhw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276696/19a3e832417f7f561ad6262e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=69c14719890128c922ee59a9ea04f6f9f5fa4b1b1487ab9bca77e6bebbf5801c&req=ciMhFM54m4hZFb4f3HP0gI1IwEs4WMlDwgUdlL0kvunXZGISHF6ztR5cEjkr%0ARYsgeUWwK70wp%2BKzhw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Edit**.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276795/26d7042fd60e490ed3c12c3b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7cb79b4a249a1008d8778730b009fc69d2d574d93d36e1067d1109633d2765a2&req=ciMhFM54mohaFb4f3HP0gAYHlfCyS7dlBEyxp9YxCWDOnC15V%2FAtHnoitMds%0AAbxbfO3LKU%2FP%2FCS9Hg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276795/26d7042fd60e490ed3c12c3b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7cb79b4a249a1008d8778730b009fc69d2d574d93d36e1067d1109633d2765a2&req=ciMhFM54mohaFb4f3HP0gAYHlfCyS7dlBEyxp9YxCWDOnC15V%2FAtHnoitMds%0AAbxbfO3LKU%2FP%2FCS9Hg%3D%3D%0A)

In the **Businesses** section, tick the **iCalendar** checkbox to enable the iCalendar feed for the business. If a practitioner works at multiple businesses, iCalendar will need to be enabled for each business.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276933/77c01742dc5fff8d918d2ff9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b91da16585e41712c25aa50c1e1d486b4570d5611527aa3bf86c4bf393221947&req=ciMhFM54lIJcFb4f3HP0gI7apBZRR1dYrckLH3e0HfRtNXcX1GXhUniUkrwi%0AylSk3c4YObbypLV%2BBg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276933/77c01742dc5fff8d918d2ff9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b91da16585e41712c25aa50c1e1d486b4570d5611527aa3bf86c4bf393221947&req=ciMhFM54lIJcFb4f3HP0gI7apBZRR1dYrckLH3e0HfRtNXcX1GXhUniUkrwi%0AylSk3c4YObbypLV%2BBg%3D%3D%0A)

The practitioner's **iCalendar URL** for this business will be displayed.

You can choose the range of appointments to sync, how patient names should be displayed, and whether client phone numbers, addresses, patient notes and patient warnings should be included in the appointment details section in your external calendar app.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137203638/96c74702b16c656f393fb8a3/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+12_11_42.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f13e191e77e70177477a0beca003d98d6cbe72349e5715350e95336ac1272448&req=dSEkEct%2BnodcUfMW1HO4ze3mYkFxgHpvzq5dONCdjswuD0HaXZ%2BZLw5huOJX%0AXO%2B61P2XP0IBgMlYkEs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137203638/96c74702b16c656f393fb8a3/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+12_11_42.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f13e191e77e70177477a0beca003d98d6cbe72349e5715350e95336ac1272448&req=dSEkEct%2BnodcUfMW1HO4ze3mYkFxgHpvzq5dONCdjswuD0HaXZ%2BZLw5huOJX%0AXO%2B61P2XP0IBgMlYkEs%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Subscribing to your iCalendar feed
==================================

Once you've enabled and saved the iCalendar integration settings, the next step is to subscribe to the iCalendar URL on your device.

Clicking on the URL itself in the windows earlier in this article will open the iCalendar feed in the default calendar app on your device. You can also choose to copy the URL or email the URL to yourself, which can be helpful if you need to access the URL on another device like your smartphone.

Most devices will support simply clicking the iCalendar URL, which will direct you to your calendar app to subscribe. If your device doesn't support clicking the URL directly, you will need to manually copy the URL and set it up in your preferred calendar application.

Setting up iCalendar on iPhone
------------------------------

After clicking on the iCalendar URL on iOS, you should see the following prompt to subscribe to your PracSuite appointment feed in the Calendar app.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/239745514/fb957e8856a8632916fafe4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ec5238180b6f1ef225911b50cc3840ae7252852a94e468f514675b59d9c3b359&req=diMuEc17mIBbFb4f3HP0gKIa6MlF9ucgpJc6M2SqhAkE1BYOIOWpZoORxqNn%0As4kxo3qwh5XSZdl4FA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/239745514/fb957e8856a8632916fafe4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ec5238180b6f1ef225911b50cc3840ae7252852a94e468f514675b59d9c3b359&req=diMuEc17mIBbFb4f3HP0gKIa6MlF9ucgpJc6M2SqhAkE1BYOIOWpZoORxqNn%0As4kxo3qwh5XSZdl4FA%3D%3D%0A)

**Setting up iCalendar in Outlook**
-----------------------------------

When clicking the iCalendar URL in Windows, you will be prompted to open the link in Outlook.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/491030863/5a16c3f971d39dd628514e19/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd243e9be5c3345a45b4568f33a4edf700ff033a5b92528fb39e98c59139fbb2&req=cCkmFsp%2BlYdcFb4f3HP0gF6Kc4oKN2Gf0VMx2mWz0WFCA%2FWcGMzv1aRb0Wt2%0AS4W9k%2F8eE1WxSk3BBA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/491030863/5a16c3f971d39dd628514e19/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd243e9be5c3345a45b4568f33a4edf700ff033a5b92528fb39e98c59139fbb2&req=cCkmFsp%2BlYdcFb4f3HP0gF6Kc4oKN2Gf0VMx2mWz0WFCA%2FWcGMzv1aRb0Wt2%0AS4W9k%2F8eE1WxSk3BBA%3D%3D%0A)

You will then get a pop-up for your Windows username and password to confirm that you want to add a web calendar for Outlook. You may need to contact your IT System Administrator if you do not have the required level of Windows access.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/491030343/324badb6cdd521cfdad502a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9aa3f52fa04ea23513e24460440a44c17a8f730be41eaa247699fa873e75193f&req=cCkmFsp%2BnoVcFb4f3HP0gI004Xs2c6Lj4TJUeMCsxARGwkrgMvMQwCw3Asq%2B%0AgqBXH1HcLWSPYm6ffg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/491030343/324badb6cdd521cfdad502a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9aa3f52fa04ea23513e24460440a44c17a8f730be41eaa247699fa873e75193f&req=cCkmFsp%2BnoVcFb4f3HP0gI004Xs2c6Lj4TJUeMCsxARGwkrgMvMQwCw3Asq%2B%0AgqBXH1HcLWSPYm6ffg%3D%3D%0A)

Once entered, select 'Yes' to subscribe to the calendar.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/239745877/0ca0394ee1c79d72c8a7507d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2457e22a35b336a12a62cda1803c359bfdc2e207a46665f4bee119a980b8459e&req=diMuEc17lYZYFb4f3HP0gKb0vUmc%2FioRLcqfIiuVLmR6GU057tzkl0h6Joc1%0AIeQfKnQsMMGibASigA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/239745877/0ca0394ee1c79d72c8a7507d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2457e22a35b336a12a62cda1803c359bfdc2e207a46665f4bee119a980b8459e&req=diMuEc17lYZYFb4f3HP0gKb0vUmc%2FioRLcqfIiuVLmR6GU057tzkl0h6Joc1%0AIeQfKnQsMMGibASigA%3D%3D%0A)
