Enabling Automatic SMS Appointment Reminders

Enabling Automatic SMS Appointment Reminders
============================================

Updated over 4 months ago

Table of contents

[Creating an SMS Reminder](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders#h_56d8c6af9a)

[Configuring the Reminder](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders#h_fc461e2708)

[Activating the Reminders](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders#h_ca7327f2a0)

[Patient Preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders#h_3cc658bfeb)

PracSuite allows you to schedule automatic SMS appointment reminders, with the option to send specific SMS templates for different Businesses, Professions, Practitioners and Appointment Types. It is also possible to schedule multiple SMS appointment reminders that go out at different times before an appointment.  
​

Creating an SMS Reminder
------------------------

#### Step 1:

Go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Reminders](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/reminders)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788135242/81d45ef3630eb367f178f5641630/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b3e2ae849327228c1b4cdc7fc576ce83fd7959c168ba328418ff1be8a200bd9&req=dScvHsh9mINbW%2FMW1HO4zSsTq5zl1dDphCyPllNy31KQkhC47P9XmJrPGio7%0AS5HbvFn8lMVxdMrGS94%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788135242/81d45ef3630eb367f178f5641630/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b3e2ae849327228c1b4cdc7fc576ce83fd7959c168ba328418ff1be8a200bd9&req=dScvHsh9mINbW%2FMW1HO4zSsTq5zl1dDphCyPllNy31KQkhC47P9XmJrPGio7%0AS5HbvFn8lMVxdMrGS94%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select **Add SMS Reminder.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788136783/ebf6477fa2fa6ff74eb93b71c978/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a38d684283118ce88936588e27402c9488c7ab4d4bb52b283cc76a788b358462&req=dScvHsh9m4ZXWvMW1HO4zbbyDqkR0YFTY%2B2te7IpnxN7j6W2fnmvNGoQOi7P%0AMlqEDepmrvPXj7yGBvQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788136783/ebf6477fa2fa6ff74eb93b71c978/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a38d684283118ce88936588e27402c9488c7ab4d4bb52b283cc76a788b358462&req=dScvHsh9m4ZXWvMW1HO4zbbyDqkR0YFTY%2B2te7IpnxN7j6W2fnmvNGoQOi7P%0AMlqEDepmrvPXj7yGBvQ%3D%0A)

Configuring the Reminder
------------------------

### Basic Settings

#### Step 1:

Enter a name for this reminder and choose when you would like the reminder to be sent. We recommend 1, 2 or 3 days before an appointment at a specific time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788139878/f6448281f28ae5b50826a09a7800/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=07cd22a937b0b541ee0ce0e2acc9e0d5195627f47d3d998069cba6ca24fa487d&req=dScvHsh9lIlYUfMW1HO4zdUquuwHZ%2FT6pJUxI%2BJbfce6A%2FurP9Lj17C6xrYS%0ARA6gLthmWUvi%2FIllxW4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788139878/f6448281f28ae5b50826a09a7800/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=07cd22a937b0b541ee0ce0e2acc9e0d5195627f47d3d998069cba6ca24fa487d&req=dScvHsh9lIlYUfMW1HO4zdUquuwHZ%2FT6pJUxI%2BJbfce6A%2FurP9Lj17C6xrYS%0ARA6gLthmWUvi%2FIllxW4%3D%0A)

Note: PracSuite will continue to send appointment reminders for newly booked appointments after reminders for that day have already been sent. Use the **'Do not send a reminder within'** option to limit sending reminders for newly booked appointments.

#### Step 2:

Replies to SMS appointment reminders will be [visible within PracSuite in several places.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4702551-viewing-sms-replies)
 You can also opt to receive patient **SMS replies via Email** to the respective business email address, or to specific email addresses.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594902665/904a892bde7bddf1a802b584/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a355662fb4589c59cc5b8f9e5c3ba391056e08bd1f79b7878d3e9c8c0b8cf5c&req=cSkjH8l8m4daFb4f3HP0gP0abbacehH%2Bk7nW%2BUzqPx8jgjTPvXZJUCTD2Cs5%0AfKdhygz%2FmT9iYHCXew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594902665/904a892bde7bddf1a802b584/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a355662fb4589c59cc5b8f9e5c3ba391056e08bd1f79b7878d3e9c8c0b8cf5c&req=cSkjH8l8m4daFb4f3HP0gP0abbacehH%2Bk7nW%2BUzqPx8jgjTPvXZJUCTD2Cs5%0AfKdhygz%2FmT9iYHCXew%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

You can opt to enable an **SMS Sender ID**, which will be displayed on the patient's mobile phone when receiving SMS reminders. **Note: Patients will not be able to reply to SMS messages sent with an SMS Sender ID.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594902750/0ee38eb1ccae13e5b260ab43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb38fab85b9505f55d36aee01b9340e26550bfc875a2873f844408adc0bac6d1&req=cSkjH8l8moRfFb4f3HP0gA7RFZIiJctptUNx0O8KdpKFRWLWwKK21RnlqKTJ%0AtFwm4t4goVVd1HWr4w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594902750/0ee38eb1ccae13e5b260ab43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb38fab85b9505f55d36aee01b9340e26550bfc875a2873f844408adc0bac6d1&req=cSkjH8l8moRfFb4f3HP0gA7RFZIiJctptUNx0O8KdpKFRWLWwKK21RnlqKTJ%0AtFwm4t4goVVd1HWr4w%3D%3D%0A)

### Setting SMS Templates

#### Step 1:

Set the **Default [SMS Reminder Template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317983-creating-sms-templates)
** to be used. This will be used for all appointments unless there is an override set.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788142573/c0f45a9dea2882c79a33f6d3e449/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f90837e1cea86f3900df0f0c191d77335c896bfed8405da06ff8ff8690f133d5&req=dScvHsh6n4RYWvMW1HO4zRBYMjsDj7dtrTq0wflVz6dULmf%2F35VqTOBJWiLu%0AU2f2RDBNDJVwCK42N34%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788142573/c0f45a9dea2882c79a33f6d3e449/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f90837e1cea86f3900df0f0c191d77335c896bfed8405da06ff8ff8690f133d5&req=dScvHsh6n4RYWvMW1HO4zRBYMjsDj7dtrTq0wflVz6dULmf%2F35VqTOBJWiLu%0AU2f2RDBNDJVwCK42N34%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select **Add** to configure override templates if you wish to send different SMS templates for appointments with a particular Business, Profession, Practitioner or Appointment type.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788144245/99e72991e85e49e430130abda896/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b708197075ae4f9f7fdd1c60f364a9b9ae4088b652e5731ca658563e25533071&req=dScvHsh6mYNbXPMW1HO4zexXZ%2Fv4RCcvgKWb%2FbSPrJeSFNHy%2BMUyzVcVjYvo%0A4sgy%2B3h5tLj9CrBz1Y4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788144245/99e72991e85e49e430130abda896/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b708197075ae4f9f7fdd1c60f364a9b9ae4088b652e5731ca658563e25533071&req=dScvHsh6mYNbXPMW1HO4zexXZ%2Fv4RCcvgKWb%2FbSPrJeSFNHy%2BMUyzVcVjYvo%0A4sgy%2B3h5tLj9CrBz1Y4%3D%0A)

Set an override for each case that requires a different template.

Note: Overrides higher in the list take priority over those lower in the list. Because of this, make sure the more specific overrides are put closer to the top of the list. You can re-organise the overrides by hovering your cursor over an entry and using the **||** symbol to drag-and-drop them into the desired order.

### Exclusions

**Exclusions** can also be defined to prevent SMS Reminders from sending for specific Businesses, Practitioners, or Appointment Types.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788146181/53a173db560a63b108afcc85cba0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef73ab2c7952e9b5be5bad814828fa7394eb0920302b1c4ee81f84f29b3a7f85&req=dScvHsh6m4BXWPMW1HO4zYYR0OF%2FDOvqQGghaYQt%2BKMWYPju%2BgF8BMK6rxqR%0AeECFMiVYEnRfgWiFCIc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788146181/53a173db560a63b108afcc85cba0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef73ab2c7952e9b5be5bad814828fa7394eb0920302b1c4ee81f84f29b3a7f85&req=dScvHsh6m4BXWPMW1HO4zYYR0OF%2FDOvqQGghaYQt%2BKMWYPju%2BgF8BMK6rxqR%0AeECFMiVYEnRfgWiFCIc%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Activating the Reminders
------------------------

After saving your reminder preferences, return to the [main reminders page](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/reminders)
 to ensure your preferred reminders are active in the grid.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594904280/0009f11108ce6143ee1337a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a4adef2b167a14dba32faf804664051012f0704f77ec692bce8afb7ab6028483&req=cSkjH8l6n4lfFb4f3HP0gGpG4O%2BRtuzs4wDNg6vXRYnb6f8pvUsKMgTPK4N6%0AMylXGdU%2BOJ41kz0WNg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594904280/0009f11108ce6143ee1337a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a4adef2b167a14dba32faf804664051012f0704f77ec692bce8afb7ab6028483&req=cSkjH8l6n4lfFb4f3HP0gGpG4O%2BRtuzs4wDNg6vXRYnb6f8pvUsKMgTPK4N6%0AMylXGdU%2BOJ41kz0WNg%3D%3D%0A)

When you're ready, enable the switch to Automatically Send SMS Reminders.

You can repeat the above process to schedule additional appointment reminders to be sent at different times.

Note: If you are going to be creating multiple reminders keep in mind that all reminders will be sent to all appointments unless they are added to the exclusions. For any businesses, practitioners, and appointment types you don't want to send a reminder to, add them to the exclusions to prevent sending multiple reminders.

Patient Preferences
-------------------

Appointment reminders will be sent to patients according to the Reminders preferences set on their patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788301606/b0d721fdf2fcda1ee318b5c8b6f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c561af2eebb9aad158bd851b8e83a0fa84caca25e6e9aeb1ebaffe81c6784622&req=dScvHsp%2BnIdfX%2FMW1HO4zdTXMLgG9b3p3Y%2FerlUc4Zj%2Fp2LT%2BJUx2yFAVEie%0A8D69XVp7gB7IajMdQ1Y%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788301606/b0d721fdf2fcda1ee318b5c8b6f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c561af2eebb9aad158bd851b8e83a0fa84caca25e6e9aeb1ebaffe81c6784622&req=dScvHsp%2BnIdfX%2FMW1HO4zdTXMLgG9b3p3Y%2FerlUc4Zj%2Fp2LT%2BJUx2yFAVEie%0A8D69XVp7gB7IajMdQ1Y%3D%0A)

For instructions on how to set up Email Reminders, please see this article: [Enabling Automatic Email Appointment Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386614-enabling-automatic-email-appointment-reminders)

Enabling Automatic Email Appointment Reminders
==============================================

Updated over 4 months ago

PracSuite allows you to schedule automatic email appointment reminders, with the option to send specific email templates for different Businesses, Professions, Practitioners and Appointment Types. It is also possible to schedule multiple email appointment reminders that go out at different times before an appointment.

Creating an Email Reminder
--------------------------

#### Step 1:

Go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Reminders](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/reminders)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788078345/617d1e3875777e086f737595e585/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b50e0f533fbf6415419bc802297608712686d8d7118b53053a3d8eb6ff969832&req=dScvHsl5lYJbXPMW1HO4zQzTQFu2uZHjy2ANg%2BlGMAw0Zzjms%2Fezn5dPwbN8%0AuHnJoC%2FdgohWbYFmKy4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788078345/617d1e3875777e086f737595e585/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b50e0f533fbf6415419bc802297608712686d8d7118b53053a3d8eb6ff969832&req=dScvHsl5lYJbXPMW1HO4zQzTQFu2uZHjy2ANg%2BlGMAw0Zzjms%2Fezn5dPwbN8%0AuHnJoC%2FdgohWbYFmKy4%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select **Add Email Reminder**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633164414/114266367260a6c9731c6b12/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=548164771ba82f5fefd7da95d5d482b5888297162f68289a09d57cf82b363a46&req=ciMkF896mYBbFb4f3HP0gKmdgv9xdP1XVMDn7tUfqrtSnml4Quztin7xd6lP%0AWupGB3x3ullKzeHm7Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633164414/114266367260a6c9731c6b12/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=548164771ba82f5fefd7da95d5d482b5888297162f68289a09d57cf82b363a46&req=ciMkF896mYBbFb4f3HP0gKmdgv9xdP1XVMDn7tUfqrtSnml4Quztin7xd6lP%0AWupGB3x3ullKzeHm7Q%3D%3D%0A)

Configuring the Reminder
------------------------

### Basic Settings

#### Step 1:

Enter a name for this reminder and choose when you would like the reminder to be sent. We recommend 1, 2 or 3 days before an appointment at a specific time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788080019/b9c796dad68338e3ae3e01939480/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b9e61751d22436a26b753cbad623c5972a11c3f13d65dd638df86d0693b8e211&req=dScvHsl2nYFeUPMW1HO4zTMKSVjhiCk7vYneSf7UGYN2AFGEHROJ0UB0UW6N%0ArMZlaza9kpROjJzAgP0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788080019/b9c796dad68338e3ae3e01939480/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b9e61751d22436a26b753cbad623c5972a11c3f13d65dd638df86d0693b8e211&req=dScvHsl2nYFeUPMW1HO4zTMKSVjhiCk7vYneSf7UGYN2AFGEHROJ0UB0UW6N%0ArMZlaza9kpROjJzAgP0%3D%0A)

Note: PracSuite will continue to send appointment reminders for newly booked appointments after reminders for that day have already been sent. Use the **'Do not send a reminder within'** option to limit sending reminders for newly booked appointments.

#### Step 2:

Select whether you want replies to come back to the businesses email address or a specified address.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788086550/5c798ce5a066adaf80df888386e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d7734cbb9e876a41ffc7da26f2ca3492111c82ed1d4921b59f175dd4e7e56f04&req=dScvHsl2m4RaWfMW1HO4zcqgfnM5Gi5ejZQiFxVEHfqbNqMhfjSssxht9gZ4%0Ar8jlN4crhjbX3X%2F%2FpRQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788086550/5c798ce5a066adaf80df888386e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d7734cbb9e876a41ffc7da26f2ca3492111c82ed1d4921b59f175dd4e7e56f04&req=dScvHsl2m4RaWfMW1HO4zcqgfnM5Gi5ejZQiFxVEHfqbNqMhfjSssxht9gZ4%0Ar8jlN4crhjbX3X%2F%2FpRQ%3D%0A)

### Setting Email Templates

#### Step 1:

Set the **Default [Email Reminder Template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317970-creating-email-templates)
** to be used. This will be used for all appointments unless there is an override set.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788090397/a3c8a7b77dc212c154f1ba667c07/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fca6d58445ac7fd6b4fa63587d7ee9e2035b18c2ea0a905dd5409b22574bf1df&req=dScvHsl3nYJWXvMW1HO4zVYoEIDGiOjadaPhzYOzntFQC0vhClpPXMDYcp9x%0AK4uImBWB9zis50MZRJQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788090397/a3c8a7b77dc212c154f1ba667c07/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fca6d58445ac7fd6b4fa63587d7ee9e2035b18c2ea0a905dd5409b22574bf1df&req=dScvHsl3nYJWXvMW1HO4zVYoEIDGiOjadaPhzYOzntFQC0vhClpPXMDYcp9x%0AK4uImBWB9zis50MZRJQ%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select **Add** to configure override templates if you wish to send different email templates for appointments with a particular Business, Profession, Practitioner or Appointment Type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788091960/5d4cfd468f9f1ec97dffb864fd2c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af6aaa9b2038e64dddef4c037cb02cf13873bac0c891650c4f188134bfe4e0d7&req=dScvHsl3nIhZWfMW1HO4zWOxyPWHmjXubU%2FOjKAsXoqUEqr3ALkbGFEhwHrU%0AY%2Fcsk3aDDJ0T4vLorz8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788091960/5d4cfd468f9f1ec97dffb864fd2c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af6aaa9b2038e64dddef4c037cb02cf13873bac0c891650c4f188134bfe4e0d7&req=dScvHsl3nIhZWfMW1HO4zWOxyPWHmjXubU%2FOjKAsXoqUEqr3ALkbGFEhwHrU%0AY%2Fcsk3aDDJ0T4vLorz8%3D%0A)

Set an override for each case that requires a different template.

Note: Overrides higher in the list take priority over those lower in the list. Because of this, make sure the more specific overrides are put closer to the top of the list. You can re-organise the overrides by hovering your cursor over an entry and using the **||** symbol to drag-and-drop them into the desired order.

### Exclusions

**Exclusions** can also be defined to prevent Email Reminders from sending for specific Businesses, Practitioners, or Appointment Types.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788106019/58225de41a17b75c022dd4f2df54/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b988b4aee5fcba55923cb11fa1ac9715db89857dc13cf5225458ecf840b001e7&req=dScvHsh%2Bm4FeUPMW1HO4zeDjVQoJDWhFBATHlhTyAPCpPcbXZxq0NB2ztX5Y%0AeOjOGEFLcJJPXHYD64g%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788106019/58225de41a17b75c022dd4f2df54/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b988b4aee5fcba55923cb11fa1ac9715db89857dc13cf5225458ecf840b001e7&req=dScvHsh%2Bm4FeUPMW1HO4zeDjVQoJDWhFBATHlhTyAPCpPcbXZxq0NB2ztX5Y%0AeOjOGEFLcJJPXHYD64g%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Activating the Reminders
------------------------

After saving your reminder preferences, return to the [main reminders page](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/reminders)
 to ensure your preferred reminders are active in the grid.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633165261/c9683a67c88d4f924fd33538/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32d5e0050c1c9cb35958bab6474933dfb8c670d64955133160644e820df85ffe&req=ciMkF897n4deFb4f3HP0gIIP0CS9nWqrniB4ZopFXnGwjkTAa3n5JO6GcgCf%0A4KqCwjRtQh6clfLYmw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633165261/c9683a67c88d4f924fd33538/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32d5e0050c1c9cb35958bab6474933dfb8c670d64955133160644e820df85ffe&req=ciMkF897n4deFb4f3HP0gIIP0CS9nWqrniB4ZopFXnGwjkTAa3n5JO6GcgCf%0A4KqCwjRtQh6clfLYmw%3D%3D%0A)

When you're ready, enable the switch to Automatically Send Email Reminders.

You can repeat the above process to schedule additional appointment reminders to be sent at different times.

Note: If you are going to be creating multiple reminders keep in mind that all reminders will be sent to all appointments unless they are added to the exclusions. For any businesses, practitioners, and appointment types you don't want to send a reminder to, add them to the exclusions to prevent sending multiple reminders.

Patient Preferences
-------------------

Appointment reminders will be sent to patients according to the Reminders preferences set on their patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788302314/d8c2e930c7b0856f51b8a28eeb9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9cf312e0c50afa268f36d6fcd9ef12f607e0e5a4984f1a321beb09dfd803ea3&req=dScvHsp%2Bn4JeXfMW1HO4zSjDHInJOM308lTb%2F3%2FVatCwiWyjn7Hnc2B9%2B2lg%0A2FWPZ6GdUsZmO2Nvxew%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788302314/d8c2e930c7b0856f51b8a28eeb9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9cf312e0c50afa268f36d6fcd9ef12f607e0e5a4984f1a321beb09dfd803ea3&req=dScvHsp%2Bn4JeXfMW1HO4zSjDHInJOM308lTb%2F3%2FVatCwiWyjn7Hnc2B9%2B2lg%0A2FWPZ6GdUsZmO2Nvxew%3D%0A)

For instructions on how to set up SMS Reminders, please see this article: [Enabling Automatic SMS Appointment Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)

Editing an Item Code Description when Invoicing

Editing an Item Code Description when Invoicing
===============================================

Updated over 3 years ago

To override the default item code description when invoicing, simply **click onto the item code drop list** and select the **Edit Pencil** on the right.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633165553/f63978509f1cf8e3c90270c3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bad4175923f7b557bb38ff3a980b5a73a798ff77ea73ef5cfad4669f1fffb2d7&req=ciMkF897mIRcFb4f3HP0gBJMF6%2FBq9f0H7acQzuiouzn6Nl4MeSVCQIZK81E%0AHdWLNC%2BgGvQvgR5a0w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633165553/f63978509f1cf8e3c90270c3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bad4175923f7b557bb38ff3a980b5a73a798ff77ea73ef5cfad4669f1fffb2d7&req=ciMkF897mIRcFb4f3HP0gBJMF6%2FBq9f0H7acQzuiouzn6Nl4MeSVCQIZK81E%0AHdWLNC%2BgGvQvgR5a0w%3D%3D%0A)

This will allow you to edit the item code description text.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633165681/beeb48405cae6888bc709fe7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=535865fe9973ce1bcbb2c1b908943d07d726f65e5a3ab8a8667e16cb763126fc&req=ciMkF897m4leFb4f3HP0gKxW4eYVMKnHoGxCvg12mV3VBXVo3AdC8BUAvDR9%0ANfEAMsR9FgDRu4Xi0A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633165681/beeb48405cae6888bc709fe7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=535865fe9973ce1bcbb2c1b908943d07d726f65e5a3ab8a8667e16cb763126fc&req=ciMkF897m4leFb4f3HP0gKxW4eYVMKnHoGxCvg12mV3VBXVo3AdC8BUAvDR9%0ANfEAMsR9FgDRu4Xi0A%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Copying a Roster

Copying a Roster
================

Updated over 3 years ago

The Copy Roster function makes it easy to use an existing roster as a base for a new Roster, especially when the rules on the roster are similar.

To copy a Roster, go to **[Settings > Practitioners > Rosters](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners/rosters)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633166306/77f36b034b1d0e0f933ea20a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0374c603f6b58a6dd793fdf56be521e7dc0db203803c4ccb6dc20fb99f156523&req=ciMkF894noFZFb4f3HP0gFPpVUxYOjjQM4lBkL140rAfQVxzsHxBVyS%2Bf5ow%0Af2sl13Ok4TglZqqgRA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633166306/77f36b034b1d0e0f933ea20a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0374c603f6b58a6dd793fdf56be521e7dc0db203803c4ccb6dc20fb99f156523&req=ciMkF894noFZFb4f3HP0gFPpVUxYOjjQM4lBkL140rAfQVxzsHxBVyS%2Bf5ow%0Af2sl13Ok4TglZqqgRA%3D%3D%0A)

Open the Roster you wish to copy and select the **Cog icon** at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633166508/accf0e56fb65480dc585bcdf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e2a72cac6e0f6cd115d7603f37b59d2c9ede78203b513a620a2c3240c426c238&req=ciMkF894mIFXFb4f3HP0gEPh4%2FQ%2BrX3z6ycztlZzXzCaK2j64MJqHo6zPPBd%0AG3ESOem6xea%2FLEKh8g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633166508/accf0e56fb65480dc585bcdf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e2a72cac6e0f6cd115d7603f37b59d2c9ede78203b513a620a2c3240c426c238&req=ciMkF894mIFXFb4f3HP0gEPh4%2FQ%2BrX3z6ycztlZzXzCaK2j64MJqHo6zPPBd%0AG3ESOem6xea%2FLEKh8g%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Copy Roster** option, which will take you to a new page with a copy of the selected Roster.

Once you've finished editing the copy of the Roster, select **Save**.

How to Manage Outstanding Invoices

How to Manage Outstanding Invoices
==================================

Updated over 3 years ago

The Outstanding Invoices report allows you to issue invoices in bulk, including bulk printing and emailing functions. This report is generally used in practices that build up their owing invoices to send out weekly/fortnight/monthly, as well as to follow up overdue invoices in bulk.

To manage owing invoices, go to **[Reports > Billing > Outstanding Invoices](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/outstandinginvoices)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959254/28fb30da105aa7ba61f2318d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=350ef20aea34ebb4a899435aa735664c47d3eeeaa7b0496f9e5b50d8fc9ed486&req=ciMmH8x3n4RbFb4f3HP0gCh4XqK7ytktIcfLac582%2BuRB58Iv9IzLq4yZtw6%0A03BPkJxxIQGl58QOaA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959254/28fb30da105aa7ba61f2318d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=350ef20aea34ebb4a899435aa735664c47d3eeeaa7b0496f9e5b50d8fc9ed486&req=ciMmH8x3n4RbFb4f3HP0gCh4XqK7ytktIcfLac582%2BuRB58Iv9IzLq4yZtw6%0A03BPkJxxIQGl58QOaA%3D%3D%0A)

Start with selecting the invoice date range. This report can be used to print or email **unissued** invoices, as well as previously **issued** and **overdue** invoices. Set your filters appropriately.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959359/bd12a2b5680b3878877eb6e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=876ccb24258e5dabe429c33bd47e7b158d14818aded145723f0f97db0f1307a8&req=ciMmH8x3noRWFb4f3HP0gI75OjJwr3xljPLf6dSBxOP0R%2Bzlw1Ep7hi1tRp3%0A3ix87FN2mj%2FR11NDIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959359/bd12a2b5680b3878877eb6e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=876ccb24258e5dabe429c33bd47e7b158d14818aded145723f0f97db0f1307a8&req=ciMmH8x3noRWFb4f3HP0gI75OjJwr3xljPLf6dSBxOP0R%2Bzlw1Ep7hi1tRp3%0A3ix87FN2mj%2FR11NDIA%3D%3D%0A)

Once you have set your filters, select **Generate Report**:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959413/978a12a7991f2a8a710f00d7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cea105323795f3bbd3211adc10f5482a6f47dc2db44a728e267b56a9102d5300&req=ciMmH8x3mYBcFb4f3HP0gGTnHk%2BqN1S3aaymu6tPqGHx%2Bm8VgRGdCwbN88f%2F%0AettEyKk3QK9GsvdG1w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959413/978a12a7991f2a8a710f00d7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cea105323795f3bbd3211adc10f5482a6f47dc2db44a728e267b56a9102d5300&req=ciMmH8x3mYBcFb4f3HP0gGTnHk%2BqN1S3aaymu6tPqGHx%2Bm8VgRGdCwbN88f%2F%0AettEyKk3QK9GsvdG1w%3D%3D%0A)

Owing invoices that match your filters are displayed in the results grid.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959630/cde7cc94584a1dfae74cd5c5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=903e1e1d786409f8b4c2b4f3bc25ec823a2826682ebf5ac3b2c20b1c6e9248dc&req=ciMmH8x3m4JfFb4f3HP0gH%2BYbvKtlyMBw3HmdRog6X0Cr%2FxvpGe1JMBdETdE%0AV7hcdl4NzA4ITWFD6w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959630/cde7cc94584a1dfae74cd5c5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=903e1e1d786409f8b4c2b4f3bc25ec823a2826682ebf5ac3b2c20b1c6e9248dc&req=ciMmH8x3m4JfFb4f3HP0gH%2BYbvKtlyMBw3HmdRog6X0Cr%2FxvpGe1JMBdETdE%0AV7hcdl4NzA4ITWFD6w%3D%3D%0A)

Mark the invoices you wish to issue with the checkboxes on the left-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959701/0694c74dd3c515e6d6ebc351/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7e4c2308a4a7064977bac31c2d8ce5db66940c87803e5bf69860ff08e8cd021e&req=ciMmH8x3moFeFb4f3HP0gLPdHqeh%2F%2BGmvUEKLefAmtb9MKyT3UnLI6305CMH%0AfKwkmSlUyHq4ftTQvA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959701/0694c74dd3c515e6d6ebc351/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7e4c2308a4a7064977bac31c2d8ce5db66940c87803e5bf69860ff08e8cd021e&req=ciMmH8x3moFeFb4f3HP0gLPdHqeh%2F%2BGmvUEKLefAmtb9MKyT3UnLI6305CMH%0AfKwkmSlUyHq4ftTQvA%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Process** button to take the selected action as displayed in the grid. Use the drop-down menu in each row to override the action.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959853/14ca0740d3730ce390b684e3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3ccd7d55c05f9d3bcf58a28a5eb890ba67bdbceb5387dda33b6a9e196ffdeac7&req=ciMmH8x3lYRcFb4f3HP0gIhJjPH1bS7LCoM6dOzVWb34m24FmgL9iPAcMT9e%0AyMBHFAc0YA3v9RFFEQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959853/14ca0740d3730ce390b684e3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3ccd7d55c05f9d3bcf58a28a5eb890ba67bdbceb5387dda33b6a9e196ffdeac7&req=ciMmH8x3lYRcFb4f3HP0gIhJjPH1bS7LCoM6dOzVWb34m24FmgL9iPAcMT9e%0AyMBHFAc0YA3v9RFFEQ%3D%3D%0A)

To print all selected invoices, select the **Print** button. To email all selected invoices, select **Email**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959934/8d887c653ae0625ba3190e98/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3cb80a3b9679b19ba8086399480ce95ff1691c60b73412c8169626ce01eb45be&req=ciMmH8x3lIJbFb4f3HP0gNYQ2j7HueyL3A0IJKtjkZjsr%2FxFNUGbKpaC%2BMU4%0AoSnrEL%2Byl6GuhDgbRA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631959934/8d887c653ae0625ba3190e98/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3cb80a3b9679b19ba8086399480ce95ff1691c60b73412c8169626ce01eb45be&req=ciMmH8x3lIJbFb4f3HP0gNYQ2j7HueyL3A0IJKtjkZjsr%2FxFNUGbKpaC%2BMU4%0AoSnrEL%2Byl6GuhDgbRA%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting Process, Print or Email, you will be given the option to send the selected invoices with their existing Invoice Date and Due Date. Select **Process** to action all emails with their existing dates.

Select **Adjust Dates** to update Invoice Dates and Due dates in bulk.

Note: You will need to factor any changes to invoice dates and due dates into your financial reporting processes. To assist you with this process, PracSuite billing reports include options to report by Invoice Date or Item Date.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631960007/18450c21e43a1aa707293fee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab31400b058158f26e3620a7743f1eeb11cac536872262f61197ac7b2ae16e68&req=ciMmH89%2BnYFYFb4f3HP0gKGwuyPbZug70Gfy3KEP7XBQs52e34PakA8LY5I%2B%0ADXKzgVLslfsNUseEpg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631960007/18450c21e43a1aa707293fee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab31400b058158f26e3620a7743f1eeb11cac536872262f61197ac7b2ae16e68&req=ciMmH89%2BnYFYFb4f3HP0gKGwuyPbZug70Gfy3KEP7XBQs52e34PakA8LY5I%2B%0ADXKzgVLslfsNUseEpg%3D%3D%0A)

Note: If your selection of invoices includes issued or overdue invoices, by default, these invoices will not be included in bulk date adjustments. If you want to update issued and overdue invoices, disabled the 'only update invoices that are not already issued' option.

Select **Next** to proceed to the next step.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631960094/1968c2de1ef90eb107b8ce93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49fa85fce14006d3a4c357c8faded33634cd0720f8172eb76eff12dc47d6f186&req=ciMmH89%2BnYhbFb4f3HP0gCgPAE7YoRu7%2BPaJykIj%2B%2BZHZmKCjk9HfXUzgw6a%0AsdbQphWM%2F0Dpaps8bg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631960094/1968c2de1ef90eb107b8ce93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49fa85fce14006d3a4c357c8faded33634cd0720f8172eb76eff12dc47d6f186&req=ciMmH89%2BnYhbFb4f3HP0gCgPAE7YoRu7%2BPaJykIj%2B%2BZHZmKCjk9HfXUzgw6a%0AsdbQphWM%2F0Dpaps8bg%3D%3D%0A)

There is one final confirmation prompt presented before invoices are automatically updated and printed or emailed based on your selections.

How to Issue and Unissue Invoices

How to Issue and Unissue Invoices
=================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Invoices are automatically marked as issued when they are printed or emailed individually.

When initially creating an invoice, you can use the Save drop-down menu to Save & Print, Save & Email an invoice or both.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639630415/ea1c352a47d6015d86859f2e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a536c971c6f05413c564387370f7d0c6191041e079863de415f88ec256c4f99f&req=ciMuEMp%2BmYBaFb4f3HP0gLiv9mMGvwAyypJR7qHHxCIZGu%2FWFaFhATPLe07o%0AWcbNj%2BrZpOGfr9Y8iw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639630415/ea1c352a47d6015d86859f2e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a536c971c6f05413c564387370f7d0c6191041e079863de415f88ec256c4f99f&req=ciMuEMp%2BmYBaFb4f3HP0gLiv9mMGvwAyypJR7qHHxCIZGu%2FWFaFhATPLe07o%0AWcbNj%2BrZpOGfr9Y8iw%3D%3D%0A)

To issue owing invoices in bulk, use the [Outstanding Invoices report](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4430319-issuing-outstanding-invoices)
.

To manually mark an invoice as issued, open the invoice by going to the **Client File > Invoices**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639625805/8eb32134c3064fdbbd0d869d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=140da542749096800d29c5f2cc76e47d8474e4c334ea3806751227e5d9a7f5da&req=ciMuEMt7lYFaFb4f3HP0gJukDrhXaS1dxlgZzsixtuANBWJlok6qFaMQ4wsC%0A3A1d4kYF0QIVdra3WA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639625805/8eb32134c3064fdbbd0d869d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=140da542749096800d29c5f2cc76e47d8474e4c334ea3806751227e5d9a7f5da&req=ciMuEMt7lYFaFb4f3HP0gJukDrhXaS1dxlgZzsixtuANBWJlok6qFaMQ4wsC%0A3A1d4kYF0QIVdra3WA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Invoice** you need to mark as issued.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639626199/df8271532dc80112062cb58b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dd74c1eee70c9a88f2327b3e58524bdb21f68253cad6617bdacd60010f6ab9e&req=ciMuEMt4nIhWFb4f3HP0gOUlEBabwtNcN0GSkEahjANUvvqTxu3Cr89bf3Mv%0AtrZzGpTRdVcV7R1p6A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639626199/df8271532dc80112062cb58b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dd74c1eee70c9a88f2327b3e58524bdb21f68253cad6617bdacd60010f6ab9e&req=ciMuEMt4nIhWFb4f3HP0gOUlEBabwtNcN0GSkEahjANUvvqTxu3Cr89bf3Mv%0AtrZzGpTRdVcV7R1p6A%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Mark as Issued** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639626498/c12d98c56079dd541f254e9c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1033fa376d911fb1c2be027335975716303cc4c3a22d70c4a139313e694caea&req=ciMuEMt4mYhXFb4f3HP0gNoNmQRGhuoEGbb0omGcuDEN1dn9kgkEYUm5WW4h%0AXbcLPeU%2B47amzCDfyw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639626498/c12d98c56079dd541f254e9c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1033fa376d911fb1c2be027335975716303cc4c3a22d70c4a139313e694caea&req=ciMuEMt4mYhXFb4f3HP0gNoNmQRGhuoEGbb0omGcuDEN1dn9kgkEYUm5WW4h%0AXbcLPeU%2B47amzCDfyw%3D%3D%0A)

To mark an invoice as unissued, select the **Mark as Unissued** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639626591/20f0a5613c211131bfd96895/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a56ca6da8bfd151a283697275fe673b4ad7b7a77a69791b26af4ecd61bbca74d&req=ciMuEMt4mIheFb4f3HP0gBUk9IrJ282Tb2jMR5AFmTYtv%2FGUzpMJHw5ZyiU6%0ApH2JkrpNDd8ZKCpzXw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639626591/20f0a5613c211131bfd96895/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a56ca6da8bfd151a283697275fe673b4ad7b7a77a69791b26af4ecd61bbca74d&req=ciMuEMt4mIheFb4f3HP0gBUk9IrJ282Tb2jMR5AFmTYtv%2FGUzpMJHw5ZyiU6%0ApH2JkrpNDd8ZKCpzXw%3D%3D%0A)

How to Reprint or Resend an Invoice

How to Reprint or Resend an Invoice
===================================

Updated over 3 years ago

To reprint an invoice or resend an invoice by email, open the invoice by going to the **Client File > Invoices**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639624740/ba37133ada03689fb10731eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72d145bd2a447f5651894558667692960872603f5ea5b166fbd02d715f29acd4&req=ciMuEMt6moVfFb4f3HP0gEQobcfbxHbl%2BNpEGhdyKEKpGZHfd%2F39PcH9pPrZ%0AtNRj2SkaKO5WOe%2Bo%2BA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639624740/ba37133ada03689fb10731eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72d145bd2a447f5651894558667692960872603f5ea5b166fbd02d715f29acd4&req=ciMuEMt6moVfFb4f3HP0gEQobcfbxHbl%2BNpEGhdyKEKpGZHfd%2F39PcH9pPrZ%0AtNRj2SkaKO5WOe%2Bo%2BA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the I**nvoice number** you wish to reprint or resend.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639625021/046fb18c25a981beb9d311b1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91b04d9ace63e70cd35385a15de49736b42c36d7d52b7c0fc27efc3f49a82b05&req=ciMuEMt7nYNeFb4f3HP0gOOPFCiRw6Thg2kRhwrOL8OUWmwONJs6UqvyhoF5%0AjKCLcjbM2ycAp6Xihg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639625021/046fb18c25a981beb9d311b1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91b04d9ace63e70cd35385a15de49736b42c36d7d52b7c0fc27efc3f49a82b05&req=ciMuEMt7nYNeFb4f3HP0gOOPFCiRw6Thg2kRhwrOL8OUWmwONJs6UqvyhoF5%0AjKCLcjbM2ycAp6Xihg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Email** or **Print** buttons at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639625310/4266ff9a391300f13e9874a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b26132a3a3bab9875bfd172daa325a3f368657fd5b3b183701730ef8fa8711b&req=ciMuEMt7noBfFb4f3HP0gK1gMe55aHNTx0ksNsG%2BsLcydXwm0qFoaRkpI8ks%0A8YqBo3RokPi0DaBxtg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/639625310/4266ff9a391300f13e9874a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b26132a3a3bab9875bfd172daa325a3f368657fd5b3b183701730ef8fa8711b&req=ciMuEMt7noBfFb4f3HP0gK1gMe55aHNTx0ksNsG%2BsLcydXwm0qFoaRkpI8ks%0A8YqBo3RokPi0DaBxtg%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 83 — Customising Invoice Preferences | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-83}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4430389-customising-invoice-preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4430389-customising-invoice-preferences)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4430389-customising-invoice-preferences#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Invoicing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413899-invoicing)

[Settings and Preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984698-settings-and-preferences)

Customising Invoice Preferences

Customising Invoice Preferences
===============================

Updated over 8 months ago

The Print on Accounts section at the bottom of the Accounts tab on both Patient and Payer files lets you customise what patient identifiers are displayed on invoices, receipts and statements.

**Patients** - To customise what details are printed on patient invoices, go to the patient file and select the **Accounts** tab.

**Payers** -To customise what details are printed on Third-party Payer Invoices, go to **Contacts > Third-party Payers**, select a file and then select the **Accounts** tab. By enabling the Print on Accounts option on the payer file, you will enforce the selected options for all patients linked to the payer.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637452291/4fe2f1da8ea62315b78bf203/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59e5fcf1f1dc52e678c4f9389df43f245fa0980a3a64b89395784d89eb8f7f11&req=ciMgEsx8n4heFb4f3HP0gDitUByxTN6ooMqxf6Fc%2BKUkH9LKRRARtlkPWPMh%0AP82V21i7neqk16vrhg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637452291/4fe2f1da8ea62315b78bf203/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59e5fcf1f1dc52e678c4f9389df43f245fa0980a3a64b89395784d89eb8f7f11&req=ciMgEsx8n4heFb4f3HP0gDitUByxTN6ooMqxf6Fc%2BKUkH9LKRRARtlkPWPMh%0AP82V21i7neqk16vrhg%3D%3D%0A)

The **Print On Accounts** grid allows you to customise the options displayed:

*   Client Name
    
*   Date of Birth
    
*   Health Fund No.
    
*   Concession Card No.
    
*   Referring Doctor, Provider No. and Expiry Date
    
*   Medicare No.
    
*   DVA No.
    
*   NDIS No.
    
*   Next Appointment
    
*   Account No.
    
*   Claim No.
    
*   Client ID
    
*   Employer
    
*   Injury
    
*   Injury Date
    
*   Hospital/Facility
    
*   Custom Label - allows you to add your own custom header and value.
    

To enable fields, select Edit and enable the fields as required. All enabled fields will display on invoices as shown below:

## Document 85 — Third-party Payer Invoice Preferences | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-85}

[Invoices and Receipts](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984691-invoices-and-receipts)

Third-party Payer Invoice Preferences

Third-party Payer Invoice Preferences
=====================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Invoicing requirements differ from one Third-party Payer to the next. Third-party Payer invoice preferences are set on a **Third-party Payer file** on the **Accounts tab**:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631956141/2e5613578c666be334485e6e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a1184c02633f55a7d3b9f8e0118288fd4848f535914e9d320f68f7e7bc9774f&req=ciMmH8x4nIVeFb4f3HP0gHquA5Nk7YV8mDzEd7h%2B%2FteMtgmhjq3WnZIIg7gD%0AgYW6H0ZDjk0tQarhTw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631956141/2e5613578c666be334485e6e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a1184c02633f55a7d3b9f8e0118288fd4848f535914e9d320f68f7e7bc9774f&req=ciMmH8x4nIVeFb4f3HP0gHquA5Nk7YV8mDzEd7h%2B%2FteMtgmhjq3WnZIIg7gD%0AgYW6H0ZDjk0tQarhTw%3D%3D%0A)

Here you can choose whether the Third-party Payer prefers printed or emailed invoices.

PracSuite allows you to create invoices that contain transactions for multiple patients on a single invoice, or a single invoice per patient.

Select the **'Include multiple patients on the same invoice'** option if this suits the preference of the payer. Deselect this option if the payer requires a single invoice per patient.

You can also choose whether to add multiple transactions in a date range to an **open invoice**. Deselect the **'Add to Last Open Invoice by Default'** if you wish to produce a new invoice each time you bill the patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/259727181/d2c790c46f404a6f9d6a5995/lbp.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=e5881be860a63b473bfcb156970d1e9c904665677ae918426d2b2960ce67f9ec&req=diUuEct5nIleFb4f3HP0gLFKt44cZ%2FzA7edSKrSVeJqfkClgmy7pavpsFY33%0AvSWWEGsxe%2BrDeu%2BRHg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/259727181/d2c790c46f404a6f9d6a5995/lbp.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=e5881be860a63b473bfcb156970d1e9c904665677ae918426d2b2960ce67f9ec&req=diUuEct5nIleFb4f3HP0gLFKt44cZ%2FzA7edSKrSVeJqfkClgmy7pavpsFY33%0AvSWWEGsxe%2BrDeu%2BRHg%3D%3D%0A)

How to Search for an Invoice Number

How to Search for an Invoice Number
===================================

Updated over 2 years ago

To search for invoices, select the **Search icon** at the top of PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633979180/7521291a8f29ebc3fdc004b6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d31d94c4797462022ca7daeaf2fba38fe6d1914a818a2dcbf970b03e7b4b5c0&req=ciMkH853nIlfFb4f3HP0gAxxYrJE8xhoTGMDnePX4EffbRPVw%2FZZ4s0o249C%0APu1S4xTS022BNbjQhQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633979180/7521291a8f29ebc3fdc004b6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d31d94c4797462022ca7daeaf2fba38fe6d1914a818a2dcbf970b03e7b4b5c0&req=ciMkH853nIlfFb4f3HP0gAxxYrJE8xhoTGMDnePX4EffbRPVw%2FZZ4s0o249C%0APu1S4xTS022BNbjQhQ%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **INV:** search parameter followed by the invoice number (note capitals are not required).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957907923/19b7e92cb2b7199f79ed0eaf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afae066fda7e3a33cd9aa9932722971f39d3e6d638e8654a15336566ff9d99c7&req=fSUgH8l5lINcFb4f3HP0gK2NTZzI733T9TgZGpZRGrry7TYCUIfVTmgWvn2e%0AtKUp8nDYZWHPdic9mg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957907923/19b7e92cb2b7199f79ed0eaf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afae066fda7e3a33cd9aa9932722971f39d3e6d638e8654a15336566ff9d99c7&req=fSUgH8l5lINcFb4f3HP0gK2NTZzI733T9TgZGpZRGrry7TYCUIfVTmgWvn2e%0AtKUp8nDYZWHPdic9mg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the invoice to open it on the relevant patient or third-party payer file.

How to Email a Receipt to a Patient

How to Email a Receipt to a Patient
===================================

Updated over 3 years ago

If you're **invoicing from the appointment book**, use the **drop-down arrow to the right of the Save button** and select the **Save & Email** option. This will email the receipt to the email listed in the Bill To section:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633980387/f6cee0ea183638a664ed8f8b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb3e50fd642360464dbc29a28efd0134d935e8457451fda4aed2e186f9bf3548&req=ciMkH8F%2BnolYFb4f3HP0gOuRzDcxLtlM8LRilzcZq%2BCLOwspaTULMhaYgqzS%0AI3EjfOXBmEPxPeSf6A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633980387/f6cee0ea183638a664ed8f8b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb3e50fd642360464dbc29a28efd0134d935e8457451fda4aed2e186f9bf3548&req=ciMkH8F%2BnolYFb4f3HP0gOuRzDcxLtlM8LRilzcZq%2BCLOwspaTULMhaYgqzS%0AI3EjfOXBmEPxPeSf6A%3D%3D%0A)

Similarly, if you're creating a new **invoice from the patient or third-party payer file**, you can issue a receipt using the same **drop-down menu** option:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633980545/ab0fbef6c48c111e06e64e8a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4cb356c69b975f6b8ed9ee2fbb5ed2b405080a473e8388546c58d6ce2fc32e00&req=ciMkH8F%2BmIVaFb4f3HP0gEt0P5ozEdbEtDm06SZJ3NioGFfp%2FebQ6igiaPYR%0AuwaGa4sXyeV%2FkqYUxQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633980545/ab0fbef6c48c111e06e64e8a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4cb356c69b975f6b8ed9ee2fbb5ed2b405080a473e8388546c58d6ce2fc32e00&req=ciMkH8F%2BmIVaFb4f3HP0gEt0P5ozEdbEtDm06SZJ3NioGFfp%2FebQ6igiaPYR%0AuwaGa4sXyeV%2FkqYUxQ%3D%3D%0A)

If you need to re-issue a receipt for a fully paid invoice, simply click the '**email**' button at the top of the invoice page:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633980741/a52d500652f05e3dda3ae5c0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eaea20e8b102550c3b6694ddba0e54bf2626a5581d00a94635bb5fe6a593db95&req=ciMkH8F%2BmoVeFb4f3HP0gL9ncAWMg%2FreFnvV0KZUt1H43jIVEIPOyny9kP0M%0Afek4Y0VslmooX1g0DQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633980741/a52d500652f05e3dda3ae5c0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eaea20e8b102550c3b6694ddba0e54bf2626a5581d00a94635bb5fe6a593db95&req=ciMkH8F%2BmoVeFb4f3HP0gL9ncAWMg%2FreFnvV0KZUt1H43jIVEIPOyny9kP0M%0Afek4Y0VslmooX1g0DQ%3D%3D%0A)

PracSuite includes a default receipt template, though you also have the option to create your own Email Templates. Invoice email template preferences can be set per Business in **[Settings > Businesses > Businesses](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/businesses)
** as shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633982159/c6f1671118faac8a924e33d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=657d1dc6a2270fe4f6dfadac048106aca32034be820943f3561477ba9eeac6c2&req=ciMkH8F8nIRWFb4f3HP0gBfDab%2B2BxRSH8KxsWUkM5A12LlcqaKsJxf3pi9b%0Asos2XcZXkIZuOu9R6Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/633982159/c6f1671118faac8a924e33d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=657d1dc6a2270fe4f6dfadac048106aca32034be820943f3561477ba9eeac6c2&req=ciMkH8F8nIRWFb4f3HP0gBfDab%2B2BxRSH8KxsWUkM5A12LlcqaKsJxf3pi9b%0Asos2XcZXkIZuOu9R6Q%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 90 — How to Mark a File Attachment as Confidential | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-90}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500066-how-to-mark-a-file-attachment-as-confidential](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500066-how-to-mark-a-file-attachment-as-confidential)

[Patient File Management](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2601287-patient-file-management)

How to Mark a File Attachment as Confidential

How to Mark a File Attachment as Confidential
=============================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Marking a file attachment as confidential will restrict access to the Owner and any other PracSuite users with the System Administrator role.

To mark a file as confidential, go into the **Patient File > Files tab** and select the **edit pencil** to the right of the Files list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496308/33ee9e61eac419f10f950cc9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6e8f390ea10565c23951c0e7edae87948300274fe2f733549ea5828e6f052333&req=ciMiEsB4noFXFb4f3HP0gBGTunnSj3a5guz9ut0VVclzDK8MVlGSQNrlFsWi%0ATmhuHVEpZfOZ8npxCA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496308/33ee9e61eac419f10f950cc9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6e8f390ea10565c23951c0e7edae87948300274fe2f733549ea5828e6f052333&req=ciMiEsB4noFXFb4f3HP0gBGTunnSj3a5guz9ut0VVclzDK8MVlGSQNrlFsWi%0ATmhuHVEpZfOZ8npxCA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the '**Confidential**' option. This will also be an opportunity to change the Owner of the file if required. Click '**Save**' to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496441/0661d5d9d8276a94cb1d7cfe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f489410cd664536381b53ccdd922905eae4696bcced21fefb97b6d69eb398a8d&req=ciMiEsB4mYVeFb4f3HP0gLHQCoj3OPYJ48BG95XtuAI0PFvgkKXWM72%2BM3KU%0ALCSprv4kZUmTNKAVRQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496441/0661d5d9d8276a94cb1d7cfe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f489410cd664536381b53ccdd922905eae4696bcced21fefb97b6d69eb398a8d&req=ciMiEsB4mYVeFb4f3HP0gLHQCoj3OPYJ48BG95XtuAI0PFvgkKXWM72%2BM3KU%0ALCSprv4kZUmTNKAVRQ%3D%3D%0A)

The Confidential icon will now be displayed in the Files list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496550/1b283e56d59313db41f936a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14093c44e0d0412a9b14b81670efd359601055591345e6017a9659671d1e3860&req=ciMiEsB4mIRfFb4f3HP0gOd8wOXar2Jq%2FuMrPeSZvGBMVAeAA0bU7fOY2LZb%0AKv1dDzOmEXrwsG2l7A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496550/1b283e56d59313db41f936a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14093c44e0d0412a9b14b81670efd359601055591345e6017a9659671d1e3860&req=ciMiEsB4mIRfFb4f3HP0gOd8wOXar2Jq%2FuMrPeSZvGBMVAeAA0bU7fOY2LZb%0AKv1dDzOmEXrwsG2l7A%3D%3D%0A)

How to Adjust the Size of the Appointment Book

How to Adjust the Size of the Appointment Book
==============================================

Updated over 3 years ago

PracSuite allows each user to customise the size of the Appointment Book.

Select the **Settings icon** in the bottom left-hand corner of the appointment book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637452957/a1fd33ac9e5c7f4d590d7b6d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b09afc4d5171d283125e59926cf58672fcb24ffc88c14307615212012cce8402&req=ciMgEsx8lIRYFb4f3HP0gFlsM8JxT2jIVltWKFGF48nlKdJL6FUxvC%2FBOpZ5%0AiumvLQ%2FNbTWbChLJcA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637452957/a1fd33ac9e5c7f4d590d7b6d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b09afc4d5171d283125e59926cf58672fcb24ffc88c14307615212012cce8402&req=ciMgEsx8lIRYFb4f3HP0gFlsM8JxT2jIVltWKFGF48nlKdJL6FUxvC%2FBOpZ5%0AiumvLQ%2FNbTWbChLJcA%3D%3D%0A)

Here you can choose your **Column Width**, **Interval Height** and **Font Size** from the drop-down menus.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637452732/9900e49f21c2f50b06f5f07d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6ba64b88463437422eb23dfd841e30d4f35b0dfbafc9d4e27e0468ec98df517a&req=ciMgEsx8moJdFb4f3HP0gG3E6rHtsjOP0oo5wW0wp3sVK5EjbTtlgEQYF96m%0AWIP9IadDYilDssf1yA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637452732/9900e49f21c2f50b06f5f07d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6ba64b88463437422eb23dfd841e30d4f35b0dfbafc9d4e27e0468ec98df517a&req=ciMgEsx8moJdFb4f3HP0gG3E6rHtsjOP0oo5wW0wp3sVK5EjbTtlgEQYF96m%0AWIP9IadDYilDssf1yA%3D%3D%0A)

Family Billing

Family Billing
==============

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[1\. Creating a Family Account for each Family Member](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_9b3161cbd6)

[2\. Enabling & Customising Family Billing Preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_c4a32a7de1)

[3\. Family Billing from the Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_44604bd9f0)

[4\. Viewing Previous Family Invoices](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_3d8616abd1)

[5\. Disabling Family Billing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_49789127ca)

Family Billing allows you to create a single invoice containing items for multiple family members. For Tyro users, this also allows submitting a health fund claim for all family members at once, as well as being able to take a single payment for all remaining gap amounts.

This article covers:

1.  [Creating a Family Account for each Family Member](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_9b3161cbd6)
    
2.  [Enabling & Customising Family Billing Preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_c4a32a7de1)
    
3.  [Family Billing from the Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_44604bd9f0)
    
4.  [Viewing Previous Family Invoices](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_3d8616abd1)
    
5.  [Disabling Family Billing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing#h_49789127ca)
    

* * *

**1\. Creating a Family Account for each Family Member**
========================================================

The easiest way to setup Family Billing is to create a Family account on every family members patient file. To do this, open the patient file and go to the Accounts tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594918598/b3221c2b6ac1813987a466f8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1c5fa1fad19871a9736f6546d130184dc5e3c46b603759fdfddd0d7353ea90b1&req=cSkjH8h2mIhXFb4f3HP0gOhtgyyAUjg%2FZFBe25Cy4vIMfECJOUBZPN5C5Upu%0AJtrOjGTtUvMoFBM9UA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594918598/b3221c2b6ac1813987a466f8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1c5fa1fad19871a9736f6546d130184dc5e3c46b603759fdfddd0d7353ea90b1&req=cSkjH8h2mIhXFb4f3HP0gOhtgyyAUjg%2FZFBe25Cy4vIMfECJOUBZPN5C5Upu%0AJtrOjGTtUvMoFBM9UA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Manage Accounts**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594918740/6938777288159025771db5ad/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3b96b0e2b29ad13e6933feaefba0368f03f09d62ba16396ff10c781e3e1f9b4c&req=cSkjH8h2moVfFb4f3HP0gKUqSFI93ZFYThlw9D27zHZDJVhCWbWEj9mOiP1R%0ApHG5rWTDLqiLAsrXbQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594918740/6938777288159025771db5ad/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3b96b0e2b29ad13e6933feaefba0368f03f09d62ba16396ff10c781e3e1f9b4c&req=cSkjH8h2moVfFb4f3HP0gKUqSFI93ZFYThlw9D27zHZDJVhCWbWEj9mOiP1R%0ApHG5rWTDLqiLAsrXbQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594919756/c148cc535ce4247288725c05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c21772132cdbb5a008f432c9d0cba47aac4c7ab4bf6c4fd3b279a3563533a266&req=cSkjH8h3moRZFb4f3HP0gIcQNTZIJeoIRrw9bvOXtuqw5Oqm081aZPFIhNYA%0AAmFYlclUvrKT1psEtg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594919756/c148cc535ce4247288725c05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c21772132cdbb5a008f432c9d0cba47aac4c7ab4bf6c4fd3b279a3563533a266&req=cSkjH8h3moRZFb4f3HP0gIcQNTZIJeoIRrw9bvOXtuqw5Oqm081aZPFIhNYA%0AAmFYlclUvrKT1psEtg%3D%3D%0A)

Type in a **Name** for the new account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594919878/8e925d796b5467107ec4a396/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6bec1e6d632f52c2ef01cf9604e295e494530e737413ec6737c33e0429710f0e&req=cSkjH8h3lYZXFb4f3HP0gESAjEroLTEiH6NlfY8UYwEXBIKBMaXYKUJWao%2Bl%0AIQdb1cFcRtz8gGPuxw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594919878/8e925d796b5467107ec4a396/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6bec1e6d632f52c2ef01cf9604e295e494530e737413ec6737c33e0429710f0e&req=cSkjH8h3lYZXFb4f3HP0gESAjEroLTEiH6NlfY8UYwEXBIKBMaXYKUJWao%2Bl%0AIQdb1cFcRtz8gGPuxw%3D%3D%0A)

Mark the new account as the **Default Account** if all future invoicing should take place on this account by default.

Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594921006/df69bae25bd460a36b696012/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6fb066b3ac4b13ae61d5fd86ca1dfeaaeb489daf3fd45d326ec869ee621ee1c8&req=cSkjH8t%2FnYFZFb4f3HP0gAX74iIB3huwVIz%2FYZuk0BSP46rvNloXH5e4doBt%0ANQZadCRk1XJJ6JtReg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594921006/df69bae25bd460a36b696012/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6fb066b3ac4b13ae61d5fd86ca1dfeaaeb489daf3fd45d326ec869ee621ee1c8&req=cSkjH8t%2FnYFZFb4f3HP0gAX74iIB3huwVIz%2FYZuk0BSP46rvNloXH5e4doBt%0ANQZadCRk1XJJ6JtReg%3D%3D%0A)

To ensure smooth family billing from the appointment book, enable the **Add to Last Open Invoice** setting.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594921126/979c9977c6dc0b136ad793ac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d0cb5eb8e00b666050f81d652276eb7684c9bad2064cfadffb16cb8801bd91c8&req=cSkjH8t%2FnINZFb4f3HP0gPbJ%2BkVBGbBdcEmvSOpGPh4eR%2BL25aPcsnptd6pX%0AOM9rcbpEFeKx1ks6Ng%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594921126/979c9977c6dc0b136ad793ac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d0cb5eb8e00b666050f81d652276eb7684c9bad2064cfadffb16cb8801bd91c8&req=cSkjH8t%2FnINZFb4f3HP0gPbJ%2BkVBGbBdcEmvSOpGPh4eR%2BL25aPcsnptd6pX%0AOM9rcbpEFeKx1ks6Ng%3D%3D%0A)

**Repeat this process for each family member**.

* * *

**2\. Enabling & Customising Family Billing Preferences**
=========================================================

Now that every family member has an account to use for family billing purposes, we can continue configuring family billing.

**Note:** Each patient can only be a member of one family at time, and only one billing account can be nominated as the 'Family Billing' account.

To enable Family Billing, go to the **Contacts** tab of the patient file and select **Edit**.

Select **Add Family** and search for each family member.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594921908/3e7fb3adb303a23bf36fec4a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8960fac112bbd8dfec9bd5dfb1b9de4c7db22b5bf519db75059e654c4df0675&req=cSkjH8t%2FlIFXFb4f3HP0gFXK8HUSPN2NL5vLfGsSfvuzq3EwyqcewJiYWrHC%0AHP%2BhEVeqIYpKcLTILA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594921908/3e7fb3adb303a23bf36fec4a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8960fac112bbd8dfec9bd5dfb1b9de4c7db22b5bf519db75059e654c4df0675&req=cSkjH8t%2FlIFXFb4f3HP0gFXK8HUSPN2NL5vLfGsSfvuzq3EwyqcewJiYWrHC%0AHP%2BhEVeqIYpKcLTILA%3D%3D%0A)

After adding all family members, enable the **Family Billing** switch and choose the account that you wish to use for Family Billing for each patient.

You'll also need to nominate one of the family members as the **Primary Biller**. Family invoices will be addressed to this individual.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594923066/1b7ca45bf84bf6b55364c649/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a72e7a37aff76c91b00574dc6e8ebb1d23eb6ed9a182c9490cbd58547b1d023&req=cSkjH8t9nYdZFb4f3HP0gHePwoGjiio%2F7fS56jd8EQt8UyoDonVPwusb1muv%0Aue9UDWa6Fn1HNXrMww%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594923066/1b7ca45bf84bf6b55364c649/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a72e7a37aff76c91b00574dc6e8ebb1d23eb6ed9a182c9490cbd58547b1d023&req=cSkjH8t9nYdZFb4f3HP0gHePwoGjiio%2F7fS56jd8EQt8UyoDonVPwusb1muv%0Aue9UDWa6Fn1HNXrMww%3D%3D%0A)

**Note**: If their are no accounts that can be used for family billing, you will be prompted to create a new account. You can also create a new account from a patient's **Account** tab as covered above.

* * *

**3\. Family Billing from the Appointment Book**
================================================

For this example, we're going to bill 3 family members from the appointment book.

Start by confirming that all 3 patient appointments are booked against the family account selected above.

To do this, click on the appointment and select **Appointment Details**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594923609/918ddcb7cf4694bf7ba2cb4e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2dc66f820f5322a3c99901d60e24f9b32b341e88302b090090ed206e94f006d1&req=cSkjH8t9m4FWFb4f3HP0gAYXT7unHH18yM3moaWkwM3A8EeUrEWRPzcMNVMd%0ACw7Kun24g3DTR20c5g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594923609/918ddcb7cf4694bf7ba2cb4e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2dc66f820f5322a3c99901d60e24f9b32b341e88302b090090ed206e94f006d1&req=cSkjH8t9m4FWFb4f3HP0gAYXT7unHH18yM3moaWkwM3A8EeUrEWRPzcMNVMd%0ACw7Kun24g3DTR20c5g%3D%3D%0A)

The account is displayed in the bottom left corner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594923765/437fb6e554057893474d3d74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cf78c851d66371c9d2e6c3b882c34c0b71a8badbbd4c4f378c398c7b8591af84&req=cSkjH8t9modaFb4f3HP0gE32tq8QZWmP75vD%2BQoD9gN0AhEnojerVglKFS7h%0AfrnUllcOO5ZI%2Br3M6Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594923765/437fb6e554057893474d3d74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cf78c851d66371c9d2e6c3b882c34c0b71a8badbbd4c4f378c398c7b8591af84&req=cSkjH8t9modaFb4f3HP0gE32tq8QZWmP75vD%2BQoD9gN0AhEnojerVglKFS7h%0AfrnUllcOO5ZI%2Br3M6Q%3D%3D%0A)

Once confirmed, you can proceed to invoicing the first family member.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594923916/e73f8b3ca51d8d909a7b920a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=53cc7b9afa4be4f690dedc83c2baeac48259b2608ae7418edeadf2e32db65899&req=cSkjH8t9lIBZFb4f3HP0gMDGHtqWJ34CkQ%2B4TUt2HGqCaJ9g%2B3GTR%2BY55Vr2%0AziGfTIxBXndb20gI9g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594923916/e73f8b3ca51d8d909a7b920a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=53cc7b9afa4be4f690dedc83c2baeac48259b2608ae7418edeadf2e32db65899&req=cSkjH8t9lIBZFb4f3HP0gMDGHtqWJ34CkQ%2B4TUt2HGqCaJ9g%2B3GTR%2BY55Vr2%0AziGfTIxBXndb20gI9g%3D%3D%0A)

Review the items added, but do not proceed to taking payments. Instead, choose the **Save** option. Do not select any other option at this time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594924058/173fd89ea30aa851af76737e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=439a3ebba181cf1ad3ed96399d2ef4f2498ee7f4840c4f0aaa5550d4b34888e9&req=cSkjH8t6nYRXFb4f3HP0gB%2FtS1FISE02T3GDiMVRxxutZnGrgNjg8ZoZMiMC%0AaupMeO80A06etG8fNg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594924058/173fd89ea30aa851af76737e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=439a3ebba181cf1ad3ed96399d2ef4f2498ee7f4840c4f0aaa5550d4b34888e9&req=cSkjH8t6nYRXFb4f3HP0gB%2FtS1FISE02T3GDiMVRxxutZnGrgNjg8ZoZMiMC%0AaupMeO80A06etG8fNg%3D%3D%0A)

After saving the first family member's invoice, you can proceed to invoicing the second family member.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594924899/6c14dab7b8e15c324c7198bb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b6b2d771787774a55f5539a6781b56b4d1dfef657db48b52588a7de672460f36&req=cSkjH8t6lYhWFb4f3HP0gPFFyeQtM1ccBNupiJOEyiD1AhU9dkorZ%2B1XgjBe%0ADwmsPbatklRKNqAEhg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594924899/6c14dab7b8e15c324c7198bb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b6b2d771787774a55f5539a6781b56b4d1dfef657db48b52588a7de672460f36&req=cSkjH8t6lYhWFb4f3HP0gPFFyeQtM1ccBNupiJOEyiD1AhU9dkorZ%2B1XgjBe%0ADwmsPbatklRKNqAEhg%3D%3D%0A)

Again, review the items billed and then select the **Save** option again. Do not process any payments at this time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594924605/aaf34512a396050139b1da2d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be028ec3d242385033374d06147336be849483a8010305ec2a7779dce684ed66&req=cSkjH8t6m4FaFb4f3HP0gH%2FNZzTWhU6WTTKf%2BCBQTaCYqle7zqRbmopmD8w9%0ARvLN2bTSPuoiC%2BCv%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594924605/aaf34512a396050139b1da2d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be028ec3d242385033374d06147336be849483a8010305ec2a7779dce684ed66&req=cSkjH8t6m4FaFb4f3HP0gH%2FNZzTWhU6WTTKf%2BCBQTaCYqle7zqRbmopmD8w9%0ARvLN2bTSPuoiC%2BCv%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)

We're now at the last family member we need to bill. Select the Invoice option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594924817/7c59abdb990e33d76834fa3d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=24bd68aabd7c2d6177499c7599ac06e1484da2225f8f02c56bc3ef153d9a020f&req=cSkjH8t6lYBYFb4f3HP0gDEXoQUM8903J%2BkbbnKy9p%2BqR5Y5Wm4MvmP9JlVJ%0AYFteaJXQHEyQGM%2FiWQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594924817/7c59abdb990e33d76834fa3d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=24bd68aabd7c2d6177499c7599ac06e1484da2225f8f02c56bc3ef153d9a020f&req=cSkjH8t6lYBYFb4f3HP0gDEXoQUM8903J%2BkbbnKy9p%2BqR5Y5Wm4MvmP9JlVJ%0AYFteaJXQHEyQGM%2FiWQ%3D%3D%0A)

You should now be seeing all 3 family members items on the single invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594925117/c57ecba62d5592a23b50eaf7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=286c077aee7b3edf538edb330eb23718f5f6554b41b3ea92912763dae0a4bdb5&req=cSkjH8t7nIBYFb4f3HP0gNyQtAVlTOzx%2FQiDpzHRSvcYTCJkPJmDdvjwSjl8%0AmQx%2BhCPkVCI2u%2B8%2Fcw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594925117/c57ecba62d5592a23b50eaf7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=286c077aee7b3edf538edb330eb23718f5f6554b41b3ea92912763dae0a4bdb5&req=cSkjH8t7nIBYFb4f3HP0gNyQtAVlTOzx%2FQiDpzHRSvcYTCJkPJmDdvjwSjl8%0AmQx%2BhCPkVCI2u%2B8%2Fcw%3D%3D%0A)

From here, you can proceed to processing payments as normal, as well as printing/emailing the receipt.

* * *

**4\. Viewing Previous Family Invoices**
========================================

The **Invoice** \> **Items** tab of each family member will show only the items they have been billed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594927176/b45979d0edb9a0b070390138/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d569f9981366708966f0a56a68fd5aa4bd9ce685d9e640cc2b46a976e67c6de9&req=cSkjH8t5nIZZFb4f3HP0gNdXlTCpk1JZPJiPO1kBR%2FmNyuRd%2FJ8m5HscTu1a%0Ai9uhcKe6Mdu%2FRRP8yg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594927176/b45979d0edb9a0b070390138/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d569f9981366708966f0a56a68fd5aa4bd9ce685d9e640cc2b46a976e67c6de9&req=cSkjH8t5nIZZFb4f3HP0gNdXlTCpk1JZPJiPO1kBR%2FmNyuRd%2FJ8m5HscTu1a%0Ai9uhcKe6Mdu%2FRRP8yg%3D%3D%0A)

The **Invoice** \> **Family** tab will show all invoices for all family members.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594927141/f1f9944b955c97dcc167b93e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5ec8fdcee474b0278ba5711216c6f63be14b1d1ca82b90285b4352dcffe5e87f&req=cSkjH8t5nIVeFb4f3HP0gIKofzuFqb%2B7oO5U%2FQ0WlyL3pc4TvtmbBFvKvItH%0AEmqrckztQDrzsQGioQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594927141/f1f9944b955c97dcc167b93e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5ec8fdcee474b0278ba5711216c6f63be14b1d1ca82b90285b4352dcffe5e87f&req=cSkjH8t5nIVeFb4f3HP0gIKofzuFqb%2B7oO5U%2FQ0WlyL3pc4TvtmbBFvKvItH%0AEmqrckztQDrzsQGioQ%3D%3D%0A)

Payments can be made for all outstanding items from the **Accounts** or **Invoices** tab of any family member's file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594927332/3eb869c50a97fa67cfcd8812/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3d0c8908f3647496b59779b9a8e77e2c838ca89f4a6412d4b333643376a9456c&req=cSkjH8t5noJdFb4f3HP0gJbV1AA0bO%2FNB3E5b9LO0jPpxXX%2FRwbKgolifTfm%0AzseTLAJJBlGADsroiQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594927332/3eb869c50a97fa67cfcd8812/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3d0c8908f3647496b59779b9a8e77e2c838ca89f4a6412d4b333643376a9456c&req=cSkjH8t5noJdFb4f3HP0gJbV1AA0bO%2FNB3E5b9LO0jPpxXX%2FRwbKgolifTfm%0AzseTLAJJBlGADsroiQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**5\. Disabling Family Billing**
================================

To _disable_ family billing or _remove_ a patient from the Family, go to the **Contacts** tab of the patient file and select **Edit**.

You can then **unselect the Family Billing** option or **remove the patient using delete button**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594927501/31b5f3f8316feece1a22cb0a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7330c7fb1f4ecec54afe2436df1115471bf7d4f3212d0590bca502c5c2afad58&req=cSkjH8t5mIFeFb4f3HP0gNn1oxTRNbvWwaxYmE1Fr6yvCTqcMyewRtVaamua%0Al65aw4lQYRnOD%2F2deg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594927501/31b5f3f8316feece1a22cb0a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7330c7fb1f4ecec54afe2436df1115471bf7d4f3212d0590bca502c5c2afad58&req=cSkjH8t5mIFeFb4f3HP0gNn1oxTRNbvWwaxYmE1Fr6yvCTqcMyewRtVaamua%0Al65aw4lQYRnOD%2F2deg%3D%3D%0A)

**Note:** Disabling Family Billing or removing a patient from the Family will not remove any invoices and the **Family** tab in the patient's Invoice tab will remain.

Making a Patient File Inactive

Making a Patient File Inactive
==============================

Updated over 6 months ago

A patient file can be marked as inactive when the patient has not attended the practice for an extended period, or has finished their treatment. Marking a patient as inactive will hide them from various search menus, including in the main Search box and when booking appointments. Further, inactive patients are also excluded by default from several PracSuite reports.

To mark a patient file as inactive, navigate to a **Patient file** and select the **cog** to the right of the patient name.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592947283/628fe688521f6c8d885e8ded/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b1881e25e4484559d13e47e78de720f81d54c226a9243c8d68e242eee78681a&req=cSklH815n4lcFb4f3HP0gIS6gjpRUj0cfwpxxAGLlDWHWO2HLesG%2B6uGKvKb%0ADh3tmmTJPtHYd2QK0Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592947283/628fe688521f6c8d885e8ded/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b1881e25e4484559d13e47e78de720f81d54c226a9243c8d68e242eee78681a&req=cSklH815n4lcFb4f3HP0gIS6gjpRUj0cfwpxxAGLlDWHWO2HLesG%2B6uGKvKb%0ADh3tmmTJPtHYd2QK0Q%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Mark Client as Inactive** and click **OK**. If applicable, select the options to mark the patient as **Deceased, Delete Future Appointments** etc.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1443327939/d7a910ecc7992780433c235810a5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=78973cb42b4ee895d96435562fb0825f2786d83c219190d0f6f08fa3ff1a2ec1&req=dSQjFcp8mohcUPMW1HO4zV6loFfw7QJiIIul4ZB5af2rW8ikGcAfFwBkk8mU%0AN0%2F%2BsHZz4ipzX5iL4xg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1443327939/d7a910ecc7992780433c235810a5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=78973cb42b4ee895d96435562fb0825f2786d83c219190d0f6f08fa3ff1a2ec1&req=dSQjFcp8mohcUPMW1HO4zV6loFfw7QJiIIul4ZB5af2rW8ikGcAfFwBkk8mU%0AN0%2F%2BsHZz4ipzX5iL4xg%3D%0A)

An **Inactive** label will be displayed at the top of the patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592943787/af8332b6a8eb3a6e4fbdcac7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=664e00ee18fec232f9d8bcf95fd98ef8105de846a540de9e6862f444b0d39974&req=cSklH819molYFb4f3HP0gMLUhpwEqRlbY%2FqA42Bkf1sz2wFQH7Xc65TwSVWc%0ALami3gTg%2Feimv%2FrR6Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592943787/af8332b6a8eb3a6e4fbdcac7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=664e00ee18fec232f9d8bcf95fd98ef8105de846a540de9e6862f444b0d39974&req=cSklH819molYFb4f3HP0gMLUhpwEqRlbY%2FqA42Bkf1sz2wFQH7Xc65TwSVWc%0ALami3gTg%2Feimv%2FrR6Q%3D%3D%0A)

To mark a patient as active, go the Client file and click the **cog** and select **Mark Client as Active**. The patient will then become active again.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592947106/db58c0b9a7214ea0d5777c49/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0fd544fb0a440039620743c55834bbcbe66f360a7cfb1c3b6f766f776c0805b5&req=cSklH815nIFZFb4f3HP0gIjKgKCgSULcz3jyR7gJjyQaJcb%2FJ6UG2ntrGWaB%0AAPcv3qNrXW%2FA%2FlRLzQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592947106/db58c0b9a7214ea0d5777c49/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0fd544fb0a440039620743c55834bbcbe66f360a7cfb1c3b6f766f776c0805b5&req=cSklH815nIFZFb4f3HP0gIjKgKCgSULcz3jyR7gJjyQaJcb%2FJ6UG2ntrGWaB%0AAPcv3qNrXW%2FA%2FlRLzQ%3D%3D%0A)

Creating Task Types

Creating Task Types
===================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Creating Task Types](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531208-creating-task-types#h_8755904ad1)

[Default Assignment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531208-creating-task-types#h_2f17f8f394)

[Default Checklists](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531208-creating-task-types#h_24bfd353bc)

Tasks can be created to remind PracSuite users of administrative and clinical tasks concerning a patient or general office tasks.

Continue reading to learn how to create Task Types.

Learn more about using Tasks in the articles below:

*   [How to Create a Patient Task](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531292-how-to-create-a-patient-task)
    
*   [Using the Task Widget](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531442-using-the-task-widget)
    
*   [Using My Tasks](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531430-using-my-tasks)
    

Creating Task Types
===================

To set up the tasks, navigate to **[Settings > General > Task Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/tasktypes)** on the main menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635497186/55c04733ca16b525308d42a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=08f7b2623bcf2d96df6c8de166734a4b8e9643cb0143a30f46990d4263a4ce2d&req=ciMiEsB5nIlZFb4f3HP0gDSmp5v8DRHR52zaX8pZC0Y7v1RyiYqSgak53ovw%0A3uW7911aDEZeDEac6Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635497186/55c04733ca16b525308d42a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=08f7b2623bcf2d96df6c8de166734a4b8e9643cb0143a30f46990d4263a4ce2d&req=ciMiEsB5nIlZFb4f3HP0gDSmp5v8DRHR52zaX8pZC0Y7v1RyiYqSgak53ovw%0A3uW7911aDEZeDEac6Q%3D%3D%0A)

Here, you can manage the task types and categorise tasks. The **Edit** button allows new custom tasks to be added and removed. The default status of a new task is also editable.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635497365/05b149474ac7c782baed86b0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d00f8a0f9f0c84dfc6661cbc75a831ec0c039661705aca0167cdd40d7a08228c&req=ciMiEsB5nodaFb4f3HP0gFjf0uQ8hAZnYuTQGMcDDsJ%2FA6g61jUUrx%2Bs7wei%0A6b8xAJ3k4iMrHxu1KQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635497365/05b149474ac7c782baed86b0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d00f8a0f9f0c84dfc6661cbc75a831ec0c039661705aca0167cdd40d7a08228c&req=ciMiEsB5nodaFb4f3HP0gFjf0uQ8hAZnYuTQGMcDDsJ%2FA6g61jUUrx%2Bs7wei%0A6b8xAJ3k4iMrHxu1KQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add** and enter a name for the task.

Select a **Default Status** for the task when creating new tasks.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792418992/f742f2c6bd32d047d2f3fe50/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+15.12.30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b95ba2f55cc4f4f1431d45d46451a5fbced2d25adbffce799cce01f19d75b148&req=cyklEsh2lIhdFb4f3HP0gBoCmVc%2Fej9aloKHhsYhCusrXHHWV0IadCZRDLwS%0Ah2gtVH02ffnCwqoQ%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792418992/f742f2c6bd32d047d2f3fe50/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+15.12.30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b95ba2f55cc4f4f1431d45d46451a5fbced2d25adbffce799cce01f19d75b148&req=cyklEsh2lIhdFb4f3HP0gBoCmVc%2Fej9aloKHhsYhCusrXHHWV0IadCZRDLwS%0Ah2gtVH02ffnCwqoQ%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)

Adjust the task order by dragging the vertical lines, or delete it by clicking the trashcan icon.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635498670/39bf8e795f0dac516c4f2e41/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c35f47a046f8c6c5601bced74d9caf0767adeee01e03713ca4a1f2b165514e6a&req=ciMiEsB2m4ZfFb4f3HP0gIsV1TKoRLDwne8HE1qGUl%2F%2Ftkv9jSHha7yaLriq%0ACveoPlhxm906oLQdUg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635498670/39bf8e795f0dac516c4f2e41/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c35f47a046f8c6c5601bced74d9caf0767adeee01e03713ca4a1f2b165514e6a&req=ciMiEsB2m4ZfFb4f3HP0gIsV1TKoRLDwne8HE1qGUl%2F%2Ftkv9jSHha7yaLriq%0ACveoPlhxm906oLQdUg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to ensure your new tasks have successfully been created.

Default Assignment
==================

When adding a new task to a patient file, the Task assignee can by dynamically selected based on the following:

*   **Task Creator**
    
*   **Default Practitioner**
    
*   **Last Appt. Practitioner**
    
*   **Next Appt. Practitioner**
    
*   **Creator's Business + Role**
    
*   **Creator's Role**
    

Default Checklists
==================

You can also add a checklist that allows you to mark things off as you go for more involved tasks.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792419778/0f6bad069a36ff68e49ae90a/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+15.15.06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8aeaef6494d4aa471b0eb0942554449d8d6dc46721a59e65c309d4ce285160e0&req=cyklEsh3moZXFb4f3HP0gHzOiBNERUmHeY4exm%2FX%2FIXp5WAE0ih6solg60VW%0AFac7Qky2Njjp86b6xg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792419778/0f6bad069a36ff68e49ae90a/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+15.15.06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8aeaef6494d4aa471b0eb0942554449d8d6dc46721a59e65c309d4ce285160e0&req=cyklEsh3moZXFb4f3HP0gHzOiBNERUmHeY4exm%2FX%2FIXp5WAE0ih6solg60VW%0AFac7Qky2Njjp86b6xg%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add Checklist**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792420247/1b38e79d457bda6a354f9fe5/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+15.16.22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7e67b643b928d6e57cfe6e63f6c874523268fdc874ea5b71fb9b9991efdb0fdd&req=cyklEst%2Bn4VYFb4f3HP0gOyI9J0RAgqP2MKeb1%2BaLZVoLdchpaT9UyE%2FJYPy%0An2SNK6g1G3Lp2Uj57w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792420247/1b38e79d457bda6a354f9fe5/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+15.16.22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7e67b643b928d6e57cfe6e63f6c874523268fdc874ea5b71fb9b9991efdb0fdd&req=cyklEst%2Bn4VYFb4f3HP0gOyI9J0RAgqP2MKeb1%2BaLZVoLdchpaT9UyE%2FJYPy%0An2SNK6g1G3Lp2Uj57w%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Add** button to add items to your checklist.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781417053/b6643bc8e17e4c00e43b3619/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10cc51945b9373facdacc65d40985d8bc79f5a660dae7c8e770d1a34883a86a5&req=cygmEsh5nYRcFb4f3HP0gPZWarJHVokz%2Bp0arJ9x1Ls87PzyBa2JCrq7iwWi%0ARdiUoJ9C91DAPxdMSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781417053/b6643bc8e17e4c00e43b3619/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10cc51945b9373facdacc65d40985d8bc79f5a660dae7c8e770d1a34883a86a5&req=cygmEsh5nYRcFb4f3HP0gPZWarJHVokz%2Bp0arJ9x1Ls87PzyBa2JCrq7iwWi%0ARdiUoJ9C91DAPxdMSQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to add your checklist.

Checklist status will be displayed within a task, as well as on the [Task widget](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531442-using-the-task-widget)
, the [Tasks Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/general/tasks)
 and [My Tasks](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531430-using-my-tasks)
 areas.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792424645/3b76f523ce455afd20d7dc61/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+15.26.30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f811495ca70b4107983e487c1a254c050815b5c5f22bbfea50c36d414dcae34&req=cyklEst6m4VaFb4f3HP0gLHJ6sU0y6ZEJe75AG1Vc8cX44lU1%2F5NYKBAZM3a%0A5NL%2FD0%2BvEAhWian42A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792424645/3b76f523ce455afd20d7dc61/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+15.26.30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f811495ca70b4107983e487c1a254c050815b5c5f22bbfea50c36d414dcae34&req=cyklEst6m4VaFb4f3HP0gLHJ6sU0y6ZEJe75AG1Vc8cX44lU1%2F5NYKBAZM3a%0A5NL%2FD0%2BvEAhWian42A%3D%3D%0A)

How to Create a Patient Task

How to Create a Patient Task
============================

Updated over 3 years ago

**Tasks** can be created to remind PracSuite users of both administrative and clinical tasks, either in relation to a patient or for general office tasks.

Go to a **Client file**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635501223/fd5fd02727e6ecf3ebd8c479/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=39ac74db58121689d10109bbc5ec2520d28ff3ea53c6cc206856aaccd10d23c8&req=ciMiE8l%2Fn4NcFb4f3HP0gGuta9TBoMnfkvgcLrnUDdcl8YPYImRV8BanB1Zd%0AfPUFOOjHU0jORCpYng%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635501223/fd5fd02727e6ecf3ebd8c479/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=39ac74db58121689d10109bbc5ec2520d28ff3ea53c6cc206856aaccd10d23c8&req=ciMiE8l%2Fn4NcFb4f3HP0gGuta9TBoMnfkvgcLrnUDdcl8YPYImRV8BanB1Zd%0AfPUFOOjHU0jORCpYng%3D%3D%0A)

In the client file, click **Tasks** in the left menu bar. All assigned tasks for the patient are grouped here. Click **Add Task** to create a new task.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635501606/1d0f60e3c6c5350cbb395aef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b091e60f1c5ee6f4da4d9a8683bf5801cc9c3e398db103674b1066bf1b278c81&req=ciMiE8l%2Fm4FZFb4f3HP0gDPA1n08%2BT0GC4A18UKZ0q6cTn0jTx2DeE5Yv%2Fxg%0AyKAdiDGl5VHFcI4LtA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635501606/1d0f60e3c6c5350cbb395aef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b091e60f1c5ee6f4da4d9a8683bf5801cc9c3e398db103674b1066bf1b278c81&req=ciMiE8l%2Fm4FZFb4f3HP0gDPA1n08%2BT0GC4A18UKZ0q6cTn0jTx2DeE5Yv%2Fxg%0AyKAdiDGl5VHFcI4LtA%3D%3D%0A)

The New Task window will appear. The Task Type, Status, Due Date and Notes can be selected as required. Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635501823/b942c3760f52ca42cf3fe20f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1c595e39a9d2eb4820708bdf82649b6214f1fb137911ef0d03413bc6f85bf788&req=ciMiE8l%2FlYNcFb4f3HP0gLxTETtCS%2BqyNhj2G7eJTTY%2B41n7gqBM%2BhFQ8E7S%0A6psIhcCwLYTYLk5qiA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635501823/b942c3760f52ca42cf3fe20f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1c595e39a9d2eb4820708bdf82649b6214f1fb137911ef0d03413bc6f85bf788&req=ciMiE8l%2FlYNcFb4f3HP0gLxTETtCS%2BqyNhj2G7eJTTY%2B41n7gqBM%2BhFQ8E7S%0A6psIhcCwLYTYLk5qiA%3D%3D%0A)
