Setting up Recall Types

Setting up Recall Types
=======================

Updated over 3 years ago

Recalls are used as reminders to contact existing patients and book their next appointment.

To create recall types, navigate to the **[Settings > General > Recall Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/recalltypes)** in the main menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635503913/00eaa21d0f3bcbce470f21ac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1b76c43158a9f941fdead1ae96a84cff9d42c273dd9598bc23cd6b0821e2cc52&req=ciMiE8l9lIBcFb4f3HP0gIyg5vdKNWdtCvHkvyMjaC0rysHxo%2FXdA%2FJXVSgX%0ABmvyBWqWbD8g6eRqAA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635503913/00eaa21d0f3bcbce470f21ac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1b76c43158a9f941fdead1ae96a84cff9d42c273dd9598bc23cd6b0821e2cc52&req=ciMiE8l9lIBcFb4f3HP0gIyg5vdKNWdtCvHkvyMjaC0rysHxo%2FXdA%2FJXVSgX%0ABmvyBWqWbD8g6eRqAA%3D%3D%0A)

To create a new recall, click **Edit** and click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635504074/c6f5784a205738655643517f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4caac874e34e879d016bba0e63990a37d1be29a3c39b15b620382bcd326b1a7&req=ciMiE8l6nYZbFb4f3HP0gAPjb9MD4O7UI5OaxlM91QPfCPTywpptTQKiZJuq%0Abkw919tAGuhkSGpJXg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635504074/c6f5784a205738655643517f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4caac874e34e879d016bba0e63990a37d1be29a3c39b15b620382bcd326b1a7&req=ciMiE8l6nYZbFb4f3HP0gAPjb9MD4O7UI5OaxlM91QPfCPTywpptTQKiZJuq%0Abkw919tAGuhkSGpJXg%3D%3D%0A)

Clicking the **Add** button will enter a new row to the bottom of the grid. Enter a name for the recall type and set the default length of the recall.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635504309/d72ef434e2dc9c49fb1c5ddd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d96f90686811a4c4110d008bd7877ff17dffaaa5eab0f00cd0ae324598d0e494&req=ciMiE8l6noFWFb4f3HP0gOHjTcvXoOcXTVfrAs4S65pDhY5PYnojdrKxUcqp%0Avg8P8CujG9DBrLGTrQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635504309/d72ef434e2dc9c49fb1c5ddd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d96f90686811a4c4110d008bd7877ff17dffaaa5eab0f00cd0ae324598d0e494&req=ciMiE8l6noFWFb4f3HP0gOHjTcvXoOcXTVfrAs4S65pDhY5PYnojdrKxUcqp%0Avg8P8CujG9DBrLGTrQ%3D%3D%0A)

Adjust the recall order by using the drag handle on the left-hand side, or delete it by clicking the trashcan icon.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635504464/95a64e00e854d4acff99ea27/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a864cfa6b4e085d1a78f3e9492ae44b55880b0b8b16ff303d588346af223ab14&req=ciMiE8l6mYdbFb4f3HP0gCIASfgLw7XAUWUhv5Y40Yoa9QR%2BS9Zuag7RmSVt%0ApwxXdZ221LVkRt9kSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635504464/95a64e00e854d4acff99ea27/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a864cfa6b4e085d1a78f3e9492ae44b55880b0b8b16ff303d588346af223ab14&req=ciMiE8l6mYdbFb4f3HP0gCIASfgLw7XAUWUhv5Y40Yoa9QR%2BS9Zuag7RmSVt%0ApwxXdZ221LVkRt9kSQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to ensure your new recalls have successfully been created.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635504522/c481ff923f3db1d90af96090/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b34186eb2f85f034eb20bde6464e7046bd1b326ed4619accb40200252078275&req=ciMiE8l6mINdFb4f3HP0gDZ9E69FfAgZ9hp43Uuag14EvBUvItNYghKfeZWF%0ADUG9%2FxNmElXs%2F9%2B4%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635504522/c481ff923f3db1d90af96090/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b34186eb2f85f034eb20bde6464e7046bd1b326ed4619accb40200252078275&req=ciMiE8l6mINdFb4f3HP0gDZ9E69FfAgZ9hp43Uuag14EvBUvItNYghKfeZWF%0ADUG9%2FxNmElXs%2F9%2B4%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)

How to Add a Patient Recall

How to Add a Patient Recall
===========================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Creating Patient Recalls](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531341-how-to-add-a-patient-recall#creating-patient-recalls-)

[Reporting on Patient Recalls](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531341-how-to-add-a-patient-recall#reporting-on-patient-recalls)

**Creating Patient Recalls**
============================

Recalls can be created through the **Recalls tab** on the patient file and selecting the **Add Recall** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/255048862/f2df66a46742ce87e7428d5e/Screen+Shot+2020-10-13+at+3.04.43+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eec540a8f6f261bb2a64fdc1986b63ca4f02fcffa659da953fcebcf366509e91&req=diUiFs12lYddFb4f3HP0gCyrrEYBgDe6Xgk0WOKN%2BQxp9CLWOS6VkxJSAJ4%2F%0AvGXRhAQNKAI%2F2yzbeQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/255048862/f2df66a46742ce87e7428d5e/Screen+Shot+2020-10-13+at+3.04.43+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eec540a8f6f261bb2a64fdc1986b63ca4f02fcffa659da953fcebcf366509e91&req=diUiFs12lYddFb4f3HP0gCyrrEYBgDe6Xgk0WOKN%2BQxp9CLWOS6VkxJSAJ4%2F%0AvGXRhAQNKAI%2F2yzbeQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select the Recall Type and select whether the recall should be assigned to a specific practitioner or to all practitioners in a particular profession. Notes can also be added to the recall to remind the practitioner of particulars when the recall is due.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/255048308/8312346c1b85efd06dfedcde/Screen+Shot+2020-10-13+at+3.04.57+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3983c39e6901f057bea856cadf818def289b97c57af6cc0aaa83a8721dc7f17c&req=diUiFs12noFXFb4f3HP0gAXY9HUvu0kFHdQZeWhYV4SIYfOvO1qvqRu5u8tL%0AMHKj3PVbo8MpeQ2NdA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/255048308/8312346c1b85efd06dfedcde/Screen+Shot+2020-10-13+at+3.04.57+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3983c39e6901f057bea856cadf818def289b97c57af6cc0aaa83a8721dc7f17c&req=diUiFs12noFXFb4f3HP0gAXY9HUvu0kFHdQZeWhYV4SIYfOvO1qvqRu5u8tL%0AMHKj3PVbo8MpeQ2NdA%3D%3D%0A)

Recall types can be managed using the cog icon to the right of the drop-down menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/255048267/0b35d32d984066f867e2145d/Screen+Shot+2020-10-13+at+3.05.05+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4aada826275bd7f62f463f997b481fd07ef304db9d509d72aad505e725c70b9&req=diUiFs12n4dYFb4f3HP0gIhNqhTms1JGUgJso%2FxFQus70hu4CAF8lt7%2FTFan%0ANUlXi5Sn5ySMpvB08w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/255048267/0b35d32d984066f867e2145d/Screen+Shot+2020-10-13+at+3.05.05+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4aada826275bd7f62f463f997b481fd07ef304db9d509d72aad505e725c70b9&req=diUiFs12n4dYFb4f3HP0gIhNqhTms1JGUgJso%2FxFQus70hu4CAF8lt7%2FTFan%0ANUlXi5Sn5ySMpvB08w%3D%3D%0A)

Select recurrence preferences if the recall should be repeated in future.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/255048495/b33d25f40f813cedadd2ddcc/Screen+Shot+2020-10-13+at+3.06.35+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe0b6523a3160a7dadd5b84639a729a8b4300a682f46d21150441588a58a03b9&req=diUiFs12mYhaFb4f3HP0gJlriYw3M8KTeZfKcvpQVAB5yw6ke%2BS%2FxdQRCEOL%0A6TJHmtEJoqIJTlcwFg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/255048495/b33d25f40f813cedadd2ddcc/Screen+Shot+2020-10-13+at+3.06.35+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe0b6523a3160a7dadd5b84639a729a8b4300a682f46d21150441588a58a03b9&req=diUiFs12mYhaFb4f3HP0gJlriYw3M8KTeZfKcvpQVAB5yw6ke%2BS%2FxdQRCEOL%0A6TJHmtEJoqIJTlcwFg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **save** to finalise the process.

**Reporting on Patient Recalls**
================================

To view a list of recalls that are due, go to **[Reports >](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/recall)
** [**Clients > Recalls**](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/recall)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/261723835/83c76e2b0c909222e1465a64/Screen+Shot+2020-11-02+at+4.04.20+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ad6dac237afda4e748961474d5c91aaad9a2f3085b8cdce4ed66ef147ea2ebd&req=diYmEct9lYJaFb4f3HP0gAGNOrTQKGV9a5TIkG253X%2FXmUnJ%2BrTRVquToWTo%0Au7f2RM6sgkjb%2BpkaMg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/261723835/83c76e2b0c909222e1465a64/Screen+Shot+2020-11-02+at+4.04.20+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ad6dac237afda4e748961474d5c91aaad9a2f3085b8cdce4ed66ef147ea2ebd&req=diYmEct9lYJaFb4f3HP0gAGNOrTQKGV9a5TIkG253X%2FXmUnJ%2BrTRVquToWTo%0Au7f2RM6sgkjb%2BpkaMg%3D%3D%0A)

Filter the report by Client Type, Recall Status, Date, Assigned To and Default Practitioner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/261725387/f725b0b2daebf82909ac6367/patient+report.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=2b90631d8fbce058ebb22d6fd08e06c69efa3e6eaa967dbffcaeb53ea8e71954&req=diYmEct7nolYFb4f3HP0gM8GP7pF9z8qYInNFwTMChE%2BmJShV97wN9FaYBqO%0ANLgEtk0TyW2EILoXwQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/261725387/f725b0b2daebf82909ac6367/patient+report.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=2b90631d8fbce058ebb22d6fd08e06c69efa3e6eaa967dbffcaeb53ea8e71954&req=diYmEct7nolYFb4f3HP0gM8GP7pF9z8qYInNFwTMChE%2BmJShV97wN9FaYBqO%0ANLgEtk0TyW2EILoXwQ%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting the desired filters, select **Generate Report** to view all the matching patients and their recall dates.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/261727326/2a3e0e3867ddd6e2d8513045/Screen+Shot+2020-11-02+at+4.32.45+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=98a06ff220f04b9afd206a57e3ff027c5392f770e0b53f140cd0165d1135caea&req=diYmEct5noNZFb4f3HP0gNTXGkFR5AQ5DI8ZPwbyHMz91siVHgj9eHU3Sz7p%0AbyrsfqlNPQf60fm8kg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/261727326/2a3e0e3867ddd6e2d8513045/Screen+Shot+2020-11-02+at+4.32.45+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=98a06ff220f04b9afd206a57e3ff027c5392f770e0b53f140cd0165d1135caea&req=diYmEct5noNZFb4f3HP0gNTXGkFR5AQ5DI8ZPwbyHMz91siVHgj9eHU3Sz7p%0AbyrsfqlNPQf60fm8kg%3D%3D%0A)

How to Upload an Attachment to a Patient File

How to Upload an Attachment to a Patient File
=============================================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Uploading an Attachment to the Patient > Files Tab](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531355-how-to-upload-an-attachment-to-a-patient-file#h_79afdb0a07)

[Confidential Files](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531355-how-to-upload-an-attachment-to-a-patient-file#h_7ccfced00d)

[Attaching a File to a Specific Clinical Note](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4531355-how-to-upload-an-attachment-to-a-patient-file#h_072468402a)

Uploading an Attachment to the Patient > Files Tab
==================================================

To upload an attachment to the patient file, navigate to the **Patient file >** **Files tab** and click **Add**. A window will appear for you to browse for files on your computer.

Alternatively, you can drag and drop the appropriate files directly into the browser into the **Drop files here to upload** section.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635572625/c74a5808a32baa34fd1aa224/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eebb21bfcff3e0c219f30bcb3a4790511d2b0f00093283849abccb8642e168cc&req=ciMiE858m4NaFb4f3HP0gHzlKIzqh2EqGIU%2FgHkmWj%2F%2BJ5rCnOAB%2BoX0lOTi%0AeRaM3qQTgv8Z%2BQMQfQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635572625/c74a5808a32baa34fd1aa224/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eebb21bfcff3e0c219f30bcb3a4790511d2b0f00093283849abccb8642e168cc&req=ciMiE858m4NaFb4f3HP0gHzlKIzqh2EqGIU%2FgHkmWj%2F%2BJ5rCnOAB%2BoX0lOTi%0AeRaM3qQTgv8Z%2BQMQfQ%3D%3D%0A)

Hovering over each file displays options to delete, edit and download the file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635572868/19fb2a7e7e130fccacd89c21/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2919998d06a4f0e44f49c5e2fe40c3536230b2ce37824a74d6b2548c48429c7c&req=ciMiE858lYdXFb4f3HP0gN5AAwAiv24l2nrfy7L%2BtfmHmQPrZQhh6dqdTamZ%0AUtH3yY3OYuTgq%2FcfnA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635572868/19fb2a7e7e130fccacd89c21/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2919998d06a4f0e44f49c5e2fe40c3536230b2ce37824a74d6b2548c48429c7c&req=ciMiE858lYdXFb4f3HP0gN5AAwAiv24l2nrfy7L%2BtfmHmQPrZQhh6dqdTamZ%0AUtH3yY3OYuTgq%2FcfnA%3D%3D%0A)

The edit window allows users to change the description, date, owner and confidential status of the file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635573027/1b589a5606414ff868ce988d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96d77b5cd79c3fd264983523ff51e7f9146d9bb07b88024bd5c6770cd709ce7e&req=ciMiE859nYNYFb4f3HP0gG1OSjXUlFF2qF3pf3C4OhhVULQNoKf9gVXAiJaH%0AD%2B0hloDlQdcVhXrTtA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635573027/1b589a5606414ff868ce988d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96d77b5cd79c3fd264983523ff51e7f9146d9bb07b88024bd5c6770cd709ce7e&req=ciMiE859nYNYFb4f3HP0gG1OSjXUlFF2qF3pf3C4OhhVULQNoKf9gVXAiJaH%0AD%2B0hloDlQdcVhXrTtA%3D%3D%0A)

Confidential Files
------------------

Marking a file attachment as confidential will restrict access to the Owner and any other PracSuite users with the System Administrator role and users with the Clinical Note Administrator permission on their role.

To mark a file as confidential, go into the **Patient File > Files tab** and select the **edit pencil** to the right of the Files list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496308/33ee9e61eac419f10f950cc9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6e8f390ea10565c23951c0e7edae87948300274fe2f733549ea5828e6f052333&req=ciMiEsB4noFXFb4f3HP0gBGTunnSj3a5guz9ut0VVclzDK8MVlGSQNrlFsWi%0ATmhuHVEpZfOZ8npxCA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496308/33ee9e61eac419f10f950cc9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6e8f390ea10565c23951c0e7edae87948300274fe2f733549ea5828e6f052333&req=ciMiEsB4noFXFb4f3HP0gBGTunnSj3a5guz9ut0VVclzDK8MVlGSQNrlFsWi%0ATmhuHVEpZfOZ8npxCA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the '**Confidential**' option. This will also be an opportunity to change the Owner of the file if required. Click '**Save**' to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496441/0661d5d9d8276a94cb1d7cfe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f489410cd664536381b53ccdd922905eae4696bcced21fefb97b6d69eb398a8d&req=ciMiEsB4mYVeFb4f3HP0gLHQCoj3OPYJ48BG95XtuAI0PFvgkKXWM72%2BM3KU%0ALCSprv4kZUmTNKAVRQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496441/0661d5d9d8276a94cb1d7cfe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f489410cd664536381b53ccdd922905eae4696bcced21fefb97b6d69eb398a8d&req=ciMiEsB4mYVeFb4f3HP0gLHQCoj3OPYJ48BG95XtuAI0PFvgkKXWM72%2BM3KU%0ALCSprv4kZUmTNKAVRQ%3D%3D%0A)

The Confidential icon will now be displayed in the Files list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496550/1b283e56d59313db41f936a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14093c44e0d0412a9b14b81670efd359601055591345e6017a9659671d1e3860&req=ciMiEsB4mIRfFb4f3HP0gOd8wOXar2Jq%2FuMrPeSZvGBMVAeAA0bU7fOY2LZb%0AKv1dDzOmEXrwsG2l7A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/635496550/1b283e56d59313db41f936a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14093c44e0d0412a9b14b81670efd359601055591345e6017a9659671d1e3860&req=ciMiEsB4mIRfFb4f3HP0gOd8wOXar2Jq%2FuMrPeSZvGBMVAeAA0bU7fOY2LZb%0AKv1dDzOmEXrwsG2l7A%3D%3D%0A)

Attaching a File to a Specific Clinical Note
============================================

To upload a File to a specific clinical note, use the **Attach File** button at the top of the clinical note tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1045801883/663f55a45e7afbe0b326faa2/CleanShot+2024-05-09+at+14_45_18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=325c7917ca6e0bf467ea7cf43614255c8579b1836611cad6ab8102d1317b9657&req=dSAjE8F%2BnIlXWvMW1HO4zedmDlzmRrGVnWoYf8%2BBkJnDThOwsjLNR9wOOXMf%0AHa5Hqf0rmpAbLVb7dEc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1045801883/663f55a45e7afbe0b326faa2/CleanShot+2024-05-09+at+14_45_18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=325c7917ca6e0bf467ea7cf43614255c8579b1836611cad6ab8102d1317b9657&req=dSAjE8F%2BnIlXWvMW1HO4zedmDlzmRrGVnWoYf8%2BBkJnDThOwsjLNR9wOOXMf%0AHa5Hqf0rmpAbLVb7dEc%3D%0A)

When uploading attachments from the clinical notes tab, you'll have the option to disable it from appearing in Files tab of the patient record. This is ideal for sensitive files that should not be available for general access to everyone with access to the Files tab.

If you do not want the attachment to display in the Files tab, uncheck the 'show in patient files' option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1046924368/56c849b39e37c14ad0a3e59e/CleanShot+2024-05-10+at+16_42_48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c4c2824a6744314854e92e4851486f9ff198ed98de1550a27076261d58f6ec3&req=dSAjEMB8mYJZUfMW1HO4zQkyylJ5Vi6ncR3oC0Sic1eSQeC%2BUM68QMvGW9sv%0AwydFQCJ42cN%2FjiNmBs8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1046924368/56c849b39e37c14ad0a3e59e/CleanShot+2024-05-10+at+16_42_48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c4c2824a6744314854e92e4851486f9ff198ed98de1550a27076261d58f6ec3&req=dSAjEMB8mYJZUfMW1HO4zQkyylJ5Vi6ncR3oC0Sic1eSQeC%2BUM68QMvGW9sv%0AwydFQCJ42cN%2FjiNmBs8%3D%0A)

The attachment will only be accessible from the clinical note you've attached it to, and will only be visible to people who can access the note itself.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1046924536/4ee2b480f611f4849a8eb881/CleanShot+2024-05-10+at+16_43_02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3f51bc2cf505260e3004fd1bfbc6733070064f489f5b6d38d233237a40b60613&req=dSAjEMB8mYRcX%2FMW1HO4zWfDWoAoN%2Fg9em8ELeBzi%2FxwfznxiW0UIx9X5avE%0A7m66n3zA08IvOjDHp7k%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1046924536/4ee2b480f611f4849a8eb881/CleanShot+2024-05-10+at+16_43_02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3f51bc2cf505260e3004fd1bfbc6733070064f489f5b6d38d233237a40b60613&req=dSAjEMB8mYRcX%2FMW1HO4zWfDWoAoN%2Fg9em8ELeBzi%2FxwfznxiW0UIx9X5avE%0A7m66n3zA08IvOjDHp7k%3D%0A)

Creating Tags and Tag Categories

Creating Tags and Tag Categories
================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Creating Tag Categories](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4534646-creating-tags-and-tag-categories#h_2e4ee577e7)

[Creating Tags](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4534646-creating-tags-and-tag-categories#h_44306130c8)

Tags can be described most simply as custom labels that can be added to patient files and clinical notes. Tags can be used as visual aids within patient files and clinical notes, and to filter report results e.g. searching for patients that have had a particular injury based on tags applied to their filters.

Click the following links to learn more about applying tags to [patient files](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590795-adding-tags-to-patient-files)
, including [pinned tags](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6610722-pinned-tags)
, and [clinical notes](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4534646-creating-tags-and-tag-categories)
.

* * *

Creating Tag Categories
=======================

**Tags** can be grouped within **Tag Categories**.

To set up **Tag Categories**, navigate to **[Settings > General > Tag Categories](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/tagcategories)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636281520/3945364d183ef8a388047b05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6ccec38354899fd5cd934cc6598937cff71f85a6dfef6c7fd579dc55775e86b&req=ciMhFMF%2FmINfFb4f3HP0gHfqBPXwdglIhnZ6YCeuOP2MhRTf4C%2B1FwZhw32w%0AnVYSZUPJ8fcxiAwGVw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636281520/3945364d183ef8a388047b05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6ccec38354899fd5cd934cc6598937cff71f85a6dfef6c7fd579dc55775e86b&req=ciMhFMF%2FmINfFb4f3HP0gHfqBPXwdglIhnZ6YCeuOP2MhRTf4C%2B1FwZhw32w%0AnVYSZUPJ8fcxiAwGVw%3D%3D%0A)

The **Tag Categories** menu shows a list of all the current task categories with their assigned tag colours. To add a new category, click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636281802/1a7b215364ad3400412724b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=92aa42cea79ea7f360621a0e883e1e1e1cda8ea217e8e874b6c4253470769bdc&req=ciMhFMF%2FlYFdFb4f3HP0gFm3cPY9X%2BkoL64n4ROTvHb%2Bw5r9klPIxnH8KFzp%0ASrYLyrNVj9RI92lZfQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636281802/1a7b215364ad3400412724b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=92aa42cea79ea7f360621a0e883e1e1e1cda8ea217e8e874b6c4253470769bdc&req=ciMhFMF%2FlYFdFb4f3HP0gFm3cPY9X%2BkoL64n4ROTvHb%2Bw5r9klPIxnH8KFzp%0ASrYLyrNVj9RI92lZfQ%3D%3D%0A)

Clicking **Add** will create a new tag category, where a name, colour and subcategory can all be assigned.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636283684/2f9cf3ec74f82e205feb4357/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9583b18dee1870059f8b7d4b209628bed58a5d568ec4c729c2a8afbea60c642&req=ciMhFMF9m4lbFb4f3HP0gOzDzIwd0u8NwaErc7icrgsv3r%2FOf9sF4F564tHK%0AsI4%2BEXHbBywtxT6awg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636283684/2f9cf3ec74f82e205feb4357/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9583b18dee1870059f8b7d4b209628bed58a5d568ec4c729c2a8afbea60c642&req=ciMhFMF9m4lbFb4f3HP0gOzDzIwd0u8NwaErc7icrgsv3r%2FOf9sF4F564tHK%0AsI4%2BEXHbBywtxT6awg%3D%3D%0A)

You can delete a tag category by clicking the **Trash Can** icon which appears to the right when you hover over the category.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636283919/cff706fcc3c1c432bd984e9f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eeb5669c0883ef77c1cb5c5298ce93f930558fd970f67be3bfc2cf056c169b97&req=ciMhFMF9lIBWFb4f3HP0gMbMZbFvkiuNqpHkIOnJTfJHwPrjPByXFjrpFrk2%0ANVHB43Qfi%2FCSEwlaxg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636283919/cff706fcc3c1c432bd984e9f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eeb5669c0883ef77c1cb5c5298ce93f930558fd970f67be3bfc2cf056c169b97&req=ciMhFMF9lIBWFb4f3HP0gMbMZbFvkiuNqpHkIOnJTfJHwPrjPByXFjrpFrk2%0ANVHB43Qfi%2FCSEwlaxg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to save any changes you've made.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636284082/b338ac2b06440cb3b4c0c1bd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e41a47fc33f43983dbc0d5f3182e51e0f3a7620b27b4f5d0a5ad045af2da1b81&req=ciMhFMF6nYldFb4f3HP0gAPows0%2BCbAgPFUw8rsMsrFvoUlRE6Bq1Btsj%2BDw%0A3m48QhNm%2FfFhNUqJ4w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636284082/b338ac2b06440cb3b4c0c1bd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e41a47fc33f43983dbc0d5f3182e51e0f3a7620b27b4f5d0a5ad045af2da1b81&req=ciMhFMF6nYldFb4f3HP0gAPows0%2BCbAgPFUw8rsMsrFvoUlRE6Bq1Btsj%2BDw%0A3m48QhNm%2FfFhNUqJ4w%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Creating Tags
=============

To create new **Tags**, go to **[Settings > General > Tags](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/tags)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636284396/82960984568f4a22a39e91f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b0008c8038060c46187af8933d2df3b1e3d2d9e44a04187b49412b782acc353&req=ciMhFMF6nohZFb4f3HP0gNthwwsRjIMRx8N5wSt234XVwrSXdDAMop8P%2B9ul%0A9OcSAO3aOJElPpfXfA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636284396/82960984568f4a22a39e91f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b0008c8038060c46187af8933d2df3b1e3d2d9e44a04187b49412b782acc353&req=ciMhFMF6nohZFb4f3HP0gNthwwsRjIMRx8N5wSt234XVwrSXdDAMop8P%2B9ul%0A9OcSAO3aOJElPpfXfA%3D%3D%0A)

To add a Tag, click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636288101/032d00a6c355b8a9a629acba/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef22259fad682fff3063f99d4d7b83bc7bb835e41059717ee3f63c8bf701ab5e&req=ciMhFMF2nIFeFb4f3HP0gAUt8GqNkZ8SMVFRUwXYewtE78p%2BimK5uQh7rNR9%0APengVU3IIC8j6bL%2FUQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636288101/032d00a6c355b8a9a629acba/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef22259fad682fff3063f99d4d7b83bc7bb835e41059717ee3f63c8bf701ab5e&req=ciMhFMF2nIFeFb4f3HP0gAUt8GqNkZ8SMVFRUwXYewtE78p%2BimK5uQh7rNR9%0APengVU3IIC8j6bL%2FUQ%3D%3D%0A)

Clicking **Add** will create a new tag at the bottom of the list, where it can be named and assigned a **Tag Category** by clicking the dropdown menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636288920/530ab74bbfe7dff0346a3b89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2bdf22aa811d693223c8c3e2bb55821b0c0911b2d949fee48d39c923a88e9820&req=ciMhFMF2lINfFb4f3HP0gPCEL1%2FoV3S7Gsd6WBBH0LmCVJ%2B1nakwCbQ6revI%0AcxmL4BrEi5lMtscfgQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636288920/530ab74bbfe7dff0346a3b89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2bdf22aa811d693223c8c3e2bb55821b0c0911b2d949fee48d39c923a88e9820&req=ciMhFMF2lINfFb4f3HP0gPCEL1%2FoV3S7Gsd6WBBH0LmCVJ%2B1nakwCbQ6revI%0AcxmL4BrEi5lMtscfgQ%3D%3D%0A)

A tag can be deleted by clicking the **Trash Can** icon, which appears on the right when you hover over the row.

Click **Save** to save any changes you have made.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636290644/df924f889b8b55536ca15398/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f989a9ccf24068b32e2f832a05abe4cd4f8666e156a9949cf469e601ac9c64c9&req=ciMhFMB%2Bm4VbFb4f3HP0gLM5aiEaUSehSeKARD4eoNvW1IU79C2i8%2FS1cpGx%0A1O9ss2cc0d9VF3E7ew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636290644/df924f889b8b55536ca15398/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f989a9ccf24068b32e2f832a05abe4cd4f8666e156a9949cf469e601ac9c64c9&req=ciMhFMB%2Bm4VbFb4f3HP0gLM5aiEaUSehSeKARD4eoNvW1IU79C2i8%2FS1cpGx%0A1O9ss2cc0d9VF3E7ew%3D%3D%0A)

Rescheduling Appointments

Rescheduling Appointments
=========================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Dragging and Dropping Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548122-rescheduling-appointments#h_3fe5ffacf5)

[Moving Appointments using the Reschedule Function](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548122-rescheduling-appointments#h_be88589884)

There are two easy ways to reschedule appointments.

*   Drag and drop your appointment to a new time
    
*   Using the reschedule function
    

**Dragging and Dropping Appointments**
======================================

To reschedule using the drag and drop function;

*   Left mouse click and hold over an appointment
    
*   Drag the appointment to the desired location and release
    
*   Provide a reason for the reschedule
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/257348419/8aeac453e1b08a786ed1537f/DD+Reschedule.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=ce3a8252e13809c7acdb800f07df43b06dbacf54eeb1eeac1e022485ade61f8b&req=diUgFc12mYBWFb4f3HP0gHAm6zoyB%2F42KM10ZwDhDJbr%2FG0Smne8esHOtamF%0A%2FW6eEAmU8NZIi1VLOg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/257348419/8aeac453e1b08a786ed1537f/DD+Reschedule.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=ce3a8252e13809c7acdb800f07df43b06dbacf54eeb1eeac1e022485ade61f8b&req=diUgFc12mYBWFb4f3HP0gHAm6zoyB%2F42KM10ZwDhDJbr%2FG0Smne8esHOtamF%0A%2FW6eEAmU8NZIi1VLOg%3D%3D%0A)

**Moving Appointments using the Reschedule Function**
=====================================================

To reschedule an appointment;

*   Right mouse click on the appointment and select **Reschedule**
    
*   Navigate to the desired new appointment time, right mouse click, and select **Reschedule _Patient Name_**
    
*   Provide a reason for the reschedule
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/257348038/f969a7b15015d4aa58851481/Next+Week+Reschedule.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=8612efb15bd92b8fd8642747c5515faa314a4d7ef8b403c7c1c684075dfa0fb7&req=diUgFc12nYJXFb4f3HP0gNm26ukfDk88qM4IAyeI7GDCaGIiTrIMGreGNhu%2F%0AEkpnWTFmBcSYIhXVfQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/257348038/f969a7b15015d4aa58851481/Next+Week+Reschedule.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=8612efb15bd92b8fd8642747c5515faa314a4d7ef8b403c7c1c684075dfa0fb7&req=diUgFc12nYJXFb4f3HP0gNm26ukfDk88qM4IAyeI7GDCaGIiTrIMGreGNhu%2F%0AEkpnWTFmBcSYIhXVfQ%3D%3D%0A)

Alternatively, you can [cancel an appointment](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548401-cancelling-an-appointment)
.

Cancelling an Appointment

Cancelling an Appointment
=========================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Cancelling Appointments from the Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548401-cancelling-an-appointment#cancelling-appointments-from-the-appointment-book)

[Cancelling Appointments in Bulk from the Patient File](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548401-cancelling-an-appointment#cancelling-appointments-in-bulk-from-the-patient-file)

**Cancelling Appointments from the Appointment Book**
=====================================================

To cancel or delete a single appointment from the Appointment Book, **click on the appointment** and select the **Delete** button from the menu.

If you want to record the appointment as cancelled, select the **Record as Cancelled** option, and provide a reason for deleting the appointment. Appointments recorded as cancelled will be logged on the patient file.

To delete an appointment entirely without a reason and without logging it on the patient file, leave the Record as Cancelled option unticked and click **OK**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/257755405/a3c27a810f32506ad685ac0a/CANCEL+APPT+FINAL.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=b378ac06bb887eaf407129a54cb8700b9bb520c6950f6b9cc303dd1312baa1ad&req=diUgEcx7mYFaFb4f3HP0gMzL3HAOFV1xEQI5QGGlv6GT2AVwIboBCy%2BMN3pv%0ALrw5CpClI4NaLqOUNA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/257755405/a3c27a810f32506ad685ac0a/CANCEL+APPT+FINAL.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=b378ac06bb887eaf407129a54cb8700b9bb520c6950f6b9cc303dd1312baa1ad&req=diUgEcx7mYFaFb4f3HP0gMzL3HAOFV1xEQI5QGGlv6GT2AVwIboBCy%2BMN3pv%0ALrw5CpClI4NaLqOUNA%3D%3D%0A)

**Cancelling Appointments in Bulk from the Patient File**
=========================================================

To cancel or delete appointments in bulk, **open the patient file** and navigate to the **Appointments tab**.

Select **one or more appointments** and then select the **Delete** button at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/261716097/8334c7753f90e5af6e0ae990/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26383b70c48a12501255bdaa8f8ffbfb6996ef25ba7ab11262daf72e2d0a15a5&req=diYmEch4nYhYFb4f3HP0gK4DshXZVxIkW%2BOHQoC8jr5ww8DWcIB0Bl7EhVbb%0A6Pq1vbVZN0CGHrGP9w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/261716097/8334c7753f90e5af6e0ae990/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26383b70c48a12501255bdaa8f8ffbfb6996ef25ba7ab11262daf72e2d0a15a5&req=diYmEch4nYhYFb4f3HP0gK4DshXZVxIkW%2BOHQoC8jr5ww8DWcIB0Bl7EhVbb%0A6Pq1vbVZN0CGHrGP9w%3D%3D%0A)

Alternatively, you can [reschedule an appointment](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548122-rescheduling-appointments)
.

## Document 102 — Using the Outstanding Clinical Notes Widget | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-102}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548402-using-the-outstanding-clinical-notes-widget](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548402-using-the-outstanding-clinical-notes-widget)

[Clinical Notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413946-clinical-notes)

Using the Outstanding Clinical Notes Widget

Using the Outstanding Clinical Notes Widget
===========================================

Updated over 3 years ago

The **Outstanding Clinical Notes** widget provides a quick and easy way to view any clinical notes that have not been completed.

To install the widget, navigate to **Customise > Outstanding Clinical Notes** on your home page and drag the icon to your desired location on the dashboard. The widget will automatically refresh and update, displaying any clinical notes that have not been completed.

Click on the patient record in the widget to go directly to the patient's clinical note area.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/259727181/d2c790c46f404a6f9d6a5995/lbp.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=e5881be860a63b473bfcb156970d1e9c904665677ae918426d2b2960ce67f9ec&req=diUuEct5nIleFb4f3HP0gLFKt44cZ%2FzA7edSKrSVeJqfkClgmy7pavpsFY33%0AvSWWEGsxe%2BrDeu%2BRHg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/259727181/d2c790c46f404a6f9d6a5995/lbp.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=e5881be860a63b473bfcb156970d1e9c904665677ae918426d2b2960ce67f9ec&req=diUuEct5nIleFb4f3HP0gLFKt44cZ%2FzA7edSKrSVeJqfkClgmy7pavpsFY33%0AvSWWEGsxe%2BrDeu%2BRHg%3D%3D%0A)

If you've completed a clinical note, but the patient is still appearing in your [Oustanding Clinical Notes widget](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548402-using-the-outstanding-clinical-notes-widget)
, it's important to check that the **Location, Practitioner** and **Date** of the clinical note match the appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301454638/36a1fd66b2a1cd02554b8bfd/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+1.34.36+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9facf92078b25b11488dbf07bb07a86db282385ad539a072b4de947b9d5555ff&req=dyAmEsx6m4JXFb4f3HP0gO4WhRclE4l9V9bR2gQh%2FC6AkKWC8NsPpnpR%2BUn1%0AuuC5I8zmQd4rfwZuPg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301454638/36a1fd66b2a1cd02554b8bfd/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+1.34.36+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9facf92078b25b11488dbf07bb07a86db282385ad539a072b4de947b9d5555ff&req=dyAmEsx6m4JXFb4f3HP0gO4WhRclE4l9V9bR2gQh%2FC6AkKWC8NsPpnpR%2BUn1%0AuuC5I8zmQd4rfwZuPg%3D%3D%0A)

To confirm that the details of an existing clinical note are correct, click on the patient in the Outstanding Clinical Notes widget, which will take you to the **Clinical Notes** tab of the patient file**.**

In the clinical note timeline, double-check that the Location, Practitioner and Date match the appointment exactly.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301455202/cda3347d710a67658a2d0fa6/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+1.37.47+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de4634834ce502c55db7b3894338ab46a918175254ee6a9d432279cb0d7eb0b3&req=dyAmEsx7n4FdFb4f3HP0gNup692uWO4wOHlqZcyEcxlGVMDMt6QXRsjodnxS%0Ae0UkDBAd4ngJFiFH0w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301455202/cda3347d710a67658a2d0fa6/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+1.37.47+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de4634834ce502c55db7b3894338ab46a918175254ee6a9d432279cb0d7eb0b3&req=dyAmEsx7n4FdFb4f3HP0gNup692uWO4wOHlqZcyEcxlGVMDMt6QXRsjodnxS%0Ae0UkDBAd4ngJFiFH0w%3D%3D%0A)

Use the practitioner drop-down or date and time calendar icon to correct any discrepancies. Click **Save** when done.

In the case of multi-location businesses, make sure that both the Practitioner and Business match the appointment. The Business selected in the top right-hand side of the screen is used to set the Business when creating new clinical notes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301438928/c42c830db73727ec4bb4437d/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+12.06.47+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f5c135e61377990d249d338c7da9057951a67d0f5eec37d80f1e227f7143498e&req=dyAmEsp2lINXFb4f3HP0gMVW%2Fjdf3ZFJO7ThmXYdlYcniHPlk%2FxXamJ5Th%2FU%0ArvuBwjECXPZRmdaeSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301438928/c42c830db73727ec4bb4437d/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+12.06.47+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f5c135e61377990d249d338c7da9057951a67d0f5eec37d80f1e227f7143498e&req=dyAmEsp2lINXFb4f3HP0gMVW%2Fjdf3ZFJO7ThmXYdlYcniHPlk%2FxXamJ5Th%2FU%0ArvuBwjECXPZRmdaeSQ%3D%3D%0A)

It is possible to enable a prompt to select your active Business each time you log into PracSuite so that the correct location is selected at the start of each day. [Click here for more info on how to enable this setting.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4853918-setting-your-business-when-logging-into-pracsuite)

## Document 103 — Creating an Invoice While Making a Future Appointment | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-103}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548412-creating-an-invoice-while-making-a-future-appointment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548412-creating-an-invoice-while-making-a-future-appointment)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413898-appointment-book)

[Appointment Book Basics](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2992886-appointment-book-basics)

Creating an Invoice While Making a Future Appointment

Creating an Invoice While Making a Future Appointment
=====================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

You can make a new subsequent appointment for an existing patient directly from the appointment book in PracSuite using the Make Next Appointment function.

*   Navigate to the current appointment, mouse click and select **Make Next Appointment**
    
*   Navigate to the new required future appointment time, changing days as required, mouse click and select **Make Next Appointment & Invoice \[patient name\]**
    
*   Invoice the patient for their consultation today as per your normal billing procedures
    
*   You have now made the next future appointment and invoiced the patient for today's consultation
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/259717514/63ea3870af84fb02a48f7c66/finalfinal.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=045df8a075887345e2220cc243a410d8f071b135d5b7cbfd20bc3c5f5e5d8f27&req=diUuEch5mIBbFb4f3HP0gAbY4goWh0BB8M3%2BGY7rYtV4uR5B1wGDiutHu6gZ%0AmIrs2BK4PLD0ldESVA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/259717514/63ea3870af84fb02a48f7c66/finalfinal.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=045df8a075887345e2220cc243a410d8f071b135d5b7cbfd20bc3c5f5e5d8f27&req=diUuEch5mIBbFb4f3HP0gAbY4goWh0BB8M3%2BGY7rYtV4uR5B1wGDiutHu6gZ%0AmIrs2BK4PLD0ldESVA%3D%3D%0A)

Handwriting features in PracSuite

Handwriting features in PracSuite
=================================

Updated over 7 months ago

Table of contents

[Handwriting with an iPad](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548424-handwriting-features-in-pracsuite#h_1cf5051fe6)

The latest operating systems generally have handwriting features built, including iPad and Microsoft Surface devices. These handwriting-to-text features work well with all fields in PracSuite, including clinical notes.

Handwriting with an iPad
========================

In the clinical notes, simply start writing with the Apple Pencil in the textbox, and your handwritten note will be converted to typed text.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/259679517/cb320c73a67bf2e698498db3/Ipad+Recording.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=2cc34fff888f744078e9b19f163856d048c4bb22bda766369d42b12e7666bdc7&req=diUuEM53mIBYFb4f3HP0gHmkseh7d%2Fp6BWDiGqK8Ci%2B3k31wMCdkEaVmZbGD%0AF1pMT2H93wlzkDDXnQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/259679517/cb320c73a67bf2e698498db3/Ipad+Recording.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=2cc34fff888f744078e9b19f163856d048c4bb22bda766369d42b12e7666bdc7&req=diUuEM53mIBYFb4f3HP0gHmkseh7d%2Fp6BWDiGqK8Ci%2B3k31wMCdkEaVmZbGD%0AF1pMT2H93wlzkDDXnQ%3D%3D%0A)

Write your notes with the Apple Pencil to save time and increase efficiency in your workday. [Learn more about the iPad handwriting features here.](https://support.apple.com/en-au/guide/ipad/ipad355ab2a7/ipados)

## Document 105 — How to Create a Group Appointment | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-105}

How to Create a Group Appointment

How to Create a Group Appointment
=================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Creating a Single Group Appointment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4551807-how-to-create-a-group-appointment#h_8fddc26995)

[Creating a Recurring Group Appointment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4551807-how-to-create-a-group-appointment#h_d282a9963b)

[Booking Patients into Group Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4551807-how-to-create-a-group-appointment#h_d8d2155927)

_Using Group Appointment features requires Group Appointment Types to be configured in [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
_

Group appointments are used to schedule appointments that contain multiple patients, such as group classes and couples therapy.

Creating a Single Group Appointment
===================================

To schedule a single group appointment, select an available time on the appointment book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936612798/adcfe6364d87315b2ba5b6ac/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.22.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bda13d9053b3f12e2ce0166a55d2b0de6a52d3c80dd469515e4a1e6d1dbe0909&req=fSMhEMh8mohXFb4f3HP0gA36awxsHa74qG7gw0npfuMy6zD%2FqugJkuQlyCmX%0Aczb9ejvtP7%2FddodBPw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936612798/adcfe6364d87315b2ba5b6ac/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.22.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bda13d9053b3f12e2ce0166a55d2b0de6a52d3c80dd469515e4a1e6d1dbe0909&req=fSMhEMh8mohXFb4f3HP0gA36awxsHa74qG7gw0npfuMy6zD%2FqugJkuQlyCmX%0Aczb9ejvtP7%2FddodBPw%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Group Appointment** in the menu bar.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936570616/9baaf8ccd2d3e411d11bdca8/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+13.32.53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a13ea156d647983e7643e09114db49517483d4b06a48e9935db961982ec2ade6&req=fSMhE85%2Bm4BZFb4f3HP0gKQQVwlhcwgMH0xiS0qwn8w9%2BKE%2BZaaVCX7tukBm%0AnguKkltqGPuuvEdrIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936570616/9baaf8ccd2d3e411d11bdca8/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+13.32.53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a13ea156d647983e7643e09114db49517483d4b06a48e9935db961982ec2ade6&req=fSMhE85%2Bm4BZFb4f3HP0gKQQVwlhcwgMH0xiS0qwn8w9%2BKE%2BZaaVCX7tukBm%0AnguKkltqGPuuvEdrIA%3D%3D%0A)

By default, only a single instance of a group appointment will be created.

If you only need to book one group appointment, confirm the Appointment Type, Duration and Maximum Size (which will be set based on the Appointment Type Defaults).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936614774/d94107b1b16816ff2439ef9b/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+13.33.51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c8144454438f05033bb647ad0415813dc66f0ad9fd4640845da171dbdefdc6b&req=fSMhEMh6moZbFb4f3HP0gA4iCrSWAwb2Iek2Uuxl7G1IqeMZaGFiRQlAq18S%0AJQJ7LwfgES8ESKf89A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936614774/d94107b1b16816ff2439ef9b/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+13.33.51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c8144454438f05033bb647ad0415813dc66f0ad9fd4640845da171dbdefdc6b&req=fSMhEMh6moZbFb4f3HP0gA4iCrSWAwb2Iek2Uuxl7G1IqeMZaGFiRQlAq18S%0AJQJ7LwfgES8ESKf89A%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Book** to finish creating the group appointment.

Creating a Recurring Group Appointment
======================================

To schedule a recurring series of group appointments, such as a weekly class, start by selecting the first instance of the group on the appointment book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936612798/adcfe6364d87315b2ba5b6ac/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.22.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bda13d9053b3f12e2ce0166a55d2b0de6a52d3c80dd469515e4a1e6d1dbe0909&req=fSMhEMh8mohXFb4f3HP0gA36awxsHa74qG7gw0npfuMy6zD%2FqugJkuQlyCmX%0Aczb9ejvtP7%2FddodBPw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936612798/adcfe6364d87315b2ba5b6ac/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.22.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bda13d9053b3f12e2ce0166a55d2b0de6a52d3c80dd469515e4a1e6d1dbe0909&req=fSMhEMh8mohXFb4f3HP0gA36awxsHa74qG7gw0npfuMy6zD%2FqugJkuQlyCmX%0Aczb9ejvtP7%2FddodBPw%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Group Appointment** in the menu bar.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936570616/9baaf8ccd2d3e411d11bdca8/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+13.32.53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a13ea156d647983e7643e09114db49517483d4b06a48e9935db961982ec2ade6&req=fSMhE85%2Bm4BZFb4f3HP0gKQQVwlhcwgMH0xiS0qwn8w9%2BKE%2BZaaVCX7tukBm%0AnguKkltqGPuuvEdrIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936570616/9baaf8ccd2d3e411d11bdca8/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+13.32.53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a13ea156d647983e7643e09114db49517483d4b06a48e9935db961982ec2ade6&req=fSMhE85%2Bm4BZFb4f3HP0gKQQVwlhcwgMH0xiS0qwn8w9%2BKE%2BZaaVCX7tukBm%0AnguKkltqGPuuvEdrIA%3D%3D%0A)

Customise the **recurrence** of this group accordingly.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936615912/449af6c34ce20fd36f3ddcad/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.31.20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ced1d3232ae3e030d2d410278e0d723868796f338dbfa50914f179891f75d253&req=fSMhEMh7lIBdFb4f3HP0gL11vfuX%2Fz3xSBB7SbSBesVwH0H2N5MQm%2BAIeTPe%0A08EH0GO10uDlhN8BCQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936615912/449af6c34ce20fd36f3ddcad/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.31.20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ced1d3232ae3e030d2d410278e0d723868796f338dbfa50914f179891f75d253&req=fSMhEMh7lIBdFb4f3HP0gL11vfuX%2Fz3xSBB7SbSBesVwH0H2N5MQm%2BAIeTPe%0A08EH0GO10uDlhN8BCQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Check & Reserve Times** to confirm that these times are available.

After resolving any conflicts, select **Book Schedule** to finalise the process.

Booking Patients into Group Appointments
========================================

Select a group appointment you wish to add a patient to and select Add Patient. You can repeat the following steps for each patient that needs to be added to the group.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936613552/d8ecac77c7058366c1f0899a/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.25.21.png?expires=1771821900&signature=70b7ac07d954f7a2cbf258ed07d80687df451eb8b0c1ba6eeb1ff25525ce61ee&req=fSMhEMh9mIRdFb4f3HP0gI6cFLwDck%2FNIC7nabDQcvdgH7s%2FeJIBJFFw9S6Y%0AFjHuFoRkR4L7ePQ1xw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936613552/d8ecac77c7058366c1f0899a/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.25.21.png?expires=1771821900&signature=70b7ac07d954f7a2cbf258ed07d80687df451eb8b0c1ba6eeb1ff25525ce61ee&req=fSMhEMh9mIRdFb4f3HP0gI6cFLwDck%2FNIC7nabDQcvdgH7s%2FeJIBJFFw9S6Y%0AFjHuFoRkR4L7ePQ1xw%3D%3D%0A)

Search for the patient and select them in the results list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/937579627/2022202ce7772229b9e107c3/CleanShot+2024-01-19+at+09.29.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=15d95182e23a0e98b2be1b9395af32dc681aa511b90ce93873b4ab3bb78fa693&req=fSMgE853m4NYFb4f3HP0gMoYErGSBD%2BR5L7pV9QGJ%2F9FnKcArrnZ8lyKC2DR%0AaG7XhzSAw1iHOXEXFQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/937579627/2022202ce7772229b9e107c3/CleanShot+2024-01-19+at+09.29.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=15d95182e23a0e98b2be1b9395af32dc681aa511b90ce93873b4ab3bb78fa693&req=fSMgE853m4NYFb4f3HP0gMoYErGSBD%2BR5L7pV9QGJ%2F9FnKcArrnZ8lyKC2DR%0AaG7XhzSAw1iHOXEXFQ%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting a patient, you have two options:

*   Select **Book** to add this patient to this instance of the group.
    
*   Select **Book Schedule** to add this patient to multiple instances of the group.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936613676/e8c34d1d10b86316ffbe9ba1/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.25.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4d1d60e89428a2812b6c0a6a5a9f90bd9b913defa03a5b01be1c35d0f7843552&req=fSMhEMh9m4ZZFb4f3HP0gFTCG1v%2FQkQtMY5DFaTCzdhQSEUPgrtWf5zuiQbg%0ATfP2VSGeHI2Hy21Zew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936613676/e8c34d1d10b86316ffbe9ba1/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.25.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4d1d60e89428a2812b6c0a6a5a9f90bd9b913defa03a5b01be1c35d0f7843552&req=fSMhEMh9m4ZZFb4f3HP0gFTCG1v%2FQkQtMY5DFaTCzdhQSEUPgrtWf5zuiQbg%0ATfP2VSGeHI2Hy21Zew%3D%3D%0A)

When selecting Book Schedule, only future instances of this particular group appointment schedule will be displayed by default.

In the filters section, select Custom to view future instances of this group appointment type regardless of whether they are a part of the original schedule.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942062031/4f5295feed8de5e3cafbf3ed/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.43.07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a6de91488b753bdd4ef57706a07ccd61cecd1b40cb6fbf5ca78938e90d26a8f&req=fSQlFs98nYJeFb4f3HP0gAQG62l7P%2Fe6hpGxKsoyvWvsCRKxPnh%2FE6mPjBXO%0AFeeOG%2FoynH4eQI%2BkQQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942062031/4f5295feed8de5e3cafbf3ed/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.43.07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a6de91488b753bdd4ef57706a07ccd61cecd1b40cb6fbf5ca78938e90d26a8f&req=fSQlFs98nYJeFb4f3HP0gAQG62l7P%2Fe6hpGxKsoyvWvsCRKxPnh%2FE6mPjBXO%0AFeeOG%2FoynH4eQI%2BkQQ%3D%3D%0A)

Future Group Appointments based on your selected filters will be displayed. Select which instances of the group appointment you wish to add this patient to.

## Document 106 — Adding Tags to Patient Files | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-106}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590795-adding-tags-to-patient-files](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590795-adding-tags-to-patient-files)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590795-adding-tags-to-patient-files#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Patient File Management](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2601287-patient-file-management)

Adding Tags to Patient Files

Adding Tags to Patient Files
============================

Updated over 2 years ago

**Tags** can be added to patient files to track and report on custom attributes that can be both clinical and marketing in nature. Tags can be used as criteria when reporting.

[First, **Tags** must be created through the **Tag Settings.**](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4534646-setting-up-tags)

To add a tag to the **Patient's File > Tags tab** and then click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595589676/4f1c3c24033107115de1d13b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=275c0440cfc3a732be50da45c52b13c0de9c53997241455f73e7fc2a26153d47&req=cSkiE8F3m4ZZFb4f3HP0gPh4K%2FTmAifAKZ6q127iVBpegi2atmgarbSh7Osy%0ApAGQD3JsqqIZEENm%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595589676/4f1c3c24033107115de1d13b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=275c0440cfc3a732be50da45c52b13c0de9c53997241455f73e7fc2a26153d47&req=cSkiE8F3m4ZZFb4f3HP0gPh4K%2FTmAifAKZ6q127iVBpegi2atmgarbSh7Osy%0ApAGQD3JsqqIZEENm%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)

In the popup window, select the desired tag(s) to add to the patient file, then click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595589915/9b945f0e829a927570404673/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e53e0d23c71e21067fc6500824b37b7052277f1a66f718a6539b5f3f642d6553&req=cSkiE8F3lIBaFb4f3HP0gGxColSr9GfKyweo1NcyMqdsmNqhxcOAsp77h4I8%0A5EGBaDq85LkZB6ZV9Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595589915/9b945f0e829a927570404673/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e53e0d23c71e21067fc6500824b37b7052277f1a66f718a6539b5f3f642d6553&req=cSkiE8F3lIBaFb4f3HP0gGxColSr9GfKyweo1NcyMqdsmNqhxcOAsp77h4I8%0A5EGBaDq85LkZB6ZV9Q%3D%3D%0A)

The patient tags will be displayed on the Tags tab. Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595590096/f502a53cdd990b7741aa86d0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=40e1d64f805cd85adda927d59aa868797a053284744800ec1efddac1bf4cf799&req=cSkiE8B%2BnYhZFb4f3HP0gIBUP4gBDAeYXVWxSP7qL6OEwLtN0dLBehi7fgor%0AKMmu%2F783IQvHOCEmpQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595590096/f502a53cdd990b7741aa86d0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=40e1d64f805cd85adda927d59aa868797a053284744800ec1efddac1bf4cf799&req=cSkiE8B%2BnYhZFb4f3HP0gIBUP4gBDAeYXVWxSP7qL6OEwLtN0dLBehi7fgor%0AKMmu%2F783IQvHOCEmpQ%3D%3D%0A)

When using select reports, Tags can be used as filters for the report criteria. For example, when using the Patient List, you can select **Tags** to filter your selection.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595590333/646679fa8cdd324d2b771f40/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cc19bb5faaf8b286321f7f9fbac94dc5bfb4c5854ea257bbbb5747ec17e57ae0&req=cSkiE8B%2BnoJcFb4f3HP0gDRFwiTrcOZL4LBtkyMPxozNw9ObB700vHvgBTcj%0A3Af%2Bf8qlhugnQJl7Zg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595590333/646679fa8cdd324d2b771f40/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cc19bb5faaf8b286321f7f9fbac94dc5bfb4c5854ea257bbbb5747ec17e57ae0&req=cSkiE8B%2BnoJcFb4f3HP0gDRFwiTrcOZL4LBtkyMPxozNw9ObB700vHvgBTcj%0A3Af%2Bf8qlhugnQJl7Zg%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595590565/f91403909e917d1d9a7f7906/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3edea6e601261b9953c8fd2eaf29fcc6156072f075c54c9f39c6d66942f20ffc&req=cSkiE8B%2BmIdaFb4f3HP0gPSU%2FuOOlZBOWboGoLnR3ufFn22MTD%2BGFxVA11Y8%0ARVc93Fd6TIniw53W%2BQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595590565/f91403909e917d1d9a7f7906/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3edea6e601261b9953c8fd2eaf29fcc6156072f075c54c9f39c6d66942f20ffc&req=cSkiE8B%2BmIdaFb4f3HP0gPSU%2FuOOlZBOWboGoLnR3ufFn22MTD%2BGFxVA11Y8%0ARVc93Fd6TIniw53W%2BQ%3D%3D%0A)

Tags can be included or excluded by selecting the appropriate checkbox.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595591457/b059e32f4947583804ad2a24/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f37615b8d4eb06d7e517d99349f6c41e02f9a149863d9647e4244976e02af9a&req=cSkiE8B%2FmYRYFb4f3HP0gKmc6AoPy6D2C%2Bb6bAOKzei8ZExw4DyVii02Ze4G%0ABQL6yMU%2FdVPxtlfWhw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595591457/b059e32f4947583804ad2a24/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f37615b8d4eb06d7e517d99349f6c41e02f9a149863d9647e4244976e02af9a&req=cSkiE8B%2FmYRYFb4f3HP0gKmc6AoPy6D2C%2Bb6bAOKzei8ZExw4DyVii02Ze4G%0ABQL6yMU%2FdVPxtlfWhw%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Generate Report** to create a list of all patients with the assigned tag.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595591779/1bdad74ac2bbe98d0242a487/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e1c9e5ea9dc72116fd1128a79601bd082f06d8987539b0e02c21e72d7991827&req=cSkiE8B%2FmoZWFb4f3HP0gLKPaVVCyoe46mLc4DLgRPHc8WiuTCy1Nw7EC8Gk%0AJfla%2BtD36pHOD4Rh6w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595591779/1bdad74ac2bbe98d0242a487/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e1c9e5ea9dc72116fd1128a79601bd082f06d8987539b0e02c21e72d7991827&req=cSkiE8B%2FmoZWFb4f3HP0gLKPaVVCyoe46mLc4DLgRPHc8WiuTCy1Nw7EC8Gk%0AJfla%2BtD36pHOD4Rh6w%3D%3D%0A)

The report has now been created. You can **Export** the report, **Print** the report, you can click **Send Message** to send an email or SMS to the patients, you can add a **Tag** in bulk to the patients and you can click **Mailchimp** which allows you to add Mailchimp Tags for use within Mailchimp.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595592100/65ac59e0e502e89e80705548/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1b9b98223776bebb1c5c94011ded9bcc3573ea74f747d44b64e8d57680d9d7a&req=cSkiE8B8nIFfFb4f3HP0gP5jvMiQ6KszWr5hJRCE14pIS9F8GwXFdUBUgfpz%0AMzA0BcHeBjaYuKqgnQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595592100/65ac59e0e502e89e80705548/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1b9b98223776bebb1c5c94011ded9bcc3573ea74f747d44b64e8d57680d9d7a&req=cSkiE8B8nIFfFb4f3HP0gP5jvMiQ6KszWr5hJRCE14pIS9F8GwXFdUBUgfpz%0AMzA0BcHeBjaYuKqgnQ%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 107 — Adding Tags to Clinical Notes | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-107}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590913-adding-tags-to-clinical-notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590913-adding-tags-to-clinical-notes)

Adding Tags to Clinical Notes

Adding Tags to Clinical Notes
=============================

Updated over 3 years ago

Add **Tags** to clinical notes by navigating to a patient file and clicking the **Clinical Notes** tab. Click **New** to create a new clinical note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636191899/74f988aa0bc8d59b608e9448/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e3e6d10c193f32d2e19e34bf76fd0218132c44d0dc11312f407f0bbf107c5f20&req=ciMhF8B%2FlYhWFb4f3HP0gCeg%2FKGXp5qWVfNBvo5an0MFBLuYop1zlHnAqhWO%0ADudA9rGQ4Y0pU2e%2FIg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636191899/74f988aa0bc8d59b608e9448/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e3e6d10c193f32d2e19e34bf76fd0218132c44d0dc11312f407f0bbf107c5f20&req=ciMhF8B%2FlYhWFb4f3HP0gCeg%2FKGXp5qWVfNBvo5an0MFBLuYop1zlHnAqhWO%0ADudA9rGQ4Y0pU2e%2FIg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add Tag** to open the tags menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636192352/9c7bfc439d802b53f82a0a0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef607a7ed6b773f95fe80cff828477da3ce335a64b2cbef8d865f12d5c99c889&req=ciMhF8B8noRdFb4f3HP0gHu%2Feyar6bpgJyssUz9a4Mp5H98qQK8akQatFypK%0AjFxfOshWB4MXXKseXQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636192352/9c7bfc439d802b53f82a0a0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef607a7ed6b773f95fe80cff828477da3ce335a64b2cbef8d865f12d5c99c889&req=ciMhF8B8noRdFb4f3HP0gHu%2Feyar6bpgJyssUz9a4Mp5H98qQK8akQatFypK%0AjFxfOshWB4MXXKseXQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select the desired tag you want to be associated with this individual clinical note. In this example, we will use the **Ankle** tag.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636195971/5f16c81d558fe24838f4b336/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4636a67f519905dc40d9999c478cddd6c97d0059df5af58a963eec4d0c7d7a28&req=ciMhF8B7lIZeFb4f3HP0gGvo2nxHVNyMqWb%2BRAF%2FDCGMWJ2VqVuW4yk%2B217x%0AbsrsNaNtC7rvvtdkRw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636195971/5f16c81d558fe24838f4b336/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4636a67f519905dc40d9999c478cddd6c97d0059df5af58a963eec4d0c7d7a28&req=ciMhF8B7lIZeFb4f3HP0gGvo2nxHVNyMqWb%2BRAF%2FDCGMWJ2VqVuW4yk%2B217x%0AbsrsNaNtC7rvvtdkRw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save**, and the tag will be assigned to the clinical note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636196123/0ba620660a90e7c78739ecd4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc5170ce99c233b3d2be1e945645e9434b3d1d0d1d4ec95683deb6e75ab9f1e7&req=ciMhF8B4nINcFb4f3HP0gEhsx7W4KaO6oEt0kCbOflyaQV1OYW8XTxjsutYm%0ApM0FEs6y0is6seIbLg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636196123/0ba620660a90e7c78739ecd4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc5170ce99c233b3d2be1e945645e9434b3d1d0d1d4ec95683deb6e75ab9f1e7&req=ciMhF8B4nINcFb4f3HP0gEhsx7W4KaO6oEt0kCbOflyaQV1OYW8XTxjsutYm%0ApM0FEs6y0is6seIbLg%3D%3D%0A)

Adding a Referring Doctor to an Account

Adding a Referring Doctor to an Account
=======================================

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590929-adding-a-referring-doctor-to-an-account#h_c93d9b056b)

[Adding a Referring Doctor](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590929-adding-a-referring-doctor-to-an-account#h_c0e6783faf)

[Deleting/Marking Referrals as Inactive](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590929-adding-a-referring-doctor-to-an-account#h_871c98447e)

Overview
========

Referring Doctors allow for the tracking and reporting of Referrals via the [Reports > Patients > Referrals](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/referrals)
 report and can be required for submitting claims.

Adding a Referring Doctor
-------------------------

#### Step 1:

Go to the **Patient File > Accounts** tab and click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636202806/7a029e36b6231d807abd3742/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d2e06fc4e4f0f107570c2e1fda09aafbae59a07c0e460ecdd21ca37de77368f&req=ciMhFMl8lYFZFb4f3HP0gCBcpjbw9UbhVccW3uTMXkdZt3JuuK%2F%2B64bZTkhr%0AVQFK9QAVp4uhM%2BixMQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636202806/7a029e36b6231d807abd3742/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d2e06fc4e4f0f107570c2e1fda09aafbae59a07c0e460ecdd21ca37de77368f&req=ciMhFMl8lYFZFb4f3HP0gCBcpjbw9UbhVccW3uTMXkdZt3JuuK%2F%2B64bZTkhr%0AVQFK9QAVp4uhM%2BixMQ%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click **Add** under the **Referring Doctors** menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636203113/0f823da51dfd1b0d3104d85e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d4eb1053f83148c02ff4fddbcc50c7efd369503325e8bdeb1b7ec226c589bbe&req=ciMhFMl9nIBcFb4f3HP0gDAK36wHHbeiMHca7Y34r%2F7gSb0WMqOSmNNvnYw9%0A8ROXmdgBqI4ck%2Fx2rw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636203113/0f823da51dfd1b0d3104d85e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d4eb1053f83148c02ff4fddbcc50c7efd369503325e8bdeb1b7ec226c589bbe&req=ciMhFMl9nIBcFb4f3HP0gDAK36wHHbeiMHca7Y34r%2F7gSb0WMqOSmNNvnYw9%0A8ROXmdgBqI4ck%2Fx2rw%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Select the referring doctor from the dropdown menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636205073/c3d588ab51145b3a7b09c0ca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0acdc7a6afeb7d97c00a46a238b30c4a055e772504dd9df97ba589cbff38b007&req=ciMhFMl7nYZcFb4f3HP0gOtUnLCT2hbclt9S27otBEmzmeEg7J0zsB5p9Abw%0AbtM1Z%2FfKd2qkexdBkw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636205073/c3d588ab51145b3a7b09c0ca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0acdc7a6afeb7d97c00a46a238b30c4a055e772504dd9df97ba589cbff38b007&req=ciMhFMl7nYZcFb4f3HP0gOtUnLCT2hbclt9S27otBEmzmeEg7J0zsB5p9Abw%0AbtM1Z%2FfKd2qkexdBkw%3D%3D%0A)

If the referring doctor doesn't have a file, use the plus icon to create a new one.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636203328/8106b148834284235d225b0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b35ab1b1010a9c20b815422b19e1c8cfba303073a968ca97d9870c6dde944eca&req=ciMhFMl9noNXFb4f3HP0gGIeWKDnKtYK5AaG1CKOyRSQUN69CaYwX4Ye850e%0AGQRgJDKTxgXUM6PAhw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636203328/8106b148834284235d225b0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b35ab1b1010a9c20b815422b19e1c8cfba303073a968ca97d9870c6dde944eca&req=ciMhFMl9noNXFb4f3HP0gGIeWKDnKtYK5AaG1CKOyRSQUN69CaYwX4Ye850e%0AGQRgJDKTxgXUM6PAhw%3D%3D%0A)

You can find more information on creating Referring Doctors in this article: [Referring Doctors](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375704-referring-doctors)

#### Step 4:

Add the referral date and referral expiry. You can quickly set the referral expiry date with the **3 Month** and **12 Month** buttons.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636203587/82d08a4a980c8b4537d90a0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8811371b57e47275d617f35080f13f720618b8191e73af5345deef0c6446710&req=ciMhFMl9mIlYFb4f3HP0gInLZuoJz9aRALKqcClLQyrtRVyW9dvQgpTaeAU9%0AiUI5EBVeHQ5GT9swnA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636203587/82d08a4a980c8b4537d90a0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8811371b57e47275d617f35080f13f720618b8191e73af5345deef0c6446710&req=ciMhFMl9mIlYFb4f3HP0gInLZuoJz9aRALKqcClLQyrtRVyW9dvQgpTaeAU9%0AiUI5EBVeHQ5GT9swnA%3D%3D%0A)

Deleting/Marking Referrals as Inactive
--------------------------------------

Once a referral has been completed, you can Mark it as Inactive by unchecking the Active box while in Edit mode. This will keep the referral for record keeping but hide it from the list/

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1884431982/067ee8dd339350e614fcb33b2eb6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a1712b30f5a611aaa334ac684c5bf652d47e4c3234ce7651f32bafd13edc2cf&req=dSgvEs19nIhXW%2FMW1HO4zfxmIqN74qCG6%2FyMhzUwgDdaj%2BpZYjKi4nLiccWc%0ASeyx0xDyQnMD8UpsFtw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1884431982/067ee8dd339350e614fcb33b2eb6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a1712b30f5a611aaa334ac684c5bf652d47e4c3234ce7651f32bafd13edc2cf&req=dSgvEs19nIhXW%2FMW1HO4zfxmIqN74qCG6%2FyMhzUwgDdaj%2BpZYjKi4nLiccWc%0ASeyx0xDyQnMD8UpsFtw%3D%0A)

If the Referral is not needed, it can be deleted by clicking on the trash can icon on the right.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1884661473/96c195beacde39221754cf00d503/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5d2884eaf76dbfd23646885723745b77eb599728a729d108cf55de3e15311a66&req=dSgvEs94nIVYWvMW1HO4zaprnVwhm5E3J%2FjH9J8BVotJx8%2FrfcLikTQY2%2F3N%0A%2FzjNjh7%2FXLdjIxbEGlU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1884661473/96c195beacde39221754cf00d503/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5d2884eaf76dbfd23646885723745b77eb599728a729d108cf55de3e15311a66&req=dSgvEs94nIVYWvMW1HO4zaprnVwhm5E3J%2FjH9J8BVotJx8%2FrfcLikTQY2%2F3N%0A%2FzjNjh7%2FXLdjIxbEGlU%3D%0A)

## Document 109 — Linking Family Members | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-109}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590931-linking-family-members](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590931-linking-family-members)

Linking Family Members

Linking Family Members
======================

Updated over 3 years ago

Family members can be linked on patient files for quick referencing and group billing.

Ideally, you should start by opening the **parent's patient file**, selecting the **Contacts** menu and select **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636207663/160367d072b0e309c0dca8aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bf8b340225ecbb030a36f5b24b5cb81a3c251db3181b62f3f4b3f8600c0006e5&req=ciMhFMl5m4dcFb4f3HP0gFPfKDTzcPpnOt6xMlB%2F4ZX3N1ctNaVzfVLRNFpj%0AuYQjXTxgVin3JG2mvA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636207663/160367d072b0e309c0dca8aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bf8b340225ecbb030a36f5b24b5cb81a3c251db3181b62f3f4b3f8600c0006e5&req=ciMhFMl5m4dcFb4f3HP0gFPfKDTzcPpnOt6xMlB%2F4ZX3N1ctNaVzfVLRNFpj%0AuYQjXTxgVin3JG2mvA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add Family**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636208159/4f7dfb9af96dc080c12c7850/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=95763d0d18b48bc0dbc2623d45d35f05db5b128d9484784f20ba7d24c456f26c&req=ciMhFMl2nIRWFb4f3HP0gJ5jfUQUvkUpqewryB0QgFi5atdA5gyShmznrRmr%0AwMqlPgv0kDRtjoNHIg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636208159/4f7dfb9af96dc080c12c7850/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=95763d0d18b48bc0dbc2623d45d35f05db5b128d9484784f20ba7d24c456f26c&req=ciMhFMl2nIRWFb4f3HP0gJ5jfUQUvkUpqewryB0QgFi5atdA5gyShmznrRmr%0AwMqlPgv0kDRtjoNHIg%3D%3D%0A)

The search menu will open where you can search for an existing or new patient file belonging to the family member.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636208464/ca0232feddc6b12690696308/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=17d1c4f0852945f5c4eac4177c1941df58524846894e48913398344778b20ab4&req=ciMhFMl2mYdbFb4f3HP0gKvE1M%2FosPhDWHS93gQN5hKm6F8BzbqXOc1M3OC%2F%0AEYPURVV%2Biten7zMELg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636208464/ca0232feddc6b12690696308/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=17d1c4f0852945f5c4eac4177c1941df58524846894e48913398344778b20ab4&req=ciMhFMl2mYdbFb4f3HP0gKvE1M%2FosPhDWHS93gQN5hKm6F8BzbqXOc1M3OC%2F%0AEYPURVV%2Biten7zMELg%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting the family member's file, they will now be added to the list of family members.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636212265/4a6bab0dcdcaf847c11f055a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=538d33f39ff6911b686f3da967d288d8730f426bf1f6503804e2694e6df62633&req=ciMhFMh8n4daFb4f3HP0gDByUY8ce3nOdI9xCkMKUBDGSP7ZeExu%2FamirS98%0Avgg5EYWEii9pC3lTkg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636212265/4a6bab0dcdcaf847c11f055a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=538d33f39ff6911b686f3da967d288d8730f426bf1f6503804e2694e6df62633&req=ciMhFMh8n4daFb4f3HP0gDByUY8ce3nOdI9xCkMKUBDGSP7ZeExu%2FamirS98%0Avgg5EYWEii9pC3lTkg%3D%3D%0A)

The notes fields can be used to store additional information about family members and their relationship with one another.

On the main **Client Details** tab, links to family members' patient files will be displayed in the Family section. These links will be displayed on all family members' patient files.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636212921/973f2950b3145b1ce625e9af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0bd9375e396e983973245e7108674f64ebd63fb4232a75b3d435964b6a3aabcf&req=ciMhFMh8lINeFb4f3HP0gPpp9cujCuJbAJPunbZppPGaDVlUdzjI%2FJJGj0eV%0A5YtahTRiDMONkW%2FA4g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636212921/973f2950b3145b1ce625e9af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0bd9375e396e983973245e7108674f64ebd63fb4232a75b3d435964b6a3aabcf&req=ciMhFMh8lINeFb4f3HP0gPpp9cujCuJbAJPunbZppPGaDVlUdzjI%2FJJGj0eV%0A5YtahTRiDMONkW%2FA4g%3D%3D%0A)

In addition to simply storing links to family members, it is also possible to set up Family Billing and Family Online Booking. Click below for further details.

*   [Learn how to set up family billing here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing)
    
*   [Learn how to set up family online booking here.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6038416-online-family-bookings)
    

If creating a patient file for a family member is not appropriate, it is also possible to store contact information for family members and other related contacts, like case managers, as Contacts. [Learn how to create patient Contacts here.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613552-storing-non-family-contacts)

Using the Practitioner Queue

Using the Practitioner Queue
============================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Practitioner Queue for Admin Staff](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4593949-using-the-practitioner-queue#h_a097913572)

[Practitioner Queue for Practitioners](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4593949-using-the-practitioner-queue#h_d41cee90ba)

The Practitioner Queue displays a list of patient appointments where the appointment status has been set to 'arrived', 'in session' or any custom 'in queue' appointment statuses.

The Practitioner Queue can be accessed in two ways:

*   [Practitioner Queue for Admin Staff](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4593949-using-the-practitioner-queue#h_a097913572)
    
*   [Practitioner Queue for Practitioners](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4593949-using-the-practitioner-queue#h_d41cee90ba)
    

Practitioner Queue for Admin Staff
==================================

Admin staff members can access the practitioner queue in the bottom left-hand corner of the appointment book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592937049/bb1c4ff1b5df413bc9e63d83/CleanShot+2022-10-06+at+11.25.57.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8991c2b8cde9c72f424c9dd3c7769702663468ffdd78d707f6a359de7745c4ef&req=cSklH8p5nYVWFb4f3HP0gCgGCu7O1Xc2zf92s18bZ2AjGz%2Fo0mHzH1r6YBJD%0AhwHxRqtQSlXnUerbGA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592937049/bb1c4ff1b5df413bc9e63d83/CleanShot+2022-10-06+at+11.25.57.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8991c2b8cde9c72f424c9dd3c7769702663468ffdd78d707f6a359de7745c4ef&req=cSklH8p5nYVWFb4f3HP0gCgGCu7O1Xc2zf92s18bZ2AjGz%2Fo0mHzH1r6YBJD%0AhwHxRqtQSlXnUerbGA%3D%3D%0A)

Any appointments with an in queue status will be displayed in the list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592937099/3336f39d6eeed959db620980/CleanShot+2022-10-06+at+11.26.06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d56517229ebb5bcd49ea5c7555a248892c19c13a085e4c6f6f4e0c0a2e1c4e7&req=cSklH8p5nYhWFb4f3HP0gEDS7NZBeXYpazof%2B%2FQnGitFJ96TnBhsJgrhNCj8%0A4MC6fU2G09ihlzcQSg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592937099/3336f39d6eeed959db620980/CleanShot+2022-10-06+at+11.26.06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d56517229ebb5bcd49ea5c7555a248892c19c13a085e4c6f6f4e0c0a2e1c4e7&req=cSklH8p5nYhWFb4f3HP0gEDS7NZBeXYpazof%2B%2FQnGitFJ96TnBhsJgrhNCj8%0A4MC6fU2G09ihlzcQSg%3D%3D%0A)

Use the filter icon to choose which practitioners to display and how to group the list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592218205/f870fc18f849114fa35ebd62/CleanShot+2022-10-05+at+12.40.02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=898229e5323142675f5097855772a1a4268ea89a71fccbff2c6218d44d47e064&req=cSklFMh2n4FaFb4f3HP0gP%2BEznW4GPLnEOTnfgnzkDKjqF0jtigyh48Ze2ap%0AQvhom0Ch3KD%2FhhNSKg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592218205/f870fc18f849114fa35ebd62/CleanShot+2022-10-05+at+12.40.02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=898229e5323142675f5097855772a1a4268ea89a71fccbff2c6218d44d47e064&req=cSklFMh2n4FaFb4f3HP0gP%2BEznW4GPLnEOTnfgnzkDKjqF0jtigyh48Ze2ap%0AQvhom0Ch3KD%2FhhNSKg%3D%3D%0A)

Select Save to finalise your changes.

Practitioner Queue for Practitioners
====================================

The practitioner queue sits in the bottom right-hand corner of the PracSuite page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262071636/540209a896ead46ae8191b37/Screen+Shot+2020-11-03+at+9.44.10+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=933ac740dff4fdb19c9cad625ab8ba08d667295bce5204b254e61652e09e6368&req=diYlFs5%2Fm4JZFb4f3HP0gHGe5f%2BCnvkEpalwAEI6Pu2Nm%2BsrKVA3Ovn1wDsA%0A6MhTYpENfE3traF6lA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262071636/540209a896ead46ae8191b37/Screen+Shot+2020-11-03+at+9.44.10+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=933ac740dff4fdb19c9cad625ab8ba08d667295bce5204b254e61652e09e6368&req=diYlFs5%2Fm4JZFb4f3HP0gHGe5f%2BCnvkEpalwAEI6Pu2Nm%2BsrKVA3Ovn1wDsA%0A6MhTYpENfE3traF6lA%3D%3D%0A)

If you don't see this icon, confirm that the user account has been linked to their practitioner file.

To add a patient to the queue, set their appointment status to **Arrived** in the appointment book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262106141/ceafe33511d84c64417bc795/redoo.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=a2ef91ee7020656337d948d77712ef9f4c6cfd6b9bca234d27c67d46617ee42a&req=diYlF8l4nIVeFb4f3HP0gEzDXKnHTIMwWruZ2kOOPOvQ2eNabGVFODiXBVmO%0AOYTu3i7%2FWdz%2BzxyuSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262106141/ceafe33511d84c64417bc795/redoo.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=a2ef91ee7020656337d948d77712ef9f4c6cfd6b9bca234d27c67d46617ee42a&req=diYlF8l4nIVeFb4f3HP0gEzDXKnHTIMwWruZ2kOOPOvQ2eNabGVFODiXBVmO%0AOYTu3i7%2FWdz%2BzxyuSQ%3D%3D%0A)

Depending on the practitioner queue settings for an individual practitioner, a sound may be played or the queue will automatically open when a patient is added to the queue.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262106882/06cec733fdd2abb8a8a341a6/Screen+Shot+2020-11-03+at+9.59.03+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=090a28bf817ef0be3356d0cb4c38d32433e9b00f1631f2cdfb6a1ac0036bdc13&req=diYlF8l4lYldFb4f3HP0gNyl6jxYHocaTFeKtgduiIMEfFIkyi%2BHY2t6Aka0%0AwJJ5HkGwar%2FS6Z5wkw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262106882/06cec733fdd2abb8a8a341a6/Screen+Shot+2020-11-03+at+9.59.03+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=090a28bf817ef0be3356d0cb4c38d32433e9b00f1631f2cdfb6a1ac0036bdc13&req=diYlF8l4lYldFb4f3HP0gNyl6jxYHocaTFeKtgduiIMEfFIkyi%2BHY2t6Aka0%0AwJJ5HkGwar%2FS6Z5wkw%3D%3D%0A)

Clicking the **Settings** icon in the menubar will reveal options to customise alert notifications, change the order of the patients in the queue and set a default **Quick Action** when you click the patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262071634/af1e79406bd6c33ebf9babb4/Screen+Shot+2020-11-03+at+9.59.09+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=97cd40d5276986c73f61c9f95aeead50dbe3501354578fcdaba1ce91e9d2ebbb&req=diYlFs5%2Fm4JbFb4f3HP0gCeo3SfIxyEaK50AShsIap7GjPU2bLEDiQkszl%2BT%0A9ojCr86N2r1j3vPf1Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262071634/af1e79406bd6c33ebf9babb4/Screen+Shot+2020-11-03+at+9.59.09+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=97cd40d5276986c73f61c9f95aeead50dbe3501354578fcdaba1ce91e9d2ebbb&req=diYlFs5%2Fm4JbFb4f3HP0gCeo3SfIxyEaK50AShsIap7GjPU2bLEDiQkszl%2BT%0A9ojCr86N2r1j3vPf1Q%3D%3D%0A)

A **Quick Action** can be set when you click the patient name in the **Practitioner Queue** such as going directly to the patient's clinical notes, opening the patient file, viewing the appointment details, patient billing, rebooking an appointment or opening the action menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262107052/c2e9f30a72e543343f910b77/Screen+Shot+2020-11-03+at+10.04.14+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1440767f1dd34dc392b3d5098bc05b99f3e6a5b9685f8e59f02d3e124948a1bf&req=diYlF8l5nYRdFb4f3HP0gCSX9CGynfYxFWCY%2FuFrUBTo88E%2BINH2%2BUmdYBQp%0A%2FxGNxFy4wdPVHAc5Zw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/262107052/c2e9f30a72e543343f910b77/Screen+Shot+2020-11-03+at+10.04.14+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1440767f1dd34dc392b3d5098bc05b99f3e6a5b9685f8e59f02d3e124948a1bf&req=diYlF8l5nYRdFb4f3HP0gCSX9CGynfYxFWCY%2FuFrUBTo88E%2BINH2%2BUmdYBQp%0A%2FxGNxFy4wdPVHAc5Zw%3D%3D%0A)

Enabling Item Code Claim Options

Enabling Item Code Claim Options
================================

Updated over 2 years ago

In order to access integrated claiming functions, item codes must have appropriate claim options enabled.

Go to **[Settings > Billing > Item Codes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595593513/87a5df4e3831f39537649db3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1b64735b0dc479a80bfb3c58b61adfc111e6f7bcf98d13a6ad07e7de651620a1&req=cSkiE8B9mIBcFb4f3HP0gHWixgQViy7AA1h%2FYqedXwg%2FE6qjbW8XW6Zur2Ff%0AGJwVV3ectXMZCyTsiA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595593513/87a5df4e3831f39537649db3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1b64735b0dc479a80bfb3c58b61adfc111e6f7bcf98d13a6ad07e7de651620a1&req=cSkiE8B9mIBcFb4f3HP0gHWixgQViy7AA1h%2FYqedXwg%2FE6qjbW8XW6Zur2Ff%0AGJwVV3ectXMZCyTsiA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the item code you want to enable claim options on or click **Add** to create a new item code. If you're unsure of how to create a new item code, a guide can be found [here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317932-creating-item-codes)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595593789/bbec1849f864814b159b5258/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a1054815512a18aeab3bf2862a296d83ec56568cbd712ec53133a92beb77271&req=cSkiE8B9molWFb4f3HP0gDNXlezFMGmZ4kq7IAnc1%2FYG9JJbYfT6YpkzVERc%0AEljbskzYKMkRKLoZqg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595593789/bbec1849f864814b159b5258/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a1054815512a18aeab3bf2862a296d83ec56568cbd712ec53133a92beb77271&req=cSkiE8B9molWFb4f3HP0gDNXlezFMGmZ4kq7IAnc1%2FYG9JJbYfT6YpkzVERc%0AEljbskzYKMkRKLoZqg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Edit** to make changes to the item code.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595593947/fda84d0ba11acd7c6dea9118/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=759df114f37eb52f82866df77f3bbff6b2d95079b0a3bbaf7ca620e88b74701a&req=cSkiE8B9lIVYFb4f3HP0gKVbKPbJfo6%2Ftc94G%2FOKH4Butj3w1iVARi1%2BVKgM%0APEh6iPpgYBKbyW1Mqw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595593947/fda84d0ba11acd7c6dea9118/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=759df114f37eb52f82866df77f3bbff6b2d95079b0a3bbaf7ca620e88b74701a&req=cSkiE8B9lIVYFb4f3HP0gKVbKPbJfo6%2Ftc94G%2FOKH4Butj3w1iVARi1%2BVKgM%0APEh6iPpgYBKbyW1Mqw%3D%3D%0A)

Select the desired claim type and add override codes if required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595594328/f8ef62a960fee54581d9ea57/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28175f4332fd45cec6ae99b394106f573487311f60b1e7a1f891ba84af403ff5&req=cSkiE8B6noNXFb4f3HP0gG47rCI983ewfJNRLia%2FifGu8hKLDXPr%2F7SlcLSG%0AT5MGuxJZIKxWXdY%2F1w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595594328/f8ef62a960fee54581d9ea57/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28175f4332fd45cec6ae99b394106f573487311f60b1e7a1f891ba84af403ff5&req=cSkiE8B6noNXFb4f3HP0gG47rCI983ewfJNRLia%2FifGu8hKLDXPr%2F7SlcLSG%0AT5MGuxJZIKxWXdY%2F1w%3D%3D%0A)

Once created, click **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595594513/8053c5bf98dce1f6094a1bf7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c6889312e1c37ed4abdc8d3ff3e80f5489c920d20964b9080483dd8628eb686&req=cSkiE8B6mIBcFb4f3HP0gLyIGgcixOmJTOeYdFI%2BiPw2qiaqnMml7IdDe31F%0AdesDnkgaJlfjuO6WbQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595594513/8053c5bf98dce1f6094a1bf7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c6889312e1c37ed4abdc8d3ff3e80f5489c920d20964b9080483dd8628eb686&req=cSkiE8B6mIBcFb4f3HP0gLyIGgcixOmJTOeYdFI%2BiPw2qiaqnMml7IdDe31F%0AdesDnkgaJlfjuO6WbQ%3D%3D%0A)

When adding item codes to invoices, the relevant claim options will be available to engage the Tyro Health Online claiming process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595595168/669dab8e8ab2e512250f3c7d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32eb69d7a74ed3eeb0d8fae587d422242b999b8c5d8a16f71d79cd3046b2fd4c&req=cSkiE8B7nIdXFb4f3HP0gMHIun2Qq5%2F99NNyJ0Q2HUiboZx2gmncunnsGBD7%0AY6MvBBX%2BtPbD1UYw1g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595595168/669dab8e8ab2e512250f3c7d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32eb69d7a74ed3eeb0d8fae587d422242b999b8c5d8a16f71d79cd3046b2fd4c&req=cSkiE8B7nIdXFb4f3HP0gMHIun2Qq5%2F99NNyJ0Q2HUiboZx2gmncunnsGBD7%0AY6MvBBX%2BtPbD1UYw1g%3D%3D%0A)
