Creating Item Groups

Creating Item Groups
====================

Item Groups

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Creating Item Groups for Report Filtering](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4610658-creating-item-groups#h_6f3b9fd16b)

[Creating Item Groups for Invoicing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4610658-creating-item-groups#h_ecd3642bb6)

**Item Groups** are designed to collate multiple item codes from different schedules together for reporting purposes. Item Groups can also be enabled for invoicing, ideal for appointments that require multiple items to be billed.

Creating Item Groups for Report Filtering
=========================================

To create an Item Group, go to **[Settings > Billing > Item Groups](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/itemgroups)
.**

Click **Add** to create a new Item Group.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631939387/8bad979d607823e3d0d65097/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee117e52fca1187a35162556581985c18a41c9aa3ab64b5bf134817a423221ff&req=ciMmH8p3nolYFb4f3HP0gKEVpY7gLeHMSKU66%2F6f0ZeZ0p5b4CivRjojzHgj%0AXMDEYOp5gudK5irIpw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631939387/8bad979d607823e3d0d65097/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee117e52fca1187a35162556581985c18a41c9aa3ab64b5bf134817a423221ff&req=ciMmH8p3nolYFb4f3HP0gKEVpY7gLeHMSKU66%2F6f0ZeZ0p5b4CivRjojzHgj%0AXMDEYOp5gudK5irIpw%3D%3D%0A)

Enter the **Item Group Name**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631939536/fcc58db5eac98c34d67a0b0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=84f9aef27127dddb66959ad78f7fa744eaee5648ecac6f51ffc0df493a6dbb8e&req=ciMmH8p3mIJZFb4f3HP0gDV%2BExsd9HqDFK1A6GAJ5emytGkQzVYTnwSX6dGu%0AdLkCPumLyvl6aH0gnw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631939536/fcc58db5eac98c34d67a0b0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=84f9aef27127dddb66959ad78f7fa744eaee5648ecac6f51ffc0df493a6dbb8e&req=ciMmH8p3mIJZFb4f3HP0gDV%2BExsd9HqDFK1A6GAJ5emytGkQzVYTnwSX6dGu%0AdLkCPumLyvl6aH0gnw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add** and then select the item codes you wish to add to this group.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631939892/67c984ffac7be25bb46f67b4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bfd5b60b918e1c127ab2b1a84d75a1b38a0d6072bc23812a0312a61ab6a9674c&req=ciMmH8p3lYhdFb4f3HP0gEYzigAaYbHL5LihZfqsG7O8%2FBcozaIbTDyETEad%0Al9%2BRPxCqh3ibli6Qyw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631939892/67c984ffac7be25bb46f67b4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bfd5b60b918e1c127ab2b1a84d75a1b38a0d6072bc23812a0312a61ab6a9674c&req=ciMmH8p3lYhdFb4f3HP0gEYzigAaYbHL5LihZfqsG7O8%2FBcozaIbTDyETEad%0Al9%2BRPxCqh3ibli6Qyw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to create the new item group.

* * *

Creating Item Groups for Invoicing
==================================

Enable **Allow Item Group to be Invoiced** if you wish to add this item group to an invoice.

Use the Add button to select the item codes you with to add to the group. Note that an item can be added to the list multiple times, or the item quantity can be customised if appropriate.

Use the drag handle on the left of the grid to adjust the rank of each item.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/897671232/b350c65fb2c2aa771711a949/CleanShot+2023-12-01+at+08.26.06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b2675baa9b2102111fecc3ffb7ab539f7f41b5d95a39daa6388ef05fe8e3ec3&req=fCkgEM5%2Fn4JdFb4f3HP0gHt9ff5kVy7FtSrTpqAmfY7Fe8sFPS%2BCBGf%2Bik70%0Awme2RA6fCL2lZ706JA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/897671232/b350c65fb2c2aa771711a949/CleanShot+2023-12-01+at+08.26.06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b2675baa9b2102111fecc3ffb7ab539f7f41b5d95a39daa6388ef05fe8e3ec3&req=fCkgEM5%2Fn4JdFb4f3HP0gHt9ff5kVy7FtSrTpqAmfY7Fe8sFPS%2BCBGf%2Bik70%0Awme2RA6fCL2lZ706JA%3D%3D%0A)

Item groups can also be applied as the default item code for your Appointments Types. More about appointment type defaults can be [found here.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types#h_a8fcc8d4b4)

If an item group can be invoiced, it will appear in a dedicated Item Groups section of the item code drop down menu on the invoice screen.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896718399/0711962443cf131523b7a6a0/CleanShot+2023-11-30+at+11.13.35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d73d31c749c98fe1f3ae5dedd01e0d5473ad4112f7f470d83d65c6658af7baf0&req=fCkhEch2nohWFb4f3HP0gHllBp2PyJU7IccaAjTCPLtzgv%2BIQVK1LMhjtxPV%0AluE70TqziC%2BR2syFLg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896718399/0711962443cf131523b7a6a0/CleanShot+2023-11-30+at+11.13.35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d73d31c749c98fe1f3ae5dedd01e0d5473ad4112f7f470d83d65c6658af7baf0&req=fCkhEch2nohWFb4f3HP0gHllBp2PyJU7IccaAjTCPLtzgv%2BIQVK1LMhjtxPV%0AluE70TqziC%2BR2syFLg%3D%3D%0A)

[Patient File Management](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2601287-patient-file-management)

Patient Contacts and Relationships

Patient Contacts and Relationships
==================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Adding a Contact to a Patient File](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613552-patient-contacts-and-relationships#h_5fd58b9416)

[Adding a Linked Contact](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613552-patient-contacts-and-relationships#h_11e42efade)

[Contact Relationships & Merge Tags](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613552-patient-contacts-and-relationships#h_9b88c7d6c4)

Contacts can be added to patient files to record details of individuals related to a patient, such as next of kin, emergency contacts, case managers and more.

There are two types of Contact that can be added to a patient file:

*   **Contact -** Information must be added from scratch every single time when adding a Contact. Ideal for entering information for individuals that are related only to one specific patient.
    

*   **Linked Contact -** Information is pulled from existing Referrers, Payer Contacts and other Patient Files saving you from having to enter the information from scratch every time. Ideal for recording information for individuals that are added to multiple patient files.
    

**Adding a Contact to a Patient File**
======================================

To add a new contact open the **Patient File >** **Contacts** tab and select **Add Contact**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601955625/9c69888ff0c31f2b083f16e6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b24652d7a9277d0f80003e3621ea87dfa500bbda50315e20d9bad5cfff15f1cc&req=ciAmH8x7m4NaFb4f3HP0gEgYs5eV7etv9kGtysIGBf9x5PyIkWO6qkjPic%2BX%0AI3IDTJFIvtW7UHFCzQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601955625/9c69888ff0c31f2b083f16e6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b24652d7a9277d0f80003e3621ea87dfa500bbda50315e20d9bad5cfff15f1cc&req=ciAmH8x7m4NaFb4f3HP0gEgYs5eV7etv9kGtysIGBf9x5PyIkWO6qkjPic%2BX%0AI3IDTJFIvtW7UHFCzQ%3D%3D%0A)

Fill in the contact details in the provided areas and attach files as required. You'll also need to select the [Relationship](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/contactrelationships)
 this individual has with the patient and whether the contact relates to all accounts or a specific account. Selecting a Relationship will also define the Merge Tag, which allows you to automatically insert contact information in Letter, Email and SMS templates. [More on this below](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613552-patient-contacts-and-relationships#h_32137fa1d4)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601956102/5694e3ad53148985a2bbeeb4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1c91e9038dad322fdcb1fc12206355dbfbf396e0d7b3d11f755e5a7b48d73303&req=ciAmH8x4nIFdFb4f3HP0gOvTzaV7ytiOk7e3dohZ8hxvSPxVNJlCOzjLId%2FQ%0AIX%2FXVplfKIf2FZvIWg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601956102/5694e3ad53148985a2bbeeb4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1c91e9038dad322fdcb1fc12206355dbfbf396e0d7b3d11f755e5a7b48d73303&req=ciAmH8x4nIFdFb4f3HP0gOvTzaV7ytiOk7e3dohZ8hxvSPxVNJlCOzjLId%2FQ%0AIX%2FXVplfKIf2FZvIWg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

* * *

**Adding a Linked Contact**
===========================

To add a Linked Contact, use the **Add Linked Contact** button.

You can then search for another Patient file, Referring Doctor or a Third-Party Payer Contact.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601956427/1af9d957cbdeaf6d4ddf289d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e24c3210eac7b5e621d0c0af18c70c584f0828d0b5d30fd58c331c578aa77d8d&req=ciAmH8x4mYNYFb4f3HP0gBz72%2FMXRfdwWYxOs2Beq5z%2F4pQJ2DDcpt3vKVJu%0AR6GdvbeLsLIzEgzf%2Fg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601956427/1af9d957cbdeaf6d4ddf289d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e24c3210eac7b5e621d0c0af18c70c584f0828d0b5d30fd58c331c578aa77d8d&req=ciAmH8x4mYNYFb4f3HP0gBz72%2FMXRfdwWYxOs2Beq5z%2F4pQJ2DDcpt3vKVJu%0AR6GdvbeLsLIzEgzf%2Fg%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting the Linked Contact that you wish to add to the patient file, you'll see the new contact screen populated with the existing information for the Linked Contact.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601956751/9cf3281d5d1ab31ca27bd857/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eadea545a6dd373c17b4f001968410c257e865450cb1873d8f70e3d4e32bf125&req=ciAmH8x4moReFb4f3HP0gDD9BrspmqKAxEysG0CLkQxXrGrJTl6O8yjdVEdA%0A7Hr3gSJ6sWrMvaZUvA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601956751/9cf3281d5d1ab31ca27bd857/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eadea545a6dd373c17b4f001968410c257e865450cb1873d8f70e3d4e32bf125&req=ciAmH8x4moReFb4f3HP0gDD9BrspmqKAxEysG0CLkQxXrGrJTl6O8yjdVEdA%0A7Hr3gSJ6sWrMvaZUvA%3D%3D%0A)

You'll also need to select the [Relationship](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/contactrelationships)
 this individual has with the patient and whether the contact relates to all accounts or a specific account. Selecting a Relationship will also define the Merge Tag, which allows you to automatically insert contact information in Letter, Email and SMS templates. [More on this below](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613552-patient-contacts-and-relationships#h_32137fa1d4)
.

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

* * *

**Contact Relationships & Merge Tags**
======================================

As explained above, when adding Contacts and Linked Contacts to a patient file, you will need to select a [Contact Relationship](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/contactrelationships)
 to define their relation to the patient. In addition, each Relationship has a corresponding Merge Tag, which allows you to automatically insert contact information in Letter, Email and SMS templates.

Contact Relationships and their corresponding Merge Tags are managed in **[Settings > General > Contact Relationships](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/contactrelationships)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601957019/1d363d144c70aea7c373aa91/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db40d7c201b0504f846d0e7b62caa151299decc3032065f58836f9e63dbfbf81&req=ciAmH8x5nYBWFb4f3HP0gPFNZ7VFJOZbzvEtlrPzTv3ala9AKeL6J%2Fxjw4kx%0AfSaqwtqYf%2BAhGCVuJg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601957019/1d363d144c70aea7c373aa91/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db40d7c201b0504f846d0e7b62caa151299decc3032065f58836f9e63dbfbf81&req=ciAmH8x5nYBWFb4f3HP0gPFNZ7VFJOZbzvEtlrPzTv3ala9AKeL6J%2Fxjw4kx%0AfSaqwtqYf%2BAhGCVuJg%3D%3D%0A)

To insert details for these contacts in Letter, Email and SMS templates, find the Contacts drop-down list in the Patient Fields section, which will contain all your relationships.

Use the drop-down list to insert fields into your template as required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601957610/90998e593af4ec080991176b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=60d138a08733e339789c447d2bc9c1bd90c0313ede6b85f97a6f489fa32d203c&req=ciAmH8x5m4BfFb4f3HP0gI0V4BoZH%2FGlZcO2LXfyv%2FI8ta69RzHalm15Y%2By%2B%0AJj2D2%2BH9ZHEZZWmefA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601957610/90998e593af4ec080991176b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=60d138a08733e339789c447d2bc9c1bd90c0313ede6b85f97a6f489fa32d203c&req=ciAmH8x5m4BfFb4f3HP0gI0V4BoZH%2FGlZcO2LXfyv%2FI8ta69RzHalm15Y%2By%2B%0AJj2D2%2BH9ZHEZZWmefA%3D%3D%0A)

The example below shows an address block structure for our example Surgeon contact relationship.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/487000179/6e060ef71ce159070bb5f63c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2a52b0caf9ae14e058236cbf970042adeac56862e2006ad93a624fce24fd515&req=cCggFsl%2BnIZWFb4f3HP0gBqi6j3S57Q%2FlLb799KzkymYZLSqJ9sO17lAUjhS%0ADCHqTI10G%2Fpo9v6sEQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/487000179/6e060ef71ce159070bb5f63c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2a52b0caf9ae14e058236cbf970042adeac56862e2006ad93a624fce24fd515&req=cCggFsl%2BnIZWFb4f3HP0gBqi6j3S57Q%2FlLb799KzkymYZLSqJ9sO17lAUjhS%0ADCHqTI10G%2Fpo9v6sEQ%3D%3D%0A)

Note: When adding multiple contacts with the same relationship for the same account, a number will be added to the end of the Merge Tag as shown below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601957928/c9c418e49183d872a9f3a580/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=345828b1c491d0f823d48ec35a0115bd8e7d1b21fb17d1972ad9e8f0bc272597&req=ciAmH8x5lINXFb4f3HP0gOTWQNhGw9E2CUNkpIm1d6z%2B2GsvUbGnFH2NS4hs%0ACcEvtJADeZ1dUrdzNw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601957928/c9c418e49183d872a9f3a580/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=345828b1c491d0f823d48ec35a0115bd8e7d1b21fb17d1972ad9e8f0bc272597&req=ciAmH8x5lINXFb4f3HP0gOTWQNhGw9E2CUNkpIm1d6z%2B2GsvUbGnFH2NS4hs%0ACcEvtJADeZ1dUrdzNw%3D%3D%0A)

Enabling the Tyro Health Online Integration in PracSuite

Enabling the Tyro Health Online Integration in PracSuite
========================================================

An overview of the PracSuite Tyro Health Online integration and how to enable it's features in PracSuite.

Updated over 11 months ago

Table of contents

[Registering for a Tyro Health Online Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-enabling-the-tyro-health-online-integration-in-pracsuite#registering-for-a-medipass-account)

[Activating Tyro Health Online Features](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-enabling-the-tyro-health-online-integration-in-pracsuite#activating-medicare-dva-and-hicaps-go-claiming)

[Activate Payment Features](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-enabling-the-tyro-health-online-integration-in-pracsuite#h_4a91b1d89a)

[Activate Claiming Features](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-enabling-the-tyro-health-online-integration-in-pracsuite#h_93941c6948)

[Entering Your Tyro Health Online API Key into PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-enabling-the-tyro-health-online-integration-in-pracsuite#entering-your-api-key-)

PracSuite's integration with [Tyro Health Online](https://www.tyrohealth.com/online/)
 allows you to submit claims and process credit card payments directly from PracSuite. The integration allows you to manage the following:

### **Online Claiming**

*   Medicare [Bulk Bill](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5088324-how-to-submit-a-medicare-bulk-bill-claim-via-medipass)
     & [Patient Claims](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5088412-how-to-submit-a-medicare-patient-claim-via-medipass)
    
*   [DVA claims](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5947532-how-to-submit-a-dva-claim-via-medipass)
    
*   [Cardless private health claims](https://www.tyrohealth.com/insurers/healthpoint/)
    
*   [icare NSW](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5644625-icare-nsw-claiming-via-medipass)
    
*   [WorkCover QLD](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5638305-workcover-qld-claiming-via-medipass)
    
*   [Worksafe VIC](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284981-worksafe-victoria-claiming-via-medipass)
    
*   [Comcare](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284980-comcare-claiming-via-medipass)
    
*   [QBE](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10536221-qbe-claiming-via-tyro-health-online)
    

### **Online Payments**

*   [Accepting payments within PracSuite](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5129300-how-to-take-a-card-payment-via-medipass)
    
*   [Online Invoice Payment Links & QR Codes](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10694263-online-invoice-payment-links)
    
*   [Online booking payments](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5590695-setting-up-online-payments)
    
*   [Pre-payment links](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7889707-inserting-pre-payment-links-in-appointment-reminders)
    
*   [Payment Instalments](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8060044-medipass-payment-instalments)
    

**Registering for a Tyro Health Online Account**
================================================

Before configuring the Tyro Health Online integration in PracSuite, you will need to register for a Tyro Health Online account. [Click here to view a step-by-step guide on this process](https://help.medipass.com.au/en/articles/3193875-signing-up-for-medipass)
.

**Activating** Tyro **Health Online Features**
==============================================

To use the Tyro Health Online integration, your providers will also need to be registered to use each feature in Tyro Health Online. Once the provider registration process has been completed in Tyro Health Online, you will be able to use these functions via PracSuite.

Activate Payment Features
-------------------------

[Click here to view instructions on setting up online payment functionality via Tyro Health Online.](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/collections/2231435-tyro-health-online-payments-thop)

Ensure that you have entered [Tyro Health Online Payment Overrides](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6343623-tyro-health-online-payment-overrides)
 for each business. This will ensure your patients can proceed with paying online when there are configuration issues with the practitioner provider number.

Activate Claiming Features
--------------------------

The links below direct to Tyro Health's help articles on how to set up and configure the various claiming features in Tyro Health. Once configured in Tyro Health, they can be used via the PracSuite integration.

**PracSuite and Tyro match practitioners based on their provider numbers. Ensure that the provider number entered on your PracSuite practitioner files matches the provider numbers entered into your Tyro Health Online account.**

*   [Click here to view instructions on how to activate Medicare and DVA claiming via Tyro Health Online](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/4064976-activating-medicare-and-dva-claiming-in-tyro-health-online)
    
*   [Click here to view instructions on how to activate Health Fund claiming via Tyro Health Online](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/2853197-private-health-claiming-without-a-terminal)
    
*   [Click here to view instructions on how to activate WorkCover Queensland claiming via Tyro Health Online](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/4824343-enable-workcover-queensland-digital-claims)
    
*   [Click here to view instructions on how to activate WorkSafe Victoria claiming via Tyro Health Online](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/5545029-introduction-to-worksafe-victoria-online-invoicing)
    
*   [Click here to view instructions on how to activate Comcare claiming via Tyro Health Online](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/5740276-introduction-to-comcare-digital-invoicing)
    
*   [Click here to view instructions on how to activate icare NSW claiming via Tyro Health Online](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/6168028-introduction-to-icare-digital-invoicing)
    
*   [Click here to view instructions on how to activate QBE claiming via Tyro Health Online](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/8682877-introduction-to-qbe-digital-invoicing)
    

**Entering Your Tyro Health Online API Key into PracSuite**
===========================================================

Once you've registered for a Tyro Health Online account, you will need to generate an API to enter into PracSuite. [Click here to learn how to generate a Tyro Health Online API key](https://help.medipass.com.au/en/articles/1142164-how-to-generate-a-medipass-api-key)
.

Once you have your API key, go to **[Settings > Integrations > Tyro Health Online](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/tyrohealthonline)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861260702/f57390afb2c4f0d2a369b4f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=20b6d7de495924aec1fcd5ceeda2ca9f72873ecf2a101834b9e809a2ec589028&req=fCYmFM9%2BmoFdFb4f3HP0gBZe3IXwnHB%2F57Qqay%2B333o0hGSWP8KFk4Kyfel6%0Avl6WL3KMy2VJnscACw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861260702/f57390afb2c4f0d2a369b4f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=20b6d7de495924aec1fcd5ceeda2ca9f72873ecf2a101834b9e809a2ec589028&req=fCYmFM9%2BmoFdFb4f3HP0gBZe3IXwnHB%2F57Qqay%2B333o0hGSWP8KFk4Kyfel6%0Avl6WL3KMy2VJnscACw%3D%3D%0A)

**Enable** the Tyro Health Online integration and click the **Add** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861260989/d0d05e64880e55627fb8a050/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=764ba6267a813a16f366a927110d5be7976e22edfd85e57fe03aee93dc96cfa7&req=fCYmFM9%2BlIlWFb4f3HP0gGP5jd3LqY21k9xj9E8Mji9nD88v4LMExZcxxopl%0AZbcZ9rCisgvYbetrqg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861260989/d0d05e64880e55627fb8a050/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=764ba6267a813a16f366a927110d5be7976e22edfd85e57fe03aee93dc96cfa7&req=fCYmFM9%2BlIlWFb4f3HP0gGP5jd3LqY21k9xj9E8Mji9nD88v4LMExZcxxopl%0AZbcZ9rCisgvYbetrqg%3D%3D%0A)

Enter your **API key** in the box provided.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861261087/e5d6ae8ca2472989125b534a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d4af3880ec600a887a547dfec2d4c93d8e9f9e5c45c4d0f8be4850534a641ba8&req=fCYmFM9%2FnYlYFb4f3HP0gObhmCbvzTy%2F6OHHT18Vvljv2cW3%2Fz4PHHOIIh%2Bp%0A3y0NDZWbQyxBOctvGA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861261087/e5d6ae8ca2472989125b534a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d4af3880ec600a887a547dfec2d4c93d8e9f9e5c45c4d0f8be4850534a641ba8&req=fCYmFM9%2FnYlYFb4f3HP0gObhmCbvzTy%2F6OHHT18Vvljv2cW3%2Fz4PHHOIIh%2Bp%0A3y0NDZWbQyxBOctvGA%3D%3D%0A)

You will now be able to select which Tyro Health Online features you wish to use via PracSuite, as well as assign businesses to each API key. If you have a multiple business setup in PracSuite that have their own Tyro Health Online accounts, be sure to only select the businesses relevant to each API key.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861261498/1127292409bcd629cf63898d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=004663bfa9f778ea2744780ac172cec9e07b97ac6b70e4be5f69fba5abcb2e81&req=fCYmFM9%2FmYhXFb4f3HP0gGv2qk6U9EeJonNUKc5VShkAanQ%2FVVvUAOv%2F3WKR%0Atfo6GNO0yWYVS2ug9Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861261498/1127292409bcd629cf63898d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=004663bfa9f778ea2744780ac172cec9e07b97ac6b70e4be5f69fba5abcb2e81&req=fCYmFM9%2FmYhXFb4f3HP0gGv2qk6U9EeJonNUKc5VShkAanQ%2FVVvUAOv%2F3WKR%0Atfo6GNO0yWYVS2ug9Q%3D%3D%0A)

Psychologists and Speech Pathologists that submit DVA claims with a duration will also need to enable the options as below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601958862/c061e801c2a2c501e7eb6490/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b976c72d1ba490003ca5416f7e4e24443bbceaa5e68f55533212c7dd5920a356&req=ciAmH8x2lYddFb4f3HP0gBrp7G2oLFY6tKA1AjH%2F3HcgSRdiGqTChLoyPDG5%0A3pp2c9q6pLfSKVbsMQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601958862/c061e801c2a2c501e7eb6490/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b976c72d1ba490003ca5416f7e4e24443bbceaa5e68f55533212c7dd5920a356&req=ciAmH8x2lYddFb4f3HP0gBrp7G2oLFY6tKA1AjH%2F3HcgSRdiGqTChLoyPDG5%0A3pp2c9q6pLfSKVbsMQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

## Document 117 — Printing and Emailing an Appointment Schedule for a Patient | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-117}

Printing and Emailing an Appointment Schedule for a Patient

Printing and Emailing an Appointment Schedule for a Patient
===========================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

To generate an appointment schedule for a patient, go to their **Patient File > Appointments tab**.

Select the **Client/Patient Schedule** button at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595597470/e6c050b3d907db5f0734e329/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ba723e8c401dce7c6f6a2d27f79b94f9168b0951af9e18dda58a8c23f622e42&req=cSkiE8B5mYZfFb4f3HP0gJjWSHkJBZJZtRDJgwVUIUo%2F8Le4rW%2Bn%2FV%2BJpXOY%0AVa4ockMlmrQ2sQvRvA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595597470/e6c050b3d907db5f0734e329/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ba723e8c401dce7c6f6a2d27f79b94f9168b0951af9e18dda58a8c23f622e42&req=cSkiE8B5mYZfFb4f3HP0gJjWSHkJBZJZtRDJgwVUIUo%2F8Le4rW%2Bn%2FV%2BJpXOY%0AVa4ockMlmrQ2sQvRvA%3D%3D%0A)

By default, an appointment schedule will contain all future appointments. Use the filters to change the default settings as required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595597619/5dcbdd317b0f26cb61816c83/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6191e2dcd011e21ee1c41ecb339dea362c9c494d65d2b7193f70963bfcf6f5a4&req=cSkiE8B5m4BWFb4f3HP0gMlIMzlqeHmZk0Q%2BDaIRiX2Fo8dNtTijEr59DFI8%0AkPtPeMHGjKjrYAGJWg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595597619/5dcbdd317b0f26cb61816c83/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6191e2dcd011e21ee1c41ecb339dea362c9c494d65d2b7193f70963bfcf6f5a4&req=cSkiE8B5m4BWFb4f3HP0gMlIMzlqeHmZk0Q%2BDaIRiX2Fo8dNtTijEr59DFI8%0AkPtPeMHGjKjrYAGJWg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Print & Email** button, or use the drop-down menu to select from other options.

Setting Default Invoice Due Date Preferences

Setting Default Invoice Due Date Preferences
============================================

Updated over 3 years ago

To set invoice due date default preferences, go to **[Settings > Billing > Billing](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/list)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594945669/e6793b1cec6646be8f077086/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5b122c5a9f0b0e7d03c27bccbf2dd5f8b098c5a33ee94429f66966cc781fed6&req=cSkjH817m4dWFb4f3HP0gLDKSuzLt1vdw8T12kNxuHSD8MntczQ7xxwOcf%2Fw%0A8ssuJNq0KYA3%2B7MwcA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594945669/e6793b1cec6646be8f077086/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5b122c5a9f0b0e7d03c27bccbf2dd5f8b098c5a33ee94429f66966cc781fed6&req=cSkjH817m4dWFb4f3HP0gLDKSuzLt1vdw8T12kNxuHSD8MntczQ7xxwOcf%2Fw%0A8ssuJNq0KYA3%2B7MwcA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Edit** to make changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594945843/d12b37be159c51ecf4f9f76e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=718cf50f5eb47fbd4052f1d56482ce726c7fa743c406d96abc98facc92f62d7d&req=cSkjH817lYVcFb4f3HP0gFAGy%2FBDEYHK%2FWsCbQWBUcv9dGlDOvRx1lMyMOuf%0AQxIILG3Ft7Hba52New%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594945843/d12b37be159c51ecf4f9f76e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=718cf50f5eb47fbd4052f1d56482ce726c7fa743c406d96abc98facc92f62d7d&req=cSkjH817lYVcFb4f3HP0gFAGy%2FBDEYHK%2FWsCbQWBUcv9dGlDOvRx1lMyMOuf%0AQxIILG3Ft7Hba52New%3D%3D%0A)

Navigate to the **Invoicing Defaults** section and use the drop-down menu to select your default invoice due date.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594945992/04730688b0dc27df4e802c43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ffcbbbee38402c7277166507e6632bf53aea3934fd6dfe1028bbd5f87bfe565b&req=cSkjH817lIhdFb4f3HP0gCLOuSY%2BMQDynJ5p%2FrqdD8d7buChv7TlH6kzGjyl%0AMsK399Kfz3Fa2EynuA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594945992/04730688b0dc27df4e802c43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ffcbbbee38402c7277166507e6632bf53aea3934fd6dfe1028bbd5f87bfe565b&req=cSkjH817lIhdFb4f3HP0gCLOuSY%2BMQDynJ5p%2FrqdD8d7buChv7TlH6kzGjyl%0AMsK399Kfz3Fa2EynuA%3D%3D%0A)

It is also possible to enable automatic updating of the invoice date to the issued date when printing or emailing invoices.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594946383/66fceddd9154789784ee3c3e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=086f60bbce7d54b096ce25a7400d639f6147cae310925c77966fbe61e4169c21&req=cSkjH814nolcFb4f3HP0gF1bC6uOxe9iy2%2BST31jrvYrUHcDuNsuTzviivY9%0AbyDSyzZWubMqsbiH0A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594946383/66fceddd9154789784ee3c3e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=086f60bbce7d54b096ce25a7400d639f6147cae310925c77966fbe61e4169c21&req=cSkjH814nolcFb4f3HP0gF1bC6uOxe9iy2%2BST31jrvYrUHcDuNsuTzviivY9%0AbyDSyzZWubMqsbiH0A%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save**. The default invoice due date will now automatically be set on all patient invoices.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594946481/e44502188816a4c353b6ea74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=89782f7248b964b6f00c63401065ee54812e314e5c3eb1ae0d64736eb184e57a&req=cSkjH814mYleFb4f3HP0gHJ9KsfV%2B7qblYS1fgnnZT%2FJsKAxVoj7N1OzAheh%0Atg0eQ4I4%2FkSzsRZdQg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594946481/e44502188816a4c353b6ea74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=89782f7248b964b6f00c63401065ee54812e314e5c3eb1ae0d64736eb184e57a&req=cSkjH814mYleFb4f3HP0gHJ9KsfV%2B7qblYS1fgnnZT%2FJsKAxVoj7N1OzAheh%0Atg0eQ4I4%2FkSzsRZdQg%3D%3D%0A)

It is also possible to manually change the invoice due date from the invoice screen if required by using the due date drop-down menu on the right-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594948489/18dec2f7e5ad31eb38488deb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a1cff46066e58ada19be93e4d971b8c87c9d857dc8537314cde37aa230318fc2&req=cSkjH812mYlWFb4f3HP0gBGtkoGbcc3Cfc%2Bb7a0jvLY8XKgUSceC6VrDX%2FCo%0AANWkWXswZq835BleUw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594948489/18dec2f7e5ad31eb38488deb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a1cff46066e58ada19be93e4d971b8c87c9d857dc8537314cde37aa230318fc2&req=cSkjH812mYlWFb4f3HP0gBGtkoGbcc3Cfc%2Bb7a0jvLY8XKgUSceC6VrDX%2FCo%0AANWkWXswZq835BleUw%3D%3D%0A)

**Creating Clinical Note Templates**
====================================

To create Clinical Note Templates navigate to **[Settings > Clinical Notes > Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/clinicalnotes/templates/list)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/269162889/5b8febe0a9bb9a8e9de0f286/Screen+Shot+2020-11-23+at+3.34.02+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91e4be261cc7aee540cf946ef87f47cfbfe3dddd3d332b7b75b614746e7b01ee&req=diYuF898lYlWFb4f3HP0gPWsHPfkCh%2FVm06UskdeSdtun0ExDnFrdbRH02a1%0ARb2vppLPz3z4lRnJbA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/269162889/5b8febe0a9bb9a8e9de0f286/Screen+Shot+2020-11-23+at+3.34.02+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91e4be261cc7aee540cf946ef87f47cfbfe3dddd3d332b7b75b614746e7b01ee&req=diYuF898lYlWFb4f3HP0gPWsHPfkCh%2FVm06UskdeSdtun0ExDnFrdbRH02a1%0ARb2vppLPz3z4lRnJbA%3D%3D%0A)

All existing Clinical Note Templates will be displayed on this page, where they can be clicked on for editing.  
​  
Click **Add Template** to create a new template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485327827/c2fcdf465e3250179ddae6c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9bb0212aa5819cf61bbf0dcf75db18a093ba4d4c952aa5e5ce40116cc5d4d9e6&req=cCgiFct5lYNYFb4f3HP0gOUxxpez%2BQhejt6F50kbAUF9ENg2cPqalh9zrhHo%0AzXb%2B9UJIXdgA8Qlnag%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485327827/c2fcdf465e3250179ddae6c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9bb0212aa5819cf61bbf0dcf75db18a093ba4d4c952aa5e5ce40116cc5d4d9e6&req=cCgiFct5lYNYFb4f3HP0gOUxxpez%2BQhejt6F50kbAUF9ENg2cPqalh9zrhHo%0AzXb%2B9UJIXdgA8Qlnag%3D%3D%0A)

To begin, please enter a **Name** for the template. If applicable you can also select a **Folder** for the template to be stored inside, and add any applicable **Tags**. Tags can be used to categorise notes for easy identification and filtering.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485328179/2f6c1ac9cc23b1e38ed6952e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=052f4b65693c95006ae68c112a16103712619e312496598542fc8ec249026d3e&req=cCgiFct2nIZWFb4f3HP0gJdrDE8Oei9pOGJJfKCbz3nwJTbb1BEx9U6yUSvf%0AsLyEJMRC7CAkYaDlaA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485328179/2f6c1ac9cc23b1e38ed6952e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=052f4b65693c95006ae68c112a16103712619e312496598542fc8ec249026d3e&req=cCgiFct2nIZWFb4f3HP0gJdrDE8Oei9pOGJJfKCbz3nwJTbb1BEx9U6yUSvf%0AsLyEJMRC7CAkYaDlaA%3D%3D%0A)

Next, click **Add To Note**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485328660/8c60ab99ea24fe25fac39901/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26ff2235f0e863aedd32c4aafed5b7dd2458ea4feae69c9ef6e0db644daaa007&req=cCgiFct2m4dfFb4f3HP0gHAydo4ht7ooz89%2BwuAWTEK%2FHDQhKBFEqUNZsnmU%0AlFeu1wfiq6ew2wiHPQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485328660/8c60ab99ea24fe25fac39901/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26ff2235f0e863aedd32c4aafed5b7dd2458ea4feae69c9ef6e0db644daaa007&req=cCgiFct2m4dfFb4f3HP0gHAydo4ht7ooz89%2BwuAWTEK%2FHDQhKBFEqUNZsnmU%0AlFeu1wfiq6ew2wiHPQ%3D%3D%0A)

This will display a list of **Components**, which can be added to the template.

You can add any combination of components you need to build your clinical note template. For example, a basic template might be a combination of **Header**, **Rich Text** and **Body Chart** components.

If needed you can then pre-fill text and other information within these components, including text, images, tables and clinical symbols.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485328755/fb43ec1d1964704f51d2fd3a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=718607b57dc9a5c0961b3bb2b74935935b0c374096a36562272e2048922975d6&req=cCgiFct2moRaFb4f3HP0gKB2l1R3oQM6KCAbTXXUApy1cOzQ29BPZDsMp7G3%0AhHpbh7vxw%2FkBDX1iNw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485328755/fb43ec1d1964704f51d2fd3a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=718607b57dc9a5c0961b3bb2b74935935b0c374096a36562272e2048922975d6&req=cCgiFct2moRaFb4f3HP0gKB2l1R3oQM6KCAbTXXUApy1cOzQ29BPZDsMp7G3%0AhHpbh7vxw%2FkBDX1iNw%3D%3D%0A)

Select one or more components to add to your template, then click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/269166440/a868b658dd601d2a0730bd67/clinicalnotestemplate.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=2c34b4a380114380e04cffa60bc03bf7a0502398f2ee74f84e64bca30b299e1c&req=diYuF894mYVfFb4f3HP0gP7POqBqM1ZVnvCo5sWBlfsvfMUnIthNPDGaKTdT%0At6It5ytI%2BbrPxF1PqA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/269166440/a868b658dd601d2a0730bd67/clinicalnotestemplate.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=2c34b4a380114380e04cffa60bc03bf7a0502398f2ee74f84e64bca30b299e1c&req=diYuF894mYVfFb4f3HP0gP7POqBqM1ZVnvCo5sWBlfsvfMUnIthNPDGaKTdT%0At6It5ytI%2BbrPxF1PqA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Basic Components**
====================

Below are some of the main components used within Clinical Note Templates:

**Header**  
The Header component is used to title your template or sections of your template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485334440/6e4e809e63746bcc4977de0e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f5964363bf0e6a7e050119cb0e69912c19454ec855dade1a628b320672343a2c&req=cCgiFcp6mYVfFb4f3HP0gBGvOgm83YONQfcNgHjdn4s1DNybsmhoZOvQq%2BcY%0A0lXEZ1bxqdJr8TfzbQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485334440/6e4e809e63746bcc4977de0e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f5964363bf0e6a7e050119cb0e69912c19454ec855dade1a628b320672343a2c&req=cCgiFcp6mYVfFb4f3HP0gBGvOgm83YONQfcNgHjdn4s1DNybsmhoZOvQq%2BcY%0A0lXEZ1bxqdJr8TfzbQ%3D%3D%0A)

Rich Text
---------

The Rich Text component is a simple text field, where the text can then be formatted as needed. Any images, text or tables entered into this field will be stored with the template and appear upon using this template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485334754/73c5ff474e747a3cf5c6ae74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6ea413b832a986bb23ba8f7cb1b4908f438b1c9dd0a90fa705f8168a3ffb7ab&req=cCgiFcp6moRbFb4f3HP0gMfmIThRyKo1q7wtVoIgSS9QvKG00D6786LVkfbB%0AsNFzthL1wcf22DK7zA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485334754/73c5ff474e747a3cf5c6ae74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6ea413b832a986bb23ba8f7cb1b4908f438b1c9dd0a90fa705f8168a3ffb7ab&req=cCgiFcp6moRbFb4f3HP0gMfmIThRyKo1q7wtVoIgSS9QvKG00D6786LVkfbB%0AsNFzthL1wcf22DK7zA%3D%3D%0A)

**Body Chart**
--------------

The Body Chart is a graphical component with various charts to choose from.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/356334685/7a814d04b8eeeb3f4eea848a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd27262023dad7e3a8b956d54f7482747c8eba05cd6135032ee3020c01d63502&req=dyUhFcp6m4laFb4f3HP0gIYes0CbxKkUEP3LtfOJ7upLxPLk5hjAocg4RkVj%0A5jNLMF4JdI8lCDf8fg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/356334685/7a814d04b8eeeb3f4eea848a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd27262023dad7e3a8b956d54f7482747c8eba05cd6135032ee3020c01d63502&req=dyUhFcp6m4laFb4f3HP0gIYes0CbxKkUEP3LtfOJ7upLxPLk5hjAocg4RkVj%0A5jNLMF4JdI8lCDf8fg%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting a body chart the graphic will appear in your clinical note template, where you can then use the various tools to mark the chart in appropriate areas.

The 'Label' feature is especially useful, as it allows you to number areas of the body and enter corresponding text with more detail.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/362164046/ebc6388bf8d7cf9bac9c5538/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=74c3d1aed75ca001beec9c4992f1199c528c75d32858be2a7f3baca105f48d01&req=dyYlF896nYVZFb4f3HP0gK6Xav%2BplhNGp3kJhFQ6NI%2FfzjTlaitlbsdTyg7X%0AFmZtEvQTaW1s9rWDfw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/362164046/ebc6388bf8d7cf9bac9c5538/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=74c3d1aed75ca001beec9c4992f1199c528c75d32858be2a7f3baca105f48d01&req=dyYlF896nYVZFb4f3HP0gK6Xav%2BplhNGp3kJhFQ6NI%2FfzjTlaitlbsdTyg7X%0AFmZtEvQTaW1s9rWDfw%3D%3D%0A)

**Spine Chart**
---------------

The Spine Chart is a component that combines a spine graphic and aligned text fields for each section of spine, allowing for specific assessment and adjustment notes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485334167/77529a976f7398f2e574cf80/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0d3bc3b6624341e22e7bd3e3064d1daa572d60450b0ea40f54321655c94bd386&req=cCgiFcp6nIdYFb4f3HP0gL1tkDEyhBgCFTZ3BQOfiqGW6wgA%2FOaQ432yVBGO%0AKN%2F8nrmz%2B7crDThbGw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485334167/77529a976f7398f2e574cf80/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0d3bc3b6624341e22e7bd3e3064d1daa572d60450b0ea40f54321655c94bd386&req=cCgiFcp6nIdYFb4f3HP0gL1tkDEyhBgCFTZ3BQOfiqGW6wgA%2FOaQ432yVBGO%0AKN%2F8nrmz%2B7crDThbGw%3D%3D%0A)

Chart allows to input a line of text for every section of the spine allowing for detailed assessment of a patients spine.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/378313401/64ed6e533d9c69d83b084dea/Image_Test_Anim.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=4aad307d95ec24a69eb7e0c00e7162e3c30aa43485005f5923adf3b840a89b7a&req=dycvFch9mYFeFb4f3HP0gEUT6jLqa2q74lIObMF1vlHC5c891FcWhc2FGs9F%0A32WCduDXQSM0zhKhFQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/378313401/64ed6e533d9c69d83b084dea/Image_Test_Anim.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=4aad307d95ec24a69eb7e0c00e7162e3c30aa43485005f5923adf3b840a89b7a&req=dycvFch9mYFeFb4f3HP0gEUT6jLqa2q74lIObMF1vlHC5c891FcWhc2FGs9F%0A32WCduDXQSM0zhKhFQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Image**
---------

The Image component allows users to browse for a graphic on their computer, which can then marked with the various tools available (stamps, labels, circles etc).

**Advanced Components**
=======================

Advanced Components give users the ability to add form-like features into your **Templates**.

**Drop down List**
------------------

In order to add a **Drop down List**, in the **Add To Notes** list, under the **_Advanced Components_** section, click **Drop down List**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/376191872/5110a2c3b45481d785ffdecf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=844411cf086ddf6275463474e9f3ae4daf5f41655216fc18b94a5bc1110be9c1&req=dychF8B%2FlYZdFb4f3HP0gEH8A7V1nyXk7QDBONAnOsvjjNoMyswMdApq%2FSfz%0AtbFUW9BsQTwnKaAlEQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/376191872/5110a2c3b45481d785ffdecf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=844411cf086ddf6275463474e9f3ae4daf5f41655216fc18b94a5bc1110be9c1&req=dychF8B%2FlYZdFb4f3HP0gEH8A7V1nyXk7QDBONAnOsvjjNoMyswMdApq%2FSfz%0AtbFUW9BsQTwnKaAlEQ%3D%3D%0A)

This allows you to create a list of selectable items that you can add to your template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/376192124/12cf6472cf87e5beb776197d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9e67b3867b671ad58a28af69d64a05dbae6e7351efb56ca34750abaa9043b87a&req=dychF8B8nINbFb4f3HP0gH5kr0G7M7wyq3ItOujdYlmgtfMwZjbaH1I3xwQF%0At7Q4P9Aa6NVdg2Xg%2BQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/376192124/12cf6472cf87e5beb776197d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9e67b3867b671ad58a28af69d64a05dbae6e7351efb56ca34750abaa9043b87a&req=dychF8B8nINbFb4f3HP0gH5kr0G7M7wyq3ItOujdYlmgtfMwZjbaH1I3xwQF%0At7Q4P9Aa6NVdg2Xg%2BQ%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/376736430/456ba6fed48294993ef0a3ab/DDL_Anim.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=16b99987fa3649926d57eee9aac3fc7033beee602fde2774e695e149d2bba93d&req=dychEcp4mYJfFb4f3HP0gM4JolqTBWKSFCpsmIvXNhVHzMGXUcoYNkgZ3m5g%0Aw5uPvW%2FapYCMr0JEcg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/376736430/456ba6fed48294993ef0a3ab/DDL_Anim.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=16b99987fa3649926d57eee9aac3fc7033beee602fde2774e695e149d2bba93d&req=dychEcp4mYJfFb4f3HP0gM4JolqTBWKSFCpsmIvXNhVHzMGXUcoYNkgZ3m5g%0Aw5uPvW%2FapYCMr0JEcg%3D%3D%0A)

**Multiple Choice**
-------------------

The Multiple Choice component allow users to select one or more options from a list.  
This could be a list of symptoms or affected areas, for example.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/378313959/dc8f898e87e648624368689e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=020c9500233b6a6699cef4915e3e177c32e999992d4e6c175fd3247b16b93681&req=dycvFch9lIRWFb4f3HP0gAVqhbSMrc4LPbnJA5HwX4bMGRrvDDywLnkkgLWS%0ATiFza0iLYL89usm9CQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/378313959/dc8f898e87e648624368689e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=020c9500233b6a6699cef4915e3e177c32e999992d4e6c175fd3247b16b93681&req=dycvFch9lIRWFb4f3HP0gAVqhbSMrc4LPbnJA5HwX4bMGRrvDDywLnkkgLWS%0ATiFza0iLYL89usm9CQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Single Choice**
-----------------

The Single Choice component allow users to select one item from a list of multiple options. This is often used in 'Yes' or 'No' scenarios where the answer can only be one of the other, but not both.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/378314259/694d8ffbae5bb7be790318ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0c32396588590001b5e813976922358ae8c1c8a6d6919637ff8b6cce6a3d77a2&req=dycvFch6n4RWFb4f3HP0gMZqWBSLnbnUAXZiE8%2Fg4DwpVLmrinRn2c6GCbfh%0AyzBmp5tJ1nhytG0JFg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/378314259/694d8ffbae5bb7be790318ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0c32396588590001b5e813976922358ae8c1c8a6d6919637ff8b6cce6a3d77a2&req=dycvFch6n4RWFb4f3HP0gMZqWBSLnbnUAXZiE8%2Fg4DwpVLmrinRn2c6GCbfh%0AyzBmp5tJ1nhytG0JFg%3D%3D%0A)

**Number**
----------

The Number component allows users to set a range of numbers to display on a scale. For example this could be a pain scale from 1 to 10.  
​  
In this case we are setting a minimum score of 1, and a maximum of 10.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/376710660/7ec5daebc6cf954f1bc343a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9fb44acce88f67263aa068c7790223f653c9d82314f5e29c8df9f82aedaeda06&req=dychEch%2Bm4dfFb4f3HP0gFORVPz1R3LrNbqvXlnMRylmrk1GplvelbDdD5Zs%0A2aiM%2F9BDekEfmiZvFg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/376710660/7ec5daebc6cf954f1bc343a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9fb44acce88f67263aa068c7790223f653c9d82314f5e29c8df9f82aedaeda06&req=dychEch%2Bm4dfFb4f3HP0gFORVPz1R3LrNbqvXlnMRylmrk1GplvelbDdD5Zs%0A2aiM%2F9BDekEfmiZvFg%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385887743/4ce4668802a52fab61f58f3f/Image_Test2_Anim.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=21c3bef0f6169f1585ed874d317a66b3a50ca2437174f7b9ad5c1bcc9efa9204&req=dygiHsF5moVcFb4f3HP0gIQwE67zOeFHoS9taZYuTC49B%2F0xM%2B1cGxkxVzeA%0AZO2MHCwfDm6lu4L%2FOQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385887743/4ce4668802a52fab61f58f3f/Image_Test2_Anim.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=21c3bef0f6169f1585ed874d317a66b3a50ca2437174f7b9ad5c1bcc9efa9204&req=dygiHsF5moVcFb4f3HP0gIQwE67zOeFHoS9taZYuTC49B%2F0xM%2B1cGxkxVzeA%0AZO2MHCwfDm6lu4L%2FOQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Hint**
--------

The Hint component is used to add additional text and guide the user of the template. For example, this could detail the information to write in a specific field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386904070/ee6a3c4487658cbad18c3627/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c541f9406057dacad40b498389b14be36b89ff7d36ffa860f8b6a071dc4a55a6&req=dyghH8l6nYZfFb4f3HP0gLIihF21WsaZ0ipfIb8aXopdB0G4z%2BlLNU5kFAl9%0AZSs8g5%2B0mmwCoimeqg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386904070/ee6a3c4487658cbad18c3627/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c541f9406057dacad40b498389b14be36b89ff7d36ffa860f8b6a071dc4a55a6&req=dyghH8l6nYZfFb4f3HP0gLIihF21WsaZ0ipfIb8aXopdB0G4z%2BlLNU5kFAl9%0AZSs8g5%2B0mmwCoimeqg%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386904681/96ffbf451d13a00534b9a3a8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f70e07b8f38834f841f0aef508088e95e66bc3020d099b84412e475ce1ad7198&req=dyghH8l6m4leFb4f3HP0gDEReLSu%2Fro6%2FT5qVfi3w93RNIqT2M%2BRJluLfCkF%0AAMtUb%2BPWTZE4Zh%2BDlw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386904681/96ffbf451d13a00534b9a3a8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f70e07b8f38834f841f0aef508088e95e66bc3020d099b84412e475ce1ad7198&req=dyghH8l6m4leFb4f3HP0gDEReLSu%2Fro6%2FT5qVfi3w93RNIqT2M%2BRJluLfCkF%0AAMtUb%2BPWTZE4Zh%2BDlw%3D%3D%0A)

Plain Text
----------

The Plain Text component is used to add _unformatted_ text into a clinical note.  
​  
Unlike the Rich Text field this cannot be formatted with styles and colours.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/465157335/c282438cb67b75081db35b71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=403f0270af227588533ec29fee3cfb6faf72145f54f507c3d35bc42020afd36d&req=cCYiF8x5noJaFb4f3HP0gL2gTLxcDSoHhzkATjpnCvZTRsJLPhOo9a0K9Gtd%0AUXIzjc1Smn0vGtHSCw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/465157335/c282438cb67b75081db35b71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=403f0270af227588533ec29fee3cfb6faf72145f54f507c3d35bc42020afd36d&req=cCYiF8x5noJaFb4f3HP0gL2gTLxcDSoHhzkATjpnCvZTRsJLPhOo9a0K9Gtd%0AUXIzjc1Smn0vGtHSCw%3D%3D%0A)

Through a combination of these components users can create very advanced templates, which can be added quickly to patient files for easy note-taking.

**Other Templates**
-------------------

Lastly, if required you can also insert entire Templates (you have previously saved) into other templates.

For example, you may have previously created a stand-alone template which is a combination of components measure the patient's pain levels. If applicable, you could insert that full set of components into your current template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485338398/ae106ca65330c15d8b87365a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59b44483eb62109c7f2f3920966422ee7321061d3d9d62922742ccfc86d6d467&req=cCgiFcp2nohXFb4f3HP0gPJKviHqJ%2BTYfeWz%2BT7%2F1IcuOmWyvCXL6Lku1yi1%0A7%2Fi7UvftGJjMPovk7A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485338398/ae106ca65330c15d8b87365a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59b44483eb62109c7f2f3920966422ee7321061d3d9d62922742ccfc86d6d467&req=cCgiFcp2nohXFb4f3HP0gPJKviHqJ%2BTYfeWz%2BT7%2F1IcuOmWyvCXL6Lku1yi1%0A7%2Fi7UvftGJjMPovk7A%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Managing Clinical Note Templates**
====================================

If you now return to **[Settings > Clinical Notes > Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/clinicalnotes/templates/list)
** your new template will be displayed in this list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485330034/3ef2de41fee14ace8281bc6c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=81cdcfb0021bc9d48f71c9ac8b31c99fd2bc1db4f2e9f044198325dcb308b5c6&req=cCgiFcp%2BnYJbFb4f3HP0gK%2FNp5YLd2RHj3InvtSt1rU%2Flvzl%2BOzJXPh4Cl7w%0Ax0CwBfeB3%2FoFxGkbjg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485330034/3ef2de41fee14ace8281bc6c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=81cdcfb0021bc9d48f71c9ac8b31c99fd2bc1db4f2e9f044198325dcb308b5c6&req=cCgiFcp%2BnYJbFb4f3HP0gK%2FNp5YLd2RHj3InvtSt1rU%2Flvzl%2BOzJXPh4Cl7w%0Ax0CwBfeB3%2FoFxGkbjg%3D%3D%0A)

By clicking the **Edit** button on this page you can:

1) Create new folders.

2) Move Clinical Note Templates between folders.

3) Manage who can access and use specific templates.

4) Delete templates.  
​

* * *

**Creating New Folders**
========================

Go to **[Settings > Clinical Notes > Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/clinicalnotes/templates/list)** and **Edit** the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/436704704/d89d3ab2cd16b8c978b4fe28/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=936109b2e0cf4a75b527490fe26fe9680dbcd35505c9c96ac932198653855dfa&req=cCMhEcl6moFbFb4f3HP0gFiLKeyUnh2hoaymRMm5QEyyHuCg%2F%2FXXZGnlnYs8%0AXf0l5WqMMz1gp4Lgsw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/436704704/d89d3ab2cd16b8c978b4fe28/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=936109b2e0cf4a75b527490fe26fe9680dbcd35505c9c96ac932198653855dfa&req=cCMhEcl6moFbFb4f3HP0gFiLKeyUnh2hoaymRMm5QEyyHuCg%2F%2FXXZGnlnYs8%0AXf0l5WqMMz1gp4Lgsw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add Folder**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/436704819/d02c74aae57cbc62b5292672/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=439a86b0af1c46f73deff137394de8eb7b72e7472f5eaa9801444093f868844c&req=cCMhEcl6lYBWFb4f3HP0gO1C75FROh8PmRn%2F21flI0gjE9jQr2nBErlb3ZYj%0A7JmRkhBKQjjmUNJS7A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/436704819/d02c74aae57cbc62b5292672/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=439a86b0af1c46f73deff137394de8eb7b72e7472f5eaa9801444093f868844c&req=cCMhEcl6lYBWFb4f3HP0gO1C75FROh8PmRn%2F21flI0gjE9jQr2nBErlb3ZYj%0A7JmRkhBKQjjmUNJS7A%3D%3D%0A)

The new folder will be created at the bottom of this list, where a **Template Name** can be added.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485330560/084b488fdec05e91344311f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7b8b479d50b2dcf5c401a332c41fa3dca5474932e85fb1040cd7068172855ba7&req=cCgiFcp%2BmIdfFb4f3HP0gGTbthDvTpMmXlKO%2BxZtpEbUHa9zj%2FG1PcTnHGIp%0ATcIS%2Bqes6ibF%2Bu2wDQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485330560/084b488fdec05e91344311f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7b8b479d50b2dcf5c401a332c41fa3dca5474932e85fb1040cd7068172855ba7&req=cCgiFcp%2BmIdfFb4f3HP0gGTbthDvTpMmXlKO%2BxZtpEbUHa9zj%2FG1PcTnHGIp%0ATcIS%2Bqes6ibF%2Bu2wDQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Moving Templates and Folders**
================================

Go to **[Settings > Clinical Notes > Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/clinicalnotes/templates/list)** and **Edit** the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425726054/49d6ad9fac92fff929cdb64e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5db5ad2933c70dd192bbc797c00d8f27e195226209641b10ea11c4a89e5cb2dd&req=cCIiEct4nYRbFb4f3HP0gD%2F1cHnf0kuMrkeijAWd0CmzOEDPHaqFzRE%2Bnxw1%0ABzQ3BjDS4h3CmUe7Kg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425726054/49d6ad9fac92fff929cdb64e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5db5ad2933c70dd192bbc797c00d8f27e195226209641b10ea11c4a89e5cb2dd&req=cCIiEct4nYRbFb4f3HP0gD%2F1cHnf0kuMrkeijAWd0CmzOEDPHaqFzRE%2Bnxw1%0ABzQ3BjDS4h3CmUe7Kg%3D%3D%0A)

Hover your mouse over a template or folder, and on the left hand side you will see a symbol of **_two parallel lines_**. If you then click and hold over this symbol you can drag the template or folder up and down in the list.

  
Please note that you can only drag vertically in-line with the symbol (two parallel lines).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485331768/8082e19daf2bb2daad1e001b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=009958d0695778fe063dda2b82e259b57e7c0ca404590742a42aa2a5b585a1c0&req=cCgiFcp%2FmodXFb4f3HP0gJj0wf8CXMlC3Zsrq78sDiZ7tq5Nm%2FTWFEUqvNyf%0AU892p%2BM0VlsWnuUoEA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485331768/8082e19daf2bb2daad1e001b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=009958d0695778fe063dda2b82e259b57e7c0ca404590742a42aa2a5b585a1c0&req=cCgiFcp%2FmodXFb4f3HP0gJj0wf8CXMlC3Zsrq78sDiZ7tq5Nm%2FTWFEUqvNyf%0AU892p%2BM0VlsWnuUoEA%3D%3D%0A)

Click and drag your templates or folders to the desired location.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485332050/013ce712114c76ef1a154150/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b76298e0151e83a809056e0b75d88792b23b8506f566c6a1fcbac1e36e12ae44&req=cCgiFcp8nYRfFb4f3HP0gD3NDt%2F%2BAT8aNHoawTVFpZhX9nE%2FPlEth9Nin%2BYL%0An0J2XkSPWVr0p8mI6g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485332050/013ce712114c76ef1a154150/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b76298e0151e83a809056e0b75d88792b23b8506f566c6a1fcbac1e36e12ae44&req=cCgiFcp8nYRfFb4f3HP0gD3NDt%2F%2BAT8aNHoawTVFpZhX9nE%2FPlEth9Nin%2BYL%0An0J2XkSPWVr0p8mI6g%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Changing Template Permissions**
=================================

Go to **[Settings > Clinical Notes > Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/clinicalnotes/templates/list)** and **Edit** the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425726054/49d6ad9fac92fff929cdb64e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5db5ad2933c70dd192bbc797c00d8f27e195226209641b10ea11c4a89e5cb2dd&req=cCIiEct4nYRbFb4f3HP0gD%2F1cHnf0kuMrkeijAWd0CmzOEDPHaqFzRE%2Bnxw1%0ABzQ3BjDS4h3CmUe7Kg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425726054/49d6ad9fac92fff929cdb64e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5db5ad2933c70dd192bbc797c00d8f27e195226209641b10ea11c4a89e5cb2dd&req=cCIiEct4nYRbFb4f3HP0gD%2F1cHnf0kuMrkeijAWd0CmzOEDPHaqFzRE%2Bnxw1%0ABzQ3BjDS4h3CmUe7Kg%3D%3D%0A)

Hover over any template or folder and click **Access**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425727560/1c05a4eeaf60b8a798f042b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f877671c40c12938bf10c050f9b33fdd699fc54ffb4ae7bd7f59c669427c4e05&req=cCIiEct5mIdfFb4f3HP0gI3%2B8GvSP41JwP9UIzU5f2fnyP3GS6aeJ86qscDt%0Af%2FU7Rzen%2BTQ%2F67iaVA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425727560/1c05a4eeaf60b8a798f042b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f877671c40c12938bf10c050f9b33fdd699fc54ffb4ae7bd7f59c669427c4e05&req=cCIiEct5mIdfFb4f3HP0gI3%2B8GvSP41JwP9UIzU5f2fnyP3GS6aeJ86qscDt%0Af%2FU7Rzen%2BTQ%2F67iaVA%3D%3D%0A)

This will display the access settings for the template or folder:  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485332184/bfc6ccd70957e9f23b3db65d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fbec96b8bad81c7af3c382e37c8075a48df630fe7deec2c814091ffdd8ff741b&req=cCgiFcp8nIlbFb4f3HP0gKDQFCymGOxEA0RzJqQZeKFuEWeay5qvKGIQn6WR%0A227HPAKSgt%2BJQ3prSw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/485332184/bfc6ccd70957e9f23b3db65d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fbec96b8bad81c7af3c382e37c8075a48df630fe7deec2c814091ffdd8ff741b&req=cCgiFcp8nIlbFb4f3HP0gKDQFCymGOxEA0RzJqQZeKFuEWeay5qvKGIQn6WR%0A227HPAKSgt%2BJQ3prSw%3D%3D%0A)

These provide the following access:

*   **Full Access** \- Allow all practitioners clinic to access the template.
    
*   **Businesses** - Restrict access to practitioners associated with specific businesses.
    
*   **Professions** - Restrict access to practitioners of a certain Profession.
    
*   **Practitioners** - Restricts access to individual practitioners.  
    ​
    

* * *

**Deleting Templates or Folders**
=================================

Go to **[Settings > Clinical Notes > Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/clinicalnotes/templates/list)** and **Edit** the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425726054/49d6ad9fac92fff929cdb64e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5db5ad2933c70dd192bbc797c00d8f27e195226209641b10ea11c4a89e5cb2dd&req=cCIiEct4nYRbFb4f3HP0gD%2F1cHnf0kuMrkeijAWd0CmzOEDPHaqFzRE%2Bnxw1%0ABzQ3BjDS4h3CmUe7Kg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425726054/49d6ad9fac92fff929cdb64e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5db5ad2933c70dd192bbc797c00d8f27e195226209641b10ea11c4a89e5cb2dd&req=cCIiEct4nYRbFb4f3HP0gD%2F1cHnf0kuMrkeijAWd0CmzOEDPHaqFzRE%2Bnxw1%0ABzQ3BjDS4h3CmUe7Kg%3D%3D%0A)

Hover over the template and click the **Delete** icon.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425729228/83c6cc49b9b8671b7092d812/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f12cd4e312bcc04a8b49305efb3eca99d127ff375b68009a736e1d74a86814a&req=cCIiEct3n4NXFb4f3HP0gPsv25HJjh5YO44%2FVL%2Fancw1mZymEYo2T5dIkGmj%0ANAi%2BY3gJL%2BBsmGg5IA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425729228/83c6cc49b9b8671b7092d812/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f12cd4e312bcc04a8b49305efb3eca99d127ff375b68009a736e1d74a86814a&req=cCIiEct3n4NXFb4f3HP0gPsv25HJjh5YO44%2FVL%2Fancw1mZymEYo2T5dIkGmj%0ANAi%2BY3gJL%2BBsmGg5IA%3D%3D%0A)

A warning will appear to confirm if you'd like to delete the template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425729404/4d388b4600f43bc0b2f14c67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f6c88bfb5f08434b1eabce0fbb734535fad83b8a43affd9cd5231030f36c070&req=cCIiEct3mYFbFb4f3HP0gLE0slYU4A5qv8IStXbP4%2B%2BpXSCGWX3jn7pVDI%2Fz%0A8GXf09E%2F3GmaTK%2B6NQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/425729404/4d388b4600f43bc0b2f14c67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f6c88bfb5f08434b1eabce0fbb734535fad83b8a43affd9cd5231030f36c070&req=cCIiEct3mYFbFb4f3HP0gLE0slYU4A5qv8IStXbP4%2B%2BpXSCGWX3jn7pVDI%2Fz%0A8GXf09E%2F3GmaTK%2B6NQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Delete** to confirm.

* * *

Through the combination of these features users can effectively create, manage and use clinical note templates within PracSuite.

A well designed template can reduce the need for manual data entry and save practitioners countless hours, so we recommend exploring these features and investing your time in template creation.

Using the 'Show History' Function
=================================

View clinical note history while writing new clinical notes and letters.

Updated over 3 years ago

Use the **Show History** function in clinical notes to see a patient's previous notes while creating a new note or letter. Navigate to the **Patient File > Clinical Notes tab**.

When creating a new clinical note, selecting the **Show History** button will reveal the patient's clinical note history on the right-hand side of the screen.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/269583040/201dbfca7d6196ed849a286e/Screen+Shot+2020-11-24+at+10.13.00+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=540f9d22228e09fd975266ee1512b9e60d5fcc581ee22ce21d992f3f8bc315cf&req=diYuE8F9nYVfFb4f3HP0gD2GARMwBFz%2FXowODCbNEZIBlEBhdN%2B7xpFq9YO0%0Aqn6izCBkIa70XDHDQA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/269583040/201dbfca7d6196ed849a286e/Screen+Shot+2020-11-24+at+10.13.00+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=540f9d22228e09fd975266ee1512b9e60d5fcc581ee22ce21d992f3f8bc315cf&req=diYuE8F9nYVfFb4f3HP0gD2GARMwBFz%2FXowODCbNEZIBlEBhdN%2B7xpFq9YO0%0Aqn6izCBkIa70XDHDQA%3D%3D%0A)

An Overview of PracSuite's Standard Reports

An Overview of PracSuite's Standard Reports
===========================================

Updated over 6 months ago

Table of contents

[Dashboard](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4659914-an-overview-of-pracsuite-s-standard-reports#dashboard-)

[Billing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4659914-an-overview-of-pracsuite-s-standard-reports#billing-)

[Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4659914-an-overview-of-pracsuite-s-standard-reports#appointments-)

[Clients](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4659914-an-overview-of-pracsuite-s-standard-reports#clients-)

[Saved Filters](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4659914-an-overview-of-pracsuite-s-standard-reports#h_833bcdc070)

[Scheduled Reports](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4659914-an-overview-of-pracsuite-s-standard-reports#h_a235062f4e)

From the **Reports** menu, see your dashboard and create custom reports on billing, clients, appointments, and more.

**Dashboard**
=============

Your Dashboard is a powerful reporting utility that allows you to customise widgets such as graphs, tables, and KPI's to provide live business intelligence information. Once you have set up a widget here, you can view it on your home screen.

**Billing**
===========

**Account Balance**

_List all outstanding amounts and credits as of the current date and time. The report can be used to list all owing clients or detail amounts owed to specific practitioners._

**Bank Transfers**

_Track bank transfer balances and payments, including which specific invoices and items the bank transfer payment was applied to._

**Banking Sheet**

_Generate a summary of cash and cheque payments received under a particular Settlement Account._

**Billing**

_Generate a summary or detailed listing of items billed within a date range, for individual clients or by practitioner._

**Cheques**

_Track cheque balances and payments, including which specific invoices and items the cheque payment was applied to._

**GST Reconciliation**

_Track invoices, items and payments that are GST inclusive. The report can be generated for both cash and accrual accounting._

**Item Codes**

_List active schedules and item codes, detailing the fee structure that applies by default for each fee category._

**Tyro Health Online**

_Report and manage invoices with an associated Tyro Health Online transaction._

**Outstanding Invoices**

_Report and action invoices with a current outstanding balance._

**Owing At**

_This report retrospectively excludes payments made after the selected date to calculate what amounts were owing as of that date. View the total amount owing to practitioners, businesses or professions as of a historical date._

**Payments**

_Payments report to view items and payments made against invoices._

**Reconciliation**

_List all payment methods used in a date range, detailing the total value and number of payments for each payment type. Used to reconcile payments received against the values entered into Pracsuite._

**Statements**

_Create and action statements in bulk to summarise patient invoices._

**Stock Adjustments**

_Adjust the current level of stock for items within a business. Includes manual adjustment, stock arrival and stock-take options._

**Stock Levels**

_List all stock items and the current stock levels of each business._

**Transactions**

_List all transactions in a date range, with filtering by business, profession, practitioner or settlement account._

**Appointments**
================

**Activity**

_Generates a list of appointments that were created, cancelled, rescheduled or missed within a date range. The report can be generated based on the appointment date or when the appointment was made, and can be filtered by business, profession or practitioner. This report can also be used to identify patients who cancelled or missed their appointment but have no future appointments._

**Appointments**

_Generate a summary of the appointment types booked within a date range, for individual patients or by practitioner. This report can also be used to identify appointments that remain unbilled or without a clinical note._

**Day List**

_List all appointments in a date range, including notes and group appointments. Appointments can be grouped by practitioner, date or resources._

**Future Appointments**

_List clients with an appointment in the specified date range and detail the future appointments of those clients. Used to identify clients with or without future appointments._

**Time Management**

_Calculate the total time booked with each practitioner per item code or appointment type._

**Clients**
===========

**Active/Inactive Clients**

_Generates a list of patients based on whether they had a transaction within a specified date range. This report can be used to determine patients who were active within a range, inactive within a range, or a combination of both. The report is primarily used to find patients who were active previously but have since become inactive._

**Birthdays**

_Identify clients with a birthday in the specified date range. Details the client's upcoming age, upon their birthday, and the total billed to each client._

**Client List**

_Generates a list of all clients and allows filtering by demographic, appointment or transaction-based options._

**Client Visit Average**

_The Client Visit Average is a calculation to show the number of times, on average, a practitioner has seen their clients per clinical episode. This can be used to indicate under-servicing or over-servicing by practitioners._

**Recalls**

_List clients with an active recall set in the future. The report can be filtered by recall date, recall type or by the assigned practitioner._

**Referrals**

_The Referrals Report generates a list of clients, doctors or entities that have referred a client within a specified period of time and displays the income generated for each referred client._

**Tasks**

_List clients with an active recall set in the future. The report can be filtered by recall date, recall type or by the assigned practitioner._

**Treatment Plan**

_The Treatment Plan Report generates a report for those clients with an active treatment plan. The details need to be set in the Treatment Plan section of the client billing details prior to viewing this report._

**Saved Filters**
=================

PracSuite allows you to [save your preferred report filters.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters)
 This can be very useful if you regularly run reports with lots of filter combinations.

**Scheduled Reports**
=====================

All PracSuite reports include the ability to be automatically sent by email to specific contacts at specified intervals using the [Scheduled Report feature.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5098313-how-to-create-a-scheduled-report)

**Viewing SMS Replies in Alerts**
=================================

SMS replies are displayed in the **Alerts** window in the bottom right-hand corner of PracSuite. Access to the Alerts tool must be enabled on the [Role assigned to a user](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353460-creating-roles)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595569122/8a5c40d73d03eeeda73273d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ce778895a9a06cbb7041a15d57a4cc4a0e1e0162e47dd7d3b17c088e392cf3df&req=cSkiE893nINdFb4f3HP0gOYUXp5PgxgO4%2B36LeDoXUgsyCsgesZ5zv%2BoQ6od%0AEBFN6i9H47WotQCuVg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595569122/8a5c40d73d03eeeda73273d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ce778895a9a06cbb7041a15d57a4cc4a0e1e0162e47dd7d3b17c088e392cf3df&req=cSkiE893nINdFb4f3HP0gOYUXp5PgxgO4%2B36LeDoXUgsyCsgesZ5zv%2BoQ6od%0AEBFN6i9H47WotQCuVg%3D%3D%0A)

A red notification icon will appear when SMS replies are received. Click on the Alerts icon to show all of your Alerts. You can filter this to just messages by clicking on SMS Replies on the left side of the Alerts window.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1648265637/b162517e7b79e7f089f206994df3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=31eb5eaecf163969282856c02e73762b9d0531bcce75b203e12a91895e6d3e6a&req=dSYjHst4mIdcXvMW1HO4zRQTWjF79mpHqjIR7%2FGoyk%2FTqtpv3VxFJJLXUPQx%0A40K6k5RF21CXTjk3c7E%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1648265637/b162517e7b79e7f089f206994df3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=31eb5eaecf163969282856c02e73762b9d0531bcce75b203e12a91895e6d3e6a&req=dSYjHst4mIdcXvMW1HO4zRQTWjF79mpHqjIR7%2FGoyk%2FTqtpv3VxFJJLXUPQx%0A40K6k5RF21CXTjk3c7E%3D%0A)

Clicking on the reply will reveal relevant actions, including opening the patient file, replying, marking the message as read and clearing the message.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1648273476/121a26c06de2fed7687a2efa8433/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b0c4b15367ed28b17589a479133a09b886110bfef92cb3c0aef48a897a64c9ce&req=dSYjHst5noVYX%2FMW1HO4zRxA1v8J9v0JDIW%2FAIbPCOAj1vt5I36%2FWoQYXeBu%0A%2BP4fXCuZYYvFHVK6AP0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1648273476/121a26c06de2fed7687a2efa8433/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b0c4b15367ed28b17589a479133a09b886110bfef92cb3c0aef48a897a64c9ce&req=dSYjHst5noVYX%2FMW1HO4zRxA1v8J9v0JDIW%2FAIbPCOAj1vt5I36%2FWoQYXeBu%0A%2BP4fXCuZYYvFHVK6AP0%3D%0A)

  
Select the **3 dots icon** to mark all alerts as read and to clear all read alerts.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1648278846/b53a8ce24885d805dde563c20747/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee7f22a6163d95f8beeb6c6c6df0d06cd24ca738c09a491f032f98c146710fc2&req=dSYjHst5lYlbX%2FMW1HO4zYaprGvVm2POsGU9KaTk2IdhHmuFnmBXUt8CgFiq%0A34HPI1AU4lHNDLI%2BvQw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1648278846/b53a8ce24885d805dde563c20747/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee7f22a6163d95f8beeb6c6c6df0d06cd24ca738c09a491f032f98c146710fc2&req=dSYjHst5lYlbX%2FMW1HO4zYaprGvVm2POsGU9KaTk2IdhHmuFnmBXUt8CgFiq%0A34HPI1AU4lHNDLI%2BvQw%3D%0A)

  
The setting cog icon includes the following options:

*   Show dock when there are unread alerts
    
*   Only show alerts for my logged-in Business (selected in the top right-hand corner of PracSuite)
    
*   Display SMS Replies
    
*   Display Online Booking Alerts
    
*   Display Practitioner Alerts
    
*   Display Waiting List Alerts
    
*   Display Forms
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595570001/048d8363700b77fc16669e46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8fa1dbdf54777500ae6b8fbaa2d80cee51a5ede70aff456bd7a13da1374e4887&req=cSkiE85%2BnYFeFb4f3HP0gEMaKZ6uifFlu5bCT3UvB2UvRnicG%2FOMQWP6B5yk%0AMROe6YibfQMhwGThDw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595570001/048d8363700b77fc16669e46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8fa1dbdf54777500ae6b8fbaa2d80cee51a5ede70aff456bd7a13da1374e4887&req=cSkiE85%2BnYFeFb4f3HP0gEMaKZ6uifFlu5bCT3UvB2UvRnicG%2FOMQWP6B5yk%0AMROe6YibfQMhwGThDw%3D%3D%0A)

**Receiving SMS Replies by Email**
=====================================

To receive general SMS replies by email, go to **[Settings > PracSuite Account > SMS](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/sms)
** and enable the setting as shown below. You can either receive replies to the relevant Business email address or to specified email addresses.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595575141/1855de76d0faa9680f83def1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c98940547b795170dd56bf2fd19bec813f3b6b2798a554d1cc7ba82c68a59508&req=cSkiE857nIVeFb4f3HP0gEwbx1B%2FmDcJVAiQvgAYKxcDOQUylUzC8NNDp7L4%0A6KjOcBcNETNoWv0oLA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595575141/1855de76d0faa9680f83def1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c98940547b795170dd56bf2fd19bec813f3b6b2798a554d1cc7ba82c68a59508&req=cSkiE857nIVeFb4f3HP0gEwbx1B%2FmDcJVAiQvgAYKxcDOQUylUzC8NNDp7L4%0A6KjOcBcNETNoWv0oLA%3D%3D%0A)

  
To receive SMS appointment reminder replies by email, go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Reminders](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/reminders)
** and enable the setting as shown below. You can either receive replies to the relevant Business email address or to specified email addresses.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595575584/7299cc4696db025c3b96417e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de6888b6e4634e3386d5d7b808c99441f31508024c63f611c919dd89bb8c8bec&req=cSkiE857mIlbFb4f3HP0gGd2gYEGaM6lo3b3jCYuHZMsn5BojBqM4kcosTCw%0A5hg5N8DIkTo9muBNQw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595575584/7299cc4696db025c3b96417e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de6888b6e4634e3386d5d7b808c99441f31508024c63f611c919dd89bb8c8bec&req=cSkiE857mIlbFb4f3HP0gGd2gYEGaM6lo3b3jCYuHZMsn5BojBqM4kcosTCw%0A5hg5N8DIkTo9muBNQw%3D%3D%0A)

Selecting Custom Date Ranges When Reporting

Selecting Custom Date Ranges When Reporting
===========================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Along with predefined date ranges, it is also possible to select custom date ranges when reporting in PracSuite.

Select **Date Range** to change the dates of any report you wish to generate.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595576146/6e8cdc18c6f403b7f1c2818c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85af380de0ca77b3aeae1686713d6d8798611330a6bb1fc5a758a8c6c425124b&req=cSkiE854nIVZFb4f3HP0gMahV%2Br9UxdX7H%2BHfOEPcFQ4ZUdSP3zUJyC6psGX%0AZGQTpya9r%2B%2FA6L%2B%2B%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595576146/6e8cdc18c6f403b7f1c2818c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85af380de0ca77b3aeae1686713d6d8798611330a6bb1fc5a758a8c6c425124b&req=cSkiE854nIVZFb4f3HP0gMahV%2Br9UxdX7H%2BHfOEPcFQ4ZUdSP3zUJyC6psGX%0AZGQTpya9r%2B%2FA6L%2B%2B%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)

On the left of the drop-down list, you will see the list of predefined date ranges to select from.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595576309/67780c4f6f3de1ed2263b6cb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a376e3ad74c3cee084a08be24482e35156b6ab4b9ca29493b717296a1556c62&req=cSkiE854noFWFb4f3HP0gG4AgEBuhCEiCsGpUPbPJo0iHsnAW8VDfI9drPM%2F%0AUBmxqGujEKCLVQEDrA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595576309/67780c4f6f3de1ed2263b6cb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a376e3ad74c3cee084a08be24482e35156b6ab4b9ca29493b717296a1556c62&req=cSkiE854noFWFb4f3HP0gG4AgEBuhCEiCsGpUPbPJo0iHsnAW8VDfI9drPM%2F%0AUBmxqGujEKCLVQEDrA%3D%3D%0A)

Selecting the **'Custom'** option will allow you to use the calendar to select a custom date range.

Select the start date, then select the end date. The date range will be highlighted as shown below. To report on a single date, simply click the desired date twice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595577061/65bc975aa894c22afbb4b8a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be96f3785b5bdfc53e863800c10810793cbf02f6c4cbc6d23fdf7a100fbe6a61&req=cSkiE855nYdeFb4f3HP0gAgRb8hlDWr%2BX63f57Vs20k3182tPDP0%2FTYftqky%0Aax8%2Fe88DcXkn0sQlnw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595577061/65bc975aa894c22afbb4b8a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be96f3785b5bdfc53e863800c10810793cbf02f6c4cbc6d23fdf7a100fbe6a61&req=cSkiE855nYdeFb4f3HP0gAgRb8hlDWr%2BX63f57Vs20k3182tPDP0%2FTYftqky%0Aax8%2Fe88DcXkn0sQlnw%3D%3D%0A)

Alternatively, type the desired date range in the **From** and **To** sections.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595576601/3cd432fbb513150e460d6da8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d27bfd1ab139b79acef7fec0de8d8c63e982496bfb4e466b1905d4dcd51e45a2&req=cSkiE854m4FeFb4f3HP0gK26NY7JpT%2BaUHtTjNNaNxSxuqnSSZJeLt%2B8fEPD%0A0dDRw8Cu0lz%2BkFKDaA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595576601/3cd432fbb513150e460d6da8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d27bfd1ab139b79acef7fec0de8d8c63e982496bfb4e466b1905d4dcd51e45a2&req=cSkiE854m4FeFb4f3HP0gK26NY7JpT%2BaUHtTjNNaNxSxuqnSSZJeLt%2B8fEPD%0A0dDRw8Cu0lz%2BkFKDaA%3D%3D%0A)

How to Print an Appointment Day List

How to Print an Appointment Day List
====================================

Updated over 3 years ago

The Day List report can be used to print a list of appointments with various grouping options. These include:

*   **Grouping by Practitioner** (with the option to print a separate page per practitioner and include empty timeslots)
    
*   **Grouping by Date** (with the option to print a separate page per day)
    
*   **Grouping by Resource**
    

It's also possible to adjust inclusions on the printout:

*   Notes
    
*   Group Appointments
    
*   Appointment Notes
    
*   Resources
    
*   File Numbers
    
*   Patient Warnings
    

Go to **[Reports > Appointments > Day List](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/appointment/daylist)**

The following will appear:

Online Booking General Settings

Online Booking General Settings
===============================

Updated over 8 months ago

Table of contents

[Customising the appearance of the online booking page](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4743365-online-booking-general-settings#customising-the-appearance-of-the-online-booking-page)

[Enabling Individual Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4743365-online-booking-general-settings#enabling-individual-appointments)

Online booking allows your clients to book directly into your PracSuite appointment book via your website and social media pages.

To enable online booking in PracSuite, go to **[Settings > Online Booking > Online Booking Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582284/5aa2cbdfbce749a90d726beb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3d3e08d8619907141ca773f7037c5ce13be78b88085dbb125e6a293d4ca4e8dd&req=cSkiE8F8n4lbFb4f3HP0gIZ0H4lCxMBMw3FewcpE5J%2FuPOcMvv9LK0Zm0ju5%0ALzlaIN0bqk%2FecikKuA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582284/5aa2cbdfbce749a90d726beb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3d3e08d8619907141ca773f7037c5ce13be78b88085dbb125e6a293d4ca4e8dd&req=cSkiE8F8n4lbFb4f3HP0gIZ0H4lCxMBMw3FewcpE5J%2FuPOcMvv9LK0Zm0ju5%0ALzlaIN0bqk%2FecikKuA%3D%3D%0A)
