**Customising the appearance of the online booking page**
=========================================================

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1588984468/340c7807ecdbc8c28f6d0f81f2ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c69f286a51f562acafcdb3bbe102cd5290864e4e636f8bf448ac4297f19d742&req=dSUvHsB2mYVZUfMW1HO4zekWGsYigwq0vgukXJ%2FY%2F3ap%2Bza7uBD9rrEEhcpH%0Ar2rkDVzuFrTIBluXooQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1588984468/340c7807ecdbc8c28f6d0f81f2ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c69f286a51f562acafcdb3bbe102cd5290864e4e636f8bf448ac4297f19d742&req=dSUvHsB2mYVZUfMW1HO4zekWGsYigwq0vgukXJ%2FY%2F3ap%2Bza7uBD9rrEEhcpH%0Ar2rkDVzuFrTIBluXooQ%3D%0A)

Enter a **Display Name**, which appears at the top of the online booking page and should encompass all your business locations.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582600/18f2b594f7760fa6b318d79b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e139367b130575064d4144d9477101e874912ff138ecfa2a9bdcb29fa79b8112&req=cSkiE8F8m4FfFb4f3HP0gEB0ZX78z1I2vnqsr35IwXst9ewLP5TGSVqJKTnr%0Avbwmc9MPs21IvjjAVQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582600/18f2b594f7760fa6b318d79b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e139367b130575064d4144d9477101e874912ff138ecfa2a9bdcb29fa79b8112&req=cSkiE8F8m4FfFb4f3HP0gEB0ZX78z1I2vnqsr35IwXst9ewLP5TGSVqJKTnr%0Avbwmc9MPs21IvjjAVQ%3D%3D%0A)

Add an optional **Display Logo**. This file should be the same size as the display logo located in General settings (200px x 60px).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582637/707a1d5fc8d97d39c84b7dac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a4e69a2a981f1c930b0bbdeef2d2b969a72e3cbff451302b9f4d467d18b40f58&req=cSkiE8F8m4JYFb4f3HP0gAy1vx178nAvJI3Ob2z7KsOEg0%2FNebaW2kFjSuYs%0AVSzO9Iw5p2u0dWNltw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582637/707a1d5fc8d97d39c84b7dac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a4e69a2a981f1c930b0bbdeef2d2b969a72e3cbff451302b9f4d467d18b40f58&req=cSkiE8F8m4JYFb4f3HP0gAy1vx178nAvJI3Ob2z7KsOEg0%2FNebaW2kFjSuYs%0AVSzO9Iw5p2u0dWNltw%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Organisation Descriptor** that best suits your business. Choose between: Practice, Clinic or Centre.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582724/aa70921b6f2018701450fdf3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c10d5b242bcac00709acaaecf686b36b6fea6a4f11a9c82b29ee3162a4fd650a&req=cSkiE8F8moNbFb4f3HP0gNcMATSvQj2s%2F7X5w10ZYhRpEosn660V4FJPIJtK%0AMjL4d4ve8MGP6C9FIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582724/aa70921b6f2018701450fdf3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c10d5b242bcac00709acaaecf686b36b6fea6a4f11a9c82b29ee3162a4fd650a&req=cSkiE8F8moNbFb4f3HP0gNcMATSvQj2s%2F7X5w10ZYhRpEosn660V4FJPIJtK%0AMjL4d4ve8MGP6C9FIA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Booking Order** to determine the selection process when booking an appointment. E.g. a client could select a location and then see what services are available there, or vice versa.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582786/a28c8ce733068dde99703d7e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=74483d95ba3c11844e8cf34d5814d5aaaf424ca56e71dc3b19ebfba247049f64&req=cSkiE8F8molZFb4f3HP0gNpxmqGy747AJPqNCD6sp%2FT2yVZZ31vVkkmEEnUw%0Av3upELR1xWtASu%2BhNQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582786/a28c8ce733068dde99703d7e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=74483d95ba3c11844e8cf34d5814d5aaaf424ca56e71dc3b19ebfba247049f64&req=cSkiE8F8molZFb4f3HP0gNpxmqGy747AJPqNCD6sp%2FT2yVZZ31vVkkmEEnUw%0Av3upELR1xWtASu%2BhNQ%3D%3D%0A)

You can select two colours to customise the appearance of your online booking site. The primary colour is usually taken from your logo and/or website. Use the palette icon to input the exact colour. Ask your web designer for the "hex code" of your theme colour. The secondary colour is used as a highlight. For the largest impact, it should be a completely different colour to the primary colour.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582824/ff664a02438ed791940c6977/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efcc918cfda23ed7a3664ed7805fbb128c5faa52075e507b3ebfdafb6e190223&req=cSkiE8F8lYNbFb4f3HP0gOSWlawvUQUJeZjNwlD5zGDVKG8EUsfzjTNutcpA%0AbC18deHV0ooicA070A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582824/ff664a02438ed791940c6977/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efcc918cfda23ed7a3664ed7805fbb128c5faa52075e507b3ebfdafb6e190223&req=cSkiE8F8lYNbFb4f3HP0gOSWlawvUQUJeZjNwlD5zGDVKG8EUsfzjTNutcpA%0AbC18deHV0ooicA070A%3D%3D%0A)

Select a **Practitioner Descriptor** as either practitioner or therapist.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582878/9d40af04cebd75ddf4e8f99b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd8373dcad586e24a7d41857120830f8c5be6742bcec5ba636ea730bdfc532bb&req=cSkiE8F8lYZXFb4f3HP0gGlGdjqvF7Nd4Hgc2fOK9k7rDCTePnwaZh1n8raZ%0Aq5Dx3mzcHxvTzz7ujg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582878/9d40af04cebd75ddf4e8f99b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bd8373dcad586e24a7d41857120830f8c5be6742bcec5ba636ea730bdfc532bb&req=cSkiE8F8lYZXFb4f3HP0gGlGdjqvF7Nd4Hgc2fOK9k7rDCTePnwaZh1n8raZ%0Aq5Dx3mzcHxvTzz7ujg%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Your Online Booking URL**
===========================

Enter your desired **Online Booking URL**, typically matching your website address. Once entered, select the tick to check and reserve the address to secure your online booking URL. You will be notified if your chosen URL is not available.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582932/2371abb78ecb101eee597b04/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=183ca1b1d610638b8fb3a84445c65d3169edc069ea099d411054eba4b5a94352&req=cSkiE8F8lIJdFb4f3HP0gK%2FYZr2qZfr3KkHQ0A9l6DCJ0vyonJxzOgRQ25X2%0AooaPJTfQXVa5J1G2eg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595582932/2371abb78ecb101eee597b04/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=183ca1b1d610638b8fb3a84445c65d3169edc069ea099d411054eba4b5a94352&req=cSkiE8F8lIJdFb4f3HP0gK%2FYZr2qZfr3KkHQ0A9l6DCJ0vyonJxzOgRQ25X2%0AooaPJTfQXVa5J1G2eg%3D%3D%0A)

You are then able to use the pencil icon to edit it or use the copy button to easily send it to your web developer. Clicking on the link will take you to your online booking site once everything has been set up.

**Note: If you change your URL, you must update all places where the previous URL appears on your website and social media pages.**

* * *

**Choosing what information to collect from patients**
======================================================

Customise what information the online booking site will collect from patients when they book as a guest. Name, Email and Phone number are always required. You have the option to hide, show or require a client's Date of Birth, Address, Gender, Appointment Reminder Preferences and/or Marketing Preferences. The Appointment Reminder and Marketing Preferences allow patients to tick SMS or Email options.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595583134/facd145450f15d5ff11c1b27/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23f0413e16faeddc56050291e71b5478a66a9163c58a0b113377dc574c65d249&req=cSkiE8F9nIJbFb4f3HP0gOGEUAi6jqxVgBRec9sgmb%2F%2BtUvrtRnO0w9Z1hfJ%0AcWcN3R9cfWS2dPZDnw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595583134/facd145450f15d5ff11c1b27/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23f0413e16faeddc56050291e71b5478a66a9163c58a0b113377dc574c65d249&req=cSkiE8F9nIJbFb4f3HP0gOGEUAi6jqxVgBRec9sgmb%2F%2BtUvrtRnO0w9Z1hfJ%0AcWcN3R9cfWS2dPZDnw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Marketing tracking**
======================

PracSuite Online Bookings allows you to add popular marketing tracking tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager and Facebook Pixel.

Click below the links below to learn more about where to find your tracking IDs.

[How to create a Google Analytics tracking ID](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/1008080?hl=en)

[How to create a Google Tag Manager tracking ID](https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/6103696?hl=en)

[How to create a Facebook Pixel tracking ID](https://en-gb.facebook.com/business/help/952192354843755?id=1205376682832142)

Enter the respective tracking ID into the fields provided.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595583654/4667335edcb3ae46e1befee6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0087a4e205a1631ad3033ec9cd1d03e49f8d5d398443c670a76f4b5eb5b1c366&req=cSkiE8F9m4RbFb4f3HP0gDKQcVoMqTSqVDUDLSn4AK9SjA%2FmCYGAhJROwefW%0AVxeOLGUE2r12CrIJVA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595583654/4667335edcb3ae46e1befee6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0087a4e205a1631ad3033ec9cd1d03e49f8d5d398443c670a76f4b5eb5b1c366&req=cSkiE8F9m4RbFb4f3HP0gDKQcVoMqTSqVDUDLSn4AK9SjA%2FmCYGAhJROwefW%0AVxeOLGUE2r12CrIJVA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy URLs**
==============================================

If you have a Terms & Conditions and/or Privacy Policy that you would like to link to in the booking process, copy and paste the links into the respective fields. Adding one or both of these links will add a line of text during the booking process stating that by booking the client agrees to the linked policies.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584032/4105743f93765f08d96b653d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91afbc8463fbcbd7e7e02b196388bb6f9e291e756249ca3f239230b103d97d4c&req=cSkiE8F6nYJdFb4f3HP0gAZDLG5ha4JV9qs1uSUrSWwtMrZe7LwxnwPNzMG8%0ANxz3wPfI2R8FoAHqFw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584032/4105743f93765f08d96b653d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91afbc8463fbcbd7e7e02b196388bb6f9e291e756249ca3f239230b103d97d4c&req=cSkiE8F6nYJdFb4f3HP0gAZDLG5ha4JV9qs1uSUrSWwtMrZe7LwxnwPNzMG8%0ANxz3wPfI2R8FoAHqFw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Welcome Message Popup**
=========================

Enabling the Welcome Message Popup allows you to customise an initial message that appears when a client first accesses the online booking page. A great way to advertise changes in policy, announce a new practitioner or service or otherwise communicate information to your patients.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/974916821/3c3a1d2e5c1924be8700b4a8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f6c38f0f9038a958e44164de1d5b001873068e70fe368eae349d35f96644e3c8&req=fScjH8h4lYNeFb4f3HP0gEfh3GaRETFi5gmF5U9%2B0WqDiB70f36qGKRuBt5E%0Aix0ux0JtTv70U8WP9w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/974916821/3c3a1d2e5c1924be8700b4a8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f6c38f0f9038a958e44164de1d5b001873068e70fe368eae349d35f96644e3c8&req=fScjH8h4lYNeFb4f3HP0gEfh3GaRETFi5gmF5U9%2B0WqDiB70f36qGKRuBt5E%0Aix0ux0JtTv70U8WP9w%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Enabling Individual Appointments**
====================================

Individual appointments are a one-on-one appointment between a client and a practitioner, excluding group appointments. Turn on the toggle to enable individual appointments to be booked online.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584441/379bd7a3f1bafcf8c8cf5584/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13d6f060e759365c345e1131e7025caac43fca73e1d0dcd43fa1e16af6526491&req=cSkiE8F6mYVeFb4f3HP0gJnxtRXyEya4JMXsHNDlM0wNsxelXrhnGLv5jOfD%0A8QNTfyheW%2Bd32Nx5Jw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584441/379bd7a3f1bafcf8c8cf5584/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13d6f060e759365c345e1131e7025caac43fca73e1d0dcd43fa1e16af6526491&req=cSkiE8F6mYVeFb4f3HP0gJnxtRXyEya4JMXsHNDlM0wNsxelXrhnGLv5jOfD%0A8QNTfyheW%2Bd32Nx5Jw%3D%3D%0A)

Set the Minimum Search Range which represents how much notice you would like when someone is booking online. For example, a one-hour minimum search range means that the earliest possible time a client can book in is one-hour away from the current time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584558/aa9f73f3542bab31a05fbb0f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef8d3ce47caae655d16a0f90a1b046ba0908492f1732335f40ab411e0a8c7c3b&req=cSkiE8F6mIRXFb4f3HP0gAk28%2FnBbKDQ1CgmzuiLiUgVZdOqHwUca0lGFg2M%0A%2FV5AUbAi5kjw1EJOJA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584558/aa9f73f3542bab31a05fbb0f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef8d3ce47caae655d16a0f90a1b046ba0908492f1732335f40ab411e0a8c7c3b&req=cSkiE8F6mIRXFb4f3HP0gAk28%2FnBbKDQ1CgmzuiLiUgVZdOqHwUca0lGFg2M%0A%2FV5AUbAi5kjw1EJOJA%3D%3D%0A)

The Maximum Search Range represents to furthest possible date a patient can search for an appointment from the current date.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584622/e999cb22d73033f4bff116f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f55ef0f21cd0d3e235b9890a8873c0df15c76c7d5e46700ede95fe5444b95ffd&req=cSkiE8F6m4NdFb4f3HP0gGVIBM3s9Q4jJCoZ6OXTLhjg6mC8Ecite5y59IC9%0Aq7InGR%2FASVFpALVsSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584622/e999cb22d73033f4bff116f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f55ef0f21cd0d3e235b9890a8873c0df15c76c7d5e46700ede95fe5444b95ffd&req=cSkiE8F6m4NdFb4f3HP0gGVIBM3s9Q4jJCoZ6OXTLhjg6mC8Ecite5y59IC9%0Aq7InGR%2FASVFpALVsSQ%3D%3D%0A)

The PracSuite online booking system allows you to decide how many appointments are offered during a period (morning, afternoon and evening). With this setting at 3 appointments per period, a client will see up to 9 appointments per date. A maximum of 10 appointments can be displayed per period, allowing up to 30 possible appointment times in a day.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584727/5505301d5907f1b6d9fac99e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee7be18a7e9f5a9eeb59dca963b4d7ee62211ebbcf01764135143dd967003fd0&req=cSkiE8F6moNYFb4f3HP0gLQc3tPg7cA6EeZ3%2BnFV%2BC2Ne1ESF24BCI%2BNHJXy%0AYEneXrFwQvXO9IhIDg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584727/5505301d5907f1b6d9fac99e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee7be18a7e9f5a9eeb59dca963b4d7ee62211ebbcf01764135143dd967003fd0&req=cSkiE8F6moNYFb4f3HP0gLQc3tPg7cA6EeZ3%2BnFV%2BC2Ne1ESF24BCI%2BNHJXy%0AYEneXrFwQvXO9IhIDg%3D%3D%0A)

Finally, set the Guest Fee Category to determine what Fee Category the booking system will use to generate a fee to display (if enabled in the Services menu).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584771/c0dd4f3ecc2578b94c1a3633/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=421e36127d8fba1b6933ca0ea85d33552a32eeb0394c30916b7eaad3288869ae&req=cSkiE8F6moZeFb4f3HP0gBebVYqHbTU4U4tlTxn%2FdBewKUHWQda0vZbkhryS%0ALxxYY4yYqYQOq7R4Wg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595584771/c0dd4f3ecc2578b94c1a3633/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=421e36127d8fba1b6933ca0ea85d33552a32eeb0394c30916b7eaad3288869ae&req=cSkiE8F6moZeFb4f3HP0gBebVYqHbTU4U4tlTxn%2FdBewKUHWQda0vZbkhryS%0ALxxYY4yYqYQOq7R4Wg%3D%3D%0A)

How to Delete a Payment

How to Delete a Payment
=======================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Deleting a payment from the invoice screen](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746205-how-to-delete-a-payment#deleting-a-payment-from-the-invoice-screen)

[Deleting a payment from a patient or payer file](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746205-how-to-delete-a-payment#deleting-a-payment-from-a-patient-or-payer-file)

**Deleting a payment from the invoice screen**
==============================================

To delete a payment from the invoice screen, hover over the payment row and select the **delete icon**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639049/c8101dc88bd1ed80eb80522a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45b8d19827823f65b12631fbfe3e6e209c286949a011993cf760a718a395fd50&req=cSkiEMp3nYVWFb4f3HP0gGGTULjraxxoFnjdln41ReZRhviFF%2BZi%2FHJTMr5g%0A181Ap2vhw0GDPhVAJg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639049/c8101dc88bd1ed80eb80522a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45b8d19827823f65b12631fbfe3e6e209c286949a011993cf760a718a395fd50&req=cSkiEMp3nYVWFb4f3HP0gGGTULjraxxoFnjdln41ReZRhviFF%2BZi%2FHJTMr5g%0A181Ap2vhw0GDPhVAJg%3D%3D%0A)

Enter the reason for deleting the payment and select **Next**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639160/f1db9c5be759a1ceb6e306e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9372d6d0f1eead98dbada337c901c2f57ba3c64c89e449eeff0f9683da0fa456&req=cSkiEMp3nIdfFb4f3HP0gFR%2B%2FAYnLJRI22Y3KTTPiTy450GfsP2HSI%2FVeTYZ%0ABm%2FroabFB1SLSr4q2Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639160/f1db9c5be759a1ceb6e306e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9372d6d0f1eead98dbada337c901c2f57ba3c64c89e449eeff0f9683da0fa456&req=cSkiEMp3nIdfFb4f3HP0gFR%2B%2FAYnLJRI22Y3KTTPiTy450GfsP2HSI%2FVeTYZ%0ABm%2FroabFB1SLSr4q2Q%3D%3D%0A)

The final step is to confirm whether you wish to delete the payment entirely, or to make the payment unallocated and add it as an account credit.

To delete the payment entirely, select the **Delete Payment** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639231/e12ee28a67d272d18dc03849/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b9ca6581e64ecb72f8f8dde1ebe61836d603cc5833c89fc43ad35ce28e821d3f&req=cSkiEMp3n4JeFb4f3HP0gBWbEaWvddK%2F7uam9xrtYYSTkHhEI1hVS9wt3eqk%0Alkq6j22vFsrsxPFc6Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639231/e12ee28a67d272d18dc03849/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b9ca6581e64ecb72f8f8dde1ebe61836d603cc5833c89fc43ad35ce28e821d3f&req=cSkiEMp3n4JeFb4f3HP0gBWbEaWvddK%2F7uam9xrtYYSTkHhEI1hVS9wt3eqk%0Alkq6j22vFsrsxPFc6Q%3D%3D%0A)

To make the payment unallocated, select '**Make Unallocated**' in the drop-down list and select **Confirm**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639332/e277d7665bce32b92bc3f855/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=389348eccd3a345d26766dbefc31d0afb3c635ac1b86bad8d2282fb2ce48e3e8&req=cSkiEMp3noJdFb4f3HP0gCgswWSTb8JgfVM2AArzpDs4peO0mH4Z%2FvVY9e83%0ArRmKvvHHH3omOcMBJg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639332/e277d7665bce32b92bc3f855/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=389348eccd3a345d26766dbefc31d0afb3c635ac1b86bad8d2282fb2ce48e3e8&req=cSkiEMp3noJdFb4f3HP0gCgswWSTb8JgfVM2AArzpDs4peO0mH4Z%2FvVY9e83%0ArRmKvvHHH3omOcMBJg%3D%3D%0A)

**Deleting a payment from a patient or payer file**
===================================================

Payments can also be deleted entirely from the patient or payer file.

Go to the **Invoices** tab of the patient or payer file and select the **Payments** tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639826/d8eb7b4652eab9d3a8c83cd7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df9c6877b99e1f135af830c1af6871ad3389d12cfdffbef7522f8df0e045f6eb&req=cSkiEMp3lYNZFb4f3HP0gBaOj8OVWpgigvSBX5bAEeNqNXMmoSKc2e2ENRDY%0Aa4ja8wdJrd2dS3b8EQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595639826/d8eb7b4652eab9d3a8c83cd7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df9c6877b99e1f135af830c1af6871ad3389d12cfdffbef7522f8df0e045f6eb&req=cSkiEMp3lYNZFb4f3HP0gBaOj8OVWpgigvSBX5bAEeNqNXMmoSKc2e2ENRDY%0Aa4ja8wdJrd2dS3b8EQ%3D%3D%0A)

Use the checkbox to select the payment you wish to delete and select the **Delete** button. You will be prompted to enter a reason for deleting the payment.

How to Edit an Item or Payment Date on an Invoice

How to Edit an Item or Payment Date on an Invoice
=================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Editing Item Dates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746206-how-to-edit-an-item-or-payment-date-on-an-invoice#editing-item-dates)

[Editing Payment Dates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746206-how-to-edit-an-item-or-payment-date-on-an-invoice#editing-payment-dates)

**Editing Item Dates**
======================

On the patient's invoice, use the **Calendar icon** on the left of the items grid to change the item date.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595640270/d384e3b8f4f2b1b1bc4f0cd7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae7ef9501c00fc5eb1dc68f4b697214280d58e57d3858e7c4976da57e8a29e0d&req=cSkiEM1%2Bn4ZfFb4f3HP0gF2qPcqdL9ePji%2BZ4DamXexfNgaovIzvIAJiAyRf%0Ac9GMIwvzfixzsUjG5A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595640270/d384e3b8f4f2b1b1bc4f0cd7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae7ef9501c00fc5eb1dc68f4b697214280d58e57d3858e7c4976da57e8a29e0d&req=cSkiEM1%2Bn4ZfFb4f3HP0gF2qPcqdL9ePji%2BZ4DamXexfNgaovIzvIAJiAyRf%0Ac9GMIwvzfixzsUjG5A%3D%3D%0A)

**Editing Payment Dates**
=========================

Use the **Calendar icon** on the left of the payments grid to edit payment dates. Note that this will only be available if the user's role has the 'edit transaction entry date' permission.

## Document 128 — Processing Online Bookings | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-128}

Processing Online Bookings

Processing Online Bookings
==========================

Updated over 3 years ago

When an appointment is booked online an **alert** will appear in the bottom right of PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595641463/095f2b3652963653f3d80312/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e9954d63cbf9db52593991b385ea52300304aba83ecbdd80514112136e41664b&req=cSkiEM1%2FmYdcFb4f3HP0gOPNu6C8mkk4UHBPJ71SUqKv283UQklpoCC%2Bwy1i%0AKOAP4g%2FxZ5BBA%2FmhSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595641463/095f2b3652963653f3d80312/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e9954d63cbf9db52593991b385ea52300304aba83ecbdd80514112136e41664b&req=cSkiEM1%2FmYdcFb4f3HP0gOPNu6C8mkk4UHBPJ71SUqKv283UQklpoCC%2Bwy1i%0AKOAP4g%2FxZ5BBA%2FmhSQ%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595641350/b38ac9dd046510e12358101c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5971292624966f95c498cccdca8e610fceae267803af60bfd86b4c02e602654b&req=cSkiEM1%2FnoRfFb4f3HP0gCHVXRbAwmB7CWRHYSVfDO5aRKTKOedr1HhAB84z%0Ai0PK3WP%2BuStQ0rQrKA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595641350/b38ac9dd046510e12358101c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5971292624966f95c498cccdca8e610fceae267803af60bfd86b4c02e602654b&req=cSkiEM1%2FnoRfFb4f3HP0gCHVXRbAwmB7CWRHYSVfDO5aRKTKOedr1HhAB84z%0Ai0PK3WP%2BuStQ0rQrKA%3D%3D%0A)

If you **don't** see the Alert tool, ensure that the user's **Role** has access to Alerts and that the Alerts tool is selected in the three-dot menu at the top-right of PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595641679/c8fc44c4e65477ba26634354/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3cfbfbbc3081ded68e87fcd27e6dade9675357394bd41e9d65eb28059d7edcbe&req=cSkiEM1%2Fm4ZWFb4f3HP0gCWPLRJeMEdKKlQCvaW7Fxu5LW8zoh%2FHcMExlekS%0Az%2Bpx9CGrJEi8B4j2Jg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595641679/c8fc44c4e65477ba26634354/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3cfbfbbc3081ded68e87fcd27e6dade9675357394bd41e9d65eb28059d7edcbe&req=cSkiEM1%2Fm4ZWFb4f3HP0gCWPLRJeMEdKKlQCvaW7Fxu5LW8zoh%2FHcMExlekS%0Az%2Bpx9CGrJEi8B4j2Jg%3D%3D%0A)

Online guest bookings will also display on the appointment book in a purple colour with a globe symbol. The colour of guest bookings can be [customised in Settings > Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746228-customising-appointment-book-colours)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595643582/7214687dbb6581141b9bbbd2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8f28ec3ba026d7322fe7601de0b147d479631b8eae3dfe0c3f3df2f415d1c3f5&req=cSkiEM19mIldFb4f3HP0gPF3YCvZ3yPl5CjvfYHv3QbMZ9thiVSbI36Ryjt9%0A3cZ%2FSYsTfaxeD8na%2FA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595643582/7214687dbb6581141b9bbbd2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8f28ec3ba026d7322fe7601de0b147d479631b8eae3dfe0c3f3df2f415d1c3f5&req=cSkiEM19mIldFb4f3HP0gPF3YCvZ3yPl5CjvfYHv3QbMZ9thiVSbI36Ryjt9%0A3cZ%2FSYsTfaxeD8na%2FA%3D%3D%0A)

When selecting the guest booking in the Alert tool or when clicking the online booking from the appointment book, the processing window will appear.

This window allows you to view the details the patient provided online and make the decision to attach the appointment to a new patient file or an existing patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595643277/7032777455b97b661fc198cb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f8a4d1c2cb629ef46c12404502762de6863a1f44a6102ab3da5cb1502a0aaa82&req=cSkiEM19n4ZYFb4f3HP0gMmX41VSveQbVWDoPmPJvvDcgq7d3Sj8%2BqTT4kAS%0Av658AVv7c2hPld3UBw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595643277/7032777455b97b661fc198cb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f8a4d1c2cb629ef46c12404502762de6863a1f44a6102ab3da5cb1502a0aaa82&req=cSkiEM19n4ZYFb4f3HP0gMmX41VSveQbVWDoPmPJvvDcgq7d3Sj8%2BqTT4kAS%0Av658AVv7c2hPld3UBw%3D%3D%0A)

Existing patient files that are a potential match to the details the patient provided when booking online are displayed at the bottom of the pane. You can also search to find a patient file that is not displayed.

If there are no matches found, simply select the **New Client** button and a new file will be created.

If you've selected an existing file, you will have a final opportunity to update the details on the existing file on the next screen on a field-by-field basis.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595643157/442bd26203727d8d872e2060/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c0fee63d1115cc2012b638a3d15f05ef5adc318e043dabd5c8fbee11b424d851&req=cSkiEM19nIRYFb4f3HP0gBQaVVxCRPs7TTFz%2FbIy92xAowh1LF5U5vQ8kh6k%0AwyDHqDFMFRQ6F%2By1EQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595643157/442bd26203727d8d872e2060/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c0fee63d1115cc2012b638a3d15f05ef5adc318e043dabd5c8fbee11b424d851&req=cSkiEM19nIRYFb4f3HP0gBQaVVxCRPs7TTFz%2FbIy92xAowh1LF5U5vQ8kh6k%0AwyDHqDFMFRQ6F%2By1EQ%3D%3D%0A)

Use the arrows in the middle of the pane to update details on the existing file.

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

The appointment will then be displayed in the regular appointment type colour, with the globe symbol remaining to indicate that it was booked online.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595642090/048f68099cafd0a23071b77c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80416bb7f2022a226b40e63f09b927b90b417feb6257c07f3b07105f29e9026e&req=cSkiEM18nYhfFb4f3HP0gH27qIbFVj3%2B1VJikCCngMZIP5V%2Fz539aQwKArj%2B%0AddGXgHjhD%2Fu3paxSeA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595642090/048f68099cafd0a23071b77c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80416bb7f2022a226b40e63f09b927b90b417feb6257c07f3b07105f29e9026e&req=cSkiEM18nYhfFb4f3HP0gH27qIbFVj3%2B1VJikCCngMZIP5V%2Fz539aQwKArj%2B%0AddGXgHjhD%2Fu3paxSeA%3D%3D%0A)

How to Generate the Number of Online Bookings Report

How to Generate the Number of Online Bookings Report
====================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Using the Online Bookings Dashboard Widget](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746233-how-to-generate-the-number-of-online-bookings-report#h_86fa248f3a)

Using the Online Bookings Dashboard Widget
==========================================

Go to **[Reports > Dashboard](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/dashboard)
**

Select the **Add Widget** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631897749/1ace00e7bf37cbe79f093652/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a8cd87ea20c90e31c522a5a74e744817f1a8cf2438a0abd308a093cb11a743b&req=ciMmHsB5moVWFb4f3HP0gCYkKrlZgT6%2B4pklqaTSuyXAxJXJxiSFyAISETdw%0AA%2FLv53A26d3NAV4Evw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631897749/1ace00e7bf37cbe79f093652/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a8cd87ea20c90e31c522a5a74e744817f1a8cf2438a0abd308a093cb11a743b&req=ciMmHsB5moVWFb4f3HP0gCYkKrlZgT6%2B4pklqaTSuyXAxJXJxiSFyAISETdw%0AA%2FLv53A26d3NAV4Evw%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Online Bookings** widget.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631897891/b978352300756316fc93b4e7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea11388b5bf5908b8a64f50f76243b36df46cd53e01ff4a6f3eb81e389d32e01&req=ciMmHsB5lYheFb4f3HP0gG%2FjpGjnw362r8HZ5g1WK%2B72ZN5P93VE%2Bq1jw%2Bwt%0AV4JUdQjRYwOgedFNOw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631897891/b978352300756316fc93b4e7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea11388b5bf5908b8a64f50f76243b36df46cd53e01ff4a6f3eb81e389d32e01&req=ciMmHsB5lYheFb4f3HP0gG%2FjpGjnw362r8HZ5g1WK%2B72ZN5P93VE%2Bq1jw%2Bwt%0AV4JUdQjRYwOgedFNOw%3D%3D%0A)

Choose your desired date range and display filters at a minimum.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631898152/4968de63685d9480998e65fa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85dae4b44f2bcb3229c8304e8e636668cd049f3b96832f77fc205ee8f52aad5c&req=ciMmHsB2nIRdFb4f3HP0gMQ0ZGgePvwjP53OMAeoAiIVVgFyfHckkp1vb%2F6K%0A74jd4SuTbp9bMZoc7A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631898152/4968de63685d9480998e65fa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85dae4b44f2bcb3229c8304e8e636668cd049f3b96832f77fc205ee8f52aad5c&req=ciMmHsB2nIRdFb4f3HP0gMQ0ZGgePvwjP53OMAeoAiIVVgFyfHckkp1vb%2F6K%0A74jd4SuTbp9bMZoc7A%3D%3D%0A)

The total number of online bookings will be displayed based on your chosen filters.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631898434/703ba7fbe2ede889f1c95c13/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=39743f32103a8b0cdaf519d21a415ba22c5f20647c745e1bf2d4c6c36841bda0&req=ciMmHsB2mYJbFb4f3HP0gDWy0cKMabIQ7diauBbldOIOXM3vMlEmM4cNqJtv%0AMIYFK472RgskCAF%2B8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631898434/703ba7fbe2ede889f1c95c13/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=39743f32103a8b0cdaf519d21a415ba22c5f20647c745e1bf2d4c6c36841bda0&req=ciMmHsB2mYJbFb4f3HP0gDWy0cKMabIQ7diauBbldOIOXM3vMlEmM4cNqJtv%0AMIYFK472RgskCAF%2B8w%3D%3D%0A)

Using the Appointment Report
============================

The Appointment Report can be used to report on the number of online bookings in a date range.

Go to **[Reports > Appointments > Appointment](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/appointment/appointments)
**

Use the **'Made by'** filter to select **Online Booking**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631898664/b26ec2e96fdc635aa7770008/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db24f181365fb0c1428d5074da3950cd06f5f548398e9055067e01bcdf8da6a8&req=ciMmHsB2m4dbFb4f3HP0gLe4EoAu3f%2Byj44%2BKb1hMiftzfdquWLxyl%2BWiia6%0A6%2FH9Wx%2BY4VgkwEkLMg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631898664/b26ec2e96fdc635aa7770008/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db24f181365fb0c1428d5074da3950cd06f5f548398e9055067e01bcdf8da6a8&req=ciMmHsB2m4dbFb4f3HP0gLe4EoAu3f%2Byj44%2BKb1hMiftzfdquWLxyl%2BWiia6%0A6%2FH9Wx%2BY4VgkwEkLMg%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Generate Report**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631898790/f57ec9bcfbd3217dbaf1c966/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b87df126fe5ab5f583c91629ff1deb89acae935f78872bed6519c9a0109b7306&req=ciMmHsB2mohfFb4f3HP0gILxJElY6wMco8jpJaIWSHuf1A6K8K%2BH3LUOnmvB%0AJGBoTZax5UPnyDKw5Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631898790/f57ec9bcfbd3217dbaf1c966/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b87df126fe5ab5f583c91629ff1deb89acae935f78872bed6519c9a0109b7306&req=ciMmHsB2mohfFb4f3HP0gILxJElY6wMco8jpJaIWSHuf1A6K8K%2BH3LUOnmvB%0AJGBoTZax5UPnyDKw5Q%3D%3D%0A)

Details of patients who have booked online will be displayed in the grid.

The total number of appointments is displayed in the bottom right of the results grid.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/280844453/8055277df32bd2019942378e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ecea033da788468768fae605e56f1151d5a97bc3e459e147e05e8ae768cbf589&req=dignHs16mYRcFb4f3HP0gGIeQy90C%2FAmaN3NosJwsYYMe9dtNXkGOHvJkS3j%0A4VZhoapFf5YiLZW0BA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/280844453/8055277df32bd2019942378e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ecea033da788468768fae605e56f1151d5a97bc3e459e147e05e8ae768cbf589&req=dignHs16mYRcFb4f3HP0gGIeQy90C%2FAmaN3NosJwsYYMe9dtNXkGOHvJkS3j%0A4VZhoapFf5YiLZW0BA%3D%3D%0A)

Online Booking Locations

Online Booking Locations
========================

Updated over 8 months ago

Table of contents

[Location Details](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746475-online-booking-locations#location-details)

[Show Map on Confirmation Page](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746475-online-booking-locations#show-map-on-confirmation-page)

[Businesses](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746475-online-booking-locations#businesses)

Online booking locations represent the physical locations that a patient will select from when stepping through the online booking process.

Go to **[Settings > Online Booking > Locations](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/locations)**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595644623/74c180aae4d52c1b24afd610/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28e79cd16097c89b435324abf73a08bfa47a7942266e4ed90e28cebf13f5d6c1&req=cSkiEM16m4NcFb4f3HP0gKSAtgByRa7GI4iU5XYFQeZO9oI1%2BoihNpb%2FDU7N%0AHKXeYF65DPhmjsLyiQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595644623/74c180aae4d52c1b24afd610/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28e79cd16097c89b435324abf73a08bfa47a7942266e4ed90e28cebf13f5d6c1&req=cSkiEM16m4NcFb4f3HP0gKSAtgByRa7GI4iU5XYFQeZO9oI1%2BoihNpb%2FDU7N%0AHKXeYF65DPhmjsLyiQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add** to create a new location.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595644815/7887f6649150e3af6be1ec4a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=394377a2357bd364f566a6b1aec01c459e4ec09d347aa020d96f209c8e799d4c&req=cSkiEM16lYBaFb4f3HP0gJ1l83AKPtgFXItXy7rFgAkCLVoHRwNpOi67gl%2Fm%0AbWEmTNfR5sqtHr9Kkw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595644815/7887f6649150e3af6be1ec4a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=394377a2357bd364f566a6b1aec01c459e4ec09d347aa020d96f209c8e799d4c&req=cSkiEM16lYBaFb4f3HP0gJ1l83AKPtgFXItXy7rFgAkCLVoHRwNpOi67gl%2Fm%0AbWEmTNfR5sqtHr9Kkw%3D%3D%0A)

**Location Details**
====================

For most practices, an online booking location will represent a single PracSuite business. However, for practices that have multiple PracSuite businesses operating at the same physical location, an online booking location can represent multiple businesses.

Enter a **Location Name** that will be displayed to patients booking online.

The Business drop-down list can be used to select the address and contact information that will be displayed. Leave the business set to **None** if you wish to manually enter the details displayed online for this location.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595664885/9b0f2228d5262f77068829c8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09492d381614a838ab35b656d4906715227a083f79f944ee182b91c5f5c5fea3&req=cSkiEM96lYlaFb4f3HP0gMRyt2KQXLoJzS5kXbv8PAGz9uoq7p9UNkLNav85%0AaKK8Cn5vscS0vRql6Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595664885/9b0f2228d5262f77068829c8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09492d381614a838ab35b656d4906715227a083f79f944ee182b91c5f5c5fea3&req=cSkiEM96lYlaFb4f3HP0gMRyt2KQXLoJzS5kXbv8PAGz9uoq7p9UNkLNav85%0AaKK8Cn5vscS0vRql6Q%3D%3D%0A)

**Show Map on Confirmation Page**
=================================

The **Show Map on Confirmation Page** option allows you to display a Google Maps overview for this location and provide the option to get directions to the location. This can either be based on the **Location Address** entered or a **Google Maps Place ID**. [Click here to search and find your Google Maps Place ID](https://developers.google.com/places/web-service/place-id)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1588996139/10988b24a72f9ddb2245737dd2ed/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be0b1a8d08391ab3bd990c183737c034fce9946c4f65c266845f56ded686ec13&req=dSUvHsB3m4BcUPMW1HO4zb8SPHCT6W60qrPL9JntOI0z%2FSZ3pN990kl7blBu%0AJdBivT8iwojIGTKbQ8w%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1588996139/10988b24a72f9ddb2245737dd2ed/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be0b1a8d08391ab3bd990c183737c034fce9946c4f65c266845f56ded686ec13&req=dSUvHsB3m4BcUPMW1HO4zb8SPHCT6W60qrPL9JntOI0z%2FSZ3pN990kl7blBu%0AJdBivT8iwojIGTKbQ8w%3D%0A)

An example of the map is shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595669815/7c716154e9454f17a0197315/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2004bcbe3c1ce17537792778f544e781e4a6b6100b3653741bda06d786366a02&req=cSkiEM93lYBaFb4f3HP0gJyAyE81%2Bq7gAqEBPJ8ro3QJFjNoEqFpLWlk1KoS%0AKPxs%2FD5k1Z8qSiDt0Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595669815/7c716154e9454f17a0197315/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2004bcbe3c1ce17537792778f544e781e4a6b6100b3653741bda06d786366a02&req=cSkiEM93lYBaFb4f3HP0gJyAyE81%2Bq7gAqEBPJ8ro3QJFjNoEqFpLWlk1KoS%0AKPxs%2FD5k1Z8qSiDt0Q%3D%3D%0A)

**Businesses**
==============

The final step of the Location setup process is to add the Businesses that will be available for online bookings at this Location.

For most practices, an online booking location will represent a single PracSuite business. However, for practices that have multiple PracSuite businesses operating at the same physical location, an online booking location can represent multiple businesses.

Select **Add** and select the relevant businesses from the drop-down menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595670012/7763949240867329f4d7052f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27611920c07ea487fa8ca30747d5918f7719a65b2a8c2e86e494ac18befa0642&req=cSkiEM5%2BnYBdFb4f3HP0gA0UM%2Fkds%2BBgCGaWTajWHKooPNXPkkgJZDeYCY5J%0A8kNMmHeSqH487eFx7A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595670012/7763949240867329f4d7052f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27611920c07ea487fa8ca30747d5918f7719a65b2a8c2e86e494ac18befa0642&req=cSkiEM5%2BnYBdFb4f3HP0gA0UM%2Fkds%2BBgCGaWTajWHKooPNXPkkgJZDeYCY5J%0A8kNMmHeSqH487eFx7A%3D%3D%0A)

Online Booking Services

Online Booking Services
=======================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Service Details](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746476-online-booking-services#service-details)

[Appointment Types](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746476-online-booking-services#appointment-types)

Services are displayed to patients when booking online and can be managed in **[Settings > Online Booking > Services](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/services)
**.

The page will display any existing services and their associated new patient and existing patient appointment types.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614800670/c65de1481cff68cacf059a01/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b2ed981ca47c0e255c59201d3c522555912f096f4002c7454fc063f65f5b35a7&req=ciEjHsl%2Bm4ZfFb4f3HP0gHRprb%2Bbt9WrvPMwKhMxxv3hYsQl7gQwFqIXBY%2Bc%0APDUON4HD0lbHhSSlyw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614800670/c65de1481cff68cacf059a01/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b2ed981ca47c0e255c59201d3c522555912f096f4002c7454fc063f65f5b35a7&req=ciEjHsl%2Bm4ZfFb4f3HP0gHRprb%2Bbt9WrvPMwKhMxxv3hYsQl7gQwFqIXBY%2Bc%0APDUON4HD0lbHhSSlyw%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add** to add create a new service.

**Service Details**
===================

When creating a new service, specify the **Service Name** that will be displayed online to patients. The Service will need to be linked to one or more **Professions**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614800855/0db93806a5a89df80f0ffe1e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b9b2030203a48bfeeaaf688428d9206d8804baada16863506f753771a898be3&req=ciEjHsl%2BlYRaFb4f3HP0gI0FYe7MvBp%2FIHJVWNvbh8jkSq%2Bqd8m9lknc662f%0AjnWbiZcyNKvLmKfCYw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614800855/0db93806a5a89df80f0ffe1e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b9b2030203a48bfeeaaf688428d9206d8804baada16863506f753771a898be3&req=ciEjHsl%2BlYRaFb4f3HP0gI0FYe7MvBp%2FIHJVWNvbh8jkSq%2Bqd8m9lknc662f%0AjnWbiZcyNKvLmKfCYw%3D%3D%0A)

The following settings can also be enabled:

**Show Description -** Explain more about this service to your patients. You can also link to another page on your website to elaborate on this.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614801245/2fb639340b0c0a1b84e52164/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3478dfdae24e14e4bf6ea4d0fb5e2fe66dfc1fd2c53d93df0e86d23dfd43a483&req=ciEjHsl%2Fn4VaFb4f3HP0gNh43kLI%2Bm2Ed5HEe9%2F7s%2BBeXm%2BPgJLAtq0Ja5Ck%0Am%2Fn%2Fl3HPE98K3zmkMA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614801245/2fb639340b0c0a1b84e52164/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3478dfdae24e14e4bf6ea4d0fb5e2fe66dfc1fd2c53d93df0e86d23dfd43a483&req=ciEjHsl%2Fn4VaFb4f3HP0gNh43kLI%2Bm2Ed5HEe9%2F7s%2BBeXm%2BPgJLAtq0Ja5Ck%0Am%2Fn%2Fl3HPE98K3zmkMA%3D%3D%0A)

**Show Photo -** Display a photo for the service.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614801497/c29655bfec3f02521c81aae2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80964c70fbe98860b58aa367fb3778515cf80586f582aaaf06c3c6cf20498572&req=ciEjHsl%2FmYhYFb4f3HP0gM5lludBxwAXuSRn6EpfCQzKSk4YZIUBVVOw%2F5tv%0ARj2D130qK%2BxmflATQw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614801497/c29655bfec3f02521c81aae2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80964c70fbe98860b58aa367fb3778515cf80586f582aaaf06c3c6cf20498572&req=ciEjHsl%2FmYhYFb4f3HP0gM5lludBxwAXuSRn6EpfCQzKSk4YZIUBVVOw%2F5tv%0ARj2D130qK%2BxmflATQw%3D%3D%0A)

**Confirmation Prompt -** Present a confirmation prompt that patients must confirm before finalising their appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614802316/96b0124474094e6c2a2fb6a0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8ac477be4ab6f27d8b6ebad8d1704593be152bb1a8f88575d1b75285018e541&req=ciEjHsl8noBZFb4f3HP0gDCSgrOQrSshAIXQdBSqf%2FdUQWUqSrMJL8nem5qC%0APKItQF31x7pBzuxC3Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614802316/96b0124474094e6c2a2fb6a0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8ac477be4ab6f27d8b6ebad8d1704593be152bb1a8f88575d1b75285018e541&req=ciEjHsl8noBZFb4f3HP0gDCSgrOQrSshAIXQdBSqf%2FdUQWUqSrMJL8nem5qC%0APKItQF31x7pBzuxC3Q%3D%3D%0A)

An example of the Service selection page that your patients will see is shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/284630750/f1920b9681234f4c851a6019/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f606d9acfcdfe328b15b91e86e9ca149fd9fdc07a8c748dbbb676768293c3e4&req=digjEMp%2BmoRfFb4f3HP0gEoRILrGZQe4miZDO9rCju5drCrlyTSXF3EWCUn6%0Ax8HVTaozs17EM4rosg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/284630750/f1920b9681234f4c851a6019/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f606d9acfcdfe328b15b91e86e9ca149fd9fdc07a8c748dbbb676768293c3e4&req=digjEMp%2BmoRfFb4f3HP0gEoRILrGZQe4miZDO9rCju5drCrlyTSXF3EWCUn6%0Ax8HVTaozs17EM4rosg%3D%3D%0A)

**Appointment Types**
=====================

When creating a service, you need to specify the **Appointment Types** that New and Existing patients can select from.

Select **Add** and select the appropriate appointment type from the drop-down list. Use the **cog icon** on the right-hand side to manage your preferences for this appointment type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614802787/ddb5020d16452f1845fdefe6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=790cd8177beafe4433897880b81263f949140938d080549d0bfd59ec40eb30b1&req=ciEjHsl8molYFb4f3HP0gG4K49G2s4XEWX7MXfDm%2FEMQ4QHkslKeeArFwAAX%0Akcfkxnr3%2B4iAd8QR8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614802787/ddb5020d16452f1845fdefe6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=790cd8177beafe4433897880b81263f949140938d080549d0bfd59ec40eb30b1&req=ciEjHsl8molYFb4f3HP0gG4K49G2s4XEWX7MXfDm%2FEMQ4QHkslKeeArFwAAX%0Akcfkxnr3%2B4iAd8QR8w%3D%3D%0A)

Tip: If you do not wish for New or Existing Patients to book for this service, do not add any appointment types to the respective grid.

When selecting the settings cog, the following popup will appear:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614805796/8c244553669b033f7bf7f984/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10251c2c65e01c649f79498a40a2d84d1a37961c5f9631864ef9a6d46dc78bc5&req=ciEjHsl7mohZFb4f3HP0gILqOmEarotMDSHR84KCZD0SN7TKwmEEiOLCOYC4%0A65mXENtiIGh66GTqDg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614805796/8c244553669b033f7bf7f984/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10251c2c65e01c649f79498a40a2d84d1a37961c5f9631864ef9a6d46dc78bc5&req=ciEjHsl7mohZFb4f3HP0gILqOmEarotMDSHR84KCZD0SN7TKwmEEiOLCOYC4%0A65mXENtiIGh66GTqDg%3D%3D%0A)

The following settings can also be enabled:

**Display Name** - Choose the display name for this appointment type that will be shown online. You can leave this blank if you wish to display the appointment type name that staff see when using PracSuite.

**Description -** Provide a description for this appointment type that will be displayed online.

**Show Duration -** Displays the length of the appointment according to the profession and practitioner defaults set on the appointment type.

**Show Fees -** Displays the fee for the appointment according to the default on the appointment type and the [Guest Fee Category](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4743365-online-booking-general-settings)
.

**Allow Notes -** Provide the option for the patient to provide a reason for their appointment.

**Require Notes -** Requires the patient to provide a reason for their appointment.

**Payments** - Online payments are enabled for this appointment type. [More info about online payments can be found here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5590695-setting-up-online-payments)
.

**Confirmation Email Template -** Select the template that will be emailed to the patient after they book online. Confirmations should not be confused with Appointment Reminders, which are sent XX days prior to an appointment.

**Confirmation SMS Template -** Select the template that will be sent as an SMS to the patient after they book online. Confirmations should not be confused with Appointment Reminders, which are sent XX days prior to an appointment.

Table of contents

[Directing patients to the standalone online booking page (most common)](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746485-how-to-add-pracsuite-online-bookings-to-your-website#h_1a1e53ca6b)

[Embedding your online booking system on an existing webpage (more complex)](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746485-how-to-add-pracsuite-online-bookings-to-your-website#embedding-your-online-booking-system-on-an-existing-webpage)

_If you require your website developer to add the booking system to your website, please direct them to this help article and provide them with your chosen Online URL as shown below._

The link to your online booking system can be found in **[Settings > Online Booking > Online Booking Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)** under the **General** section.

You can copy the URL by selecting the **copy button** to the right of the URL.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595648634/61a244b77bdfb91481de68cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49ef4d5bea73154554db9b9029342fbc66fa588d11484b2dcf8b9f5dfe749023&req=cSkiEM12m4JbFb4f3HP0gHRbAt6aJKA82%2FGIria48f5cYtZPtI8WIef8v%2BSD%0AvhAfZBPOEBMwSfao5Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595648634/61a244b77bdfb91481de68cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49ef4d5bea73154554db9b9029342fbc66fa588d11484b2dcf8b9f5dfe749023&req=cSkiEM12m4JbFb4f3HP0gHRbAt6aJKA82%2FGIria48f5cYtZPtI8WIef8v%2BSD%0AvhAfZBPOEBMwSfao5Q%3D%3D%0A)

It's also possible to create direct booking links for particular locations, services and practitioners. [Click here to learn more about direct booking URLs.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6339111-finding-and-using-direct-online-booking-links)

* * *

Now that you have the URL for your online booking site, there are two options for adding the URL to your website:

1.  Directing patients to the standalone online booking page
    
2.  Embedding your online booking system on an existing webpage
    

Directing patients to the standalone online booking page (most common)
======================================================================

If you do not wish to embed your online booking page in an existing webpage, you can instead choose to link directly to it. This will direct the patient away from your website to the online booking page.

This method will require your website developer to attach your online booking URL to an 'online booking' button that is easily discoverable on your website.

Embedding your online booking system on an existing webpage (more complex)
==========================================================================

It is possible to embed your online booking site onto another page on your website, though this setup is more complex and may limit your ability to [track online booking conversions](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6077310-tracking-online-booking-conversions-with-google-analytics-4-and-google-tag-manager)
 with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager and Facebook Pixel.

First, you must enable embedding of the booking website in [Settings > Online Booking > Overview.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)

Select **Add** and enter your website domain(s) that you will be embedding the booking website on.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/658943050/2e220cae09d35f37bd4da727/CleanShot+2023-01-25+at+09.15.45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85b73625430d64686201d07e5f78015755bdbf34da69e8d2cc99de2f3d6fe72a&req=ciUvH819nYRfFb4f3HP0gKHqhed8g4inHCQcRbtSjfDqCrHtaFqVPdzfJO6Q%0A148hWmTf5fDMpHMP%2FA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/658943050/2e220cae09d35f37bd4da727/CleanShot+2023-01-25+at+09.15.45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85b73625430d64686201d07e5f78015755bdbf34da69e8d2cc99de2f3d6fe72a&req=ciUvH819nYRfFb4f3HP0gKHqhed8g4inHCQcRbtSjfDqCrHtaFqVPdzfJO6Q%0A148hWmTf5fDMpHMP%2FA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Once you've added your domains to the list, use the code snippet below to embed your online booking system on an existing page on your website.

**Note: You must replace YOUR\_PRACTICE with your chosen name in the online booking URL. This must be done in all 3 places shown below.**

<div id="ob-iframe-container">  
    <iframe id="ob-iframe" src="https://YOUR\_PRACTICE.bookings.pracsuite.com/" height="800px" width="100%"></iframe>  
    <script type="application/javascript" src="https://YOUR\_PRACTICE.bookings.pracsuite.com/static\_js/embed.js"></script>  
    <link type="text/css" rel="stylesheet" href="https://YOUR\_PRACTICE.bookings.pracsuite.com/css/embed.css" />  
</div>

Online Booking Setup Overview

Online Booking Setup Overview
=============================

How to enable and setup online bookings in PracSuite

Updated over 12 months ago

Online bookings for individual and group appointments are available to all PracSuite users at no additional cost. PracSuite also offers both a **guest booking** path (patients do not require a login) as well as a **client login portal**, which allows patients to **check upcoming appointment times**, as well as options to **cancel** and **reschedule** their appointments.

Click through the articles below to learn how to set up and customise the online booking experience for your patients. For Online Bookings to function correctly you need to follow articles **1**, **2**, **3** and **5**.

1.  [Online Booking General Settings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4743365-online-booking-general-settings)
    
2.  [Online Booking Locations](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746475-online-booking-locations)
    
3.  [Online Booking Services](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746476-online-booking-services)
    
4.  [Managing Online Booking for Group Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4919961-enabling-group-online-bookings)
    
5.  [Enabling Online Booking for Practitioners](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4767394-enabling-a-practitioner-for-online-booking)

7.  [Specifying Available Time for Online Bookings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4770750-specifying-available-time-for-online-bookings)
    
8.  [Processing Online Bookings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746220-processing-online-bookings)
    
9.  [Enabling Online Payments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5590695-setting-up-online-payments)
    
10.  [How to Add Online Bookings to Your Website](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746485-how-to-add-pracsuite-online-bookings-to-your-website)
    
11.  [How to Report on the Number of Online Bookings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746233-how-to-report-on-the-number-of-online-bookings)
    

Please don't hesitate to [contact Smartsoft](https://www.smartsoft.com.au/support/)

Enabling a Practitioner for Online Booking

Enabling a Practitioner for Online Booking
==========================================

Updated over 2 weeks ago

Table of contents

[Practitioner Details](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4767394-enabling-a-practitioner-for-online-booking#practitioner-details)

[Locations & Services](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4767394-enabling-a-practitioner-for-online-booking#h_2adc115ed5)

[Patient Booking Permissions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4767394-enabling-a-practitioner-for-online-booking#h_d0c2de566c)

To make a practitioner available for online bookings, go to **[Settings > Online Booking Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/practitioners)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601959284/5fb5c8369cfcf1c74ef876ee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4683fb8b36573443d6135e7964b79caee9711f2216d0ce23fc8ef6b56afcf17e&req=ciAmH8x3n4lbFb4f3HP0gF8jkU%2FqNxMxhmc2BkWrGgXcUlWPEJTrgFA%2F4BpO%0ATOMRefRK4WA%2BbnHiJg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601959284/5fb5c8369cfcf1c74ef876ee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4683fb8b36573443d6135e7964b79caee9711f2216d0ce23fc8ef6b56afcf17e&req=ciAmH8x3n4lbFb4f3HP0gF8jkU%2FqNxMxhmc2BkWrGgXcUlWPEJTrgFA%2F4BpO%0ATOMRefRK4WA%2BbnHiJg%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add** to add a new practitioner to your online booking site.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601959431/1c139dd8a3218d26d443c247/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a2271db6dd9afd4c0d41f32432a5f77d4afb6608225425702ffbe81fbb8b0f05&req=ciAmH8x3mYJeFb4f3HP0gP0lsVtE1NAztF2HshfBwaCDx0r%2BkkNjL9AJXx6j%0AnLFvDwgrGdIfQTnCzw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601959431/1c139dd8a3218d26d443c247/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a2271db6dd9afd4c0d41f32432a5f77d4afb6608225425702ffbe81fbb8b0f05&req=ciAmH8x3mYJeFb4f3HP0gP0lsVtE1NAztF2HshfBwaCDx0r%2BkkNjL9AJXx6j%0AnLFvDwgrGdIfQTnCzw%3D%3D%0A)

**Practitioner Details**
========================

Use the Practitioner dropdown to select the Practitioner you wish to enable.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1589006329/4bb62fe3380dda389b8ea469f8d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3ee7a1c364c7204bc9ca678207029b66f98568d939ed603989fc1d3830c21502&req=dSUvH8l%2Bm4JdUPMW1HO4zWSjj4mkawpmBljzqA9TdxGlQ%2FFsbrRKQX8zS8fV%0ADVCxKDIumt0heECGBPw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1589006329/4bb62fe3380dda389b8ea469f8d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3ee7a1c364c7204bc9ca678207029b66f98568d939ed603989fc1d3830c21502&req=dSUvH8l%2Bm4JdUPMW1HO4zWSjj4mkawpmBljzqA9TdxGlQ%2FFsbrRKQX8zS8fV%0ADVCxKDIumt0heECGBPw%3D%0A)

If the practitioner is happy to accept new patient bookings, enable the **Allow New Patient Bookings** setting.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601960509/2cbbf6d42a1974e12bb6074f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06b6cdfb110bdb54e4d8250160c8ebad9a33b83ce07b6f9fe0de60386f46f94e&req=ciAmH89%2BmIFWFb4f3HP0gH5XLpBv36TzuWbHDAf7g%2FQ%2BKayBT5B8LBOL55ZS%0AinQ5kfbC1z2OCRd%2B7Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601960509/2cbbf6d42a1974e12bb6074f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06b6cdfb110bdb54e4d8250160c8ebad9a33b83ce07b6f9fe0de60386f46f94e&req=ciAmH89%2BmIFWFb4f3HP0gH5XLpBv36TzuWbHDAf7g%2FQ%2BKayBT5B8LBOL55ZS%0AinQ5kfbC1z2OCRd%2B7Q%3D%3D%0A)

You can also select **Show Description** and **Show Photo** should display additional information for your patients to help inform who they are booking with. If you can't fit in all the information you want to present, you can also add a more detailed description adding a **Long Description URL** to link to an external page on your website.

Locations & Services
--------------------

You will see a list of the Practitioner's **Businesses** and their **Corresponding Locations**. Select the **Businesses** that you would like to enable online booking for and then click into the services lines to add the services the practitioner offers at that location.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1589020357/43da09c6ee0e6ffa4e96cbf64ea9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cdb78c1ee0462f947f6d86fe7c448f3aef9974a9c4f1cee8d24495910383ba93&req=dSUvH8l8nYJaXvMW1HO4zSKsH2B%2BmkqY98fAxnoiuZm4n5EyL7zgXAGluZI%2F%0AxJ8dnu6fIPnM3r1NkTA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1589020357/43da09c6ee0e6ffa4e96cbf64ea9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cdb78c1ee0462f947f6d86fe7c448f3aef9974a9c4f1cee8d24495910383ba93&req=dSUvH8l8nYJaXvMW1HO4zSKsH2B%2BmkqY98fAxnoiuZm4n5EyL7zgXAGluZI%2F%0AxJ8dnu6fIPnM3r1NkTA%3D%0A)

When you are done, click **Save** at the top to confirm your changes.

Patient Booking Permissions
---------------------------

In addition to setting the Services for a Location, you can also set restrictions on which patients can book at each one.

While in Edit mode, hovering over a Location will show the Edit button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2028652773/103c9eaac754ff769f5c98e10b60/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06e08824152c253f350c5666e1b4faca0e2e6ec7728d8c38ffc7a6456a124e9f&req=diAlHs97n4ZYWvMW1HO4zY2GsUXHvp5XIpZphJZpNKsVe2U08hyKevM6q1U9%0AfLo3M3LyJ%2BDjLD6Ow9U%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2028652773/103c9eaac754ff769f5c98e10b60/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06e08824152c253f350c5666e1b4faca0e2e6ec7728d8c38ffc7a6456a124e9f&req=diAlHs97n4ZYWvMW1HO4zY2GsUXHvp5XIpZphJZpNKsVe2U08hyKevM6q1U9%0AfLo3M3LyJ%2BDjLD6Ow9U%3D%0A)

Clicking on that button will open the Permissions window where you can set restrictions on the patients that can book with this Practitioner or patients that have this Practitioner set as their Default Practitioner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2028671913/be6dedbd8fd1f437d662484f7926/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d31b92b13695f98b4f9155b440fde75d0425bcc0851e0af158af7232010dcc9a&req=diAlHs95nIheWvMW1HO4zTZv4C7hoezfas6qPhQyYAVuJ05ac218fHfVhzTc%0AWmpBaprabXTrpapWo80%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2028671913/be6dedbd8fd1f437d662484f7926/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d31b92b13695f98b4f9155b440fde75d0425bcc0851e0af158af7232010dcc9a&req=diAlHs95nIheWvMW1HO4zTZv4C7hoezfas6qPhQyYAVuJ05ac218fHfVhzTc%0AWmpBaprabXTrpapWo80%3D%0A)

Specifying Available Time for Online Bookings
=============================================

Online appointment availability in PracSuite is affected by all of the following:

*   Minimum and maximum search period
    
*   Consecutive Appointments
    
*   Rosters
    
*   Roster Overrides
    
*   Existing appointments
    
*   Days off
    
*   Notes
    
*   Rule Outs
    

**Minimum and Maximum Search Period**
=====================================

You can specify the minimum and maximum search range for online bookings by going to **[Settings > Online Booking > Online Booking Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
**.

For example, you may not want patients booking within an hour of the current time and not beyond 3 months.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595598416/3e1c075325105b92b2931751/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6608ea7cf6136d0a17b5f041da5392c3a35db853b04b88b42c4901bf8cf50ce9&req=cSkiE8B2mYBZFb4f3HP0gGRc8OyQZS%2B8azTzMSgDBQMKBEFqW6s4swUO41lW%0AQtjViMyopPZ%2Fbtm80g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595598416/3e1c075325105b92b2931751/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6608ea7cf6136d0a17b5f041da5392c3a35db853b04b88b42c4901bf8cf50ce9&req=cSkiE8B2mYBZFb4f3HP0gGRc8OyQZS%2B8azTzMSgDBQMKBEFqW6s4swUO41lW%0AQtjViMyopPZ%2Fbtm80g%3D%3D%0A)

Consecutive Appointments
========================

If you would prefer to prevent or allow Back-to-back bookings, you can alter the **Consecutive Appointments** setting on the **[Settings > Online Booking > Online Booking Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
** page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2028416279/0159b7d82f7b715c993f508a8960/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d835ca934f59c131a5277ec19f0a9494ec15f0096cfc9ba04eabaec47a98e55e&req=diAlHs1%2Fm4NYUPMW1HO4zS00EikVsdGH8ooqGNmd38zrL2yhRzBPejYHFnH5%0AmqvKjtNz4fJflzWMKLQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2028416279/0159b7d82f7b715c993f508a8960/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d835ca934f59c131a5277ec19f0a9494ec15f0096cfc9ba04eabaec47a98e55e&req=diAlHs1%2Fm4NYUPMW1HO4zS00EikVsdGH8ooqGNmd38zrL2yhRzBPejYHFnH5%0AmqvKjtNz4fJflzWMKLQ%3D%0A)

More information on this setting can be found by hovering your cursor over the tooltip icon next to this setting. ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2028419648/dd46885bff483a2022a0e15370f8/image.png?expires=1771902000&signature=bc725806376d81382ad0da7528e22e896ee37cf8072f7c947a95ec1150cdef79&req=diAlHs1%2FlIdbUfMW3Hu4gbyoZpGqyiK2h9AZ2BsTvf3s9rScbOsw3EmNtFqY%0AyQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Roster Availability**
=======================

The easiest way to control when patients are able to book online is by using **Rosters**. [For a detailed guide on setting up a **Roster** please click here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides)
.

The practitioner's Roster is the first level that informs PracSuite if time in the appointment book is available for online appointments.

For each day that a Roster is active, between the start and end times, the **Roster Availability** dictates whether **Online Appointments** are available via the checkbox pictured below.

For details on how to manage online booking availability for practitioners with multiple appointment book columns, [please click here](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4773602-specifying-available-time-for-online-bookings-for-multi-column-practitioners)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595598576/0f141a39628ee0aa2f3e4271/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a8bc0ff6489d07773b6ac2fb5cf39704bacd97a08a9b73fa46c05811683b711&req=cSkiE8B2mIZZFb4f3HP0gLVzMnuEN2pNJQqMYsWS0nZW%2FZpOf29sNOFbuh4m%0Alc90kPSl5YM%2Bt%2BZc%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595598576/0f141a39628ee0aa2f3e4271/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a8bc0ff6489d07773b6ac2fb5cf39704bacd97a08a9b73fa46c05811683b711&req=cSkiE8B2mIZZFb4f3HP0gLVzMnuEN2pNJQqMYsWS0nZW%2FZpOf29sNOFbuh4m%0Alc90kPSl5YM%2Bt%2BZc%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)

For example, a Roster with no rules that has Monday 9 am - 5 pm set as the start and end times with the **Online Appointments** option ticked will allow patients to book in any time during these hours.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595598866/41631cfd19ca97caefaf9837/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9bf4c30f806561a2d1fe1d38799a3fb80f509262a98260eaf25d28e4b35fdc6&req=cSkiE8B2lYdZFb4f3HP0gPUSPIE6qgZ5VDYiWvrLpwLy7D5OoKBNM7m2WoH1%0A%2BzPFghN%2Bm2t37LYCLQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595598866/41631cfd19ca97caefaf9837/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9bf4c30f806561a2d1fe1d38799a3fb80f509262a98260eaf25d28e4b35fdc6&req=cSkiE8B2lYdZFb4f3HP0gPUSPIE6qgZ5VDYiWvrLpwLy7D5OoKBNM7m2WoH1%0A%2BzPFghN%2Bm2t37LYCLQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Roster Rules**
================

Adding **Rules** to rosters allows you to manipulate the available times further by indicating times within the day's start and end times that are either available or unavailable for Online Appointments.

This is indicated by the final three tick-boxes; **M** (Manual appointments), **O** (Online appointments) and **W** (Waiting list).

Using the **Add Rule** button, you can create a rule that represents a lunch break (for example) where you may allow manual appointments for emergencies, but don't want these times to be available for patients to book in themselves, online. Untick the **O** (Online appointments) box and leave the **M** (Manual appointments) ticked.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595599224/a33885a98d4f2ce08c56a02f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb2d45199a0804cf9982de572de7f8ef71b2b5de0f5b3ee91549e79ebe8c0f36&req=cSkiE8B3n4NbFb4f3HP0gA%2BMbV2X8opNRIdIdEZkPQAT9B5fdEYQtb6Wl7lI%0A0kH5OYqDVwhi9uTmJw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595599224/a33885a98d4f2ce08c56a02f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb2d45199a0804cf9982de572de7f8ef71b2b5de0f5b3ee91549e79ebe8c0f36&req=cSkiE8B3n4NbFb4f3HP0gA%2BMbV2X8opNRIdIdEZkPQAT9B5fdEYQtb6Wl7lI%0A0kH5OYqDVwhi9uTmJw%3D%3D%0A)

**_Please note that the opposite will also work. Depending on how you set up your Roster, you could have the general Roster Availability set to Online Appointments off and then create rules that make specific time available for Online Appointments._**

**Appointment Type Restrictions**
=================================

You can also use the Roster rules to create space in the Appointment Book exclusively for new patients (as an example).

Select the **Cog icon** when customising a rule to tell PracSuite what appointment types can be booked during that timeframe.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595599537/806dcd6dfed5e81bf024fefc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bdce3ade2730514b036e09feb6af229b0a4b3297879e32b203b7a9d522050fac&req=cSkiE8B3mIJYFb4f3HP0gH%2BBGzNnDCu1sxSfR4IsfMC2u0IJtEOXelRLsaeM%0AD9xj60zM2OQMVEhUQw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595599537/806dcd6dfed5e81bf024fefc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bdce3ade2730514b036e09feb6af229b0a4b3297879e32b203b7a9d522050fac&req=cSkiE8B3mIJYFb4f3HP0gH%2BBGzNnDCu1sxSfR4IsfMC2u0IJtEOXelRLsaeM%0AD9xj60zM2OQMVEhUQw%3D%3D%0A)

Select one or more Appointment Types.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595599793/f37ad734d6ba7c7824fb6b35/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b578a7eeb0154c5367b16290479486f53fedd62de60432df7ccd7375446ea155&req=cSkiE8B3mohcFb4f3HP0gFOdNjAfXnsIXbSS84YyMJAQ1Aa%2Boo4DTHN8PXRe%0AgdETT7eDz%2BwQHvryBA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595599793/f37ad734d6ba7c7824fb6b35/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b578a7eeb0154c5367b16290479486f53fedd62de60432df7ccd7375446ea155&req=cSkiE8B3mohcFb4f3HP0gFOdNjAfXnsIXbSS84YyMJAQ1Aa%2Boo4DTHN8PXRe%0AgdETT7eDz%2BwQHvryBA%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595599946/1753569d6d70f696a1e99505/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d09c9d65f19776b563face98b29855cfc59e1ae3fdd4024058384d2a7ed00323&req=cSkiE8B3lIVZFb4f3HP0gDIirVUCue2rshd1dEVGkyrcbosozUow8wz84EBx%0AGJTpXT3MR3MTyT6AEw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595599946/1753569d6d70f696a1e99505/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d09c9d65f19776b563face98b29855cfc59e1ae3fdd4024058384d2a7ed00323&req=cSkiE8B3lIVZFb4f3HP0gDIirVUCue2rshd1dEVGkyrcbosozUow8wz84EBx%0AGJTpXT3MR3MTyT6AEw%3D%3D%0A)

**Notes and Rule Outs**
=======================

When you need to make time unavailable for patients to book online on a one-off basis, you can simply rule out or create a note on the appointment book and that time will be instantly unavailable when a patient next looks online.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595600165/139af944d237003070f08808/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5609786ed8c188fef43d2c34ac7eb419c9627b2604550a4eee4b2ae51d4e365e&req=cSkiEMl%2BnIdaFb4f3HP0gEACTD1oi4VMOJC0VQtGojjn%2BH7kTJWPOSA1zWfI%0AP7QrGRgoV11naMKXwQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595600165/139af944d237003070f08808/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5609786ed8c188fef43d2c34ac7eb419c9627b2604550a4eee4b2ae51d4e365e&req=cSkiEMl%2BnIdaFb4f3HP0gEACTD1oi4VMOJC0VQtGojjn%2BH7kTJWPOSA1zWfI%0AP7QrGRgoV11naMKXwQ%3D%3D%0A)

  
**Online Booking Start Times**
=================================

In addition to the options above, you can also specify the start times for appointments booked online. More information can be found in the article: [Controlling Online Booking Start Times](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9372819-controlling-online-booking-start-times)
.

Specifying Available Time for Online Bookings for Multi-Column Practitioners

Specifying Available Time for Online Bookings for Multi-Column Practitioners
============================================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Using Roster Overrides to make columns unavailable](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4773602-specifying-available-time-for-online-bookings-for-multi-column-practitioners#using-roster-overrides-to-make-columns-unavailable-)

[Using Rules to make columns unavailable](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4773602-specifying-available-time-for-online-bookings-for-multi-column-practitioners#using-rules-to-make-columns-unavailable)

This article will explain how to manage online booking availability for practitioners that have multiple appointment book columns. Information for practitioners with a single appointment book column can be found [here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4770750-specifying-available-time-for-online-bookings)
.

Practitioners using multiple appointment book columns often do not want online bookings appearing in all columns. Instead, they may only permit online bookings in select columns, which can be managed by adding **Rules** and **Roster Overrides** to the practitioner's **Roster**.

**Using Roster Overrides to make columns unavailable**
======================================================

If a practitioner never wants to see online bookings in a particular column, the simplest way to prevent online bookings is to add a **Roster Override**.

Go to **[Settings > Practitioners > Rosters](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners/rosters)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595600831/bd68b31a58294dfc24f08b7c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f9a92a9951266cb12fc8207a634263b52e080e7119d511cd1626cfafb80435c&req=cSkiEMl%2BlYJeFb4f3HP0gPu08xeEIvR29S0mWrIeQ3xNf%2F8UJSaIyLCqIkJc%0AmR15yeo7pG8sIQ1jCQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595600831/bd68b31a58294dfc24f08b7c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f9a92a9951266cb12fc8207a634263b52e080e7119d511cd1626cfafb80435c&req=cSkiEMl%2BlYJeFb4f3HP0gPu08xeEIvR29S0mWrIeQ3xNf%2F8UJSaIyLCqIkJc%0AmR15yeo7pG8sIQ1jCQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click on the Roster you wish to **edit** and scroll to **Roster Overrides**. Select **Add Override** to create a new rule or select an existing override from the list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595601233/483c26f3f8e3d1a8442706ef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=55fcae32bb93c30e948d2e737b88854aefe4e2a13ec1599a35ccf76b032901d4&req=cSkiEMl%2Fn4JcFb4f3HP0gE66aXEiPw3MgwA52lenk2CgOTTZV2GCFDWmguCK%0AiboPZ%2F%2FtvHqABBtelw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595601233/483c26f3f8e3d1a8442706ef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=55fcae32bb93c30e948d2e737b88854aefe4e2a13ec1599a35ccf76b032901d4&req=cSkiEMl%2Fn4JcFb4f3HP0gE66aXEiPw3MgwA52lenk2CgOTTZV2GCFDWmguCK%0AiboPZ%2F%2FtvHqABBtelw%3D%3D%0A)

In the below example, we have created an override that occurs every working day and covers all opening hours. Under the **Column** header, we have selected column 2 and deselected the Online Booking option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595601606/a09b9a6e62e62f38ac6076c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=81ad1ee1553378147d1f33a4b74af7cc7371e05893fdc68507b68640e64455d9&req=cSkiEMl%2Fm4FZFb4f3HP0gFdH9XsbgmSmq%2BXBrnK6CERdhIz0KH7Um7j%2B%2BQnl%0A6%2F%2FWWNtjqWnTlrvurw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595601606/a09b9a6e62e62f38ac6076c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=81ad1ee1553378147d1f33a4b74af7cc7371e05893fdc68507b68640e64455d9&req=cSkiEMl%2Fm4FZFb4f3HP0gFdH9XsbgmSmq%2BXBrnK6CERdhIz0KH7Um7j%2B%2BQnl%0A6%2F%2FWWNtjqWnTlrvurw%3D%3D%0A)

With this override in place, no online bookings will ever occur in column 2.

**Using Rules to make columns unavailable**
===========================================

If a practitioner is happy to permit online bookings in multiple columns, but only at particular times of the day, **Rules** should be added to the appropriate day on the Roster.

When adding Rules to a Roster, use the column dropdown to select which **Columns** the rule applies to e.g. **All** columns, column **1** or column **2**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595601718/c4d5a8389f559f099c56450d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b03d9be8d6b1417865098fd6138bb3a8d1392716dbe4dda09ab1da60f039bddc&req=cSkiEMl%2FmoBXFb4f3HP0gPxiENr4HYf6hsvHlmzeopQvTGUom2JDKW%2BTb0Rg%0Ate48SLvtjHRN7ChI%2Fg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595601718/c4d5a8389f559f099c56450d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b03d9be8d6b1417865098fd6138bb3a8d1392716dbe4dda09ab1da60f039bddc&req=cSkiEMl%2FmoBXFb4f3HP0gPxiENr4HYf6hsvHlmzeopQvTGUom2JDKW%2BTb0Rg%0Ate48SLvtjHRN7ChI%2Fg%3D%3D%0A)

[Enabling Telehealth Appointment Types](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4790236-managing-telehealth-appointments#enabling-telehealth-appointment-types)

[Managing Telehealth Links on Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4790236-managing-telehealth-appointments#managing-telehealth-links-on-appointments)

[Telehealth Appointment Menu](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4790236-managing-telehealth-appointments#telehealth-appointment-menu)

[SMS & Email Reminders](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4790236-managing-telehealth-appointments#sms--email-reminders)

PracSuite includes tools to manage telehealth appointments via external integrations with leading video calling platforms, as well as the option to manually enter static meeting join links.

Telehealth Integrations
=======================

Click the links below to view specific instructions on how to configure PracSuite's telehealth integrations.

*   [Zoom](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8789273-zoom-meeting-integration)
    
*   [Microsoft Teams](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8789270-microsoft-teams-meeting-integration)
    
*   [Google Meet](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7948131-google-calendar-google-meet-integration)
    

Enabling Telehealth Features on the Practitioner File
=====================================================

Once you've configured the integration with your preferred telehealth platform following the guides linked above, you will need to confirm that telehealth is enabled on the respective practitioner file.

Go to **[Settings > Practitioners > Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)
**, select a **Practitioner** and scroll to the **Telehealth** section.

This section will display which telehealth platform is active for the practitioner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421712660/169bc79b24850fd1a21bd68ad60a/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+09_50_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=02e4517d67ee95ede738e5640039dedad32632df7866e36e7a18763d2e39bfb2&req=dSQlF85%2Fn4dZWfMW1HO4zYUElmtdzNdoSmnvSBH7zyS30OqvA3s9xBgU2FtF%0AoMHt0AQk2YqR%2Bwe6%2F9E%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421712660/169bc79b24850fd1a21bd68ad60a/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+09_50_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=02e4517d67ee95ede738e5640039dedad32632df7866e36e7a18763d2e39bfb2&req=dSQlF85%2Fn4dZWfMW1HO4zYUElmtdzNdoSmnvSBH7zyS30OqvA3s9xBgU2FtF%0AoMHt0AQk2YqR%2Bwe6%2F9E%3D%0A)

Adding Static Telehealth Join Links
===================================

If you are not using the integrations with Zoom, Teams or Google Meet, there is an option to manually add a static join link, such as a [waiting room for platforms like Coviu.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8973447-using-coviu-alongside-pracsuite)

On the practitioner file, enable telehealth and select **Manual**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421711361/a4d986398d58b4a0740ca433a6d7/CleanShot%2B2025-03-14%2Bat%2B09_04_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=48bde60b22fd99d452d9d30bfc9a6c078ee1bbabb5722d5902137ca026dc5c86&req=dSQlF85%2FnIJZWPMW1HO4zZ4wqwL43A104nacsbDYp0N4jBedu3vGTaNYyV7g%0ATWpAkewPcrPCPVcXTQg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421711361/a4d986398d58b4a0740ca433a6d7/CleanShot%2B2025-03-14%2Bat%2B09_04_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=48bde60b22fd99d452d9d30bfc9a6c078ee1bbabb5722d5902137ca026dc5c86&req=dSQlF85%2FnIJZWPMW1HO4zZ4wqwL43A104nacsbDYp0N4jBedu3vGTaNYyV7g%0ATWpAkewPcrPCPVcXTQg%3D%0A)

You can then enter the static telehealth join links for the patient and practitioner.

*   If the telehealth links for either the patient or practitioner change per appointment, leave the respective fields blank.
    
*   If telehealth links for the practitioner and their patients remain the same for all appointments, enter the links in the fields provided.
    

Enabling Telehealth Appointment Types
=====================================

The telehealth links will only be generated for appointment types that are flagged as telehealth appointment types.

Go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)** and select the Telehealth appointment type. If you don't have a Telehealth appointment type setup, [please follow the guide here on how to create an Appointment Type](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types)
.

Enable the **Telehealth appointment** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595602744/809d77978078f9a954e6f559/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea6a24d3b67595adff3b3f17ccebb49cf2b74da974646280a7b1945da2f80608&req=cSkiEMl8moVbFb4f3HP0gIOIMn0DZje8p0ctOvetzYectZE5gwyYzKa18%2BT%2F%0AebZry9FMnpmjBOJy5A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595602744/809d77978078f9a954e6f559/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea6a24d3b67595adff3b3f17ccebb49cf2b74da974646280a7b1945da2f80608&req=cSkiEMl8moVbFb4f3HP0gIOIMn0DZje8p0ctOvetzYectZE5gwyYzKa18%2BT%2F%0AebZry9FMnpmjBOJy5A%3D%3D%0A)

Managing Telehealth Links on Appointments
=========================================

When booking telehealth-enabled appointment types, the patient and practitioner link fields will be visible on the Appointment Details page. Telehealth links will automatically be generated using the practitioner's preferred telehealth platform as configured on their practitioner file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595603160/d51bcff43b99fd0781a9fc18/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7cbf1b0cadfc6be9f2c0dd9bfaf4f111238d27c6ef676eb7c49056cf36182888&req=cSkiEMl9nIdfFb4f3HP0gP4JRVACKQorS%2FIogyhFfhMKdvB5ANZ5dhSAxN%2Ba%0AnOCJnxmyY3yUckKYzA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595603160/d51bcff43b99fd0781a9fc18/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7cbf1b0cadfc6be9f2c0dd9bfaf4f111238d27c6ef676eb7c49056cf36182888&req=cSkiEMl9nIdfFb4f3HP0gP4JRVACKQorS%2FIogyhFfhMKdvB5ANZ5dhSAxN%2Ba%0AnOCJnxmyY3yUckKYzA%3D%3D%0A)

Telehealth Appointment Menu
===========================

Telehealth appointments will display a new Telehealth option in the Appointment Menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595603279/b77d3879abeff1987b3c930b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3cf2e6c82b7a9a9f8f53c92f5014b1a25a2f7c74c4fd0f1dfce74daf2a6e76f6&req=cSkiEMl9n4ZWFb4f3HP0gEUVRYjxZxNRP%2FZaYruxLZbnV6cdK03X%2BgfuP0%2BA%0AWvSMvq6I7mIFgWMW0g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595603279/b77d3879abeff1987b3c930b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3cf2e6c82b7a9a9f8f53c92f5014b1a25a2f7c74c4fd0f1dfce74daf2a6e76f6&req=cSkiEMl9n4ZWFb4f3HP0gEUVRYjxZxNRP%2FZaYruxLZbnV6cdK03X%2BgfuP0%2BA%0AWvSMvq6I7mIFgWMW0g%3D%3D%0A)

This will display a popup menu to manage the telehealth links for this appointment, as well as options to SMS & email links to the client and practitioner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595603382/4be52836d757b9c581c84eca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d72449d073456d64722772b1fcdea6544f9e0561b309d6119d79b9f04e87e7cc&req=cSkiEMl9noldFb4f3HP0gElnX79%2Bo1oRL3hNhGEmtVWeXPIpI9olW0HP4HPC%0ADcuu2xsugMpu8L0R%2BA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595603382/4be52836d757b9c581c84eca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d72449d073456d64722772b1fcdea6544f9e0561b309d6119d79b9f04e87e7cc&req=cSkiEMl9noldFb4f3HP0gElnX79%2Bo1oRL3hNhGEmtVWeXPIpI9olW0HP4HPC%0ADcuu2xsugMpu8L0R%2BA%3D%3D%0A)

The links can also be copied using the icon on the right, and the practitioner link can be opened in a new tab.

=========================

<<AppointmentTelehealthLink>> - Inserts the patient's telehealth link

<<AppointmentTelehealthLinkPrac>> - Inserts the practitioner's telehealth link
