Managing Treatment Plans

Managing Treatment Plans
========================

Creating, viewing and reporting on Treatment Plans

Updated over 5 months ago

Table of contents

[Reporting on Treatment Plans](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4841280-managing-treatment-plans#h_d95236f3fc)

The Treatment Plan feature is a **tracking and monitoring system for invoiced items**, allowing you to track the total number or value (cost) of consultations with a patient within a set date range.

Treatment Plans are beneficial when dealing with third-party payers that approve a certain number or value of treatments, such as Medicare Chronic Disease Management (CDM) plans, formally known as Enhanced Primary Care (EPC) plans, NDIS budgets and more.

Treatment Plans also have optional features to prevent invoicing when the plan limit has been reached, and funding periods designed to help manage patients with NDIS funding.

Creating a Treatment Plan on a Patient Account
==============================================

To create a Treatment Plan, go to **Patient File,** select the **Accounts tab** and then select **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595585301/af5f970d7ab44385ae64d17b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e17ac601e941973a3703faee9fad6695fb8ce8314f95cd0ef8a1c305d64f6fd5&req=cSkiE8F7noFeFb4f3HP0gDoFF6pKqoQoACvwu9HDIqfdHpJRKBgQOj2yj%2BTS%0AwV7FkyI9%2FaGwGTUWuQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595585301/af5f970d7ab44385ae64d17b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e17ac601e941973a3703faee9fad6695fb8ce8314f95cd0ef8a1c305d64f6fd5&req=cSkiE8F7noFeFb4f3HP0gDoFF6pKqoQoACvwu9HDIqfdHpJRKBgQOj2yj%2BTS%0AwV7FkyI9%2FaGwGTUWuQ%3D%3D%0A)

Scroll down to the Treatment Plan section and select **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750128662/2f591f484a9b7c1ad3ad6a3af5b7/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+13_48_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fefe070b4eec7edcf0bb859bab3501dbf6708a75980fb499f3a8e290bd94cb06&req=dSciFsh8lYdZW%2FMW1HO4zbjL4XpTRt9gi%2BT0gOPxSJOBvx4%2F9YaoHr01eeoZ%0A6VRPGZ7sbt43YHMvR3A%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750128662/2f591f484a9b7c1ad3ad6a3af5b7/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+13_48_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fefe070b4eec7edcf0bb859bab3501dbf6708a75980fb499f3a8e290bd94cb06&req=dSciFsh8lYdZW%2FMW1HO4zbjL4XpTRt9gi%2BT0gOPxSJOBvx4%2F9YaoHr01eeoZ%0A6VRPGZ7sbt43YHMvR3A%3D%0A)

You will then need to configure the Treatment Plan properties outlined below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750122878/d0aecd1c068ffa9ef84f452811b4/CleanShot%2B2025-09-29%2Bat%2B13_22_59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49f056c6ecc4079ae68cd5f5fa385d29ecea578f409dfc588db3fb3c79e6c689&req=dSciFsh8n4lYUfMW1HO4zRoQS40TFWpoSKpsIbex0eUuWx2La96Sb1lKWAFa%0AOAI0I%2FO%2F4D3SEa34gFE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750122878/d0aecd1c068ffa9ef84f452811b4/CleanShot%2B2025-09-29%2Bat%2B13_22_59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49f056c6ecc4079ae68cd5f5fa385d29ecea578f409dfc588db3fb3c79e6c689&req=dSciFsh8n4lYUfMW1HO4zRoQS40TFWpoSKpsIbex0eUuWx2La96Sb1lKWAFa%0AOAI0I%2FO%2F4D3SEa34gFE%3D%0A)

**Plan Name**
-------------

Enter a descriptive **Plan Name** to identify the Treatment Plan. This name will be used when displaying the plan on the patient file and in the Treatment Plan report.

**Plan Dates**
--------------

*   **Start Date** – Choose the start date for tracking billed items. Items billed before this date will not factor into the tracking.
    
*   **End Date** _(optional)_ – To include an End Date, enable the checkbox and select a default duration relative to the start date.
    
    For example, if set to _12 months_, then upon applying this Default Treatment Plan, the patient’s plan will automatically be created with an end date 12 months from the current date.
    
*   **Use Account Dates** – Enable this if you want the plan to automatically match the Start and End Dates of the patient’s Account.
    

**Plan Type**
-------------

Select how the Treatment Plan should track invoiced items. The following options are available:

*   **Number of Items** – Tracks the number of individual items billed.
    
*   **Number of Items (by Distinct Days)** – Tracks one increment per day, regardless of how many items are billed that day.
    
*   **Item Quantity** – Tracks item usage based on the item quantity, including decimal values.
    
*   **Item Dollar Value** – Tracks usage based on the total dollar value of billed items.
    

**Plan Limit and Alerts**
-------------------------

*   **Plan Limit** – Enter the total number, quantity, or dollar value that represents the plan’s maximum allocation.
    
*   **Alert** – Enter the value at which alerts should begin appearing to users (for example, when 4 of 5 visits have been used).
    
*   **Prevent invoicing if plan limit has been reached** – Optionally enable this to block further invoicing once the plan’s limit has been used. New invoices cannot be created once the limit has been reached.
    

**Tracked Item Codes (optional)**
---------------------------------

If required, you can specify which items should contribute to this plan’s usage:

*   Choose a specific **Item**, **[Schedule](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/schedules)
    **, or **[Item Group](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/itemgroups)
    **.
    
*   If left as _Any Item_, all billed items will count toward the plan.
    

**Treatment Plan State (optional)**
-----------------------------------

Select an optional, customisable **[Treatment State](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/treatmentstates)
** to apply, e.g. “Active”, “Complete”, “In Progress”. This can assist with reporting and filtering.

**Funding Periods (optional)**
------------------------------

Designed for NDIS patients, **[Funding Periods](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods)
** allow a Treatment Plan to be divided into multiple sub-periods, each with its own allocation. For example, a 12-month plan may be split into 4 quarterly periods, tracking usage and rollover between them.

For more details on how Funding Periods work, see: [NDIS Funding Periods](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods)

After choosing your preferred settings, click **Save** to finalise your changes.

To avoid having to create Treatment Plans from scratch, as shown in the steps above, you can instead configure [Default Treatment Plans](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8184782-default-treatment-plans)
.

Once configured, Default Treatment Plans can be quickly inserted into a patient's account with minimal setup required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750126082/a808478414e2f8b5cfdfa8591c44/CleanShot-2B2025-09-25-2Bat-2B11_32_10.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e27f8e0ed504510bf97dedea83a98bd078089945c745b2da04a0f6cfc08a0f3&req=dSciFsh8m4FXW%2FMW1HO4zSqQ6StMrZBfbZw%2FHT5YBbMnhTqA9C1p7vtyty8L%0AOihN82%2FcMGF2EkIYYIQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750126082/a808478414e2f8b5cfdfa8591c44/CleanShot-2B2025-09-25-2Bat-2B11_32_10.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e27f8e0ed504510bf97dedea83a98bd078089945c745b2da04a0f6cfc08a0f3&req=dSciFsh8m4FXW%2FMW1HO4zSqQ6StMrZBfbZw%2FHT5YBbMnhTqA9C1p7vtyty8L%0AOihN82%2FcMGF2EkIYYIQ%3D%0A)

* * *

Treatment Plan Examples
=======================

Below are some common use cases for Treatment Plans.

Medicare CDM/EPC Example
------------------------

The example below is set up to track 5 billed items over 12 months, and will display an alert on billing the 4th item. Tracked Item Codes are limited to our Medicare [Item Group](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/itemgroups)
 so that only these items impact the tracking.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750135040/d7e02636c49f525dc033bf8ae49c/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+13_56_16.png?expires=1771821900&signature=119ae8f038cc29aca9fb2a6ca0f5f2cafe5407c1b98b5a9d4477a1353c27fc2c&req=dSciFsh9mIFbWfMW1HO4zTXER5sGx35B01XeSLKjWe4cZ3L0gUmT2Q7xOGMp%0AqH0cjRY8U%2FGGezb6NKM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750135040/d7e02636c49f525dc033bf8ae49c/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+13_56_16.png?expires=1771821900&signature=119ae8f038cc29aca9fb2a6ca0f5f2cafe5407c1b98b5a9d4477a1353c27fc2c&req=dSciFsh9mIFbWfMW1HO4zTXER5sGx35B01XeSLKjWe4cZ3L0gUmT2Q7xOGMp%0AqH0cjRY8U%2FGGezb6NKM%3D%0A)

Dollar Value Example (NDIS Budget or Workcover Funding)
-------------------------------------------------------

The example below is set up to track $5,000 of allocated funds. Tracked Item Codes are limited to our NDIS [Item Group](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/itemgroups)
 so that only these items impact the tracking.

We have also enabled [Funding Periods](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods)
 and 'prevent invoicing if plan of funding period limit has been reached'.

Treatment Plan Status and Alerts
================================

Treatment Plan usage and alerts are displayed in several places in PracSuite.

--------------------------------

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750145245/aeb8ff32ba897278238fb7903bb6/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+14_09_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3889b1df8a3adf055272d7c9ddeb2fe2e19087da83780a92c40d8d799a20b32c&req=dSciFsh6mINbXPMW1HO4zRXAOlBeT2tqKSA0xt6o83GWKAuY4EnlG2b4QcBy%0AX2eD0KLqkXGYxg2jPqs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750145245/aeb8ff32ba897278238fb7903bb6/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+14_09_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3889b1df8a3adf055272d7c9ddeb2fe2e19087da83780a92c40d8d799a20b32c&req=dSciFsh6mINbXPMW1HO4zRXAOlBeT2tqKSA0xt6o83GWKAuY4EnlG2b4QcBy%0AX2eD0KLqkXGYxg2jPqs%3D%0A)

An example of a Treatment Plan with Funding Periods enabled is shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750144828/955fe5de8affc1645c6fd0ad7068/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+14_09_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=04d86377275723973e5890c2121c9fb3b2e6ab6b1acd18c0bef074fafcf657fe&req=dSciFsh6mYldUfMW1HO4zUNeG2HussDfZVLk8nyaMmKOnz5VQX8Fk3rjK%2BkB%0A0VvdyKtqnzdvnECLNUs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750144828/955fe5de8affc1645c6fd0ad7068/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+14_09_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=04d86377275723973e5890c2121c9fb3b2e6ab6b1acd18c0bef074fafcf657fe&req=dSciFsh6mYldUfMW1HO4zUNeG2HussDfZVLk8nyaMmKOnz5VQX8Fk3rjK%2BkB%0A0VvdyKtqnzdvnECLNUs%3D%0A)

Including Future Appointments in Treatment Plan Usage
=====================================================

Treatment Plans have an option to visualise how future appointments impact the plan limit, which can be toggled on from the accounts tab of the patient file.

This option will include future appointments in the “used” total based on the item code set on each unbilled appointment, up to the treatment plan end date. If hourly billing is enabled, quantities are based on appointment duration. This helps forecast usage and stay within the allocated funding.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750199161/506a7f13a25030334c685a00dbb1/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_15_52.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bc27a2fea482ad04458805790f1d619505fa6b2e244ce03e77a9cd6315415693&req=dSciFsh3lIBZWPMW1HO4zVfXqoezmPQhwZBaotnzV51FOyZZ8pbtS0VbxEQV%0AfItX7mrAzeVxABvJ0dA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750199161/506a7f13a25030334c685a00dbb1/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_15_52.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bc27a2fea482ad04458805790f1d619505fa6b2e244ce03e77a9cd6315415693&req=dSciFsh3lIBZWPMW1HO4zVfXqoezmPQhwZBaotnzV51FOyZZ8pbtS0VbxEQV%0AfItX7mrAzeVxABvJ0dA%3D%0A)

It's also possible to include future appointments in calculations when using the [Treatment Plan report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/treatmentplan)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750205522/4b398d7cec5a0f829784e6376c0c/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_23_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7436ddf79808ee80e7e9dbda463db85c719e39cac249f1354d1ad8a19579960&req=dSciFst%2BmIRdW%2FMW1HO4zWW7YWhDwTj1KfjJ%2BXbjsVh1iaJgkWt%2BjqDosgbu%0AX4fYV6tRBk3%2BuXgG37Q%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750205522/4b398d7cec5a0f829784e6376c0c/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_23_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7436ddf79808ee80e7e9dbda463db85c719e39cac249f1354d1ad8a19579960&req=dSciFst%2BmIRdW%2FMW1HO4zWW7YWhDwTj1KfjJ%2BXbjsVh1iaJgkWt%2BjqDosgbu%0AX4fYV6tRBk3%2BuXgG37Q%3D%0A)

A Future Appts column is displayed when using this option, which will also factor these amounts into the remaining figure.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750206210/98d821f08c49cd8e12d62cf05870/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_23_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=02db0f3039eafb92b5a183fe5db006700385e9c7c6702d0ce5c92ad99ee1268a&req=dSciFst%2Bm4NeWfMW1HO4zVpojkF4RiSgul6q%2FRxpCkOb8GfYPjGtT0%2FWb%2BZP%0Aat93zsDnTxD8ILC8li8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750206210/98d821f08c49cd8e12d62cf05870/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_23_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=02db0f3039eafb92b5a183fe5db006700385e9c7c6702d0ce5c92ad99ee1268a&req=dSciFst%2Bm4NeWfMW1HO4zVpojkF4RiSgul6q%2FRxpCkOb8GfYPjGtT0%2FWb%2BZP%0Aat93zsDnTxD8ILC8li8%3D%0A)

Viewing Transactions Contributing to a Treatment Plan
=====================================================

To view the transactions contributing to a Treatment Plan, go to the **Accounts tab of the patient file** and select the **View Transactions** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750198808/fd1d66fa6b67a59deb6354ad45a0/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_15_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3eb148485b2b7fa395304e5963940d6e6c7eabd02e804873d3154dd8adf026dd&req=dSciFsh3lYlfUfMW1HO4zUQf9OVJR92E5S8jScufbSNVHUXvM%2Bx2JVM%2BRYxS%0AWgWXkc%2Fyfjd%2FY6D%2FV8I%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750198808/fd1d66fa6b67a59deb6354ad45a0/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_15_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3eb148485b2b7fa395304e5963940d6e6c7eabd02e804873d3154dd8adf026dd&req=dSciFsh3lYlfUfMW1HO4zUQf9OVJR92E5S8jScufbSNVHUXvM%2Bx2JVM%2BRYxS%0AWgWXkc%2Fyfjd%2FY6D%2FV8I%3D%0A)

A grid will appear, displaying the item details that contribute to the plan. You can also use the pie chart to visualise usage by business, practitioner, profession, item code and schedule.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750218418/099db6a4739d29bb4f197b144c52/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_36_33.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e70c7cc785f1e6787daef4a6c3d1d0613d88f5e78f53f7323e2f47f35eafd396&req=dSciFst%2FlYVeUfMW1HO4zTfDaQF30IbipWgMIdsYzjLRSIXiTTJMZpYP5geE%0AdE0fvDbgTiAluNJoVhg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750218418/099db6a4739d29bb4f197b144c52/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+15_36_33.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e70c7cc785f1e6787daef4a6c3d1d0613d88f5e78f53f7323e2f47f35eafd396&req=dSciFst%2FlYVeUfMW1HO4zTfDaQF30IbipWgMIdsYzjLRSIXiTTJMZpYP5geE%0AdE0fvDbgTiAluNJoVhg%3D%0A)

* * *

Reporting on Treatment Plans
============================

The [Treatment Plan Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/treatmentplan)
 is designed to report on treatment plans across all patient files. Common uses for the Treatment Plan report are:

*   Viewing Treatment Plan remaining balances across all patients
    
*   Viewing Treatment Plans that are due to expire soon
    
*   Viewing Treatment Plans for patients with upcoming appointments
    
*   Viewing Treatment Plan Funding Period usage per patient account
    
*   Viewing Treatment Plan balances when factoring in future appointments
    
*   Sending out bulk emails/SMS to patients with matching Treatment Plan criteria

**Enabling Group Appointments Online**
======================================

Group Appointments are between one practitioner and multiple clients. Turn on Group Appointments by going to **[Settings > Online Booking > Online Booking Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595606748/d7f195af3e1be1fd0516c838/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b117a767f57b8292d8570944003131bb934fe5db65b62cf266ebffb91c46a72&req=cSkiEMl4moVXFb4f3HP0gF9iDnUgx5ywlFajqw7zL1HOu1pnzZm2KKjWO4Uj%0AvcvFU8H%2F%2FwRyMvFkVw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595606748/d7f195af3e1be1fd0516c838/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b117a767f57b8292d8570944003131bb934fe5db65b62cf266ebffb91c46a72&req=cSkiEMl4moVXFb4f3HP0gF9iDnUgx5ywlFajqw7zL1HOu1pnzZm2KKjWO4Uj%0AvcvFU8H%2F%2FwRyMvFkVw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Edit** and scroll down to **Group Appointments** and enable the toggle.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595607649/e042a65373e022a5487050fe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a1ed691cb4dc7247a945287a0dc9cc8d96b73ae3002f5c5db0f159ccad61a53&req=cSkiEMl5m4VWFb4f3HP0gNfQvKwnLNryhNcqqkf1IUs%2F3qhh3sf1HxAeNxGU%0ASqIqO%2BuvtVeaTNhAzA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595607649/e042a65373e022a5487050fe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a1ed691cb4dc7247a945287a0dc9cc8d96b73ae3002f5c5db0f159ccad61a53&req=cSkiEMl5m4VWFb4f3HP0gNfQvKwnLNryhNcqqkf1IUs%2F3qhh3sf1HxAeNxGU%0ASqIqO%2BuvtVeaTNhAzA%3D%3D%0A)

Customise the Group Appointment Descriptor between Class or Session.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595607863/6bef9e2e5cb9e27436dab352/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2a6afe7eeda4342d0fd2098f84aa05dac585a52918c87d40391c744efe1f92e&req=cSkiEMl5lYdcFb4f3HP0gLuynsbIhP4JY9SRpJMoRG5x1b4HiOD1c8i5%2FscO%0ACbGKpjl%2BBKoDMkt6aA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595607863/6bef9e2e5cb9e27436dab352/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2a6afe7eeda4342d0fd2098f84aa05dac585a52918c87d40391c744efe1f92e&req=cSkiEMl5lYdcFb4f3HP0gLuynsbIhP4JY9SRpJMoRG5x1b4HiOD1c8i5%2FscO%0ACbGKpjl%2BBKoDMkt6aA%3D%3D%0A)

Set the Minimum Search Range, which represents how much notice you would like when someone is booking a group appointment online. For example, a one-hour minimum search range means that the earliest possible time a client can book in is one-hour away from the current time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595607959/ce006cfea3d928e0256a72fe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7bb5e68bf841d69801068dedf3f55bae14df049a76e2b041f83397546816fba6&req=cSkiEMl5lIRWFb4f3HP0gLmKrHX4uCCK9x7sE%2BsP%2Fas3b9aBDZQDSh0gkD%2BS%0AfW028UTTEC2B9PuN%2BQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595607959/ce006cfea3d928e0256a72fe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7bb5e68bf841d69801068dedf3f55bae14df049a76e2b041f83397546816fba6&req=cSkiEMl5lIRWFb4f3HP0gLmKrHX4uCCK9x7sE%2BsP%2Fas3b9aBDZQDSh0gkD%2BS%0AfW028UTTEC2B9PuN%2BQ%3D%3D%0A)

The Maximum Search Range represents to furthest possible date a patient can search for a group appointment from the current date.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595607998/3f463d9bd92fb7fa6763fec5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2216169aa55513fbffc7cd4d3893a2778ce2aa071a3cb4c654cc35bf6d44807&req=cSkiEMl5lIhXFb4f3HP0gOJaIHE9i3SDM0QH6V6%2FsUvSuEtEvStEANDTUXwA%0A%2B3KLpJBqgTOz1zcS2A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595607998/3f463d9bd92fb7fa6763fec5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2216169aa55513fbffc7cd4d3893a2778ce2aa071a3cb4c654cc35bf6d44807&req=cSkiEMl5lIhXFb4f3HP0gOJaIHE9i3SDM0QH6V6%2FsUvSuEtEvStEANDTUXwA%0A%2B3KLpJBqgTOz1zcS2A%3D%3D%0A)

If you would like your clients to know how full a group appointment is while they are booking, tick the checkbox to display the number of bookings per group e.g. 8/10. Leaving this option unticked will only indicate if a group appointment is full, or not full.

Next, turn on the toggle if you would like to allow clients to book recurring appointments. This feature allows a client to book regular occurring group appointments if they are set up to occur weekly at the same time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608107/e905fd0f6df155fdb6c62618/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23b29b91bd229038021222800dea52e31ea01abd4c44b170625a539a44ef9e46&req=cSkiEMl2nIFYFb4f3HP0gEQkil%2B75QDW%2BzIu11tmiSHqn5DueRU7ULM4yT6a%0Abhd3jPcFMWocAMvaLw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608107/e905fd0f6df155fdb6c62618/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23b29b91bd229038021222800dea52e31ea01abd4c44b170625a539a44ef9e46&req=cSkiEMl2nIFYFb4f3HP0gEQkil%2B75QDW%2BzIu11tmiSHqn5DueRU7ULM4yT6a%0Abhd3jPcFMWocAMvaLw%3D%3D%0A)

When recurring bookings is enabled, you can also decide if you would like to limit the number of appointments that can be booked at once. Enable the toggle and select the maximum number of group appointments a client can book as part of a recurrence.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608172/e1488fc5d776381079f2ab0b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7b9cfae7f8932c1d1cf414e34232440f369dfdeb6eb02bfa3a61cf89b834949d&req=cSkiEMl2nIZdFb4f3HP0gCAHUHtSok%2Ba%2BhiHwPWJJXQFFlZ%2BnYw1tEozSVSQ%0AsA9bBRqx4bAfc0iU4A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608172/e1488fc5d776381079f2ab0b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7b9cfae7f8932c1d1cf414e34232440f369dfdeb6eb02bfa3a61cf89b834949d&req=cSkiEMl2nIZdFb4f3HP0gCAHUHtSok%2Ba%2BhiHwPWJJXQFFlZ%2BnYw1tEozSVSQ%0AsA9bBRqx4bAfc0iU4A%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Setting up Class Services**
=============================

Under **[Settings > Online Booking > Services](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/services)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608478/d6ae0f001ff2da10efab21b2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=19143cda65df6d9517269ca587c1be1194fe0a53a3f2f2908de5cbd17085784f&req=cSkiEMl2mYZXFb4f3HP0gJ9sSyO1KjACJneORAgcGKOrAQ9wSutt7GU2Ylmm%0A%2F2zoUEyJwtnOooYrsQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608478/d6ae0f001ff2da10efab21b2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=19143cda65df6d9517269ca587c1be1194fe0a53a3f2f2908de5cbd17085784f&req=cSkiEMl2mYZXFb4f3HP0gJ9sSyO1KjACJneORAgcGKOrAQ9wSutt7GU2Ylmm%0A%2F2zoUEyJwtnOooYrsQ%3D%3D%0A)

Scroll down to **Class Services** and here you can create group appointment services which can then be assigned to practitioners. The page will display any existing services and their associated new patient and existing patient appointment types.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608614/7d7aa54a0240c25e072f328a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=19b5d70a0d076c3b0c5d18a15f1117d63d03e6ba2a65ada0845dbdbf95ffcbc3&req=cSkiEMl2m4BbFb4f3HP0gKZ5p8gY62y2CanpvjldK%2BSq7uPbvaI1hzSSDc8j%0AdGqejEr%2FjQdUYNLA%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608614/7d7aa54a0240c25e072f328a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=19b5d70a0d076c3b0c5d18a15f1117d63d03e6ba2a65ada0845dbdbf95ffcbc3&req=cSkiEMl2m4BbFb4f3HP0gKZ5p8gY62y2CanpvjldK%2BSq7uPbvaI1hzSSDc8j%0AdGqejEr%2FjQdUYNLA%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add** to add create a new service.

Service Details
---------------

When creating a new service, specify the **Service Name** that will be displayed online to patients. The Service will also need to be linked to an existing Profession in your PracSuite system.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608901/7dc86ec54af54931b7ce3460/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0271541aab1173799f320ac09ea0da2194728690201acf3ce59a60f4f443d4a8&req=cSkiEMl2lIFeFb4f3HP0gMUVee0uzk5rx5JzplGcnz9UVlRZD%2BcN42LcXXic%0AciscX1ZPbgGPDEvLOw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595608901/7dc86ec54af54931b7ce3460/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0271541aab1173799f320ac09ea0da2194728690201acf3ce59a60f4f443d4a8&req=cSkiEMl2lIFeFb4f3HP0gMUVee0uzk5rx5JzplGcnz9UVlRZD%2BcN42LcXXic%0AciscX1ZPbgGPDEvLOw%3D%3D%0A)

The following settings can also be enabled:

*   **Show Description -** Display further details regarding the service
    
*   **Show Photo -** Display a photo for the service
    
*   **Confirmation Prompt -** Present a confirmation prompt that patients must confirm before finalising their appointment.
    
*   **This class service can be booked by** - Allows the option to choose who can book into this class, either All Patients, Guest Patients, Logged in Patients or Approved Patients.
    

Creating multiple services allows patients to filter to certain group appointment types grouped by Service.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301918566/2a5f945631c5e38e9935fb03/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d11025fcd384557f5816db05873600a546488715eb04dc765aa37ee9f22f437c&req=dyAmH8h2mIdZFb4f3HP0gAxXZm1IFpPRBjTbfHAzNs1CYWm9ptYWK5GWDC8m%0AKWYAdBct%2BC7eS0A6DA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301918566/2a5f945631c5e38e9935fb03/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d11025fcd384557f5816db05873600a546488715eb04dc765aa37ee9f22f437c&req=dyAmH8h2mIdZFb4f3HP0gAxXZm1IFpPRBjTbfHAzNs1CYWm9ptYWK5GWDC8m%0AKWYAdBct%2BC7eS0A6DA%3D%3D%0A)

Appointment Types
-----------------

When creating a class service, you need to specify the **Appointment Types** that New and Existing patients can select from.

Select **Add** and select the appropriate appointment type from the drop-down list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595610192/5a46430d8f5f7f533204ffdb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9ab1ba32f418d82944c681202587ceafb90f03fa8c92ed4260fb2cc74bfbc67&req=cSkiEMh%2BnIhdFb4f3HP0gKfDJ0QpEYsbrUjznS9hO7fhdfHgRB61CvrmPXAk%0AjuMLLyu8yhRbk8wR%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595610192/5a46430d8f5f7f533204ffdb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9ab1ba32f418d82944c681202587ceafb90f03fa8c92ed4260fb2cc74bfbc67&req=cSkiEMh%2BnIhdFb4f3HP0gKfDJ0QpEYsbrUjznS9hO7fhdfHgRB61CvrmPXAk%0AjuMLLyu8yhRbk8wR%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Note: If you do not wish for New or Existing Patients to book for this service, do not add any appointment types to the respective grid.**

The following settings can also be enabled:

*   **Description -** Override the name of the appointment type and provide a description that will be displayed online.
    
*   **Show Duration -** Displays the length of the appointment according to the profession and practitioner defaults set on the appointment type.
    
*   **Show Fees -** Displays the fee for the appointment according to the default on the appointment type and the [Guest Fee Category](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4743365-online-booking-general-settings)
    .
    
*   **Allow Notes -** Provide the option for the patient to provide a reason for their appointment.
    
*   **Require Notes -** Requires the patient to provide a reason for their appointment.
    
*   **Confirmation Email Template -** The selected template will be emailed to the patient after confirming their appointment.
    
*   **Confirmation SMS Template -** The selected template will be sent as an SMS to the patient after confirming their appointment.
    

* * *

**Enabling Practitioners for Group Appointments**
=================================================

To make a practitioner available for online group bookings, go to **[Settings > Online Booking > Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/practitioners)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595610549/19cc35061f31987b5e8e3e43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1452cf56063e092bbe075c52fada833abb1b0ddce827f0216c54b3ee5f7a247b&req=cSkiEMh%2BmIVWFb4f3HP0gBZmiYD2i8wV22Kiyku02z%2FasgitOvvK1JcjN%2FyL%0A%2BYPWqbhFEiDvhprkoQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595610549/19cc35061f31987b5e8e3e43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1452cf56063e092bbe075c52fada833abb1b0ddce827f0216c54b3ee5f7a247b&req=cSkiEMh%2BmIVWFb4f3HP0gBZmiYD2i8wV22Kiyku02z%2FasgitOvvK1JcjN%2FyL%0A%2BYPWqbhFEiDvhprkoQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add** to add a new practitioner to your online booking site.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595610794/d14400cea35ee95659191d50/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a415f60213632e0ba9501e1092daa852f04c1c25f798d765a1a0860cebb34c04&req=cSkiEMh%2BmohbFb4f3HP0gOB%2BdGHHm%2Fci1Hp1ZfJ7U2vmyislsHfI3mcet2lE%0AdA%2F%2Bw91GNayAwf8Idg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595610794/d14400cea35ee95659191d50/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a415f60213632e0ba9501e1092daa852f04c1c25f798d765a1a0860cebb34c04&req=cSkiEMh%2BmohbFb4f3HP0gOB%2BdGHHm%2Fci1Hp1ZfJ7U2vmyislsHfI3mcet2lE%0AdA%2F%2Bw91GNayAwf8Idg%3D%3D%0A)

Practitioner Details
--------------------

Use the Practitioner dropdown to select the Practitioner you wish to enable.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595610991/5a40abf7f88af082828a4109/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a8d1a60e3ae466ecd5b856ba8a8b099190ca0b6cd42793d2654309b059e227d9&req=cSkiEMh%2BlIheFb4f3HP0gB4KrNHTxfFmuIkIcxoB641ncXm%2F%2Fh4qcwhjVknT%0ACyV6hqVUDdAZfsnFCg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595610991/5a40abf7f88af082828a4109/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a8d1a60e3ae466ecd5b856ba8a8b099190ca0b6cd42793d2654309b059e227d9&req=cSkiEMh%2BlIheFb4f3HP0gB4KrNHTxfFmuIkIcxoB641ncXm%2F%2Fh4qcwhjVknT%0ACyV6hqVUDdAZfsnFCg%3D%3D%0A)

If the practitioner is happy to accept new patient bookings, enable the **Allow New Patient Bookings** setting.

Should the practitioner only accept group appointments and you don't want to allow one-on-one appointments to be booked with them, tick **Group Appointments Only**.

_Please note that the Practitioner's description and photo do not display while booking a group appointment._

Locations & Services
--------------------

You will see a list of the Practitioner's **Businesses** and their **Corresponding Locations**. Select the **Businesses** that you would like to enable online booking for and then click into the services line to add the services the practitioner offers at that location.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595611312/e3dca689b7ad89533fed292e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f119483ab4499cc54543a4bda7da56f9da6925d7bbb7dfc971ef88501b004f85&req=cSkiEMh%2FnoBdFb4f3HP0gA%2FvUy2r6ShbXQ8vFn6xeEZNXsfL2cTOkYCZOVly%0AyJjUAkbZ5B2JJPiAfg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595611312/e3dca689b7ad89533fed292e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f119483ab4499cc54543a4bda7da56f9da6925d7bbb7dfc971ef88501b004f85&req=cSkiEMh%2FnoBdFb4f3HP0gA%2FvUy2r6ShbXQ8vFn6xeEZNXsfL2cTOkYCZOVly%0AyJjUAkbZ5B2JJPiAfg%3D%3D%0A)

When you are done, click **Save** at the top to confirm your changes.

* * *

You have now successfully set up group appointments for online booking!

Emailing a Letter as a PDF

Emailing a Letter as a PDF
==========================

Updated over 3 years ago

When using the word processor in PracSuite, it's possible to email the letter as a Word document or as a PDF. Select the main **Email** button to email the letter as a Word document.

Select the drop-down icon next to the Email and select **Email as PDF**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595612041/59363978e66ec13ef8e23ce2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdaa961c73935ec63a064764e8373b8447a5dd9f73a2b83b872422e4e53e2f77&req=cSkiEMh8nYVeFb4f3HP0gPabnx7rThnnph2et2z7EaqUT2E1QGMti4F1AHMy%0A%2Ff%2F2UC6ccKeSs7NsTA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595612041/59363978e66ec13ef8e23ce2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdaa961c73935ec63a064764e8373b8447a5dd9f73a2b83b872422e4e53e2f77&req=cSkiEMh8nYVeFb4f3HP0gPabnx7rThnnph2et2z7EaqUT2E1QGMti4F1AHMy%0A%2Ff%2F2UC6ccKeSs7NsTA%3D%3D%0A)

The compose window will open with the letter attached as a PDF.

Alternatively, you can **select the Word document** you would like to email as a PDF and select **Email**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595613119/300ab5ca9802e6fb8780e3e9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8c9cb469aae0b4c098d2a809a6f6e74c61b143ebe8adcf9680ce40aa8877bae8&req=cSkiEMh9nIBWFb4f3HP0gCA7QHCmz73TgGgI4l%2FguU%2B8CAkxnddudEf8yqOK%0ADLpTjnBYd0P%2Fyi7heg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595613119/300ab5ca9802e6fb8780e3e9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8c9cb469aae0b4c098d2a809a6f6e74c61b143ebe8adcf9680ce40aa8877bae8&req=cSkiEMh9nIBWFb4f3HP0gCA7QHCmz73TgGgI4l%2FguU%2B8CAkxnddudEf8yqOK%0ADLpTjnBYd0P%2Fyi7heg%3D%3D%0A)

The following window will appear, where you can choose to send the document as a PDF file or keep it as a Word document.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595612988/e9b3278facdb3fa347285533/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ed33af621997e1123fd9b1edeac1d6035ee075a1f9b2471cd481d9699c060fb&req=cSkiEMh8lIlXFb4f3HP0gA5JXpOFi%2BwP2zfTkdX9dIxIdDb9KjA%2FxI1xMqVx%0AxaAhqkV0VsWmanCaSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595612988/e9b3278facdb3fa347285533/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ed33af621997e1123fd9b1edeac1d6035ee075a1f9b2471cd481d9699c060fb&req=cSkiEMh8lIlXFb4f3HP0gA5JXpOFi%2BwP2zfTkdX9dIxIdDb9KjA%2FxI1xMqVx%0AxaAhqkV0VsWmanCaSQ%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 142 — How to Copy a Clinical Note | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-142}

How to Copy a Clinical Note

How to Copy a Clinical Note
===========================

Updated over 3 years ago

There are two ways to copy an existing clinical note in PracSuite. Both options require the Copy Clinical Note permission to be enabled on user roles.

1\. **Create a new note based on a copy of an existing note**

In the main clinical note timeline, use the **Copy icon** to create a new clinical note as a copy of the selected note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595630665/0fdac6a8393e32ccbe22795c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59398256d1785bdab4e0fb521b68b05fd8878d8ced4f03a02f680ac3b2035cd2&req=cSkiEMp%2Bm4daFb4f3HP0gLs0SxYF3N4dIJkluIEvd6g3jN3zyLTYVYkgTrpr%0AWlz%2BNj2FrDFy%2BJn9pA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595630665/0fdac6a8393e32ccbe22795c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59398256d1785bdab4e0fb521b68b05fd8878d8ced4f03a02f680ac3b2035cd2&req=cSkiEMp%2Bm4daFb4f3HP0gLs0SxYF3N4dIJkluIEvd6g3jN3zyLTYVYkgTrpr%0AWlz%2BNj2FrDFy%2BJn9pA%3D%3D%0A)

**2\. Copying an existing note when writing a new note**

When a new clinical note is already in progress, you can use the **Copy icon** when hovering over a clinical note in the History pane to insert the contents of that note to the bottom of the current note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595631544/ba5cc126415f12574a276af4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1946f5cb9f020b1897f0fc9b3f2054707146bf9efa82e1f9fd4911808bf1948c&req=cSkiEMp%2FmIVbFb4f3HP0gErv6cie%2FCVsYu9cJ9RE9kV9X3tJbup52YYN58mX%0AXlFgWKzxMNiKL0F%2Few%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595631544/ba5cc126415f12574a276af4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1946f5cb9f020b1897f0fc9b3f2054707146bf9efa82e1f9fd4911808bf1948c&req=cSkiEMp%2FmIVbFb4f3HP0gErv6cie%2FCVsYu9cJ9RE9kV9X3tJbup52YYN58mX%0AXlFgWKzxMNiKL0F%2Few%3D%3D%0A)

Invoice Status Colours

Invoice Status Colours
======================

Updated over 3 years ago

There are four colours differentiating the **Status** of an **Invoice**.

**Blue** indicates the Invoice is **_Unissued_**. An invoice is unissued if it has not been emailed, saved as a PDF or printed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301429543/41c2333114a3e906d8a1ed8f/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+11.26.19+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b354ce1c02a395077dc3ef9d64107e3af20661822e1c7309dbf7a50535e99ce5&req=dyAmEst3mIVcFb4f3HP0gMguYBHRlc8xTS%2FagrupN68xq%2ByvZMUpA1KdgI8f%0A%2BkV5ZzyXzI67Uomj4A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301429543/41c2333114a3e906d8a1ed8f/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+11.26.19+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b354ce1c02a395077dc3ef9d64107e3af20661822e1c7309dbf7a50535e99ce5&req=dyAmEst3mIVcFb4f3HP0gMguYBHRlc8xTS%2FagrupN68xq%2ByvZMUpA1KdgI8f%0A%2BkV5ZzyXzI67Uomj4A%3D%3D%0A)

**Yellow** indicates that the Invoice has been **_Issued_**. All invoices are issued after they have been emailed, saved as a PDF, printed or manually marked as issued.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301430266/7251dadd649461d6d5ee9e0a/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+11.24.48+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2dd3264d9c5aa947e88e5cf8d008c9c6bd69a8a4a9feb611e607158b5babc5b5&req=dyAmEsp%2Bn4dZFb4f3HP0gOn9Ty%2FLMBJC8XoZ73CQViXRy%2FD3aKPG%2BoilnbJ8%0Ad2y2LSg5eL%2BRv9Rvtg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301430266/7251dadd649461d6d5ee9e0a/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+11.24.48+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2dd3264d9c5aa947e88e5cf8d008c9c6bd69a8a4a9feb611e607158b5babc5b5&req=dyAmEsp%2Bn4dZFb4f3HP0gOn9Ty%2FLMBJC8XoZ73CQViXRy%2FD3aKPG%2BoilnbJ8%0Ad2y2LSg5eL%2BRv9Rvtg%3D%3D%0A)

**Green** indicates that the invoice has been fully **_Paid_**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301430255/c414964f276b5bbdc65d45d7/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+11.25.27+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f050fa3413b075de8df2cbe8296c550fa2fbf1af4c2c919a80db115de2ef1f9&req=dyAmEsp%2Bn4RaFb4f3HP0gBwjw6%2B%2B3KEnbISJi5FWbMZUD5loUelkHArwXGsy%0AQTs%2FKXXMVL%2B%2BDKg6AA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301430255/c414964f276b5bbdc65d45d7/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+11.25.27+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f050fa3413b075de8df2cbe8296c550fa2fbf1af4c2c919a80db115de2ef1f9&req=dyAmEsp%2Bn4RaFb4f3HP0gBwjw6%2B%2B3KEnbISJi5FWbMZUD5loUelkHArwXGsy%0AQTs%2FKXXMVL%2B%2BDKg6AA%3D%3D%0A)

**Red** indicates that the Invoice remains **_Unpaid_** or **_Overdue_**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301430189/50227b7134065cb8d3597f62/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+11.28.53+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09e13933d2adc07191b285419402f6334741cd4115e6b64607b6519500c0c391&req=dyAmEsp%2BnIlWFb4f3HP0gH94%2Fvo4zqnTocNrC7lDLfZRn6q5wklk570c8UTR%0A70vg1ndWViGOEAtIXw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/301430189/50227b7134065cb8d3597f62/Screen+Shot+2021-02-18+at+11.28.53+am.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09e13933d2adc07191b285419402f6334741cd4115e6b64607b6519500c0c391&req=dyAmEsp%2BnIlWFb4f3HP0gH94%2Fvo4zqnTocNrC7lDLfZRn6q5wklk570c8UTR%0A70vg1ndWViGOEAtIXw%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 144 — Marketing Statuses | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-144}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927850-marketing-statuses](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927850-marketing-statuses)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927850-marketing-statuses#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Patient File Management](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2601287-patient-file-management)

Marketing Statuses

Marketing Statuses
==================

Updated over 3 years ago

Marketing Statuses can be found on the **Patient's File > Patient Details tab** under **Communication & Marketing**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595631947/aa5bd3d3bfe8208249e792d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e0f12177c1ec38b91be0ccdd9dfb2acd7c17a1fb3377566992caaa087dfb0024&req=cSkiEMp%2FlIVYFb4f3HP0gHPR7qeZToI5wxoweZND77Kydy3RwFGbjBwQ%2FjjO%0AaTQ34Rc9g%2F5FHn2LUw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595631947/aa5bd3d3bfe8208249e792d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e0f12177c1ec38b91be0ccdd9dfb2acd7c17a1fb3377566992caaa087dfb0024&req=cSkiEMp%2FlIVYFb4f3HP0gHPR7qeZToI5wxoweZND77Kydy3RwFGbjBwQ%2FjjO%0AaTQ34Rc9g%2F5FHn2LUw%3D%3D%0A)

There is the option to select **Soft Opt-In**, **Soft Opt-Out**, **Opt-In** or **Opt-Out**.

**Soft Opt-in** and **Soft Opt-Out** indicate that your practice has decided what marketing material the patient will receive.

**Opt-In** and **Opt-Out** are for when the patient has made the decision about what marketing material they wish to receive from your practice. It's currently possible for patients to make this decision if your online booking system is configured to request marketing preferences when patients book online. Alternatively, you may set this based on the patient's responses to your new patient intake form.

Patients who have either **Soft Opt-Out** or **Opt-Out** selected will automatically be excluded from the bulk communication function available on PracSuite reports.

## Document 145 — Clinical Notes Appear as Outstanding | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-145}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927877-clinical-notes-appear-as-outstanding](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927877-clinical-notes-appear-as-outstanding)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927877-clinical-notes-appear-as-outstanding#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Clinical Notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413946-clinical-notes)

Clinical Notes Appear as Outstanding

Clinical Notes Appear as Outstanding
====================================

Updated over 3 years ago

If you've completed a clinical note, but the patient is still appearing in your [Outstanding Clinical Notes widget](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4548402-using-the-outstanding-clinical-notes-widget)
, it's important to check that the **Location**, **Practitioner** and **Date** of the clinical note match the appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595632723/7380359e802b61b36961f496/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6fa9bb20a969086a1a0bfe8cfb0e6fa328a587f1e13922d215965afe610379f1&req=cSkiEMp8moNcFb4f3HP0gHhgJcD4Nz1AiXfhT1WroI44%2F%2F2%2BRh4LyFNLANi%2B%0Aw3Cx3K58gm5kEPn0bQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595632723/7380359e802b61b36961f496/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6fa9bb20a969086a1a0bfe8cfb0e6fa328a587f1e13922d215965afe610379f1&req=cSkiEMp8moNcFb4f3HP0gHhgJcD4Nz1AiXfhT1WroI44%2F%2F2%2BRh4LyFNLANi%2B%0Aw3Cx3K58gm5kEPn0bQ%3D%3D%0A)

To confirm that the details of an existing clinical note are correct, click on the patient in the Outstanding Clinical Notes widget, which will take you to the **Clinical Notes** tab of the patient file**.**

In the clinical notes timeline, double-check that the Location, Practitioner and Date match the appointment exactly.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595632920/bb8948ee513093fc41b890b6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc89b6b231af53f0f63a6e6a9de93b46d73f470f89c555236ccc10b05ba70fea&req=cSkiEMp8lINfFb4f3HP0gBl1NhJ6Ikg6Ywy5%2B3lNWtBVsOhDUtk3UOEhfD21%0AD167kwQkK2NfZM480Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595632920/bb8948ee513093fc41b890b6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc89b6b231af53f0f63a6e6a9de93b46d73f470f89c555236ccc10b05ba70fea&req=cSkiEMp8lINfFb4f3HP0gBl1NhJ6Ikg6Ywy5%2B3lNWtBVsOhDUtk3UOEhfD21%0AD167kwQkK2NfZM480Q%3D%3D%0A)

Use the practitioner drop-down or date and time calendar icon to correct any discrepancies. Click **Save** when done.

In the case of multi-location businesses, make sure that both the Practitioner and Business match the appointment. The Business selected in the top right-hand side of the screen is used to set the Business when creating new clinical notes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595633243/1f5e90bc123c82e3b284bf58/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b601d59133f8cb79b0d6437546370244266954b8969a55e366c35894913fb509&req=cSkiEMp9n4VcFb4f3HP0gKhJ%2Fa5sgSTAuQNeJslZJ8s4nc2uq%2Bp5OZPc3uW5%0A17lO6a%2BUOGJTnFilXQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595633243/1f5e90bc123c82e3b284bf58/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b601d59133f8cb79b0d6437546370244266954b8969a55e366c35894913fb509&req=cSkiEMp9n4VcFb4f3HP0gKhJ%2Fa5sgSTAuQNeJslZJ8s4nc2uq%2Bp5OZPc3uW5%0A17lO6a%2BUOGJTnFilXQ%3D%3D%0A)

It is possible to enable a prompt to select your active Business each time you log into PracSuite so that the correct location is selected at the start of each day. [Click here for more info on how to enable this setting.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4853918-setting-your-business-when-logging-into-pracsuite)

Adding an Account Credit

Adding an Account Credit
========================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Overpayment on an Invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4928319-adding-an-account-credit#h_2d9f9a8daa)

[Selecting the Payment button on a Patient File](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4928319-adding-an-account-credit#h_c19a566a33)

There are two ways you can add an account **Credit** in PracSuite:

1.  [Overpayment on an Invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4928319-adding-an-account-credit#h_2d9f9a8daa)
    
2.  [Selecting the Payment button](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4928319-adding-an-account-credit#h_c19a566a33)
    

Overpayment on an Invoice
-------------------------

When processing an invoice, type in the payment amount into one of the payment method fields, that is greater than the invoice total.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601970006/1e84fbbb06c8062ad85b0cec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d5bcf3f19ae90edf482680635c1e74fe88234aca714de864ec70cd6fdf88efbf&req=ciAmH85%2BnYFZFb4f3HP0gLqF7QGQp7FXdxCqvAIunq8hTTJYrqWc6DknN826%0AxHw7NdQZW0mXZQIyUg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601970006/1e84fbbb06c8062ad85b0cec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d5bcf3f19ae90edf482680635c1e74fe88234aca714de864ec70cd6fdf88efbf&req=ciAmH85%2BnYFZFb4f3HP0gLqF7QGQp7FXdxCqvAIunq8hTTJYrqWc6DknN826%0AxHw7NdQZW0mXZQIyUg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add Payment** and an alert will appear to confirm adding the overpayment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601970217/f7e7b66b2a98c8886ef4b08f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a39e6a75c97d07c2422e2cebf9094b454fa2f4d15705a42bd7b81bce9bfa5c11&req=ciAmH85%2Bn4BYFb4f3HP0gAXM2O8%2BPdLNcBvT2WeozWBDWIO5xWErdeg0qkyi%0ArUkfajwZqUU3vJ9mhQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601970217/f7e7b66b2a98c8886ef4b08f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a39e6a75c97d07c2422e2cebf9094b454fa2f4d15705a42bd7b81bce9bfa5c11&req=ciAmH85%2Bn4BYFb4f3HP0gAXM2O8%2BPdLNcBvT2WeozWBDWIO5xWErdeg0qkyi%0ArUkfajwZqUU3vJ9mhQ%3D%3D%0A)

Selecting the Payment button on a Patient File
----------------------------------------------

Open the Patient File and click the **Payment** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601970559/23f8fca63997439edc3d81e3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3763da7e02d4803a684f3434fd28e430897236239460857a9e81b1026c94ba3f&req=ciAmH85%2BmIRWFb4f3HP0gHJDiiFa5Rn2xiIvPQoLPukQtCC5bjLTc1%2BcVAxK%0ATzh0YNs5dPhSPIxDGA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601970559/23f8fca63997439edc3d81e3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3763da7e02d4803a684f3434fd28e430897236239460857a9e81b1026c94ba3f&req=ciAmH85%2BmIRWFb4f3HP0gHJDiiFa5Rn2xiIvPQoLPukQtCC5bjLTc1%2BcVAxK%0ATzh0YNs5dPhSPIxDGA%3D%3D%0A)

Enter the credit amount into the appropriate payment field and select **Add Payment**. The overpayment alert will appear to confirm adding the credit.

Note: If the patient has an **outstanding invoice** you have the option to **Auto** Allocate, **Manually** Allocate or leave **Unallocated** the payment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601970959/139ff7afe2382f0f763939d8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0bfb751e0fe996d92701e1e914223162c9e5b4184e7e4f711d570f3b6c824d16&req=ciAmH85%2BlIRWFb4f3HP0gPIdDJ8GD7b0kuTfRsYsD5elEoRzp8d%2B1ITqb6DP%0AT2x5W2OPif5GBVomZQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601970959/139ff7afe2382f0f763939d8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0bfb751e0fe996d92701e1e914223162c9e5b4184e7e4f711d570f3b6c824d16&req=ciAmH85%2BlIRWFb4f3HP0gPIdDJ8GD7b0kuTfRsYsD5elEoRzp8d%2B1ITqb6DP%0AT2x5W2OPif5GBVomZQ%3D%3D%0A)

How to Use an Unallocated Payment or Credit

How to Use an Unallocated Payment or Credit
===========================================

Updated over 10 months ago

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461984642/f5dcc4284b5cbf407b62d6d2564f/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_37_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=30c5ee4f2a982458fcdfdf2af34a1c23828dcf209666a336a5cfe3289018afa4&req=dSQhF8B2mYdbW%2FMW1HO4zRBnz%2FJfPYkZ8zXu4QIMgCjqp9mpzYcYNF70cBEs%0AnL3yV3jXKqsS8wKfC5U%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461984642/f5dcc4284b5cbf407b62d6d2564f/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_37_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=30c5ee4f2a982458fcdfdf2af34a1c23828dcf209666a336a5cfe3289018afa4&req=dSQhF8B2mYdbW%2FMW1HO4zRBnz%2FJfPYkZ8zXu4QIMgCjqp9mpzYcYNF70cBEs%0AnL3yV3jXKqsS8wKfC5U%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601971607/b6b2c14c3fb101356bddb1a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0af65edeb578fcb5f065f70d920da7b20eb23670bbdcde9388ae41c100e98fde&req=ciAmH85%2Fm4FYFb4f3HP0gAHlACVGprgJ0v9rIw739p2czM8tptbjYYlvdoJP%0AK12sl0%2Fr1hb9DHsk1Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601971607/b6b2c14c3fb101356bddb1a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0af65edeb578fcb5f065f70d920da7b20eb23670bbdcde9388ae41c100e98fde&req=ciAmH85%2Fm4FYFb4f3HP0gAHlACVGprgJ0v9rIw739p2czM8tptbjYYlvdoJP%0AK12sl0%2Fr1hb9DHsk1Q%3D%3D%0A)

Alternatively, use the quick pay icon to pay off the outstanding balance of the invoice using the available credit balance.

Including Add to Calendar links in Appointment Reminders

Including Add to Calendar links in Appointment Reminders
========================================================

Updated over 10 months ago

Table of contents

[Including Add to Calendar links in SMS templates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4945159-including-add-to-calendar-links-in-appointment-reminders#h_2ecc32589c)

[Including Add to Calendar links in email templates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4945159-including-add-to-calendar-links-in-appointment-reminders#h_35920c9a57)

[Features that support Add to Calendar links](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4945159-including-add-to-calendar-links-in-appointment-reminders#h_c611927b9b)

For patient convenience, PracSuite's appointment confirmations and reminders allow you to include Add to Calendar links that make it easy for the patient to add their appointment to their calendar on their personal devices.

Patients adding their appointments to their calendars have the following benefits, depending on the device they're using:

*   Their calendar app can provide additional reminders about the appointment
    
*   Their calendar app can suggest a 'time to leave' to arrive at the practice on time
    
*   The patient can tap to get directions to your practice
    
*   If it's a telehealth appointment, the Zoom, Google Meet or Teams join link will be included
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1462115990/c9e988c02adcd1625a3773d746ac/icallinkinphonedouble-smal2l.png?expires=1771821900&signature=723338e0512f165f17b9adf05386292f899b76c9f3049cb0789f557e5ecf9966&req=dSQhFMh%2FmIhWWfMW1HO4zSFDwXoItFvNuyBlATrjfl3bLp6Gj5KSSpfIkRb7%0AIqSVsjdvivBJABe%2FjwE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1462115990/c9e988c02adcd1625a3773d746ac/icallinkinphonedouble-smal2l.png?expires=1771821900&signature=723338e0512f165f17b9adf05386292f899b76c9f3049cb0789f557e5ecf9966&req=dSQhFMh%2FmIhWWfMW1HO4zSFDwXoItFvNuyBlATrjfl3bLp6Gj5KSSpfIkRb7%0AIqSVsjdvivBJABe%2FjwE%3D%0A)

When selecting the link from your SMS or email, the patient will be able to select their preferred calendar to add their appointment to.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1462115431/342ef718d720edf5d61152fc4144/CleanShot+X+2025-04-07+11_17_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea028776581558bd8691d10067ef95537a08bee37cbf89d37e0418d5d69a7902&req=dSQhFMh%2FmIVcWPMW1HO4zehb2mIBFQKTQPsGcaU%2BN1ln0kJ9Eu%2F8IKmDhGxz%0AE0yiA%2F9G1cnF5F9m%2Fbc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1462115431/342ef718d720edf5d61152fc4144/CleanShot+X+2025-04-07+11_17_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea028776581558bd8691d10067ef95537a08bee37cbf89d37e0418d5d69a7902&req=dSQhFMh%2FmIVcWPMW1HO4zehb2mIBFQKTQPsGcaU%2BN1ln0kJ9Eu%2F8IKmDhGxz%0AE0yiA%2F9G1cnF5F9m%2Fbc%3D%0A)

Including Add to Calendar links in your appointment reminders and confirmations is as simple as including the <<AppointmentIcalLink>> merge field into your templates.

* * *

Including Add to Calendar links in SMS templates
================================================

Go to **[Settings > Templates > SMS Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/sms)
** and [create or edit an SMS Template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317983-creating-sms-templates)
.

From the **Appointment** dropdown, insert the **Appointment** **iCal Link** merge field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595633980/0f21a2364a7f82a50f8cf079/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14d4e09419c06c7a7d5ce2efd329d5d0ed8592d01b31b7cb548a4c09b3a7e85f&req=cSkiEMp9lIlfFb4f3HP0gJwCPjdJqefJFi53RCTAL0jaQ9%2B2dP2DLIKEL9yn%0AvGvGFW0f6QmoaQ9%2BoA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595633980/0f21a2364a7f82a50f8cf079/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14d4e09419c06c7a7d5ce2efd329d5d0ed8592d01b31b7cb548a4c09b3a7e85f&req=cSkiEMp9lIlfFb4f3HP0gJwCPjdJqefJFi53RCTAL0jaQ9%2B2dP2DLIKEL9yn%0AvGvGFW0f6QmoaQ9%2BoA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

* * *

Including Add to Calendar links in email templates
==================================================

Go to **[Settings > Templates > Email templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/email)
** and [create or edit an email template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317970-creating-email-templates)
.

From the **Appointment** dropdown, insert the **Appointment** **iCal Link** merge field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595634575/7fe19595c013145b10c4eaf8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d4430a7571586a942a152ddda75a253da78b01a97587df2612df1b3b5b2019e7&req=cSkiEMp6mIZaFb4f3HP0gJOxwX1NSdMgN2lcFGk9Nc7EozGXf12gpDcHxB9S%0A5KWODE0ZlKA0drs2pQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595634575/7fe19595c013145b10c4eaf8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d4430a7571586a942a152ddda75a253da78b01a97587df2612df1b3b5b2019e7&req=cSkiEMp6mIZaFb4f3HP0gJOxwX1NSdMgN2lcFGk9Nc7EozGXf12gpDcHxB9S%0A5KWODE0ZlKA0drs2pQ%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting the Appointment iCal Link merge field, it will be copied to your clipboard.

Place your cursor where you would like to use the tag, and right-click > paste or press CTRL V to place the client field in your email template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595634978/0734ccc8686b555a4358a39d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5fbbb94895b3be6b7d350d9c6c1c495d6680d1a60f1a3206e7c7966e5ba10f6e&req=cSkiEMp6lIZXFb4f3HP0gA%2F1koVwJcVKuKvGSf190hY1b5aQhDuyKpkJp3D3%0AVelqeeak5NbWL291QQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595634978/0734ccc8686b555a4358a39d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5fbbb94895b3be6b7d350d9c6c1c495d6680d1a60f1a3206e7c7966e5ba10f6e&req=cSkiEMp6lIZXFb4f3HP0gA%2F1koVwJcVKuKvGSf190hY1b5aQhDuyKpkJp3D3%0AVelqeeak5NbWL291QQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

* * *

Once your template has been created or modified to include the Appointment iCal Link merge field, you'll be able to use the Add to Calendar links when sending emails or SMS using the features listed below. Click through the links below to learn more about each feature.

## Document 149 — How to Move an Invoice to a Different Account | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-149}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5005464-how-to-move-an-invoice-to-a-different-account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5005464-how-to-move-an-invoice-to-a-different-account)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5005464-how-to-move-an-invoice-to-a-different-account#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Invoicing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413899-invoicing)

[Invoices and Receipts](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984691-invoices-and-receipts)

How to Move an Invoice to a Different Account

How to Move an Invoice to a Different Account
=============================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Invoices can be moved to a different account, provided they meet the following criteria:

*   Only invoices on the same account can be moved together
    
*   Invoices with multiple patients cannot be moved to another account
    
*   Invoices containing payments applied to multiple invoices cannot be moved to another account if you only select one of the associated invoices. You have to move all invoices that the payment is associated with.
    

To move an invoice to a different account, go to the **Patient File > Invoices tab**.

Select the **Invoices tab** to move a private invoice or a non-linked third party invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601972380/b6ffcad518d2146ef366afa1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7851e08f2a843fbdbd97910badde17f610cc2c89fdc42d123367fa07f9305f3b&req=ciAmH858nolfFb4f3HP0gP2pIEouKBYwEhiBfD0SDeoYFVkILN5FEtu77VjN%0ARgK7tMnzq%2FOLh4Uxeg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601972380/b6ffcad518d2146ef366afa1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7851e08f2a843fbdbd97910badde17f610cc2c89fdc42d123367fa07f9305f3b&req=ciAmH858nolfFb4f3HP0gP2pIEouKBYwEhiBfD0SDeoYFVkILN5FEtu77VjN%0ARgK7tMnzq%2FOLh4Uxeg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Third-Party Linked tab** to move a linked third-third party invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601972700/a6627b02f124540c0e189b8f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=845008b4b919fb1fcecfd48292a96bf5e78a43ceda9b00306b17d37cffa882d6&req=ciAmH858moFfFb4f3HP0gP37Pqo9XblFwvWLKD78sRaQLHWWKnhmXyds4CqT%0AdwMJpZHiPLpnepXCXQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601972700/a6627b02f124540c0e189b8f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=845008b4b919fb1fcecfd48292a96bf5e78a43ceda9b00306b17d37cffa882d6&req=ciAmH858moFfFb4f3HP0gP37Pqo9XblFwvWLKD78sRaQLHWWKnhmXyds4CqT%0AdwMJpZHiPLpnepXCXQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select one or more invoices and select the **Move** button.

Select the account you wish to move the invoice to and select **Confirm** to finalise the process.

How to Create Statements in Bulk Using the Statement Report

How to Create Statements in Bulk Using the Statement Report
===========================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

The [Statement Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/statements)
 allows you to generate and print/email statements in bulk. Statements are a summary of invoices.

Go to **[Reports > Billing > Statements](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/statements)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973150/617b6b52127cd9ae00ebe13c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=60c7ca36b1eaea390cdff3573569b518303b97720bcd17cac5e569ae40d844e9&req=ciAmH859nIRfFb4f3HP0gOo2qXbUPx%2BsSPk2getB4uQlaynU048MKhE9Hwo%2B%0AVuJWyQ51IIBjyarEeQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973150/617b6b52127cd9ae00ebe13c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=60c7ca36b1eaea390cdff3573569b518303b97720bcd17cac5e569ae40d844e9&req=ciAmH859nIRfFb4f3HP0gOo2qXbUPx%2BsSPk2getB4uQlaynU048MKhE9Hwo%2B%0AVuJWyQ51IIBjyarEeQ%3D%3D%0A)

Start with selecting the invoice date range. This report can be used to print or email a statement that includes invoices that are **issued**, **overdue** or **paid** depending on the filters you select.

If you want to include a copy of the invoices along with the Statement page, check **Include invoice copies**.

You also have the option to **Include unallocated payments** and to **Print itemised invoices on statements**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973319/a8926e79dd6490f766836832/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc1eb9892cb86a4318e78f7bbd99099f8844c6cea5e37c0df30b39b6fc0ea3da&req=ciAmH859noBWFb4f3HP0gKIWn%2FAn5izP8S4f5woBvvfnVAgCfIpZoetEG%2Flq%0A7CoeQl4wHr6EzoHaCg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973319/a8926e79dd6490f766836832/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc1eb9892cb86a4318e78f7bbd99099f8844c6cea5e37c0df30b39b6fc0ea3da&req=ciAmH859noBWFb4f3HP0gKIWn%2FAn5izP8S4f5woBvvfnVAgCfIpZoetEG%2Flq%0A7CoeQl4wHr6EzoHaCg%3D%3D%0A)

Once you have set your filters, select **Generate Report**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973513/a47db4fb3bd015f74add6b20/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddc9f58a4e069ff8a2131315a99f05174260509d50a6050da3a64e16485ec23c&req=ciAmH859mIBcFb4f3HP0gJjDy7Dh3RTZD1E9SiXGVavBgliGHr9LGY5nZhcb%0APXHBQojWaTckT%2BjlfQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973513/a47db4fb3bd015f74add6b20/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddc9f58a4e069ff8a2131315a99f05174260509d50a6050da3a64e16485ec23c&req=ciAmH859mIBcFb4f3HP0gJjDy7Dh3RTZD1E9SiXGVavBgliGHr9LGY5nZhcb%0APXHBQojWaTckT%2BjlfQ%3D%3D%0A)

The results will display a line for each patient per account and per business.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973802/0761195a0e0e37243a30b449/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a08df17e3dd42399f2e2ef3092650277fd7cc8db16999b696f9a5cd87e003d0&req=ciAmH859lYFdFb4f3HP0gNnbxelezsYU8mN18huwrtm%2Bdoovw5FnEAk52x%2Fv%0AKkQuIJZkdbNkcBroLQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973802/0761195a0e0e37243a30b449/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a08df17e3dd42399f2e2ef3092650277fd7cc8db16999b696f9a5cd87e003d0&req=ciAmH859lYFdFb4f3HP0gNnbxelezsYU8mN18huwrtm%2Bdoovw5FnEAk52x%2Fv%0AKkQuIJZkdbNkcBroLQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select the accounts you wish to issue a statement for with the checkboxes on the left-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973892/fb6e7a3c5da58e1f7d078072/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8374558b106549bdefa9eba6f5d9424c81456f214810524c71ca4c25a7efc6e3&req=ciAmH859lYhdFb4f3HP0gIbv41nHDxOdsal%2Bs03QyXwaZjHcZ%2BBYrYoW0ly5%0AVDwkXNnh8lrjacunVg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601973892/fb6e7a3c5da58e1f7d078072/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8374558b106549bdefa9eba6f5d9424c81456f214810524c71ca4c25a7efc6e3&req=ciAmH859lYhdFb4f3HP0gIbv41nHDxOdsal%2Bs03QyXwaZjHcZ%2BBYrYoW0ly5%0AVDwkXNnh8lrjacunVg%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Process** button to take the selected action as displayed in the grid. Use the drop-down menu in each row to override the action.

To print all selected statements, select the **Print** button. To email all selected statements, select **Email**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974012/ebdde835c01f5ad1f57f2b39/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=62f1c3a421ac124299cae53d057a82a6a0d9564411ce9912777b46dc574b5e5d&req=ciAmH856nYBdFb4f3HP0gBkgh435Qwis%2BO3Neg7LNdRbl2d5EPgCdECF60i4%0AYFY7ISyYp%2Bk9WEKOjg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974012/ebdde835c01f5ad1f57f2b39/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=62f1c3a421ac124299cae53d057a82a6a0d9564411ce9912777b46dc574b5e5d&req=ciAmH856nYBdFb4f3HP0gBkgh435Qwis%2BO3Neg7LNdRbl2d5EPgCdECF60i4%0AYFY7ISyYp%2Bk9WEKOjg%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting Process, Print or Email, you will be given the option to send the selected statements with the default email template or specify which email template to use. The default email template is set by going to **[Settings > Businesses > Businesses](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/businesses)
 > selecting a business > select Edit** and by scrolling down to the **Default Email Templates** section. If no Default template is set, it will use the PracSuite default.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974183/52f956a3def9d85b296f509b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=57222155601f5320b2b620cb000688a82a526554fedc95f5dbff79e5b1718c2c&req=ciAmH856nIlcFb4f3HP0gNdPQQV9M20DmwXrzdYxKAW%2FuQvjqyr5B8VBmmIP%0A8jw6UYLHbxWoafPg8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974183/52f956a3def9d85b296f509b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=57222155601f5320b2b620cb000688a82a526554fedc95f5dbff79e5b1718c2c&req=ciAmH856nIlcFb4f3HP0gNdPQQV9M20DmwXrzdYxKAW%2FuQvjqyr5B8VBmmIP%0A8jw6UYLHbxWoafPg8w%3D%3D%0A)

How to Create a Statement for a Client

How to Create a Statement for a Client
======================================

Updated over 3 years ago

A Statement is a summary of invoices that can be easier to digest than providing a patient with a stack of individual invoices.

To print or email a statement for an individual client, go to the client's **Invoices** tab and select **Statement** at the top.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974544/b92796eb870a26febc60cf00/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3682c0292222bd019f97b0dd08c389e7230897aecc76780862a254f822e1793c&req=ciAmH856mIVbFb4f3HP0gL6R0cPMZeHy%2FbU0UslXrm06AOioAWaDhU6B11QK%0ARVMLKRlRhkhaNuMvHA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974544/b92796eb870a26febc60cf00/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3682c0292222bd019f97b0dd08c389e7230897aecc76780862a254f822e1793c&req=ciAmH856mIVbFb4f3HP0gL6R0cPMZeHy%2FbU0UslXrm06AOioAWaDhU6B11QK%0ARVMLKRlRhkhaNuMvHA%3D%3D%0A)

Start with selecting the invoice date range. This report can be used to print or email a statement that includes invoices that are **issued**, **overdue** or **paid** depending on the filters you select.

You must select a single **Business** to generate a Statement from the client's file.

If you want to include a copy of the invoices along with the Statement page, check **Include invoice copies**.

You also have the option to **Include unallocated payments** and to **Print itemised invoices on statements**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974626/4299eed65520e7de1101d36d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=53becf32d45e93fe8eacc384e694d93c38dfb5d7591df60aa9b56005de002179&req=ciAmH856m4NZFb4f3HP0gJCWoNmK6PGTgidpHTrzC%2BAK%2BEFeuXZklraLCEx%2F%0A5oYEcwTmDJ8zZh%2B7WQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974626/4299eed65520e7de1101d36d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=53becf32d45e93fe8eacc384e694d93c38dfb5d7591df60aa9b56005de002179&req=ciAmH856m4NZFb4f3HP0gJCWoNmK6PGTgidpHTrzC%2BAK%2BEFeuXZklraLCEx%2F%0A5oYEcwTmDJ8zZh%2B7WQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once you have set your filters, select **Find Invoices**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974675/b969d319d68fc00e607fd703/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cdc6413aa13d5a9373494c56e24c7e87ff0662e916af583d958ce3fe403f683c&req=ciAmH856m4ZaFb4f3HP0gETBDN%2BIEX8M7yx0lBmE9s0TPya%2BS764Mc6JaTFl%0A4ZULCQFry3%2FAjzd1cw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601974675/b969d319d68fc00e607fd703/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cdc6413aa13d5a9373494c56e24c7e87ff0662e916af583d958ce3fe403f683c&req=ciAmH856m4ZaFb4f3HP0gETBDN%2BIEX8M7yx0lBmE9s0TPya%2BS764Mc6JaTFl%0A4ZULCQFry3%2FAjzd1cw%3D%3D%0A)

The results are displayed in a grid detailing each invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601975011/f622d2c6c1d8b85340ab73da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=505621e9474c50bdf8fd6cc2ccaa0f3e910040306d4cc63f1a3a59145a08d136&req=ciAmH857nYBeFb4f3HP0gJ4no%2FBTaODCo%2Fbjr0tRPr3Rg14397ef96wyhNPg%0AHc0bHIdxBny%2FRGlIKg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601975011/f622d2c6c1d8b85340ab73da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=505621e9474c50bdf8fd6cc2ccaa0f3e910040306d4cc63f1a3a59145a08d136&req=ciAmH857nYBeFb4f3HP0gJ4no%2FBTaODCo%2Fbjr0tRPr3Rg14397ef96wyhNPg%0AHc0bHIdxBny%2FRGlIKg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the invoices you wish to include in the statement with the checkboxes on the left-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601975167/228fbd5cb31f6222243f7901/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=caead4cea270e2aed221d2ae3fa303d903593f3f027cf078cc40b88f8efa46fc&req=ciAmH857nIdYFb4f3HP0gArLNQrfymMrzvuu3W7xAD8ENXN29N8jw4YS8C9k%0Ah0Yb4Dtyyei8Yfjm0g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601975167/228fbd5cb31f6222243f7901/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=caead4cea270e2aed221d2ae3fa303d903593f3f027cf078cc40b88f8efa46fc&req=ciAmH857nIdYFb4f3HP0gArLNQrfymMrzvuu3W7xAD8ENXN29N8jw4YS8C9k%0Ah0Yb4Dtyyei8Yfjm0g%3D%3D%0A)

The button above the grid will be based on the client's default method of receiving invoices either **Save & Email**, **Save & Print** or **Save, Print & Email**. Select the button to perform the action or use the dropdown to select another delivery method to generate the statement.

The statement you have generated can be reprinted from the **Statements** tab on the client's file under the Invoices tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601975274/d42bf48dad6bc56728566568/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=87fd673c78cc954e1ff8f7217845e2256f8607249a509cf25a131816b2599523&req=ciAmH857n4ZbFb4f3HP0gM3EK5w3fbC6DyNMbRgh48rsjQBR9czsx%2F5S9JyK%0AnJV3eM8xNNKeWkkkcA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601975274/d42bf48dad6bc56728566568/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=87fd673c78cc954e1ff8f7217845e2256f8607249a509cf25a131816b2599523&req=ciAmH857n4ZbFb4f3HP0gM3EK5w3fbC6DyNMbRgh48rsjQBR9czsx%2F5S9JyK%0AnJV3eM8xNNKeWkkkcA%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601983507/5cf76f6696aae494524a8ec4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d11afc7b65ca74bd5e4ebe467936d968c0c0fcf57948d9a7da32d63e30e2a945&req=ciAmH8F9mIFYFb4f3HP0gJfa1Gt75%2BMlesyVbXpygPJ3DgiyNGeu%2B%2BQY4yyy%0As%2BV7EEgE40ji%2BzeycA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601983507/5cf76f6696aae494524a8ec4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d11afc7b65ca74bd5e4ebe467936d968c0c0fcf57948d9a7da32d63e30e2a945&req=ciAmH8F9mIFYFb4f3HP0gJfa1Gt75%2BMlesyVbXpygPJ3DgiyNGeu%2B%2BQY4yyy%0As%2BV7EEgE40ji%2BzeycA%3D%3D%0A)

The results are displayed in a grid detailing each invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601983621/a84049d34e151ed440d4b918/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac9e79151fbc692cb5495f5aad7c3b1c6f9f0a2363d124c0f5eb37853141281b&req=ciAmH8F9m4NeFb4f3HP0gFQVhqKOXbWSOojEVnWESC4rKrRJfOdZC3BA97Az%0An3aVWg1S9KkmFJO6pg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601983621/a84049d34e151ed440d4b918/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac9e79151fbc692cb5495f5aad7c3b1c6f9f0a2363d124c0f5eb37853141281b&req=ciAmH8F9m4NeFb4f3HP0gFQVhqKOXbWSOojEVnWESC4rKrRJfOdZC3BA97Az%0An3aVWg1S9KkmFJO6pg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the invoices you wish to include in the statement with the checkboxes on the left-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601983689/bf0d3d2943325607fa692d5b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f28a39c0d259bd72dae5900bdf60025fddc6348742c686ef497576c58bebd2db&req=ciAmH8F9m4lWFb4f3HP0gPXT9PyK%2Fi7clTj5U0wN4HCCTrB17HALYVAjBFrF%0APo5ND9YORlSVakAvSg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601983689/bf0d3d2943325607fa692d5b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f28a39c0d259bd72dae5900bdf60025fddc6348742c686ef497576c58bebd2db&req=ciAmH8F9m4lWFb4f3HP0gPXT9PyK%2Fi7clTj5U0wN4HCCTrB17HALYVAjBFrF%0APo5ND9YORlSVakAvSg%3D%3D%0A)

The button above the grid will be based on the third-party payer's default method of receiving invoices either **Save & Email**, **Save & Print** or **Save, Print & Email**. Select the button to perform the action or use the dropdown to select another delivery method to generate the statement.

The statement you have generated can be reprinted from the **Statements** tab on the third party payer's file under invoices.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601983865/fc366c0a7db8c30f2a1c3318/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b044dd7f1fe8dca8ff1f4970c50efde1e5a539d8e18b85f5b5d683da638821b7&req=ciAmH8F9lYdaFb4f3HP0gDJy705ctdt2HS2SC6MTaSL1jbnMSy%2FNHXx8MuCb%0AN5XZBa4Bg5OQ5CsN7w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601983865/fc366c0a7db8c30f2a1c3318/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b044dd7f1fe8dca8ff1f4970c50efde1e5a539d8e18b85f5b5d683da638821b7&req=ciAmH8F9lYdaFb4f3HP0gDJy705ctdt2HS2SC6MTaSL1jbnMSy%2FNHXx8MuCb%0AN5XZBa4Bg5OQ5CsN7w%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 153 — Creating a Direct Login URL | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-153}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5039584-creating-a-direct-login-url](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5039584-creating-a-direct-login-url)

Creating a Direct Login URL

Creating a Direct Login URL
===========================

Updated over a month ago

Table of contents

[1\. Creating a User Account for the Third-party Booking Agency](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5039584-creating-a-direct-login-url#h_04b934a46c)

[2\. Enabling IP Barring for the User](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5039584-creating-a-direct-login-url#h_854ebaa5d4)

[3\. Configuring the Direct Login URL for the User](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5039584-creating-a-direct-login-url#h_0855e808bf)

A Direct Login URL is an encrypted link that allows a PracSuite user to log in without entering a username or password. This feature is designed for third-party booking agencies that require temporary access to your appointment book.

When accessed, a Direct Login URL provides access for up to 15 minutes, after which the user is automatically logged out.

**Important security information**

Direct Login URLs provide direct access to your PracSuite system. These links must be stored in a controlled, encrypted environment and treated with the same level of security as a username and password.

1\. Creating a User Account for the Third-party Booking Agency
--------------------------------------------------------------

To enable the Direct Login feature, you will need to [create a new PracSuite User account](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account)
 for your third-party booking agency and [assign a Role](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353460-creating-roles)
 with the desired permissions. If you have already created a login for your third-party booking agency, you can jump to step 2.  
​  
We strongly encourage you to restrict the permissions on the Role that you create for the third-party booking agency so that they can only access the functions they require i.e. appointment booking.

2\. Enabling IP Barring for the User
------------------------------------

A requirement to use the Direct Login URL feature is that [IP Address Barring](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4343809-ip-address-barring)
 is enabled for the user login. This will require you to create an IP address group in Settings > Users & Security > IP Addresses that contains a list of approved/whitelisted IP addresses.

[You can learn more about creating an IP Address group here.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4343809-ip-address-barring)

Note: This will require you to obtain the public IP addresses for the individuals at the third-party booking agency who will be logging into PracSuite.

3\. Configuring the Direct Login URL for the User
-------------------------------------------------

After creating the IP address group, head back to the user account you created for the third-party booking agency. Scroll down to the Security section and select the IP address group that you created from the IP Barring drop-down.

You will then be able to enable the Direct Login URL switch.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636292963/53f613e02f68304f98c2444c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a7f6ebb71869c12369f900899ad2b6598dfd5ffd554dfbb16796abe3dbd7ecaa&req=ciMhFMB8lIdcFb4f3HP0gCnixHO2rHFlYpcefagqcxhRMJHPO47TgO1m7vlU%0AAKWHVtOCBjjwMjLMsg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636292963/53f613e02f68304f98c2444c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a7f6ebb71869c12369f900899ad2b6598dfd5ffd554dfbb16796abe3dbd7ecaa&req=ciMhFMB8lIdcFb4f3HP0gCnixHO2rHFlYpcefagqcxhRMJHPO47TgO1m7vlU%0AAKWHVtOCBjjwMjLMsg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the Copy icon next to the switch to open the URL generation prompt.

The Direct Login URL can be set up to direct the user to the home screen or directly to the appointment book, including a specific business, practitioner and/or profession.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636293323/f9b782999931394f40a10d0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83ae516321205a69cad2f85f2a94b7ff95ad677eee07275ca377761c3133b423&req=ciMhFMB9noNcFb4f3HP0gJtLUO0%2BDctw4LIg0%2FpjsreB%2BHmHI56zWFf3VbjX%0APwoZ0VKjrP4mpbyLFA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636293323/f9b782999931394f40a10d0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83ae516321205a69cad2f85f2a94b7ff95ad677eee07275ca377761c3133b423&req=ciMhFMB9noNcFb4f3HP0gJtLUO0%2BDctw4LIg0%2FpjsreB%2BHmHI56zWFf3VbjX%0APwoZ0VKjrP4mpbyLFA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Generate URL** to finalise the Direct Login URL.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636293505/b16765480135e78c18d64b12/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3b346da3c7448125569dda7b4124b71f064562a379dff89280aceee51eb7965d&req=ciMhFMB9mIFaFb4f3HP0gDA%2FJee6oeJlne%2FP3vx9T75bSkE2OHvrptn0yeW0%0Alo%2BGLqFczto5OugBIQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636293505/b16765480135e78c18d64b12/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3b346da3c7448125569dda7b4124b71f064562a379dff89280aceee51eb7965d&req=ciMhFMB9mIFaFb4f3HP0gDA%2FJee6oeJlne%2FP3vx9T75bSkE2OHvrptn0yeW0%0Alo%2BGLqFczto5OugBIQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Copy URL** to copy the link to your clipboard so that you can provide it to your third-party booking agency.

**Important security information**

Direct Login URLs provide direct access to your PracSuite system. These links must be stored in a controlled, encrypted environment and treated with the same level of security as a username and password.

How to Print or Export Clinical Notes
=====================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Exporting a Single Clinical Note
================================

To print, email or download a PDF of a **single clinical note**, hover over a clinical note in the timeline and select the **Export** icon in the top right.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/700879910/24acf6157f7abe0ae91f6652/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=198ec8ca3d9b4f8cd079f6d8c81ac36a1e43163f6eccdc7eb8556b8a8ddfbcda&req=cyAnHs53lIBfFb4f3HP0gLPBhWntSRcQgseAttjQzP8xHLQEDEGjypiHx%2BDl%0ApRw7%2FC3knGaDlMU2qA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/700879910/24acf6157f7abe0ae91f6652/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=198ec8ca3d9b4f8cd079f6d8c81ac36a1e43163f6eccdc7eb8556b8a8ddfbcda&req=cyAnHs53lIBfFb4f3HP0gLPBhWntSRcQgseAttjQzP8xHLQEDEGjypiHx%2BDl%0ApRw7%2FC3knGaDlMU2qA%3D%3D%0A)

Exporting Multiple Clinical Notes
=================================

To print, download or email a PDF of **multiple clinical notes**, click the **Export** icon at the top of a patient's clinical note timeline.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/700879123/3544b4e19ab5980e060ed5d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5fc92e54ac47b5f3b627e848b6c1d69f759bcfca277e7d4796685c6f1c09619c&req=cyAnHs53nINcFb4f3HP0gCcpjlWGLm07uoS4JD6vfW6MW1RPbYWG8mx%2Fme6V%0Ahk5jcexkBO1NLlTMUA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/700879123/3544b4e19ab5980e060ed5d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5fc92e54ac47b5f3b627e848b6c1d69f759bcfca277e7d4796685c6f1c09619c&req=cyAnHs53nINcFb4f3HP0gCcpjlWGLm07uoS4JD6vfW6MW1RPbYWG8mx%2Fme6V%0Ahk5jcexkBO1NLlTMUA%3D%3D%0A)

Use the filters to adjust which clinical notes you would like to include.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792413001/d02bc196c32dd60336191743/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+14.50.22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e2cbbedf072ad3bf50d4ea80aaa791b43b6f79ce4399d5c88207f72ec36b6b2&req=cyklEsh9nYFeFb4f3HP0gKtcLsnnCFmJIYFUq13tFzb5vCL2qSQI8ObFJPOr%0AVwAKZUU%2FXU3u1OPyNA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792413001/d02bc196c32dd60336191743/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+14.50.22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e2cbbedf072ad3bf50d4ea80aaa791b43b6f79ce4399d5c88207f72ec36b6b2&req=cyklEsh9nYFeFb4f3HP0gKtcLsnnCFmJIYFUq13tFzb5vCL2qSQI8ObFJPOr%0AVwAKZUU%2FXU3u1OPyNA%3D%3D%0A)

Selecting **Revisions** will include all copies of a clinical note from the current iteration to the original version.

Enabling the Business header will add your business information to the top right of the export.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792413801/be3103286eea895efa68288d/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+14.56.35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f42d8bb119c6948bc56c5f7a17e4c1fc74f875445b8e85ad08c044fe63d63262&req=cyklEsh9lYFeFb4f3HP0gK9oBeYvDzLUXSK4YwhByil2xVbNuGV8Lak5QbEO%0APNdDD%2BlbCqS7La6HpQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792413801/be3103286eea895efa68288d/CleanShot+2023-07-25+at+14.56.35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f42d8bb119c6948bc56c5f7a17e4c1fc74f875445b8e85ad08c044fe63d63262&req=cyklEsh9lYFeFb4f3HP0gK9oBeYvDzLUXSK4YwhByil2xVbNuGV8Lak5QbEO%0APNdDD%2BlbCqS7La6HpQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once you have selected the appropriate filters and inclusions, click **Print**, **Email** or **Download,** depending on the action you'd like to complete.
