[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059210-how-to-book-multiple-appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059210-how-to-book-multiple-appointments)

[Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413898-appointment-book)

[Appointment Book Basics](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2992886-appointment-book-basics)

How to Book Multiple Appointments

How to Book Multiple Appointments
=================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Booking a New Appointment Schedule](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059210-how-to-book-multiple-appointments#h_f029c138d4)

[Editing an Existing Appointment Schedule](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059210-how-to-book-multiple-appointments#h_7b5b39de25)

If a patient requires multiple appointments, it is easy to make all appointments at one time using the Schedule function.

Booking a New Appointment Schedule
==================================

On the Appointment Book, select a day and time for the first appointment in the schedule.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936612798/adcfe6364d87315b2ba5b6ac/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.22.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bda13d9053b3f12e2ce0166a55d2b0de6a52d3c80dd469515e4a1e6d1dbe0909&req=fSMhEMh8mohXFb4f3HP0gA36awxsHa74qG7gw0npfuMy6zD%2FqugJkuQlyCmX%0Aczb9ejvtP7%2FddodBPw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936612798/adcfe6364d87315b2ba5b6ac/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+15.22.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bda13d9053b3f12e2ce0166a55d2b0de6a52d3c80dd469515e4a1e6d1dbe0909&req=fSMhEMh8mohXFb4f3HP0gA36awxsHa74qG7gw0npfuMy6zD%2FqugJkuQlyCmX%0Aczb9ejvtP7%2FddodBPw%3D%3D%0A)

Search for the patient you're booking the schedule for.

Select the **Appointment type** and click **Book Schedule**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601960974/a605eef8cf14bb89ba779eda/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2dc286b87948d4a575221e2f6f8d9fec858ffad02e876af19d431207711c8a00&req=ciAmH89%2BlIZbFb4f3HP0gAGj%2F45HYM6kz8c8zbXyJB1cVkXD4bo4uVB%2BAp1V%0AkA5Qty0lBlieXxQXCQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601960974/a605eef8cf14bb89ba779eda/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2dc286b87948d4a575221e2f6f8d9fec858ffad02e876af19d431207711c8a00&req=ciAmH89%2BlIZbFb4f3HP0gAGj%2F45HYM6kz8c8zbXyJB1cVkXD4bo4uVB%2BAp1V%0AkA5Qty0lBlieXxQXCQ%3D%3D%0A)

The Scheduler Pane will appear.

Customise the **recurrence** settings appropriately.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/940998912/423a4700a43c0a99341b0f91/CleanShot+2024-01-23+at+16.18.31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=373f2b4f9cf8333fbd8e98482e9d5c7c0d002b587abb23857170003543f402f8&req=fSQnH8B2lIBdFb4f3HP0gK3PklwzZFHNfurUG3wb%2Bi%2BnUYWQvNi8%2FIxPLpqQ%0AQMfx1wMZkbE9rJk5tw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/940998912/423a4700a43c0a99341b0f91/CleanShot+2024-01-23+at+16.18.31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=373f2b4f9cf8333fbd8e98482e9d5c7c0d002b587abb23857170003543f402f8&req=fSQnH8B2lIBdFb4f3HP0gK3PklwzZFHNfurUG3wb%2Bi%2BnUYWQvNi8%2FIxPLpqQ%0AQMfx1wMZkbE9rJk5tw%3D%3D%0A)

The scheduler pane will be filled according to the recurrence settings.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/940999967/948eab0b14c4bcf5eb47938d/CleanShot+2024-01-23+at+16.21.06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=47cf6945f58fd9068f6651c32e94c5c43b0fdf3a7e5ae14f66051189b12f7f6c&req=fSQnH8B3lIdYFb4f3HP0gKSc3cKlU9NSEM8fs8JaMmYOvOoLLqxEMR5iGyxb%0ANCp4PAEonto3UrAZCw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/940999967/948eab0b14c4bcf5eb47938d/CleanShot+2024-01-23+at+16.21.06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=47cf6945f58fd9068f6651c32e94c5c43b0fdf3a7e5ae14f66051189b12f7f6c&req=fSQnH8B3lIdYFb4f3HP0gKSc3cKlU9NSEM8fs8JaMmYOvOoLLqxEMR5iGyxb%0ANCp4PAEonto3UrAZCw%3D%3D%0A)

You can modify any instances of the recurrence schedule as required.

You can also use the menu on the right-hand side to apply the preferences of a particular instance all appointments in the schedule, or to remove an instance.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/941000307/c3145279d49a76b51afae1bb/CleanShot+2024-01-23+at+16.21.47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8f79838e9f27c5765a4f835745e62e9afea398de422fc8e9bd9ed1887a5393ef&req=fSQmFsl%2BnoFYFb4f3HP0gE%2F%2FcqtQUyoDvgE2vItNj771EbjHehG7gq8Fn6G9%0ANxyRN0OoSy7eZkvXbw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/941000307/c3145279d49a76b51afae1bb/CleanShot+2024-01-23+at+16.21.47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8f79838e9f27c5765a4f835745e62e9afea398de422fc8e9bd9ed1887a5393ef&req=fSQmFsl%2BnoFYFb4f3HP0gE%2F%2FcqtQUyoDvgE2vItNj771EbjHehG7gq8Fn6G9%0ANxyRN0OoSy7eZkvXbw%3D%3D%0A)

When you've **Check & Reserve Times** to determine whether the times are available to accommodate the recurrence.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942049305/1b223934cac80b95e65fc020/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.09.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdb57307721839d47069b08744b2cafd30a8f40611e143c937182effd11024cf&req=fSQlFs13noFaFb4f3HP0gGdMGuB5p4xSD6MSJsgmROSSE0Wtwm6feMrZHUB%2B%0ARnuV2DrQtX1%2F7TcntQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942049305/1b223934cac80b95e65fc020/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.09.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdb57307721839d47069b08744b2cafd30a8f40611e143c937182effd11024cf&req=fSQlFs13noFaFb4f3HP0gGdMGuB5p4xSD6MSJsgmROSSE0Wtwm6feMrZHUB%2B%0ARnuV2DrQtX1%2F7TcntQ%3D%3D%0A)

If a conflict is detected and a recurrence instance is unable to be booked, you will see a red exclamation will be shown next to it. You can use the drop-down menu to select another time that is available on that date or choose to delete that instance of the recurrence.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601962274/76a587b8433ad6cb148b598b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=42dcf0d543f1bb0de101702c16182a37359d4e5a61daee71885d24773d6762bf&req=ciAmH898n4ZbFb4f3HP0gNkiImF6MyJeqPIFoq10RoNO4oR%2BhIP%2FJERNJvyj%0A%2BeeR90QXGFspF6dJgQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601962274/76a587b8433ad6cb148b598b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=42dcf0d543f1bb0de101702c16182a37359d4e5a61daee71885d24773d6762bf&req=ciAmH898n4ZbFb4f3HP0gNkiImF6MyJeqPIFoq10RoNO4oR%2BhIP%2FJERNJvyj%0A%2BeeR90QXGFspF6dJgQ%3D%3D%0A)

If adjustments have been made, select the **Check & Reserve Times** button again.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942049305/1b223934cac80b95e65fc020/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.09.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdb57307721839d47069b08744b2cafd30a8f40611e143c937182effd11024cf&req=fSQlFs13noFaFb4f3HP0gGdMGuB5p4xSD6MSJsgmROSSE0Wtwm6feMrZHUB%2B%0ARnuV2DrQtX1%2F7TcntQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942049305/1b223934cac80b95e65fc020/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.09.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdb57307721839d47069b08744b2cafd30a8f40611e143c937182effd11024cf&req=fSQlFs13noFaFb4f3HP0gGdMGuB5p4xSD6MSJsgmROSSE0Wtwm6feMrZHUB%2B%0ARnuV2DrQtX1%2F7TcntQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once any conflicts have been resolved, you'll be able to select **Book Schedule** to finalise the process. An option is also available in the dropdown to [Print and/or Email the patient their upcoming appointment schedule](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4646222-printing-and-emailing-an-appointment-schedule-for-a-patient)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601962372/64581554cbaf3cb50e87d154/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7556e39e2a809cfe33caf6c0c987f07b00d43485a7fc089890e2c81557bc1006&req=ciAmH898noZdFb4f3HP0gBNqxdQbZM4Uc81pepoqEm%2BFj8wq7xQYxKb2o3or%0AP4YfpvHUyxzB1HDuLg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601962372/64581554cbaf3cb50e87d154/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7556e39e2a809cfe33caf6c0c987f07b00d43485a7fc089890e2c81557bc1006&req=ciAmH898noZdFb4f3HP0gBNqxdQbZM4Uc81pepoqEm%2BFj8wq7xQYxKb2o3or%0AP4YfpvHUyxzB1HDuLg%3D%3D%0A)

Editing an Existing Appointment Schedule
========================================

Appointments in an existing schedule can be edited in bulk from the Appointment Book.

Select an appointment in the schedule from the Appointment Book and select **Appointment Details**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942045801/6d447956692a4bcb769097ee/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.00.34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f25d509df81d85967c2d1833577d0d6f5e900b8a48da3f8baddb76233070aa4c&req=fSQlFs17lYFeFb4f3HP0gIcqSueLzaukuAbkvQnUe3eXE5s%2FGaTjQToCoEdm%0AYalylrUN4Cmw9BAyfg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942045801/6d447956692a4bcb769097ee/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.00.34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f25d509df81d85967c2d1833577d0d6f5e900b8a48da3f8baddb76233070aa4c&req=fSQlFs17lYFeFb4f3HP0gIcqSueLzaukuAbkvQnUe3eXE5s%2FGaTjQToCoEdm%0AYalylrUN4Cmw9BAyfg%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Edit Schedule**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942045568/aadae355921cfd8b6f51ed51/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+12.59.59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=16c1256cabf576172248fb8684194188e259711b8c49f2e4335af5b41904c76d&req=fSQlFs17mIdXFb4f3HP0gE0vtbvIfZBe35Okmpcdu7EWKho3kSFtMgVInnbe%0AAP3DerK37PrE38YsHA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942045568/aadae355921cfd8b6f51ed51/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+12.59.59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=16c1256cabf576172248fb8684194188e259711b8c49f2e4335af5b41904c76d&req=fSQlFs17mIdXFb4f3HP0gE0vtbvIfZBe35Okmpcdu7EWKho3kSFtMgVInnbe%0AAP3DerK37PrE38YsHA%3D%3D%0A)

Only future appointments in the schedule will be displayed by default.

Make any changes to the appointment schedule as required and then select **Edit Schedule**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942046205/75c4950758180f3a37a92d3d/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.01.31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=684cf175835fa417cc079e7b1c9028797caff858e7380c5c65e898af6e0fbbf1&req=fSQlFs14n4FaFb4f3HP0gCTmFOoMYmIPO6xSrrcETIYQCQXV6sPjPUx88Eg%2B%0Al0LG45iyGbgIrKgx5w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942046205/75c4950758180f3a37a92d3d/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.01.31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=684cf175835fa417cc079e7b1c9028797caff858e7380c5c65e898af6e0fbbf1&req=fSQlFs14n4FaFb4f3HP0gCTmFOoMYmIPO6xSrrcETIYQCQXV6sPjPUx88Eg%2B%0Al0LG45iyGbgIrKgx5w%3D%3D%0A)

If no conflicts are detected, you will receive a confirmation that these appointments have been successfully edited.

Any conflicts will be highlighted and will need to be resolved.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942046720/83b54b35b956bcbca310fd1c/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.02.58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7ff80f923e00acbbaf525aa66e78ae807ad888ccccd980a27d76349bb386eaf8&req=fSQlFs14moNfFb4f3HP0gJRWbKRldYp3wvARkir%2Fgo8xzy0BQO4QRLO8kYVY%0AztpqN6NZ%2B4UMti4nKw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/942046720/83b54b35b956bcbca310fd1c/CleanShot+2024-01-24+at+13.02.58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7ff80f923e00acbbaf525aa66e78ae807ad888ccccd980a27d76349bb386eaf8&req=fSQlFs14moNfFb4f3HP0gJRWbKRldYp3wvARkir%2Fgo8xzy0BQO4QRLO8kYVY%0AztpqN6NZ%2B4UMti4nKw%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Edit Schedule** to finalise the process.

How to Delete an Invoice

How to Delete an Invoice
========================

Delete or Void an Invoice

Updated over 3 years ago

To delete an invoice, go to the **Patient File > Invoices tab > select Invoices**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595635525/b0f896cfe59f68bfbb750a3a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e96aa51ce28758b6a2cad0227b34a83b7eded1d5a116531d8620a887796c3139&req=cSkiEMp7mINaFb4f3HP0gHaKYmn2BhtTif069Q6eiLRsiRQRj5U%2BGRXSpadT%0AMRofr4qenldE23ustw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595635525/b0f896cfe59f68bfbb750a3a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e96aa51ce28758b6a2cad0227b34a83b7eded1d5a116531d8620a887796c3139&req=cSkiEMp7mINaFb4f3HP0gHaKYmn2BhtTif069Q6eiLRsiRQRj5U%2BGRXSpadT%0AMRofr4qenldE23ustw%3D%3D%0A)

Select the Invoice, by selecting the tickbox to the left of the invoice number.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595635743/229fb82342b5a2b60d9921a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80fae149711f1fa48929762ceaad2db5a1caeca9743159cacd10cd20fce5edd2&req=cSkiEMp7moVcFb4f3HP0gLN5fUOFqEh9EbrTGn34XkigSrz2676ThvC5dINV%0AFpNmAqOwlem5uYPPqQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595635743/229fb82342b5a2b60d9921a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80fae149711f1fa48929762ceaad2db5a1caeca9743159cacd10cd20fce5edd2&req=cSkiEMp7moVcFb4f3HP0gLN5fUOFqEh9EbrTGn34XkigSrz2676ThvC5dINV%0AFpNmAqOwlem5uYPPqQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Delete**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595635861/1de6b9ba671e908199b0ac8d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=942f78e476796bfad13d03b95d8b4a18e2e79ad64d748702425141a8354723d4&req=cSkiEMp7lYdeFb4f3HP0gO4xVnHXZ2amaUXhX8l4fxkSCxbLh3f7%2B5wVGuak%0AHzGacEwEqKzqjuluHg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595635861/1de6b9ba671e908199b0ac8d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=942f78e476796bfad13d03b95d8b4a18e2e79ad64d748702425141a8354723d4&req=cSkiEMp7lYdeFb4f3HP0gO4xVnHXZ2amaUXhX8l4fxkSCxbLh3f7%2B5wVGuak%0AHzGacEwEqKzqjuluHg%3D%3D%0A)

The next screen will ask you to confirm by typing **Delete** and by giving a reason.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595636541/f889126bb75ae68d0751b606/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=889ac1eefc360a81adb3cf39c7d64882b81ede573627d19b95245f224f015726&req=cSkiEMp4mIVeFb4f3HP0gAObkMTeerKu7i07h0BhXuoKXd3QY83eoRoFIc1n%0AkcFN%2Beg2v7pIcKkbAA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595636541/f889126bb75ae68d0751b606/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=889ac1eefc360a81adb3cf39c7d64882b81ede573627d19b95245f224f015726&req=cSkiEMp4mIVeFb4f3HP0gAObkMTeerKu7i07h0BhXuoKXd3QY83eoRoFIc1n%0AkcFN%2Beg2v7pIcKkbAA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Next**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595636625/88e496a7ca38b27372354369/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8a3015ecf17ed8772a780a4f38165a5d6bfaeaa2b17db58f8552871aeab35411&req=cSkiEMp4m4NaFb4f3HP0gC4iGozD4091olAA82OonqDUITS%2FYoBeEGfTLfsY%0AxxLhwyb%2BAjoWgipQvw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595636625/88e496a7ca38b27372354369/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8a3015ecf17ed8772a780a4f38165a5d6bfaeaa2b17db58f8552871aeab35411&req=cSkiEMp4m4NaFb4f3HP0gC4iGozD4091olAA82OonqDUITS%2FYoBeEGfTLfsY%0AxxLhwyb%2BAjoWgipQvw%3D%3D%0A)

If the invoice has a payment allocated against it, select if you would like to either **Make Payment Unallocated** (a credit) or **Delete Payment**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595637302/e8694c62dea982890c27869e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d2f0b5ffa6469a7ad170d9019f92242fd496283ac3565342e4bbf02d9e40800&req=cSkiEMp5noFdFb4f3HP0gJLPaTFOvF3XEPIba%2FQPdeiAWOUjbZLZ7hpJ28RK%0AXPvoJaMJIxJIl2LeGQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595637302/e8694c62dea982890c27869e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d2f0b5ffa6469a7ad170d9019f92242fd496283ac3565342e4bbf02d9e40800&req=cSkiEMp5noFdFb4f3HP0gJLPaTFOvF3XEPIba%2FQPdeiAWOUjbZLZ7hpJ28RK%0AXPvoJaMJIxJIl2LeGQ%3D%3D%0A)

Or if one or more payments are associated with multiple items they can only be **Unallocated**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595637418/ec5b21894dd29cf288931206/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=da98f4777b88f1fd7de21e54dbdba13074ecf965fc72f99484d504592cca20a4&req=cSkiEMp5mYBXFb4f3HP0gBH474mgCOe06SexJrBVSkygVJ0EzaravLn5ekhv%0APo8KlpviSkTYMqzFwA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595637418/ec5b21894dd29cf288931206/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=da98f4777b88f1fd7de21e54dbdba13074ecf965fc72f99484d504592cca20a4&req=cSkiEMp5mYBXFb4f3HP0gBH474mgCOe06SexJrBVSkygVJ0EzaravLn5ekhv%0APo8KlpviSkTYMqzFwA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Delete** to confirm.

Using Appointment Resources

Using Appointment Resources
===========================

Creating a Resource

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Creating a Resource](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059413-using-appointment-resources#h_359a21c0a6)

[Allocating a Resource to an Appointment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059413-using-appointment-resources#h_5f1f57f012)

[Choosing Default Resources per Appointment Type](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059413-using-appointment-resources#h_fa7275abea)

Resources can be allocated to an appointment to reserve a room or piece of equipment, and to prevent double-bookings. For example, resources at a podiatry clinic would be a laser machine or 3D scanner.

Creating a Resource
===================

To create a resource, Go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Resources](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/resources)
.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595649543/8cae746ee749d6bc6740583f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dcd59cf1ca9f11b94afda89aad72ef97c4b64f1749f4592a7ab3a4d9fdd44dda&req=cSkiEM13mIVcFb4f3HP0gOntPlfvkebr3iFLOEUe55pawmL%2FDZnXjLW9FIp4%0AXR%2F24ft7eKEqdQCTNw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595649543/8cae746ee749d6bc6740583f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dcd59cf1ca9f11b94afda89aad72ef97c4b64f1749f4592a7ab3a4d9fdd44dda&req=cSkiEM13mIVcFb4f3HP0gOntPlfvkebr3iFLOEUe55pawmL%2FDZnXjLW9FIp4%0AXR%2F24ft7eKEqdQCTNw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595649855/0ab73522feada4816811d034/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3206f70974736c681b97651cfbf9d9d3832e5b94a31c0d530e949e562a4331f3&req=cSkiEM13lYRaFb4f3HP0gMCz5nGbrtqmNaO9i1qYZpWeMlFIYYrjswakFakk%0AtncgUicvLvKyWqCfMA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595649855/0ab73522feada4816811d034/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3206f70974736c681b97651cfbf9d9d3832e5b94a31c0d530e949e562a4331f3&req=cSkiEM13lYRaFb4f3HP0gMCz5nGbrtqmNaO9i1qYZpWeMlFIYYrjswakFakk%0AtncgUicvLvKyWqCfMA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595650025/105fc65a81a23eb469da0af1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85e3481de21784925b1355e51911d025f688a64f77a9df4c40d6230444176fb5&req=cSkiEMx%2BnYNaFb4f3HP0gBj%2BaraVSZrxPbwCR6y7hinVGozRjLy1DUp4B3o8%0AHmTYgnHuu6qmUvQMuw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595650025/105fc65a81a23eb469da0af1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85e3481de21784925b1355e51911d025f688a64f77a9df4c40d6230444176fb5&req=cSkiEMx%2BnYNaFb4f3HP0gBj%2BaraVSZrxPbwCR6y7hinVGozRjLy1DUp4B3o8%0AHmTYgnHuu6qmUvQMuw%3D%3D%0A)

A new line will appear, enter the Name and select one or more businesses that will have use of the resource.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595650292/3b62c7c3be02d7e527efc03f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8abb16dead4a8dfc603f4ec67c4dd96c868b86eb948e98e066b3aeb347540189&req=cSkiEMx%2Bn4hdFb4f3HP0gNVzoASSFVcbCo%2FbP1r%2BCXnQVfzmOnFODZPPNgRl%0AKSAVuuZuedJE6yraoQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595650292/3b62c7c3be02d7e527efc03f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8abb16dead4a8dfc603f4ec67c4dd96c868b86eb948e98e066b3aeb347540189&req=cSkiEMx%2Bn4hdFb4f3HP0gNVzoASSFVcbCo%2FbP1r%2BCXnQVfzmOnFODZPPNgRl%0AKSAVuuZuedJE6yraoQ%3D%3D%0A)

By clicking **Access**, you can choose which practitioner has access to the resource.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595650630/9ad089c5827b3966ee3d2037/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d4936b79ac35911fef8eaa5b13dc52b5af9a48412043c8e487a9a4e68676b076&req=cSkiEMx%2Bm4JfFb4f3HP0gOsVK9OK5yXFQYnEbpDsX8Qy2Yo7jd2ZQuNjPTCy%0A4g3HJBTUQS1A1NggxA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595650630/9ad089c5827b3966ee3d2037/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d4936b79ac35911fef8eaa5b13dc52b5af9a48412043c8e487a9a4e68676b076&req=cSkiEMx%2Bm4JfFb4f3HP0gOsVK9OK5yXFQYnEbpDsX8Qy2Yo7jd2ZQuNjPTCy%0A4g3HJBTUQS1A1NggxA%3D%3D%0A)

Choose the practitioners who need access to the resource and click **Save** to confirm the changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595651027/0d82bed510a6eb1f02bf1f50/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d79eb215ceae5e90c4e3686c62c5da5fecf9d8ff376df0b9b208109cc8862495&req=cSkiEMx%2FnYNYFb4f3HP0gDdqaWBgf3FVHcPTDtoRkZxit77Yom9VLJhfATT9%0AezY9YHtgmdtLPGgX7A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595651027/0d82bed510a6eb1f02bf1f50/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d79eb215ceae5e90c4e3686c62c5da5fecf9d8ff376df0b9b208109cc8862495&req=cSkiEMx%2FnYNYFb4f3HP0gDdqaWBgf3FVHcPTDtoRkZxit77Yom9VLJhfATT9%0AezY9YHtgmdtLPGgX7A%3D%3D%0A)

Allocating a Resource to an Appointment
=======================================

To add a resource to an appointment, select the Appointment and then select Appointment Details.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595637874/003a95988a3c0af9c19b5e94/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aa175981d56a1b02a10c686f057c6f0e51b5a34a95769d354c22587009397954&req=cSkiEMp5lYZbFb4f3HP0gCVLy0x9KwKjC%2BYUXNh4EnbcGflgcxANd06A4HTD%0AMQ6TDUPBAU5bqrzwog%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595637874/003a95988a3c0af9c19b5e94/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aa175981d56a1b02a10c686f057c6f0e51b5a34a95769d354c22587009397954&req=cSkiEMp5lYZbFb4f3HP0gCVLy0x9KwKjC%2BYUXNh4EnbcGflgcxANd06A4HTD%0AMQ6TDUPBAU5bqrzwog%3D%3D%0A)

Under **Resources** a drop down menu will appear.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595638133/ce5f610b34d0a2dfd71faa58/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aa66316e9009a1f5af6be8aa967c7f5757056be6b0f577135a9e82a02bd070de&req=cSkiEMp2nIJcFb4f3HP0gMdH%2FIFbA0XCf41vEV6pPSh8P3T42rOJSn8fARcw%0A8ofCcrnsFbvN7qHBEA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595638133/ce5f610b34d0a2dfd71faa58/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aa66316e9009a1f5af6be8aa967c7f5757056be6b0f577135a9e82a02bd070de&req=cSkiEMp2nIJcFb4f3HP0gMdH%2FIFbA0XCf41vEV6pPSh8P3T42rOJSn8fARcw%0A8ofCcrnsFbvN7qHBEA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the resource you want to add and select **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595638387/f237f8d43c2c12c180a5101e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=18c1234ea9ad744601e507fcddaf96e05864bb86ec2deafc20bde29df1435132&req=cSkiEMp2nolYFb4f3HP0gK1NF4klWmrIUZ%2FbqbO4MnvT4yt%2FCFrDMvvY5G24%0AKkHpUiyAUWJzLGIKrg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595638387/f237f8d43c2c12c180a5101e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=18c1234ea9ad744601e507fcddaf96e05864bb86ec2deafc20bde29df1435132&req=cSkiEMp2nolYFb4f3HP0gK1NF4klWmrIUZ%2FbqbO4MnvT4yt%2FCFrDMvvY5G24%0AKkHpUiyAUWJzLGIKrg%3D%3D%0A)

By allocating this resource to an appointment, it will not be possible to assign the resource to another appointment at the same time.

Choosing Default Resources per Appointment Type
===============================================

If a resource should always be allocated to a specific [Appointment Type](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types#h_2268b861f5)
, you can set the resource as a **Default Resource**. Any time that Appointment Type is booked, it will attempt to reserve the resource.

This feature also works with the Waiting List and Online Booking system so that times for an appointment are only displayed when the resource is available and not already booked.

You can learn more about Appointment Type Details [by clicking here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types#h_2268b861f5)

## Document 158 — How to Send an SMS to Patients in Bulk | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-158}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059680-how-to-send-an-sms-to-patients-in-bulk](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059680-how-to-send-an-sms-to-patients-in-bulk)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059680-how-to-send-an-sms-to-patients-in-bulk#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[SMS, Email & Letters](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2491723-sms-email-letters)

[Marketing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3252010-marketing)

How to Send an SMS to Patients in Bulk

How to Send an SMS to Patients in Bulk
======================================

Updated over 3 years ago

SMS messages can be sent to patients in bulk via several reports in PracSuite. For example, this could be for recall notices, to send a broadcast to all patients (e.g. COVID information) or to message new patients thanking them for their visit a week after their appointment.

The following reports currently support sending SMS in bulk:

*   Activity
    
*   Appointment
    
*   Day List
    
*   Future Appointments
    
*   Waiting List
    
*   Active / Inactive Patients
    
*   Birthdays
    
*   Messages
    
*   Client List
    
*   Recalls
    
*   Tasks
    

Once you've applied your chosen filters and generated a report, select the **Send Message** button and select **SMS** to target patients displayed in the Results grid.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595651895/6dd65ba933ee4431498091cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d949d9d48b99ff1a4c2c45aa3476c16cdccfa1d22b25d63b82329e11939e60e&req=cSkiEMx%2FlYhaFb4f3HP0gPgRHL%2BfhhaNC94%2FALgHy4EAnZ1%2BVZF7JDxfgy7E%0As6BudW4PAoyucvVKxQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595651895/6dd65ba933ee4431498091cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d949d9d48b99ff1a4c2c45aa3476c16cdccfa1d22b25d63b82329e11939e60e&req=cSkiEMx%2FlYhaFb4f3HP0gPgRHL%2BfhhaNC94%2FALgHy4EAnZ1%2BVZF7JDxfgy7E%0As6BudW4PAoyucvVKxQ%3D%3D%0A)

The Send Bulk SMS window will appear detailing how many total patients with mobile numbers from the report results will be targeted. You can manage who will receive the bulk SMS using the **Edit Recipients** button. Patients that have an SMS [marketing status](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927850-marketing-statuses)
 of soft opt-out or opt-out will be filtered out by default.

You can either compose a message ad-hoc or insert an [existing template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317983-creating-sms-templates)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595652336/f0080bed1679d766012eab59/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9a7c03ee27fd650d6b9d2a05fa393609a42692639e3797806dec31f98de99c5&req=cSkiEMx8noJZFb4f3HP0gC1Bxz%2F6Ck0H66NJZO7hPJ%2FDBK4KDU5fLKMZkBJ8%0ADLHQExfHN1Kd7NJhqQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595652336/f0080bed1679d766012eab59/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9a7c03ee27fd650d6b9d2a05fa393609a42692639e3797806dec31f98de99c5&req=cSkiEMx8noJZFb4f3HP0gC1Bxz%2F6Ck0H66NJZO7hPJ%2FDBK4KDU5fLKMZkBJ8%0ADLHQExfHN1Kd7NJhqQ%3D%3D%0A)

After composing your message and editing recipients (if required), select **Next** to proceed to the final step.

You can choose to **Send Now** or **Schedule Send**, which allows your message to be sent at a later time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595652592/ccca6c0447a135f8b37fc218/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8ca470fd449851f5cf8604ce34d858cccf78ef9ba40dc0e7b91dced599a7273a&req=cSkiEMx8mIhdFb4f3HP0gAwUuP4Jo28%2B8O2Gf%2FILi9F2gTG0bBZzxYZXKPfo%0AG%2BpQVph3g%2BY%2FK8CApg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595652592/ccca6c0447a135f8b37fc218/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8ca470fd449851f5cf8604ce34d858cccf78ef9ba40dc0e7b91dced599a7273a&req=cSkiEMx8mIhdFb4f3HP0gAwUuP4Jo28%2B8O2Gf%2FILi9F2gTG0bBZzxYZXKPfo%0AG%2BpQVph3g%2BY%2FK8CApg%3D%3D%0A)

Scheduled SMS can be cancelled or rescheduled via the **[Tools > SMS > Scheduled SMS](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/scheduledsms)
** [page](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/scheduledsms)
.

## Document 159 — Appointment Book Day Notes & Reminders | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-159}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059691-appointment-book-day-notes-reminders](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059691-appointment-book-day-notes-reminders)

[Appointment Book Basics](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2992886-appointment-book-basics)

Appointment Book Day Notes & Reminders

Appointment Book Day Notes & Reminders
======================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Appointment Book Day Notes & Reminders allow you to store text-based information for your team on the left-hand side of the appointment book.

*   **Day Notes** are specific to each day
    
*   **Reminders** are displayed regardless of what day is selected
    

To access Day Notes & Reminders, select the **Note icon** in the bottom left of the Appointment Book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313591585/bd9554b9f688dee1dffee033/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e1621d73ac13992babc617d371f927a63d3dc07d3a6662549feaa366270257c&req=dyEkE8B%2FmIlaFb4f3HP0gMw1c7rapuXnWaiSL%2BK%2FnmRNxaxqoiGa9hoj5ct6%0A%2B2wgmNuU82ofX73Uxw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313591585/bd9554b9f688dee1dffee033/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e1621d73ac13992babc617d371f927a63d3dc07d3a6662549feaa366270257c&req=dyEkE8B%2FmIlaFb4f3HP0gMw1c7rapuXnWaiSL%2BK%2FnmRNxaxqoiGa9hoj5ct6%0A%2B2wgmNuU82ofX73Uxw%3D%3D%0A)

To edit Day Note or Reminders, click into each field and add or edit the text as required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313591661/8dd812e2b2f1785dd2be23a7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b054b1e733eece43666acedf1d0ac3ab886047d6954ea95ba0a9ebe2333833b2&req=dyEkE8B%2Fm4deFb4f3HP0gLCWw1FoSb%2FnBsEPUl4l0bbRr3FhXW0aJ2n5J5sy%0A3GENwXcGW3dGachr7Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313591661/8dd812e2b2f1785dd2be23a7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b054b1e733eece43666acedf1d0ac3ab886047d6954ea95ba0a9ebe2333833b2&req=dyEkE8B%2Fm4deFb4f3HP0gLCWw1FoSb%2FnBsEPUl4l0bbRr3FhXW0aJ2n5J5sy%0A3GENwXcGW3dGachr7Q%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

In a multi-business environment, these fields can be managed per business, with a shared All Businesses option also available.

Use the drop-down list above Day Notes to view Day Notes and Reminders for a particular business.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313593030/b7d190a95f58b5d567199df1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8dd9df94c0b094c95c4ab0c2c1205e9363656eef5415b826cbca4d11e8ea55ba&req=dyEkE8B9nYJfFb4f3HP0gAPEIigbtXc4T%2FfdteBtqD49z%2FJjHKfUgcPqApZD%0A06PoOH3muGzNFoqdAg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313593030/b7d190a95f58b5d567199df1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8dd9df94c0b094c95c4ab0c2c1205e9363656eef5415b826cbca4d11e8ea55ba&req=dyEkE8B9nYJfFb4f3HP0gAPEIigbtXc4T%2FfdteBtqD49z%2FJjHKfUgcPqApZD%0A06PoOH3muGzNFoqdAg%3D%3D%0A)

The Day Notes & Reminders displayed can change based on the Business selected in the top right of the Appointment Book, or can stay as the last selected Business on above the Day Notes field.

To set your preference, select the settings cog in the bottom left of the Appointment Book and choose your Day Notes Default Business preference.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313592690/e2741b226a7031c989ac469c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cde9b10fcf5796655f7bd1d2352af82c09c3e627bb6c3a3bf4da1d9c7858dd49&req=dyEkE8B8m4hfFb4f3HP0gGe23AaXJLiGSFntp0L5wqaSdkWjxKpHTvVJP%2F4j%0AAPiaZXhKNMKpRIsP7g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313592690/e2741b226a7031c989ac469c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cde9b10fcf5796655f7bd1d2352af82c09c3e627bb6c3a3bf4da1d9c7858dd49&req=dyEkE8B8m4hfFb4f3HP0gGe23AaXJLiGSFntp0L5wqaSdkWjxKpHTvVJP%2F4j%0AAPiaZXhKNMKpRIsP7g%3D%3D%0A)

When a user attempts to save Day Notes or Reminders that have since been edited by another user, a prompt will appear asking whether to proceed with overwriting the last saved changes or to cancel the attempt to save changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313600631/0b6c122def143ba12142c66c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=869e0e97501e6bdd30fc15cacf2ddd2a0b089f8e12fb86c19a3f34f790a97bed&req=dyEkEMl%2Bm4JeFb4f3HP0gDyRXHZ09HzQUCRAnqLInxFKD1D7yTJCStOIMClo%0AHi9ol7J432BC5zyRQg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/313600631/0b6c122def143ba12142c66c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=869e0e97501e6bdd30fc15cacf2ddd2a0b089f8e12fb86c19a3f34f790a97bed&req=dyEkEMl%2Bm4JeFb4f3HP0gDyRXHZ09HzQUCRAnqLInxFKD1D7yTJCStOIMClo%0AHi9ol7J432BC5zyRQg%3D%3D%0A)

How to Send an Email to Patients in Bulk

How to Send an Email to Patients in Bulk
========================================

Sending a once off email campaign to patients

Updated over 2 weeks ago

Table of contents

[Creating a Once-Off Campaign](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059765-how-to-send-an-email-to-patients-in-bulk#h_74f8f0732b)

[Campaign Name](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059765-how-to-send-an-email-to-patients-in-bulk#h_4eb788616f)

[Open and Click Tracking](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059765-how-to-send-an-email-to-patients-in-bulk#h_7d33a0da87)

[Editing Recipients](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059765-how-to-send-an-email-to-patients-in-bulk#h_41c92096ba)

Email messages can be sent to patients in bulk from most reports in PracSuite. Bulk email broadcasts from reports are also referred to as **Once-Off Campaigns**.

Common examples of reports that are used to send bulk emails include:

*   **Patient List Report** - Emailing all patients with updates regarding the practice, such as a practice newsletter
    
*   **Recalls Report** - Emailing all patients who a due to be sent a recall notice
    
*   **Appointments Report** - Emailing all patients that have a specific type of appointment in a date range
    
*   **Treatment Plan Report** - Emailing patients whose treatment plans are due to expire
    

Creating a Once-Off Campaign
============================

Start with selecting the report to find patients that you wish to send a bulk email to from the Reports menu at the top of PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011052111/32de8816ea49bf0b7113b463/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_18_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6baffbe8bccdeaf3e8a35a4ed671bc1170cc1aa5de3b2485f72efaa2777d8070&req=dSAmF8l7n4BeWPMW1HO4zTq41E3pOkZX7nRiL3i6BgUMcT7kTulWdGd9CjyD%0AtNh2HVLj7MlPznA7ijs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011052111/32de8816ea49bf0b7113b463/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_18_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6baffbe8bccdeaf3e8a35a4ed671bc1170cc1aa5de3b2485f72efaa2777d8070&req=dSAmF8l7n4BeWPMW1HO4zTq41E3pOkZX7nRiL3i6BgUMcT7kTulWdGd9CjyD%0AtNh2HVLj7MlPznA7ijs%3D%0A)

Applied your desired filters and select **Generated Report**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011052506/b22594d16d58e064ca1c0aec/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_19_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b624365a74714b33628f0b0596109e4c41447933fa144337eb43f0b1f38c0fc&req=dSAmF8l7n4RfX%2FMW1HO4zUP5X6Cq0tBwIfMMSEWfuD5Vhbp%2B%2BcZpjRtJYaxd%0A4tAZ3naSZVE%2B5spAkFU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011052506/b22594d16d58e064ca1c0aec/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_19_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b624365a74714b33628f0b0596109e4c41447933fa144337eb43f0b1f38c0fc&req=dSAmF8l7n4RfX%2FMW1HO4zUP5X6Cq0tBwIfMMSEWfuD5Vhbp%2B%2BcZpjRtJYaxd%0A4tAZ3naSZVE%2B5spAkFU%3D%0A)

Above the results grid, you will find a **Send Message** button, which allows you to send a bulk email (or SMS).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595670623/9940dbaf7ac7e59c9f3f741d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5870de1cee7d2376d6f6430e8a8ad90c01bd4b217c9db0df1cdd3c4b65382037&req=cSkiEM5%2Bm4NcFb4f3HP0gCJ546bGyr7duHXsGY4X7l9GkMluzzL02QhbDwNe%0AszOddy%2Fc3LzylfIVgg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595670623/9940dbaf7ac7e59c9f3f741d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5870de1cee7d2376d6f6430e8a8ad90c01bd4b217c9db0df1cdd3c4b65382037&req=cSkiEM5%2Bm4NcFb4f3HP0gCJ546bGyr7duHXsGY4X7l9GkMluzzL02QhbDwNe%0AszOddy%2Fc3LzylfIVgg%3D%3D%0A)

The Send Bulk Email window will appear to begin customising the Once-Off Campaign.

Selecting the From Email Address
--------------------------------

The **Send From** drop-down allows you to select which email address you want to send the email from, which will also be where patient replies are directed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595671642/97b4a1e68b3e9b195a6e1fa9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ad8da5228890ae0a386215db06a42d1ddfd36c0b8054685347478c8f52c0a3a&req=cSkiEM5%2Fm4VdFb4f3HP0gNQ6agvgAVuw%2FhlyOJY4%2FtplVo825VCF3lglDdYr%0AB0RsCeXk%2Fq7iLUQRsA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595671642/97b4a1e68b3e9b195a6e1fa9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ad8da5228890ae0a386215db06a42d1ddfd36c0b8054685347478c8f52c0a3a&req=cSkiEM5%2Fm4VdFb4f3HP0gNQ6agvgAVuw%2FhlyOJY4%2FtplVo825VCF3lglDdYr%0AB0RsCeXk%2Fq7iLUQRsA%3D%3D%0A)

Campaign Name
-------------

Enter a name into the Once-Off Campaign Name field to make finding the Campaign easier.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2033258747/0acefd9d628ce0ad32d5f687def4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7b3b68397e7ae3445635faa04b7a285a352590d9dd63161a87f4ae36a58692f&req=diAkFct7lYZbXvMW1HO4zZUZ%2FCVJYyInYkb6eT2tq4ZDdaP1E9DUBi9elzYS%0A5W%2B2MuNxA4J7vGUqbZo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2033258747/0acefd9d628ce0ad32d5f687def4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7b3b68397e7ae3445635faa04b7a285a352590d9dd63161a87f4ae36a58692f&req=diAkFct7lYZbXvMW1HO4zZUZ%2FCVJYyInYkb6eT2tq4ZDdaP1E9DUBi9elzYS%0A5W%2B2MuNxA4J7vGUqbZo%3D%0A)

Note: A Campaign Name is required. If the Send button doesn't enable, it is likely that a name hasn't been entered.

Open and Click Tracking
-----------------------

All Once-Off Campaigns are displayed in Reports > Campaigns so that you can track the performance of the campaign.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011063255/fad6cbc8cb39bbe63c4c92a0/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_36_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f6842f99a0dcf203fe5d2a627ac1e78b3c1f4df74e51073a80006d5e06cc2a50&req=dSAmF8l4noNaXPMW1HO4zWawmjuMXIKPV%2BeaqcELRJF606dWW5waonkaX0Xr%0A5V55GlV4rJCGmTpLe1Y%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011063255/fad6cbc8cb39bbe63c4c92a0/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_36_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f6842f99a0dcf203fe5d2a627ac1e78b3c1f4df74e51073a80006d5e06cc2a50&req=dSAmF8l4noNaXPMW1HO4zWawmjuMXIKPV%2BeaqcELRJF606dWW5waonkaX0Xr%0A5V55GlV4rJCGmTpLe1Y%3D%0A)

Open & Click Tracking is available to provide insight into how many recipients opened the email and how many clicked on links within the email. [Click here to learn more about Campaign Tracking.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6591245-creating-email-sms-campaigns)

Open & Click Tracking is only available when using the [Send via PracSuite email method](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6150780-understanding-how-emails-are-sent-through-pracsuite)
.

If you select an Outlook or Gmail email as the 'from address' and enable Open & Click Tracking, your email will be Sent via PracSuite. The email will still be sent with the same email address and sender name. [Click here to learn more about this.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6150780-understanding-how-emails-are-sent-through-pracsuite)

Editing Recipients
------------------

The **Send To** section details how many total patients in the report results have email addresses. Patients that have an email [marketing status](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927850-marketing-statuses)
 of soft opt-out or opt-out will be filtered out by default.

If required, you can use the **Edit Recipients** button to further customise the recipients of the message.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011054888/6ccb75764e937659a2af56a6/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_23_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c47eec0daa12d2d2f7bce8dc191828230049a5873830b948f9cfa00de58c22b9&req=dSAmF8l7mYlXUfMW1HO4zUVHRzA9IjG8s6esMYW04tiWeQqdWmibjga9wP7L%0Ac8bVfJZKSgMuhxHsbRs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011054888/6ccb75764e937659a2af56a6/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_23_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c47eec0daa12d2d2f7bce8dc191828230049a5873830b948f9cfa00de58c22b9&req=dSAmF8l7mYlXUfMW1HO4zUVHRzA9IjG8s6esMYW04tiWeQqdWmibjga9wP7L%0Ac8bVfJZKSgMuhxHsbRs%3D%0A)

Editing the Email Message Content
---------------------------------

The content for your message can be customised in the Message section. Select the Use Template button to insert an existing template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011056121/9159394d53704729b5a72683/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_25_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b34e8ff75ee9fbb573120ad704214b895d597b3ee94930ad4ee6fdbe2684c2ee&req=dSAmF8l7m4BdWPMW1HO4zZ2uhxhKcfEaafGxr5Sc7gN9P4QW2OqsWgwIY4SW%0AP6GrNDnRt02ewRjqwaQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011056121/9159394d53704729b5a72683/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+08_25_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b34e8ff75ee9fbb573120ad704214b895d597b3ee94930ad4ee6fdbe2684c2ee&req=dSAmF8l7m4BdWPMW1HO4zZ2uhxhKcfEaafGxr5Sc7gN9P4QW2OqsWgwIY4SW%0AP6GrNDnRt02ewRjqwaQ%3D%0A)

You can either compose an ad-hoc message or insert an [existing email template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317970-creating-email-templates)
.

Unsubscribe Links
-----------------

When sending bulk emails via reports, unsubscribe links must be included in the message. If you have a preferred place to display the unsubscribe link in your email message, you can manually add the <<EmailUnsubscribe>> merge field.

As this merge field is mandatory for emails sent in bulk from any reports, if it is not manually added to your email template, it will automatically be added to the bottom of your message.

Previewing and Sending the Message
----------------------------------

After reviewing the Once-Off Campaign settings and the message content, select **Next** to proceed to the final step where a Preview of your message will be shown.

You can choose to **Send Now** or **Schedule Send**, which allows your message to be sent at a later time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595673012/a8a1ef13c5a4e2a32d89935f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85414cb9407fc81d4e8ab60e20edcff15992de65cbc923892e064062b7acd7a4&req=cSkiEM59nYBdFb4f3HP0gLyqhAP5uH8%2Fdu27mz5U7swko6FegNFVcFYCNj%2BJ%0AnTqHAJ7BJrVk2GrHfw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595673012/a8a1ef13c5a4e2a32d89935f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85414cb9407fc81d4e8ab60e20edcff15992de65cbc923892e064062b7acd7a4&req=cSkiEM59nYBdFb4f3HP0gLyqhAP5uH8%2Fdu27mz5U7swko6FegNFVcFYCNj%2BJ%0AnTqHAJ7BJrVk2GrHfw%3D%3D%0A)

Editing a Scheduled Once-Off Campaign
=====================================

If you have chosen to schedule your message to be sent at a later time, you will be able to edit the message content and the time it's due to be sent from [Reports > Campaigns](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/campaigns)
.

Scroll to the Once-Off Campaigns grid and select your campaign.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011084735/42b34508573e5a9e03160485/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+09_16_48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb9fadeb80eaffd82b65dfa53726f37eff66bd48936a567bbb95f36273b9079f&req=dSAmF8l2mYZcXPMW1HO4zUhN9dcdsn3ekD7dy0QyISrrDyJh95SIBrj%2BYUXL%0ALHEXrH8%2BOHljS7risYs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011084735/42b34508573e5a9e03160485/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+09_16_48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb9fadeb80eaffd82b65dfa53726f37eff66bd48936a567bbb95f36273b9079f&req=dSAmF8l2mYZcXPMW1HO4zUhN9dcdsn3ekD7dy0QyISrrDyJh95SIBrj%2BYUXL%0ALHEXrH8%2BOHljS7risYs%3D%0A)

After selecting your campaign, select **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012233202/eab73517d3e216af91e1acf3/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+08_23_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ec354ca7446813a11148ed0761de09edf1eb8e8ee7ec02d399081f9a15740f57&req=dSAmFMt9noNfW%2FMW1HO4zQGc9mmldnK8UrjNoP%2Bzd9iYffSpL5vlhw8ErQ4X%0ANg1%2FQEpztVrwGG%2FFbjU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012233202/eab73517d3e216af91e1acf3/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+08_23_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ec354ca7446813a11148ed0761de09edf1eb8e8ee7ec02d399081f9a15740f57&req=dSAmFMt9noNfW%2FMW1HO4zQGc9mmldnK8UrjNoP%2Bzd9iYffSpL5vlhw8ErQ4X%0ANg1%2FQEpztVrwGG%2FFbjU%3D%0A)

Here, you can edit your message template as desired and the time the message is scheduled to be sent.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012233540/b34e3d9cec1cf23969ded436/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+08_24_12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ccb8329344a66ef730dfa05b2bae48a66a154c0c5fc9d1d2cd80d1e92bf8fa4&req=dSAmFMt9noRbWfMW1HO4zQPoab4dgjdbXp5FCVJxBp8JDVUH%2BM0PkdIOF%2B6F%0A%2FE8HgjJm3au%2FILt1ms4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012233540/b34e3d9cec1cf23969ded436/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+08_24_12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ccb8329344a66ef730dfa05b2bae48a66a154c0c5fc9d1d2cd80d1e92bf8fa4&req=dSAmFMt9noRbWfMW1HO4zQPoab4dgjdbXp5FCVJxBp8JDVUH%2BM0PkdIOF%2B6F%0A%2FE8HgjJm3au%2FILt1ms4%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Viewing Once-Off Campaign Statistics
====================================

Statistics for your Campaign can be viewed in [Reports > Campaigns](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/campaigns)
.

Scroll to the Once-Off Campaigns grid and select your campaign.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011084735/42b34508573e5a9e03160485/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+09_16_48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb9fadeb80eaffd82b65dfa53726f37eff66bd48936a567bbb95f36273b9079f&req=dSAmF8l2mYZcXPMW1HO4zUhN9dcdsn3ekD7dy0QyISrrDyJh95SIBrj%2BYUXL%0ALHEXrH8%2BOHljS7risYs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011084735/42b34508573e5a9e03160485/CleanShot+2024-04-04+at+09_16_48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb9fadeb80eaffd82b65dfa53726f37eff66bd48936a567bbb95f36273b9079f&req=dSAmF8l2mYZcXPMW1HO4zUhN9dcdsn3ekD7dy0QyISrrDyJh95SIBrj%2BYUXL%0ALHEXrH8%2BOHljS7risYs%3D%0A)

You will be able to see a history of the patients that the message was sent to, which of those patients opened or clicked links in the email, and which patients the email failed to send to.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012236367/f9f92f5faa8305c45485a71a/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+08_29_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5b855ca5906e7b968b287379728e5b5b7027a88d73e007340e203ea82b6c201&req=dSAmFMt9m4JZXvMW1HO4zSxKDigRcgjfiyS4jhlLfm6%2BFukv3b8iX%2F8G02Z1%0AfJujCiRcL%2Bkiq1H19ag%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012236367/f9f92f5faa8305c45485a71a/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+08_29_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5b855ca5906e7b968b287379728e5b5b7027a88d73e007340e203ea82b6c201&req=dSAmFMt9m4JZXvMW1HO4zSxKDigRcgjfiyS4jhlLfm6%2BFukv3b8iX%2F8G02Z1%0AfJujCiRcL%2Bkiq1H19ag%3D%0A)

If your campaign has been sent via the Outlook or Gmail integration, only Sent and Failed statistics will be available.

How to Pin a Clinical Note

How to Pin a Clinical Note
==========================

Updated over 3 years ago

Pinning a clinical note will highlight and bring that particular note out of the timeline so that it will be the first note you see every time you open a particular patient's clinical notes tab.  
​  
To pin a clinical note, simply **hover the mouse over the note** you wish to pin and **click the Pin icon** on the right-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595674037/4ff9f12d4f4b594fc9d32c89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=73c0493f5f8d92efd932d78992e8c6540788aaef0b1dc523e0ee1b6c8a9b78a4&req=cSkiEM56nYJYFb4f3HP0gOAz%2B%2BlXKSJ9zeY3qr7kzfVAenDu%2F6QhThWaWGnq%0AT49Ex%2BsfpsKVxhERAg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595674037/4ff9f12d4f4b594fc9d32c89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=73c0493f5f8d92efd932d78992e8c6540788aaef0b1dc523e0ee1b6c8a9b78a4&req=cSkiEM56nYJYFb4f3HP0gOAz%2B%2BlXKSJ9zeY3qr7kzfVAenDu%2F6QhThWaWGnq%0AT49Ex%2BsfpsKVxhERAg%3D%3D%0A)

Pinned clinical notes will appear in blue and at the top of the page. You can un-pin at any time by repeating these steps.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595674295/a385653ab242a288d52154cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83ae88cd5ea670966d597008a82ae95bf97deb9c11bcedbb48237cdd27ad8d94&req=cSkiEM56n4haFb4f3HP0gMHkr3wa%2FQVyHKiQ66sQ2KT5kwr8iJ8QdQQjBfwo%0AbZebLu%2FJW%2F5KqDk%2Blg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/595674295/a385653ab242a288d52154cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83ae88cd5ea670966d597008a82ae95bf97deb9c11bcedbb48237cdd27ad8d94&req=cSkiEM56n4haFb4f3HP0gMHkr3wa%2FQVyHKiQ66sQ2KT5kwr8iJ8QdQQjBfwo%0AbZebLu%2FJW%2F5KqDk%2Blg%3D%3D%0A)

How to Cancel a Tyro Health Online Claim Submitted via PracSuite

How to Cancel a Tyro Health Online Claim Submitted via PracSuite
================================================================

Updated over a year ago

When a Medicare **Bulk Bill** or **DVA** claim is submitted from PracSuite via Tyro Health Online, the corresponding invoice in PracSuite becomes locked. This prevents changes from being made to the invoice in PracSuite until Medicare or DVA has approved or declined the claim.

In these cases, the following message is displayed at the top of an invoice:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1008730984/522ed6af96408118427af452/CleanShot+2024-04-02+at+12_49_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bcc42a83276953fc7c758a5396402091bd56530aaabde25be35628ff86e4545d&req=dSAnHs59nYhXXfMW1HO4zcPzATGEG7msPYNVAoycj8rG%2BbRXd0GksciFAtHl%0AHXlbRIx53WPQQhvXz9A%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1008730984/522ed6af96408118427af452/CleanShot+2024-04-02+at+12_49_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bcc42a83276953fc7c758a5396402091bd56530aaabde25be35628ff86e4545d&req=dSAnHs59nYhXXfMW1HO4zcPzATGEG7msPYNVAoycj8rG%2BbRXd0GksciFAtHl%0AHXlbRIx53WPQQhvXz9A%3D%0A)

PracSuite allows you to remove the lock on the invoice. This is most commonly used when a new provider hasn't been correctly registered for online claiming in Tyro Online, and the claim becomes stuck in an outstanding state. Once the registration issues have been resolved, you can remove the lock on the invoice in PracSuite and proceed to resubmit the claim.

🚨🚨 **Important Information** 🚨🚨

  
Please note that the cancel function only unlocks the invoice in PracSuite. It **DOES NOT** cancel the claim in Tyro Health Online or Medicare. **You must contact Tyro Health Online and Medicare if a claim has been submitted in error.**

You can learn more about this process on the [Tyro Health Knowledge Base.](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/3222670-cancelling-a-medicare-bulk-bill-or-dva-claim)

[Visit Tyro Health to Learn More About Cancelling Claims](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/3222670-cancelling-a-medicare-bulk-bill-or-dva-claim)

Bulk Bill and DVA claims can be cancelled from the Tyro Health Online tab of the patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1008744153/2a275a324c18c81d45c34886/CleanShot+2024-04-02+at+13_18_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a12309b6c7b3d8d2f43c162dbc4fd2e4e5019b3ab1a73257adf479a417c694a&req=dSAnHs56mYBaWvMW1HO4zaTus3AluOihBRJoT2B540bM4RXiGqHzT%2BBmXeTn%0A6VaDJFiGg%2Bg9tGdaG6M%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1008744153/2a275a324c18c81d45c34886/CleanShot+2024-04-02+at+13_18_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a12309b6c7b3d8d2f43c162dbc4fd2e4e5019b3ab1a73257adf479a417c694a&req=dSAnHs56mYBaWvMW1HO4zaTus3AluOihBRJoT2B540bM4RXiGqHzT%2BBmXeTn%0A6VaDJFiGg%2Bg9tGdaG6M%3D%0A)

**Hover over the claim** you wish to cancel and select the **X** to cancel the claim in PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861231556/bec553ca4a23a74cdfc3148d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35318d93bebf5ea81b8fbca66f90c0d1763ba1ca427b89679b8a72e35edf611d&req=fCYmFMp%2FmIRZFb4f3HP0gNFYUMUL91fgM4BlwBSQH3y5t%2ByoPds5VZaIhy7s%0AC%2FIE7LEiftKo1Qt1DQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861231556/bec553ca4a23a74cdfc3148d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35318d93bebf5ea81b8fbca66f90c0d1763ba1ca427b89679b8a72e35edf611d&req=fCYmFMp%2FmIRZFb4f3HP0gNFYUMUL91fgM4BlwBSQH3y5t%2ByoPds5VZaIhy7s%0AC%2FIE7LEiftKo1Qt1DQ%3D%3D%0A)

The invoice will be unlocked, and you will be able to edit the invoice in PracSuite.

You must ensure that you have contacted Tyro Health and Medicare to cancel or reverse any bulk bill or DVA claims that have been submitted in error.

How to Generate an Appointment Report
=====================================

Appointment Report

Updated over 3 years ago

The [Appointment Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/appointment/appointments)
 is designed to show a list of appointments booked, cancelled, rescheduled or completed within a date range. This report can also be used to identify appointments that remain unbilled or without a clinical note.

Go to **Reports > Appointment > Appointment**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/436706213/6771e103bd956ec84b2d0250/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bc9e48a62bee8bffbdc9d5e106db8a2d34e342bb9fa85e16f637a0eb1bbf3f6c&req=cCMhEcl4n4BcFb4f3HP0gP1XQixRSQ7FpIKe5l5KD0rQIGcrv6bG7XFgubOM%0AFLDMFMWfTe1C6btjRA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/436706213/6771e103bd956ec84b2d0250/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bc9e48a62bee8bffbdc9d5e106db8a2d34e342bb9fa85e16f637a0eb1bbf3f6c&req=cCMhEcl4n4BcFb4f3HP0gP1XQixRSQ7FpIKe5l5KD0rQIGcrv6bG7XFgubOM%0AFLDMFMWfTe1C6btjRA%3D%3D%0A)

Apply the applicable filters and click **Generate Report**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/576618670/80a96427e8ca51fe51154c1e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e45d2aaabf303549e9e7d1c0c077826b30250d802374ae61fc08c1c1074dc0de&req=cSchEMh2m4ZfFb4f3HP0gOdCCj8RjF6p6JEoBjkZGcKiplTQmy0nXqWbEwZJ%0AkPljPydbgJ8%2FjQOyBg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/576618670/80a96427e8ca51fe51154c1e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e45d2aaabf303549e9e7d1c0c077826b30250d802374ae61fc08c1c1074dc0de&req=cSchEMh2m4ZfFb4f3HP0gOdCCj8RjF6p6JEoBjkZGcKiplTQmy0nXqWbEwZJ%0AkPljPydbgJ8%2FjQOyBg%3D%3D%0A)

Once generated, choose from **Print Preview**, **Export** or **Communication**. When clicking _Communication_, this will allow you to either Email or send an SMS to the list of patients that the report generates.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/322033148/60f10a9d464f556038670062/Screen+Shot+2021-04-09+at+1.27.05+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44a31353c569fa6544b9b774ac140de80d614cd81294c9f3685e14b83b334ee7&req=dyIlFsp9nIVXFb4f3HP0gJW8OjfrKOKI3F4AjeYJ9rN8zqYeF83%2FKMwfhWab%0AtN41Rg4h6rEW8XrNWQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/322033148/60f10a9d464f556038670062/Screen+Shot+2021-04-09+at+1.27.05+pm.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44a31353c569fa6544b9b774ac140de80d614cd81294c9f3685e14b83b334ee7&req=dyIlFsp9nIVXFb4f3HP0gJW8OjfrKOKI3F4AjeYJ9rN8zqYeF83%2FKMwfhWab%0AtN41Rg4h6rEW8XrNWQ%3D%3D%0A)

Managing Stock in PracSuite

Managing Stock in PracSuite
===========================

Performing a stocktake, stock arrival or stock adjustment

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Stock Adjustments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5088496-managing-stock-in-pracsuite#h_72680856dd)

[Stock Levels Report](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5088496-managing-stock-in-pracsuite#h_f63586b8e4)

This article discusses the management of stock in PracSuite, including how to perform **Stock Adjustments** and report on **Stock Levels**.

**Stock Adjustments**
=====================

To perform a **Stock Adjustment** go to **[Reports > Billing > Stock Adjustments](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/stockadjustments)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594888306/a9723ed77374efb75259b375/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5288c301e5f4bb90bbc3a45400eea4f17b5a7aa2e5d2550b170aeafcc1d84fb2&req=cSkjHsF2noFZFb4f3HP0gDnEaik1UXU%2BzniGwZlxMXiCKs9hCsGgl5ty8vCT%0ANqNqOLSLIxE0FSBhwQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594888306/a9723ed77374efb75259b375/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5288c301e5f4bb90bbc3a45400eea4f17b5a7aa2e5d2550b170aeafcc1d84fb2&req=cSkjHsF2noFZFb4f3HP0gDnEaik1UXU%2BzniGwZlxMXiCKs9hCsGgl5ty8vCT%0ANqNqOLSLIxE0FSBhwQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **New Adjustment**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594888405/c16232459a6e15e1c63d1c17/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc1e4a4890e73276d733828a9ee710bc6339648bf2c640b32615ff00e9838db9&req=cSkjHsF2mYFaFb4f3HP0gIJYH9nHQIgKel7gmK67V5p2KTU%2FsOQUwEwwr6wE%0AXD1OxNQSCsU8cpZlXA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594888405/c16232459a6e15e1c63d1c17/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc1e4a4890e73276d733828a9ee710bc6339648bf2c640b32615ff00e9838db9&req=cSkjHsF2mYFaFb4f3HP0gIJYH9nHQIgKel7gmK67V5p2KTU%2FsOQUwEwwr6wE%0AXD1OxNQSCsU8cpZlXA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Date**, **Time** and **Business** this adjustment is being made for.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594889426/07960a977e0462f27d2980e9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9b49483fab844a311dbac49c64fee8aaf2996f08d4eb00042dc3d0af06842dd8&req=cSkjHsF3mYNZFb4f3HP0gPR%2F1GEQ5wwcQEYG2aPbaMLIBEV32NEZOv2ob9fl%0AUJph6NQnpwChRvTMuA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594889426/07960a977e0462f27d2980e9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9b49483fab844a311dbac49c64fee8aaf2996f08d4eb00042dc3d0af06842dd8&req=cSkjHsF3mYNZFb4f3HP0gPR%2F1GEQ5wwcQEYG2aPbaMLIBEV32NEZOv2ob9fl%0AUJph6NQnpwChRvTMuA%3D%3D%0A)

Choose the **Type** of adjustment. There are 3 options available:

1.  **Adjustment**  
    This is used to adjust the level of stock available without making a sale. This is commonly used to decrease stock levels when products are lost, broken or expired.  
    ​
    
2.  **Arrival**  
    When new stock has been purchased and arrives at the business, an Arrival entry should be added to represent the additional stock received.  
    ​
    
3.  **Stocktake**  
    A stocktake needs to be completed for all new stock items, but it is otherwise recommended to perform a stocktake yearly to maintain accurate stock levels.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594889507/776351e503d732e04cb51ff6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9976a6ce7150cdb51d4a6bfe8cbade91a8c4e8e7ceaef11c9220cb132cf0edf&req=cSkjHsF3mIFYFb4f3HP0gN2Os0%2B7LYfXzJYK5TZJ%2FNWRc%2Bz6ighUskQMtUqI%0AYuxUQiHu9z08PunyiQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594889507/776351e503d732e04cb51ff6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9976a6ce7150cdb51d4a6bfe8cbade91a8c4e8e7ceaef11c9220cb132cf0edf&req=cSkjHsF3mIFYFb4f3HP0gN2Os0%2B7LYfXzJYK5TZJ%2FNWRc%2Bz6ighUskQMtUqI%0AYuxUQiHu9z08PunyiQ%3D%3D%0A)

In the **Items** section, click **Add** to select which items you are performing the adjustment against.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594889584/8e1e61e7a744fda83f5f8f4f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=483f8364ec59ae350c9347715cf2c714e3e9e30286e0d7f52f9cf8434690bb8f&req=cSkjHsF3mIlbFb4f3HP0gLy8xIbR6Ynp0333ZyjdT4KfzRt4Ob5F7oANSGPr%0AVvADu7XaOIs567HhgQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594889584/8e1e61e7a744fda83f5f8f4f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=483f8364ec59ae350c9347715cf2c714e3e9e30286e0d7f52f9cf8434690bb8f&req=cSkjHsF3mIlbFb4f3HP0gLy8xIbR6Ynp0333ZyjdT4KfzRt4Ob5F7oANSGPr%0AVvADu7XaOIs567HhgQ%3D%3D%0A)

On each item added, enter the details of the adjustment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594889943/064f7f595157edc4543994be/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f203f7f4e4c919f0691b2cd925ca290445eb6bd5ba54f39586cb7ff95db3564d&req=cSkjHsF3lIVcFb4f3HP0gLYuA9oL%2F6b864iwLrYE8wVxHz2x4olDcrXUnssr%0AxGqyWtHe4kbqZ9%2Fq8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594889943/064f7f595157edc4543994be/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f203f7f4e4c919f0691b2cd925ca290445eb6bd5ba54f39586cb7ff95db3564d&req=cSkjHsF3lIVcFb4f3HP0gLYuA9oL%2F6b864iwLrYE8wVxHz2x4olDcrXUnssr%0AxGqyWtHe4kbqZ9%2Fq8w%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594890019/ce9dc6300e4b7cf4272b4ea9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b35b24aaa0f4caf44dd6419e4d85792fbce51a22dadf80b9a5c9e9f766b95ba3&req=cSkjHsB%2BnYBWFb4f3HP0gHX%2Bj9gL01%2BA0l7byr9pgOut7e1Gbrx51nxcjy6Y%0AeKDh%2BLApi%2FdVHOP14A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594890019/ce9dc6300e4b7cf4272b4ea9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b35b24aaa0f4caf44dd6419e4d85792fbce51a22dadf80b9a5c9e9f766b95ba3&req=cSkjHsB%2BnYBWFb4f3HP0gHX%2Bj9gL01%2BA0l7byr9pgOut7e1Gbrx51nxcjy6Y%0AeKDh%2BLApi%2FdVHOP14A%3D%3D%0A)

The **Stock Adjustment** will now appear in the main list for referencing.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594892592/ef9f90dcc2c85a816ea410ca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d13ac02bfbcd2942da00eace2eead6751afde70ca77431d5ae3a4110e2fec00&req=cSkjHsB8mIhdFb4f3HP0gMQkKdlTWc%2BIq%2BeH51yDXrqo4ZCiPREUv05YKU0H%0ATGJfo41Phf%2FmDpq6xA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594892592/ef9f90dcc2c85a816ea410ca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d13ac02bfbcd2942da00eace2eead6751afde70ca77431d5ae3a4110e2fec00&req=cSkjHsB8mIhdFb4f3HP0gMQkKdlTWc%2BIq%2BeH51yDXrqo4ZCiPREUv05YKU0H%0ATGJfo41Phf%2FmDpq6xA%3D%3D%0A)

**Stock Levels Report**
=======================

The **Stock Levels** report is used to detail the current level of stock held at each business for any stock items entered into PracSuite. Please note that this report will only show items that have completed a stocktake, otherwise we cannot calculate current levels.

Go to to **[Reports > Billing > Stock Levels](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/stockcontrol)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594892812/886f2bff85bbafed878b6413/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ead97f7d2e239fa815c099aff7341c7e3ac2fa510a4a92bacfadd533fdc6e689&req=cSkjHsB8lYBdFb4f3HP0gH8VQaE9Chn0B5o34U5GJ0Rzj6iSRWZt1x%2FFu3sh%0A4K2MOqvPEYLxaKySvA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594892812/886f2bff85bbafed878b6413/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ead97f7d2e239fa815c099aff7341c7e3ac2fa510a4a92bacfadd533fdc6e689&req=cSkjHsB8lYBdFb4f3HP0gH8VQaE9Chn0B5o34U5GJ0Rzj6iSRWZt1x%2FFu3sh%0A4K2MOqvPEYLxaKySvA%3D%3D%0A)

Several filters are available to report on different information related to stock.

There are two main report **Types** available:

1.  **_Stock Levels_**  
    This report type will detail the current level of all stock items in PracSuite.
    
2.  **_Stock Order_**  
    This report type will detail of all the stock items that are below the 'minimum' level specified, and indicate which items should be ordered to maintain the desired stock availability.
    

The filters available include:

*   **Supplier** \- Report only on items sourced from a specific supplier.
    
*   **Settlement Account / Business** - Report only on items offered at particular businesses or under specific settlement accounts.
    
*   **Item** - Report only on specific items or item groups.
    
*   **Include archived item codes** - Include archived item codes in the report results.
    
*   **Include stock notes** - Show stock notes in the report results.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594892971/e3a2331d9d496ccc41b0a10f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2fd0532a973188563ac28ee371b4ce9f732b1abea7fb60ef97eac17355e6c481&req=cSkjHsB8lIZeFb4f3HP0gC4vSlkV04tANYIYBjCiPf8lw41FaiL0ISFVsTOH%0AS4Lkoc6pNTI1Fda5%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594892971/e3a2331d9d496ccc41b0a10f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2fd0532a973188563ac28ee371b4ce9f732b1abea7fb60ef97eac17355e6c481&req=cSkjHsB8lIZeFb4f3HP0gC4vSlkV04tANYIYBjCiPf8lw41FaiL0ISFVsTOH%0AS4Lkoc6pNTI1Fda5%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Generate Report**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594893038/7e1e06f1948636b36e0ed562/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f7d935e45604f891bab8f5619b5e29314b0f7245f6654e96efe893719df33284&req=cSkjHsB9nYJXFb4f3HP0gFqCB%2BBM72%2BBdRwCPpTxFMYhN7BrRk5PPjYFyuEr%0ASJ%2BqllC53oxca3w2Ew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594893038/7e1e06f1948636b36e0ed562/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f7d935e45604f891bab8f5619b5e29314b0f7245f6654e96efe893719df33284&req=cSkjHsB9nYJXFb4f3HP0gFqCB%2BBM72%2BBdRwCPpTxFMYhN7BrRk5PPjYFyuEr%0ASJ%2BqllC53oxca3w2Ew%3D%3D%0A)

Depending on the **Type** of report generated, the requested information will display in the grid below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594893165/72c5e0530d14ca7ed47ce8b6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3d52cd2e9e9f81664a15a6e6ac40f8bf22d7432a9c7c911b3088c17efd41032c&req=cSkjHsB9nIdaFb4f3HP0gDv496Zui1px%2FaqZgkp%2FNjoABtQcVrF1lrbOgGk6%0AZ4WRbkPjK5ROuWvcCQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594893165/72c5e0530d14ca7ed47ce8b6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3d52cd2e9e9f81664a15a6e6ac40f8bf22d7432a9c7c911b3088c17efd41032c&req=cSkjHsB9nIdaFb4f3HP0gDv496Zui1px%2FaqZgkp%2FNjoABtQcVrF1lrbOgGk6%0AZ4WRbkPjK5ROuWvcCQ%3D%3D%0A)

Practitioner Tooltip
====================

Updated over 3 years ago

When hovering over a practitioner's name at the top of the appointment book, a tooltip with key info is displayed, including:

*   Appointment stats
    
*   Cancellation and reschedule details for the selected day
    
*   Outstanding clinical notes

Automatically Opting-Out of SMS Marketing

Automatically Opting-Out of SMS Marketing
=========================================

Updated over 3 years ago

PracSuite provides tools to send SMS in bulk via reports, [which you can read more about here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059680-how-to-send-an-sms-to-patients-in-bulk)
. The bulk SMS feature is often used to send marketing messages like promotions and birthday wishes.

If a client does not want to receive marketing SMS, the SMS [marketing status](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927850-marketing-statuses)
 on their client file can be set to opt-out.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601965894/ed66dd077fd37d9226e4583b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=05a97f3a43794c0d0743ee45d486237c3956932ed7c8fa61b13ee26a75f922e9&req=ciAmH897lYhbFb4f3HP0gIIJs3%2F%2FMi6nDcvTyv4XzWphWCJOj%2FyqpY%2Ft2RTK%0AAcfXXo4fenr1RDMwbQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601965894/ed66dd077fd37d9226e4583b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=05a97f3a43794c0d0743ee45d486237c3956932ed7c8fa61b13ee26a75f922e9&req=ciAmH897lYhbFb4f3HP0gIIJs3%2F%2FMi6nDcvTyv4XzWphWCJOj%2FyqpY%2Ft2RTK%0AAcfXXo4fenr1RDMwbQ%3D%3D%0A)

When using the bulk SMS functions via reports, clients whose marketing status is set to opt-out will automatically be excluded from receiving the SMS.

Note: A client's marketing status does not affect appointment reminders and ad-hoc SMS. It will only impact bulk SMS sent via reports.

PracSuite also includes tools to automatically set a client's SMS marketing status to opt-out when an SMS reply is received with keywords such as STOP or Unsubscribe. **This feature is enabled for all PracSuite users by default.**

To manage this feature, go to **[Settings > PracSuite Account > SMS](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/sms)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601966152/a57c3792bd446cccaf6c0922/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ccf759277f6b1e96957c344d50e5963a2b271cb9250d159cb80481e1a963b42&req=ciAmH894nIRdFb4f3HP0gPCa672fVUwN61NsCWOguNlLNms0ab2I87QakxS7%0AOXz1%2B5Ned%2F3Fernesg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601966152/a57c3792bd446cccaf6c0922/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ccf759277f6b1e96957c344d50e5963a2b271cb9250d159cb80481e1a963b42&req=ciAmH894nIRdFb4f3HP0gPCa672fVUwN61NsCWOguNlLNms0ab2I87QakxS7%0AOXz1%2B5Ned%2F3Fernesg%3D%3D%0A)

Here, you can disable the feature (not recommended) as well as customising which reply phrases trigger the automatic opt-out on the client's file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601966320/02287efcc3083520aab324d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac0dd1284aab2c0afd47d696da8d5b5b3f7d4a6d9d7b661ef2cf8bcd5ccee5a5&req=ciAmH894noNfFb4f3HP0gBt%2BBGhV0U%2F%2B7zPhyx64E3mHr8SJaFg5hggLu6cd%0AkUUSfO4KsuqORNMOEQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601966320/02287efcc3083520aab324d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac0dd1284aab2c0afd47d696da8d5b5b3f7d4a6d9d7b661ef2cf8bcd5ccee5a5&req=ciAmH894noNfFb4f3HP0gBt%2BBGhV0U%2F%2B7zPhyx64E3mHr8SJaFg5hggLu6cd%0AkUUSfO4KsuqORNMOEQ%3D%3D%0A)

How to Create a Scheduled Report

How to Create a Scheduled Report
================================

How to schedule a report to be emailed to you automatically

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Creating Scheduled Reports](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5098313-how-to-create-a-scheduled-report#h_8372696f1a)

[Managing Scheduled Reports](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5098313-how-to-create-a-scheduled-report#h_cff0a2a2d2)

The Scheduled Report feature allows a PDF or Excel copy of PracSuite report results to be automatically emailed to chosen recipients on a recurring basis.

Creating Scheduled Reports
==========================

Use the Schedule Report button at the top of each report page to create a Scheduled Report.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637453464/3050d23951c43ff25e456d2f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a2d2b3c1b2dc2ea941507b6c9df502a8458dfbb9093f2359615ae3d6cc1023d8&req=ciMgEsx9mYdbFb4f3HP0gIRrMeqTNImcKYkG38RQ2tbuKIUodxYQzwWaDe13%0AXD5TkzGN2F814uQmcw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637453464/3050d23951c43ff25e456d2f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a2d2b3c1b2dc2ea941507b6c9df502a8458dfbb9093f2359615ae3d6cc1023d8&req=ciMgEsx9mYdbFb4f3HP0gIRrMeqTNImcKYkG38RQ2tbuKIUodxYQzwWaDe13%0AXD5TkzGN2F814uQmcw%3D%3D%0A)

The following prompt will appear:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637453661/b475b70910ed9809cb5f8bf0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dee3ff321d736c92c20a1dc2ba17123155f5865424523e0e9375518a55a98b37&req=ciMgEsx9m4deFb4f3HP0gF4b3pTTY1qePV4fb9cer7pr1Eh%2FRzQOBPml4Llg%0AfqygRFqrv9rcu7ynGw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637453661/b475b70910ed9809cb5f8bf0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dee3ff321d736c92c20a1dc2ba17123155f5865424523e0e9375518a55a98b37&req=ciMgEsx9m4deFb4f3HP0gF4b3pTTY1qePV4fb9cer7pr1Eh%2FRzQOBPml4Llg%0AfqygRFqrv9rcu7ynGw%3D%3D%0A)

*   Select the **Saved Filters** that will be applied to the Scheduled Report when it is automatically generated. [Click here to learn more about creating Saved Filters.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters)
    

*   Enter the **email addresses** of the recipients of the Scheduled Report
    
*   Select the **Business Header** that will be applied to the top of the report
    
*   Choose whether to turn on **password protection** for the PDF or Excel. When receiving and opening the scheduled report, the user will need to enter the password
    
*   Choose whether to send the report as a PDF, Excel spreadsheet or both.
    
*   Choose how frequently the report should be sent and at what time it should be sent
    

Select **Save** to finalise the process.

The Scheduled Report will be sent based on the selected preferences. It's important to note that the report will be limited by the permissions associated with the user who has created the scheduled report.

Managing Scheduled Reports
==========================

Go to **[Reports > Scheduled](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/scheduled)
** [**Reports**](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/scheduled)
 to view a full list of all active Scheduled Reports. this page can be used to add, edit and delete Scheduled Reports.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637453985/c98cbed36270be977d94febd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5d92f913dafc8c516e917b79a2523dd2fd76d2cb4f084a7ea89adbfd5a139c5&req=ciMgEsx9lIlaFb4f3HP0gMVyHhvNBcNfDU1spSd0xs5JdEcec0q65dWskgOE%0AaMPF5hYgFajCma22Kg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637453985/c98cbed36270be977d94febd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5d92f913dafc8c516e917b79a2523dd2fd76d2cb4f084a7ea89adbfd5a139c5&req=ciMgEsx9lIlaFb4f3HP0gMVyHhvNBcNfDU1spSd0xs5JdEcec0q65dWskgOE%0AaMPF5hYgFajCma22Kg%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add New** to create a new Scheduled report from this page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637454040/e1e08602cb9b500a960e0472/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d7e854448d64da67abe3c262580649658f5369ab28a20c786e023a850bd39ff4&req=ciMgEsx6nYVfFb4f3HP0gGBqs0CKJ9BQ9vI5HzViG5wBB7FoShvS4FZDNf3j%0AfUhXTJTx1IYamZstsA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637454040/e1e08602cb9b500a960e0472/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d7e854448d64da67abe3c262580649658f5369ab28a20c786e023a850bd39ff4&req=ciMgEsx6nYVfFb4f3HP0gGBqs0CKJ9BQ9vI5HzViG5wBB7FoShvS4FZDNf3j%0AfUhXTJTx1IYamZstsA%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Edit** and **Delete** buttons to modify existing Scheduled Report preferences.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637454156/72a1d2edec225f423c289722/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=732c3cafafbcdb058a40d0da38b11ab25d60a14db566d65e1e7638e6b99d7a78&req=ciMgEsx6nIRZFb4f3HP0gNwu8OCgTAcQIBV1EiqEwreFHurc3l9BJS4o7qAd%0AfpZx9cR%2BP%2B3mNwPWJg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637454156/72a1d2edec225f423c289722/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=732c3cafafbcdb058a40d0da38b11ab25d60a14db566d65e1e7638e6b99d7a78&req=ciMgEsx6nIRZFb4f3HP0gNwu8OCgTAcQIBV1EiqEwreFHurc3l9BJS4o7qAd%0AfpZx9cR%2BP%2B3mNwPWJg%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 168 — Saving Report Filters | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-168}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Reporting](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2419427-reporting)

[Basics](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984788-basics)

Saving Report Filters

Saving Report Filters
=====================

Updated over 3 years ago

PracSuite allows you to save your preferred report filters. This can be very useful if you regularly run reports with lots of filter combinations and also allows you to select your favourite filter preset to automatically apply when you first access a report.

The **Save Filters** and **Load Filters** options can be found at the top of all reports.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614806715/3759759d41504902e7c1f0b1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91d18b3b1f10ed37ca54e4eee81ed7c27b9d03adcc1f53153845d154856fa592&req=ciEjHsl4moBaFb4f3HP0gFHXE7S2xqAimRhV2pZtg20C15QYDitJXFtNE9SN%0ACNqh1zG7s%2FsOjnW7rg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614806715/3759759d41504902e7c1f0b1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91d18b3b1f10ed37ca54e4eee81ed7c27b9d03adcc1f53153845d154856fa592&req=ciEjHsl4moBaFb4f3HP0gFHXE7S2xqAimRhV2pZtg20C15QYDitJXFtNE9SN%0ACNqh1zG7s%2FsOjnW7rg%3D%3D%0A)

To Save Filters, start with applying all your preferred filters to the report. When you're ready, select the **Save Filters** button.

Choose a name for your saved filters and select **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614806937/2b4adea97e20622aaee36ea9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e08784cd31cdadbe5f25427094bb650ef4c59178b9b781843b17afb1458d5d5&req=ciEjHsl4lIJYFb4f3HP0gInadcRtq3SQS36p4z60B56LHOunHC7HUgWFFSJZ%0AYpX3oZ7%2F%2Fj%2FtW%2B4Cfg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614806937/2b4adea97e20622aaee36ea9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e08784cd31cdadbe5f25427094bb650ef4c59178b9b781843b17afb1458d5d5&req=ciEjHsl4lIJYFb4f3HP0gInadcRtq3SQS36p4z60B56LHOunHC7HUgWFFSJZ%0AYpX3oZ7%2F%2Fj%2FtW%2B4Cfg%3D%3D%0A)

Next time you need to run the report, select **Load Filters**.

Hover over a Filter Preset and select the star icon to set as your favourite which will automatically apply the next time you go into the report.

To load a Filter Preset, select which set of saved filters you'd like to apply.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614807105/784414e8dba273243d7c240e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64441b66004ab4a67bf3970abd6377d691ca575450588e835d7c92f884034d65&req=ciEjHsl5nIFaFb4f3HP0gM83QFEHeKe4kV8jm9PuPVJE88Vh507%2BLpZcepww%0ABV0abSphNuZaFJaHfQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614807105/784414e8dba273243d7c240e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64441b66004ab4a67bf3970abd6377d691ca575450588e835d7c92f884034d65&req=ciEjHsl5nIFaFb4f3HP0gM83QFEHeKe4kV8jm9PuPVJE88Vh507%2BLpZcepww%0ABV0abSphNuZaFJaHfQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once you've selected your saved filters, you can generate the report.

How to Store Medicare & DVA Card Details

How to Store Medicare & DVA Card Details
========================================

Updated over 11 months ago

Medicare and DVA card details card be stored in the Medicare/DVA tab of the patient file.

Go to the **Patient's File > Medicare / DVA tab**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602027299/4dcbd194c2b9d15d9da31d91/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1cc517e5e1534f27f081d401bd608e6f8ea3ce1e2f7de551b9eb7650332525e&req=ciAlFst5n4hWFb4f3HP0gF9hyrEbcxRpGoPYNhyGj7VVnWnCD6eCagJ%2BNip0%0ANukk7p%2B6BDlA2lD0aA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602027299/4dcbd194c2b9d15d9da31d91/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1cc517e5e1534f27f081d401bd608e6f8ea3ce1e2f7de551b9eb7650332525e&req=ciAlFst5n4hWFb4f3HP0gF9hyrEbcxRpGoPYNhyGj7VVnWnCD6eCagJ%2BNip0%0ANukk7p%2B6BDlA2lD0aA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602027453/bda2fd3cd3c608ef3455bbd8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4d0a76e2967fba35f45d9493c5d5f1773a0649c29e538474d7b0c583616668cc&req=ciAlFst5mYRcFb4f3HP0gBzjk9ZjBs2%2BELkuUNhlsKdw5eVEc9hzxKPA%2BDuc%0AtoYPxF4d83IT9dWNWw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602027453/bda2fd3cd3c608ef3455bbd8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4d0a76e2967fba35f45d9493c5d5f1773a0649c29e538474d7b0c583616668cc&req=ciAlFst5mYRcFb4f3HP0gBzjk9ZjBs2%2BELkuUNhlsKdw5eVEc9hzxKPA%2BDuc%0AtoYPxF4d83IT9dWNWw%3D%3D%0A)

Enter the Medicare number, IRN (reference number), Medicare Exp. and/or the DVA number and Card Type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437353935/e207e169a764ed25eb1b5f977fc0/CleanShot+2025-03-24+at+14_25_13.png?expires=1771821900&signature=08ba3d4c42698534164098b1ac4f5fd919cd18d644bc788edf6f998e35400843&req=dSQkEcp7nohcXPMW1HO4zV3J548NLG2pHvt%2FQx6XAmmH6o05kSeT1OPYuV4O%0AhcDyS17ji9lPf3E0scw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437353935/e207e169a764ed25eb1b5f977fc0/CleanShot+2025-03-24+at+14_25_13.png?expires=1771821900&signature=08ba3d4c42698534164098b1ac4f5fd919cd18d644bc788edf6f998e35400843&req=dSQkEcp7nohcXPMW1HO4zV3J548NLG2pHvt%2FQx6XAmmH6o05kSeT1OPYuV4O%0AhcDyS17ji9lPf3E0scw%3D%0A)

An **Alternate Claimant** is added when submitting Medicare Patient Claims on behalf of a dependent, such as a minor. During the Medicare Patient Claim process, the Alternate Claimant can be selected via [Tyro EFTPOS](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550074-processing-a-medicare-claim-via-the-tyro-health-eftpos-integration)
 or [Tyro Health Online](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5088412-how-to-submit-a-medicare-patient-claim-via-tyro-health-online)
.

The Default Claimant will be selected by default when submitting Patient Claims. Ensure you enter their name, DOB and Medicare Card number to proceed with the claiming process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437354156/5eb71bace5b92280e9abe02b3baf/CleanShot+2025-03-24+at+14_25_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d3011130579b6c458bc34b419f35bc8b20078ab962d93b456d67853ec6351a15&req=dSQkEcp7mYBaX%2FMW1HO4zW4%2FM6CnQLUg1DwpKVA9yJA%2FsIhG2HBlOMlfY%2FlA%0A7%2BsygCJSHPQlBzMbRfE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437354156/5eb71bace5b92280e9abe02b3baf/CleanShot+2025-03-24+at+14_25_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d3011130579b6c458bc34b419f35bc8b20078ab962d93b456d67853ec6351a15&req=dSQkEcp7mYBaX%2FMW1HO4zW4%2FM6CnQLUg1DwpKVA9yJA%2FsIhG2HBlOMlfY%2FlA%0A7%2BsygCJSHPQlBzMbRfE%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Click here to learn how to verify a patient's Medicare and DVA card details.
