How to create a Patient Reactivation Campaign using a bulk SMS broadcast

How to create a Patient Reactivation Campaign using a bulk SMS broadcast
========================================================================

Using the Active/Inactive Client report to re-engage with inactive patients

Updated over 3 months ago

Table of contents

[Creating Your template](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5143493-how-to-create-a-patient-reactivation-campaign-using-a-bulk-sms-broadcast#h_39011dc0c5)

[Using the Active/Inactive Clients Report](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5143493-how-to-create-a-patient-reactivation-campaign-using-a-bulk-sms-broadcast#h_04ea0a1c8d)

[Running the Active/Inactive Client Report](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5143493-how-to-create-a-patient-reactivation-campaign-using-a-bulk-sms-broadcast#h_76c539f416)

[SMS Marketing Opt-Outs and Editing Recipients](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5143493-how-to-create-a-patient-reactivation-campaign-using-a-bulk-sms-broadcast#h_6acf687a4a)

[Sending Your SMS](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5143493-how-to-create-a-patient-reactivation-campaign-using-a-bulk-sms-broadcast#h_6478df0aae)

PracSuite includes powerful communication and marketing tools built into the majority of the standard reports that allow you to contact patients in bulk. This article will explore using the [Active/Inactive Client Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/active)
 to create an SMS campaign targeting clients that visited the practice in the last two years but have had no recent activity, inviting them to book an appointment online.

**Creating Your template**
==========================

First, an [SMS template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317983-creating-sms-templates)
 needs to be created for this campaign. Below is an example, but you can customise it to your liking. Make sure you replace our example website with your own website or a link to your [online booking system](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4766658-setting-up-online-bookings-in-pracsuite)
.

<<FirstName>>, My Health Practice is fully operational after recent COVID lockdowns with extra hygiene procedures to ensure your safety. Book your next appointment at www.myhealthpractice.com Reply STOP to opt-out of marketing messages

💡 Tip: If you need to include long URLs in your SMS, URL shortening services like [Bitly](https://bitly.com/)
 are ideal.

**Using the Active/Inactive Clients Report**
============================================

After finalising your SMS template, go to **[Reports > Clients > Active/Inactive Clients](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/clients/active)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990045/377b19a84aed58ff291bc1bb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9366a2b3b5f656395fe264972df687576ac0c0f9fbd841708ef3bdc0d594598a&req=ciAmH8B%2BnYVaFb4f3HP0gDkjDeni6AWQRTcgXk7rtIj%2BYAbFMsAE0%2FNhIN43%0AJXF6W2Jl2pI2hcgP4g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990045/377b19a84aed58ff291bc1bb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9366a2b3b5f656395fe264972df687576ac0c0f9fbd841708ef3bdc0d594598a&req=ciAmH8B%2BnYVaFb4f3HP0gDkjDeni6AWQRTcgXk7rtIj%2BYAbFMsAE0%2FNhIN43%0AJXF6W2Jl2pI2hcgP4g%3D%3D%0A)

If you don't have access to this report, contact your PracSuite System Administrator.

For our example shown below, we will target clients who had a transaction in the last two years but haven't had a transaction in the last 60 days. We will also exclude _Clients with future appointments_ so that we aren't contacting patients who have upcoming appointments.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990383/ed45f89489169d08581ef9fa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c034d996dd253204d22cb2927d9da128b9fe4d5e7fc4c30b9f9ef73a48792c7&req=ciAmH8B%2BnolcFb4f3HP0gLe9wQWyEDlNLijZbhZZT%2BW6HwYLWAQajeXgdRf0%0ARvuW1vKBhl4U4blBZw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990383/ed45f89489169d08581ef9fa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c034d996dd253204d22cb2927d9da128b9fe4d5e7fc4c30b9f9ef73a48792c7&req=ciAmH8B%2BnolcFb4f3HP0gLe9wQWyEDlNLijZbhZZT%2BW6HwYLWAQajeXgdRf0%0ARvuW1vKBhl4U4blBZw%3D%3D%0A)

💡 Tip: If you regularly run this report, you can choose to save your selected filters so that you can easily load them next time. More information on [Saved Filters can be found here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters)
.  
​  
You can find more information on using this report in this article: [How to Find Inactive Patients via the Active / Inactive Patients Report](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10895929-how-to-find-inactive-patients-via-the-active-inactive-patients-report)
.

**Running the Active/Inactive Client Report**
=============================================

Once your filters are set, select **Generate Report** to find patients matching your selected criteria.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990514/b1c4a3316b46b17b99aaf1d8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdd238505c1a735f286b6485f00aaf6cc7ac4bd1866a105c3ca226c2f41ca272&req=ciAmH8B%2BmIBbFb4f3HP0gM0Iaq6q3dUcT5JL5bJ5%2FHc9C5H0JN2b5ScisW4y%0AGbDQfkX9zxiL3faQew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990514/b1c4a3316b46b17b99aaf1d8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdd238505c1a735f286b6485f00aaf6cc7ac4bd1866a105c3ca226c2f41ca272&req=ciAmH8B%2BmIBbFb4f3HP0gM0Iaq6q3dUcT5JL5bJ5%2FHc9C5H0JN2b5ScisW4y%0AGbDQfkX9zxiL3faQew%3D%3D%0A)

Using the **Send Message** button, we can contact patients that appear in the results by SMS.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990576/6f0f3169d7d57ef9cabc96a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2cea1e27e6ce6d38a164e6e19d01569d208f33a3e4ba542a4fb0160b84bf0e02&req=ciAmH8B%2BmIZZFb4f3HP0gAtkZHrzH%2FIMJvVrTgDzK%2FN1ezHUIMCILXmbVyNU%0AhNB4Gzyrs8omInT9Qw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990576/6f0f3169d7d57ef9cabc96a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2cea1e27e6ce6d38a164e6e19d01569d208f33a3e4ba542a4fb0160b84bf0e02&req=ciAmH8B%2BmIZZFb4f3HP0gAtkZHrzH%2FIMJvVrTgDzK%2FN1ezHUIMCILXmbVyNU%0AhNB4Gzyrs8omInT9Qw%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Use Template** button to insert a saved template or compose a message ad-hoc.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990795/507daa99a9e6edbf09e8037c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6045529a38a96306fc7b003608521c8d092bf8164b35c8527f4bff894ee3a487&req=ciAmH8B%2BmohaFb4f3HP0gDXaeT7v1T0P11H1blcjAB6lI%2FhtI1SBL99xU0JR%0A3Vg4ORSUORJFDImsaQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601990795/507daa99a9e6edbf09e8037c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6045529a38a96306fc7b003608521c8d092bf8164b35c8527f4bff894ee3a487&req=ciAmH8B%2BmohaFb4f3HP0gDXaeT7v1T0P11H1blcjAB6lI%2FhtI1SBL99xU0JR%0A3Vg4ORSUORJFDImsaQ%3D%3D%0A)

🗒Note: Enabling an SMS Sender ID will not allow SMS replies to be delivered back into PracSuite.

**SMS Marketing Opt-Outs and Editing Recipients**
=================================================

By default, PracSuite **excludes** patients that have an SMS marketing status set to Opt-Out from bulk SMS sent from reports.

Selecting **Edit Recipients** on the Send Bulk SMS window will allow you to include patients that have opted out of SMS marketing at your discretion. For example, this can be useful when the SMS you are sending is an important announcement and must be sent to all patients, such as a COVID-19 broadcast.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991027/c683a14adfadf0ff726db18a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d05f27a1947cf8b3d669d82351c0d3d1188cea65c9cc8b507d3a54fcae6dcdee&req=ciAmH8B%2FnYNYFb4f3HP0gHWlD4nzwIPHIBu9sxvROmvaYJ6DdoOURcnMKkRE%0A1egWQjQRYgKqHtWl%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991027/c683a14adfadf0ff726db18a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d05f27a1947cf8b3d669d82351c0d3d1188cea65c9cc8b507d3a54fcae6dcdee&req=ciAmH8B%2FnYNYFb4f3HP0gHWlD4nzwIPHIBu9sxvROmvaYJ6DdoOURcnMKkRE%0A1egWQjQRYgKqHtWl%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)

If the patient chooses to reply with STOP to an SMS sent from PracSuite reports, the SMS marketing status on their patient file will automatically be set to Opt-Out, excluding them by default from future marketing SMS sent in bulk from reports. Note that this does not affect the patient receiving future SMS appointment reminders. Additional opt-out trigger phrases can be configured in **[Settings > PracSuite Account > SMS](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/sms)
.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991118/2985003e5212098b78c1f80f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7e0eb09c3b0f1e23208e4b5ed067befd619ae46dfa601c20b5f3fbd37daa2c80&req=ciAmH8B%2FnIBXFb4f3HP0gOEHiE2A9dcdhZQtRRfk8GaaY0WX2b%2BRaj9pvyNi%0AyRMceaYjdPaGkRQtVQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991118/2985003e5212098b78c1f80f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7e0eb09c3b0f1e23208e4b5ed067befd619ae46dfa601c20b5f3fbd37daa2c80&req=ciAmH8B%2FnIBXFb4f3HP0gOEHiE2A9dcdhZQtRRfk8GaaY0WX2b%2BRaj9pvyNi%0AyRMceaYjdPaGkRQtVQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Sending Your SMS**
====================

Once you have finalised the content of your SMS message and edited your recipient list, selecting **Next** will allow you to preview your SMS before sending it. The SMS can be sent immediately or scheduled to send at a later time. PracSuite will also calculate the approximate number of credits required for this broadcast, giving you the chance to go back and alter your template if required.

Select **Send Now** or **Schedule** to send your messages.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991389/9e096a21ef71aa8148d60ba6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2588bb654566482984cd189130469a89cc138a6a0e489765a0c861f57cf4a972&req=ciAmH8B%2FnolWFb4f3HP0gDD%2FoZvCTW0PGVSP33cqo5J%2BwZ5xWUWIdqG%2FRgZv%0AGZeXOh0tLUIimTdglg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991389/9e096a21ef71aa8148d60ba6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2588bb654566482984cd189130469a89cc138a6a0e489765a0c861f57cf4a972&req=ciAmH8B%2FnolWFb4f3HP0gDD%2FoZvCTW0PGVSP33cqo5J%2BwZ5xWUWIdqG%2FRgZv%0AGZeXOh0tLUIimTdglg%3D%3D%0A)

Scheduled SMS messages can be rescheduled or cancelled from the [Scheduled SMS page](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/scheduledsms)
.

Automatic SMS Marketing Opt-Outs

Automatic SMS Marketing Opt-Outs
================================

Updated over 3 years ago

By default, PracSuite **excludes** patients that have an SMS [marketing status](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927850-marketing-statuses)
 set to Opt-Out from [bulk SMS sent from reports](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059680-how-to-send-an-sms-to-patients-in-bulk)
.

In a scenario where the SMS you are sending is an important announcement and must be sent to all patients, such as a COVID-19 broadcast, selecting **Edit Recipients** on the Send Bulk SMS window will allow you to include patients that have opted out of your marketing at your discretion.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991708/9247f45484fff81e6f0251a0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bfdb496c8fbd1743d1b6cb38e192dc998ee2760ee0dbe889375d337623b72925&req=ciAmH8B%2FmoFXFb4f3HP0gHfgBBR3HPo4EiYiJgv%2FYh%2Bmox1CSvZCea8HUSV4%0ATlTncGp5zPwIJlbAqw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991708/9247f45484fff81e6f0251a0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bfdb496c8fbd1743d1b6cb38e192dc998ee2760ee0dbe889375d337623b72925&req=ciAmH8B%2FmoFXFb4f3HP0gHfgBBR3HPo4EiYiJgv%2FYh%2Bmox1CSvZCea8HUSV4%0ATlTncGp5zPwIJlbAqw%3D%3D%0A)

If the patient chooses to reply with STOP to an SMS sent from PracSuite reports, the SMS marketing status on their patient file will automatically be set to Opt-Out, excluding them by default from future SMS sent in bulk from reports. Additional opt-out trigger phrases can be configured in **[Settings > PracSuite Account > SMS](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/sms)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991754/3d3d5a8fb2a4015fd6e4d021/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d3bafd09b1d3bc441dc7af1fefab6c67f9b53e853fefea12a601b6f9058ce197&req=ciAmH8B%2FmoRbFb4f3HP0gDloXkLNV%2B6F6wUNq0GbxqPpaS5XWIbjU3P%2BqRcK%0AdE%2BIk2E4q4xudWl%2FXg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601991754/3d3d5a8fb2a4015fd6e4d021/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d3bafd09b1d3bc441dc7af1fefab6c67f9b53e853fefea12a601b6f9058ce197&req=ciAmH8B%2FmoRbFb4f3HP0gDloXkLNV%2B6F6wUNq0GbxqPpaS5XWIbjU3P%2BqRcK%0AdE%2BIk2E4q4xudWl%2FXg%3D%3D%0A)

Enabling Appointment Alerts for Practitioners

Enabling Appointment Alerts for Practitioners
=============================================

Receive SMS, Email or system notifications when an appointment is made, cancelled and rescheduled.

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Enabling Alert Preferences Per Practitioner](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5193442-enabling-appointment-alerts-for-practitioners#h_0decc50cf1)

[Alert Previews](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5193442-enabling-appointment-alerts-for-practitioners#h_ee069445cb)

[System](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5193442-enabling-appointment-alerts-for-practitioners#h_69dc2b8161)

[Email](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5193442-enabling-appointment-alerts-for-practitioners#h_b633686c1e)

[SMS](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5193442-enabling-appointment-alerts-for-practitioners#h_f0406f6220)

Practitioner Appointment Alerts allow practitioners to be notified when appointments are made, rescheduled or cancelled by a staff member or client online via the online booking system. These alerts are enabled individually per practitioner and can be sent by SMS (standard SMS charges apply), email and/or system alert within PracSuite.

Note that a practitioner will not receive alerts when they are changing their own appointment book, or for any appointments in the past.

**Enabling Alert Preferences Per Practitioner**
===============================================

Go to [Settings > Practitioners > Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)
.

From the list, **select the practitioner** you wish to enable alerts for and select **Edit** at the top to make changes.

Scroll down to the **Appointment Alerts** section.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011108414/a98c1d1e74e532e88cda9e49/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0fbb6a9c5848cc1cfe4e1a798a95751956e73e888df40dd2f438c82180f67def&req=dSAmF8h%2BlYVeXfMW1HO4zekmJJqm7rGDRWm6jeq7DkXPfnrO7%2BOQWN3DEFR5%0AGgpMs54kuBx%2FDCtwooY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1011108414/a98c1d1e74e532e88cda9e49/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0fbb6a9c5848cc1cfe4e1a798a95751956e73e888df40dd2f438c82180f67def&req=dSAmF8h%2BlYVeXfMW1HO4zekmJJqm7rGDRWm6jeq7DkXPfnrO7%2BOQWN3DEFR5%0AGgpMs54kuBx%2FDCtwooY%3D%0A)

You can choose to enable alerts for new, rescheduled and cancelled appointments. Separate options are available for changes made by staff and for patient managing their appointments online.

**Alert Previews**
==================

System
------

System Alerts are displayed as notifications and and within the Alerts pane in the bottom right-hand corner of PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/330883424/bb0cfcbc6b7332b675f2f8b3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0483196cddccbe72c827939a55c88413f05f70782f6d7bd3872ed908983fe9be&req=dyMnHsF9mYNbFb4f3HP0gIYU2rFLqJiLGY03NK%2Fwp58zBjXvQk175s4PSNk7%0A1XlAD%2BkgPABybdYLxQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/330883424/bb0cfcbc6b7332b675f2f8b3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0483196cddccbe72c827939a55c88413f05f70782f6d7bd3872ed908983fe9be&req=dyMnHsF9mYNbFb4f3HP0gIYU2rFLqJiLGY03NK%2Fwp58zBjXvQk175s4PSNk7%0A1XlAD%2BkgPABybdYLxQ%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/330883467/023b0b09811474e38d3b3345/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f89ab1f9110c8fbabf49bf4b59f25867f992e7db5620b72c42e70908be7c676&req=dyMnHsF9mYdYFb4f3HP0gJeuTS6EtnnFzwQxsZWN5GPVxob4kZEomdjjW8cB%0A71RRA%2FiLOlJZd62KCg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/330883467/023b0b09811474e38d3b3345/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7f89ab1f9110c8fbabf49bf4b59f25867f992e7db5620b72c42e70908be7c676&req=dyMnHsF9mYdYFb4f3HP0gJeuTS6EtnnFzwQxsZWN5GPVxob4kZEomdjjW8cB%0A71RRA%2FiLOlJZd62KCg%3D%3D%0A)

Email
-----

Email Alerts are sent to the email address listed on the Practitioner File.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/330884075/15b86017fe9a24a05ff45c90/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f4bc365e6f51413928f4813a1d73ff7aeec870fe5a46a699ac26e84858d8004&req=dyMnHsF6nYZaFb4f3HP0gI4st45q0vyoEroAWsbybIWtzwxu6WiasPvvgfeP%0A8qHCDLgfBwX%2BvwyIvA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/330884075/15b86017fe9a24a05ff45c90/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f4bc365e6f51413928f4813a1d73ff7aeec870fe5a46a699ac26e84858d8004&req=dyMnHsF6nYZaFb4f3HP0gI4st45q0vyoEroAWsbybIWtzwxu6WiasPvvgfeP%0A8qHCDLgfBwX%2BvwyIvA%3D%3D%0A)

**SMS**
-------

SMS Alerts are sent to the mobile number stored on the user account that the practitioner file is associated with. Note that standard SMS charges apply for SMS alerts. [Click here to learn more about PracSuite SMS pricing.](https://pracsuite.com/pricing#contentPricing4)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/330884000/ddeea43d4ef3347f272f78af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=41f96a9958aa501ed158463beda3a26b6c89aa0e28ed9a8a8adbf0e567e4432a&req=dyMnHsF6nYFfFb4f3HP0gLF%2FY6%2FoUDd%2BpCUGaj5ezsIR5kVST2x2knFOy3FX%0AoJgqLGqwLgrnbezUkA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/330884000/ddeea43d4ef3347f272f78af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=41f96a9958aa501ed158463beda3a26b6c89aa0e28ed9a8a8adbf0e567e4432a&req=dyMnHsF6nYFfFb4f3HP0gLF%2FY6%2FoUDd%2BpCUGaj5ezsIR5kVST2x2knFOy3FX%0AoJgqLGqwLgrnbezUkA%3D%3D%0A)

### **Setting up the practitioner's mobile number for SMS Notifications**

To enable SMS notifications, the practitioner will need to have a [User Account](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account)
. Make sure their Mobile number is entered correctly and that they are set as the correct practitioner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601993159/468ea7d69aeea47874553cdb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d300d5a60d21da8cbbae263d8a556a598ce6c678006c3e3bc95cad20eeefbe70&req=ciAmH8B9nIRWFb4f3HP0gJlPiRz2PTKTKQSjG%2FIUpGVXO2xaYlLMaN2fGkGK%0AALAHmzwhPCyNBB%2FziA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601993159/468ea7d69aeea47874553cdb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d300d5a60d21da8cbbae263d8a556a598ce6c678006c3e3bc95cad20eeefbe70&req=ciAmH8B9nIRWFb4f3HP0gJlPiRz2PTKTKQSjG%2FIUpGVXO2xaYlLMaN2fGkGK%0AALAHmzwhPCyNBB%2FziA%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601993506/c7e6d26287c5ef572d6c6f29/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45524fa36e54e4042363f52007b750a7c13f33d1160968bba5875a08cbc5974f&req=ciAmH8B9mIFZFb4f3HP0gCgpAARQNpe1aHV1U%2FQR4yVsTR%2Fb5wZ%2F36NhNpdY%0AtcPkIRdtEc8Bmh5lIw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601993506/c7e6d26287c5ef572d6c6f29/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45524fa36e54e4042363f52007b750a7c13f33d1160968bba5875a08cbc5974f&req=ciAmH8B9mIFZFb4f3HP0gCgpAARQNpe1aHV1U%2FQR4yVsTR%2Fb5wZ%2F36NhNpdY%0AtcPkIRdtEc8Bmh5lIw%3D%3D%0A)

Enabling the Client Login Portal

Enabling the Client Login Portal
================================

Allow your clients to log in online to view, make, reschedule and cancel their appointments

Updated over 3 months ago

Table of contents

[Enabling the Login Portal](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5205910-enabling-the-client-login-portal#h_f9f755ae69)

[Cancellation and Reschedule Preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5205910-enabling-the-client-login-portal#h_42c14cabe0)

[Processing Registration Requests](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5205910-enabling-the-client-login-portal#h_6add9e4210)

[Practitioner Permissions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5205910-enabling-the-client-login-portal#h_69791df621)

[Client Permissions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5205910-enabling-the-client-login-portal#h_d3f02a1e98)

[Group Appointment/Class Permissions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5205910-enabling-the-client-login-portal#h_0285156dca)

The [online booking system](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4766658-setting-up-online-bookings-in-pracsuite)
 includes an optional Login Portal that allows clients to view their upcoming appointments, as well as options to book, reschedule and cancel their appointments online. Appointments that are booked while a client is logged in do not require processing by staff as is required for Guest Bookings.

The Login Portal also provides practices with greater control over which clients are able to book online, as well as what services and practitioners clients can book with when they are logged in.

**Enabling the Login Portal**
=============================

To enable the Login Portal go to **[Settings > Online Booking > Online Booking Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601993893/d60f15107477889929fda002/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=979a1a4a7e9cdd2f8fa9adf00b1d88351d9e52df6e33e5d1104773b42b8554c1&req=ciAmH8B9lYhcFb4f3HP0gCRFGiK3M9beat5qfuBbDpLZ56Yn%2FjPUQin2MZmq%0ALrEsjRYasCvw0TBHAA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601993893/d60f15107477889929fda002/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=979a1a4a7e9cdd2f8fa9adf00b1d88351d9e52df6e33e5d1104773b42b8554c1&req=ciAmH8B9lYhcFb4f3HP0gCRFGiK3M9beat5qfuBbDpLZ56Yn%2FjPUQin2MZmq%0ALrEsjRYasCvw0TBHAA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Edit** > scroll down to **Login Portal** and **_enable the toggle_**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601994088/1090e7e7ad7b1f0957483969/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8626cdf13a810f4dd6a34031818b2a7ac206f1ee15c475001c4aa7bb3002da37&req=ciAmH8B6nYlXFb4f3HP0gCIO6Q1iNv%2FKKnjLQn3DRGT%2BnPqw%2BfkiP%2F6KRQxL%0ATIqqqNfgPQb0mEYlpw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601994088/1090e7e7ad7b1f0957483969/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8626cdf13a810f4dd6a34031818b2a7ac206f1ee15c475001c4aa7bb3002da37&req=ciAmH8B6nYlXFb4f3HP0gCIO6Q1iNv%2FKKnjLQn3DRGT%2BnPqw%2BfkiP%2F6KRQxL%0ATIqqqNfgPQb0mEYlpw%3D%3D%0A)

**Cancellation and Reschedule Preferences**
===========================================

Enabling the Login Portal will display new settings under **Individual** and **Group Appointments** regarding cancellation and reschedule preferences. You can enable rescheduling and cancelling of individual appointments and set how much notice is required to do so online as well as allowing group appointments to be cancelled online.

The minimum cancellation/reschedule notice can be set to hours, days or business days.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601994561/276d7f8a223d4a20033b737d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f80189f1b14ecf5dc1b65439f276d9831b05af3e063a99cef1404a7ed1413445&req=ciAmH8B6mIdeFb4f3HP0gNbWNCt%2B3N9FMUsniVtBKFyArKElzjG2MNGOb356%0AwxID%2FXy%2BpSOfWoeCPg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601994561/276d7f8a223d4a20033b737d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f80189f1b14ecf5dc1b65439f276d9831b05af3e063a99cef1404a7ed1413445&req=ciAmH8B6mIdeFb4f3HP0gNbWNCt%2B3N9FMUsniVtBKFyArKElzjG2MNGOb356%0AwxID%2FXy%2BpSOfWoeCPg%3D%3D%0A)

**Processing Registration Requests**
====================================

Clients can register an account from the online booking home page or choose to register when they're booking an appointment as a guest.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/332825278/9e0f68cb744f31364c9c001e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=93124db346584db63ecaaab28564f927a3cadb0a7cb119377a469faa879d0131&req=dyMlHst7n4ZXFb4f3HP0gDoE83jD2G2AfBP3XGlWY632PpDvjbNm%2Fp4vtgEi%0AH6XbSZePab1VLYikkQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/332825278/9e0f68cb744f31364c9c001e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=93124db346584db63ecaaab28564f927a3cadb0a7cb119377a469faa879d0131&req=dyMlHst7n4ZXFb4f3HP0gDoE83jD2G2AfBP3XGlWY632PpDvjbNm%2Fp4vtgEi%0AH6XbSZePab1VLYikkQ%3D%3D%0A)

If a client books as a guest and chooses to register an account at the same time, they will receive an email to generate their password and confirm their email address. When you [process the appointment](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746220-processing-online-bookings)
, their account will also be confirmed.

If a client registers without making an appointment, you will receive an alert in the [PracSuite dock](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4655992-customising-the-dock-and-menu-bar)
 within Alerts. Select the Registration Request to process it by linking it to an existing client or creating a new client file. See the [processing of a guest appointment article](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746220-processing-online-bookings)
 for more information.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601995409/e146c53424a68e3245f4a88c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b918533381f216846fee7a91aba9f4e63f389c107265738f897bfc7cf801037d&req=ciAmH8B7mYFWFb4f3HP0gK80T6OXDl79o9AbAFXBhrtig7IzDXirSHG9F6Cc%0Aoj5Ep7M3Uq43%2B5S5OA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601995409/e146c53424a68e3245f4a88c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b918533381f216846fee7a91aba9f4e63f389c107265738f897bfc7cf801037d&req=ciAmH8B7mYFWFb4f3HP0gK80T6OXDl79o9AbAFXBhrtig7IzDXirSHG9F6Cc%0Aoj5Ep7M3Uq43%2B5S5OA%3D%3D%0A)

You can select if practice staff must first process registration requests before a patient can log into their account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/333388941/e60c057ebc436975b8b9762e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5ca8668ea06916357ecbc553f931dea51b4751004f52c644ce1968b0521ff3be&req=dyMkFcF2lIVeFb4f3HP0gAgdfndJcP85pulMvtypWi8q9ew16DjmUkWZTIrh%0AsbYvRaVSO7ZA%2BkIOFQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/333388941/e60c057ebc436975b8b9762e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5ca8668ea06916357ecbc553f931dea51b4751004f52c644ce1968b0521ff3be&req=dyMkFcF2lIVeFb4f3HP0gAgdfndJcP85pulMvtypWi8q9ew16DjmUkWZTIrh%0AsbYvRaVSO7ZA%2BkIOFQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Practitioner Permissions**
============================

On the practitioner's online booking profile in **[Settings > Online Booking > Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/practitioners)
**, **Patient Booking Permissions** can be configured to limit which patients are able to book online with the practitioner when logged into their account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601995573/e4155a2e66db83ba08d3e198/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ff815d2f8be580e246259c6ad6082f1b0c8f8dc46302fd55a3550cc2ef0dc43b&req=ciAmH8B7mIZcFb4f3HP0gKWMnCvqjtIHKq%2FGI6vi5keDYndV6IkSncqnG8uK%0Ax4XcLRzPzaK1JBkdUw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601995573/e4155a2e66db83ba08d3e198/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ff815d2f8be580e246259c6ad6082f1b0c8f8dc46302fd55a3550cc2ef0dc43b&req=ciAmH8B7mIZcFb4f3HP0gKWMnCvqjtIHKq%2FGI6vi5keDYndV6IkSncqnG8uK%0Ax4XcLRzPzaK1JBkdUw%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601995819/8e5cf2bc111d7abbc8cecfdc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac1171f9401e1fd57fd94f0f7fc0904710db9dbb9f7982b1e14b8ee18337d8fa&req=ciAmH8B7lYBWFb4f3HP0gAVlhbR8BpqaclLchAYV3f1wF2jEJbua8a8W3vGI%0A2xLwv472dj84l6f7Gg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601995819/8e5cf2bc111d7abbc8cecfdc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac1171f9401e1fd57fd94f0f7fc0904710db9dbb9f7982b1e14b8ee18337d8fa&req=ciAmH8B7lYBWFb4f3HP0gAVlhbR8BpqaclLchAYV3f1wF2jEJbua8a8W3vGI%0A2xLwv472dj84l6f7Gg%3D%3D%0A)

Tick the box if you would like to prevent registered patients from booking with this practitioner if they have not previously had appointments with that practitioner at this business. You can also edit which locations, services or practitioners registered patients can book with if they have this practitioner set as the Default Practitioner on their patient file.

**Client Permissions**
======================

Go to the Appointments tab of a client's file and select the Online Booking button at the top.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601996002/212c5ef283e7556af5e5d4e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a71b5bd5abd39e7931c089f2cdbfac2f3429029ed349db8a8483980856139345&req=ciAmH8B4nYFdFb4f3HP0gB9URX%2FVPPGpEVA7W7Wp9DovjkbhRJ%2BrxsRtWboa%0A2rNXMd4v6PXSiABEIw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601996002/212c5ef283e7556af5e5d4e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a71b5bd5abd39e7931c089f2cdbfac2f3429029ed349db8a8483980856139345&req=ciAmH8B4nYFdFb4f3HP0gB9URX%2FVPPGpEVA7W7Wp9DovjkbhRJ%2BrxsRtWboa%0A2rNXMd4v6PXSiABEIw%3D%3D%0A)

You can completely revoke a client's access to the login portal by turning off the toggle. Untick the options for enabling Individual or Group appointments and limit which practitioners this patient can book into. Note that this supersedes the practitioner overrides. You can also define limited group appointment services that the client can book online.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601996132/b3c54069fdf3fb4b45c100f6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bcae9eff7ad64c3651a0532392ae024743d4b6502feeb00b1b68b7f903e34164&req=ciAmH8B4nIJdFb4f3HP0gLPZxCohkRpngYFq8bnqLiV%2B%2BWTs2j%2FRkrkZBJef%0AtmfpR2KMrrKZu%2FspJQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601996132/b3c54069fdf3fb4b45c100f6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bcae9eff7ad64c3651a0532392ae024743d4b6502feeb00b1b68b7f903e34164&req=ciAmH8B4nIJdFb4f3HP0gLPZxCohkRpngYFq8bnqLiV%2B%2BWTs2j%2FRkrkZBJef%0AtmfpR2KMrrKZu%2FspJQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Group Appointment/Class Permissions**
=======================================

Each [Class Service](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4919961-enabling-group-online-bookings)
 can be configured so that it is only available to be booked online to select patients. This is ideal for practices that offer advanced classes that they only wish approved patients to book into.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601996290/bc88915a3c3fb3a4c923ab40/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f2eef0a32e0221ef551af8516e545c515c2ff1ddf8d3fb98a0e8e863864cadf&req=ciAmH8B4n4hfFb4f3HP0gAYn6uFg3GXoMw%2BFDhbZTQm3buAVgOyVCzGeNH2g%0A5UfvOgu3ZXS8lCaleg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601996290/bc88915a3c3fb3a4c923ab40/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f2eef0a32e0221ef551af8516e545c515c2ff1ddf8d3fb98a0e8e863864cadf&req=ciAmH8B4n4hfFb4f3HP0gAYn6uFg3GXoMw%2BFDhbZTQm3buAVgOyVCzGeNH2g%0A5UfvOgu3ZXS8lCaleg%3D%3D%0A)

**All Clients -** the service can be booked by Guest and Logged In clients.

**Guest Clients -** the service can only be booked by guests.

**Logged in Clients -** the service can only be booked by logged in clients.

**Approved Clients -** the service can only be booked by clients that have permission to book into.

Using the Physitrack Integration

Using the Physitrack Integration
================================

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Signing up for a Physitrack account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration#h_5a1cfda1e0)

[Enabling the integration and creating your API Key](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration#h_e205581916)

[Accessing Physitrack via Clinical Notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration#h_857e95c973)

[Receiving Exercise Prescription PDFs](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration#h_2d6ba895da)

[Physitrack Direct (PT Direct) API Setup](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration#h_da10f2dbf5)

PracSuite integrates with exercise prescription and Telehealth solution Physitrack. Key features include:

*   prescribing exercise programs
    
*   tracking patient outcomes in real-time (incl. 60+ outcome measures)
    
*   educating patients through 3D anatomical animations
    
*   having secure Telehealth video calls with your patients
    
*   helping patients stay on track with their exercises with Physitrack's free PhysiApp patient app
    

Using the integration, practitioners can quickly create and open Physitrack patient profiles directly from PracSuite patient files, with PDFs of prescribed exercise programs automatically saved to the patient's Clinical Notes tab in PracSuite.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804611298/d9db819c627f6b1f3b5bcb369701/24360-1rekl6g_inline.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ce085bfc84c7037fe54d09a805ee8e23784136ad3a6f2886dd8703862d69c03&req=dSgnEs9%2FnINWUfMW1HO4zWdX9TG73RAuXtQkPgDZKuUNhuyxSGRFpXBYJrjC%0AX%2BArhhYwd%2F4XHBeBND4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1804611298/d9db819c627f6b1f3b5bcb369701/24360-1rekl6g_inline.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ce085bfc84c7037fe54d09a805ee8e23784136ad3a6f2886dd8703862d69c03&req=dSgnEs9%2FnINWUfMW1HO4zWdX9TG73RAuXtQkPgDZKuUNhuyxSGRFpXBYJrjC%0AX%2BArhhYwd%2F4XHBeBND4%3D%0A)

This article covers:

*   [Signing up for a Physitrack account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration#h_5a1cfda1e0)
    
*   [Enabling the integration and creating your API Key](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration#h_e205581916)
    
*   [Accessing Physitrack via Clinical Notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration#h_857e95c973)
    
*   [Receiving Exercise Prescription PDFs](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5252602-using-the-physitrack-integration#h_2d6ba895da)
    

Signing up for a Physitrack account
===================================

To sign up to Physitrack, please visit [www.physitrack.com](https://au.physitrack.com/register)
. If your practice has 10+ practitioners, please contact Physitrack at [sales@physitrack.com](mailto:sales@physitrack.com)
 for a group account.

**Physitrack Discount Code**

PracSuite users save 10% by using the following affiliate discount code:

**PRACSUITE10**

The instructions for new Physitrack customers to signup with a coupon code can be found below:  
​[https://support.physitrack.com/article/544-sign-up-to-physitrack-with-a-discount](https://support.physitrack.com/article/544-sign-up-to-physitrack-with-a-discount)

  
The instructions for existing Phystraick customers to add a coupon code to their account can be found below:  
​[https://support.physitrack.com/article/2177-add-a-discount-code-or-coupon-to-your-subscription](https://support.physitrack.com/article/2177-add-a-discount-code-or-coupon-to-your-subscription)

Enabling the integration and creating your API Key
==================================================

To enable the Physitrack integration, go to [Settings > Integrations > Physitrack](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/physitrack)
.

An API key must be created within PracSuite for each practitioner that wishes to use the Phystirack integration. Select **Add** to create a new API key and then select the appropriate practitioner from the drop-down menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339361412/15c2d2e7659a79820126227b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e371345f3a3c08bb6d4a01799eb19922512821b66bacc2ff402110bfe2bdb6f&req=dyMuFc9%2FmYBdFb4f3HP0gBMmKs3LbiAdK2M0ftEcs6KCc91%2BnBghm9PBPloa%0AFH2TnKiKu9iU37xrIQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339361412/15c2d2e7659a79820126227b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e371345f3a3c08bb6d4a01799eb19922512821b66bacc2ff402110bfe2bdb6f&req=dyMuFc9%2FmYBdFb4f3HP0gBMmKs3LbiAdK2M0ftEcs6KCc91%2BnBghm9PBPloa%0AFH2TnKiKu9iU37xrIQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once the API key has been generated in PracSuite, it must be linked to a corresponding Physitrack account. Use the **Copy** button to copy the API key.

Log into the corresponding Physitrack account and **select your username** in the bottom right-hand corner of the screen and then select **Settings.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339364267/d3d839a139585332415743d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8c7d6f06042103142c01f79ad509a7c9e7f4d611a94b191f515c8a199849a757&req=dyMuFc96n4dYFb4f3HP0gDksXgZcF%2BUpS483tVfUGZeIFJQl9dtfCQmuz%2Fdw%0AewtTq5i5dC%2BaTAR28Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339364267/d3d839a139585332415743d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8c7d6f06042103142c01f79ad509a7c9e7f4d611a94b191f515c8a199849a757&req=dyMuFc96n4dYFb4f3HP0gDksXgZcF%2BUpS483tVfUGZeIFJQl9dtfCQmuz%2Fdw%0AewtTq5i5dC%2BaTAR28Q%3D%3D%0A)

Scroll down to the Integrations section and select **PracSuite** from the 'Synchronise my patient data from' list.

**Paste the API key** generated in PracSuite into the API key field and select **Save Changes.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339364941/89c3a0649dbba4471f406e89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ba95da6df6e60a91cdaca0a545cbcc60602548829409df5e6c856b20bd1bad95&req=dyMuFc96lIVeFb4f3HP0gOuNr%2F1L2nnp3cmv%2BTx63qmaydl3Lq2UhX%2FGfvnT%0AiJZYTDBYG4AMQnCPKw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339364941/89c3a0649dbba4471f406e89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ba95da6df6e60a91cdaca0a545cbcc60602548829409df5e6c856b20bd1bad95&req=dyMuFc96lIVeFb4f3HP0gOuNr%2F1L2nnp3cmv%2BTx63qmaydl3Lq2UhX%2FGfvnT%0AiJZYTDBYG4AMQnCPKw%3D%3D%0A)

Return to PracSuite and select the **Verify** button to confirm that your API key has been entered into Physitrack successfully.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339361759/952a5d037122be084d44ce6c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=46903b0a4b3581c467ee77fab5e004577262e028fae313e3bc4eccdd615ffa86&req=dyMuFc9%2FmoRWFb4f3HP0gD0KqT4%2BNpdkKW9LjCQWSx7ZcdU90rRTzul%2BZfaV%0AlZctozPE1VFpq2%2Flog%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339361759/952a5d037122be084d44ce6c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=46903b0a4b3581c467ee77fab5e004577262e028fae313e3bc4eccdd615ffa86&req=dyMuFc9%2FmoRWFb4f3HP0gD0KqT4%2BNpdkKW9LjCQWSx7ZcdU90rRTzul%2BZfaV%0AlZctozPE1VFpq2%2Flog%3D%3D%0A)

If you are using **Physitrack Direct**, the management platform to centrally manage multiple practitioner accounts, please see alternate instructions at the bottom of this page in the section ''**Physitrack Direct (PT Direct) API Setup**''.

* * *

Accessing Physitrack via Clinical Notes
=======================================

Once the integration is enabled for a practitioner, they will see a Physitrack button at the top of the Clinical Notes tab of the patient file.

⚠️ Note: The Physitrack button will only appear to [practitioners whose files have been linked to their user account.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5258078-marking-a-user-as-a-practitioner)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339359768/54cfa3a674650fdf9f65964e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26cab77e8812fdf7af21d2d383d838832e5d5d3abcf5b86ceb1d10facfe18639&req=dyMuFcx3modXFb4f3HP0gCD8qiQMOtrdfF%2FjWAvC1CbrojGoeke8HdsHAUDc%0AjDCa0XdHp4w5ZanzoA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339359768/54cfa3a674650fdf9f65964e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26cab77e8812fdf7af21d2d383d838832e5d5d3abcf5b86ceb1d10facfe18639&req=dyMuFcx3modXFb4f3HP0gCD8qiQMOtrdfF%2FjWAvC1CbrojGoeke8HdsHAUDc%0AjDCa0XdHp4w5ZanzoA%3D%3D%0A)

Selecting the Physitrack button will either create a new patient profile or open an existing patient profile in Physitrack.

Receiving Exercise Prescription PDFs
====================================

After prescribing exercises in Physitrack, a PDF of the exercises will automatically be added to the patient's Clinical Note timeline.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339362795/b2857232c17bdb0cdb3480e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=34bd2be8921ed51683030a39d45c3abf141a05f2814c2fbf28f1c048424e74dd&req=dyMuFc98mohaFb4f3HP0gHbAELD16eZ7cJorvCdpQjxFsUHxrjdzm250SUk6%0AoOHNs93x6b2oEdw7wQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/339362795/b2857232c17bdb0cdb3480e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=34bd2be8921ed51683030a39d45c3abf141a05f2814c2fbf28f1c048424e74dd&req=dyMuFc98mohaFb4f3HP0gHbAELD16eZ7cJorvCdpQjxFsUHxrjdzm250SUk6%0AoOHNs93x6b2oEdw7wQ%3D%3D%0A)

Receiving the prescribed exercise PDF will not trigger a completed clinical note unless selecting the option below. As most practitioners create a clinical note separate from the exercise PDF, we recommend leaving this option unchecked.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/513536367/cb1dd99b5370792c4ffa9375/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a4497739f6a0205f32d03759905b4ee85a02842b3218b474c31d1d0e951057b3&req=cSEkE8p4nodYFb4f3HP0gG%2FLIw%2FrAvtCaJPJtO9I4IBIbTJ6fNwAyfLUYYKB%0AU%2FroBhHzIu9AWBaNaw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/513536367/cb1dd99b5370792c4ffa9375/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a4497739f6a0205f32d03759905b4ee85a02842b3218b474c31d1d0e951057b3&req=cSEkE8p4nodYFb4f3HP0gG%2FLIw%2FrAvtCaJPJtO9I4IBIbTJ6fNwAyfLUYYKB%0AU%2FroBhHzIu9AWBaNaw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Physitrack Direct (PT Direct) API Setup**
===========================================

**Physitrack Direct (PT Direct)** is a management platform for larger physiotherapy clinics and healthcare organizations, allowing administrators to centrally manage multiple Physitrack practitioner accounts and the corresponding API keys used for integration.

The integration process follows a slightly different process, when using PT Direct:

1) Within PracSuite, generate API keys for each practitioner under [Settings > Integrations > Physitrack](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/physitrack)
.

2) In **PT Direct**, open the **Users** tab (second option on the top-left menu).

3) Select the **Practitioner** being integrated.

4) Enter the corresponding **API key** from PracSuite into the field provided.  
​

5) Select **Save** in Physitrack Direct.

6) Return to PracSuite and select **Verify**.

Once verified successfully, the integration will be available to this practitioner.

⚠️ Note: The Physitrack button will only appear to [practitioners whose files have been linked to their user account.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5258078-marking-a-user-as-a-practitioner)

How to Process a Refund

How to Process a Refund
=======================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Processing refunds from an invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5263704-how-to-process-a-refund#h_b1a6421389)

[Processing refunds from the Payments section on patient and third-party payer files](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5263704-how-to-process-a-refund#h_907e61d511)

There are two ways to process a refund in PracSuite:

1.  [Processing refunds from an invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5263704-how-to-process-a-refund#h_b1a6421389)
    
2.  [Processing refunds from the Payments section on Patient and Third-party Payer files](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5263704-how-to-process-a-refund#h_907e61d511)
    

**Processing refunds from an invoice**
======================================

To process a refund on an invoice that _contains payments_, place the invoice into Edit mode. You will then be able to select the **Refund** button at the top of the Items section.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601996975/2e6825efe1f5fbd67b41d687/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=46b7a9d852285caa4652d63822395a9f45fd58b0b8dfdc248776d65739d42bc6&req=ciAmH8B4lIZaFb4f3HP0gMLCe7oEdMrLqFh0PR0%2ByI04dBDvBqzvEa5XNy8w%0AUuYwcoTMZ0oUXSoHrQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601996975/2e6825efe1f5fbd67b41d687/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=46b7a9d852285caa4652d63822395a9f45fd58b0b8dfdc248776d65739d42bc6&req=ciAmH8B4lIZaFb4f3HP0gMLCe7oEdMrLqFh0PR0%2ByI04dBDvBqzvEa5XNy8w%0AUuYwcoTMZ0oUXSoHrQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Processing refunds from the Payments section on patient and third-party payer files**
=======================================================================================

To refund any payment, including unallocated payments, go to the **Invoices tab** of the **Patient** or **Third-party Payer file**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601997263/24cf61ea9ae71c6e6602951f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=723c92ea9ee3ebe691ceac7d2ea568c510a6d12f5b0ce80fc7924604904f1557&req=ciAmH8B5n4dcFb4f3HP0gFHZYtxvEG9qswXPf3jxLqQcetivq%2FRQzSkOsDgV%0ASBblo1nmK1hxbLfdQw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601997263/24cf61ea9ae71c6e6602951f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=723c92ea9ee3ebe691ceac7d2ea568c510a6d12f5b0ce80fc7924604904f1557&req=ciAmH8B5n4dcFb4f3HP0gFHZYtxvEG9qswXPf3jxLqQcetivq%2FRQzSkOsDgV%0ASBblo1nmK1hxbLfdQw%3D%3D%0A)

1.  Select the **Payments tab**
    
2.  Select a **single payment** to be refund
    
3.  Select the **Refund** button to start the refund process
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601997486/9e223dacdf0f5afe94e6646f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae9ae0ec70cc85635f8c145c7c9412e78e7b450cf8d78dcdfa3d4d8013e394ec&req=ciAmH8B5mYlZFb4f3HP0gPEva5rd3kMIdLxAkzfW0Wf5Dd25%2B1oUkKXA2%2FZW%0AzGO1YQHy2jhTI15oaw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601997486/9e223dacdf0f5afe94e6646f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae9ae0ec70cc85635f8c145c7c9412e78e7b450cf8d78dcdfa3d4d8013e394ec&req=ciAmH8B5mYlZFb4f3HP0gPEva5rd3kMIdLxAkzfW0Wf5Dd25%2B1oUkKXA2%2FZW%0AzGO1YQHy2jhTI15oaw%3D%3D%0A)

Using the Waiting List

Using the Waiting List
======================

Adding patients to a waitlist

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Adding a Patient to the Waiting List](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_c3e769a4d5)

[Adding a Patient to the Waiting List While Booking an Appointment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_39fc77ec71)

[Filtering the Waiting List](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_7453d0c684)

[Processing Waiting List Entries](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_822dec8f7f)

[Reporting on the Waiting List](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_1099c9f06d)

With the Waiting List, PracSuite can actively search for appointment availabilities matching the preferences of patients added to the waiting list. When an appointment is found matching a patient's preferences, PracSuite will notify you of the availability to prompt you to contact the patient to confirm the appointment time.

This article covers:

*   [Adding a Patient to the Waiting List](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_c3e769a4d5)
    
*   [Adding a Patient to the Waiting List While Booking an Appointment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_39fc77ec71)
    
*   [Specifying Available Time for the Waiting List](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5322059-specifying-available-time-for-the-waiting-list)
    
*   [Filtering the Waiting List](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_7453d0c684)
    
*   [Processing Waiting List Entries](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_822dec8f7f)
    
*   [Reporting on the Waiting List](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list#h_1099c9f06d)
    

For more information on adding patients to the Waiting List for group appointments, [click here.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5375420-using-the-waiting-list-for-group-appointments)

To access the **Waiting List**, click the clipboard icon on the bottom left of the Appointment Book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/347804935/3f8cb1defa976e88eaf03d65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cf9d8ecde7d622b326f56e9d7648aa50492f78ea66e60d77d24017522be79289&req=dyQgHsl6lIJaFb4f3HP0gBOK82asMc0VosNx8q3JrEdfUmKpDGSUVQYjtsQ7%0AZeXOvot5ozIjEu%2FSTA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/347804935/3f8cb1defa976e88eaf03d65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cf9d8ecde7d622b326f56e9d7648aa50492f78ea66e60d77d24017522be79289&req=dyQgHsl6lIJaFb4f3HP0gBOK82asMc0VosNx8q3JrEdfUmKpDGSUVQYjtsQ7%0AZeXOvot5ozIjEu%2FSTA%3D%3D%0A)

Adding a Patient to the Waiting List
====================================

Select the add icon to start the process of adding a patient to the waiting list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612363666/0adb51595646954228835441/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28c160fb743830bacc755c9b4aa6ef6336b2d3a1f4309aa0bb97ab69095573f2&req=ciElFc99m4dZFb4f3HP0gHpMDQnc6LxrDt91Wgfa0o9ug6QqkV5o710z%2B%2FY2%0AUzMHEH3jhi5%2B76%2B9sA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612363666/0adb51595646954228835441/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28c160fb743830bacc755c9b4aa6ef6336b2d3a1f4309aa0bb97ab69095573f2&req=ciElFc99m4dZFb4f3HP0gHpMDQnc6LxrDt91Wgfa0o9ug6QqkV5o710z%2B%2FY2%0AUzMHEH3jhi5%2B76%2B9sA%3D%3D%0A)

Search for an existing patient or create a new patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612364191/46cb645c4338e2724e1c607e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=33bb3f5948f0dbf24e50930e9ade869f6397c61f353f206b032ff069e3e31a97&req=ciElFc96nIheFb4f3HP0gKQRiQgcaQ%2BmsdB87Nge6jQPXlVO6TtbPRuX1YPP%0AJO5YzVWK6AFVIQofDw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612364191/46cb645c4338e2724e1c607e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=33bb3f5948f0dbf24e50930e9ade869f6397c61f353f206b032ff069e3e31a97&req=ciElFc96nIheFb4f3HP0gKQRiQgcaQ%2BmsdB87Nge6jQPXlVO6TtbPRuX1YPP%0AJO5YzVWK6AFVIQofDw%3D%3D%0A)

You'll then need to specify the patient's **appointment preferences**, starting with the **Appointment Type, Duration, Width** and **Priority.**

You can also specify the **Businesses, Professions and Practitioners** that the patient is waiting to see, as well as any relevant **Resources** and **Notes**.

Choose a **Wait Until Date,** at which point the waiting list entry with expire and PracSuite will no longer check for availabilities. If you wish to wait until the patient's next appointment date, select this option. Waiting Until Date defaults can be set in [Settings > Appointment Book.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612365178/8047c3760ee51844f6a774d5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64140041af8457d3bb90ac7d7d7164d35f5d6724654c9fe08d93c0777ea86701&req=ciElFc97nIZXFb4f3HP0gPQLEwdwWNqy2GFgWEGxG0Tfz7kI7VYw0qE2VI2N%0AqC44mf1t8V8kYw8MoQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612365178/8047c3760ee51844f6a774d5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64140041af8457d3bb90ac7d7d7164d35f5d6724654c9fe08d93c0777ea86701&req=ciElFc97nIZXFb4f3HP0gPQLEwdwWNqy2GFgWEGxG0Tfz7kI7VYw0qE2VI2N%0AqC44mf1t8V8kYw8MoQ%3D%3D%0A)

To set what time the patient is waiting for you can use either **Quick Selection** or **Advanced**. The quick selection allows you to select broad times such as Monday AM or Tuesday PM.

The Advanced availability option allows you to specify specific time blocks such as 9AM - 10AM Tuesday and Wednesday, as well as 11AM - 1PM Thursday.

Select **Add** to define a new advanced availability and then **Save** to add it as a preferred appointment time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612365633/aa803c375275a28fbf5a142c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8996501944d6a9ef9c03e78246593625f6d7afb20c24440eda4722ecb558b67&req=ciElFc97m4JcFb4f3HP0gNug7uMYe58VuATOvTDy9Ew4UnABqe%2B9eJoQOPiO%0AWMcwTu5hTS%2F9ZdXmqw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612365633/aa803c375275a28fbf5a142c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8996501944d6a9ef9c03e78246593625f6d7afb20c24440eda4722ecb558b67&req=ciElFc97m4JcFb4f3HP0gNug7uMYe58VuATOvTDy9Ew4UnABqe%2B9eJoQOPiO%0AWMcwTu5hTS%2F9ZdXmqw%3D%3D%0A)

Once this has been set correctly, select Add to Waiting on the top right.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612365824/b64e7830e43112a4e22efadc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efed405f52e2212f0fe71dc6b79a21c4d37314b2c4b513a4cd0804b79982fc8b&req=ciElFc97lYNbFb4f3HP0gNmJD3Erqasiw0IgKkxr8Atc5bFYOUeSceN8NmCV%0AsBSjnwSZS8soworYgA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612365824/b64e7830e43112a4e22efadc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efed405f52e2212f0fe71dc6b79a21c4d37314b2c4b513a4cd0804b79982fc8b&req=ciElFc97lYNbFb4f3HP0gNmJD3Erqasiw0IgKkxr8Atc5bFYOUeSceN8NmCV%0AsBSjnwSZS8soworYgA%3D%3D%0A)

If PracSuite finds a time that is already available based on the selected preferences, you will receive a popup detailing the availabilities.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612366064/d3e883fb284809a5d9375670/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=19ff856b8be2805ae1fdc731b612bd0423debab3aca5c3875c8516cd09c66dfa&req=ciElFc94nYdbFb4f3HP0gJgmW5ZZm%2BbdVRXMPHujS6FFRPr6qHqEm4k5d5xM%0AI5Hr%2BruAOludY%2BDUpg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612366064/d3e883fb284809a5d9375670/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=19ff856b8be2805ae1fdc731b612bd0423debab3aca5c3875c8516cd09c66dfa&req=ciElFc94nYdbFb4f3HP0gJgmW5ZZm%2BbdVRXMPHujS6FFRPr6qHqEm4k5d5xM%0AI5Hr%2BruAOludY%2BDUpg%3D%3D%0A)

If the appointment time is suitable, select the **Book** button to proceed with the appointment. If the patient is not available at suggested times, mark the time as **Not Suitable**. You can also use the **Find Next Available** button to search for another time. Once you have exhausted your options and PracSuite identifies that there are no other appropriate times available, select **Add to Waiting List** to complete the process.

Adding a Patient to the Waiting List While Booking an Appointment
=================================================================

PracSuite also makes it easy to add a patient to the waiting list while you're booking an appointment. This is ideal if the patient wants to book an appointment in the future, but also to be added to the waiting list for an earlier time.

While in the normal appointment booking process, use the drop-down arrow to the right of the Book button to select the option to finalise the booking and add the patient to the waiting list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612366647/b0cc8bd2f442e7fabf0e8721/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea0d796b8b6879247fdd6788b143a096bfe25d837842a98c75f45baeefccb2ad&req=ciElFc94m4VYFb4f3HP0gBXMqDqVGsewQyLXEHXabPJk7ZkBGKwVQjwoCjd9%0A8d%2FjczLz7TrtPipoZA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612366647/b0cc8bd2f442e7fabf0e8721/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea0d796b8b6879247fdd6788b143a096bfe25d837842a98c75f45baeefccb2ad&req=ciElFc94m4VYFb4f3HP0gBXMqDqVGsewQyLXEHXabPJk7ZkBGKwVQjwoCjd9%0A8d%2FjczLz7TrtPipoZA%3D%3D%0A)

You'll then need to step through the waiting list process for the patient.

Filtering the Waiting List
==========================

Filter the results shown in the Waiting List using the filter icon. You can choose which practitioners/businesses to show, and whether the waiting list should display availabilities on all days, or just the selected day/week.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612367319/1fc649a107b83a31af791a13/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3f5234708a24bf8dd559c987e69b55d36acbb3da39958051e14c702d1dfd478&req=ciElFc95noBWFb4f3HP0gPATcLF6ts3CMlSsb0VYxYzuEPuk2GjrNCKeNKiZ%0APx0xTwX4hrCTfuU0LA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612367319/1fc649a107b83a31af791a13/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3f5234708a24bf8dd559c987e69b55d36acbb3da39958051e14c702d1dfd478&req=ciElFc95noBWFb4f3HP0gPATcLF6ts3CMlSsb0VYxYzuEPuk2GjrNCKeNKiZ%0APx0xTwX4hrCTfuU0LA%3D%3D%0A)

Processing Waiting List Entries
===============================

PracSuite automatically checks for appointment availabilities every 10 minutes and a notification will be displayed if an available appointment is found. Clients will remain on the Waiting List until an appointment is found or the entry expires based on the Wait Until Date selected.

When an appointment is found it will appear in the **Appointment Available** section, along with the patients that can be booked at the available time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612395995/3c42c867fe72674b0370b984/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3eb4e79768aeaa234759668d29fe37bec6faf5361b75c826fb5fcb2bf186ded7&req=ciElFcB7lIhaFb4f3HP0gKAn865XAxc96GmnE7z6mz1TVwk0s95XIdSPeVWM%0ANJnlTKecaCZImjcOlA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612395995/3c42c867fe72674b0370b984/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3eb4e79768aeaa234759668d29fe37bec6faf5361b75c826fb5fcb2bf186ded7&req=ciElFcB7lIhaFb4f3HP0gKAn865XAxc96GmnE7z6mz1TVwk0s95XIdSPeVWM%0ANJnlTKecaCZImjcOlA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the patient to wish to book into the available time to view options to book the appointment, go to the appointment time, view/edit the waiting list details, go to the patient's file or delete the Waiting List entry.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612396173/7df3908719d353f0d0cb5933/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44dedced1085fd619debcc6aec2358e38bbad5a7f10b1b08bc3a7bf6065ba36a&req=ciElFcB4nIZcFb4f3HP0gGj1NX%2FwvLJjMETssncOyB%2Fv34FfrHe6rVincFhp%0Ac3vxp%2BDxqOk3UiEXkg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612396173/7df3908719d353f0d0cb5933/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44dedced1085fd619debcc6aec2358e38bbad5a7f10b1b08bc3a7bf6065ba36a&req=ciElFcB4nIZcFb4f3HP0gGj1NX%2FwvLJjMETssncOyB%2Fv34FfrHe6rVincFhp%0Ac3vxp%2BDxqOk3UiEXkg%3D%3D%0A)

Selecting **Book This Appointment** will start the process of finalising the appointment. If the client is able to attend one of the available appointments, select the **Book** button to bring up the Appointment Details screen to complete the booking.

If the time is not suitable for the patient, you can mark it as **Not Suitable** and use the **Find Next Available** button to see if there are any other suitable times available. If you mark any times as Not Suitable, select **Save** in the top right to return the patient to the Waiting List.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612396590/491422274842acc182b95857/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6be9721fc74f48ef8bbed9c28ab881f49cf63985a40ea1c5335556ed7f5c65a5&req=ciElFcB4mIhfFb4f3HP0gNGZnXcsZS%2ByTTaWSUSw%2FmH2k6I3kyZnU07bzgqM%0A9JGA4AX3UG7Q4zzvng%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/612396590/491422274842acc182b95857/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6be9721fc74f48ef8bbed9c28ab881f49cf63985a40ea1c5335556ed7f5c65a5&req=ciElFcB4mIhfFb4f3HP0gNGZnXcsZS%2ByTTaWSUSw%2FmH2k6I3kyZnU07bzgqM%0A9JGA4AX3UG7Q4zzvng%3D%3D%0A)

Reporting on the Waiting List
=============================

The [Waiting List Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/appointment/waitinglist)
 can be used to search and send messages in bulk to patients on the waiting list.

Specifying Available Time for the Waiting List

Specifying Available Time for the Waiting List
==============================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Roster Availability](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5322059-specifying-available-time-for-the-waiting-list#h_023f8c5f8b)

[Roster Rules](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5322059-specifying-available-time-for-the-waiting-list#h_43edad14e2)

[Appointment Type Restrictions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5322059-specifying-available-time-for-the-waiting-list#h_3bc29df519)

The [Waiting List](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list)
 is designed to automatically monitor changes on the appointment book and prompt you to fill available times with patients added to the Waiting List. Read on below to learn how PracSuite determines what's considered as available time for the Waiting List.

**Roster Availability**
=======================

The primary way to control available time for the Waiting List is via practitioners' **Rosters**. [For a detailed guide on setting up a **Roster** please click here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides)
.

For each day that a Roster is active, between the start and end times, the **Roster Availability** dictates whether an appointment would be available for the **Waiting List** via the checkbox pictured below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601997705/4a8ec2ec3fb82768958a86ac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6d23c4f8d4433faedf74e2dd71bee37960c46c2bdba3123a7d60ba7ddb5559c9&req=ciAmH8B5moFaFb4f3HP0gGmL1KIJF3Pe%2BC%2FCdSuixg2g%2BlhPEy1iO3W7VQ2c%0AbLEc9YKYvZ7T1zm%2FFw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601997705/4a8ec2ec3fb82768958a86ac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6d23c4f8d4433faedf74e2dd71bee37960c46c2bdba3123a7d60ba7ddb5559c9&req=ciAmH8B5moFaFb4f3HP0gGmL1KIJF3Pe%2BC%2FCdSuixg2g%2BlhPEy1iO3W7VQ2c%0AbLEc9YKYvZ7T1zm%2FFw%3D%3D%0A)

For details on how to manage Waiting List availability for practitioners with multiple appointment book columns, [please click here](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4773602-specifying-available-time-for-online-bookings-for-multi-column-practitioners)
.

For example, a Roster with no rules that has Monday 9 am - 5 pm set as the start and end times with the **Waiting List** option ticked will allow the Waiting List to find available appointments in any time during these hours.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601997828/b6f43dc74247c223b4cd7ee2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52a3c17b7738a381c55cbe27782d1b3d82392ed6089e1d70b57569c9b57d8c76&req=ciAmH8B5lYNXFb4f3HP0gBpf16uuDDw1PRTqM1RF2IL8kK8JHp2nADIZ%2F9Qq%0As2lvaW19qk4RCpn%2F4w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601997828/b6f43dc74247c223b4cd7ee2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52a3c17b7738a381c55cbe27782d1b3d82392ed6089e1d70b57569c9b57d8c76&req=ciAmH8B5lYNXFb4f3HP0gBpf16uuDDw1PRTqM1RF2IL8kK8JHp2nADIZ%2F9Qq%0As2lvaW19qk4RCpn%2F4w%3D%3D%0A)

**Roster Rules**
================

Adding **Rules** to rosters allows you to manipulate the available times further by indicating times within the day's start and end times that are either available or unavailable for the Waiting List.

This is indicated by the final three tick-boxes; **M** (Manual appointments), **O** (Online appointments) and **W** (Waiting list).

Using the **Add Rule** button, you can create a rule that represents a lunch break (for example) where you may allow manual appointments for emergencies, but don't want these times to be available for patients to book in themselves, online or available on the Waiting List. Untick the **O** (Online appointments) box as well as the **W** (Waiting List) and leave the **M** (Manual appointments) ticked.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601998086/504a86e39e3a7ac2d8a03143/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5baa34d7e96910a3cc448889dc8794c1a482fe8d5a0daa0475de3735904f4024&req=ciAmH8B2nYlZFb4f3HP0gHYDxaiTXuJO5A5WbHpBcFq1N4huUI42FQAZAsyg%0AmzTzCgbwWgndxF9RVg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601998086/504a86e39e3a7ac2d8a03143/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5baa34d7e96910a3cc448889dc8794c1a482fe8d5a0daa0475de3735904f4024&req=ciAmH8B2nYlZFb4f3HP0gHYDxaiTXuJO5A5WbHpBcFq1N4huUI42FQAZAsyg%0AmzTzCgbwWgndxF9RVg%3D%3D%0A)

**_Please note that the opposite will also work. Depending on how you set up your Roster, you could have the general Roster Availability set to Waiting List off and then create rules that make specific time available for the Waiting List._**

**Appointment Type Restrictions**
=================================

You can also use the Roster rules to limit what Appointment Types can be booked in a particular timeframe. Select the cog icon when customising a Rule to limit what appointment types can be booked during the selected timeframe.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601998378/63edff3189fd73609c4871dc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bbceab59fd9a72beb38dfbfcbd5998c407f6e0ca6eb6c560486df3b5edb9db24&req=ciAmH8B2noZXFb4f3HP0gAAwSMxRbNp1NbA9H1BJQEShENCDnDb6ut5prBpk%0A4anTcb1fjVrGS%2BhYEA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601998378/63edff3189fd73609c4871dc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bbceab59fd9a72beb38dfbfcbd5998c407f6e0ca6eb6c560486df3b5edb9db24&req=ciAmH8B2noZXFb4f3HP0gAAwSMxRbNp1NbA9H1BJQEShENCDnDb6ut5prBpk%0A4anTcb1fjVrGS%2BhYEA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Payment Receipts

Payment Receipts
================

Updated over 4 months ago

Payment Receipts can be generated for any payment added to PracSuite, including unallocated payments/account credits.

To print or email a Payment Receipt, go to the **Invoices > Payments tab** of a patient or payer file.

Use the checkboxes to select one or more payments that you would like to print a Payment Receipt for and then select **Print** or **Email**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768729752/3ca8dc381c126755cee2b5b15205/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e570e31ad8472a758670fec23850482baced4b94b434d0e05caa6332f10a9297&req=dSchHs58lIZaW%2FMW1HO4zbTYv2oBXNTrd6rmZyYj646QR2lH6Zq5q4anaG6Z%0As%2FdIcqTBmUUbo9O%2FUQw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768729752/3ca8dc381c126755cee2b5b15205/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e570e31ad8472a758670fec23850482baced4b94b434d0e05caa6332f10a9297&req=dSchHs58lIZaW%2FMW1HO4zbTYv2oBXNTrd6rmZyYj646QR2lH6Zq5q4anaG6Z%0As%2FdIcqTBmUUbo9O%2FUQw%3D%0A)

Selecting the checkbox at the top will allow you to select all of the payments, this is useful for exporting a complete history of the patient's payments.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768731875/7d06ebdb50dbb38a98b71d52eb72/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0be9e29434409c0f72267a6e52bc9598b8e25490af432cffbacf54f1476c7ad6&req=dSchHs59nIlYXPMW1HO4zQDgjr0amubCVX4Zh2ezyN76v7Lht5dkot%2Fr0QVn%0Aa4RyVUMBwKhTOr3%2B2oQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1768731875/7d06ebdb50dbb38a98b71d52eb72/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0be9e29434409c0f72267a6e52bc9598b8e25490af432cffbacf54f1476c7ad6&req=dSchHs59nIlYXPMW1HO4zQDgjr0amubCVX4Zh2ezyN76v7Lht5dkot%2Fr0QVn%0Aa4RyVUMBwKhTOr3%2B2oQ%3D%0A)

Payment Receipts can also be printed or email when saving an **invoice that contains an unallocated payment**, **such as an overpayment**. The following prompt will appear in this instance, allowing you to select your preferences for the Payment Receipt.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602004554/a10c17a0546752c6895375d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=33ab9f093c0ba3a550fc26c4e1f93afdf7606baac5a0e339baacabbabe40a62a&req=ciAlFsl6mIRbFb4f3HP0gEr9OsPbQ80EbbfkbnHXVMRU4x7JHoj47cdnxtyS%0AGVa6YpmCyg26CtW3RQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602004554/a10c17a0546752c6895375d4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=33ab9f093c0ba3a550fc26c4e1f93afdf7606baac5a0e339baacabbabe40a62a&req=ciAlFsl6mIRbFb4f3HP0gEr9OsPbQ80EbbfkbnHXVMRU4x7JHoj47cdnxtyS%0AGVa6YpmCyg26CtW3RQ%3D%3D%0A)

The **Default Email Template** to use for Payment Receipts can be configured per business in **[Settings > Businesses > Businesses](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/businesses)
 \> select a Business > select Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602004907/84ce22277c7f04e0f9799c48/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=945492f9c4cd0e4dd1f440446ff79432fb552a7589ceba0a937dd9847e4e1327&req=ciAlFsl6lIFYFb4f3HP0gLp5VYLOcovdCWbuSsWVfCEgzJtppCi%2FxXx6T8eE%0AkWV3trnwikHL%2Fry7iw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602004907/84ce22277c7f04e0f9799c48/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=945492f9c4cd0e4dd1f440446ff79432fb552a7589ceba0a937dd9847e4e1327&req=ciAlFsl6lIFYFb4f3HP0gLp5VYLOcovdCWbuSsWVfCEgzJtppCi%2FxXx6T8eE%0AkWV3trnwikHL%2Fry7iw%3D%3D%0A)

Preparing for End of Financial Year

Preparing for End of Financial Year
===================================

What you need to know for EOFY

Updated over 3 years ago

At the end of the financial year, many users ask how PracSuite can help prepare their business for tax purposes. There is one report that is essential to run after COB on June 30 – that is the **Account Balance Report**.  
​  
​**It is important that this report is run (or [scheduled](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5098313-how-to-create-a-scheduled-report)
) at the close of business June 30th as this report cannot be back-dated and will only report the outstanding amounts and credits as of the current date and time.**  
​  
The **Account Balance Report** is found under **[Report > Billing > Account Balance](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/accounts)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601966825/5654747a2674f33e3a1d717c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=397da252aa390ce71ffb499c82aa6c26a99320403a0cea21e9cef49dad665fce&req=ciAmH894lYNaFb4f3HP0gGukSbXqlkAnKAjObOWDMV8DezciAZPMoT4BnVOc%0AwqfmcIYPWkHJZCazbA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601966825/5654747a2674f33e3a1d717c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=397da252aa390ce71ffb499c82aa6c26a99320403a0cea21e9cef49dad665fce&req=ciAmH894lYNaFb4f3HP0gGukSbXqlkAnKAjObOWDMV8DezciAZPMoT4BnVOc%0AwqfmcIYPWkHJZCazbA%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601966969/ddd89da34588204d424ceabd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3966be029ab2d32fdb6942ae9ede004e5f859c7f6362ccd656229865e96e3cc0&req=ciAmH894lIdWFb4f3HP0gIVh8dUrW2hySA00%2BzNeDNGNI2w8wYecl4tIM5x%2F%0AmFoKHOuDH1dj6zA1GA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601966969/ddd89da34588204d424ceabd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3966be029ab2d32fdb6942ae9ede004e5f859c7f6362ccd656229865e96e3cc0&req=ciAmH894lIdWFb4f3HP0gIVh8dUrW2hySA00%2BzNeDNGNI2w8wYecl4tIM5x%2F%0AmFoKHOuDH1dj6zA1GA%3D%3D%0A)

This report will list all patients with **Outstanding amounts and credits**, with three report **Types** available to select:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601967055/08cf1e905fecd01ba87ca331/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a53c9a28f9659932efb1bf4381f027dd4d687fc7b61271bdcb0c34527ecb2ba8&req=ciAmH895nYRaFb4f3HP0gIr5rNHcL3VeNu%2FE%2FFM5qTopRBBD6kwKeBTz0RSO%0AZGEMqiZB18OiXydH6g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601967055/08cf1e905fecd01ba87ca331/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a53c9a28f9659932efb1bf4381f027dd4d687fc7b61271bdcb0c34527ecb2ba8&req=ciAmH895nYRaFb4f3HP0gIr5rNHcL3VeNu%2FE%2FFM5qTopRBBD6kwKeBTz0RSO%0AZGEMqiZB18OiXydH6g%3D%3D%0A)

*   **Summary:** Lists all patients and payers with an outstanding amount or credit, providing a summary breakdown for un-issued amounts, the age and total owing.  
    ​
    
*   **Detailed:** Lists all patients and payers with an outstanding amount or credit, with the same breakdown as the '_Summary'_ type, however the _'Detailed'_ view also details each outstanding item.  
    ​
    
*   **Practitioner Totals:** Lists the total amount owed to each practitioner, where items have been raised for that practitioner but left outstanding.
    

For multi-business environments, this report includes an option to **Group By** each **Business**, so these same break-downs are separated per business/location.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601967170/7b3d220f4a756996d364bcf9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=996c48a53f53d23288ec56a918cc2055c6c92b68de057ae107ee1c5512ae528a&req=ciAmH895nIZfFb4f3HP0gP5X4pUfYESH3GAFBVIKupFSUxWfKIMqSrwStXtU%0AFPWdSiuyXmVHGqhDDw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601967170/7b3d220f4a756996d364bcf9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=996c48a53f53d23288ec56a918cc2055c6c92b68de057ae107ee1c5512ae528a&req=ciAmH895nIZfFb4f3HP0gP5X4pUfYESH3GAFBVIKupFSUxWfKIMqSrwStXtU%0AFPWdSiuyXmVHGqhDDw%3D%3D%0A)

Printing or previewing and saving this report as a PDF is essential. Exporting to .CSV or Excel format is also available.

**Remember, this report should be run after your COB on June 30th! For more information on scheduling a report please see:**  
​

[How to Create a Scheduled Report](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5098313-how-to-create-a-scheduled-report)

  
​

Using the Waiting List for Group Appointments

Using the Waiting List for Group Appointments
=============================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Adding a client to the Waiting List from a full Group Appointment](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5375420-using-the-waiting-list-for-group-appointments#h_209ef4e63c)
