[Processing a Waiting List Entry from the Waiting List](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5375420-using-the-waiting-list-for-group-appointments#h_2b85a5b45f)

This article outlines how to add patients to the Waiting List for group appointments. Information on how to add patients to the Waiting List for individual appointments can be [found here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list)
.

**Adding a client to the Waiting List from a full Group Appointment**
=====================================================================

When viewing a Group Appointment with no availabilities, you will see an **Add to Waiting List** button appear next to the Add Patient button. Select **Add to Waiting List** to add a client.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602006467/f3c64c7beab6fe99f2f9dd9b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=522a15c2f1582356a075cc8fc35bde0a7918aa1ea893a70ff8f92fa7871cb993&req=ciAlFsl4mYdYFb4f3HP0gDyhZA2dBg0337ABjKl%2B6npMJHmAIMqC275%2FMkKq%0AQAnWC5wwKnn7lk0XiQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602006467/f3c64c7beab6fe99f2f9dd9b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=522a15c2f1582356a075cc8fc35bde0a7918aa1ea893a70ff8f92fa7871cb993&req=ciAlFsl4mYdYFb4f3HP0gDyhZA2dBg0337ABjKl%2B6npMJHmAIMqC275%2FMkKq%0AQAnWC5wwKnn7lk0XiQ%3D%3D%0A)

Search for an existing patient or create a new patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602006713/644c169444009cbfdb815a9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be66abc0b7ffc844830cfe8e6ed5621dd45c966339100598914fb92a24a995ad&req=ciAlFsl4moBcFb4f3HP0gDGSTX9hfeHPZ1b8Wbn%2BV47rnP3L0G2wGFqfjF88%0AMDAuWP9%2FBgK6B3k7Lw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602006713/644c169444009cbfdb815a9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be66abc0b7ffc844830cfe8e6ed5621dd45c966339100598914fb92a24a995ad&req=ciAlFsl4moBcFb4f3HP0gDGSTX9hfeHPZ1b8Wbn%2BV47rnP3L0G2wGFqfjF88%0AMDAuWP9%2FBgK6B3k7Lw%3D%3D%0A)

You can set the **Priority** and add **Waiting List Notes** to the Waiting List entry before selecting which full group appointments you wish to add the client to the waiting list for. To continue, select **Add to Waiting** at the top to confirm.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602006961/ed6a9bf6cde0af239a9136eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4939009f8a01e7f36c34f2c8998497cfd65b656f903cde147a2373345f3d29b8&req=ciAlFsl4lIdeFb4f3HP0gOiA67hwPcdxBNZ7yBfQoKhKMWusqfcj0vGzw%2BDR%0AfvQiKhD%2FkmqVeJIUeQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602006961/ed6a9bf6cde0af239a9136eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4939009f8a01e7f36c34f2c8998497cfd65b656f903cde147a2373345f3d29b8&req=ciAlFsl4lIdeFb4f3HP0gOiA67hwPcdxBNZ7yBfQoKhKMWusqfcj0vGzw%2BDR%0AfvQiKhD%2FkmqVeJIUeQ%3D%3D%0A)

You will be returned to the Group Appointment view which will now have a new card for Waiting List

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602007189/a65638e6fbe1b7db3d4c85a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=155312862a4a49e61e0fcfe7d58a1972608c66b37d6545e1457e02c0ba521a3c&req=ciAlFsl5nIlWFb4f3HP0gDoJPqwxSxzkEZy7MaWe1YoQ2EQEosKAkjb7Q5oY%0AHBu5r7evPQuZ2AKThA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602007189/a65638e6fbe1b7db3d4c85a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=155312862a4a49e61e0fcfe7d58a1972608c66b37d6545e1457e02c0ba521a3c&req=ciAlFsl5nIlWFb4f3HP0gDoJPqwxSxzkEZy7MaWe1YoQ2EQEosKAkjb7Q5oY%0AHBu5r7evPQuZ2AKThA%3D%3D%0A)

**Adding a client from the Waiting List**
=========================================

To access the **Waiting List**, click the **Clipboard icon** on the bottom left of the Appointment Book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602007304/6ea9bf6723e58e4582c8ca15/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45d4079d9b2ceabbd40a5003b1cf45e3ef85a9cec6235aa605d68903cdd55482&req=ciAlFsl5noFbFb4f3HP0gK9q5jVIrF5zKZzjGKtEm8%2Bvwmtg0zyQHKkP%2FLzV%0Ao%2B6GIF7NK8rnsvTxRA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602007304/6ea9bf6723e58e4582c8ca15/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45d4079d9b2ceabbd40a5003b1cf45e3ef85a9cec6235aa605d68903cdd55482&req=ciAlFsl5noFbFb4f3HP0gK9q5jVIrF5zKZzjGKtEm8%2Bvwmtg0zyQHKkP%2FLzV%0Ao%2B6GIF7NK8rnsvTxRA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the add '**+**' icon to start the process of adding a patient to the waiting list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602008020/aa05a9ab02ac84110cbb5442/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db75e38fde89b9fd6e34151847d405a9b1e19b8b827a53785ddf3f6c1e21cd92&req=ciAlFsl2nYNfFb4f3HP0gHZ5IduSXn7T1xJwJNyHIjm3Gn5DSOydjC2QaOuz%0AuaWlrqfPk3ZkEy9Z3g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602008020/aa05a9ab02ac84110cbb5442/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db75e38fde89b9fd6e34151847d405a9b1e19b8b827a53785ddf3f6c1e21cd92&req=ciAlFsl2nYNfFb4f3HP0gHZ5IduSXn7T1xJwJNyHIjm3Gn5DSOydjC2QaOuz%0AuaWlrqfPk3ZkEy9Z3g%3D%3D%0A)

Search for an existing patient or create a new patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602007592/c069e008aa1a5adaa2d8905b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=98c539e26db215776fdaa01d62c2dbbc34a3555e52b72975599efa7793b270ff&req=ciAlFsl5mIhdFb4f3HP0gDqNr%2F%2BQ0VO8AudrDZ8aWoRnyw%2FC8e50qs8MVMyl%0AgvmSN2jZYj%2B5QXk2uw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602007592/c069e008aa1a5adaa2d8905b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=98c539e26db215776fdaa01d62c2dbbc34a3555e52b72975599efa7793b270ff&req=ciAlFsl5mIhdFb4f3HP0gDqNr%2F%2BQ0VO8AudrDZ8aWoRnyw%2FC8e50qs8MVMyl%0AgvmSN2jZYj%2B5QXk2uw%3D%3D%0A)

Select the Group Appointment Type that you are looking for. You can set the **Priority** and add **Waiting List Notes**. You can also specify the **Businesses**, **Professions** and **Practitioners** that the patient is waiting to see.

Use the AM/PM day filters to search for certain days and then select **Find Full Group Appointments**. Note that on the waiting list, only full Group Appointments will display.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602008844/3eede2e7b909d9f7e6a758ec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2a22c83281cbe0c17dc9e58985a120a64db4cf388f0c9e3d0c24fec04f1a1995&req=ciAlFsl2lYVbFb4f3HP0gCZwbk9f142jEnIXFpsdcP8edtV8eYN1rIimAtEf%0AP2e%2BkDFo8fsM5dB1wQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602008844/3eede2e7b909d9f7e6a758ec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2a22c83281cbe0c17dc9e58985a120a64db4cf388f0c9e3d0c24fec04f1a1995&req=ciAlFsl2lYVbFb4f3HP0gCZwbk9f142jEnIXFpsdcP8edtV8eYN1rIimAtEf%0AP2e%2BkDFo8fsM5dB1wQ%3D%3D%0A)

Tick the group appointments that you wish to add the client to the waiting list for and select **Add to Waiting** at the top to confirm. A Waiting List entry will be created for each Group Appointment the client is waiting for.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602008416/a50d8941f34d40fa1eb5ebcb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8da6075a5b5df8b03ab8f373aa30431f258c882d19b0b8523b1180a4a47e3173&req=ciAlFsl2mYBZFb4f3HP0gA5LL8BfQ6XGQe%2F8%2BA8pmPyMe8Or3HgXQxczm4iA%0ACGx7ZSoVl3VYMdYbpg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602008416/a50d8941f34d40fa1eb5ebcb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8da6075a5b5df8b03ab8f373aa30431f258c882d19b0b8523b1180a4a47e3173&req=ciAlFsl2mYBZFb4f3HP0gA5LL8BfQ6XGQe%2F8%2BA8pmPyMe8Or3HgXQxczm4iA%0ACGx7ZSoVl3VYMdYbpg%3D%3D%0A)

**Processing a Waiting List Entry from a Group Appointment**
============================================================

You can add a client on the Group Appointment Waiting List to the Group Appointment by hovering over the entry and then selecting the **Book** button. Note that this can be done even when the Group Appointment is full, if this is the case a warning will appear that there is no free space but you will still be allowed to book the client in.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602008948/248c469ae7faef3f5cda6ae4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b9b0affe5c9f6ae3eb10ece8bc8dea308b4476213414b7f4e76f080eb607867&req=ciAlFsl2lIVXFb4f3HP0gHPi6wNSxktGDVRfdAXQS%2F24MtIKSRle1FH4CERi%0APGWlHUFafrPFG%2FRUEQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602008948/248c469ae7faef3f5cda6ae4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b9b0affe5c9f6ae3eb10ece8bc8dea308b4476213414b7f4e76f080eb607867&req=ciAlFsl2lIVXFb4f3HP0gHPi6wNSxktGDVRfdAXQS%2F24MtIKSRle1FH4CERi%0APGWlHUFafrPFG%2FRUEQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Processing a Waiting List Entry from the Waiting List**
=========================================================

PracSuite automatically checks for appointment availabilities every 10 minutes and a notification will be displayed if an available appointment is found. Clients will remain on the Waiting List until an appointment is found or the group appointment is in the past when they will move to Expired.

Entries on the Waiting List adapt to the filters selected in the top-right of the Appointment Book.

To view the Waiting List entries either for all days or for the selected day or week only, select the **Filter** icon in the Waiting List, make a selection under **Days to Display** and to save your selection, select **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602009441/6815efa34a444de799c99e67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e28f377cf508913be888baccd7ed14d61a91d5402eb361c8d1b08288455f5dc4&req=ciAlFsl3mYVeFb4f3HP0gEWngNaS67si7CIZ8KYlPx4IYwtggwe3E8DzePxI%0AAezByj%2Bxb%2FVqkO9GTg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602009441/6815efa34a444de799c99e67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e28f377cf508913be888baccd7ed14d61a91d5402eb361c8d1b08288455f5dc4&req=ciAlFsl3mYVeFb4f3HP0gEWngNaS67si7CIZ8KYlPx4IYwtggwe3E8DzePxI%0AAezByj%2Bxb%2FVqkO9GTg%3D%3D%0A)

When an appointment is found it will appear in the **Appointment Available** section, along with the patients that can be booked at the available time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602010744/9008e24b1484dc83d5b1222a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a1c9c9b31ec7622e84f6f336dbbc36ebef538db0353730af179a44c29835b03b&req=ciAlFsh%2BmoVbFb4f3HP0gL5bBJ9my5z%2Fl9NxffjPnPa2jnp0GOagllGeKWIj%0A1HhcpH5eSrmUljs6%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602010744/9008e24b1484dc83d5b1222a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a1c9c9b31ec7622e84f6f336dbbc36ebef538db0353730af179a44c29835b03b&req=ciAlFsh%2BmoVbFb4f3HP0gL5bBJ9my5z%2Fl9NxffjPnPa2jnp0GOagllGeKWIj%0A1HhcpH5eSrmUljs6%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select the client you to wish to book into the available space to view options to book the appointment, go to the appointment time, go to the patient's file or delete the Waiting List entry.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602010898/14b481527725acaacd4996a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b191b5eaf8c12c916466abbd3b1c519959febb6c618e86a560da53bf41cf0ae7&req=ciAlFsh%2BlYhXFb4f3HP0gKku4sLdNLIytaM9CNuAmXrY1t%2Bk86YgUVilFN2Q%0A1%2BgUqUWKN63ysoDfRQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602010898/14b481527725acaacd4996a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b191b5eaf8c12c916466abbd3b1c519959febb6c618e86a560da53bf41cf0ae7&req=ciAlFsh%2BlYhXFb4f3HP0gKku4sLdNLIytaM9CNuAmXrY1t%2Bk86YgUVilFN2Q%0A1%2BgUqUWKN63ysoDfRQ%3D%3D%0A)

Selecting **Book This Appointment** will start the process of finalising the appointment. If the client is able to attend the group appointment, select the **Book** button to bring up the Appointment Details screen to complete the booking.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602011067/bdd3ab2cc6e464871c40920a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25cc126dd920fb6742846cb0c1b1c30054b8db6a72b5f8348d3a4889f0757c5b&req=ciAlFsh%2FnYdYFb4f3HP0gHhZONYUJrYJY1N3JL8UPSfM5Js0mLwdInv1W5rM%0ArvFDWjVGilr1aQ1%2BVg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602011067/bdd3ab2cc6e464871c40920a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25cc126dd920fb6742846cb0c1b1c30054b8db6a72b5f8348d3a4889f0757c5b&req=ciAlFsh%2FnYdYFb4f3HP0gHhZONYUJrYJY1N3JL8UPSfM5Js0mLwdInv1W5rM%0ArvFDWjVGilr1aQ1%2BVg%3D%3D%0A)

Setting Up PracSuite Security Tokens

Setting Up PracSuite Security Tokens
====================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Linking a PracSuite Security Token to a User Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5483233-setting-up-pracsuite-security-tokens#h_77e59b50d8)

PracSuite security tokens can be used as an alternative to app-based authenticators that require smartphones or computers. These physical security tokens are suited to practice environments where 2FA authenticator apps cannot be installed on users' personal devices, or the use of personal devices is not permitted.

After [purchasing PracSuite Security Tokens](https://www.smartsoft.com.au/order/pracsuitesecuritytoken)
, you will need to link the token to a PracSuite user account. A PracSuite Security Token can be linked with one or more PracSuite user accounts.

**Linking a PracSuite Security Token to a User Account**
========================================================

1\. If the user already has 2FA configured on their PracSuite user account, you will need to start with [resetting 2FA on their user account](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4229484-how-to-reset-two-factor-authentication)
.

2\. Once 2FA has been reset, the user will need to log out of PracSuite.

3\. When the user attempts to log into PracSuite, they will be asked to set up Two-Factor Authentication. Select **PracSuite Security Token** from the Authentication Method drop-down list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602012085/1453123f9f893fff99e8dd65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=973a6768637aaf4059fef02d98644a762602aed0933e3f863731b0cd610aa082&req=ciAlFsh8nYlaFb4f3HP0gEf5kXRifjl%2FF7P9RM86t%2Ffbso3ThQORH2uKK7o6%0AK2xhK4SkssVFW5uyiQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602012085/1453123f9f893fff99e8dd65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=973a6768637aaf4059fef02d98644a762602aed0933e3f863731b0cd610aa082&req=ciAlFsh8nYlaFb4f3HP0gEf5kXRifjl%2FF7P9RM86t%2Ffbso3ThQORH2uKK7o6%0AK2xhK4SkssVFW5uyiQ%3D%3D%0A)

3\. Enter the serial number found on the back of the PracSuite Security Token.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602011988/e97f31b4d4cf22cbfd38c945/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4064b121b1e2846b980046d032b2b5b48838a60edc424c110a5e8e5fa29c66c&req=ciAlFsh%2FlIlXFb4f3HP0gJOAz%2FZDJAX5wX0%2BSFV6ChFZQNBPKMYkUEGgZCFE%0A%2B4oCrXCmr%2BFFIlVl8g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602011988/e97f31b4d4cf22cbfd38c945/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4064b121b1e2846b980046d032b2b5b48838a60edc424c110a5e8e5fa29c66c&req=ciAlFsh%2FlIlXFb4f3HP0gJOAz%2FZDJAX5wX0%2BSFV6ChFZQNBPKMYkUEGgZCFE%0A%2B4oCrXCmr%2BFFIlVl8g%3D%3D%0A)

4\. Press the PracSuite logo on the token and enter the verification code.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/374350526/07d9d0e5ea16ca3fcf3f1e71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e93a38443d6502f70c2db4a15e28f8dd128cdba45fe1d7d72d5a30ac25d974de&req=dycjFcx%2BmINZFb4f3HP0gNBHF6wkKCXP6cxLJO%2BxsFlv6t0%2FqUSk0s0reTn3%0AUZ6HYbx3AayYmifLUg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/374350526/07d9d0e5ea16ca3fcf3f1e71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e93a38443d6502f70c2db4a15e28f8dd128cdba45fe1d7d72d5a30ac25d974de&req=dycjFcx%2BmINZFb4f3HP0gNBHF6wkKCXP6cxLJO%2BxsFlv6t0%2FqUSk0s0reTn3%0AUZ6HYbx3AayYmifLUg%3D%3D%0A)

5\. Once successfully verified, you will be able to login using the token.

Enabling the Gmail Integration

Enabling the Gmail Integration
==============================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Linking Gmail accounts to PracSuite Businesses](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration#h_df40059c41)

[Adding a Gmail account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration#h_a683377890)

[Adding Gmail Aliases / Send As Email Addresses to PracSuite Businesses](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration#h_ee838b602c)

[Configuring Outbound Email Settings per Business](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration#h_5b4de264d1)

[Linking an individual PracSuite user to a Gmail account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration#h_71adf0c85f)

[Selecting Gmail Accounts When Composing Emails](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration#h_88bbf9dd09)

By default, PracSuite sends email using our built-in email gateway (Send via PracSuite), which suits the majority of users. PracSuite also integrates with Gmail so that emails can be sent through your Google accounts instead of Send via PracSuite.

A key benefit of this integration is that sent emails will appear in the Sent folder of the Gmail account. A disadvantage compared to the Send via PracSuite option is that PracSuite is unable to receive information regarding an email being delivered or failed, so emails will only appear as Sent in the Messages tab of Patient and Payer files.

This article covers:

*   [Linking Gmail accounts to PracSuite Businesses](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration#h_df40059c41)
    
*   [Adding Gmail aliases to PracSuite Businesses](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration#h_ee838b602c)
    
*   [Linking an individual PracSuite user to a Gmail account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration#h_71adf0c85f)
    
*   [Selecting Gmail accounts when composing emails](http://Selecting%20Gmail%20Accounts%20When%20Composing%20Emails)
    

To enable this integration, go to **[Settings > Integrations > Gmail](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/gmail)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602013985/4bb017a6b55e586233778314/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de86c668a1d588c129095cabeb62843776ae0a2d84fa68956b941798e2951113&req=ciAlFsh9lIlaFb4f3HP0gKQ1Tu%2BUeDJrHetIPbUnqTubt0iFLftVbojmqi%2Fz%0AigyFbpIDu%2BZv6h2ebw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602013985/4bb017a6b55e586233778314/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de86c668a1d588c129095cabeb62843776ae0a2d84fa68956b941798e2951113&req=ciAlFsh9lIlaFb4f3HP0gKQ1Tu%2BUeDJrHetIPbUnqTubt0iFLftVbojmqi%2Fz%0AigyFbpIDu%2BZv6h2ebw%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Edit** and **enable** the toggle.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602014131/8986435eceedcc9476db5b79/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6cf4bdfb042ce1de7ff004ace7f6a5ee752c257ae8f2a253bca93e71f39c9e9f&req=ciAlFsh6nIJeFb4f3HP0gLTSGm6raITDW58bYHT0zuSpq6gVqpo13Wy%2Brwo%2B%0AHa6ieJRP%2Fr9XK5N9BA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602014131/8986435eceedcc9476db5b79/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6cf4bdfb042ce1de7ff004ace7f6a5ee752c257ae8f2a253bca93e71f39c9e9f&req=ciAlFsh6nIJeFb4f3HP0gLTSGm6raITDW58bYHT0zuSpq6gVqpo13Wy%2Brwo%2B%0AHa6ieJRP%2Fr9XK5N9BA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Linking Gmail accounts to PracSuite Businesses**
==================================================

Adding a Gmail account
----------------------

Under the Business Emails heading, select **Add** to start the setup process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602014277/015a8588a5ea977ef1cbe8e9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cb4989adeec91e4a7409ee290d5c2fa6f9e43d65c756f5ae5b47794b3f145362&req=ciAlFsh6n4ZYFb4f3HP0gOTrv7eRmve47DxhcyKkhSLsYAdBcby8dVrRxdKw%0AHfKyWmRGo8aWCC6Qdg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602014277/015a8588a5ea977ef1cbe8e9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cb4989adeec91e4a7409ee290d5c2fa6f9e43d65c756f5ae5b47794b3f145362&req=ciAlFsh6n4ZYFb4f3HP0gOTrv7eRmve47DxhcyKkhSLsYAdBcby8dVrRxdKw%0AHfKyWmRGo8aWCC6Qdg%3D%3D%0A)

The following prompt will appear:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602014404/7ca410555036d35d797ddf9c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e14ff4b06184ec29dcfa12b3ad915216e781cc63e18aa306221bb13a046425f8&req=ciAlFsh6mYFbFb4f3HP0gOsF%2BzKZGdzwDVxFvzv9Ah0bPOnqjq19w9TIi2AZ%0Aly3BUat4hDQ4zSAr7Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602014404/7ca410555036d35d797ddf9c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e14ff4b06184ec29dcfa12b3ad915216e781cc63e18aa306221bb13a046425f8&req=ciAlFsh6mYFbFb4f3HP0gOsF%2BzKZGdzwDVxFvzv9Ah0bPOnqjq19w9TIi2AZ%0Aly3BUat4hDQ4zSAr7Q%3D%3D%0A)

After clicking **Sign in with Google**, you will be directed to log in with the Google account you wish to add to PracSuite. After entering your Google credentials, you will need to authorise PracSuite to send emails on your behalf. You must select this option to proceed with configuring the integration.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/377260766/22eae0876e2d5f63e4acd58f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ff065b7e5f8e9090ab7cdca14430878381ef355e79cefbdaaee0ffb918a03d7c&req=dycgFM9%2BmodZFb4f3HP0gGQ%2BxMgr8JFZpjnau1tINU8grGadcHZe7weibGah%0ApELJZn0vMUWPEQc%2BoQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/377260766/22eae0876e2d5f63e4acd58f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ff065b7e5f8e9090ab7cdca14430878381ef355e79cefbdaaee0ffb918a03d7c&req=dycgFM9%2BmodZFb4f3HP0gGQ%2BxMgr8JFZpjnau1tINU8grGadcHZe7weibGah%0ApELJZn0vMUWPEQc%2BoQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once verified, the Gmail account will be added to the list of available accounts.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602018886/146e3d06ffbfcccce7872e4c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a46fdd4f3f32265592aa1581e16a32c1bce006fe8180fb5f45be91ae5cd6d7a2&req=ciAlFsh2lYlZFb4f3HP0gAqD1p6zSi8E9FlAoiEnhY%2FZjRtT8C5NX0s285zU%0ABe9525cAPaScyDRH2g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602018886/146e3d06ffbfcccce7872e4c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a46fdd4f3f32265592aa1581e16a32c1bce006fe8180fb5f45be91ae5cd6d7a2&req=ciAlFsh2lYlZFb4f3HP0gAqD1p6zSi8E9FlAoiEnhY%2FZjRtT8C5NX0s285zU%0ABe9525cAPaScyDRH2g%3D%3D%0A)

Edit the **Sender Name** and select the **Access** button to determine which Businesses can send email using this Google account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602019318/2db179f0c0570e9d8828d065/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49e389addcc95f2154790ed5744290bbd57f6efeb2e775e14b2c3362d4733c54&req=ciAlFsh3noBXFb4f3HP0gGH5ATU7qN8iP8JXt2H1ZwfJSv%2FYmCUWzO48jN%2FZ%0AEUYewgVlrsjp%2BGvI0A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602019318/2db179f0c0570e9d8828d065/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49e389addcc95f2154790ed5744290bbd57f6efeb2e775e14b2c3362d4733c54&req=ciAlFsh3noBXFb4f3HP0gGH5ATU7qN8iP8JXt2H1ZwfJSv%2FYmCUWzO48jN%2FZ%0AEUYewgVlrsjp%2BGvI0A%3D%3D%0A)

Repeat this process as many times as required for all of your Google accounts.

Note: If PracSuite fails to authenticate with Google, all places where that account is selected will revert back to Send via PracSuite. The account will need to be verified again in [Settings > Integrations > Gmail](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/gmail)
 before it can be selected again on Businesses.

Adding Gmail Aliases / Send As Email Addresses to PracSuite Businesses
----------------------------------------------------------------------

After registering Gmail accounts, aliases associated with these accounts can also be added to PracSuite using the Add button under the **Send As Email Addresses** heading.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602019816/202d3cd0195f375558c973d5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72be2c5e08e692e961ff95537f682f04d95176b5484f57333f289493185b8be7&req=ciAlFsh3lYBZFb4f3HP0gLZopbD5MLknAuOPV0TpZCMNs4gzwmSkPDnVPrRI%0AYlgXUNyq14OB8VWfUw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602019816/202d3cd0195f375558c973d5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72be2c5e08e692e961ff95537f682f04d95176b5484f57333f289493185b8be7&req=ciAlFsh3lYBZFb4f3HP0gLZopbD5MLknAuOPV0TpZCMNs4gzwmSkPDnVPrRI%0AYlgXUNyq14OB8VWfUw%3D%3D%0A)

Edit the Sender Name and select the Access button to determine which Businesses can send email using this Google alias.

------------------------------------------------

 > select a Business > click Edit**.

Scroll down to the **Outbound Email** section to select your preferences.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602021159/e655d175be5bdf217a175388/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=798071fbceaba8d759c43a8e853b8620e6a1d067184a38ba4b7a566f8dcf4992&req=ciAlFst%2FnIRWFb4f3HP0gMuiEoFAyVl2d5BAJylpruK%2BgBIRlnE%2B1bbjTlhc%0Au3Fo0YDJGdobF9l5KA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602021159/e655d175be5bdf217a175388/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=798071fbceaba8d759c43a8e853b8620e6a1d067184a38ba4b7a566f8dcf4992&req=ciAlFst%2FnIRWFb4f3HP0gMuiEoFAyVl2d5BAJylpruK%2BgBIRlnE%2B1bbjTlhc%0Au3Fo0YDJGdobF9l5KA%3D%3D%0A)

Repeat this step for all the Businesses that should use Gmail addresses to send emails.

**.

Users with this permission will then be able to access the **Manage Email Addresses** option from the user menu in the top right corner of PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/908915293/45e236416c0c42d1e9b94357/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a70b924cd032bd2f5483071e6af096cbf219476f508ae8fd6ad5c129b6113d40&req=fSAvH8h7n4hcFb4f3HP0gEi2MoxXQ8pwxHsuCuk4rpxFW8kf%2FAHQ2KksqDht%0ADrSCpIt%2ByghNwjG2ag%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/908915293/45e236416c0c42d1e9b94357/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a70b924cd032bd2f5483071e6af096cbf219476f508ae8fd6ad5c129b6113d40&req=fSAvH8h7n4hcFb4f3HP0gEi2MoxXQ8pwxHsuCuk4rpxFW8kf%2FAHQ2KksqDht%0ADrSCpIt%2ByghNwjG2ag%3D%3D%0A)

Once the individual user account is linked, this same option, **Manage Email Addresses** option will allow the user to how they would like to send emails through PracSuite, including options to register alias addresses.

Enabling the Outlook Integration

Enabling the Outlook Integration
================================

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Linking an Outlook account with PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_be711d9bfe)

[Linking an Outlook 'Send As' address with PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_eba1760b94)

[Configuring Outbound Email Settings per Business](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_4576ce4ef7)

[Linking an individual PracSuite user to an Outlook account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_936c578e7b)

[Selecting Outlook Accounts When Composing Emails](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_ecfb0b942e)

[Managing API Permissions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_1cfb1db9bd)

By default, PracSuite sends emails using our built-in email gateway (Send via PracSuite), which suits the majority of users. PracSuite also integrates with Outlook, including Microsoft 365, so that emails can be sent through these accounts instead of Send via PracSuite.

A key benefit of this integration is that sent emails will appear in the Sent folder of the Outlook account. A disadvantage compared to the Send via PracSuite option is that PracSuite is unable to receive information regarding an email being delivered or failed, so emails will only appear as Sent in the Messages tab of Patient and Payer files.

This article covers:

*   [Linking an Outlook account with PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_be711d9bfe)
    
*   [Linking an Outlook 'Send As' address with PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_eba1760b94)
    
*   [Configuring Outbound Email Settings per Business](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_4576ce4ef7)
    
*   [Linking an individual PracSuite user to an Outlook account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_936c578e7b)
    
*   [Selecting Outlook accounts when composing emails](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration#h_ecfb0b942e)
    

To enable this integration, go to [Settings > Integrations > Outlook](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/outlook)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631906362/24d12fd38dbb4a3fbd9403e0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aff2b3f7d6064fa285ffc76755d782ebba9e546f94378010c674a47105deab30&req=ciMmH8l4noddFb4f3HP0gJs9aV9hLczdF0HjSJOZlGWZaiv8WmfUonxNYVvb%0AbaUlCznf2VJY0WyzBg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631906362/24d12fd38dbb4a3fbd9403e0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aff2b3f7d6064fa285ffc76755d782ebba9e546f94378010c674a47105deab30&req=ciMmH8l4noddFb4f3HP0gJs9aV9hLczdF0HjSJOZlGWZaiv8WmfUonxNYVvb%0AbaUlCznf2VJY0WyzBg%3D%3D%0A)

Linking an Outlook account with PracSuite
=========================================

Under the Business Emails heading, select **Add** to start the setup process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631906412/a4749157753b2b15333c265e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0bea6e4ad3787ba3d06c7aea6a5b43f329afd5f9db9372d7085a342f523076f5&req=ciMmH8l4mYBdFb4f3HP0gCbCdeNrRZtZm6gSpmQCoNEKrAFXqf75J2vaenv0%0AvZLnl2ystwOuejrj7g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631906412/a4749157753b2b15333c265e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0bea6e4ad3787ba3d06c7aea6a5b43f329afd5f9db9372d7085a342f523076f5&req=ciMmH8l4mYBdFb4f3HP0gCbCdeNrRZtZm6gSpmQCoNEKrAFXqf75J2vaenv0%0AvZLnl2ystwOuejrj7g%3D%3D%0A)

After clicking continue, you will be directed to log in with your Outlook account. After entering your credentials, you will need to authorise PracSuite to send email on your behalf.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/377264791/9effb2afdc0e3da99e489d40/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=685165904028f281a9a00716b68819886e1882ae6b9d64d6c8d86f92b5c4da43&req=dycgFM96moheFb4f3HP0gAFP7m0fET%2BUBSYocdBkvIgMLXLhHsoZYM%2BHd9%2F4%0Ab0zD%2BFSoqeQ%2FfiI0lg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/377264791/9effb2afdc0e3da99e489d40/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=685165904028f281a9a00716b68819886e1882ae6b9d64d6c8d86f92b5c4da43&req=dycgFM96moheFb4f3HP0gAFP7m0fET%2BUBSYocdBkvIgMLXLhHsoZYM%2BHd9%2F4%0Ab0zD%2BFSoqeQ%2FfiI0lg%3D%3D%0A)

If you're presented with a message stating that Administrator approval is required to allow PracSuite access, you will need to provide this access from within your Office 365 account.  
​  
Please see the section titled ''**Managing API Permissions''** at the bottom of this article for more information.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631907069/c9ed75b9aff7151fdef65333/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f6bd77a64a86609e157e3165929810cb99e3519d078589debb217b883ceba20&req=ciMmH8l5nYdWFb4f3HP0gNbpoG5RTnDpTp85qd%2FZk%2BOgRa1yuZ8Gqd2Vg2M7%0AwQcLl7jHra7IVnrhjA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631907069/c9ed75b9aff7151fdef65333/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f6bd77a64a86609e157e3165929810cb99e3519d078589debb217b883ceba20&req=ciMmH8l5nYdWFb4f3HP0gNbpoG5RTnDpTp85qd%2FZk%2BOgRa1yuZ8Gqd2Vg2M7%0AwQcLl7jHra7IVnrhjA%3D%3D%0A)

Edit the Sender Name and select the Access button to determine which Businesses this Outlook account is available to.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631907172/2014cd2c8b964b0b27c33809/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee1124fe4aad85600b76744869621df1ac21637cfcd532741f735d78c6d74592&req=ciMmH8l5nIZdFb4f3HP0gGe4SyBm%2BmN2R%2Fjoc2yq85zYs9oi4HdVkZ%2Fp0cZo%0As8tZu8ev%2BD2QnHQYEg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631907172/2014cd2c8b964b0b27c33809/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee1124fe4aad85600b76744869621df1ac21637cfcd532741f735d78c6d74592&req=ciMmH8l5nIZdFb4f3HP0gGe4SyBm%2BmN2R%2Fjoc2yq85zYs9oi4HdVkZ%2Fp0cZo%0As8tZu8ev%2BD2QnHQYEg%3D%3D%0A)

Repeat this process as many times as required for all of your Outlook accounts.

Linking an Outlook 'Send As' address with PracSuite
===================================================

After linking an Outlook account to PracSuite, you can also register Outlook Send As addresses that are available to that Outlook account, including shared mailboxes and distribution lists.

Note: To successfully send emails from a 'Send As' address via PracSuite, your [Outlook 365 permissions must permit the Outlook user to be able to Send As](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/solutions/allow-members-to-send-as-or-send-on-behalf-of-group?view=o365-worldwide)
 the appropriate email address. Contact your Outlook administrator for further assistance.

On the Outlook Integration settings page, scroll to the **Send As Email Addresses** section and select **Add**.

Enter the Send As Email Address, and provide access to this address to the relevant Businesses.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631907445/71ecbcccb70071c370412ee6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2c361b65ba30a22e99bd07dea7428f9f56a15cd2bcdfab6a1238c21d64e6c18&req=ciMmH8l5mYVaFb4f3HP0gLFPzWlWPJ9OEpQkKAu2NXuRyYuXYgqAaJ3Gy8gp%0AiaaAsfnA4KfOMKghhQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631907445/71ecbcccb70071c370412ee6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2c361b65ba30a22e99bd07dea7428f9f56a15cd2bcdfab6a1238c21d64e6c18&req=ciMmH8l5mYVaFb4f3HP0gLFPzWlWPJ9OEpQkKAu2NXuRyYuXYgqAaJ3Gy8gp%0AiaaAsfnA4KfOMKghhQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Configuring Outbound Email Settings per Business
================================================

After adding Outlook accounts to PracSuite, the final step is to review the Outbound email settings set for each of your Businesses in [Settings > Businesses.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/businesses)
 set Outlook as the Default Email Method and to select the appropriate email address per Business in

After scrolling to the bottom of each Business, you'll find the Outbound Email section where you can change the Default Email Method to Outlook and select the appropriate Outlook account to send from.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631908528/500d6f32437d94b4acd18cb2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bc9435564d76ad5568e4acfb3f959b18922e9d5ae7eddb189963047f3de44d33&req=ciMmH8l2mINXFb4f3HP0gIPWyq46JaFBPpFmGizJyKewol9%2BNPv49VPnTQ%2BI%0AnHXcxW9DHoTthU27SA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631908528/500d6f32437d94b4acd18cb2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bc9435564d76ad5568e4acfb3f959b18922e9d5ae7eddb189963047f3de44d33&req=ciMmH8l2mINXFb4f3HP0gIPWyq46JaFBPpFmGizJyKewol9%2BNPv49VPnTQ%2BI%0AnHXcxW9DHoTthU27SA%3D%3D%0A)

Repeat this step for all the Businesses that should use Outlook addresses to send emails.

Note: If PracSuite fails to authenticate with Outlook at any time in the future, all Businesses selected to use that account will revert back to Send via PracSuite. The Outlook account will need to be re-verified in Settings > Integrations > Outlook before it can be used again for emailing.

* * *

Linking an individual PracSuite user to an Outlook account
==========================================================

The Outlook integration also allows individual users to link their own Outlook account to PracSuite, which will be available only to that user when manually composing emails. To allow your users to link their specific email with PracSuite, the following setting must be enabled in [Settings > Integrations > Outlook](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/outlook)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386335019/5d4e410ced6dd7a0028bcedb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=97be4f8fedf32df6f4f8557e7e40cffe6fc934cea27f206d9e7358177dc2e287&req=dyghFcp7nYBWFb4f3HP0gONu9O%2Felv7y6BpvC85yRqxd7r5u%2BC%2F%2B7nSrDrFR%0ABtvGQN03DLG5m3Le5g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386335019/5d4e410ced6dd7a0028bcedb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=97be4f8fedf32df6f4f8557e7e40cffe6fc934cea27f206d9e7358177dc2e287&req=dyghFcp7nYBWFb4f3HP0gONu9O%2Felv7y6BpvC85yRqxd7r5u%2BC%2F%2B7nSrDrFR%0ABtvGQN03DLG5m3Le5g%3D%3D%0A)

Users with this permission will then be able to access the **Manage Email Addresses** option from the user menu in the top right corner of PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/908916351/6937346a26be1de31a0159a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=756710177ae7f5c2f0915bdbcdd788a8fbf4a9af2b07d46977ad50fdf521f390&req=fSAvH8h4noReFb4f3HP0gI7CFrbJYdeyTc%2FkaY1B%2FdNbxHQtY%2BiCC5DsPl5o%0AsmkhW%2BpyAUYKhUjDwA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/908916351/6937346a26be1de31a0159a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=756710177ae7f5c2f0915bdbcdd788a8fbf4a9af2b07d46977ad50fdf521f390&req=fSAvH8h4noReFb4f3HP0gI7CFrbJYdeyTc%2FkaY1B%2FdNbxHQtY%2BiCC5DsPl5o%0AsmkhW%2BpyAUYKhUjDwA%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting this option, they will be directed to sign in with Outlook.

Once the individual user account is linked, using the same **Manage Email Addresses** option, this will allow the user to choose how they would like to send emails through PracSuite.

In the Manage Email Addresses prompt, the user can override their sender email from Send via PracSuite to their Outlook account. They also have the option to send from this email address when composing emails.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/545459556/028977c259f5c76df40b9725/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=120fce4ca4f494b983c344e0b5453110258d8b65a05acfcc5f887ae60937b9d8&req=cSQiEsx3mIRZFb4f3HP0gNj%2FvQBaUxmIT1i847P3MHzxNHnhJwE0iY69sUMr%0AGh3isuWlPP25GZnMDA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/545459556/028977c259f5c76df40b9725/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=120fce4ca4f494b983c344e0b5453110258d8b65a05acfcc5f887ae60937b9d8&req=cSQiEsx3mIRZFb4f3HP0gNj%2FvQBaUxmIT1i847P3MHzxNHnhJwE0iY69sUMr%0AGh3isuWlPP25GZnMDA%3D%3D%0A)

Send As email addresses for the individual user can also be configured.

Selecting Outlook Accounts When Composing Emails
================================================

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/377266209/3884b3126c7ea8c7e8fffe35/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c11541e6e5643904b252d2e192c18bf918aef7d5ccd150195f26302a8ac21fa1&req=dycgFM94n4FWFb4f3HP0gKEzDfj52jSrnLgyfCjDU68J2PFFX%2BrKFzDIXrPU%0Ak88qcQfIr17fnXWkfQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/377266209/3884b3126c7ea8c7e8fffe35/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c11541e6e5643904b252d2e192c18bf918aef7d5ccd150195f26302a8ac21fa1&req=dycgFM94n4FWFb4f3HP0gKEzDfj52jSrnLgyfCjDU68J2PFFX%2BrKFzDIXrPU%0Ak88qcQfIr17fnXWkfQ%3D%3D%0A)

Managing API Permissions
========================

If you're presented with a message stating that Administrator approval is required to allow PracSuite access, you will need to provide this access from within your Office 365 account.

While making changes to your Microsoft account is outside of our support scope, these general steps should point you in the right direction. This would need to be completed by a user with access to the **Microsoft admin portal**.  
​﻿  
​﻿**How to manage API permissions in Microsoft Entra:**  
​﻿

1.  **Go to the Microsoft Entra admin portal**  
    ​[https://entra.microsoft.com](https://entra.microsoft.com/)
      
    Sign in with your Microsoft 365 admin account.  
    ​
    
2.  **Open Identity**  
    On the left, go to **Identity**.  
    ​
    
3.  **Choose Applications**  
    Go to the section titled **App registrations**.  
    ​
    
4.  **Select the app**  
    Find the app that corresponds to your PracSuite integration.  
    ​
    
5.  **API Permissions**  
    Inside the app, open **API Permissions**.  
    ​  
    This is where you can:
    

*   Add or remove permissions
    
*   Click **Grant admin consent** if required
    

If you have any issues in granting this access the next step would be to contact Microsoft for support.

Once permission is granted and your account is verified, the Outlook account will be added to the list of available accounts.

How to Merge Duplicate Patient Files

How to Merge Duplicate Patient Files
====================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[1\. Selecting patient files to merge](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504546-how-to-merge-duplicate-patient-files#h_54a37f04e3)

[2\. Merging accounts](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504546-how-to-merge-duplicate-patient-files#h_5379219b5b)

[3\. Finalising the merge process](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504546-how-to-merge-duplicate-patient-files#h_da191e2925)

[4\. Archiving or deleting the source patient file](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504546-how-to-merge-duplicate-patient-files#h_61a0178f0f)

The Merge Patient tool allows you to consolidate duplicate patient files. This article refers to the **source patient** as the duplicate file that will be archived or removed following the merge. The **destination patient** is the file that will receive the data from the source patient and will continue to be used following the completion of the merge process.

⚠ **This tool must be used with caution as it is not possible to reverse this action** ⚠

While the aim of the Merge Patient tool is to move as much data from the source patient to the destination patient, some user intervention may be required. Standing data, such as the patient’s **Name**, **Address**, **Phone Numbers** and **Medicare Number** may still need to be updated manually. This is necessary because these fields on the source and destination may contain conflicting data, and only the user can identify the latest and most accurate information to retain follow the merge.

**1\. Selecting patient files to merge**
========================================

Navigate to the **source patient file** (the duplicate file), select the **Cog icon** at the top of the page and select **Merge Patient**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601967991/4139ac6536109177c976ab38/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c72a2d75c3c935677c71b86c69b761017e4cbdc582fe7712779da83e04bcb51e&req=ciAmH895lIheFb4f3HP0gB%2F3jv%2FYRPwaw6%2FNJjr9Q7XMyGvsBBN8vPo%2BgEqr%0A4nfeUPCrLw74m1T0Tw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601967991/4139ac6536109177c976ab38/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c72a2d75c3c935677c71b86c69b761017e4cbdc582fe7712779da83e04bcb51e&req=ciAmH895lIheFb4f3HP0gB%2F3jv%2FYRPwaw6%2FNJjr9Q7XMyGvsBBN8vPo%2BgEqr%0A4nfeUPCrLw74m1T0Tw%3D%3D%0A)

A list of possible duplicate files are displayed along with the option to manually search for the **destination patient file**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968100/26b593915760cdc3a9a30938/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ddc5965294a7b17e3e86c2401327c89cd5eb19c9ab55f9bde6f4c184035d2d7&req=ciAmH892nIFfFb4f3HP0gHy29juW%2F1gwH7xWnPNtMyl%2FQBGnaMI4IHXga9cd%0AXbJkOVw6atNFLFkhSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968100/26b593915760cdc3a9a30938/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ddc5965294a7b17e3e86c2401327c89cd5eb19c9ab55f9bde6f4c184035d2d7&req=ciAmH892nIFfFb4f3HP0gHy29juW%2F1gwH7xWnPNtMyl%2FQBGnaMI4IHXga9cd%0AXbJkOVw6atNFLFkhSQ%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting the destination patient file, you will see a comparison of basic patient details and an overview of the contents of both files. If required, use the **Switch button** to reverse the direction of the merge.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968241/9a8cbbd375499fe02b144e1a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45f2773c6d0f5346da882c06514d42c6da0747f0fe377bde2179c93d41f5bcd2&req=ciAmH892n4VeFb4f3HP0gKPTtSOxn6e7ViGwR8qjThLVUciszPY%2BjRYKO2z8%0AQX3ObKi6GDbhqsTg%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968241/9a8cbbd375499fe02b144e1a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45f2773c6d0f5346da882c06514d42c6da0747f0fe377bde2179c93d41f5bcd2&req=ciAmH892n4VeFb4f3HP0gKPTtSOxn6e7ViGwR8qjThLVUciszPY%2BjRYKO2z8%0AQX3ObKi6GDbhqsTg%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)

**2\. Merging accounts**
========================

The main action required is to select where the account and related invoice and payment data on the source patient should be transferred to on the destination patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968458/50dc7e44e26313a89051dc82/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=156405ac54f0951bc7fc3589fd67430bb0f5aa041481cca7634104fab3965335&req=ciAmH892mYRXFb4f3HP0gB%2BSzj4LADXhjckFDKEjNNH3fEmJHmQbo32DGU7K%0ACr%2FoP6Z9QD%2B9yHq0sQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968458/50dc7e44e26313a89051dc82/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=156405ac54f0951bc7fc3589fd67430bb0f5aa041481cca7634104fab3965335&req=ciAmH892mYRXFb4f3HP0gB%2BSzj4LADXhjckFDKEjNNH3fEmJHmQbo32DGU7K%0ACr%2FoP6Z9QD%2B9yHq0sQ%3D%3D%0A)

It is only possible to merge certain types of accounts together:

*   Private type accounts can only be merge into another Private type account.
    
*   Third-Party Linked accounts can only be moved to the destination file as a new account.
    
*   Family accounts can only be merged into another Family account if both files belong to the same family.
    

**3\. Finalising the merge process**
====================================

After reviewing the account details, the final step is to **Confirm** the merge process.

⚠ **Proceed with caution as it is not possible to reverse this action** ⚠

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968616/74190053f8f9dd01360e15aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dce4881f8721cd8b0aabeb263eb0f212a943c14bf47a9f0993b997a9e4b684aa&req=ciAmH892m4BZFb4f3HP0gCX8GS%2FX1VFSxmBBzo9dP9nzphthYZInKS20kwPW%0AvBpIfkdJMs5n6IEAkA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968616/74190053f8f9dd01360e15aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dce4881f8721cd8b0aabeb263eb0f212a943c14bf47a9f0993b997a9e4b684aa&req=ciAmH892m4BZFb4f3HP0gCX8GS%2FX1VFSxmBBzo9dP9nzphthYZInKS20kwPW%0AvBpIfkdJMs5n6IEAkA%3D%3D%0A)

**4\. Archiving or deleting the source patient file**
=====================================================

Once the merge process has been completed successfully, you will be asked what you would like to do with the source patient file.

As mentioned at the start of this article, standing data, such as the patient’s **Name**, **Address**, **Phone Numbers** and **Medicare Number** may still need to be updated manually. This is necessary because these fields on the source and destination may contain conflicting data, and only the user can identify the latest and most accurate information to retain follow the merge.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968674/d2aa6f303a0279b5ded52a1b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df24cbc64beed10fdd5be438320cd3dc9f3b14123fdd6df6a01c4d4058a0fec0&req=ciAmH892m4ZbFb4f3HP0gH7y9oQ2iOEfig7K2uIvlBYGDKwZbLnQ4%2FspDz9X%0Av3MaZvH2KXvlYslEhw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601968674/d2aa6f303a0279b5ded52a1b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df24cbc64beed10fdd5be438320cd3dc9f3b14123fdd6df6a01c4d4058a0fec0&req=ciAmH892m4ZbFb4f3HP0gH7y9oQ2iOEfig7K2uIvlBYGDKwZbLnQ4%2FspDz9X%0Av3MaZvH2KXvlYslEhw%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 187 — Pairing a Tyro Health EFTPOS Terminal | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-187}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550066-pairing-a-tyro-health-eftpos-terminal](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550066-pairing-a-tyro-health-eftpos-terminal)

Pairing a Tyro Health EFTPOS Terminal

Pairing a Tyro Health EFTPOS Terminal
=====================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Completing the Pairing Process](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550066-pairing-a-tyro-health-eftpos-terminal#h_c8230095fc)

[General Settings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550066-pairing-a-tyro-health-eftpos-terminal#h_17e27c88a9)

_💡Tip: [If your Tyro terminal has been paired with other software in the past, make sure you clear existing Tyro terminal pairings before starting this process.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6360654-how-to-clear-tyro-terminal-pairings)
_

To add and pair a Tyro terminal with PracSuite, go to **[Settings > Integrations > Tyro Health EFTPOS](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/tyro)
**.

Click the **Add** button within the **Terminals** section.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636215394/984cd01d8dfd4279c716fa15/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c046dfca5823fe2bd72fa8b2854ab34f8c0b28eab96b816c723301ed2be58b8&req=ciMhFMh7nohbFb4f3HP0gFBl2Y6vuStptqazpgaXZZ2BhodXF4yXEawenvOV%0AttYFRalaSHmMgKp6KQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636215394/984cd01d8dfd4279c716fa15/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c046dfca5823fe2bd72fa8b2854ab34f8c0b28eab96b816c723301ed2be58b8&req=ciMhFMh7nohbFb4f3HP0gFBl2Y6vuStptqazpgaXZZ2BhodXF4yXEawenvOV%0AttYFRalaSHmMgKp6KQ%3D%3D%0A)

This will take you to a new page to enter the **Terminal Name**, **Terminal ID** and **Merchant ID** of the Tyro terminal. A **Business** must also be selected, which represents the businesses that will use this terminal.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861201258/2f49660db7abe735a1aeb262/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b3dfe5c8b52aeea674c140d81463c7128f8f8b563c76c66b3bdbe4612c003308&req=fCYmFMl%2Fn4RXFb4f3HP0gHTlrNgJZtzZLYaT4ueqE0sUqJl0CkxnxkS17hwI%0A8oTKd%2BAS7a3rDF6wdg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861201258/2f49660db7abe735a1aeb262/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b3dfe5c8b52aeea674c140d81463c7128f8f8b563c76c66b3bdbe4612c003308&req=fCYmFMl%2Fn4RXFb4f3HP0gHTlrNgJZtzZLYaT4ueqE0sUqJl0CkxnxkS17hwI%0A8oTKd%2BAS7a3rDF6wdg%3D%3D%0A)

If required, **Merchant ID Overrides** can also be configured to allow different Merchant ID’s to be used for practitioners and businesses.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636215698/bf18086c11867b2afe85f20d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac7dd4bbdba8c47a4794e2b9928a2dcbb3ad9b4c417d37d6c2599a2f3de85ae2&req=ciMhFMh7m4hXFb4f3HP0gKTrdm1yKPQ2goTFQFnFkjzPa80v5Qqy4tpwEzJ1%0A2Pn9CVHPuRxofq%2FGpQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636215698/bf18086c11867b2afe85f20d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac7dd4bbdba8c47a4794e2b9928a2dcbb3ad9b4c417d37d6c2599a2f3de85ae2&req=ciMhFMh7m4hXFb4f3HP0gKTrdm1yKPQ2goTFQFnFkjzPa80v5Qqy4tpwEzJ1%0A2Pn9CVHPuRxofq%2FGpQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once you’re the details of your Tyro terminal have been entered, click **Pair & Save**.

Completing the Pairing Process
==============================

Follow the instructions in order to complete the pairing process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636215816/3b07012224c3ca442754ad4a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91bea9be7fc94317e44bd631b784fca79171d3d7b10244352929038f353e8038&req=ciMhFMh7lYBZFb4f3HP0gKOC3ggamYGnAtbTKOusq3bXci79xlD9VVyI0T91%0A3esgJTQsHkhUk%2FEzeA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636215816/3b07012224c3ca442754ad4a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=91bea9be7fc94317e44bd631b784fca79171d3d7b10244352929038f353e8038&req=ciMhFMh7lYBZFb4f3HP0gKOC3ggamYGnAtbTKOusq3bXci79xlD9VVyI0T91%0A3esgJTQsHkhUk%2FEzeA%3D%3D%0A)

Assuming you have entered the correct details and follow the above steps correctly, your terminal should now be paired with PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636216193/db899848a79bcb8ec3f4e090/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f3f654c493947489caec586d6a3ec28ebf0b9e249e3ed1c5c290c45059ffd3e&req=ciMhFMh4nIhcFb4f3HP0gEKW3u%2Bk5K9LfJR66IPfpW5P09VCyulLMB8%2BobbK%0AbXHW9nQ720O4vpXaqg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636216193/db899848a79bcb8ec3f4e090/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f3f654c493947489caec586d6a3ec28ebf0b9e249e3ed1c5c290c45059ffd3e&req=ciMhFMh4nIhcFb4f3HP0gEKW3u%2Bk5K9LfJR66IPfpW5P09VCyulLMB8%2BobbK%0AbXHW9nQ720O4vpXaqg%3D%3D%0A)

General Settings
================

Upon returning to the Tyro settings page, navigate to the **Professions** section and select an appropriate **Tyro Healthpoint Profession** for each of the professions in your PracSuite system.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636216310/c1cb299732366b00d79aeb3c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ce30c0fe453df77a725312f27268355536b95357a46416d8eb8d5669db060d8&req=ciMhFMh4noBfFb4f3HP0gDghE0%2F5yatGWM3W%2BIEAHeGBzfIcLLOrkNsbkeRj%0AYUcQufy3HyQRbw%2FBsg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636216310/c1cb299732366b00d79aeb3c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ce30c0fe453df77a725312f27268355536b95357a46416d8eb8d5669db060d8&req=ciMhFMh4noBfFb4f3HP0gDghE0%2F5yatGWM3W%2BIEAHeGBzfIcLLOrkNsbkeRj%0AYUcQufy3HyQRbw%2FBsg%3D%3D%0A)

If required, Healthpoint claiming via Tyro can be disabled for specific practitioners. This is recommended if you are in a multi-practitioner environment where some practitioners are unable to claim a private health fund rebate.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636216414/7fc6770682f89f6c48074a89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a0f5642d17fdc099ef07338bd4848b2b3908e1e5f273789a9c5e1400a1641a98&req=ciMhFMh4mYBbFb4f3HP0gLq67rG4cFpq9vc7isnYBLVDCgIOpq5o1QahonIm%0AQTkcmqeby2%2BrrjF5Gg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636216414/7fc6770682f89f6c48074a89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a0f5642d17fdc099ef07338bd4848b2b3908e1e5f273789a9c5e1400a1641a98&req=ciMhFMh4mYBbFb4f3HP0gLq67rG4cFpq9vc7isnYBLVDCgIOpq5o1QahonIm%0AQTkcmqeby2%2BrrjF5Gg%3D%3D%0A)

Processing a Health Fund Claim via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration

Processing a Health Fund Claim via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration
=====================================================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Configuring Item Codes to enable Health Fund Claiming](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550071-processing-a-health-fund-claim-via-the-tyro-health-eftpos-integration#h_2a3e023f71)

[Patient Health Fund Setup](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550071-processing-a-health-fund-claim-via-the-tyro-health-eftpos-integration#h_ffb044b7f3)

[Submitting a Health Fund Claim](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550071-processing-a-health-fund-claim-via-the-tyro-health-eftpos-integration#h_8f427e65db)

**Configuring Item Codes to enable Health Fund Claiming**
=========================================================

For an **Item Code** to be claimed through Tyro Healthpoint, it must first be enabled as a **Health Fund Item**.

Go to **[Settings](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
** [> **Billing** > **Item Codes**](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023181/9bbeb1cc9b58f8345ab414c6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80b4226a133c739cdb89ffc9a181d452237c355b6542af45dede4b092dee74af&req=ciAlFst9nIleFb4f3HP0gCPjAIGrFBkt%2Bpzwg4BKhvG%2FoBqJdotIZ1utTfdF%0AJoo4Ie6Cm%2B4Rb6E2RQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023181/9bbeb1cc9b58f8345ab414c6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80b4226a133c739cdb89ffc9a181d452237c355b6542af45dede4b092dee74af&req=ciAlFst9nIleFb4f3HP0gCPjAIGrFBkt%2Bpzwg4BKhvG%2FoBqJdotIZ1utTfdF%0AJoo4Ie6Cm%2B4Rb6E2RQ%3D%3D%0A)

From your list of available **Item Codes**, click on an item to open its settings.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023330/81f3c325ac40e905201e35bd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4872f6c1a4956bde76fc84073b8cd5db44695cefc1ad7336326f2e14866da847&req=ciAlFst9noJfFb4f3HP0gCFzgx3C5z3IXZxAClur97T2NnvRmD4e%2BsqurErj%0AuDYbZSf5XX7MLE29wQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023330/81f3c325ac40e905201e35bd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4872f6c1a4956bde76fc84073b8cd5db44695cefc1ad7336326f2e14866da847&req=ciAlFst9noJfFb4f3HP0gCFzgx3C5z3IXZxAClur97T2NnvRmD4e%2BsqurErj%0AuDYbZSf5XX7MLE29wQ%3D%3D%0A)

  
Click **Edit** and under the **Claiming Options** enable the **Health Fund Item** option.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023432/4c5f4331a8d33c89968a004e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96d867b52cf2c35ca205de287a6be2b40199ca44ea6d33b4970e08704d7e1e61&req=ciAlFst9mYJdFb4f3HP0gLeDSx9yfRJztmfDUIF1Idvb9P2uK%2FY8JOg8mqvd%0ASTSAwheoa5JdKG8WSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023432/4c5f4331a8d33c89968a004e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96d867b52cf2c35ca205de287a6be2b40199ca44ea6d33b4970e08704d7e1e61&req=ciAlFst9mYJdFb4f3HP0gLeDSx9yfRJztmfDUIF1Idvb9P2uK%2FY8JOg8mqvd%0ASTSAwheoa5JdKG8WSQ%3D%3D%0A)

If required, an **Override Code** can be entered if you need to submit a different code to Tyro Healthpoint when processing a claim. This is only necessary if your **Item Code** is not a valid Healthpoint code already.

**Patient Health Fund Setup**
=============================

A patient’s **Health Fund Information** can be entered pre-emptively on the patient file, so it is ready for use with Healthpoint claiming at the time of invoicing. This information is entered on the **Patient Details** tab of the patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023713/1402bca26d6a4f0e42af463b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=20e54b8259551b06631519ddef407bd2a90589654def7b7e243a5d1de41a5af1&req=ciAlFst9moBcFb4f3HP0gI0M1JhA2pnUaftoypMhZgjxII2qYesJs65tafIF%0AuXLMddwWVGJbrB%2BPBQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023713/1402bca26d6a4f0e42af463b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=20e54b8259551b06631519ddef407bd2a90589654def7b7e243a5d1de41a5af1&req=ciAlFst9moBcFb4f3HP0gI0M1JhA2pnUaftoypMhZgjxII2qYesJs65tafIF%0AuXLMddwWVGJbrB%2BPBQ%3D%3D%0A)

To enter the details, click **Edit** and under the **Health Fund & Benefits** section, select the patient’s **Health** **Fund** and then enter a:

*   **Member Number** (Membership number)
    
*   **ID** (patient’s number on the card)
    
*   **Card No.** (the issued card number, if applicable).
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023850/173ccce655c7c3e33701cb0e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80716621722787930e3959755ff7382dec82a7f0a2a8edafe32cb76e374e3ddf&req=ciAlFst9lYRfFb4f3HP0gBeF14sDMW5h8rx9FmK7JzT%2B%2Bu7ix4r8gWlx%2FQfX%0Akt0%2FAhkUlw0JXzeoNg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602023850/173ccce655c7c3e33701cb0e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80716621722787930e3959755ff7382dec82a7f0a2a8edafe32cb76e374e3ddf&req=ciAlFst9lYRfFb4f3HP0gBeF14sDMW5h8rx9FmK7JzT%2B%2Bu7ix4r8gWlx%2FQfX%0Akt0%2FAhkUlw0JXzeoNg%3D%3D%0A)

If these details have not already been entered into the patient file, you will be prompted to enter a **Member No.** and **Member ID** when attempting to submit a claim.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602024272/53cb0329cf5497e172897ae1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=529b8461be4ea2c6cf0703411a77f4eaa1818c7d13e81776ad978150603e7534&req=ciAlFst6n4ZdFb4f3HP0gJv1on8bdZA10FTYaqKoushB0XJdKuOO2LesyJZd%0ASMDsXW1bC5dySmZLMw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602024272/53cb0329cf5497e172897ae1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=529b8461be4ea2c6cf0703411a77f4eaa1818c7d13e81776ad978150603e7534&req=ciAlFst6n4ZdFb4f3HP0gJv1on8bdZA10FTYaqKoushB0XJdKuOO2LesyJZd%0ASMDsXW1bC5dySmZLMw%3D%3D%0A)

**Submitting a Health Fund Claim**
==================================

When creating an invoice and adding Health Fund claimable Item Codes, the Tyro button will appear with the option to submit a health fund claim.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861213697/fc17eb0ad792f75770596d55/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bac4d0b76678d4e083199806c0eb125c59b8ef7cb644eef12fbc221157fba8ba&req=fCYmFMh9m4hYFb4f3HP0gGEUpzl071DhNE44bmEVkVtA2AIIyl6jUHG2XPrO%0Ay2ykhTI73RFxQmH8Vg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861213697/fc17eb0ad792f75770596d55/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bac4d0b76678d4e083199806c0eb125c59b8ef7cb644eef12fbc221157fba8ba&req=fCYmFMh9m4hYFb4f3HP0gGEUpzl071DhNE44bmEVkVtA2AIIyl6jUHG2XPrO%0Ay2ykhTI73RFxQmH8Vg%3D%3D%0A)

After choosing which terminal to send the claim to, select the Health Fund Claim button. The Tyro popup will appear requesting you to swipe the patient's health fund card.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385409542/a2befed6ee3a1719f34cc9e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b24119a58989b11ad4b37b04cae354be689f7337425f8af7305f65eb657ad643&req=dygiEsl3mIVdFb4f3HP0gJpxl3tpHZzEBXfAltLThEvY%2BlaopvPghzwHJJAu%0AePfi6m3qPBgJ9%2BKEvQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385409542/a2befed6ee3a1719f34cc9e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b24119a58989b11ad4b37b04cae354be689f7337425f8af7305f65eb657ad643&req=dygiEsl3mIVdFb4f3HP0gJpxl3tpHZzEBXfAltLThEvY%2BlaopvPghzwHJJAu%0AePfi6m3qPBgJ9%2BKEvQ%3D%3D%0A)

After following the prompts in the Tyro popup, you'll receive a response. If the claim has been paid, you can accept the response.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386343689/a8f813f044e76872491ce8da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d934dbc5fde1f0bf40c801bc8fd72bbed2ac453dcd9211bc7331b6eb85101d70&req=dyghFc19m4lWFb4f3HP0gMQIJmz%2FjBAMnPG%2FGXNU%2F2nGgM8JFW9wv53g3DKD%0AhvYu3hndDI%2BuBPHKuA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386343689/a8f813f044e76872491ce8da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d934dbc5fde1f0bf40c801bc8fd72bbed2ac453dcd9211bc7331b6eb85101d70&req=dyghFc19m4lWFb4f3HP0gMQIJmz%2FjBAMnPG%2FGXNU%2F2nGgM8JFW9wv53g3DKD%0AhvYu3hndDI%2BuBPHKuA%3D%3D%0A)

The Health Fund benefit will automatically be added to the invoice and a popup advising the outstanding gap (balance) will be displayed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386343750/0a5e7237d98cfe14f15fb764/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=73941b0af5a76aab75cb06cc855769fab5dd23af7b2462bcb698b7464577642d&req=dyghFc19moRfFb4f3HP0gFxFEL59rW6SpkWTxDZ6tZRPyj5obudc7CgQ8l1c%0AXV%2B16rlVsE%2F%2Bk1Jz3g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386343750/0a5e7237d98cfe14f15fb764/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=73941b0af5a76aab75cb06cc855769fab5dd23af7b2462bcb698b7464577642d&req=dyghFc19moRfFb4f3HP0gFxFEL59rW6SpkWTxDZ6tZRPyj5obudc7CgQ8l1c%0AXV%2B16rlVsE%2F%2Bk1Jz3g%3D%3D%0A)

Payment for the gap amount (if applicable) can then be processed. [Click here for information on how to process a card payment via the Tyro integration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550072-processing-a-card-payment-via-the-tyro-integration)
.

Processing a Card Payment via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration

Processing a Card Payment via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration
================================================================

Updated over 2 years ago

To process a card payment via the Tyro Health EFTPOS integration, hover over the EFTPOS or Credit Card payment field and select the Tyro Health EFTPOS quick pay icon to pay the outstanding balance of the invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861211863/20d537c63878977ae567a865/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0e8bcb423305ff2e89c4942046b67d2f707ea08ca777562cb6465db2c763a080&req=fCYmFMh%2FlYdcFb4f3HP0gLhrbbjqUBTb6cpp0Id%2Fnm89%2F1WMgFAd0orUBZZ%2B%0Aye%2BecxIi%2BZpYYNErMg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861211863/20d537c63878977ae567a865/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0e8bcb423305ff2e89c4942046b67d2f707ea08ca777562cb6465db2c763a080&req=fCYmFMh%2FlYdcFb4f3HP0gLhrbbjqUBTb6cpp0Id%2Fnm89%2F1WMgFAd0orUBZZ%2B%0Aye%2BecxIi%2BZpYYNErMg%3D%3D%0A)

Alternatively, enter the amount to be paid into the EFTPOS or Credit Card field and select the **Tyro button** to send the entered amount to the terminal. The Terminal drop-down selector will be displayed if multiple Tyro Terminals are available at a particular business.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861212748/006dc2b9dea5510076a3a51a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=48ad2729e37393a6a044c5abb0abe473f099fd93dd963f9361ec8f41d0eb77e0&req=fCYmFMh8moVXFb4f3HP0gEmYjN4pYy01krvr32BXAIzizd7%2BUYTGUTYe%2F0ec%0Aqb6%2F5DWnUQRrJ8R%2Bjw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861212748/006dc2b9dea5510076a3a51a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=48ad2729e37393a6a044c5abb0abe473f099fd93dd963f9361ec8f41d0eb77e0&req=fCYmFMh8moVXFb4f3HP0gEmYjN4pYy01krvr32BXAIzizd7%2BUYTGUTYe%2F0ec%0Aqb6%2F5DWnUQRrJ8R%2Bjw%3D%3D%0A)

After swiping or tapping the patient's card on the Tyro Terminal, you'll receive a payment declined or approved response and the payment will be added to the invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385391770/006a37b60fe8b2800129f60a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc29c0f485f9281759a0b9c5ffd83f3fe1d41c0e8301c465bd4622e017a43978&req=dygiFcB%2FmoZfFb4f3HP0gB5GS90a6uJ%2Bsrvrc7GExpCVsU3%2BDW0ZbcP6GZMW%0AbQOTcc1aU68lVLxiEQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385391770/006a37b60fe8b2800129f60a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc29c0f485f9281759a0b9c5ffd83f3fe1d41c0e8301c465bd4622e017a43978&req=dygiFcB%2FmoZfFb4f3HP0gB5GS90a6uJ%2Bsrvrc7GExpCVsU3%2BDW0ZbcP6GZMW%0AbQOTcc1aU68lVLxiEQ%3D%3D%0A)

The [Tyro Health EFTPOS Transactions](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/tyro/tyrotransactions)
 report can be used to view a list of all Tyro payments.

Processing a Payment Refund via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration

Processing a Payment Refund via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration
==================================================================

Updated over 2 years ago

To refund a payment via the Tyro terminal, open the relevant patient file and navigate to the **Invoices > Payments tab**.

Select the **EFTPOS** or **Credit Card payment** and select **Refund**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614745199/0860bd46dadfe411fe2d206b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d606f7fc72d39b5287ce7d7238deffae35f7e5b7db6098a257270d779cab55b&req=ciEjEc17nIhWFb4f3HP0gI0du0doL0I1RBR9f1YRXV05tRrCANbfwcYoP5q0%0AY4HLTmelyCjrM1BzJw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614745199/0860bd46dadfe411fe2d206b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d606f7fc72d39b5287ce7d7238deffae35f7e5b7db6098a257270d779cab55b&req=ciEjEc17nIhWFb4f3HP0gI0du0doL0I1RBR9f1YRXV05tRrCANbfwcYoP5q0%0AY4HLTmelyCjrM1BzJw%3D%3D%0A)

**Enter a reason** for the refund.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614747520/6b3dfe4246d0ea6c3ab4c655/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59974209ba9cdfa337ed53bbce4842c37e9f6ea749fd4bbfe152a874f55dacf6&req=ciEjEc15mINfFb4f3HP0gFGN9JeLG1msgyNzLLdohVLXQxAyZjNoivWPGG1D%0A5VROZ4S0drL9RuDAgA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614747520/6b3dfe4246d0ea6c3ab4c655/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59974209ba9cdfa337ed53bbce4842c37e9f6ea749fd4bbfe152a874f55dacf6&req=ciEjEc15mINfFb4f3HP0gFGN9JeLG1msgyNzLLdohVLXQxAyZjNoivWPGG1D%0A5VROZ4S0drL9RuDAgA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Tyro Terminal** you wish to process the refund on (if applicable) and select **Next**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614748299/cd2e7d2b9b2c0e71634ed7bc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4ce36a36cfef19338105306335048dc19090bb434b14ba14ecad8f45850a02e8&req=ciEjEc12n4hWFb4f3HP0gOaPLrapih4YjjdDuVpCQIiCTpN1vWllWfhouuvj%0AYW9QTPUpV5Rr8FzFFQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614748299/cd2e7d2b9b2c0e71634ed7bc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4ce36a36cfef19338105306335048dc19090bb434b14ba14ecad8f45850a02e8&req=ciEjEc12n4hWFb4f3HP0gOaPLrapih4YjjdDuVpCQIiCTpN1vWllWfhouuvj%0AYW9QTPUpV5Rr8FzFFQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Confirm** to confirm the refund.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614748571/ccffc97d49e5b4b353195bda/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9667f43e0b921ec7de1e7bb6a7c0d841473ec9de1b5195f0658853f87c6de15&req=ciEjEc12mIZeFb4f3HP0gHHKpCHeRhG6I96NyGlUEpxbCI4nEOeUu0vIBZpv%0Acup6r8mB97RhtEK77Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614748571/ccffc97d49e5b4b353195bda/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9667f43e0b921ec7de1e7bb6a7c0d841473ec9de1b5195f0658853f87c6de15&req=ciEjEc12mIZeFb4f3HP0gHHKpCHeRhG6I96NyGlUEpxbCI4nEOeUu0vIBZpv%0Acup6r8mB97RhtEK77Q%3D%3D%0A)

You'll receive confirmation if the refund is successful.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385404606/644f844a47f1bec74955784c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fad777b446e44903831e438e41466765111041b4fec2beb8709e63109ffa83ae&req=dygiEsl6m4FZFb4f3HP0gPzSynu4edXkhfLwOGCAKd2blb%2B9Cl2AxTy68cnN%0ASKFAPDMRscreAqomhg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385404606/644f844a47f1bec74955784c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fad777b446e44903831e438e41466765111041b4fec2beb8709e63109ffa83ae&req=dygiEsl6m4FZFb4f3HP0gPzSynu4edXkhfLwOGCAKd2blb%2B9Cl2AxTy68cnN%0ASKFAPDMRscreAqomhg%3D%3D%0A)

Alternatively, if the payment was made in error and you wish to delete the payment instead, you can open the relevant patient file and navigate to the **Invoices > Payments tab**.

Select the **EFTPOS** or **Credit Card payment** and select **Delete**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614749970/ed931af51a70c5dabe932b3b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=994eb9ec28010dfad861c4132d2e5ad669228da10e16dda22f3172c939a0fd25&req=ciEjEc13lIZfFb4f3HP0gBqA1tIHyoERymwFUGELUy8Wn875AYeyYLSvJC9i%0Ac1DErDHpfqh%2B9u3P2A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614749970/ed931af51a70c5dabe932b3b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=994eb9ec28010dfad861c4132d2e5ad669228da10e16dda22f3172c939a0fd25&req=ciEjEc13lIZfFb4f3HP0gBqA1tIHyoERymwFUGELUy8Wn875AYeyYLSvJC9i%0Ac1DErDHpfqh%2B9u3P2A%3D%3D%0A)

**Enter a reason** for the deletion and select **Next**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614750497/77fb6620246d8ff8acbb6125/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=988905eba4f94ae30a26d15c9a882ee05b08eb31da0d8dea78ca7cd6baf42ab2&req=ciEjEcx%2BmYhYFb4f3HP0gBn0TFYaCQZL%2FPkZGyjdPC2eALf60C1xJvbCN0HE%0A58zQdb6gMLDhfy1SVQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614750497/77fb6620246d8ff8acbb6125/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=988905eba4f94ae30a26d15c9a882ee05b08eb31da0d8dea78ca7cd6baf42ab2&req=ciEjEcx%2BmYhYFb4f3HP0gBn0TFYaCQZL%2FPkZGyjdPC2eALf60C1xJvbCN0HE%0A58zQdb6gMLDhfy1SVQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Delete Payment and Refund via Tyro** and the terminal you wish to process the refund on (if applicable).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614751034/510f306b904499a74af594b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c78b9e9d525093704df4f490c17ea8c1bc294a8c51549511f7f619f2ddfbc3ad&req=ciEjEcx%2FnYJbFb4f3HP0gO%2FlIg71VSf7%2FrBbNZy7qAFmhhlw65MTWPc7u9QO%0AqsZkSopBzvkvc7Yugg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614751034/510f306b904499a74af594b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c78b9e9d525093704df4f490c17ea8c1bc294a8c51549511f7f619f2ddfbc3ad&req=ciEjEcx%2FnYJbFb4f3HP0gO%2FlIg71VSf7%2FrBbNZy7qAFmhhlw65MTWPc7u9QO%0AqsZkSopBzvkvc7Yugg%3D%3D%0A)

You'll receive confirmation if the refund is successful.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385404606/644f844a47f1bec74955784c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fad777b446e44903831e438e41466765111041b4fec2beb8709e63109ffa83ae&req=dygiEsl6m4FZFb4f3HP0gPzSynu4edXkhfLwOGCAKd2blb%2B9Cl2AxTy68cnN%0ASKFAPDMRscreAqomhg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385404606/644f844a47f1bec74955784c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fad777b446e44903831e438e41466765111041b4fec2beb8709e63109ffa83ae&req=dygiEsl6m4FZFb4f3HP0gPzSynu4edXkhfLwOGCAKd2blb%2B9Cl2AxTy68cnN%0ASKFAPDMRscreAqomhg%3D%3D%0A)

Processing a Medicare Claim via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration

Processing a Medicare Claim via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration
==================================================================

Updated over 11 months ago

Table of contents

[Configuring Item Codes to enable Medicare claiming](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550074-processing-a-medicare-claim-via-the-tyro-health-eftpos-integration#h_b9bfd9d04a)

[Submitting a Medicare Bulk Bill Claim via Tyro EFTPOS](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550074-processing-a-medicare-claim-via-the-tyro-health-eftpos-integration#h_9c8b5bac64)

[Submitting a Medicare Patient Claim via Tyro EFTPOS](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550074-processing-a-medicare-claim-via-the-tyro-health-eftpos-integration#h_fe0868b40f)

Medicare claims submitted via Tyro EFTPOS terminals are referred to as Medicare Easyclaim. Processing a Patient Claim via Tyro EFTPOS requires the patient to have a savings/debit card. [Click here to learn more about the differences between Medicare claiming via Tyro EFTPOS and Tyro Health Online.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6106562-what-are-the-differences-between-medicare-claiming-via-tyro-health-online-and-tyro-health-eftpos)

**Configuring Item Codes to enable Medicare claiming**
======================================================

For an **Item Code** to be claimed through Medicare via the Tyro terminal, it must first be enabled as a **Medicare Item**.

Go to **[Settings > Billing > Item Codes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
**  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594905068/da9cc15708ed35c178bc2b93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4e3624aaa5626d1e2192f7d63246c6ad2606dbf2dfd7005ef1acfbacd1f1405f&req=cSkjH8l7nYdXFb4f3HP0gMSBYFrXky1Vfz5OkhCzEBwkpMhKMRzELSUCfIZu%0A2JRHr560NopGJlGLQA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594905068/da9cc15708ed35c178bc2b93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4e3624aaa5626d1e2192f7d63246c6ad2606dbf2dfd7005ef1acfbacd1f1405f&req=cSkjH8l7nYdXFb4f3HP0gMSBYFrXky1Vfz5OkhCzEBwkpMhKMRzELSUCfIZu%0A2JRHr560NopGJlGLQA%3D%3D%0A)

From your list of available **Item Codes**, click on an item to open its settings.  
​

You can now **Edit** this item code, and under the **Claiming Options,** enable the **Medicare Item** option.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594905609/fab4bb7eab7937c7ec90088c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0272f842c41e04e900e9b4751e6e432e898ebebb2b66708ec6d4aae0f8740a04&req=cSkjH8l7m4FWFb4f3HP0gDvOtXRNHiwdyTogY85MXnNwQmBFtPLs0PdLFHq0%0AcUrIgt%2BkBr5LXj53mw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594905609/fab4bb7eab7937c7ec90088c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0272f842c41e04e900e9b4751e6e432e898ebebb2b66708ec6d4aae0f8740a04&req=cSkjH8l7m4FWFb4f3HP0gDvOtXRNHiwdyTogY85MXnNwQmBFtPLs0PdLFHq0%0AcUrIgt%2BkBr5LXj53mw%3D%3D%0A)

If required, an **Override Code** can be entered if you need to submit a different code when processing a claim. This is only necessary if your **Item Code** is not already a valid Medicare code.

**Submitting a Medicare Bulk Bill Claim via Tyro EFTPOS**
=========================================================

Bulk bill claims can be submitted via the Tyro terminal. **Once approved, claims will be paid to you by Medicare, and they need to be manually paid off in PracSuite.** To avoid having to manually pay off approved bulk bill claims once paid to you, consider using the [Tyro Health Online integration.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-how-to-enable-the-pracsuite-tyro-health-online-integration)

Applying any type of payment to a bulk-billed item will prevent you from submitting a bulk-bill claim. If the bulk bill button doesn't appear, ensure that you have not applied a payment to the item.  
​  
​**If you accept a gap payment or full payment from the patient, you cannot bulk bill, and you must submit a patient claim instead.**

After adding a Medicare item to an invoice, the Tyro EFTPOS button will appear.

Select the **Medicare Bulk Bill** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861210368/af88ed1e33860d4b955fe9cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=998632bc2471bfaa4019a8ab3d9b80ca6efd28d742456d7bd4d48b6aead8c691&req=fCYmFMh%2BnodXFb4f3HP0gCeDVRSHP8HkINb3ox%2BFWBhxelK9%2BOXlkRSeSrnM%0AKy74Em0Rg5WhEGm%2F3Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861210368/af88ed1e33860d4b955fe9cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=998632bc2471bfaa4019a8ab3d9b80ca6efd28d742456d7bd4d48b6aead8c691&req=fCYmFMh%2BnodXFb4f3HP0gCeDVRSHP8HkINb3ox%2BFWBhxelK9%2BOXlkRSeSrnM%0AKy74Em0Rg5WhEGm%2F3Q%3D%3D%0A)

The Medicare details and referral details stored on the patient file will be displayed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385406531/3cbd2a18bb6b47c7ed2b2253/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dc3009dbd96af8a0673a198cc3f08d8498bb71d2ba5f69e85d3b859cacea4c5c&req=dygiEsl4mIJeFb4f3HP0gBOewTTZaoqhXC9pq7nrH3uJBFosoZwaPB93lBVa%0Ai682LeVwb7ueZlP9ow%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385406531/3cbd2a18bb6b47c7ed2b2253/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dc3009dbd96af8a0673a198cc3f08d8498bb71d2ba5f69e85d3b859cacea4c5c&req=dygiEsl4mIJeFb4f3HP0gBOewTTZaoqhXC9pq7nrH3uJBFosoZwaPB93lBVa%0Ai682LeVwb7ueZlP9ow%3D%3D%0A)

The '**+**' **icon** to the left of each item allows you to submit additional information with the claim.
