**Submitting a Medicare Patient Claim via Tyro EFTPOS**
=======================================================

Medicare Patient Claims can be submitted via the Tyro Health EFTPOS integration.

**Patient Claims with full upfront payment**  
If you submit a Patient Claim with **full up-front payment**, the patient will be asked to swipe their **savings/debit card** to receive the rebate back immediately. Ensure you fully pay off the item in PracSuite before selecting the 'Medicare Patient Claim' option to achieve this result. If a patient doesn't have a savings/debit card, you will not be able to proceed with the claim.

  
​**Patient Claims with no or partial upfront payment**

If you submit a Patient Claim **without full up-front payment**, the patient will receive a cheque from Medicare, which they will need to return to the business as payment for the service. This also applies if the patient has made a _partial_ payment that doesn't cover the full service cost.

​  
Considering the additional impost to the patient to return the cheque to the practice, it is highly encouraged to accept full upfront payment so that you can process the rebate to the patient's savings/debit card immediately. As an alternative, businesses can consider using the [Tyro Health Online integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-how-to-enable-the-pracsuite-tyro-health-online-integration)
 to submit patient claims where the rebate is paid back into the patient's Medicare-registered bank account.

This article will step through claiming for a Medicare item that has been fully paid upfront.

After adding a Medicare item to an invoice, accept full payment via any payment method.

Once you have accepted full payment, the Tyro EFTPOS button will appear.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437306568/d672c39814bb8b9dd2971e437650/CleanShot+2025-03-24+at+13_28_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9e1d63f72898d65eb23c97bfcec6c881bddb23057e357b329e8e8537661735bd&req=dSQkEcp%2Bm4RZUfMW1HO4zRZT6LhG9FUwnHU6PBmU%2FKMjquHSy7QsgrfJ7Oi7%0AHbduSUFB0s%2BAlMh926o%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1437306568/d672c39814bb8b9dd2971e437650/CleanShot+2025-03-24+at+13_28_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9e1d63f72898d65eb23c97bfcec6c881bddb23057e357b329e8e8537661735bd&req=dSQkEcp%2Bm4RZUfMW1HO4zRZT6LhG9FUwnHU6PBmU%2FKMjquHSy7QsgrfJ7Oi7%0AHbduSUFB0s%2BAlMh926o%3D%0A)

Select the **Medicare Patient Claim** option.

The Medicare details and referral details stored on the patient file will be displayed. Review these as required.

If submitting a claim for a child, enter the **alternate claimant** details for the individual receiving the rebate from Medicare.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385407242/0ae09847349b370cc14d409e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cffd334f93f5adb1fb5086084c740047f5bd7aaa586c77183dfc38b60ae98f3b&req=dygiEsl5n4VdFb4f3HP0gLN4IsSvp3w3pkSyUpW1fMRZK7O4rBLxObNr0nIQ%0ApD%2Fey%2FwghF8zpfu6jg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385407242/0ae09847349b370cc14d409e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cffd334f93f5adb1fb5086084c740047f5bd7aaa586c77183dfc38b60ae98f3b&req=dygiEsl5n4VdFb4f3HP0gLN4IsSvp3w3pkSyUpW1fMRZK7O4rBLxObNr0nIQ%0ApD%2Fey%2FwghF8zpfu6jg%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Submit** to begin the process. You will be stepped through submitting the claim, including swiping the patient's debit/saving cards to receive the rebate if the patient has paid up-front.

**The patient must have a debit/savings card to receive the rebate when processing an Easyclaim via Tyro EFTPOS.** If a patient doesn't have a savings/debit card, you will not be able to proceed with the claim.

As an alternative method of claiming, you can consider using the [Tyro Health Online integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-how-to-enable-the-pracsuite-tyro-health-online-integration)
 to submit patient claims where the rebate is paid back into the patient's Medicare-registered bank account instead of a savings/debit card.

Once complete, you will receive confirmation of the benefit in PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385407437/06a790a221cda11d9e52e670/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9bd8cc229b211a66ae3f2f43932bf24e0d8e60372c46533620274930d995481a&req=dygiEsl5mYJYFb4f3HP0gMf1LPcdC42WwfmK1WEVPvtLEg7wvqaGUHaXN21z%0ACFUzUB3x%2BvC6PFoXcA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385407437/06a790a221cda11d9e52e670/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9bd8cc229b211a66ae3f2f43932bf24e0d8e60372c46533620274930d995481a&req=dygiEsl5mYJYFb4f3HP0gMf1LPcdC42WwfmK1WEVPvtLEg7wvqaGUHaXN21z%0ACFUzUB3x%2BvC6PFoXcA%3D%3D%0A)

**Tyro Health EFTPOS Transactions Report**
==========================================

The Tyro Health EFTPOS Transactions Report can be used to list Tyro HealthPoint and Tyro EFTPOS transactions, detailing any associated patients, invoices and items.

Go to **[Reports > Integrations](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/tyro/tyrotransactions)** [\> **Tyro Health EFTPOS Transactions**](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/tyro/tyrotransactions)

Use the '**Transaction with**' filter if you would only like to report on specific businesses, professions, practitioners or settlement accounts.

**Tyro Health EFTPOS HealthPoint Report**
=========================================

The Tyro Health EFTPOS HealthPoint Report can be used to summarise Tyro HealthPoint payments, which can then be grouped by merchant ID, health fund and/or date.  
​  
Go to **[Reports > Integrations](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/tyro/tyrohealthpoint)** [\> **Tyro Health EFTPOS HealthPoint**](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/tyro/tyrohealthpoint)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861206147/73a7d4e173f30bf54ec57cd2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4ce62d1579ff0fdca4592627221b4c39a56a2a12835094f2ae5ddc1a12d1347e&req=fCYmFMl4nIVYFb4f3HP0gM9xCuaROmO6TLqpI2tf0iCUP5ZnXX1k49wlr0dU%0AILVNBmH13LFxVwZ2hA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861206147/73a7d4e173f30bf54ec57cd2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4ce62d1579ff0fdca4592627221b4c39a56a2a12835094f2ae5ddc1a12d1347e&req=fCYmFMl4nIVYFb4f3HP0gM9xCuaROmO6TLqpI2tf0iCUP5ZnXX1k49wlr0dU%0AILVNBmH13LFxVwZ2hA%3D%3D%0A)

The following will appear:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385857296/6db35c49bd11085f9073034e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ba2224e3854617ee9c12f432b7868b7303f3cecde9a685d02e05dc13b951e91&req=dygiHsx5n4hZFb4f3HP0gOo%2BmcMLi1tSCTFXstXofvDc3P02nUjlaYXS3NE8%0ARLrMyGEgtnXgnm3F8A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385857296/6db35c49bd11085f9073034e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ba2224e3854617ee9c12f432b7868b7303f3cecde9a685d02e05dc13b951e91&req=dygiHsx5n4hZFb4f3HP0gOo%2BmcMLi1tSCTFXstXofvDc3P02nUjlaYXS3NE8%0ARLrMyGEgtnXgnm3F8A%3D%3D%0A)

There are three **Types** of Tyro HealthPoint report available:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385857551/a692b0eff6fe13bf50502980/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=65d75527754bc7ff19c827c9c9d88463862e2db81eae7311bf42f15ade501e5b&req=dygiHsx5mIReFb4f3HP0gNgKKVu%2FYjcVE9BLKPXcbZOqUS3eEUpRPTgFZRiZ%0AogyO%2FTGs0EPZ1Y2i0Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385857551/a692b0eff6fe13bf50502980/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=65d75527754bc7ff19c827c9c9d88463862e2db81eae7311bf42f15ade501e5b&req=dygiHsx5mIReFb4f3HP0gNgKKVu%2FYjcVE9BLKPXcbZOqUS3eEUpRPTgFZRiZ%0AogyO%2FTGs0EPZ1Y2i0Q%3D%3D%0A)

**Totals Only:**

Shows the total benefits paid for each Practitioner, Business, Health Fund and Merchant ID. The results are grouped by Merchant ID > Health Fund > Business > Practitioner.

Details of all applicable Medicare Easyclaim transactions will be displayed in the grid,

Claims can have a status of **Bulk Bill**, **Fully Paid** or **Part Paid**:

**Bulk Bill:**  
This claim was submitted as a **Bulk Bill** claim, meaning no gap payment was applicable and the patient has not made any payment towards the consultation. In this case the servicing practitioner (or designated payee practitioner) will receive the rebate payment from Medicare.

**Fully Paid:**

This claim was submitted as a **Patient Claim**, where the patient has paid the entire balance of the consultation themselves. Patient claims that are fully paid are approved or declined within seconds, and the patient can then receive the rebate payment by swiping their EFTPOS card on the terminal. The payment is then paid directly to their bank account, almost immediately.

**Part Paid:**

This claim was submitted as a **Patient Claim**, where the patient has only paid for part of the consultation (typically the 'gap' amount) and not the entire balance. In this case the patient (or alternate claimant) will receive the rebate in the form of a cheque, however the cheque will be issued to the servicing practitioner or designated payee practitioner. The patient must then bring the cheque to the practice along with any outstanding balance.

Each grid result can be expanded to show the items submitted in the claim, including the charge amount and benefit amount where applicable.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385861503/53d499da07aa3d73d5508ac1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f948f9bfcd3a13c06a9dcc669315207f4ec61b42f11a193dba5355f4c06b87ee&req=dygiHs9%2FmIFcFb4f3HP0gNGd7Z5DKbQfXmRz9Z5uXRzQO81xnllp3bKPxiWn%0AOqMYK%2Fx7sUJ5y4gTMg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385861503/53d499da07aa3d73d5508ac1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f948f9bfcd3a13c06a9dcc669315207f4ec61b42f11a193dba5355f4c06b87ee&req=dygiHs9%2FmIFcFb4f3HP0gNGd7Z5DKbQfXmRz9Z5uXRzQO81xnllp3bKPxiWn%0AOqMYK%2Fx7sUJ5y4gTMg%3D%3D%0A)

All grid results can be exported to Excel or CSV by using the **Export** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385869663/d948f904fd0d5e78bef31045/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=21333350baf850d7ba0dcacf21f8c61fb9367f3553db67240939db370b4b0788&req=dygiHs93m4dcFb4f3HP0gEZDJZfuUxwIK%2B5qYlgWlwHY9axV5m7PzMqLnYi2%0AtxdfQi4PpduQMhzYBQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/385869663/d948f904fd0d5e78bef31045/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=21333350baf850d7ba0dcacf21f8c61fb9367f3553db67240939db370b4b0788&req=dygiHs93m4dcFb4f3HP0gEZDJZfuUxwIK%2B5qYlgWlwHY9axV5m7PzMqLnYi2%0AtxdfQi4PpduQMhzYBQ%3D%3D%0A)

Cancelling a Tyro Health EFTPOS Health Fund Claim

Cancelling a Tyro Health EFTPOS Health Fund Claim
=================================================

Updated over 2 years ago

It is possible to cancel a Tyro Health EFTPOS health fund claim on the same day as it was submitted. To do this, open the relevant patient file and navigate to the **Invoices > Payments tab**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386403327/11a4d8d2337bdfdbb1bba9ef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c61cbbdeeb34efe301d6467e13fe17f45d30c2e0e0192226da06e05a03f1309d&req=dyghEsl9noNYFb4f3HP0gLn714pQTHKcIZci%2BCnmsiLVsGcNoPJ02ITtCoAZ%0Aape18UISHynSCQ6GiA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386403327/11a4d8d2337bdfdbb1bba9ef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c61cbbdeeb34efe301d6467e13fe17f45d30c2e0e0192226da06e05a03f1309d&req=dyghEsl9noNYFb4f3HP0gLn714pQTHKcIZci%2BCnmsiLVsGcNoPJ02ITtCoAZ%0Aape18UISHynSCQ6GiA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Health Fund claim** and select **Delete**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386403575/fa37b74b93699bb3bec9a8dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d290b0fb4fb9322f48924ed36bc05bcd418c113c56b8759a2979d731efa5b68&req=dyghEsl9mIZaFb4f3HP0gEFuwN1ukaxqVqY3BUBYCMWqMtM3E2CO0FDSFaTi%0AijMpPF56yi%2FACedOoA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386403575/fa37b74b93699bb3bec9a8dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d290b0fb4fb9322f48924ed36bc05bcd418c113c56b8759a2979d731efa5b68&req=dyghEsl9mIZaFb4f3HP0gEFuwN1ukaxqVqY3BUBYCMWqMtM3E2CO0FDSFaTi%0AijMpPF56yi%2FACedOoA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Delete Payment and Cancel via Tyro** and the terminal you wish to process the health fund claim cancellation on (if applicable).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386343871/b9fe50cce9a95d084926e016/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be1bfa8dd47bd9c4880a147190d7d7919c138e4273d5eb1e16839610218d451b&req=dyghFc19lYZeFb4f3HP0gMIwLvqP8s17%2FTjEbn55RuTu7BWIvU1QGzVOLPRc%0Av5seMiXC61gyfSBZ6g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386343871/b9fe50cce9a95d084926e016/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be1bfa8dd47bd9c4880a147190d7d7919c138e4273d5eb1e16839610218d451b&req=dyghFc19lYZeFb4f3HP0gMIwLvqP8s17%2FTjEbn55RuTu7BWIvU1QGzVOLPRc%0Av5seMiXC61gyfSBZ6g%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386343908/6ab5b259b9ca0a0162db17e0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f04a6c4e2de99b4a636db8717dcf1bafd771cf8c86f8dd05254d9eaf03cb3e76&req=dyghFc19lIFXFb4f3HP0gBP%2B1adJC7PLRWCQv09gvMSTnZKquKOTGEJGMRaQ%0AU8YAIHA05hIVH22Cig%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/386343908/6ab5b259b9ca0a0162db17e0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f04a6c4e2de99b4a636db8717dcf1bafd771cf8c86f8dd05254d9eaf03cb3e76&req=dyghFc19lIFXFb4f3HP0gBP%2B1adJC7PLRWCQv09gvMSTnZKquKOTGEJGMRaQ%0AU8YAIHA05hIVH22Cig%3D%3D%0A)

PracSuite's Online Booking System offers the ability to take a payment when a patient books online. PracSuite offers the ability to collect either the **full fee** or a **deposit** at the time of booking.

**Prerequisites**
=================

Online payments are facilitated via PracSuite's integrations with [Tyro Health Online](https://www.tyrohealth.com/)
 (Australia only) or [Stripe](https://stripe.com/)
.

Transaction fees are applicable for both payment processors and will be passed onto you by the respective payment processor. Tyro Health Online [offers lower transaction fees for Australian users](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/4964000-tyro-health-online-pricing-for-pracsuite)
 than Stripe. You can learn more about [Stripe pricing here.](https://stripe.com/pricing)

To enable online payments in PracSuite, you will need to:

1.  Familiarise yourselves with the transaction fees for your chosen payment processor.
    
2.  Create a [Tyro Health Online](https://tyrohealth.medipass.io/sign-up)
     or [Stripe](https://stripe.com/)
     account.
    
3.  Integrate Tyro Health Online or Stripe with PracSuite by following the integration setup guides linked below:
    

[Tyro Health Online Integration Guide](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-enabling-the-tyro-health-online-integration-in-pracsuite)

[Stripe Integration Guide](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/11091461-stripe-integration)

If you've selected Tyro Health Online as your payment processor, you should also add your Tyro Unique ID Number to ensure that patients can proceed with their online payment if there are any issues finding the practitioner by provider number in your Tyro Health Online account. [Click here to learn more.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6343623-tyro-health-online-payment-overrides)

**Enabling online payments**
============================

Provided the above steps are complete, follow the steps below to enable online payments.

Online payments are enabled in **[Settings > Online Bookings > Online Booking Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
**.

Scroll down to the bottom of the page to find the Online Payments section.

You'll see an overview of your active businesses, along with payment integrations available to them, and which payment processor is currently selected.

Online payments will not be available for any businesses without a payment processor selected. If you choose to **require** online payments for business with misconfigured online payments, patients will be unable to complete the online booking process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1546476147/e5614e5a88beea7b42372c3cce25/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=21c3e4fd3772204b52f701125614f4f2c03528b677898dc6bd9a6c2a53bbe77f&req=dSUjEM15m4BbXvMW1HO4zf4PULVgAlBikGMKwNX0LW25zEy8EMr3v9kvv%2FtR%0AZdl3uQ0TJ5Bcc9LJ4UM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1546476147/e5614e5a88beea7b42372c3cce25/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=21c3e4fd3772204b52f701125614f4f2c03528b677898dc6bd9a6c2a53bbe77f&req=dSUjEM15m4BbXvMW1HO4zf4PULVgAlBikGMKwNX0LW25zEy8EMr3v9kvv%2FtR%0AZdl3uQ0TJ5Bcc9LJ4UM%3D%0A)

If you've selected Tyro Health Online as your payment processor, you should also add your Tyro Unique ID Number to ensure that patients can proceed with their online payment if there are any issues finding the practitioner by provider number in your Tyro Health Online account. [Click here to learn more.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6343623-tyro-health-online-payment-overrides)

**Configuring online payments per service**
===========================================

Online payments can be enabled per [Online Booking Service](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/services)
 and per Appointment Type.

Go to [Settings > Online Booking > Services](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/services)
 and select the service you want to enable online payment functionality for.

For each Appointment Type, select the settings cog on the right-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614764270/94057d0ae08363af19f33111/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32326562cbf6b049b024e4ba9d48706d23dd4047e28578e53c38149469fd669d&req=ciEjEc96n4ZfFb4f3HP0gP9V%2FuWGlno23tJZrwSc8Au0EA0AWml%2BPCxKpABA%0A5CskaeobpyjGo0zAMg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614764270/94057d0ae08363af19f33111/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32326562cbf6b049b024e4ba9d48706d23dd4047e28578e53c38149469fd669d&req=ciEjEc96n4ZfFb4f3HP0gP9V%2FuWGlno23tJZrwSc8Au0EA0AWml%2BPCxKpABA%0A5CskaeobpyjGo0zAMg%3D%3D%0A)

In the pop-up window, you will need to choose your online payment preferences for this Appointment Type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1504305189/ff4399e611646944732ea15beb55/CleanShot%2B2025-05-02%2Bat%2B11_54_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f869a0d2ee85042e831c529bf2c321880cb947368939bb044bbe0be4f24d7243&req=dSUnEsp%2BmIBXUPMW1HO4zXp5eeaNoQhgegmES3Lz7hJagUaP9HibTQVrqtLM%0Axiyj63Xy9TB9eY4zeLo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1504305189/ff4399e611646944732ea15beb55/CleanShot%2B2025-05-02%2Bat%2B11_54_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f869a0d2ee85042e831c529bf2c321880cb947368939bb044bbe0be4f24d7243&req=dSUnEsp%2BmIBXUPMW1HO4zXp5eeaNoQhgegmES3Lz7hJagUaP9HibTQVrqtLM%0Axiyj63Xy9TB9eY4zeLo%3D%0A)

If choosing to enable online payments for this Appointment Type, you will need to choose from the following options:

*   **Payment Required or Optional** \- Specifying whether payment is required or optional at the time of booking online.
    
*   **Payment Explanation** - Outline to your patients why you are requesting payment at the time of booking online.
    
*   **Payment Type** - What type of payment you're requesting:
    
    *   **Full Fee -** The full Item Code fee associated with this Appointment Type will be requested.
        
    *   **Deposit % -** Choose whether to charge a % of the full fee. Select the Manage Fees button to view the item codes and fees associated with this Appointment Type.
        
    *   **Deposit Fee -** Choose whether to charge a **fixed fee** regardless of the associated item code fee. This is suitable if you wish to always charge the same fee, e.g., a $20 deposit.
        
    

Once the above selections are made, select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Repeat this process for all Appointment Types and services you wish to collect online payments for.

* * *

Online Payment Considerations
=============================

Please note that **online payments may not be suitable for all services**, so consideration should be given before enabling this feature. Accepting payment at the time of booking may be suitable for private billing scenarios where the patient is not eligible for benefits, like health fund claiming. Online payments are generally not suitable for third-party billing scenarios, for example, when you are processing a Medicare Bulk Bill, Workcover or other insurance claims for the service.

Scenarios where accepting full payment may be suitable:
-------------------------------------------------------

*   Patients paying in full privately
    
*   The patient will pay in full and will be provided with a receipt to manually claim with their health fund (i.e. a claim is not processed in the clinic via a health fund claiming terminal)
    
*   A patient will be paying in full and the clinic will be submitting a Medicare Patient Claim
    

Scenarios where accepting a deposit may be suitable:
----------------------------------------------------

*   Where the final fee is unknown at the time of the booking
    
*   Reserving funds for late cancellations or no shows (with the option to apply the payment to an invoice or refund it via your online payment processor)
    
*   Reserving funds for a gap amount to be paid on the date of service. In this case, the deposit should be the gap amount or less to avoid having to provide refunds.
    

Click the articles below for further information regarding online payments:

*   [Processing online payments](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5590697-processing-online-payments)
    
*   [Refunding online payments when a patient cancels their appointment online](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5590698-refunding-online-payments-when-a-patient-cancels-their-appointment-online)

Processing Online Payments

Processing Online Payments
==========================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Alerts for online payments for Guest Bookings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5590697-processing-online-payments#h_ae0b5d66cb)

[Alerts for online payments for logged in patients](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5590697-processing-online-payments#h_430cc3b88a)

When patients book and pay online, an invoice will automatically be created with a partial or full payment depending on your configuration. When looking at the appointment book, appointments with online payments will appear as processed, however, the Appointment Status will _not_ be set to Complete.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393907451/f7164aaa2042d9e3ed502c05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=58e0676a8b0437050d02266277f89fb8af7e8e3a6773b1eb450aa6011b2473ed&req=dykkH8l5mYReFb4f3HP0gIhxcBSL3NycFhz4BR250KBAfV3qPJxL63dHcMVD%0ALGKU0aYVeRvLc68j8g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393907451/f7164aaa2042d9e3ed502c05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=58e0676a8b0437050d02266277f89fb8af7e8e3a6773b1eb450aa6011b2473ed&req=dykkH8l5mYReFb4f3HP0gIhxcBSL3NycFhz4BR250KBAfV3qPJxL63dHcMVD%0ALGKU0aYVeRvLc68j8g%3D%3D%0A)

Notifications will also be displayed in the Alerts utility if additional action is required to process the online payment.

**Alerts for online payments for Guest Bookings**
=================================================

When patients book and pay online as a Guest, you will receive a notification in the Alerts utility displaying both a globe to represent an online booking and a dollar sign to indicate that there is a payment attached.

Select the notification to process the online booking and payment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393355350/190026977793188fa084ad10/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=355b12e46f0376b003b39cc6d4a9a9b1350d592a2958d69dad5b3bf369120187&req=dykkFcx7noRfFb4f3HP0gNvxrnYPavcS0HkTYFlWFxZ8A9eJ1MNqXShueIyD%0A3M4L1N3BnH6icFA7%2FA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393355350/190026977793188fa084ad10/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=355b12e46f0376b003b39cc6d4a9a9b1350d592a2958d69dad5b3bf369120187&req=dykkFcx7noRfFb4f3HP0gNvxrnYPavcS0HkTYFlWFxZ8A9eJ1MNqXShueIyD%0A3M4L1N3BnH6icFA7%2FA%3D%3D%0A)

Along with the patient's contact information, details regarding the online payment will be displayed. PracSuite will display any possible patient file matches in your database. If you recognise a match select that client to link both the appointment and payment to. If no matches are found, select **New Patient** to create a patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393355673/a4a0ff3f9d8080b332338997/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d7c10caa9a2ece5f819e66ce41118ca04f2d75b959cef7529dd221d55deb7b5e&req=dykkFcx7m4ZcFb4f3HP0gMKGftkFuspfrQ%2FINF6dtHjr12cfWALv2NAs4Zlc%0AEyX2N2ZkOALtLNcD5w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393355673/a4a0ff3f9d8080b332338997/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d7c10caa9a2ece5f819e66ce41118ca04f2d75b959cef7529dd221d55deb7b5e&req=dykkFcx7m4ZcFb4f3HP0gMKGftkFuspfrQ%2FINF6dtHjr12cfWALv2NAs4Zlc%0AEyX2N2ZkOALtLNcD5w%3D%3D%0A)

**Alerts for online payments for logged in patients**
=====================================================

Alerts will also appear if a patient logs into their online booking account and pays for an appointment. This alert will only appear if no Account on the patient file is selected for online payments.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393355941/311941ff44bb865d515330aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8a674d650273454bc576dd831e322e36980cd0f9988a7b99662586d92de899e6&req=dykkFcx7lIVeFb4f3HP0gCwXrGf7%2FgsZIPzYoDnxN963buE2KIK01AzCKSkc%0ALnDr3jaZyK5sdoOiKg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393355941/311941ff44bb865d515330aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8a674d650273454bc576dd831e322e36980cd0f9988a7b99662586d92de899e6&req=dykkFcx7lIVeFb4f3HP0gCwXrGf7%2FgsZIPzYoDnxN963buE2KIK01AzCKSkc%0ALnDr3jaZyK5sdoOiKg%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting the alert, you will see the patient's details as well as a summary of the payment that has been received. Use the dropdown to select which **Account** to associate the payment with.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393356321/efb050769c6673f64bdc1946/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2e4c6b3c64218289b49b4ba65c11fd0f366ece17890ae95651996f7b14faaa3&req=dykkFcx4noNeFb4f3HP0gA%2BM%2BtOpb0eyDxLFmZhca33sBTjYhIvuRsDj7zHG%0A9LwF6a1HAGN4o9v36w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393356321/efb050769c6673f64bdc1946/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2e4c6b3c64218289b49b4ba65c11fd0f366ece17890ae95651996f7b14faaa3&req=dykkFcx4noNeFb4f3HP0gA%2BM%2BtOpb0eyDxLFmZhca33sBTjYhIvuRsDj7zHG%0A9LwF6a1HAGN4o9v36w%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Confirm** to complete the process.

The account to use for online payments can also be set using the **Manage Accounts** prompt at the top of the **Accounts tab** on the **Patient File**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393402858/6bff6adc3290fdf0224e5a12/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2e15d6f2d1d2ab527e80af3f00205320d5d6121d2084cec9032ff32a9c9d940&req=dykkEsl8lYRXFb4f3HP0gGfBHZJ1L11I6c9cJ8B2gFC1uFlUlNmjjd%2BPWjzi%0AY7HQKOLawS%2FDzlHAyg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393402858/6bff6adc3290fdf0224e5a12/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2e15d6f2d1d2ab527e80af3f00205320d5d6121d2084cec9032ff32a9c9d940&req=dykkEsl8lYRXFb4f3HP0gGfBHZJ1L11I6c9cJ8B2gFC1uFlUlNmjjd%2BPWjzi%0AY7HQKOLawS%2FDzlHAyg%3D%3D%0A)

Refunding Online Payments when a Patient Cancels their Appointment Online

Refunding Online Payments when a Patient Cancels their Appointment Online
=========================================================================

Updated over 9 months ago

Patients who have made an online payment for their upcoming appointment may later cancel that appointment, which could require you to refund all or part of their payment, depending on your cancellation policy.

When an appointment is cancelled online by the patient, the following alert will be displayed if a payment was processed at the time of booking.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1544240891/b741087fc5c7004fa5049fabbd20/CleanShot+2025-05-28+at+14_21_27.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8255f1aaee17b87ae98d68fa20244b1e910519dd7310caf1f9a33a7f7fdff976&req=dSUjEst6nYlWWPMW1HO4zVx4rUywRZpv2VYrJZmPQqAhXcrkewi6n3pTJRq3%0Af4QaYcbKzKIZK4veqnc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1544240891/b741087fc5c7004fa5049fabbd20/CleanShot+2025-05-28+at+14_21_27.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8255f1aaee17b87ae98d68fa20244b1e910519dd7310caf1f9a33a7f7fdff976&req=dSUjEst6nYlWWPMW1HO4zVx4rUywRZpv2VYrJZmPQqAhXcrkewi6n3pTJRq3%0Af4QaYcbKzKIZK4veqnc%3D%0A)

Upon clicking this alert, the **Appointment Cancelled** window will appear, offering details of the cancelled appointment and any online payments received.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1544242639/8c9673bb0279b29f67db2d72191b/CleanShot+2025-05-28+at+14_23_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=251f47b840c33b7d1ed8fd66c1190b361212836f6567769910c5528490026f99&req=dSUjEst6n4dcUPMW1HO4zb57vkEdgaOQNtL%2BuxxP4ZKZbkAYZ99LcKgOIw2y%0AsIwcFw9Ndx4uwkJxjC0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1544242639/8c9673bb0279b29f67db2d72191b/CleanShot+2025-05-28+at+14_23_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=251f47b840c33b7d1ed8fd66c1190b361212836f6567769910c5528490026f99&req=dSUjEst6n4dcUPMW1HO4zb57vkEdgaOQNtL%2BuxxP4ZKZbkAYZ99LcKgOIw2y%0AsIwcFw9Ndx4uwkJxjC0%3D%0A)

In the bottom-right of this window is an area titled **Action for Remaining Payment and Invoice**. This is where you can decide what action to take for the invoice and payment associated with the cancelled appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1544242847/0ebf7fb5e156b1bb0fe87f267272/CleanShot+2025-05-28+at+14_24_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c6c7050a628486c045f31f089d3e3c6c4a30235643ee156cd91af75ccd79fed&req=dSUjEst6n4lbXvMW1HO4zZb6e8WMHrZyIuZ9H0gXv9vRE1oaFH%2F5htuzU%2BwG%0AXjlii9yp31i6cuISmp0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1544242847/0ebf7fb5e156b1bb0fe87f267272/CleanShot+2025-05-28+at+14_24_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c6c7050a628486c045f31f089d3e3c6c4a30235643ee156cd91af75ccd79fed&req=dSUjEst6n4lbXvMW1HO4zZb6e8WMHrZyIuZ9H0gXv9vRE1oaFH%2F5htuzU%2BwG%0AXjlii9yp31i6cuISmp0%3D%0A)

The **Invoice** and **Payment** can be actioned separately. For the invoice, you can choose whether to leave the invoice in the patient file or delete the invoice entirely.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393905140/1dc9df8c5e6afbd7d59cef28/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0899086725551027d654a01b6401f1355b4ccaac28f4ac5293cb99f1852e2dac&req=dykkH8l7nIVfFb4f3HP0gFVxDlAaFZRqCH45jM7OFitPsWjjvq%2FNK2jHdf2V%0A50KdDUOBTrK9rV18uw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393905140/1dc9df8c5e6afbd7d59cef28/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0899086725551027d654a01b6401f1355b4ccaac28f4ac5293cb99f1852e2dac&req=dykkH8l7nIVfFb4f3HP0gFVxDlAaFZRqCH45jM7OFitPsWjjvq%2FNK2jHdf2V%0A50KdDUOBTrK9rV18uw%3D%3D%0A)

For the payment, you can choose to leave the payment in place on the invoice, make the payment unallocated, or refund the payment in PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393905196/eab8c2292da0714eadab1002/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8a6f0ee07d1e076f1a96ab5e0bcde37f55423433c9d3525a87d888f982523f47&req=dykkH8l7nIhZFb4f3HP0gAS4FOre%2BmRqUcTDYIX%2BkKMvWf%2FifsGDJ1qnS9oo%0AhYWV5fauzJuVIwmdqw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393905196/eab8c2292da0714eadab1002/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8a6f0ee07d1e076f1a96ab5e0bcde37f55423433c9d3525a87d888f982523f47&req=dykkH8l7nIhZFb4f3HP0gAS4FOre%2BmRqUcTDYIX%2BkKMvWf%2FifsGDJ1qnS9oo%0AhYWV5fauzJuVIwmdqw%3D%3D%0A)

When refunding the payment in PracSuite, you must select the refund method, date and business to record the refund against.

By default, the refund method will be set to Credit Card and will automatically process a refund via your chosen payment processor (Tyro Health Online or Stripe).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393905318/cd15ba36407808639f4decce/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=204fe75de2e28d66d91afc5dbccb0e4ce688658d9adbd9009f960325f367bf44&req=dykkH8l7noBXFb4f3HP0gC8yELH0nuUvGMOcOxUf29uDqvoOhdec0T%2FV4Pij%0AofEgGBx87fy1f15ssQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/393905318/cd15ba36407808639f4decce/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=204fe75de2e28d66d91afc5dbccb0e4ce688658d9adbd9009f960325f367bf44&req=dykkH8l7noBXFb4f3HP0gC8yELH0nuUvGMOcOxUf29uDqvoOhdec0T%2FV4Pij%0AofEgGBx87fy1f15ssQ%3D%3D%0A)

If an appointment is **cancelled on the same day** as the original payment, you won't have the option to refund the payment, as the funds have not yet been settled into your bank account. Instead, this will result in a payment 'cancellation' and no refund will be recorded in PracSuite.

If you do not choose to refund the patient via Tyro Health Online, PracSuite will not return the payment to the patient automatically. You must ensure that the patient is appropriately refunded.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1544244069/801f41afc06e74924e2e3fc6a499/CleanShot+2025-05-28+at+14_25_47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=418d6c301457e3c5afc1fe066efe58aa5b64f831b332f5fdccaf6d3f39b0b09e&req=dSUjEst6mYFZUPMW1HO4zQYECoHHaZhwXpIUi9GbXN4qPNlo%2FGefr%2BfI0cGh%0AUZYI0JVRj7s%2FZfpBs9Q%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1544244069/801f41afc06e74924e2e3fc6a499/CleanShot+2025-05-28+at+14_25_47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=418d6c301457e3c5afc1fe066efe58aa5b64f831b332f5fdccaf6d3f39b0b09e&req=dSUjEst6mYFZUPMW1HO4zQYECoHHaZhwXpIUi9GbXN4qPNlo%2FGefr%2BfI0cGh%0AUZYI0JVRj7s%2FZfpBs9Q%3D%0A)

Recording a Patient's COVID-19 Vaccination Status
=================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

A patient's COVID-19 Vaccination status can be selected in the patient file by going to the **Patient File > Patient Details > select Edit** and under the **Additional** section you have a COVID Vaccination option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614776570/72bcb1072d9f289b074fb1cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e25e866f03c4ced7cec1c8aaf789e6cf71c43def6d6ecf8d0e7827d6e47179d1&req=ciEjEc54mIZfFb4f3HP0gDzu5RGAukXRlgVCxQAxb3inqP65hDhDSjjHbu%2FS%0A27ybaB4exVQvucvqwA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614776570/72bcb1072d9f289b074fb1cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e25e866f03c4ced7cec1c8aaf789e6cf71c43def6d6ecf8d0e7827d6e47179d1&req=ciEjEc54mIZfFb4f3HP0gDzu5RGAukXRlgVCxQAxb3inqP65hDhDSjjHbu%2FS%0A27ybaB4exVQvucvqwA%3D%3D%0A)

Enabling Automatic Email Appointment Confirmations

Enabling Automatic Email Appointment Confirmations
==================================================

Updated over 4 months ago

Table of contents

[Creating a Confirmation](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-enabling-automatic-email-appointment-confirmations#h_2df26a928c)

[Configuring the Confirmation](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-enabling-automatic-email-appointment-confirmations#h_841a45cd2c)

[Preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-enabling-automatic-email-appointment-confirmations#h_2a801c07f8)

Appointment Confirmations can be used to send patients an email at the time their appointment is made in PracSuite. Email templates for Appointment Confirmations can be configured per business, profession and appointment type.

Creating a Confirmation
-----------------------

#### Step 1:

Go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Confirmations](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/confirmations)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788157648/f351097ea16dacc2f7d7ac4fa0ad/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0d98d78165c9a27ad480c7624d877fd09d9addf5367b99e24631ae3d4481ae42&req=dScvHsh7modbUfMW1HO4ze8svUSiRawEquRU2S5gEyktxHSg87p5nuhOBA7y%0ALaS0%2FPHaMqy%2FNqQbqB4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788157648/f351097ea16dacc2f7d7ac4fa0ad/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0d98d78165c9a27ad480c7624d877fd09d9addf5367b99e24631ae3d4481ae42&req=dScvHsh7modbUfMW1HO4ze8svUSiRawEquRU2S5gEyktxHSg87p5nuhOBA7y%0ALaS0%2FPHaMqy%2FNqQbqB4%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select **Email** confirmations.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788183934/79669a10bf415720c6b7c45576b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2b2725fc194ea1ced160e1a808ad08b36078a074108b685b7e50c841adbfafa4&req=dScvHsh2nohcXfMW1HO4za0yV7ivMCL6ib%2FV185BxjaDKQ7G0LkvbHKaY99%2F%0AyLhGLDioLMOuvuUdS0E%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788183934/79669a10bf415720c6b7c45576b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2b2725fc194ea1ced160e1a808ad08b36078a074108b685b7e50c841adbfafa4&req=dScvHsh2nohcXfMW1HO4za0yV7ivMCL6ib%2FV185BxjaDKQ7G0LkvbHKaY99%2F%0AyLhGLDioLMOuvuUdS0E%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Select the toggle to enable Appointment Confirmations.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788185359/32b02e46b8de609e7298cdba0358/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7444fc054ce2788a6245685cf1841171c74c5fcb6d647c099501527de4af5702&req=dScvHsh2mIJaUPMW1HO4zW5%2FyLXEkThNpXc5VqgPlp97WOJQ8hotMtn38FJ4%0AY8P4qe4s5cXzpY%2Fi1EE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788185359/32b02e46b8de609e7298cdba0358/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7444fc054ce2788a6245685cf1841171c74c5fcb6d647c099501527de4af5702&req=dScvHsh2mIJaUPMW1HO4zW5%2FyLXEkThNpXc5VqgPlp97WOJQ8hotMtn38FJ4%0AY8P4qe4s5cXzpY%2Fi1EE%3D%0A)

Configuring the Confirmation
----------------------------

#### Step 1:

Set whether you want to disable confirmations if an appointment is booked on, for example: the same day as the appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788302749/4f301b2a64cbf47edff6239fca0d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb85934733f33d8a0926d0c077f515164f56d89097bfd9af8ec6962b7a111c36&req=dScvHsp%2Bn4ZbUPMW1HO4zaaFzvqfF9iS0FSs1zkE9qmotsLyYi8gJa7vOzg9%0AG0Tg%2BYO8f6v%2BqPbAxYo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788302749/4f301b2a64cbf47edff6239fca0d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb85934733f33d8a0926d0c077f515164f56d89097bfd9af8ec6962b7a111c36&req=dScvHsp%2Bn4ZbUPMW1HO4zaaFzvqfF9iS0FSs1zkE9qmotsLyYi8gJa7vOzg9%0AG0Tg%2BYO8f6v%2BqPbAxYo%3D%0A)

Note: If you send important information in your confirmation you may want to leave this option disabled.

#### Step 2:

Select whether you want replies to come back to the businesses email address or a specified address.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788303472/944950f55f12726fae788aa5d37a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=89431c9216da465a6397377b436f82e2ab67b5b84f0c24d8f75446a7cd616f25&req=dScvHsp%2BnoVYW%2FMW1HO4zRgMvorkh4gEtjhclNtk2PzbgdEJw3ESkcqECmL4%0AQjQOgFaa6%2FexjvhjXaw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788303472/944950f55f12726fae788aa5d37a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=89431c9216da465a6397377b436f82e2ab67b5b84f0c24d8f75446a7cd616f25&req=dScvHsp%2BnoVYW%2FMW1HO4zRgMvorkh4gEtjhclNtk2PzbgdEJw3ESkcqECmL4%0AQjQOgFaa6%2FexjvhjXaw%3D%0A)

### Setting Email Templates

#### Step 1:

Set the **Default [Email Confirmation Template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317970-creating-email-templates)
** to be used. This will be used for all appointments unless there is an override set.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788304773/c9b1f6fafb19255a2e94d879ff51/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4dd3df4c20f8e7ed807281e7974132546582dc1c4a944a3e1a10a6d068f0c347&req=dScvHsp%2BmYZYWvMW1HO4zXnktUIqTWqu1thPE%2BRvz%2Fu%2Fq5RT5%2Bv4WDSBJOE0%0AgnRm3yjk%2F17ym68hxB0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788304773/c9b1f6fafb19255a2e94d879ff51/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4dd3df4c20f8e7ed807281e7974132546582dc1c4a944a3e1a10a6d068f0c347&req=dScvHsp%2BmYZYWvMW1HO4zXnktUIqTWqu1thPE%2BRvz%2Fu%2Fq5RT5%2Bv4WDSBJOE0%0AgnRm3yjk%2F17ym68hxB0%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select **Add** to configure override templates if you wish to send different email templates for appointments with a particular Business, Profession, Practitioner or Appointment Type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788308974/933d834c8ef75b5c3002dbd48be8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59ed929ec80dcb397a501aaab0c924bc1d41170536004a97231cb54e9e3237bd&req=dScvHsp%2BlYhYXfMW1HO4zTYdb1zA54YETAUVdEbxFoO%2B2eqfOWaJNbk2DsF5%0AJMSyEcJAsa6iCLfCHOQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788308974/933d834c8ef75b5c3002dbd48be8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59ed929ec80dcb397a501aaab0c924bc1d41170536004a97231cb54e9e3237bd&req=dScvHsp%2BlYhYXfMW1HO4zTYdb1zA54YETAUVdEbxFoO%2B2eqfOWaJNbk2DsF5%0AJMSyEcJAsa6iCLfCHOQ%3D%0A)

Set an override for each case that requires a different template.

Note: Overrides higher in the list take priority over those lower in the list. Because of this, make sure the more specific overrides are put closer to the top of the list. You can re-organise the overrides by hovering your cursor over an entry and using the **||** symbol to drag-and-drop them into the desired order.

### Exclusions

If required, you can also prevent/exclude Appointment Confirmations from being sent for particular Businesses, Practitioners and Appointment Types.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788310189/afb2f91b9ae885075624fff08f44/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9b0f6d2fee34743c0fd67cf280429fb60ba22270188af02f76cc4a118af16dcc&req=dScvHsp%2FnYBXUPMW1HO4zdwc9Col8JOWJb371k5Wy8m%2BhQ6ymSE1xN8LUpPS%0A7gzTLwPcWB%2BFGfyNZiM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788310189/afb2f91b9ae885075624fff08f44/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9b0f6d2fee34743c0fd67cf280429fb60ba22270188af02f76cc4a118af16dcc&req=dScvHsp%2FnYBXUPMW1HO4zdwc9Col8JOWJb371k5Wy8m%2BhQ6ymSE1xN8LUpPS%0A7gzTLwPcWB%2BFGfyNZiM%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to confirm your changes.

Preferences
-----------

Appointment confirmations will be sent to patients according to the Confirmations preferences set on their patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788220290/626ed58528d067a794e490c77701/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=99f2193f366a2aa2febfc216566b2607bae91b891fbd742a53a5495e4e9e10f9&req=dScvHst8nYNWWfMW1HO4zZve88DKhVR28SEcDDw6l3WnymrL9vtD5BBmLBMY%0ANiwt5v%2FGGaOJaQzu7R4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788220290/626ed58528d067a794e490c77701/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=99f2193f366a2aa2febfc216566b2607bae91b891fbd742a53a5495e4e9e10f9&req=dScvHst8nYNWWfMW1HO4zZve88DKhVR28SEcDDw6l3WnymrL9vtD5BBmLBMY%0ANiwt5v%2FGGaOJaQzu7R4%3D%0A)

When booking or rescheduling appointments, confirmation email messages will be sent according to your preferences. You can set whether Confirmations are re-sent when rescheduling appointments on the [main Confirmations page](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/confirmations)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788292685/a979bab3cf0dd39c13daa4d6bf3a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cf10d7f4688c296f536eb6c89c6c58373efb5db763e8deb826a6c43d878bbb57&req=dScvHst3n4dXXPMW1HO4zaScDQ9U7Xor5m7KJRqMoNImbh4%2B9CzyaIJO9IP7%0Anamc77iMkYG%2FSrIU3xU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1788292685/a979bab3cf0dd39c13daa4d6bf3a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cf10d7f4688c296f536eb6c89c6c58373efb5db763e8deb826a6c43d878bbb57&req=dScvHst3n4dXXPMW1HO4zaScDQ9U7Xor5m7KJRqMoNImbh4%2B9CzyaIJO9IP7%0Anamc77iMkYG%2FSrIU3xU%3D%0A)

Appointment confirmations are not currently supported for booking [appointment schedules](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5059210-how-to-book-multiple-appointments)
.

When booking new appointments in particular, use the drop-down arrow to book the appointment without sending a confirmation SMS or email.

COVID-19 Vaccination Status Warnings

COVID-19 Vaccination Status Warnings
====================================

Updated over 3 years ago

PracSuite includes the ability to store a patient's COVID-19 vaccination status. [More info on this feature can be found here](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5638287-recording-a-patient-s-covid-19-vaccination-status)
.

In **[Settings > General > Warnings & Alerts](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/warnings)
** you can configure whether warnings should appear regarding a patient's vaccination status when:

*   Opening a patient file
    
*   When booking or deleting an appointment
    
*   When marking a patient as arrived
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987042/992e3c99403d89ff6a259874/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8279d91a89c76314718453a271035e9f78899b4599edeec104e6c0b76b73a953&req=ciAmH8F5nYVdFb4f3HP0gFM7NLOxHSGDaqNz2yLcwvy0cfhDzOAxubwl7bD3%0AxddxhS37aE7YMKiDfg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987042/992e3c99403d89ff6a259874/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8279d91a89c76314718453a271035e9f78899b4599edeec104e6c0b76b73a953&req=ciAmH8F5nYVdFb4f3HP0gFM7NLOxHSGDaqNz2yLcwvy0cfhDzOAxubwl7bD3%0AxddxhS37aE7YMKiDfg%3D%3D%0A)

It is also possible to display an icon on the appointment book if a patient is full or partially vaccinated, as well as if the patient is exempt from receiving the vaccination.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987267/a2bda15e3aec4f66028cd589/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8f33f65a370b2664f4c2456b5f03e2a9af2613161d5b3399a33244818c298b5&req=ciAmH8F5n4dYFb4f3HP0gHIjY4aPTBsgYz5OEBMGD7%2Fa4n9s7ikPZHSAS%2Fs2%0Ad333Oy5lcWZeqAfgnA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987267/a2bda15e3aec4f66028cd589/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8f33f65a370b2664f4c2456b5f03e2a9af2613161d5b3399a33244818c298b5&req=ciAmH8F5n4dYFb4f3HP0gHIjY4aPTBsgYz5OEBMGD7%2Fa4n9s7ikPZHSAS%2Fs2%0Ad333Oy5lcWZeqAfgnA%3D%3D%0A)

Using the Hold Appointment Reminders Feature

Using the Hold Appointment Reminders Feature
============================================

Updated over 3 years ago

The Hold Appointment Reminders feature prevents automatic [email](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386614-enabling-automatic-email-reminders)
 and [SMS](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)
 reminders from being sent when an appointment is set to a specific status. This feature can be useful, for example, if you're sending multiple appointment reminders and a patient has already replied to confirm their appointment. By enabling the Hold Appointment Reminders feature for the 'confirmed' status, you can prevent subsequent reminders from being sent to appointments marked with this status.

To enable this feature, go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Book](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook)
**.

Scroll down to the **Appointment Statuses** section and enable the **Hold App. Reminders** checkbox as required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614781108/3adba6ffaa3dc444bfbc744d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e36dde203d59b75b26de5cdae357a03086620dfb02922a1a104cbbfc8f46bf56&req=ciEjEcF%2FnIFXFb4f3HP0gJ5Wy8PnlWdktvWijQyxh4Gyde4xA73wRxQoTgRU%0AI%2BPy9%2FVhBHb8abSQ3g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614781108/3adba6ffaa3dc444bfbc744d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e36dde203d59b75b26de5cdae357a03086620dfb02922a1a104cbbfc8f46bf56&req=ciEjEcF%2FnIFXFb4f3HP0gJ5Wy8PnlWdktvWijQyxh4Gyde4xA73wRxQoTgRU%0AI%2BPy9%2FVhBHb8abSQ3g%3D%3D%0A)

Enabling the NDIS integration

Enabling the NDIS integration
=============================

Updated over 2 years ago

_[Learn more about working with the NDIS and PracSuite here.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8303276-what-to-know-about-the-ndis-and-pracsuite)
  
​_

The PracSuite NDIS integration is designed for practices consulting and treating **agency managed patients** and provides tools to create the Bulk Payment Export CSV file that can be uploaded directly to the NDIA myplace provider portal for payment. More information on this process is [available via the NDIS website.](https://www.ndis.gov.au/providers/working-provider/getting-paid/bulk-payments)

The integration allows you to:

*   Record your business' NDIS registration number
    
*   Add NDIS participant numbers to patient files
    
*   Enable NDIS claiming options on item codes
    
*   Select claim type when adding NDIS items to invoices
    
*   Use the [NDIS Bulk Export report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/ndisbulkpayments)
     to create bulk payment CSV exports that can be uploaded directly to the NDIA myplace provider portal
    
*   Once payment has been made to you by the NDIA, you can pay off the items included on exports in bulk
    

Click below to watch our information webinar regarding NDIS features in PracSuite:

[Watch Webinar](https://bit.ly/3ESkGlW)

To enable the integration, go to **[Settings > Integrations > NDIS](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/NDIS)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636296683/a90890c7f39dde87a7bef388/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5792b5981f041047300a8f738f0a8e698a1f67b9e422c65a060acd4d2d8fa489&req=ciMhFMB4m4lcFb4f3HP0gNe1iSwhU7oK1UHFWVHeAPcU%2F7tSAOxlCDRPRQ4I%0ApiazpF5qr2Kxf0szNQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636296683/a90890c7f39dde87a7bef388/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5792b5981f041047300a8f738f0a8e698a1f67b9e422c65a060acd4d2d8fa489&req=ciMhFMB4m4lcFb4f3HP0gNe1iSwhU7oK1UHFWVHeAPcU%2F7tSAOxlCDRPRQ4I%0ApiazpF5qr2Kxf0szNQ%3D%3D%0A)

Note: We highly recommended restricting the NDIS integration to [Fee Categories](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4196739-creating-a-fee-category)
 used for **agency managed patients only**. Without restricting the integration to select Fee Categories, self-managed and third-party plan managed patients may appear in the bulk export.

After enabling the NDIS integration, you will be able to add your NDIS Registration Number to your Businesses.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636297033/ca25738e4e6ee9791db53ed8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83fc61e2df95a9a9f752af5928f602c207520c9e2728e26d54cab3e64f82d25e&req=ciMhFMB5nYJcFb4f3HP0gL4OE3ZXAmAT5AqvzTdFx2LnxgF6BFb5zGCyjeXZ%0AbPSQnqblUhS%2BBxmBsQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636297033/ca25738e4e6ee9791db53ed8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83fc61e2df95a9a9f752af5928f602c207520c9e2728e26d54cab3e64f82d25e&req=ciMhFMB5nYJcFb4f3HP0gL4OE3ZXAmAT5AqvzTdFx2LnxgF6BFb5zGCyjeXZ%0AbPSQnqblUhS%2BBxmBsQ%3D%3D%0A)

NDIS Participant Numbers can also be recorded in the **Health Fund & Benefits** section on patient files.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636297349/927356612ca2ccc93da1d5aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=806cf19fece9d583c2404a47e9c9d23e4653935e9accd37f617cddee771898f9&req=ciMhFMB5noVWFb4f3HP0gGEg8p%2B8Lm7lGcrYJCA84GfY13UcvJIjloxnPPzn%0AUZfXehq%2BaxjBD3stIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636297349/927356612ca2ccc93da1d5aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=806cf19fece9d583c2404a47e9c9d23e4653935e9accd37f617cddee771898f9&req=ciMhFMB5noVWFb4f3HP0gGEg8p%2B8Lm7lGcrYJCA84GfY13UcvJIjloxnPPzn%0AUZfXehq%2BaxjBD3stIA%3D%3D%0A)

More information about using this integration can be found in the articles below:

*   [Managing NDIS Item Codes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5759042-managing-ndis-item-codes)
    
*   [Creating an NDIS Bulk Export](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5754587-creating-an-ndis-bulk-export)

Creating an NDIS Bulk Export

Creating an NDIS Bulk Export
============================

Creating and exporting NDIS bulk exports

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Creating a New Bulk Export](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5754587-creating-an-ndis-bulk-export#h_43455ad3ef)

[Managing Existing Bulk Exports](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5754587-creating-an-ndis-bulk-export#h_e16053ac0c)

The [NDIS Bulk Export Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/ndisbulkpayments)
 is used to create CSV exports that can be uploaded directly to the NDIA for payment via the myplace provider portal. Once payment has been made to you by the NDIA, you can pay off the items included in exports in bulk

**Creating a New Bulk Export**
==============================

Go to **[Reports > Integrations > NDIS Bulk Export Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/ndisbulkpayments)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602028325/9c09c973aa59db8a390d52bd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6b22b970a4423e70ce854c811e639bdb45e2fb3119393e899c18af7fb1b2a0d&req=ciAlFst2noNaFb4f3HP0gHvN2hQKL23Z9l4y%2Bx04iAmXav6pfNJkbKw6w0Af%0A9PzkAFAvZqRv1szqVg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602028325/9c09c973aa59db8a390d52bd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6b22b970a4423e70ce854c811e639bdb45e2fb3119393e899c18af7fb1b2a0d&req=ciAlFst2noNaFb4f3HP0gHvN2hQKL23Z9l4y%2Bx04iAmXav6pfNJkbKw6w0Af%0A9PzkAFAvZqRv1szqVg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **New Bulk Export** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602028504/c968bb461de98030f2c67182/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ecd92a769aaf70ecba3e6a553f2bcf94f81d6365f1e9896d20022d9055d3f7ef&req=ciAlFst2mIFbFb4f3HP0gOuSnDaM47wScFQLK74%2FQUyCP9X%2BZ77pLNtD6jGr%0Afakt5BPmplnPTQHACw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602028504/c968bb461de98030f2c67182/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ecd92a769aaf70ecba3e6a553f2bcf94f81d6365f1e9896d20022d9055d3f7ef&req=ciAlFst2mIFbFb4f3HP0gOuSnDaM47wScFQLK74%2FQUyCP9X%2BZ77pLNtD6jGr%0Afakt5BPmplnPTQHACw%3D%3D%0A)

The filters should be used to narrow which billed NDIS items should be included on the export. By default, items already included on previous NDIS Bulk Exports will be excluded.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602028883/f3de7d1702cf401ed0eb1ad0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5bf93dc981f0543347d041cbcd0ef5561a78458309aa4568890354053d055288&req=ciAlFst2lYlcFb4f3HP0gKgcytyJ7FTj1BMIn6ZdsohfsjmYghQOZo7m7jb%2B%0AJsj%2Fa7oPYXNeOOsdRA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602028883/f3de7d1702cf401ed0eb1ad0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5bf93dc981f0543347d041cbcd0ef5561a78458309aa4568890354053d055288&req=ciAlFst2lYlcFb4f3HP0gKgcytyJ7FTj1BMIn6ZdsohfsjmYghQOZo7m7jb%2B%0AJsj%2Fa7oPYXNeOOsdRA%3D%3D%0A)

After applying your filters, select the **Find Items** button at the top of the report.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602028966/83d240bc32614b88c1545a38/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1909673fcf8b1c41a631c91ec6523ea76f54ecca6038182248ba9b20b8db9a56&req=ciAlFst2lIdZFb4f3HP0gGQ%2F5ilAE%2FXFicsKT%2BFFz9f3Jqn7Lb3HhTaiYXzS%0ARPGL%2BrRIOdfNyPmcxw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602028966/83d240bc32614b88c1545a38/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1909673fcf8b1c41a631c91ec6523ea76f54ecca6038182248ba9b20b8db9a56&req=ciAlFst2lIdZFb4f3HP0gGQ%2F5ilAE%2FXFicsKT%2BFFz9f3Jqn7Lb3HhTaiYXzS%0ARPGL%2BrRIOdfNyPmcxw%3D%3D%0A)

Once the results are generated, select **Save & Download**, which will download a CSV file in the required format.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602029279/668a405cc0c645b2d289610f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=24e0c301d9630a6dfb79e017a63c9497dfb3cf94d13fd92a0a944dff7b2203c4&req=ciAlFst3n4ZWFb4f3HP0gLHiG55ZCiJdWkPbkTWzWySWV2q1wIaqDXgoA%2F8D%0AxioICjguRX1yyc%2FBVg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602029279/668a405cc0c645b2d289610f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=24e0c301d9630a6dfb79e017a63c9497dfb3cf94d13fd92a0a944dff7b2203c4&req=ciAlFst3n4ZWFb4f3HP0gLHiG55ZCiJdWkPbkTWzWySWV2q1wIaqDXgoA%2F8D%0AxioICjguRX1yyc%2FBVg%3D%3D%0A)

The CSV file can then be uploaded via the NDIA myplace provider portal. More information on this process is [available via the NDIS website](https://www.ndis.gov.au/providers/working-provider/getting-paid/bulk-payments)
.

Managing Existing Bulk Exports
==============================

All exports created using the NDIS Bulk Export report will be saved and can be downloaded again if required. To view previous exports, go to the [main report page](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/ndisbulkpayments)
 and apply your desired filters.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602029725/f04024defb8ce5cb6045d676/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=483194fbf0526bae83975b9d40c115464e1b1f0d695beb5b1e176cda50b70283&req=ciAlFst3moNaFb4f3HP0gNysEmHC28kJTJ9JRUXZ03tlDv2mLmSwXm2Se%2FPi%0ALnrIrS19XMK7ivevsg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602029725/f04024defb8ce5cb6045d676/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=483194fbf0526bae83975b9d40c115464e1b1f0d695beb5b1e176cda50b70283&req=ciAlFst3moNaFb4f3HP0gNysEmHC28kJTJ9JRUXZ03tlDv2mLmSwXm2Se%2FPi%0ALnrIrS19XMK7ivevsg%3D%3D%0A)

A list of previous exports will be displayed, which you can export, delete or pay off in bulk.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602030009/e016a7390689a07f23df0579/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=816fbe5701e03e6bc3ab133bd9c72661e31d41759c8afdfd4c59d00ff476dae9&req=ciAlFsp%2BnYFWFb4f3HP0gLuG27HCGEj7z28G2%2FMRJeu1e3zrXDQff2P63Kj9%0AtAKR%2BbU5Xq20osIOrw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602030009/e016a7390689a07f23df0579/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=816fbe5701e03e6bc3ab133bd9c72661e31d41759c8afdfd4c59d00ff476dae9&req=ciAlFsp%2BnYFWFb4f3HP0gLuG27HCGEj7z28G2%2FMRJeu1e3zrXDQff2P63Kj9%0AtAKR%2BbU5Xq20osIOrw%3D%3D%0A)

The final step in this process is paying off the items included in an export once payment is made by the NDIA. [Information regarding paying off exports in bulk can be found here](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5754666-paying-off-ndis-bulk-exports)

Paying Off NDIS Bulk Exports
============================

Paying off NDIS bulk exports

Updated over 3 years ago

The NDIS Bulk Export Report is used to pay off items included in an NDIS CSV export in bulk.

Go to **[Reports > Integrations > NDIS Bulk Export](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/ndisbulkpayments)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987565/5df9e862717b23d2c30daf3c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cce6979e6dc938a4c53ad89ce2d426b60a7a396d72e84a690af99c7f6aab6816&req=ciAmH8F5mIdaFb4f3HP0gG7YoDhfGEOW7LO9aunT73FbsKfZrY9y%2FkxphN%2Bc%0AXmGoXT7MxjbrZV7zBQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987565/5df9e862717b23d2c30daf3c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cce6979e6dc938a4c53ad89ce2d426b60a7a396d72e84a690af99c7f6aab6816&req=ciAmH8F5mIdaFb4f3HP0gG7YoDhfGEOW7LO9aunT73FbsKfZrY9y%2FkxphN%2Bc%0AXmGoXT7MxjbrZV7zBQ%3D%3D%0A)

Use the filters to search for previously generated exports that you wish to pay off.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987699/41167a15a0f9dd977870528e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ceeae5ef2c15e56fb9ad10d06af732b89c19dc1db1c981f8cb18c20620ceec99&req=ciAmH8F5m4hWFb4f3HP0gHKXh5rvS9uaODIh8xCz0tM0igj1u%2Bkr9xdLGN%2B2%0AfhU%2BzhO6kXks17aamA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987699/41167a15a0f9dd977870528e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ceeae5ef2c15e56fb9ad10d06af732b89c19dc1db1c981f8cb18c20620ceec99&req=ciAmH8F5m4hWFb4f3HP0gHKXh5rvS9uaODIh8xCz0tM0igj1u%2Bkr9xdLGN%2B2%0AfhU%2BzhO6kXks17aamA%3D%3D%0A)

In the grid of results, select the export that you wish to pay off and select the **Payment** button. Only one export can be paid at a time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987832/d62b4dc4444f1be53a0be8d8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7a3612aec01273c553d8dbcdbfd95f83a05c69c454c0693f6947d4d18fae13f&req=ciAmH8F5lYJdFb4f3HP0gN3jin0hVIeGHJoWZfRUfSKzs8Qdq%2BvlSoFlHfxu%0AVKT3qEIyIdb4L396%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601987832/d62b4dc4444f1be53a0be8d8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7a3612aec01273c553d8dbcdbfd95f83a05c69c454c0693f6947d4d18fae13f&req=ciAmH8F5lYJdFb4f3HP0gN3jin0hVIeGHJoWZfRUfSKzs8Qdq%2BvlSoFlHfxu%0AVKT3qEIyIdb4L396%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)

_Group Cheques_ and _Group Bank Transfers_ are the only supported payment methods for NDIS exports.

By default, the payment entered will be set to auto allocate i.e. paying off the oldest item to the newest item. Use the **edit** button next to the allocation dropdown if you wish to manually select which items to pay off.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601988094/737947f8ed594847c9f49449/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44fc4fa2cd7d58eefb2ffed0f1f1470ef0d912bc665ff7f16a218f1706a6f0dd&req=ciAmH8F2nYhbFb4f3HP0gLdxRFFvNbvENslj0nBHL7O3w36c7qkfGcfECGOm%0AcZ7KSOTdFeQde49ByA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601988094/737947f8ed594847c9f49449/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44fc4fa2cd7d58eefb2ffed0f1f1470ef0d912bc665ff7f16a218f1706a6f0dd&req=ciAmH8F2nYhbFb4f3HP0gLdxRFFvNbvENslj0nBHL7O3w36c7qkfGcfECGOm%0AcZ7KSOTdFeQde49ByA%3D%3D%0A)

In the popup window that appears, you'll be able to allocate the payment to specific invoices or specific items.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601988425/43e3a282771261e0d87cd81a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=506ef624ac05f3052b83d35ad2d9f1f6368c1abe9d83c20ea73759b2390f9436&req=ciAmH8F2mYNaFb4f3HP0gFU77N0TsA9dVofqHxU9CihK0j5uBba6WB3ZnKoP%0A5qByocVbLcIIjOJDwA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601988425/43e3a282771261e0d87cd81a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=506ef624ac05f3052b83d35ad2d9f1f6368c1abe9d83c20ea73759b2390f9436&req=ciAmH8F2mYNaFb4f3HP0gFU77N0TsA9dVofqHxU9CihK0j5uBba6WB3ZnKoP%0A5qByocVbLcIIjOJDwA%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Save** button to finalise paying off the export.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601988473/047de300d47a869f60a1ccfa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2c031f219418e96cb720b6a24a518beeb489c435076c73ea517cf82d0eefb247&req=ciAmH8F2mYZcFb4f3HP0gKM7ZP37A%2FaKHB4bULqe4Dyhyc4SQkg3KDOuMTYF%0AviXiyRR1hXG9Z7bhow%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601988473/047de300d47a869f60a1ccfa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2c031f219418e96cb720b6a24a518beeb489c435076c73ea517cf82d0eefb247&req=ciAmH8F2mYZcFb4f3HP0gKM7ZP37A%2FaKHB4bULqe4Dyhyc4SQkg3KDOuMTYF%0AviXiyRR1hXG9Z7bhow%3D%3D%0A)

Managing NDIS Item Codes
========================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[General Tips for Setting Up NDIS Item Codes In PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5759042-managing-ndis-item-codes#h_c67bcb9f33)

General Tips for Setting Up NDIS Item Codes In PracSuite
========================================================

Below are some general tips for setting up NDIS billing/item Codes in PracSuite.

Item Codes can be set up in [Settings > Billing > Item Codes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
.

Due to the length of NDIS item codes, you will need to choose a shorter code (a maximum of 7 characters) to enter in the Item Code field that will only be used internally in PracSuite. The full code and description must be entered in the Description field. You also want to set a generic 'Print Code As' option, such as NDIS. This will override the internal Item Code when printed on invoices so that it doesn't cause any confusion for plan managers paying invoices.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1185153524/060e9eaa64654696f38f4d0a/CleanShot+2024-09-19+at+12_26_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b523edc597dda62528f0ff8570684763e43160ed659f706f0392494f040b93c&req=dSEvE8h7noRdXfMW1HO4zZhceUegyn2oeLQoGUteTcglkf9s1%2FlSvGuu8fVP%0A7IJ7Ggg%2Fv0QNNNI%2F1rA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1185153524/060e9eaa64654696f38f4d0a/CleanShot+2024-09-19+at+12_26_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4b523edc597dda62528f0ff8570684763e43160ed659f706f0392494f040b93c&req=dSEvE8h7noRdXfMW1HO4zZhceUegyn2oeLQoGUteTcglkf9s1%2FlSvGuu8fVP%0A7IJ7Ggg%2Fv0QNNNI%2F1rA%3D%0A)

You'll need to repeate the steps above to create duplicates for each variant of this NDIS item code. e.g. One for standard service charges, non face-to-face charges, travel etc.

Separating item codes in this way will provide your practice with greater flexibility when reporting on your invoiced item codes as it will provide a clear breakdown of income generated from standard service charges, non face-to-face charges, travel etc.

**Do you know about the Hourly Billing feature?**

Hourly Billing is designed for practices that invoice at an hourly rate, such as with the NDIS. When invoicing via the Appointment Book, Hourly Billing will set the quantity field for the item code based on the appointment duration. For example, a quantity of 1 = 60 minutes, 0.5 = 30 minutes etc.

[Learn More About Hourly Billing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8648935-using-the-hourly-billing-feature)

* * *

Item Codes and the NDIS Agency Managed Integration
==================================================

After [enabling the NDIS integration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5735167-enabling-the-ndis-integration)
, it is essential to configure any NDIS item codes so that they appear correctly in the bulk export that will be uploaded to the agency website.

Enabling the NDIS Claim Option on Item Codes
--------------------------------------------

Go to **[Settings > Billing > Item Codes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
**.

The NDIS claiming option only needs to be enabled if you're using the [NDIS integration designed for agency-managed patients only.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8303276-what-to-know-about-the-ndis-and-pracsuite#h_fedf58556e)
 **If you're not an agency-registered provider, you do not need to enable the claim option at this time.**

Due to the length of NDIS item codes, you will need to choose a shorter code (a maximum of 7 characters) to enter in the Item Code field used internally in PracSuite. The full code and description must be entered in the Description field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/826462143/cad2da6c130daa8513ad512e/CleanShot+2023-09-09+at+14.54.22%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3668a0dbacef6772dc0ff1975524d34221deca2d762be992e3b1d18b19f746f8&req=fCIhEs98nIVcFb4f3HP0gDLXCtALHTnmG%2FANcfHrPHKG%2BWH9FsBjlMTElv0O%0ANT6SpGdlyFb1WhaIwg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/826462143/cad2da6c130daa8513ad512e/CleanShot+2023-09-09+at+14.54.22%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3668a0dbacef6772dc0ff1975524d34221deca2d762be992e3b1d18b19f746f8&req=fCIhEs98nIVcFb4f3HP0gDLXCtALHTnmG%2FANcfHrPHKG%2BWH9FsBjlMTElv0O%0ANT6SpGdlyFb1WhaIwg%3D%3D%0A)

You can also choose how the item code will be exported in the bulk upload CSV. PracSuite can either convert the item code quantity to hours, or output the exact quantity.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601989197/5f4ada4fb6acaf2069f3d964/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=280f188d3e22728f439d93108660611d5292cb1046e674e02b6b63a93c197444&req=ciAmH8F3nIhYFb4f3HP0gOXrGuKcBWOa9M2lXEKVeYbvujiB7XvQCBl9w%2Fz%2B%0AqtWzMJEOKvjz2MwWQw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601989197/5f4ada4fb6acaf2069f3d964/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=280f188d3e22728f439d93108660611d5292cb1046e674e02b6b63a93c197444&req=ciAmH8F3nIhYFb4f3HP0gOXrGuKcBWOa9M2lXEKVeYbvujiB7XvQCBl9w%2Fz%2B%0AqtWzMJEOKvjz2MwWQw%3D%3D%0A)

An example of how this appears in the export is shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/826467125/096b5ad52e737d9370554588/CleanShot+2023-09-09+at+15.18.54%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52655874995f265b0642d9f0528ac2e2e5c00c7994fa04c819eae188882eac04&req=fCIhEs95nINaFb4f3HP0gLinUa7W6xtx%2BarEMceteItSzkXf5LiQFGGlPp%2F5%0ACol%2B%2FTNtMm7TyXsq1w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/826467125/096b5ad52e737d9370554588/CleanShot+2023-09-09+at+15.18.54%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52655874995f265b0642d9f0528ac2e2e5c00c7994fa04c819eae188882eac04&req=fCIhEs95nINaFb4f3HP0gLinUa7W6xtx%2BarEMceteItSzkXf5LiQFGGlPp%2F5%0ACol%2B%2FTNtMm7TyXsq1w%3D%3D%0A)

Item quantities can be set on the invoice screen.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/826464730/583905783e4d3b02d81eb9fe/CleanShot+2023-09-09+at+15.06.44%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab4de0d6cffcb0d48d050803e8873a461c829c9a4366216302fb7ac72231cbe4&req=fCIhEs96moJfFb4f3HP0gIGaCByozmlWi%2BygZlXQFg8%2BZ1zgdIdjZTR%2BX1fs%0Am9atA4t4g2Jc4X4VCA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/826464730/583905783e4d3b02d81eb9fe/CleanShot+2023-09-09+at+15.06.44%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab4de0d6cffcb0d48d050803e8873a461c829c9a4366216302fb7ac72231cbe4&req=fCIhEs96moJfFb4f3HP0gIGaCByozmlWi%2BygZlXQFg8%2BZ1zgdIdjZTR%2BX1fs%0Am9atA4t4g2Jc4X4VCA%3D%3D%0A)

We recommend billing in 15-minute increments to avoid rounding issues with common NDIS item codes when billing for e.g. 10-minute increments. These rounding issues can lead to getting underpaid or claims being rejected.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Duration** | **Quantity** |
| 15 minutes | 0.25 |
| 30 minutes | 0.5 |
| 45 minutes | 0.75 |
| 60 minutes | 1   |

PracSuite includes an '[NDIS rounding logic](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9463962-ndis-rounding)
' option to better handle item quantities and fees when invoicing under the NDIS, where fees are typically rounded down. It ensures smoother interactions with plan managers and the NDIA, reducing rounding issues and minimising rejections for invoices and bulk uploads.

[Learn More About NDIS Rounding](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9463962-ndis-rounding)

**Adding NDIS Item Codes to Invoices**
--------------------------------------

When adding Item Codes with the NDIS claim option enabled to an invoice, you will be prompted to select the appropriate claim type for the service.

Standard Service Charges will be selected as the default Claim Type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601989625/ec2cf001573364c6660628a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8157d17df7344816a8eef210ebe2cd69bd3364e6dd60389a7bf81fdb9409d7f4&req=ciAmH8F3m4NaFb4f3HP0gIN90xVY%2B%2F%2Bb4F3z9JxHtNmLyj2B5vzF4Lck%2F2P%2B%0A1Ac1x7Ke4aT5rAYCjg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601989625/ec2cf001573364c6660628a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8157d17df7344816a8eef210ebe2cd69bd3364e6dd60389a7bf81fdb9409d7f4&req=ciAmH8F3m4NaFb4f3HP0gIN90xVY%2B%2F%2Bb4F3z9JxHtNmLyj2B5vzF4Lck%2F2P%2B%0A1Ac1x7Ke4aT5rAYCjg%3D%3D%0A)

**Setting NDIS Claim Type Per Appointment Type**
------------------------------------------------

The NDIS Claim Type can automatically be set based on an Appointment Type. For example, if you're booking a travel appointment type, the NDIS Claim Type can automatically be set to Travel Charges.

Go to [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
.

In the Default Item Code & Duration section, select the appropriate NDIS Claim Type for this Appointment Type. This option will only be displayed when selecting Item Codes enabled for NDIS claiming.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012319037/c2be82415f028066ad53dc7f/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+11_29_22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=73c29d6781b91839d42eed64cf16483cd805cceb332405f3be7e8526813a89be&req=dSAmFMp%2FlIFcXvMW1HO4zYT8wJcZbpvvqNBEIM5g4yQTvba4SEJWhspVASPb%0AjYEDm%2B2tbdG5P9KAh5I%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012319037/c2be82415f028066ad53dc7f/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+11_29_22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=73c29d6781b91839d42eed64cf16483cd805cceb332405f3be7e8526813a89be&req=dSAmFMp%2FlIFcXvMW1HO4zYT8wJcZbpvvqNBEIM5g4yQTvba4SEJWhspVASPb%0AjYEDm%2B2tbdG5P9KAh5I%3D%0A)

Editing NDIS Claim Type On Existing Items
-----------------------------------------

To edit the Claim Type of an existing NDIS Item Code, select the **Item Code drop-down menu** and then select the **NDIS** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601989735/26b7fdfdaf42f66706db76b4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b893446bafb0a876a45bce9f9997ad04ab19febd74e0bb8ef747c4942286e97&req=ciAmH8F3moJaFb4f3HP0gCpaee7e%2BHD50BD13AaePrfGdqNB%2FtQCdL38CEGP%0A5v7SVoaOVrO2jqULlw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601989735/26b7fdfdaf42f66706db76b4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b893446bafb0a876a45bce9f9997ad04ab19febd74e0bb8ef747c4942286e97&req=ciAmH8F3moJaFb4f3HP0gCpaee7e%2BHD50BD13AaePrfGdqNB%2FtQCdL38CEGP%0A5v7SVoaOVrO2jqULlw%3D%3D%0A)

**Welcome Email**
=================

To begin the owner of the account must complete their PracSuite registration process. This process begins with a simple **Welcome Email** that will be sent to the account holder. If you have not received your Welcome Email, please [contact Smartsoft support.](https://pracsuite.com/ContactUs)

After clicking the **Get Started** button, they will be asked to set their **Password** and **Security Questions.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/433764568/506145138609ddeadf0339e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac70c941c149c1cbf5774ad2376e8c785def54acbed12908b960d2565b8fd850&req=cCMkEc96mIdXFb4f3HP0gHxJf8vp2e2gNYP0%2FgAAdvS99IISM5G2Y3Xvan%2Bz%0AxY9RIOME75QcdC8UMA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/433764568/506145138609ddeadf0339e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac70c941c149c1cbf5774ad2376e8c785def54acbed12908b960d2565b8fd850&req=cCMkEc96mIdXFb4f3HP0gHxJf8vp2e2gNYP0%2FgAAdvS99IISM5G2Y3Xvan%2Bz%0AxY9RIOME75QcdC8UMA%3D%3D%0A)

Upon logging in for the first time the user can then configure their **Two-Factor Authentication** as per the following article: [Setting up 2FA](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242927-how-to-enable-two-factor-authentication)

Once logged in you are officially ready to start setting up your PracSuite account!

 and drag and drop the PracSuite Setup Checklist widget as shown below:

**PracSuite Setup Essentials**
=================================

We recommend reading through the following articles to learn more about the recommended settings to configure before you can go live with PracSuite.

1.  **[General System Settings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4181566-configuring-general-system-settings)
    **  
    Enter the details of your PracSuite account.
    
2.  **[Settlement Accounts](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4181601-settlement-accounts)
    **  
    Enter banking details for incoming payments.  
    ​
    
3.  **[Businesses](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4181612-setting-up-a-new-business)
    **  
    Create business entities and locations.  
    ​
    
4.  **[Professions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4181668-setting-up-professions)
    **  
    Create professions that will be allocated to your practitioners.  
    ​
    
5.  **[Rosters](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides)
    **  
    Create rosters to determine when practitioners are available for appointments.  
    ​
    
6.  **[Practitioner files](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4181679-creating-a-new-practitioner-file)
    **  
    Create practitioner files, which are linked to both businesses and professions.
    
    Apply rosters and set availability per practitioner.
    
7.  **[Users](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353473-setting-up-a-pracsuite-user-account)** and **[Roles](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353460-creating-roles)**  
    Create users and roles, allowing access to the PracSuite system.  
    ​
    
8.  **[SMS Templates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317983-creating-sms-templates)
    **  
    Create SMS templates.  
    ​
    
9.  **[Email Templates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317970-creating-email-templates)
    **  
    Create Email templates.  
    ​
    
10.  **[Letter templates](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375690-creating-letter-templates)
    **  
    Create Letter templates.  
    ​
    
11.  **[Appointment Types](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types)
    \***  
    ​Appointment Types represent the bookings in your calendar for your services.  
    ​
    
12.  **[Fee Categories](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4196739-creating-a-fee-category)
    \***  
    ​Fee Categories are primarily used to identify the funding nature for a patient's services.  
    ​
    
13.  **[Item Codes](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317932-creating-item-codes)
    \***  
    Item Codes are added to invoices for your services and stock/products.  
    ​
    
14.  **[SMS Credit Purchase Settings](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/sms)
    **  
    ​Enable SMS credit purchasing to send SMS messages from PracSuite.  
    ​
    

\***If you are migrating from Front Desk, please DO NOT add any of the following unless directed by Smartsoft as they will be removed during the migration:**

*   Appointment Types
    
*   Item Codes
    
*   Fee Categories
    
*   Third-Party Payers
    
*   Referring Doctors
    
*   Referring Organisations
    
*   Tags
    

These will be added automatically through our data migration services. If you are uncertain, please discuss with Smartsoft before adding data manually.

You can create a few test patient files for training purposes but please limit the number of these patients to 10 or under. Creating too many patient files before the transfer can cause delays with the transfer itself as these need to be manually removed before the transfer can start.

* * *

**Completing Your Training**
============================

_If you have purchased 3 x 1-hour guided Zoom setup and training sessions, you will have received links to book these with our team. If you have not received these links, please contact our Business Care team._

With the setup process complete, you are now ready to begin training. The links below allow you to access the pre-recorded training videos.

**1\. Admin Training**
----------------------

The Admin Training session includes:

*   Working with patient files.
    
*   Creating and managing appointments.
    
*   Invoicing and payments.
    
*   Basic end-of-day reporting.
    

[Watch Recording](https://us02web.zoom.us/rec/share/HFdXFQAXh_4otwwuhHCntpuq_JFOI3qpuNWUzdBm2XKczdh_2ZfAgxWIuxRWcnig.YGR1pdVyECbjkn6T)

**2\. Practitioner Training**
-----------------------------

The Practitioner Training session includes:

*   Creating and managing clinical notes.
    
*   Clinical note templates.
    
*   Advanced reporting.

     and [Patient claiming](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5088412-how-to-submit-a-medicare-patient-claim-via-tyro-health-online)

    , [icare NSW](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5644625-icare-nsw-claiming-via-tyro-health-online)
    , [WorkSafe VIC](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284981-worksafe-victoria-claiming-via-tyro-health-online)
     & [Comcare claiming](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284980-comcare-claiming-via-tyro-health-online)
    
*   [Saving patient payment card info](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5129300-how-to-take-a-card-payment-via-tyro-health-online)
