*   [Instalment payments](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8060044-tyro-health-online-payment-instalments)
    
*   [Appointment Prepayment Links](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7889707-inserting-pre-payment-links-in-appointment-reminders)
    

[Click here to learn more about Tyro Health Online and its associated pricing.](https://www.tyrohealth.com/pricing/)

To use any of the above features, you will need to [set up your Tyro Health Online account](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/3193875-get-started-with-tyro-health-online)
 and integrate it with PracSuite. If you're

If you want to use the Medicare/DVA claiming features, note that you must submit provider registration paperwork to Services Australia. You will be guided through this process while setting up your Tyro Health Online account. Note that Services Australia can take several business days to process your registration for online claiming via Tyro Health Online.

If you're migrating from other software with integrated Medicare/DVA claiming, **DO NOT submit the paperwork to Service Australia** **until 5 days before your data migration.** Submitting the paperwork for online claiming via Tyro Health Online will **DEACTIVATE** any existing Medicare & DVA Online claiming functionality you have in place in other software.

If you choose not to use the Tyro Health Online integration, the only other integrated method of Medicare claiming is via the Tyro Health EFTPOS terminal.

[More information about the Tyro Health Online integration can be found here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-how-to-enable-the-pracsuite-medipass-integration)

**Forms**
=========

Forms allow you to create fully customisable patient forms (e.g. new patient forms) that can be automatically sent to patients in Appointment [Confirmations](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-automatic-appointment-confirmations)

. Patients can complete forms on their own device or on a tablet provided in the practice. Once completed, a patient's form responses are seamlessly updated on their patient file.

**Online Booking**
==================

Online bookings for individual and group appointments are available to all PracSuite users at no additional cost. PracSuite also offers both a **guest booking** path (patients do not require a login) and a **client login portal**, which allows patients to **check upcoming appointment times**, as well as options to **cancel** and **reschedule** their appointments.

_Note: If you're waiting for Appointment Types to be transferred across from Front Desk, you will only be able to work through this process following your data migration._

[View Setup Guide](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4766658-setting-up-online-bookings-in-pracsuite)

Forms Overview

Forms Overview
==============

Updated over 4 months ago

Forms allow you to create fully customisable patient forms (e.g. new patient forms) that can be automatically sent to patients in Appointment [Confirmations](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-automatic-appointment-confirmations)
 and [Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)
. Patients can complete forms on their own device or on a tablet provided in the practice. Once completed, a patient's form responses are seamlessly updated on their patient file.

The best way to learn how to setup Forms is by watching our information webinar.

[Watch Webinar](https://bit.ly/3meo5El)

To enable the Forms feature, go to **[Settings > Forms](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/forms)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602030311/42b0eef7394d187cc03baf89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9600bafa9078864a2dfecae7918c6e9acb03bcda9df4a16cf33691ab145b6e58&req=ciAlFsp%2BnoBeFb4f3HP0gDY1rjGOF3VMscZImpLoZxHXSyauc7ShpOwTv%2FDn%0AX6buIyV8ov0ncLnDXQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602030311/42b0eef7394d187cc03baf89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9600bafa9078864a2dfecae7918c6e9acb03bcda9df4a16cf33691ab145b6e58&req=ciAlFsp%2BnoBeFb4f3HP0gDY1rjGOF3VMscZImpLoZxHXSyauc7ShpOwTv%2FDn%0AX6buIyV8ov0ncLnDXQ%3D%3D%0A)

For practices that are already using the online booking feature, the easiest option is to select 'Copy From Online Booking', which will keep the branding of these two features in sync.

Alternatively, you can leave this option unchecked to use different branding for the Forms page.

After enabling Forms, you're now ready to start creating Form Templates. Click through the articles below that will step you through creating and using Forms:

*   [Creating Form Templates](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789044-creating-form-templates)
    
*   [Sending Forms Automatically in Appointment Confirmations and Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789045-sending-forms-automatically-in-appointment-confirmations-reminders)
    
*   [Sending Forms Manually via SMS and Email](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789048-sending-forms-to-patients-via-sms-email)
    
*   [Using a Practice Device (e.g. tablet) to Complete a Form](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789049-sending-forms-to-a-practice-supplied-device)
    
*   [Embedding Forms on Your Website (e.g. New Patient Referral Form)](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5801538-embedding-forms-into-an-existing-website)

**Form Basics**
===============

To create a Form Template, go to **[Settings > Forms > Form Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/forms/templates)
** and select **Add Template**.

Choose your preferred Name, Display Name (shown to patients), Folder and Merge Field. The Merge Field is inserted into SMS and email templates to send the form link to patients.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602031319/2b689e76920bb649a2ade600/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=554208ca2f84508debe156fe96218781c57e5d02cfbfe2062e252ac724607381&req=ciAlFsp%2FnoBWFb4f3HP0gHIfVCRq0ca2j3LVLLgyfuqVIFJklXVpSA5za264%0AC2HBBezx%2Bb%2FH%2Fx%2Fu4w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602031319/2b689e76920bb649a2ade600/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=554208ca2f84508debe156fe96218781c57e5d02cfbfe2062e252ac724607381&req=ciAlFsp%2FnoBWFb4f3HP0gHIfVCRq0ca2j3LVLLgyfuqVIFJklXVpSA5za264%0AC2HBBezx%2Bb%2FH%2Fx%2Fu4w%3D%3D%0A)

A **Description** for the form can be added, which will be displayed to the patient at the beginning of the form. A **Submission Confirmation Message** can also be added, which will be displayed to the patient once they complete the form.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602032099/141b7c345bd632bc06438dd1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db4aa03d8325abce4a58d2b458b032328bd7247743fd1e1f8d4036bccbc1009c&req=ciAlFsp8nYhWFb4f3HP0gDkZ3ypxQlh5PiNxTvx%2BUqx%2BPhLZp%2FqNVsMG1AbF%0AW0FBo6g18zidsnZebg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602032099/141b7c345bd632bc06438dd1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db4aa03d8325abce4a58d2b458b032328bd7247743fd1e1f8d4036bccbc1009c&req=ciAlFsp8nYhWFb4f3HP0gDkZ3ypxQlh5PiNxTvx%2BUqx%2BPhLZp%2FqNVsMG1AbF%0AW0FBo6g18zidsnZebg%3D%3D%0A)

In the **Form Defaults** section, you can set your default preferences for the following:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602032409/437df932ac4981e6472c01cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6403103b34cacc889c0b06cde2c28880fff55c1348ba1259482fd7bfe46d8a03&req=ciAlFsp8mYFWFb4f3HP0gDl3kx%2BStDdSrLP6%2BGHBkWgrI3KlsQUTczdPVTNl%0A%2F5S3pWX5teiCvI6%2FSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602032409/437df932ac4981e6472c01cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6403103b34cacc889c0b06cde2c28880fff55c1348ba1259482fd7bfe46d8a03&req=ciAlFsp8mYFWFb4f3HP0gDl3kx%2BStDdSrLP6%2BGHBkWgrI3KlsQUTczdPVTNl%0A%2F5S3pWX5teiCvI6%2FSQ%3D%3D%0A)

*   **Add to Clinical Notes** - [see below](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789044-creating-form-templates#h_41aa0aaeca)
    
*   **Prefill** - [see below](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789044-creating-form-templates#h_48cc8f885d)
    
*   **Required** - this marks the response from the patient as a required response
    

Use the **Add to Form** button to start adding elements to your form.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602032669/2edf0b1aa9938dd27e575e4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a0ade726aa5df7e30df3566c6a5831fc45995286edaaab60e0202b5d6be52aae&req=ciAlFsp8m4dWFb4f3HP0gMpfxu641TrJMyN6x7W9EDatwzB9XGLRENCpe%2BdA%0ASq3R6UH5UwAG3b%2BD8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/602032669/2edf0b1aa9938dd27e575e4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a0ade726aa5df7e30df3566c6a5831fc45995286edaaab60e0202b5d6be52aae&req=ciAlFsp8m4dWFb4f3HP0gMpfxu641TrJMyN6x7W9EDatwzB9XGLRENCpe%2BdA%0ASq3R6UH5UwAG3b%2BD8w%3D%3D%0A)

The Add to Form menu is separated into 3 sections; **Common Fields**, **Custom Fields** and **Formatting**. Continue reading to learn more.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435117963/f1fdd419d95f2ae3cbceae3e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=caa9689a92365ffc82a1ce2c96340ce44f987d575a354c2228bc8abf7a3e3ef7&req=cCMiF8h5lIdcFb4f3HP0gDThnrQxXVKSH%2FKTaeWD1vBAsBIJK3pooiMdZOhA%0A4e2GdFGUJP8%2FHf%2FMdw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435117963/f1fdd419d95f2ae3cbceae3e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=caa9689a92365ffc82a1ce2c96340ce44f987d575a354c2228bc8abf7a3e3ef7&req=cCMiF8h5lIdcFb4f3HP0gDThnrQxXVKSH%2FKTaeWD1vBAsBIJK3pooiMdZOhA%0A4e2GdFGUJP8%2FHf%2FMdw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Inserting Common Fields**
===========================

Common fields generally map one-to-one with existing patient file fields.

**Contact Details**
-------------------

Choose which contact details you wish to request from your patients.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435164215/6558fa5e7d0b83a078810826/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2949c39ffa496bdce8089e70535c648ba5b31cc1e081b1df8c6ac384c22ff458&req=cCMiF896n4BaFb4f3HP0gM8QMUR7c1MJeZVOjsgFH5Kf30l1zkw8%2FQJK3Vz4%0Aisz%2FfWehYfpWrlVdpw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435164215/6558fa5e7d0b83a078810826/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2949c39ffa496bdce8089e70535c648ba5b31cc1e081b1df8c6ac384c22ff458&req=cCMiF896n4BaFb4f3HP0gM8QMUR7c1MJeZVOjsgFH5Kf30l1zkw8%2FQJK3Vz4%0Aisz%2FfWehYfpWrlVdpw%3D%3D%0A)

**Patient File Fields**
-----------------------

Insert patient file fields that you would like the patient to fill in, including:

*   How did you find us?
    
*   Communication preferences
    
*   Health Fund (Member No, ID, Card No.)
    
*   Medicare, DVA and concession card details
    
*   GP details
    
*   Occupation
    
*   COVID vaccination status
    
*   NDIS Participant No.
    
*   Notes
    
*   Warnings
    

**Account Fields**
------------------

Insert patient account fields that you would like the patient to fill in, including:

*   Invoice & Statement Preferences
    
*   Referring Doctor
    
*   Account No.
    
*   Claim No.
    
*   Client ID
    
*   Employer
    
*   Injury Date & Description
    
*   Hospital
    

**Treatment Consent**
---------------------

Outline your consent to treatment text and choose the wording that requests the patient to accept.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435156998/eb0cab1c10c412a4cd6c83d7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=087a5e46b5bbd8ffab4a12c18459a0eb0cd66b6fca2f68eae7979f143e726c00&req=cCMiF8x4lIhXFb4f3HP0gH2BHW62T8%2BiEC5f1SQWEpB9%2BJy%2BxUwCCjdkeKn8%0ASjuIFmDODFV9HIas7w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435156998/eb0cab1c10c412a4cd6c83d7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=087a5e46b5bbd8ffab4a12c18459a0eb0cd66b6fca2f68eae7979f143e726c00&req=cCMiF8x4lIhXFb4f3HP0gH2BHW62T8%2BiEC5f1SQWEpB9%2BJy%2BxUwCCjdkeKn8%0ASjuIFmDODFV9HIas7w%3D%3D%0A)

**Privacy Policy**
------------------

Outline your Privacy Policy text and choose the wording that requests the patient to accept.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435157151/e42200afa35146b6af064abe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=63a153fc09bd8991fdce4080343ad8c2de8de5990f26cdd598ecdd34313126e6&req=cCMiF8x5nIReFb4f3HP0gBLhkeFTJPDTjTVlHWRQAft9dOouct6pQAZD83H5%0AlvTYVmLUUeOuolrpMQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435157151/e42200afa35146b6af064abe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=63a153fc09bd8991fdce4080343ad8c2de8de5990f26cdd598ecdd34313126e6&req=cCMiF8x5nIReFb4f3HP0gBLhkeFTJPDTjTVlHWRQAft9dOouct6pQAZD83H5%0AlvTYVmLUUeOuolrpMQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Signature**
-------------

Include the Signature tool for patients to electronically sign your form. Choose the wording that accompanies the signature field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435157296/6a155cbab25ddd11569fc0ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88c8e8ec6411a2008538acb77f68b0213cea9617dbf7bc1ad7c0cf8aa11a16e9&req=cCMiF8x5n4hZFb4f3HP0gPxwZ%2BgArwcw2prYdLe3vlcZEAXgDVvavmJTPM5q%0AmLn%2FyINZLuLBjEVBbg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435157296/6a155cbab25ddd11569fc0ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88c8e8ec6411a2008538acb77f68b0213cea9617dbf7bc1ad7c0cf8aa11a16e9&req=cCMiF8x5n4hZFb4f3HP0gPxwZ%2BgArwcw2prYdLe3vlcZEAXgDVvavmJTPM5q%0AmLn%2FyINZLuLBjEVBbg%3D%3D%0A)

**Inserting Custom Fields**
===========================

Along with the common fields above, forms can also include custom questions that aren't linked to existing patient file fields.

**Text Response**
-----------------

Designed for basic text responses, with the option to enable long answers.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435156298/e521792282dda1efe1270be4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=00aec56ab52f010d9521d6a631dc595c05a83bd1e4bc6acc91a32529e7a9390c&req=cCMiF8x4n4hXFb4f3HP0gIitnJigu3L8%2FKnof4FbinP9Ew7kbfcYotE29iC3%0AxQnju5EKO2Kk6xK%2FUA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435156298/e521792282dda1efe1270be4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=00aec56ab52f010d9521d6a631dc595c05a83bd1e4bc6acc91a32529e7a9390c&req=cCMiF8x4n4hXFb4f3HP0gIitnJigu3L8%2FKnof4FbinP9Ew7kbfcYotE29iC3%0AxQnju5EKO2Kk6xK%2FUA%3D%3D%0A)

Below is an example of a long answer text response.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435156174/bb629910f71bc3f86dbd03a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3abc66dc5b8a54572a66224b17322643c462693ff15ec0e3881411c726c6ef8b&req=cCMiF8x4nIZbFb4f3HP0gMV%2F8fsWrJqwSRkS%2B5rgPvGLbwFZ8lrMTEM9rEsx%0AaWZ12JBR37O2eHaVSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435156174/bb629910f71bc3f86dbd03a3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3abc66dc5b8a54572a66224b17322643c462693ff15ec0e3881411c726c6ef8b&req=cCMiF8x4nIZbFb4f3HP0gMV%2F8fsWrJqwSRkS%2B5rgPvGLbwFZ8lrMTEM9rEsx%0AaWZ12JBR37O2eHaVSQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Single Choice**
-----------------

Requires the patient to select one of the displayed options. Use the **Add "Other" Option** to display a blank text field for the patient to enter a custom option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435151388/55acc53cbd0cdf3efce37e7f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6ad38ff2dba0022721d3cb31044c07bae9078668216a66edb252964d95c70e82&req=cCMiF8x%2FnolXFb4f3HP0gOF8rtHra4%2FzwRrZ0acO7FjLkJLRITeodvWfDS76%0AnUcEHYCKmEBsF5EH%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435151388/55acc53cbd0cdf3efce37e7f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6ad38ff2dba0022721d3cb31044c07bae9078668216a66edb252964d95c70e82&req=cCMiF8x%2FnolXFb4f3HP0gOF8rtHra4%2FzwRrZ0acO7FjLkJLRITeodvWfDS76%0AnUcEHYCKmEBsF5EH%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)

**Multiple Choice**
-------------------

Outline a selection of options for the patient to select. Use the **Add "Other" Option** to display a blank text field for the patient to enter a custom option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435151324/249849a3255f98ce75c5e198/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1d956f10ceeb64566c84025c657e38321889a8c9ba81e3aa6fcecb2a8daa5157&req=cCMiF8x%2FnoNbFb4f3HP0gAoJvGdqPuMT4NEB1GfrPlruzIFHIXgKRl6meoCe%0AomKAgsPZG9pujve%2F1w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435151324/249849a3255f98ce75c5e198/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1d956f10ceeb64566c84025c657e38321889a8c9ba81e3aa6fcecb2a8daa5157&req=cCMiF8x%2FnoNbFb4f3HP0gAoJvGdqPuMT4NEB1GfrPlruzIFHIXgKRl6meoCe%0AomKAgsPZG9pujve%2F1w%3D%3D%0A)

**Number/Scale Response**
-------------------------

Allow your patient to use a sliding scale or a number stepper.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435151227/96fb0dd0a871c4927a8032e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=43a9d1674bde5da7ac4d14a67f436b3a8a4aaf63b71493150da86f555c75f352&req=cCMiF8x%2Fn4NYFb4f3HP0gBmTV%2F28M3WFsqL9to2CGK%2By7T0uQnaer1kLve0z%0ASqgL4EKujVuD%2B73V%2FA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435151227/96fb0dd0a871c4927a8032e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=43a9d1674bde5da7ac4d14a67f436b3a8a4aaf63b71493150da86f555c75f352&req=cCMiF8x%2Fn4NYFb4f3HP0gBmTV%2F28M3WFsqL9to2CGK%2By7T0uQnaer1kLve0z%0ASqgL4EKujVuD%2B73V%2FA%3D%3D%0A)

An example of the slider is below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435159984/d925a3d1394724b81ae60ed5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=71ac869244c5f2029eb73654e0f33d31c48b51330b18cd2f324a8e40e17b0509&req=cCMiF8x3lIlbFb4f3HP0gCJVA%2BxXj84oO0AkxqIhnT0lMXocixU%2F0O7WZ4Nn%0AOiHyF%2F3D9VQxKR7hBg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435159984/d925a3d1394724b81ae60ed5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=71ac869244c5f2029eb73654e0f33d31c48b51330b18cd2f324a8e40e17b0509&req=cCMiF8x3lIlbFb4f3HP0gCJVA%2BxXj84oO0AkxqIhnT0lMXocixU%2F0O7WZ4Nn%0AOiHyF%2F3D9VQxKR7hBg%3D%3D%0A)

**Attachment Upload**
---------------------

Ideal if you require a patient to upload a document while completing the form.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435150990/1682d525a6a3631deec9e802/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28b1a66a93121091a2615a2c64425a22242c137efb9cf6acf62f9cc99f71eb54&req=cCMiF8x%2BlIhfFb4f3HP0gB%2FLSbwzaS2heAuLrP56MxRJmzhGIJl0GifX8YVn%0A38roDUZ3W%2BRhMpbpnA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435150990/1682d525a6a3631deec9e802/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28b1a66a93121091a2615a2c64425a22242c137efb9cf6acf62f9cc99f71eb54&req=cCMiF8x%2BlIhfFb4f3HP0gB%2FLSbwzaS2heAuLrP56MxRJmzhGIJl0GifX8YVn%0A38roDUZ3W%2BRhMpbpnA%3D%3D%0A)

Question Matrix
---------------

The matrix component allows you to ask a series of related questions and calculate a score based on the answers.

[Click here to learn more](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8170237-using-a-matrix-in-patient-forms)
 about this component, including a sample template for a DASS21 test.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792429271/dd917fe149d5d558a43e8f71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=140efa57723029ec89e524b94be98f59b2b2675a81454e21a21bcf03d7251dce&req=cyklEst3n4ZeFb4f3HP0gM3ZAuR7wvcp3we7UxHNjMjjAjkvAvKBsJIw7YFC%0A1EPHvZyPDf8%2FSAqxow%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792429271/dd917fe149d5d558a43e8f71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=140efa57723029ec89e524b94be98f59b2b2675a81454e21a21bcf03d7251dce&req=cyklEst3n4ZeFb4f3HP0gM3ZAuR7wvcp3we7UxHNjMjjAjkvAvKBsJIw7YFC%0A1EPHvZyPDf8%2FSAqxow%3D%3D%0A)

Calculator
----------

Calculator component is can be used to outline NDIS budgets on service agreements, constructing a table of rates and calculating a client's Body Mass Index (BMI).

[Click here to learn more](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8610437-using-a-calculator-in-patient-forms)
 about this component, including sample templates for NDIS budgets and BMI calculations.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889079527/81e880d2595c1bcf3b5d24de/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a4471ba7f2774ea776280cce8328520fcd85d4fd7dab96af9fd5cb204f5f9c6&req=fCguFs53mINYFb4f3HP0gMY9vZNj0anVglJOLiJ%2FKzzB%2B65xc%2BKQTQ5BWEKz%0AJI7Jg0KYRG1qgkV01g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889079527/81e880d2595c1bcf3b5d24de/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a4471ba7f2774ea776280cce8328520fcd85d4fd7dab96af9fd5cb204f5f9c6&req=fCguFs53mINYFb4f3HP0gMY9vZNj0anVglJOLiJ%2FKzzB%2B65xc%2BKQTQ5BWEKz%0AJI7Jg0KYRG1qgkV01g%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Prefilling**
==============

Patient File fields added to forms have the option to prefill existing patient data. Select the Prefill option to enable this.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435148067/0278e76a8da09e5cf5da80c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ca4e5ff23748092fd0617bc547752a47f20953d36bd9462d66ba01124d30a2c8&req=cCMiF812nYdYFb4f3HP0gFXN5gpGPBe1EoJnbDYF7fJn2%2BYYy%2BoK0Ak0cTAt%0A6kQxyhML7LV6ztMv5w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435148067/0278e76a8da09e5cf5da80c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ca4e5ff23748092fd0617bc547752a47f20953d36bd9462d66ba01124d30a2c8&req=cCMiF812nYdYFb4f3HP0gFXN5gpGPBe1EoJnbDYF7fJn2%2BYYy%2BoK0Ak0cTAt%0A6kQxyhML7LV6ztMv5w%3D%3D%0A)

Note: We recommend caution with using the prefill function, in particular for Patient File fields like Notes and Warnings.

* * *

**Formatting**
==============

**Section Header**
------------------

Use Section Headers to organise and title different sections of your form. Section Headers also include the option to insert page breaks.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435150437/29ec0beb6a40dad14d909baa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5f56ff8dceee9a5be0231a582c15f5e3b457453feb5edb61d8799ebb8a213778&req=cCMiF8x%2BmYJYFb4f3HP0gPdYdyKyUSD59t2SXgTnEaMYs6%2BlKtiBfCknfueS%0AwZqxWiF7Uq0aMySh1w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435150437/29ec0beb6a40dad14d909baa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5f56ff8dceee9a5be0231a582c15f5e3b457453feb5edb61d8799ebb8a213778&req=cCMiF8x%2BmYJYFb4f3HP0gPdYdyKyUSD59t2SXgTnEaMYs6%2BlKtiBfCknfueS%0AwZqxWiF7Uq0aMySh1w%3D%3D%0A)

**Subheader**
-------------

Use subheaders to organise and title different sections of your form.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435150532/e48a006dc6baf36d579e0181/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=067acf6033c87c465adfee440e72bd47988e64d0403d2c314bdb7f08123e72f8&req=cCMiF8x%2BmIJdFb4f3HP0gOkaMKmL1V73v6MIYTBUyOo290Z9fR7Knqgxfn7%2B%0Acf2xU6fed6wkxIBGmw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435150532/e48a006dc6baf36d579e0181/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=067acf6033c87c465adfee440e72bd47988e64d0403d2c314bdb7f08123e72f8&req=cCMiF8x%2BmIJdFb4f3HP0gOkaMKmL1V73v6MIYTBUyOo290Z9fR7Knqgxfn7%2B%0Acf2xU6fed6wkxIBGmw%3D%3D%0A)

**Information Block**
---------------------

Information blocks allow you to add rich text and images into your form. They are intended to be used for guiding text as they do not require a response from a patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435158958/b9dc5533994750f736885981/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d3744ad39441576cef4d47859bff8b13d7459932acbd9554d5b200de89bf932e&req=cCMiF8x2lIRXFb4f3HP0gBn21MteclG9Hgpv5TUHZhXoP45liFtsChA0piNG%0ALVwbuuo%2BOm3DDUIZjQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435158958/b9dc5533994750f736885981/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d3744ad39441576cef4d47859bff8b13d7459932acbd9554d5b200de89bf932e&req=cCMiF8x2lIRXFb4f3HP0gBn21MteclG9Hgpv5TUHZhXoP45liFtsChA0piNG%0ALVwbuuo%2BOm3DDUIZjQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Label**
---------

Labels appear as simple text within your form. They are intended to be used for guiding text as they do not require a response from a patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435159195/e55eb9a1f9ddefe9ca2230f0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=41358674a863b7dca76d6ab67841e82e03f22563ea0f0bf1a627cfe6e123b951&req=cCMiF8x3nIhaFb4f3HP0gET1s8jkdOVkAjcvdfEedyXkTAdzPWtex7zb3Amx%0AQEdWvWVGQ4EJsKyYlQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435159195/e55eb9a1f9ddefe9ca2230f0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=41358674a863b7dca76d6ab67841e82e03f22563ea0f0bf1a627cfe6e123b951&req=cCMiF8x3nIhaFb4f3HP0gET1s8jkdOVkAjcvdfEedyXkTAdzPWtex7zb3Amx%0AQEdWvWVGQ4EJsKyYlQ%3D%3D%0A)

Warning Block
-------------

Warning blocks allow you to draw attention to important information in your form using a coloured background of your choosing.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1002315363/71d1f75acc7e81211a3b94b3/CleanShot+2024-03-26+at+09_15_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=020456c7af527a4e4a056e3e7e9c2d7ff8e45ad4743a63f232a59b931742d4b5&req=dSAnFMp%2FmIJZWvMW1HO4zT%2Fewa%2BhS4MuU7tcNoTbfmReTyT49iI4AfJUqFr6%0AvPfREO%2B2Qb%2B9a2IKlgg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1002315363/71d1f75acc7e81211a3b94b3/CleanShot+2024-03-26+at+09_15_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=020456c7af527a4e4a056e3e7e9c2d7ff8e45ad4743a63f232a59b931742d4b5&req=dSAnFMp%2FmIJZWvMW1HO4zT%2Fewa%2BhS4MuU7tcNoTbfmReTyT49iI4AfJUqFr6%0AvPfREO%2B2Qb%2B9a2IKlgg%3D%0A)

**Displaying Responses to Practitioners in Clinical Notes**
===========================================================

If questions in the form are clinical in nature, enabling the **Add to Clinical Notes** option will automatically display the response within the patient's clinical notes timeline.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435121752/96b43be25a586315a123a666/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=62230ab2ae35b03973758e40857a598189eeba6e9964734acf0af4121a09bf7e&req=cCMiF8t%2FmoRdFb4f3HP0gCce10kWPHAuPd2SYnkcgUWzzFujOFG%2FLrpouky3%0ASTmt%2FjpzB75ubME8ZQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435121752/96b43be25a586315a123a666/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=62230ab2ae35b03973758e40857a598189eeba6e9964734acf0af4121a09bf7e&req=cCMiF8t%2FmoRdFb4f3HP0gCce10kWPHAuPd2SYnkcgUWzzFujOFG%2FLrpouky3%0ASTmt%2FjpzB75ubME8ZQ%3D%3D%0A)

Any form responses marked with **Add to Clinical Notes** will appear in the patient's clinical notes timeline with a yellow banner as shown below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435156783/2c93ae20e0731c55700242e4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdce0395c0789a7510ea01bd9e4e92162f49d4146ee1841329a8c76f35b18958&req=cCMiF8x4molcFb4f3HP0gMuDBSRAKD%2FZhdUgDw%2BRRR1VI46tzkpYSzDVsjia%0AsHoevsPWuNldY7wo%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435156783/2c93ae20e0731c55700242e4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fdce0395c0789a7510ea01bd9e4e92162f49d4146ee1841329a8c76f35b18958&req=cCMiF8x4molcFb4f3HP0gMuDBSRAKD%2FZhdUgDw%2BRRR1VI46tzkpYSzDVsjia%0AsHoevsPWuNldY7wo%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)

**Confidential Form Responses**
===============================

When using the Add to Clinical Notes option, you also have the option to mark the response as **Confidential**, which will only be visible to the treating practitioner and will not be visible to admin staff when processing the form.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435122137/f55117206c9ecead795e29a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8738a6bb076e9af4af05fa40bd9f5d14d20065b24b45d5e8fc7201b3cae77923&req=cCMiF8t8nIJYFb4f3HP0gAteTeEsC84P0w38gEoOiWwPIItpbAD8AusZC0kO%0AQHnk%2FE3yeH73trZAaw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435122137/f55117206c9ecead795e29a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8738a6bb076e9af4af05fa40bd9f5d14d20065b24b45d5e8fc7201b3cae77923&req=cCMiF8t8nIJYFb4f3HP0gAteTeEsC84P0w38gEoOiWwPIItpbAD8AusZC0kO%0AQHnk%2FE3yeH73trZAaw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Branching**
=============

Branching allows you to add logic to your forms so that the questions displayed to the patient change according to their responses. If the questions don't apply, the patient is redirected to a different set of questions or will skip a set of questions altogether.

**Before enabling branching, we strongly recommend that you add all your desired questions to the form.** When you're ready to add branching, follow these steps.

Branching works best with single choice questions. In the example below, we ask 'Do you have health insurance?' By enabling branching, you are able to direct the patient to different questions depending on their response. If they answer yes, they will be directed to question 9, which asks them for their health fund details. If they answer no, they will skip over question 9 entirely.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435126822/7b5196837819d30dc65781db/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b2531c0954764162e510a5562f7d7a80a98f30115c50ac6143605cd887195287&req=cCMiF8t4lYNdFb4f3HP0gGNWmnuP3tNWureCany5mxszd9Iy9EAyz8WKG4VD%0AiZq6d7Qp6u3aYiNA0g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/435126822/7b5196837819d30dc65781db/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b2531c0954764162e510a5562f7d7a80a98f30115c50ac6143605cd887195287&req=cCMiF8t4lYNdFb4f3HP0gGNWmnuP3tNWureCany5mxszd9Iy9EAyz8WKG4VD%0AiZq6d7Qp6u3aYiNA0g%3D%3D%0A)

Sending Forms Automatically in Appointment Confirmations & Reminders

Sending Forms Automatically in Appointment Confirmations & Reminders
====================================================================

Automatically send new patients a link to complete your intake form on their own device

Updated over 3 weeks ago

Table of contents

[Adding Your Form Link to an SMS or Email template](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789045-sending-forms-automatically-in-appointment-confirmations-reminders#h_7613fb1255)

[Configuring Appointment Confirmations](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789045-sending-forms-automatically-in-appointment-confirmations-reminders#h_7011b28244)

[Configuring Appointment Reminders](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789045-sending-forms-automatically-in-appointment-confirmations-reminders#h_e763f1f877)

[Form Link Expiry Time Frames](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789045-sending-forms-automatically-in-appointment-confirmations-reminders#h_d002719d1e)

PracSuite can automatically send form links to patients in both [Appointment Confirmations](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-automatic-appointment-confirmations)
 (sent at the time the appointment is booked) as well as in [Appointment Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)
 (generally sent 1-2 days before an appointment).

The article assumes that you have created a Form Template that you wish to use for these scenarios. [Click here to view further information on how to create a Form Template](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789044-creating-form-templates)
.

* * *

**Adding Your Form Link to an SMS or Email template**
-----------------------------------------------------

For both Confirmations and Reminders, the first step is to create an SMS or email template with your desired text as well as the form link.

Along with your desired text, use the **Form drop-down list** to insert your form link into the template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614707678/d09b84fad3bdad35c811891f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=69115f02f9c62fd4b4e06d818b3a82ff02cac91d2796041508ff66e4e1fc8cd3&req=ciEjEcl5m4ZXFb4f3HP0gIsIoaCzxkFIM%2B5RiRBp%2FTw8X06y3WgP7pg6e7he%0AT%2FqwBqORzDRWdjow5w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614707678/d09b84fad3bdad35c811891f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=69115f02f9c62fd4b4e06d818b3a82ff02cac91d2796041508ff66e4e1fc8cd3&req=ciEjEcl5m4ZXFb4f3HP0gIsIoaCzxkFIM%2B5RiRBp%2FTw8X06y3WgP7pg6e7he%0AT%2FqwBqORzDRWdjow5w%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting your desired form, you will see a merge tag in your template which will be used to automatically generate the form link when an Appointment Confirmation or Appointment Reminder is sent to patients.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614708171/066a1bbfda9a43f39eace037/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=598329e0de5978388fdb7ead6b6924a7e00dc9611866da78f56dd58521987ebc&req=ciEjEcl2nIZeFb4f3HP0gKl93yt%2BYAYuEKoY0jCbwFBaC%2B%2Fwg2hM0A2g3kZ0%0A7BCwQg5fHIPKws76%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614708171/066a1bbfda9a43f39eace037/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=598329e0de5978388fdb7ead6b6924a7e00dc9611866da78f56dd58521987ebc&req=ciEjEcl2nIZeFb4f3HP0gKl93yt%2BYAYuEKoY0jCbwFBaC%2B%2Fwg2hM0A2g3kZ0%0A7BCwQg5fHIPKws76%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Configuring Appointment Confirmations**
-----------------------------------------

Appointment Confirmations can be used to automatically send patients a link to complete the form at the time an appointment is booked. Once your SMS or email template has been completed, the next step is to select this template when configuring Appointment Confirmations. [Click here to learn more about configuring Appointment Confirmations](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-automatic-appointment-confirmations)
.

* * *

**Configuring Appointment Reminders**
-------------------------------------

Appointment Reminders can be used to automatically send patients a link to complete the form at the time an appointment is booked. Once your SMS or email template has been completed, the next step is to select this template when configuring Appointment Confirmations.

[Click here to learn more about configuring SMS Appointment Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-automatic-appointment-confirmations)
.

[Click here to learn more about configuring Email Appointment Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386614-enabling-automatic-email-reminders)
.

Once completed by the patient, the form will be sent to PracSuite for staff to process. [You can learn more about processing completed forms here](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789051-processing-completed-forms)
.

* * *

**Form Link Expiry Time Frames**
--------------------------------

For security reasons, form links expire after a set period of time. The expiration window depends on how the link is generated or delivered.

**When sending links by email:**

Standard form links expire **60 days** after they are created.  
​

**When sending links by SMS:**

When a form link is sent via SMS, a shortened link is used to save characters. These SMS short links expire after **14 days**.

**When manually entering a code, or scanning a QR code:**

Forms accessed manually expire after **1 hour**.  
​

Note: If the same form is sent to the patient again, the expiration timer resets.

Sending Forms to Patients via SMS & Email

Sending Forms to Patients via SMS & Email
=========================================

Allow your patients to complete the form on their own device

Updated over 3 years ago

To manually send a patient a link to complete a form, go to the **Forms tab** of their **Patient File**.

Select **Send Form** at the top of the webpage.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594901710/99591b7c63d9f6c0cb7ac264/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35a4ca55a41d2a332d2c449d6551935589853b9e2f200b545b171034e04ae6c1&req=cSkjH8l%2FmoBfFb4f3HP0gG%2BfD1gbFYjt5%2B7nJmup85EgE3%2Bw5FRXevhIawfw%0AWd0ABuFpToPLE2Ptvg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594901710/99591b7c63d9f6c0cb7ac264/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35a4ca55a41d2a332d2c449d6551935589853b9e2f200b545b171034e04ae6c1&req=cSkjH8l%2FmoBfFb4f3HP0gG%2BfD1gbFYjt5%2B7nJmup85EgE3%2Bw5FRXevhIawfw%0AWd0ABuFpToPLE2Ptvg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the form you wish to send, the account that the form relates to, and then **select** **either Email or SMS.** The drop downs menus will allow you to select email templates that the form link appears in.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594901644/25d0315f741810baf4d19733/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1229591ec21d6fa45cc4cdce0a92c9a28423bafbb4eaa86cf643fcf2a4dbe1c7&req=cSkjH8l%2Fm4VbFb4f3HP0gISL9td5WVAIgMXj1fyEOdnMJd8E2y1Wky4nJ63m%0ANSWxetua5XB5lInfLA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594901644/25d0315f741810baf4d19733/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1229591ec21d6fa45cc4cdce0a92c9a28423bafbb4eaa86cf643fcf2a4dbe1c7&req=cSkjH8l%2Fm4VbFb4f3HP0gISL9td5WVAIgMXj1fyEOdnMJd8E2y1Wky4nJ63m%0ANSWxetua5XB5lInfLA%3D%3D%0A)

The compose window will appear for you to finalise your message and to send the form link to the patient.

Once completed by the patient, the form will be sent to PracSuite for staff to process. [You can learn more about processing completed forms here](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789051-processing-completed-forms)
.

Sending Forms to a Practice Supplied Device

Sending Forms to a Practice Supplied Device
===========================================

Provide your patient with a tablet to complete the form in the practice

Updated over 11 months ago

While links can be sent to patients to complete the form on their own device, you can also provide patients with a device, such as an iPad/tablet, to complete the form in the practice.

Go to the **Forms tab** of the **Patient File** and select **Send Form**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594901852/3f3450a5e61d1aade74d0447/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6050a52ea3ff4b24b96e5eb10d043809c7c1128c535871deb50573b2c4518f98&req=cSkjH8l%2FlYRdFb4f3HP0gBG1g9CfjmrvJJYW2evlWOTe68BMf4KioEdhnjUy%0AhxP5%2FTH8ogVaOMezdw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594901852/3f3450a5e61d1aade74d0447/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6050a52ea3ff4b24b96e5eb10d043809c7c1128c535871deb50573b2c4518f98&req=cSkjH8l%2FlYRdFb4f3HP0gBG1g9CfjmrvJJYW2evlWOTe68BMf4KioEdhnjUy%0AhxP5%2FTH8ogVaOMezdw%3D%3D%0A)

  
Select the form you wish to send, the account that the form relates to, and then select **Get Code.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594902031/80b8ed246d1d0de6b2739707/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=11996ea0caa78da5f1617991f6dfbb9331c0bd51c6a50eaa9f8cbecfd5370b9c&req=cSkjH8l8nYJeFb4f3HP0gJAt3%2FAOzx7aJRyoaSe%2FYCM7IbMsiQXGc4bNjTyy%0AspEN7P%2BB6xrcVI1rzg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594902031/80b8ed246d1d0de6b2739707/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=11996ea0caa78da5f1617991f6dfbb9331c0bd51c6a50eaa9f8cbecfd5370b9c&req=cSkjH8l8nYJeFb4f3HP0gJAt3%2FAOzx7aJRyoaSe%2FYCM7IbMsiQXGc4bNjTyy%0AspEN7P%2BB6xrcVI1rzg%3D%3D%0A)

  
You can either **scan the QR code** with the device you'll provide to the patient, or follow the instructions to manually type in the form code on your device.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594902125/a27969ac3716c969ceaf5ffd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f01a1f9ac6b988f6459bad19cdec4228f0f3748356e9d5fac167fb34df36d8d6&req=cSkjH8l8nINaFb4f3HP0gOHiVWh%2B09p5JcqPk7oyUS2hFk7O2AkzHOq4JWw1%0APUZqM8bbjVMSj7odlA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594902125/a27969ac3716c969ceaf5ffd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f01a1f9ac6b988f6459bad19cdec4228f0f3748356e9d5fac167fb34df36d8d6&req=cSkjH8l8nINaFb4f3HP0gOHiVWh%2B09p5JcqPk7oyUS2hFk7O2AkzHOq4JWw1%0APUZqM8bbjVMSj7odlA%3D%3D%0A)

You can now hand over the device to the patient for them to complete the form. Once completed by the patient, the form will be sent to PracSuite for staff to process. [You can learn more about processing completed forms here](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789051-processing-completed-forms)
.

**Important:**  
Please be mindful of what the patient can access on your device. Most businesses using this approach set up a dedicated device in "Kiosk" or "Guided Access" mode to restrict access to other applications, websites, downloads, browsing history, and settings.

Please refer to your I.T. provider for assistance with restricted access devices.

## Document 211 — Processing Completed Forms | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-211}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789051-processing-completed-forms](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789051-processing-completed-forms)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789051-processing-completed-forms#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Forms](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3247047-forms)

Processing Completed Forms

Processing Completed Forms
==========================

Process form responses into the patient file

Updated this week

When a form has been completed by a patient, a notification will be displayed in the **Alerts** section.

**Select the form alert** to start processing the patient's responses into their patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631893392/60848b034c0bfe552b296580/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6547f2f1a6119f6788ca00f3023fe7298cc332fbe100376321bc5e8b88ac2104&req=ciMmHsB9nohdFb4f3HP0gM%2BHFpZPirSRB0H4Lo9%2B5YysWwREwqwf7fFb4C3M%0AhegTlsQrK5CxfFwaxw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631893392/60848b034c0bfe552b296580/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6547f2f1a6119f6788ca00f3023fe7298cc332fbe100376321bc5e8b88ac2104&req=ciMmHsB9nohdFb4f3HP0gM%2BHFpZPirSRB0H4Lo9%2B5YysWwREwqwf7fFb4C3M%0AhegTlsQrK5CxfFwaxw%3D%3D%0A)

If a form is not already associated with a patient, you will be asked to link the form to a new or existing patient file.

Once associated with a patient file, the patient's responses (excluding confidential fields) will be displayed.

Forms containing patient account fields or confidential fields will require you to select the **Treating Practitioner** and **Account** that the form relates to.

You will also need to resolve any conflicts that arise between the existing patient file data and the information collected on the form.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631893683/3ef9dd575b403caa202d81dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5581f8080a1b2abf3c009c9f469d3f5c89eea6ec94f02e44a246627e5b55e1cc&req=ciMmHsB9m4lcFb4f3HP0gGxeraSkk332QO%2BQ2FqABgtit75x45x6oLJc9ap6%0ABbs%2FSAdvd6FAuMwcLg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631893683/3ef9dd575b403caa202d81dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5581f8080a1b2abf3c009c9f469d3f5c89eea6ec94f02e44a246627e5b55e1cc&req=ciMmHsB9m4lcFb4f3HP0gGxeraSkk332QO%2BQ2FqABgtit75x45x6oLJc9ap6%0ABbs%2FSAdvd6FAuMwcLg%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Accept All Changes** to overwrite the existing patient file information with the information provided by the patients. Alternatively, scroll through the patient's form responses to manually resolve conflicts.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631893853/3bac1d6140f068a6c938584e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=188716aadf4e2505c7d6f891fc96442e4636067f8ecfe74c47dba574cd5f0eb2&req=ciMmHsB9lYRcFb4f3HP0gBouI1MAsr8KSrmooexNXwD5u5U9ogK8vLx4qAJS%0Aa8DoSCjYCFqgrB%2F%2BvQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631893853/3bac1d6140f068a6c938584e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=188716aadf4e2505c7d6f891fc96442e4636067f8ecfe74c47dba574cd5f0eb2&req=ciMmHsB9lYRcFb4f3HP0gBouI1MAsr8KSrmooexNXwD5u5U9ogK8vLx4qAJS%0Aa8DoSCjYCFqgrB%2F%2BvQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once all conflicts have been resolved, select **Save** to finalise the process and update the patient file accordingly.

Completed forms can be viewed on the Forms tab of the patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631894061/5c11c0fc9df545f111dc801f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0729e0d14890346888db262e8f5ee2fa368a4d8852a1239b0f7d2c509693d46d&req=ciMmHsB6nYdeFb4f3HP0gMo0cZUZkg8B5JphpBhKvlNNBcCKWM%2BmwCPv3pUT%0Ahz5HJL44RKTnPWKK5Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631894061/5c11c0fc9df545f111dc801f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0729e0d14890346888db262e8f5ee2fa368a4d8852a1239b0f7d2c509693d46d&req=ciMmHsB6nYdeFb4f3HP0gMo0cZUZkg8B5JphpBhKvlNNBcCKWM%2BmwCPv3pUT%0Ahz5HJL44RKTnPWKK5Q%3D%3D%0A)

If a form contains Treatment Consent and Privacy Policy fields, the corresponding fields on the patient file will be updated accordingly with links to the relevant form.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631894166/768dade96f9617d5b9e97ee0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a674699509805ed45efa4f83e4904e82d888fb10519f29d20e4d3fa8740841df&req=ciMmHsB6nIdZFb4f3HP0gIkl2UxPjEH%2FGW8fQHiZrqj8u026MRugNpvzCNqH%0AYOv9fveB1Zd7qCcSqA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631894166/768dade96f9617d5b9e97ee0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a674699509805ed45efa4f83e4904e82d888fb10519f29d20e4d3fa8740841df&req=ciMmHsB6nIdZFb4f3HP0gIkl2UxPjEH%2FGW8fQHiZrqj8u026MRugNpvzCNqH%0AYOv9fveB1Zd7qCcSqA%3D%3D%0A)

Any form responses marked with _Add to Clinical Notes_ will also appear in the patient's clinical notes timeline with a yellow banner as shown below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631894334/5b00bd27faeec6702c3db743/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f2ea0802428a720f62eb1fe0e3dd94eedb99c6464f93b75e17269c634fb64bfd&req=ciMmHsB6noJbFb4f3HP0gF%2B9Hm6gH%2FTxNDRX%2FpX%2FMwg0j8H1%2FxcfDAf4I8y8%0AP8PVjHM34huF%2BXGvIg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631894334/5b00bd27faeec6702c3db743/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f2ea0802428a720f62eb1fe0e3dd94eedb99c6464f93b75e17269c634fb64bfd&req=ciMmHsB6noJbFb4f3HP0gF%2B9Hm6gH%2FTxNDRX%2FpX%2FMwg0j8H1%2FxcfDAf4I8y8%0AP8PVjHM34huF%2BXGvIg%3D%3D%0A)

When sending form links to patients via appointment confirmations and reminders, a form icon will also be displayed on the appointment to indicate a completed form.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631897318/022652519cc5cd6175a63c03/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c0764f69abfa4fcf67bf5ac017e035417c43b6dc88ce2d55f5460eff147bd01&req=ciMmHsB5noBXFb4f3HP0gEmeJ%2Bi4m40u%2F0%2B2F2K1yccKSU1fiEwkJSj6N6Rj%0AfGvmtAVGD3BDweJ5mQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631897318/022652519cc5cd6175a63c03/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c0764f69abfa4fcf67bf5ac017e035417c43b6dc88ce2d55f5460eff147bd01&req=ciMmHsB5noBXFb4f3HP0gEmeJ%2Bi4m40u%2F0%2B2F2K1yccKSU1fiEwkJSj6N6Rj%0AfGvmtAVGD3BDweJ5mQ%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 212 — Embedding Forms into an Existing Website | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-212}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5801538-embedding-forms-into-an-existing-website](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5801538-embedding-forms-into-an-existing-website)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5801538-embedding-forms-into-an-existing-website#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Forms](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3247047-forms)

Embedding Forms into an Existing Website

Embedding Forms into an Existing Website
========================================

e.g. New Patient Referral Form

Updated over 3 years ago

PracSuite Forms can be embedded into an existing webpage, allowing you to collect information via your website that is directly added to PracSuite for processing. This is particularly useful in practices where online booking may not be suitable, and a new patient referral form must be completed instead.

Go to [Settings > Forms > Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/forms)
 and enable the **Embedding of Forms Website** switch.

Select **Add** and enter the website domain(s) that you will be embedding the forms on.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/658945918/309320e0b5bdce724808cff8/CleanShot+2023-01-25+at+09.24.37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3509be2e210039fcf979b4eafecf87b188b48e93a9ba9d291bb5fe0eaf910142&req=ciUvH817lIBXFb4f3HP0gOGEVn97TwouewBtqfLbgdQP86QxH0zwSXPS4DFF%0Avb6eWqieXeRXxCxHow%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/658945918/309320e0b5bdce724808cff8/CleanShot+2023-01-25+at+09.24.37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3509be2e210039fcf979b4eafecf87b188b48e93a9ba9d291bb5fe0eaf910142&req=ciUvH817lIBXFb4f3HP0gOGEVn97TwouewBtqfLbgdQP86QxH0zwSXPS4DFF%0Avb6eWqieXeRXxCxHow%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Next, go to **[Settings > Forms > Form Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/forms/templates)
**.

In the form template grid, copy the link to the form you wish to embed on another web page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614715551/18578d366153b033c3146516/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=660cea66315e40985503c4496b562c1b757d58d037c50ac400ed87ebe634a5e4&req=ciEjEch7mIReFb4f3HP0gPEGnazb4bHyLbjkBEXFxxyRQ6dIEwcUaDOGyVqt%0AQz0p7D6euJpZOSmccg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614715551/18578d366153b033c3146516/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=660cea66315e40985503c4496b562c1b757d58d037c50ac400ed87ebe634a5e4&req=ciEjEch7mIReFb4f3HP0gPEGnazb4bHyLbjkBEXFxxyRQ6dIEwcUaDOGyVqt%0AQz0p7D6euJpZOSmccg%3D%3D%0A)

This link must be added to the code snippet below in place of [https://YOUR\_PRACTICE.forms.pracsuite.com/YOUR\_FORM\_LINK](https://your_practice.forms.pracsuite.com/YOUR_FORM_LINK)

**Note: You must also replace all instances of YOUR\_PRACTICE with your chosen URL.**

<div id="ob-iframe-container">  
    <iframe id="ob-iframe" src="https://YOUR\_PRACTICE.forms.pracsuite.com/YOUR\_FORM\_LINK" height="800px" width="100%"></iframe>  
    <script type="application/javascript" src="https://YOUR\_PRACTICE.forms.pracsuite.com/static\_js/embed.js"></script>  
    <link type="text/css" rel="stylesheet" href="https://YOUR\_PRACTICE.forms.pracsuite.com/css/embed.css" />  
</div>

After modifying the above code snippet, you will need to contact your website developer to add the snippet to the relevant page on your website.

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5826664-how-to-create-stock-items#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Invoicing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413899-invoicing)

[Stock Management](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3267458-stock-management)

How to Create Stock Items

How to Create Stock Items
=========================

Creating Stock Items

Updated over 3 years ago

**Item Codes** can be setup to represent either services you provide or stock/products you sell. The following guide details how to create an item code for a product or stock, rather than a service.

To begin, create a regular item code following [this guide](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317932-creating-item-codes)
. To configure the item code for stock, please see below:

Navigate to **[Settings > Billing > Item Codes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
:**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614808149/964108b7f3d79b289a4c30ea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=faaf90ad3f80bacdca4861da80e385a068e44c9a3450b3df5ea207e5c57781fe&req=ciEjHsl2nIVWFb4f3HP0gNpRrQDvMQMqlDm8pG6qRho%2FGydMYvPCkUgszRzv%0ANOaJ2K3YPu8Il22qog%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614808149/964108b7f3d79b289a4c30ea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=faaf90ad3f80bacdca4861da80e385a068e44c9a3450b3df5ea207e5c57781fe&req=ciEjHsl2nIVWFb4f3HP0gNpRrQDvMQMqlDm8pG6qRho%2FGydMYvPCkUgszRzv%0ANOaJ2K3YPu8Il22qog%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add** to create a new item code or **Edit** an existing item code by selecting it from the grid.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614808708/4bf8d3dbc911c3f88996454c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc6e20e06a10f0d3a278ca31326379af8c2c407d5d3745a67026fe2ca28811a4&req=ciEjHsl2moFXFb4f3HP0gO86M4Z7xHEWbV6oGCejcnriW6Z3l%2BmlP2QlgT9L%0ACM3tBkPuztxxE7BDdA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614808708/4bf8d3dbc911c3f88996454c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc6e20e06a10f0d3a278ca31326379af8c2c407d5d3745a67026fe2ca28811a4&req=ciEjHsl2moFXFb4f3HP0gO86M4Z7xHEWbV6oGCejcnriW6Z3l%2BmlP2QlgT9L%0ACM3tBkPuztxxE7BDdA%3D%3D%0A)

To enable the Item Code as stock, enable the option '**This is a stock item**'.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614811318/78817df66c9985b28c90f8cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=807f1c7e030dbae974a65e062075706a7e680535eaa8cd90fa307b69bf8b45bb&req=ciEjHsh%2FnoBXFb4f3HP0gEeU2X%2BQbpTjHwtf208olW0vr8UqFFc6VrIUXYQ0%0AxKwEr7drZW5Ihg1QSw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614811318/78817df66c9985b28c90f8cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=807f1c7e030dbae974a65e062075706a7e680535eaa8cd90fa307b69bf8b45bb&req=ciEjHsh%2FnoBXFb4f3HP0gEeU2X%2BQbpTjHwtf208olW0vr8UqFFc6VrIUXYQ0%0AxKwEr7drZW5Ihg1QSw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add Supplier** to enter in your supplier of the stock item.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614811501/a4299493910f2550914eb035/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8ce9d33cee34ac74beec450872de61a03337181f51f6c2efcf839d375d67a6d&req=ciEjHsh%2FmIFeFb4f3HP0gLgqsdwepWKFpslOoJRbetPM936LZxeKuJM7EdQ0%0Ap39u%2BvbhTxhPaCk%2Faw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614811501/a4299493910f2550914eb035/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8ce9d33cee34ac74beec450872de61a03337181f51f6c2efcf839d375d67a6d&req=ciEjHsh%2FmIFeFb4f3HP0gLgqsdwepWKFpslOoJRbetPM936LZxeKuJM7EdQ0%0Ap39u%2BvbhTxhPaCk%2Faw%3D%3D%0A)

Select the appropriate **Supplier** from the drop down list.  
​  
If required a new Supplier can be created by following [this guide](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5826664-how-to-create-stock-items)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614811779/3300252ff8d286ab70cfb9d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7bba1442eeb8dc366284d82bb23f17e2aa926812c8d446d80884bbf588da12de&req=ciEjHsh%2FmoZWFb4f3HP0gFgDWRsNs%2F8n4bR4HRtGpk7CsLK9%2B3jx%2BHTG0X5c%0AlEBGVpkum7O5hqtIog%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614811779/3300252ff8d286ab70cfb9d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7bba1442eeb8dc366284d82bb23f17e2aa926812c8d446d80884bbf588da12de&req=ciEjHsh%2FmoZWFb4f3HP0gFgDWRsNs%2F8n4bR4HRtGpk7CsLK9%2B3jx%2BHTG0X5c%0AlEBGVpkum7O5hqtIog%3D%3D%0A)

Enter the **Supplier Code**.  
This is the item code you use to order this product from your supplier.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614813194/9966ab5a0bc02629f773c3d9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=219fd4f65ea201bb7342e538b9c5060c8c1384f743ee6c76acb7bd9ac983e908&req=ciEjHsh9nIhbFb4f3HP0gBNudqFKbcGRBn9g5xWZeejqpC5KT6%2B4vYnMk4oc%0AcloiHETpetrAoAoxqQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614813194/9966ab5a0bc02629f773c3d9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=219fd4f65ea201bb7342e538b9c5060c8c1384f743ee6c76acb7bd9ac983e908&req=ciEjHsh9nIhbFb4f3HP0gBNudqFKbcGRBn9g5xWZeejqpC5KT6%2B4vYnMk4oc%0AcloiHETpetrAoAoxqQ%3D%3D%0A)

Enter the **Order Quantity**.  
This is the typical quantity you receive with each order.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614813768/6938c625d299a4e475b1fec5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9b6f071e80acc3c253525033335206913f278dc0482b361a258783d3b9e621a&req=ciEjHsh9modXFb4f3HP0gBwlPkVw4%2FeOnPXP0Dp0bS2F%2FKsEBYHtCpxQqjOW%0AYw8gr%2BtLyGCyuGaAlg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614813768/6938c625d299a4e475b1fec5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9b6f071e80acc3c253525033335206913f278dc0482b361a258783d3b9e621a&req=ciEjHsh9modXFb4f3HP0gBwlPkVw4%2FeOnPXP0Dp0bS2F%2FKsEBYHtCpxQqjOW%0AYw8gr%2BtLyGCyuGaAlg%3D%3D%0A)

Enter the **Unit Cost**.  
This is the wholesale cost to you for each unit.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614813932/1dae06bff7aa567940ab33af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a157c088c9d08123983692f1aedbb99b05254da894e30502e5ebdf659c8ae6b&req=ciEjHsh9lIJdFb4f3HP0gI8uwptx3axRbNrmzrPuRSv0ISU0Rs%2B47EDwlr10%0AEn%2FAcOVZ52qTYmbUdg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614813932/1dae06bff7aa567940ab33af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a157c088c9d08123983692f1aedbb99b05254da894e30502e5ebdf659c8ae6b&req=ciEjHsh9lIJdFb4f3HP0gI8uwptx3axRbNrmzrPuRSv0ISU0Rs%2B47EDwlr10%0AEn%2FAcOVZ52qTYmbUdg%3D%3D%0A)

Under the **Availability** section, select which businesses are stocking this item by selecting the '**Active**' tickbox to the left.  
​  
Enter the **Minimum Level** you would like to hold at each location, before you need to re-order from the supplier. Select a **Default Supplier** for each business.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/626780756/5982d7df4af8c90cca81a2b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=162e18f2533959846c420396e79b0ea25c5fce21df5178cbac7b6d8e072b6237&req=ciIhEcF%2BmoRZFb4f3HP0gIAlh%2B1N9aZgReC%2F7yeWhAuPaoObYYkGcTsM3L33%0ADtmV0OTqQ2iC4USYDQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/626780756/5982d7df4af8c90cca81a2b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=162e18f2533959846c420396e79b0ea25c5fce21df5178cbac7b6d8e072b6237&req=ciIhEcF%2BmoRZFb4f3HP0gIAlh%2B1N9aZgReC%2F7yeWhAuPaoObYYkGcTsM3L33%0ADtmV0OTqQ2iC4USYDQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click the **Adjust Levels** button to perform an initial stocktake or enter a stock adjustment. A stocktake must be performed at least once to set the initial stock levels, which will decrease with each sale and increase with each stock arrival.  
​  
You will be prompted to save the item code before you can use the **Adjust Levels** feature.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614814805/c8542bbcc98cd8c0835ad088/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e68b98e1acac49db568e5c8b726096bb7c71565aabc6fca39396228de5f93a11&req=ciEjHsh6lYFaFb4f3HP0gEpAZOWI2l22BGYaq7VJkMu5MUNLLXfO5eZVDjs9%0AjY8%2F38%2FOpIwyr5LZxQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614814805/c8542bbcc98cd8c0835ad088/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e68b98e1acac49db568e5c8b726096bb7c71565aabc6fca39396228de5f93a11&req=ciEjHsh6lYFaFb4f3HP0gEpAZOWI2l22BGYaq7VJkMu5MUNLLXfO5eZVDjs9%0AjY8%2F38%2FOpIwyr5LZxQ%3D%3D%0A)

The **Stock Adjustments** page will appear.  
​  
This same page is used for several purposes:

*   **Stock Adjustments:** Increasing or decreasing the stock without requiring a sale or arrival (e.g. stock was broken or expired).  
    ​
    
*   **Stock Arrival:** Stock that was previously ordered has now arrived, and new stock needs to be added to the available counts.  
    ​
    
*   **Stocktake:** A counting of stock to determine the current available level.
    

In this case we are completing a _Stocktake_ to set the initial level available. Enter the **Date** and **Time** for the stocktake and confirm _Stocktake_ is selected.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614815118/d0dc116cc3cb77845067d478/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1745d6b67f9a0264d9c5fc625167ede4d08fd65ce139a969d02e0f7224d6e445&req=ciEjHsh7nIBXFb4f3HP0gLMCYYU0Aq7Xe%2FJfhs7PTVxJUGvwGMOcRyxXDNPV%0AgK5r0jJyZ52JkBrITA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614815118/d0dc116cc3cb77845067d478/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1745d6b67f9a0264d9c5fc625167ede4d08fd65ce139a969d02e0f7224d6e445&req=ciEjHsh7nIBXFb4f3HP0gLMCYYU0Aq7Xe%2FJfhs7PTVxJUGvwGMOcRyxXDNPV%0AgK5r0jJyZ52JkBrITA%3D%3D%0A)

Finally, click **Add** in the grid below and select the item(s) you are performing a stocktake against. This can be one or more items.  
​  
Enter the **New Level**, which will become the current stock level for the selected items upon clicking **Save**.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614815426/aa472438269c393e0e59628e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8750f534cea6475c3bce33f6dd1010c6f8617cb89ea0ad2c8c9984eaa8a0e4d&req=ciEjHsh7mYNZFb4f3HP0gATB82XWY8nzHZxXh0BsmIYDD8KQtAXh%2BsJwdG3c%0AXxMJ2JS1g5LBivGIxg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614815426/aa472438269c393e0e59628e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8750f534cea6475c3bce33f6dd1010c6f8617cb89ea0ad2c8c9984eaa8a0e4d&req=ciEjHsh7mYNZFb4f3HP0gATB82XWY8nzHZxXh0BsmIYDD8KQtAXh%2BsJwdG3c%0AXxMJ2JS1g5LBivGIxg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614815586/e7f64ed7cfcfbcc8e738b89c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c11381b2bda4e80cc7df446550aa30d669e3a562ffe33b14ace337d2e6babecb&req=ciEjHsh7mIlZFb4f3HP0gGgKohLTvXaeWRH%2BZ6QQz24l56MWtrM0OduaHlnG%0A%2FkbQjBu3jvn%2FObPKbw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614815586/e7f64ed7cfcfbcc8e738b89c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c11381b2bda4e80cc7df446550aa30d669e3a562ffe33b14ace337d2e6babecb&req=ciEjHsh7mIlZFb4f3HP0gGgKohLTvXaeWRH%2BZ6QQz24l56MWtrM0OduaHlnG%0A%2FkbQjBu3jvn%2FObPKbw%3D%3D%0A)

Success! You have now created and configured a stock item.

Suppliers
=========

Adding a Supplier

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5829458-suppliers#h_920416f710)

[Adding a Supplier](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5829458-suppliers#h_5176307123)

[Exporting Suppliers](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5829458-suppliers#h_8549722460)

Overview
========

Suppliers can be created to represent where your **Stock Items** are being sourced, which is later used when creating Item Codes and managing stock levels and adjustments.

Adding a Supplier
-----------------

#### Step 1:

Navigate to **[Contacts > Suppliers](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/suppliers)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614716551/e7e0d7b54a8a277b203afa30/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=761e7aceb0559a1cf54c7d1c6597375082957d31730b46e969a841b22264df9b&req=ciEjEch4mIReFb4f3HP0gFKUxMbDzq9OdMoAg86q6uUB%2FbvgvhgECrRQKTU8%0A1kmeEgqqlN%2FETV5kQQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614716551/e7e0d7b54a8a277b203afa30/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=761e7aceb0559a1cf54c7d1c6597375082957d31730b46e969a841b22264df9b&req=ciEjEch4mIReFb4f3HP0gFKUxMbDzq9OdMoAg86q6uUB%2FbvgvhgECrRQKTU8%0A1kmeEgqqlN%2FETV5kQQ%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614716774/aa4a6c1cc90f3f0111c872a0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=055d34a3314376155ff0be3257d99bd0cc989c71b3fdff9b2c1fbc442c4beae3&req=ciEjEch4moZbFb4f3HP0gAkwBltayqfRByIGsO4JmfvEm6LSvqv69Znk6VkL%0AQxpv%2FTpMrs7styQJ1g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614716774/aa4a6c1cc90f3f0111c872a0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=055d34a3314376155ff0be3257d99bd0cc989c71b3fdff9b2c1fbc442c4beae3&req=ciEjEch4moZbFb4f3HP0gAkwBltayqfRByIGsO4JmfvEm6LSvqv69Znk6VkL%0AQxpv%2FTpMrs7styQJ1g%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Fill in the **Suppliers** details.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614717081/ea986200f2dad45cb8a0bc8e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8248c0fe15157ed25b9b0c42e7ca0dfb68d6bfc82257885e3937068ab7b4fc1f&req=ciEjEch5nYleFb4f3HP0gAbLbIcVdpX9yVE%2BEl1kEldxh6fOM5mY%2F5XLn2AO%0AZfr42wGjYzeUjq1fUA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614717081/ea986200f2dad45cb8a0bc8e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8248c0fe15157ed25b9b0c42e7ca0dfb68d6bfc82257885e3937068ab7b4fc1f&req=ciEjEch5nYleFb4f3HP0gAbLbIcVdpX9yVE%2BEl1kEldxh6fOM5mY%2F5XLn2AO%0AZfr42wGjYzeUjq1fUA%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614717228/f6ba0af0cfc697ea07614d77/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96f402ba781ac3b26c739e261ffacc9c0e0379726082e1d84c7fe36d66dc96b4&req=ciEjEch5n4NXFb4f3HP0gHmf%2FEv20J2a%2BIqBkgJi%2Fu22QiUZNrhKcGJkjY7Y%0Ah7xB7ADanpFb6A%2FqVQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614717228/f6ba0af0cfc697ea07614d77/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96f402ba781ac3b26c739e261ffacc9c0e0379726082e1d84c7fe36d66dc96b4&req=ciEjEch5n4NXFb4f3HP0gHmf%2FEv20J2a%2BIqBkgJi%2Fu22QiUZNrhKcGJkjY7Y%0Ah7xB7ADanpFb6A%2FqVQ%3D%3D%0A)

Exporting Suppliers
-------------------

A list of all of your suppliers can be exported to a spreadsheet by clicking on the Export button at the top of the Contacts > Suppliers page.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1884699892/582ddf62ec32213eef348a0214cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae4e3c3c4c772a8be79ea327cec25960c55940bee0f753c6ed0b1a163465e93f&req=dSgvEs93lIlWW%2FMW1HO4zceQOyavMbP3VkwCR7qbaSiyixGZV%2BqsvLhQbQub%0AX929S1ppRlQP6qs34Ks%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1884699892/582ddf62ec32213eef348a0214cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae4e3c3c4c772a8be79ea327cec25960c55940bee0f753c6ed0b1a163465e93f&req=dSgvEs93lIlWW%2FMW1HO4zceQOyavMbP3VkwCR7qbaSiyixGZV%2BqsvLhQbQub%0AX929S1ppRlQP6qs34Ks%3D%0A)

You can find more information on creating stock items in this article: [How to Create Stock Items](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5826664-how-to-create-stock-items)

## Document 215 — Browser pop-ups are not appearing (e.g. Print dialogs and Tyro Health Online Claiming) | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-215}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5837954-browser-pop-ups-are-not-appearing-e-g-print-dialogs-and-tyro-health-online-claiming](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5837954-browser-pop-ups-are-not-appearing-e-g-print-dialogs-and-tyro-health-online-claiming)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5837954-browser-pop-ups-are-not-appearing-e-g-print-dialogs-and-tyro-health-online-claiming#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Miscellaneous](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2435043-miscellaneous)

Browser pop-ups are not appearing (e.g. Print dialogs and Tyro Health Online Claiming)

Browser pop-ups are not appearing (e.g. Print dialogs and Tyro Health Online Claiming)
======================================================================================

Your browser may be preventing pop-ups from appearing in PracSuite, which are used for multiple features.

Updated over a week ago

There are a number of features in PracSuite such as the Tyro Health Online integration, printing and the ability to download all files at once from a patient/client file that require the pop-ups within web browsers to be enabled.

If pop-ups are disabled for your web browser and/or the PracSuite website, the Tyro Health Online and printing pop-ups will fail to load. The button can be clicked but nothing appears. In the case of attempting to download multiple files from a patient/client file, if pop-ups are disabled only one file will download. If this is ever the case, please check to make sure that pop-ups are enabled for the _app.pracsuite.com_ website by completing the following step-by-step guide for your browser.

 ![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729476152/6b263a340be23b90ea513b7c4760/image.png?expires=1758186000&signature=e64d35760dc3149d95d1f756d22db812705463dc35db62c8f4ebc5a39ed878fe&req=dSclH815m4BaW%2FMW3Hu4gQ2ie7wtWAaSfFbIwmkCQ6LV0iUF8rRi0FvQtAWD%0AxA%3D%3D%0A) **Google Chrome**
======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

Navigate to the **3 dots** in the top right-hand corner of Google Chrome.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729564219/a38475e922b72d2eb49f4a10c513/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e30850fc7475de0904471b2188f601464554c9f9c89881107644d62993265a67&req=dSclH8x4mYNeUPMW1HO4zQw9gJlUAJ1%2BKFfztkGpN6Dqphb0s6bCWDr69e3V%0ACOKN%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729564219/a38475e922b72d2eb49f4a10c513/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e30850fc7475de0904471b2188f601464554c9f9c89881107644d62993265a67&req=dSclH8x4mYNeUPMW1HO4zQw9gJlUAJ1%2BKFfztkGpN6Dqphb0s6bCWDr69e3V%0ACOKN%0A)

Click **Settings**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729564218/9e181da18c4f62cf4c1f8fa4136b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a858f187df14d977d966edf8885967463a8d2b00c71a6842e2259ba81bfb94a8&req=dSclH8x4mYNeUfMW1HO4zc5jp2FJesBjyUPXp6a5jEKZaU0aBmYnuij9OeIY%0ADHaX%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729564218/9e181da18c4f62cf4c1f8fa4136b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a858f187df14d977d966edf8885967463a8d2b00c71a6842e2259ba81bfb94a8&req=dSclH8x4mYNeUfMW1HO4zc5jp2FJesBjyUPXp6a5jEKZaU0aBmYnuij9OeIY%0ADHaX%0A)

Click **Privacy and Security**.

Creating and Processing Quotes

Creating and Processing Quotes
==============================

Updated over 3 years ago

To create a Quote, go to the **Invoices tab** of the **Patient File** and select the **Quote** button at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614816815/638bfd596342699f07a0e9ae/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0968c901432de94310aa5d543578fc4d83a350d7ac3ca75deef125954bd08846&req=ciEjHsh4lYBaFb4f3HP0gAfyyKoYGMmqBh4%2FMxhgRzKdcitPtQcmkcrCuDwO%0AvcRxmjGC7MdPmJQxsQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614816815/638bfd596342699f07a0e9ae/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0968c901432de94310aa5d543578fc4d83a350d7ac3ca75deef125954bd08846&req=ciEjHsh4lYBaFb4f3HP0gAfyyKoYGMmqBh4%2FMxhgRzKdcitPtQcmkcrCuDwO%0AvcRxmjGC7MdPmJQxsQ%3D%3D%0A)

Like invoices, you can add items to your quote in the items grid, and set the quote date and expiry on the right-hand side of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614817589/7c506967d4bc9189ced7f33d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2b6042a2566ae345d648ce1c900fde68b2c51d876a904b67642229d326fd3a0c&req=ciEjHsh5mIlWFb4f3HP0gDQnLoq1vRGuzoKhvXb6hP%2B2HvpcjHT5Vcb8GJy%2F%0ATCP6Y3XfNRsZlcrnew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614817589/7c506967d4bc9189ced7f33d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2b6042a2566ae345d648ce1c900fde68b2c51d876a904b67642229d326fd3a0c&req=ciEjHsh5mIlWFb4f3HP0gDQnLoq1vRGuzoKhvXb6hP%2B2HvpcjHT5Vcb8GJy%2F%0ATCP6Y3XfNRsZlcrnew%3D%3D%0A)

When you've finished adding items to the quote, use the **Save** button at the top to save and print/email the quote for the patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614818051/0c07f3d0e7d5d63174b0b610/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eda61cd719a32362f3b36582626564b12b609dcc60edcdcb8fe7c076e18368b8&req=ciEjHsh2nYReFb4f3HP0gJ1B7YO9V5FlIyCTefLWGA4B6iYMve37AETogq2%2F%0A%2FH7q7ah6Dhn2TBM%2Bow%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614818051/0c07f3d0e7d5d63174b0b610/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eda61cd719a32362f3b36582626564b12b609dcc60edcdcb8fe7c076e18368b8&req=ciEjHsh2nYReFb4f3HP0gJ1B7YO9V5FlIyCTefLWGA4B6iYMve37AETogq2%2F%0A%2FH7q7ah6Dhn2TBM%2Bow%3D%3D%0A)

To convert a quote to an invoice, go to the **Invoices tab** of the **Patient File** and select the **Quotes** section.

Select the checkbox next to the quote and select **Save as Invoice**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614818683/90945861ba37d7b31593b715/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1cf2b451b00af435c9f426118387b24fdf6ab10f962ea432fb2e8a0ca6297b6a&req=ciEjHsh2m4lcFb4f3HP0gAYL1l8OyNgb0VsfU1faXs4qge06u0N6JnUQ1eG1%0AAZ9j0DyUn02zrD7aFA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614818683/90945861ba37d7b31593b715/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1cf2b451b00af435c9f426118387b24fdf6ab10f962ea432fb2e8a0ca6297b6a&req=ciEjHsh2m4lcFb4f3HP0gAYL1l8OyNgb0VsfU1faXs4qge06u0N6JnUQ1eG1%0AAZ9j0DyUn02zrD7aFA%3D%3D%0A)

Enabling the Mailchimp Integration

Enabling the Mailchimp Integration
==================================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Connecting PracSuite to Your Mailchimp Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5946977-enabling-the-mailchimp-integration#h_bf66bfb77e)

[Synching Additional Patient Fields](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5946977-enabling-the-mailchimp-integration#h_7191e956cd)

[Resolving Duplicate Emails](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5946977-enabling-the-mailchimp-integration#h_b51801d9ba)

[Mailchimp Tag Syncing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5946977-enabling-the-mailchimp-integration#h_ff40abe0e5)

[Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/)
 is an online email marketing solution that allows you to manage email campaigns for your patients. This integration includes the option to automatically sync your PracSuite patient list to Mailchimp, as well as tools to sync specific patients that appear in PracSuite report results.

Mailchimp is a US-based email and marketing platform outside of Australia and the EU. As part of the Mailchimp integration, patient-specific data will be transferred to Mailchimp servers overseas. A patient's email address is the only required field to sync, with title, first name, middle name, preferred name, last name, address, mobile number, date of birth as optional fields that can be synchronised.  
​  
Users should familiarise themselves with the Mailchimp [Global Privacy Statement](https://www.intuit.com/privacy/statement/)
, [Standard Terms of Use](https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/)
, [Additional Terms](https://mailchimp.com/legal/additional-terms/)
, and [Data Processing Addendum](https://mailchimp.com/legal/data-processing-addendum/)
.  
​  
To use the Mailchimp integration, you will need:

*   A [Mailchimp account](https://login.mailchimp.com/signup/)
    
*   A [Mailchimp audience](https://admin.mailchimp.com/audience/)
     to be used for syncing your PracSuite patient list
    

Connecting PracSuite to Your Mailchimp Account
==============================================

Go to **[Settings > Integrations > Mailchimp](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/mailchimp)
** to enable the integration and select **Connect Mailchimp**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461253905/6575cb6767a12a294eceef00/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddde34952992b82712dc7b7a2da335ed0b09652e78ab01b83e0716c7376c5844&req=cCYmFMx9lIFaFb4f3HP0gLJq3SnvmLNOB%2FxShOwSB3ww4kSMA6%2Bqi3cYnHQP%0A3IkdNNwlKd3OVfMB6g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461253905/6575cb6767a12a294eceef00/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddde34952992b82712dc7b7a2da335ed0b09652e78ab01b83e0716c7376c5844&req=cCYmFMx9lIFaFb4f3HP0gLJq3SnvmLNOB%2FxShOwSB3ww4kSMA6%2Bqi3cYnHQP%0A3IkdNNwlKd3OVfMB6g%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Continue** to be directed to the Mailchimp website.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461254239/ad70050fcb722dfb6eb85aed/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=355ec750ba2a769f411d7777495a4289b6888b46ed014dd9e7956da570a7cc99&req=cCYmFMx6n4JWFb4f3HP0gJYNSSqxwmbYYz0PRjspwpniqH0WRsZIGIby0uNC%0A4vBJYGeORZknDh2QoA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461254239/ad70050fcb722dfb6eb85aed/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=355ec750ba2a769f411d7777495a4289b6888b46ed014dd9e7956da570a7cc99&req=cCYmFMx6n4JWFb4f3HP0gJYNSSqxwmbYYz0PRjspwpniqH0WRsZIGIby0uNC%0A4vBJYGeORZknDh2QoA%3D%3D%0A)

After logging into your Mailchimp account, select **Allow** to authorise PracSuite to access your Mailchimp account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461254901/71ad122711378fe61fae52eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5979e113e0831cd395e6c8725117f9b51cdfd5596cce58a516ad86c1a73eb5e9&req=cCYmFMx6lIFeFb4f3HP0gFbQiMWorOlFgGt1OLm0WbfkLX8a5LRyEpx4Wrk4%0A4gTkU%2BSpuRrZO6EC2A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461254901/71ad122711378fe61fae52eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5979e113e0831cd395e6c8725117f9b51cdfd5596cce58a516ad86c1a73eb5e9&req=cCYmFMx6lIFeFb4f3HP0gFbQiMWorOlFgGt1OLm0WbfkLX8a5LRyEpx4Wrk4%0A4gTkU%2BSpuRrZO6EC2A%3D%3D%0A)

After successfully connecting your Mailchimp account with PracSuite, ensure that you have selected the appropriate Primary Audience to sync your patient list to.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461251554/7efb136dface551b9011e343/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=383261aadb98ed3666599ce66c4be3143480d1409c25aa9cafadaade384d8cca&req=cCYmFMx%2FmIRbFb4f3HP0gLDGCKz%2BW3X3vIz6hlDZWSa3hN8sE8mlPhctEgtM%0AJABNfmEAMh3XLqxRkg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461251554/7efb136dface551b9011e343/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=383261aadb98ed3666599ce66c4be3143480d1409c25aa9cafadaade384d8cca&req=cCYmFMx%2FmIRbFb4f3HP0gLDGCKz%2BW3X3vIz6hlDZWSa3hN8sE8mlPhctEgtM%0AJABNfmEAMh3XLqxRkg%3D%3D%0A)

We highly recommend **excluding archived patients** from the Mailchimp sync, which will be enabled by default. Often, archived patients include deceased patients, and it wouldn't be appropriate to include these patients in marketing correspondence.

Select **Sync Now** to start syncing with Mailchimp.

Select **Automatically Sync with Mailchimp** to continue syncing your patient list automatically. Automatic syncs occur between 1AM and 5AM ACST.

Opting Out and Mailchimp Unsubscribes
=====================================

Patients with an [email marketing status](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4927850-marketing-statuses)
 of Opt Out or Soft Opt Out in PracSuite will not be synced to Mailchimp. If you change a patient's email marketing status in PracSuite to Opt-In, they will be synced to Mailchimp, unless the patient has opted out via Mailchimp directly.

If a patient unsubscribes to your emails sent via Mailchimp, such as clicking an unsubscribe link from an email sent from Mailchimp, that email address will be permanently unsubscribed from future Mailchimp syncs. There is no way to opt them back in again via PracSuite.

**Note that patients unsubscribing via Mailchimp will not affect the email marketing preferences in PracSuite**. This means that it is possible for the patient to be included in bulk email broadcasts sent directly via PracSuite. PracSuite email marketing preferences can only be modified directly in PracSuite.

Synching Additional Patient Fields
==================================

Mailchimp only requires that an email address is synced at a minimum. You also have the choice of syncing additional patient data, though **we strongly advise caution with enabling these features** as you will be increasing the volume of patient data stored with overseas third parties.

When choosing to sync additional patient fields, you'll need to map them to [corresponding fields in your Mailchimp account](https://mailchimp.com/help/manage-audience-signup-form-fields/)
 using the drop-down menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461251669/0eb2fa7866ccfd90d3ae52a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cfb0daba9b63f4b662823435763cbc481dd40891784bf4f3078508f784abedfd&req=cCYmFMx%2Fm4dWFb4f3HP0gL%2F95rKauC%2BogGInTNtgJNPymQon%2BtgX2xK605pp%0Aj34%2FJcuE2jZpb6R50g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/461251669/0eb2fa7866ccfd90d3ae52a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cfb0daba9b63f4b662823435763cbc481dd40891784bf4f3078508f784abedfd&req=cCYmFMx%2Fm4dWFb4f3HP0gL%2F95rKauC%2BogGInTNtgJNPymQon%2BtgX2xK605pp%0Aj34%2FJcuE2jZpb6R50g%3D%3D%0A)

Resolving Duplicate Emails
==========================

If patients in your system share an email address, only one patient with that email can be synced with Mailchimp. In the **Duplicate Email Addresses** section, you will need to resolve these duplicates by choosing which patient to sync, or choosing not to sync that email address at all.

Use the **Update All To Most Recent** button to automatically select the most recently active patient across all duplicates in the list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/458098768/f17e5d96348894dd0aeb6536/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=36b9a2a10d5de241df1461fc9c688ec70a8c58f1efb82eed0bb8da39748287ec&req=cCUvFsB2modXFb4f3HP0gP6nVlEeGY%2FI82pspgDGxygLKLYkiaANxauY9D41%0A4%2FbBgfMgft4cnkTQvw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/458098768/f17e5d96348894dd0aeb6536/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=36b9a2a10d5de241df1461fc9c688ec70a8c58f1efb82eed0bb8da39748287ec&req=cCUvFsB2modXFb4f3HP0gP6nVlEeGY%2FI82pspgDGxygLKLYkiaANxauY9D41%0A4%2FbBgfMgft4cnkTQvw%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Process** to finalise the duplicate resolution process.

Mailchimp Tag Syncing
=====================

Along with syncing your entire patient list to Mailchimp, reports in PracSuite allow you to apply tags to your contacts in Mailchimp. Automatic Tag Syncing also allows you to leverage PracSuite's [Saved Report Filters](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters)
 to automatically tag a patient's corresponding Mailchimp contact based on whether they appear in the report results.

By tagging contacts in Mailchimp, you can take advantage of [Mailchimp automation features](https://mailchimp.com/marketing-automation/)
, which are ideal for automatically sending email correspondence to patients in the following scenarios:

*   Following up missed and cancelled appointments where a patient has no future appointments scheduled
    
*   Daily/Monthly/Weekly Birthday Emails
    
*   New Patient Welcome Emails
    
*   Sending Recall Notices
    
*   Appointment Reviews/Surveys
    

Click below to learn more about these features:

*   [Manually Tagging Mailchimp Contacts](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5947030-manually-tagging-mailchimp-contacts)
    
*   [Automatically Tagging Mailchimp Contacts Using Saved Report Filters](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5947069-automatically-tagging-mailchimp-contacts-using-saved-report-filters)
