Manually Tagging Mailchimp Contacts

Manually Tagging Mailchimp Contacts
===================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Along with syncing your entire patient list to Mailchimp, reports in PracSuite also allow you to [apply tags to your contacts in Mailchimp](https://mailchimp.com/help/getting-started-tags/)
. Using the tags in your Mailchimp account, you can [target specific patients with our email campaigns](https://mailchimp.com/help/send-tags/)
.

The majority of the reports in PracSuite include the ability to add tags to patients that appear in your report criteria.

After selecting a report, selecting your filters and generating your report results, select the **Mailchimp button** to apply tags to the patients' corresponding Mailchimp contact.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/458097482/0d97df3cfd629779de0b4a2f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=56d1c9ad622290f915de81938c8b9c0c3f8866ede3966e981ce6e17753e966a2&req=cCUvFsB5mYldFb4f3HP0gAO%2BOPXdHFlgEYf%2FSzoQkkjusc5BwZ1DeahGYeFh%0AOpLIlHOALcKf%2F4Tyow%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/458097482/0d97df3cfd629779de0b4a2f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=56d1c9ad622290f915de81938c8b9c0c3f8866ede3966e981ce6e17753e966a2&req=cCUvFsB5mYldFb4f3HP0gAO%2BOPXdHFlgEYf%2FSzoQkkjusc5BwZ1DeahGYeFh%0AOpLIlHOALcKf%2F4Tyow%3D%3D%0A)

You will need to select the tag within your Mailchimp account that you would like to apply to the patients/contacts. Select the **\+ icon** next to the Mailchimp tags menu to create a new tag in your Mailchimp account.

Using the **Action** menu, you have the choice of:

*   **Add** \- Applies the tag to the selected contacts in Mailchimp. Any existing contacts in Mailchimp with this tag will retain the tag.
    
*   **Replace -** The tag will be removed from contacts in Mailchimp that currently have the tag and the tag will be added only to the contacts appearing in the report results.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/464440927/54cdf8dc4f85db543c6cda52/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3f51940c259c1bcc61950e03f432f5001cf7051337f803f486945963fb43614b&req=cCYjEs1%2BlINYFb4f3HP0gGghMt%2B7OnhXtZ9ju9KJvSGt0n%2FxMxd4d3AwREmT%0AkwkEjp3qdGETP9B67w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/464440927/54cdf8dc4f85db543c6cda52/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3f51940c259c1bcc61950e03f432f5001cf7051337f803f486945963fb43614b&req=cCYjEs1%2BlINYFb4f3HP0gGghMt%2B7OnhXtZ9ju9KJvSGt0n%2FxMxd4d3AwREmT%0AkwkEjp3qdGETP9B67w%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add** to finalise the process.

Automatically Tagging Mailchimp Contacts Using Saved Report Filters

Automatically Tagging Mailchimp Contacts Using Saved Report Filters
===================================================================

Updated over 4 years ago

Automatic Tag Syncing allows you to leverage PracSuite's [Saved Report Filters](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters)
 to automatically tag a patient's corresponding Mailchimp contact based on whether they appear in the report results. By tagging contacts in Mailchimp, you can take advantage of [Mailchimp automation features](https://mailchimp.com/marketing-automation/)
, which are ideal for automatically sending email correspondence to patients in the following scenarios:

*   Following up missed and cancelled appointments where a patient has no future appointments scheduled
    
*   Daily/Monthly/Weekly Birthday Emails
    
*   New Patient Welcome Emails
    
*   Sending Recall Notices
    
*   Appointment Reviews/Surveys
    

Go to [Settings > Integrations > Mailchimp](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/mailchimp)
 and scroll to the **Mailchimp Tag Synchronising** section.

Select **Add** to create an automatic tag sync.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/458100320/ab559aa5b28db7116be97229/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88ee763ff5afef7edcc29203c2401e287338335e3cb3562cf55582a81bb26fbe&req=cCUvF8l%2BnoNfFb4f3HP0gC36e6k%2BCAMrcNCOpFycB8KStztXhK%2BzIeCtEqtJ%0ABz%2Bfbbr5nOynGTIa6A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/458100320/ab559aa5b28db7116be97229/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88ee763ff5afef7edcc29203c2401e287338335e3cb3562cf55582a81bb26fbe&req=cCUvF8l%2BnoNfFb4f3HP0gC36e6k%2BCAMrcNCOpFycB8KStztXhK%2BzIeCtEqtJ%0ABz%2Bfbbr5nOynGTIa6A%3D%3D%0A)

You will need to select the:

*   **Report -** Select the report you wish to use for the auto tag sync
    
*   **Saved Filters -** Select your [saved report filters](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters)
     for the selected report
    
*   **Mailchimp Tag** \- Select the tag you wish to apply to these contacts in Mailchimp
    
*   **Sync Type**
    

**Add** \- Applies the tag to the selected contacts in Mailchimp. Any existing contacts in Mailchimp with this tag will retain the tag.

**Replace -** The tag will be removed from contacts in Mailchimp that currenly have the tag and the tag will be added only to the contacts appearing in the report results

*   **Sync Frequency -** When should the auto tag sync run e.g. Daily/Weekly/Monthly
    

**Note:** Automatic Mailchimp Tag Syncing occurs automatically per the chosen sync frequency between 1AM - 5AM ACST. Please ensure that you consider this timeframe when configuring [Mailchimp automations.](https://mailchimp.com/marketing-automation/)

Select **Save** to finalise your settings.

Recovering Unsaved Clinical Notes

Recovering Unsaved Clinical Notes
=================================

Updated over 3 years ago

PracSuite automatically saves clinical notes in the background so that in the event of computer/network failures, notes can potentially be recovered. This is also useful if you work across multiple devices and forget to save a note. The autosave feature allows you to resume editing on your other device.

In a **Patient's File > Clinical Notes tab** and at the top, PracSuite will display a **_Clinical Note Recovered banner_**. Use the **Recover Note** button to resume editing the note, or select **Clear** to disregard the note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614782715/a7f7cf7ca732465acb0f5e48/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ca0735336ca6b011d0a1294ce8d3f72806d6cc4027c3c6050a1728110570572d&req=ciEjEcF8moBaFb4f3HP0gKX2R3czOl8Wu%2F8W4vIKAa3kJemQf0%2FEgkm4UdmM%0AX3DpwDVwNwgrBAF29g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614782715/a7f7cf7ca732465acb0f5e48/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ca0735336ca6b011d0a1294ce8d3f72806d6cc4027c3c6050a1728110570572d&req=ciEjEcF8moBaFb4f3HP0gKX2R3czOl8Wu%2F8W4vIKAa3kJemQf0%2FEgkm4UdmM%0AX3DpwDVwNwgrBAF29g%3D%3D%0A)

How to Write-Off an Outstanding Invoice

How to Write-Off an Outstanding Invoice
=======================================

Write Offs

Updated over 3 years ago

Sometimes within a patient file you may need to write-off an outstanding invoice that is never going to be paid.

To Write-Off an Outstanding Invoice open the **Patient File > Invoices**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618192631/c7415da891323559292ff66a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26429d1e962ba021075b00c98bf126ed5b2fb14f168f100a859ffc950e37cb41&req=ciEvF8B8m4JeFb4f3HP0gGvkAyyAvwo1TzX921qYCCK2wc3OPxPGLpBS5r13%0AzVOFOJ3RusbGImh0kA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618192631/c7415da891323559292ff66a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26429d1e962ba021075b00c98bf126ed5b2fb14f168f100a859ffc950e37cb41&req=ciEvF8B8m4JeFb4f3HP0gGvkAyyAvwo1TzX921qYCCK2wc3OPxPGLpBS5r13%0AzVOFOJ3RusbGImh0kA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Invoices**.

Adding an Account to a Patient File

Adding an Account to a Patient File
===================================

Patient Accounts

Updated over 3 years ago

To add an additional account to a patient file, follow the guide below.

Open the **Patient File > Accounts**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614718420/11d0dd62d6bf130abdbb8129/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5fdf04698cdaaef73fdcd31b7e68110dfa5d6565a8953ac02fb7430d1b7f43ad&req=ciEjEch2mYNfFb4f3HP0gNKNLMSAQUwZIaM1aQA0%2B%2FDRIPabr1%2BDZLQojecK%0ApzNABgfIPBmnB3Ug1g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614718420/11d0dd62d6bf130abdbb8129/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5fdf04698cdaaef73fdcd31b7e68110dfa5d6565a8953ac02fb7430d1b7f43ad&req=ciEjEch2mYNfFb4f3HP0gNKNLMSAQUwZIaM1aQA0%2B%2FDRIPabr1%2BDZLQojecK%0ApzNABgfIPBmnB3Ug1g%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Manage Accounts**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614719056/2243d7edcbbd4dab9825fba0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8abd2be56f5e362b398040163c6c970e0f1b02ee0dd1a8ecabfda5cb39e38504&req=ciEjEch3nYRZFb4f3HP0gDdetRd3UNYhy3VQZnuTLv1WMgiExrfX5IcaUpzR%0AxPN8hvrJ3Dj%2B6Gx0lw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614719056/2243d7edcbbd4dab9825fba0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8abd2be56f5e362b398040163c6c970e0f1b02ee0dd1a8ecabfda5cb39e38504&req=ciEjEch3nYRZFb4f3HP0gDdetRd3UNYhy3VQZnuTLv1WMgiExrfX5IcaUpzR%0AxPN8hvrJ3Dj%2B6Gx0lw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614719494/fac2c3ec2fb5024547cecf36/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=43280d677126d259ec87b2f8994e7dfa37ed90b38cbba0f41d1465a925c5264b&req=ciEjEch3mYhbFb4f3HP0gFRuOGBkEWdmYc0gUjkU204TTxn2k9iMMlGngn8u%0ApI%2BxMiOWLRNt36tk9w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614719494/fac2c3ec2fb5024547cecf36/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=43280d677126d259ec87b2f8994e7dfa37ed90b38cbba0f41d1465a925c5264b&req=ciEjEch3mYhbFb4f3HP0gFRuOGBkEWdmYc0gUjkU204TTxn2k9iMMlGngn8u%0ApI%2BxMiOWLRNt36tk9w%3D%3D%0A)

Type in the name of the new account, for example 'DVA' and select whether it is going to be default account or not.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614720044/b69c7ed8021fa303431df8ac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=431a334c859071cf9a14de596f4f444896c44ef0d7408a757b50be6f38829302&req=ciEjEct%2BnYVbFb4f3HP0gLoqu7dHtyocG1Ok%2BdEekobWbCDFtPGVlAAwkYFI%0AonTqZiLvSXokV0sfbQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614720044/b69c7ed8021fa303431df8ac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=431a334c859071cf9a14de596f4f444896c44ef0d7408a757b50be6f38829302&req=ciEjEct%2BnYVbFb4f3HP0gLoqu7dHtyocG1Ok%2BdEekobWbCDFtPGVlAAwkYFI%0AonTqZiLvSXokV0sfbQ%3D%3D%0A)

The default account is the one which will be invoiced by default when invoicing through the patient file and also the account that will, by default, be associated with any appointments created for this patient from this point forward.

Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614720343/d4f23eb7d6761103be89f791/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4bbdaec77cb3b43dc839c3bcd30a472e0acdddc0e5e8594d7b7a15c53b70bbc2&req=ciEjEct%2BnoVcFb4f3HP0gNDzihWHewhAeq19M0z2matXEwUrhKs300WFXU7t%0ACgQ58O7klFCdbM3tQQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614720343/d4f23eb7d6761103be89f791/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4bbdaec77cb3b43dc839c3bcd30a472e0acdddc0e5e8594d7b7a15c53b70bbc2&req=ciEjEct%2BnoVcFb4f3HP0gNDzihWHewhAeq19M0z2matXEwUrhKs300WFXU7t%0ACgQ58O7klFCdbM3tQQ%3D%3D%0A)

Alternatively, if you have already created additional Default Accounts (as seen below), you can select the drop-down option here and choose the required account instead of manually creating it.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/646369862/ffc32bfebf1b66f74a3a8398/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d1b0b0f6ec101e54d2e2a00465263372d255453c82a9c33bfae43c7a7d1c5b1a&req=ciQhFc93lYddFb4f3HP0gAK0XMQrQpiw7Op1hnrzSr4CrXkZbMqNOOftSz6y%0AwwfZh3uCUPj1vn4mrA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/646369862/ffc32bfebf1b66f74a3a8398/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d1b0b0f6ec101e54d2e2a00465263372d255453c82a9c33bfae43c7a7d1c5b1a&req=ciQhFc93lYddFb4f3HP0gAK0XMQrQpiw7Op1hnrzSr4CrXkZbMqNOOftSz6y%0AwwfZh3uCUPj1vn4mrA%3D%3D%0A)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Patient File Management](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2601287-patient-file-management)

Adding Default Accounts

Adding Default Accounts
=======================

Default Accounts, Settings

Updated over 5 months ago

**Default Accounts** in PracSuite let you set up preconfigured accounts that can be quickly applied to patient files. They save time and reduce errors when adding commonly used accounts, such as WorkCover, Medicare, or DVA, by giving you ready-to-use templates with all the necessary details already filled in.

When you create a Default Account, you can:

*   Specify the account name and billing type (Private or Third-Party).
    
*   Link the account to a payer (if Third-Party).
    
*   Enter billing details like contact information, address, and fee category overrides.
    
*   Attach Default Treatment Plans so they’re included automatically when the account is applied.
    
*   Adjust invoice and statement settings, such as whether to separate PDFs, limit email attachments, or add charges to the last open invoice.
    
*   Configure print options for accounts.
    

Once saved, Default Accounts can be applied to patient files in just a few clicks, making billing setup faster, easier, and more consistent.

* * *

To add a **Default Account** go to **[Settings > Billing > Billing](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/list)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614723696/01342b21e8a9370ca14049cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2321a541b0d6bd2b7cfeee3016b49c4faf5a91781b9beb8f220a036f2867b1dd&req=ciEjEct9m4hZFb4f3HP0gBBDANTqe85j3HZTP1%2B0QHE%2FU97RgHmzUMWKRGN5%0AKOSdBgXR5jO%2Bq6vlFw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614723696/01342b21e8a9370ca14049cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2321a541b0d6bd2b7cfeee3016b49c4faf5a91781b9beb8f220a036f2867b1dd&req=ciEjEct9m4hZFb4f3HP0gBBDANTqe85j3HZTP1%2B0QHE%2FU97RgHmzUMWKRGN5%0AKOSdBgXR5jO%2Bq6vlFw%3D%3D%0A)

Scroll down to **_Default Accounts_** and click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614724956/1e3862f2293d6d3e09e7d061/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e5b71516cc4887ae1ce0db4f55a81c710b7cadee02db92f10bcc5097536a76e0&req=ciEjEct6lIRZFb4f3HP0gB31Kvcm59TD99lIh%2BpMiO6tQn%2Fhmn0XIeH6i2wb%0Av660fn3h4qAN5zJOOw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614724956/1e3862f2293d6d3e09e7d061/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e5b71516cc4887ae1ce0db4f55a81c710b7cadee02db92f10bcc5097536a76e0&req=ciEjEct6lIRZFb4f3HP0gB31Kvcm59TD99lIh%2BpMiO6tQn%2Fhmn0XIeH6i2wb%0Av660fn3h4qAN5zJOOw%3D%3D%0A)

Under **_Options_**, type in an _Account Name_.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614727954/b0315ace7afe3d1b054ffd20/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52ee2b05cdf8c1233bee64f753585ffa67ca39a6b5c496e045ebfd50d8ffead1&req=ciEjEct5lIRbFb4f3HP0gPRZ6UpiyShXeNSSsBWc9O2YswaetVu8qSFisuVp%0ANxgLDIRuquZQ6F48oA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614727954/b0315ace7afe3d1b054ffd20/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52ee2b05cdf8c1233bee64f753585ffa67ca39a6b5c496e045ebfd50d8ffead1&req=ciEjEct5lIRbFb4f3HP0gPRZ6UpiyShXeNSSsBWc9O2YswaetVu8qSFisuVp%0ANxgLDIRuquZQ6F48oA%3D%3D%0A)

Under **_Billing Details_** select the _Billing Type_ that the account is, either _Private_ or _Third-Party_. If it's Third-Party select whether its _Linked to Payer_ or not.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614728925/1103dfd4de3980427515f7eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=77a0c6cdad33c6721a1b033ff0d02b8a8f929ff96b58c24d8ee9957a056d67a1&req=ciEjEct2lINaFb4f3HP0gCsf3tua6RdhTfgQW400YJM4zlGEyo7GTsS1IkQX%0AodA51y0iEUsB419SCA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614728925/1103dfd4de3980427515f7eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=77a0c6cdad33c6721a1b033ff0d02b8a8f929ff96b58c24d8ee9957a056d67a1&req=ciEjEct2lINaFb4f3HP0gCsf3tua6RdhTfgQW400YJM4zlGEyo7GTsS1IkQX%0AodA51y0iEUsB419SCA%3D%3D%0A)

Enter the **_Bill To_**, **_Address_** and **_contact details_** and select whether the **_Fee Category Override_** applies or not.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614729087/692d2dd10f6c39e9aa5e4c33/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9dfff4cc01837e2f2fe54026642fc215bd1513db9c6bc31a2ad695652ee4d52f&req=ciEjEct3nYlYFb4f3HP0gPb8IO%2BKVsN%2BUeOvTRlm85in4A2rW%2FOM0NdlHjGE%0AR%2FJ8jth%2FzKzm%2BfcvPA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614729087/692d2dd10f6c39e9aa5e4c33/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9dfff4cc01837e2f2fe54026642fc215bd1513db9c6bc31a2ad695652ee4d52f&req=ciEjEct3nYlYFb4f3HP0gPb8IO%2BKVsN%2BUeOvTRlm85in4A2rW%2FOM0NdlHjGE%0AR%2FJ8jth%2FzKzm%2BfcvPA%3D%3D%0A)

If required, users can add **Default Treatment Plans** to a **Default Account**.  
​

Click the **Add** button and select which Treatment Plans you want included on this account by default. [Click here for a full guide on creating and using **Default Treatment Plans**.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8184782-default-treatment-plans)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796438087/678f103ea3a119099909b30d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e19c68a5da795a8a54acba1d1ee1f0040c65f8022abc9d1733bd9871394119f&req=cykhEsp2nYlYFb4f3HP0gDoAxxYm2OU2Wl%2B95R9eXfVG2McmjiO109ijL0YA%0A70jyuufP1eRmwN8KmA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796438087/678f103ea3a119099909b30d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e19c68a5da795a8a54acba1d1ee1f0040c65f8022abc9d1733bd9871394119f&req=cykhEsp2nYlYFb4f3HP0gDoAxxYm2OU2Wl%2B95R9eXfVG2McmjiO109ijL0YA%0A70jyuufP1eRmwN8KmA%3D%3D%0A)

Under **_Invoice & Statement Options_**, if they apply, select _Separate PDF's for each Invoice/Statement_, _Limit Email PDF Attachments_ and/or _Add to Last Open Invoice by Default_.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614734961/507fc1aa1d67142c1804e75a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fce46d4cf53e137d42e121f880bc626b8742d94cffd6e6cd5a1606a15d96e7b0&req=ciEjEcp6lIdeFb4f3HP0gDAyDwn15kR1Zu1izrg%2B9gAbZgX1bEQd15jejFF4%0A8gkknf7X%2BvPxkefo%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614734961/507fc1aa1d67142c1804e75a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fce46d4cf53e137d42e121f880bc626b8742d94cffd6e6cd5a1606a15d96e7b0&req=ciEjEcp6lIdeFb4f3HP0gDAyDwn15kR1Zu1izrg%2B9gAbZgX1bEQd15jejFF4%0A8gkknf7X%2BvPxkefo%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)

Under the **_Print On Accounts_** section, select any option that is required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614735106/08b30cca192ab0ecc5de53c7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3bdd0d65c9737cfe7c0834d3baba69ab6013eedd1df1802f55ec37a653ff2d4a&req=ciEjEcp7nIFZFb4f3HP0gCMjOghT03XswNrYAUmNa8hAY8URLi3%2BxTIGc%2BGp%0AQYs35tbUMbC%2FGVv6qA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614735106/08b30cca192ab0ecc5de53c7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3bdd0d65c9737cfe7c0834d3baba69ab6013eedd1df1802f55ec37a653ff2d4a&req=ciEjEcp7nIFZFb4f3HP0gCMjOghT03XswNrYAUmNa8hAY8URLi3%2BxTIGc%2BGp%0AQYs35tbUMbC%2FGVv6qA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save**.

Deleting an Account

Deleting an Account
===================

Patient Accounts

Updated over 3 years ago

To delete an account from a Patient's Account tab the patient must not have any associated invoices or payments on the account nor can it be the Default account on a patient's file.

To delete an account go to the **Patient File > Accounts**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618198395/c1162e0038c2887b78f1bc68/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=597a6268aef553a468193778642c659c75a99bc465b1ff07c64b23881e3ee491&req=ciEvF8B2nohaFb4f3HP0gKffwfw68dskLfInC3%2BbXBBFvzDxfuDZgAy7bwzN%0AQyZIW3%2B%2BeWrWP%2Fm5Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618198395/c1162e0038c2887b78f1bc68/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=597a6268aef553a468193778642c659c75a99bc465b1ff07c64b23881e3ee491&req=ciEvF8B2nohaFb4f3HP0gKffwfw68dskLfInC3%2BbXBBFvzDxfuDZgAy7bwzN%0AQyZIW3%2B%2BeWrWP%2Fm5Fw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Manage Accounts**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618198541/7a2766bffa531104fcd5516b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=abb7b53ff7710d7ad9bc73d2c64edae26a0082d3574804515565e7d6815a531f&req=ciEvF8B2mIVeFb4f3HP0gEHHqNDdKIx0esSgNGimCPUbvsnTeKvImDrFU%2BLk%0AGuJSUrGMFlywEo5RQg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618198541/7a2766bffa531104fcd5516b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=abb7b53ff7710d7ad9bc73d2c64edae26a0082d3574804515565e7d6815a531f&req=ciEvF8B2mIVeFb4f3HP0gEHHqNDdKIx0esSgNGimCPUbvsnTeKvImDrFU%2BLk%0AGuJSUrGMFlywEo5RQg%3D%3D%0A)

Click the **Trash Can icon** off the right of the account you wish to delete.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618198919/19812d4ead042e594000c7c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4563564369e6041b45e74089f96fb9c1bcfd6d9af0178ae88ec3c04221458265&req=ciEvF8B2lIBWFb4f3HP0gMb%2BcWJ1%2BwHGsoZU4FWAQIFa74LhfgJOa8SpN8D0%0AVEIfJ%2FEKfvzAPsf5JA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618198919/19812d4ead042e594000c7c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4563564369e6041b45e74089f96fb9c1bcfd6d9af0178ae88ec3c04221458265&req=ciEvF8B2lIBWFb4f3HP0gMb%2BcWJ1%2BwHGsoZU4FWAQIFa74LhfgJOa8SpN8D0%0AVEIfJ%2FEKfvzAPsf5JA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Delete**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618199060/926c299a5281adcd32be99dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9565a0b7883f898bb5b911f2e75518a954bba103a00cc356ce90defeb9f79cd2&req=ciEvF8B3nYdfFb4f3HP0gPy9DInqprG%2FIoYNXqC4e2jmSot9RWXanxgfCXbZ%0A3kb6vt6I6QxoVVyuxw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/618199060/926c299a5281adcd32be99dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9565a0b7883f898bb5b911f2e75518a954bba103a00cc356ce90defeb9f79cd2&req=ciEvF8B3nYdfFb4f3HP0gPy9DInqprG%2FIoYNXqC4e2jmSot9RWXanxgfCXbZ%0A3kb6vt6I6QxoVVyuxw%3D%3D%0A)

Health Fund Rebate Estimates via Tyro Health EFTPOS

Health Fund Rebate Estimates via Tyro Health EFTPOS
===================================================

Updated over 2 years ago

When using the [Tyro Health EFTPOS integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550059-enabling-the-tyro-integration)
, it is possible to process health fund rebate estimates through PracSuite's [Quote feature](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5902970-creating-and-processing-quotes)
.

When creating quotes, you'll see the Tyro Health EFTPOS button at the top of the items grid.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861216774/186b307d9202a6ac489bb03c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=860ac4f24fbdf3fdd97029f3750773cc5ae99b8af8b2a189d8875916bd0d7439&req=fCYmFMh4moZbFb4f3HP0gKWaJ3RWg%2BTJwyo6P%2B4Ez6rDtAxY6iOV%2BZKZ4i7u%0AJiUPhpzYNsOyNwAA%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861216774/186b307d9202a6ac489bb03c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=860ac4f24fbdf3fdd97029f3750773cc5ae99b8af8b2a189d8875916bd0d7439&req=fCYmFMh4moZbFb4f3HP0gKWaJ3RWg%2BTJwyo6P%2B4Ez6rDtAxY6iOV%2BZKZ4i7u%0AJiUPhpzYNsOyNwAA%2Bw%3D%3D%0A)

After adding item(s) to the quote, select the **Tyro Health EFTPOS button**, choose the terminal to use (if applicable) and select **Health Fund Rebate Estimate.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861216837/607ca8ebbfc5171d14a7b504/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3d25db6f9020337e6b254ff426690217317c7e27ffac8cfbaadd6f5cebf3bd75&req=fCYmFMh4lYJYFb4f3HP0gJq2ChTfl%2F7ooX4jhkqEQJAXnP0YgaFQs8qqJsmz%0ADjzDdFdQFBp1HYylZw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861216837/607ca8ebbfc5171d14a7b504/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3d25db6f9020337e6b254ff426690217317c7e27ffac8cfbaadd6f5cebf3bd75&req=fCYmFMh4lYJYFb4f3HP0gJq2ChTfl%2F7ooX4jhkqEQJAXnP0YgaFQs8qqJsmz%0ADjzDdFdQFBp1HYylZw%3D%3D%0A)

The Tyro popup will appear to process the rebate estimate. Once processed, you'll receive a prompt to **Print the member copy**. We recommend printing this out.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/468977813/4135e3946785b756fe8fcece/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67f40892b5669eea508d21b6cd03f95bbeb27abe8e98a1acc54612b95e544035&req=cCYvH855lYBcFb4f3HP0gCt7kLFiA0eiwaKVLHV6Dzbbty9MdcelZpkWoZOM%0AN29sn7oAayI3NzrRWQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/468977813/4135e3946785b756fe8fcece/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67f40892b5669eea508d21b6cd03f95bbeb27abe8e98a1acc54612b95e544035&req=cCYvH855lYBcFb4f3HP0gCt7kLFiA0eiwaKVLHV6Dzbbty9MdcelZpkWoZOM%0AN29sn7oAayI3NzrRWQ%3D%3D%0A)

The rebate estimate and remaining gap amount will be displayed onscreen.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/468977519/e4c6a05a73ecb61f1685d657/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=566cc094ac093eb48b45db3439ad394a67f75c44371c48544c843fad3fbbfd88&req=cCYvH855mIBWFb4f3HP0gERSMSisCnVDQUadQVxRHGt9aphKYIV%2F47thua%2By%0ATGI1h6cqpMwbwr3f%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/468977519/e4c6a05a73ecb61f1685d657/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=566cc094ac093eb48b45db3439ad394a67f75c44371c48544c843fad3fbbfd88&req=cCYvH855mIBWFb4f3HP0gERSMSisCnVDQUadQVxRHGt9aphKYIV%2F47thua%2By%0ATGI1h6cqpMwbwr3f%2FQ%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 226 — Clinical Notes Quick Buttons | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-226}

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Clinical Notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413946-clinical-notes)

Clinical Notes Quick Buttons

Clinical Notes Quick Buttons
============================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Setting Up Quick Buttons](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6034699-clinical-notes-quick-buttons#h_6e501c47ee)

[Reordering and Hiding Quick Button Sets](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6034699-clinical-notes-quick-buttons#h_740dd39650)

[Using Quick Buttons](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6034699-clinical-notes-quick-buttons#h_5edf9ddc4e)

**Quick Buttons** allow you to speed through your clinical notes by clicking/tapping buttons to output commonly used phrases and paragraphs without having to manually type it each time. The output text can be simple phrases, richly formatted text (with images) and can dynamically insert patient data using merge fields. Quick Buttons can be especially useful for PracSuite users with touch screens/tablet devices.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/475832299/741e30073d856ad352bb88f9/quickbuttonsgif.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=566e597d5c01cce1fef761ad6798b2f9c3e25c71928f27ca07d3cd628118b815&req=cCciHsp8n4hWFb4f3HP0gCgd%2FPl%2BDpjnn9m4Pxj09hjdSBSHnc10w%2BGNM9wt%0A9FRzBOuZuQ0TWUp7Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/475832299/741e30073d856ad352bb88f9/quickbuttonsgif.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=566e597d5c01cce1fef761ad6798b2f9c3e25c71928f27ca07d3cd628118b815&req=cCciHsp8n4hWFb4f3HP0gCgd%2FPl%2BDpjnn9m4Pxj09hjdSBSHnc10w%2BGNM9wt%0A9FRzBOuZuQ0TWUp7Fw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Setting Up Quick Buttons**
============================

Go to [Settings > Clinical Notes > Quick Buttons](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/clinicalnotes/quickbuttons/list)
 and select **Add Button Set** to create a collection of Quick Buttons.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/475833409/0a22946c540568029b2a223a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a91001d967a44f4c8454fc5d1c5ea556f92be04efb0932d144445bb16e66df6&req=cCciHsp9mYFWFb4f3HP0gOSlNASRVhzyUgIFxvo7rWaquF0MKvKGzy5aMi0b%0Aj4vhmHTG%2F54YzbZeqA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/475833409/0a22946c540568029b2a223a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a91001d967a44f4c8454fc5d1c5ea556f92be04efb0932d144445bb16e66df6&req=cCciHsp9mYFWFb4f3HP0gOSlNASRVhzyUgIFxvo7rWaquF0MKvKGzy5aMi0b%0Aj4vhmHTG%2F54YzbZeqA%3D%3D%0A)

After naming your Quick Button Set, type in a Label for the button that will be displayed within clinical notes. You can choose to type in a simple plain text output or tick the Rich Text box to bring up the rich text editor.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/475833869/797d34b379d97c71a89edb28/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7389f558cc27c2ea28c838d91e3605ee9e7f2380e2b55e9269057c7b690e9690&req=cCciHsp9lYdWFb4f3HP0gBuH4%2B9GR7inLzP%2FatJch15oyGwCqs8AVHe4j1KD%0A8qM6%2FPSVuY%2BDwGLqBA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/475833869/797d34b379d97c71a89edb28/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7389f558cc27c2ea28c838d91e3605ee9e7f2380e2b55e9269057c7b690e9690&req=cCciHsp9lYdWFb4f3HP0gBuH4%2B9GR7inLzP%2FatJch15oyGwCqs8AVHe4j1KD%0A8qM6%2FPSVuY%2BDwGLqBA%3D%3D%0A)

The Insert Fields button at the top allows you to auto-populate information from your client's file or the logged-in user/practitioner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476425504/e7a54d0a21524cf642d8a02f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d81817fd646137bed162935bd23c8db9da9b7390681c68fa71a3d97a585a834e&req=cCchEst7mIFbFb4f3HP0gBSqg14Y1%2B55DebNCaohA45ud3ZM9bBNc%2FVS1HI2%0Ag3n2XTEZd93ZK7LgIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476425504/e7a54d0a21524cf642d8a02f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d81817fd646137bed162935bd23c8db9da9b7390681c68fa71a3d97a585a834e&req=cCchEst7mIFbFb4f3HP0gBSqg14Y1%2B55DebNCaohA45ud3ZM9bBNc%2FVS1HI2%0Ag3n2XTEZd93ZK7LgIA%3D%3D%0A)

You can also change the colour of the button to quickly spot commonly used or important buttons.

Use the Add Button button to keep creating more buttons and then select **Save** at the top when you are done.

* * *

Reordering and Hiding Quick Button Sets
=======================================

If you have multiple Quick Button Sets you can reorder them on the Quick Buttons settings page. Select Edit and then use the drag handles to reposition them. Note that this changes the order for all users so it is important to discuss the preferred order as a team.

You can also edit the Access level to define who can see the Quick Button Set. This would allow you to hide certain sets that you will never use.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476423671/c4758017a64b08ef0d9d5fff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dea3089e454589efb8819bfec1bf8dea42572b174e27b91b9b44b332f10bef66&req=cCchEst9m4ZeFb4f3HP0gNbvodem9Ha6H4IpmQ0n%2Fkwhr0yfk%2Baz2h8qUuyB%0AA1Vc3527XBYir%2BVx1A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476423671/c4758017a64b08ef0d9d5fff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dea3089e454589efb8819bfec1bf8dea42572b174e27b91b9b44b332f10bef66&req=cCchEst9m4ZeFb4f3HP0gNbvodem9Ha6H4IpmQ0n%2Fkwhr0yfk%2Baz2h8qUuyB%0AA1Vc3527XBYir%2BVx1A%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Using Quick Buttons
===================

While writing a Clinical Note, select **Show Quick Buttons** and you will see your Quick Buttons on the right (or below on smaller screens).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/475836438/e7201f1677dc2a348decc802/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9b8bd5743d8a47de2092371d4feb864422949d901731cf102f0d2afbf87f094f&req=cCciHsp4mYJXFb4f3HP0gA4jYEa593%2F1r3A902r8GxNND2IpyO2AlRiXCmVx%0AtHq2KWKzshH6HtnLmQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/475836438/e7201f1677dc2a348decc802/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9b8bd5743d8a47de2092371d4feb864422949d901731cf102f0d2afbf87f094f&req=cCciHsp4mYJXFb4f3HP0gA4jYEa593%2F1r3A902r8GxNND2IpyO2AlRiXCmVx%0AtHq2KWKzshH6HtnLmQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select a Quick Button Set to view their buttons and use the arrow buttons to scroll through sets if you have created multiple sets.

Selecting a quick button will insert your text wherever the cursor was last so that as you are typing you can select a Quick button and the text will instantly appear in your clinical note!

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476421356/6fe48845999b86f5c40171f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b6b88c9806538285e20771e044111e81d0335f316bfdfd0399d4f3bf3ccd6b6&req=cCchEst%2FnoRZFb4f3HP0gPryzzAUtevTlPVkSQEe9qGCNN15tCq%2FxU4PobzS%0AP%2FwM9u7RPzOG6t0LGw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476421356/6fe48845999b86f5c40171f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b6b88c9806538285e20771e044111e81d0335f316bfdfd0399d4f3bf3ccd6b6&req=cCchEst%2FnoRZFb4f3HP0gPryzzAUtevTlPVkSQEe9qGCNN15tCq%2FxU4PobzS%0AP%2FwM9u7RPzOG6t0LGw%3D%3D%0A)

If your cursor isn't already in a text field, you will see a notification in the top right advising that the next text field you select will add your Quick Button text.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476456668/bbd73b48523624f48f5b85e0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aefafa0a0eb0b16e5cf54628ebd339b3c317a6c1123dbf5b7ca4bcdee5771d25&req=cCchEsx4m4dXFb4f3HP0gKGKEMiBVKKYk73NQqNf6o46Ho3%2B6g7MVONG%2BcFM%0Ah%2BZuvom9%2FkPZSjWg3A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476456668/bbd73b48523624f48f5b85e0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aefafa0a0eb0b16e5cf54628ebd339b3c317a6c1123dbf5b7ca4bcdee5771d25&req=cCchEsx4m4dXFb4f3HP0gKGKEMiBVKKYk73NQqNf6o46Ho3%2B6g7MVONG%2BcFM%0Ah%2BZuvom9%2FkPZSjWg3A%3D%3D%0A)

💡 If you also have Show History enabled, you can use the handlebar to adjust the space provided for Quick Buttons and History.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476423074/acec868a7199b898504d1503/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8d277a25093a7b143d9dd81e7e667095ccb074528b59978da3fb725fb3915d5&req=cCchEst9nYZbFb4f3HP0gJeCAgJ1zsDRsB%2BfFcK4w%2BjouBywmpPPCRJ5uOaT%0Ag%2Bqz6P2JhVMtf5wmfg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476423074/acec868a7199b898504d1503/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8d277a25093a7b143d9dd81e7e667095ccb074528b59978da3fb725fb3915d5&req=cCchEst9nYZbFb4f3HP0gJeCAgJ1zsDRsB%2BfFcK4w%2BjouBywmpPPCRJ5uOaT%0Ag%2Bqz6P2JhVMtf5wmfg%3D%3D%0A)

Online Family Bookings

Online Family Bookings
======================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Enabling Shared Online Bookings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6038416-online-family-bookings#h_b2ea753d18)

[Client Perspective](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6038416-online-family-bookings#h_a6481db0db)

Enabling Shared Online Bookings on a client's file allows linked Family members with an online booking account to see and manage appointments on behalf of other shared online bookings enabled family members.

💡 To link Family members together, [please see this article here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590931-linking-family-members)
.

* * *

**Enabling Shared Online Bookings**
===================================

On the **Contacts tab** of a **Client's File** select **Edit** and turn on the toggle for Shared Online Bookings for any family members that would like to manage their family's appointments. Please note that only family members with Shared Online Bookings enabled will be able to have other family members book in with them - They do not have to have their own account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614785965/1b4acfedfb1ed63e3a005eea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2c0a0858681ba5c305e1d25cdbcf042de6e821dd667c8462c54c4b8ab2457c14&req=ciEjEcF7lIdaFb4f3HP0gGNPPYQAhlwHgOBjpGsWxNLEalxuES%2BS1mUHfsTN%0Aud9VywTFVbuBL1T0EA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614785965/1b4acfedfb1ed63e3a005eea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2c0a0858681ba5c305e1d25cdbcf042de6e821dd667c8462c54c4b8ab2457c14&req=ciEjEcF7lIdaFb4f3HP0gGNPPYQAhlwHgOBjpGsWxNLEalxuES%2BS1mUHfsTN%0Aud9VywTFVbuBL1T0EA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Client Perspective**
======================

When logged in, Timothy can see their own and their family's bookings.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476442751/89cb8ca7fe5ef71e5a6b2486/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=84c9407ecae82de1dd00208358d6b3f4229ea8e11b30611ca06b074c740b61be&req=cCchEs18moReFb4f3HP0gDzCRjFMvGp9pci6H9q0ps99KipIiaNZXBeQp1ru%0A1iIQpChSDrUIhvInZA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476442751/89cb8ca7fe5ef71e5a6b2486/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=84c9407ecae82de1dd00208358d6b3f4229ea8e11b30611ca06b074c740b61be&req=cCchEs18moReFb4f3HP0gDzCRjFMvGp9pci6H9q0ps99KipIiaNZXBeQp1ru%0A1iIQpChSDrUIhvInZA%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting **Book Appointment** or **Book Class** the client is then asked who they would like to make an appointment for.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476443208/961e84a7ff608dc6175ad373/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b536bd2ed4765fb55c43bdc89fadf8657429f20a4c338da08db665f49abed7f&req=cCchEs19n4FXFb4f3HP0gCVbWTEn7yA%2BFlYUm7RfOSKUHmRPFj5Juud%2FiCqI%0Av5Zf2%2B0I6ePwa%2B21yA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/476443208/961e84a7ff608dc6175ad373/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b536bd2ed4765fb55c43bdc89fadf8657429f20a4c338da08db665f49abed7f&req=cCchEs19n4FXFb4f3HP0gCVbWTEn7yA%2BFlYUm7RfOSKUHmRPFj5Juud%2FiCqI%0Av5Zf2%2B0I6ePwa%2B21yA%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 229 — Clinical Note Memos | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-229}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6074381-clinical-note-memos](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6074381-clinical-note-memos)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

Clinical Note Memos

Clinical Note Memos
===================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Creating a Clinical Note Memo](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6074381-clinical-note-memos#h_84c1c97492)

[Clinical Note Memo Security Permissions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6074381-clinical-note-memos#h_5b271dcce3)

Clinical Note Memos are designed for non-practitioner users to add notes into a patient's Clinical Notes timeline. Clinical Note Memos are recorded as written by the User, not the Practitioner. To maintain the security of clinical notes, it is possible to provide non-practitioner users with the ability to add Memos without viewing a patient's clinical notes.

Creating a Clinical Note Memo
=============================

To create a Memo, select the **Memo** button at the top of the client's Clinical Notes tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463295/b9d44bac43165d9f9f43bbdf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c0852e4858cf32e0978d6f08e5412607814797392726a040ce50380e326a5c8&req=ciMgEs99n4haFb4f3HP0gFrcuh7bLXr6cdGIb7EtPMZRLETcqjyUkz5ZcBRH%0ANp2i1LWs7ZNa%2FMY9qQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463295/b9d44bac43165d9f9f43bbdf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c0852e4858cf32e0978d6f08e5412607814797392726a040ce50380e326a5c8&req=ciMgEs99n4haFb4f3HP0gFrcuh7bLXr6cdGIb7EtPMZRLETcqjyUkz5ZcBRH%0ANp2i1LWs7ZNa%2FMY9qQ%3D%3D%0A)

The Memo screen will appear. Type in your Memo and format it as required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463428/dd1587dc115d4d2f2de67c3d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8941ece909e838a4eefbb406d814f907a03678f4b2b0c12f6a96c619b4668deb&req=ciMgEs99mYNXFb4f3HP0gNMW6HFgqALb%2Bu586qGiGvoKQ1fk%2Fx8Et1Ms5dhV%0AjG7AGRq%2FqRKFaCz0wg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463428/dd1587dc115d4d2f2de67c3d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8941ece909e838a4eefbb406d814f907a03678f4b2b0c12f6a96c619b4668deb&req=ciMgEs99mYNXFb4f3HP0gNMW6HFgqALb%2Bu586qGiGvoKQ1fk%2Fx8Et1Ms5dhV%0AjG7AGRq%2FqRKFaCz0wg%3D%3D%0A)

You can also change the Access to make the Memo only show to certain Businesses, Professions, Practitioners or Users using the Memo Access button, add Attachments or [Tags](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4590913-adding-tags-to-clinical-notes)
. Once you are done select **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637465142/e277d896c59912b0685c3ea7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=918e6ea8016c49fd78c3db94682a5beed02ebd3bed973da7115b2e1a84e5629e&req=ciMgEs97nIVdFb4f3HP0gHnPSl%2BFXP9wi8OjmfPo8zu3HZxeBONCR%2FkcipXJ%0A%2Bz7qk5wck07jwpROmQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637465142/e277d896c59912b0685c3ea7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=918e6ea8016c49fd78c3db94682a5beed02ebd3bed973da7115b2e1a84e5629e&req=ciMgEs97nIVdFb4f3HP0gHnPSl%2BFXP9wi8OjmfPo8zu3HZxeBONCR%2FkcipXJ%0A%2Bz7qk5wck07jwpROmQ%3D%3D%0A)

The Memo will now be in the Clinical Notes timeline for anyone who has access to it. Memos have a distinct appearance indicated by the green header bar.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463486/b6b91e16ea34806949931ca3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea59cc0396ae0584050ac41799a7865ef4d6f0b00c1a5fe1a1c7e8419193d8f3&req=ciMgEs99mYlZFb4f3HP0gC7O0Z9erl2TfgAvpXHZvlwEXxp2P6P9Av%2BT4fr0%0AD40TABZRz9NAVxRuzw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463486/b6b91e16ea34806949931ca3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea59cc0396ae0584050ac41799a7865ef4d6f0b00c1a5fe1a1c7e8419193d8f3&req=ciMgEs99mYlZFb4f3HP0gC7O0Z9erl2TfgAvpXHZvlwEXxp2P6P9Av%2BT4fr0%0AD40TABZRz9NAVxRuzw%3D%3D%0A)

Hovering over a Memo shows buttons to allow you to Edit, Pin, Print or Delete the Memo.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463566/1083f5177d91a10f79ddc1ab/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83735778e6f0af98a692a9350ab9b057667c84c8a3f98eec2f60d5ea0b71fcd4&req=ciMgEs99mIdZFb4f3HP0gDtRFTLZS2o4COs3%2F7dMFLzeGGzA2ZbXl3%2Fmcyjn%0AO8DpfOKj4QgHYpBxtw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463566/1083f5177d91a10f79ddc1ab/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83735778e6f0af98a692a9350ab9b057667c84c8a3f98eec2f60d5ea0b71fcd4&req=ciMgEs99mIdZFb4f3HP0gDtRFTLZS2o4COs3%2F7dMFLzeGGzA2ZbXl3%2Fmcyjn%0AO8DpfOKj4QgHYpBxtw%3D%3D%0A)

💡 Please note that edits to Memos are not stored as revisions.

* * *

Clinical Note Memo Security Permissions
=======================================

To allow a user to be able to see and/or edit Clinical Notes Memos their [Role](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353460-creating-roles)
 needs to have the required access level.

The Clinical Memo security setting can be found under Clinical Notes and can be set to No access, read-only or full (create/edit) access.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463816/b8d359671f648699c7f223c2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23e7974fe4c28f77ecf9ac2a94a95bf5d82eacace0de8e71e2fd5ae9b6fe0895&req=ciMgEs99lYBZFb4f3HP0gPe0CgnPqdmG%2FteXjIONxgbEgPNFi0nSfYeBVBRK%0AwaNaVZPD4i%2F9jc8ZAg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637463816/b8d359671f648699c7f223c2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23e7974fe4c28f77ecf9ac2a94a95bf5d82eacace0de8e71e2fd5ae9b6fe0895&req=ciMgEs99lYBZFb4f3HP0gPe0CgnPqdmG%2FteXjIONxgbEgPNFi0nSfYeBVBRK%0AwaNaVZPD4i%2F9jc8ZAg%3D%3D%0A)

Using the **Memo Access** button while editing a Memo will allow you to decide who can see this particular Memo. You can limit it to Businesses, Professions, Practitioners or Users.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637464676/8a818586de3aabe5632dc246/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9f4b925c634415e1af725efcea3b80f3bdcaf84bfb1e0637d7b91ab719871ffa&req=ciMgEs96m4ZZFb4f3HP0gLKblYjLGj1W%2Bk6nGnRS0ekeYfGoIOJaze846GtH%0ArF3wxpxGN0A3sViO8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637464676/8a818586de3aabe5632dc246/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9f4b925c634415e1af725efcea3b80f3bdcaf84bfb1e0637d7b91ab719871ffa&req=ciMgEs96m4ZZFb4f3HP0gLKblYjLGj1W%2Bk6nGnRS0ekeYfGoIOJaze846GtH%0ArF3wxpxGN0A3sViO8w%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637464782/40111d978eaf5e1b0ad52ace/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=410a582d6db85d3f3d2f50415f943c263ad0988465bfb6b4a449794e686664c7&req=ciMgEs96moldFb4f3HP0gDeMNi3%2FZ9XrVWQrVT0Zsqoe%2F7ub45dsmFd9mi%2BA%0ArN0kz1WbfZ0t10splw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637464782/40111d978eaf5e1b0ad52ace/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=410a582d6db85d3f3d2f50415f943c263ad0988465bfb6b4a449794e686664c7&req=ciMgEs96moldFb4f3HP0gDeMNi3%2FZ9XrVWQrVT0Zsqoe%2F7ub45dsmFd9mi%2BA%0ArN0kz1WbfZ0t10splw%3D%3D%0A)

💡 Please note that the Memo creator will always be able to see their Memo, therefore you do not need to factor in yourself when customising Access.

Creating Spreadsheet Templates

Creating Spreadsheet Templates
==============================

Updated over 3 years ago

1\. Go to **[Settings > Templates > Spreadsheet Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/spreadsheet)
**  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637466095/8c28f000ab57b59ec375ae43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a53a3ed2993ca7f6b2b73b4a1054a32966cab9d6d704ff3e86869663c05196ad&req=ciMgEs94nYhaFb4f3HP0gHGGMNyTQ6W578jgc4GrkC0ytpxOZdZGvjN52sfd%0AQC%2BCzGhzRVa4NdyC%2BA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637466095/8c28f000ab57b59ec375ae43/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a53a3ed2993ca7f6b2b73b4a1054a32966cab9d6d704ff3e86869663c05196ad&req=ciMgEs94nYhaFb4f3HP0gHGGMNyTQ6W578jgc4GrkC0ytpxOZdZGvjN52sfd%0AQC%2BCzGhzRVa4NdyC%2BA%3D%3D%0A)

2\. You can create **folders** to store and categorise your Spreadsheet Templates. Click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637468356/7223adc681b91532eb143be9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=414225ffd7936b94d6e3dbbe67d3f53b20b5e4bf697e42098ef97087c9c73341&req=ciMgEs92noRZFb4f3HP0gENmxpOsSkyxanKlM%2BHSlytUlXjYPaNOKFMCc9jw%0AMWv87RFKERVlVHcYbQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637468356/7223adc681b91532eb143be9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=414225ffd7936b94d6e3dbbe67d3f53b20b5e4bf697e42098ef97087c9c73341&req=ciMgEs92noRZFb4f3HP0gENmxpOsSkyxanKlM%2BHSlytUlXjYPaNOKFMCc9jw%0AMWv87RFKERVlVHcYbQ%3D%3D%0A)

3\. Click **Add Folder** to create a new **Spreadsheet Template Folder** then click **Save** to save your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637468624/f7f710d0480edcebe76fcaf7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1ba0ef020fbb73a5d4a9cfab65f30448d19e69c2a3b0164b4ac53fad2924ae9&req=ciMgEs92m4NbFb4f3HP0gB1v3y8iBz8XKkckzB4JFSryZYhzJixOVffWsvxS%0AMgq6lFdBNve5dE8rqQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637468624/f7f710d0480edcebe76fcaf7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f1ba0ef020fbb73a5d4a9cfab65f30448d19e69c2a3b0164b4ac53fad2924ae9&req=ciMgEs92m4NbFb4f3HP0gB1v3y8iBz8XKkckzB4JFSryZYhzJixOVffWsvxS%0AMgq6lFdBNve5dE8rqQ%3D%3D%0A)

4\. Click **Add Template** to create a **New Spreadsheet Template**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637468881/7ec65b33c8281a9723fcb83e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e131205d30f8d9e71f32b876ad3116a913b2de7083f983c624d3460469159105&req=ciMgEs92lYleFb4f3HP0gBiwpBPqwbl4%2B9Zub2KZqNuLLZ%2B7efIRhjm8%2FRYo%0A1Ykwp%2B6haKN00ecKng%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637468881/7ec65b33c8281a9723fcb83e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e131205d30f8d9e71f32b876ad3116a913b2de7083f983c624d3460469159105&req=ciMgEs92lYleFb4f3HP0gBiwpBPqwbl4%2B9Zub2KZqNuLLZ%2B7efIRhjm8%2FRYo%0A1Ykwp%2B6haKN00ecKng%3D%3D%0A)

5\. Edit your Spreadsheet Template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637469054/ceedd8c5f8297cedeab42b76/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6538d0fc939aacc38e910f82ff49a7c4d30b3c0b8823870b49f115f09c9c5653&req=ciMgEs93nYRbFb4f3HP0gBK2HSWa2tMcdKSJtg1qBjz4TJDv2whvCnluuOQX%0AR3WbO0PDcfLrmekmgg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637469054/ceedd8c5f8297cedeab42b76/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6538d0fc939aacc38e910f82ff49a7c4d30b3c0b8823870b49f115f09c9c5653&req=ciMgEs93nYRbFb4f3HP0gBK2HSWa2tMcdKSJtg1qBjz4TJDv2whvCnluuOQX%0AR3WbO0PDcfLrmekmgg%3D%3D%0A)

6\. Click **Save** to finalise your template changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637469148/8e0ab7db79eb7df89877d63a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f067114906968ef5fcddbda8233796dde1d1f19bbbc340502ca82a51ebe6534a&req=ciMgEs93nIVXFb4f3HP0gLoOnASuNsUjfxLH5Y7cBawbsV3AabB0GYxNQI8D%0AD3WBC6MvMIK2muRQ2A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637469148/8e0ab7db79eb7df89877d63a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f067114906968ef5fcddbda8233796dde1d1f19bbbc340502ca82a51ebe6534a&req=ciMgEs93nIVXFb4f3HP0gLoOnASuNsUjfxLH5Y7cBawbsV3AabB0GYxNQI8D%0AD3WBC6MvMIK2muRQ2A%3D%3D%0A)

7\. Specify a **Description** for the template, and if it should be stored in a **template folder**, then click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637469273/79e457aa729e6b07b352aafb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cc6838dbe331ff37b3ff48c8ac0f315e35f4be3cfbdf95d860c0d3d126d38c87&req=ciMgEs93n4ZcFb4f3HP0gAiFfMavYY16pWrh%2Bo95VU%2FRNvZJrNqajlYsVPPP%0Ai%2F08KjIyUyOHlVw1Uw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637469273/79e457aa729e6b07b352aafb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cc6838dbe331ff37b3ff48c8ac0f315e35f4be3cfbdf95d860c0d3d126d38c87&req=ciMgEs93n4ZcFb4f3HP0gAiFfMavYY16pWrh%2Bo95VU%2FRNvZJrNqajlYsVPPP%0Ai%2F08KjIyUyOHlVw1Uw%3D%3D%0A)

8\. Your spreadsheet template will now appear in its respective template folder.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637469341/536c966827563d07d38d9c16/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dd097de02eb449f12d3f863a8b9abb633b4b6ff432e3e3f95623d8080c714411&req=ciMgEs93noVeFb4f3HP0gKyyaDRgG7dEPr5c8siWpkrqE9EprFcELvm0ijEy%0ApJhjXv3avcxRzSNyiw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637469341/536c966827563d07d38d9c16/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dd097de02eb449f12d3f863a8b9abb633b4b6ff432e3e3f95623d8080c714411&req=ciMgEs93noVeFb4f3HP0gKyyaDRgG7dEPr5c8siWpkrqE9EprFcELvm0ijEy%0ApJhjXv3avcxRzSNyiw%3D%3D%0A)

How to Send an SMS or Email to Referring Doctors and Organisations in Bulk

How to Send an SMS or Email to Referring Doctors and Organisations in Bulk
==========================================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Send SMS](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6077030-how-to-send-an-sms-or-email-to-referring-doctors-and-organisations-in-bulk#h_614fcc8055)

[Send Email](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6077030-how-to-send-an-sms-or-email-to-referring-doctors-and-organisations-in-bulk#h_4b8ba3b8d1)

Go to **[Contacts](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/referrers/doctors)
** [> **Referrers** \> **Referring Doctors**](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/referrers/doctors)
 (or **[Organisations](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/referrers/organisations)
**)

========

You can either compose a message ad-hoc or insert an [existing template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317983-creating-sms-templates)
.

Tracking Online Booking Conversions with Google Tag Manager

Tracking Online Booking Conversions with Google Tag Manager
===========================================================

Updated over 3 weeks ago

Table of contents

This article provides an overview of how to track PracSuite online booking conversions using **Google Tag Manager (GTM)** in combination with **Google Analytics 4 (GA4)**.

It is written for clinic owners, web managers, or marketing professionals who are already familiar with Google’s analytics tools.

With the exception of confirming that your Google Tag Manager container ID has been added to PracSuite correctly, **configuration and troubleshooting within Google Tag Manager or Google Analytics is outside of Smartsoft’s support scope**.  
​

For assistance with advanced tracking setups, attribution, or marketing optimisation, we recommend engaging your SEO or digital marketing professional.

If you wish to trigger Custom HTML using Google Tag Manager, you must contact Smartsoft and request that the ability to run custom GTM scripts be enabled on the associated PracSuite account.

* * *

A note on tracking conversions when embedding the PracSuite booking site
========================================================================

Modern browsers now block third-party cookies by default and limit how websites can track users across domains. This affects how marketing platforms like Google Analytics, Facebook, or Google Ads track user journeys, especially when PracSuite’s online booking system is embedded inside another website using an iframe.

Without some extra configuration, two things can happen:

*   Your main website won’t be able to track bookings or conversions that happen inside the PracSuite iframe.
    
*   The booking site may be seen as a separate “referral” in your analytics, breaking the link between the original traffic source (e.g. Google Ads or Facebook) and the actual booking.
    

### **What You (or Your Marketing Expert) Can Do**

If you want to track conversions properly and keep attribution intact, your marketing or web team will need to:

*   Set up communication between your site and the PracSuite booking iframe using tools like window.postMessage.
    
*   Use Google Tag Manager (GTM) on your main site to listen for events from the iframe (such as “booking complete”) and record them as conversions.
    
*   Update your Google Analytics settings to exclude PracSuite from referral traffic, so it doesn’t interfere with attribution.
    

### **Who Can Help**

A skilled SEO or digital marketing developer should know how to do this. You can also search for guides on terms like:

*   “GA4 cross-domain iframe tracking”
    
*   “Google Tag Manager postMessage tracking”
    
*   “Tracking conversions in embedded iframes”
    

[Some guidance is also available from third-party marketing blogs.](https://www.impression.co.uk/blog/cross-domain-iframe-tracking-via-google-tag-manager/)

* * *

If you are **not embedding** the PracSuite booking site, continue below for standard standalone tracking instructions.

Prerequisites
=============

This article assumes that you have set up the following:

*   [A Google Analytics GA4 account](https://analytics.google.com/)
    
*   [A Google Tag Manager account](https://tagmanager.google.com/)
    

This article covers the following:

*   [Adding Your Tracking IDs to PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6077310-tracking-online-booking-conversions-with-google-tag-manager#h_00ee7a6860)
    
*   [Configuring Google Tag Manager](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6077310-tracking-online-booking-conversions-with-google-tag-manager#h_f01587e699)
    
*   [Creating a trigger for the conversion](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6077310-tracking-online-booking-conversions-with-google-tag-manager#h_e115057915)
    
*   [Viewing Events in Google Analytics](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6077310-tracking-online-booking-conversions-with-google-tag-manager#h_e248123804)

Adding Your GTM Tracking ID to PracSuite
========================================

This article focuses on using Google Tag Manager to track conversions, and pass events to Google Analytics.

You do **not** need to add both GTM and GA4 tracking IDs to PracSuite.

When using Google Tag Manager:

*   The GTM container is loaded by PracSuite.
    
*   GA4 events are sent **from within GTM** using your GA4 Measurement ID.
    

This is the recommended and preferred approach, as it avoids duplicate pageviews and conflicting configurations.

To begin, add your GTM account ID only in PracSuite under [Settings > Online Booking > Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996816793/5cc31004d176523a5381459ff424/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+12_00_23%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b3d42229b9fb1f32a3f98196206c1f317e2aa1c10e6f2f03141783e3e35e5b7&req=dSkuEMF%2Fm4ZWWvMW1HO4zYNYWFFf8xmijXMI2QR%2FRV2bqU%2BpWAaeGWbRTnLy%0A%2BJOQLzWFk9zJbKnbyZM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996816793/5cc31004d176523a5381459ff424/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+12_00_23%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0b3d42229b9fb1f32a3f98196206c1f317e2aa1c10e6f2f03141783e3e35e5b7&req=dSkuEMF%2Fm4ZWWvMW1HO4zYNYWFFf8xmijXMI2QR%2FRV2bqU%2BpWAaeGWbRTnLy%0A%2BJOQLzWFk9zJbKnbyZM%3D%0A)

Your Google Tag Manager tracking ID can be found in the top right-hand corner of your Google Tag Manager account. Copy this into PracSuite into the field shown above.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/511023411/8f394abc965754c70a7e0dec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c945a0209e88fe7715c8fb3e26d27f1878f29033ea2cd5c07493311036f85dc2&req=cSEmFst9mYBeFb4f3HP0gGAlOP0VJVIIku9mB3T8M7ODxevMbkZPixBR0FrX%0Ah%2BmqApZgwaxN62VlHQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/511023411/8f394abc965754c70a7e0dec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c945a0209e88fe7715c8fb3e26d27f1878f29033ea2cd5c07493311036f85dc2&req=cSEmFst9mYBeFb4f3HP0gGAlOP0VJVIIku9mB3T8M7ODxevMbkZPixBR0FrX%0Ah%2BmqApZgwaxN62VlHQ%3D%3D%0A)

Configuring Google Tag Manager
==============================

We now need to set up Google Tag Manager to send an event to Google Analytics when an appointment is booked online in PracSuite.

Start by logging into your Google Tag Manager account.

Step 1: Create a GA4 Event Tag
------------------------------

Select **Add a new tag**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996768487/6809e22e13f6caca9fc3a8a74e2d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3487ce114e123dd79348b3925453f3071052d30106e404be00fe81da4575335c&req=dSkuEM54lYVXXvMW1HO4zXe7SyQ%2BXRXmewb5oOZABCOqgQsDVUolv1GdZM0F%0AOV3uz%2BeGnKJAQcZ%2BA8Y%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996768487/6809e22e13f6caca9fc3a8a74e2d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3487ce114e123dd79348b3925453f3071052d30106e404be00fe81da4575335c&req=dSkuEM54lYVXXvMW1HO4zXe7SyQ%2BXRXmewb5oOZABCOqgQsDVUolv1GdZM0F%0AOV3uz%2BeGnKJAQcZ%2BA8Y%3D%0A)

Give your tag a name e.g. Online Booking Complete and then click in the area shown below to start configuring the tag.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996768486/7dd1a7093650b1b4c0ab0aca678e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0dae14e98debfb5b83864861cf2eeb9b53ed2dad02fb6e51f44fa93f0e0ee4f6&req=dSkuEM54lYVXX%2FMW1HO4zaeWK%2B7m%2BXm0SVpnJboN5evREGICbP7Ujakx6MA7%0AJSb8WRBRR7ngADwB5r8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996768486/7dd1a7093650b1b4c0ab0aca678e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0dae14e98debfb5b83864861cf2eeb9b53ed2dad02fb6e51f44fa93f0e0ee4f6&req=dSkuEM54lYVXX%2FMW1HO4zaeWK%2B7m%2BXm0SVpnJboN5evREGICbP7Ujakx6MA7%0AJSb8WRBRR7ngADwB5r8%3D%0A)

There are many other Tag Types to choose from.

**If you wish to trigger Custom HTML using Google Tag Manager, you must contact Smartsoft and request that the ability to run custom GTM scripts be enabled on the associated PracSuite account.**

For this example, our tag will send a **Google Analytics** **GA4 Event**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996768485/f0596cb64bd51265de77db55f239/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ff35b7c29f366fdde18c587d10dbf912cb7d12226ff8c57407be7f9b67e0fc9&req=dSkuEM54lYVXXPMW1HO4zYF8jnij2fxYqPG5XxyrhwAS3zb0MQKzbjN%2BKHLR%0ApmjwQfD%2FPmo%2Fveq6qh0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996768485/f0596cb64bd51265de77db55f239/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ff35b7c29f366fdde18c587d10dbf912cb7d12226ff8c57407be7f9b67e0fc9&req=dSkuEM54lYVXXPMW1HO4zYF8jnij2fxYqPG5XxyrhwAS3zb0MQKzbjN%2BKHLR%0ApmjwQfD%2FPmo%2Fveq6qh0%3D%0A)

  
Next, you will require your **Google Analytics Measurement ID**. Expand the section below to learn more about creating/obtaining a Google Analytics Measurement ID.

Finding your Google Analytics Measurement ID
--------------------------------------------

  
For Google Analytics 4, you will need to create a new Data Stream to obtain your measurement ID.

After logging into your Google Analytics account, start by searching for data stream in the search bar at the top of the page and then select the **Data Streams** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996763602/5176d4a30668c5ebbdaab9c5d288/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc69107d1cc13f53008ffced47e8f78aee9d93fc4bcfc40ffeb027547457b942&req=dSkuEM54nodfW%2FMW1HO4zagdmJpTOwQr0T1CylZDTfN8g1VZo0jeRth9tvh8%0AmttV%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996763602/5176d4a30668c5ebbdaab9c5d288/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc69107d1cc13f53008ffced47e8f78aee9d93fc4bcfc40ffeb027547457b942&req=dSkuEM54nodfW%2FMW1HO4zagdmJpTOwQr0T1CylZDTfN8g1VZo0jeRth9tvh8%0AmttV%0A)

Select **Add Stream** and then select **Web**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996763605/ed0286be78f6fa28cd522110adea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32231aabb5c1c31f8640f6c2c214c9d315959115e81afddf39e6cb05e9657ce5&req=dSkuEM54nodfXPMW1HO4zUw4cL1kS7GDqNq1mWXgwI%2FRq5yKSLPbsK41dn1O%0AkJYR%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996763605/ed0286be78f6fa28cd522110adea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32231aabb5c1c31f8640f6c2c214c9d315959115e81afddf39e6cb05e9657ce5&req=dSkuEM54nodfXPMW1HO4zUw4cL1kS7GDqNq1mWXgwI%2FRq5yKSLPbsK41dn1O%0AkJYR%0A)

Enter the URL of your PracSuite online booking system, which [you can find here.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
 You will also need to enter a stream name, such as Online Bookings.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996763603/fc419c0efc53bc0f01d64d3b26f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1b8c746e0cabb5d88916efb3cb5176bf3630eadd1b4db3776b9982f80c3ac16&req=dSkuEM54nodfWvMW1HO4zcpFhqbF8awoebUxQQIZIdCMmxO1LPe37UBQwnN2%0Ahn57%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996763603/fc419c0efc53bc0f01d64d3b26f5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1b8c746e0cabb5d88916efb3cb5176bf3630eadd1b4db3776b9982f80c3ac16&req=dSkuEM54nodfWvMW1HO4zcpFhqbF8awoebUxQQIZIdCMmxO1LPe37UBQwnN2%0Ahn57%0A)

Select **Create stream.**

You will then see the Measurement ID for your new Data Stream.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996763604/7ffea1ad5d7e7af0019daf136aa4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=045d0431444adb2b66619b8ae5de459aada98dc04e751967ea4f51dbcc1bb0ca&req=dSkuEM54nodfXfMW1HO4zdnzexhEDdhL2OMW5k5WX9Plv2Q2fIrVn%2FN9xSrL%0AoUQ1%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996763604/7ffea1ad5d7e7af0019daf136aa4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=045d0431444adb2b66619b8ae5de459aada98dc04e751967ea4f51dbcc1bb0ca&req=dSkuEM54nodfXfMW1HO4zdnzexhEDdhL2OMW5k5WX9Plv2Q2fIrVn%2FN9xSrL%0AoUQ1%0A)

Copy and paste your **Google Analytics Measurement ID** into the Measurement ID field. You will also need to choose an **Event Name**, which we've set to bookingconfirmed for this example.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/939710099/0a0e892c5e400f82269168ac/CleanShot+2024-01-22+at+09.04.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0d1bf349852c8a82f52f0a2a7ae57f7f592faab572cee31031344c6deece04cf&req=fSMuEch%2BnYhWFb4f3HP0gMWqnxMO17Pw8lFWG9%2FibD73A8Z2sJJNNVE%2BQgHK%0A%2FSuXsBTPCFlqYvD%2FKQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/939710099/0a0e892c5e400f82269168ac/CleanShot+2024-01-22+at+09.04.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0d1bf349852c8a82f52f0a2a7ae57f7f592faab572cee31031344c6deece04cf&req=fSMuEch%2BnYhWFb4f3HP0gMWqnxMO17Pw8lFWG9%2FibD73A8Z2sJJNNVE%2BQgHK%0A%2FSuXsBTPCFlqYvD%2FKQ%3D%3D%0A)

Step 2: Create a Trigger
------------------------

We now need to choose what action on the PracSuite online booking site should trigger the tag to send the event to Google Analytics.

For this example, we will fire the conversion event when the visitor reaches the booking complete page that appears after they click the confirm booking button.

1.  Click **Triggering**.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996777811/e5b576784e8ef87baff9c770b773/CleanShot%2B2024-01-22%2Bat%2B09_08_03.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e77f9635096565ed01e8ab965f57e435fc481f3980208248d53a6a0a2ff3a46&req=dSkuEM55moleWPMW1HO4zUElS1WXgny4rvE0r4W%2F3oy9TeHMcYLqfHR56U5A%0AXe%2Bh%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996777811/e5b576784e8ef87baff9c770b773/CleanShot%2B2024-01-22%2Bat%2B09_08_03.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e77f9635096565ed01e8ab965f57e435fc481f3980208248d53a6a0a2ff3a46&req=dSkuEM55moleWPMW1HO4zUElS1WXgny4rvE0r4W%2F3oy9TeHMcYLqfHR56U5A%0AXe%2Bh%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
2.  Create a new trigger.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996778540/43452ae014066013bbaca5d2e343/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=178acadbe88053e284b69724529036a657d0d06e8b5ba9a993ca41141d59a1f3&req=dSkuEM55lYRbWfMW1HO4za9PFpe16tRfu0kZ76%2FOLDtukZUESmVelNh%2FSbF7%0AIWLR%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996778540/43452ae014066013bbaca5d2e343/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=178acadbe88053e284b69724529036a657d0d06e8b5ba9a993ca41141d59a1f3&req=dSkuEM55lYRbWfMW1HO4za9PFpe16tRfu0kZ76%2FOLDtukZUESmVelNh%2FSbF7%0AIWLR%0A)
    
      
    ​  
    For this example, we are firing the conversion event when they reach the booking complete page after the patient clicks the confirm booking button. This is based on /complete being in the page URL.  
    ​  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996782035/e4afabdf6b4f8b1c0ff3ab788d60/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=11eef3babf24ce4945c57e9df7e1b961c1f15564427ff09f4af0981c62907451&req=dSkuEM52n4FcXPMW1HO4zYUc2fyUfHAQVG5LeUjF8bnJdUjyVGVST%2FU3Td0P%0AmScO%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996782035/e4afabdf6b4f8b1c0ff3ab788d60/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=11eef3babf24ce4945c57e9df7e1b961c1f15564427ff09f4af0981c62907451&req=dSkuEM52n4FcXPMW1HO4zYUc2fyUfHAQVG5LeUjF8bnJdUjyVGVST%2FU3Td0P%0AmScO%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
3.  Select **History Change** as the trigger type.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996779013/69c1bbfd05f43dbea703ab765d8c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f11c84849e3e2c6b29196f563acaedb8d1fe8c85171e221b9fbfddbc6ec9349&req=dSkuEM55lIFeWvMW1HO4zSqf8bWGdGQSoitvkQMYvkkuF9hKAI6YHnsquZw1%0AalYV%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996779013/69c1bbfd05f43dbea703ab765d8c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f11c84849e3e2c6b29196f563acaedb8d1fe8c85171e221b9fbfddbc6ec9349&req=dSkuEM55lIFeWvMW1HO4zSqf8bWGdGQSoitvkQMYvkkuF9hKAI6YHnsquZw1%0AalYV%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
4.  Choose **Some History Changes**.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996779502/022086e6cd8c39e367ea1cbac48d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a477c42e49896d81e227abad7aa032f15945771deb45a9a174203abf9d2460ff&req=dSkuEM55lIRfW%2FMW1HO4zT5U0xvDPw%2FB0F03nLlazA4Beg28uhg1Ptu8TTjz%0AJju7%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996779502/022086e6cd8c39e367ea1cbac48d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a477c42e49896d81e227abad7aa032f15945771deb45a9a174203abf9d2460ff&req=dSkuEM55lIRfW%2FMW1HO4zT5U0xvDPw%2FB0F03nLlazA4Beg28uhg1Ptu8TTjz%0AJju7%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
5.  Set the condition:
    

*   Page Path contains `/complete`
    

This trigger fires when the PracSuite booking flow transitions to the confirmation screen.

**Save** the trigger and complete the tag setup.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996802890/00beba802b8812da16f342fe7e3d/CleanShot-2B2024-01-22-2Bat-2B09_09_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=600633cd4f4c2b05eac4b8efb1c3ee18d0379a45d461367a3bf03d3bc39732cf&req=dSkuEMF%2Bn4lWWfMW1HO4zRKzQucJcNsPAeWwRmwzF5wVI6ZEXoudBbeFFFJ8%0A7jdiJiVul%2BmuQ27BBq8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996802890/00beba802b8812da16f342fe7e3d/CleanShot-2B2024-01-22-2Bat-2B09_09_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=600633cd4f4c2b05eac4b8efb1c3ee18d0379a45d461367a3bf03d3bc39732cf&req=dSkuEMF%2Bn4lWWfMW1HO4zRKzQucJcNsPAeWwRmwzF5wVI6ZEXoudBbeFFFJ8%0A7jdiJiVul%2BmuQ27BBq8%3D%0A)

The last step is to select **Submit** in the top-right corner of Google Tag Manager to publish the tag live to your booking site.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996804535/fcaa91492af0b2b0870c24f521da/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+11_53_33%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2c7aba239b50fc86cff64f100ccc6e3cb6e41a8ada829ff667c2e64be4e5fd0b&req=dSkuEMF%2BmYRcXPMW1HO4zaHSrDMMYtyIJOA9dXml4R7M1r6zdgZoPs9E23KN%0AvSYN%2F8vLB6Cwh28MjR4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996804535/fcaa91492af0b2b0870c24f521da/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+11_53_33%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2c7aba239b50fc86cff64f100ccc6e3cb6e41a8ada829ff667c2e64be4e5fd0b&req=dSkuEMF%2BmYRcXPMW1HO4zaHSrDMMYtyIJOA9dXml4R7M1r6zdgZoPs9E23KN%0AvSYN%2F8vLB6Cwh28MjR4%3D%0A)

This completes the setup of firing a GA4 event when your patient reaches the online booking confirmed page.

PracSuite Data Layer
=======================

The PracSuite online booking site automatically exposes basic booking‑related information to the browser via the **data layer**. It does not expose any information about the patient that would compromise privacy.

This data can be accessed inside Google Tag Manager by creating **Data Layer Variables**.

Available Data Layer Objects
----------------------------

The following object is populated and updated by the PracSuite booking site. Inline comments show the **data type** and expected values for each field.

ps\_booking: {  
  logged\_in: false,                  // boolean (true | false)  
  booking\_mode: "appointment",     // string ("appointment" | "class")  
  patient\_type: "new",              // string ("new" | "existing")  
  location\_id: 14,                    // number (integer ID)  
  location\_name: "Perth",            // string  
  service\_id: 1,                      // number (integer ID)  
  service\_name: "Physiotherapy",     // string  
  practitioner\_id: 31,                // number (integer ID)  
  practitioner\_name: "Jessica Gomes",// string  
  appointment\_type\_id: 3,             // number (integer ID)  
  appointment\_type\_name: "Initial Consult", // string  
  duration: 30,                       // number (minutes)  
  confirmed: true                     // boolean (true when booking is confirmed)  
}

Using These Values in GTM
-------------------------

To use any of these fields in Google Tag Manager:

1.  Create a **Data Layer Variable** in GTM.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996795997/7c3375e543fc851b3af0c9174f61/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+11_49_10%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=24f91a8c741089a6ab7b95b09e26f12f7e7530af7550acf923b3db632ea63ce4&req=dSkuEM53mIhWXvMW1HO4zVh6eJItkypGt2eYemOEd66kuaraLks9F6bW%2FhSG%0AaN80%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996795997/7c3375e543fc851b3af0c9174f61/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+11_49_10%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=24f91a8c741089a6ab7b95b09e26f12f7e7530af7550acf923b3db632ea63ce4&req=dSkuEM53mIhWXvMW1HO4zVh6eJItkypGt2eYemOEd66kuaraLks9F6bW%2FhSG%0AaN80%0A)
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996797245/8c2335e6a0699a1003b6fed8e912/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+11_50_11%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ab21832334e03a47736fba7602164af015bc4ab855b09f53588a1c0e05b2570&req=dSkuEM53moNbXPMW1HO4zZ%2FBX2mOh0qGHfhhnv3ahGNzxxdCPfuYUwpLM%2Fz7%0AesK3%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996797245/8c2335e6a0699a1003b6fed8e912/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+11_50_11%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ab21832334e03a47736fba7602164af015bc4ab855b09f53588a1c0e05b2570&req=dSkuEM53moNbXPMW1HO4zZ%2FBX2mOh0qGHfhhnv3ahGNzxxdCPfuYUwpLM%2Fz7%0AesK3%0A)
    
      
    ​
    
2.  Set the Data Layer Variable Name to the relevant path, for example:
    
    *   `ps_booking.patient_type`
        
    *   `ps_booking.booking_mode`
        
    *   `ps_booking.confirmed`  
        ​  
        ​
        
        [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1997134629/d4bb6d63732fba6360672ee8da87/Slack+2026-01-28+11_50_52.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f954437dc0339a6bce2a3353c55aa06137072c9308ba79eaa980e6d46d5a78ec&req=dSkuEch9mYddUPMW1HO4zUTBOVmoih1iI3w%2B3xm0uwAcQPtGoTQjnuS6HG1i%0AUGVB%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1997134629/d4bb6d63732fba6360672ee8da87/Slack+2026-01-28+11_50_52.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f954437dc0339a6bce2a3353c55aa06137072c9308ba79eaa980e6d46d5a78ec&req=dSkuEch9mYddUPMW1HO4zUTBOVmoih1iI3w%2B3xm0uwAcQPtGoTQjnuS6HG1i%0AUGVB%0A)
        
          
        ​
        
    
3.  These variables can then be used in:
    
    *   Triggers
        
    *   GA4 event parameters
        
    *   Conditions and filters
        
    

This allows you to build more precise conversion logic, such as:

*   Separating new vs existing patients
    
*   Differentiating appointment vs class bookings
    

Adding Conditions Based on Data Layer Objects
---------------------------------------------

For example, to fire a **new patient conversion event only**:

*   Add an additional condition:
    
    *   `ps_booking.patient_type` equals `new`
        
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996807695/c0cf40bcf98aa4025d83b3fe5623/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+11_54_53%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06ee12576a0238798e3d4bb45c6b126bdd329679b01a2f789445c1674458ddbb&req=dSkuEMF%2BmodWXPMW1HO4zQCCvvxFsnn9o%2F%2B50fgQrh7tCnumnEXnIsOXTmmO%0Aamu5ZA%2BvFiXDztEJKN0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1996807695/c0cf40bcf98aa4025d83b3fe5623/CleanShot+2026-01-28+at+11_54_53%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06ee12576a0238798e3d4bb45c6b126bdd329679b01a2f789445c1674458ddbb&req=dSkuEMF%2BmodWXPMW1HO4zQCCvvxFsnn9o%2F%2B50fgQrh7tCnumnEXnIsOXTmmO%0Aamu5ZA%2BvFiXDztEJKN0%3D%0A)

  
​  
This allows you to send different GA4 events for different scenarios, such as:

*   New patient bookings vs existing patient bookings
    
*   Appointment bookings vs class bookings
    
*   Bookings for specific locations or services
    

Example setups:

*   Event name: `booking_confirmed_new_patient`
    
    *   Conditions:
        
        *   Page Path contains `/complete`
            
        *   `ps_booking.patient_type` equals `new`
            
        
    
*   Event name: `booking_confirmed_existing_patient`
    
    *   Conditions:
        
        *   Page Path contains `/complete`
            
        *   `ps_booking.patient_type` equals `existing`
            
        
    

* * *

Viewing Events in Google Analytics
==================================

After completing an online booking based on the example above, you will be able to see Events recorded in your corresponding Google Analytics account.

In Google Analytics, select **Reports** and then **Realtime**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/511031419/b6f8c3f763312929494685ce/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88ca2a7c23f8874577b7c723b2b04d45aa598faee394674aaddc285acb359bcd&req=cSEmFsp%2FmYBWFb4f3HP0gEaJyV0jVrsmgCTMKAJdVFHFRxjBHOte8iRofI%2FD%0AQbd%2FWaW0XtmhR%2F5DPw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/511031419/b6f8c3f763312929494685ce/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88ca2a7c23f8874577b7c723b2b04d45aa598faee394674aaddc285acb359bcd&req=cSEmFsp%2FmYBWFb4f3HP0gEaJyV0jVrsmgCTMKAJdVFHFRxjBHOte8iRofI%2FD%0AQbd%2FWaW0XtmhR%2F5DPw%3D%3D%0A)

In the bottom right corner, you will see an event count where you should see the 'bookingconfirmed' event we created earlier.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/511031450/49083e9b90d9cb401b9187ec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27bd3eb8b92f38c660c2e3bb392affc129b85b82376b4315ca0ff988810b83ab&req=cSEmFsp%2FmYRfFb4f3HP0gEiBcZYQbuud%2F97cfjyu%2FT5wE3%2Bip5u1r7h%2BA%2BhG%0A7SYTDeGxuo%2FxR89bcg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/511031450/49083e9b90d9cb401b9187ec/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27bd3eb8b92f38c660c2e3bb392affc129b85b82376b4315ca0ff988810b83ab&req=cSEmFsp%2FmYRfFb4f3HP0gEiBcZYQbuud%2F97cfjyu%2FT5wE3%2Bip5u1r7h%2BA%2BhG%0A7SYTDeGxuo%2FxR89bcg%3D%3D%0A)

What are the benefits of migrating from Front Desk to PracSuite?
================================================================

PracSuite is a modern practice management system built for the web. It can be accessed through a web browser on PC, Mac, iPad and other devices with modern web browsers. This means your data is safely and securely stored and backed up in Australian-based cloud servers, and doesn't require any complex server setups within your practice.

PracSuite has many new features that Front Desk doesn't support, including:

*   Streamlined workflows make daily tasks more efficient
    
*   Electronic patient intake forms
    
*   Online booking payments/deposits
    
*   Online invoice payments
    
*   Automatic appointment confirmations, reminders and follow ups
    
*   Automatic marketing campaigns
    
*   Practitioner performance dashboard
    
*   PracSuite AI clinical note and letter writing tools
    
*   Comprehensive support for clinics billing to the NDIS
    

And much more.

We recommend [booking a demo with our team](https://pracsuite.as.me/demo)
 for a closer look at PracSuite's features.

* * *

What data is transferred from Front Desk?
=========================================

[Further information regarding Front Desk data transfer inclusions and exclusions can be found here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6108192-front-desk-data-migration-inclusions-and-exclusions)
