What needs to be completed prior to your data migration date?
=============================================================

Setup and training must be completed prior to your data migration date. [Further information about the PracSuite setup process can be found here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5777254-pracsuite-setup-guide)

* * *

Can I access Front Desk after the data migration?
=================================================

While you maintain a PracSuite subscription, Smartsoft is happy to provide the benefits of the Front Desk Extended Care Plan at no cost for an archival copy of your Front Desk installation.

* * *

Can I still use my HICAPS terminal with PracSuite?
==================================================

Yes. HICAPS users can use their terminal _manually_ alongside PracSuite without issue.

Note that the HICAPS terminal cannot integrate with any cloud-based products like PracSuite. Until HICAPS can provide Smartsoft with the development tools to achieve this, you will need to manually enter in payments and claims into the terminal. If you're happy to use the HICAPS terminal in this way, then there is no need to consider other options.

If an integrated terminal experience is a must for your practice, your only option is to look at setting up a [Tyro terminal](https://www.tyro.com/industries/allied-health/)
, which can be integrated with PracSuite.

* * *

What is Tyro Health Online?
===========================

Tyro Health Online is the backbone of the following online claiming and digital payment features in PracSuite:

*   Medicare [Bulk Bill](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5088324-how-to-submit-a-medicare-bulk-bill-claim-via-tyro-health-online)
     and [Patient claiming](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5088412-how-to-submit-a-medicare-patient-claim-via-tyro-health-online)
    
*   [Department of Veterans Affairs (DVA) claiming](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5947532-how-to-submit-a-dva-claim-via-tyro-health-online)
    
*   [Cardless health fund claiming](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6160796-submitting-private-health-fund-claims-via-tyro-health-online)
    
*   [WorkCover QLD](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5638305-workcover-qld-claiming-via-tyro-health-online)
    , [icare NSW](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5644625-icare-nsw-claiming-via-tyro-health-online)
    , [WorkSafe VIC](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284981-worksafe-victoria-claiming-via-tyro-health-online)
     & [Comcare claiming](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284980-comcare-claiming-via-tyro-health-online)
    
*   [Saving patient payment card info](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5129300-how-to-take-a-card-payment-via-tyro-health-online)
    
*   [Online booking payments](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5590695-setting-up-online-payments)
    
*   [Instalment payments](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8060044-tyro-health-online-payment-instalments)
    
*   [Appointment Prepayment Links](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7889707-inserting-pre-payment-links-in-appointment-reminders)
    

[Click here to learn more about Tyro Health Online and its associated pricing.](https://www.tyrohealth.com/pricing/)

To use any of the above features, you will need to [set up your Tyro Health Online account](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/3193875-get-started-with-tyro-health-online)
 and integrate it with PracSuite. If you're

If you want to use the Medicare/DVA claiming features, note that you must submit provider registration paperwork to Services Australia. You will be guided through this process while setting up your Tyro Health Online account. Note that Services Australia can take several business days to process your registration for online claiming via Tyro Health Online.

If you're migrating from other software with integrated Medicare/DVA claiming, **DO NOT submit the paperwork to Service Australia** **until 5 days before your data migration.** Submitting the paperwork for online claiming via Tyro Health Online will **DEACTIVATE** any existing Medicare & DVA Online claiming functionality you have in place in other software.

If you choose not to use the Tyro Health Online integration, the only other integrated method of Medicare claiming is via the Tyro Health EFTPOS terminal.

* * *

Does Tyro Health Online replace my HICAPS or Tyro terminal?
===========================================================

Tyro Health Online is a completely virtual solution (i.e it is not a physical terminal) and for the majority of practices, Tyro Health Online will not replace your physical HICAPS or Tyro terminal.

The majority of PracSuite users only require Tyro Health Online for Medicare & DVA online claiming. They will continue using their HICAPS or Tyro terminal for card payments and health fund claims.

As mentioned above, the Tyro Health Online integration also supports additional, optional features including:

*   Medicare Bulk Bill and Patient claiming
    
*   Department of Veterans Affairs (DVA) claiming
    
*   Cardless health fund claiming
    
*   WorkCover QLD, icare NSW, WorkSafe VIC & Comcare claiming
    
*   Saving patient payment card info
    
*   Online booking payments
    
*   Appointment Prepayment Links.
    

* * *

What happens on your data migration date?
=========================================

Please find a general overview of the final data migration date and process below:

*   We will obtain a backup of your existing Front Desk data. The size of your Front Desk backup will determine whether we obtain a backup the evening before or morning of your final migration date so that we have enough time to complete the process.
    
*   Any data entered into Front Desk after the backup process commences will not be transferred to PracSuite and will need to be manually re-entered once your PracSuite data migration is complete.
    
*   Our aim is to minimise your downtime. For most practices, the data migration process will reach a point when where you can start using the system by late afternoon on your migration date. We will call you to confirm when the process is at this point and give you the all-clear to start using PracSuite. Some historical data such as clinical notes great than two years old will continue to be uploaded into the evening.
    
*   Note that you will need to re-enter into PracSuite any data you’ve added to Front Desk since we have taken the initial backup for the migration process.
    

* * *

What happens after the data migration?
======================================

By mid-late afternoon on your data migration date, our team will call to confirm that your data migration is complete. After this time, you will need to start using PracSuite. Once you've received this call, we highly recommend reviewing the following within PracSuite:

*   Manually transfer into PracSuite any data entered into Front Desk since the backup was collected
    
*   [Add a credit card to use SMS features](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/sms)
    
*   [Configure Automatic Appointment Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)
    
*   [Appointment Type defaults](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613492-setting-default-appointment-types)
    
*   [Configure Online bookings](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4766658-setting-up-online-bookings-in-pracsuite)
    
*   [Update your website with your new PracSuite online booking link](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746485-how-to-add-pracsuite-online-bookings-to-your-website)

Front Desk Data Migration Inclusions and Exclusions

Front Desk Data Migration Inclusions and Exclusions
===================================================

Updated over 4 months ago

Table of contents

[What Front Desk features and integrations are not currently available in PracSuite?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6108192-front-desk-data-migration-inclusions-and-exclusions#h_f3d0cde2bc)

[What data is transferred from Front Desk to PracSuite?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6108192-front-desk-data-migration-inclusions-and-exclusions#h_b5bfdfc871)

[What existing data is not transferred from Front Desk to PracSuite?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6108192-front-desk-data-migration-inclusions-and-exclusions#h_b53596723c)

As two separate products, there are key differences between PracSuite and Front Desk. This information should be used to determine if PracSuite is currently suitable for your practice. Due to the changing nature of software development, this list has been provided as a guide only. If you have any specific needs that are important to you, please [contact the Business Care team.](https://pracsuite.com/contactus)

Existing Front Desk users with an active Extended Care Plan have the option to transfer their existing patient data to PracSuite at no cost. Front Desk users without an Extended Care Plan can migrate their data at $290 inc GST. Note that it is not possible to repeat data transfers or to move PracSuite data back to Front Desk.

**What Front Desk features and integrations are not currently available in PracSuite?**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

*   HICAPS integration - The HICAPS terminal is unable to integrate with cloud-based products like PracSuite. Until HICAPS support this and can provide Smartsoft with the development tools to achieve this, you will need to manually punch in payments and claims into the terminal.
    
*   Scanner integration - A web browser is unable to communicate directly with a document scanner. You will need to scan the file to your computer before uploading it to PracSuite.
    
*   X-ray viewer and annotation tools
    
*   Any and all custom integrations and utilities developed by Smartsoft
    

**What data is transferred from Front Desk to PracSuite?**
----------------------------------------------------------

The majority of your existing patient data on the following Front Desk patient file tabs is transferred to PracSuite:

*   General
    
*   Additional
    
*   Medicare/DVA card details
    
*   Billing Details
    
*   Appointments (a maximum of 24 months of past appointments are transferred)
    
*   Transactions (all payments are transferred as 'cash' payments, refunds are not transferred)
    
*   Tracking tab (these will be re-created as Tags)
    
*   Notes & Warnings
    
*   Clinical Notes
    
*   Recalls (future recalls only)
    
*   Attachments
    
*   Contacts
    
*   X-rays
    
*   Events tab (migrated to the Tasks tab in PracSuite)
    

The following are also transferred to PracSuite as a part of the migration:

*   Fee Categories
    
*   Item Schedules
    
*   Item Codes (excluding stock levels & unit cost)
    
*   Item Groups
    
*   Appointment Types
    
*   Referring Doctors and Organisations
    
*   Linked third-party billers
    
*   Occupations
    
*   Suppliers
    
*   Clinical Note Auto-Completes and Quick Buttons
    
*   Appointment Book Day Notes & Reminders
    

  
**What existing data is not transferred from Front Desk to PracSuite?**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

To follow is a list of data that is not transferred to PracSuite and will remain accessible in Front Desk:

*   Appointment Statuses (e.g. Patient Arrived, Confirmed) - Instead, all past appointments will have a status of 'Completed' while future appointments are set as 'Booked'.
    
*   SMS tab history
    
*   Statements
    
*   Medicare/DVA claim history
    
*   Medical Specialist Referrals (this does not refer to standard referrals added to the Billing Details tab)
    
*   Quotations
    
*   Waiting List entries
    
*   Appointment Book Rules (replaced by [Rosters](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4183049-creating-rosters-and-roster-overrides)
     in PracSuite)
    
*   Manual Appointment Book Rule Outs
    
*   Refunds
    
*   Payment methods – all payments are transferred to PracSuite as ‘cash’
    
*   Some clinical note data may not come across 100% as it appears on Front Desk i.e. there may be some minor formatting issues.
    
*   Patient logins to the Online Booking system – patients will need to sign-up anew for the PracSuite Online Booking system.  
    ​
    

**What Front Desk data needs to be added to PracSuite manually?**

*   Practice Groups (now known as Businesses) and Practitioner files
    
*   Practitioner Rosters (replacing Appointment Book Rules in Front Desk)
    
*   User accounts and Roles (security permissions for users)
    
*   Clinical note templates
    
*   Letter templates
    
*   SMS templates
    
*   Email templates
    
*   Appointment resources
    
*   Stock levels & unit cost
    

**What features need to be reconfigured once the data migration is complete?**

*   [Default](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613492-setting-default-appointment-types)
     and [Following](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613493-setting-following-appointment-types)
     Appointment Types
    
*   [Appointment Type Defaults](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types)
     (e.g. default duration, width and item code)
    
*   [Appointment Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)
     and [Confirmations](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-automatic-appointment-confirmations)
    
*   [Online Bookings](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4766658-setting-up-online-bookings-in-pracsuite)
     (patients awill need to sign-up anew)

Understanding How Emails Are Sent Through PracSuite

Understanding How Emails Are Sent Through PracSuite
===================================================

Updated over 11 months ago

Table of contents

[PracSuite Email Gateway](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6150780-understanding-how-emails-are-sent-through-pracsuite#h_a2f3de6601)

[Google Gmail and Microsoft Outlook/Office 365 Integrations](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6150780-understanding-how-emails-are-sent-through-pracsuite#h_aee84df88c)

**PracSuite Email Gateway**
===========================

Emails sent via PracSuite are automatically sent through the PracSuite Email Gateway by default, which is designed to meet the needs of most users. The key advantages of this system include:

*   No complex setup
    
*   Direct visibility of delivery status within PracSuite
    
*   Replies to your emails are sent back directly to your business’ email address
    

Even though emails appear to come from your email address, they are sent using the PracSuite Email Gateway and not through your own domain or SMTP settings. Emails sent through PracSuite will be formatted as [client.YOUR\_SENDER\_ID@send-via.pracsuite.com](mailto:client.YOUR_SENDER_ID@send-via.pracsuite.com)
, known as your PracSuite Email Sender ID. This can be found under [Settings > General > General](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general)
. This means that:

*   SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records are not required
    
*   We are not authenticating with your domain
    

Your patients typically won’t notice any difference between emails sent via PracSuite and those sent from your regular email application.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614786665/5bc4f020cb7ccd746ec607d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f9dacd869abd10d5918a99a1a8143201cddefe74d33965d4b2b9ffad4cae207b&req=ciEjEcF4m4daFb4f3HP0gBJDB485nZJGO3jXqZMm7%2B2kc5WI3A8aLCMk8wUx%0AOnv17s7I5PVpkZugZQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/614786665/5bc4f020cb7ccd746ec607d3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f9dacd869abd10d5918a99a1a8143201cddefe74d33965d4b2b9ffad4cae207b&req=ciEjEcF4m4daFb4f3HP0gBJDB485nZJGO3jXqZMm7%2B2kc5WI3A8aLCMk8wUx%0AOnv17s7I5PVpkZugZQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Google Gmail and Microsoft Outlook/Office 365 Integrations**
==============================================================

As an alternative to the PracSuite Email Gateway, you can integrate your Gmail or Outlook account directly with PracSuite. Key benefits of this integration include:

*   Emails sent through PracSuite will appear in the Sent folder of your Gmail/Outlook account.
    
*   There is typically no visible trace of PracSuite in the emails sent.
    

However, there are some limitations to consider. Unlike the PracSuite Email Gateway, PracSuite cannot track delivery or failure statuses with these integrations. As a result, emails will only appear as Sent in the Messages tab of Patient and Payer files, without confirmation of delivery.

To learn more about configuring these integrations, refer to the articles below:

[Gmail Integration Guide](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration)

## Document 236 — Creating a unique email address for PracSuite | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-236}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6151131-creating-a-unique-email-address-for-pracsuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6151131-creating-a-unique-email-address-for-pracsuite)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[SMS, Email & Letters](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2491723-sms-email-letters)

[Other](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3394698-other)

Creating a unique email address for PracSuite

Creating a unique email address for PracSuite
=============================================

Updated over 11 months ago

Table of contents

[How It Works](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6151131-creating-a-unique-email-address-for-pracsuite#h_bb89bd448e)

For security reasons, each email address can only be registered to a single PracSuite user account. This means that if an employee has worked across multiple businesses using PracSuite, their email address may be considered ''in use'' and therefore unavailable to register again.  
​  
Thankfully, there is an easy solution called "**subaddressing**" to work around this problem - without needing multiple email accounts or any prior setup.  
​  
Subaddressing, also known as **plus addressing**, lets you modify your email address by adding a **plus sign (+) and a keyword** before the "@" symbol. This feature is supported by most major email providers, including **Gmail, Outlook, and Yahoo**.

**How It Works**
----------------

If your email address is:  
📧 **[yourname@example.com](mailto:yourname@example.com)
**  
​

You can create variations like:  
📧 **[yourname+pracsuite@example.com](mailto:yourname+pracsuite@example.com)
**  
📧 **[yourname+adelaide@example.com](mailto:yourname+adelaide@example.com)
**  
📧 **[yourname+sydney@example.com](mailto:yourname+sydney@example.com)
**  
​

All emails sent to these addresses will **still go to your original inbox** (**[yourname@example.com](mailto:yourname@example.com)
**), but you can use the variations to register multiple user accounts within PracSuite.

**As an alternative, you can also:**  
1) Create an **alias** address in your email account, which creates a more permanent secondary address linked to your mailbox.  
​  
2) Where supported by your email provider, use an **interchangeable domain**.

For example, users with an **@gmail.com** address can also use the domain **@googlemail.com** (e.g. [smartsoft@googlemail.com](mailto:smartsoft@googlemail.com)
 can be used in place of [smartsoft@gmail.com](mailto:smartsoft@gmail.com)
)

When creating new PracSuite user accounts, you can opt to register the user with an email address in any of the above formats.

Filtering Appointment Book Columns
==================================

To display the appointment book for a specific business, profession or practitioner, select the name in the list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333618865/e50e5d8399513ccd91e78695814d/CleanShot+X+2025-01-14+10_35_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9123bb8d35f7a609057fa70a346ba5c089d3d8bbc151d90b69ff3f0e0788b959&req=dSMkFc9%2FlYlZXPMW1HO4zfEAf5wb2wKjo9YxDU4nY8JIVoUS496M84EMtq2q%0ArDO8wUfLq1t6U2xekcM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333618865/e50e5d8399513ccd91e78695814d/CleanShot+X+2025-01-14+10_35_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9123bb8d35f7a609057fa70a346ba5c089d3d8bbc151d90b69ff3f0e0788b959&req=dSMkFc9%2FlYlZXPMW1HO4zfEAf5wb2wKjo9YxDU4nY8JIVoUS496M84EMtq2q%0ArDO8wUfLq1t6U2xekcM%3D%0A)

If you wish to filter to multiple businesses, professions or practitioners, use the checkboxes shown when hovering over options in the list, and then select **Apply**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333618903/2738a9a28125a1fdcc80624031ca/CleanShot+2025-01-14+at+10_37_12.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=c896d15f4f29fcfee2d254868a05ca18442fd480d0d6d59947030661a5ca6df6&req=dSMkFc9%2FlYhfWvMW1HO4zSBRzAK%2Bz%2BQpLmfvV0Z%2BqNISWCO06esu%2BjY5AJXB%0A2Y%2BZTnfg7Ut3w3BwHRo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333618903/2738a9a28125a1fdcc80624031ca/CleanShot+2025-01-14+at+10_37_12.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=c896d15f4f29fcfee2d254868a05ca18442fd480d0d6d59947030661a5ca6df6&req=dSMkFc9%2FlYhfWvMW1HO4zSBRzAK%2Bz%2BQpLmfvV0Z%2BqNISWCO06esu%2BjY5AJXB%0A2Y%2BZTnfg7Ut3w3BwHRo%3D%0A)

Changing the Order of Business and Practitioner Columns
=======================================================

To manage the order of practitioner columns displayed on the appointment book, go to [Settings > Appointment Book > Column Order](https://app.intercom.com/)

The column order will apply to all users within your PracSuite subscription.

Select **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333619715/d5c8067c318c2f8d49fd96f329e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8ee840ee6108ddc747a9bc34d61cf4134a54aaf5de8da1d7107954cc0f687488&req=dSMkFc9%2FlIZeXPMW1HO4zUVMv1l62YgNIuMho8I5RuluGPYxoLhNaTRlD8fm%0AA49udBJ%2BG0vABoxzB3o%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333619715/d5c8067c318c2f8d49fd96f329e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8ee840ee6108ddc747a9bc34d61cf4134a54aaf5de8da1d7107954cc0f687488&req=dSMkFc9%2FlIZeXPMW1HO4zUVMv1l62YgNIuMho8I5RuluGPYxoLhNaTRlD8fm%0AA49udBJ%2BG0vABoxzB3o%3D%0A)

Changing the Order of Businesses
--------------------------------

Start by setting the preferred order of your Businesses.

Use the drag handle to set the order by dragging and dropping each Business. You can also use the up/down arrows displayed on the right-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333619713/dc65d024fc87ecac1f899531e2d9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2a97b395e829a9dbdb78ef122a17498c2a977551506060c248028e501daa17ba&req=dSMkFc9%2FlIZeWvMW1HO4zbNHcJc28Wl2eyuPORuPVyrJBBg9rRApN2EqSB3M%0AnXI014mklbZHqEeQUA8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333619713/dc65d024fc87ecac1f899531e2d9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2a97b395e829a9dbdb78ef122a17498c2a977551506060c248028e501daa17ba&req=dSMkFc9%2FlIZeWvMW1HO4zbNHcJc28Wl2eyuPORuPVyrJBBg9rRApN2EqSB3M%0AnXI014mklbZHqEeQUA8%3D%0A)

-----------------------------------

Below the grid will all Businesses, you will see a grid per Business containing the practitioners available at that Business.

Use the drag handle to set the order by dragging and dropping each Business. You can also use the up/down arrows displayed on the right-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333619716/4735ede3f65a65337923da1ed2f0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8cc91b57374baba7fcc0b220aef275d0f776a22d770d6896f3ba66bdc1f07738&req=dSMkFc9%2FlIZeX%2FMW1HO4zYlvOqKLgFnJdWW%2BwYQDv6dJZ1nCXeGO7Q0FwLRs%0A%2Ff103DpHedNFzHkLl14%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1333619716/4735ede3f65a65337923da1ed2f0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8cc91b57374baba7fcc0b220aef275d0f776a22d770d6896f3ba66bdc1f07738&req=dSMkFc9%2FlIZeX%2FMW1HO4zYlvOqKLgFnJdWW%2BwYQDv6dJZ1nCXeGO7Q0FwLRs%0A%2Ff103DpHedNFzHkLl14%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Hiding Businesses and Practitioners in All View
===============================================

Each PracSuite user can choose to show/hide practitioner columns on the appointment book, which will only affect their individual user login.

These settings will apply when the appointment book filters are set to All, but you can still use the drop-down menus to select a specific practitioner when you need to.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636297942/a53431ce4c6a588d0b6ee283/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee01614064694ddbf3081199656505328a34953be334c5e8b449740a8a22f0b2&req=ciMhFMB5lIVdFb4f3HP0gM6dnwIAhITo2HV6rxqNkOnjW2MAttUz707TRUOE%0AcQAN1HoDjJlGum71kg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636297942/a53431ce4c6a588d0b6ee283/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee01614064694ddbf3081199656505328a34953be334c5e8b449740a8a22f0b2&req=ciMhFMB5lIVdFb4f3HP0gM6dnwIAhITo2HV6rxqNkOnjW2MAttUz707TRUOE%0AcQAN1HoDjJlGum71kg%3D%3D%0A)

Go to the **Appointment Book** and select the **Settings Cog** in the bottom left-hand corner.

Viewing details of who made or changed an appointment

Viewing details of who made or changed an appointment
=====================================================

How to access a log of all changes to an appointment

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[From a Patient File](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6219528-viewing-details-of-who-made-or-changed-an-appointment#h_65d986cb16)

[From the Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6219528-viewing-details-of-who-made-or-changed-an-appointment#h_31d776eba9)

From a Patient File
===================

For a detailed log outlining the history of all appointment changes, go to the **Appointments tab** of a patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1222552515/2d24c361307aea526bb12439b8a9/CleanShot+2024-10-21+at+08_37_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9e58009d114f38913f585bbd8b9303298b80515321b4436beb9999233098a47f&req=dSIlFMx7n4ReXPMW1HO4zaoPjJFKH483TQRGnvkrIZ%2F3HFhLcmXzZ2d8yJcG%0AH1AdKo4rr1%2Fl7asDx68%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1222552515/2d24c361307aea526bb12439b8a9/CleanShot+2024-10-21+at+08_37_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9e58009d114f38913f585bbd8b9303298b80515321b4436beb9999233098a47f&req=dSIlFMx7n4ReXPMW1HO4zaoPjJFKH483TQRGnvkrIZ%2F3HFhLcmXzZ2d8yJcG%0AH1AdKo4rr1%2Fl7asDx68%3D%0A)

In the list of appointments, use the plus icon to reveal the full audit log for the appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637443734/8e67342463eebe9e585823a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=079c92188c7f2591266f3d9bc14f8107350d8d2aa0344ca97f37395e698baf7e&req=ciMgEs19moJbFb4f3HP0gJFqnGGuigOwzJhNL5mfKmbSjcOMPhdl4PKf4QKk%0AxD%2FtzpNvM4z0SBOZxg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637443734/8e67342463eebe9e585823a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=079c92188c7f2591266f3d9bc14f8107350d8d2aa0344ca97f37395e698baf7e&req=ciMgEs19moJbFb4f3HP0gJFqnGGuigOwzJhNL5mfKmbSjcOMPhdl4PKf4QKk%0AxD%2FtzpNvM4z0SBOZxg%3D%3D%0A)

The audit log will expand to show all changes that have been made to the appointment since it was created, including cancellation and reschedule reasons.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637443817/0f2a59836a3816fd5ddac802/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=151ed78783ac83c58c6ebced47fa92d8f9b859670a3ea903580389319ec1932c&req=ciMgEs19lYBYFb4f3HP0gLeJROBW50fs629baCJ9f3VlyyeaX%2BJvzhh%2FzDqk%0A4lkPkx5MMSS2p%2BppbA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/637443817/0f2a59836a3816fd5ddac802/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=151ed78783ac83c58c6ebced47fa92d8f9b859670a3ea903580389319ec1932c&req=ciMgEs19lYBYFb4f3HP0gLeJROBW50fs629baCJ9f3VlyyeaX%2BJvzhh%2FzDqk%0A4lkPkx5MMSS2p%2BppbA%3D%3D%0A)

From the Appointment Book
=========================

From the appointment book, hover over an appointment and you'll find who made the appointment at the bottom of the tooltip.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1222552099/a0f234f9cdfe025be0745d817d94/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=74a966107acae385ad15ebfc295fe73ef24e939b5bee0f8697e33eec2398859d&req=dSIlFMx7n4FWUPMW1HO4zXDJNO6vuMnw3JuWAkVm%2Br3KUTQ8HFhLYZd2hW3t%0ACdNA3y%2Fi1gXdSpwAZVk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1222552099/a0f234f9cdfe025be0745d817d94/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=74a966107acae385ad15ebfc295fe73ef24e939b5bee0f8697e33eec2398859d&req=dSIlFMx7n4FWUPMW1HO4zXDJNO6vuMnw3JuWAkVm%2Br3KUTQ8HFhLYZd2hW3t%0ACdNA3y%2Fi1gXdSpwAZVk%3D%0A)

When hovering over a practitioner's name at the top of the appointment book, a tooltip with key info is displayed, including cancellation and reschedule reasons.

[![<a href="https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/676215677/764d4983dde6180e83d9ba51/image.png?expires=1771902000&amp;signature=d3b6eb7bb0b635f8563dd6c18f3b43f67b4d976ef94288939c0bc019e3bc705a&amp;req=cichFMh7m4ZYFb4X1HO4gaQRDDPmeMpEQAG%2BzWCt91vCeSa39RqnbnMXQZBh%0A" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener noreferrer">https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/676215677/764d4983dde6180e83d9ba51/image.png</a>](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1222552992/46944fbc06356ace30f81faa18c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f27e386d52398d0f766fbeaf79417da905fb947b5de85d62d36d85f1d1ddf0d6&req=dSIlFMx7n4hWW%2FMW1HO4zRNPXBmM5sfnmCj%2FG%2FQVyNRWIkCBDLoAuxSG0GNC%0AK%2FaLTzXeT74aQGb2R%2FI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1222552992/46944fbc06356ace30f81faa18c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f27e386d52398d0f766fbeaf79417da905fb947b5de85d62d36d85f1d1ddf0d6&req=dSIlFMx7n4hWW%2FMW1HO4zRNPXBmM5sfnmCj%2FG%2FQVyNRWIkCBDLoAuxSG0GNC%0AK%2FaLTzXeT74aQGb2R%2FI%3D%0A)

Troubleshooting Appointment Merge Fields

Troubleshooting Appointment Merge Fields
========================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Sending a manual reminder from the appointment book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6239637-troubleshooting-appointment-merge-fields#h_8775bb759d)

[Sending bulk messages via reports](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6239637-troubleshooting-appointment-merge-fields#h_0ed493bd27)

If you're reading this article, you have probably received the following prompt when composing an SMS or email in PracSuite:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636278054/0fd846fd2cdf609308512010/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=30e9da64d92aad4e50351cdb0351f07739e73b900a9cea95f68832bd265c3d03&req=ciMhFM52nYRbFb4f3HP0gCiWaq1toxqMJQdfNK6dEGCgiAKtD9z7gLmHHzx9%0AlNTJUIC37V0Pl7Sl2g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636278054/0fd846fd2cdf609308512010/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=30e9da64d92aad4e50351cdb0351f07739e73b900a9cea95f68832bd265c3d03&req=ciMhFM52nYRbFb4f3HP0gCiWaq1toxqMJQdfNK6dEGCgiAKtD9z7gLmHHzx9%0AlNTJUIC37V0Pl7Sl2g%3D%3D%0A)

**When this prompt is displayed, appointment details will not be correctly inserted in your message. Read below for tips on how to resolve this.**

As indicated by the prompt, the merge fields that you've included in your message are not compatible when sending your message manually. Generally, this prompt means that you're including merge fields that are designed for automatic appointment confirmations and reminders in an ad-hoc message.

Merge fields that are **only suitable for automatic confirmations and reminders** include:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| Appointment Time | <<AppointmentTime>> |
| Appointment Date | <<AppointmentDate>> |
| Appointment Practitioner Full Name | <<AppointmentPracName>> |
| Appointment Practitioner Title | <<AppointmentPracTitle>> |
| Appointment Practitioner First Name | <<AppointmentPracFirstName>> |
| Appointment Practitioner Surname | <<AppointmentPracSurname>> |
| Appointment Business Display Name | <<AppointmentBusiness>> |
| Appointment Business Address Line 1 | <<AppointmentBusinessAddress1>> |
| Appointment Business Address Line 2 | <<AppointmentBusinessAddress2>> |
| Appointment Business Address Line 3 | <<AppointmentBusinessAddress3>> |
| Appointment Business Address Line 4 | <<AppointmentBusinessAddress4>> |
| Appointment Business Suburb | <<AppointmentBusinessSuburb>> |
| Appointment Business State | <<AppointmentBusinessState>> |
| Appointment Business Postcode | <<AppointmentBusinessPostcode>> |
| Appointment Business Country | <<AppointmentBusinessCountry>> |
| Appointment Business Phone | <<AppointmentBusinessPhone>> |
| Appointment Business Fax | <<AppointmentBusinessFax>> |
| Appointment Business Email | <<AppointmentBusinessEmail>> |
| Appointment Business Website | <<AppointmentBusinessWebsite>> |
| Appointment Profession | <<AppointmentProfession>> |

Sending a manual reminder from the appointment book
===================================================

If you need to send a manual appointment reminder, you can use templates that include the tags listed above only when sending a message directly from an appointment.

Find the patient's appointment on the appointment book and select Appointment Details.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636278273/2097637cb099a5b7488e9fb4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=737032bd69ec17e04ab2d51230e40e6430885e2bdeefe4fb7e44a9f0f55ee64d&req=ciMhFM52n4ZcFb4f3HP0gERyPIdXAoi6jRwcnt9Kol8j%2F7zq%2F3l6qZxkuKxH%0AVf3Uwwx7LBWxGd1osw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636278273/2097637cb099a5b7488e9fb4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=737032bd69ec17e04ab2d51230e40e6430885e2bdeefe4fb7e44a9f0f55ee64d&req=ciMhFM52n4ZcFb4f3HP0gERyPIdXAoi6jRwcnt9Kol8j%2F7zq%2F3l6qZxkuKxH%0AVf3Uwwx7LBWxGd1osw%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Send SMS** button in the bottom right to send a manual reminder.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636278420/79d0f17de309b195a411d806/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f713065f455e818985d087e306ffa9ef026cab5054d45bc58644cd644b07b39d&req=ciMhFM52mYNfFb4f3HP0gJEp2gSpwWWcTJnog%2BjL8j2ZvKD7tHSXEYL45yaM%0A%2BbboRUSPGK%2FokR%2B3zQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636278420/79d0f17de309b195a411d806/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f713065f455e818985d087e306ffa9ef026cab5054d45bc58644cd644b07b39d&req=ciMhFM52mYNfFb4f3HP0gJEp2gSpwWWcTJnog%2BjL8j2ZvKD7tHSXEYL45yaM%0A%2BbboRUSPGK%2FokR%2B3zQ%3D%3D%0A)

Sending a manual appointment reminder in any other way will lead to missing appointment information.

Sending bulk messages via reports
=================================

If you need to manually send bulk appointment reminders from a report, you cannot include the merge fields listed above. You must use the following merge fields, which are suitable for sending ad-hoc messages:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| Next Appointment 1 Date | <<NextAppointment1Date>> |
| Next Appointment 1 Time | <<NextAppointment1Time>> |
| Next Appointment 1 Business | <<NextAppointment1Business>> |
| Next Appointment 1 Practitioner | <<NextAppointment1PracName>> |
| Next Appointment 1 Practitioner Email | <<NextAppointment1PracEmail>> |
| Next Appointment 1 Practitioner Title | <<NextAppointment1PracTitle>> |
| Next Appointment 1 Practitioner Surname | <<NextAppointment1PracSurname>> |
| Next Appointment 1 Practitioner First Name | <<NextAppointment1PracFirstName>> |
| Next Appointment 1 Practitioner Provider Number | <<NextAppointment1PracProviderNo>> |
| Next Appointment 1 Practitioner Professional Title | <<NextAppointment1PracProfessionalTitle>> |
| Next Appointment 2 Date | <<NextAppointment2Date>> |
| Next Appointment 2 Time | <<NextAppointment2Time>> |
| Next Appointment 2 Practitioner | <<NextAppointment2PracName>> |
| Next Appointment 2 Business | <<NextAppointment2Business>> |
| Next Appointment 3 Date | <<NextAppointment3Date>> |
| Next Appointment 3 Time | <<NextAppointment3Time>> |
| Next Appointment 3 Practitioner | <<NextAppointment3PracName>> |
| Next Appointment 3 Business | <<NextAppointment3Business>> |
| Previous Appointment 1 Date | <<PreviousAppointment1Date>> |
| Previous Appointment 1 Time | <<PreviousAppointment1Time>> |
| Previous Appointment 1 Business | <<PreviousAppointment1Business>> |
| Previous Appointment 1 Practitioner | <<PreviousAppointment1PracName>> |
| Previous Appointment 1 Practitioner Email | <<PreviousAppointment1PracEmail>> |
| Previous Appointment 1 Practitioner Title | <<PreviousAppointment1PracTitle>> |

## Document 243 — Using the Hold Invoices feature | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-243}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6271251-using-the-hold-invoices-feature](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6271251-using-the-hold-invoices-feature)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6271251-using-the-hold-invoices-feature#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Invoicing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413899-invoicing)

[Invoices and Receipts](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984691-invoices-and-receipts)

Using the Hold Invoices feature

Using the Hold Invoices feature
===============================

Updated over 3 years ago

There are often scenarios, in particular involving third-party payers, where invoices have been raised for services provided to patients, but you're not ready to send the invoices to the payer.

The Hold Invoices function is designed to assist in these scenarios so that these owing invoices do not get sent out when using the [Outstanding Invoices report](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4430319-how-to-manage-outstanding-invoices)
, as well as the [NDIS bulk export](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5735167-enabling-the-ndis-integration)
.

To enable the Hold Invoices feature, open the patient or payer file and go to the **Accounts** tab. In the **Invoice & Statement Options** section, enable the **Hold Invoices** setting.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636275756/331283bfb3dc87874f5284a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3031e5d99e35fbfbc004ba0db6d51f424a58794634bb92a0bdfa7e8a69832665&req=ciMhFM57moRZFb4f3HP0gODl0KrzkSZH8zDa9Cbssa09waes%2FkpFVZarazIZ%0ABXtinPAe9OlNINL3zw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636275756/331283bfb3dc87874f5284a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3031e5d99e35fbfbc004ba0db6d51f424a58794634bb92a0bdfa7e8a69832665&req=ciMhFM57moRZFb4f3HP0gODl0KrzkSZH8zDa9Cbssa09waes%2FkpFVZarazIZ%0ABXtinPAe9OlNINL3zw%3D%3D%0A)

Note: enabling this on a payer file will place all outstanding invoices across all linked patients on hold.

When sending invoices in bulk using the Outstanding Invoices report, any invoices on accounts that have been put on hold will not filter into the report by default. You will need to adjust the filter if you wish to include the invoices on hold.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276044/9211c3a9934a9a7e72b23a82/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6095a6f5b4d412873583a02d78809ebb78035015636c35cbcf4cd1cee03b973f&req=ciMhFM54nYVbFb4f3HP0gBjmus3MLdSiaMsJtLyOA8Caui2xEd4lxvBYpH97%0AWZdax8oa2G1RRt7%2FkQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636276044/9211c3a9934a9a7e72b23a82/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6095a6f5b4d412873583a02d78809ebb78035015636c35cbcf4cd1cee03b973f&req=ciMhFM54nYVbFb4f3HP0gBjmus3MLdSiaMsJtLyOA8Caui2xEd4lxvBYpH97%0AWZdax8oa2G1RRt7%2FkQ%3D%3D%0A)

You can also use the filter highlighted above to search for invoices that have been placed on hold to ensure you're staying on top of them.

When you're ready to include these invoices, you can disable the Hold Invoices setting on the relevant patient or payer.

Enabling the Return to Work SA Integration

Enabling the Return to Work SA Integration
==========================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Enabling the RTWSA Integration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6271566-enabling-the-return-to-work-sa-integration#h_83fb72b4eb)

[Patient File Requirements](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6271566-enabling-the-return-to-work-sa-integration#h_7f56a5274f)

[Creating a New Bulk RTWSA Export](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6271566-enabling-the-return-to-work-sa-integration#h_4dc2ef21e0)

[Paying Off Previous RTWSA Exports](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6271566-enabling-the-return-to-work-sa-integration#h_bf598c0b3a)

The [Return to Work SA](https://www.rtwsa.com/)
 (RTWSA) integration allows users in South Australia to export a CSV file directly from PracSuite containing claimable items. This CSV file can be uploaded directly to the RTWSA website to submit claims in bulk.

Enabling the RTWSA Integration
==============================

To enable this integration, go to **[Settings > Integrations > Return to Work SA](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/RTWSA)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263062/ebb5b6d8f6493d9f8fcbfa5a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4d02d04d3e95cae938c6ebd09b149ff69ac0451e04a3653e8f69d2216c0c017d&req=ciMhFM99nYddFb4f3HP0gJIP5s%2BUa6rK%2BavgzRR7TC5ev5QoCqgHKp3YEBmW%0AY2x8NFSZiQ3TytakLw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263062/ebb5b6d8f6493d9f8fcbfa5a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4d02d04d3e95cae938c6ebd09b149ff69ac0451e04a3653e8f69d2216c0c017d&req=ciMhFM99nYddFb4f3HP0gJIP5s%2BUa6rK%2BavgzRR7TC5ev5QoCqgHKp3YEBmW%0AY2x8NFSZiQ3TytakLw%3D%3D%0A)

After enabling the integration, you will need to ensure that the RTWSA Claiming Option is enabled on all item codes that you bill under RTWSA.

Go to **[Settings > Billing > Item Codes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
** and select an item that you will bill to RTWSA.

Under the **Claiming Options** header, enable Return to Work SA. You only need to fill in the Override Code if the Item Code field does not already contain the item code that applicable to RTWSA.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263356/1b58ca8bb9d6d64b1ac9589a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=15ab703ccb65deef92807cc4b6d8c293800d25a57a8421b827d5184c206573f0&req=ciMhFM99noRZFb4f3HP0gA9nN6xFFUVzGK%2BVkDb2TkaGGkf6Q%2FrEjs3%2BFl6E%0Ay0t3qzvClJ%2Fi3Oiu8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263356/1b58ca8bb9d6d64b1ac9589a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=15ab703ccb65deef92807cc4b6d8c293800d25a57a8421b827d5184c206573f0&req=ciMhFM99noRZFb4f3HP0gA9nN6xFFUVzGK%2BVkDb2TkaGGkf6Q%2FrEjs3%2BFl6E%0Ay0t3qzvClJ%2Fi3Oiu8w%3D%3D%0A)

Patient File Requirements
=========================

The patient's account must have a **Claim No.** entered on their Accounts tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263555/434e02118eea51b0e525bbe6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=02491a1e702604a377a291ced0f93b744e080fc22169bc39fb3a325355727ef8&req=ciMhFM99mIRaFb4f3HP0gCO0GPrNNjK9u%2Btb0ZxxELCNaiAcmjuV9rJmFwUS%0AuMXhOaIzGomPpuHAaw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263555/434e02118eea51b0e525bbe6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=02491a1e702604a377a291ced0f93b744e080fc22169bc39fb3a325355727ef8&req=ciMhFM99mIRaFb4f3HP0gCO0GPrNNjK9u%2Btb0ZxxELCNaiAcmjuV9rJmFwUS%0AuMXhOaIzGomPpuHAaw%3D%3D%0A)

Creating a New Bulk RTWSA Export
================================

Go to **[Reports > Integrations > Return to Work SA Export](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/rtwsa)
.**

Select **New Bulk Export**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263741/647e8d60def71da014470b0b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea9aaceda644ea2c50731845a51d46bb22be863d54941029f09adab37a2a5161&req=ciMhFM99moVeFb4f3HP0gBkJKgYezmqdw7Z4Wm%2FGRfxm9kEZglUNkI5jtYEK%0A7kUq8xuuSSEGq1k71Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263741/647e8d60def71da014470b0b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ea9aaceda644ea2c50731845a51d46bb22be863d54941029f09adab37a2a5161&req=ciMhFM99moVeFb4f3HP0gBkJKgYezmqdw7Z4Wm%2FGRfxm9kEZglUNkI5jtYEK%0A7kUq8xuuSSEGq1k71Q%3D%3D%0A)

Use the filters to narrow down what billed items to include on the export. Note that items that have already been added to another RTWSA export will be excluded by default.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263956/16e0f243889c2ec3386d9413/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=41bb0b430bf601adb3ff4396e0ebe935f3500e914ea160f5b26b455a1cc524a4&req=ciMhFM99lIRZFb4f3HP0gMPfN1VDb8%2FCFh4DChnWWKayfo%2BsqSFvbPje2xxo%0A8ZQTNBiGP%2B94l47bJg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636263956/16e0f243889c2ec3386d9413/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=41bb0b430bf601adb3ff4396e0ebe935f3500e914ea160f5b26b455a1cc524a4&req=ciMhFM99lIRZFb4f3HP0gMPfN1VDb8%2FCFh4DChnWWKayfo%2BsqSFvbPje2xxo%0A8ZQTNBiGP%2B94l47bJg%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Find Items** to search for any RTWSA claimable items matching your filters. Any RTWSA items that have been billed per your report filters will be displayed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636266769/34b4619da5e0ef2a25be215a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6f5ff287487e0cb4eca5abc417cba11af130031d671e85a2be768eba54064fb&req=ciMhFM94modWFb4f3HP0gOH3oLmm%2FNTje%2F%2B91EgHOmUYa9j68QE4zuILb0uA%0AZIalf3XYyFUC4qI6gA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636266769/34b4619da5e0ef2a25be215a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6f5ff287487e0cb4eca5abc417cba11af130031d671e85a2be768eba54064fb&req=ciMhFM94modWFb4f3HP0gOH3oLmm%2FNTje%2F%2B91EgHOmUYa9j68QE4zuILb0uA%0AZIalf3XYyFUC4qI6gA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Save & Download** to generate the CSV export for upload to RTWSA.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636264513/a5055e8534da5345f64b14df/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2c4ecc657bc35326639077d3ecd8400a3356bc1dc4dd6c07334ce64a1926adf&req=ciMhFM96mIBcFb4f3HP0gAN3fzGHyERUSo2rxKehue1GZmNTENZb%2FrgYRooq%0A50eS4ColXoocITaClw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636264513/a5055e8534da5345f64b14df/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2c4ecc657bc35326639077d3ecd8400a3356bc1dc4dd6c07334ce64a1926adf&req=ciMhFM96mIBcFb4f3HP0gAN3fzGHyERUSo2rxKehue1GZmNTENZb%2FrgYRooq%0A50eS4ColXoocITaClw%3D%3D%0A)

If you see fields highlighted in red, this indicates that these are invalid. Please review the invalid fields and modify the associated patient file or item details accordingly.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636264569/a99a8e95ede4771cf9f4e916/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=881a3b49c58e8e398889832468299d2a14167c15ce921c9f5a429ebcee91bb13&req=ciMhFM96mIdWFb4f3HP0gL1AfHKwFfMdWVq%2FF7TW85hN0gi2ObdzmtWD%2B%2BYv%0Az1V1d%2FyIHRk2cmC8%2BA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636264569/a99a8e95ede4771cf9f4e916/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=881a3b49c58e8e398889832468299d2a14167c15ce921c9f5a429ebcee91bb13&req=ciMhFM96mIdWFb4f3HP0gL1AfHKwFfMdWVq%2FF7TW85hN0gi2ObdzmtWD%2B%2BYv%0Az1V1d%2FyIHRk2cmC8%2BA%3D%3D%0A)

When attempting to export a CSV containing invalid fields, you will also receive the following prompt:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636265201/5cf8ece2fee224cbd589ce36/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=40e34c8cb66a90405a7cc686995dd88f8d7b3e94973424cd0572a8b6468a0493&req=ciMhFM97n4FeFb4f3HP0gCCiNRFdt7Pkwiz51y40k74ljKhgCew69PYYRUEX%0AahwURbqCiEfVQcFalw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636265201/5cf8ece2fee224cbd589ce36/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=40e34c8cb66a90405a7cc686995dd88f8d7b3e94973424cd0572a8b6468a0493&req=ciMhFM97n4FeFb4f3HP0gCCiNRFdt7Pkwiz51y40k74ljKhgCew69PYYRUEX%0AahwURbqCiEfVQcFalw%3D%3D%0A)

Paying Off Previous RTWSA Exports
=================================

Go to **[Reports > Integrations > Return to Work SA Export](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/rtwsa)
**.

Use the filters to find the previously generated export that you wish to pay off.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636266086/6d4ed87eac70553019b4ad46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=15955ebae82692ae13cbdccd5e361cc958802f92d0a0dc106dc8fc6019b23b15&req=ciMhFM94nYlZFb4f3HP0gG6EXGEi1PDiXUo3ZY1Cr2Jc08e%2B1GKTgbkuzsJ6%0AICTVaW6s0tNV5z6fpQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636266086/6d4ed87eac70553019b4ad46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=15955ebae82692ae13cbdccd5e361cc958802f92d0a0dc106dc8fc6019b23b15&req=ciMhFM94nYlZFb4f3HP0gG6EXGEi1PDiXUo3ZY1Cr2Jc08e%2B1GKTgbkuzsJ6%0AICTVaW6s0tNV5z6fpQ%3D%3D%0A)

From the report results, select the export you wish to pay and then select **Payment**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636266244/d22cba0615ff3a31bbfe501d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d5067217787775c717972e5ad0105152c599dce5f7d67f5d6c2a7df39311b320&req=ciMhFM94n4VbFb4f3HP0gP5agIecygllV6XB3yar6KiY7VDneDRCNNoZq40K%0ADAxCI6FTGQntnvrAHQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636266244/d22cba0615ff3a31bbfe501d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d5067217787775c717972e5ad0105152c599dce5f7d67f5d6c2a7df39311b320&req=ciMhFM94n4VbFb4f3HP0gP5agIecygllV6XB3yar6KiY7VDneDRCNNoZq40K%0ADAxCI6FTGQntnvrAHQ%3D%3D%0A)

The payment screen will appear for you to apply the payment accordingly.

Referrer Professions

Referrer Professions
====================

Referrer Professions

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6280107-referrer-professions#h_30d6c324ad)

[Adding a New Referrer Profession](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6280107-referrer-professions#h_13a0642853)

[Removing Professions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6280107-referrer-professions#h_484d989629)

Overview
========

Referrer Professions are added to Referring Doctors to enable easier searching and communication on the Referring Doctors page. You can add and manage them by going to the **[Contacts > Referrers > Referrer Professions](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/referrers/professions)** page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1726098491/b122eb790f4ebb91f72c48abd107/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=055dd451c07b215804d0be958e337bd39b631f19907bd50ead8883dc3805965a&req=dSclEMl3lYVWWPMW1HO4zSc9SNEqqhPlHboXFnoQtqmOukQgis32qeTlGmRk%0AOnr6oYyBzNSLbwoKliI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1726098491/b122eb790f4ebb91f72c48abd107/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=055dd451c07b215804d0be958e337bd39b631f19907bd50ead8883dc3805965a&req=dSclEMl3lYVWWPMW1HO4zSc9SNEqqhPlHboXFnoQtqmOukQgis32qeTlGmRk%0AOnr6oYyBzNSLbwoKliI%3D%0A)

Adding a New Referrer Profession
--------------------------------

#### Step 1:

Click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636270304/3ef6aa75857f4a6bfe9123b2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=73af0a6f9e6baa4efa539f67a0043e7a1c05dfaed7c11f1e102437a1da16c4b0&req=ciMhFM5%2BnoFbFb4f3HP0gGtH4TAmJL%2BVjlsqmXv9k9vUIAEuU%2Bmj7Jl2wCd3%0ALvTefunq79TzHIJ4bg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636270304/3ef6aa75857f4a6bfe9123b2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=73af0a6f9e6baa4efa539f67a0043e7a1c05dfaed7c11f1e102437a1da16c4b0&req=ciMhFM5%2BnoFbFb4f3HP0gGtH4TAmJL%2BVjlsqmXv9k9vUIAEuU%2Bmj7Jl2wCd3%0ALvTefunq79TzHIJ4bg%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636271486/d6f8e6907f7e3985b8af8438/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59815be6eb90ab150d9134c0100f7a75c7c8677790a5f06514e57328e63f2169&req=ciMhFM5%2FmYlZFb4f3HP0gA7uNdbXv122xoMT8M5fyd60dS4bubFklTnHJ3rC%0AYYCLPsw16v3B9qXgOA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636271486/d6f8e6907f7e3985b8af8438/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=59815be6eb90ab150d9134c0100f7a75c7c8677790a5f06514e57328e63f2169&req=ciMhFM5%2FmYlZFb4f3HP0gA7uNdbXv122xoMT8M5fyd60dS4bubFklTnHJ3rC%0AYYCLPsw16v3B9qXgOA%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Type in the name of the new referrer profession.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636271664/1c6d3454015bcee4126a22ba/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=84cfcc360556e91da194d60b0bca612966feca8149e7f9bf47fad1d2e72a8853&req=ciMhFM5%2Fm4dbFb4f3HP0gOaLuWmSR29fw5Wq1yBQ%2FupoDMy935FaBIeZjBx9%0ApUhiTAgmpQInoCagAg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636271664/1c6d3454015bcee4126a22ba/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=84cfcc360556e91da194d60b0bca612966feca8149e7f9bf47fad1d2e72a8853&req=ciMhFM5%2Fm4dbFb4f3HP0gOaLuWmSR29fw5Wq1yBQ%2FupoDMy935FaBIeZjBx9%0ApUhiTAgmpQInoCagAg%3D%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636271764/9ba1e0c56e155fb926845c82/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fbd22d142a6e0604072ec30cd35c4d064e11ee5d3ad2cd21821a88801b546df5&req=ciMhFM5%2FmodbFb4f3HP0gJ15kGfrbcV5gMUGns5D5afC1qzgnCwfKkX%2Fu1ae%0AWRelvrNPASd4qXOybQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636271764/9ba1e0c56e155fb926845c82/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fbd22d142a6e0604072ec30cd35c4d064e11ee5d3ad2cd21821a88801b546df5&req=ciMhFM5%2FmodbFb4f3HP0gJ15kGfrbcV5gMUGns5D5afC1qzgnCwfKkX%2Fu1ae%0AWRelvrNPASd4qXOybQ%3D%3D%0A)

  
  
  
Removing Professions
-----------------------------

Professions that you no longer need can be Archived so they no longer show up in the list when selecting a profession for a Referring Doctor.

To archive a profession, select Edit and then uncheck the box on the left for the profession you want to archive.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1726148052/2d1b0fd723d62ea9ffc0737d28ca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3356be8cc6f93bb1866b2f2076d299abe7885229d3447a689b3800cd7908c749&req=dSclEMh6lYFaW%2FMW1HO4zYzt62W0JP%2BeoGUWtgRAyUCUFHMhzwB54PsXvv7C%0A5di5ZS18x0ha%2BLWiw28%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1726148052/2d1b0fd723d62ea9ffc0737d28ca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3356be8cc6f93bb1866b2f2076d299abe7885229d3447a689b3800cd7908c749&req=dSclEMh6lYFaW%2FMW1HO4zYzt62W0JP%2BeoGUWtgRAyUCUFHMhzwB54PsXvv7C%0A5di5ZS18x0ha%2BLWiw28%3D%0A)

  
​  
If the profession hasn't been used before you can also delete it by clicking on the Trash Can icon on the right.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1726149216/dc57df51dd68f778c3ba9b0c9e0b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bf8cb05a541d8813c20661ddf684f62cd7f576fdd18cc53b4c41ab322694fb80&req=dSclEMh6lINeX%2FMW1HO4zYdYM10lD2%2BBu4bs436CFm2xKZuYxP9gzmAhEjqp%0ATkhbrQwJnW1%2Bqlwu2rw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1726149216/dc57df51dd68f778c3ba9b0c9e0b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bf8cb05a541d8813c20661ddf684f62cd7f576fdd18cc53b4c41ab322694fb80&req=dSclEMh6lINeX%2FMW1HO4zYdYM10lD2%2BBu4bs436CFm2xKZuYxP9gzmAhEjqp%0ATkhbrQwJnW1%2Bqlwu2rw%3D%0A)

  
​  
You can find more information on referring doctors in this article on **[Referring Doctors](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4375704-referring-doctors)
**.

Enabling the Healthengine Integration

Enabling the Healthengine Integration
=====================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Finding your Healthengine Practice ID](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284962-enabling-the-healthengine-integration#h_9f8820b13e)

[Enabling the Healthengine Integration in PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284962-enabling-the-healthengine-integration#h_b9fecc75c7)

_This article assumes you have [signed up for a Health engine practice account.](https://practices.healthengine.com.au/list-your-practice/?pracsource=header-link-2)
_

**⚠️⚠️⚠️**

**Before using this integration, you must contact Healthengine support and request that they enable the PMS partners integration API for your practice. Healthengine can be contacted by email [support@healthengine.com.au](mailto:support@healthengine.com.au)
 or by phone on 1300 377 639**

This article covers:

*   [Finding your Healthengine Practice ID](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284962-enabling-the-healthengine-integration#h_9f8820b13e)
    
*   [Enabling the Healthengine Integration in PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284962-enabling-the-healthengine-integration#h_b9fecc75c7)
    
*   [Configuring Practitioner Settings in Healthengine](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284962-enabling-the-healthengine-integration#h_f8f17bf475)
    
*   [Configuring Appointment Types in Healthengine](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284962-enabling-the-healthengine-integration#h_755519d5b1)
    
*   [Online Appointment Availability](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284962-enabling-the-healthengine-integration#h_f7f39bbd44)
    
*   [Processing Healthengine Guest Bookings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6284962-enabling-the-healthengine-integration#h_fb79e29120)
    

**⚠️⚠️⚠️**

**Before using this integration, you must contact Healthengine support and request that they enable the PMS partners integration API for your practice. Healthengine can be contacted by email [support@healthengine.com.au](mailto:support@healthengine.com.au)
 or by phone on 1300 377 639**

* * *

**Finding your Healthengine Practice ID**
=========================================

[Log into your Healthengine practice account](https://healthengine.com.au/appointment/admin)
.

If you have multiple practices linked to your Healthengine account, ensure that you are logged into the correct practice using the drop-down list in the top right corner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532578990/4ed474a1d7854e69af5bf205/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=925890e36773504979d5a12dc588152a22eeae10cac95d8cab876599ea25d547&req=cSMlE852lIhfFb4f3HP0gOkrgQK9aDZ0cweUTq2IwmSion4EEr3SLEiBJq6U%0AT1Lf4gQSIb52bYHMRw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532578990/4ed474a1d7854e69af5bf205/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=925890e36773504979d5a12dc588152a22eeae10cac95d8cab876599ea25d547&req=cSMlE852lIhfFb4f3HP0gOkrgQK9aDZ0cweUTq2IwmSion4EEr3SLEiBJq6U%0AT1Lf4gQSIb52bYHMRw%3D%3D%0A)

Copy your practice ID from the URL bar at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532568866/d25b071c6a5af7883bcca86b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=972664759aa2faf6e93476f7726ff6eb3ab6d600ca5b22ad541fedaeaf8d3d76&req=cSMlE892lYdZFb4f3HP0gGXszcRLUZsMXPljFUgwb1kSwlDfaD2w67mwDgg9%0A0xug1%2FUn7Tojd0qoSw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532568866/d25b071c6a5af7883bcca86b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=972664759aa2faf6e93476f7726ff6eb3ab6d600ca5b22ad541fedaeaf8d3d76&req=cSMlE892lYdZFb4f3HP0gGXszcRLUZsMXPljFUgwb1kSwlDfaD2w67mwDgg9%0A0xug1%2FUn7Tojd0qoSw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Enabling the Healthengine Integration in PracSuite**
======================================================

In PracSuite, go to [Settings > Integrations > Healthengine](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/healthengine)
.

Enable the integration switch and select **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532580695/a6040e1c8295796c3fc340f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ceab402b32f1cb4b0c79349ebb7497cf25c27ca34d4f2597c785ebcb516eebb1&req=cSMlE8F%2Bm4haFb4f3HP0gDJnwgB%2FCpvLzFMCqLNUz0842Ffe4mfg1M6Mzqzs%0ArK%2FZDThghfVAFUrMag%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532580695/a6040e1c8295796c3fc340f4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ceab402b32f1cb4b0c79349ebb7497cf25c27ca34d4f2597c785ebcb516eebb1&req=cSMlE8F%2Bm4haFb4f3HP0gDJnwgB%2FCpvLzFMCqLNUz0842Ffe4mfg1M6Mzqzs%0ArK%2FZDThghfVAFUrMag%3D%3D%0A)

A popup will appear for you to add the Practice ID found in the step above. Copy your Practice ID into the box and select **Connect with Healthengine**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532580806/66e2d82c2232c05eae4e8746/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bda2b3e571fd8650d7d4c27e24e645cae7ac0c36d093bebe87f1efa55d4dcfe7&req=cSMlE8F%2BlYFZFb4f3HP0gDjAq2y2tVpA5g6k16g2QN5ZmxFu%2Fo295dT2jMB8%0AuulqMQQU8qv3ee89ew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532580806/66e2d82c2232c05eae4e8746/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bda2b3e571fd8650d7d4c27e24e645cae7ac0c36d093bebe87f1efa55d4dcfe7&req=cSMlE8F%2BlYFZFb4f3HP0gDjAq2y2tVpA5g6k16g2QN5ZmxFu%2Fo295dT2jMB8%0AuulqMQQU8qv3ee89ew%3D%3D%0A)

You will be directed to the Healthengine login screen. Login to your account and select the green tick to authorise connecting your Healthengine account to PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532568723/feefa249395bd27bbee312b6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cc948b611a6164f3c7f94cf1979d652026081c070c0f348af7f4d53b64183df5&req=cSMlE892moNcFb4f3HP0gHd4cgBCWsJVCuX1bGUIB0mPkhbDDJuXVgsQuzoj%0ABv74gBfqg1m3qXfP3A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532568723/feefa249395bd27bbee312b6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cc948b611a6164f3c7f94cf1979d652026081c070c0f348af7f4d53b64183df5&req=cSMlE892moNcFb4f3HP0gHd4cgBCWsJVCuX1bGUIB0mPkhbDDJuXVgsQuzoj%0ABv74gBfqg1m3qXfP3A%3D%3D%0A)

You will be returned to PracSuite to continue configuring the integration.

You will need to choose the **Appointment Types** and **Practitioners** that you wish to make available for online booking via Healthengine. Select the setting cog buttons shown below to manage these lists.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532613081/67d26d0e874262ca1eca3f4a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2206670a8decdde12d9a548e167e1dc949067258c9cb7022a97bff5eee764ae7&req=cSMlEMh9nYleFb4f3HP0gNi%2FP5kgfj46wZtOe9OeBXIS2iUozcGVReN60f8c%0A90oPu0bLMZXgNt4Cjw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532613081/67d26d0e874262ca1eca3f4a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2206670a8decdde12d9a548e167e1dc949067258c9cb7022a97bff5eee764ae7&req=cSMlEMh9nYleFb4f3HP0gNi%2FP5kgfj46wZtOe9OeBXIS2iUozcGVReN60f8c%0A90oPu0bLMZXgNt4Cjw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**Configuring Practitioner Settings in Healthengine**
=====================================================

The next step is to configure the practitioner profiles on the Healthengine site.

Once logged into your Healthengine account, go to **Settings > Manage Practitioners.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532613306/981236fabd0348dd65efbe3e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ebd37aecb25024cb1d1a9ff88252738fdc0c8d0035c4223590f2545a433e4451&req=cSMlEMh9noFZFb4f3HP0gJ4wdI4qKnbCtsvKo8TzHDq%2Fw%2BOFrr845dPQ%2B5zt%0AQmgZyoAAVPL8Tf2vOQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532613306/981236fabd0348dd65efbe3e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ebd37aecb25024cb1d1a9ff88252738fdc0c8d0035c4223590f2545a433e4451&req=cSMlEMh9noFZFb4f3HP0gJ4wdI4qKnbCtsvKo8TzHDq%2Fw%2BOFrr845dPQ%2B5zt%0AQmgZyoAAVPL8Tf2vOQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Add Practitioner.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532613363/9ba4ef86a473ab4d7e60011b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eb5363f37af63309e7b376791ae2a3583a557adf0b37bd2fad2b91652256a594&req=cSMlEMh9nodcFb4f3HP0gNkAAtDJoniuaimlQOrG%2B7X9m2rp2L7fHHZcP7FO%0ApWlPLmU6G140f%2BYJMQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532613363/9ba4ef86a473ab4d7e60011b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eb5363f37af63309e7b376791ae2a3583a557adf0b37bd2fad2b91652256a594&req=cSMlEMh9nodcFb4f3HP0gNkAAtDJoniuaimlQOrG%2B7X9m2rp2L7fHHZcP7FO%0ApWlPLmU6G140f%2BYJMQ%3D%3D%0A)

Enter the practitioner details as required. When you reach the "**Is this practitioner available for online appointments**?" question, select **Yes**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532613975/889744eafc6496b523e0a425/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80f1e8399baa796cbec1a8d12a874525d19d445033e76ce89ac81e3f036da813&req=cSMlEMh9lIZaFb4f3HP0gLWkMtUdeD3rrpxpcD6Yh9zsq3OmGzYt%2BNGxn3dM%0Afu233IbRHb7lHClhVg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532613975/889744eafc6496b523e0a425/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80f1e8399baa796cbec1a8d12a874525d19d445033e76ce89ac81e3f036da813&req=cSMlEMh9lIZaFb4f3HP0gLWkMtUdeD3rrpxpcD6Yh9zsq3OmGzYt%2BNGxn3dM%0Afu233IbRHb7lHClhVg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the associated PracSuite practitioner file from the drop-down list.

Select **Add Practitioner** to finalise this step.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532614076/6dce4164ad9bd80070b8e8f9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb147bda9f24b451a01cc67a57d2ca0c4066d2309af018aa6c4696bb14cc49b4&req=cSMlEMh6nYZZFb4f3HP0gMn39JEU%2FAK0%2FePXCnVZwwTKdicpGAw2vBelbVWZ%0A4HSRLOzwTzA8UcCeBQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532614076/6dce4164ad9bd80070b8e8f9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb147bda9f24b451a01cc67a57d2ca0c4066d2309af018aa6c4696bb14cc49b4&req=cSMlEMh6nYZZFb4f3HP0gMn39JEU%2FAK0%2FePXCnVZwwTKdicpGAw2vBelbVWZ%0A4HSRLOzwTzA8UcCeBQ%3D%3D%0A)

Regarding the "**Is this practitioner available for online bookings on public holidays**?" question, if you've already ruled out public holidays in PracSuite, then no times on these dates will be sent to Healthengine. Respond to this question as you wish.

Repeat this process for all practitioner location and profession combinations as required.

* * *

**Configuring Appointment Types in Healthengine**
=================================================

Once the practitioner has been added to Healthengine, remain in the **Settings > Manage Practitioners** section**.**

Select the **Edit appointment types** button alongside their name to choose which appointment types can be booked via Healthengine for this practitioner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532615242/0f2eff8e6bd9a1b3aebc3ffc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35db817aa5e7b5112c855bf4f0daa6dd3318af1b744cbdf159304b4a9a1db649&req=cSMlEMh7n4VdFb4f3HP0gOotcalrC4O1Ay6%2BB3yJX8Mxtb8H2bXtLhvAWdwz%0AH9Aru1d9X0OhzwXAYA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532615242/0f2eff8e6bd9a1b3aebc3ffc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35db817aa5e7b5112c855bf4f0daa6dd3318af1b744cbdf159304b4a9a1db649&req=cSMlEMh7n4VdFb4f3HP0gOotcalrC4O1Ay6%2BB3yJX8Mxtb8H2bXtLhvAWdwz%0AH9Aru1d9X0OhzwXAYA%3D%3D%0A)

Scroll down to find the **Add Appointment Type** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532616001/359c911f05f166e62ac74a30/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ba0c6c08bb356e904856b5451178262a3ff4887a5b87ee879116f5d432c5a4ea&req=cSMlEMh4nYFeFb4f3HP0gKUWJs3ltgRyeU9QQi96UnPcxm0xCTEBxPHYA3ug%0Am9yjXvweG2nEqYbWWA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532616001/359c911f05f166e62ac74a30/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ba0c6c08bb356e904856b5451178262a3ff4887a5b87ee879116f5d432c5a4ea&req=cSMlEMh4nYFeFb4f3HP0gKUWJs3ltgRyeU9QQi96UnPcxm0xCTEBxPHYA3ug%0Am9yjXvweG2nEqYbWWA%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Linked PMS Appointment** list to map the Healthengine appointment type to the corresponding PracSuite appointment type. You will also need to specify whether the appointment type is available to new or existing patients, or both.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532616733/f4517e82b76bc34516cdd95b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=219fea28639548d0f04a5ec6293521f30191670d7a636dc75e51b59b573c4604&req=cSMlEMh4moJcFb4f3HP0gHmE%2FlBhyqi7wtv6yqvhGztZ5GqMd5a4R0fbV66M%0AVSvqgJsStS2w%2FN26iQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532616733/f4517e82b76bc34516cdd95b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=219fea28639548d0f04a5ec6293521f30191670d7a636dc75e51b59b573c4604&req=cSMlEMh4moJcFb4f3HP0gHmE%2FlBhyqi7wtv6yqvhGztZ5GqMd5a4R0fbV66M%0AVSvqgJsStS2w%2FN26iQ%3D%3D%0A)

Note: The appointment type duration entered into Healthengine will be ignored as PracSuite will respect the appointment duration preferences as set within PracSuite in [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
.

Continue to select **Add Appointment Type** and repeat this above process until you've listed all appointment types that you want to make available for this practitioner.

Select **Save All** to finalise your changes for this practitioner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532623391/3cf8e491c847befa6cf676dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67d6e9961cb41741af092a875c469b5d9971c6af66c337c5fb006ece5340b28a&req=cSMlEMt9noheFb4f3HP0gGwKWmKEj%2FX9q2c1L3WLVZZtflpq149aYbKQcufP%0ASOCeEp2sVJsSQ1adGg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/532623391/3cf8e491c847befa6cf676dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67d6e9961cb41741af092a875c469b5d9971c6af66c337c5fb006ece5340b28a&req=cSMlEMt9noheFb4f3HP0gGwKWmKEj%2FX9q2c1L3WLVZZtflpq149aYbKQcufP%0ASOCeEp2sVJsSQ1adGg%3D%3D%0A)

Repeat this process for all practitioner profiles in Healthengine.

Time considered as available for Healthengine online bookings follows the same principles as PracSuite online bookings. [Click here for further details.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4770750-specifying-available-time-for-online-bookings)

Understanding Clinical Note Revisions

Understanding Clinical Note Revisions
=====================================

Updated over 3 months ago

Table of contents

[Revision Period](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6302023-understanding-clinical-note-revisions#h_0baa508bfb)

[Role Permissions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6302023-understanding-clinical-note-revisions#h_88e5b12526)

[Viewing Clinical Note Revisions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6302023-understanding-clinical-note-revisions#h_586ba86b76)

Editing existing clinical notes within PracSuite is optional. However, if a user has permission, PracSuite automatically tracks the edit history of clinical notes after they're saved and marked as completed.

Additionally, PracSuite can be configured to lock completed clinical notes after a specified revision period (up to 96 hours). Once this period has passed, the note can no longer be edited.

Note that edits to drafts are not tracked as revisions. Revisions only occur when editing a completed note.

Revision Period
===============

From **Settings > Clinical Notes > Clinical Notes**, you can set the Edit/Revision period. The revision period can be set to hourly intervals up to 96 hours.

Role Permissions
----------------

A PracSuite user with the System Administrator Role can always edit a note at any time. For other roles, you can configure the following permissions relating to revisions:

*   **Edit Notes** - allows a user to edit a note once it has been saved as complete during the revision period, only within the revision period
    
*   **Edit Notes After Revision Period** - allows a user to edit a note at any time, including after the revision period
    

Note that revisions are always tracked regardless of the chosen revision period. Users with the ability to edit notes after revision period will still have their edits tracked.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1817633929/eb34b0c4cfd80385ac0e6c714a9c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a36a9a3217bec157a00cf550b0d80c25ecdf2203e5bab457705dae4cb7db37c&req=dSgmEc99nohdUPMW1HO4zZdGWmNTY2LuAODkUjgFPRwuKdFMo2bdK86yuOo8%0A4l2uEZ8ZRBaW0fhFHZ8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1817633929/eb34b0c4cfd80385ac0e6c714a9c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a36a9a3217bec157a00cf550b0d80c25ecdf2203e5bab457705dae4cb7db37c&req=dSgmEc99nohdUPMW1HO4zZdGWmNTY2LuAODkUjgFPRwuKdFMo2bdK86yuOo8%0A4l2uEZ8ZRBaW0fhFHZ8%3D%0A)

Viewing Clinical Note Revisions
===============================

When a revision has been made to a clinical note, you will see the history icon and a last edited message, which includes the user who last edited the note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1817634713/b6f864171bb6d894b18f5938f3ee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72eb3a1fe428dbd7de441297219cfa8f0ec7f8505993ec4f9f5af0814595bb11&req=dSgmEc99mYZeWvMW1HO4zYEu0ClFEqTKDToPXyzSTxQPxFk%2FMfWyAplhV8og%0A8n5fJtn6f8q%2B0UGv3xY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1817634713/b6f864171bb6d894b18f5938f3ee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72eb3a1fe428dbd7de441297219cfa8f0ec7f8505993ec4f9f5af0814595bb11&req=dSgmEc99mYZeWvMW1HO4zYEu0ClFEqTKDToPXyzSTxQPxFk%2FMfWyAplhV8og%0A8n5fJtn6f8q%2B0UGv3xY%3D%0A)

Clicking on the last edited badge will allow you to view the revisions dating back to the original instance of that clinical note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631919851/aa22ca4df29cf9376ada53aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4fc7d816b4a28ff5efec4a4237fc42e27c40d271e835ad140771401230bdbfe7&req=ciMmH8h3lYReFb4f3HP0gJlz6i4klT8DMUDzP4msnj6tpA2FtyKlULIO8s9S%0AlYYHLNGRjI%2F%2BRmedmQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631919851/aa22ca4df29cf9376ada53aa/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4fc7d816b4a28ff5efec4a4237fc42e27c40d271e835ad140771401230bdbfe7&req=ciMmH8h3lYReFb4f3HP0gJlz6i4klT8DMUDzP4msnj6tpA2FtyKlULIO8s9S%0AlYYHLNGRjI%2F%2BRmedmQ%3D%3D%0A)
