How to enable and submit HCF 'More For' claims using Tyro Health EFTPOS integration

How to enable and submit HCF 'More For' claims using Tyro Health EFTPOS integration
===================================================================================

Updated over 7 months ago

Practices have the option to participate in [HCF's 'More For' program](https://www.hcf.com.au/provider-portals/more-for-you/)
, which is available to eligible members of the HCF private health fund. If your practice participates in this program, please find further instructions below:

#### Contents

1) [How to enable HCF More For Claiming](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6305300-how-to-enable-and-submit-hcf-more-for-claims-using-tyro-health-eftpos-integration#h_bbcd7330b6)

2) [How to setup Item Codes for HCF More For claiming](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6305300-how-to-enable-and-submit-hcf-more-for-claims-using-tyro-health-eftpos-integration#h_374ec96067)

3) [Using a HCF 'More For' item code and claiming](https://Using%20a%20HCF%20'More%20For'%20item%20code%20and%20claiming)

4) [Additional Information - Links to ICD-10 Codes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6305300-how-to-enable-and-submit-hcf-more-for-claims-using-tyro-health-eftpos-integration#h_85e6d6b672)
  
​

* * *

#### How to enable HCF More For Claiming

1) Go to [Settings > Integrations > Tyro Health EFTPOS](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/tyro)
.

2) In the top 'Tyro Health EFTPOS' settings section, enable **HCF More For claiming** as seen below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861220248/8a9550a9032e7f4e3d2b9ced/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3a41df7e37b1b968bb7b359481dcfda1a73b658ae9ad278a87d8f6f76f46d5d7&req=fCYmFMt%2Bn4VXFb4f3HP0gHqS3lrVHW9gEgVE6fJst%2BoFFooFQyV29VkYxYOP%0AZ%2BY2eMrlvew%2FZpfQSg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861220248/8a9550a9032e7f4e3d2b9ced/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3a41df7e37b1b968bb7b359481dcfda1a73b658ae9ad278a87d8f6f76f46d5d7&req=fCYmFMt%2Bn4VXFb4f3HP0gHqS3lrVHW9gEgVE6fJst%2BoFFooFQyV29VkYxYOP%0AZ%2BY2eMrlvew%2FZpfQSg%3D%3D%0A)

3) Once enabled, click **Save.**

* * *

####   
How to setup Item Codes for HCF More For claiming

With the **HCF More For Claiming** feature enabled, you will now need to specify which item codes are applicable to this program.

1) Go to [Settings > Billing > Item Codes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117056136/c2f87f2ddf77230db2daeaee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f2258bcedab2633a8426db74788b4f5aaab65ba4a8143972fc8259b3511c31b6&req=dSEmEcl7m4BcX%2FMW1HO4zTIV6IlCHuPos%2FhibqLej8UF2ZhdK9GgrQG03ifo%0AwKnmJevYivi70w0gOaY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117056136/c2f87f2ddf77230db2daeaee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f2258bcedab2633a8426db74788b4f5aaab65ba4a8143972fc8259b3511c31b6&req=dSEmEcl7m4BcX%2FMW1HO4zTIV6IlCHuPos%2FhibqLej8UF2ZhdK9GgrQG03ifo%0AwKnmJevYivi70w0gOaY%3D%0A)

2) Click to open an **item code** that is applicable to the **HCF More For** program.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117057561/91904501a28ab2691e7959d6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a66ff95f4417deb2d7a971ef2294f857b2aacefb929a5e1c8fa52d2e2719dda2&req=dSEmEcl7moRZWPMW1HO4zdAm6qCPndvUuF6KPsTAMxoHIYpfXBmKTRr1HgO0%0A6zxaC7C23XBs3T5JzHo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117057561/91904501a28ab2691e7959d6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a66ff95f4417deb2d7a971ef2294f857b2aacefb929a5e1c8fa52d2e2719dda2&req=dSEmEcl7moRZWPMW1HO4zdAm6qCPndvUuF6KPsTAMxoHIYpfXBmKTRr1HgO0%0A6zxaC7C23XBs3T5JzHo%3D%0A)

  
3) Click **Edit** to change the item code.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117058065/a85678db9165bec61f209de1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e195d97bc3b3e48355f5e07d4381642704e651100cdba305041ad7388864ab6&req=dSEmEcl7lYFZXPMW1HO4zQ6buma9xyOkX%2BsGyrR5vZ%2FXMP7IkHEwUP9BLYzy%0Avy6QNIYoZkJELwvPWoY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117058065/a85678db9165bec61f209de1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e195d97bc3b3e48355f5e07d4381642704e651100cdba305041ad7388864ab6&req=dSEmEcl7lYFZXPMW1HO4zQ6buma9xyOkX%2BsGyrR5vZ%2FXMP7IkHEwUP9BLYzy%0Avy6QNIYoZkJELwvPWoY%3D%0A)

4) Enable the **HCF 'More For'** claiming option, as shown below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631901344/e0de354df49f274e31283038/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e7422b3a6efde1770252256b1051ee3f8518f90f7db881d82bb2695bc1a75ba7&req=ciMmH8l%2FnoVbFb4f3HP0gPMR4uAMZDwbq6im8crYTJcYDRUuP9Aljhh3lUdg%0AZMwJL%2FVRv53ek%2F1t2A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631901344/e0de354df49f274e31283038/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e7422b3a6efde1770252256b1051ee3f8518f90f7db881d82bb2695bc1a75ba7&req=ciMmH8l%2FnoVbFb4f3HP0gPMR4uAMZDwbq6im8crYTJcYDRUuP9Aljhh3lUdg%0AZMwJL%2FVRv53ek%2F1t2A%3D%3D%0A)

5) Repeat this process for all relevant item codes.  
​

* * *

#### Using a HCF 'More For' item code and claiming  

When adding HCF More For enabled item codes to an invoice, you will now be prompted to enter the appropriate **ICD-10 code**.

1) Before you begin, ensure the **Health Fund** of the patient has been set to **HCF**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117064672/f71ee011778c997cfbaf0322/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c244e6b4be14761c00f0d69772c8433d5693eb7947d7616b9618abe828543b4e&req=dSEmEcl4mYdYW%2FMW1HO4zQFXYfCQwRh%2FwOLAQLf23syJt%2BnnbgrAy%2Fh3%2F9Df%0AkGUcehvReVH2X%2Fk7qzA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117064672/f71ee011778c997cfbaf0322/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c244e6b4be14761c00f0d69772c8433d5693eb7947d7616b9618abe828543b4e&req=dSEmEcl4mYdYW%2FMW1HO4zQFXYfCQwRh%2FwOLAQLf23syJt%2BnnbgrAy%2Fh3%2F9Df%0AkGUcehvReVH2X%2Fk7qzA%3D%0A)

2) From the invoice screen, select a HCF 'More For' enabled item code.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117063939/1de166136e64e5a0e0db1103/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a73be19c22f119bb36a0f87f9b4a1b8741ebdea20801837271b6b266bcb27b9&req=dSEmEcl4nohcUPMW1HO4zW5VMy8ocxB0QwTJxb8pEy7ujTrD3fMdRkQ684bx%0AqEYf2yKBr%2BCyBODFmss%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117063939/1de166136e64e5a0e0db1103/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5a73be19c22f119bb36a0f87f9b4a1b8741ebdea20801837271b6b266bcb27b9&req=dSEmEcl4nohcUPMW1HO4zW5VMy8ocxB0QwTJxb8pEy7ujTrD3fMdRkQ684bx%0AqEYf2yKBr%2BCyBODFmss%3D%0A)

2) When prompted, enter the appropriate ICD-10 code for your profession and click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117067410/ba3a740cfc39bececccabc0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4cd5c8c8fada277513082330df67eb98f4f7caddc5f0268138384b801357a88d&req=dSEmEcl4moVeWfMW1HO4ze0ndZYfiH8%2BdNUqCeK4fWyVL2baSg%2B2pf0ng22r%0AzNsv0%2BiZgCMEXCf7Nc0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1117067410/ba3a740cfc39bececccabc0c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4cd5c8c8fada277513082330df67eb98f4f7caddc5f0268138384b801357a88d&req=dSEmEcl4moVeWfMW1HO4ze0ndZYfiH8%2BdNUqCeK4fWyVL2baSg%2B2pf0ng22r%0AzNsv0%2BiZgCMEXCf7Nc0%3D%0A)

If you have entered the ICD-10 code incorrectly, this can be changed by clicking into the Item Code drop-down and clicking the HCF button.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631901694/fbd501b7a24b33c8689f6b70/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8443af2a3fbb4e280f1e51a3051294526f0ef4ffbec73a6f200ec47ad9a11afb&req=ciMmH8l%2Fm4hbFb4f3HP0gIVb0SRk8xi5ozYsExVk4ulwZsevrxdfwKz%2BDHkI%0ATOj7sb897IWkESY2mg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631901694/fbd501b7a24b33c8689f6b70/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8443af2a3fbb4e280f1e51a3051294526f0ef4ffbec73a6f200ec47ad9a11afb&req=ciMmH8l%2Fm4hbFb4f3HP0gIVb0SRk8xi5ozYsExVk4ulwZsevrxdfwKz%2BDHkI%0ATOj7sb897IWkESY2mg%3D%3D%0A)

3) Once your items have been added to the invoice with an appropriate ICD-10 code , use the normal '**Tyro EFTPOS > Health Fund Claim**' button (in the Payment area) to submit your claim to the Tyro terminal.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861220741/a239a63bc5e0eceedae5e806/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b3b27ed564f59e5f2d71063e987a1154f91b49e7c3ffdbfec1bb6ad520287008&req=fCYmFMt%2BmoVeFb4f3HP0gOGdNuf1r6HBDUzYV3YizAc8WR%2FSm%2BNI3m0fgNT8%0ACIe310vLSOWmo9xa8A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/861220741/a239a63bc5e0eceedae5e806/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b3b27ed564f59e5f2d71063e987a1154f91b49e7c3ffdbfec1bb6ad520287008&req=fCYmFMt%2BmoVeFb4f3HP0gOGdNuf1r6HBDUzYV3YizAc8WR%2FSm%2BNI3m0fgNT8%0ACIe310vLSOWmo9xa8A%3D%3D%0A)

  
After submitting the claim, Tyro will display a summary of the health fund benefit and any remaining gap amounts as usual.

Why can't I view all the patient's I've added on the Waiting List?

Why can't I view all the patient's I've added on the Waiting List?
==================================================================

Waiting List Troubleshooting

Updated over 3 years ago

When using the [Waiting List](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5319191-using-the-waiting-list)
 functionality, filtering can affect which patients are displayed. To make sure you can view all patients that have been added to the Waiting List follow the guide below.

Click the **Waiting List Icon** in the bottom left of the Appointment Book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269300/cd21e70ca1763842c4c93887/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=17884d9b021b0c51c39ef13b3cad8c8db3d79f26af3d25c97ebe4d05335a6fcc&req=ciMhFM93noFfFb4f3HP0gLKui5aEAUcojXEP9rjtfFS9HSjHXK1vzBiM9vd0%0AJewOWbxDHKXQgOmk7w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269300/cd21e70ca1763842c4c93887/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=17884d9b021b0c51c39ef13b3cad8c8db3d79f26af3d25c97ebe4d05335a6fcc&req=ciMhFM93noFfFb4f3HP0gLKui5aEAUcojXEP9rjtfFS9HSjHXK1vzBiM9vd0%0AJewOWbxDHKXQgOmk7w%3D%3D%0A)

At the top of the Waiting List, click the **Filter Icon**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269369/d96b108543d3b7da585b54a7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e2b43013088148c65f6694125d673980d1bcff8b9151adfcc3af90eda820f23b&req=ciMhFM93nodWFb4f3HP0gAjSESy%2BkITyTr141At6gyW90tvCMHwcFc%2BLOP%2BC%0A%2BkkSAL052HKluC9%2B8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269369/d96b108543d3b7da585b54a7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e2b43013088148c65f6694125d673980d1bcff8b9151adfcc3af90eda820f23b&req=ciMhFM93nodWFb4f3HP0gAjSESy%2BkITyTr141At6gyW90tvCMHwcFc%2BLOP%2BC%0A%2BkkSAL052HKluC9%2B8w%3D%3D%0A)

Under **Practitioners to Display**, select **_Appointment Book Filters_**. This will ensure that you will be able to view patients on the waiting list that are associated with the businesses/practitioners you are viewing on the Appointment Book.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269587/274263957a81281d70fe8845/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c2a62f0e426b668df2aeed096154b080180ffcffccfd39ae6f47e12759667d9&req=ciMhFM93mIlYFb4f3HP0gMHXvGB8UdshxvqtwUaS108LsWoTLOOtCH%2BQU0ul%0A5jE6sBh3AXQ8a%2FvnIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269587/274263957a81281d70fe8845/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6c2a62f0e426b668df2aeed096154b080180ffcffccfd39ae6f47e12759667d9&req=ciMhFM93mIlYFb4f3HP0gMHXvGB8UdshxvqtwUaS108LsWoTLOOtCH%2BQU0ul%0A5jE6sBh3AXQ8a%2FvnIA%3D%3D%0A)

Under **Days to Display**, select **_All Days_**. This will ensure that you will be able to view patients on the waiting list for all days rather than for just today.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269628/721ea26e00c7fabb92cfd4b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2e743732317a9de0744dc3371809b13f94d671f8447a3f42496d071875f3c4d&req=ciMhFM93m4NXFb4f3HP0gBg3ZVFwC69FnXQ2yL9IugzbISTJlJdCxSGw8WZn%0ACZLEX6yGZzpqy7g6rg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269628/721ea26e00c7fabb92cfd4b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2e743732317a9de0744dc3371809b13f94d671f8447a3f42496d071875f3c4d&req=ciMhFM93m4NXFb4f3HP0gBg3ZVFwC69FnXQ2yL9IugzbISTJlJdCxSGw8WZn%0ACZLEX6yGZzpqy7g6rg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269695/c63848413f73f45d548ac4ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a78a0772baa3a169d51ad5c53c6c36ba8d3d9f5910c4122274cedfcec0ad274&req=ciMhFM93m4haFb4f3HP0gJZ25dUhjAl1dJ%2B8xUAtXl5xfNPhk%2Fzp4J2ornoV%0Au4U%2FNQKZePU79nGhBQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636269695/c63848413f73f45d548ac4ff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a78a0772baa3a169d51ad5c53c6c36ba8d3d9f5910c4122274cedfcec0ad274&req=ciMhFM93m4haFb4f3HP0gJZ25dUhjAl1dJ%2B8xUAtXl5xfNPhk%2Fzp4J2ornoV%0Au4U%2FNQKZePU79nGhBQ%3D%3D%0A)

Third-party Payers

Third-party Payers
==================

Creating a Third Party Payer

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6311960-third-party-payers#h_37c08774bd)

[Adding a Third-party Payer](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6311960-third-party-payers#h_c28034cf16)

[Exporting Third-party Payers](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6311960-third-party-payers#h_0e953a62c4)

[Emailing Third-party Payers](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6311960-third-party-payers#h_063fab62bb)

Overview
========

Third-party Payers are designed to manage invoicing for patient treatments that need to be addressed to an entity other than the patient. This allows invoicing to the Third-party on behalf of the patient once the payer has been linked to a patient's account.

Adding a Third-party Payer
--------------------------

#### Step 1:

Navigate to the **[Contacts > Third Party Payers](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/payers)** page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886444029/bc6a2b743d15eaa11878d15748a8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=68139c92abf90d8c7dffb33d560caa72878dd91f7c1bbaa18128384ec97657ec&req=dSgvEM16mYFdUPMW1HO4zdFYgrf%2BL4Jsvxwj%2FXjX4%2FGE%2BYfGGyI5PJNaNUuS%0AF38oCFODtjlEzpKSaYU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886444029/bc6a2b743d15eaa11878d15748a8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=68139c92abf90d8c7dffb33d560caa72878dd91f7c1bbaa18128384ec97657ec&req=dSgvEM16mYFdUPMW1HO4zdFYgrf%2BL4Jsvxwj%2FXjX4%2FGE%2BYfGGyI5PJNaNUuS%0AF38oCFODtjlEzpKSaYU%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Click **Add**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886529382/5fedff798d5123a66067b70c023c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df38c2d3cfdaf7802dd97b99e087e7cc9b1a7dbc93f262629877fa273bc1a415&req=dSgvEMx8lIJXW%2FMW1HO4zZH1xBrvgGhIro59Uh%2BBj4Uyl8iV7kuST1byHzgs%0AJ2o4gS96tCh3fxWLr4I%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886529382/5fedff798d5123a66067b70c023c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df38c2d3cfdaf7802dd97b99e087e7cc9b1a7dbc93f262629877fa273bc1a415&req=dSgvEMx8lIJXW%2FMW1HO4zZH1xBrvgGhIro59Uh%2BBj4Uyl8iV7kuST1byHzgs%0AJ2o4gS96tCh3fxWLr4I%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Fill in all the Third Party Payers contact information.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886530773/ada45b235c8bbc873d9aba4b2c3a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5277254b77f17ce26c47271f6bb2907639e0974228133cc8d7b72602da794c6f&req=dSgvEMx9nYZYWvMW1HO4zfKzXMAT5lrFwiFxJHe9PMxHEby8MGcc%2FUTVzJ9e%0AuEfzaUpr0%2BDIz43pDTk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886530773/ada45b235c8bbc873d9aba4b2c3a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5277254b77f17ce26c47271f6bb2907639e0974228133cc8d7b72602da794c6f&req=dSgvEMx9nYZYWvMW1HO4zfKzXMAT5lrFwiFxJHe9PMxHEby8MGcc%2FUTVzJ9e%0AuEfzaUpr0%2BDIz43pDTk%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886531981/cf607907e37c23d13026b217e786/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14254c89596163db7ebf5287577c294c6a43ec23a810d47946b0998d9a6124f6&req=dSgvEMx9nIhXWPMW1HO4zb%2Fg3g22vFdnBDw9o8XGzrO78seJb9lStNsP9cEa%0A7hmdQF0E1fVf07LILfg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886531981/cf607907e37c23d13026b217e786/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14254c89596163db7ebf5287577c294c6a43ec23a810d47946b0998d9a6124f6&req=dSgvEMx9nIhXWPMW1HO4zb%2Fg3g22vFdnBDw9o8XGzrO78seJb9lStNsP9cEa%0A7hmdQF0E1fVf07LILfg%3D%0A)

Exporting Third-party Payers
----------------------------

A list of all of your Third-party Payers can be exported to a spreadsheet by clicking on the Export button at the top of the [Contacts > Third-party Payers](https://app.pracsuite.com/contacts/contactslist/payers)
 page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886612972/1ec86d25d6426b0836cbab5b62fd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6fb15037ef7e5c0727ee04aae238a838685d9e0e19715c936378e5feb0063eb&req=dSgvEM9%2Fn4hYW%2FMW1HO4zTmlj%2FXnIdeu7gyRBiRykwrr96wtKIYtiZIkEJMm%0Apt%2Fn0XoRLDjvsVuuj2I%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886612972/1ec86d25d6426b0836cbab5b62fd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6fb15037ef7e5c0727ee04aae238a838685d9e0e19715c936378e5feb0063eb&req=dSgvEM9%2Fn4hYW%2FMW1HO4zTmlj%2FXnIdeu7gyRBiRykwrr96wtKIYtiZIkEJMm%0Apt%2Fn0XoRLDjvsVuuj2I%3D%0A)

Emailing Third-party Payers
---------------------------

You can email your Third-party Payers by clicking on the Send Email button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886614814/75f2552227d12f81b9abb665bba5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c7952153b5d28b84ecca5e60b8e730870fbc15ab3a1971feb844a995d96bdf87&req=dSgvEM9%2FmYleXfMW1HO4zZNofClFxUvas%2Bmlptf94BfDoRWBpTO%2BSSsPeGsZ%0ABssJni70CJKxmd%2B5Hb0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1886614814/75f2552227d12f81b9abb665bba5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c7952153b5d28b84ecca5e60b8e730870fbc15ab3a1971feb844a995d96bdf87&req=dSgvEM9%2FmYleXfMW1HO4zZNofClFxUvas%2Bmlptf94BfDoRWBpTO%2BSSsPeGsZ%0ABssJni70CJKxmd%2B5Hb0%3D%0A)

**Note**: You can edit the recipients from the email windows that opens after clicking the Send Email button.

You can find more information on linking a Third Party Payer to a patient file in this article: [Invoicing from a Patient File to a Third-party Payer](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6311974-invoicing-from-a-patient-file-to-a-third-party-payer)

You can find more information on setting invoice preferences for Third-party's in this article: [Third-party Payer Invoice Preferences](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4430416-third-party-payer-invoice-preferences)

## Document 251 — Invoicing from a Patient File to a Third-party Payer | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-251}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6311974-invoicing-from-a-patient-file-to-a-third-party-payer](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6311974-invoicing-from-a-patient-file-to-a-third-party-payer)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6311974-invoicing-from-a-patient-file-to-a-third-party-payer#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Patient File Management](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2601287-patient-file-management)

Invoicing from a Patient File to a Third-party Payer

Invoicing from a Patient File to a Third-party Payer
====================================================

Linking Third Party Payers to Patient Files

Updated over 2 months ago

In PracSuite, each patient **Account** can be linked to a **Third Party Payer** for invoicing purposes. When linked to a Third Party Payer, any invoices created on that patient account will be billed to the third-party instead of the patient themselves.

When patients are first created they will have a 'PRIMARY' account, which is typically used for private billing (i.e. the patient is paying). To invoice to a third-party, we recommend you create a **new account** to store all third-party invoices. For more information on creating Accounts, please see [this article](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5987114-adding-an-account-to-a-patient-file)
.

In this example we have created a new account called 'WORK COVER'. By default the account is created with a **Billing Type** of 'Private'.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636224401/ab5c0ca2e2ecaf8d8cac7598/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6f9daf05e40ce951aed1fc23dd118d2cd51c1bf897650ed5682c6c43c0daf386&req=ciMhFMt6mYFeFb4f3HP0gBeS%2BjZ3FN6BUNWrm2bhoslbCcKDxxxFRnYUY9yj%0AHqEyShfX52HSt%2BoXFQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636224401/ab5c0ca2e2ecaf8d8cac7598/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6f9daf05e40ce951aed1fc23dd118d2cd51c1bf897650ed5682c6c43c0daf386&req=ciMhFMt6mYFeFb4f3HP0gBeS%2BjZ3FN6BUNWrm2bhoslbCcKDxxxFRnYUY9yj%0AHqEyShfX52HSt%2BoXFQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Edit** to make changes to this account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636224532/d04c5d5f4d85df09094ac21c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eec9fa4d52abff9b60a1cd924f278f91edc2e56d301a6d3c049c4c0bcbd13989&req=ciMhFMt6mIJdFb4f3HP0gAsjaeeXikSEOB6uQOnQQxQP2GGWRH0NTzFkUezh%0AbLM9OsAjAkOAPIktUQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636224532/d04c5d5f4d85df09094ac21c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eec9fa4d52abff9b60a1cd924f278f91edc2e56d301a6d3c049c4c0bcbd13989&req=ciMhFMt6mIJdFb4f3HP0gAsjaeeXikSEOB6uQOnQQxQP2GGWRH0NTzFkUezh%0AbLM9OsAjAkOAPIktUQ%3D%3D%0A)

Under the **Billing Type** drop-down, change the account type from **Private** to **Third-Party**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636224775/700405ad51d210f038d13326/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7fd2fb8dce51ba159060553988473ad35d5794d9b6cbdf56cc925b627d0e3aef&req=ciMhFMt6moZaFb4f3HP0gJzoXknIS64wbXLrTAevbbsJrmQp3cEVZ3TXSg9G%0AIKxSpW3U6BByPCtkGA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636224775/700405ad51d210f038d13326/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7fd2fb8dce51ba159060553988473ad35d5794d9b6cbdf56cc925b627d0e3aef&req=ciMhFMt6moZaFb4f3HP0gJzoXknIS64wbXLrTAevbbsJrmQp3cEVZ3TXSg9G%0AIKxSpW3U6BByPCtkGA%3D%3D%0A)

In the **Bill To** section, select the desired **Third Party Payer**.  
​  
Note: If the **Third Party Payer** does not already exist, hovering over this field will display a '**+**' icon that allows a third-party to be created.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636224970/b258239317da10cbf65d61c8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6445d2d4318b4c4d4fd2386416147750eacbee714da914121b668ff11f5544b&req=ciMhFMt6lIZfFb4f3HP0gDs4fTDA6IuNsdInpmMrSgK9Ws%2F9VfMMSmasgThf%0AcD6JRe4v%2F%2FUDIH7Muw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636224970/b258239317da10cbf65d61c8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6445d2d4318b4c4d4fd2386416147750eacbee714da914121b668ff11f5544b&req=ciMhFMt6lIZfFb4f3HP0gDs4fTDA6IuNsdInpmMrSgK9Ws%2F9VfMMSmasgThf%0AcD6JRe4v%2F%2FUDIH7Muw%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636226620/a050bbcafc70778509033027/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eb086fce5268926d0087ce05134d25d9e5c172fc3ff42fd94bc62a1e5d0b822f&req=ciMhFMt4m4NfFb4f3HP0gEGV%2FbYth2AB7s17ORbSWUOtGSEHioJfj%2FZeNx%2FD%0Am0Rw2XhRqCm3Nb8bNg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636226620/a050bbcafc70778509033027/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eb086fce5268926d0087ce05134d25d9e5c172fc3ff42fd94bc62a1e5d0b822f&req=ciMhFMt4m4NfFb4f3HP0gEGV%2FbYth2AB7s17ORbSWUOtGSEHioJfj%2FZeNx%2FD%0Am0Rw2XhRqCm3Nb8bNg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636226707/b758fb0a311b1055adb95b39/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2f1284f051c50dc48804e4bf9a6260747c132f5d453225adf1b7724f5e0bce2&req=ciMhFMt4moFYFb4f3HP0gKUvHK2ynq0g2wBojH%2BEkHAWBiThm4ty1ljhgluh%0A%2FDDTt2qDHH%2FWhKbD9w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/636226707/b758fb0a311b1055adb95b39/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2f1284f051c50dc48804e4bf9a6260747c132f5d453225adf1b7724f5e0bce2&req=ciMhFMt4moFYFb4f3HP0gKUvHK2ynq0g2wBojH%2BEkHAWBiThm4ty1ljhgluh%0A%2FDDTt2qDHH%2FWhKbD9w%3D%3D%0A)

Success! You have successfully linked a patient **Account** to a **Third Party Payer**.  
​  
All invoices created on this account will now be addressed to the third-party, and will also appear on the Third Party Payer file (**Contacts** > **Third-Party Payers**) where they can be centrally managed.  
​  
Please note this account will follow the **invoice preferences** of the Third Party Payer, which includes whether you wish to '**Add to last open invoice by default**' and '**Include multiple patients on the same invoice**'. For more information on adjusting these invoicing preferences, which typically depends on the third-parties requirements, please see [this article](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4430416-third-party-payer-invoice-preferences)
.

How to add a Memo to the Messages tab of the Patient File
=========================================================

Adding Memos to the Messages tab of the Patient File

Updated over 3 years ago

The Memo functionality available within the Patient File > Messages tab allows users to manually add additional correspondence between themselves and the patient, such as email replies or other notes regarding patient correspondence, into the patient file.

To add a Memo, open the **Patient File > Messages tab**.

Click **Memo**.

PracSuite Post-migration Checklist
==================================

Updated over 3 years ago

**Congratulations on completing your migration to PracSuite!** We highly recommend reading through our post-migration checklist, which contains tips on how to get the most of your new system.

1\. Manual Data Entry
=====================

The first task following your migration is to manually transfer into PracSuite any data entered into your old software since Smartsoft collected a backup of your data.

===================

## Document 254 — Using Direct Online Booking Links | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-254}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6339111-using-direct-online-booking-links](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6339111-using-direct-online-booking-links)

[Adding Your Booking Page to Your Website](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984731-adding-your-booking-page-to-your-website)

Using Direct Online Booking Links

Using Direct Online Booking Links
=================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Finding a Direct URL](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6339111-using-direct-online-booking-links#h_812f5d1c56)

[Exporting Direct URLs in Bulk](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6339111-using-direct-online-booking-links#h_16db9080ab)

[Combining URLs To Create Unique Links](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6339111-using-direct-online-booking-links#h_782b9c7b75)

[Direct to Appointments, Classes or Login Page](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6339111-using-direct-online-booking-links#h_e8c8586dad)

After [configuring online bookings](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4766658-setting-up-online-bookings-in-pracsuite)
, you will have a general URL that should be placed on your website so that patients can access your PracSuite online booking system.

In addition to your general booking URL, PracSuite allows you to create direct booking URLs for specific **locations**, **services** and **practitioners**.

For example, if you have practitioner profile pages on your website, you can create a direct booking URL for each practitioner to add to their profile page, funnelling your patient into booking with that specific practitioner. The same can be done to book at a specific location or to book a specific service.

* * *

Finding a Direct URL
====================

To find a link, go to the relevant page, e.g. **Settings > Online Booking > Services** (or **Locations** or **Practitioners**)

Hover over an entry; on the right, you will have a **Copy** and an **Open** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/537096090/347114eb3e0e2e74dcd96dc8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c055f1f2484b13bc16e40e7dead80cb4c24c074583df778e31c247804a9f72c&req=cSMgFsB4nYhfFb4f3HP0gCalKyvtszaQJIXneyJyyZ7saUIQHiFC%2FfzdAADB%0AdM3KgxdeYgjhstfexQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/537096090/347114eb3e0e2e74dcd96dc8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c055f1f2484b13bc16e40e7dead80cb4c24c074583df778e31c247804a9f72c&req=cSMgFsB4nYhfFb4f3HP0gCalKyvtszaQJIXneyJyyZ7saUIQHiFC%2FfzdAADB%0AdM3KgxdeYgjhstfexQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Open** to preview how the page will look. In the above example, clients will skip the location option and automatically be booked into the Adelaide City location.

**Copy** the URL, which you can then pass on to your web developer to add a "Book at Adelaide City" styled button on a specific page on your website.

* * *

Exporting Direct URLs in Bulk
=============================

Rather than copy each link one by one, if you want to get a separate link for all Locations, for example, you can use the Export Direct Booking Links button at the top of the relevant page to produce a spreadsheet with every link you need. This makes it easy to pass on to your web developer to put in the direct booking buttons on your website.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/537097190/1d5244c5742a9700ae8dc85f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f96b0a453334d3469895d77b365739a998312b3cbf97e3005f1cf1070b92cf88&req=cSMgFsB5nIhfFb4f3HP0gOMLfUXYqQ8P%2FtvghLhLsyqtwh4IOiW4n7DNr8tw%0AeXH83J0uqpcUV8Wnnw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/537097190/1d5244c5742a9700ae8dc85f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f96b0a453334d3469895d77b365739a998312b3cbf97e3005f1cf1070b92cf88&req=cSMgFsB5nIhfFb4f3HP0gOMLfUXYqQ8P%2FtvghLhLsyqtwh4IOiW4n7DNr8tw%0AeXH83J0uqpcUV8Wnnw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Combining URLs To Create Unique Links
=====================================

Direct URLs can be constructed with multiple locations, services and/or practitioners.

*   A ? should always follow your general booking URL before adding direct URLs
    
*   Use commas to separate multiple direct URL IDs of the same type
    
*   Use an & to separate different direct URL ID types
    
*   When combining types, always use the order: Locations > Services - Practitioners
    

Below are some examples of how to construct direct URLs:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/634799798/c86c2addfba9dc296dfdd33e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b3b3e6ebcdffb06072bdc5737426d6dc648babd1a086a8c6a715bb9d7b94ad5a&req=ciMjEcB3mohXFb4f3HP0gIcIjthbaKMKa6%2FSK9Fd13AzU9ifEEMBTb%2Fqyj1q%0AaVsFqVIr07k0zxOp1Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/634799798/c86c2addfba9dc296dfdd33e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b3b3e6ebcdffb06072bdc5737426d6dc648babd1a086a8c6a715bb9d7b94ad5a&req=ciMjEcB3mohXFb4f3HP0gIcIjthbaKMKa6%2FSK9Fd13AzU9ifEEMBTb%2Fqyj1q%0AaVsFqVIr07k0zxOp1Q%3D%3D%0A)

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Description** | **Example** | **Example URL** |
| Filter multiple locations | Book at Adelaide or Prospect | _clinic.bookings.pracsuite.com?**l=4,5**_ |
| Filter to a specific service and practitioner | Book only Physio with Peter | _clinic.bookings.pracsuite.com**?s=2&p=1**_ |
| Filter multiple locations for a specific service and practitioner | Book only Massage with Jodie at Adelaide or Prospect | _clinic.bookings.pracsuite.com?**l=4,5&s=3&p=15**_ |

* * *

Direct to Appointments, Classes or Login Page
=============================================

The following parameters can be added after the general booking URL to hide certain booking paths.

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Parameter** | **Description** | **example** |
| **bt=c** | Enables class booking functions only and hides the individual appointment booking path | _clinic.bookings.pracsuite.com/_**?bt=c** |
| **bt=a** | Enables individual booking functions only and hides the class booking path | _clinic.bookings.pracsuite.com/_**?bt=a** |
| **bt=login** | Hides guest booking options and displays login path only (only supported if guest bookings is enabled) | _clinic.bookings.pracsuite.com/_**?bt=login** |
| **pt=n** | Hides existing patient booking paths and only displays new patient bookings path (only supported if guest bookings is enabled).<br><br>When combined with location, service and practitioner IDs, the first page of the booking process is skipped entirely. | _clinic.bookings.pracsuite.com/_**?pt=n** |
| **pt=e** | Hides new patient booking paths and only displays existing patient bookings path (only supported if guest bookings is enabled)<br><br>When combined with location, service and practitioner IDs, the first page of the booking process is skipped entirely. | _clinic.bookings.pracsuite.com/_**?pt=e** |

* * *

[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6347444-how-to-process-a-refund-from-an-invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6347444-how-to-process-a-refund-from-an-invoice)

How to Process a Refund from an Invoice

How to Process a Refund from an Invoice
=======================================

Refunding in PracSuite

Updated over 2 years ago

To refund a payment to a patient, go to the **Patient File > Invoices** tab**.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631925349/e907ad0ef64154f4f42ad688/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b0c74cdab689047481bc0b49c83cd5d3ef491d86b4ed81668f894aec3ff4f324&req=ciMmH8t7noVWFb4f3HP0gNAq4QNGy2DCF6hh3y5%2FltHQSbPsUJEKt6Gy0GeF%0ALFklXGkj5bSJklENjA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631925349/e907ad0ef64154f4f42ad688/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b0c74cdab689047481bc0b49c83cd5d3ef491d86b4ed81668f894aec3ff4f324&req=ciMmH8t7noVWFb4f3HP0gNAq4QNGy2DCF6hh3y5%2FltHQSbPsUJEKt6Gy0GeF%0ALFklXGkj5bSJklENjA%3D%3D%0A)

Click the **Invoice number** you need to Refund.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926666/a7c25d207aeb6a593ef65ba2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e7fc8d685b45d280a6ad56b280244ee1bee6b492c16e0d3e353a00abfa0136ac&req=ciMmH8t4m4dZFb4f3HP0gFE8lrZlgoMt%2B0Wgcgf%2FwQ6ddLMdPyL0at6RjU3o%0Asacvy7KH4saP%2BOGNhQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926666/a7c25d207aeb6a593ef65ba2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e7fc8d685b45d280a6ad56b280244ee1bee6b492c16e0d3e353a00abfa0136ac&req=ciMmH8t4m4dZFb4f3HP0gFE8lrZlgoMt%2B0Wgcgf%2FwQ6ddLMdPyL0at6RjU3o%0Asacvy7KH4saP%2BOGNhQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926762/7451df5ebc33f4812397cf67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3a5bda6b622ab56fb2d6827e3dd30856f5c4939dd1e0c6b41d89e0efb2ea0a6&req=ciMmH8t4moddFb4f3HP0gJOpwr6Ng7Yr%2Fcz9abVG2rOD3myjTJMymUHJtlXi%0AdlIjw6JyYouhs%2BoD8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926762/7451df5ebc33f4812397cf67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3a5bda6b622ab56fb2d6827e3dd30856f5c4939dd1e0c6b41d89e0efb2ea0a6&req=ciMmH8t4moddFb4f3HP0gJOpwr6Ng7Yr%2Fcz9abVG2rOD3myjTJMymUHJtlXi%0AdlIjw6JyYouhs%2BoD8w%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Refund**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926852/427da1757c9bb7affb083e29/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ec523fbdf15d9f504b5f45572028c39c62acb5a18782de596e52dab0b98ad7b0&req=ciMmH8t4lYRdFb4f3HP0gNMsFD%2FIvR2n0%2FbXpv1XrgvkbKv3gKi8E8BCYzLs%0AuohQGOotweUx7NifYg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926852/427da1757c9bb7affb083e29/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ec523fbdf15d9f504b5f45572028c39c62acb5a18782de596e52dab0b98ad7b0&req=ciMmH8t4lYRdFb4f3HP0gNMsFD%2FIvR2n0%2FbXpv1XrgvkbKv3gKi8E8BCYzLs%0AuohQGOotweUx7NifYg%3D%3D%0A)

**Type in the amount** to refund, _either the full amount or a partial amount_.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926894/cde40ac06f5170be0bbecb50/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d6f9cbb984d87f246d5c19fe4b08d196daefeefe742a951302d65c0ef9f3960&req=ciMmH8t4lYhbFb4f3HP0gIBEXxYWMk9eFHUH%2FCO6EL3J95F%2FuHEbnG0lGEtr%0AfWm%2FvRGgL0ImF6Hyiw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926894/cde40ac06f5170be0bbecb50/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d6f9cbb984d87f246d5c19fe4b08d196daefeefe742a951302d65c0ef9f3960&req=ciMmH8t4lYhbFb4f3HP0gIBEXxYWMk9eFHUH%2FCO6EL3J95F%2FuHEbnG0lGEtr%0AfWm%2FvRGgL0ImF6Hyiw%3D%3D%0A)

Or click the **Hand icon** to _refund the full amount_.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926974/731cf2424962251c617da677/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=39bcb75bc429fc1b945df6fe6a6d32df1f5df8ff372e14adc24ec4c8670cf96e&req=ciMmH8t4lIZbFb4f3HP0gHK3icfA%2FUJ3TO7fUfEvJiSQ4PI01uIGDcwRm6y%2B%0AyYMiiWVzdOzhtrpsjg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631926974/731cf2424962251c617da677/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=39bcb75bc429fc1b945df6fe6a6d32df1f5df8ff372e14adc24ec4c8670cf96e&req=ciMmH8t4lIZbFb4f3HP0gHK3icfA%2FUJ3TO7fUfEvJiSQ4PI01uIGDcwRm6y%2B%0AyYMiiWVzdOzhtrpsjg%3D%3D%0A)

**Type in a Reason for Refund**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631927121/bd8525eb0c20b5ca29df7434/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=29116ea7e1cd512f816bd9be7ccf4e525de634f829920507cc1f8014366ca01e&req=ciMmH8t5nINeFb4f3HP0gDAjz%2BPu6W1%2FwnlaBlbDiKSzED1J6avA7btc1%2Bfd%0A1NF9o3e3L5alGB%2B60g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631927121/bd8525eb0c20b5ca29df7434/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=29116ea7e1cd512f816bd9be7ccf4e525de634f829920507cc1f8014366ca01e&req=ciMmH8t5nINeFb4f3HP0gDAjz%2BPu6W1%2FwnlaBlbDiKSzED1J6avA7btc1%2Bfd%0A1NF9o3e3L5alGB%2B60g%3D%3D%0A)

**Choose how the Refund** is to be given, either by Cash (from takings), Cash (other), Bank Transfer, EFTPOS, Credit Card or Tyro Health EFTPOS.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631927232/d1a9e394cdef4dff01c444e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=461ff43fea3ad79749e61c551dd8649cdb27f5f949a1b501be4c0a7fe7a452b2&req=ciMmH8t5n4JdFb4f3HP0gKCAXUbz7kxwz7PKcRyoqcASyrdWn%2Fa0Qpe3DabT%0ARqfXVfZpNITTvtpPmw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631927232/d1a9e394cdef4dff01c444e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=461ff43fea3ad79749e61c551dd8649cdb27f5f949a1b501be4c0a7fe7a452b2&req=ciMmH8t5n4JdFb4f3HP0gKCAXUbz7kxwz7PKcRyoqcASyrdWn%2Fa0Qpe3DabT%0ARqfXVfZpNITTvtpPmw%3D%3D%0A)

_\*\* Please note, with the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration, Tyro will only be an option if the original payment was made via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration \*\*_

Click **Next**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631927282/ffc2275e1691e44cffcdb5e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=03fa83198d5afc91ae32f6b1c902d5469c75e8b507b3abc99556887165abb4a8&req=ciMmH8t5n4ldFb4f3HP0gG9ulu27Kxbfrtuf6HLNlwXzGZbF76l%2BQNFn0fwE%0AqK45vq7cPTXUGT2J7w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631927282/ffc2275e1691e44cffcdb5e1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=03fa83198d5afc91ae32f6b1c902d5469c75e8b507b3abc99556887165abb4a8&req=ciMmH8t5n4ldFb4f3HP0gG9ulu27Kxbfrtuf6HLNlwXzGZbF76l%2BQNFn0fwE%0AqK45vq7cPTXUGT2J7w%3D%3D%0A)

Choose how you would like PracSuite to handle the Item Code after the refund has been applied.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931156/1be6d4a51005bf84a86fe5d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b4fe51c97b981ca81814924dd33a3ca503bda202039401f6768cdf0a328ac72a&req=ciMmH8p%2FnIRZFb4f3HP0gOhPmXdYT%2BXHdymzdfSTmHO0je76jQCxw3URRUcr%0Aj%2BVGRfBunGsLoUfFBQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931156/1be6d4a51005bf84a86fe5d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b4fe51c97b981ca81814924dd33a3ca503bda202039401f6768cdf0a328ac72a&req=ciMmH8p%2FnIRZFb4f3HP0gOhPmXdYT%2BXHdymzdfSTmHO0je76jQCxw3URRUcr%0Aj%2BVGRfBunGsLoUfFBQ%3D%3D%0A)

There are one of four options:

*   **None - Add refund amount to item balance** - this makes the refunded item code outstanding.
    
*   **Discount equivalent to refund amount** - this discounts the fee to $0.00.
    
*   **Write-Off equivalent to refund amount** - this writes off the item code.
    
*   **Manual adjustment** \- allows you the choice to manually choose what you would like to do.
    

In this situation, I'm going to choose Discount equivalent to refund amount.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931266/df34ddd64425fe03dcb0c8e9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88619452649aa9b5f7c2f7eb461a9eb48d9de268956dedebe24f25b715d1a9da&req=ciMmH8p%2Fn4dZFb4f3HP0gJAudT0A72yOm63ESsnooWQbTmQSRpeaRYcPCMte%0AiYhUQFc6cg1VLq0ZbQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931266/df34ddd64425fe03dcb0c8e9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88619452649aa9b5f7c2f7eb461a9eb48d9de268956dedebe24f25b715d1a9da&req=ciMmH8p%2Fn4dZFb4f3HP0gJAudT0A72yOm63ESsnooWQbTmQSRpeaRYcPCMte%0AiYhUQFc6cg1VLq0ZbQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Next**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931300/8b1b648c045350bd6d01830a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb6f488074befc5d7342179a3ca83c7c2b3543ce724b9a8943d9b730e3f89318&req=ciMmH8p%2FnoFfFb4f3HP0gK%2F3H%2B32YjdFMFDyqh%2BvcXhvfIJLbvH5pZZs5GpP%0Alx2amA0h5k4Za%2FQoYw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931300/8b1b648c045350bd6d01830a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb6f488074befc5d7342179a3ca83c7c2b3543ce724b9a8943d9b730e3f89318&req=ciMmH8p%2FnoFfFb4f3HP0gK%2F3H%2B32YjdFMFDyqh%2BvcXhvfIJLbvH5pZZs5GpP%0Alx2amA0h5k4Za%2FQoYw%3D%3D%0A)

If the Item being refunded is a Stock Item, you will be given the option to return the item back into Stock.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931398/9a86bc3fe71f5b891ff19557/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a1627e8b91904203924254d0e2175c5004dacb9d10806c0961f559086ed42a2e&req=ciMmH8p%2FnohXFb4f3HP0gEUe97zRBxA402yhvBc%2B301rM2YNyux4zs2JQ6NR%0AS5keUlNwFmkOpLOHhg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931398/9a86bc3fe71f5b891ff19557/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a1627e8b91904203924254d0e2175c5004dacb9d10806c0961f559086ed42a2e&req=ciMmH8p%2FnohXFb4f3HP0gEUe97zRBxA402yhvBc%2B301rM2YNyux4zs2JQ6NR%0AS5keUlNwFmkOpLOHhg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Next**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931447/d1554052a116e01891866836/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=000e874f99955d0bfea8bae4b4d303335730f1a153ed4a8c1f9e2ac8050908b3&req=ciMmH8p%2FmYVYFb4f3HP0gMsfx6ypmWghuffJdy3um6Bo2syK5imTYa4gYBMO%0Ak4xLcSN0j7mA3wjxhg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631931447/d1554052a116e01891866836/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=000e874f99955d0bfea8bae4b4d303335730f1a153ed4a8c1f9e2ac8050908b3&req=ciMmH8p%2FmYVYFb4f3HP0gMsfx6ypmWghuffJdy3um6Bo2syK5imTYa4gYBMO%0Ak4xLcSN0j7mA3wjxhg%3D%3D%0A)

A confirmation window will show.

How to find an Unallocated Credit

How to find an Unallocated Credit
=================================

Finding Unallocated Credits

Updated over 10 months ago

Table of contents

[Private or Family Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6350772-how-to-find-an-unallocated-credit#h_63b003e32e)

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6350772-how-to-find-an-unallocated-credit#h_edd79ff73c)

[Third-Party Payer Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6350772-how-to-find-an-unallocated-credit#h_391a83e6df)

[Using an Unallocated Credit](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6350772-how-to-find-an-unallocated-credit#h_e56c5b348e)

Depending on the type of account you're working with, the unallocated payment or credit may be located in one of two places.

*   If you're working with a private or family account, the credit will appear on the patient's file
    
*   If you're working with an account linked to a third-party payer, the credit will appear on the payer file.
    

**Private or Family Account**
=============================

To find an Unallocated Credit on a private account, go to the patient file.

Select the **Invoices** tab in the sidebar.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631934819/996d0ab148234e5d309c9359/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c0fdf8987e282cf15e787f53ba16b94ed4bae0d0b36b421e56013ddab2a5d140&req=ciMmH8p6lYBWFb4f3HP0gPBJwekpvfRtOVBfvcCzDIDfQu9I4xyz3i0xg6y3%0AhRJ99YMUut%2BeCyIwsQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631934819/996d0ab148234e5d309c9359/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c0fdf8987e282cf15e787f53ba16b94ed4bae0d0b36b421e56013ddab2a5d140&req=ciMmH8p6lYBWFb4f3HP0gPBJwekpvfRtOVBfvcCzDIDfQu9I4xyz3i0xg6y3%0AhRJ99YMUut%2BeCyIwsQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Payments** tab**.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631937056/9d92d3253505dda1ed98aefc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2137257644be885d074d540ad24d5ecfe267a1ec415e8952c681fd8c203f5521&req=ciMmH8p5nYRZFb4f3HP0gPze4mUsz2PrNgMpW8h7z7QojKARHGzEzdoZdupd%0AoF%2BkpE7VeA3OHWhCmg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631937056/9d92d3253505dda1ed98aefc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2137257644be885d074d540ad24d5ecfe267a1ec415e8952c681fd8c203f5521&req=ciMmH8p5nYRZFb4f3HP0gPze4mUsz2PrNgMpW8h7z7QojKARHGzEzdoZdupd%0AoF%2BkpE7VeA3OHWhCmg%3D%3D%0A)

Select '**Show unallocated payments only**' to filter the payments grid to payments that have outstanding credit amounts.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461974886/76c815c9d1068d661f35db37ce1f/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_21_47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=33d83e9c62620cfb406c53d3e628d5f513d5310a128816b9ed5cb99c53a090b1&req=dSQhF8B5mYlXX%2FMW1HO4zScOC1wQcDSHxxKK1A1vS5SI8ziiSDSjX0L6CXYB%0AtFuit6ksOJZ%2FPD5hwFM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461974886/76c815c9d1068d661f35db37ce1f/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_21_47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=33d83e9c62620cfb406c53d3e628d5f513d5310a128816b9ed5cb99c53a090b1&req=dSQhF8B5mYlXX%2FMW1HO4zScOC1wQcDSHxxKK1A1vS5SI8ziiSDSjX0L6CXYB%0AtFuit6ksOJZ%2FPD5hwFM%3D%0A)

**Third-Party Payer Account**
=============================

To find an unallocated credit on a patient account that is linked to a Third-Party Payer, you will need to go to the payer file.

Select the link to the payer from the accounts tab on the patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461979033/4e9286096debb8aee09f259db3f4/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_28_45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ba5495d853fbe54923c5474164e0aa65caec6a2f75359c45713ebab22747468a&req=dSQhF8B5lIFcWvMW1HO4za8M0KGvIZoCb4kk9GQLikLRGYHvZl0OpVs3DSrv%0A57CmzVK2wxNwe0mnogI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1461979033/4e9286096debb8aee09f259db3f4/CleanShot+2025-04-07+at+10_28_45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ba5495d853fbe54923c5474164e0aa65caec6a2f75359c45713ebab22747468a&req=dSQhF8B5lIFcWvMW1HO4za8M0KGvIZoCb4kk9GQLikLRGYHvZl0OpVs3DSrv%0A57CmzVK2wxNwe0mnogI%3D%0A)

Alternatively, go to the **Contacts** menu at the top of PracSuite and select **Third-Party Payers.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/646344785/fa27ec725769527d545d43eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=74a8fe60c26a37e9339fce3cb3f8d21e675d96c625416a75367c948f2ee09c38&req=ciQhFc16molaFb4f3HP0gGFr11CTKWSCO38%2BEz1hrnHaujes9UYTJgqPekOj%0AXgrMBGkrK0TrsqYsIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/646344785/fa27ec725769527d545d43eb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=74a8fe60c26a37e9339fce3cb3f8d21e675d96c625416a75367c948f2ee09c38&req=ciQhFc16molaFb4f3HP0gGFr11CTKWSCO38%2BEz1hrnHaujes9UYTJgqPekOj%0AXgrMBGkrK0TrsqYsIA%3D%3D%0A)

Find and select the Third-Party Payer file the Patient is linked to.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/646346214/ef44ea6f1ac7fb36663b32a9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=413d64b0036aea019272d53f9e6a44fa7e13341adabdbc181c3d6ffb80e7fd37&req=ciQhFc14n4BbFb4f3HP0gLVA7nTvOmtRs8cmz8HfXMMl85bdUF26gWNlhSAH%0AvWxJF%2FvNOP4rdGBMSg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/646346214/ef44ea6f1ac7fb36663b32a9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=413d64b0036aea019272d53f9e6a44fa7e13341adabdbc181c3d6ffb80e7fd37&req=ciQhFc14n4BbFb4f3HP0gLVA7nTvOmtRs8cmz8HfXMMl85bdUF26gWNlhSAH%0AvWxJF%2FvNOP4rdGBMSg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Invoices** tab in the sidebar.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/646346981/2a0e9fd56e38d45bf470a7c2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c5120ae2949cd928fe2caa5b59bc34decbd08e4727e7108b4ac7648b1a030508&req=ciQhFc14lIleFb4f3HP0gHXHRxZ1mEN9c9Q3uUKHoYpkXa9Kc5WHxz5W4TOZ%0A1bqqS9qDPk5wcFR7Xg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/646346981/2a0e9fd56e38d45bf470a7c2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c5120ae2949cd928fe2caa5b59bc34decbd08e4727e7108b4ac7648b1a030508&req=ciQhFc14lIleFb4f3HP0gHXHRxZ1mEN9c9Q3uUKHoYpkXa9Kc5WHxz5W4TOZ%0A1bqqS9qDPk5wcFR7Xg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Payments** tab.

How to Clear Tyro Health EFTPOS Terminal Pairings

How to Clear Tyro Health EFTPOS Terminal Pairings
=================================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Follow the instructions below to clear any Tyro terminal pairings with existing software:

1.  On the Tyro Terminal, press menu.
    
2.  Go to 5 - Configuration.
    
3.  Enter in your store manager PIN.
    
4.  Go to Integrated EFTPOS.
    
5.  Go to 3 - Clear Pairings.
    
6.  Select YES to confirm you want to clear the pairing.

## Document 260 — How to Generate a Utilisation Report | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-260}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6366231-how-to-generate-a-utilisation-report](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6366231-how-to-generate-a-utilisation-report)

[Report Overviews](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984789-report-overviews)

How to Generate a Utilisation Report

How to Generate a Utilisation Report
====================================

Utilisation Report

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Understanding Utilisable Time](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6366231-how-to-generate-a-utilisation-report#h_ba62eb64e6)

[Understanding Utilised Time](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6366231-how-to-generate-a-utilisation-report#h_8f3ffaeb7d)

[Interpreting Report Results](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6366231-how-to-generate-a-utilisation-report#h_7a63739cc9)

The [Utilisation Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/appointment/utilisation)
 is an advanced report designed to calculate how much of a practitioner's available time on the appointment book is being utilised. This is achieved by defining **utilisable time** (i.e. time that can be utilised by the practitioner for appointments or other tasks) using the practitioner's **roster**. You will also define what should and should not contribute as **utilised time**.

This article covers:

*   [Understanding Utilisable Time](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6366231-how-to-generate-a-utilisation-report#h_ba62eb64e6)
    
*   [Defining what types of appointments count as utilised time](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6366231-how-to-generate-a-utilisation-report#h_8f3ffaeb7d)
    
*   [Interpreting Report Results](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6366231-how-to-generate-a-utilisation-report#h_7a63739cc9)
    

Understanding Utilisable Time
=============================

Utilisable Time is directly related to the **rules** on a practitioner's **roster**. Specifically, when you create rules on a roster, you decide whether that time can be used for **manual appointments**, **online bookings** and/or the **waiting list**.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/812514017/92b83f9d1424cc182a6ecabb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a07845b09eb050b7f3a92d0ed1e37b1ccc04b8b54fcc51b14fb9472b36fcb60&req=fCElE8h6nYBYFb4f3HP0gFsLh74Hm3opvT%2FqpcWKII6vfrC7VPqmLjTr3O66%0At6U44nJfiI6xSTqEvg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/812514017/92b83f9d1424cc182a6ecabb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a07845b09eb050b7f3a92d0ed1e37b1ccc04b8b54fcc51b14fb9472b36fcb60&req=fCElE8h6nYBYFb4f3HP0gFsLh74Hm3opvT%2FqpcWKII6vfrC7VPqmLjTr3O66%0At6U44nJfiI6xSTqEvg%3D%3D%0A)

When setting **Utilisable Time**, the report will refer to the these settings on the roster to determine what you consider '_time available to be utilised_' by the practitioner.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/812513552/a8119992df24c96e1360386a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=94a3f27c62c9fe94555a7b493d57f5f6873d30a6f025373030a6e257478c8ab0&req=fCElE8h9mIRdFb4f3HP0gF8GiGnCSSjlxZrnM64XvynezautsoSVuu%2BNBHM2%0AeP%2BQIkBFiQSgOftX0g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/812513552/a8119992df24c96e1360386a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=94a3f27c62c9fe94555a7b493d57f5f6873d30a6f025373030a6e257478c8ab0&req=fCElE8h9mIRdFb4f3HP0gF8GiGnCSSjlxZrnM64XvynezautsoSVuu%2BNBHM2%0AeP%2BQIkBFiQSgOftX0g%3D%3D%0A)

As a general rule, we recommend defining a practitioner's utilisable time based on slots available for online booking and the waiting list by using the filters below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/810171531/c4eeb2ec7356b34591ff6560/CleanShot+2023-08-18+at+11.41.15.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee8836985e492af7debb60ffb49ca8d9c44896e55cc65ddfe7c91e857887a670&req=fCEnF85%2FmIJeFb4f3HP0gElBm2KTk%2FehntiW4T1RrXLM0DdP9seNbds6X2H1%0Ayr7DlYUUiuqX8ATjsw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/810171531/c4eeb2ec7356b34591ff6560/CleanShot+2023-08-18+at+11.41.15.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee8836985e492af7debb60ffb49ca8d9c44896e55cc65ddfe7c91e857887a670&req=fCEnF85%2FmIJeFb4f3HP0gElBm2KTk%2FehntiW4T1RrXLM0DdP9seNbds6X2H1%0Ayr7DlYUUiuqX8ATjsw%3D%3D%0A)

In most practices, online booking and waiting list availability will generally correspond to times practitioners are available to see patients, and will exclude breaks and meetings etc. Slots available for manual bookings are commonly used in case of emergency bookings or adding notes, but not for general availability.

Understanding Utilised Time
===========================

After defining **_Utilisable_** Time, you will need to decide what is considered **_Utilised_** time for comparison (i.e. what on the appointment is counted as 'utilised' time, for comparison with 'utilisable' time). The following options are available for **Utilised Time**:

*   **Appointments** - Choose which appointment types should count as utilised time.
    
*   **Group Appointments** - Choose which group appointment types should count as utilised time.
    
*   **Empty Group Appointments** - Should empty groups count as utilised time?
    
*   **Notes** \- Should Notes count as utilised time?
    
*   **Rule Outs** \- Should Rule Outs count as utilised time?
    

There is also a unique _option_ to **Count utilisation outside of Utilisable Slots**, which means the report will count utilisation (following your selections above) even if this appears outside of what you've set as 'utilisable' time.

By manipulating the above filters, it's possible to determine how much time a practitioner has booked with a particular appointment type. For example, if you choose only your initial consult appointment type(s), you can determine what percentage of a practitioner's schedule contains initial consults.

Interpreting Report Results
===========================

After setting your preferred filters, click **Generate Report**. The results can also be exported as Excel or CSV.

Along with an overall percentage utilised figure, the results provide a breakdown of how many utilisable (available) and utilised slots the practitioner has in their schedule and an hourly figure based on their appointment book interval.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/811701666/9ede78a713d0a3fed6b1085c/CleanShot+2023-08-21+at+14.31.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5e7e39960215226b4bd37e7a2affce60f71b6283c324e01557d53b285fd7a62&req=fCEmEcl%2Fm4dZFb4f3HP0gPKHh6yBrcOuHdI3A0lgkLZj1gch55Yh97%2Fnkz5K%0AmNy3ildUqxBztxLSfg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/811701666/9ede78a713d0a3fed6b1085c/CleanShot+2023-08-21+at+14.31.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5e7e39960215226b4bd37e7a2affce60f71b6283c324e01557d53b285fd7a62&req=fCEmEcl%2Fm4dZFb4f3HP0gPKHh6yBrcOuHdI3A0lgkLZj1gch55Yh97%2Fnkz5K%0AmNy3ildUqxBztxLSfg%3D%3D%0A)

If you have enabled the **Count utilisation outside of Utilisable Slots** mentioned above, it's possible to see the utilisation percentage figure exceeding 100%. As the filter implies, it counts any appointments booked outside of slots you've defined as utilisable time.

For example, if you define utilisable time as slots available for online bookings and the waiting list, this filter will also count appointments in manual booking periods.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/811701790/24e1769d4d19828ea81b4f1e/CleanShot+2023-08-21+at+14.32.22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9065dfe8e89287143f23ae41915ae8d2ebecef19ea5c23e19a37541f7f27e992&req=fCEmEcl%2FmohfFb4f3HP0gM80Pm9dSfmqNSX5piN%2BHpuYjQUxI3Z%2By7Jz8djH%0A6N3b%2FX4%2ByEmvLM3Rew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/811701790/24e1769d4d19828ea81b4f1e/CleanShot+2023-08-21+at+14.32.22.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9065dfe8e89287143f23ae41915ae8d2ebecef19ea5c23e19a37541f7f27e992&req=fCEmEcl%2FmohfFb4f3HP0gM80Pm9dSfmqNSX5piN%2BHpuYjQUxI3Z%2By7Jz8djH%0A6N3b%2FX4%2ByEmvLM3Rew%3D%3D%0A)

Notice Board Widget
===================

Notice Board Widget

The Notice Board Widget can be added to your home screen to publish announcements for staff members, such as welcoming a new staff member and notifying staff of after-hour gatherings.

To add the Notice Board Widget, click the **[PracSuite logo](https://app.pracsuite.com/)
** or the **home icon** in the top left of PracSuite.

Click **Customise** in the top right of PracSuite.

Using the Share Notes feature

Using the Share Notes feature
=============================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Enabling Sharing For Your Notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6382092-using-the-share-notes-feature#h_8cfb365834)

[Managing Sharing Settings on Behalf of Another Practitioner](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6382092-using-the-share-notes-feature#h_65be5637ee)

The **Share Notes** feature is designed to allow practitioners access to clinical notes that they are typically restricted from viewing. This allows for sharing notes on a per-patient basis, which can include confidential notes, files and forms.  
​  
​**e.g.** The practitioner 'John Smith' is only allowed to view their own clinical notes by default, as configured under [Settings > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)
. A situation arises that requires John to view the notes of another practitioner called 'Peter Provider', for a particular patient. The practitioner 'Peter Provider' can now use the "Share Notes" feature to share his notes with 'John Smith' for the requested patient.

**Note:** For a user to share their notes with another practitioner, they must have their user profile linked with their practitioner file as seen below. Please ensure that this has been completed in [Settings > Users & Security.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777841098/5b74368847c1c25d8aadc927/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=689cc8b6e30ac5628b64720c7aa095eba5b3d111c86ecc6ca25d8d1704194c55&req=cycgHs1%2FnYhXFb4f3HP0gJvN4In8OuX%2BMjUFo43wWILVEFIpXoblXicSiQEe%0ABMCRV5mAuFCOUK9Z0w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777841098/5b74368847c1c25d8aadc927/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=689cc8b6e30ac5628b64720c7aa095eba5b3d111c86ecc6ca25d8d1704194c55&req=cycgHs1%2FnYhXFb4f3HP0gJvN4In8OuX%2BMjUFo43wWILVEFIpXoblXicSiQEe%0ABMCRV5mAuFCOUK9Z0w%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Enabling Sharing For Your Notes
===============================

  
To share your clinical notes, go to the **Clinical Notes** tab of the patient file on which you wish to share notes and select the **Share Notes** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777850108/05f295f75067b375d464f7c4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1340b22dd2585f5f806d0059b1cd8598c845d3c14258713e4b5568d2fc2c7876&req=cycgHsx%2BnIFXFb4f3HP0gGf9A9tt2Boc3QZO20zgzhUJuUubC4suJIM%2BxxzR%0AG%2BgG5cb8YKJO6S8pQg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777850108/05f295f75067b375d464f7c4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1340b22dd2585f5f806d0059b1cd8598c845d3c14258713e4b5568d2fc2c7876&req=cycgHsx%2BnIFXFb4f3HP0gGf9A9tt2Boc3QZO20zgzhUJuUubC4suJIM%2BxxzR%0AG%2BgG5cb8YKJO6S8pQg%3D%3D%0A)

Once enabled, you will be given options on the notes being shared, and who they are being shared with. You can also select whether to share your confidential notes, confidential files and confidential form responses.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777851327/1d821aaef63fc3000722e70d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e5cd5c06ddab7966ad8ee92d6bd252ad89a3b4d48d3d59106499bc86f16d45f8&req=cycgHsx%2FnoNYFb4f3HP0gB8UrYsbRoGYSmxoH5gu8bPmQ7uGLJyz1xV8OvQN%0AC8dUnCWquuTmOVMvLg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777851327/1d821aaef63fc3000722e70d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e5cd5c06ddab7966ad8ee92d6bd252ad89a3b4d48d3d59106499bc86f16d45f8&req=cycgHsx%2FnoNYFb4f3HP0gB8UrYsbRoGYSmxoH5gu8bPmQ7uGLJyz1xV8OvQN%0AC8dUnCWquuTmOVMvLg%3D%3D%0A)

You can then select which practitioners you are sharing these clinical notes with. This can be **All Businesses & Practitioners**, or specific **Businesses**, **Professions** and **Practitioners**.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777849994/9717e76417bcc897503ba687/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d131fe8dfc8777fd1808e2b3f514d684d128e1b105718ac73eb2ae64b14d096f&req=cycgHs13lIhbFb4f3HP0gLaXR2JNUOrSMsfclgE4i9EBAGjX6c8e4wwkIKhw%0AVMW4BBqdWhMYo0qcpQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777849994/9717e76417bcc897503ba687/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d131fe8dfc8777fd1808e2b3f514d684d128e1b105718ac73eb2ae64b14d096f&req=cycgHs13lIhbFb4f3HP0gLaXR2JNUOrSMsfclgE4i9EBAGjX6c8e4wwkIKhw%0AVMW4BBqdWhMYo0qcpQ%3D%3D%0A)

The Share Notes button will display a green tick to indicate when sharing is active for a patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777850231/b037a5c249e82648da0fbbf7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0761a4d2902688ded5eeef0d1cdec32f729d78e34c5280f324a65344342494d0&req=cycgHsx%2Bn4JeFb4f3HP0gB%2FiKD7W79MoS0n406QGcB20YeKaz9NUsHsLNKmH%0Ayoo0dCt4w7Qlth0Ubw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777850231/b037a5c249e82648da0fbbf7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0761a4d2902688ded5eeef0d1cdec32f729d78e34c5280f324a65344342494d0&req=cycgHsx%2Bn4JeFb4f3HP0gB%2FiKD7W79MoS0n406QGcB20YeKaz9NUsHsLNKmH%0Ayoo0dCt4w7Qlth0Ubw%3D%3D%0A)

Clinical notes that have been shared with you will include a Shared label as shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777853561/c02abb0e43a3a1a8112c7d05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=30faeb952d4e6d6b70074d54d66ff4d96395eedb4276b48711b99d8eb0dc94c5&req=cycgHsx9mIdeFb4f3HP0gBxpIwRdOV65Uen%2FxynZVnsu%2Fsw4pWaj5fQHg29l%0AS5Zq5a1X%2Bwm65QieOQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777853561/c02abb0e43a3a1a8112c7d05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=30faeb952d4e6d6b70074d54d66ff4d96395eedb4276b48711b99d8eb0dc94c5&req=cycgHsx9mIdeFb4f3HP0gBxpIwRdOV65Uen%2FxynZVnsu%2Fsw4pWaj5fQHg29l%0AS5Zq5a1X%2Bwm65QieOQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Managing Sharing Settings on Behalf of Another Practitioner
===========================================================

If the user is a 'System Administrator' or has a role with 'Clinical Administrator' privileges, this will also allow them to use the 'Share Notes' function on behalf of any practitioner.

When using the Share Notes function as a System Administrator or Clinical Notes Administrator, you'll see an additional drop-down named '**Change Sharing Permission For**'. Select a practitioner in the list to manage their sharing permissions for the patient file you're on.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777850910/ae6b7248f10d71564c51be9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5233db77d0bafbea3c5ccfdacacbde8d82875e021aa74bef14023ef40d386ed2&req=cycgHsx%2BlIBfFb4f3HP0gN4S9goeuyLjYcrIAQEiVf4pzEfyNIUzJbABsHUu%0AgSOfGGgQMYhIereaww%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/777850910/ae6b7248f10d71564c51be9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5233db77d0bafbea3c5ccfdacacbde8d82875e021aa74bef14023ef40d386ed2&req=cycgHsx%2BlIBfFb4f3HP0gN4S9goeuyLjYcrIAQEiVf4pzEfyNIUzJbABsHUu%0AgSOfGGgQMYhIereaww%3D%3D%0A)

Note: This will be hidden for practitioners who only have permission to share their own notes.

## Document 263 — Using 'Fee Adjustments' to update Fees, Discounts and Rebates across multiple Item Codes | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-263}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6435015-using-fee-adjustments-to-update-fees-discounts-and-rebates-across-multiple-item-codes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6435015-using-fee-adjustments-to-update-fees-discounts-and-rebates-across-multiple-item-codes)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6435015-using-fee-adjustments-to-update-fees-discounts-and-rebates-across-multiple-item-codes#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Invoicing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413899-invoicing)

[Settings and Preferences](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984698-settings-and-preferences)

Using 'Fee Adjustments' to update Fees, Discounts and Rebates across multiple Item Codes

Using 'Fee Adjustments' to update Fees, Discounts and Rebates across multiple Item Codes
========================================================================================

Updated over 3 years ago

**Fee Adjustments** can be used to update the **Fees**, **Discounts** and **Rebates** of multiple item codes at once. This can be used to change the fee, discount and rebate amounts by a percentage or fixed value. Users can also make manual adjustments as required, along with changing which item codes are GST inclusive.  
​  
Go to **[Settings](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/feeadjustments)** [\> **Billing** \> **Fee Adjustments**](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/feeadjustments)
.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594936519/d8e0d5e2dd52d61a08df10b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=70be3a1a2aa66ef3bafd6a5cea6933866a6b6939ca0953fc7b9f07f8852a0529&req=cSkjH8p4mIBWFb4f3HP0gNEpr6K%2BVvey3T1qHGaCF6auUsQ0xcKO1YNkK42j%0AJkRTQ8jG7JZhxZnWSQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594936519/d8e0d5e2dd52d61a08df10b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=70be3a1a2aa66ef3bafd6a5cea6933866a6b6939ca0953fc7b9f07f8852a0529&req=cSkjH8p4mIBWFb4f3HP0gNEpr6K%2BVvey3T1qHGaCF6auUsQ0xcKO1YNkK42j%0AJkRTQ8jG7JZhxZnWSQ%3D%3D%0A)

Click **[New Fee Adjustment](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/feeadjustments/new)** to create an adjustment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594936941/e46374c5d22f3e69898cf5b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85df8eb870439a2e21d3f00c95f366d99701c95588bddb57e3a46c3895679bc5&req=cSkjH8p4lIVeFb4f3HP0gMY0kD%2Bv7Rnjt7dSae1pdA1GWN9Yw3E2pZBXvuan%0A3QVFJVcJKGkXM4QoKg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594936941/e46374c5d22f3e69898cf5b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85df8eb870439a2e21d3f00c95f366d99701c95588bddb57e3a46c3895679bc5&req=cSkjH8p4lIVeFb4f3HP0gMY0kD%2Bv7Rnjt7dSae1pdA1GWN9Yw3E2pZBXvuan%0A3QVFJVcJKGkXM4QoKg%3D%3D%0A)

Enter a **Description** for this Fee Adjustment, such as 'July Increase 202X'

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937165/7f9bb18072b3b7a0bf0ef65b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4a297e313ac9b2ec611af1c910f5b556576bedcc0112b2d71d50f7a7f964f87&req=cSkjH8p5nIdaFb4f3HP0gHr%2FpFRL18GNpldr%2B1gi%2BUN5XrBY9%2FjkPc%2FFAPxG%0AqMM9uiDk6n18muYoKQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937165/7f9bb18072b3b7a0bf0ef65b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4a297e313ac9b2ec611af1c910f5b556576bedcc0112b2d71d50f7a7f964f87&req=cSkjH8p5nIdaFb4f3HP0gHr%2FpFRL18GNpldr%2B1gi%2BUN5XrBY9%2FjkPc%2FFAPxG%0AqMM9uiDk6n18muYoKQ%3D%3D%0A)

Next select an appropriate **Adjustment Type**, which can be:

*   Percentage Increase
    
*   Percentage Decrease
    
*   Fixed Increase
    
*   Fixed Decrease
    
*   Manual
    

The '**percentage**' types will apply a percentage increase or decrease across all the selected items, whereas the '**fixed**' options will apply a fixed amount increase or decrease. The '**manual**' type will not apply any adjustment automatically, and will rely on the user to adjust each fee in the grid results (after previewing).  
​  
With the **Adjustment Type** selected, enter an **Amount** and select whether to apply this adjustment to the item code's **Fees, Discounts** or **Rebates**.  
​  
In this example we are going to do a **Percentage Increase** of **15%** and apply this to our **Fees**:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937244/8c31eae06874efa96ec2ff41/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e831f32d94381aa1196c5e898144184929217674fad15a53dab5b891680a00a&req=cSkjH8p5n4VbFb4f3HP0gMSdWwKZ%2FlRFLtyjwSMQE9A5Dhif9jjFD0EycsFy%0A74QeWZdZzmNcnOp4nA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937244/8c31eae06874efa96ec2ff41/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5e831f32d94381aa1196c5e898144184929217674fad15a53dab5b891680a00a&req=cSkjH8p5n4VbFb4f3HP0gMSdWwKZ%2FlRFLtyjwSMQE9A5Dhif9jjFD0EycsFy%0A74QeWZdZzmNcnOp4nA%3D%3D%0A)

Users can set the **Item** and **Fee Category** filters to only apply the adjustment to specific Item Codes or Fee Categories. In this case we are only going to apply the 15% increase to items in the '**Service**' schedule, and only for the **Private**, **Family** and **Concession** fee categories.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937504/8b784a37e911c7274973bb6d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=50e81030bd46bdfa9a8f75a972da8ea6ac41c0dcf4f701819219eacb409d41ed&req=cSkjH8p5mIFbFb4f3HP0gFPj0EqtyesZjOeoa6tZGXvQ7NV25sGxQsPdhbSp%0AXhPAcNfNIUbUIvfSPw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937504/8b784a37e911c7274973bb6d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=50e81030bd46bdfa9a8f75a972da8ea6ac41c0dcf4f701819219eacb409d41ed&req=cSkjH8p5mIFbFb4f3HP0gFPj0EqtyesZjOeoa6tZGXvQ7NV25sGxQsPdhbSp%0AXhPAcNfNIUbUIvfSPw%3D%3D%0A)

There are additional '**Display**' options available, if the user doesn't want to see unnecessary columns in the results. There are also additional '**Options**' including:

*   **Round to nearest 5 cents, 10 cents, 50 cents, or dollar**  
    This is only available when applying a percentage increase, and allows users to specify rounding for the adjustment.
    
*   **Apply adjustments to $0.00 amounts**  
    Many users intentionally set fees at $0.00 for unrelated Fee Categories within an Item Code. For example, if an item is only being sold to 'Medicare' patients they may have intentionally left the fee at $0.00 for all other patient categories. This option determines whether the adjustment is applied to Fee Categories with a $0.00 amount, and is off by default.
    
*   **Include Inactive Item Codes**  
    Applies the adjustment to inactive item codes.
    

With the appropriate **Filters** and **Options** selected, click **Preview Fees** to continue. This will not immediately apply the fee adjustment to the selected item codes, but will instead generate a list of changes for the user to review.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937585/00699cbb94f83746c8502e79/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=717cf302c05c6861719af36f6d322102029a17599f880bfe474eb4023d19f995&req=cSkjH8p5mIlaFb4f3HP0gMrW%2FF32puiufK99R4vvYSfW5bp1cBZPHlD5F2XT%0AIm%2FP2O48txRvUB3gvA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937585/00699cbb94f83746c8502e79/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=717cf302c05c6861719af36f6d322102029a17599f880bfe474eb4023d19f995&req=cSkjH8p5mIlaFb4f3HP0gMrW%2FF32puiufK99R4vvYSfW5bp1cBZPHlD5F2XT%0AIm%2FP2O48txRvUB3gvA%3D%3D%0A)

Carefully review the changes displayed in the grid results, which details the updated **Fees**, **Discounts** and **Rebates** alongside the current values.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937988/22f5fd8336f36a929ffa6b5b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2749bedef36fa3bc8cc92712646f5b7e8e0da21d65a889c6971760a673c4522&req=cSkjH8p5lIlXFb4f3HP0gMKy9XQ4gij9sAIvsHqTgYvQYCjKkw%2FMqIsdnvSi%0AtmTNJSa85W9X2LV0ug%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594937988/22f5fd8336f36a929ffa6b5b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2749bedef36fa3bc8cc92712646f5b7e8e0da21d65a889c6971760a673c4522&req=cSkjH8p5lIlXFb4f3HP0gMKy9XQ4gij9sAIvsHqTgYvQYCjKkw%2FMqIsdnvSi%0AtmTNJSa85W9X2LV0ug%3D%3D%0A)

If required, users can make further changes manually by directly typing into the grid results below. You can also adjust whether an item is GST inclusive.  
​  
After reviewing the adjusted fees, use the **Save & Process** button to make this change immediately. Otherwise use the drop-down if you'd like to **Save as Draft** or **Save & Schedule**:

*   **Save as Draft** will save this Fee Adjustment for another time, where it can be re-opened and adjusted further before being processed (or scheduled).  
    ​
    
*   **Save & Schedule** will allow the user to specify a date on which these fee changes will take effect.
    

Before any fee adjustment is processed or scheduled, a pop-up will appear for users to confirm. This will require users to type specific text before continuing to prevent accidental processing of fee adjustments.

**Please be aware that Fee adjustments cannot be reversed once processed**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594938230/0e9ae651a355147ce0e1abff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df92c9c2505a9201e14b5fdfd9639f062744498d7872235426b220990e0dc02d&req=cSkjH8p2n4JfFb4f3HP0gBIu6MuZUdpSj%2BfzBfoSL5EgLQmXFBwmfxAntftR%0ATbB7pFqp4jeAoAOV5A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594938230/0e9ae651a355147ce0e1abff/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df92c9c2505a9201e14b5fdfd9639f062744498d7872235426b220990e0dc02d&req=cSkjH8p2n4JfFb4f3HP0gBIu6MuZUdpSj%2BfzBfoSL5EgLQmXFBwmfxAntftR%0ATbB7pFqp4jeAoAOV5A%3D%3D%0A)

Once the Fee Adjustment has been saved or processed, it will appear in the main '**Fee Adjustments**' screen (**[Settings > Billing > Fee Adjustments](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/feeadjustments)
**).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594940181/3514814846a7ddaa1fdf8c46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=375d6709b39aba8ded2b301b51f75b1df7de172517e3ba6fdd22b6ae15d63fb8&req=cSkjH81%2BnIleFb4f3HP0gIglocJXvXMp2eeLV7spRDLydjDaI2kFCMTIoXYj%0AGjB%2BA2flzk3qqLkn9A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594940181/3514814846a7ddaa1fdf8c46/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=375d6709b39aba8ded2b301b51f75b1df7de172517e3ba6fdd22b6ae15d63fb8&req=cSkjH81%2BnIleFb4f3HP0gIglocJXvXMp2eeLV7spRDLydjDaI2kFCMTIoXYj%0AGjB%2BA2flzk3qqLkn9A%3D%3D%0A)

Users can click on any **Fee Adjustment** in this list to re-open the full adjustment. If the Fee Adjustment has yet to be processed (i.e. it is a draft or scheduled) the user can make further changes as needed.  
​  
As noted above, please proceed with caution and ensure you have reviewed all adjustments thoroughly prior to processing. Changes cannot be reversed once processed.

Appointment Tooltip Preferences

Appointment Tooltip Preferences
===============================

Updated over 6 months ago

When hovering over an appointment on the appointment book, a tooltip appears with key patient information, as well as the option to display the following:

*   Patient File Notes and Warnings
    
*   Treatment Plan
    
*   Referring Doctor
    
*   Recalls
    
*   Health Fund card details
    
*   Medicare/DVA card details
    
*   Other Benefits (Concession Card and NDIS details)
    
*   Passes and remaining redemptions
    
*   Patient Tags
    

Follow the instructions below to adjust the order of the bottom row of the tooltip.

Go to the **Appointment Book**, select the **Settings** icon in the bottom left-hand corner and choose **Tooltip Preferences**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652079141/329e1f151b6909bf60f2acb9d911/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ceef785c63a71830628ee805b8d67c877c07501625fd3a5cd9631320b600ff7&req=dSYiFMl5lIBbWPMW1HO4zRS14mvobEDKqD4kBd9XK5rKOS9wyjNeus%2Bmiag1%0AbtMCQumdOdZkF4dolvA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1652079141/329e1f151b6909bf60f2acb9d911/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ceef785c63a71830628ee805b8d67c877c07501625fd3a5cd9631320b600ff7&req=dSYiFMl5lIBbWPMW1HO4zRS14mvobEDKqD4kBd9XK5rKOS9wyjNeus%2Bmiag1%0AbtMCQumdOdZkF4dolvA%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594928359/20386212bd8ff6bed7c075ed/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e9696322b42acd09e3f55e4c8376dec71ba5aafb9827f11e06d32f02ed19a10a&req=cSkjH8t2noRWFb4f3HP0gAxNbWJ9xlY2QqR9SYRqTervvPRnK%2Fd1zSMcqULq%0AHMegbEWaWc82W2n8WA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594928359/20386212bd8ff6bed7c075ed/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e9696322b42acd09e3f55e4c8376dec71ba5aafb9827f11e06d32f02ed19a10a&req=cSkjH8t2noRWFb4f3HP0gAxNbWJ9xlY2QqR9SYRqTervvPRnK%2Fd1zSMcqULq%0AHMegbEWaWc82W2n8WA%3D%3D%0A)

Select which tiles you would like to display in the appointment tooltip. Use the drag handle to re-order the tiles.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594928536/0e7e3f3bccad0c76ad89cc8a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8f1e1e9f47258052a24a8a750eb56efbd34d6b17a078e203d2e2ffaf080aa66&req=cSkjH8t2mIJZFb4f3HP0gPHEdsp%2F%2BLdibmU%2FmBWhcI12npyrBUNS74qE5mHM%0A8%2FEcwwVSJ%2Fxzo3oX3A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594928536/0e7e3f3bccad0c76ad89cc8a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8f1e1e9f47258052a24a8a750eb56efbd34d6b17a078e203d2e2ffaf080aa66&req=cSkjH8t2mIJZFb4f3HP0gPHEdsp%2F%2BLdibmU%2FmBWhcI12npyrBUNS74qE5mHM%0A8%2FEcwwVSJ%2Fxzo3oX3A%3D%3D%0A)
