Patient Time Zones

Patient Time Zones
==================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Time Zone in Appointment Confirmations and Reminders](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6516678-patient-time-zones#h_5bc4a05169)

[Time Zone on the Online Booking Site](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6516678-patient-time-zones#h_0a3c4c208a)

PracSuite allows you to store a patient's time zone on their file, primarily to send confirmations and reminders to the patient listing their appointment time in their own time zone. This is ideal for practices offering telehealth appointments around the country. It is also possible for patients to see appointments in their time zone when booking online.

To enable this feature, go to **[Settings > General](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general)** and enable the **Store Time Zone Per Patient** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594912149/4a624086fec94dbde2b0b1b4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b40349be3faff6b50f501d99cde77d5c6ffab6eb50ffeadea7f0ac7bca745a8f&req=cSkjH8h8nIVWFb4f3HP0gEnU69Zo0IZDvO4x4ojsIUIsRMA6MMclHZdz0%2B03%0AsFa3znOJK1GhadQ7LA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594912149/4a624086fec94dbde2b0b1b4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b40349be3faff6b50f501d99cde77d5c6ffab6eb50ffeadea7f0ac7bca745a8f&req=cSkjH8h8nIVWFb4f3HP0gEnU69Zo0IZDvO4x4ojsIUIsRMA6MMclHZdz0%2B03%0AsFa3znOJK1GhadQ7LA%3D%3D%0A)

When enabled, you will see a new field to store the patient's time zone on the patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594912325/737797d635d281170d48d116/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c73dfea64023c65c46def52655960be112fb53725a0a4b27761653ecef8ea86&req=cSkjH8h8noNaFb4f3HP0gCpofWxY19spCw5qBOaOhPF3aJMqj4QNn098EsQx%0A6nM%2BVV4TejQcQq5xyg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594912325/737797d635d281170d48d116/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c73dfea64023c65c46def52655960be112fb53725a0a4b27761653ecef8ea86&req=cSkjH8h8noNaFb4f3HP0gCpofWxY19spCw5qBOaOhPF3aJMqj4QNn098EsQx%0A6nM%2BVV4TejQcQq5xyg%3D%3D%0A)

Time Zone in Appointment Confirmations and Reminders
====================================================

To send appointment confirmations and reminders to patients with times listed in the patient's time zone, **you must include the following letter tag:**

**<<AppointmentTimePatientTZ>>**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594913187/a81541b83ccac1b59ca6924a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2d97c6e70fcb74b1137a799809c22fe1a3b8dc4457d2a8488cc90fd80d4250e1&req=cSkjH8h9nIlYFb4f3HP0gC2kJE24SHLOBtWyT7FLh9W2EE5EC%2F03ujL1DEvo%0AuIQBrNWuSctU%2Bsfvsw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594913187/a81541b83ccac1b59ca6924a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2d97c6e70fcb74b1137a799809c22fe1a3b8dc4457d2a8488cc90fd80d4250e1&req=cSkjH8h9nIlYFb4f3HP0gC2kJE24SHLOBtWyT7FLh9W2EE5EC%2F03ujL1DEvo%0AuIQBrNWuSctU%2Bsfvsw%3D%3D%0A)

If you include the standard <<AppointmentTime>> tag, this will display appointments in your PracSuite time zone.

Time Zone on the Online Booking Site
====================================

When **Store Time Zone Per Patient** is enabled**,** you will have the option to display a time zone selector on the online booking site. This will allow patients to view appointments in their own time zone while booking online.

Go to [Settings > Online Booking > Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
.

Ensure the Patient Time Zone slider is enabled in the 'Information to Collect' section.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594917620/12c811f3c63e281379a5c96f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7336eedd493bc314507510b05e4734c6ff1c975739e02e360be5319deadbec5d&req=cSkjH8h5m4NfFb4f3HP0gPvzzWSmj8oF76Rm%2BOgr4XBGqIFzA%2F4FcAFRSeR7%0AqeIXNQj9Sav%2Fat6DaQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594917620/12c811f3c63e281379a5c96f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7336eedd493bc314507510b05e4734c6ff1c975739e02e360be5319deadbec5d&req=cSkjH8h5m4NfFb4f3HP0gPvzzWSmj8oF76Rm%2BOgr4XBGqIFzA%2F4FcAFRSeR7%0AqeIXNQj9Sav%2Fat6DaQ%3D%3D%0A)

When appointment times are displayed, the time zone selector will be displayed at the top of the page. Time zones within your country will be displayed, with the patient's device time zone automatically detected.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/574531469/251ff17f3c8b056581a3115f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dbfe10d72a3ae4a50ab6e7260e83e7d10cf0b623d8d3ba7aa6d77ccf2d721989&req=cScjE8p%2FmYdWFb4f3HP0gIOkk82qvCE01XRiCefnIVX6D4UPGVOkdbfhzZuw%0AX9XitXDnakQbcKLAHw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/574531469/251ff17f3c8b056581a3115f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dbfe10d72a3ae4a50ab6e7260e83e7d10cf0b623d8d3ba7aa6d77ccf2d721989&req=cScjE8p%2FmYdWFb4f3HP0gIOkk82qvCE01XRiCefnIVX6D4UPGVOkdbfhzZuw%0AX9XitXDnakQbcKLAHw%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 266 — Having trouble logging into PracSuite? | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-266}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6540500-having-trouble-logging-into-pracsuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6540500-having-trouble-logging-into-pracsuite)

Having trouble logging into PracSuite?

Having trouble logging into PracSuite?
======================================

Forgotten password, issues logging in and 2FA

Updated over a week ago

If you or another user are having trouble logging into PracSuite, please confirm the following:  
​﻿﻿  
​﻿﻿**1) Is the email address you are entering correct?**  
﻿The email address you enter into PracSuite must be the one registered to your account.  
​﻿﻿  
​﻿﻿**2) Is your password correct?**  
﻿If you are unsure, it may be best to follow the [Reset Password](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242876-how-to-reset-your-password)
 procedure and reset your password. If you are relying on a _saved_ password, such as in your browser, please note this may no longer be accurate. We recommend you re-type your password manually just in case.

If you cannot answer the security questions to reset your password, please contact a **System Administrator** at your business for assistance. This is typically the business owner or Practice Manager, who can follow [these steps](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4242877-how-to-reset-another-user-s-password-as-a-system-administrator)
 to reset your password.

If you are a **System Administrator** assisting another user with login issues, please contact us from your own logged-in account for further help.  
​  
If you are a **System Administrator** who cannot log in to your _own_ account, you should first reach out to any other System Administrator at your business for assistance. Smartsoft can only provide support in this situation if you are the business owner and the sole System Administrator on the account.

​﻿﻿  
​﻿﻿**3) Is the time on your devices accurate?**  
﻿Your 2FA code is time-sensitive. This means that your mobile and computer must have the correct time and cannot be a few minutes slow or fast.  
​﻿﻿  
​**4) Are you entering the correct 2FA code from your device?**  
﻿In the _Authenticator_ app on your phone, ensure you are entering the code for your PracSuite account, which should have your PracSuite email address listed alongside the 2FA code.  
​  
​**5) Still having trouble? Reset your Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**  
By this step you have confirmed your using the correct login details and tried resetting your password. If you are still unable to login, it could be because your 2FA code is incorrect or no longer valid.  
​  
Please contact your **System Administrator** and have them follow [these steps](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4229484-how-to-reset-two-factor-authentication)
 to reset your two-factor authentication.  
​

* * *

  
​﻿﻿To notify your System Administrator and request assistance, please click the **Request Login Assistance** button from the login screen:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594905967/b7410931144c22233a694eea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb3b2f957a28d59409b5a8640d6f760e7572cd34f5ca9134a053055071f59471&req=cSkjH8l7lIdYFb4f3HP0gMCtAFNDz%2FxnYsw9iHKxWTCF8Jajq8TZKdhIqXOA%0AH7IJnf0TXHVzSk2KfQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/594905967/b7410931144c22233a694eea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb3b2f957a28d59409b5a8640d6f760e7572cd34f5ca9134a053055071f59471&req=cSkjH8l7lIdYFb4f3HP0gMCtAFNDz%2FxnYsw9iHKxWTCF8Jajq8TZKdhIqXOA%0AH7IJnf0TXHVzSk2KfQ%3D%3D%0A)

This will send an email to the System Administrator of your organisation with further instructions. At this stage you may wish to call them separately to expedite the process.﻿﻿

Creating a Dashboard in PracSuite

Creating a Dashboard in PracSuite
=================================

Dashboard Creation

Updated over 2 years ago

The **Dashboard** is a powerful reporting utility allowing users to add and configure widgets that display live statistics, offering insight into your business performance. Each widget can be displayed as a single value, graph or table and can be filtered to individual businesses, professions or practitioners.

To create a new **Dashboard** go to **[Reports > Dashboard](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/dashboard)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781468997/d2335b17cd422a8817cf2819/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=50d63a83c011d48756d86152602ba0355c7a30ffb2cf8a1386268cbf102dd0b0&req=cygmEs92lIhYFb4f3HP0gD2Oerntq0SFjeXU00iT1LXK7x%2BpaAjoPZpR5fVb%0AX34agvRQ0f8oC1wWUw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781468997/d2335b17cd422a8817cf2819/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=50d63a83c011d48756d86152602ba0355c7a30ffb2cf8a1386268cbf102dd0b0&req=cygmEs92lIhYFb4f3HP0gD2Oerntq0SFjeXU00iT1LXK7x%2BpaAjoPZpR5fVb%0AX34agvRQ0f8oC1wWUw%3D%3D%0A)

Click **New Dashboard**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469129/f154868eaf463f249ff9e68a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fbfd2075b9e2b1e17a29a9937e02d57e212d45bb5395ce63ac55726dedb989c5&req=cygmEs93nINWFb4f3HP0gJoCtRmbz7YMB%2FoFgVN53JCOYNl8kQSfBJNb%2FKrW%0A672P8z6VLK07Riq7BQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469129/f154868eaf463f249ff9e68a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fbfd2075b9e2b1e17a29a9937e02d57e212d45bb5395ce63ac55726dedb989c5&req=cygmEs93nINWFb4f3HP0gJoCtRmbz7YMB%2FoFgVN53JCOYNl8kQSfBJNb%2FKrW%0A672P8z6VLK07Riq7BQ%3D%3D%0A)

The **New Dashboard** pop-up will appear, where you can enter a **Name** for this dashboard.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469454/db18b2890875f892004426dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a2454554d4cb73cb6ca975811b5e60cd3808be268ef083b349c5a23542a58e1&req=cygmEs93mYRbFb4f3HP0gM%2FQt9SwVkqUEEHVg4Zt2crnDPVxElEurRDTHUz%2F%0A9MqWcoLgsrVECf7rdA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469454/db18b2890875f892004426dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a2454554d4cb73cb6ca975811b5e60cd3808be268ef083b349c5a23542a58e1&req=cygmEs93mYRbFb4f3HP0gM%2FQt9SwVkqUEEHVg4Zt2crnDPVxElEurRDTHUz%2F%0A9MqWcoLgsrVECf7rdA%3D%3D%0A)

Optionally, you can use the **Copy From** drop-down to duplicate an existing dashboard (including widgets). If you would like to create a new 'blank' dashboard this drop-down can be left as '**\-- CREATE NEW --**'.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469546/bbb24e14288e02c8877659db/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=221c38bdfa6a34c0d5449d991e2b2ea99e1ab78163fb0e8025fcd4a6d8aa2bd0&req=cygmEs93mIVZFb4f3HP0gJT%2B8q8UCHxxyYAJlHZ2RRY9leddYPj8ie9t%2BG%2FO%0AUqzdjnu4oUhEz%2B43tA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469546/bbb24e14288e02c8877659db/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=221c38bdfa6a34c0d5449d991e2b2ea99e1ab78163fb0e8025fcd4a6d8aa2bd0&req=cygmEs93mIVZFb4f3HP0gJT%2B8q8UCHxxyYAJlHZ2RRY9leddYPj8ie9t%2BG%2FO%0AUqzdjnu4oUhEz%2B43tA%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Owner** drop-down to set the owner of this dashboard.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469624/946e997be6b15ecad6c78483/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26d256a10e558bf44482085ef4102afac714c596fa171414c983e6785713485c&req=cygmEs93m4NbFb4f3HP0gLXSHpkAJ2FoJw5M5K3ZNQV86P4SsTM08BNdkud0%0Ahl%2BImV3yZcKwYCTaMw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469624/946e997be6b15ecad6c78483/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26d256a10e558bf44482085ef4102afac714c596fa171414c983e6785713485c&req=cygmEs93m4NbFb4f3HP0gLXSHpkAJ2FoJw5M5K3ZNQV86P4SsTM08BNdkud0%0Ahl%2BImV3yZcKwYCTaMw%3D%3D%0A)

The **Share Dashboard With** section then determines who should have access to this dashboard. The sharing options are as follows:  
​  
\- **_All Users Read-Only_**  
All users can view this dashboard, but only the owner can make changes.  
​  
\- **_All Users Full Access_**  
All users can view and edit this dashboard.  
​  
\- **_Specific Roles and Users_**  
Roles and users are added manually, and the owner can specify read-only or full access as needed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469878/15f4ba4f8340d9aefd64c651/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de9c177d54d9d68bada98318ab366d8e150f9390222d88651b85bb2b79e0dba9&req=cygmEs93lYZXFb4f3HP0gFTbRp9SzigECDfEBr7b4txDjI1%2FNc7ejWEBmSoF%0A6YYjK%2Boc5YqGh79Jqg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781469878/15f4ba4f8340d9aefd64c651/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de9c177d54d9d68bada98318ab366d8e150f9390222d88651b85bb2b79e0dba9&req=cygmEs93lYZXFb4f3HP0gFTbRp9SzigECDfEBr7b4txDjI1%2FNc7ejWEBmSoF%0A6YYjK%2Boc5YqGh79Jqg%3D%3D%0A)

For more information about how to use the **Dashboard**, [click here](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6571538-using-dashboards-in-pracsuite)
.

How to Delete an Unallocated Payment / Credit

How to Delete an Unallocated Payment / Credit
=============================================

Deleting Unallocated Payments / Credits

Updated over 10 months ago

If you have an Unallocated Payment / Credit you wish to delete follow the guide below.

[If you are unsure of how to locate the Unallocated Payment / Credit, click here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6350772-how-to-find-an-unallocated-credit-on-a-patient-s-file)

Once the Unallocated Payment / Credit has been found, **select the payment** by clicking the **tickbox to the left**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582544524/ac266746a0a4f9a70743636a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f4b330c775ee1232982e60dea23b6c9c7bb97aab093d592746d628902bed445f&req=cSglE816mINbFb4f3HP0gN%2F%2BIufMnNszx0g6sw3ay5Gfuv1bOwMUlqtymt%2Bn%0A1K3kvB%2F0kpKbvhkZew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582544524/ac266746a0a4f9a70743636a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f4b330c775ee1232982e60dea23b6c9c7bb97aab093d592746d628902bed445f&req=cSglE816mINbFb4f3HP0gN%2F%2BIufMnNszx0g6sw3ay5Gfuv1bOwMUlqtymt%2Bn%0A1K3kvB%2F0kpKbvhkZew%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Delete**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582544681/dcde24862427bd2e947f696c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6aeaac7a47b5d7f2a49930149735fccc9b3e3c87ff6f7887096b559714c9b384&req=cSglE816m4leFb4f3HP0gOikpnI79gTWAiTuOYOawqR57HcYPEkbfjquZ1NQ%0AIznx555UrydmXlWD5g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582544681/dcde24862427bd2e947f696c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6aeaac7a47b5d7f2a49930149735fccc9b3e3c87ff6f7887096b559714c9b384&req=cSglE816m4leFb4f3HP0gOikpnI79gTWAiTuOYOawqR57HcYPEkbfjquZ1NQ%0AIznx555UrydmXlWD5g%3D%3D%0A)

Type in a **reason** for the deletion.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582544952/c36c3254e617137bd6d91957/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=250fb192672652af9ff7bb0c8581068ef5d674538a4eb2ed1066edec998a3890&req=cSglE816lIRdFb4f3HP0gEOXUXLcc8Y4sOkrFs4FbF7Z%2F%2BcxgmXuEwMyqNNy%0AYVdStDPtKxSNgSkmDg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582544952/c36c3254e617137bd6d91957/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=250fb192672652af9ff7bb0c8581068ef5d674538a4eb2ed1066edec998a3890&req=cSglE816lIRdFb4f3HP0gEOXUXLcc8Y4sOkrFs4FbF7Z%2F%2BcxgmXuEwMyqNNy%0AYVdStDPtKxSNgSkmDg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Next**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582545145/434a8f83623ecac0b50b14cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=89b31615b9837d7131e6270337c2bea8fc22abe7298ec17e9c938e1ef91dc1ad&req=cSglE817nIVaFb4f3HP0gJ36o%2FLiyw4AM3Z%2FSf4%2Blhm%2FSL6S8OEiawH0fBor%0ATU70RUEoOzmFSENRPQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582545145/434a8f83623ecac0b50b14cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=89b31615b9837d7131e6270337c2bea8fc22abe7298ec17e9c938e1ef91dc1ad&req=cSglE817nIVaFb4f3HP0gJ36o%2FLiyw4AM3Z%2FSf4%2Blhm%2FSL6S8OEiawH0fBor%0ATU70RUEoOzmFSENRPQ%3D%3D%0A)

To confirm the deletion, click **Delete**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582545476/1854e389ec501aca15964d28/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b6bbc7fe4ee3a6c68ca21c9e39c7139a0c5d902ff26bcd33e35ca35a9187be33&req=cSglE817mYZZFb4f3HP0gHKXY%2FHSBbvlgHZoSFwi1baqvyy64oPUBhpdeHnm%0A3rXRE4kKm89vPQEm3A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/582545476/1854e389ec501aca15964d28/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b6bbc7fe4ee3a6c68ca21c9e39c7139a0c5d902ff26bcd33e35ca35a9187be33&req=cSglE817mYZZFb4f3HP0gHKXY%2FHSBbvlgHZoSFwi1baqvyy64oPUBhpdeHnm%0A3rXRE4kKm89vPQEm3A%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 269 — Using Dashboards in PracSuite | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-269}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6571538-using-dashboards-in-pracsuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6571538-using-dashboards-in-pracsuite)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6571538-using-dashboards-in-pracsuite#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Reporting](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2419427-reporting)

[Dashboard](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984787-dashboard)

Using Dashboards in PracSuite

Using Dashboards in PracSuite
=============================

Dashboard and Widgets

Updated over 2 years ago

**Dashboards** are a tool for visualizing data by adding and configuring widgets, which display live statistics and information and provide insight into your business performance.  
​  
The following widgets are available:

*   **Appointment Totals**  
    The total number of appointments in a date range, broken down by date, appointment type, business, profession or practitioner.  
    ​
    
*   **Billing Totals**  
    Billing or payment totals in a date range, broken down by date, practitioner, profession, business, item code, fee category, schedule or third-party payer.  
    ​
    
*   **Patient Visit Average**  
    A Patient Visit Average for each practitioner, or the total for a business or profession.  
    ​
    
*   **Online Bookings**  
    The total number of online bookings in a date range, broken down by date, appointment type, business, profession or practitioner.  
    ​
    
*   **Unique Patients**  
    The total number of patients with an appointment or transaction in a date range.  
    ​
    
*   **Appointment Book Utilisation**  
    The percentage of utilised time on the Appointment Book, broken down by date, practitioner or business.
    

To add a widget to the dashboard, click **Add Widget**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781447955/0913d4f8014f2b9f3e2dab67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2562cdb66e26a38c86cb3af509e2288b4d7a4d2ed58a32f599d7d01e66b3b0c&req=cygmEs15lIRaFb4f3HP0gAc06dawUv8EHpZ7FdWmpGFtv%2FQ1ArkHwChv9bq1%0AOZKxpwUNXg2D1jBkRw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781447955/0913d4f8014f2b9f3e2dab67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2562cdb66e26a38c86cb3af509e2288b4d7a4d2ed58a32f599d7d01e66b3b0c&req=cygmEs15lIRaFb4f3HP0gAc06dawUv8EHpZ7FdWmpGFtv%2FQ1ArkHwChv9bq1%0AOZKxpwUNXg2D1jBkRw%3D%3D%0A)

Select a widget to add to your dashboard.  
​  
In this example we are selecting the **Appointment Totals** widget.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448197/1f5b8ce510bd61e9e4a920dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c86b9e6c61cb6ef30d89b59137be435deb8588d3af000cbad27215d9615bdcb2&req=cygmEs12nIhYFb4f3HP0gBFfxjD5sT3zDKTUqHaevBQp48WX6AjvnqkFr0FY%0A5FXXogyMh%2FaIH8YFDg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448197/1f5b8ce510bd61e9e4a920dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c86b9e6c61cb6ef30d89b59137be435deb8588d3af000cbad27215d9615bdcb2&req=cygmEs12nIhYFb4f3HP0gBFfxjD5sT3zDKTUqHaevBQp48WX6AjvnqkFr0FY%0A5FXXogyMh%2FaIH8YFDg%3D%3D%0A)

Enter a **Name** for the widget.  
​  
This should be something descriptive, based on your intended use of the widget and the filters you are selecting.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448350/867c4fe26bc39b0e71783286/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52d5bd773920cc2ec9c57b7089e01f1f63cba9f27030c08e19afc09d47d74100&req=cygmEs12noRfFb4f3HP0gBeuEkBZqYBKu9L25ziiUrMmVumLGkT%2F4omg8Jsy%0APKNmBxttAaaWLQgvFg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448350/867c4fe26bc39b0e71783286/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52d5bd773920cc2ec9c57b7089e01f1f63cba9f27030c08e19afc09d47d74100&req=cygmEs12noRfFb4f3HP0gBeuEkBZqYBKu9L25ziiUrMmVumLGkT%2F4omg8Jsy%0APKNmBxttAaaWLQgvFg%3D%3D%0A)

Choose how you'd like the information in the widget to be presented, either a **Value**, **Table** or **Graph**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448583/0f1d058f7b568c3eac476a93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c562cc3d6b65696900f3db3b51f5c3debc808103241bb9ba4455e91f305d4ea7&req=cygmEs12mIlcFb4f3HP0gAJuyidzY%2F8dPAcNQ2w4j5vLgTJlQY25TjyZkVsb%0A1te%2BQtuanlui9RNvqQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448583/0f1d058f7b568c3eac476a93/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c562cc3d6b65696900f3db3b51f5c3debc808103241bb9ba4455e91f305d4ea7&req=cygmEs12mIlcFb4f3HP0gAJuyidzY%2F8dPAcNQ2w4j5vLgTJlQY25TjyZkVsb%0A1te%2BQtuanlui9RNvqQ%3D%3D%0A)

Choose a **Date Range**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448711/fe3f260e33c18f49de1b8969/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0976e68bd3e1ed2d948af3ca19471344c61f6395ed6257ebcb1b2a145d2e1fe1&req=cygmEs12moBeFb4f3HP0gPvqeX8GuwMWab2agoAqnMHcYG3Nh8bwDZGJr2iw%0ACoDvyjuE3sVVyqCDMw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448711/fe3f260e33c18f49de1b8969/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0976e68bd3e1ed2d948af3ca19471344c61f6395ed6257ebcb1b2a145d2e1fe1&req=cygmEs12moBeFb4f3HP0gPvqeX8GuwMWab2agoAqnMHcYG3Nh8bwDZGJr2iw%0ACoDvyjuE3sVVyqCDMw%3D%3D%0A)

Use the Compare option if you'd like a comparison against a historical date range (e.g. 'This Month' vs 'Last Month).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448808/b62c0fa100235c1ded3bbef5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8ada96fbbf6ab3f462711e2aab85912bfe78662269e3da1b7093fe61bb6eaeb7&req=cygmEs12lYFXFb4f3HP0gDRBk2rlpXe1Mj6sfz%2BbbmgGrC5kzkPl43wQLTxI%0A2arWEOsnXXXiEXrb0Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781448808/b62c0fa100235c1ded3bbef5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8ada96fbbf6ab3f462711e2aab85912bfe78662269e3da1b7093fe61bb6eaeb7&req=cygmEs12lYFXFb4f3HP0gDRBk2rlpXe1Mj6sfz%2BbbmgGrC5kzkPl43wQLTxI%0A2arWEOsnXXXiEXrb0Q%3D%3D%0A)

Choose a **Business**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452155/0565e66db3e440e25f360cfc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bcb54c68b0a1a9ad763343902028daa888ed4dac2d64fd398674dec00e929685&req=cygmEsx8nIRaFb4f3HP0gKPOo8NQmosaXMaSx5UStyfxTQiMqGnN9vcfJguZ%0AQlIRbfp2NDIUs1niTw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452155/0565e66db3e440e25f360cfc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bcb54c68b0a1a9ad763343902028daa888ed4dac2d64fd398674dec00e929685&req=cygmEsx8nIRaFb4f3HP0gKPOo8NQmosaXMaSx5UStyfxTQiMqGnN9vcfJguZ%0AQlIRbfp2NDIUs1niTw%3D%3D%0A)

Choose a **Profession**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781468155/4f92ba950dbbd56064037e3f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=38460ed4a2992eadc9b72f96aa81e6543dfd062e4c4090953d3d15342f6f743d&req=cygmEs92nIRaFb4f3HP0gNo2ACda9Kw9LoKht66Pa6q1wXKi93WIxzRmzYko%0AATpeQh3pQnkjNr%2FVTA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781468155/4f92ba950dbbd56064037e3f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=38460ed4a2992eadc9b72f96aa81e6543dfd062e4c4090953d3d15342f6f743d&req=cygmEs92nIRaFb4f3HP0gNo2ACda9Kw9LoKht66Pa6q1wXKi93WIxzRmzYko%0AATpeQh3pQnkjNr%2FVTA%3D%3D%0A)

Choose a **Practitioner**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452426/4fe5edc5b29a716d98720d67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=823c3f79901c7ecd1e7d0576978567329769df32c67ea1ff05ceeb9f83b463d7&req=cygmEsx8mYNZFb4f3HP0gAk%2FUYBQxoGzKhvi3uosIAl36Rte%2B8AwyIAi%2Fx%2Bp%0Ad4BcyP0zPrmXzDOvUA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452426/4fe5edc5b29a716d98720d67/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=823c3f79901c7ecd1e7d0576978567329769df32c67ea1ff05ceeb9f83b463d7&req=cygmEsx8mYNZFb4f3HP0gAk%2FUYBQxoGzKhvi3uosIAl36Rte%2B8AwyIAi%2Fx%2Bp%0Ad4BcyP0zPrmXzDOvUA%3D%3D%0A)

Choose an **Appointment Type**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452501/920c7e2aeade87c7e4efc92b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afbbe9047749f085558a713e9cb1a4b1ae54e3c673d893930ad79a09e500b4d2&req=cygmEsx8mIFeFb4f3HP0gLflemV3jDxah4pTBjMugdPRE0Lr4CKBHWHDUj%2FO%0A8ZTxU2BPvGygGMR8wA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452501/920c7e2aeade87c7e4efc92b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afbbe9047749f085558a713e9cb1a4b1ae54e3c673d893930ad79a09e500b4d2&req=cygmEsx8mIFeFb4f3HP0gLflemV3jDxah4pTBjMugdPRE0Lr4CKBHWHDUj%2FO%0A8ZTxU2BPvGygGMR8wA%3D%3D%0A)

Choose whether to **Count Group Appts** as a Single appt, Multiple appts or to Exclude them altogether.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452576/65033f357309e21c15e1657e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=400010447119c3b55e3df87b6e46dcbd171be1c3102afe330d4c533122f968be&req=cygmEsx8mIZZFb4f3HP0gDHZRtdXvKKIZNZZRVZOFfoPqYO8FiZEeQ3%2Bwdfq%0AOgfnoAkj2dmuhQd1kw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452576/65033f357309e21c15e1657e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=400010447119c3b55e3df87b6e46dcbd171be1c3102afe330d4c533122f968be&req=cygmEsx8mIZZFb4f3HP0gDHZRtdXvKKIZNZZRVZOFfoPqYO8FiZEeQ3%2Bwdfq%0AOgfnoAkj2dmuhQd1kw%3D%3D%0A)

Choose whether to **Count Notes as Appts**.  
​  
This refers to the 'Notes' that can be added to the Appointment Book, and determines if these are counted in the totals.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452637/b770e5bef0f1412b610db978/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afbb34ae18e33a1aeef6b9035df3b9b0293341fe5c324abba93b796c3d1811bc&req=cygmEsx8m4JYFb4f3HP0gKaa7VEj%2F3d4W5QuGxP%2F8GbzgAg90dRv%2Fj%2BhIdZw%0AzDMFy1KTDKXdOJvPbw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452637/b770e5bef0f1412b610db978/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afbb34ae18e33a1aeef6b9035df3b9b0293341fe5c324abba93b796c3d1811bc&req=cygmEsx8m4JYFb4f3HP0gKaa7VEj%2F3d4W5QuGxP%2F8GbzgAg90dRv%2Fj%2BhIdZw%0AzDMFy1KTDKXdOJvPbw%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Breakdown by** option to determine how the data is consolidated. You can choose from **_Date_**, **_Appointment Type_**, **_Business_**, **_Profession_** or **_Practitioner_**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781453197/a0f7fc8445bdf8d224dc83ef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1e49abd991da8628f3024b1cd7882ff360e69c39ae914ed851784a669eb6b0a7&req=cygmEsx9nIhYFb4f3HP0gEKnYgxdtUumPNHLNOesLTydVsJBCGwiLxFzehl%2B%0AJ2UNowR4BvTH0aLdyQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781453197/a0f7fc8445bdf8d224dc83ef/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1e49abd991da8628f3024b1cd7882ff360e69c39ae914ed851784a669eb6b0a7&req=cygmEsx9nIhYFb4f3HP0gEKnYgxdtUumPNHLNOesLTydVsJBCGwiLxFzehl%2B%0AJ2UNowR4BvTH0aLdyQ%3D%3D%0A)

Use the **Display** drop-down to determine how the widget will present the data.  
​  
The options available in this menu depend on the 'Type' of widget you have selected. For example the 'Graph' type can be displayed as a **Column**, **Line** or **Area** graph.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781453262/1d1270c71a1229b7721c0441/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b19f02ba469692e3320b54471493c18473a36d5cd09c9143cbb1d88c17bfd77&req=cygmEsx9n4ddFb4f3HP0gPeAEZiCFR8rDqhp22jShhJIec0VeUvZad37ncK5%0AYlDm8FdAMH%2FKrzx9yQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781453262/1d1270c71a1229b7721c0441/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8b19f02ba469692e3320b54471493c18473a36d5cd09c9143cbb1d88c17bfd77&req=cygmEsx9n4ddFb4f3HP0gPeAEZiCFR8rDqhp22jShhJIec0VeUvZad37ncK5%0AYlDm8FdAMH%2FKrzx9yQ%3D%3D%0A)

Choose to display the data in either **_Days_**_, **Weeks**_ or **_Months_**.  
​  
The options available in this drop-down will depend on the 'Date Range' you have selected, and will determine what totals is displayed on the widget (i.e. daily totals, weekly totals, monthly totals).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781453401/029a5f9b7fe6195fa96e7c18/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b75e2bb704ed8feb395142e0cd4eab23d33b9d80e3c1f7a0c6d67039721b1ca&req=cygmEsx9mYFeFb4f3HP0gOXZOkc3Cr6T%2FZB1ElgZQ%2F%2FLl2gpmHSzB1EFX2Zn%0ABxb8LnBiVQphNnD2%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781453401/029a5f9b7fe6195fa96e7c18/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6b75e2bb704ed8feb395142e0cd4eab23d33b9d80e3c1f7a0c6d67039721b1ca&req=cygmEsx9mYFeFb4f3HP0gOXZOkc3Cr6T%2FZB1ElgZQ%2F%2FLl2gpmHSzB1EFX2Zn%0ABxb8LnBiVQphNnD2%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)

Choose to show the **Legend** or not.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781453485/e7d71996351465b4afa3beb0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f8259f3d4b68e608511f57d21a14243e21380a793ba4748f24070c44f6dfa70&req=cygmEsx9mYlaFb4f3HP0gHyKz9mwObnv1XJuhJlQeQRZotReH7Eaz20ArAow%0AZpvESwOqf%2BhjYDOJRA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781453485/e7d71996351465b4afa3beb0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f8259f3d4b68e608511f57d21a14243e21380a793ba4748f24070c44f6dfa70&req=cygmEsx9mYlaFb4f3HP0gHyKz9mwObnv1XJuhJlQeQRZotReH7Eaz20ArAow%0AZpvESwOqf%2BhjYDOJRA%3D%3D%0A)

Choose the **Refresh Rate** you'd like for the widget.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781454805/859af1725608e6b8d76fe39c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d8b998f26edba655282c5772899de859bdd99f2362800c84a583e3b6839f1a6&req=cygmEsx6lYFaFb4f3HP0gP9tNI4abn1BBdMYzk3DVuCDTDnRrYvxUb6AhMGA%0A8ObzfcT5GBHASRkjTA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781454805/859af1725608e6b8d76fe39c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d8b998f26edba655282c5772899de859bdd99f2362800c84a583e3b6839f1a6&req=cygmEsx6lYFaFb4f3HP0gP9tNI4abn1BBdMYzk3DVuCDTDnRrYvxUb6AhMGA%0A8ObzfcT5GBHASRkjTA%3D%3D%0A)

Choose the **Theme**, this is the colour scheme the widget will display in.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781467864/7cc4f2949b8d5620efa626cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=42611a221dc29dc244ba451bcc9bb34f50d80e652c994511e429a20f5fd015e5&req=cygmEs95lYdbFb4f3HP0gGightlGrTzyp2gQHOIlr5%2BbECTqwPLZqaqe3bAU%0AxfZFBOOF2iVLlv6itQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781467864/7cc4f2949b8d5620efa626cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=42611a221dc29dc244ba451bcc9bb34f50d80e652c994511e429a20f5fd015e5&req=cygmEs95lYdbFb4f3HP0gGightlGrTzyp2gQHOIlr5%2BbECTqwPLZqaqe3bAU%0AxfZFBOOF2iVLlv6itQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once done, click **OK**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781451901/e2f4c36bfc0f33e78ce0f856/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5969c2fedde803fba64b38da54284ae6e21666fc388e2a074775c7cb98f5576&req=cygmEsx%2FlIFeFb4f3HP0gP6JBQDcJ9JkD%2FzKoVSgr%2B5FcnJomTiK%2FpOSpbIy%0AhidpqSG7GNsI6Kq3Jw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781451901/e2f4c36bfc0f33e78ce0f856/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5969c2fedde803fba64b38da54284ae6e21666fc388e2a074775c7cb98f5576&req=cygmEsx%2FlIFeFb4f3HP0gP6JBQDcJ9JkD%2FzKoVSgr%2B5FcnJomTiK%2FpOSpbIy%0AhidpqSG7GNsI6Kq3Jw%3D%3D%0A)

This will add the widget to the Dashboard.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452034/3c7c5950938a5ec06c5ada83/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=790d8c1d508cd013f36d1dc82d1663081bad7edf54c38929fef66b2e6a4ff1b5&req=cygmEsx8nYJbFb4f3HP0gFqBQ72FT6r0u3PQYVsK00ytEt%2F0XT2rU3LK%2Ba9m%0AQT3%2FZhGG1S5vtSu9Fg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/781452034/3c7c5950938a5ec06c5ada83/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=790d8c1d508cd013f36d1dc82d1663081bad7edf54c38929fef66b2e6a4ff1b5&req=cygmEsx8nYJbFb4f3HP0gFqBQ72FT6r0u3PQYVsK00ytEt%2F0XT2rU3LK%2Ba9m%0AQT3%2FZhGG1S5vtSu9Fg%3D%3D%0A)

In this example we have a widget displaying **Appointment Totals** for all businesses, professions and practitioners. The days are displayed on the X Axis, while the total number of appointments per day is represented on the Y Axis.

Creating Email & SMS Campaigns

Creating Email & SMS Campaigns
==============================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Creating a Campaign](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6591245-creating-email-sms-campaigns#h_3c53509518)

[Viewing Campaign Statistics](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6591245-creating-email-sms-campaigns#h_ebad86a278)

Campaigns allow you to automate sending SMS and emails to patients that appear in report results on an ongoing basis. They are ideal for automatically sending:

*   weekly/monthly recall notices
    
*   birthday messages to patients with birthdays 'this month'
    
*   new patients a welcome/thank you email
    

Campaigns work using your chosen [saved filters](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters)
 for most reports in PracSuite. Each time the campaign is scheduled to run, it will generate your report with the chosen filters to identify the latest group of patients that will be targeted with the campaign.

Creating a Campaign
===================

To create a campaign, go to **[Reports > Campaigns](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/campaigns)
**.

Select **Edit** in the top left.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592939617/77d93a05f123e60d55e3fcc1/CleanShot+2022-10-06+at+11.38.12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0f31f1cad80dac900707d2786b10ddcb0c4171c31a65e82044ff62c968491084&req=cSklH8p3m4BYFb4f3HP0gJ6%2B5qA%2BqEqZS%2BeBY4mCVzqhEQGXKGPQ2uPmnXSu%0AmrXg4PeljpwBa5JhZQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592939617/77d93a05f123e60d55e3fcc1/CleanShot+2022-10-06+at+11.38.12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0f31f1cad80dac900707d2786b10ddcb0c4171c31a65e82044ff62c968491084&req=cSklH8p3m4BYFb4f3HP0gJ6%2B5qA%2BqEqZS%2BeBY4mCVzqhEQGXKGPQ2uPmnXSu%0AmrXg4PeljpwBa5JhZQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Add Campaign** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592985930/9c5168e08ada638684e9a2bd/CleanShot+2022-10-06+at+15.16.01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b581216df8e0d7851e27954a752e49aff3ea929d2a026b57a69fd2cbedb8e778&req=cSklH8F7lIJfFb4f3HP0gMMImIbmmAoBfI488%2FkJ63vuxdkCv0HfvOw7c3LO%0ADGcAoTEwoxKvXOQF%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592985930/9c5168e08ada638684e9a2bd/CleanShot+2022-10-06+at+15.16.01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b581216df8e0d7851e27954a752e49aff3ea929d2a026b57a69fd2cbedb8e778&req=cSklH8F7lIJfFb4f3HP0gMMImIbmmAoBfI488%2FkJ63vuxdkCv0HfvOw7c3LO%0ADGcAoTEwoxKvXOQF%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012362529/0005be82741127c14623e929/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+13_17_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1449cc7486cebfa9c90cfd34e7b28e2940863b86629e85a879b2ae491bbe815e&req=dSAmFMp4n4RdUPMW1HO4zW7UkphAUSnxaecqJC2Rg6jLo5V%2Btg2XrqPPfIZt%0Anq5NLCyNCX3C0kwgmik%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012362529/0005be82741127c14623e929/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+13_17_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1449cc7486cebfa9c90cfd34e7b28e2940863b86629e85a879b2ae491bbe815e&req=dSAmFMp4n4RdUPMW1HO4zW7UkphAUSnxaecqJC2Rg6jLo5V%2Btg2XrqPPfIZt%0Anq5NLCyNCX3C0kwgmik%3D%0A)

You will then need to select the following preferences for your campaign:

**1\. Campaign Name**

Select a name for your campaign to help identify it.

**2\. Choose your report**

Select the report that returns a list of patients to target with the campaign.

**3\. Saved Filters**

Choose the filters to apply for the campaign. If you have not already saved a set of filters for the report, [follow these instructions.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5101252-saving-report-filters)

**4\. Type**

The Campaign Type determines how the message will be sent to the patient.

*   Email - The message will be sent to patients opted into email marketing
    
*   SMS - The message will be sent to patients opted into SMS marketing
    
*   Prefer Email - PracSuite will send an email to patients that have both an email and mobile number on their file, and then SMS the remaining patients without.
    
*   Prefer SMS - PracSuite will SMS the message to those with an SMS, and then email patients without a mobile number on their file.
    

Only patients who have opted into Email or SMS Marketing will receive messages sent through Campaigns.

**5.** **Business**

When emailing campaigns, this will determine which business' outbound email settings to use.

**6.** **SMS/Email Template**

Choose the SMS and/or email template to use for the campaign.

**7\. Open & Click Tracking** - Select this to provide insight into how many recipients opened the email and how many clicked on links within the email.

Open & Click Tracking is only available when using the [Send via PracSuite email method](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6150780-understanding-how-emails-are-sent-through-pracsuite)
.  
​

If you select an Outlook or Gmail email as the 'from address' and enable Open & Click Tracking, your email will be Sent via PracSuite. The email will still be sent with the same email address and sender name. [Click here to learn more about this.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6150780-understanding-how-emails-are-sent-through-pracsuite)

**8.** **When to Send**

Choose how often this campaign should run. Based on the selected frequency, PracSuite will run the report using your chosen saved filters and then send the email/SMS message to the patients that appear in the report results accordingly.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012363923/e9955b04b03763c2a89934dc/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+13_21_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dec0681c520134340281c823696a7644acaeb807e581784a1a34d7f1e8883f4a&req=dSAmFMp4nohdWvMW1HO4zStW4RuoQz3w%2FYp9LPI9RUB9Fc26fYE7mUrI3gSf%0A6Ddp55SS13%2FbGSycWrQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012363923/e9955b04b03763c2a89934dc/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+13_21_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dec0681c520134340281c823696a7644acaeb807e581784a1a34d7f1e8883f4a&req=dSAmFMp4nohdWvMW1HO4zStW4RuoQz3w%2FYp9LPI9RUB9Fc26fYE7mUrI3gSf%0A6Ddp55SS13%2FbGSycWrQ%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Viewing Campaign Statistics
===========================

Statistics for your Campaign can be viewed in [Reports > Campaigns](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/campaigns)
.

Select a Campaign from the grid.

You will be able to see a history of the patients that the message was sent to, which of those patients opened or clicked links in the email, and which patients the email failed to send to.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012236367/f9f92f5faa8305c45485a71a/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+08_29_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5b855ca5906e7b968b287379728e5b5b7027a88d73e007340e203ea82b6c201&req=dSAmFMt9m4JZXvMW1HO4zSxKDigRcgjfiyS4jhlLfm6%2BFukv3b8iX%2F8G02Z1%0AfJujCiRcL%2Bkiq1H19ag%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012236367/f9f92f5faa8305c45485a71a/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+08_29_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5b855ca5906e7b968b287379728e5b5b7027a88d73e007340e203ea82b6c201&req=dSAmFMt9m4JZXvMW1HO4zSxKDigRcgjfiyS4jhlLfm6%2BFukv3b8iX%2F8G02Z1%0AfJujCiRcL%2Bkiq1H19ag%3D%0A)

If your campaign has been sent via the Outlook or Gmail integration, only Sent and Failed statistics will be available.

Changing the order of patient file tabs

Changing the order of patient file tabs
=======================================

Updated over 3 years ago

To reorder the tabs on the patient file, open any patient record.

Make sure the left-hand side menu is pinned open, and then select the reorder icon found at the bottom of the menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/591456792/e300586f10c38a83e80cf708/CleanShot+2022-10-04+at+11.10.52.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5f5c066c9cfc60de74c7edf39edbef20a36eb876530053cc0e449ee552decb98&req=cSkmEsx4mohdFb4f3HP0gHOkTMwmhPF2AaKjTC7UZpZbF29ZVVawEhVu5FxM%0AaQN%2BtLRD%2FBllD6a0cA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/591456792/e300586f10c38a83e80cf708/CleanShot+2022-10-04+at+11.10.52.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5f5c066c9cfc60de74c7edf39edbef20a36eb876530053cc0e449ee552decb98&req=cSkmEsx4mohdFb4f3HP0gHOkTMwmhPF2AaKjTC7UZpZbF29ZVVawEhVu5FxM%0AaQN%2BtLRD%2FBllD6a0cA%3D%3D%0A)

Click and hold the || icon while dragging to reorder the tabs, as shown below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592217059/5e6a3aee362d453e1062f0c5/CleanShot+2022-10-05+at+12.34.11.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=90a4a5c0c4ba90fb3d446c5277d4f8fc66c35fade6cf53f3a0c389e1ec33d89f&req=cSklFMh5nYRWFb4f3HP0gADi9%2FxCS0U8wchiaRKOztDyqDKS8BVzc6LaFBck%0Aw%2FZN55ICDXzwbvbHGw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592217059/5e6a3aee362d453e1062f0c5/CleanShot+2022-10-05+at+12.34.11.gif?expires=1771821900&signature=90a4a5c0c4ba90fb3d446c5277d4f8fc66c35fade6cf53f3a0c389e1ec33d89f&req=cSklFMh5nYRWFb4f3HP0gADi9%2FxCS0U8wchiaRKOztDyqDKS8BVzc6LaFBck%0Aw%2FZN55ICDXzwbvbHGw%3D%3D%0A)

Select the tick icon to save your changes. These preferences will be saved for all patient files.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592217380/179194d71d0a68916df719aa/CleanShot+2022-10-05+at+12.35.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0f01938423c809291f327bdc89456757f120529b61ca6ff57a9e207ea7feb61c&req=cSklFMh5nolfFb4f3HP0gEuw%2B%2Bd87MhS3NIlN2sKe7Pm%2Bp24HhvhffmBbViY%0Ad%2FxhiPjxH5smpmEzZg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592217380/179194d71d0a68916df719aa/CleanShot+2022-10-05+at+12.35.49.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0f01938423c809291f327bdc89456757f120529b61ca6ff57a9e207ea7feb61c&req=cSklFMh5nolfFb4f3HP0gEuw%2B%2Bd87MhS3NIlN2sKe7Pm%2Bp24HhvhffmBbViY%0Ad%2FxhiPjxH5smpmEzZg%3D%3D%0A)

You can also cancel or reset to the default order using the respective icons.

Appointment Follow Ups

Appointment Follow Ups
======================

Automatically send an email or SMS after an appointment

Updated over 7 months ago

Table of contents

[Examples of how to use Follow Ups](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6610735-appointment-follow-ups#h_886bb14e24)

[FAQ:](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6610735-appointment-follow-ups#h_a8e4ae0820)

PracSuite allows you to schedule automatic email and/or SMS to be sent after an appointment has been completed, missed or cancelled. There are options to send specific messages based on the appointment type, the practitioner, profession and business. It is also possible to schedule multiple appointment follow-ups that go out at different times after an appointment.

Examples of how to use Follow Ups
---------------------------------

*   'Thank you for visiting' message
    
*   Post-appointment survey
    
*   Contacting missed or cancelled appointments where there the patient has no future appointment booked
    

1\. Go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Follow Ups](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/followups)
**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592261076/e6f6f162744a5e387a14a86f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4476b0de7cac7867d6521a623dc08adf42636431f63b041a9462a68f8e7257fb&req=cSklFM9%2FnYZZFb4f3HP0gNCg5PmH3fj7Q0QvSLeHbts8PEaiKAlHX1gtGNFn%0A0JeVROzJERQ712li3Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592261076/e6f6f162744a5e387a14a86f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4476b0de7cac7867d6521a623dc08adf42636431f63b041a9462a68f8e7257fb&req=cSklFM9%2FnYZZFb4f3HP0gNCg5PmH3fj7Q0QvSLeHbts8PEaiKAlHX1gtGNFn%0A0JeVROzJERQ712li3Q%3D%3D%0A)

2\. Select either Add SMS Follow Up or Add Email Follow Up

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592261822/59bb76518fea8343d67a7155/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=66ede4d07eb98f2800e9047145b3cbc8e3028ccc1beb256e2c6d2b72f87b4439&req=cSklFM9%2FlYNdFb4f3HP0gImSmXyT59ZWh7vRNCF4GaMpPNlwboe1FZfZsY3e%0ACSdv49aWLZeLEJzYog%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592261822/59bb76518fea8343d67a7155/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=66ede4d07eb98f2800e9047145b3cbc8e3028ccc1beb256e2c6d2b72f87b4439&req=cSklFM9%2FlYNdFb4f3HP0gImSmXyT59ZWh7vRNCF4GaMpPNlwboe1FZfZsY3e%0ACSdv49aWLZeLEJzYog%3D%3D%0A)

3\. Enter a name for this Follow Up and choose whether they should be sent once an appointment is completed, missed or cancelled. Specify how long after an appointment the message will be sent.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592262878/17bbec252f3097f72a7bf7b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5eeb5ecde71948d5b7e7facde9b1b7f7ce27b178cac2a53d1efbb3a92fc668ca&req=cSklFM98lYZXFb4f3HP0gMaYMlRITGN64f03%2BwVBFDl2vmUvl%2BQldpiV%2B8yT%0AUdlwjelnManJkIlz%2BQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592262878/17bbec252f3097f72a7bf7b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5eeb5ecde71948d5b7e7facde9b1b7f7ce27b178cac2a53d1efbb3a92fc668ca&req=cSklFM98lYZXFb4f3HP0gMaYMlRITGN64f03%2BwVBFDl2vmUvl%2BQldpiV%2B8yT%0AUdlwjelnManJkIlz%2BQ%3D%3D%0A)

📝 Note that a completed appointment is an appointment with the status 'Complete', you can manually change this, or it will happen automatically when an appointment has been invoiced. An appointment must be changed to the status 'Missed/D.N.A.' to count as missed and an appointment that is considered cancelled needs to have the 'cancelled' option checked when deleting an appointment.

4\. Decide whether only patients with no future appointments should be receiving this Follow Up, check the box if appropriate.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592264438/89af7d423541a42c2a5d586b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=77740546bdb2ba19da0c8c8e24ca909c94e95deefe5f2087cf45aa03092d6104&req=cSklFM96mYJXFb4f3HP0gDbdRQolbgyL54XW4b9Vr0fJgjL8xt%2FEn%2FUpwRRV%0AhIKWqmQuASyKm%2BDKVQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592264438/89af7d423541a42c2a5d586b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=77740546bdb2ba19da0c8c8e24ca909c94e95deefe5f2087cf45aa03092d6104&req=cSklFM96mYJXFb4f3HP0gDbdRQolbgyL54XW4b9Vr0fJgjL8xt%2FEn%2FUpwRRV%0AhIKWqmQuASyKm%2BDKVQ%3D%3D%0A)

**_Steps 5 and 6 are for SMS Follow Ups only_**

5\. Replies to SMS Follow Ups will be [visible within PracSuite in several places.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4702551-viewing-sms-replies)
 You can also opt to receive patient **SMS replies via Email** to the respective business email address, or to specific email addresses.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/415304072/ab0fb8061bc76898b4cbe6cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f7a36a4f60630f13399c81410fb7a023903657d335e99584615dbe613eb4ca13&req=cCEiFcl6nYZdFb4f3HP0gAXM3ATKj5VubmrYYtMD7M3KAeXLvTZnCmdvnbIP%0AMOYkouwSzUqMjp7PFg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/415304072/ab0fb8061bc76898b4cbe6cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f7a36a4f60630f13399c81410fb7a023903657d335e99584615dbe613eb4ca13&req=cCEiFcl6nYZdFb4f3HP0gAXM3ATKj5VubmrYYtMD7M3KAeXLvTZnCmdvnbIP%0AMOYkouwSzUqMjp7PFg%3D%3D%0A)

6\. You can opt to enable an **SMS Sender ID**, which will be displayed on the patient's mobile phone when receiving SMS reminders. **Note: Patients will not be able to reply to SMS messages sent with an SMS Sender ID.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/240509910/3480b0e08ce0e660fde77462/5.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83264669cfa951690b63d352573922e3f2c1315c447925b9d280006d06930229&req=diQnE8l3lIBfFb4f3HP0gJPmjKMY25H3n7Lf5X4g0mvGEQXKTkYU0lWFTW1Q%0AnrbKra5snSyZzkU0Qg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/240509910/3480b0e08ce0e660fde77462/5.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83264669cfa951690b63d352573922e3f2c1315c447925b9d280006d06930229&req=diQnE8l3lIBfFb4f3HP0gJPmjKMY25H3n7Lf5X4g0mvGEQXKTkYU0lWFTW1Q%0AnrbKra5snSyZzkU0Qg%3D%3D%0A)

7\. Set the **Default [SMS](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317983-creating-sms-templates)
/[Email](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317970-creating-email-templates)
 Follow Up Template** to be used.

Select Add to configure override templates if you wish to send different SMS templates for appointments with a particular Business, Profession, Practitioner or Appointment type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592265517/c95dea1cbd1c49fdc1878032/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c1687790f5ae23c597fb16fe247f0ff4e2eef7ed5ccc9e627aed0cd6ce2d7d5&req=cSklFM97mIBYFb4f3HP0gJDj0G5WNsph2ZRWx%2B9nAiezyiDeQomBhnp%2B4kB4%0AxTO2D67wtn6%2FLFS0IA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592265517/c95dea1cbd1c49fdc1878032/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c1687790f5ae23c597fb16fe247f0ff4e2eef7ed5ccc9e627aed0cd6ce2d7d5&req=cSklFM97mIBYFb4f3HP0gJDj0G5WNsph2ZRWx%2B9nAiezyiDeQomBhnp%2B4kB4%0AxTO2D67wtn6%2FLFS0IA%3D%3D%0A)

8\. **Exclusions** can also be defined to prevent Follow Ups from sending for specific Businesses, Practitioners or Appointment Types.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592266171/02729d2a3342fe7540481c44/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a29db7ca8b466293b091ad3899f252ac487867407578af52dd874690e9381ba&req=cSklFM94nIZeFb4f3HP0gJ1M3nNoNBXG2W1hTASO0gq2gzg4j98xw9ea8Vp6%0A5s2LFVSG6lRvilczvg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592266171/02729d2a3342fe7540481c44/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9a29db7ca8b466293b091ad3899f252ac487867407578af52dd874690e9381ba&req=cSklFM94nIZeFb4f3HP0gJ1M3nNoNBXG2W1hTASO0gq2gzg4j98xw9ea8Vp6%0A5s2LFVSG6lRvilczvg%3D%3D%0A)

9\. Finally, select **Save** at the top once complete.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592266531/87681d4883a5d425ef6d6f37/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=62dfc0cd382006e3292b46e080faf0d93aae03fa20b6a03d4772751da8f0b95b&req=cSklFM94mIJeFb4f3HP0gPZKdgVlkzP9NkTbArLqh90HsVpW59KtmEaCJiOS%0AFQyN5%2Fi6s%2B2FruA7rA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/592266531/87681d4883a5d425ef6d6f37/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=62dfc0cd382006e3292b46e080faf0d93aae03fa20b6a03d4772751da8f0b95b&req=cSklFM94mIJeFb4f3HP0gPZKdgVlkzP9NkTbArLqh90HsVpW59KtmEaCJiOS%0AFQyN5%2Fi6s%2B2FruA7rA%3D%3D%0A)

  
FAQ:
=======

**When creating a new Follow Up, will it consider historical appointments?**

Yes, historical appointments will be considered within a limited period.  
​  
​**When you create and enable a new follow-up:**

*   **Cancellation Follow-up**:  
    Once enabled, the system will identify all appointments canceled within the past 24 hours and automatically schedule an SMS or email to be sent. Additionally, it will continue to track and schedule messages for any new cancellations moving forward.  
    ​
    
*   **Completed Follow-up**:  
    For completed appointments, the system will look back at the last 7 days to find appointments that meet your criteria and have a "Completed" status. It will then schedule an SMS or email follow-up for these appointments.  
    ​  
    As more appointments are set with the "Completed" status they will also be scheduled with a follow-up.  
    ​
    
*   **Missed Follow-up**:  
    For missed appointments, the system will look back at the last 7 days to find appointments that meet your criteria and have a "Missed" status. It will then schedule an SMS or email follow-up for these appointments.  
    ​  
    As more appointments are set with the "Missed" status they will also be scheduled with a follow-up.

Linking an Appointment to an Invoice

Linking an Appointment to an Invoice
====================================

Updated over 2 weeks ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6610892-linking-an-appointment-to-an-invoice#h_41b62c12b0)

[Manually Linking an Appointment to an Invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6610892-linking-an-appointment-to-an-invoice#h_87e84803f9)

[Un-linking an Appointment with an Invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6610892-linking-an-appointment-to-an-invoice#h_f56e2b05fb)

Overview
========

Appointments are linked to invoices for a couple of reasons:

1.  To automatically mark the appointment as complete when performed as part of your workflow.
    
2.  To be able to see which invoice and appointment belongs to and vice versa.
    

This linking happens automatically when you create the invoice from the directly from the appointment, see [this article](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10996798-how-to-invoice-a-patient#h_42c0f07183)
 for more information.

If the invoice is generated from the patient's file however, it will need to be manually linked to the correct appointment.

Manually Linking an Appointment to an Invoice
---------------------------------------------

#### Step 1:

Open the invoice you want to link. This will need to be done on the patient's file.

#### Step 2:

Select the **Edit** button in the top left of the invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725890245/8513a19b52266c78561c0a1b021e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=381c0b207e88aba5ba7b042d3c299c714e08c79b28bc2cf51ed2f57e4e3b0eb4&req=dSclE8F3nYNbXPMW1HO4zeEjPKG40Bwu%2BV7xlyBOx9bMb%2FvfPuWZZufPvin0%0AgF08sd%2B%2Fn7dty5dZVXI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725890245/8513a19b52266c78561c0a1b021e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=381c0b207e88aba5ba7b042d3c299c714e08c79b28bc2cf51ed2f57e4e3b0eb4&req=dSclE8F3nYNbXPMW1HO4zeEjPKG40Bwu%2BV7xlyBOx9bMb%2FvfPuWZZufPvin0%0AgF08sd%2B%2Fn7dty5dZVXI%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

In the bottom right-hand corner, find the **Linked Appointment** section and select the edit icon.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725892973/e8ce8765f4e12f397eddccce83df/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=534f6d45d07c3e32b3a9593319ec2fcc1a735a919ffe13add6fe6dcadb01d348&req=dSclE8F3n4hYWvMW1HO4zcdmhFftsDUNnjLHaz4IOynnKZPoFvgIuizCxXUy%0AR990PDPpJZEZH15muNw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725892973/e8ce8765f4e12f397eddccce83df/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=534f6d45d07c3e32b3a9593319ec2fcc1a735a919ffe13add6fe6dcadb01d348&req=dSclE8F3n4hYWvMW1HO4zcdmhFftsDUNnjLHaz4IOynnKZPoFvgIuizCxXUy%0AR990PDPpJZEZH15muNw%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

In the popup that appears, you will see all invoice items. Use the Appointment drop-down list to associate each item with an appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725896708/86bf968370bf8510d5daa85efc0a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b71eec0fecb80cdb5d9fd13a85c9543febca3cf58cc41e8c0e7b9029c263471b&req=dSclE8F3m4ZfUfMW1HO4zUngiW%2BFbyCAwNCHJ72B6xQibd1canMX4tzv2jyX%0AtZLA0zBw%2BPqCAtaxMzI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1725896708/86bf968370bf8510d5daa85efc0a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b71eec0fecb80cdb5d9fd13a85c9543febca3cf58cc41e8c0e7b9029c263471b&req=dSclE8F3m4ZfUfMW1HO4zUngiW%2BFbyCAwNCHJ72B6xQibd1canMX4tzv2jyX%0AtZLA0zBw%2BPqCAtaxMzI%3D%0A)

If the appointment doesn't show in the list, it was most likely outside of the Date Range set or with a different Practitioner. You can adjust these filters as needed to show the correct appointment.

#### Step 5:

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

You can find more information on invoicing patients in this article on [How to Invoice a Patient](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10996798-how-to-invoice-a-patient#h_42c0f07183)
.

Un-linking an Appointment with an Invoice
-----------------------------------------

To remove a link, hover your cursor over the linked appointment and click on the X icon.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2033300560/0073b91aa39ccbeffc7c6d9b31cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7163259b60206cb8c748a9401250fa17fcc194292c96739edc0b95a925df27fb&req=diAkFcp%2BnYRZWfMW1HO4zQNqoipgaEMyhaBltBXl5M%2BjYAXdNfhhtczcFOa6%0A5WN%2F%2BZ%2Fm%2Bnu1I%2F2yYqI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2033300560/0073b91aa39ccbeffc7c6d9b31cc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7163259b60206cb8c748a9401250fa17fcc194292c96739edc0b95a925df27fb&req=diAkFcp%2BnYRZWfMW1HO4zQNqoipgaEMyhaBltBXl5M%2BjYAXdNfhhtczcFOa6%0A5WN%2F%2BZ%2Fm%2Bnu1I%2F2yYqI%3D%0A)

Using the Image Viewer

Using the Image Viewer
======================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Supported File Types](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6655102-using-the-image-viewer#h_29724b8f2e)

PracSuite has an inbuilt image viewer which automatically opens [supported image types](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6655102-using-the-image-viewer#h_29724b8f2e)
 when opening images within clinical notes and on the files tab of the patient card.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/600558703/2cbe9ffff2e456eed8dff0e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c86429e0fc0186327e0a5efd2223145dc4f44145eb68de23f6a3b208e1c110e&req=ciAnE8x2moFcFb4f3HP0gKJOf2VRFGfj2nVsIM2cXHBVk0vpI9H7JhhQ1kBs%0A%2BqM04M%2FoOfg64kOfdw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/600558703/2cbe9ffff2e456eed8dff0e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9c86429e0fc0186327e0a5efd2223145dc4f44145eb68de23f6a3b208e1c110e&req=ciAnE8x2moFcFb4f3HP0gKJOf2VRFGfj2nVsIM2cXHBVk0vpI9H7JhhQ1kBs%0A%2BqM04M%2FoOfg64kOfdw%3D%3D%0A)

The toolbar buttons allow you to zoom, rotate or flip the image. You can also use the fit screen or fill screen shortcuts to quickly zoom to appropriate levels. You can select and drag the image around the canvas for better visibility.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601918297/be78e444feeacc502c06ff51/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61bd0d6d6284111d6ab180ad1fb63551f270e9538cb977c977f290416fdd39ac&req=ciAmH8h2n4hYFb4f3HP0gPV8jEYEaY9CjDWtaNXLBW0FRwYrfDRK5Sk1ITQZ%0AqvRVsdtbEDfYXvWl%2Fg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/601918297/be78e444feeacc502c06ff51/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61bd0d6d6284111d6ab180ad1fb63551f270e9538cb977c977f290416fdd39ac&req=ciAmH8h2n4hYFb4f3HP0gPV8jEYEaY9CjDWtaNXLBW0FRwYrfDRK5Sk1ITQZ%0AqvRVsdtbEDfYXvWl%2Fg%3D%3D%0A)

Supported File Types
====================

The PracSuite image viewer supports the following file types:

*   JPG
    
*   JPEG
    
*   PNG
    
*   GIF
    
*   BMP
    
*   SVG

Booking Appointments as a Family

Booking Appointments as a Family
================================

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6720804-booking-appointments-as-a-family#h_bb6cbf86de)

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6720804-booking-appointments-as-a-family#h_6e0469d25a)

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6720804-booking-appointments-as-a-family#h_714bd83d0b)

PracSuite includes automated processes to book Family Members together in Group Appointments or sequentially as individual appointments.

This article covers:

1\. [Enabling 'Booking as Family' in PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6720804-booking-appointments-as-a-family#h_bb6cbf86de)

2\. [Adding Families to Group Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6720804-booking-appointments-as-a-family#h_6e0469d25a)

3\. [Booking Families with Individual Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6720804-booking-appointments-as-a-family#h_714bd83d0b)

* * *

**1\. Enabling 'Booking as Family' in PracSuite**
=================================================

Go to **[Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6720804-booking-appointments-as-a-family)** and click **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613213709/50b488afe90093c6edc1a6a5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=332e7fa2d1becc79c191953c2fe1ec1ef1f536cb2f9ea64f10f50bec25018387&req=ciEkFMh9moFWFb4f3HP0gLKG0MLcpu4MXqgyuKk1vD2VpSWbH15eO%2F6yuuUf%0A3wSXGJJvMok01fCVpg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613213709/50b488afe90093c6edc1a6a5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=332e7fa2d1becc79c191953c2fe1ec1ef1f536cb2f9ea64f10f50bec25018387&req=ciEkFMh9moFWFb4f3HP0gLKG0MLcpu4MXqgyuKk1vD2VpSWbH15eO%2F6yuuUf%0A3wSXGJJvMok01fCVpg%3D%3D%0A)

Under the **General** section, enable the option '**Enable Booking as Family**' and click **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613194472/c18e2ad85acfa2627a628fcb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8221e5fd19da2cb4224c4883759b7c17298eddb5483eef5b0aa86d72179ffb6&req=ciEkF8B6mYZdFb4f3HP0gJpky%2BZ3G9JzvkIxctV9nOqWwxdRu3XgVwqsZ5Pl%0AvOkR9d48i%2F01U2fbJQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613194472/c18e2ad85acfa2627a628fcb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e8221e5fd19da2cb4224c4883759b7c17298eddb5483eef5b0aa86d72179ffb6&req=ciEkF8B6mYZdFb4f3HP0gJpky%2BZ3G9JzvkIxctV9nOqWwxdRu3XgVwqsZ5Pl%0AvOkR9d48i%2F01U2fbJQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**2\. Adding Families to Group Appointments**
=============================================

Create a new **Group Appointment** or open an existing booking.

Click the **Add Family** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613196324/0877cdd4c76484afc5066e74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=214383e618fb043dcb0222591bddcab81db5998b294a32a130dee6772084d5bb&req=ciEkF8B4noNbFb4f3HP0gMbSMwn7WCny8Yp4py%2F1EAhPvWoiZ2fASLApHz05%0AoLWc2CIYf2EeXVKa7Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613196324/0877cdd4c76484afc5066e74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=214383e618fb043dcb0222591bddcab81db5998b294a32a130dee6772084d5bb&req=ciEkF8B4noNbFb4f3HP0gMbSMwn7WCny8Yp4py%2F1EAhPvWoiZ2fASLApHz05%0AoLWc2CIYf2EeXVKa7Q%3D%3D%0A)

On the patient selection pane a toggle will be available to change between booking an **Individual** or a **Family**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613196992/6447036c6ded1ae84c65a785/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67f59d8210d9e9d092bdaeef56c27389b498152cc84389252f7d0e0468b23084&req=ciEkF8B4lIhdFb4f3HP0gBhMmo%2FJ%2FuxItHzhsyxnwm0LJIFwaRh%2FAMUm6mhz%0AHaCMCbkrIMFu0nqIaw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613196992/6447036c6ded1ae84c65a785/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67f59d8210d9e9d092bdaeef56c27389b498152cc84389252f7d0e0468b23084&req=ciEkF8B4lIhdFb4f3HP0gBhMmo%2FJ%2FuxItHzhsyxnwm0LJIFwaRh%2FAMUm6mhz%0AHaCMCbkrIMFu0nqIaw%3D%3D%0A)

When toggled to **Individual**, selecting a patient will add that individual patient to the group appointment.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613197459/e8a0e307186751e11ccba645/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c630774b8f98dd3b26ec006ebcce2133bc52abf0b0bcf141e3516714a0cc6b84&req=ciEkF8B5mYRWFb4f3HP0gPPytvEVug9qs4FERjbmOWjDFkx%2FPDaW1d4Da3qQ%0ADIvcjm2INJK0kL1B8Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613197459/e8a0e307186751e11ccba645/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c630774b8f98dd3b26ec006ebcce2133bc52abf0b0bcf141e3516714a0cc6b84&req=ciEkF8B5mYRWFb4f3HP0gPPytvEVug9qs4FERjbmOWjDFkx%2FPDaW1d4Da3qQ%0ADIvcjm2INJK0kL1B8Q%3D%3D%0A)

While toggled to **Family** you still begin by selecting a _single_ patient, however, you will then be prompted to select the additional family members to book into this group appointment.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613197508/7b3d2fb4a0b7a49485313955/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6332af1827b4d5b09aed93f482446c30a0613d784f45ed4da671671e59d58e4&req=ciEkF8B5mIFXFb4f3HP0gEaeYNIhhBXIexBHZq1L5R%2B8K90gQELQTlq0x88f%0AENflmlQ8%2BsMYo7SW8g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613197508/7b3d2fb4a0b7a49485313955/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6332af1827b4d5b09aed93f482446c30a0613d784f45ed4da671671e59d58e4&req=ciEkF8B5mIFXFb4f3HP0gEaeYNIhhBXIexBHZq1L5R%2B8K90gQELQTlq0x88f%0AENflmlQ8%2BsMYo7SW8g%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613198320/a485d934f1b7d765aa128fa3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52ca2d6e1a02eabc6cc9a50ead8a4560f9d12be45d98bb282607e2601849d15a&req=ciEkF8B2noNfFb4f3HP0gMIaZ8So%2Fd6ck%2Bv8HyxulheNZJvn78D2cpnIAic1%0AKwtaT13Y938qIKH2CQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613198320/a485d934f1b7d765aa128fa3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52ca2d6e1a02eabc6cc9a50ead8a4560f9d12be45d98bb282607e2601849d15a&req=ciEkF8B2noNfFb4f3HP0gMIaZ8So%2Fd6ck%2Bv8HyxulheNZJvn78D2cpnIAic1%0AKwtaT13Y938qIKH2CQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select all the additional **Family Members** that you would like to add to this Group Appointment. You can also adjust the **Account** and **Item Code** to be booked for each selected patient.

**Please note that:**

*   By default, each family member will be set to use their '**Family**' billing account. This is to accommodate '**[Family Billing](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4500310-family-billing)
    **' and allow for shared invoices.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613200021/23fb198bc237853e7af3d55f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=29be389033ef778c145048719f65e766834fb62b896bce9e4ec22733968a0e7d&req=ciEkFMl%2BnYNeFb4f3HP0gNL3QU1EAdrXircPjQjBxrNwmAdEZsuFBawxOdXG%0AoHU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613200021/23fb198bc237853e7af3d55f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=29be389033ef778c145048719f65e766834fb62b896bce9e4ec22733968a0e7d&req=ciEkFMl%2BnYNeFb4f3HP0gNL3QU1EAdrXircPjQjBxrNwmAdEZsuFBawxOdXG%0AoHU%3D%0A)
    

*   If the family member does not have 'Family Billing' enabled, this will be set to using that patients default account instead.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613200084/85df95d73c501387e44f094d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2364d3ae994f556ec1db3b7f5c07efd3b006254eec75953ee224beba88b4bd9e&req=ciEkFMl%2BnYlbFb4f3HP0gEpDWqH6Z2PEFwsOVapdPnSAoFoEazaaDtN1YBIk%0ARMA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613200084/85df95d73c501387e44f094d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2364d3ae994f556ec1db3b7f5c07efd3b006254eec75953ee224beba88b4bd9e&req=ciEkFMl%2BnYlbFb4f3HP0gEpDWqH6Z2PEFwsOVapdPnSAoFoEazaaDtN1YBIk%0ARMA%3D%0A)
    
*   Each family member will be booked using their default communication preferences, for appointment **Reminders** and **Follow Ups**. This can be overwritten for all selected patients by selecting **Apply Custom Settings**.  
    ​
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613199440/ac17cb94acc78608bc7ffcdf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4245e9f9846883905db3547e187b84cc09636941ca1284cc2db8dac53a61e8f7&req=ciEkF8B3mYVfFb4f3HP0gDhYHONFjyvJ0siimUxOQn0ikstYswosDuPK3pM%2F%0Atmw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613199440/ac17cb94acc78608bc7ffcdf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4245e9f9846883905db3547e187b84cc09636941ca1284cc2db8dac53a61e8f7&req=ciEkF8B3mYVfFb4f3HP0gDhYHONFjyvJ0siimUxOQn0ikstYswosDuPK3pM%2F%0Atmw%3D%0A)
    

Click **Book** to add the selected family members to the group appointment.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613200491/136bdfc0053a862ded4a0e0a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f08d4ce8eea6f1b62b9423d5f89d916eb7d1d90c16023155c7299efc01e021bd&req=ciEkFMl%2BmYheFb4f3HP0gAHjk9gtyUH0QgQ1rPd44v28Tekf3G7z9mfPWmo4%0AMVdHno%2FMUKx2fem4Vw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613200491/136bdfc0053a862ded4a0e0a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f08d4ce8eea6f1b62b9423d5f89d916eb7d1d90c16023155c7299efc01e021bd&req=ciEkFMl%2BmYheFb4f3HP0gAHjk9gtyUH0QgQ1rPd44v28Tekf3G7z9mfPWmo4%0AMVdHno%2FMUKx2fem4Vw%3D%3D%0A)

This process can be repeated to book additional families and does not prevent other individuals from being added separately.

* * *

**3\. Booking Families with Individual Appointments**
=====================================================

Following the standard booking process, click an empty slot on the Appointment Book to begin making an appointment.

On the patient selection pane a toggle is available to change between booking an **Individual** or a **Family**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613196992/6447036c6ded1ae84c65a785/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67f59d8210d9e9d092bdaeef56c27389b498152cc84389252f7d0e0468b23084&req=ciEkF8B4lIhdFb4f3HP0gBhMmo%2FJ%2FuxItHzhsyxnwm0LJIFwaRh%2FAMUm6mhz%0AHaCMCbkrIMFu0nqIaw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613196992/6447036c6ded1ae84c65a785/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=67f59d8210d9e9d092bdaeef56c27389b498152cc84389252f7d0e0468b23084&req=ciEkF8B4lIhdFb4f3HP0gBhMmo%2FJ%2FuxItHzhsyxnwm0LJIFwaRh%2FAMUm6mhz%0AHaCMCbkrIMFu0nqIaw%3D%3D%0A)

When toggled to **Individual**, selecting a patient will continue the booking process for that patient alone.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613197459/e8a0e307186751e11ccba645/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c630774b8f98dd3b26ec006ebcce2133bc52abf0b0bcf141e3516714a0cc6b84&req=ciEkF8B5mYRWFb4f3HP0gPPytvEVug9qs4FERjbmOWjDFkx%2FPDaW1d4Da3qQ%0ADIvcjm2INJK0kL1B8Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613197459/e8a0e307186751e11ccba645/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c630774b8f98dd3b26ec006ebcce2133bc52abf0b0bcf141e3516714a0cc6b84&req=ciEkF8B5mYRWFb4f3HP0gPPytvEVug9qs4FERjbmOWjDFkx%2FPDaW1d4Da3qQ%0ADIvcjm2INJK0kL1B8Q%3D%3D%0A)

While toggled to **Family** you will still begin by selecting a _single_ patient, however, you will then enter a process to book all other family members in sequence.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613197508/7b3d2fb4a0b7a49485313955/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6332af1827b4d5b09aed93f482446c30a0613d784f45ed4da671671e59d58e4&req=ciEkF8B5mIFXFb4f3HP0gEaeYNIhhBXIexBHZq1L5R%2B8K90gQELQTlq0x88f%0AENflmlQ8%2BsMYo7SW8g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613197508/7b3d2fb4a0b7a49485313955/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6332af1827b4d5b09aed93f482446c30a0613d784f45ed4da671671e59d58e4&req=ciEkF8B5mIFXFb4f3HP0gEaeYNIhhBXIexBHZq1L5R%2B8K90gQELQTlq0x88f%0AENflmlQ8%2BsMYo7SW8g%3D%3D%0A)

Toggle the option to **Family** and select the first patient you would like to book. The patient selected at this step will be placed into the selected appointment slot.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613209197/c4ca2ec09437781670f1bf2b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44fc8f995697d43bb451f3fde7b472958e8221a2ba0240a61622332f2aa70cc2&req=ciEkFMl3nIhYFb4f3HP0gJGfAuJM582goeiQefoNTwX2vZknjj92dEG%2Fef%2Fk%0AaSMnP%2BfBwrpW3ZPSjQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613209197/c4ca2ec09437781670f1bf2b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44fc8f995697d43bb451f3fde7b472958e8221a2ba0240a61622332f2aa70cc2&req=ciEkFMl3nIhYFb4f3HP0gJGfAuJM582goeiQefoNTwX2vZknjj92dEG%2Fef%2Fk%0AaSMnP%2BfBwrpW3ZPSjQ%3D%3D%0A)

A notification will appear on the right-hand side of the screen to show the family members being booked.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613213476/42ddf26e4ed6948424d2c597/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9789b0163232d951a4597292a7ed8e556ca7216bdf850aad2bf58f10f1f23be7&req=ciEkFMh9mYZZFb4f3HP0gHQShQ9LV6JfTyUuvcgeFQWtOkUdn0QWwl2b4%2Bqi%0AHPd4pPs74WUVsvWqEA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613213476/42ddf26e4ed6948424d2c597/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9789b0163232d951a4597292a7ed8e556ca7216bdf850aad2bf58f10f1f23be7&req=ciEkFMh9mYZZFb4f3HP0gHQShQ9LV6JfTyUuvcgeFQWtOkUdn0QWwl2b4%2Bqi%0AHPd4pPs74WUVsvWqEA%3D%3D%0A)

Clicking any slot on the appointment book will proceed with booking that patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613212151/08e34a5198ddc8b9c3d86a6c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb99032cc3ee5c6b7dc783ec353c6d1973c7adfd93f14f77ee1ada95c619fae0&req=ciEkFMh8nIReFb4f3HP0gDCFdcXQFSlgufd3TwM1IxymjGtdLangfRekKRQt%0AYLLT1KtWmwyBC78mjQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613212151/08e34a5198ddc8b9c3d86a6c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fb99032cc3ee5c6b7dc783ec353c6d1973c7adfd93f14f77ee1ada95c619fae0&req=ciEkFMh8nIReFb4f3HP0gDCFdcXQFSlgufd3TwM1IxymjGtdLangfRekKRQt%0AYLLT1KtWmwyBC78mjQ%3D%3D%0A)

As you book each family member in sequence the notification will update accordingly.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613213332/1e2b20b5e3249be4c52c762a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14307088c7c5902fa980bb2d33f3981c84ea2f1139524998744f340213168ab7&req=ciEkFMh9noJdFb4f3HP0gCA0z7vpcaX%2B12Bgyr%2FBcvMQYtxoCgfTCcs97eQp%0ARKTxnJ6v905Cbl4%2FCA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613213332/1e2b20b5e3249be4c52c762a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14307088c7c5902fa980bb2d33f3981c84ea2f1139524998744f340213168ab7&req=ciEkFMh9noJdFb4f3HP0gCA0z7vpcaX%2B12Bgyr%2FBcvMQYtxoCgfTCcs97eQp%0ARKTxnJ6v905Cbl4%2FCA%3D%3D%0A)

Continue booking each family member in sequence until all patients are booked.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613213231/6a7ac46b49d7e12db6557562/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88f794238f0327e0e46289459cc413dbffb9d26e017deb544fb038c852c7588e&req=ciEkFMh9n4JeFb4f3HP0gEYfRivLqylKmvJ%2FbCf7vbDYr%2FHVVflvOzMZzTK2%0AAHnVsNgDnVfDwUkOhg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613213231/6a7ac46b49d7e12db6557562/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=88f794238f0327e0e46289459cc413dbffb9d26e017deb544fb038c852c7588e&req=ciEkFMh9n4JeFb4f3HP0gEYfRivLqylKmvJ%2FbCf7vbDYr%2FHVVflvOzMZzTK2%0AAHnVsNgDnVfDwUkOhg%3D%3D%0A)

If you do not wish to book a particular family member at this time, you can remove them from this process by hovering over there name and using the cross.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613212552/2d679e0b0384622e3cf9ee87/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=529cc7d0c89c5e95c6ace5c4c2e007d05da52b91739de9448d60c50e16162764&req=ciEkFMh8mIRdFb4f3HP0gKDfXrWoJhEQuCaxUku%2FACBOucttgK9iB6J3nJxQ%0AuVFUrR0xTGXsyChLug%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613212552/2d679e0b0384622e3cf9ee87/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=529cc7d0c89c5e95c6ace5c4c2e007d05da52b91739de9448d60c50e16162764&req=ciEkFMh8mIRdFb4f3HP0gKDfXrWoJhEQuCaxUku%2FACBOucttgK9iB6J3nJxQ%0AuVFUrR0xTGXsyChLug%3D%3D%0A)

Once all family members have been booked or cleared the Book Family notification will disappear automatically. Alternatively the process can be ended at any time by closing the notification using the cross in the top-right corner.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613215487/9f6983b38c56253b15773229/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=92afbf92b1c05ba11401807ea28234f833bc6c982b46da3d01df20ac53e6fb6d&req=ciEkFMh7mYlYFb4f3HP0gNnQhwMX64SYF4fRVUaeHhxd4JcROZxe4dYTcRcx%0AeM2tPeRN3WHmY%2BEPTQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613215487/9f6983b38c56253b15773229/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=92afbf92b1c05ba11401807ea28234f833bc6c982b46da3d01df20ac53e6fb6d&req=ciEkFMh7mYlYFb4f3HP0gNnQhwMX64SYF4fRVUaeHhxd4JcROZxe4dYTcRcx%0AeM2tPeRN3WHmY%2BEPTQ%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613215581/e4f2efe5273fb2026ccadedb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eb6b03ab7b5c62cbb750e24d69f6d7f0f1fda07f6246bf6e21809644c06028de&req=ciEkFMh7mIleFb4f3HP0gHWiCIun1cObLs8MFOxidi8Iu%2Fx03brw36vsmEzN%0Agqt9NjWtVZfjez9%2Fgg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/613215581/e4f2efe5273fb2026ccadedb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eb6b03ab7b5c62cbb750e24d69f6d7f0f1fda07f6246bf6e21809644c06028de&req=ciEkFMh7mIleFb4f3HP0gHWiCIun1cObLs8MFOxidi8Iu%2Fx03brw36vsmEzN%0Agqt9NjWtVZfjez9%2Fgg%3D%3D%0A)

This is a quick and easy way of booking multiple family members with individual appointments, without having to open or re-select those patient files individually.
