Enabling the ACC New Zealand Integration

Enabling the ACC New Zealand Integration
========================================

Updated over 5 months ago

Table of contents

[Enabling the ACC Integration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6740176-enabling-the-acc-new-zealand-integration#h_6d5c6d2927)

[Patient File Requirements](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6740176-enabling-the-acc-new-zealand-integration#h_c0dc81f858)

[Creating a New Bulk ACC Export](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6740176-enabling-the-acc-new-zealand-integration#h_fdac9f830b)

[Paying Off Previous ACC Exports](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6740176-enabling-the-acc-new-zealand-integration#h_0e0b5c730e)

The ACC integration allows users in New Zealand to export a CSV file directly from PracSuite containing claimable items. This CSV file can be uploaded directly to the ACC '**SendInvoice**' app to submit claims in bulk.

[Click here to read through information from ACC about how to register and download the ACC SendInvoice app.](https://developer.acc.co.nz/get-started/sendinvoice-what-to-expect)

Enabling the ACC Integration
============================

To enable this integration, go to **[Settings > Integrations > ACC](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/ACC)
.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617478369/acb8e38dccb8c1a809d7e0ae/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=003237e7ede0287a3955c64f641005ed7e87897e1cd5e9f14de11ab2a66ca8f0&req=ciEgEs52nodWFb4f3HP0gJBUY5H2owlvx4wtz1bGHq0U5CPVhJMmUL2bH5GP%0ASshTpTKLiaeYRaaddw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617478369/acb8e38dccb8c1a809d7e0ae/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=003237e7ede0287a3955c64f641005ed7e87897e1cd5e9f14de11ab2a66ca8f0&req=ciEgEs52nodWFb4f3HP0gJBUY5H2owlvx4wtz1bGHq0U5CPVhJMmUL2bH5GP%0ASshTpTKLiaeYRaaddw%3D%3D%0A)

After enabling the integration, you will need to ensure that the ACC Claiming Option is enabled on all item codes that you bill under ACC.

Go to **[Settings > Billing > Item Codes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/items)
** and select an item that you will bill to ACC.

Under the Claiming Options header, enable ACC. You only need to fill in the Override Code if the Item Code field does not already contain the item code that applicable to ACC.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617478777/3804541b3ffce1ee91e29269/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a612305cdaea04e3085205825d642dafd9211d478e290bece8fdeb507dd5c017&req=ciEgEs52moZYFb4f3HP0gEFV5GbfCFn0liA2WzDyaz9SH6AyzELJ6NdSeS7g%0Aknq%2F3wsLpfWslcvNnw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617478777/3804541b3ffce1ee91e29269/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a612305cdaea04e3085205825d642dafd9211d478e290bece8fdeb507dd5c017&req=ciEgEs52moZYFb4f3HP0gEFV5GbfCFn0liA2WzDyaz9SH6AyzELJ6NdSeS7g%0Aknq%2F3wsLpfWslcvNnw%3D%3D%0A)

Patient File Requirements
=========================

The patient's account must have a Claim No. entered on their Accounts tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/530162285/d7e30d4fc8bdab3b56b987bf/CleanShot+2022-06-15+at+09.04.28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d1389b00d791035234f6481e84c26f67a0f088b9d76665af2bbef17d58efc276&req=cSMnF898n4laFb4f3HP0gOnt8plJSfUXSA706QobwYLww17G3IumS%2FTVAZVr%0AfPeyg5z2HC%2BlilrGXw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/530162285/d7e30d4fc8bdab3b56b987bf/CleanShot+2022-06-15+at+09.04.28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d1389b00d791035234f6481e84c26f67a0f088b9d76665af2bbef17d58efc276&req=cSMnF898n4laFb4f3HP0gOnt8plJSfUXSA706QobwYLww17G3IumS%2FTVAZVr%0AfPeyg5z2HC%2BlilrGXw%3D%3D%0A)

Creating a New Bulk ACC Export
==============================

Go to **[Reports > Integrations > ACC Bulk Export](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/acc)
.**

Select **New Bulk Export.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617479062/7ff6aed801bc62a7b33d07a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e2a6b9826a55b5d24633ec0a74b190d3375150d1972437d67768f1741d30ea71&req=ciEgEs53nYddFb4f3HP0gGY%2BQ8CVFd9sfUSlrl1da7x%2FQl%2FiS%2BTAJms9KrhK%0ATna5UYcJXvM2c3N%2F%2BA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617479062/7ff6aed801bc62a7b33d07a1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e2a6b9826a55b5d24633ec0a74b190d3375150d1972437d67768f1741d30ea71&req=ciEgEs53nYddFb4f3HP0gGY%2BQ8CVFd9sfUSlrl1da7x%2FQl%2FiS%2BTAJms9KrhK%0ATna5UYcJXvM2c3N%2F%2BA%3D%3D%0A)

Use the filters to narrow down what billed items to include on the export. Note that items that have already been added to another ACC export will be excluded by default.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617479446/a83d603c0ce88ccd21d609fc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72fa8b1124b99a18123ef6855b5db34be6c9ddde3aaa24da1c658d57485b2b82&req=ciEgEs53mYVZFb4f3HP0gLtgq1oP9FW%2BJ75mauUnOEYuU4yfFmNGH56rX%2BTt%0AyTnLdD83SwjplO%2F0iA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617479446/a83d603c0ce88ccd21d609fc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72fa8b1124b99a18123ef6855b5db34be6c9ddde3aaa24da1c658d57485b2b82&req=ciEgEs53mYVZFb4f3HP0gLtgq1oP9FW%2BJ75mauUnOEYuU4yfFmNGH56rX%2BTt%0AyTnLdD83SwjplO%2F0iA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Find Items** to search for any ACC claimable items matching your filters. Any ACC items that have been billed per your report filters will be displayed.

Select **Save & Download** to generate the CSV export for upload to ACC.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617480034/711e77a14818755ee499d019/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c0a3ee56f7afcdc762f9c8d01fdb006f03a321339fdc761e199b3741c44d7be4&req=ciEgEsF%2BnYJbFb4f3HP0gFGLl8uGurCxyL0XNrJgmZJKa5PYq788BASGmm%2Bb%0AY049Sv0%2FwOA4pq9aZw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617480034/711e77a14818755ee499d019/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c0a3ee56f7afcdc762f9c8d01fdb006f03a321339fdc761e199b3741c44d7be4&req=ciEgEsF%2BnYJbFb4f3HP0gFGLl8uGurCxyL0XNrJgmZJKa5PYq788BASGmm%2Bb%0AY049Sv0%2FwOA4pq9aZw%3D%3D%0A)

Paying Off Previous ACC Exports
===============================

Go to **[Reports > Integrations > ACC Bulk Exports](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/integrations/acc)
.**

Use the filters to find the previously generated export that you wish to pay off.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617481121/c8880837839eec6bf619df09/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=895fb8a379d02554583434acf8c8d16fc459036f5eb59c121c830840b5e82d64&req=ciEgEsF%2FnINeFb4f3HP0gIggpCxziNXOkC55sBtt7R0hKjm1uAsq%2B4Ec%2FUEb%0AmnbvAk5LUhSgnrsQ7w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/617481121/c8880837839eec6bf619df09/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=895fb8a379d02554583434acf8c8d16fc459036f5eb59c121c830840b5e82d64&req=ciEgEsF%2FnINeFb4f3HP0gIggpCxziNXOkC55sBtt7R0hKjm1uAsq%2B4Ec%2FUEb%0AmnbvAk5LUhSgnrsQ7w%3D%3D%0A)

From the report results, select the export you wish to pay and then select **Payment**.

The payment screen will appear for you to apply the payment accordingly.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1708334592/abf362c4819eb3668335117833cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=376081509e2e64fd56c0e19d1c9a729c16f7f509143d86b8b4287b5213a47a55&req=dScnHsp9mYRWW%2FMW1HO4zaVJadNpJX1Uo%2FbzFg7Cx0orUfe108ziCEdmTDRJ%0Auw%2BLhBhIyi8BjmWU3WM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1708334592/abf362c4819eb3668335117833cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=376081509e2e64fd56c0e19d1c9a729c16f7f509143d86b8b4287b5213a47a55&req=dScnHsp9mYRWW%2FMW1HO4zaVJadNpJX1Uo%2FbzFg7Cx0orUfe108ziCEdmTDRJ%0Auw%2BLhBhIyi8BjmWU3WM%3D%0A)

Enter the payment amount and relevant details into the Group Cheque or Group Bank Transfer fields.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1708339356/d7f5654cc73f0604cf7b3966039b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f61e9d329b51f4bad7c44f1b504bf0fedbaaa823ad8c6e47dffc8fdaa5fe12b8&req=dScnHsp9lIJaX%2FMW1HO4zZMaLeatGoXS5BGcHG0ObRIOQqFB4go04aa2WBvE%0AmdMVcWL4aC71lau7UsA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1708339356/d7f5654cc73f0604cf7b3966039b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f61e9d329b51f4bad7c44f1b504bf0fedbaaa823ad8c6e47dffc8fdaa5fe12b8&req=dScnHsp9lIJaX%2FMW1HO4zZMaLeatGoXS5BGcHG0ObRIOQqFB4go04aa2WBvE%0AmdMVcWL4aC71lau7UsA%3D%0A)

Once the payment has been added you can edit how it is allocated to the items by clicking on the edit icon for the payment.  
​

Note: The edit icon will only show when you hover your cursor over the payment.

In the Edit Payment window the allocation of the payment can be edited by using the fields in the Allocation column on the right. Once you're happy with how the payments have been allocated, click Confirm.  
​

Finally, click on Save at the top of the page to finalise the process.

Enabling the Xero Integration

Enabling the Xero Integration
=============================

Updated over 9 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview: How PracSuite Syncs with Xero](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6828584-enabling-the-xero-integration#h_d55b7073ec)

PracSuite integrates with Xero to help you reconcile the payments you're recording in PracSuite with the settlements you're receiving in your bank account. This article outlines how the integration works so that bookkeepers understand the data flow and intent, as well as the steps to configure the integration.

Overview: How PracSuite Syncs with Xero
=======================================

Key Points
----------

*   **Daily Summary Sync**: Payments entered in PracSuite are synced to Xero as daily totals per payment method. We don’t mirror individual invoices from PracSuite to Xero.
    
*   **Purpose of the Integration**: This process makes it easier to reconcile what was recorded in PracSuite with the payments settled into your bank account.
    
*   **Invoice per Payment Method per Day**: PracSuite creates one invoice per payment method for each synced date in Xero. For example, if on 1 May you took payments via Cash, EFTPOS, and Bank Transfer, three invoices will be created in Xero.
    
*   **Invoices Are Automatically Paid**: These invoices are marked as paid in Xero using intelligent logic to match how payments are settled into your bank account. The payments we create in Xero include detailed reference information to assist with reconciliation. For example:
    
    *   **Bank Transfers**: Payments entered in PracSuite as bank transfers are created individually in Xero and applied to the relevant daily 'Bank Transfer' invoice. Each payment includes the payer name and remittance number from PracSuite.
        
    *   **Medicare and DVA**: Payments are created individually per practitioner, and the payment descriptions in Xero include the provider number. This mirrors how Medicare and DVA settlements appear on your bank statement.
        
    *   [Click here to learn more about how payment data is synced to Xero.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6986979-how-are-pracsuite-payments-synced-to-xero)
        
    

General Bookkeeping Workflow
----------------------------

When using the PracSuite Xero integration on an ongoing basis, the general workflow for bookkeepers is:

1.  **Apply payments to invoices in PracSuite** for the date range you're planning to sync.
    
2.  **Once all payments for a specific date have been entered in PracSuite, sync that date to Xero**.
    
    *   You **cannot re-sync a date**, so ensure the day’s takings are final before syncing.
        
    
3.  **Use Xero’s reconciliation tools** to match the invoices and payments PracSuite created with the transactions on your bank feed.
    

Common Misunderstandings
------------------------

*   **No 1-to-1 Invoice Syncing**: We don’t create an invoice in Xero for each invoice in PracSuite. Instead, we summarise the payments.
    
*   **Outstanding Invoices Are Not Relevant**: The integration is focused on payments applied to invoices, not on tracking which individual invoices in PracSuite are still unpaid. Whether an invoice in PracSuite is outstanding does not affect what gets sent to Xero. You can manage owing invoice in PracSuite directly using the Outstanding Invoices and Account Balance reports.
    
*   **Refunds Are Not Synced**: Refunds are not included in the Xero sync. If you refund a payment, you’ll need to manually adjust this in Xero.
    

Tips for Success
----------------

*   Start by testing the integration using a Xero demo or test organisation.
    
*   Only sync once all payments received in your bank account on a particular date have all been applied in PracSuite.
    
*   Speak to your accountant or bookkeeper before syncing to ensure the chart of accounts and sync setup align with your business needs.
    

For detailed configuration and step-by-step instructions, continue with the rest of this guide.

* * *

Below is an overview of the data flow between PracSuite and Xero:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/669630393/4a057b4a220a24bcccc6f5c4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7503ee7bd0ffa29d2160e01cde03d967d3f7851c0d9c598cd8b4e6a11632ee67&req=ciYuEMp%2BnohcFb4f3HP0gOYryHDFF%2BqzdEWax09wXVf5et0yNr4l92S3a09R%0AHNqBP0PFreSFD9ANyA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/669630393/4a057b4a220a24bcccc6f5c4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7503ee7bd0ffa29d2160e01cde03d967d3f7851c0d9c598cd8b4e6a11632ee67&req=ciYuEMp%2BnohcFb4f3HP0gOYryHDFF%2BqzdEWax09wXVf5et0yNr4l92S3a09R%0AHNqBP0PFreSFD9ANyA%3D%3D%0A)

**Before using this integration, please note that Xero does not provide any means to reverse an upload made to their system. We strongly suggest that you test your integration using the ‘Demo Company’ organisation before uploading data to your live (production) Xero organisation.**

We provide the Xero integration 'as-is' and users must assess for themselves whether the integration is suitable for their professional use. It is assumed that all data being uploaded to Xero has been finalised, with no further changes expected, before it is uploaded to Xero. There may still be situations that require manual adjustments in Xero.

**Smartsoft Pty Ltd is not responsible for any unwanted changes to your Xero account.**

Step 1 - Creating a Xero organisation
----------------------------------------

To integrate Xero you will first need to create a Xero account and Organisation, if you do not already have one available. If you are new to Xero, it is essential to work with your accountant or bookkeeper to configure your Xero accounts in a way that suits your accounting and taxation needs. These accounts will then be set in PracSuite to determine where invoices and payments are uploaded within Xero.

**We strongly recommend using the ‘Demo Company’ organisation to trial the integration and confirm the uploaded data is appropriate for your accounting needs.**

1) Navigate to [https://www.xero.com/signup](https://www.xero.com.au/signup)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649139551/22af2952c74a74aea585d2af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=484baaf959ff4edfae64d317969d46c99dcd02ec2681ad4d7ff496ed0c7f0514&req=ciQuF8p3mIReFb4f3HP0gLdlIPOp57SBOLD7uxwC0nLhKzibiTEopXMpKYJE%0AI2Qn2OHtZe8NcN3gWA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649139551/22af2952c74a74aea585d2af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=484baaf959ff4edfae64d317969d46c99dcd02ec2681ad4d7ff496ed0c7f0514&req=ciQuF8p3mIReFb4f3HP0gLdlIPOp57SBOLD7uxwC0nLhKzibiTEopXMpKYJE%0AI2Qn2OHtZe8NcN3gWA%3D%3D%0A)

2) Enter your details and click **Next: Confirmation**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649139742/5cce0ac69da44b525d8433c0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b14704330dc53a17ec8b3a66e82a7501f325157db8fec78aa9b1351faa289803&req=ciQuF8p3moVdFb4f3HP0gNEEJOIkcoCmp91VbUrW2Pv8RHtN2LBGBHxP2%2FIj%0A2S%2BKoidjFBCzoR2vvA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649139742/5cce0ac69da44b525d8433c0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b14704330dc53a17ec8b3a66e82a7501f325157db8fec78aa9b1351faa289803&req=ciQuF8p3moVdFb4f3HP0gNEEJOIkcoCmp91VbUrW2Pv8RHtN2LBGBHxP2%2FIj%0A2S%2BKoidjFBCzoR2vvA%3D%3D%0A)

You will be sent an email to verify your account.

3) Following the email instructions, activate your account in Xero by entering a password.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649143531/593a207f4d290caf38c7594c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1725243f06f164e808ef13f3bc8be37a37641693597268131b1f5f6a6d1933d0&req=ciQuF819mIJeFb4f3HP0gJ%2BfxibiBRSxokED6mAbIU8m45dsFxrZ8HEMw4Mt%0Addy%2FLP%2FOkX1Bo8eCPg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649143531/593a207f4d290caf38c7594c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1725243f06f164e808ef13f3bc8be37a37641693597268131b1f5f6a6d1933d0&req=ciQuF819mIJeFb4f3HP0gJ%2BfxibiBRSxokED6mAbIU8m45dsFxrZ8HEMw4Mt%0Addy%2FLP%2FOkX1Bo8eCPg%3D%3D%0A)

4) Add your business details and click **Start trial**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649144088/5343f3c2ff3ed3946d526933/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2807fd9258815336ecdc9591e12d9d39e8564078892424c6a213877106354004&req=ciQuF816nYlXFb4f3HP0gDoPn3SFCa55g49WZxeRvk2%2F7PSp1Qa2OvT6DHyr%0AZLcUi67aGxfs%2Br0Epg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649144088/5343f3c2ff3ed3946d526933/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2807fd9258815336ecdc9591e12d9d39e8564078892424c6a213877106354004&req=ciQuF816nYlXFb4f3HP0gDoPn3SFCa55g49WZxeRvk2%2F7PSp1Qa2OvT6DHyr%0AZLcUi67aGxfs%2Br0Epg%3D%3D%0A)

On completion you will be directed to your Xero dashboard, where your organisation name should be displayed in the top left of the screen.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649144963/fb5c040d6e65c73dad89dc86/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96e881287483a901458741685bcc1f87db2c5fa93da263454fbe3d1e14a5f62e&req=ciQuF816lIdcFb4f3HP0gObtJujBt48QgbA41XNaUefIGgIGMds%2B9C%2BDGhnf%0As7q9PUgG2SjVzeXWQQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649144963/fb5c040d6e65c73dad89dc86/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=96e881287483a901458741685bcc1f87db2c5fa93da263454fbe3d1e14a5f62e&req=ciQuF816lIdcFb4f3HP0gObtJujBt48QgbA41XNaUefIGgIGMds%2B9C%2BDGhnf%0As7q9PUgG2SjVzeXWQQ%3D%3D%0A)

5) Rather than use the **Demo Company** we recommend you create a new 'dummy' organisation titled 'PracSuite Xero Testing' or similar, where you can safely trial the uploads from PracSuite to Xero.

* * *

  
Step 2 - Creating Xero accounts
----------------------------------

Accounts are an important part of the Xero system and fundamental to the integration with PracSuite. When syncing to Xero we need to know where PracSuite should create sales invoices, along with where to allocate payments. We recommend planning your account setup with your bookkeeper or accountant for best results.

Expand the section below to view further details on creating accounts in Xero

How to create accounts in your Xero trial account
-------------------------------------------------

1) From the Xero menu, click **Accounting** and select **Chart of accounts**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802706/050398526844d0c430f72881054a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=102ae05152b08545a097cc47459b7fb9c91823d5b94fe98336cc501848acac17&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZfX%2FMW1HO4zZd50o8SRjiZRf4zdBY7Hrb8VshuWeAwSXMoMMts%0A5lYX%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802706/050398526844d0c430f72881054a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=102ae05152b08545a097cc47459b7fb9c91823d5b94fe98336cc501848acac17&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZfX%2FMW1HO4zZd50o8SRjiZRf4zdBY7Hrb8VshuWeAwSXMoMMts%0A5lYX%0A)

The **Chart of accounts** is used by Xero to categorise transactions, such as those we will be uploading from PracSuite. Default accounts are available, but if required you can create additional accounts.

2) Click the **Add Account** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802707/94c71c9b2bc23547f9fa409d2596/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25d6c4cdc8ea30010e4724b79b0bf60455f8e260706b9ee5788fc1d926c64969&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZfXvMW1HO4zSIf%2FBDqATzjeYq%2FRygsC%2F0w2JYl4uAzBCKFZG2I%0AzcFY%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802707/94c71c9b2bc23547f9fa409d2596/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25d6c4cdc8ea30010e4724b79b0bf60455f8e260706b9ee5788fc1d926c64969&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZfXvMW1HO4zSIf%2FBDqATzjeYq%2FRygsC%2F0w2JYl4uAzBCKFZG2I%0AzcFY%0A)

3) Enter details appropriate for a **Sales/Invoices** account, then click **Save**.  
​  
Below is an example for a 'Sales' account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802708/46313994f5bd2497aa9764330f95/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d316678d4e924cffe99e16f551ee09d69b06cea21dc5af1218b71b8ff30daf2&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZfUfMW1HO4zUfk6x%2F2A%2BB%2BOfYDAqlHEHFvPHbK7y1OTIKts0hx%0AlbP%2B%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802708/46313994f5bd2497aa9764330f95/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d316678d4e924cffe99e16f551ee09d69b06cea21dc5af1218b71b8ff30daf2&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZfUfMW1HO4zUfk6x%2F2A%2BB%2BOfYDAqlHEHFvPHbK7y1OTIKts0hx%0AlbP%2B%0A)

4) Click the **Add Bank Account** button and link your Bank Account to Xero.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802713/57e512ba728c61c918929a8bb087/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3fe21c4930278dea79c79627eb496ed3459fda039dd5aa7acdcf7b4d0e3d9f21&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZeWvMW1HO4zVzFIVZzYJquxcDyM%2BZr2Y7WoCWkZl7CHFTLdhZK%0Akh%2F%2B%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802713/57e512ba728c61c918929a8bb087/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3fe21c4930278dea79c79627eb496ed3459fda039dd5aa7acdcf7b4d0e3d9f21&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZeWvMW1HO4zVzFIVZzYJquxcDyM%2BZr2Y7WoCWkZl7CHFTLdhZK%0Akh%2F%2B%0A)

Follow the prompts to create a bank account in Xero.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802712/d1d6cb4fae31f7c7f15c969fa6fc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3a93e5182f7005f1b7106ef17ffcb343af0cc38f3b1a0395397c9a2fc4303f2c&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZeW%2FMW1HO4zRSyjKhliJGY4uQYW3VvtQH2%2FT%2B0igeO9lsNDgsb%0AWwNM%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802712/d1d6cb4fae31f7c7f15c969fa6fc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3a93e5182f7005f1b7106ef17ffcb343af0cc38f3b1a0395397c9a2fc4303f2c&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZeW%2FMW1HO4zRSyjKhliJGY4uQYW3VvtQH2%2FT%2B0igeO9lsNDgsb%0AWwNM%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802711/d8495ae525b0b12824cccb81da9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5da7d16717fc37042f5757d3b4198867842cd9924df23fbbe8565f1cb0b0b494&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZeWPMW1HO4zcQ6ao0hbdHvATCImLA3jYLx9yNLDCKret5jh8EY%0AhumZ%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547802711/d8495ae525b0b12824cccb81da9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5da7d16717fc37042f5757d3b4198867842cd9924df23fbbe8565f1cb0b0b494&req=dSUjEcF%2Bn4ZeWPMW1HO4zcQ6ao0hbdHvATCImLA3jYLx9yNLDCKret5jh8EY%0AhumZ%0A)

**Please note that for use of the Reconciliation features in Xero, this should be selected as your 'Payments' account in PracSuite.**

  
5) Repeat as needed to create additional accounts.  
​  
If needed, PracSuite allows users to:

*   Upload each payment method to a unique account.  
    ​
    
*   Create sales invoices in unique accounts depending on which **Item Schedule** the payment was allocated against.  
    ​
    
*   Create sales invoices in unique accounts depending on which **Item** the payment was allocated against.
    

All of which can be set per **Business** in PracSuite.

* * *

Step 3 - Configuring PracSuite for Xero integration
---------------------------------------------------

With your Xero account configured, you can now enable the integration features in PracSuite and begin your upload configuration.

1) In PracSuite, Go to **[Settings > Integrations > Xero](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/xero)
**.

2) Enable the Xero Integration.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649157421/e8328f0fa3c422bffedf964c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0e5515fb57828c069fbe10009ced0f9902f144d1747e76e0eeeb93fb30ccc4d4&req=ciQuF8x5mYNeFb4f3HP0gK3STEJ%2B52UXDYl9aMFAqha97o5RJ9pDWOf5oZaR%0A8FPjJxp%2Fr2eanTG%2FgQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649157421/e8328f0fa3c422bffedf964c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0e5515fb57828c069fbe10009ced0f9902f144d1747e76e0eeeb93fb30ccc4d4&req=ciQuF8x5mYNeFb4f3HP0gK3STEJ%2B52UXDYl9aMFAqha97o5RJ9pDWOf5oZaR%0A8FPjJxp%2Fr2eanTG%2FgQ%3D%3D%0A)

3) Click the **Add** button, after which you will be prompted to login to your Xero account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649157586/699db371bf10dd1de71924b1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=41e22c4f879537963c8760c799ec6911a8cee4cc7a9349a04c031304a043557c&req=ciQuF8x5mIlZFb4f3HP0gLWvXhvLtfsnXTAGjJPJZH%2BE%2BPhNeyg6qmxyoFka%0A3L6lhd0hMO%2Fnj92aOg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649157586/699db371bf10dd1de71924b1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=41e22c4f879537963c8760c799ec6911a8cee4cc7a9349a04c031304a043557c&req=ciQuF8x5mIlZFb4f3HP0gLWvXhvLtfsnXTAGjJPJZH%2BE%2BPhNeyg6qmxyoFka%0A3L6lhd0hMO%2Fnj92aOg%3D%3D%0A)

4) Select the **Organisation** you wish to integrate with, and then click **Allow access**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649158194/6223226b98e43810649ef3b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0c85b63b03a6ad5bf0c04ce628fea4a7707f6a291069fb0a342308036e51efcb&req=ciQuF8x2nIhbFb4f3HP0gKRM8y4AFrpTRci%2BRpX2Yerk6fUFDoKsieU0ET9y%0A1hRUJHvtDucRw%2Foa4A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649158194/6223226b98e43810649ef3b5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0c85b63b03a6ad5bf0c04ce628fea4a7707f6a291069fb0a342308036e51efcb&req=ciQuF8x2nIhbFb4f3HP0gKRM8y4AFrpTRci%2BRpX2Yerk6fUFDoKsieU0ET9y%0A1hRUJHvtDucRw%2Foa4A%3D%3D%0A)

If you do not see the 'Organisation' drop-down at the top of this screen, it means you only have a single organisation available in Xero and it has been selected automatically.

We strongly recommend using a 'Demo' organisation to test your integration, where you can safely upload data without consequence. You can later repeat this process and connect to your live organisation, once you have verified the settings and resulting uploads are correct for your business.

Once you have allowed access to your Xero organisation, a corresponding 'organisation' will be created in PracSuite where you can configure the integration options.

5) Select the default **Sales** and **Payment** accounts to be used.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547820786/c7daf2b1ad1915fa8451f49e7da3/CleanShot%2B2025-05-30%2Bat%2B09_56_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8c3377e4636dbb23f5290b751af5238cda552b15d8c19a4f1f0ee57f68f34f4d&req=dSUjEcF8nYZXX%2FMW1HO4zWbJUwWza2cAOqD3phOFG9WUYG%2Bl28ZzN3grm%2FFt%0AR%2FH2RwXmC1Gd3mWlXgU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547820786/c7daf2b1ad1915fa8451f49e7da3/CleanShot%2B2025-05-30%2Bat%2B09_56_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8c3377e4636dbb23f5290b751af5238cda552b15d8c19a4f1f0ee57f68f34f4d&req=dSUjEcF8nYZXX%2FMW1HO4zWbJUwWza2cAOqD3phOFG9WUYG%2Bl28ZzN3grm%2FFt%0AR%2FH2RwXmC1Gd3mWlXgU%3D%0A)

In the selected **Sales Account**, PracSuite will create an invoice per date per payment method for the payments received from that payment method.

In the selected **Payments Accounts**, PracSuite will create payments per date per payment method and apply them to the associated invoice created in the Sales Account. The Payment Account is generally the bank account into which your payments are settled.

If you do not see your bank account in the payments drop-down menu, ensure that you have allocated an account code to your bank account within Xero from the [Accounting > Chart of Accounts](https://go.xero.com/GeneralLedger/ChartOfAccounts.aspx)
 section.

[Click here to learn more about how payment data is synced to Xero.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6986979-how-are-pracsuite-payments-synced-to-xero)
  
​

These are the default accounts to be used when no further overrides are specified on the **Business**, **Payment Method**, **Schedule** or **Item Code**.

6) In the **Businesses** section, click **Add** and select the businesses associated with this Xero organisation.

Any payments added to PracSuite for the selected business will be uploaded to this Xero organisation.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649165040/ff6b7ef955ee7160c3bec723/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=33a9d50aa1b096aaa8fba342548f1929920e16d56dc231350d662d0a32e12de6&req=ciQuF897nYVfFb4f3HP0gO12J10qpnlDTa0Uvj85JGyTlmoTplPbZkGfUAQA%0A2yc9gMSWfJDJo%2FWOAA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649165040/ff6b7ef955ee7160c3bec723/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=33a9d50aa1b096aaa8fba342548f1929920e16d56dc231350d662d0a32e12de6&req=ciQuF897nYVfFb4f3HP0gO12J10qpnlDTa0Uvj85JGyTlmoTplPbZkGfUAQA%0A2yc9gMSWfJDJo%2FWOAA%3D%3D%0A)

By default the totals for these businesses will be uploaded separately into Xero. If you require these totals to be consolidated, use the **Consolidate** checkbox to select which businesses should have their totals combined.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649165902/af3437405e48b68c21b2289c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2e7d39484d74d9214abe7889457c5709d30a777346285ebd8886253df512775e&req=ciQuF897lIFdFb4f3HP0gCbh2Vc9POMyZilPeDZYw9WXsGQWEkzOX1bU9gtH%0AWEgC8E%2FjsfihcNfcow%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649165902/af3437405e48b68c21b2289c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2e7d39484d74d9214abe7889457c5709d30a777346285ebd8886253df512775e&req=ciQuF897lIFdFb4f3HP0gCbh2Vc9POMyZilPeDZYw9WXsGQWEkzOX1bU9gtH%0AWEgC8E%2FjsfihcNfcow%3D%3D%0A)

7) **Payment Method Overrides** can be configured if required. These overrides control which accounts certain payments will be synced to in Xero.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547806481/ef8520209e05b189ebb83e167355/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+09_57_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a1a2b44363738737d205e95f47b5c744669e02ca8a9e3570b10ef80e6b9c93e2&req=dSUjEcF%2Bm4VXWPMW1HO4zY0zoW7FsKwmK38XrpEjlD9gJM0ISN8wgSqEgHJf%0Ai3LO2kfnngsfk1ePb0A%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547806481/ef8520209e05b189ebb83e167355/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+09_57_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a1a2b44363738737d205e95f47b5c744669e02ca8a9e3570b10ef80e6b9c93e2&req=dSUjEcF%2Bm4VXWPMW1HO4zY0zoW7FsKwmK38XrpEjlD9gJM0ISN8wgSqEgHJf%0Ai3LO2kfnngsfk1ePb0A%3D%0A)

Optionally, you can also choose whether to:

*   **Exclude Payment Methods from Xero Sync**  
    Ideal for payment methods that you do not want to sync to Xero as income received (such as when gift cards are used to pay off items).  
    ​
    
*   **Consolidate Credit Card Payments**  
    This determines if 'Credit Card' payments should be uploaded as a single total, or with separate totals for 'Visa' and 'Mastercard' etc.  
    ​
    
*   **Consolidate Health Fund Payments**  
    This determines if 'Health Fund' payments should be uploaded as a single total, or uploaded separately based on whether the payment was entered manually or using Tyro Health Online or Tyro Health EFTPOS.
    

8) **Schedule Overrides** can be added if required. This can be used to specify a different **Sales Account** to be used when the payment has been allocated to an Item Code within the specified Schedule.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649173733/452787b7e0866bd6f7430743/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc9a82ba36ee56ce1b58969231c074d8e8d107435e8492ea89aab2586852b03a&req=ciQuF859moJcFb4f3HP0gK%2FvDCB%2Fx%2B4caF6yxUvkPO9v4LdCeJJ3EK2twcn7%0AuWguTqY5BteHm20s1w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649173733/452787b7e0866bd6f7430743/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc9a82ba36ee56ce1b58969231c074d8e8d107435e8492ea89aab2586852b03a&req=ciQuF859moJcFb4f3HP0gK%2FvDCB%2Fx%2B4caF6yxUvkPO9v4LdCeJJ3EK2twcn7%0AuWguTqY5BteHm20s1w%3D%3D%0A)

9) **Item Code Overrides** can be added if required. You can configure the following types of Item Code Overrides:

*   **Exclude Item Codes -** PracSuite will not sync payments applied to these specific items. This is ideal for Tyro EFTPOS users that apply surcharges to card payments. We are required to include these items on invoices when using the Tyro EFTPOS integration, however as surcharges are deducted from your transaction fees and are not settled to your bank account daily, they can be excluded from the Xero sync process so that these amounts don't interfer with reconciliation workflows.  
    ​
    
*   **Override Item Code Account -** This can be used to specify a different **Sales Account** to be used when the payment has been allocated to a specific Item Code.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547814716/d80a68ba8c640861dd986a80bc69/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+10_06_47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ade69ce91e4a1a402423020409d2e938683b230d280816c2c4e01890ae32c878&req=dSUjEcF%2FmYZeX%2FMW1HO4zWrCKS2CSWE7xYGKRO2EampUhfJM82oYI3yFcXjM%0AAAUTpzM0Q0%2FRBOFynFs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547814716/d80a68ba8c640861dd986a80bc69/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+10_06_47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ade69ce91e4a1a402423020409d2e938683b230d280816c2c4e01890ae32c878&req=dSUjEcF%2FmYZeX%2FMW1HO4zWrCKS2CSWE7xYGKRO2EampUhfJM82oYI3yFcXjM%0AAAUTpzM0Q0%2FRBOFynFs%3D%0A)

Overriding Account Settings Per Business
----------------------------------------

If you are syncing multiple PracSuite businesses to the same Xero organisation and you require payments to be synced to Xero to separate accounts, you can configure Xero account overrides per business.

Under the **Businesses** section, select the **Account Setup** button and repeat the steps above to configure your preferences for that specific business.

The business-specific configuration will take precedence over any settings on the main Xero page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649171494/7c7a0a2f3eb24b23b1a6bf64/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=122b107e9fa928433dc78b235145c5a5407316ae58b452080ef1dee62c36b1a9&req=ciQuF85%2FmYhbFb4f3HP0gNhyHmsUI67ECDYugA0aPyE01SewJrneL1clhAqy%0ARMDV65y8md75OqFV5w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649171494/7c7a0a2f3eb24b23b1a6bf64/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=122b107e9fa928433dc78b235145c5a5407316ae58b452080ef1dee62c36b1a9&req=ciQuF85%2FmYhbFb4f3HP0gNhyHmsUI67ECDYugA0aPyE01SewJrneL1clhAqy%0ARMDV65y8md75OqFV5w%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Step 4 - Syncing to Xero
------------------------

Once your Xero account has been integrated with PracSuite and configured correctly, you are now ready to sync your payment totals to Xero.

Please ensure you have recorded all payments for the date range you are planning to sync in PracSuite. Once a date range has been synced to Xero, it cannot be synced again.

1) Log in to PracSuite and navigate to **[Settings > Integrations > Xero](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/xero)
**.

2) Select the **Organisation** from the displayed list.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649178131/ed0749dc515d8194682ac8af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5c51586f05819c433d7ba1cb3d83ba3cce5acaba5c4ca8ce85562c21d505a4e4&req=ciQuF852nIJeFb4f3HP0gGld5Gscuw%2FM%2BvHPWDc1BFlkU5KI8I8vLpLmlErG%0ANUzFd9pGkWDfjEgZSg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649178131/ed0749dc515d8194682ac8af/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5c51586f05819c433d7ba1cb3d83ba3cce5acaba5c4ca8ce85562c21d505a4e4&req=ciQuF852nIJeFb4f3HP0gGld5Gscuw%2FM%2BvHPWDc1BFlkU5KI8I8vLpLmlErG%0ANUzFd9pGkWDfjEgZSg%3D%3D%0A)

3) Click the **Sync Now** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649178424/49dd3b51c0ed57069a2cc155/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be9ae3a0b1504061849fec1d65ed4a72a62e46df99b3522b252304d11830b3b8&req=ciQuF852mYNbFb4f3HP0gNqaXCUgYTsliVif45bazO1L%2BHqtdRFjHV6t8i6t%0ANGRztmK%2FhZXbwFqFgQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649178424/49dd3b51c0ed57069a2cc155/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=be9ae3a0b1504061849fec1d65ed4a72a62e46df99b3522b252304d11830b3b8&req=ciQuF852mYNbFb4f3HP0gNqaXCUgYTsliVif45bazO1L%2BHqtdRFjHV6t8i6t%0ANGRztmK%2FhZXbwFqFgQ%3D%3D%0A)

4) When syncing to Xero for the first time, you will be able to specify both a **Start Date** and an **End Date**. PracSuite will upload payment totals for each date in this range.  
​  
Enter a **Start Date** and **End Date**, then click **Sync**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649179029/b7fabf3a35698c385432c47a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f50f8570b99f8859dcf919d8409b8c88b26ea584c701db3eed959ace5b264ae&req=ciQuF853nYNWFb4f3HP0gAUe7u3uQr7EYcCyvv8bh88I6ubYh2qerm%2BIwXe%2F%0A0OprPhmvK%2Bz3GXOJlw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649179029/b7fabf3a35698c385432c47a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4f50f8570b99f8859dcf919d8409b8c88b26ea584c701db3eed959ace5b264ae&req=ciQuF853nYNWFb4f3HP0gAUe7u3uQr7EYcCyvv8bh88I6ubYh2qerm%2BIwXe%2F%0A0OprPhmvK%2Bz3GXOJlw%3D%3D%0A)

Please note when clicking Sync in the future you will only be able to specify an **End Date** and not overlap past upload periods. You cannot re-upload dates that have already been synced to Xero.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547832240/ef617455f9d05c099ff46b240d5e/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+10_33_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1edb31f9e53ef9592c9d2de3a9756836cda315a72328483f3413714c906505d&req=dSUjEcF9n4NbWfMW1HO4zajIf14Kx4%2FfMn15yI17Ec3QcCJLq4MbeyUdYoUd%0A0dCeljjYRKQ%2FO2cBWYg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1547832240/ef617455f9d05c099ff46b240d5e/CleanShot+2025-05-30+at+10_33_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1edb31f9e53ef9592c9d2de3a9756836cda315a72328483f3413714c906505d&req=dSUjEcF9n4NbWfMW1HO4zajIf14Kx4%2FfMn15yI17Ec3QcCJLq4MbeyUdYoUd%0A0dCeljjYRKQ%2FO2cBWYg%3D%0A)

Congratulations, you have successfully used Xero integration.  
​

* * *

Step 5 - Sync Log and Resync
----------------------------

If you believe an upload to Xero has failed, the **Log** is available to view and allows you to attempt resyncing the failed upload.

1) Log in to PracSuite and navigate to **[Settings > Integrations > Xero](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/xero)
**.

2) Select the **Organisation** from the displayed list.

3) Select the **Log** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649181881/c5fed352d0432ebec9d30692/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dfc9a1756ee8056c7abfa795e76137e37c9e8b0f59fb715d8207b2a2134106f&req=ciQuF8F%2FlYleFb4f3HP0gEzx9GwaF0voSAV7TWPQFjLwqVRk%2Bxg6c%2FKpacpi%0AYpCsMus3XEcv%2FMzYnQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649181881/c5fed352d0432ebec9d30692/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dfc9a1756ee8056c7abfa795e76137e37c9e8b0f59fb715d8207b2a2134106f&req=ciQuF8F%2FlYleFb4f3HP0gEzx9GwaF0voSAV7TWPQFjLwqVRk%2Bxg6c%2FKpacpi%0AYpCsMus3XEcv%2FMzYnQ%3D%3D%0A)

This will provide a summary of Completed and Failed uploads to Xero.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649182072/172c1a68ac773ff101360665/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ffbb3b2a383fa352182105902c99b3844f1b8876dc201e8694baa231923778ac&req=ciQuF8F8nYZdFb4f3HP0gPQlJGPKXs5C5pTHHE5WWib1qFIe03qpYVRrIN63%0AhtD9IXM7BdCjkv1LdA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649182072/172c1a68ac773ff101360665/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ffbb3b2a383fa352182105902c99b3844f1b8876dc201e8694baa231923778ac&req=ciQuF8F8nYZdFb4f3HP0gPQlJGPKXs5C5pTHHE5WWib1qFIe03qpYVRrIN63%0AhtD9IXM7BdCjkv1LdA%3D%3D%0A)

If the **Sync Status** is 'Failed' you will be able to expand the grid to see additional details.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649184861/c265ef654a29c7154814e33d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0f6301c9aa259d456a72bd35f3a807da0067d7c985450be05ec7af7dfccf9594&req=ciQuF8F6lYdeFb4f3HP0gOCUWFogxCAGHOjh1n7Is5RmDg0nQmr%2F%2BJhMTmx%2F%0AManXlMAv21BPtXSMWQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/649184861/c265ef654a29c7154814e33d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0f6301c9aa259d456a72bd35f3a807da0067d7c985450be05ec7af7dfccf9594&req=ciQuF8F6lYdeFb4f3HP0gOCUWFogxCAGHOjh1n7Is5RmDg0nQmr%2F%2BJhMTmx%2F%0AManXlMAv21BPtXSMWQ%3D%3D%0A)

In this example we can see the failure description is 'Account could not be found', which suggests the account in Xero is no longer available or has changed name or ID. This can be resolved by using the '**Reload Accounts**' option in PracSuite and ensuring your have a valid payment account selected.

Once resolved, you can return to the Log and select the **Re-Sync** option to attempt the upload again. Alternatively, you can choose the **Ignore** option if you want to resolve this failure manually or re-syncing is not a viable option.

Frequently Asked Questions
==========================

#### **I’m not familiar with Xero, how much support can Smartsoft provide?**

Smartsoft can assist with integrating your PracSuite system to Xero, however we cannot provide assistance with the use of Xero itself. This includes the creation of your Xero account, along with the creation of individual accounts and bank reconciliation. Further, we are not accountants and cannot provide financial or taxation advice.  
​

* * *

#### **Do I really need to start with a trial organisation in Xero?**  
​

We strongly recommend beginning with a trial organisation in Xero. This will allow you to verify your account mapping between PracSuite and Xero, while also confirming the results match your expectations. If you upload to the wrong account or are not satisfied with the resulting information in Xero, please note it cannot simply be reversed or deleted.

* * *

#### **I am ready to sync to my trial organisation in Xero, where should I start?**  
​

We recommend you start by syncing a period from several months ago, then verify the results.  
​  
You should confirm:

*   Invoices and Payments are uploading to the correct accounts
    
*   Your accounts are balancing as expected for the period.
    
*   If you are connecting to multiple Xero organisations, confirm the split of invoices and payments is accurate.
    
*   The setup of Xero meets the needs of your accountant or bookkeeper.
    

* * *

####   
​**I’m ready to begin using a live Xero organisation, what should I do?**

When you are ready to begin uploading to your live Xero organisation, you should:

1) In Xero, re-create the account setup from your trial organisation into your live organisation.  
​

2) Following **Step 3** of this guide, integrate your live Xero organisation with PracSuite.

3) In PracSuite, copy the settings from your trial organisation into your live organisation.

4) When satisfied that your 'Live' setup matches your 'Demo' setup, which you have previously verified, begin by syncing a small date-range to ensure there are no issues.

Verify your results before proceeding with larger ranges.

* * *

####   
​**My Xero balance isn’t correct, what should I do?**

Depending on your Xero setup there are several reasons your balance might seem inaccurate. For example, if you’ve split payments across multiple businesses, and those businesses are uploading to different Xero organisations, the balance may not reflect as you are expecting.

It is recommended that you use the **Reconciliation report** (**[Reports > Billing > Reconciliation](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/reconciliation)
**) and compare small ranges of data, and narrow down any discrepancies to the smallest range possible. Please ensure you are filtering the Reconciliation report to match your Xero upload before comparing results.

Smartsoft can only provide limited support in identifying discrepancies and comparing reports or balances. You will first need to locate a specific date and payment method that is causing the discrepancy before we can assist.

* * *

#### **I’ve made changes to a previously synced accounting period, what should I do?**

Sync periods are final, and once a period has been uploaded to Xero you cannot make further changes. For this reason we highly recommend only syncing closed and verified accounting periods.

* * *

Basic Spreadsheet Import
========================

Smartsoft provides a free basic data transfer service from an Excel spreadsheet template. For further information on this option, please contact us.

[Contact Us](https://www.pracsuite.com/contactus)

* * *

Capable
=======

Priced at $790 inc GST.

*   Basic Patient Data - Contact details, addresses, DOB, notes/warnings, and Medicare/DVA details.
    
*   Appointments - Future appointments and historical appointments for 2 years previously.
    
*   Attachments - All documents/files uploaded to patient files.
    
*   Clinical Notes - All historical clinical notes will be included.
    
*   Patient Account balances - If a patient is in credit or owing, we can add either a cash payment as credit or an outstanding invoice for the amount owing on the patient file.
    

* * *

Cliniko
=======

Priced at $790 inc GST.

*   Basic Patient Data - Contact details, addresses, DOB, referral information, notes/warnings, and Medicare/DVA details.
    
*   Appointments - Future appointments and historical appointments for 2 years previously.
    
*   Attachments - All documents/files uploaded to patient files.
    
*   Clinical Notes - All historical clinical notes will be included.
    
*   Patient Account balances - If a patient is in credit or owing, we can add either a cash payment as credit or an outstanding invoice for the amount owing on the patient file.
    

Data backups for the transfer are sourced via exports directly from the Cliniko software. Done through the settings menu and then select the "Data Exports" option. Here exports can be run that provide all of the data we need for the transfer. A guide for this is below.

[Exporting Data from Cliniko](https://help.cliniko.com/en/articles/1023831-export-your-data)

* * *

CorePlus
========

Priced at $790 inc GST.

*   Basic Patient Data - Contact details, addresses, DOB, referral information, notes/warnings, Medicare/DVA details, and patient contacts if in use.
    
*   Appointments - Future appointments and historical appointments for 2 years previously.
    
*   Attachments - All documents/files uploaded to patient files
    
*   Clinical Notes - All historical clinical notes will be included.
    
*   Patient Account balances - If a patient is in credit or owing, we can add either a cash payment as credit or an outstanding invoice for the amount owing on the patient file.
    

A data backup for the transfer can be completed from inside the CorePlus software when logged in as a user with 'Supervisor' level access. Below is a guide for completing a data backup in CorePlus.

[Core Plus Data Backup Guide](https://help.coreplus.com.au/en/articles/1399679-data-backup-on-a-pc)

* * *

eNoteFile
=========

Priced at $790 inc GST.

*   Clinical notes are exported from eNote file in PDF format, which will be imported into the patient's clinical note timeline in PracSuite.
    
*   Attachments are added to the Files tab within the PracSuite patient file.
    
*   We will attempt to match eNote PDFs based on patient first name, last name and DOB.
    
*   If there are multiple possible patient file matches in PracSuite, we won't import those eNote PDFs because we don't know which patient file is the correct one.
    
*   If we cannot match the eNote PDF to a patient file in PracSuite, the PDF won't be imported.  
    ​
    

* * *

Halaxy
======

Priced at $790 inc GST.

*   Basic Patient Data - Contact details, addresses, DOB, referral information, notes/warnings, and Medicare/DVA details.
    
*   Appointments - Future appointments and historical appointments for 2 years previously.
    
*   Attachments - All documents/files uploaded to patient files

**Data Migration Frequently Asked Questions**
=============================================

What needs to be completed before your data migration date?
-----------------------------------------------------------

Setup and training must be completed prior to your data migration date. [Further information about the PracSuite setup process can be found here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5777254-pracsuite-setup-guide)

* * *

What happens on your data migration date?
-----------------------------------------

Please find a general overview of the final data migration date and process below:

*   We will obtain a backup of your existing data. The size of your backup will determine whether we obtain a backup the evening before or the morning of your final migration date so that we have enough time to complete the process.
    
*   Any data entered into your old software after the backup process commences will not be transferred to PracSuite and will need to be manually re-entered once your PracSuite data migration is complete.
    
*   Our aim is to minimise your downtime. For most practices, the data migration process will reach a point when where you can start using the system by late afternoon on your migration date. We will call you to confirm when the process is at this point and give you the all-clear to start using PracSuite. Some historical data such as clinical notes great than two years old will continue to be uploaded into the evening.
    

* * *

What happens after the data migration?
--------------------------------------

For most practices, our team will call by late afternoon on your data migration date to confirm that your data migration is complete. After this time, you will need to start using PracSuite. Once you've received this call, we highly recommend reviewing the following within PracSuite:

*   Manually transfer into PracSuite any data you've entered into your old software since the backup was collected
    
*   [Add a credit card to use SMS features](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/sms)
    
*   [Configure Automatic Appointment Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)
    
*   [Appointment Type defaults](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613492-setting-default-appointment-types)
    
*   [Configure Online bookings](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4766658-setting-up-online-bookings-in-pracsuite)
    
*   [Update your website with your new PracSuite online booking link](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4746485-how-to-add-pracsuite-online-bookings-to-your-website)
    

* * *

Managing Outstanding Invoice After Migrating to PracSuite
=========================================================

Due to fundamental differences between platforms, PracSuite does not migrate invoice, transaction, or payment data from third-party systems. This is consistent with industry practice, as financial data structures vary significantly between systems, making automated migration technically unfeasible and unreliable.

**What are the alternatives?**

While we don’t import detailed financial records, there is an option to enter _opening account balances_ into PracSuite using a generic item code. This allows you to reflect amounts that were outstanding at the time of your PracSuite migration, but does not include itemised invoice data or match original invoice numbers.

Some practices choose not to import opening balances and prefer to manage outstanding accounts separately in their previous system. Others prefer to bring those balances into PracSuite. There’s no one-size-fits-all approach – it depends on what works best for your clinic.

Below are the two most common approaches:

* * *

**Option 1: Manage Outstanding Balances in Your Previous System**

*   Maintain access to your previous system for a few more months so you can view and reconcile any unpaid invoices and process remaining payments.
    
*   Continue issuing receipts for those invoices within the old system to preserve original invoice numbers.
    
*   Ensure these amounts are included in your financial reporting in addition to your PracSuite financial reporting.
    
*   Avoid recreating these invoices in PracSuite to prevent duplicating records.
    

This approach is often the most straightforward short-term solution. Once the majority of outstanding balances are paid off, you may choose to switch to Option 2 for any remaining amounts.

* * *

**Option 2: Enter Outstanding Balances into PracSuite**

*   Manually record outstanding amounts as opening balances using a generic item code (e.g. “Opening Balance - Previous System”).
    
*   These entries will not contain itemised details or match original invoice numbers. Alternatively, you can manually recreate full invoices in PracSuite, but this involves more effort, and the invoice numbers will differ from the originals.
    
*   You’ll need to decide whether payments against these balances will be processed in PracSuite alone, or also applied in your previous system.
    

* * *

**Long-Term Consideration**

Regardless of which option you choose, it’s important to plan ahead for when you cancel your subscription to your previous practice management system. Once access is removed, you will no longer be able to retrieve historical financial data, including invoices, payments, and transaction histories.

We strongly recommend exporting and securely storing all relevant financial reports before closing your old system. This includes:

*   Full invoice and payment history
    
*   Outstanding balances
    
*   Any reports required for future audits or compliance
    

These exports will serve as your only reference for financial history after your previous system is deactivated.

Dedicated/Fixed SMS Sender Number

Dedicated/Fixed SMS Sender Number
=================================

Sending SMS from PracSuite with the same phone number

Updated over a year ago

By default, PracSuite sends SMS using a pool of shared mobile numbers. PracSuite will try to send SMS from your account using the same mobile number, helping patients recognise messages from your practice. Note that the mobile number may be shared by other practices using PracSuite, generally outside of your area.

As an optional add-on, PracSuite users can lease a dedicated SMS sender number. The advantages of a dedicated, fixed SMS sender number are:  
​

1\. The mobile number is reserved solely for your PracSuite account, which will not be used by any other private or business users.

2\. Any SMS message sent to the dedicated number will be delivered to your PracSuite account, regardless of whether a message has been previously sent to the patient. This means that the number can be advertised so that previously unknown people can send SMS messages to your practice and into PracSuite.

SMS dedicated numbers have a once-off setup fee of $33 inc GST and an ongoing monthly fee of $11 inc GST.

If you wish to add this feature to your PracSuite subscription, please [contact our Business Care team.](https://pracsuite.com/contactus)

How to add a refund in PracSuite when the refund has already been processed manually via Tyro Health EFTPOS

How to add a refund in PracSuite when the refund has already been processed manually via Tyro Health EFTPOS
===========================================================================================================

Manual Refunds in PracSuite

Updated over 2 years ago

When a refund has been manually processed via your Tyro terminal, it is recommended that you also add that refund into PracSuite for reconciliation purposes. This article covers this specific scenario, where you need to add a refund entry in PracSuite without actually re-processing the refund.

1) Go to the **Patient File > Invoices** tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631925349/e907ad0ef64154f4f42ad688/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b0c74cdab689047481bc0b49c83cd5d3ef491d86b4ed81668f894aec3ff4f324&req=ciMmH8t7noVWFb4f3HP0gNAq4QNGy2DCF6hh3y5%2FltHQSbPsUJEKt6Gy0GeF%0ALFklXGkj5bSJklENjA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631925349/e907ad0ef64154f4f42ad688/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b0c74cdab689047481bc0b49c83cd5d3ef491d86b4ed81668f894aec3ff4f324&req=ciMmH8t7noVWFb4f3HP0gNAq4QNGy2DCF6hh3y5%2FltHQSbPsUJEKt6Gy0GeF%0ALFklXGkj5bSJklENjA%3D%3D%0A)

2) Click **Payments**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650730516/4112fc5925ca06e9ee654bdb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=948c1aeaafb2afa484ac75b22d2331423f3e1b8f37838c7b505bab6fd5c019a8&req=ciUnEcp%2BmIBZFb4f3HP0gPU%2BvNq3EfxPhCrWe1Bm7FE5TwrHdFuY9e5NpkAY%0AecUEo%2FPtvK702M1agg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650730516/4112fc5925ca06e9ee654bdb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=948c1aeaafb2afa484ac75b22d2331423f3e1b8f37838c7b505bab6fd5c019a8&req=ciUnEcp%2BmIBZFb4f3HP0gPU%2BvNq3EfxPhCrWe1Bm7FE5TwrHdFuY9e5NpkAY%0AecUEo%2FPtvK702M1agg%3D%3D%0A)

3) Within the grid, select the **Payment** you would like to refund.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650722345/55fce35fb52e2ac0aa51564d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eac5ad0a545a1955218134c57957dd7e8c578f41dc02bfa4c3dd94bdf2b279bf&req=ciUnEct8noVaFb4f3HP0gAWXSllUUE3MQVZej4a3HvX59B3PocqKMSFPlbtn%0A8TQfv%2FRg8UL%2F%2FEcjvw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650722345/55fce35fb52e2ac0aa51564d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=eac5ad0a545a1955218134c57957dd7e8c578f41dc02bfa4c3dd94bdf2b279bf&req=ciUnEct8noVaFb4f3HP0gAWXSllUUE3MQVZej4a3HvX59B3PocqKMSFPlbtn%0A8TQfv%2FRg8UL%2F%2FEcjvw%3D%3D%0A)

4) Click **Refund**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650722529/f50ef0bf9ed7ba50625c0d15/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cacccec8a26f216e6dac13257ff05122b0fd2e2c2928134a1e472d22bfca4cb1&req=ciUnEct8mINWFb4f3HP0gAbrBZ7Bddm0xXkvTSjBzfVSiJqo7VnPGOztosLd%0AjGx6d9mAKSylo8Dy5A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650722529/f50ef0bf9ed7ba50625c0d15/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cacccec8a26f216e6dac13257ff05122b0fd2e2c2928134a1e472d22bfca4cb1&req=ciUnEct8mINWFb4f3HP0gAbrBZ7Bddm0xXkvTSjBzfVSiJqo7VnPGOztosLd%0AjGx6d9mAKSylo8Dy5A%3D%3D%0A)

The **Refund Allocation** window will appear, where you can specify the amount being refunded and the refund method.

5) In the **Tyro Terminal** drop-down, select **None**.

Please note that having a Tyro Terminal selected here will re-process the refund via Tyro. In this scenario the refund has already been processed manually on the Tyro terminal, so we do **not** want to process the refund again a second time.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650722815/00d029ab475f203e5c78ad6f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8324ec43f8723ab00084ddb25415dadc8b23f2187195ab8f7e3ae700867a11ad&req=ciUnEct8lYBaFb4f3HP0gELx4oO7%2FzGu7zjRy0vKYE%2FufLZcRc4QJ9s%2BQy%2BX%0AEoVFXU70FwHI1EjIqA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650722815/00d029ab475f203e5c78ad6f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8324ec43f8723ab00084ddb25415dadc8b23f2187195ab8f7e3ae700867a11ad&req=ciUnEct8lYBaFb4f3HP0gELx4oO7%2FzGu7zjRy0vKYE%2FufLZcRc4QJ9s%2BQy%2BX%0AEoVFXU70FwHI1EjIqA%3D%3D%0A)

6) Type in the **Refund** amount, matching the amount refunded via the Tyro terminal.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650726075/9d320115bb3c763934e7f9e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d49f7e17bf790fde8bb4d700f8b8493023ec5a78d4c8472dd1ec531e3f0484bf&req=ciUnEct4nYZaFb4f3HP0gEN4airLHmf2uBlNFLGvIMl5Fe4z9b99WuBZsaBB%0AbFtwfH%2BHKxOrG2EKiw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650726075/9d320115bb3c763934e7f9e8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d49f7e17bf790fde8bb4d700f8b8493023ec5a78d4c8472dd1ec531e3f0484bf&req=ciUnEct4nYZaFb4f3HP0gEN4airLHmf2uBlNFLGvIMl5Fe4z9b99WuBZsaBB%0AbFtwfH%2BHKxOrG2EKiw%3D%3D%0A)

7) In the **Refund via** drop-down, ensure that **EFTPOS** has been selected.  
​  
This is the most accurate representation of how the refund was provided.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650731637/9a5982b951a4cca7b02535f6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c8ad1293f03518f8a34821baf77d206cd075ad60981cde063a4f7016b5297fbe&req=ciUnEcp%2Fm4JYFb4f3HP0gIdSzVlvv7LxRcpR%2FMh9YlypE3nuQYRdd7MJEqFO%0ADeLTEN%2FUSjC6Clb36w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650731637/9a5982b951a4cca7b02535f6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c8ad1293f03518f8a34821baf77d206cd075ad60981cde063a4f7016b5297fbe&req=ciUnEcp%2Fm4JYFb4f3HP0gIdSzVlvv7LxRcpR%2FMh9YlypE3nuQYRdd7MJEqFO%0ADeLTEN%2FUSjC6Clb36w%3D%3D%0A)

8) Enter a **Reason for Refund.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650726475/7675b5604755cd6e8f5841c5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f7466f38f5cbb32ec3b3eb153df78a8b5bba1fbf01a2faf40b3eeb729aa991e7&req=ciUnEct4mYZaFb4f3HP0gKbcJJi1SQwJ2GAbRA4w%2FDCmcGujdZGv%2FUzjcRY4%0A3670OnV784GRcETRgQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650726475/7675b5604755cd6e8f5841c5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f7466f38f5cbb32ec3b3eb153df78a8b5bba1fbf01a2faf40b3eeb729aa991e7&req=ciUnEct4mYZaFb4f3HP0gKbcJJi1SQwJ2GAbRA4w%2FDCmcGujdZGv%2FUzjcRY4%0A3670OnV784GRcETRgQ%3D%3D%0A)

9) **Confirm** that the payment was refunded manually via Tyro by enabling the check-box next to the message:  
​  
'_I confirm this payment was refunded manually via Tyro, or I have provided a refund for this payment through another method_'

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650727357/fb0d5432b7f6a4f8084fa004/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e95a29750775ffe7fec316652d807912cde85ae1ff7539bfc2c4e84682b9aa41&req=ciUnEct5noRYFb4f3HP0gH%2BLJxl6JnyLO3sJIexKkv1UGLLgvpVAnDekF%2Fmi%0Al2ujZq6mMLLA2quQ7A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650727357/fb0d5432b7f6a4f8084fa004/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e95a29750775ffe7fec316652d807912cde85ae1ff7539bfc2c4e84682b9aa41&req=ciUnEct5noRYFb4f3HP0gH%2BLJxl6JnyLO3sJIexKkv1UGLLgvpVAnDekF%2Fmi%0Al2ujZq6mMLLA2quQ7A%3D%3D%0A)

10) Click **Next**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650727459/631ecd4fe92716e4dff9bf4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b420dd64fd5f8b9384c42d0317fd2977f6b8f4c336a555ef001737d9856fa364&req=ciUnEct5mYRWFb4f3HP0gFpoLMAZ0wzcSpJRtpHPtuTmLP58V%2FSApGXSEfvb%0AfLmqvBTCmh%2BNOdNm5w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650727459/631ecd4fe92716e4dff9bf4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b420dd64fd5f8b9384c42d0317fd2977f6b8f4c336a555ef001737d9856fa364&req=ciUnEct5mYRWFb4f3HP0gFpoLMAZ0wzcSpJRtpHPtuTmLP58V%2FSApGXSEfvb%0AfLmqvBTCmh%2BNOdNm5w%3D%3D%0A)

11) Complete the remaining steps in the PracSuite refund process.  
​  
All steps beyond this follow the normal refund process and can be completed as normal by following the prompts.  
​  
12) **Success!** You have now added a refund in PracSuite that reflects a manual refund processed on the Tyro terminal.

How to Process a Refund from the Payments section on Patient & Third-party Payers

How to Process a Refund from the Payments section on Patient & Third-party Payers
=================================================================================

Refunding Payments in PracSuite

Updated over 2 years ago

To process a refund from the Payments section, go to the **Patient File > Invoices** tab.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631925349/e907ad0ef64154f4f42ad688/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b0c74cdab689047481bc0b49c83cd5d3ef491d86b4ed81668f894aec3ff4f324&req=ciMmH8t7noVWFb4f3HP0gNAq4QNGy2DCF6hh3y5%2FltHQSbPsUJEKt6Gy0GeF%0ALFklXGkj5bSJklENjA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/631925349/e907ad0ef64154f4f42ad688/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b0c74cdab689047481bc0b49c83cd5d3ef491d86b4ed81668f894aec3ff4f324&req=ciMmH8t7noVWFb4f3HP0gNAq4QNGy2DCF6hh3y5%2FltHQSbPsUJEKt6Gy0GeF%0ALFklXGkj5bSJklENjA%3D%3D%0A)

Select Payments.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650730516/4112fc5925ca06e9ee654bdb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=948c1aeaafb2afa484ac75b22d2331423f3e1b8f37838c7b505bab6fd5c019a8&req=ciUnEcp%2BmIBZFb4f3HP0gPU%2BvNq3EfxPhCrWe1Bm7FE5TwrHdFuY9e5NpkAY%0AecUEo%2FPtvK702M1agg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650730516/4112fc5925ca06e9ee654bdb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=948c1aeaafb2afa484ac75b22d2331423f3e1b8f37838c7b505bab6fd5c019a8&req=ciUnEcp%2BmIBZFb4f3HP0gPU%2BvNq3EfxPhCrWe1Bm7FE5TwrHdFuY9e5NpkAY%0AecUEo%2FPtvK702M1agg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the payment you would like to refund.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650735412/c28c9b8d4a11534730674b63/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=138be304a39259dc2a95958f1f53e98ec0a84f5a6ce959e03f4ccb939a800f0f&req=ciUnEcp7mYBdFb4f3HP0gDcjWi6WM15jCuphV9TB9%2FVdhYocPR%2BpB2xvdWin%0AeQSMUBniDUc9p21BEw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650735412/c28c9b8d4a11534730674b63/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=138be304a39259dc2a95958f1f53e98ec0a84f5a6ce959e03f4ccb939a800f0f&req=ciUnEcp7mYBdFb4f3HP0gDcjWi6WM15jCuphV9TB9%2FVdhYocPR%2BpB2xvdWin%0AeQSMUBniDUc9p21BEw%3D%3D%0A)

Click Refund.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650735578/ca140d8fec92f59490bce6ad/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2185dec8bd56b2f2911b5c4de5b99d89c75b311e058cdb6a3db97e75594bbf1a&req=ciUnEcp7mIZXFb4f3HP0gEgRfw2Okz1Frw9Mb90tYhdrf%2BNPvYhZo5ju5nX3%0AosHQ%2FSNjiFshBaZC1A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650735578/ca140d8fec92f59490bce6ad/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2185dec8bd56b2f2911b5c4de5b99d89c75b311e058cdb6a3db97e75594bbf1a&req=ciUnEcp7mIZXFb4f3HP0gEgRfw2Okz1Frw9Mb90tYhdrf%2BNPvYhZo5ju5nX3%0AosHQ%2FSNjiFshBaZC1A%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650731608/dbcfb73a962a65f25cba23de/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ba1090dc1336d486d6575b738b06deb8d34f2bb931fcac3389b3ca32b5e6030c&req=ciUnEcp%2Fm4FXFb4f3HP0gLq9rfD%2Fzs7ln9RWjLKSeijN87HKhPjRh3Y7J3Z2%0AJ3hnsLEl6GKT33hVnw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650731608/dbcfb73a962a65f25cba23de/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ba1090dc1336d486d6575b738b06deb8d34f2bb931fcac3389b3ca32b5e6030c&req=ciUnEcp%2Fm4FXFb4f3HP0gLq9rfD%2Fzs7ln9RWjLKSeijN87HKhPjRh3Y7J3Z2%0AJ3hnsLEl6GKT33hVnw%3D%3D%0A)

Click Refund.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650731759/a5281e972ff7fdd841e228a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0123bd1f01666cf2af713ca16fe7185388cd456322e520296a45300db90f54fa&req=ciUnEcp%2FmoRWFb4f3HP0gIQjXvYglM33qq49qLD8JR0LcKXOp8426NeQJlCv%0AIjfxObNjuD8Je%2BzI%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650731759/a5281e972ff7fdd841e228a6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0123bd1f01666cf2af713ca16fe7185388cd456322e520296a45300db90f54fa&req=ciUnEcp%2FmoRWFb4f3HP0gIQjXvYglM33qq49qLD8JR0LcKXOp8426NeQJlCv%0AIjfxObNjuD8Je%2BzI%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)

Select the Refund Date and the Business this refund is associated with.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650740781/1be97c3be649161bb9cf16fd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c40a815426bd9ccc3d9358410fdce6af2717cf89d5526215b9b07e554bc2475c&req=ciUnEc1%2BmoleFb4f3HP0gJoqjWx1wHgE9bwSphuxkTCk8ta%2F5vApH5A2lOYZ%0AI5QriNtuupwbUqBmHA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650740781/1be97c3be649161bb9cf16fd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c40a815426bd9ccc3d9358410fdce6af2717cf89d5526215b9b07e554bc2475c&req=ciUnEc1%2BmoleFb4f3HP0gJoqjWx1wHgE9bwSphuxkTCk8ta%2F5vApH5A2lOYZ%0AI5QriNtuupwbUqBmHA%3D%3D%0A)

**Type in the amount** to refund, _either the full amount or a partial amount_ or click the **Hand Icon** to **_refund the full amount_**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650740915/4ecc250c95bf5fcdb857123b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c185784b0a557016780c1597bc0d8281ac346427f7aa47d452079e74106965e4&req=ciUnEc1%2BlIBaFb4f3HP0gF41mQaPANBU54kAYN6WCAS5n1rBrwVqEHkRlm2a%0AZdUhbOJcpQnbTuyUzQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650740915/4ecc250c95bf5fcdb857123b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c185784b0a557016780c1597bc0d8281ac346427f7aa47d452079e74106965e4&req=ciUnEc1%2BlIBaFb4f3HP0gF41mQaPANBU54kAYN6WCAS5n1rBrwVqEHkRlm2a%0AZdUhbOJcpQnbTuyUzQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Type in a Reason for Refund**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650741391/843468ce33edfefc22621373/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bfe5ac03c71a2af91e6ba0732e0d23a475b6b0ea3747aa0d3ef28b6000fba577&req=ciUnEc1%2FnoheFb4f3HP0gBll3GKBh13z%2FeuqpP5jpNO6SGt1y7Kvi78L%2BzSw%0ADYjTl9gW6thoqbrh3g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650741391/843468ce33edfefc22621373/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bfe5ac03c71a2af91e6ba0732e0d23a475b6b0ea3747aa0d3ef28b6000fba577&req=ciUnEc1%2FnoheFb4f3HP0gBll3GKBh13z%2FeuqpP5jpNO6SGt1y7Kvi78L%2BzSw%0ADYjTl9gW6thoqbrh3g%3D%3D%0A)

**Choose how the Refund** is to be given, either by Cash (from takings), Cash (other), Bank Transfer, EFTPOS, Credit Card or Tyro Health EFTPOS).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650741746/7022ddba8376e4fc141cab57/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e11d99e7fc076b7d0fe6bf5a83f3594049d3b9c2c817de9e505118c5568685a7&req=ciUnEc1%2FmoVZFb4f3HP0gByMVhU2N6fMZMre5PJOdmWVURsuZx6wu3VD8t%2Bm%0AHLJMuMe%2BLhJlFXBbCw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650741746/7022ddba8376e4fc141cab57/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e11d99e7fc076b7d0fe6bf5a83f3594049d3b9c2c817de9e505118c5568685a7&req=ciUnEc1%2FmoVZFb4f3HP0gByMVhU2N6fMZMre5PJOdmWVURsuZx6wu3VD8t%2Bm%0AHLJMuMe%2BLhJlFXBbCw%3D%3D%0A)

_\*\* Please note, with the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration, Tyro will only be an option if the original payment was made via the Tyro Health EFTPOS Integration \*\*_

Click **Next**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650743672/e5ecced9b2007fe733976ff7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6306c961707c77899ec263fb5cc075374be3dd52d51ec6a0b21612f9e8c2b914&req=ciUnEc19m4ZdFb4f3HP0gL%2BK%2F8%2B1awxoi17y6OrO2AL3cBFFnyOfebA%2BjO6h%0A31S2yfESP4p6alEntA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650743672/e5ecced9b2007fe733976ff7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6306c961707c77899ec263fb5cc075374be3dd52d51ec6a0b21612f9e8c2b914&req=ciUnEc19m4ZdFb4f3HP0gL%2BK%2F8%2B1awxoi17y6OrO2AL3cBFFnyOfebA%2BjO6h%0A31S2yfESP4p6alEntA%3D%3D%0A)

Choose how you would like PracSuite to handle the Item Code after the refund has been applied.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650743963/4ae3d820ca56093bb3e0c5cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ca36b0f6538b7b8289377af36eda75fc498246206beeab86926c85c7d472d886&req=ciUnEc19lIdcFb4f3HP0gKLLcZlBJH1c0Krfe%2FmXf1SEIfq5catbsC7CdjhA%0AKd8h2fCcKMZCvebSYA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650743963/4ae3d820ca56093bb3e0c5cd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ca36b0f6538b7b8289377af36eda75fc498246206beeab86926c85c7d472d886&req=ciUnEc19lIdcFb4f3HP0gKLLcZlBJH1c0Krfe%2FmXf1SEIfq5catbsC7CdjhA%0AKd8h2fCcKMZCvebSYA%3D%3D%0A)

There are one of four options:

*   **None - Add refund amount to item balance** - this makes the refunded item code outstanding.
    
*   **Discount equivalent to refund amount** - this discounts the fee to $0.00.
    
*   **Write-Off equivalent to refund amount** - this writes off the item code.
    
*   **Manual adjustment** \- allows you the choice to manually choose what you would like to do.
    

In this situation, I'm going to choose Write-Off equivalent to refund amount.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650744468/71111c0e409540ec99c6757a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=02490a4fa72e18bf199afc3ab4f9e0ae8dec6abb277e637ba6236f12e450d91b&req=ciUnEc16mYdXFb4f3HP0gMtmcKQcZwnUNFtmvkRe20KWlfWd6bTvwJOTSHiI%0AdP0dkz9DbO0aHdX%2Fng%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650744468/71111c0e409540ec99c6757a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=02490a4fa72e18bf199afc3ab4f9e0ae8dec6abb277e637ba6236f12e450d91b&req=ciUnEc16mYdXFb4f3HP0gMtmcKQcZwnUNFtmvkRe20KWlfWd6bTvwJOTSHiI%0AdP0dkz9DbO0aHdX%2Fng%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Next.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650744537/e0d77feab4b71f6a2a19fbe3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ded9e1c9bd9dc9a7cd06c3a262ab73456aef9119037e0d39eea12a90917c91a&req=ciUnEc16mIJYFb4f3HP0gMt%2FwLSNeDs8ryEn3fN9oE%2FzKAjwcqos90xCyBQc%0A4Rp6HIhHT8R0KEXEsQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650744537/e0d77feab4b71f6a2a19fbe3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ded9e1c9bd9dc9a7cd06c3a262ab73456aef9119037e0d39eea12a90917c91a&req=ciUnEc16mIJYFb4f3HP0gMt%2FwLSNeDs8ryEn3fN9oE%2FzKAjwcqos90xCyBQc%0A4Rp6HIhHT8R0KEXEsQ%3D%3D%0A)

Check the Summary and click **Confirm** to complete the refund.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650744759/9f9183d292acc9f63337423a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4f292382b162b8e2186ddbab16c492384c9b5e041d68d53e7bc6917bf70b962&req=ciUnEc16moRWFb4f3HP0gDTWo%2FM0%2F2I3n%2BR05Nv5wzwmGUSB0oOk4kCpe4nq%0AIftYuW%2FXAYZXcWZuLQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650744759/9f9183d292acc9f63337423a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4f292382b162b8e2186ddbab16c492384c9b5e041d68d53e7bc6917bf70b962&req=ciUnEc16moRWFb4f3HP0gDTWo%2FM0%2F2I3n%2BR05Nv5wzwmGUSB0oOk4kCpe4nq%0AIftYuW%2FXAYZXcWZuLQ%3D%3D%0A)

[Your PracSuite Subscription](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984771-your-pracsuite-subscription)

How to Mark a Practitioner as Inactive

How to Mark a Practitioner as Inactive
======================================

Disabling a Practitioner & User who has left your clinic

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[To mark a Practitioner File as Inactive](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6885654-how-to-mark-a-practitioner-as-inactive#h_cb39d34068)

[To Mark a User Account as Inactive and/or Delete the User Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6885654-how-to-mark-a-practitioner-as-inactive#h_4d9a6c0956)

When a practitioner leaves your clinic there are two sections you need to mark them as inactive, these are:

1.  [Practitioner File](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6885654-how-to-mark-a-practitioner-as-inactive#h_3756c51c26)
    
2.  [User Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6885654-how-to-mark-a-practitioner-as-inactive#h_08c05768af)
    

When a practitioner has been marked as inactive, their appointment book column will be hidden. Their appointment data can still be viewed within the appointments tab of the patient file and using the [Appointment report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/appointment/appointments)
. All inactive practitioners will appear in the Inactive tab when using the 'Appointment with' filter on the Appointment report.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1047988021/be812ad144d311849c3e2389/CleanShot+2024-05-11+at+20_59_33%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=197dbb3ff485e78a9a8616d7280096d2855276662da3c5a634e2bdfe53d0d69d&req=dSAjEcB2lYFdWPMW1HO4zXA%2F98jaaRLyu4W%2Fa3M5CCcSC7XbmMHRTRjyVL9q%0AYT2QBlJO3m51mODkbxE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1047988021/be812ad144d311849c3e2389/CleanShot+2024-05-11+at+20_59_33%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=197dbb3ff485e78a9a8616d7280096d2855276662da3c5a634e2bdfe53d0d69d&req=dSAjEcB2lYFdWPMW1HO4zXA%2F98jaaRLyu4W%2Fa3M5CCcSC7XbmMHRTRjyVL9q%0AYT2QBlJO3m51mODkbxE%3D%0A)

Before marking a practitioner as inactive, you should thoroughly check the Appointment Book for future appointments that may have been booked with that practitioner. The [Appointment report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/appointment/appointments)
 is ideal for this purpose.

To mark a Practitioner File as Inactive
=======================================

Go to **[Settings > Practitioners > Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650751956/11cf1fff5c71128fddee2969/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3ee2bbc5e59f93545b962cc7d3f6ce30c1d7c443bf2469cf435bb0f77cd8d1d9&req=ciUnEcx%2FlIRZFb4f3HP0gMY7FEG0cbqYORTEPYWWwjVdcWbB5wQl7bQErHZE%0AhSxJkfspsPq1nkmPtA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650751956/11cf1fff5c71128fddee2969/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3ee2bbc5e59f93545b962cc7d3f6ce30c1d7c443bf2469cf435bb0f77cd8d1d9&req=ciUnEcx%2FlIRZFb4f3HP0gMY7FEG0cbqYORTEPYWWwjVdcWbB5wQl7bQErHZE%0AhSxJkfspsPq1nkmPtA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Practitioner** you need to mark as inactive.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650755173/e78c96a01a69b8538e6a2115/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c6781025f08a5d191de2b46d3b8f028001af9636a35ffbe874a51ccff76db9d&req=ciUnEcx7nIZcFb4f3HP0gCm9MRWq9Cuv%2BBxj6fKLtGMSSu6yPGVADIp2XHXF%0Ah%2FeXNW2%2FQPqCh%2B2g%2FA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650755173/e78c96a01a69b8538e6a2115/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7c6781025f08a5d191de2b46d3b8f028001af9636a35ffbe874a51ccff76db9d&req=ciUnEcx7nIZcFb4f3HP0gCm9MRWq9Cuv%2BBxj6fKLtGMSSu6yPGVADIp2XHXF%0Ah%2FeXNW2%2FQPqCh%2B2g%2FA%3D%3D%0A)

Click the **Cog Icon**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650755316/956505ef6108712e906cc875/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=478c0a47fe1a648cc5a89b0c181be5c54a275525e3ac7937e5f95bc9bd65520d&req=ciUnEcx7noBZFb4f3HP0gHhP7zPkp8h0lf%2BwidqSdTWKr8Az22jixeQz%2ByhO%0AC2yMfJ67UnZADSLDLA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650755316/956505ef6108712e906cc875/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=478c0a47fe1a648cc5a89b0c181be5c54a275525e3ac7937e5f95bc9bd65520d&req=ciUnEcx7noBZFb4f3HP0gHhP7zPkp8h0lf%2BwidqSdTWKr8Az22jixeQz%2ByhO%0AC2yMfJ67UnZADSLDLA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Mark Practitioner as Inactive**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650755431/7f6794c493e06a937e8c98c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0cd72da3ab486428f319362eef2df91c554a2aca3bc1ff16aaaec145b7dc5d63&req=ciUnEcx7mYJeFb4f3HP0gBK2kQZMxrELrm28aPm7YyLhnWnsGpudy0uzNC9c%0AhpJUp6jI8Xb4OWD6wA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/650755431/7f6794c493e06a937e8c98c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0cd72da3ab486428f319362eef2df91c554a2aca3bc1ff16aaaec145b7dc5d63&req=ciUnEcx7mYJeFb4f3HP0gBK2kQZMxrELrm28aPm7YyLhnWnsGpudy0uzNC9c%0AhpJUp6jI8Xb4OWD6wA%3D%3D%0A)

To Mark a User Account as Inactive and/or Delete the User Account
=================================================================

To find out how to Mark a User Account as Inactive or to find out how to delete the User Account click [here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6993962-how-to-mark-a-user-account-as-inactive-or-delete-a-user-account)
.

Once both the Practitioner File and the User Account have been marked as inactive, the practitioner who has left will have no further access to PracSuite and will be unable to login.
