How to report on outstanding clinical notes

How to report on outstanding clinical notes
===========================================

Finding appointments with missing clinical notes in bulk

Updated over 3 years ago

Table of contents

[Generating the report](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6888906-how-to-report-on-outstanding-clinical-notes#h_8d4c198986)

This article will run through the reporting process of identifying appointments with outstanding clinical notes.

### Why choose this report over the Outstanding Clinical notes widget?

This report allows you to get the total amount of appointments that require Clinical notes within a date range. The Widget only displays a maximum of 40 appointments across all practitioners. The report can be best suited for large clinics and can be best used with the scheduled report system to get this report sent via a daily, weekly or monthly email.

Generating the report
---------------------

To generate the report, go to **Reports > Appointments > Appointments.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651557151/e86e1ce9e893429b864ec83d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5cb6618e0563166293cb54c3d565b43f02ed99a13ea00bd86856bf00138f1920&req=ciUmE8x5nIReFb4f3HP0gKCzrGpccKxJqvaASCAax2io66Hm678t1YSSQQHC%0AUa0k1i%2F0d9mJanGKVw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651557151/e86e1ce9e893429b864ec83d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5cb6618e0563166293cb54c3d565b43f02ed99a13ea00bd86856bf00138f1920&req=ciUmE8x5nIReFb4f3HP0gKCzrGpccKxJqvaASCAax2io66Hm678t1YSSQQHC%0AUa0k1i%2F0d9mJanGKVw%3D%3D%0A)

Input your preferred date range. For this example, we will use **This week**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651557800/b03d454a7315e23b94bc5431/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=21d52282a1f7b5914e195e75aa870130d8bc049f4ff2b8618f90f91c591581e9&req=ciUmE8x5lYFfFb4f3HP0gKXuObwaydMlf0YRoyPBgJAJtgniDR80dqoOC2e3%0AoayS9GjnQTQJYkyzpA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651557800/b03d454a7315e23b94bc5431/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=21d52282a1f7b5914e195e75aa870130d8bc049f4ff2b8618f90f91c591581e9&req=ciUmE8x5lYFfFb4f3HP0gKXuObwaydMlf0YRoyPBgJAJtgniDR80dqoOC2e3%0AoayS9GjnQTQJYkyzpA%3D%3D%0A)

Ensure that you keep the Report type on **Patient**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651558000/aca5069c61cd5be6a27950c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fafd20293c329bcdfe07228ebee9ee07aa56852d9806a287b9f49937e60f214f&req=ciUmE8x2nYFfFb4f3HP0gCQamPLqzyWCZLNObwD0ylalYMpLVmRhe2JV1qWh%0A4JC4cVwK5ncS%2FFaj6g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651558000/aca5069c61cd5be6a27950c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fafd20293c329bcdfe07228ebee9ee07aa56852d9806a287b9f49937e60f214f&req=ciUmE8x2nYFfFb4f3HP0gCQamPLqzyWCZLNObwD0ylalYMpLVmRhe2JV1qWh%0A4JC4cVwK5ncS%2FFaj6g%3D%3D%0A)

Select the Billing status as **Billed.** This is to get only completed appointments.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651558311/8b3345bb261304cd0c897f06/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83cbd6fbe47d50b086c9545c1b4b95ab22ba0b17047f62c20e0a89e563842731&req=ciUmE8x2noBeFb4f3HP0gJg34hkS2hg0kxSLDIxMecsUMqMhulhqwLc1B%2BVd%0Ap8YpvsTZEsI0GPXqAw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651558311/8b3345bb261304cd0c897f06/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=83cbd6fbe47d50b086c9545c1b4b95ab22ba0b17047f62c20e0a89e563842731&req=ciUmE8x2noBeFb4f3HP0gJg34hkS2hg0kxSLDIxMecsUMqMhulhqwLc1B%2BVd%0Ap8YpvsTZEsI0GPXqAw%3D%3D%0A)

Set the **Clinical notes** filter drop down to **None**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651558225/bbdcad9e3555a94b80052941/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5f2fe32f13c8c88cb639ef74f1e47dc3d6b855bc924fb36efdf43fe31614ab03&req=ciUmE8x2n4NaFb4f3HP0gObj9TpudoGtycH%2FnSj8MCguQjlmz4CerTO%2Bc9%2Fl%0AUt1Ub4I7QAxhWkNwrg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651558225/bbdcad9e3555a94b80052941/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5f2fe32f13c8c88cb639ef74f1e47dc3d6b855bc924fb36efdf43fe31614ab03&req=ciUmE8x2n4NaFb4f3HP0gObj9TpudoGtycH%2FnSj8MCguQjlmz4CerTO%2Bc9%2Fl%0AUt1Ub4I7QAxhWkNwrg%3D%3D%0A)

### Optional Filters include:

**Appointment With:** To filter on certain Practitioners.

**Appointment Type:** To focus on certain appointment types.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651558914/54e72569dc1b05517712e0e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e5d9e08a2248099e95bc9b69d61921a87e48563d8dc2dc7c47d8b552f7b282d&req=ciUmE8x2lIBbFb4f3HP0gC7ihb6q%2BjArBbbuHTQMQ5SlXzM6DKUcxvtLXgO9%0ADGS8ChPJk%2BOBBcwYeA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651558914/54e72569dc1b05517712e0e5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e5d9e08a2248099e95bc9b69d61921a87e48563d8dc2dc7c47d8b552f7b282d&req=ciUmE8x2lIBbFb4f3HP0gC7ihb6q%2BjArBbbuHTQMQ5SlXzM6DKUcxvtLXgO9%0ADGS8ChPJk%2BOBBcwYeA%3D%3D%0A)

After applying your preferred filters, click **Generate report.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651559341/5357a2bf65a32214deb71173/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d86f17f14c69f48e2961ee55842575dc96a94969d20b51b68867d08c17c03397&req=ciUmE8x3noVeFb4f3HP0gC3Rr71GTsUIVeB2hOltp3KFN5E6uQcugqXfKpDM%0AK282G0JrDYhFvNt0Ag%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/651559341/5357a2bf65a32214deb71173/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d86f17f14c69f48e2961ee55842575dc96a94969d20b51b68867d08c17c03397&req=ciUmE8x3noVeFb4f3HP0gC3Rr71GTsUIVeB2hOltp3KFN5E6uQcugqXfKpDM%0AK282G0JrDYhFvNt0Ag%3D%3D%0A)

This will list all appointments in your filter set without clinical notes.

As mentioned above, this report is best used with scheduled reports. To set this up, see the [How to create a scheduled report](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6888906-how-to-report-on-outstanding-clinical-notes)
 setup article.

How are PracSuite Payments Synced to Xero?

How are PracSuite Payments Synced to Xero?
==========================================

Understanding how PracSuite payments appear in Xero

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[How PracSuite payment methods are synced to Xero:](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6986979-how-are-pracsuite-payments-synced-to-xero#h_798f08dcd6)

The [Xero integration within PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6828584-enabling-the-xero-integration)
 is designed to summarise payments entered into PracSuite intelligently and to sync these summary values to Xero.

Within Xero, PracSuite will create an invoice per payment method per day. For example, if you have synced the date '15/01/2022' and on that day you received payments via Cash, EFTPOS and Bank Transfer, you would see the following invoices in Xero.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677846238/b06fc795d7edea7f1fe41b05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e0362bdb8e6e25ab79b81999dbbc190c75e59118476bad751ebd4a01a79fab2d&req=cicgHs14n4JXFb4f3HP0gHjEULqdw51mVunFSgJNLL9BnVA8boUzqIaEoFSY%0A%2F6bfZOI1jP3m1b37og%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677846238/b06fc795d7edea7f1fe41b05/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e0362bdb8e6e25ab79b81999dbbc190c75e59118476bad751ebd4a01a79fab2d&req=cicgHs14n4JXFb4f3HP0gHjEULqdw51mVunFSgJNLL9BnVA8boUzqIaEoFSY%0A%2F6bfZOI1jP3m1b37og%3D%3D%0A)

The **Number** displayed in Xero represents the date synced, along with the final number which represents the payment method.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677846182/d359edee667f8f318e1df4a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b693b78d54c82adb304c72dd6fceffbbb04026a1b76a2fc845d306f0edbb2b70&req=cicgHs14nIldFb4f3HP0gB66lyq%2FdJ8684uVFyXFovyehc8FXC5VdiACXTiM%0AZCAh9PHyW0MEiIqLMg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677846182/d359edee667f8f318e1df4a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b693b78d54c82adb304c72dd6fceffbbb04026a1b76a2fc845d306f0edbb2b70&req=cicgHs14nIldFb4f3HP0gB66lyq%2FdJ8684uVFyXFovyehc8FXC5VdiACXTiM%0AZCAh9PHyW0MEiIqLMg%3D%3D%0A)

Each invoice represents the total amount received via that payment method on that day. Within that invoice, you will find payments, which are used by Xero's _reconciliation_ process to balanced against your imported bank statements.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677847464/446965d0edbadee6bf5ca7ee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d21902f18119fa1443bd573c4358c79eb30d44fe991aa9fde2abcaf549477b28&req=cicgHs15mYdbFb4f3HP0gHeaUQeBOig1IHA6SZGQauxdyxokoUc9VDj5VWsY%0AemujO9UQS1UamLfKyw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677847464/446965d0edbadee6bf5ca7ee/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d21902f18119fa1443bd573c4358c79eb30d44fe991aa9fde2abcaf549477b28&req=cicgHs15mYdbFb4f3HP0gHeaUQeBOig1IHA6SZGQauxdyxokoUc9VDj5VWsY%0AemujO9UQS1UamLfKyw%3D%3D%0A)

Depending on the payment method and your integration settings in PracSuite, the breakdown of these payments within each invoice can vary.

For example, if you were syncing EFTPOS payments for a _single_ business, there would only be a single payment within the 'EFTPOS' invoice in Xero. Alternatively, if you were syncing data for multiple businesses this would appear as a single EFTPOS invoice but with a separate payment per business. In this case, each payment will include more information in the description so the payment can be identified.  
​  
As another example, when syncing Health Fund payments, these can be consolidated or uploaded separately based on whether the payment was entered manually or using Tyro Health Online or Tyro Health EFTPOS.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677850800/382e835ef72f08febaef0dea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4014cc4d66222fd8bbfb137e0e60bf04c3a4fdf9380f51048bc395916f7b7855&req=cicgHsx%2BlYFfFb4f3HP0gOR7CPXEX7cLvLEoWTopVHy0ceHT%2Bhjn0%2B7C5h3m%0AKN06%2Fu8pdh1KmQNgng%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677850800/382e835ef72f08febaef0dea/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4014cc4d66222fd8bbfb137e0e60bf04c3a4fdf9380f51048bc395916f7b7855&req=cicgHsx%2BlYFfFb4f3HP0gOR7CPXEX7cLvLEoWTopVHy0ceHT%2Bhjn0%2B7C5h3m%0AKN06%2Fu8pdh1KmQNgng%3D%3D%0A)

You can also choose whether to:

*   **Include Gift Card Payments**  
    This determines if payments made under the 'Gift Card' method are uploaded to Xero.
    
*   **Consolidate Credit Card Payments**  
    This determines if 'Credit Card' payments should be uploaded as a single total, or with separate totals for 'Visa' and 'Mastercard' etc.
    
*   **Consolidate Health Fund Payments**  
    This determines if 'Health Fund' payments should be uploaded as a single total, or uploaded separately based on whether the payment was entered manually or using Tyro Health Online or Tyro Health EFTPOS.  
    ​
    

* * *

  
How PracSuite payment methods are synced to Xero:
----------------------------------------------------

### Cash

Cash payments upload as a single amount, and payments will only be separated when you have multiple unconsolidated businesses being synced.

### EFTPOS

EFTPOS payments upload as a single amount, and payments will only be separated when you have multiple unconsolidated businesses being synced.

### Credit Card

Credit Card payments can be uploaded as a single consolidated amount or separated for card payments made via Tyro Health EFTPOS, Tyro Health Online or manually, depending on your consolidation setting.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677855181/3d7e1c9a73d3c48bbbd05f89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d237868ebb97753b076454da4af3769e9e6a3c291bf8bb30560494d0a3e3f2c1&req=cicgHsx7nIleFb4f3HP0gGnAurKVqPCqxP6DtDr%2FYiao%2F4bHlZ9wjB9KmTh4%0ANQtvfAcdbVQwFn%2FqfA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677855181/3d7e1c9a73d3c48bbbd05f89/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d237868ebb97753b076454da4af3769e9e6a3c291bf8bb30560494d0a3e3f2c1&req=cicgHsx7nIleFb4f3HP0gGnAurKVqPCqxP6DtDr%2FYiao%2F4bHlZ9wjB9KmTh4%0ANQtvfAcdbVQwFn%2FqfA%3D%3D%0A)

This will be separated further if you have multiple uncolidated businesses being synced.

### Health Fund

Health Fund payments can be uploaded as a single consolidated amount or separated for payments made via Tyro Health EFTPOS, Tyro Health Online or manually, depending on your consolidation setting.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677856772/25ef4e03a061c810873e0334/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=acbb2b6f40d27445887c4ba71af28c751f9052a3be2f960f4e69b67de17fed35&req=cicgHsx4moZdFb4f3HP0gFzz3dYxVa5jGWVgXJzN1jDyRx992ZRKN0s5MNBV%0A5Pq3538PnsiF8Z24hQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677856772/25ef4e03a061c810873e0334/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=acbb2b6f40d27445887c4ba71af28c751f9052a3be2f960f4e69b67de17fed35&req=cicgHsx4moZdFb4f3HP0gFzz3dYxVa5jGWVgXJzN1jDyRx992ZRKN0s5MNBV%0A5Pq3538PnsiF8Z24hQ%3D%3D%0A)

This will be separated further if you have multiple unconsolidated businesses being synced.  
​  
As an exception, Tyro Health EFTPOS payments received by HCF claims will be uploaded as individual payments per provider as this is how they appear on bank statements.

### Medicare

Medicare payments will be automatically separated per provider to best match how payments appear on bank statements.

### DVA

Medicare payments will be automatically separated per provider to best match how payments appear on bank statements.

### Bank Transfers

Bank Transfer payments will be separated per bank transfer, with a description containing the payer and remittance information for reconciliation purposes.

### Cheques

Cheque payments will be separated per cheque, with a description containing the cheque number and drawer information for reconciliation purposes.  
​

* * *

### A Note on Refunds

Refunds are not considered when syncing to Xero. Refunding a payment will not change the invoice amount or payment amounts uploaded to Xero, and if further adjustment is needed for refund handling, this will need to be completed manually in Xero.

How to Delete or Mark a User Account as Inactive

How to Delete or Mark a User Account as Inactive
================================================

Updated over 5 months ago

Table of contents

[Marking a User Account as Inactive](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6993962-how-to-delete-or-mark-a-user-account-as-inactive#h_f04872756b)

[Deleting a User Account](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6993962-how-to-delete-or-mark-a-user-account-as-inactive#h_9a990fc22a)

As Users and/or staff move on, you will more than likely find the need to **Mark a User Account as Inactive** or the need to **Delete a User Account**.

**_Please note:_** _you will need to double check to see if the User has any Scheduled Reports associated with their User Account and either remove them or adjust who the Scheduled Reports are associated with by going to [Reports > Scheduled Reports](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/scheduled)
._

Marking a User Account as Inactive
----------------------------------

#### Step 1:

Navigate to the **[Settings > Users & Security > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)** page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729576833/2b104a36460577e15545c8210473/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a92b0beca2375f8c79b637d29a2eae0b84d7a036ad9cdf6679d0f5eb146c7dbb&req=dSclH8x5m4lcWvMW1HO4zZcrDwPeywTin0ItjrbykLSQO2GFN5O%2B0QpESDgs%0AZylqhdymNVMK6BdAIsk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729576833/2b104a36460577e15545c8210473/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a92b0beca2375f8c79b637d29a2eae0b84d7a036ad9cdf6679d0f5eb146c7dbb&req=dSclH8x5m4lcWvMW1HO4zZcrDwPeywTin0ItjrbykLSQO2GFN5O%2B0QpESDgs%0AZylqhdymNVMK6BdAIsk%3D%0A)

#### Step 2:

Select the **User** you need to Mark as Inactive.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729601484/a91fff82b59a849171b1cf9220c6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7794de171329f33e0fbc3eb0093be4255fd96b2d9be6ede3f39b2ce4f33300f2&req=dSclH89%2BnIVXXfMW1HO4zXnppwcMdErmIDtbxRz9%2FOjwAisDbxop007AJAx0%0AeY3VzFmnmmjaD1PSMT8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729601484/a91fff82b59a849171b1cf9220c6/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7794de171329f33e0fbc3eb0093be4255fd96b2d9be6ede3f39b2ce4f33300f2&req=dSclH89%2BnIVXXfMW1HO4zXnppwcMdErmIDtbxRz9%2FOjwAisDbxop007AJAx0%0AeY3VzFmnmmjaD1PSMT8%3D%0A)

#### Step 3:

Click on the **Cog Icon**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729581248/81db71d11de384117a169402e766/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6423392228c5f8bf2ea188846b73223b34723ae261c80a8a0320eab710de5bab&req=dSclH8x2nINbUfMW1HO4zYE3lKmaqa6ukq5ykM7Zj7ar90ayIQfO%2F5O7P4c6%0Ao%2BkL78MJHrG%2BLnecntI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729581248/81db71d11de384117a169402e766/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6423392228c5f8bf2ea188846b73223b34723ae261c80a8a0320eab710de5bab&req=dSclH8x2nINbUfMW1HO4zYE3lKmaqa6ukq5ykM7Zj7ar90ayIQfO%2F5O7P4c6%0Ao%2BkL78MJHrG%2BLnecntI%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

Select **Mark User as Inactive**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729602049/9f7be3ab08d1ac518ba576410394/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f07a07584b0e0fca13d24dfb9e14bc6b078ba3b6a9ab5fd7021ec2aedc94ec72&req=dSclH89%2Bn4FbUPMW1HO4zVw1kLIra6rE75vLNUNxT2awIY7mfqD%2FwYki%2BTiD%0AzYp8yQS2RRe3mAaP2%2Bg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729602049/9f7be3ab08d1ac518ba576410394/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f07a07584b0e0fca13d24dfb9e14bc6b078ba3b6a9ab5fd7021ec2aedc94ec72&req=dSclH89%2Bn4FbUPMW1HO4zVw1kLIra6rE75vLNUNxT2awIY7mfqD%2FwYki%2BTiD%0AzYp8yQS2RRe3mAaP2%2Bg%3D%0A)

-----------------------

**.

#### Step 3:

Click the **Cog Icon**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729602295/4240360f135cd9157204cb1a89fe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26316fccd3cfc8bf8368f949769d271d63809286165662d77ef06de7f7e8308a&req=dSclH89%2Bn4NWXPMW1HO4zULh0YFbVLLKWONINWTYj59z1HwZ1%2FEV1AK6LtxC%0AjbNKjq8lDjN3e0NWlc0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729602295/4240360f135cd9157204cb1a89fe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26316fccd3cfc8bf8368f949769d271d63809286165662d77ef06de7f7e8308a&req=dSclH89%2Bn4NWXPMW1HO4zULh0YFbVLLKWONINWTYj59z1HwZ1%2FEV1AK6LtxC%0AjbNKjq8lDjN3e0NWlc0%3D%0A)

#### Step 4:

Click **Delete User**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729602635/33378a62517f3f180e968d750afe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=916dcf05fcbd7c48af879974295d32129ef1713bd729e998a0f6ab3c96cbc1d3&req=dSclH89%2Bn4dcXPMW1HO4zfSO11vA%2BcpcO62FkvrvY5mGpUtgFjPJ0tR5a1Rk%0AngGpQGQ%2F82SMNQspgXM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1729602635/33378a62517f3f180e968d750afe/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=916dcf05fcbd7c48af879974295d32129ef1713bd729e998a0f6ab3c96cbc1d3&req=dSclH89%2Bn4dcXPMW1HO4zfSO11vA%2BcpcO62FkvrvY5mGpUtgFjPJ0tR5a1Rk%0AngGpQGQ%2F82SMNQspgXM%3D%0A)

End of Day Reconciliation and Managing Discrepancies

End of Day Reconciliation and Managing Discrepancies
====================================================

Tips for end of day reconciliation process and finding discrepancies

Updated over 10 months ago

Overview
========

The [Reconciliation Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/reconciliation)
 provides a summary of payment totals recorded for each payment method. It is typically used at the end of the day to reconcile the payments recorded in PracSuite against your daily takings (e.g. cash, EFTPOS, Credit Card, Health Fund).  
​  
In most cases you will be reconciling this report against your:  
\- Cash drawer

\- POS terminal summary (e.g. Tyro EFTPOS terminal)

\- Bank statement  
​  
The results of this report can also be grouped by date and business.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/676331272/39881dbca5eaacf62bba92d5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b25a3a4ded180177eaebe1a73d7b80cff3c18c0256e63e507d441820c9adabc1&req=cichFcp%2Fn4ZdFb4f3HP0gBjXaeoDTMSW4Ce60gnMbB7KFS%2F4lbYS7Tssaf7L%0AqjjnL%2F2TdpUX5eV8UA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/676331272/39881dbca5eaacf62bba92d5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b25a3a4ded180177eaebe1a73d7b80cff3c18c0256e63e507d441820c9adabc1&req=cichFcp%2Fn4ZdFb4f3HP0gBjXaeoDTMSW4Ce60gnMbB7KFS%2F4lbYS7Tssaf7L%0AqjjnL%2F2TdpUX5eV8UA%3D%3D%0A)

  
How to manage discrepancies
==============================

If you are noting a discrepancy between the **Reconciliation Report** and your physical cash, EFTPOS or banking records, possible causes include:  
​  
\- An additional payment has been recorded in PracSuite;  
\- A payment has not been recorded in PracSuite;  
\- A payment has been recorded with an incorrect amount, date, business or payment method.  
​  
You should trust that the amounts listed in PracSuite are accurately calculated based on the payments you have entered. We recommend the following approach to finding discrepancies:

  
**1) Identify the affected payment method(s)**
-------------------------------------------------

Using the **Reconciliation Report**, identify the payment method(s) that are not reconciling and note the difference in amount between PracSuite and your source.

**_e.g._**  
​  
​_"We are missing $120.00 in EFTPOS payments in PracSuite, compared to the EFTPOS terminal printout."_  
​  
​**or**  
​  
"Our cash is $100.00 over in PracSuite, but our Credit Card value is $100 short."

Please ensure you are searching for a limited date range, such as a single day, rather than an entire week or month.

2) Confirm that you are comparing the correct details
-----------------------------------------------------

Ensure that you are referencing the correct date and business on your Reconciliation Report, in comparison to your EFTPOS, Credit Card, or Health Fund summary.  
​

3) Search the Payments Report for details
-----------------------------------------

Run the **[Payments Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/payments)
** in PracSuite, searching by "Payment Date" to obtain a **detailed** list of payments recorded with that payment method.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1405769429/322b42c75cf7d0cb1b4a2ff7ee71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1bf710a8c9e575124dc7ef804822a51d61f4ee9d4f95c176ed5ad678d633e508&req=dSQnE854lIVdUPMW1HO4zSZXoGYXofW4Hkgclo2eT15pn463yd01isLjQ%2B9j%0ArU%2FXt8nSSnwtdZ%2BFwcA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1405769429/322b42c75cf7d0cb1b4a2ff7ee71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1bf710a8c9e575124dc7ef804822a51d61f4ee9d4f95c176ed5ad678d633e508&req=dSQnE854lIVdUPMW1HO4zSZXoGYXofW4Hkgclo2eT15pn463yd01isLjQ%2B9j%0ArU%2FXt8nSSnwtdZ%2BFwcA%3D%0A)

4) Cross-checking your transactions
-----------------------------------

Cross-check each payment on the **Payments Report** against each transaction on your terminal printout or banking summary.

**e.g.**  
​  
If you have a **↑↑ HIGHER↑↑** amount recorded in PracSuite compared to your EFTPOS summary, you are searching for a payment that is **not recorded on your EFTPOS terminal**.

If you have a **↓↓LOWER↓↓** amount recorded in PracSuite compared to your EFTPOS summary, you are searching for a payment that is **not recorded in PracSuite**.

Note that the **Payments Report** in PracSuite includes a date and time, which should be checked chronologically against your EFTPOS/Banking summary.

###   
**Still having trouble?**

You can also filter these reports by **Date and Time**. ​  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1405797224/24272bb374d4fe3a4800e4dc4c38/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=381ae8f5bb544f0497d94a1f01db147d2c2125a1d4e900c7556793bb0ab3c595&req=dSQnE853moNdXfMW1HO4zadbIFvy42uJ7SSxpHVWHK%2FhRUeclHEmKG7YX5vj%0AdJ81PQfdQM%2BRBi6sLww%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1405797224/24272bb374d4fe3a4800e4dc4c38/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=381ae8f5bb544f0497d94a1f01db147d2c2125a1d4e900c7556793bb0ab3c595&req=dSQnE853moNdXfMW1HO4zadbIFvy42uJ7SSxpHVWHK%2FhRUeclHEmKG7YX5vj%0AdJ81PQfdQM%2BRBi6sLww%3D%0A)

  
This can be used to reduce the search range to the smallest window possible. If you cannot reconcile an entire day, try to reconcile a few hours at a time until you find the issue.  
​

5) Make appropriate payment adjustments
---------------------------------------

Resolve the payment discrepancy in PracSuite by:  
​  
\- Adding or removing a payment.  
\- Editing a payment to be the correct amount, type, date or business.  
​  
​[Click here for instructions on how to edit payments.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7020578-how-to-edit-existing-payments)
  
​

* * *

Frequently Asked Questions
--------------------------

### How are Tyro settlements received?

As with Bank Transfers, several factors can affect when your daily takings from Tyro services are deposited into your account. Please see the following page for more details: [https://help.tyro.com/s/article/Guide-to-Tyro-settlements](https://help.tyro.com/s/article/Guide-to-Tyro-settlements)

Most Tyro transactions made via integration with PracSuite are approved or declined immediately, and when approved, they can be trusted to reach your bank account on schedule. If you believe payments are not being received correctly, please refer to Tyro or your accountant/bookkeeper for further investigation.  
​  
For further information on Tyro Health Fund settlements, please see below:  
​[https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/5826582-tyro-health-online-settlements](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/5826582-tyro-health-online-settlements)

###   
How are bank transfers and cheques reconciled?

Bank transfers and deposited cheques may not appear in your bank account immediately, often taking 1-2 business days. In most workflows, you would only record the payment in PracSuite after it has been confirmed in your bank account, which would then reconcile cleanly.  
​  
If you are recording a bank transfer preemptively, based on a remittance advice, the payment dates in PracSuite may appear differently compared to the transaction on your bank statement. Consider reconciling directly against [Reports > Billing > Bank Transfers](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/groupdeposits)
 or [Reports > Billing > Cheques](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/groupcheques)
 if needed.

How to Edit Existing Payments

How to Edit Existing Payments
=============================

Editing Payment Method, Amount, Allocations and Allocation Dates

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Editing Payments from the Payments Tab on Patient and Payer Files](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7020578-how-to-edit-existing-payments#h_d40bc71e01)

[Editing Payments from an Invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7020578-how-to-edit-existing-payments#h_04a2520d49)

There are two ways to edit payments in PracSuite:

1.  [Editing Payments from the Payments Tab on Patient and Payer Files](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7020578-how-to-edit-existing-payments#h_d40bc71e01)
    
2.  [Editing Payments from an Invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7020578-how-to-edit-existing-payments#h_04a2520d49)
    

Note: To edit payments, the Edit Previous Saved Payments [Role permission](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353460-creating-roles)
 must be enabled, along with the following permission as required:

*   Edit Payment Date/Time
    
*   Edit Payment Allocations
    
*   Edit Payment Business
    
*   Edit Payment Amount
    
*   Edit Payment Method

Editing Payments from the Payments Tab on Patient and Payer Files
=================================================================

Existing payments can be edited from the Invoices > Payments tab on patient and payer files.

**Patient File**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677753047/82d1b53550dcebc6ad64de66/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c5a6c7325357aaf4f33f8cfcdd04ec3918d1e73017432cf89567a6bccfbe75b0&req=cicgEcx9nYVYFb4f3HP0gK2RbISjpSK%2BqppjyaQA8xAZm474QsMb4WLlfCHZ%0AzfHL4PKyVfWJ0l2CNQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677753047/82d1b53550dcebc6ad64de66/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c5a6c7325357aaf4f33f8cfcdd04ec3918d1e73017432cf89567a6bccfbe75b0&req=cicgEcx9nYVYFb4f3HP0gK2RbISjpSK%2BqppjyaQA8xAZm474QsMb4WLlfCHZ%0AzfHL4PKyVfWJ0l2CNQ%3D%3D%0A)

**Payer File**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677753528/35bb9bccbac6905b6953add4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45825afb344fff7c7634526afc8fe56fc9affbc193eed02317bae58b963991db&req=cicgEcx9mINXFb4f3HP0gFAzMcWNAzgO6mVLbAVF7QKsyMvccOpU0EA33Xuq%0AHAkylCN%2B5ldBaYPbmA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677753528/35bb9bccbac6905b6953add4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45825afb344fff7c7634526afc8fe56fc9affbc193eed02317bae58b963991db&req=cicgEcx9mINXFb4f3HP0gFAzMcWNAzgO6mVLbAVF7QKsyMvccOpU0EA33Xuq%0AHAkylCN%2B5ldBaYPbmA%3D%3D%0A)

Once you're on the payments tab, select the payment in the grid results and then select **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677753747/dff646bb6493100997bcf682/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=20157af054ad572b6dfc8fc75851b09999ad8eb2816343b5f9e157f3126700ae&req=cicgEcx9moVYFb4f3HP0gFc0z7%2FR2jsgsNlZneqva%2Fwulyt8nkibFYHt1khc%0AzMczXbRKXYR67jC3Qw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677753747/dff646bb6493100997bcf682/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=20157af054ad572b6dfc8fc75851b09999ad8eb2816343b5f9e157f3126700ae&req=cicgEcx9moVYFb4f3HP0gFc0z7%2FR2jsgsNlZneqva%2Fwulyt8nkibFYHt1khc%0AzMczXbRKXYR67jC3Qw%3D%3D%0A)

Within the popup, you can:

*   Edit Payment Method
    
*   Edit Payment Amount
    
*   Edit Payment Allocation Dates
    
*   View all invoices associated with the payment
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677793939/5d534d00d38aa42086f916b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5478db998f6b955a3c8ad32e28c1128c4ee4c1b3afed1119038cbd6c7348856a&req=cicgEcB9lIJWFb4f3HP0gAYqKAje2pOehI8qxhlnPeLLV97UZ8gNepM96saj%0AhXsEs811d9G4XaRntg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/677793939/5d534d00d38aa42086f916b8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5478db998f6b955a3c8ad32e28c1128c4ee4c1b3afed1119038cbd6c7348856a&req=cicgEcB9lIJWFb4f3HP0gAYqKAje2pOehI8qxhlnPeLLV97UZ8gNepM96saj%0AhXsEs811d9G4XaRntg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Confirm** to finalise your changes.

Editing Payments from an Invoice
================================

Open an invoice from the Invoices tab of a patient or payer file.

Select **Edit** in the top left.

Hover of the payment you wish to modify and select the **Edit pencil** icon.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/683241550/118e46f6fcdf182425e3f654/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=892fdb2682b4fb1f8b6109b435101f62e067961e07c3fd34f8319d7c72b53f97&req=cigkFM1%2FmIRfFb4f3HP0gP%2Bm10oQ4NgTRHpKR2XVhVHytWPohwxoyOGQTTqg%0APbajUVcB5h9Dz97Clg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/683241550/118e46f6fcdf182425e3f654/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=892fdb2682b4fb1f8b6109b435101f62e067961e07c3fd34f8319d7c72b53f97&req=cigkFM1%2FmIRfFb4f3HP0gP%2Bm10oQ4NgTRHpKR2XVhVHytWPohwxoyOGQTTqg%0APbajUVcB5h9Dz97Clg%3D%3D%0A)

A red banner will appear when editing a payment that is associated with multiple invoices. If you choose to edit the payment date, time, business, type and amount, note that this will affect all invoices that the payment is associated with.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/685512863/2931b60a035faec2e045779f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3c4c2b70617a39a01fab4e01da6d653f24a9e310ba62ae65a605f2594ce2d893&req=cigiE8h8lYdcFb4f3HP0gJaVgzmjEAzehxeo1wLIG3Sn0Uq1g4EScf6muDuq%0ADSU3Cz5lvA7I2yG6iQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/685512863/2931b60a035faec2e045779f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3c4c2b70617a39a01fab4e01da6d653f24a9e310ba62ae65a605f2594ce2d893&req=cigiE8h8lYdcFb4f3HP0gJaVgzmjEAzehxeo1wLIG3Sn0Uq1g4EScf6muDuq%0ADSU3Cz5lvA7I2yG6iQ%3D%3D%0A)

Enter a reason for editing the payment.

Select **Confirm** to finalise your changes.

**Monthly Subscription Fee**
============================

PracSuite has a monthly fee per practitioner, and all subscriptions include the following:

*   Access to all features
    
*   Prompt telephone and live chat support
    
*   Unlimited admin staff
    
*   Unlimited devices
    
*   Unlimited locations
    
*   Regular updates and improvements
    
*   Two-way SMS functionality, [from 10c per message](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7438358-pracsuite-subscription-pricing#h_3254ea8232)
    .
    
*   Unlimited emails
    
*   Secure cloud hosting and backup
    

**A PracSuite subscription starts at $84, which covers the first practitioner.** Additional practitioners are priced according to the total number of practitioners, as outlined in the rate chart below. All prices are in AUD and exclude GST.

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Total Practitioners** | **Additional Full-Time Practitioners** | **Additional Part-Time\* Practitioners** |
| **2 - 4** | $46.00 | $36.00 |
| **5 - 9** | $44.00 | $34.00 |
| **10 - 19** | $42.00 | $32.00 |
| **20 - 39** | $40.00 | $30.00 |
| **40 - 79** | $38.00 | $28.00 |
| **80+** | $36.00 | $26.00 |

_Pricing as at 1/7/2025._

Subscribers are billed one month in advance based on the previous month’s practitioner activity. Any practitioner files that are active in the billing period will incur charges. Active practitioner files can be found in PracSuite in [Settings > Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)
. Any practitioners added part-way through the month will be charged on a prorated basis at the beginning of the following month.

### Part-Time Practitioner Policy

Practitioners will automatically qualify for the part-time rates outlined above **if they meet the following criteria for two consecutive months.** Part-time discounts will automatically be applied to your monthly subscription invoice.

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
|     |     |
| **A maximum of 16 hours of appointments per week** | Based on the total duration of appointments booked with the practitioner. Excludes notes and rule outs. Patients within group appointments are counted individually. |
| **A maximum of 32 appointments per week** | The total number of appointments booked with the practitioner. Excludes notes and rule outs. Patients within group appointments are counted individually. |
| **A maximum of 32 transactions per week** | The total number of items billed for the practitioner. Only a single item is counted per patient each day. |

=============================================================

Important Information For New Zealand Users
===========================================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[SMS Restrictions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7881301-important-information-for-new-zealand-users#h_39b8a7eb1b)

[Bulk SMS Sending from Reports in PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7881301-important-information-for-new-zealand-users#h_140fad92c8)

[Integrations](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7881301-important-information-for-new-zealand-users#h_c353668b12)

The following information relates to PracSuite users in New Zealand:

SMS Restrictions
================

Effective from **1st October 2024**, all SMS messages sent to New Zealand numbers through PracSuite will automatically include the following statement at the end of each message: **“Standard SMS charges apply to reply.”**

This ensures compliance with New Zealand regulations.

### **How does this affect you?**

**Message Length**: The addition of this phrase may increase the length of your SMS messages, which could result in using additional SMS credits if the message exceeds the standard character limit. Please note that since our system cannot determine whether your SMS template will be used for New Zealand numbers, the estimated character count will not include the characters added by this required statement. It will only be appended at the time of sending.

**Patient Impact**: While most mobile phone users in New Zealand have SMS included in their plans, some may be on plans that charge for replying to messages. This change ensures that all recipients are aware of potential costs when responding.

### **What do you need to do?**

No action is required from you, as this change will be applied automatically. However, we recommend reviewing your SMS templates to account for the additional characters, which could affect message length or credit usage.

* * *

Bulk SMS Sending from Reports in PracSuite
==========================================

Due to legislation aimed at combating spam SMS in New Zealand, businesses must apply for a 'short code' to send commercial SMS in New Zealand, which has high setup costs and ongoing monthly fees.

  
Rather than removing all SMS functionality for New Zealand customers, Smartsoft has chosen to bear the cost of the short code on behalf of our users. However, there will be some restrictions to comply with the law.

  
SMS functions will only be available for appointment reminders, follow-ups, and ad-hoc correspondence of a clinical nature. **Sending marketing SMS to New Zealand numbers is prohibited in PracSuite.**

  
Further, the bulk SMS messaging function derived from a patient list in a report and customised SMS Sender IDs will no longer be available.

  
We apologise for any inconvenience this may cause; however, these changes are necessary to protect the integrity of the SMS channel and ensure compliance with New Zealand law.

Restricting patients from booking appointments online

Restricting patients from booking appointments online
=====================================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Customising Online Booking Services](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7900866-restricting-patients-from-booking-appointments-online#h_51e6ed8f5e)

[Customising Online Booking Access Per Patient](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7900866-restricting-patients-from-booking-appointments-online#h_3378521248)

[Disabling All Online Bookings for a Patient](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7900866-restricting-patients-from-booking-appointments-online#h_e5ecb5831e)

The online booking [patient login portal](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5205910-enabling-the-client-login-portal)
 allows patients to view and manage their upcoming appointments. The login portal also allows you to restrict what types of services individual patients can book online while logged in and the ability to entirely disable a specific patient from booking online.

Customising Online Booking Services
===================================

**Important:** It's only possible to restrict a patient's online booking experience if you require them to log in to book appointments. **If you allow appointments to be booked as a guest, anyone can book without restriction.**

As you can see below, you can choose which type of patients can book each of your [online booking services](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/services)
 in Settings > Online Booking > Services.

*   **All Patients** - Both Guests and Logged In patients can book the service
    
*   **Guest Patients** - Only patients booking as a guest can book the service
    
*   **Logged In Patients** \- Anyone logged in can book the service
    
*   **Approved Patients** \- Only patients you permit via their file can book this service
    

For this example, we're focusing on services restricted to Logged in Patients or Approved Patients.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/741596542/3ec3bf91b19019ee2eeb5eb8/028563bf-1dbf-4bc1-8585-872bf11bda52?expires=1771821900&signature=4e2e1b00f0a7a9e01853806ab70bc4c02b90c05659063326e75bf09b7ac36aa2&req=cyQmE8B4mIVdFb4f3HP0gGqKzeU5%2F0ik3n9IjA8RmCZ3z2Z%2BXkzXdBxY9gfx%0A8A6C6TSrBfSkh%2F7hcA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/741596542/3ec3bf91b19019ee2eeb5eb8/028563bf-1dbf-4bc1-8585-872bf11bda52?expires=1771821900&signature=4e2e1b00f0a7a9e01853806ab70bc4c02b90c05659063326e75bf09b7ac36aa2&req=cyQmE8B4mIVdFb4f3HP0gGqKzeU5%2F0ik3n9IjA8RmCZ3z2Z%2BXkzXdBxY9gfx%0A8A6C6TSrBfSkh%2F7hcA%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Customising Online Booking Access Per Patient
=============================================

After reviewing your online booking service settings, the next step is customising an individual patient's online booking permissions.

Open their patient file, go to the Appointments tab and select the Online Booking button at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/748310632/7532a3d689796e3a4f24f67f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2318f0aec35c5bde9e3926b7a86fcb4697bcdafd52d9681cecd9236be9dd7060&req=cyQvFch%2Bm4JdFb4f3HP0gByfsbqM2Cv3unA8rYbpHeb5NCLC2opUFrP2RehJ%0AAOjbqiT5XZFuNGfV0A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/748310632/7532a3d689796e3a4f24f67f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2318f0aec35c5bde9e3926b7a86fcb4697bcdafd52d9681cecd9236be9dd7060&req=cyQvFch%2Bm4JdFb4f3HP0gByfsbqM2Cv3unA8rYbpHeb5NCLC2opUFrP2RehJ%0AAOjbqiT5XZFuNGfV0A%3D%3D%0A)

Disabling All Online Bookings for a Patient
-------------------------------------------

As shown below, you can disable individual and group bookings for the patient when they log in.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/741596558/893f9985dbc5a199454b4cbe/c7dbfedd-6bf8-4e9e-81fc-47e069d46038?expires=1771821900&signature=70c25553ca7c9ebf752ba2b4ae6876dff8e1a318120e6fd39a405416c0eb7c7f&req=cyQmE8B4mIRXFb4f3HP0gBjPfkzDVifYugtlwvCsHCsHBaCn2Z48IwPEIw%2Bw%0Aj1usA98bmsFsSj0hFQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/741596558/893f9985dbc5a199454b4cbe/c7dbfedd-6bf8-4e9e-81fc-47e069d46038?expires=1771821900&signature=70c25553ca7c9ebf752ba2b4ae6876dff8e1a318120e6fd39a405416c0eb7c7f&req=cyQmE8B4mIRXFb4f3HP0gBjPfkzDVifYugtlwvCsHCsHBaCn2Z48IwPEIw%2Bw%0Aj1usA98bmsFsSj0hFQ%3D%3D%0A)

You can also choose which individual and group services the patient can book while logged in.

If you have chosen for an online booking service to only be booked by Approved Patients, this is where you can enable that patient to book those services.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/748310743/3502d7336c0bb4ff4d6aed68/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=603efef99e95595a38d000743c268f69f1b78dae843e6531d1cd3c81dda15cda&req=cyQvFch%2BmoVcFb4f3HP0gJHBzhYjaMwYaP%2Bjqp7AFTomWRgE1zCgMp7FrlSQ%0AgxIRhLXxo8EQtkVnIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/748310743/3502d7336c0bb4ff4d6aed68/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=603efef99e95595a38d000743c268f69f1b78dae843e6531d1cd3c81dda15cda&req=cyQvFch%2BmoVcFb4f3HP0gJHBzhYjaMwYaP%2Bjqp7AFTomWRgE1zCgMp7FrlSQ%0AgxIRhLXxo8EQtkVnIA%3D%3D%0A)

When they log in, their online booking experience will be restricted according to the settings in the above popup.

## Document 296 — Xero Tracking Categories | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-296}

Xero Tracking Categories

Xero Tracking Categories
========================

Updated over a year ago

_This article assumes you have created Tracking Categories in Xero. [Click here to learn more about creating Tracking Categories in Xero.](https://central.xero.com/s/article/Set-up-tracking-categories)
_

This feature is designed to apply Xero's tracking categories to the invoices and payments that are created in Xero as a part of the sync process.

To configure which tracking category to apply when syncing PracSuite data to Xero, go to [Settings > Integrations > Xero](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/xero)
 and select your Xero organisation in the main grid.

Under the Businesses heading, choose which Tracking Category to apply to the invoices and payments that are created in Xero as a part of the sync process. In the example below, we have created a Tracking Category in Xero called Business, with options below representing each business in PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756262012/7bc056d876456d03e2be8ef8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5618c2b3683fd8bc7aac2f7aaf4787092190cf4f19111a0d00d2c32bf5d7a14&req=cyUhFM98nYBdFb4f3HP0gES6PeRtGXfxJoEo5UrJcX%2FohJ3EXqMBy1TCHB9q%0ATM0eTEXTTIjJPGXozw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756262012/7bc056d876456d03e2be8ef8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5618c2b3683fd8bc7aac2f7aaf4787092190cf4f19111a0d00d2c32bf5d7a14&req=cyUhFM98nYBdFb4f3HP0gES6PeRtGXfxJoEo5UrJcX%2FohJ3EXqMBy1TCHB9q%0ATM0eTEXTTIjJPGXozw%3D%3D%0A)

If you do not see any tracking categories in the drop-down list, [ensure that you have created tracking categories in your Xero account.](https://central.xero.com/s/article/Set-up-tracking-categories-US)

Click Save to finalise your changes.

Once configured, the selected Tracking Category will be applied to the invoices created in Xero.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756276119/6162a2fc7d594500b0525530/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4352722411941755ce59c7389e10a60536b10a29ea5277b2cb7a079050593edf&req=cyUhFM54nIBWFb4f3HP0gCjGTMsIXv3RkeKPxMR0WZyKsGn%2FCYM0gB39dKez%0AkUy9N5Txl3GqbkPwpA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756276119/6162a2fc7d594500b0525530/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4352722411941755ce59c7389e10a60536b10a29ea5277b2cb7a079050593edf&req=cyUhFM54nIBWFb4f3HP0gCjGTMsIXv3RkeKPxMR0WZyKsGn%2FCYM0gB39dKez%0AkUy9N5Txl3GqbkPwpA%3D%3D%0A)

[You can learn more about how to use tracking categories within Xero here.](https://central.xero.com/s/article/Tracking-Summary-Report-US)

Google Calendar & Google Meet Integration

Google Calendar & Google Meet Integration
=========================================

Updated over 11 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7948131-google-calendar-google-meet-integration#h_19260bf4a8)

[Create a Dedicated Calendar in Google](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7948131-google-calendar-google-meet-integration#h_75fe016db4)

[Enabling the Google Calendar Integration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7948131-google-calendar-google-meet-integration#h_ebe0973957)

[Enabling Google Meet Integration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7948131-google-calendar-google-meet-integration#h_dfb92632fa)

[Telehealth Appointment Types](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7948131-google-calendar-google-meet-integration#h_5c46f60ff7)

[Accessing Google Meet Links via the Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7948131-google-calendar-google-meet-integration#h_0e2849c99b)

[Adding Google Meet Links to SMS & Email Templates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7948131-google-calendar-google-meet-integration#h_db43ee5ba0)

Overview
========

The Google Calendar integration allows a practitioner's PracSuite appointment book to appear in their Google Calendar account. **The integration is one-way**, meaning that your PracSuite appointment appears in Google; however, changes cannot be made via Google. All changes to appointments must be made directly in PracSuite.

The Google Calendar integration is ideal for Google and Android users, and it should refresh quicker than the [iCalendar feature](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4379561-icalendar-integration-for-practitioners)
.

After enabling Google Calendar integration, it's also possible to use **Google Meet** as your preferred platform for **telehealth** appointments.

* * *

Create a Dedicated Calendar in Google
=====================================

Within each practitioner's Google Calendar account, **a dedicated calendar for PracSuite appointments must be created for each corresponding PracSuite business.**

To create a new calendar, [go to your Google Calendar](https://calendar.google.com/)
 and select the + icon on the left side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137206581/4680a82bcdad09470d9bfbd4/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+12_18_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=16310491c76ed1e594284ba2799cedc6d58deffcb8ce767f12bf0148a8c71dca&req=dSEkEct%2Bm4RXWPMW1HO4zd9tCQXUNs69Jg3AzUSA0OIQ8EM9p%2BEVXh6Ig8vf%0AepmqVcMfV4UPjGBtLPE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137206581/4680a82bcdad09470d9bfbd4/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+12_18_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=16310491c76ed1e594284ba2799cedc6d58deffcb8ce767f12bf0148a8c71dca&req=dSEkEct%2Bm4RXWPMW1HO4zd9tCQXUNs69Jg3AzUSA0OIQ8EM9p%2BEVXh6Ig8vf%0AepmqVcMfV4UPjGBtLPE%3D%0A)

Repeat this process for each PracSuite business.

Enabling the Google Calendar Integration
========================================

Google Calendar integration is only available to user accounts that are linked with a practitioner file. The following option must be enabled on a practitioner's user account in [Settings > Users & Security > Users & Security](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users)
.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1092426503/b29a9c49212e246b36e7e912/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddbdf66214393de4bc60201c90604e5aac5bb487cfd9436e65ef3d9c66f7c65c&req=dSAuFM18m4RfWvMW1HO4zZm5jOXCiw1tmJtPBZjkHQoRcFVwYuA7SxjTyBsD%0A2wM8a7RNZmYkCMDepo0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1092426503/b29a9c49212e246b36e7e912/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ddbdf66214393de4bc60201c90604e5aac5bb487cfd9436e65ef3d9c66f7c65c&req=dSAuFM18m4RfWvMW1HO4zZm5jOXCiw1tmJtPBZjkHQoRcFVwYuA7SxjTyBsD%0A2wM8a7RNZmYkCMDepo0%3D%0A)

Each practitioner must set up their Google Calendar integration within their individual PracSuite account. **It is not possible to set up Google Calendar integration on behalf of another practitioner.**

After creating dedicated calendars for each business in Google, each practitioner must work through the following steps.

From the user menu in the top right-hand corner of their PracSuite account, select **Manage Calendar Integrations.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1128609357/b59031888e0399ee4eae8451/CleanShot+2024-07-30+at+10_13_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64f7d391d2fb87fbdd60d1755accdb59e073a2f822e3687334b781d4f1515bb9&req=dSElHs9%2BlIJaXvMW1HO4zUvpDnxdmpaqxDhaDaWkMpV8zr7l%2FVlx8I9WtrlM%0AHcVrRlBZMKuyiPXRKV8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1128609357/b59031888e0399ee4eae8451/CleanShot+2024-07-30+at+10_13_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64f7d391d2fb87fbdd60d1755accdb59e073a2f822e3687334b781d4f1515bb9&req=dSElHs9%2BlIJaXvMW1HO4zUvpDnxdmpaqxDhaDaWkMpV8zr7l%2FVlx8I9WtrlM%0AHcVrRlBZMKuyiPXRKV8%3D%0A)

  
Enable Google Calendar for the required businesses. These steps will need to be repeated for each business.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756286172/aa959dda7b6807aa3e7a1a26/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b449c6e9a29150cd1093d6acc4135ae41cf2a29c6d751b6da2d2c6bea7266b32&req=cyUhFMF4nIZdFb4f3HP0gJFvVNCMCcqpvkdUzecAkpbqN7EiLYr6fDW2z4r6%0Agb4Cki2RYBpAnyeVpg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756286172/aa959dda7b6807aa3e7a1a26/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b449c6e9a29150cd1093d6acc4135ae41cf2a29c6d751b6da2d2c6bea7266b32&req=cyUhFMF4nIZdFb4f3HP0gJFvVNCMCcqpvkdUzecAkpbqN7EiLYr6fDW2z4r6%0Agb4Cki2RYBpAnyeVpg%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting a business, you'll be prompted to **Sign in with Google**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756286202/1ab877c3e3e4f3ea192172e7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7eeab60f74858d4ffc6956a9f1015c3a16460674bb23ea4e5143fcb4c0f3980d&req=cyUhFMF4n4FdFb4f3HP0gGkfJF33rUSEefKYRG4bg2GFz5ri7aWjW3H9Pj3t%0AiE1PVpeGZgkR22ByBg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756286202/1ab877c3e3e4f3ea192172e7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7eeab60f74858d4ffc6956a9f1015c3a16460674bb23ea4e5143fcb4c0f3980d&req=cyUhFMF4n4FdFb4f3HP0gGkfJF33rUSEefKYRG4bg2GFz5ri7aWjW3H9Pj3t%0AiE1PVpeGZgkR22ByBg%3D%3D%0A)

After signing in to your Google account, select the **Select All** option to ensure PracSuite can access all required data.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756286280/9b0a8ab2ec16de815353368d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a67c11ce0e162087ab80670baf9ca7eefb3f95801b610dbdc5ed31782afb855e&req=cyUhFMF4n4lfFb4f3HP0gH0uqyhwaPODgn3jMp9yMTO9pL7TFChRbiRJJCZX%0AR92YeYHhZbCRT2FGDg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756286280/9b0a8ab2ec16de815353368d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a67c11ce0e162087ab80670baf9ca7eefb3f95801b610dbdc5ed31782afb855e&req=cyUhFMF4n4lfFb4f3HP0gH0uqyhwaPODgn3jMp9yMTO9pL7TFChRbiRJJCZX%0AR92YeYHhZbCRT2FGDg%3D%3D%0A)

Select the corresponding Google Calendar for PracSuite to sync appointments for this business.

**You must select a calendar in your Google account that is dedicated to an individual business in PracSuite. Do not select a calendar that is used for other purposes or a calendar that you have selected to use for Google Calendar integration with another PracSuite business.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420085138/0948e33ce0e652f3c9b3fb37bf54/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=680b7e6dd7e524f05501eef30d067be598a016b5451b6a3a0ec78876b1f0d8b8&req=dSQlFsl2mIBcUfMW1HO4zZ1lbhG0%2F7vooYe2VeLyqPeI3Y1qL42jCGeK6j8R%0AFVp%2B5eniXu0o4CLV%2F9k%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420085138/0948e33ce0e652f3c9b3fb37bf54/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=680b7e6dd7e524f05501eef30d067be598a016b5451b6a3a0ec78876b1f0d8b8&req=dSQlFsl2mIBcUfMW1HO4zZ1lbhG0%2F7vooYe2VeLyqPeI3Y1qL42jCGeK6j8R%0AFVp%2B5eniXu0o4CLV%2F9k%3D%0A)

You can also customise how patient names should appear in Google Calendar, along with the patient identifiers you want to appear on the appointment in Google Calendar.

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Repeat the steps above for each PracSuite business, remembering to select a different Google Calendar for each business.

You will now see PracSuite appointments in your selected Google Calendar.

PracSuite will sync the next two years of appointments with Google Calendar. During busy periods, changes to appointments made in PracSuite may take a few minutes to reflect in Google Calendar.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420087643/a4d1090c8ecad5e7cd831c4f1bb4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44358b63f9384dc86cb5b66e26e67150744e45d69210e5b8660422996e3eea18&req=dSQlFsl2modbWvMW1HO4zWdn4B4qTznJTXhQrc8vP1AcPuz7%2BauudxEOZtFg%0AvhINjxDv3PGWMcFvjdk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420087643/a4d1090c8ecad5e7cd831c4f1bb4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44358b63f9384dc86cb5b66e26e67150744e45d69210e5b8660422996e3eea18&req=dSQlFsl2modbWvMW1HO4zWdn4B4qTznJTXhQrc8vP1AcPuz7%2BauudxEOZtFg%0AvhINjxDv3PGWMcFvjdk%3D%0A)

* * *

Enabling Google Meet Integration
================================

From the user menu in the top right-hand corner of their PracSuite account, select **Manage Calendar Integrations.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420095148/2829487f68f316b435564cc1fef7/CleanShot%2B2024-07-30%2Bat%2B10_13_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=394158b738de2ddbd6df5831c913e3f1e58bf13f82f26e3fa3d4599688f72b53&req=dSQlFsl3mIBbUfMW1HO4zYzJErQKqNvIdLl9zcB2DbWJU2nenGxvA1FbUsNa%0Awk23vH8lmFKkZp8iUMo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420095148/2829487f68f316b435564cc1fef7/CleanShot%2B2024-07-30%2Bat%2B10_13_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=394158b738de2ddbd6df5831c913e3f1e58bf13f82f26e3fa3d4599688f72b53&req=dSQlFsl3mIBbUfMW1HO4zYzJErQKqNvIdLl9zcB2DbWJU2nenGxvA1FbUsNa%0Awk23vH8lmFKkZp8iUMo%3D%0A)

  
​**Enable** Google Calendar for a business or use the cog button to **Edit** an existing setup.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420097212/5fec7ef22d6f827e91c6bf78e171/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c028007e3fa5929568413455ef48ad74dbbf82dbdf2298b3502cdc1dcfdef4bd&req=dSQlFsl3moNeW%2FMW1HO4zW0po04Pgj3chgn4%2BcoF6Q6pg%2FilD0%2F%2BWRWkHNdy%0AStYiZP3iA6SIZYt9gas%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420097212/5fec7ef22d6f827e91c6bf78e171/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c028007e3fa5929568413455ef48ad74dbbf82dbdf2298b3502cdc1dcfdef4bd&req=dSQlFsl3moNeW%2FMW1HO4zW0po04Pgj3chgn4%2BcoF6Q6pg%2FilD0%2F%2BWRWkHNdy%0AStYiZP3iA6SIZYt9gas%3D%0A)

To automatically generate Google Meet links for telehealth-enabled appointments, select a Calendar and enable the option "**Create Google Meet Links for Telehealth Appointments**".

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420093227/b3a9fcde49cc048e2293e6aedef3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e79938acf38c5ce4fe7ddbe38a360da01a0528a98dad673c4b9d3885e93acc56&req=dSQlFsl3noNdXvMW1HO4zbWc6FI6b%2FU8o4dmFE8CRjwzhhv7VEG1W0broNgV%0AeUYOxaDnPYpMuis67lU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1420093227/b3a9fcde49cc048e2293e6aedef3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e79938acf38c5ce4fe7ddbe38a360da01a0528a98dad673c4b9d3885e93acc56&req=dSQlFsl3noNdXvMW1HO4zbWc6FI6b%2FU8o4dmFE8CRjwzhhv7VEG1W0broNgV%0AeUYOxaDnPYpMuis67lU%3D%0A)

Once enabled, Google Meet will be set as the practitioner's preferred telehealth platform and used to create telehealth meeting links. After enabling Google Meet, join links will be created for all future telehealth appointments.

To confirm whether Google Meet is enabled for a practitioner, go to [Settings > Practitioners > Practitioners](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)
.

Select the practitioner and scroll down to the Telehealth section.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421725747/d2da45e1812cf91b836440a454dc/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+10_07_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de18981ace8e717e3fe5f73764e2a26a260faaadf6c5b7059a1f00417fae1db5&req=dSQlF858mIZbXvMW1HO4zdj9xztC1F6cqIvvSriGaxXbWTigrahI4e2NTB6u%0A%2BbrDqYUb5tXpSlx9tMA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421725747/d2da45e1812cf91b836440a454dc/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+10_07_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=de18981ace8e717e3fe5f73764e2a26a260faaadf6c5b7059a1f00417fae1db5&req=dSQlF858mIZbXvMW1HO4zdj9xztC1F6cqIvvSriGaxXbWTigrahI4e2NTB6u%0A%2BbrDqYUb5tXpSlx9tMA%3D%0A)

  
If the user has not linked their Google account to PracSuite from the user menu, the following message will display instead.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421728417/cf56f26cab464d25afceb95c41c9/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+10_11_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f8e2d3a0f73518cf201e38cd0dff9f1798b17aed9f018872085adb0880b59fd2&req=dSQlF858lYVeXvMW1HO4zcl%2FfM01RDA6RClwon%2FIerNFQwgxCeYCXSPW%2Bp5%2B%0Argpr7gENGllFfP2RPQw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421728417/cf56f26cab464d25afceb95c41c9/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+10_11_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f8e2d3a0f73518cf201e38cd0dff9f1798b17aed9f018872085adb0880b59fd2&req=dSQlF858lYVeXvMW1HO4zcl%2FfM01RDA6RClwon%2FIerNFQwgxCeYCXSPW%2Bp5%2B%0Argpr7gENGllFfP2RPQw%3D%0A)

Telehealth Appointment Types
============================

Google Meet links will only be created for Appointment Types enabled for telehealth. To confirm whether your telehealth appointments are set up correctly, go to [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
.

Ensure that the **Telehealth appointment** option is enabled for all appointment types Google Meet links should be automatically created for.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421718845/d0c68c1bc3dc829f2e91491018b8/CleanShot%2B2024-02-09%2Bat%2B11_49_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9875276ebacaa597b0ec891cc91efa8b03af3c026e8e60a17b1b038c59fb8919&req=dSQlF85%2FlYlbXPMW1HO4zXeeqF2Tr5wzXhFLSCvt%2BopmjhzEX1qjODwzsuuy%0Avjb5Igb1TjVfk0PCOus%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421718845/d0c68c1bc3dc829f2e91491018b8/CleanShot%2B2024-02-09%2Bat%2B11_49_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9875276ebacaa597b0ec891cc91efa8b03af3c026e8e60a17b1b038c59fb8919&req=dSQlF85%2FlYlbXPMW1HO4zXeeqF2Tr5wzXhFLSCvt%2BopmjhzEX1qjODwzsuuy%0Avjb5Igb1TjVfk0PCOus%3D%0A)

Accessing Google Meet Links via the Appointment Book
====================================================

When booking telehealth appointment types, Google Meet meeting links will automatically be created. When rescheduling or cancelling telehealth appointments in PracSuite, the corresponding Google Meet event will also be updated.

You will see the following on the Appointment Details screen before booking appointments.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421718844/7f18d7cc9378caa5e66a35188d16/CleanShot%2B2024-02-09%2Bat%2B14_15_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fea7c7dfa41f4b8b78b01a81501052b3159fce0023414f9875d5f9a3956f5f7d&req=dSQlF85%2FlYlbXfMW1HO4zQW56tWF6wIQn8EceDMuKMD8H%2B8kEwMFQ%2B5JYZA2%0AuAvHFAiGjZvSMLQYo30%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421718844/7f18d7cc9378caa5e66a35188d16/CleanShot%2B2024-02-09%2Bat%2B14_15_09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fea7c7dfa41f4b8b78b01a81501052b3159fce0023414f9875d5f9a3956f5f7d&req=dSQlF85%2FlYlbXfMW1HO4zQW56tWF6wIQn8EceDMuKMD8H%2B8kEwMFQ%2B5JYZA2%0AuAvHFAiGjZvSMLQYo30%3D%0A)

Google Meet links will appear in this area after the appointment has been booked.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421721082/e1671ab9a36eeb5cbd66ad71357c/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+10_00_40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e19c60aa7f4d87ea10846f0e77a54d49850519bc0e24e2a02076b18d49fcbc42&req=dSQlF858nIFXW%2FMW1HO4zWpVahAXTeZaXaxG9%2BcKR1tiEuoSlSBVqg2Q1Rqo%0A1uvE4jiZNabXFxhI9eM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421721082/e1671ab9a36eeb5cbd66ad71357c/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+10_00_40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e19c60aa7f4d87ea10846f0e77a54d49850519bc0e24e2a02076b18d49fcbc42&req=dSQlF858nIFXW%2FMW1HO4zWpVahAXTeZaXaxG9%2BcKR1tiEuoSlSBVqg2Q1Rqo%0A1uvE4jiZNabXFxhI9eM%3D%0A)

Google Meet links can also be accessed from the Telehealth section of the appointment menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421718841/de496808a79081145b57c5b0ea0b/CleanShot%2B2024-02-09%2Bat%2B14_15_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6bd32e5e58ea3434f2ab3ee5064dccd1cbb74af51969dfa0310fe225ae2d2874&req=dSQlF85%2FlYlbWPMW1HO4zTlmuUigs6rRaIkaB%2F7FItcfN9OtXbV4SBCzqvJL%0Ai1XTDQcRttHZ5qdQPx0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421718841/de496808a79081145b57c5b0ea0b/CleanShot%2B2024-02-09%2Bat%2B14_15_54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6bd32e5e58ea3434f2ab3ee5064dccd1cbb74af51969dfa0310fe225ae2d2874&req=dSQlF85%2FlYlbWPMW1HO4zTlmuUigs6rRaIkaB%2F7FItcfN9OtXbV4SBCzqvJL%0Ai1XTDQcRttHZ5qdQPx0%3D%0A)

Use the open button to quickly join the meeting via Google Meet.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421720818/b6f5d9dc646eac127670a3de23af/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+10_00_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e8f922a5020d9c29bc584424042b3b3888ec5e246d04be392046fe132c57e5e&req=dSQlF858nYleUfMW1HO4zSYaFUsjiuT%2BGnZO%2FuIwXvSPi6bO0Zvufc86GUo6%0AZd%2B48%2BnQo0BiXVgirqU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1421720818/b6f5d9dc646eac127670a3de23af/CleanShot+2025-03-14+at+10_00_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e8f922a5020d9c29bc584424042b3b3888ec5e246d04be392046fe132c57e5e&req=dSQlF858nYleUfMW1HO4zSYaFUsjiuT%2BGnZO%2FuIwXvSPi6bO0Zvufc86GUo6%0AZd%2B48%2BnQo0BiXVgirqU%3D%0A)

Adding Google Meet Links to SMS & Email Templates
=================================================

The following merge fields are available to include in your SMS & Email templates.

<<AppointmentTelehealthLink>> - Inserts the patient's telehealth link

<<AppointmentTelehealthLinkPrac>> - Inserts the practitioner's telehealth link

## Document 298 — Editing Forms Before Sending | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-298}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7957993-editing-forms-before-sending](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7957993-editing-forms-before-sending)

Editing Forms Before Sending

Editing Forms Before Sending
============================

Updated over 2 years ago

Editing a form before sending it to a patient is only possible when manually sending it.

Go to the relevant patient file and select the **Send Form** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756315096/38775ebb13a26d7d6ee1d019/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b2201e4a8b0a40fb97611c1de8ddd0c4266d6836d9129cf7a8385ee56806da88&req=cyUhFch7nYhZFb4f3HP0gHyVWatScvSdg0jPoMJFhK7VR7qziD7y38JvsMNV%0AoZ%2Bnkkyq8fazRANBfA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/756315096/38775ebb13a26d7d6ee1d019/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b2201e4a8b0a40fb97611c1de8ddd0c4266d6836d9129cf7a8385ee56806da88&req=cyUhFch7nYhZFb4f3HP0gHyVWatScvSdg0jPoMJFhK7VR7qziD7y38JvsMNV%0AoZ%2Bnkkyq8fazRANBfA%3D%3D%0A)

**Select your template** and then select the **Edit Before Sending** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/752204832/ca6f1d9405c383fa44a7a5c2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28987a7623602f7bd857654ccf8f8bdea6fa1241e37d0c895b8119b770a1ffda&req=cyUlFMl6lYJdFb4f3HP0gGZDv8zMRUkUgQjT7WgYKctrqhPG3AJuOZBR8pwG%0AAvwK1ESRzVucCumKtA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/752204832/ca6f1d9405c383fa44a7a5c2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28987a7623602f7bd857654ccf8f8bdea6fa1241e37d0c895b8119b770a1ffda&req=cyUlFMl6lYJdFb4f3HP0gGZDv8zMRUkUgQjT7WgYKctrqhPG3AJuOZBR8pwG%0AAvwK1ESRzVucCumKtA%3D%3D%0A)

The form preview window will appear. Work through the form, making edits/selections as required.

Select **Save** once you have completed your edits.

You can then choose how you wish to send the link to the edited form to the patient as normal.

Using a Matrix in Clinical Notes

Using a Matrix in Clinical Notes
================================

Enter the Matrix

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Example DASS 21 Template](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7963762-using-a-matrix-in-clinical-notes#h_0cf8810cea)

PracSuite [Clinical Notes](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413946-clinical-notes)
 allow you to add a configurable Matrix component. This allows you to ask a series of related questions and calculate a score based on the answers.

Begin by adding the component to your [Clinical Note Template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4656061-working-with-clinical-notes-templates)
 via the Add To Note button at the top.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753090350/839677c41e51e77a880a895f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f196dbe8d149b1cfb1dcb4783b9cc092372be596479b705bf481fefb3fccf58f&req=cyUkFsB%2BnoRfFb4f3HP0gGY7bMNDOqCJeWLuQnPedKOJX9BSzGohDJu1EwFN%0AilKMQOr4aHfJ7liQDg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753090350/839677c41e51e77a880a895f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f196dbe8d149b1cfb1dcb4783b9cc092372be596479b705bf481fefb3fccf58f&req=cyUkFsB%2BnoRfFb4f3HP0gGY7bMNDOqCJeWLuQnPedKOJX9BSzGohDJu1EwFN%0AilKMQOr4aHfJ7liQDg%3D%3D%0A)

When you add the component, some defaults appear to help you understand how it will display. Start by giving it a Label.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753091457/c06690109710769bfc6bbd18/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8569754296fad7f6afa4fce9f414cf79db14bcfab1a6fa516868bf76f632f085&req=cyUkFsB%2FmYRYFb4f3HP0gA0C6Wkm6gF%2BqHn9M07uH1JDsP56CXPqrU%2FUnC5m%0AYWIvgCXWMrJ6lQ13PA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753091457/c06690109710769bfc6bbd18/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8569754296fad7f6afa4fce9f414cf79db14bcfab1a6fa516868bf76f632f085&req=cyUkFsB%2FmYRYFb4f3HP0gA0C6Wkm6gF%2BqHn9M07uH1JDsP56CXPqrU%2FUnC5m%0AYWIvgCXWMrJ6lQ13PA%3D%3D%0A)

The switch for Assigning number values for choices is on by default, this will allow calculations, switch it off if it is not required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753091987/74671fea1e2c8b427d3ea486/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72e602b68b9a8bd65af309368aad9614fddd07facc2ce721e0b8fc8f38a55644&req=cyUkFsB%2FlIlYFb4f3HP0gIJwszguR9eBWzYyZ2UxXRfpA0f%2FH5zsTFKoUcUR%0AQ8EcCz4ZoULY4fDI%2FA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753091987/74671fea1e2c8b427d3ea486/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72e602b68b9a8bd65af309368aad9614fddd07facc2ce721e0b8fc8f38a55644&req=cyUkFsB%2FlIlYFb4f3HP0gIJwszguR9eBWzYyZ2UxXRfpA0f%2FH5zsTFKoUcUR%0AQ8EcCz4ZoULY4fDI%2FA%3D%3D%0A)

PracSuite Matricies can handle multiple sections, which allows you to have an advanced calculation across different question and choice combinations. Use the add button above Section 1 to add an additional set of questions and choices.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/870986107/cd757343ad615128cc1ef412/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10a89818dede1e8f6a4ffc7212e9f8bf28098e72da8d131863d08529821fdaf7&req=fCcnH8F4nIFYFb4f3HP0gDmsmKAazTpqW%2B3VqGPVq7hnZ3QgpUyXDji97Wmd%0AmfdskmqG5JDJ69F5mg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/870986107/cd757343ad615128cc1ef412/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10a89818dede1e8f6a4ffc7212e9f8bf28098e72da8d131863d08529821fdaf7&req=fCcnH8F4nIFYFb4f3HP0gDmsmKAazTpqW%2B3VqGPVq7hnZ3QgpUyXDji97Wmd%0AmfdskmqG5JDJ69F5mg%3D%3D%0A)

In each section, you start with three Choices, edit these and use the Add button to create more, or use the trash can icon to remove them.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753092269/1e812c2ea0bf7a3a4a5c2cd8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49b9ab1b8490ad43ddbe297ed62b945fe112014bf43a380947502994cc85f442&req=cyUkFsB8n4dWFb4f3HP0gPR2tRiqEQAf78n3GFnDohS%2FD59%2FxoCve3UQG%2Fnp%0A6wiPuKWF%2FG9btWQ8Ew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753092269/1e812c2ea0bf7a3a4a5c2cd8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49b9ab1b8490ad43ddbe297ed62b945fe112014bf43a380947502994cc85f442&req=cyUkFsB8n4dWFb4f3HP0gPR2tRiqEQAf78n3GFnDohS%2FD59%2FxoCve3UQG%2Fnp%0A6wiPuKWF%2FG9btWQ8Ew%3D%3D%0A)

Next, configure the Questions, as with the choices, you begin with three. Edit the questions and use the Add button to create more, or use the trash can icon to remove them.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753092785/67eb0b6cef9a5c3c18cf35e7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=910e3fd12fdd590a2d96874587f6f67fc984d40fd938282aef9889b567bd3807&req=cyUkFsB8molaFb4f3HP0gPhgGxvyrPonpdWA3qPSN7h1wWTZyIOHQLr1HeUf%0A2LHK12Mr9DXJ9tMpGQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753092785/67eb0b6cef9a5c3c18cf35e7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=910e3fd12fdd590a2d96874587f6f67fc984d40fd938282aef9889b567bd3807&req=cyUkFsB8molaFb4f3HP0gPhgGxvyrPonpdWA3qPSN7h1wWTZyIOHQLr1HeUf%0A2LHK12Mr9DXJ9tMpGQ%3D%3D%0A)

Finally, you can Include totals on results. Turn this off if it is not required. By default you have the grand total and column totals programmed for you, if you do not want to see these untick the checkboxes in the display column. You can also add in your own calculations, simply select Add, give it a title and then write in a custom calculation referencing previous answers to your questions above using their reference letter (A,B,C in the above screenshot).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/754805052/8d2f1a680b328c9dc8a72f84/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=928bc1f127ba36cc161180fc61c000be4756f60d86430814ffc8d6fc003563f5&req=cyUjHsl7nYRdFb4f3HP0gHclGLD%2FYuRyOD2euQl90V%2B3UHvJ2iFqdmTLpIC1%0AldNxuzFL56HKwmAyPw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/754805052/8d2f1a680b328c9dc8a72f84/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=928bc1f127ba36cc161180fc61c000be4756f60d86430814ffc8d6fc003563f5&req=cyUjHsl7nYRdFb4f3HP0gHclGLD%2FYuRyOD2euQl90V%2B3UHvJ2iFqdmTLpIC1%0AldNxuzFL56HKwmAyPw%3D%3D%0A)

You can use the following expressions in your calculator:

*   ( ) Parenthesis to indicate the internal calculation should occur first
    
*   \+ Addition
    
*   \- Subtraction
    
*   / Division
    
*   \* Multiplication
    

Once you are done, select Save and preview it on a test patient before using it.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/754806222/6f89c38eb4f65e29e18a899a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=461924444d71f47590200e539fd92ccdffb75dfd29e9b2baa92cb3530288caa2&req=cyUjHsl4n4NdFb4f3HP0gLo8KZ8nhrf0veux%2Fbp9CjLb9QwUU%2BS6efVR3M9%2B%0AZETF%2FeXfrODmaqrveQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/754806222/6f89c38eb4f65e29e18a899a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=461924444d71f47590200e539fd92ccdffb75dfd29e9b2baa92cb3530288caa2&req=cyUjHsl4n4NdFb4f3HP0gLo8KZ8nhrf0veux%2Fbp9CjLb9QwUU%2BS6efVR3M9%2B%0AZETF%2FeXfrODmaqrveQ%3D%3D%0A)

Example DASS 21 Template
========================

Attached to this article is a Clinical Note Template example for the standard DASS 21 test. Download the file at the bottom of the article. Click [here](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6271159-exporting-and-importing-clinical-notes-form-templates)
 to learn how to import the template.

## Document 300 — Clinical Note Administrators | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-300}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8060042-clinical-note-administrators](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8060042-clinical-note-administrators)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Clinical Notes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2413946-clinical-notes)

Clinical Note Administrators

Clinical Note Administrators
============================

Updated over 2 years ago

When configuring **[Roles](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4353460-creating-roles)** in PracSuite, there is a special role permission within Clinical Notes called **Full Clinical Administrator Permissions**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/776245313/6110be66b19d0f2e7281f1d9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ccf9c8ecf413f6ade8aa7688c26ea60ef31d7d5fa52af1ce229bdad26e599d6&req=cychFM17noBcFb4f3HP0gPm%2BFegMdEODi2yo0fVmvPur%2FMagX2QpvPB6xb%2Bc%0AeP6DIDrVeLZ2ZM8mAQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/776245313/6110be66b19d0f2e7281f1d9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2ccf9c8ecf413f6ade8aa7688c26ea60ef31d7d5fa52af1ce229bdad26e599d6&req=cychFM17noBcFb4f3HP0gPm%2BFegMdEODi2yo0fVmvPur%2FMagX2QpvPB6xb%2Bc%0AeP6DIDrVeLZ2ZM8mAQ%3D%3D%0A)

'Full Clinical Administrator Permissions' is a unique option that will grant users of this role **full access** to clinical notes. This includes all standard functionality such as viewing, creating, drafting, editing and copying (etc), but then goes a step further and allows the role to:

*   Access notes marked as '**Confidential**' by other users.
    
*   Change the '**Share Notes'** setting on behalf of other users, allowing the notes to be shared with other practitioners as needed (including people that are not 'Clinical Administrators' or 'System Administrators').  
    ​
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/776249975/2f0f7cd9335a629029f7d220/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee97a2917bd94eaf4acd326d4ec1771d1d6f37337aac684eac13326587cec241&req=cychFM13lIZaFb4f3HP0gI4LHy6kbG2IE%2FrbyqnriiC4Dub2e2zkzA%2BGhjzz%0AHOjVVs%2B7tQPG5PwWHQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/776249975/2f0f7cd9335a629029f7d220/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee97a2917bd94eaf4acd326d4ec1771d1d6f37337aac684eac13326587cec241&req=cychFM13lIZaFb4f3HP0gI4LHy6kbG2IE%2FrbyqnriiC4Dub2e2zkzA%2BGhjzz%0AHOjVVs%2B7tQPG5PwWHQ%3D%3D%0A)

Since these are functions typically reserved to **System Administrator** users, who have unrestricted access to the PracSuite system, the '**Full Clinical Administrator Permissions**' option can only be enabled or disabled by a System Administrator.

  
This allows roles to be configured with 'administrator-level' permissions for Clinical Notes specifically, without having to make those users a full System Administrator and granting unrestricted access to the entire PracSuite system.  
​

* * *

  
It is important to note that 'Clinical Administrators' can still be configured with user-level restrictions, which means they can only access notes authored by specific businesses, professions or practitioners.  
​  
For example, you can have a role with full 'Clinical Administrator' access, but then restrict the user settings so the individual can only see notes for specific businesses, professions or practitioners. The user will have the special 'clinical administrator' permissions, which includes access to confidential notes and sharing, but only for the practitioners they are allowed.  
​  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/776258284/f52c1391d14be974e74285b0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb2e7c432208b26cc532f8c59013aa88a8eab5f5c5d330b4db9d91f3849619ea&req=cychFMx2n4lbFb4f3HP0gNEea6a5RFHaefp1BQ%2FL5mmdLduQP%2BCXvCD8hpUX%0AlO7K1avJeuupTkvXqQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/776258284/f52c1391d14be974e74285b0/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bb2e7c432208b26cc532f8c59013aa88a8eab5f5c5d330b4db9d91f3849619ea&req=cychFMx2n4lbFb4f3HP0gNEea6a5RFHaefp1BQ%2FL5mmdLduQP%2BCXvCD8hpUX%0AlO7K1avJeuupTkvXqQ%3D%3D%0A)

The Clinical Administrator permission should be used with caution, understanding that it can be used to bypass the confidentiality and sharing of clinical notes as set by individual users.  
​

* * *
