Using Xero integration with Accrual Accounting

Using Xero integration with Accrual Accounting
==============================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Why does accrual accounting need a separate process?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8114438-using-xero-integration-with-accrual-accounting#h_d499781dc7)

[How to setup Xero integration for accrual businesses:](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8114438-using-xero-integration-with-accrual-accounting#h_cf050938b8)

[The Workflow:](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8114438-using-xero-integration-with-accrual-accounting#h_4f61ef095b)

When integrating with Xero, PracSuite will upload a payment total for each day per payment method. This process is designed for easy bank reconciliation.

As an integration focused on uploading payments received, this is best suited to businesses operating on a cash basis; however, there are ways to make this work for businesses using an accrual accounting method. This article details a workflow for using the PracSuite Xero integration for accrual accounting.

**Please note that Smartsoft cannot offer specific accounting advice; this information is only provided as a general guide. You may need to consult your accountant or bookkeeper to adjust this process to your needs.**

* * *

**Why does accrual accounting need a separate process?**
--------------------------------------------------------

Our integration uploads based on payments received and does not upload all revenue billed in a period. This process uses Xero **journal entries** to add the outstanding revenue amounts into Xero and includes a process to re-upload the GST amounts based on an accrual accounting system.

**How to setup Xero integration for accrual businesses:**
---------------------------------------------------------

Whether you operate on a cash or accrual system, the basic setup of your Xero organisation and integration within PracSuite stays the same. Please follow the article below for information on the general setup of PracSuite for Xero integration.

[Enabling the Xero Integration in PracSuite](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6828584-enabling-the-xero-integration)

An accountant or bookkeeper should guide your exact setup of Xero accounts.

* * *

**Important:** To complete this workflow, you need to be an '**Advisor**' level user in Xero, which can be configured by going to "My Xero" from the menu, then clicking into the 'Manage Users' section.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782251716/d845a739a8215847c9cdfa78/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e8c2a1f11138c6c62b2731a5b21ee89abe386415523be95ad0efa1c8ba550c0&req=cyglFMx%2FmoBZFb4f3HP0gIjp8MJvrvMOzWjJiLing%2BLvkxeQ3RS9Q7idANY4%0A%2BskYfBylprSkTbDezw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782251716/d845a739a8215847c9cdfa78/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e8c2a1f11138c6c62b2731a5b21ee89abe386415523be95ad0efa1c8ba550c0&req=cyglFMx%2FmoBZFb4f3HP0gIjp8MJvrvMOzWjJiLing%2BLvkxeQ3RS9Q7idANY4%0A%2BskYfBylprSkTbDezw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

The Workflow:
=============

Once you have set up your Xero organisation and integrated with PracSuite, below are the steps for managing your accrual business for each upload period. Due to the number of steps involved, we recommend that this process be done at the end of each month.

#### 1) Syncing Payments to Xero

The first step is to upload your received payments into PracSuite, following the same process as businesses running on a cash basis. Assuming you have configured your integration settings following the guide above, this is done using the **Sync Now** button within your PracSuite 'Xero Organisation'.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782245534/daa8b6d612721fd5a95f994f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=39d420f838af7fbc07ce9fae83f8a2cfbf4010648b44ab9f0974a8c10d7c78b1&req=cyglFM17mIJbFb4f3HP0gGsjgD3SFrxH0WrgkW0YPMfybGbNYIL4WhfsS%2FFp%0A5IQ3qqAM1j3PNHvtXw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782245534/daa8b6d612721fd5a95f994f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=39d420f838af7fbc07ce9fae83f8a2cfbf4010648b44ab9f0974a8c10d7c78b1&req=cyglFM17mIJbFb4f3HP0gGsjgD3SFrxH0WrgkW0YPMfybGbNYIL4WhfsS%2FFp%0A5IQ3qqAM1j3PNHvtXw%3D%3D%0A)

In this example, we are uploading for June 2023.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782245811/c559c085bce3448031aa43a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aff5f1c68f9f40efb52a45bcdd6bf68b42b8100ba564c6601a25c6829869ca82&req=cyglFM17lYBeFb4f3HP0gAYr4gdO3zuLAQAZgVv42L8UAf8yea9CHA9tm%2BPv%0AU7eF6GUTmhcd4BTmeQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782245811/c559c085bce3448031aa43a4/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=aff5f1c68f9f40efb52a45bcdd6bf68b42b8100ba564c6601a25c6829869ca82&req=cyglFM17lYBeFb4f3HP0gAYr4gdO3zuLAQAZgVv42L8UAf8yea9CHA9tm%2BPv%0AU7eF6GUTmhcd4BTmeQ%3D%3D%0A)

To simplify this example, our breakdown of payments for the month of June is as follows:  
​  
10 x $100 cash  
​**Total = $1000**  
​  
It should be noted that GST is added to Xero whenever a payment (in PracSuite) is allocated to a GST-applicable item. For this example, half of the total payments ($500) have been allocated to GST-applicable items.

#### 2) How to find the Accounts Receivable amount to be added

Our next goal is to determine the accounts receivable amount to be added to Xero for this month.

a) In PracSuite, run an **Account Balance** report from **[Reports > Billing > Account Balance](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/accounts)
**.

In this example, we have a total of **$2687.00** currently outstanding.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782318963/4644e64324035ea90ed8e35f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1182bf763cff05354e760a351b4b9595fa6dd27d1fa1297fc66e66f2e2d22706&req=cyglFch2lIdcFb4f3HP0gH%2FQ8q5xfQECrxEiW9mGYHWMh4ONYMYUdADfAjyG%0AeQF15%2BNPsCvU7jnBzA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782318963/4644e64324035ea90ed8e35f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1182bf763cff05354e760a351b4b9595fa6dd27d1fa1297fc66e66f2e2d22706&req=cyglFch2lIdcFb4f3HP0gH%2FQ8q5xfQECrxEiW9mGYHWMh4ONYMYUdADfAjyG%0AeQF15%2BNPsCvU7jnBzA%3D%3D%0A)

**Note:** The account balance report is based on amounts outstanding at the **current date and time** and cannot be generated retrospectively.

b) In Xero, go to the **Accounting** menu and view your **Balance Sheet**.

Note down your current **Accounts Receivable** balance in Xero, which must be deducted from the total owing in PracSuite.

e.g.

*   PracSuite reported a current owing amount of $2687.00
    
*   The balance sheet in Xero shows that $2000 of this has already been included.
    
*   You need to deduct the previous balance in Xero to get the remainder of $687.00, which represents the total owing balance being added for this month.
    

#### 3) Creating a Manual journal in Xero to include Accounts Receivable

We now need to create a Manual journal entry in Xero, adjusting the accounts receivable to match PracSuite. In our example, the account balance to be added is $687.00.  
​  
a) In Xero, go to the **Accounting** menu and select **Manual journals**.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782268662/ee6b16694aa068f418285c39/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=282b4f33361bf0264ed6d1f09f2e5d1362251c4c1fbf1aab987a82c79ce2946b&req=cyglFM92m4ddFb4f3HP0gObXKk3k%2FSJDKsp9oEMpr1izDRQBAmpLAfhAZK0F%0AEELcg5mdyXGRtYLJjg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782268662/ee6b16694aa068f418285c39/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=282b4f33361bf0264ed6d1f09f2e5d1362251c4c1fbf1aab987a82c79ce2946b&req=cyglFM92m4ddFb4f3HP0gObXKk3k%2FSJDKsp9oEMpr1izDRQBAmpLAfhAZK0F%0AEELcg5mdyXGRtYLJjg%3D%3D%0A)

b) Click **New Journal**, and create entries to adjust the **Accounts Receivable** on the balance sheet to match PracSuite.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782298069/6c9c9558c6650321c04a347f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=289e1319bab90c076f571eea2577e8b0a17ac6d6b8ece0f0312a7f41a0f6ffa2&req=cyglFMB2nYdWFb4f3HP0gAVrweW8yqcZb8SJJcp89dZHxjDgHiqeWR093HIk%0AR6RuESSCjcowVgVYuA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782298069/6c9c9558c6650321c04a347f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=289e1319bab90c076f571eea2577e8b0a17ac6d6b8ece0f0312a7f41a0f6ffa2&req=cyglFMB2nYdWFb4f3HP0gAVrweW8yqcZb8SJJcp89dZHxjDgHiqeWR093HIk%0AR6RuESSCjcowVgVYuA%3D%3D%0A)

Success! Your balance sheet is now including the accounts receivable from PracSuite.

#### 3) Adjusting Xero to remove GST

When syncing to Xero, transactions were created with GST included - but this was GST from a cash basis. To resolve this, we first need to remove the GST from the transactions we've already uploaded, which we will do using the '**[Find and Recode](https://central.xero.com/s/article/About-Find-Recode)
**' feature within Xero.

a) Login to your Xero account, and select **Find and recode** from the **Accounting** menu.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782252153/c4e0ff732de64ea4d3ba9eca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3b3afa25127ca3dd5ca2982cd7f4e408ca9eeb7c812684ace472cdb5fc55c332&req=cyglFMx8nIRcFb4f3HP0gCfQcNOJmciedvYALVt9YRbhaAqA31QUcE3TJjzy%0AqFH2%2Bl8dCSUPPLlSkA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782252153/c4e0ff732de64ea4d3ba9eca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3b3afa25127ca3dd5ca2982cd7f4e408ca9eeb7c812684ace472cdb5fc55c332&req=cyglFMx8nIRcFb4f3HP0gCfQcNOJmciedvYALVt9YRbhaAqA31QUcE3TJjzy%0AqFH2%2Bl8dCSUPPLlSkA%3D%3D%0A)

b) Click **Find and recode**, then **Add a condition** with the following conditions:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782252837/4c5be0b5b960a18dfa765b74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06f6d8cefdf15f6fd6f4300e8ed70fa603dc8b999434fb23d0c519a6eaea96a9&req=cyglFMx8lYJYFb4f3HP0gAV09Z%2BWlW1ElEiO9xsAHWUepRaFINP7kR3dTFEE%0Aze600dsLDD33iX1%2BDA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782252837/4c5be0b5b960a18dfa765b74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06f6d8cefdf15f6fd6f4300e8ed70fa603dc8b999434fb23d0c519a6eaea96a9&req=cyglFMx8lYJYFb4f3HP0gAV09Z%2BWlW1ElEiO9xsAHWUepRaFINP7kR3dTFEE%0Aze600dsLDD33iX1%2BDA%3D%3D%0A)

This will find all the transactions in this date range that have a GST component:  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782253524/7fa99743e4603a83504d5ad5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dc3db3f67ab7aecb1508f4d326fc113392ee320d35bcca437e8e158b5582bd6&req=cyglFMx9mINbFb4f3HP0gHDM%2BLxeK5nKq9TK46Uocf2Ci3WUa%2FFeqi8c2Nkk%0ARTSXRjzShBlvfuip%2BA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782253524/7fa99743e4603a83504d5ad5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3dc3db3f67ab7aecb1508f4d326fc113392ee320d35bcca437e8e158b5582bd6&req=cyglFMx9mINbFb4f3HP0gHDM%2BLxeK5nKq9TK46Uocf2Ci3WUa%2FFeqi8c2Nkk%0ARTSXRjzShBlvfuip%2BA%3D%3D%0A)

c) Select all transactions and click **Recode.**  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782253788/dec8d2965aa25f91967d4f1c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=38eb73ce8bef23d5b511f71ed36afd0fd6597a53450d408ac9fc9305675031d9&req=cyglFMx9molXFb4f3HP0gCQPjfxf0Ta3HAkVVV27BgRUoSnGEkVTcszRIaaT%0AsYdjTXwKllFPiJ50jw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782253788/dec8d2965aa25f91967d4f1c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=38eb73ce8bef23d5b511f71ed36afd0fd6597a53450d408ac9fc9305675031d9&req=cyglFMx9molXFb4f3HP0gCQPjfxf0Ta3HAkVVV27BgRUoSnGEkVTcszRIaaT%0AsYdjTXwKllFPiJ50jw%3D%3D%0A)

d) Change the **Tax Rate** to **GST Free Income**, then click **Review**.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782253992/0120977c092d8e5d0bcb100c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f034b54d81d352e783e4305675dd7ec36fc01440fa65f7855fccec1f685e2f1&req=cyglFMx9lIhdFb4f3HP0gLyiQTKYKv2aQMwLoTgCq%2BevFamaGLbwHZg%2FCc%2FS%0AXCOLfcssYYYeYRUmmw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782253992/0120977c092d8e5d0bcb100c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f034b54d81d352e783e4305675dd7ec36fc01440fa65f7855fccec1f685e2f1&req=cyglFMx9lIhdFb4f3HP0gLyiQTKYKv2aQMwLoTgCq%2BevFamaGLbwHZg%2FCc%2FS%0AXCOLfcssYYYeYRUmmw%3D%3D%0A)

d) Click **Confirm.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782254104/35a932fb96441f4972a2af8c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cc57087a65c1a414f1257871648673be274afc07a5dbffc5a0d2bab570556975&req=cyglFMx6nIFbFb4f3HP0gHGUqKx1wXGrfkECT2bYXpzhKAWNPWeiTFWU%2FjHf%0AFqlj1vn2Oj2t81UTZQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782254104/35a932fb96441f4972a2af8c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cc57087a65c1a414f1257871648673be274afc07a5dbffc5a0d2bab570556975&req=cyglFMx6nIFbFb4f3HP0gHGUqKx1wXGrfkECT2bYXpzhKAWNPWeiTFWU%2FjHf%0AFqlj1vn2Oj2t81UTZQ%3D%3D%0A)

Success! These transactions have now been made GST Free.

#### 5) Re-adding GST into Xero based on the Accrual system

The last step in this process is to re-add your GST into Xero, but this time based on the accrued GST value.  
​  
a) In PracSuite, go to **[Reports > Billing > GST Reconciliation](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/gst)
**.

b) Enter the correct **Date Range,** then select 'Accrual' as the **Accounting Method**.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782275765/bf4b1e9f54add1deaa0a8c7d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2dafe087a7cbf167a5e764188f163e46506aea8d0bb3f49d64716a2fc4fe6bfd&req=cyglFM57modaFb4f3HP0gMM8dGRZvZyhaSF%2BV0MhtYaLjorWEr%2BV%2Ft2%2F8y1u%0A3LpbnDHj4C5LU9eVOg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782275765/bf4b1e9f54add1deaa0a8c7d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2dafe087a7cbf167a5e764188f163e46506aea8d0bb3f49d64716a2fc4fe6bfd&req=cyglFM57modaFb4f3HP0gMM8dGRZvZyhaSF%2BV0MhtYaLjorWEr%2BV%2Ft2%2F8y1u%0A3LpbnDHj4C5LU9eVOg%3D%3D%0A)

c) Click **Generate Report**, and note the total in the **amount** column.  
​  
This represents the total amount of GST applicable items billed in the date range.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782302593/0c30c69d95c860b4412025d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=616c51f4e51998f6ec644d4d7c07cd7941d75c14f6bf6b090fa776e2b4476f50&req=cyglFcl8mIhcFb4f3HP0gB2bDoBJRuv44yAGDxIfo6ka0nDWQtvdnc6nCM%2B8%0AIwph6medaTb3DQ%2BdKQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782302593/0c30c69d95c860b4412025d2/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=616c51f4e51998f6ec644d4d7c07cd7941d75c14f6bf6b090fa776e2b4476f50&req=cyglFcl8mIhcFb4f3HP0gB2bDoBJRuv44yAGDxIfo6ka0nDWQtvdnc6nCM%2B8%0AIwph6medaTb3DQ%2BdKQ%3D%3D%0A)

d) In Xero, go to the **Accounting** menu and click **Manual journals**.  
​  
The total GST income can then be added as below:  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782302920/6d5fae2d6f64c5562c28bb52/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44926ba28fdea857d6466249fb0b77064f5de3988e947daafdbdf239dcd7bad1&req=cyglFcl8lINfFb4f3HP0gL7ifzbObFaQ%2BaWeUCzkzPqjweNRBO0TmLD0uw4H%0ADZMq9CLOWlF%2BZePwCw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/782302920/6d5fae2d6f64c5562c28bb52/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=44926ba28fdea857d6466249fb0b77064f5de3988e947daafdbdf239dcd7bad1&req=cyglFcl8lINfFb4f3HP0gL7ifzbObFaQ%2BaWeUCzkzPqjweNRBO0TmLD0uw4H%0ADZMq9CLOWlF%2BZePwCw%3D%3D%0A)

You have now re-added your GST balance to PracSuite under the accrual system. When viewing your Balance Sheet in Xero you should now have:  
​  
\- A **GST** total matching the **GST Reconciliation (Accrual)** report in PracSuite.  
​  
\- A **Total Equity** matching the total received plus the total owing.

**Success! You have completed the accrual workflow using the Xero integration in PracSuite.**  
​

Using a Matrix in Patient Forms

Using a Matrix in Patient Forms
===============================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Example DASS 21 Template](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8170237-using-a-matrix-in-patient-forms#h_ba4e4c9c80)

PracSuite [Forms](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3247047-forms)
 allow you to add a configurable Matrix component. This allows you to ask a series of related questions and calculate a score based on the answers.

Begin by adding the component to your [Form Template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789044-creating-form-templates)
 via the Add To Form button at the top.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792413874/14364f5002751c49e6ad773c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e0ca539c785459729a3355a8b96c68bb1a83708e2338f8b9ecfcea0d6a512ab1&req=cyklEsh9lYZbFb4f3HP0gIZPA7a2%2FB0GwG%2BtFq%2FT1dDq%2Fe2IjUzpkqQrafjh%0AT3MpU%2BvJ4EZz1H2ARg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792413874/14364f5002751c49e6ad773c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e0ca539c785459729a3355a8b96c68bb1a83708e2338f8b9ecfcea0d6a512ab1&req=cyklEsh9lYZbFb4f3HP0gIZPA7a2%2FB0GwG%2BtFq%2FT1dDq%2Fe2IjUzpkqQrafjh%0AT3MpU%2BvJ4EZz1H2ARg%3D%3D%0A)

When you add the component, some defaults appear to help you understand how it will display. Start by giving it a Label.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792414203/962ce0391d9d3cacb5133354/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7ee472e9ce0dbd14872e949e040baed6c9a1e3008ff1adb62ed8ab6ab76d5f28&req=cyklEsh6n4FcFb4f3HP0gB9dWBElauL%2BCGgoPm5EyCjOOhFwxW1X62fDDI90%0A%2FzS5XNOrmt5RDPSHoQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792414203/962ce0391d9d3cacb5133354/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7ee472e9ce0dbd14872e949e040baed6c9a1e3008ff1adb62ed8ab6ab76d5f28&req=cyklEsh6n4FcFb4f3HP0gB9dWBElauL%2BCGgoPm5EyCjOOhFwxW1X62fDDI90%0A%2FzS5XNOrmt5RDPSHoQ%3D%3D%0A)

The switch for Assigning number values for choices is on by default, this will allow calculations, switch it off if it is not required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753091987/74671fea1e2c8b427d3ea486/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72e602b68b9a8bd65af309368aad9614fddd07facc2ce721e0b8fc8f38a55644&req=cyUkFsB%2FlIlYFb4f3HP0gIJwszguR9eBWzYyZ2UxXRfpA0f%2FH5zsTFKoUcUR%0AQ8EcCz4ZoULY4fDI%2FA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753091987/74671fea1e2c8b427d3ea486/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72e602b68b9a8bd65af309368aad9614fddd07facc2ce721e0b8fc8f38a55644&req=cyUkFsB%2FlIlYFb4f3HP0gIJwszguR9eBWzYyZ2UxXRfpA0f%2FH5zsTFKoUcUR%0AQ8EcCz4ZoULY4fDI%2FA%3D%3D%0A)

PracSuite Matricies can handle multiple sections, which allows you to have an advanced calculation across different question and choice combinations. Use the add button above Section 1 to add an additional set of questions and choices.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/870986107/cd757343ad615128cc1ef412/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10a89818dede1e8f6a4ffc7212e9f8bf28098e72da8d131863d08529821fdaf7&req=fCcnH8F4nIFYFb4f3HP0gDmsmKAazTpqW%2B3VqGPVq7hnZ3QgpUyXDji97Wmd%0AmfdskmqG5JDJ69F5mg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/870986107/cd757343ad615128cc1ef412/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10a89818dede1e8f6a4ffc7212e9f8bf28098e72da8d131863d08529821fdaf7&req=fCcnH8F4nIFYFb4f3HP0gDmsmKAazTpqW%2B3VqGPVq7hnZ3QgpUyXDji97Wmd%0AmfdskmqG5JDJ69F5mg%3D%3D%0A)

In each section, you start with three Choices, edit these and use the Add button to create more, or use the trash can icon to remove them.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753092269/1e812c2ea0bf7a3a4a5c2cd8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49b9ab1b8490ad43ddbe297ed62b945fe112014bf43a380947502994cc85f442&req=cyUkFsB8n4dWFb4f3HP0gPR2tRiqEQAf78n3GFnDohS%2FD59%2FxoCve3UQG%2Fnp%0A6wiPuKWF%2FG9btWQ8Ew%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753092269/1e812c2ea0bf7a3a4a5c2cd8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=49b9ab1b8490ad43ddbe297ed62b945fe112014bf43a380947502994cc85f442&req=cyUkFsB8n4dWFb4f3HP0gPR2tRiqEQAf78n3GFnDohS%2FD59%2FxoCve3UQG%2Fnp%0A6wiPuKWF%2FG9btWQ8Ew%3D%3D%0A)

Next, configure the Questions, as with the choices, you begin with three. Edit the questions and use the Add button to create more, or use the trash can icon to remove them.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753092785/67eb0b6cef9a5c3c18cf35e7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=910e3fd12fdd590a2d96874587f6f67fc984d40fd938282aef9889b567bd3807&req=cyUkFsB8molaFb4f3HP0gPhgGxvyrPonpdWA3qPSN7h1wWTZyIOHQLr1HeUf%0A2LHK12Mr9DXJ9tMpGQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/753092785/67eb0b6cef9a5c3c18cf35e7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=910e3fd12fdd590a2d96874587f6f67fc984d40fd938282aef9889b567bd3807&req=cyUkFsB8molaFb4f3HP0gPhgGxvyrPonpdWA3qPSN7h1wWTZyIOHQLr1HeUf%0A2LHK12Mr9DXJ9tMpGQ%3D%3D%0A)

Finally, you can Include totals on results. Turn this off if it is not required. By default you have the grand total and column totals programmed for you. If you do not want to see these untick the checkboxes in the display column.

There is also an option to decide whether you want to Display it to the Patient or not.  
​  
You can add in your own calculations, select Add, give it a title and then write in a custom calculation referencing previous answers to your questions above using their reference letter (A,B,C in the above screenshot).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792434603/53a0273d7f7c1ea862165c66/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5be6c83655af01f743378181fcd4576db50aea64d93683098d87129783a0ec8&req=cyklEsp6m4FcFb4f3HP0gCyWEd4v%2FsyateH1r2x%2F4pV3U6VJLIUfxSJ7mziA%0AlC6YjJ1rk8yxDCGhAA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792434603/53a0273d7f7c1ea862165c66/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b5be6c83655af01f743378181fcd4576db50aea64d93683098d87129783a0ec8&req=cyklEsp6m4FcFb4f3HP0gCyWEd4v%2FsyateH1r2x%2F4pV3U6VJLIUfxSJ7mziA%0AlC6YjJ1rk8yxDCGhAA%3D%3D%0A)

You can use the following expressions in your calculator:

*   ( ) Parenthesis to indicate the internal calculation should occur first
    
*   \+ Addition
    
*   \- Subtraction
    
*   / Division
    
*   \* Multiplication
    

Below is how it appears when used on a form from the Patient's perspective:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792429271/dd917fe149d5d558a43e8f71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=140efa57723029ec89e524b94be98f59b2b2675a81454e21a21bcf03d7251dce&req=cyklEst3n4ZeFb4f3HP0gM3ZAuR7wvcp3we7UxHNjMjjAjkvAvKBsJIw7YFC%0A1EPHvZyPDf8%2FSAqxow%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/792429271/dd917fe149d5d558a43e8f71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=140efa57723029ec89e524b94be98f59b2b2675a81454e21a21bcf03d7251dce&req=cyklEst3n4ZeFb4f3HP0gM3ZAuR7wvcp3we7UxHNjMjjAjkvAvKBsJIw7YFC%0A1EPHvZyPDf8%2FSAqxow%3D%3D%0A)

Accounting Periods

Accounting Periods
==================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Creating Accounting Periods](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8180314-accounting-periods#h_4d0ca79a55)

[Managing Accounting Periods](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8180314-accounting-periods#h_053707c3f2)

[Locking Months](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8180314-accounting-periods#h_2c633ecea0)

[Locking Quarters & Years](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8180314-accounting-periods#h_e38928b190)

[Role Permissions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8180314-accounting-periods#h_c025a66efa)

[Full Access (Create, Edit, Delete and Allocate)](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8180314-accounting-periods#h_12a1ea6913)

[Allocate Only (Payments, Refunds and Write-Offs)](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8180314-accounting-periods#h_95763d50b8)

[Warnings](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8180314-accounting-periods#h_8a343b89ef)

[Understanding Lock Symbols](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8180314-accounting-periods#h_02fead901f)

The Accounting Periods feature is designed to control which users can make changes to financial data in historical date ranges. For example, if your accountant or bookkeeper has already reconciled the previous financial quarter, that period can be locked to prevent further changes unless a user has the required permission.

Before enabling this feature, we recommend discussing it with your accountant or bookkeeper to develop a workflow suited to your business and accounting processes.

Creating Accounting Periods
===========================

By default, only System Administrators will have access to manage Accounting Periods. Any non-System Administrators who need to manage Accounting Periods will require access to the Accounting Periods settings page on their Role, which can be edited in Settings > Users & Security > Roles.

Scroll down to the Settings section and enable the Accounting Periods page access.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995435658/ccce94c69eea8214bfed5643/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_51_12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3eebf68a561a47bc2f21788ac453bc01725f840951f4f11996d47987572a15f8&req=fSkiEsp7m4RXFb4f3HP0gBaDpYSXjWThyVFdlsuy4Sf8DrBx%2FgrWCSw5TymI%0AN27EkZew9jlGHVZZ7g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995435658/ccce94c69eea8214bfed5643/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_51_12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3eebf68a561a47bc2f21788ac453bc01725f840951f4f11996d47987572a15f8&req=fSkiEsp7m4RXFb4f3HP0gBaDpYSXjWThyVFdlsuy4Sf8DrBx%2FgrWCSw5TymI%0AN27EkZew9jlGHVZZ7g%3D%3D%0A)

With access enabled for Accounting Periods, go to [Settings > Billing > Accounting Periods.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/accountingperiods)

The first step is to create a financial year. Select **Add** and follow the instructions shown in the prompt.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995437104/72d848c43dae0ab047db0892/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_54_55.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c304a0144cef167e58ca6f8daa7b23af9415a6b48a6aff7705adbd40d84fee80&req=fSkiEsp5nIFbFb4f3HP0gHXZ3iLkemRCVTBemX7%2FI7nt%2BczuY5p%2BUge%2BQ4KI%0ACA6jYFjAyhi7XNqWTw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995437104/72d848c43dae0ab047db0892/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_54_55.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c304a0144cef167e58ca6f8daa7b23af9415a6b48a6aff7705adbd40d84fee80&req=fSkiEsp5nIFbFb4f3HP0gHXZ3iLkemRCVTBemX7%2FI7nt%2BczuY5p%2BUge%2BQ4KI%0ACA6jYFjAyhi7XNqWTw%3D%3D%0A)

As explained in the prompt, enter the year that the financial year will end.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995438305/0217baa2ebfd232b2479f4cd/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_57_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dd8cba20723238dedad61ed212bfca851f4cbd42547626b28d62ba6c5956ef23&req=fSkiEsp2noFaFb4f3HP0gMcMraBjzR4pmAx%2BBh1sElGU1IqZAbkDYshoHYIw%0AwmwgaZ2kRszmWpAlJQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995438305/0217baa2ebfd232b2479f4cd/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_57_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dd8cba20723238dedad61ed212bfca851f4cbd42547626b28d62ba6c5956ef23&req=fSkiEsp2noFaFb4f3HP0gMcMraBjzR4pmAx%2BBh1sElGU1IqZAbkDYshoHYIw%0AwmwgaZ2kRszmWpAlJQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Confirm** to create an Accounting Period for the financial year entered.

Repeat these steps for all past financial years as required.

After creating all the required financial years, select **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995458646/d25d842fbd5ccf7922738816/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_42_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c298e73bbfcf6eab803c141ffb6773e9da1e27a3f026398d0596b55d10d28b87&req=fSkiEsx2m4VZFb4f3HP0gBIc0uUiPJC5EhvtftsLnZyeIqzGERsdvnqyN7QM%0A7405DsdfC8Q5NgXjUg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995458646/d25d842fbd5ccf7922738816/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_42_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c298e73bbfcf6eab803c141ffb6773e9da1e27a3f026398d0596b55d10d28b87&req=fSkiEsx2m4VZFb4f3HP0gBIc0uUiPJC5EhvtftsLnZyeIqzGERsdvnqyN7QM%0A7405DsdfC8Q5NgXjUg%3D%3D%0A)

The financial years you've created will be reflected in the list of Accounting Periods.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995438549/919633366ec6d6554a761af8/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_58_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9695c3e30ad63f72994fa15df87f6f180572e2dc7e05e651b840031fe3ba0881&req=fSkiEsp2mIVWFb4f3HP0gAvx3CBGY8IGBgoRLa9l1hvNkAwIW5fq7J9PjgfD%0AlDJSPKffSugjzpUTCA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995438549/919633366ec6d6554a761af8/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_58_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9695c3e30ad63f72994fa15df87f6f180572e2dc7e05e651b840031fe3ba0881&req=fSkiEsp2mIVWFb4f3HP0gAvx3CBGY8IGBgoRLa9l1hvNkAwIW5fq7J9PjgfD%0AlDJSPKffSugjzpUTCA%3D%3D%0A)

**Note: PracSuite will consider any financial years that do not appear in the list of Accounting Periods as Open. Invoicing actions within open periods will not be restricted.**

* * *

Managing Accounting Periods
===========================

Accounting Periods are managed in [Settings > Billing > Accounting Periods.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/accountingperiods)

Each **Financial Year** is divided into Financial **Quarters** and **Months**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995447416/e9b3221f54b177fec665e2c2/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_15_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=698fbf8d8586367b12edf6af61d7576eca3f375f2f05eb3850bcfe997c6b056e&req=fSkiEs15mYBZFb4f3HP0gDcz0Kh%2BYywkbWXfyIkVxk537Py0ZABNKDQGg%2F8%2F%0AyYq6i%2BMsxof3kH6Jxw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995447416/e9b3221f54b177fec665e2c2/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_15_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=698fbf8d8586367b12edf6af61d7576eca3f375f2f05eb3850bcfe997c6b056e&req=fSkiEs15mYBZFb4f3HP0gDcz0Kh%2BYywkbWXfyIkVxk537Py0ZABNKDQGg%2F8%2F%0AyYq6i%2BMsxof3kH6Jxw%3D%3D%0A)

Accounting Periods can have the following statuses:

*   **Open** - This period is open for all Businesses and there are no user restrictions on working within this period.
    
*   **Partially Locked -** This period is locked for some businesses or only some quarters/months. Restrictions will be enforced for any locked periods.
    
*   **Locked** - This period is completely locked and user restrictions are enforced for the entire period.
    

When editing this page, each financial period will have a 'Manage' button available to manage that period. To manage a Month, Quarter or Year, hover over the associated row and select the Manage button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995461122/9c15952494ab7d99225500f5/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_48_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ca99cd82f10d787b550cd6808e0866d3d09028143d79d426a6896e06fddd3c8&req=fSkiEs9%2FnINdFb4f3HP0gEYIBNCx%2FtjYy0j4iszl8kxUsMF8b0C0%2F8WLIEYu%0AS%2FRKGYtTcyr6Dj%2FsSg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995461122/9c15952494ab7d99225500f5/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_48_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ca99cd82f10d787b550cd6808e0866d3d09028143d79d426a6896e06fddd3c8&req=fSkiEs9%2FnINdFb4f3HP0gEYIBNCx%2FtjYy0j4iszl8kxUsMF8b0C0%2F8WLIEYu%0AS%2FRKGYtTcyr6Dj%2FsSg%3D%3D%0A)

Locking Months
--------------

Hover over the row for the month and select Manage Month on the right-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995446916/18c8d0c2a7e9b8ae9393ea71/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_13_44.png?expires=1771821900&signature=56b99b6898da1d06eabc16042ae4d167e0e5482040b5a238e0d74ad4d520353c&req=fSkiEs14lIBZFb4f3HP0gAadHVR016VRqPwG9dy8MvaIYOVxqnla8PpuzOU%2F%0ANMgGHHeVXNJXd5VJgg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995446916/18c8d0c2a7e9b8ae9393ea71/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_13_44.png?expires=1771821900&signature=56b99b6898da1d06eabc16042ae4d167e0e5482040b5a238e0d74ad4d520353c&req=fSkiEs14lIBZFb4f3HP0gAadHVR016VRqPwG9dy8MvaIYOVxqnla8PpuzOU%2F%0ANMgGHHeVXNJXd5VJgg%3D%3D%0A)

The status of the period for all businesses will be displayed along with the option to lock the period for each individual business.

When locking an individual month, you can lock the entire month, or lock up to a particular date within the month. Set the **Lock Up To** date according to your preference.

Partially locking the month can be useful if you wish to lock periods after completing weekly or fortnightly bank reconciliation processes.

Use the **Apply Lock On** date to choose the date the lock will apply. You can set this to 'today' to lock the period immediately or schedule the lock to occur at a later date e.g. the last date in the period.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995458306/1744cf5db1b7fba0287b3c92/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_41_25.png?expires=1771821900&signature=82c05cfe08d24d26407a845919070af24590dab06ec9f0e85b255188c72de041&req=fSkiEsx2noFZFb4f3HP0gBq0rq%2FmhIfLsGUWa5doVibRd566SYMkc4Fy9bBo%0AHQL7VGa97hXRD3FIXA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995458306/1744cf5db1b7fba0287b3c92/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_41_25.png?expires=1771821900&signature=82c05cfe08d24d26407a845919070af24590dab06ec9f0e85b255188c72de041&req=fSkiEsx2noFZFb4f3HP0gBq0rq%2FmhIfLsGUWa5doVibRd566SYMkc4Fy9bBo%0AHQL7VGa97hXRD3FIXA%3D%3D%0A)

Locking Quarters & Years
------------------------

Hover over the row for the Quarter or Year and select the corresponding Manage button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995446797/e946f4474fadee72e8f97f4f/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_13_21.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6f91d85802d2225ba36c8b41762666e7583eec9798a3067cfad699c26d6d87f0&req=fSkiEs14mohYFb4f3HP0gNQY6r9Q7H3KhWxB6LsENZ4HHZ8bTZr5rkQgAsrl%0AtyVd%2BFxRF3G7NyOK8A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995446797/e946f4474fadee72e8f97f4f/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_13_21.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6f91d85802d2225ba36c8b41762666e7583eec9798a3067cfad699c26d6d87f0&req=fSkiEs14mohYFb4f3HP0gNQY6r9Q7H3KhWxB6LsENZ4HHZ8bTZr5rkQgAsrl%0AtyVd%2BFxRF3G7NyOK8A%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995447074/290fac8a6ce573f80769cfa8/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_13_57.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d46ec3a32e7824b5cc03755964ddaaf92550855b045614635a45f4280b60d13&req=fSkiEs15nYZbFb4f3HP0gPX9MLfnOeA1%2Fb%2B4cjUjqal7emO4bwViLE1uOj26%0A4VYMfE6Q8jWX3Cjuag%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995447074/290fac8a6ce573f80769cfa8/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_13_57.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d46ec3a32e7824b5cc03755964ddaaf92550855b045614635a45f4280b60d13&req=fSkiEs15nYZbFb4f3HP0gPX9MLfnOeA1%2Fb%2B4cjUjqal7emO4bwViLE1uOj26%0A4VYMfE6Q8jWX3Cjuag%3D%3D%0A)

When managing Quarters and Years, you only have the option to lock the entire period as of a particular date.

Use the **Lock Entire Period On** date to choose the date the lock will apply. You can set this to 'today' to enforce the change immediately, or schedule the lock to occur at a later date e.g. the last date in the period.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995448372/5a7fe0ffff40d43b5aa6058f/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_17_00.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8cbb70eabff17517986d121c685b890c81f38b9a19a667952eac80d29dce47f&req=fSkiEs12noZdFb4f3HP0gJw2NeN8ke6%2BpYInubzpcmte%2BTmlBC5EyO%2BRpd8n%0APa%2Bfae2obJydiExWOA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995448372/5a7fe0ffff40d43b5aa6058f/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_17_00.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b8cbb70eabff17517986d121c685b890c81f38b9a19a667952eac80d29dce47f&req=fSkiEs12noZdFb4f3HP0gJw2NeN8ke6%2BpYInubzpcmte%2BTmlBC5EyO%2BRpd8n%0APa%2Bfae2obJydiExWOA%3D%3D%0A)

After editing the Accounting Periods, select **Confirm** and then **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995459169/c450c7250ec77571c0ee95a8/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_42_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2531b7447590b7d552a1d26eadcaa75b23fc2565095ecc67cafdddd3e586132b&req=fSkiEsx3nIdWFb4f3HP0gBBvPIRH%2FC51QQyBf2dBapbUJ6pQ3DUjbZumB2zi%0A1CvQCn5TiJ2hpU4dpw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995459169/c450c7250ec77571c0ee95a8/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_42_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2531b7447590b7d552a1d26eadcaa75b23fc2565095ecc67cafdddd3e586132b&req=fSkiEsx3nIdWFb4f3HP0gBBvPIRH%2FC51QQyBf2dBapbUJ6pQ3DUjbZumB2zi%0A1CvQCn5TiJ2hpU4dpw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

  
Role Permissions
===================

As this feature will restrict users from performing common functions, such as creating and editing invoices, there are specific **Role Permissions** to allow working within Locked Accounting periods.

To adjust these **Role Permissions** go to **[Settings > Users & Security > Roles](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/users/roles)** and select the role you'd like to change.

Within the **Invoices** area, you will find a section titled 'Within Locked Accounting Periods' with the following permissions:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995479145/71d1142fa9de31a9eed020ea/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+12_31_16.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d019dafdf7bbaf5938b0b4046e52ddbdd2aaab90565dc4ccc92be938a144cd0c&req=fSkiEs53nIVaFb4f3HP0gCpAKYymWaGuif0BQaTFE5zPqxhqhi%2Fjz6klyzT1%0AuiUCcccuKpwo3f5RhA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995479145/71d1142fa9de31a9eed020ea/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+12_31_16.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d019dafdf7bbaf5938b0b4046e52ddbdd2aaab90565dc4ccc92be938a144cd0c&req=fSkiEs53nIVaFb4f3HP0gCpAKYymWaGuif0BQaTFE5zPqxhqhi%2Fjz6klyzT1%0AuiUCcccuKpwo3f5RhA%3D%3D%0A)

With both permissions disabled, users will not be able to complete any actions against invoices in locked Accounting Periods.​

**Full Access (Create, Edit, Delete and Allocate)**
---------------------------------------------------

Users with '**Full Access**' can create, edit, delete and allocate in ways that can affect previously reconciled values.

**For example, a user with this permission could:**

*   Create a new item or payment dated within a locked accounting period, affecting the total billed or received for that period.
    
*   Edit the date of an item, invoice or payment, affecting which accounting period those values appear in (i.e. moving items or payments into or out of a locked period).
    
*   Delete an item, payment or invoice within a locked accounting period, affecting the total billed or received in that period.
    
*   Allocate payments, refunds and write-offs to items or invoices within a locked accounting period.
    

**Note:** These settings do not override the standard invoicing permissions applied to the role. For example, if the role does not have permission to "**Delete Invoices and Items**", the user will still not be allowed to delete items or invoices within closed periods.

This permission should only be reserved for managers, bookkeepers and accountants who are trusted to maintain your records and understand how your accounts may be synchronised across other systems.

**Allocate Only (Payments, Refunds and Write-Offs)**
----------------------------------------------------

Users with the '**Allocate Only**' permission can only allocate payments, refunds and write-offs to items or invoices dated within a locked account period. They cannot create new or edit existing invoices, items, payments, refunds or write-offs that are dated within a locked period. This permission will only allow changes to the allocation of payments, refunds and write-offs where they apply to the locked period.

**For example, a user with this permission could:**

*   Create a new payment dated in an unlocked accounting period and allocate it to an item or invoice dated within a locked accounting period.
    
*   Apply existing credits to new invoices and invoices in locked accounting periods.
    
*   Remove or edit allocations that are applied to items or invoices within a locked accounting period.
    

If you expect your staff to be able to pay off invoices in locked periods, this permission must be enabled.

* * *

Users with access to 'Allocate Only' will see the following warning when editing invoices:

Understanding Lock Symbols
==========================

When viewing **Invoices** on a patient file, a lock symbol will be displayed next the invoice number to indicate whether they are in a locked accounting period.

**Open (No Symbol)**  
The invoice has not been issued and is considered open for additions (i.e. open invoicing).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995417122/6a4f7975263cfca82f0d4e35/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_10_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=da47e59df5c20d9beda9f2927e1181a6d4b8d6ab95ffa55c56a1c50f70f23ee8&req=fSkiEsh5nINdFb4f3HP0gLr53fxwhlym%2Bz4bWP1sRkJ%2BzD8rS2gNeZotabUz%0AIE5jnFXVZzewXM8glg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995417122/6a4f7975263cfca82f0d4e35/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_10_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=da47e59df5c20d9beda9f2927e1181a6d4b8d6ab95ffa55c56a1c50f70f23ee8&req=fSkiEsh5nINdFb4f3HP0gLr53fxwhlym%2Bz4bWP1sRkJ%2BzD8rS2gNeZotabUz%0AIE5jnFXVZzewXM8glg%3D%3D%0A)

  
​

**Closed (Grey Lock)**

The invoice has been issued or paid, and won't be used for open invoicing. The invoice can still be edited if needed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995417194/68419986e5f7ce4ffaac030b/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_10_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a72e351c382211877497fe5790d72e6887c5ffa2857edd5a8fbc7ef05d2984b&req=fSkiEsh5nIhbFb4f3HP0gMCK3VfLkj7%2FF%2BaVvrlcmsRrtvS%2BhrGOAVpy02LB%0AHywNiHD%2FqB4rzIdeIg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995417194/68419986e5f7ce4ffaac030b/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+10_10_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a72e351c382211877497fe5790d72e6887c5ffa2857edd5a8fbc7ef05d2984b&req=fSkiEsh5nIhbFb4f3HP0gMCK3VfLkj7%2FF%2BaVvrlcmsRrtvS%2BhrGOAVpy02LB%0AHywNiHD%2FqB4rzIdeIg%3D%3D%0A)

  
​

**Locked (Red Lock)**  
This invoice is locked by Accounting Periods, and only users with the appropriate Role Permissions can make further changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995445988/b2e3cadee10bfb0c3f46e553/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_11_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=94c6854aca209478073724a4331ba375ccbba01c96e7f1921a4d2d2702a0e1ac&req=fSkiEs17lIlXFb4f3HP0gHkeXTiE60HMiJc5zCxRjjqLxAmPHXSrmzAKzjrS%0AKnJdqj9tE77zFsZWDw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/995445988/b2e3cadee10bfb0c3f46e553/CleanShot+2024-03-19+at+11_11_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=94c6854aca209478073724a4331ba375ccbba01c96e7f1921a4d2d2702a0e1ac&req=fSkiEs17lIlXFb4f3HP0gHkeXTiE60HMiJc5zCxRjjqLxAmPHXSrmzAKzjrS%0AKnJdqj9tE77zFsZWDw%3D%3D%0A)

Default Treatment Plans

Default Treatment Plans
=======================

Updated over 5 months ago

Table of contents

[Creating Default Treatment Plans](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8184782-default-treatment-plans#h_e3bac99414)

[Plan Name](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8184782-default-treatment-plans#h_0cebd82d02)

[Plan Dates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8184782-default-treatment-plans#h_556e2696f0)

[Funding Periods (optional)](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8184782-default-treatment-plans#h_a1e22d9a39)

[Inserting Default Treatment Plans into Patient Accounts](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8184782-default-treatment-plans#h_c6eccf2ac1)

Default Treatment Plans are designed to make the process of creating [Treatment Plans](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4841280-managing-treatment-plans)
 for common scenarios (e.g. Medicare referrals, NDIS budgets) on a patient's account easier. Once configured, Default Treatment Plans can be quickly inserted into a patient's account with minimal setup required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750072712/4aafa874e2a85daf6fd1f1ee86fc/CleanShot-2B2025-09-25-2Bat-2B11_32_10.png?expires=1771821900&signature=657084716add5048079ae98ce0e9e3d5ddfb3d8d603cfd6d070a37035c6ad4bd&req=dSciFsl5n4ZeW%2FMW1HO4zVTbjE4xxmvb8PkHnoE4w64aaMQofUi0C90VS2x3%0AyywMlLTBuCYtrPO%2F%2B%2BY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750072712/4aafa874e2a85daf6fd1f1ee86fc/CleanShot-2B2025-09-25-2Bat-2B11_32_10.png?expires=1771821900&signature=657084716add5048079ae98ce0e9e3d5ddfb3d8d603cfd6d070a37035c6ad4bd&req=dSciFsl5n4ZeW%2FMW1HO4zVTbjE4xxmvb8PkHnoE4w64aaMQofUi0C90VS2x3%0AyywMlLTBuCYtrPO%2F%2B%2BY%3D%0A)

* * *

Creating Default Treatment Plans
================================

To add a new Default Treatment Plan, go to **[Settings > General > Treatment Plans](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/treatmentplans)
**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796424680/01275efd77243bb4cd789479/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f42bc06313839c887aa27d935fe3e4f547fca7d49cd894f538c6a9e1d6675c4c&req=cykhEst6m4lfFb4f3HP0gNfRQe7SQG76GO19hFDFS%2F%2BIWquPsvVL8Xvd4bEX%0ASwbCte6jp3ZEQ79gng%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796424680/01275efd77243bb4cd789479/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f42bc06313839c887aa27d935fe3e4f547fca7d49cd894f538c6a9e1d6675c4c&req=cykhEst6m4lfFb4f3HP0gNfRQe7SQG76GO19hFDFS%2F%2BIWquPsvVL8Xvd4bEX%0ASwbCte6jp3ZEQ79gng%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Edit** to make changes to this page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796425539/f422a16a3718eea12ecdd34b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab7acc5c583e9f92251708ae51aa2f408070ca9342947c1fa3a4752e0e514fe0&req=cykhEst7mIJWFb4f3HP0gOSLTXbD6IipKMKA4uFs3jAZ1SUmeTWqe6PPa4wd%0Au6XxYnNPF8Y5xSt7aw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796425539/f422a16a3718eea12ecdd34b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab7acc5c583e9f92251708ae51aa2f408070ca9342947c1fa3a4752e0e514fe0&req=cykhEst7mIJWFb4f3HP0gOSLTXbD6IipKMKA4uFs3jAZ1SUmeTWqe6PPa4wd%0Au6XxYnNPF8Y5xSt7aw%3D%3D%0A)

In the **Default Treatment Plans** section, click the **Add** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750107486/e3cac32688d01e1ba3e0e6f5712d/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+13_20_18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5d9d5db21f586a78a893b1830cb3bf1e2c37ed26286e3bbac17835ffd134b8ab&req=dSciFsh%2BmoVXX%2FMW1HO4zZiOWkYDkmJMNYyx2QU9An7GWbGDAKfZhMaTgodl%0AQUpc5MwXvyIWyIQbP8o%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750107486/e3cac32688d01e1ba3e0e6f5712d/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+13_20_18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5d9d5db21f586a78a893b1830cb3bf1e2c37ed26286e3bbac17835ffd134b8ab&req=dSciFsh%2BmoVXX%2FMW1HO4zZiOWkYDkmJMNYyx2QU9An7GWbGDAKfZhMaTgodl%0AQUpc5MwXvyIWyIQbP8o%3D%0A)

You will then need to configure the defaults that will be applied to the plan when inserted into a patient's account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750109336/cb4ed584e090b25524f846b95fc2/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+13_22_59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af6c5cd4897c7ddf38b62692214f081907999f14faec8c50e521b08e31004ac3&req=dSciFsh%2BlIJcX%2FMW1HO4zQk%2BqzK57P2iosXvNva%2FXBFsYzfOZMCNnBfRtCnl%0AgvY%2FYKIhtlU6SB3bHm4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1750109336/cb4ed584e090b25524f846b95fc2/CleanShot+2025-09-29+at+13_22_59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af6c5cd4897c7ddf38b62692214f081907999f14faec8c50e521b08e31004ac3&req=dSciFsh%2BlIJcX%2FMW1HO4zQk%2BqzK57P2iosXvNva%2FXBFsYzfOZMCNnBfRtCnl%0AgvY%2FYKIhtlU6SB3bHm4%3D%0A)

**Plan Name**
-------------

Enter a descriptive **Plan Name** to identify the Default Treatment Plan. This name will be used when the Treatment Plan is added to a patient file.

**Plan Dates**
--------------

*   **Start Date** – When inserting a default treatment plan, the start date will always always default to the current date.
    
*   **End Date** _(optional)_ – To include an End Date, enable the checkbox and select a default duration relative to the start date.
    
    For example, if set to _12 months_, then upon applying this Default Treatment Plan, the patient’s plan will automatically be created with an end date 12 months from the current date.
    
*   **Use Account Dates** – Enable this if you want the plan to automatically match the Start and End Dates of the patient’s Account.
    

**Plan Type**
-------------

Select how the Treatment Plan should track usage. The following options are available:

*   **Number of Items** – Tracks the number of individual items billed.
    
*   **Number of Items (by Distinct Days)** – Tracks one increment per day, regardless of how many items are billed that day.
    
*   **Item Quantity** – Tracks item usage based on the item quantity, including decimal values.
    
*   **Item Dollar Value** – Tracks usage based on the total dollar value of billed items.
    

**Plan Limit and Alerts**
-------------------------

*   **Plan Limit** – Enter the total number, quantity, or dollar value that represents the plan’s maximum allocation.
    
*   **Alert** – Enter the value at which alerts should begin appearing to users (for example, when 4 of 5 visits have been used).
    
*   **Prevent invoicing if plan limit has been reached** – Optionally enable this to block further invoicing once the plan’s limit has been used.
    

**Tracked Item Codes (optional)**
---------------------------------

If required, you can specify which items should contribute to this plan’s usage:

*   Choose a specific **Item**, **[Schedule](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/schedules)
    **, or **[Item Group](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/itemgroups)
    **.
    
*   If left as _Any Item_, all billed items will count toward the plan.
    

**Treatment Plan State (optional)**
-----------------------------------

Select an optional, customisable **[Treatment State](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/treatmentstates)
** to apply by default, e.g. “Active”, “Complete”, “In Progress”. This can assist with reporting and filtering.

**Funding Periods (optional)**
------------------------------

If your clinic uses **[Funding Periods](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods)
**, you can enable this option on the Default Treatment Plan.

Funding Periods allow a Treatment Plan to be divided into multiple sub-periods, each with its own allocation. For example, a 12-month plan may be split into 4 quarterly periods, tracking usage and rollover between them.

When enabled:

*   Each new patient Treatment Plan created from this default will include the Funding Periods toggle pre-enabled.
    
*   You can then define the number of periods, their start and end dates, and individual limits.
    
*   The Funding Period feature integrates with all Plan Types.
    

For more details on how Funding Periods work, see: [NDIS Funding Periods](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/12345286-ndis-funding-periods)
  
​

* * *

Inserting Default Treatment Plans into Patient Accounts
=======================================================

To use a Default Treatment Plan on an ad-hoc basis, navigate to the **Accounts** tab of a patient file. When editing the page, use the drop-down on the **Add** button to select your intended Treatment Plan.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796437253/90bbdd30c5273933b24fd72d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f26598ba2f35890d68fde4a6fe7641228590fc8112b3a33e606e1b5c91cf6c6a&req=cykhEsp5n4RcFb4f3HP0gMe%2FsEsiBl3bxFvVVqmBKhjXkIAJBsfl3Pw194sV%0ATSojBJV2spCMympQPw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796437253/90bbdd30c5273933b24fd72d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f26598ba2f35890d68fde4a6fe7641228590fc8112b3a33e606e1b5c91cf6c6a&req=cykhEsp5n4RcFb4f3HP0gMe%2FsEsiBl3bxFvVVqmBKhjXkIAJBsfl3Pw194sV%0ATSojBJV2spCMympQPw%3D%3D%0A)

Alternatively, you can add **Default Treatment Plans** to your **Default Accounts**. To do this, go to **[Settings > General > Patient Defaults](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/clientdefaults)
.**

After opening a **Default Account** and clicking **Edit**, click the Add button and select which Treatment Plans you want included on this account by default. This will apply whenever this Account is added to a patient file, including when Accounts are created automatically for new patients.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796438087/678f103ea3a119099909b30d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e19c68a5da795a8a54acba1d1ee1f0040c65f8022abc9d1733bd9871394119f&req=cykhEsp2nYlYFb4f3HP0gDoAxxYm2OU2Wl%2B95R9eXfVG2McmjiO109ijL0YA%0A70jyuufP1eRmwN8KmA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/796438087/678f103ea3a119099909b30d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3e19c68a5da795a8a54acba1d1ee1f0040c65f8022abc9d1733bd9871394119f&req=cykhEsp2nYlYFb4f3HP0gDoAxxYm2OU2Wl%2B95R9eXfVG2McmjiO109ijL0YA%0A70jyuufP1eRmwN8KmA%3D%3D%0A)

**For more information on Accounts, please refer to the following articles:**

*   [Adding an Account to a Patient File](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5987114-adding-an-account-to-a-patient-file)
    .
    

*   [Adding Default Accounts](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5987374-adding-default-accounts)
    .

Pinned Contacts
===============

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

Overview
========

Pinning [Contacts](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613552-patient-contacts-and-relationships)
 will display their details alongside family members on the main page of patient files. For example, you can pin emergency contact information and have it visible on the front page of patient files.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/798346196/84abd41fa6dfe2f130742c95/CleanShot+2023-08-02+at+14.19.08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dac198050f37c93113aa916bfc71135973827d3ee012af7e71552b4431083e35&req=cykvFc14nIhZFb4f3HP0gKJBr9RKWMwgZzlcPrZPV2TT0wUw6QpXcQlPguo8%0AH0gtbuVj7jkWCyCZBA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/798346196/84abd41fa6dfe2f130742c95/CleanShot+2023-08-02+at+14.19.08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dac198050f37c93113aa916bfc71135973827d3ee012af7e71552b4431083e35&req=cykvFc14nIhZFb4f3HP0gKJBr9RKWMwgZzlcPrZPV2TT0wUw6QpXcQlPguo8%0AH0gtbuVj7jkWCyCZBA%3D%3D%0A)

Pinning All Contacts with a Specific Relationship
=================================================

You can choose which Contact Relationships to pin across all patient files in [Settings > Contact Relationships](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general/contactrelationships)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/798343460/184a9b25630f417deeb247ff/CleanShot+2023-08-02+at+14.10.08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=035bb2705670499f71e92a13bedbb32eec16053dd0236d927d7318f27b37f1d5&req=cykvFc19mYdfFb4f3HP0gNLAs%2FYWQEt5wz3wmFN8VC1GdNl62PwGzNMBuF0g%0AGwaVKX9mdLgMhyMhMg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/798343460/184a9b25630f417deeb247ff/CleanShot+2023-08-02+at+14.10.08.png?expires=1771821900&signature=035bb2705670499f71e92a13bedbb32eec16053dd0236d927d7318f27b37f1d5&req=cykvFc19mYdfFb4f3HP0gNLAs%2FYWQEt5wz3wmFN8VC1GdNl62PwGzNMBuF0g%0AGwaVKX9mdLgMhyMhMg%3D%3D%0A)

If you modify pinned contact preferences, you will be asked whether you wish to pin existing contacts with that relationship across all patient files.

Pinning Individual Contacts on a Patient File
=============================================

To pin contacts individually, go to the Contacts tab of the patient file and select **Edit**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/799235892/f2a0596835d16cac74046fc0/CleanShot+2023-08-03+at+13.26.34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f3bd9580d8a993a7f861f3fd0aa9da7c359beeaa059e17b4d5cf3e59a9b2554&req=cykuFMp7lYhdFb4f3HP0gHBJBaTaTdl%2Ffbdok9WPl8WA1ILWOrB91opCayUM%0AbgBe25QNLrwHQIyi8g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/799235892/f2a0596835d16cac74046fc0/CleanShot+2023-08-03+at+13.26.34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f3bd9580d8a993a7f861f3fd0aa9da7c359beeaa059e17b4d5cf3e59a9b2554&req=cykuFMp7lYhdFb4f3HP0gHBJBaTaTdl%2Ffbdok9WPl8WA1ILWOrB91opCayUM%0AbgBe25QNLrwHQIyi8g%3D%3D%0A)

Choose which contacts to pin using the checkbox on the right-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/799236255/8f818f8e6cb6043f37e0bd68/CleanShot+2023-08-03+at+13.27.59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ebcaa7a2af9805b3c82e0e544e243800d439de8ca4e199709429f093862b5ef1&req=cykuFMp4n4RaFb4f3HP0gNJqstb5yUyJX6W0uNw19mky7QSi%2FuqYY7thvCkW%0A7XMilQwPaeJbka8aUQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/799236255/8f818f8e6cb6043f37e0bd68/CleanShot+2023-08-03+at+13.27.59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ebcaa7a2af9805b3c82e0e544e243800d439de8ca4e199709429f093862b5ef1&req=cykuFMp4n4RaFb4f3HP0gNJqstb5yUyJX6W0uNw19mky7QSi%2FuqYY7thvCkW%0A7XMilQwPaeJbka8aUQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Using an SMS Sender ID in PracSuite

Using an SMS Sender ID in PracSuite
===================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[1\. Custom Mobile Number](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8222998-using-an-sms-sender-id-in-pracsuite#h_8a888c1072)

[Enabling Custom Mobile Number Sender ID](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8222998-using-an-sms-sender-id-in-pracsuite#h_08c7406575)

[2\. Alphanumeric](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8222998-using-an-sms-sender-id-in-pracsuite#h_c004fa686b)

[Enabling Alphanumeric Sender ID](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8222998-using-an-sms-sender-id-in-pracsuite#h_f7ff24f293)

By default, PracSuite sends SMS using a rotating pool of mobile numbers. [It's also possible to secure a dedicated sender number](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6870223-dedicated-fixed-sms-sender-number)
 so SMS from your PracSuite account are always sent with the same number. Using these options, SMS replies from patients will always be returned to PracSuite.

For advanced users, you also have the option to send SMS using a Sender ID.

Two types of Sender IDs can be configured in PracSuite:

1\. Custom Mobile Number
========================

SMS from PracSuite will be sent from the desired mobile number.

⚠️ **When using this type of Sender ID, replies from patients will only be delivered to this number and will not be returned to PracSuite** ⚠️

Enabling Custom Mobile Number Sender ID
---------------------------------------

To enable this feature, go to [Settings > PracSuite Accounts > SMS](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/sms)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/807605798/0868e4622008e246d45feb95/CleanShot+2023-08-15+at+10.37.55.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d75bf7a6f8de7bf757dde4ba6092b84df094b542b58f5ec3057dfe2669a796da&req=fCAgEMl7mohXFb4f3HP0gPpfOSCX8KFDwh8UPM9dbGOVGJhPjkuij1ohSwrA%0AohwyyOPqm2ZaCA4qqw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/807605798/0868e4622008e246d45feb95/CleanShot+2023-08-15+at+10.37.55.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d75bf7a6f8de7bf757dde4ba6092b84df094b542b58f5ec3057dfe2669a796da&req=fCAgEMl7mohXFb4f3HP0gPpfOSCX8KFDwh8UPM9dbGOVGJhPjkuij1ohSwrA%0AohwyyOPqm2ZaCA4qqw%3D%3D%0A)

Configure the following settings:

*   **Use Sender ID By Default** - Whether the sender ID should be enabled by default when manually composing SMS
    
*   **Show Sender ID When Sending SMS -** This will provide the opportunity to toggle the Sender ID on/off when manually composing SMS
    
*   **ID Type** \- Select Number
    
*   **Sender ID** \- Enter the mobile number you would like the SMS sent from.
    

If you wish to use this feature for SMS Confirmations, Reminders and/or Follow Ups, you must enable this option separately on the relevant settings pages. By default, a sender ID will not be used for these functions as replies will not return to PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936463980/b29a75f39ebb569eecd55641/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+09.07.34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d9f01794a4bb086426e16154cb27caac2d128f1c6618d97e172cba8419727755&req=fSMhEs99lIlfFb4f3HP0gKRsdJa5HKPzDIeCAJKYObTfFADxCo4NenP1PNVZ%0AIucUe7dbuH%2FqPYkb8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936463980/b29a75f39ebb569eecd55641/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+09.07.34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d9f01794a4bb086426e16154cb27caac2d128f1c6618d97e172cba8419727755&req=fSMhEs99lIlfFb4f3HP0gKRsdJa5HKPzDIeCAJKYObTfFADxCo4NenP1PNVZ%0AIucUe7dbuH%2FqPYkb8w%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

**2\. Alphanumeric**
====================

Due to regulatory requirements, alphanumeric SMS Sender IDs must be relevant to your business and must be approved for use in PracSuite. Using generic SMS Sender IDs such as 'NoReply' or 'DoNotReply' is not permitted.

Alphanumeric Sender IDs can have a maximum of 11 characters and cannot include spaces. Only the following characters are permitted:

*   a-z
    
*   A-Z
    
*   0-9
    
*   \- (hyphen)
    
*   \_ (underscore)  
    ​
    

⚠️ **Please note: Patients _cannot_ reply to an SMS sent using an alphanumeric Sender ID. This feature is intended for one-way, no-reply advisory messages to your patients appearing from your business name.**

If you'd like to use the alphanumeric Sender ID function and understand that patients cannot reply to these messages, please [email our Business Care team](mailto:businesscare@smartsoft.com.au?subject=Alphanumeric%20Sender%20ID)
 with your preferred Sender ID.

Enabling Alphanumeric Sender ID
-------------------------------

Once you have received confirmation from Smartsoft that your Sender ID has been approved, you can enable this feature in [Settings > PracSuite Accounts > SMS](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/sms)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/806811164/14342957d02f43447c763654/CleanShot+2023-08-14+at+15.15.48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dab16cb36b712be664d582eb22d2b87a976033eaf7ccb24c174acdad94eab55f&req=fCAhHsh%2FnIdbFb4f3HP0gIwEGSSuDVszmBZeeSJxkZeQ4OuhbxBUNaelP8l%2F%0AaAaF4kNGoewwAMqVzw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/806811164/14342957d02f43447c763654/CleanShot+2023-08-14+at+15.15.48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dab16cb36b712be664d582eb22d2b87a976033eaf7ccb24c174acdad94eab55f&req=fCAhHsh%2FnIdbFb4f3HP0gIwEGSSuDVszmBZeeSJxkZeQ4OuhbxBUNaelP8l%2F%0AaAaF4kNGoewwAMqVzw%3D%3D%0A)

Configure the following settings:

*   **Use Sender ID By Default** - Whether the sender ID should be enabled by default when manually composing SMS
    
*   **Show Sender ID When Sending SMS -** This will provide the opportunity to toggle the Sender ID on/off when manually composing SMS
    
*   **ID Type** \- Select Alphanumeric
    

If you wish to use this feature for SMS Confirmations, Reminders and/or Follow Ups, you must enable this option separately on the relevant settings pages. By default, a sender ID will not be used for these functions as replies will not return to PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936463980/b29a75f39ebb569eecd55641/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+09.07.34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d9f01794a4bb086426e16154cb27caac2d128f1c6618d97e172cba8419727755&req=fSMhEs99lIlfFb4f3HP0gKRsdJa5HKPzDIeCAJKYObTfFADxCo4NenP1PNVZ%0AIucUe7dbuH%2FqPYkb8w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/936463980/b29a75f39ebb569eecd55641/CleanShot+2024-01-18+at+09.07.34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d9f01794a4bb086426e16154cb27caac2d128f1c6618d97e172cba8419727755&req=fSMhEs99lIlfFb4f3HP0gKRsdJa5HKPzDIeCAJKYObTfFADxCo4NenP1PNVZ%0AIucUe7dbuH%2FqPYkb8w%3D%3D%0A)

VALD Integration

VALD Integration
================

Updated over 2 weeks ago

Table of contents

[Enabling the VALD Integration](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8244563-vald-integration#h_3e691b7648)

[Using VALD features from the Clinical Notes tab in PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8244563-vald-integration#h_593ec28a05)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1202153416/848b29ce1155709b1ded7e2b/VALD_Hub_Full_RGB.png?expires=1771821900&signature=438d3177a80f6d30011ffad400b894bc95fa138b184e896167914d0c04ae2877&req=dSInFMh7noVeX%2FMW1HO4zQ%2F9En%2FbzFOopW%2FM4Dp5InVrQAEGd%2B%2BKzMmiFd3K%0ARUbydtykKCFXidvx6KI%3D%0A)](https://valdhealth.com/products/valdhub)

PracSuite integrates with [VALD Hub](https://valdhealth.com/products/valdhub)
, a solution that combines exercise prescription, outcome measurement and human measurement tools.

Best of all, in VALD Hub you can prescribe exercise programs, outcome measures and education articles for free! Patients will access their tasks from their MoveHealth app. The MoveHealth app will allow your patients to access all of their movement health data in one place, allowing them to access their exercise programs, outcome measures and education content all in one place. They will also be able to view in-clinic testing data captured on [VALD systems](https://valdhealth/products)
\*. Learn more about MoveHealth app on [movehealth.me](https://movehealth.me/)

_\*Test results available for DynaMo and ForceDecks, with more VALD systems coming soon._

From its best-in-class interface to having your clients seamlessly record and upload videos of their exercises for extra visibility, VALD Hub reduces the barriers to adopting exercise prescription technology in your practice.  
​  
The PracSuite integration allows practitioners to quickly create new patient profiles and access existing patient profiles in VALD, reducing the double handling of patient information.

* * *

Enabling the VALD Integration
=============================

_If you don't already have a VALD TeleHab account, [click here to sign up](https://app.telehab.io/sign-up)
._

1\. [Log into your VALD account](https://hub.valdperformance.com/)
 and obtain your [VALD Organisation ID](https://support.vald.com/hc/en-au/articles/15812248569113)
.

You can find your VALD Organisation ID on the Management page of VALD Hub.

From the left-hand navigation menu, click the **Management** option and select the **ORGANISATION** tab at the top.

[![management_orgID.png](https://pracsuite.intercom-attachments-7.com/i/o/806768212/fecbe4f33ac909b28586a4c6/15813328394393?expires=1771821900&signature=ecce051b57809e4a47cb5a06695adb3fa67c4389c7e81b345e2eb35412f4c175&req=fCAhEc92n4BdFb4f3HP0gC%2F3wXAXPzCAAPygRcDFov%2FLrPfNPjsxCeAqvgHu%0AEX%2BvJgi7LR36FudnBw%3D%3D%0A)](https://pracsuite.intercom-attachments-7.com/i/o/806768212/fecbe4f33ac909b28586a4c6/15813328394393?expires=1771821900&signature=ecce051b57809e4a47cb5a06695adb3fa67c4389c7e81b345e2eb35412f4c175&req=fCAhEc92n4BdFb4f3HP0gC%2F3wXAXPzCAAPygRcDFov%2FLrPfNPjsxCeAqvgHu%0AEX%2BvJgi7LR36FudnBw%3D%3D%0A)

**2\. [Email VALD Support](mailto:support@valdperformance.com?&cc=helpdesk@smartsoft.com.au&subject=Grant%20Access%20to%20PracSuite&body=Pleaes%20allow%20PracSuite%20to%20access%20our%20data%20from%20the%20following%20organisation%20ID:%20%3C%3CYOUR%20ORGANISATION%20ID%20HERE%3E%3E)
, copying in [helpdesk@smartsoft.com.au](mailto:helpdesk@smartsoft.com.au)
, to request that they allow PracSuite to access your VALD data. Be sure to include your VALD Organisation in the email.**

3\. When you receive confirmation from VALD that they have processed your request, return to PracSuite and go to [Settings > Integrations > VALD](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/VALD)
.

After enabling the integration, add your VALD Organisation ID and apply it to the relevant PracSuite Businesses. Repeat the above process if you have different VALD accounts per business.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/806741162/41f6054d3a9e3c4b2e302f05/CleanShot+2023-08-14+at+11.08.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ff312ae93af8db456ba65f40b53516954699ce14fe77b8b7444a191ea9c95158&req=fCAhEc1%2FnIddFb4f3HP0gD83aBVJSXAq%2Fg0TuF%2BJtXHqIYJYWW4UWhFLVhtc%0AlShsc6XwhMT7PqKmpg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/806741162/41f6054d3a9e3c4b2e302f05/CleanShot+2023-08-14+at+11.08.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ff312ae93af8db456ba65f40b53516954699ce14fe77b8b7444a191ea9c95158&req=fCAhEc1%2FnIddFb4f3HP0gD83aBVJSXAq%2Fg0TuF%2BJtXHqIYJYWW4UWhFLVhtc%0AlShsc6XwhMT7PqKmpg%3D%3D%0A)

4\. You can now use the VALD button at the top of the Clinical Notes timeline to create new and access existing VALD patient profiles.  
​

**Using VALD features from the Clinical Notes tab in PracSuite**
================================================================

⚠️ Only users with a linked practitioner file can access the VALD integration features. If you are not a practitioner, or your PracSuite user account is not linked to your practitioner file, VALD features will not be available.  
​  
​[Learn how to link a user to a practitioner file here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5258078-marking-a-user-as-a-practitioner)

From the Clinical Notes tab of a patient file, you will find the VALD button:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2033267536/d7921b1fc5e7d90c2992041097dc/CleanShot%2B2023-08-14%2Bat%2B11_10_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9007abeda2d1fb8dc7a56ef555d72111fcdb1ae911546a7309b263278282068&req=diAkFct4moRcX%2FMW1HO4zSD7s9UQeeIKo%2F%2F6C3S75Tr%2FwKI%2BovKKmKAYY1S6%0APGtjNEURvlLzlH2mqno%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/2033267536/d7921b1fc5e7d90c2992041097dc/CleanShot%2B2023-08-14%2Bat%2B11_10_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c9007abeda2d1fb8dc7a56ef555d72111fcdb1ae911546a7309b263278282068&req=diAkFct4moRcX%2FMW1HO4zSD7s9UQeeIKo%2F%2F6C3S75Tr%2FwKI%2BovKKmKAYY1S6%0APGtjNEURvlLzlH2mqno%3D%0A)

PracSuite will pass the following patient information to VALD:

*   First Name (required)
    
*   Last Name (required)
    
*   Date of Birth (required)
    
*   Email (required)
    
*   Sex  
    ​
    

**Please note:** PracSuite cannot link to pre-existing patient files that were added manually to your VALD account. For PracSuite to integrate properly with VALD, the patient file must be created anew via this integration, using the VALD button in PracSuite, which establishes a connection between the two products.

Displaying Participant IDs on Invoices
======================================

The NDIS Participant ID field can be found in the Health Fund & Benefits section on the main tab of the patient file.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/820400741/34584009cdaa7aa30743420c/CleanShot+2023-09-01+at+14.50.11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=870434dfd27fef1677d50c3176279e65fcd9b6b0cdd888fa15da7b018ae6bbcb&req=fCInEsl%2BmoVeFb4f3HP0gO%2FjyrCcdHOMt5enGhgoGCEt3IGAYlptKp0x%2Fnmx%0AeLHq60IEuNmWszMN8g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/820400741/34584009cdaa7aa30743420c/CleanShot+2023-09-01+at+14.50.11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=870434dfd27fef1677d50c3176279e65fcd9b6b0cdd888fa15da7b018ae6bbcb&req=fCInEsl%2BmoVeFb4f3HP0gO%2FjyrCcdHOMt5enGhgoGCEt3IGAYlptKp0x%2Fnmx%0AeLHq60IEuNmWszMN8g%3D%3D%0A)

The option to include a participant ID on an invoice is found within the Accounts tab of the patient file. You can enable this at a [global level on default accounts](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5987374-adding-default-accounts)
 and on individual third-party payers.

Hourly Billing
==============

Hourly Billing is designed for practices that invoice at an hourly rate, such as with the NDIS. When invoicing via the Appointment Book, Hourly Billing will set the quantity field for the item code based on the appointment duration. For example, a quantity of 1 = 60 minutes, 0.5 = 30 minutes etc.

[Learn More About Hourly Billing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8648935-using-the-hourly-billing-feature)

* * *

Automatic Invoicing
===================

The Automatic Invoicing feature streamlines the billing process by automatically generating invoices for appointments at a specified time after the appointment ends.

This feature is designed for third-party billing workflows where payment is not required on the day. Payments are not processed when using this feature. This tool is particularly useful for practices that prefer to accumulate invoices over a set billing cycle—be it weekly, fortnightly, or monthly—and then issue these invoices in bulk at the end of the cycle.

[Learn More About Automatic Invoicing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9126986-automatic-invoicing)

* * *

Creating Service Agreements Using Forms
=======================================

Forms allow you to create fully customisable patient forms (e.g. new patient forms) that can be automatically sent to patients in Appointment [Confirmations](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5684511-automatic-appointment-confirmations)
 and [Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)
. Patients can complete forms on their own device or on a tablet provided in the practice. Once completed, a patient's form responses are seamlessly updated on their patient file.

The Forms features are ideal for preparing intake forms and service agreements, and include tools such as [budget calculators](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8610437-using-a-calculator-in-patient-forms)
 and the option to [edit forms before sending](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7957993-editing-forms-before-sending)
 them.

[Learn More About Forms](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789041-forms-overview)

Exporting Quick Buttons
=======================

To export Quick Buttons, go to [Settings > Clinical Notes > Quick Buttons](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/clinicalnotes/quickbuttons/list)
.

Select the set you wish to export in the list.

Select the **Export** button shown at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/830083189/05556d1e1150c0cdf28cd255/CleanShot+2023-09-14+at+10.11.12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=36c762d7c6a6cc2c15bc14b8f9770afcfc55416ad6461e4ba9a852de7d8aa7d1&req=fCMnFsF9nIlWFb4f3HP0gAG39CdxVps1WuTCIEpunxWQxcMNu%2Bgm7DSgelUP%0ATQyH5WAbvGxNMDVasA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/830083189/05556d1e1150c0cdf28cd255/CleanShot+2023-09-14+at+10.11.12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=36c762d7c6a6cc2c15bc14b8f9770afcfc55416ad6461e4ba9a852de7d8aa7d1&req=fCMnFsF9nIlWFb4f3HP0gAG39CdxVps1WuTCIEpunxWQxcMNu%2Bgm7DSgelUP%0ATQyH5WAbvGxNMDVasA%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 311 — Form Link Expiry Time Frames | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-311}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8491518-form-link-expiry-time-frames](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8491518-form-link-expiry-time-frames)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8491518-form-link-expiry-time-frames#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Forms](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3247047-forms)

Form Link Expiry Time Frames

Form Link Expiry Time Frames
============================

Updated over 3 weeks ago

For security reasons, form links expire after a set period of time. The expiration window depends on how the link is generated or delivered.

**When sending links by email:**

Standard form links expire **60 days** after they are created.  
​

**When sending links by SMS:**

When a form link is sent via SMS, a shortened link is used to save characters. These SMS short links expire after **14 days**.

**When manually entering a code, or scanning a QR code:**

Forms accessed manually expire after **1 hour**.  
​

Note: If the same form is sent to the patient again, the expiration timer resets.

Sending Copies of Appointment and Invoice Correspondence to Patient Contacts

Sending Copies of Appointment and Invoice Correspondence to Patient Contacts
============================================================================

Updated over 2 months ago

Table of contents

[Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8503751-sending-copies-of-appointment-and-invoice-correspondence-to-patient-contacts#h_f9339cbda1)

[Enabling Sending Copies of Appointment and Invoice Correspondence](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8503751-sending-copies-of-appointment-and-invoice-correspondence-to-patient-contacts#h_5f28478229)

[SMS Replies from Contacts](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8503751-sending-copies-of-appointment-and-invoice-correspondence-to-patient-contacts#h_c35d353628)

Overview
========

The Contacts tab of the patient file is designed to store the details of individuals associated with a patient, such as parents, emergency contacts, case managers, support coordinators and more. [You can learn more about Patient Contacts here.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4613552-patient-contacts-and-relationships)

In this article, we will focus on the tools available to send a copy of appointment and invoice correspondence to contacts added to a patient file.

Enabling Sending Copies of Appointment and Invoice Correspondence
-----------------------------------------------------------------

To enable these options, go to the Contacts tab on a patient file and select a contact. On the contact's page, you will find the following options:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/859321340/7a8cb7671c73fa9d433cbbfd/CleanShot+2023-10-23+at+10.35.46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b215474e2a985835a753452f4bd5a1b5f4cb0bcf008f249242bb6940e27dd794&req=fCUuFct%2FnoVfFb4f3HP0gGuhirQougJLjNWBBGccfGaXa0zC75VpvsC5DkOe%0A2wEJ4B6MqOq1e1AW5Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/859321340/7a8cb7671c73fa9d433cbbfd/CleanShot+2023-10-23+at+10.35.46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b215474e2a985835a753452f4bd5a1b5f4cb0bcf008f249242bb6940e27dd794&req=fCUuFct%2FnoVfFb4f3HP0gGuhirQougJLjNWBBGccfGaXa0zC75VpvsC5DkOe%0A2wEJ4B6MqOq1e1AW5Q%3D%3D%0A)

These options allow you to send a copy of:

*   Appointment Confirmations, Reminders and Follow Ups by SMS or email
    
*   Invoices, Statements and Quotes by email
    
*   Manually composed emails with the contact automatically added to the CC or BCC field
    

It is important to consider the **Linked Account** selected on the contact.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/859321421/a95d78bd174e2c5fbf41e690/CleanShot+2023-10-23+at+10.36.00.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28bdbc552dc2495294d0dc3d552c22445ce317048d3cc742d4250fa65b3db6d9&req=fCUuFct%2FmYNeFb4f3HP0gNk%2BjfTSDh74GUQqiC%2F808ex%2Bx5FbYYfCw61Ph5N%0AfvZlAlpTv6eGJuogqw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/859321421/a95d78bd174e2c5fbf41e690/CleanShot+2023-10-23+at+10.36.00.png?expires=1771821900&signature=28bdbc552dc2495294d0dc3d552c22445ce317048d3cc742d4250fa65b3db6d9&req=fCUuFct%2FmYNeFb4f3HP0gNk%2BjfTSDh74GUQqiC%2F808ex%2Bx5FbYYfCw61Ph5N%0AfvZlAlpTv6eGJuogqw%3D%3D%0A)

The contact will only receive a copy of the correspondence when it relates to the chosen **Linked Account**. For example, if the contact is linked to the Workcover account, they will only receive appointment and invoice correspondence related to the Workcover account.

When contact copying is enabled, red banners will appear in various places in PracSuite to highlight that this feature is enabled. This includes:

*   The Communication section on the main Patient Details tab of the patient file.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/859321536/176c2a5c1d4027b31bbb0bf0/CleanShot+2023-10-23+at+10.36.35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=95ac671bb6a1c3267965c87327d5395038efa1a0e9619ec81a746e43a37d5f37&req=fCUuFct%2FmIJZFb4f3HP0gDWZz0VPvcZnQRudA2qHK0kU0QngqiV9Ten4DidM%0AHIMhqYe%2Fk8lpqRAteQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/859321536/176c2a5c1d4027b31bbb0bf0/CleanShot+2023-10-23+at+10.36.35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=95ac671bb6a1c3267965c87327d5395038efa1a0e9619ec81a746e43a37d5f37&req=fCUuFct%2FmIJZFb4f3HP0gDWZz0VPvcZnQRudA2qHK0kU0QngqiV9Ten4DidM%0AHIMhqYe%2Fk8lpqRAteQ%3D%3D%0A)

*   The Communication section of the Appointment Details pane.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/859321983/9ec6832cbdcc8f386d1feccd/CleanShot+2023-10-23+at+10.38.43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac2ea7fa1485e66b2ebfcaf67e638e25ffec7013abf9eb4a2300381d1d33c561&req=fCUuFct%2FlIlcFb4f3HP0gCkZ3sSJutghJWdKQcx0uZf8VFokSyTkaojixyvr%0A4tDsvkcb5bpwEEZ41w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/859321983/9ec6832cbdcc8f386d1feccd/CleanShot+2023-10-23+at+10.38.43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ac2ea7fa1485e66b2ebfcaf67e638e25ffec7013abf9eb4a2300381d1d33c561&req=fCUuFct%2FlIlcFb4f3HP0gCkZ3sSJutghJWdKQcx0uZf8VFokSyTkaojixyvr%0A4tDsvkcb5bpwEEZ41w%3D%3D%0A)
