Enabling Task Alerts

Enabling Task Alerts
====================

Updated over 2 years ago

PracSuite users can individually choose to enable task alerts based on various triggers. In your alert settings, you will find all possible task alert triggers that can be tailored to your individual preferences.

Open the Alerts pane in the bottom right corner of PracSuite and select the settings cog.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877871779/f4b834591a624dcd841f86d5/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.59.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0542bc94829ee03ae0f3d31551f86512b3181e0eb5be512124cc397c18eb30e2&req=fCcgHs5%2FmoZWFb4f3HP0gO%2BkNU4VX1IXEFoZ6yCbWSG8zSQZ4bnPwS7XoUFH%0AwBcsOWIp6MELHq6HTA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877871779/f4b834591a624dcd841f86d5/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.59.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0542bc94829ee03ae0f3d31551f86512b3181e0eb5be512124cc397c18eb30e2&req=fCcgHs5%2FmoZWFb4f3HP0gO%2BkNU4VX1IXEFoZ6yCbWSG8zSQZ4bnPwS7XoUFH%0AwBcsOWIp6MELHq6HTA%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877792501/43213ec7c9ae3da6659d7bbf/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+10.55.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=783376fa0e27344540302e2c57572f924ed29022d132904e05c2e6d3f9ba2bf1&req=fCcgEcB8mIFeFb4f3HP0gOERrCye2LQqFiehQZZLWnyq2Hq4zKrPdP%2F%2FCdZy%0APccZhWgA%2B8qSjW3CjA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877792501/43213ec7c9ae3da6659d7bbf/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+10.55.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=783376fa0e27344540302e2c57572f924ed29022d132904e05c2e6d3f9ba2bf1&req=fCcgEcB8mIFeFb4f3HP0gOERrCye2LQqFiehQZZLWnyq2Hq4zKrPdP%2F%2FCdZy%0APccZhWgA%2B8qSjW3CjA%3D%3D%0A)

There are three general categories of alerts that you can enable:

*   Tasks Assigned to your user
    
*   Tasks Assigned to your role
    
*   Tasks that were created by your user login
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/875856599/90f1bc53459e0182f6515e78/CleanShot+2023-11-06+at+14.16.11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe99e542a41f0422753029fbd84bd93c839092daf465efebba68f57c862e335d&req=fCciHsx4mIhWFb4f3HP0gCMSYVDAw7PJ8Y4XovbGD42up4Rejlp0WLXbTqA8%0AAJI2Pg4qeMgmEvIv8g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/875856599/90f1bc53459e0182f6515e78/CleanShot+2023-11-06+at+14.16.11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe99e542a41f0422753029fbd84bd93c839092daf465efebba68f57c862e335d&req=fCciHsx4mIhWFb4f3HP0gCMSYVDAw7PJ8Y4XovbGD42up4Rejlp0WLXbTqA8%0AAJI2Pg4qeMgmEvIv8g%3D%3D%0A)

Task alerts appear in their own category of the alerts pane.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877856167/2fc4e63894788bd0c5707c03/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.12.00.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ad422a62704101896eaa994e9ad42d6c89b102316244e7c842482a095558b226&req=fCcgHsx4nIdYFb4f3HP0gGUkSKptUToNt%2BXiEzH%2Bb2uarn0DbI1BqpoQjYSf%0ACjUgTNtLiGCydoDqRw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877856167/2fc4e63894788bd0c5707c03/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.12.00.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ad422a62704101896eaa994e9ad42d6c89b102316244e7c842482a095558b226&req=fCcgHsx4nIdYFb4f3HP0gGUkSKptUToNt%2BXiEzH%2Bb2uarn0DbI1BqpoQjYSf%0ACjUgTNtLiGCydoDqRw%3D%3D%0A)

## Document 314 — Appointment Report Heatmap | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-314}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8563463-appointment-report-heatmap](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8563463-appointment-report-heatmap)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

Appointment Report Heatmap

Appointment Report Heatmap
==========================

Updated over 2 years ago

Using the [Appointment Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/appointment/appointments)
, a heatmap can be generated to identify the busiest times of the week.

This feature works with the filters on the Appointment Report, allowing you to identify the busiest times for e.g. initial consults or missed appointments. The heatmap can provide insight into both past and future appointment numbers.

After selecting your preferred filters, select **Generate Report**.

Select the **Show Heatmap** button to display the heatmap above the results grid.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877803171/4ef2a319c6061b63ec48eeed/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+11.26.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a5f894671601b96f7eb99d12b93bc619e070fb4a13c0e4596140f25dccc9519c&req=fCcgHsl9nIZeFb4f3HP0gP52d%2FZEe1AukPcHN%2Fu8P8XiUQ47bM21AGyCZusb%0AizhSV2jvh%2B3T7MMdUA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877803171/4ef2a319c6061b63ec48eeed/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+11.26.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a5f894671601b96f7eb99d12b93bc619e070fb4a13c0e4596140f25dccc9519c&req=fCcgHsl9nIZeFb4f3HP0gP52d%2FZEe1AukPcHN%2Fu8P8XiUQ47bM21AGyCZusb%0AizhSV2jvh%2B3T7MMdUA%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877803062/37a5c10fb8ed00c6cffd90aa/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+11.24.18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df298c18adfb3f68f70962a18c7da13d1852baf4dfcc4d9a2aec3d9a8fe05c30&req=fCcgHsl9nYddFb4f3HP0gARl5RoXmF9NN30lCb9SWkinSWp%2BaKX%2Bp3Y4wTSr%0AiLifQKZdUfg8Xl5RPw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877803062/37a5c10fb8ed00c6cffd90aa/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+11.24.18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df298c18adfb3f68f70962a18c7da13d1852baf4dfcc4d9a2aec3d9a8fe05c30&req=fCcgHsl9nYddFb4f3HP0gARl5RoXmF9NN30lCb9SWkinSWp%2BaKX%2Bp3Y4wTSr%0AiLifQKZdUfg8Xl5RPw%3D%3D%0A)

_Note: The heatmap cannot be included in the report print out. If you wish to print the heatmap, you'll need to take a screenshot of it._

How to Email an Invoice
=======================

Updated over 5 months ago

Emailing an Individual Invoice
==============================

If you're in the process of invoicing, there is an option to save the invoice and email.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877853598/32402951f9ee4263b4292961/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.04.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d95a6e8d6f52b484f396bd7240a8d7587cb49a841498077af5967eb48c74e2e0&req=fCcgHsx9mIhXFb4f3HP0gDmXC8VF8AdoiGdjiehOxxmAwXMUvIRacw9vP5VS%0Ap6VJ5dePQumv%2FatIIA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877853598/32402951f9ee4263b4292961/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.04.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d95a6e8d6f52b484f396bd7240a8d7587cb49a841498077af5967eb48c74e2e0&req=fCcgHsx9mIhXFb4f3HP0gDmXC8VF8AdoiGdjiehOxxmAwXMUvIRacw9vP5VS%0Ap6VJ5dePQumv%2FatIIA%3D%3D%0A)

  
If you're viewing an existing invoice, the email option is found at the top of the invoice.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877853887/56f47dc3f463ea90979bfbcb/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.05.20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dc7a0d14e408818c97d8456d84c156ec58e6878d65d0fa03f29519eafb6a0def&req=fCcgHsx9lYlYFb4f3HP0gGsvUrPu%2FEa7K0Cs%2BrBPypCzEs4KIIbZwRF%2BMgpd%0Af3%2B%2FVHZNvqvY8E4B%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877853887/56f47dc3f463ea90979bfbcb/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.05.20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dc7a0d14e408818c97d8456d84c156ec58e6878d65d0fa03f29519eafb6a0def&req=fCcgHsx9lYlYFb4f3HP0gGsvUrPu%2FEa7K0Cs%2BrBPypCzEs4KIIbZwRF%2BMgpd%0Af3%2B%2FVHZNvqvY8E4B%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)

Emailing Multiple Invoices
==========================

To email multiple invoices, go to the Invoices tab on a patient file.

Select the Invoices section at the top of the page.

Use the checkboxes to select the invoices and then select email.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877854482/c2be6b67c8f804c802e0217e/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.06.48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a490e67ddf3d08c3a8f0fe668207056ef17e291b8a942079a28b06b287a9f25f&req=fCcgHsx6mYldFb4f3HP0gND64X%2F4cFxgJU0BqKezkwy69Y1sUcq%2BUqhzRx4w%0AKIfy6jPfBLmCJYmImA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/877854482/c2be6b67c8f804c802e0217e/CleanShot+2023-11-08+at+14.06.48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a490e67ddf3d08c3a8f0fe668207056ef17e291b8a942079a28b06b287a9f25f&req=fCcgHsx6mYldFb4f3HP0gND64X%2F4cFxgJU0BqKezkwy69Y1sUcq%2BUqhzRx4w%0AKIfy6jPfBLmCJYmImA%3D%3D%0A)

Using a Calculator in Patient Forms

Using a Calculator in Patient Forms
===================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[How to configure a calculator component on a patient form](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8610437-using-a-calculator-in-patient-forms#h_7feb216cc6)

[Number](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8610437-using-a-calculator-in-patient-forms#h_893b1e9048)

[Forms](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3247047-forms)
 allow you to add a configurable Calculator component. Some examples of using this component include defining NDIS budgets on service agreements, constructing a table of rates and calculating a client's Body Mass Index (BMI).

Included at the bottom of this article are samples of an NDIS budget intended for service agreements and a BMI calculator. Note that you will need to customise and edit the values for your profession)

Begin by adding the component to your [Form Template](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5789044-creating-form-templates)
 using the Add To Form button at the top.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889023108/f7ef81a4ea64053b03a40fe3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3617fae9aa00e734bc049d2d389ebc8f2626bf2f814510c440c68c50d3a8c70&req=fCguFst9nIFXFb4f3HP0gBnj6YMZS%2BWogbOWYhZ0po3vrX24y8A81WJByiSN%0AkCrakXdZny3OFKSzQQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889023108/f7ef81a4ea64053b03a40fe3/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3617fae9aa00e734bc049d2d389ebc8f2626bf2f814510c440c68c50d3a8c70&req=fCguFst9nIFXFb4f3HP0gBnj6YMZS%2BWogbOWYhZ0po3vrX24y8A81WJByiSN%0AkCrakXdZny3OFKSzQQ%3D%3D%0A)

How to configure a calculator component on a patient form
=========================================================

Label your calculator and use the switch to decide if a patient should be able to see the calculation fields.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/891063777/f267550a73767e79922dd01c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=280de1224e3c75a984e7a99815beefd6a417016b3edfdfbdd89b695e86896328&req=fCkmFs99moZYFb4f3HP0gIbEu8AzWRPcTLsOU4ZMt403B105EvgKKQQSuYnv%0A7CP9ceaR0tf%2FWwrzsQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/891063777/f267550a73767e79922dd01c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=280de1224e3c75a984e7a99815beefd6a417016b3edfdfbdd89b695e86896328&req=fCkmFs99moZYFb4f3HP0gIbEu8AzWRPcTLsOU4ZMt403B105EvgKKQQSuYnv%0A7CP9ceaR0tf%2FWwrzsQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Configuring Columns
===================

The first step is to add a Column using the **ADD** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889040453/0c5763a6b6349410336204da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27969fb574aaf64e70c8eaa0f71079e7fcc53f391b37e00b325f29d0da12537b&req=fCguFs1%2BmYRcFb4f3HP0gGmtmLJc0%2F%2B6LSfBrSolRfRKu0VS5cUOi2zUZ4r2%0AsRZVC0INXLVyf9GCxA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889040453/0c5763a6b6349410336204da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27969fb574aaf64e70c8eaa0f71079e7fcc53f391b37e00b325f29d0da12537b&req=fCguFs1%2BmYRcFb4f3HP0gGmtmLJc0%2F%2B6LSfBrSolRfRKu0VS5cUOi2zUZ4r2%0AsRZVC0INXLVyf9GCxA%3D%3D%0A)

Use the type dropdown to decide what data is presented in this column. The first column is named A, and subsequent columns you add are given a new letter alphabetically. Once you have selected the Type of column, you configure a column using the cog button or select the **Configured per row** option if you want to use custom settings on each row.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889070000/fd60e110c1cf78b6cffce8fb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=643997ed0f990ad012ce0c8c731352544f30b33b70f0a2ba0b979f960c8cfd01&req=fCguFs5%2BnYFfFb4f3HP0gFzfuJzsrDrv%2FK3yVm%2F95W6hcn7Vkg5xBtHQZ0Fe%0AEQQggBJaqAFUJDl6DQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889070000/fd60e110c1cf78b6cffce8fb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=643997ed0f990ad012ce0c8c731352544f30b33b70f0a2ba0b979f960c8cfd01&req=fCguFs5%2BnYFfFb4f3HP0gFzfuJzsrDrv%2FK3yVm%2F95W6hcn7Vkg5xBtHQZ0Fe%0AEQQggBJaqAFUJDl6DQ%3D%3D%0A)

The different Column data types are:

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Element** | **Calculatable** | **Patient Editable** |
| Label | N   | N   |
| Number | Y   | Y   |
| Drop Down | Y   | Y   |
| Calculation | Y   | N   |

Label
-----

Use the Label option for guiding someone through your calculator. You can leave the column header label blank and customise the entry on each row.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889072387/eaa08f8b48d36ca706720f1b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2b8eeab795484d8acb01398d8d4299a8c2ff9052f0b2ed2cd619533bac5dc05&req=fCguFs58nolYFb4f3HP0gCLiuJyh7ijKpXnrV9M%2B74UAXoHEbjYejlcaJXV%2B%0AB7iiER9QR3ntbqDBGw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889072387/eaa08f8b48d36ca706720f1b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c2b8eeab795484d8acb01398d8d4299a8c2ff9052f0b2ed2cd619533bac5dc05&req=fCguFs58nolYFb4f3HP0gCLiuJyh7ijKpXnrV9M%2B74UAXoHEbjYejlcaJXV%2B%0AB7iiER9QR3ntbqDBGw%3D%3D%0A)

Number
------

Define the minimum and maximum, how many decimal places are required, and add a prefix or a suffix.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889072630/76463043018d464c3274293c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ae5ab522caf6122cddc88b3c7851ed91adb39d0328ae453b7c906051da1c6a6&req=fCguFs58m4JfFb4f3HP0gEjm2YLBG%2FWJ66fGx%2Fcihxd4A6wf6wXaDLNoVkIF%0Aw5rxwcXtJnr3TFxo8Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889072630/76463043018d464c3274293c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0ae5ab522caf6122cddc88b3c7851ed91adb39d0328ae453b7c906051da1c6a6&req=fCguFs58m4JfFb4f3HP0gEjm2YLBG%2FWJ66fGx%2Fcihxd4A6wf6wXaDLNoVkIF%0Aw5rxwcXtJnr3TFxo8Q%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889072786/28d788db7e73f7f3fb9ec041/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=58a2d87406e30a399ec7f18e98ab087d3e13354676bd43799564c347b9bfa9ea&req=fCguFs58molZFb4f3HP0gPrGM4VTCG5gSffFjquCPxhFi4P3NEMt2qOSJ9eC%0ApHMiuvlFzrHRH6a4Eg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889072786/28d788db7e73f7f3fb9ec041/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=58a2d87406e30a399ec7f18e98ab087d3e13354676bd43799564c347b9bfa9ea&req=fCguFs58molZFb4f3HP0gPrGM4VTCG5gSffFjquCPxhFi4P3NEMt2qOSJ9eC%0ApHMiuvlFzrHRH6a4Eg%3D%3D%0A)

Drop Down
---------

The drop-down option is great for having a text-based selection tied to a value.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073385/2e1c52732f21cbb266780f9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=121d922926bf926db8311ec7ee8122196386cd3ff674c91f22a6fca1e85a30fb&req=fCguFs59nolaFb4f3HP0gNvcO47vE9ZsxJnAfRi%2FeIJbivpZghqEJrxl2T7i%0A9PNzfpvENjQMkVNYdA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073385/2e1c52732f21cbb266780f9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=121d922926bf926db8311ec7ee8122196386cd3ff674c91f22a6fca1e85a30fb&req=fCguFs59nolaFb4f3HP0gNvcO47vE9ZsxJnAfRi%2FeIJbivpZghqEJrxl2T7i%0A9PNzfpvENjQMkVNYdA%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073629/29d75f2285329cc6eddb9f00/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c91c3839c9a9ddda5cb1da7fe5fd69ecc71f7176a85b24c1f1a648e0fb4818b&req=fCguFs59m4NWFb4f3HP0gLZg7lirXhjBOKYLOCtmL35f9S9uQSh18zqytLtM%0ATEektA5Y0aeJDzkmlQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073629/29d75f2285329cc6eddb9f00/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c91c3839c9a9ddda5cb1da7fe5fd69ecc71f7176a85b24c1f1a648e0fb4818b&req=fCguFs59m4NWFb4f3HP0gLZg7lirXhjBOKYLOCtmL35f9S9uQSh18zqytLtM%0ATEektA5Y0aeJDzkmlQ%3D%3D%0A)

Calculation
-----------

The engine of the Calculator. Use + - \* and / to create a formula for your calculation element, and then use totals at the bottom of the template to perform complex calculations.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073782/6766fb7c9bfd4758777feb4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72f8bc394655a05b3dffd6c06d5bdebe2760694690b0dd35fa2cc6cef46ae846&req=fCguFs59moldFb4f3HP0gKo10EzZfChSn2RT5ltEQvYC6uE2MRJevb%2F1USYe%0AgmeCLcDfNk%2B2%2Fyi72Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073782/6766fb7c9bfd4758777feb4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72f8bc394655a05b3dffd6c06d5bdebe2760694690b0dd35fa2cc6cef46ae846&req=fCguFs59moldFb4f3HP0gKo10EzZfChSn2RT5ltEQvYC6uE2MRJevb%2F1USYe%0AgmeCLcDfNk%2B2%2Fyi72Q%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073912/e940912f140dff678836b35a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0c73d5db682062582b9159be69c7e876336ba4029778985a9f654e4e3d67e7b5&req=fCguFs59lIBdFb4f3HP0gEhgB1HKYK5zZfpnZll50CkIoJhmf%2Fj1P6CV5rGD%0ACzMJijpIxv6IwT1bJQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073912/e940912f140dff678836b35a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0c73d5db682062582b9159be69c7e876336ba4029778985a9f654e4e3d67e7b5&req=fCguFs59lIBdFb4f3HP0gEhgB1HKYK5zZfpnZll50CkIoJhmf%2Fj1P6CV5rGD%0ACzMJijpIxv6IwT1bJQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Configuring Rows
================

Once you have added at least one column, you can add a Row below your column list.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889068229/e2c09f7bc2c6bd211abff30d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=530475eb038443dc44dfd357598fc942c1a3086140a597b8da6eefa747ed1740&req=fCguFs92n4NWFb4f3HP0gBtuhYfaR0OotgPoJayU%2FrDr%2FyWzS%2FArBdXWsC%2Bt%0AZvu911e%2BMzsh%2FYu1Sw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889068229/e2c09f7bc2c6bd211abff30d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=530475eb038443dc44dfd357598fc942c1a3086140a597b8da6eefa747ed1740&req=fCguFs92n4NWFb4f3HP0gBtuhYfaR0OotgPoJayU%2FrDr%2FyWzS%2FArBdXWsC%2Bt%0AZvu911e%2BMzsh%2FYu1Sw%3D%3D%0A)

Each row is given a number that you can use to reference a specific cell in a calculation, e.g., A1, B1, C1. You can prefill the form here by editing individual values in any label, number or dropdown row. If you have selected Configured per row on any columns, you will see a cog next to each section you can configure.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889079527/81e880d2595c1bcf3b5d24de/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a4471ba7f2774ea776280cce8328520fcd85d4fd7dab96af9fd5cb204f5f9c6&req=fCguFs53mINYFb4f3HP0gMY9vZNj0anVglJOLiJ%2FKzzB%2B65xc%2BKQTQ5BWEKz%0AJI7Jg0KYRG1qgkV01g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889079527/81e880d2595c1bcf3b5d24de/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1a4471ba7f2774ea776280cce8328520fcd85d4fd7dab96af9fd5cb204f5f9c6&req=fCguFs53mINYFb4f3HP0gMY9vZNj0anVglJOLiJ%2FKzzB%2B65xc%2BKQTQ5BWEKz%0AJI7Jg0KYRG1qgkV01g%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Allow Patient to Edit
=====================

Unique to forms, the calculator component allows you to specify whether a patient can edit a field. After selecting the cog on a column (unless configured by row), you will find this option as a checkbox.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/891053067/f31c8956fc657f6711e62128/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13488df61e04abae2061239c1f6d0edfd4bac0d28a95dec50f4b5798c378a975&req=fCkmFsx9nYdYFb4f3HP0gIFf7fYHmXzbY8iVAiQn8sgeswzd7TvIlWBtRG9r%0Aclnbrgr6ibW6sHMXtw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/891053067/f31c8956fc657f6711e62128/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=13488df61e04abae2061239c1f6d0edfd4bac0d28a95dec50f4b5798c378a975&req=fCkmFsx9nYdYFb4f3HP0gIFf7fYHmXzbY8iVAiQn8sgeswzd7TvIlWBtRG9r%0Aclnbrgr6ibW6sHMXtw%3D%3D%0A)

Disallowing patients to edit sections allows you to use the Edit Before Sending option when manually sending patients' forms. This is ideal for NDIS service agreements as you can fill it in and then send the patient a read-only version for them to sign.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/891053208/8ae9902cffaede44f3c0d563/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=30e9a68611a7c464066d3cb3ddcb1c2a73a9bea7192e119e820f4e3e31910d50&req=fCkmFsx9n4FXFb4f3HP0gJ0Dbu%2BdPVcKle0ojCRS864Ft122%2B27tvsYEbb3F%0AtFPb7LNUjyrP1a8fng%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/891053208/8ae9902cffaede44f3c0d563/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=30e9a68611a7c464066d3cb3ddcb1c2a73a9bea7192e119e820f4e3e31910d50&req=fCkmFsx9n4FXFb4f3HP0gJ0Dbu%2BdPVcKle0ojCRS864Ft122%2B27tvsYEbb3F%0AtFPb7LNUjyrP1a8fng%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Totals
======

In the Totals section, you will find a preset calculation for a Grand Total (every value figure added together) and column totals. If you don't want these to display, untick the Display box.

Use the **Add** button to create your own calculations. Use the **Display to Patient** option to choose whether the calculation is shown to patients completing the form, or only to staff within PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/891064611/1b00da99a64722966a66ee0e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52f6655b8b4a5214e861d89ffde9abf9c20d1a03fbe4a0a55e45b5f673c79885&req=fCkmFs96m4BeFb4f3HP0gJ%2BMUcllUQgOPzZEVy5d6ka35In4nBGFxQxDPeIL%0AeH5Bdxyct1v9iBu0sg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/891064611/1b00da99a64722966a66ee0e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52f6655b8b4a5214e861d89ffde9abf9c20d1a03fbe4a0a55e45b5f673c79885&req=fCkmFs96m4BeFb4f3HP0gJ%2BMUcllUQgOPzZEVy5d6ka35In4nBGFxQxDPeIL%0AeH5Bdxyct1v9iBu0sg%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Example Templates
=================

Included at the bottom of this article are samples of an NDIS budget intended for service agreements and a BMI calculator.

Did you know you can insert these examples into your Form templates without starting from scratch? Hover over an element in your existing template and use the plus icon to add another template directly below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/895554802/8557175dcf598bbd4b578859/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe18bb7035f6dde039bb5b5ae458c4cbee1d1d52a2c7fcb4a0d554a6f41eb1df&req=fCkiE8x6lYFdFb4f3HP0gE89GkOUprMwBXcSg7SWdCVjzUwa63k1QiHMqm7m%0A3N5bzOg5j8IgDlOwQw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/895554802/8557175dcf598bbd4b578859/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe18bb7035f6dde039bb5b5ae458c4cbee1d1d52a2c7fcb4a0d554a6f41eb1df&req=fCkiE8x6lYFdFb4f3HP0gE89GkOUprMwBXcSg7SWdCVjzUwa63k1QiHMqm7m%0A3N5bzOg5j8IgDlOwQw%3D%3D%0A)

Extended Gender List
====================

An Extended Gender List can be enabled in [Settings > General > General.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general)

Once enabled, you can use the Cog button to configure which additional gender options you wish to display.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/890049717/27869448b5f744ee03d50d49/CleanShot+2023-11-22+at+13.51.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee5c06e0e5504d1a33710500efc4d74275cd338fde6f3de4e7081470a8cc85a3&req=fCknFs13moBYFb4f3HP0gApXPyCaH9Kc%2BWkqfUc2TbHtkokARortzZlYn18i%0AEgyqhjy3N7N4gZJ2Ig%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/890049717/27869448b5f744ee03d50d49/CleanShot+2023-11-22+at+13.51.40.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ee5c06e0e5504d1a33710500efc4d74275cd338fde6f3de4e7081470a8cc85a3&req=fCknFs13moBYFb4f3HP0gApXPyCaH9Kc%2BWkqfUc2TbHtkokARortzZlYn18i%0AEgyqhjy3N7N4gZJ2Ig%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/890024027/82c10171f8d09710e43281fc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b11426ed379b12db423e2ad71ef927964f3813f3e69a1e2b3f00718b8941e845&req=fCknFst6nYNYFb4f3HP0gFVyXobiTN5CcJWVA%2BHqIvrQb%2FnvrmvpYPMzCKrh%0AfdEExQppAR10Ljs7pw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/890024027/82c10171f8d09710e43281fc/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b11426ed379b12db423e2ad71ef927964f3813f3e69a1e2b3f00718b8941e845&req=fCknFst6nYNYFb4f3HP0gFVyXobiTN5CcJWVA%2BHqIvrQb%2FnvrmvpYPMzCKrh%0AfdEExQppAR10Ljs7pw%3D%3D%0A)

High Visibility Pronouns
========================

High Visibility Pronouns can be enabled in [Settings > General > General.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/general)

Once enabled, a patient's preferred pronouns will be prominently displayed at the top of their patient file and in the appointment tooltip.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/890018787/76523cc8d400c1e927549322/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1e8489a00959b634059a5377643497c79e4f4a4f71303fbe9e1706c026452d7&req=fCknFsh2molYFb4f3HP0gJArHryOLEwLc4Eai7nJ7wl0JW4o4f2QTC0NG%2Bqp%0AIFOKJ34u%2FjTe16UpmQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/890018787/76523cc8d400c1e927549322/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b1e8489a00959b634059a5377643497c79e4f4a4f71303fbe9e1706c026452d7&req=fCknFsh2molYFb4f3HP0gJArHryOLEwLc4Eai7nJ7wl0JW4o4f2QTC0NG%2Bqp%0AIFOKJ34u%2FjTe16UpmQ%3D%3D%0A)

Online Booking
==============

In [Settings > Online Booking > Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
, you can choose which fields to display to patients completing a guest booking or registering an account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/890048849/66fe7709fb6cc14966c838b2/CleanShot+2023-11-22+at+13.48.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6aeb3b63af956ca2a990572d5d348b9cc92a22b4ffe87de9292f6c773031c598&req=fCknFs12lYVWFb4f3HP0gFG3dW7Yl4nnSu7SSb%2F%2BKFJqtk2qRKqigyu14jk5%0A0FkbU1MU8c8CdhT3AQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/890048849/66fe7709fb6cc14966c838b2/CleanShot+2023-11-22+at+13.48.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6aeb3b63af956ca2a990572d5d348b9cc92a22b4ffe87de9292f6c773031c598&req=fCknFs12lYVWFb4f3HP0gFG3dW7Yl4nnSu7SSb%2F%2BKFJqtk2qRKqigyu14jk5%0A0FkbU1MU8c8CdhT3AQ%3D%3D%0A)

=====

After adding the Patient Details element to patient forms, you can choose which fields to display to patients completing the form.

Using the Hourly Billing feature

Using the Hourly Billing feature
================================

Updated over 7 months ago

Table of contents

[Enabling Hourly Billing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8648935-using-the-hourly-billing-feature#h_a71f7f4965)

[Using Hourly Billing via the Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8648935-using-the-hourly-billing-feature#h_c48ccdcfd8)

Hourly Billing is designed for practices that invoice at an hourly rate, such as with the NDIS. When invoicing via the Appointment Book, Hourly Billing will set the quantity field for the item code based on the appointment duration. For example, a quantity of 1 = 60 minutes, 0.5 = 30 minutes etc.

Note: Hourly Billing is only supported when invoicing via the appointment book.

Enabling Hourly Billing
=======================

Go to [Settings > Billing > Billing](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/list/edit)
 and check **Enable Hourly Billing.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903015339/f599a580f7355ab32998fa32/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+16.25.19.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7b33538ebba2d49b96fc96051b3be573e6a29a78ff020fc897bf2a41c7ba4ac5&req=fSAkFsh7noJWFb4f3HP0gAkpRuMmlPBsEcnhZA%2F3X1s9CtHggwoZyNMOhvv8%0AQpIF0%2BuxZVujiJdtHQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903015339/f599a580f7355ab32998fa32/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+16.25.19.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7b33538ebba2d49b96fc96051b3be573e6a29a78ff020fc897bf2a41c7ba4ac5&req=fSAkFsh7noJWFb4f3HP0gAkpRuMmlPBsEcnhZA%2F3X1s9CtHggwoZyNMOhvv8%0AQpIF0%2BuxZVujiJdtHQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once enabled, Hourly Billing is configured per **Appointment Type**.

Go to [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
.

Select an Appointment Type from the list that requires Hourly Billing.

Scroll down to the **Default Item Code & Duration** section. Along with enabling Hourly Billing, you must specify the default duration and item code.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903010136/4e72eb4f1e56c684bc559b1b/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+16.11.42.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e12d35c0ffbddff20674f406b82f1fd834d7ea5ce96196d0c8da921f552ed9bf&req=fSAkFsh%2BnIJZFb4f3HP0gKr0dzzn7G%2BxI4a42FeiqIWksKlvnvqR0q2zLbvY%0A0SphQYReZ4OakNy%2Fjw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903010136/4e72eb4f1e56c684bc559b1b/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+16.11.42.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e12d35c0ffbddff20674f406b82f1fd834d7ea5ce96196d0c8da921f552ed9bf&req=fSAkFsh%2BnIJZFb4f3HP0gKr0dzzn7G%2BxI4a42FeiqIWksKlvnvqR0q2zLbvY%0A0SphQYReZ4OakNy%2Fjw%3D%3D%0A)

Note: It's important for the default item code you select to represent the total hourly rate. Do not select item codes with fees less than the hourly rate.

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Using Hourly Billing via the Appointment Book
=============================================

Hourly billing relies on an appointment's duration, so it will only work when invoicing via the appointment book.

Go to an appointment and select the **Invoice** option.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903029158/c7de0579bbdebf83248cdc01/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+16.54.39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f8ca6b8c4f59b1bb3db7b323786969e128bd64a8195ce804858a96851ea5e0dd&req=fSAkFst3nIRXFb4f3HP0gO2406xnqx3nrt6cYJEiuXQSo99lUUomL5SpFm4E%0Arsl9O6t1w2rDZQhI9A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903029158/c7de0579bbdebf83248cdc01/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+16.54.39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f8ca6b8c4f59b1bb3db7b323786969e128bd64a8195ce804858a96851ea5e0dd&req=fSAkFst3nIRXFb4f3HP0gO2406xnqx3nrt6cYJEiuXQSo99lUUomL5SpFm4E%0Arsl9O6t1w2rDZQhI9A%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting Invoice in the appointment menu, you'll see your default billing code added to the invoice with the quantity field set according to the appointment's duration.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903011060/81f0cac30d4cc5854fb9ed6c/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+16.14.01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2d8e419e0e2ba52cf53e408c8053e9d72beee2cfb88cc5ce74219c57f1dd532c&req=fSAkFsh%2FnYdfFb4f3HP0gOFTM01pma%2B%2BumpKyuyDW%2B3fcThCsZH9qcAeON%2Bm%0AEaQrWRFDbIKOeh3VNQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903011060/81f0cac30d4cc5854fb9ed6c/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+16.14.01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2d8e419e0e2ba52cf53e408c8053e9d72beee2cfb88cc5ce74219c57f1dd532c&req=fSAkFsh%2FnYdfFb4f3HP0gOFTM01pma%2B%2BumpKyuyDW%2B3fcThCsZH9qcAeON%2Bm%0AEaQrWRFDbIKOeh3VNQ%3D%3D%0A)

After the default item is added, proceed with your standard invoicing workflow.

* * *

Some typical duration and quantity combinations are outlined below.

Based on user feedback, PracSuite now includes an option to adjust hourly billing rounding to better align with the NDIS preference for truncating (rather than rounding) quantity values to two decimal places. Practices invoicing the NDIS can enable this alternative rounding logic. You can learn more about the [NDIS rounding logic behaviour in this article.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9463962-ndis-rounding)

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Duration** | **Quantity** |
| 10 mins | 0.17 |
| 15 mins | 0.25 |
| 20 mins | 0.33 |
| 30 mins | 0.5 |
| 40 mins | 0.67 |
| 45 mins | 0.75 |
| 50 mins | 0.83 |
| 60 mins | 1.0 |

Using a Calculator in Clinical Notes

Using a Calculator in Clinical Notes
====================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[How to configure a calculator component on a clinical note template](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8653744-using-a-calculator-in-clinical-notes#h_ca9430e956)

[Configuring Columns](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8653744-using-a-calculator-in-clinical-notes#h_728561e77a)

[Label](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8653744-using-a-calculator-in-clinical-notes#h_47df3afaf8)

[Number](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8653744-using-a-calculator-in-clinical-notes#h_beefb763ab)

[Drop Down](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8653744-using-a-calculator-in-clinical-notes#h_e3a71ffaa7)

[Calculation](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8653744-using-a-calculator-in-clinical-notes#h_f0a17a7090)

[Configuring Rows](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8653744-using-a-calculator-in-clinical-notes#h_8c29f817cc)

[Totals](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8653744-using-a-calculator-in-clinical-notes#h_a8a9144895)

[Example Templates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8653744-using-a-calculator-in-clinical-notes#h_86be500569)

Clinical Notes allow you to add a configurable Calculator component. Some examples of using this component include defining NDIS budgets on service agreements, constructing a table of rates and calculating a client's Body Mass Index (BMI).

Included at the bottom of this article are samples of an NDIS budget intended for service agreements and a BMI calculator. Note that you will need to customise and edit the values for your profession.

Begin by adding the component to your Clinical Notes Template using the Add To Notes button at the top.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896659807/8cefe6804f3f83ac048b5835/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cca34f891fe50513c6a1eab2726996bbccd1b3a99cd5ec956bbf81cc2b51141e&req=fCkhEMx3lYFYFb4f3HP0gOC5LvI0bRnYfA8lvirnuHIDMunxeX7GNpvv76Xu%0AVeS1oajEMzv3uYWCBA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896659807/8cefe6804f3f83ac048b5835/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cca34f891fe50513c6a1eab2726996bbccd1b3a99cd5ec956bbf81cc2b51141e&req=fCkhEMx3lYFYFb4f3HP0gOC5LvI0bRnYfA8lvirnuHIDMunxeX7GNpvv76Xu%0AVeS1oajEMzv3uYWCBA%3D%3D%0A)

How to configure a calculator component on a clinical note template
===================================================================

Label your calculator to make it easy to identify.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896660777/a31ce6af94d605d7de05fa60/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25232fe4e987130e67d90f16ef329882e828786630b751bd7891993db9b3ec57&req=fCkhEM9%2BmoZYFb4f3HP0gCRl%2FIqED2oCjG8r2zXCw8gEQo5WWpw0PDktjmG7%0Avz%2F7QX8zgeIpDqEXkg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896660777/a31ce6af94d605d7de05fa60/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25232fe4e987130e67d90f16ef329882e828786630b751bd7891993db9b3ec57&req=fCkhEM9%2BmoZYFb4f3HP0gCRl%2FIqED2oCjG8r2zXCw8gEQo5WWpw0PDktjmG7%0Avz%2F7QX8zgeIpDqEXkg%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Configuring Columns
===================

The first step is to add a Column using the **ADD** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889040453/0c5763a6b6349410336204da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27969fb574aaf64e70c8eaa0f71079e7fcc53f391b37e00b325f29d0da12537b&req=fCguFs1%2BmYRcFb4f3HP0gGmtmLJc0%2F%2B6LSfBrSolRfRKu0VS5cUOi2zUZ4r2%0AsRZVC0INXLVyf9GCxA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889040453/0c5763a6b6349410336204da/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27969fb574aaf64e70c8eaa0f71079e7fcc53f391b37e00b325f29d0da12537b&req=fCguFs1%2BmYRcFb4f3HP0gGmtmLJc0%2F%2B6LSfBrSolRfRKu0VS5cUOi2zUZ4r2%0AsRZVC0INXLVyf9GCxA%3D%3D%0A)

Use the type dropdown to decide what data is presented in this column. The first column is named A, and subsequent columns you add are given a new letter alphabetically. Once you have selected the Type of column, you configure a column using the cog button or select the **Configured per row** option if you want to use custom settings on each row.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889070000/fd60e110c1cf78b6cffce8fb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=643997ed0f990ad012ce0c8c731352544f30b33b70f0a2ba0b979f960c8cfd01&req=fCguFs5%2BnYFfFb4f3HP0gFzfuJzsrDrv%2FK3yVm%2F95W6hcn7Vkg5xBtHQZ0Fe%0AEQQggBJaqAFUJDl6DQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889070000/fd60e110c1cf78b6cffce8fb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=643997ed0f990ad012ce0c8c731352544f30b33b70f0a2ba0b979f960c8cfd01&req=fCguFs5%2BnYFfFb4f3HP0gFzfuJzsrDrv%2FK3yVm%2F95W6hcn7Vkg5xBtHQZ0Fe%0AEQQggBJaqAFUJDl6DQ%3D%3D%0A)

The different Column data types are:

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| **Element** | **Calculatable** |
| Label | N   |
| Number | Y   |
| Drop Down | Y   |
| Calculation | Y   |

Label
-----

Use the Label option for guiding someone through your calculator. You can leave the column header label blank and customise the entry on each row.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896665742/189bb4732a63105d5db1cc61/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e04f755440f21846f135a08dc2baf958dfc5ff99450a0c17c86628163b499fd7&req=fCkhEM97moVdFb4f3HP0gKPLzqV01%2FhLDg4XAwBG5NQjJtrRWm8tUEgETKLU%0A7PXGj%2Bn27y4rnpKTlw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896665742/189bb4732a63105d5db1cc61/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e04f755440f21846f135a08dc2baf958dfc5ff99450a0c17c86628163b499fd7&req=fCkhEM97moVdFb4f3HP0gKPLzqV01%2FhLDg4XAwBG5NQjJtrRWm8tUEgETKLU%0A7PXGj%2Bn27y4rnpKTlw%3D%3D%0A)

Number
------

Define the minimum and maximum, how many decimal places are required, and add a prefix or a suffix.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896666182/14cc91cb0dbc88bf030d7c75/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2e2d51c1f7e32198c2bd6f7e5ff2157e9271634d34b090ac9fb3b57936e9b808&req=fCkhEM94nIldFb4f3HP0gOkdYXxqvT2L7SrHLp%2BHbCphYHfUbKLDjt0rxSon%0AnPAEM0bnyybFFdL3Ww%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896666182/14cc91cb0dbc88bf030d7c75/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2e2d51c1f7e32198c2bd6f7e5ff2157e9271634d34b090ac9fb3b57936e9b808&req=fCkhEM94nIldFb4f3HP0gOkdYXxqvT2L7SrHLp%2BHbCphYHfUbKLDjt0rxSon%0AnPAEM0bnyybFFdL3Ww%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896666705/7c6541a35d9eb0f5f8d56acd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23a167267e220c4c1356d01977b4610d0cd2d7b24cf7999a1eb873ab999cfedc&req=fCkhEM94moFaFb4f3HP0gCz%2B1JXE00rLxnTiuQB36M4CDrcRgrwRfC0t1C%2Bt%0AumCwjkpqdSxVNE5mSA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896666705/7c6541a35d9eb0f5f8d56acd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23a167267e220c4c1356d01977b4610d0cd2d7b24cf7999a1eb873ab999cfedc&req=fCkhEM94moFaFb4f3HP0gCz%2B1JXE00rLxnTiuQB36M4CDrcRgrwRfC0t1C%2Bt%0AumCwjkpqdSxVNE5mSA%3D%3D%0A)

Drop Down
---------

The drop-down option is great for having a text-based selection tied to a value.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073385/2e1c52732f21cbb266780f9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=121d922926bf926db8311ec7ee8122196386cd3ff674c91f22a6fca1e85a30fb&req=fCguFs59nolaFb4f3HP0gNvcO47vE9ZsxJnAfRi%2FeIJbivpZghqEJrxl2T7i%0A9PNzfpvENjQMkVNYdA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073385/2e1c52732f21cbb266780f9a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=121d922926bf926db8311ec7ee8122196386cd3ff674c91f22a6fca1e85a30fb&req=fCguFs59nolaFb4f3HP0gNvcO47vE9ZsxJnAfRi%2FeIJbivpZghqEJrxl2T7i%0A9PNzfpvENjQMkVNYdA%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896673989/7eef399bf68e0567f1ab9e65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9553dcb0392d40830f1f154ab63cc10c5ac1e4a07dd0113ebbc394247b2cba87&req=fCkhEM59lIlWFb4f3HP0gFv%2FbzqRexL8yjCqWDKIndRx5nh8r8nNpS976RjK%0AX4JVNCJqtnJTvkjq5A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896673989/7eef399bf68e0567f1ab9e65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9553dcb0392d40830f1f154ab63cc10c5ac1e4a07dd0113ebbc394247b2cba87&req=fCkhEM59lIlWFb4f3HP0gFv%2FbzqRexL8yjCqWDKIndRx5nh8r8nNpS976RjK%0AX4JVNCJqtnJTvkjq5A%3D%3D%0A)

Calculation
-----------

The engine of the Calculator. Use + - \* and / to create a formula for your calculation element, and then use totals at the bottom of the template to perform complex calculations.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073782/6766fb7c9bfd4758777feb4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72f8bc394655a05b3dffd6c06d5bdebe2760694690b0dd35fa2cc6cef46ae846&req=fCguFs59moldFb4f3HP0gKo10EzZfChSn2RT5ltEQvYC6uE2MRJevb%2F1USYe%0AgmeCLcDfNk%2B2%2Fyi72Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073782/6766fb7c9bfd4758777feb4d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72f8bc394655a05b3dffd6c06d5bdebe2760694690b0dd35fa2cc6cef46ae846&req=fCguFs59moldFb4f3HP0gKo10EzZfChSn2RT5ltEQvYC6uE2MRJevb%2F1USYe%0AgmeCLcDfNk%2B2%2Fyi72Q%3D%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073912/e940912f140dff678836b35a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0c73d5db682062582b9159be69c7e876336ba4029778985a9f654e4e3d67e7b5&req=fCguFs59lIBdFb4f3HP0gEhgB1HKYK5zZfpnZll50CkIoJhmf%2Fj1P6CV5rGD%0ACzMJijpIxv6IwT1bJQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889073912/e940912f140dff678836b35a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0c73d5db682062582b9159be69c7e876336ba4029778985a9f654e4e3d67e7b5&req=fCguFs59lIBdFb4f3HP0gEhgB1HKYK5zZfpnZll50CkIoJhmf%2Fj1P6CV5rGD%0ACzMJijpIxv6IwT1bJQ%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Configuring Rows
================

Once you have added at least one column, you can add a Row below your column list.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889068229/e2c09f7bc2c6bd211abff30d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=530475eb038443dc44dfd357598fc942c1a3086140a597b8da6eefa747ed1740&req=fCguFs92n4NWFb4f3HP0gBtuhYfaR0OotgPoJayU%2FrDr%2FyWzS%2FArBdXWsC%2Bt%0AZvu911e%2BMzsh%2FYu1Sw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/889068229/e2c09f7bc2c6bd211abff30d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=530475eb038443dc44dfd357598fc942c1a3086140a597b8da6eefa747ed1740&req=fCguFs92n4NWFb4f3HP0gBtuhYfaR0OotgPoJayU%2FrDr%2FyWzS%2FArBdXWsC%2Bt%0AZvu911e%2BMzsh%2FYu1Sw%3D%3D%0A)

Each row is given a number that you can use to reference a specific cell in a calculation, e.g., A1, B1, C1. You can prefill the form here by editing individual values in any label, number or dropdown row. If you have selected Configured per row on any columns, you will see a cog next to each section you can configure.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896668643/f8a8dcfea1ce37f90209904a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45975aa153edc8f971dca767a69180f1f4c087cac99fbad68592a5897194e3c7&req=fCkhEM92m4VcFb4f3HP0gFYhq8ZpmyzDiUCTk7F3imtiZoApzJClbLdzob8Z%0APSK8HEPEu2FHNrAG%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896668643/f8a8dcfea1ce37f90209904a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=45975aa153edc8f971dca767a69180f1f4c087cac99fbad68592a5897194e3c7&req=fCkhEM92m4VcFb4f3HP0gFYhq8ZpmyzDiUCTk7F3imtiZoApzJClbLdzob8Z%0APSK8HEPEu2FHNrAG%2Fw%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

* * *

Totals
======

In the Totals section, you will find a preset calculation for a Grand Total (every value figure added together) and column totals. If you don't want these to display, untick the Display box.

Use the **Add** button to create your own calculations.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896669526/ee55a51ff7dba807a91aef9f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d0fd6bdf3bfecf5447ad5ba595b2f8da00a2baeb7e1656174becdc6bf2b5347&req=fCkhEM93mINZFb4f3HP0gCG54KpHzdnb6LGf2ty9Fkv5wk7akDuUpRvPmKFd%0AKuW7vogu%2B6fV0UdnKg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/896669526/ee55a51ff7dba807a91aef9f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8d0fd6bdf3bfecf5447ad5ba595b2f8da00a2baeb7e1656174becdc6bf2b5347&req=fCkhEM93mINZFb4f3HP0gCG54KpHzdnb6LGf2ty9Fkv5wk7akDuUpRvPmKFd%0AKuW7vogu%2B6fV0UdnKg%3D%3D%0A)

* * *

Example Templates
=================

Included at the bottom of this article are samples of an NDIS budget intended for service agreements and a BMI calculator.

Did you know you can insert these examples into your Clinical Note templates without starting from scratch? Hover over an element in your existing template and use the plus icon to add another template directly below.

PDF Templates

PDF Templates
=============

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Creating PDF Templates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8682991-pdf-templates#h_bc0269e5b5)

[Using PDF Template on Patient Files](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8682991-pdf-templates#h_d0f2f6db0b)

Creating PDF Templates
======================

To create PDF Templates, go to Settings > Templates > PDF Templates.

Select **Add** Template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903001214/3292d6ef449b6cef338ac9f8/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.49.23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f6b76a885cbc65c8828f45cc41d16246f56a16c0b72b2023faf0ae5fe696be9&req=fSAkFsl%2Fn4BbFb4f3HP0gIWxgLnk%2F4XNtlDYRHgXGu8HOwITaDDmwPl4DAeI%0A5SO5dcdbiW7maX62JA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903001214/3292d6ef449b6cef338ac9f8/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.49.23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1f6b76a885cbc65c8828f45cc41d16246f56a16c0b72b2023faf0ae5fe696be9&req=fSAkFsl%2Fn4BbFb4f3HP0gIWxgLnk%2F4XNtlDYRHgXGu8HOwITaDDmwPl4DAeI%0A5SO5dcdbiW7maX62JA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Open** button if you have an existing PDF form that you wish to import.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903001154/e443fd4b88a91ca536d1e600/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.49.11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c45c1e3670564a04f3ad5d117113d785bafcf8cb9a51175182753de82e432ba1&req=fSAkFsl%2FnIRbFb4f3HP0gM8vtBMwOpAz1QqahXLZsIaHRU0lXH5o%2BpBkXZwn%0AzB%2BofsUUj39Uk51QTQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903001154/e443fd4b88a91ca536d1e600/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.49.11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c45c1e3670564a04f3ad5d117113d785bafcf8cb9a51175182753de82e432ba1&req=fSAkFsl%2FnIRbFb4f3HP0gM8vtBMwOpAz1QqahXLZsIaHRU0lXH5o%2BpBkXZwn%0AzB%2BofsUUj39Uk51QTQ%3D%3D%0A)

If your PDF has fillable fields, consider prepopulating patient data by inserting merge fields using the row of merge field drop-downs.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/902999868/fdfc4b963d16a8caf50bb7e9/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.45.45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e7da91ada82cc216a41cc2f8e92892fd6e8ed08e21b6ecf28fa4b1867eed3d0e&req=fSAlH8B3lYdXFb4f3HP0gGW806WiJu1DbjGK6ZAJSGCyw528YlGx%2Fdt31zWO%0ALVEjXLPlew1mN3zuhw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/902999868/fdfc4b963d16a8caf50bb7e9/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.45.45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e7da91ada82cc216a41cc2f8e92892fd6e8ed08e21b6ecf28fa4b1867eed3d0e&req=fSAlH8B3lYdXFb4f3HP0gGW806WiJu1DbjGK6ZAJSGCyw528YlGx%2Fdt31zWO%0ALVEjXLPlew1mN3zuhw%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting a merge field from a drop-down, you must place your cursor in the corresponding fillable field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/902999751/d59dc1f2039f2a9f0a9f32de/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.45.28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef167383981f55ce6adeb92099e295e7cea6991d48a983ed9886de4ce615bad7&req=fSAlH8B3moReFb4f3HP0gLEJT8Jtr00t7RbO2eU%2FSzLD0YbD2Vv7Kj4Efhhi%0ATUOrL5RPEBgP1EmG5A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/902999751/d59dc1f2039f2a9f0a9f32de/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.45.28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ef167383981f55ce6adeb92099e295e7cea6991d48a983ed9886de4ce615bad7&req=fSAlH8B3moReFb4f3HP0gLEJT8Jtr00t7RbO2eU%2FSzLD0YbD2Vv7Kj4Efhhi%0ATUOrL5RPEBgP1EmG5A%3D%3D%0A)

Select a fillable field in the template to insert the relevant merge field.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903001094/b1004aa6eff175f1f0a3b421/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.48.46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14de210a984096703901375f51ebead5c144e4a87992a00791cccdd9a6613485&req=fSAkFsl%2FnYhbFb4f3HP0gPc%2FHxr62R6874NTXNaTrghvHUez0Y8up8d1NqtS%0At1ZWzmZsBuyHXpAoXA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/903001094/b1004aa6eff175f1f0a3b421/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.48.46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14de210a984096703901375f51ebead5c144e4a87992a00791cccdd9a6613485&req=fSAkFsl%2FnYhbFb4f3HP0gPc%2FHxr62R6874NTXNaTrghvHUez0Y8up8d1NqtS%0At1ZWzmZsBuyHXpAoXA%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

Using PDF Template on Patient Files
===================================

PDF Templates can be used from the Files tab of patient records.

Use the drop-down menu to select from existing templates.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/902999551/dca1ba4ffceab15e7354c1cc/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.44.55.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4800ee822f713ae645e521f36c948e42d89aada9b664290e62f4ee04281c5450&req=fSAlH8B3mIReFb4f3HP0gDDTcIDkH6s5BRN8c4nPS772L7jEp1f0hWuw1CtH%0ArUlKgIl6dOBxIGjaCg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/902999551/dca1ba4ffceab15e7354c1cc/CleanShot+2023-12-07+at+15.44.55.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4800ee822f713ae645e521f36c948e42d89aada9b664290e62f4ee04281c5450&req=fSAlH8B3mIReFb4f3HP0gDDTcIDkH6s5BRN8c4nPS772L7jEp1f0hWuw1CtH%0ArUlKgIl6dOBxIGjaCg%3D%3D%0A)

After selecting a template, any merge fields will be populated with patient data where relevant.

Secure Messaging

Secure Messaging
================

Updated over 7 months ago

Table of contents

[HealthLink](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8701219-secure-messaging#h_ef2060062d)

[Medical Objects](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8701219-secure-messaging#h_5bb0d52c09)

PracSuite does not currently integrate with HL7 secure messaging platforms. For information on how to send and receive secure messages between health professionals externally to PracSuite, please contact each secure messaging vendor directly.

**HealthLink**
==============

HealthLink is the most widely used secure messaging platform in Australia. The My HealthLink Portal is designed for allied health practitioners to manually send secure messages externally from PracSuite.

[Click here for more information](https://www.healthlink.com.au/solutions/allied-health/)
 regarding HealthLink options for allied health practitioners.

**Medical Objects**
===================

Medical Objects offers a desktop client app and plug-in with Microsoft Word. After composing a letter within PracSuite, you can download and open it in Microsoft Word to send it via the Medical Objects plug-in.

[Click here for more information](https://www.medicalobjects.com/allied-health/secure-messaging/)
 regarding Medical Objects for allied health practitioners.

Microsoft Teams Meeting Integration

Microsoft Teams Meeting Integration
===================================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Connecting a Teams Account with PracSuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8789270-microsoft-teams-meeting-integration#h_65c56c24f8)

[Telehealth Appointment Types](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8789270-microsoft-teams-meeting-integration#h_a4140d1c03)

[Accessing Teams Links via the Appointment Book](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8789270-microsoft-teams-meeting-integration#h_15f70ef555)

[Adding Teams Links to SMS & Email Templates](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8789270-microsoft-teams-meeting-integration#h_bc6929ac06)

The Microsoft Teams integration automatically creates Microsoft Teams meeting links for telehealth appointment types in PracSuite. Corresponding meetings in Microsoft Teams will automatically be created, rescheduled and cancelled for all telehealth Appointment Types in PracSuite.

This integration is only compatible with Microsoft Teams for Work or School plans. It is not available for the free version of Microsoft Teams.

Connecting a Teams Account with PracSuite
=========================================

Teams accounts you wish to use in PracSuite must be added in [Settings > Integrations > Teams.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/teams)

Select **Add** to start the process.

Select **Continue** to be redirected to log in with your Microsoft account.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/960274215/188d5c6aea91149e1d70040d/CleanShot+2024-02-12+at+09.30.47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9aa72a87b4a9d4085df029e2f57b5a96adfb3259cfbeda94f2c35758711e2fab&req=fSYnFM56n4BaFb4f3HP0gIvnZQ3gRZDgDbLE44a%2BrCJ3lW48zRYi8yRDQzty%0A1XnPXDgad7aj3fCtqA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/960274215/188d5c6aea91149e1d70040d/CleanShot+2024-02-12+at+09.30.47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9aa72a87b4a9d4085df029e2f57b5a96adfb3259cfbeda94f2c35758711e2fab&req=fSYnFM56n4BaFb4f3HP0gIvnZQ3gRZDgDbLE44a%2BrCJ3lW48zRYi8yRDQzty%0A1XnPXDgad7aj3fCtqA%3D%3D%0A)

Log in with the Microsoft account you wish to connect with PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/960277246/2ae46ab5bb8432a3387ad9a7/CleanShot+2024-02-12+at+09.36.15.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bca91851091853ca34677bc98bbdade84659f1141aae1e4f9786e4a8bc1378b7&req=fSYnFM55n4VZFb4f3HP0gFP4IpTeTPiM5tAwzOaOT81ehqND2XKmnHPW%2Fsp4%0AM9kTwsR1ZUwikqZXhg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/960277246/2ae46ab5bb8432a3387ad9a7/CleanShot+2024-02-12+at+09.36.15.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bca91851091853ca34677bc98bbdade84659f1141aae1e4f9786e4a8bc1378b7&req=fSYnFM55n4VZFb4f3HP0gFP4IpTeTPiM5tAwzOaOT81ehqND2XKmnHPW%2Fsp4%0AM9kTwsR1ZUwikqZXhg%3D%3D%0A)

You will be redirected back to PracSuite.

Once the account is linked with PracSuite, you can assign the account to specific practitioners.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/960274538/20a1596704ded006d3d8d193/CleanShot+2024-02-12+at+09.31.18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dc67000cfef4354123d950db3e9359dd8a2445b8fdb8dd442d99abdf480f31df&req=fSYnFM56mIJXFb4f3HP0gHpOuBHb%2FqhsVemzGvXXeZmnalCH15DxHFWzlzGG%0Apia71oJPG%2BAw6I9mGQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/960274538/20a1596704ded006d3d8d193/CleanShot+2024-02-12+at+09.31.18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dc67000cfef4354123d950db3e9359dd8a2445b8fdb8dd442d99abdf480f31df&req=fSYnFM56mIJXFb4f3HP0gHpOuBHb%2FqhsVemzGvXXeZmnalCH15DxHFWzlzGG%0Apia71oJPG%2BAw6I9mGQ%3D%3D%0A)

Telehealth features via Teams will be enabled for that practitioner when saving.

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Telehealth Appointment Types
============================

Teams links will only be created for Appointment Types enabled for telehealth. To confirm whether your telehealth appointments are set up correctly, go to [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
.

Ensure that the **Telehealth appointment** option is enabled for all appointment types Teams links should be automatically created for.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957936430/b776f96da4b828303a6c1047/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+11.49.41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e79ed619aa0729d109b5120f67da245f59ddac8880461b65876356d87dfe6d7&req=fSUgH8p4mYJfFb4f3HP0gMErrP1zzgEGTdCYwYIk0FAjX7QjKguMNHRHlNQp%0ArK%2BN5DDhaF6XvFdQoQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957936430/b776f96da4b828303a6c1047/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+11.49.41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e79ed619aa0729d109b5120f67da245f59ddac8880461b65876356d87dfe6d7&req=fSUgH8p4mYJfFb4f3HP0gMErrP1zzgEGTdCYwYIk0FAjX7QjKguMNHRHlNQp%0ArK%2BN5DDhaF6XvFdQoQ%3D%3D%0A)

Accessing Teams Links via the Appointment Book
==============================================

When booking telehealth appointment types, Teams meeting links will automatically be created. When rescheduling or cancelling telehealth appointments, the corresponding Teams meetings will also be updated.

You will see the following on the Appointment Details screen before booking appointments.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957991382/bd0db3a60cc0f13c4ebf4c5d/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+14.15.09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df451c7856d154674f38a46107993e14d9ac9492a6463c725f5fb12e68280322&req=fSUgH8B%2FnoldFb4f3HP0gOemzKVZz3ohgw4z1iSmjyIqVeC3Hf9ffkm1yfZG%0AWEUON8yQfSKa85Ymow%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957991382/bd0db3a60cc0f13c4ebf4c5d/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+14.15.09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df451c7856d154674f38a46107993e14d9ac9492a6463c725f5fb12e68280322&req=fSUgH8B%2FnoldFb4f3HP0gOemzKVZz3ohgw4z1iSmjyIqVeC3Hf9ffkm1yfZG%0AWEUON8yQfSKa85Ymow%3D%3D%0A)

Teams links will appear in this area after the appointment has been booked.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/960278391/b61410a35361ec01203dfd64/CleanShot+2024-02-12+at+09.40.19.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8bb660cd7052a102ffe1fad0ebd3cab272f785ad11bf3ee999ba8ba03473555&req=fSYnFM52noheFb4f3HP0gIN2jp5tQeS8nA545PAPiGqvwDDbvfZgASQ2LhYg%0AV3BPPLXk7zIg2AJaPw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/960278391/b61410a35361ec01203dfd64/CleanShot+2024-02-12+at+09.40.19.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8bb660cd7052a102ffe1fad0ebd3cab272f785ad11bf3ee999ba8ba03473555&req=fSYnFM52noheFb4f3HP0gIN2jp5tQeS8nA545PAPiGqvwDDbvfZgASQ2LhYg%0AV3BPPLXk7zIg2AJaPw%3D%3D%0A)

The Teams link can also be accessed from the Telehealth section of the appointment menu.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957991794/024083dd1a7b3db47d252e52/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+14.15.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a6ff0cc1f89391e57afa9ca36c267ba78f4c97be690ca938bd675159412456a&req=fSUgH8B%2FmohbFb4f3HP0gNzDfb9%2FFDnkWd15bkuJOHXJikv9EnsjUZk9DK6u%0ATB62VteUgWvLFST2Aw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957991794/024083dd1a7b3db47d252e52/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+14.15.54.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a6ff0cc1f89391e57afa9ca36c267ba78f4c97be690ca938bd675159412456a&req=fSUgH8B%2FmohbFb4f3HP0gNzDfb9%2FFDnkWd15bkuJOHXJikv9EnsjUZk9DK6u%0ATB62VteUgWvLFST2Aw%3D%3D%0A)

Use the open button to quickly join the meeting via the Teams app.

Adding Teams Links to SMS & Email Templates
===========================================

The following merge fields are available to include in your SMS & Email templates.

<<AppointmentTelehealthLink>> - Inserts the patient's telehealth link

<<AppointmentTelehealthLinkPrac>> - Inserts the practitioner's telehealth link

You will be redirected back to PracSuite.

Once the account is linked with PracSuite, you can assign the account to specific practitioners.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955653647/9482ba0441f533d16b5f30c5/CleanShot+2024-02-07+at+12.27.05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ccacf61ccccb374c2ba1c9b231d9fb0476dee8945961be84032146ee61b183b&req=fSUiEMx9m4VYFb4f3HP0gKbjxxpGhZL%2BPOrygCbLjXmt5%2FdEkEzXDzuplXk6%0A6O52anuVlhEmfaE2RQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955653647/9482ba0441f533d16b5f30c5/CleanShot+2024-02-07+at+12.27.05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1ccacf61ccccb374c2ba1c9b231d9fb0476dee8945961be84032146ee61b183b&req=fSUiEMx9m4VYFb4f3HP0gKbjxxpGhZL%2BPOrygCbLjXmt5%2FdEkEzXDzuplXk6%0A6O52anuVlhEmfaE2RQ%3D%3D%0A)

Telehealth features via Zoom will be enabled for that practitioner when saving.

Select **Save** to finalise your changes.

Telehealth Appointment Types
============================

Zoom links will only be created for Appointment Types enabled for telehealth. To confirm whether your telehealth appointments are set up correctly, go to [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
.

Ensure that the **Telehealth appointment** option is enabled for all appointment types Zoom links should be automatically created for.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957936430/b776f96da4b828303a6c1047/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+11.49.41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e79ed619aa0729d109b5120f67da245f59ddac8880461b65876356d87dfe6d7&req=fSUgH8p4mYJfFb4f3HP0gMErrP1zzgEGTdCYwYIk0FAjX7QjKguMNHRHlNQp%0ArK%2BN5DDhaF6XvFdQoQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957936430/b776f96da4b828303a6c1047/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+11.49.41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8e79ed619aa0729d109b5120f67da245f59ddac8880461b65876356d87dfe6d7&req=fSUgH8p4mYJfFb4f3HP0gMErrP1zzgEGTdCYwYIk0FAjX7QjKguMNHRHlNQp%0ArK%2BN5DDhaF6XvFdQoQ%3D%3D%0A)

Zoom links will appear in this area after the appointment has been booked.

Adding Zoom Links to SMS & Email Templates
==========================================

The following merge fields are available to include in your SMS & Email templates.

<<AppointmentTelehealthLink>> - Inserts the patient's telehealth link

<<AppointmentTelehealthLinkPrac>> - Inserts the practitioner's telehealth link

Disabling the Zoom Integration
==============================

To remove and disable the integration for a particular Zoom account, go to [Settings > Integrations > Zoom](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/zoom)
.

Select **Edit** and then hover over the Zoom account you wish to remove from PracSuite. Select the Delete icon.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/958991701/aafe3de12531ae32cb120f49/CleanShot+2024-02-10+at+12.43.50%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ceefd914bbd36744e8d3aef58179c75de158b605475e97c3f6c99e9175531000&req=fSUvH8B%2FmoFeFb4f3HP0gNyXnjJzBLklityAqWOmJf1chLDzZDASDuKU0AOD%0AtekSNHp6ij1pF%2Bhi%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/958991701/aafe3de12531ae32cb120f49/CleanShot+2024-02-10+at+12.43.50%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ceefd914bbd36744e8d3aef58179c75de158b605475e97c3f6c99e9175531000&req=fSUvH8B%2FmoFeFb4f3HP0gNyXnjJzBLklityAqWOmJf1chLDzZDASDuKU0AOD%0AtekSNHp6ij1pF%2Bhi%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)

Click **Save** to finalise your changes.

The Zoom integration will also be disabled in PracSuite if it's removed via [your list of installed apps](https://marketplace.zoom.us/user/installed)
 on the Zoom Marketplace.

Triggering a Custom HTML Tag via Google Tag Manager

Triggering a Custom HTML Tag via Google Tag Manager
===================================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[1\. Create a variable to store the nonce value](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8797681-triggering-a-custom-html-tag-via-google-tag-manager#h_9331c8bf55)

[2\. Confirm that the variable is working](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8797681-triggering-a-custom-html-tag-via-google-tag-manager#h_933a9ef1e3)

[3\. Apply the nonce parameter to your existing Custom HTML Tags.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8797681-triggering-a-custom-html-tag-via-google-tag-manager#h_72af6f40ff)

The PracSuite online booking site has a strict CSP (Content Security Policy) to protect practice security and patient privacy. By default, this will block and prevent custom HTML scripts from firing via Google Tag Manager (GTM).

Official advice from Google regarding using a CSP with Tag Manager [can be found here](https://developers.google.com/tag-platform/security/guides/csp)
, however you can find some basic steps on navigating this with the PracSuite booking site below.

**If you wish to trigger Custom HTML using Google Tag Manager, you must contact Smartsoft and request that the ability to run custom GTM scripts be enabled on the associated PracSuite account.**

After this feature has been enabled by Smartsoft, any Custom HTML tags triggered in Google Tag Manager must also be modified to include a `nonce` parameter, which will authorise custom scripts to be run on the PracSuite booking site.

1\. Create a variable to store the nonce value
==============================================

After ensuring that Smartsoft has enabled the ability to run custom GTM scripts on the booking site, the first step is to create a User-Defined Variable in the relevant GTM account.

In the GTM account, select **Variables** on the left-hand side, and create a new variable.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929271216/c4a3c313e9222483daa133a8/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.31.53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=22c22dc25b841e08c4b11ef93c8316a3b88d0c4a6042c0c6d6bdd5c62b87084b&req=fSIuFM5%2Fn4BZFb4f3HP0gHmf8TVX8NX30LaQnismki9A%2F0ErH8GIM0tejgwE%0Af81zVNqjqdB1DJFlEA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929271216/c4a3c313e9222483daa133a8/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.31.53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=22c22dc25b841e08c4b11ef93c8316a3b88d0c4a6042c0c6d6bdd5c62b87084b&req=fSIuFM5%2Fn4BZFb4f3HP0gHmf8TVX8NX30LaQnismki9A%2F0ErH8GIM0tejgwE%0Af81zVNqjqdB1DJFlEA%3D%3D%0A)

Select the **Edit pencil** to configure the new variable.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929272704/6c29c57557ac6a5a59e6d533/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.37.14.png?expires=1771821900&signature=98c665bdbfbdab74ff57cb2e385e4bbb5b7b8ed1f795400bd4a3ee2b1fbe920e&req=fSIuFM58moFbFb4f3HP0gCyvFGEMZJhVLVRGXFVwWb0wZ8%2BSgslWq18%2FVsUh%0AVw4V4ygogLVtpc7WPA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929272704/6c29c57557ac6a5a59e6d533/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.37.14.png?expires=1771821900&signature=98c665bdbfbdab74ff57cb2e385e4bbb5b7b8ed1f795400bd4a3ee2b1fbe920e&req=fSIuFM58moFbFb4f3HP0gCyvFGEMZJhVLVRGXFVwWb0wZ8%2BSgslWq18%2FVsUh%0AVw4V4ygogLVtpc7WPA%3D%3D%0A)

Select **DOM element**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929272797/02dd50b40943e7361ae6d860/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.37.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=509f4ed4e0ba9c3157652a875fb986c2fb6c2c362fc2f27f022afbb68f0b8a17&req=fSIuFM58mohYFb4f3HP0gAa4At1qIL4G3FeDd3o2gYMjwlUNBOl0w2VV%2F5fb%0AQqWbTWNZMEyOm8xrZQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929272797/02dd50b40943e7361ae6d860/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.37.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=509f4ed4e0ba9c3157652a875fb986c2fb6c2c362fc2f27f022afbb68f0b8a17&req=fSIuFM58mohYFb4f3HP0gAa4At1qIL4G3FeDd3o2gYMjwlUNBOl0w2VV%2F5fb%0AQqWbTWNZMEyOm8xrZQ%3D%3D%0A)

Eneter `ps-staticjs` as the **Element ID** and `data-nonce` as the **Attribute Name.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929166110/1d25493563d5dd3a026c2137/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+09.43.05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=92c41f73ff31c4de122a269160e26a789f24e1ec5c36d0a31fa0e78a0e72f872&req=fSIuF894nIBfFb4f3HP0gK%2B2xz2lDQHVAPKI36C3yNkQTXLtV1ks3JIs%2B5uZ%0AN5GnIOzbTg6tpETiDQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929166110/1d25493563d5dd3a026c2137/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+09.43.05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=92c41f73ff31c4de122a269160e26a789f24e1ec5c36d0a31fa0e78a0e72f872&req=fSIuF894nIBfFb4f3HP0gK%2B2xz2lDQHVAPKI36C3yNkQTXLtV1ks3JIs%2B5uZ%0AN5GnIOzbTg6tpETiDQ%3D%3D%0A)

Select **Save** to finalise these changes.

2\. Confirm that the variable is working
========================================

_If you're familiar with adding nonce parameters, skip to step 3._

After creating the variable, it's best to confirm that the `nonce` value is being written to the `data-nonce` variable correctly.

To do this, we will create a new Tag that will be triggered on loading the booking site.

Select **Tags** on the left-hand side and select **New**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929276964/ae4da54f27621c7ca2ac9834/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.50.41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1d3bc1a3c50ac1687b02108ab65529252d827f1de4456634967ad2dbe3495d2c&req=fSIuFM54lIdbFb4f3HP0gEIqigR3iBKHu%2F5MzjutoTifLzcTt36nTqM2UL90%0AxCW%2B4ch1UySdlNLq4w%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929276964/ae4da54f27621c7ca2ac9834/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.50.41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1d3bc1a3c50ac1687b02108ab65529252d827f1de4456634967ad2dbe3495d2c&req=fSIuFM54lIdbFb4f3HP0gEIqigR3iBKHu%2F5MzjutoTifLzcTt36nTqM2UL90%0AxCW%2B4ch1UySdlNLq4w%3D%3D%0A)

In the Tag Configuration section, select **Custom HTML**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929277189/9d5a3c46ee27b52c5c3decae/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.51.59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f54e3df9336fc0d37d02bfe5e3cb8b1732c069326e6e4a9ed091279de2c4fccb&req=fSIuFM55nIlWFb4f3HP0gAWJ2o4XZTg0Auk1UmlVErMOJu6cNLvLtiInKTx%2B%0ACk11qC6DAbPYv538nA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929277189/9d5a3c46ee27b52c5c3decae/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.51.59.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f54e3df9336fc0d37d02bfe5e3cb8b1732c069326e6e4a9ed091279de2c4fccb&req=fSIuFM55nIlWFb4f3HP0gAWJ2o4XZTg0Auk1UmlVErMOJu6cNLvLtiInKTx%2B%0ACk11qC6DAbPYv538nA%3D%3D%0A)

Paste in the code snippet below, which will allow you to confirm that the nonce value is being correctly stored in the `data-nonce` variable created in step 1 by writing it to the browser console.  
​

<script nonce="{{data-nonce}}">  
console.log("CSP-allowed script with nonce:", "{{data-nonce}}");  
</script>

Also, enable the **Support document.write** option at the bottom of the Tag Configuration window.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929165244/bdd8d065b2d27d33ed206f97/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+09.40.56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3758d8292c6fc81d102b535c2644c54f7d493a75da337576214165d9390fcd71&req=fSIuF897n4VbFb4f3HP0gFimVhPoHXGWMsvUrud4m0PT5%2Fj5UaMDUARPNErv%0AR1KbVwSXH%2FZjpQQF5g%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929165244/bdd8d065b2d27d33ed206f97/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+09.40.56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3758d8292c6fc81d102b535c2644c54f7d493a75da337576214165d9390fcd71&req=fSIuF897n4VbFb4f3HP0gFimVhPoHXGWMsvUrud4m0PT5%2Fj5UaMDUARPNErv%0AR1KbVwSXH%2FZjpQQF5g%3D%3D%0A)

**Save** this Tag and **Publish** these changes live..

If the steps above have been configured correctly, when loading the booking site, you should see the following text outputted to the browser console (displayed when pressing F12 on the keyboard).

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929274055/69d3fe2a700e7782b37dfc39/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.41.37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e35a59295b403ed19f306aee62e2720711cf48f0534bb749b179613f26947fb9&req=fSIuFM56nYRaFb4f3HP0gAE5zb9OI2eGNTaVZBQBDBp88iwhIsCT20hTxDVO%0A0VLgoNMINCmtCMGj%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929274055/69d3fe2a700e7782b37dfc39/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.41.37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e35a59295b403ed19f306aee62e2720711cf48f0534bb749b179613f26947fb9&req=fSIuFM56nYRaFb4f3HP0gAE5zb9OI2eGNTaVZBQBDBp88iwhIsCT20hTxDVO%0A0VLgoNMINCmtCMGj%2Bg%3D%3D%0A)

With the variable confirmed as working, it's best that you **pause** or **remove** the example Tag created during this step so that it no longer outputs the variable to the browser console.

3\. Apply the nonce parameter to your existing Custom HTML Tags.
================================================================

If the variable created in step 1 is working correctly, the final step is to add the `nonce="{{data-nonce}}"` parameter to your existing Custom HTML Tags.

An example is shown below. Be sure to enable the **Support document.write** option at the bottom of the Tag Configuration window.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929278428/b0bb343f04d6e8799ed088a4/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.56.05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d29453cb065cab3def22ab3f5c630adbe3ac488cb9472427ab5197163a9b3adb&req=fSIuFM52mYNXFb4f3HP0gIeQMhXskrDxG5WUDsIKUPecCFjlmMbp5u3Nw52P%0ASU1WEFYAteGK3X9pGg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/929278428/b0bb343f04d6e8799ed088a4/CleanShot+2024-01-10+at+14.56.05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d29453cb065cab3def22ab3f5c630adbe3ac488cb9472427ab5197163a9b3adb&req=fSIuFM52mYNXFb4f3HP0gIeQMhXskrDxG5WUDsIKUPecCFjlmMbp5u3Nw52P%0ASU1WEFYAteGK3X9pGg%3D%3D%0A)

Once the relevant Tags have been modified to include the `nonce` parameter, **Save** and **Publish** these changes in GTM.  
​

## Document 325 — Overview of Automatic SMS and Email features in PracSuite | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-325}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8859221-overview-of-automatic-sms-and-email-features-in-pracsuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8859221-overview-of-automatic-sms-and-email-features-in-pracsuite)

Overview of Automatic SMS and Email features in PracSuite

Overview of Automatic SMS and Email features in PracSuite
=========================================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Appointment Confirmations](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8859221-overview-of-automatic-sms-and-email-features-in-pracsuite#h_f5e1dab9f5)

[Appointment Reminders](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8859221-overview-of-automatic-sms-and-email-features-in-pracsuite#h_652b70ac4a)

[Appointment Follow-ups](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8859221-overview-of-automatic-sms-and-email-features-in-pracsuite#h_924dd3cc5b)

[Campaigns](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8859221-overview-of-automatic-sms-and-email-features-in-pracsuite#h_1f25b1c845)

[Scheduled Reports](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8859221-overview-of-automatic-sms-and-email-features-in-pracsuite#h_ea6cef954d)

[Scheduled SMS or Emails](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8859221-overview-of-automatic-sms-and-email-features-in-pracsuite#h_56745d7e57)

PracSuite has several ways to automatically send an email or SMS to patients or users based on:

*   The results of a report.
    
*   Past or future appointments.
    
*   A fixed or recurring schedule.
    

Below are the different types of automatic messaging that can be utilised in PracSuite and when to use them.

* * *

Appointment Confirmations
=========================

#### [Settings > Appointment > Confirmations](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/confirmations)

Appointment Confirmations can be used to send patients an SMS or email to the patient immediately after their appointment is created in PracSuite. Confirmations are best used to _confirm_ the details of an appointment, particularly if the appointment was made over the phone, and reduce any misunderstandings or miscommunications.

**Examples of when to use Confirmations:**

*   To confirm the details of an appointment made over the phone or in-person, avoiding miscommunications and other mistakes when booking.  
    ​
    
*   To send specific information or instructions to a patient depending on the appointment type, giving the patient time to follow your request.  
    ​  
    ​**Example 1:**  
    For an _Initial Appointment_, the confirmation can include additional information or an intake form for the patient to complete before the booking.  
    ​  
    ​**Example 2:**  
    For a treatment that requires _written consent_ or has _terms and conditions_ to acknowledge, the confirmation can include a consent form or link to your privacy policy etc.
    

  
For more information Confirmations please see:  
​[Automatic Appointment Confirmations](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)

* * *

Appointment Reminders
=====================

#### [Settings > Appointment Book > Reminders](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/reminders)

Appointment Reminders are sent to the patient at a specific schedule before the appointment. This can be an exact number of hours prior to the appointment, or a number of days prior to the appointment at a specific time (e.g. 1 day before the appointment at 10:00AM). This serves as a final reminder to patients who may have forgotten their appointment and can drastically reduce missed appointments.  
​  
Appointment Reminders can be configured to use specific email or SMS templates for each Businesses, Professions, Practitioners and Appointment Type. It is also possible to schedule multiple appointment reminders to send at different intervals before an appointment.

**Examples of when to use Reminders:**

*   As a reminder to the the patient the day before their appointment, including details or when and where the appointment is taking place.  
    ​
    
*   As a reminder of important information regarding their appointment.  
    ​  
    Examples:  
    \- A reminder to wear appropriate clothing for the treatment.
    
    \- Directions to parking.  
    \- Instructions to arrive 15 minutes prior to the appointment to complete an intake form or other documentation.  
    \- A reminder to bring equipment, a referral or other necessary items.  
    ​
    

For more information on Reminders please see:

[Enabling Automatic Email Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386614-enabling-automatic-email-reminders)

[Enabling Automatic SMS Appointment Reminders](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386530-enabling-automatic-sms-appointment-reminders)

* * *

Appointment Follow-ups
======================

#### [Settings > Appointment Book > Follow Ups](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/followups)

Appointment Follow-ups are used to schedule an email or SMS after an appointment has been completed, missed, or cancelled. Follow-ups can be used for marketing purposes, or to gather feedback from the patient regarding their visit to the clinic.

**Examples of when to use Follow Ups:**

*   Sending a 'Thank you for visiting' message.
    
*   Sending the patient a survey or requesting an online review.
    
*   Automatically contacting a patient to re-schedule a missed appointment.
    

For more information on Follow Ups please see:  
​[Appointment Follow-ups](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6610735-appointment-follow-ups)

* * *

Campaigns
=========

#### [Reports > Campaigns](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/campaigns)

Campaigns are used to automatically SMS or emails patients based on the results of a saved report, typically on a recurring basis.

For example, a campaign could be configured to:

*   Run the Birthday List every day, to identify all patients with a birthday 'today'.
    
*   Send those patients an SMS or email to wish them a happy birthday.
    

It is important to understand that a campaign is based on the results of your report at the time of sending. _i.e. if you create a campaign to send at 10:00AM on the last day of each month, it will be sent to patients who appear in that report at that time._

**Other examples of when to use Campaigns:**

*   General marketing and promotions (using the Patient List).
    
*   Re-engaging with Inactive patients (using the Active/Inactive Patients report).
    
*   Automating your Recalls to message patients on a schedule (using the Recalls report).
    

💡**Note:** Campaigns can only be sent to patients that are opted into SMS and email marketing.

For more information on Campaigns please see:  
​[Creating Email & SMS Campaigns](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/6591245-creating-email-sms-campaigns)

* * *

Scheduled Reports
=================

#### [Reports > Scheduled Reports](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/scheduled)

Scheduled Report are used to email a PracSuite report (in PDF or Excel format) to a user on a specific schedule.

**Examples of when to use Scheduled Reports:**

*   As a business owner or practice manager, reports can be scheduled to send each week, fortnight or month to monitor business performance and other metrics.  
    ​
    
*   As an accountant or bookkeeper, reports for each accounting period can be scheduled to send automatically and reduce the need to manual reporting.  
    ​
    
*   As a practitioner, a Day List can be sent each morning to show their upcoming appointments for the day. A Billings Report could also be scheduled each week to summarise the services provided and their expected earnings.  
    ​
    
*   As a receptionist, the Appointment Activity report can be scheduled to show which patients missed an appointment this week and require a follow-up.
    

For more information on Scheduled Reports please see:  
​[How to Create a Scheduled Report](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5098313-how-to-create-a-scheduled-report)

* * *

Scheduled SMS or Emails
=======================

[Tools > SMS > Scheduled SMS](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/scheduledsms)
 or [Tools > Email > Scheduled Emails](https://app.pracsuite.com/tools/scheduledemails)
  
​  
Lastly, when manually sending an SMS or Email it is possible to set a 'Scheduled Send' at a specific date and time, which can then be managed in the Tools area as linked above. This will then automatically deliver that message at the specified time.

**Examples of when to use Schedule Send:**

*   When the message is being written for an ad-hoc purpose but needs to be delivered at a specific time.  
    ​
    
*   When a message is being written ad-hoc, but it's an inappropriate time to message (such as late at night) and you'd like it to be received during polite hours.
    

* * *

[Enabling Automatic Email Appointment Reminders](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4386614-enabling-automatic-email-appointment-reminders)
