## Document 326 — Adding Locum Practitioners | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-326}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8905467-adding-locum-practitioners](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8905467-adding-locum-practitioners)

[Skip to main content](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8905467-adding-locum-practitioners#main-content)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Your PracSuite Subscription](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3984771-your-pracsuite-subscription)

Adding Locum Practitioners

Adding Locum Practitioners
==========================

Updated over 2 years ago

If you have a locum practitioner attending the practice, they will require a dedicated practitioner file with their relevant provider number.

Creating additional practitioner files does impact your monthly PracSuite subscription fee.

**Charges for Locum Practitioners**

If you wish to reduce fees for locums, you should avoid marking their practitioner file as active until as close to their start date as possible and continue to book appointments in the primary practitioner's column.

When creating a new practitioner file, you will have the option to create the file, but leave it marked as inactive so that it doesn't impact your subscription fee.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/953232140/744a472154f1cdbbe530a57d/CleanShot+2024-02-05+at+10.18.09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e14dd8df28c27082ecaaeba6c7038de9cc060ac0246379cfc0276d8995a8af40&req=fSUkFMp8nIVfFb4f3HP0gJgF3zncbGl4xcYDZQFQXM5%2BZpNwNLbmriDBZT3K%0ABvY9SVXlTmsgHGx5ZA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/953232140/744a472154f1cdbbe530a57d/CleanShot+2024-02-05+at+10.18.09.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e14dd8df28c27082ecaaeba6c7038de9cc060ac0246379cfc0276d8995a8af40&req=fSUkFMp8nIVfFb4f3HP0gJgF3zncbGl4xcYDZQFQXM5%2BZpNwNLbmriDBZT3K%0ABvY9SVXlTmsgHGx5ZA%3D%3D%0A)

When you're ready for the locum's practitioner file to become active, you can create a new file or mark an existing file for them as active in [Settings > Practitioners.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/practitioners)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/953233179/98b3e5f7267fda8254e3f26c/CleanShot+2024-02-05+at+10.22.12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=92ebb563d8ed2252011c3cc3732fc6cf2fafac18d85132c6a840aeecf1f00796&req=fSUkFMp9nIZWFb4f3HP0gHdezilbnrkXrYFCn8M5r4pxAZaT5LzvUwcuRCJB%0AyqQGuG470pwTutP8bQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/953233179/98b3e5f7267fda8254e3f26c/CleanShot+2024-02-05+at+10.22.12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=92ebb563d8ed2252011c3cc3732fc6cf2fafac18d85132c6a840aeecf1f00796&req=fSUkFMp9nIZWFb4f3HP0gHdezilbnrkXrYFCn8M5r4pxAZaT5LzvUwcuRCJB%0AyqQGuG470pwTutP8bQ%3D%3D%0A)

Once the locum's practitioner file is active, you can move appointments from the original practitioner's column to the locum's column. The easiest way to do this is by dragging and dropping the appointments.

You should also consider the following:

*   Ruling out the main practitioner's column for the duration of their absence using a rule out, Day Off or Roster Override.
    
*   Enabling the locum practitioner file for online booking (if applicable)

## Document 327 — Editing a patient's appointments in bulk | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-327}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8913831-editing-a-patient-s-appointments-in-bulk](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8913831-editing-a-patient-s-appointments-in-bulk)

Editing a patient's appointments in bulk

Editing a patient's appointments in bulk
========================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Table of contents

[Editing All Future Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8913831-editing-a-patient-s-appointments-in-bulk#h_59174ecd20)

[Editing Specific Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8913831-editing-a-patient-s-appointments-in-bulk#h_8ab632e3b5)

[Editing Appointment Details](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8913831-editing-a-patient-s-appointments-in-bulk#h_f59ee3ffad)

From the Appointments tab of that patient file, you can edit appointments in bulk, which can be handy if you need to update all appointments to a new type or practitioner.

Note that this function is not available for group appointments.

Begin by opening the patient file and heading to the Appointments tab.

Editing All Future Appointments
===============================

To edit all future appointments, select the **Edit Appointments** button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955581990/cbeaf94fe31ddcb54851550a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8b124bb723c58ed04096b422eab38cb90485b986f0ed026dd9e7d273f49e02c&req=fSUiE8F%2FlIhfFb4f3HP0gDxXwfDhAlK%2BmA1z1V9RjsI7MBDBYQyRGH3VUue3%0A3RRTSrb4L8J%2Bnxfs4A%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955581990/cbeaf94fe31ddcb54851550a/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d8b124bb723c58ed04096b422eab38cb90485b986f0ed026dd9e7d273f49e02c&req=fSUiE8F%2FlIhfFb4f3HP0gDxXwfDhAlK%2BmA1z1V9RjsI7MBDBYQyRGH3VUue3%0A3RRTSrb4L8J%2Bnxfs4A%3D%3D%0A)

Editing Specific Appointments
=============================

To edit select appointments in bulk, usethe checkboxes to select which appointments you would like to edit and then select **Edit Selected Appointments**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955582338/dd4f41a0521594528d54fc10/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b00b865fd20bbed9077b2ababf4f591c72616c150591e3cca057a114e319e285&req=fSUiE8F8noJXFb4f3HP0gI2ofq%2Fht2x8V%2FiBZsv59wmx3vhlf6E2mgzbghQ2%0AogtgByFbKtt6Mp%2FPVw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955582338/dd4f41a0521594528d54fc10/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b00b865fd20bbed9077b2ababf4f591c72616c150591e3cca057a114e319e285&req=fSUiE8F8noJXFb4f3HP0gI2ofq%2Fht2x8V%2FiBZsv59wmx3vhlf6E2mgzbghQ2%0AogtgByFbKtt6Mp%2FPVw%3D%3D%0A)

Editing Appointment Details
===========================

You will be taken to the appointment book and see a list of the patient's appointments you can then edit where you can update the **Date, Time, Practitioner - Business, Profession, Appointment Type, Resources, Duration and Item Code**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955616599/e3e3f0f06673169d91aada4e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2d7e8af9480392f78d2149b2fc037081cbc38332c5e02409f650cf3ed5b7c505&req=fSUiEMh4mIhWFb4f3HP0gDJzwSeA5EtBMld534e9sYzTKk5V0INwD7qRZ6vF%0Apoa6f70504p3FYZmlQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955616599/e3e3f0f06673169d91aada4e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2d7e8af9480392f78d2149b2fc037081cbc38332c5e02409f650cf3ed5b7c505&req=fSUiEMh4mIhWFb4f3HP0gDJzwSeA5EtBMld534e9sYzTKk5V0INwD7qRZ6vF%0Apoa6f70504p3FYZmlQ%3D%3D%0A)

Hover over the three-dot menu on an appointment row to apply all settings to every other appointment you are editing, excluding the date. This allows you to quickly move all appointments to a specific practitioner or update the item code for all appointments, etc.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955619092/7bad50a1de8c6afff1646265/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09fe8f001896d772c9a9f65ffc49b956bcecd376f97eb1cbe114ea426d636a5e&req=fSUiEMh3nYhdFb4f3HP0gFBfjGewYk9qv025BZZ0HN3OlA6HNshGxcMTLBI8%0Agn677hflnfBEex8Klw%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955619092/7bad50a1de8c6afff1646265/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=09fe8f001896d772c9a9f65ffc49b956bcecd376f97eb1cbe114ea426d636a5e&req=fSUiEMh3nYhdFb4f3HP0gFBfjGewYk9qv025BZZ0HN3OlA6HNshGxcMTLBI8%0Agn677hflnfBEex8Klw%3D%3D%0A)

After finalising your changes, select **Edit Appointments** at the top or use the drop-down to Edit Appointments and Print/Email a schedule to the patient.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955618780/a1006709be40a881206830a5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3c01909dd488e463e6c564ae47ce611d6e4235e8dc9ec5dab5c44773d33501dc&req=fSUiEMh2molfFb4f3HP0gE7wGeqhrlbMa%2BZufWI1gdF8oBoRiIJNY9A1eM76%0A3h9cyrpDbHhnL5CyPQ%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/955618780/a1006709be40a881206830a5/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3c01909dd488e463e6c564ae47ce611d6e4235e8dc9ec5dab5c44773d33501dc&req=fSUiEMh2molfFb4f3HP0gE7wGeqhrlbMa%2BZufWI1gdF8oBoRiIJNY9A1eM76%0A3h9cyrpDbHhnL5CyPQ%3D%3D%0A)

If there are any conflicts, they will then be displayed on the screen for you to resolve. This is due to the change made not being a valid appointment. All valid changes will have been made to the patient's appointments. You can select **Back** and leave these conflicts unchanged or use the dropdowns to rectify before selecting **Edit Appointments** again to confirm.

## Document 328 — Applying Surcharges with Tyro Health EFTPOS | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-328}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8952527-applying-surcharges-with-tyro-health-eftpos](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8952527-applying-surcharges-with-tyro-health-eftpos)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[Integrations](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2633444-integrations)

[Tyro Health EFTPOS](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/3123383-tyro-health-eftpos)

Applying Surcharges with Tyro Health EFTPOS

Applying Surcharges with Tyro Health EFTPOS
===========================================

Updated over 2 years ago

Automatic surcharge handling in PracSuite is only available via the [Tyro Health EFTPOS integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5550059-enabling-the-tyro-health-eftpos-integration)
.

Surcharge rates are configured directly in your Tyro Health EFTPOS settings. For further details on how to do this, [please click here to visit the Tyro Health knowledge base.](https://help.tyrohealth.com/en/articles/6102930-surcharging-for-tyro-eftpos-machines)

When the Tyro EFTPOS terminal applies the surcharge to a card payment, it will automatically be added as a separate item code on the invoice in PracSuite. If you don't already have a surcharge item code, one will be created to record this amount.

You can nominate your preferred surcharge item code in [Settings > Integrations > Tyro Health EFTPOS.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/integrations/tyrohealtheftpos)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957836375/01c22d38a23d385e27ade099/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+08.20.24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4d7e86a72e26ad24790147051ea229223b724e2fda2009e6b9f2b9a6627d51e&req=fSUgHsp4noZaFb4f3HP0gI6iBE4YrKn1OWHZCOEr1grU00Qs55eU%2FkmeRDZS%0AlRtw8VOOi8i6xqN5QA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957836375/01c22d38a23d385e27ade099/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+08.20.24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c4d7e86a72e26ad24790147051ea229223b724e2fda2009e6b9f2b9a6627d51e&req=fSUgHsp4noZaFb4f3HP0gI6iBE4YrKn1OWHZCOEr1grU00Qs55eU%2FkmeRDZS%0AlRtw8VOOi8i6xqN5QA%3D%3D%0A)

Your invoice will automatically list the surcharge item as a separate item.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957840195/d8ff15aca171dbb49e18521e/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+08.26.23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35c637872f2be7e3847e648a8faed9828747918a53069b02f1d9a91dec42a157&req=fSUgHs1%2BnIhaFb4f3HP0gCuIu%2BFfNisVxivgqPErjUlM9iYp%2BCSPV6UefrVK%0AZR70LbhWwEPtlx49Pg%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957840195/d8ff15aca171dbb49e18521e/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+08.26.23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=35c637872f2be7e3847e648a8faed9828747918a53069b02f1d9a91dec42a157&req=fSUgHs1%2BnIhaFb4f3HP0gCuIu%2BFfNisVxivgqPErjUlM9iYp%2BCSPV6UefrVK%0AZR70LbhWwEPtlx49Pg%3D%3D%0A)

Regarding billing reports, we recommend placing the surcharge item in a different item schedule compared to the services that impact practitioner wages. You can select this on the item code you create for the surcharge.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957837595/bef27cd69141f206b68ec1bb/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+08.22.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25e307f56f0a233d4398e350a636ec09fc37ab4d5c159f2c77a47004f635efaa&req=fSUgHsp5mIhaFb4f3HP0gOyN44f67GUeWRi9h77TZh6sadllxgfGstccDVfv%0AkbUQQkL%2FgsHkyAJ5VA%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957837595/bef27cd69141f206b68ec1bb/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+08.22.29.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25e307f56f0a233d4398e350a636ec09fc37ab4d5c159f2c77a47004f635efaa&req=fSUgHsp5mIhaFb4f3HP0gOyN44f67GUeWRi9h77TZh6sadllxgfGstccDVfv%0AkbUQQkL%2FgsHkyAJ5VA%3D%3D%0A)

When running the Billing report grouped by schedule, you will see the surcharge item separated from the other billing totals that factor into practitioner wages.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957839295/5385879ca9489141592e7f89/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+08.24.58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d99faa81bd4c8fba3c3010b6d2f40dab6f19e7d0da5535cb45458c8c96cb18ad&req=fSUgHsp3n4haFb4f3HP0gPItDCiaesZvx3X27sybWnVxmKJZZGKCxclZBgW6%0AEO80Y5RkFGidKbwY2Q%3D%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/957839295/5385879ca9489141592e7f89/CleanShot+2024-02-09+at+08.24.58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d99faa81bd4c8fba3c3010b6d2f40dab6f19e7d0da5535cb45458c8c96cb18ad&req=fSUgHsp3n4haFb4f3HP0gPItDCiaesZvx3X27sybWnVxmKJZZGKCxclZBgW6%0AEO80Y5RkFGidKbwY2Q%3D%3D%0A)

Automatic Batch Invoicing

Automatic Batch Invoicing
=========================

The Batch Invoicing feature streamlines the billing process by automatically generating invoices for appointments at a specified time after the appointment ends, as well as ad hoc for a selected date range.

Updated over 3 months ago

The Batch Invoicing feature streamlines the billing process by automatically generating invoices for appointments at a specified time after the appointment ends, as well as ad hoc for a selected date range.

This feature is designed for third-party billing workflows where payment is not required on the day. Payments are not processed when using this feature. This tool is particularly useful for practices that prefer to accumulate invoices over a set billing cycle—be it weekly, fortnightly, or monthly—and then issue these invoices in bulk at the end of the cycle.

**Key Benefits:**

*   **Efficiency:** Automates the invoicing process after each appointment without manual intervention.
    
*   **Flexible:** Allows practices to choose specific appointments to automatically invoice. It also works alongside regular invoicing, as any appointments that have been manually invoiced will be excluded from the automatic process.
    
*   **Reduces Complexity:** Allows staff to concentrate on reflecting billable time as appointments rather than working with the invoice screen.
    

**Note that invoices are created but not issued (emailed) to patients or third-party payers when using this feature.** After the batch invoice process is complete, invoices must still be issued in bulk using the [Outstanding Invoice report](https://test2.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/outstandinginvoices)
.

Reviewing Appointment Type Default Item Codes
=============================================

When automatic appointment invoicing occurs, an invoice will be created using the appointment's default Item Code or Item Group. Therefore, it is essential to correctly configure default Item Codes in [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
. More information regarding this is available [on our knowledge base.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types#h_a8fcc8d4b4)

The default Item Code and Fee can be viewed quickly from the appointment book in the tooltip displayed when hovering over an appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1036699321/0a284b9e59ee810fb681505f/CleanShot+2024-04-30+at+12_11_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6434d2a6bb81635f729c11c4c83cb6bb1ffedb288d9615e39a69542f22dd8f1&req=dSAkEM93lIJdWPMW1HO4zReGv%2F0l19zjhg87kwverBuICr0Ly6TeubB8f1p%2B%0AFvyd5Aqy5Phrxv9BDJs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1036699321/0a284b9e59ee810fb681505f/CleanShot+2024-04-30+at+12_11_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e6434d2a6bb81635f729c11c4c83cb6bb1ffedb288d9615e39a69542f22dd8f1&req=dSAkEM93lIJdWPMW1HO4zReGv%2F0l19zjhg87kwverBuICr0Ly6TeubB8f1p%2B%0AFvyd5Aqy5Phrxv9BDJs%3D%0A)

Note: Invoices will not be automatically generated if the appointment does not have a default Item Code.

Automatic Batch Invoicing
=========================

Automatic Batch Invoicing can be enabled in [Settings > Billing > Batch Invoicing](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/autoinvoice)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825783364/1183b452d5f65e710c783cac399c/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_36_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bca6ce804c6b165561e9e085966d31a6fdffa55fc0c2d1e3f8ab472644154498&req=dSglE852noJZXfMW1HO4zXuxdFxV3M05K0odHbMpcIEIp3OfW10NmUaSuuau%0AOHOxIj6suC%2ButTeJmR0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825783364/1183b452d5f65e710c783cac399c/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_36_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bca6ce804c6b165561e9e085966d31a6fdffa55fc0c2d1e3f8ab472644154498&req=dSglE852noJZXfMW1HO4zXuxdFxV3M05K0odHbMpcIEIp3OfW10NmUaSuuau%0AOHOxIj6suC%2ButTeJmR0%3D%0A)

Automatic Invoice Start Date
----------------------------

The "Auto Invoice Start Date" determines when the automatic batch invoicing feature for appointments will begin.

Selecting When to Automatically Generate Invoices
-------------------------------------------------

After enabling Automatic Batch Invoicing, you must choose when appointments will be automatically invoiced. Invoices will be generated after your chosen time, generally within 30 minutes during busy periods.

The following options are available:

### After an appointment ends

This option will generate the invoice after the appointment's end time. This can be set to 0 hours after an appointment if you want the invoice to be created ASAP after the appointment ends.

### End of day at

Automatic batch invoicing will occur at the chosen time at the end of the day. Be sure to set a time after your latest appointments, as any appointments that appear after your chosen time will not be automatically invoiced.

### Weekly on

Automatic batch invoicing will occur weekly on the chosen day and time.

Manual/Ad Hoc Batch Invoicing
=============================

You can choose to manually trigger the batch invoicing process for a specific date range. You can choose to use the manual batch invoicing process in combination with the automatic batch invoicing process.

To start the manual batch invoicing process, select **Batch Invoice Now**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825781777/4f72d4763e35cc1060dae1cb0bc5/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_34_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2bf11b7d9daaa01c4b66ea44e0ca37f4fd04418785d8d53fd3fa5de339ce2fdb&req=dSglE852nIZYXvMW1HO4zfAsmBnXB9sQg3YWlmg8pyLXzCLku%2BBrItYFzRL7%0AHFMSuDM9D6ncS0qMZRk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825781777/4f72d4763e35cc1060dae1cb0bc5/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_34_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2bf11b7d9daaa01c4b66ea44e0ca37f4fd04418785d8d53fd3fa5de339ce2fdb&req=dSglE852nIZYXvMW1HO4zfAsmBnXB9sQg3YWlmg8pyLXzCLku%2BBrItYFzRL7%0AHFMSuDM9D6ncS0qMZRk%3D%0A)

Select the date range you wish to manually invoice. You can select a maximum of 31 days at a time. You cannot select future dates.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825788502/26a28fa8e1c669d02b6e35b21fc5/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_42_27.png?expires=1771821900&signature=811abfeecd79ca1abaf9d853fcb15946deefdf8e3ffb920b2c2da03a6d731327&req=dSglE852lYRfW%2FMW1HO4zac1qPXpo0VKFiNW8grDiAKK7bE94n4da%2FOb0K40%0AXIXqKZ8lK2ncO8eNt6I%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825788502/26a28fa8e1c669d02b6e35b21fc5/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_42_27.png?expires=1771821900&signature=811abfeecd79ca1abaf9d853fcb15946deefdf8e3ffb920b2c2da03a6d731327&req=dSglE852lYRfW%2FMW1HO4zac1qPXpo0VKFiNW8grDiAKK7bE94n4da%2FOb0K40%0AXIXqKZ8lK2ncO8eNt6I%3D%0A)

Batch invoicing cannot be undone in bulk once generated. Double-check your invoicing criteria before continuing.

Type CONFIRM into the text box to proceed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825788719/9e891cdcccfcb86c803b040b0381/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_42_45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6a7bce72c0360043e2df5e9de04e953d8e484a5c5f3af456a7729bcb198f27e&req=dSglE852lYZeUPMW1HO4zfk4MplIbcy4CwKm%2BnRASI1hGpMQ1MT2u4rYGMTL%0APhp1dhFo8BDNxw%2BO1Mo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825788719/9e891cdcccfcb86c803b040b0381/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_42_45.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a6a7bce72c0360043e2df5e9de04e953d8e484a5c5f3af456a7729bcb198f27e&req=dSglE852lYZeUPMW1HO4zfk4MplIbcy4CwKm%2BnRASI1hGpMQ1MT2u4rYGMTL%0APhp1dhFo8BDNxw%2BO1Mo%3D%0A)

Select **Invoice** to finalise the process.

  
Choosing Appointments to Batch Invoice
=========================================

By default, invoices will be automatically generated for all appointments. Under the Appointment Criteria heading, you can choose to narrow the scope of automatic invoices to appointments with specific Appointment Types, Statuses, Fee Categories, Professions, Businesses and Practitioners.

For example, you can use the Fee Category to only raise invoices for appointments associated with third-party payer Fee Categories, like Workcover or NDIS billing scenarios.

Adjust the appointment criteria according to your preferences.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1033013724/53f7a96132e010057450b25d/CleanShot+2024-04-26+at+13_18_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afb0e906fccdf02bb9904abb551e6b68df5d2f6dbe08e6bbed3aae1ee1f587de&req=dSAkFcl%2FnoZdXfMW1HO4zUo5vyNrMVWngXMPr3bXv8guQg8uoFlCY2dWIB2g%0AxJl8zSRDpRxjxR4qI%2FU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1033013724/53f7a96132e010057450b25d/CleanShot+2024-04-26+at+13_18_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=afb0e906fccdf02bb9904abb551e6b68df5d2f6dbe08e6bbed3aae1ee1f587de&req=dSAkFcl%2FnoZdXfMW1HO4zUo5vyNrMVWngXMPr3bXv8guQg8uoFlCY2dWIB2g%0AxJl8zSRDpRxjxR4qI%2FU%3D%0A)

Enable the option if you wish for appointments with default item values of $0.00 to be invoiced.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825789945/c450d156f239024fa336c87611a6/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_44_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=11639e10f3a11152558c4c209f999f012b8e998afa665bc0553d7dcde2862bf2&req=dSglE852lIhbXPMW1HO4zWKls6GEYyfvj8FpEOTrzDSYll2mqsh6U%2FFJ5D9Y%0AkPBfTZyRxItYSRf87Os%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825789945/c450d156f239024fa336c87611a6/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_44_24.png?expires=1771821900&signature=11639e10f3a11152558c4c209f999f012b8e998afa665bc0553d7dcde2862bf2&req=dSglE852lIhbXPMW1HO4zWKls6GEYyfvj8FpEOTrzDSYll2mqsh6U%2FFJ5D9Y%0AkPBfTZyRxItYSRf87Os%3D%0A)

Invoices will not be automatically generated in the following scenarios:

*   The appointment does not match the criteria outlined above
    
*   An invoice is already linked to the appointment
    
*   The appointment has no default item code set
    

Using an Appointment Status to Identify Batch Invoiced Appointments
===================================================================

Consistent with manually invoicing appointments, the appointment will turn to your chosen 'processed' colour, and the appointment status will be updated to 'completed'. It's possible to change automatically invoiced appointments to a different appointment status, or have the appointment status remain unchanged.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825790158/61dfe526317b4930ff234e3b46d5/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_44_44.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2c1a56698d26ba3c3dd421cf51bf008e30ed8d8570aa6d730929f799fb33467&req=dSglE853nYBaUfMW1HO4zYBDWODkPSvjTCqJXWqvL5cTK2wwVQPdx59BM2s%2F%0AHjVUmOd7u5sESTY8TBE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825790158/61dfe526317b4930ff234e3b46d5/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_44_44.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2c1a56698d26ba3c3dd421cf51bf008e30ed8d8570aa6d730929f799fb33467&req=dSglE853nYBaUfMW1HO4zYBDWODkPSvjTCqJXWqvL5cTK2wwVQPdx59BM2s%2F%0AHjVUmOd7u5sESTY8TBE%3D%0A)

Issuing Invoices That Have Been Generated Automatically
=======================================================

As mentioned earlier, this feature does not automatically email invoices to patients or third-party payers. After the batch invoice process occurs, invoices must still be sent to the recipient. The easiest way to issue invoices in bulk is via the [Outstanding Invoice report](https://test2.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/outstandinginvoices)
.

Frequently Asked Questions
==========================

Are invoices automatically emailed to patients or third-party payers?
---------------------------------------------------------------------

When using this feature, invoices are not automatically emailed to patients or third-party payers. After the batch invoice process occurs, invoices must still be sent to the recipient. The easiest way to issue invoices in bulk is via the [Outstanding Invoice report](https://test2.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/outstandinginvoices)
.

Can I automatically add multiple items to an invoice?
-----------------------------------------------------

Yes, batch invoicing can add multiple items to an invoice when an [Item Group](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4610658-creating-item-groups)
 is set as the [default Item Code for the Appointment Type](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4317911-creating-appointment-types#h_a8fcc8d4b4)
.

Are claims automatically submitted?
-----------------------------------

No, claims are not submitted when using batch invoicing. All claims, including health fund, Medicare and DVA claims, must be submitted manually.

Does batch invoicing work with [Open Invoicing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9233498-understanding-open-invoicing)
?
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Yes, batch invoicing will add items to open invoices.

Does batch invoicing work with [Hourly Billing](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8648935-using-the-hourly-billing-feature)
?
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Yes, batch invoicing is compatible with Hourly Billing, which is designed for practices that invoice at an hourly rate, such as NDIS providers.

Does batch invoicing work with the [NDIS integration for agency-managed patients](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5735167-enabling-the-ndis-integration)
?
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Yes, batch invoicing will use the default NDIS Claim Type you have selected for the Appointment Type. You can review the default NDIS Claim Types you have selected in [Settings > Appointment Book > Appointment Types](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/appointmentbook/types/list)
, as shown below.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031714453/ccb95f80201f5bf4b202f806/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_45_37%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae5b35a2f70c74d69aa04ea40ee0478243df4e31527f701f48bf21a4abb7e10f&req=dSAkF85%2FmYVaWvMW1HO4zVBtxKELWNbJx6txUq32wY0EW%2FCLlFkQ%2BIrOwvPD%0AZgABSsCy8q6HaTPeKhw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031714453/ccb95f80201f5bf4b202f806/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_45_37%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ae5b35a2f70c74d69aa04ea40ee0478243df4e31527f701f48bf21a4abb7e10f&req=dSAkF85%2FmYVaWvMW1HO4zVBtxKELWNbJx6txUq32wY0EW%2FCLlFkQ%2BIrOwvPD%0AZgABSsCy8q6HaTPeKhw%3D%0A)

Can I view a log of appointments that have been batch invoiced?
---------------------------------------------------------------

Yes, use the Log button at the top of the Batch Invoicing settings page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825790967/67ba8ca7c6a12f98abd0dc61d6b2/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_45_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=04b3fee2e32d676b6ef481a385a02b8b12ee8f19e1e38f0944e29a631447bc3d&req=dSglE853nYhZXvMW1HO4zUjpFuHRVJBvqW5an65imhn%2F58eUNOnj12InhSyC%0AsJ8ggUKOj2EPdB%2FCh5Q%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825790967/67ba8ca7c6a12f98abd0dc61d6b2/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_45_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=04b3fee2e32d676b6ef481a385a02b8b12ee8f19e1e38f0944e29a631447bc3d&req=dSglE853nYhZXvMW1HO4zUjpFuHRVJBvqW5an65imhn%2F58eUNOnj12InhSyC%0AsJ8ggUKOj2EPdB%2FCh5Q%3D%0A)

Use the plus icon on the right-hand side to view a list of appointments that have been batch invoiced. In the user column, you will see System for automatic batch invoice runs, and the actual user name for any ad hoc/manual batch invoice runs.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825791103/447c85e67f86eb7834ae04f632b0/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_45_52.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efba01523864b77017eed50dde960232ec75e37335427f97a5fa7a6947703b8c&req=dSglE853nIBfWvMW1HO4zdrb%2BDkwLDMPICsGzWVozmxmQnkSEKzm8mk7IpHp%0AusFpQoPNo0QhfrY6tXA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1825791103/447c85e67f86eb7834ae04f632b0/CleanShot+2025-11-12+at+12_45_52.png?expires=1771821900&signature=efba01523864b77017eed50dde960232ec75e37335427f97a5fa7a6947703b8c&req=dSglE853nIBfWvMW1HO4zdrb%2BDkwLDMPICsGzWVozmxmQnkSEKzm8mk7IpHp%0AusFpQoPNo0QhfrY6tXA%3D%0A)

Forms & Tags
============

2\. Tags based on how the patient responds to multiple-choice or single-choice questions.

The Add Tag button is found next to each option, as shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012341119/e3fd107b208878de8f6d39d7/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+12_06_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5d9e9ee3217915e97fca28e32b01576ecdb08f4ac01159a3886aa912bc7537e4&req=dSAmFMp6nIBeUPMW1HO4zakE89lvBi0DxzzjQ3hrmvIq8IqqAByt2iNYUH2L%0AECuQj8FUny94f5lOsu8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1012341119/e3fd107b208878de8f6d39d7/CleanShot+2024-04-05+at+12_06_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5d9e9ee3217915e97fca28e32b01576ecdb08f4ac01159a3886aa912bc7537e4&req=dSAmFMp6nIBeUPMW1HO4zakE89lvBi0DxzzjQ3hrmvIq8IqqAByt2iNYUH2L%0AECuQj8FUny94f5lOsu8%3D%0A)

Understanding Open Invoicing

Understanding Open Invoicing
============================

Updated over 5 months ago

Table of contents

[Enabling Open Invoicing](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9233498-understanding-open-invoicing#h_08e67dd9b0)

[Working with the Open Invoice Feature](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9233498-understanding-open-invoicing#h_a113ed5924)

[Closing an Individual Invoice](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9233498-understanding-open-invoicing#h_011e8347ab)

[Closing Invoices in Bulk](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9233498-understanding-open-invoicing#h_118e5b65fb)

[Managing Open Invoice Preference per Third-party Payer](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9233498-understanding-open-invoicing#h_32d59dc305)

[Managing Open Invoice Preference per Patient](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9233498-understanding-open-invoicing#h_78981fc505)

The opening invoicing feature allows you to seamlessly create a single invoice with multiple item codes on different dates. This feature is ideal for practices that let their invoices accumulate over a weekly/fortnightly/monthly billing cycle and action emailing them out in bulk at the end of the cycle.

[Open invoicing is also compatible with the automatic invoicing feature.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9126986-automatic-invoicing)

Enabling Open Invoicing
=======================

Open invoicing is enabled by default for all PracSuite users. If you always want a new invoice to be created every time you attempt to bill a patient, this feature can be disabled on the [Settings > Billing > Billing](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/list)
 page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1033048603/65cfc11d18185b2611e8f854/CleanShot+2024-04-26+at+14_35_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27c0eacbf532934f921d15e6241c99f470f6635f7c677ed80699fafd89c37407&req=dSAkFcl6lYdfWvMW1HO4zSOCmamPglzD9eIm16Vv6e3zowD3LLBheK6Ee6eo%0A5%2BhlCI2fhA8NyB%2BKSXM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1033048603/65cfc11d18185b2611e8f854/CleanShot+2024-04-26+at+14_35_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=27c0eacbf532934f921d15e6241c99f470f6635f7c677ed80699fafd89c37407&req=dSAkFcl6lYdfWvMW1HO4zSOCmamPglzD9eIm16Vv6e3zowD3LLBheK6Ee6eo%0A5%2BhlCI2fhA8NyB%2BKSXM%3D%0A)

Working with the Open Invoice Feature
=====================================

When using open invoicing, each time you attempt to invoice a patient, whether via the appointment book or directly from the patient file, the oldest open invoice will be opened for you to continue adding items to.

Invoices become closed when they're issued, i.e. printed or emailed. Until this occurs, the invoice will remain open and items will continue to be added the oldest open invoice.

Therefore, it is essential that you only use the **Save** option if you wish for the invoice to remain open. The invoice will be closed if you choose the Save & Print/Email options.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031702570/764b3260caffb428d85a6deb/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_12_08%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db1b5bccad6fd9eef43f3852ae779e5375c56ae6f7d0138b621ab6e7565c394f&req=dSAkF85%2Bn4RYWfMW1HO4zdeNxXf9%2FqzxKd%2BgtKLnccNE6%2B9NAuuMR5%2BK%2FyeW%0AR0A2DXFlptkA%2BwDCal8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031702570/764b3260caffb428d85a6deb/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_12_08%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db1b5bccad6fd9eef43f3852ae779e5375c56ae6f7d0138b621ab6e7565c394f&req=dSAkF85%2Bn4RYWfMW1HO4zdeNxXf9%2FqzxKd%2BgtKLnccNE6%2B9NAuuMR5%2BK%2FyeW%0AR0A2DXFlptkA%2BwDCal8%3D%0A)

Closing an Individual Invoice
-----------------------------

An individual invoice can be closed using the standard Print and Email buttons available on the invoice screen.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031707086/cffbee5d9dead0b9bb47f7dd/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_25_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06f444aa0979cb68f42a0e64de50d025f8e93e3bc8e4ed2bd89c3a86f8fc56aa&req=dSAkF85%2BmoFXX%2FMW1HO4zSf3iX47%2BBlK5BVcZTt0kFP%2FkOksh7ywIFCSXvDk%0AyTYW%2BY%2BFal%2Bx0qcz6w0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031707086/cffbee5d9dead0b9bb47f7dd/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_25_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=06f444aa0979cb68f42a0e64de50d025f8e93e3bc8e4ed2bd89c3a86f8fc56aa&req=dSAkF85%2BmoFXX%2FMW1HO4zSf3iX47%2BBlK5BVcZTt0kFP%2FkOksh7ywIFCSXvDk%0AyTYW%2BY%2BFal%2Bx0qcz6w0%3D%0A)

An invoice can also be marked as issued manually using the **Mark As Issued** button at the top of the invoice screen.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1052462560/0854f7995426a6081d54483b/CleanShot+2024-05-16+at+11_41_38.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe545999efac6b86d297657cee5d027d7701109e35ce5a9231893a5058dd13e9&req=dSAiFM14n4RZWfMW1HO4zUJ3WuChSR3gkwPX6kJ%2F8gxQfEzH3Ge2ETCtpO%2FP%0AxczLreGKC9e4OkCaOWc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1052462560/0854f7995426a6081d54483b/CleanShot+2024-05-16+at+11_41_38.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fe545999efac6b86d297657cee5d027d7701109e35ce5a9231893a5058dd13e9&req=dSAiFM14n4RZWfMW1HO4zUJ3WuChSR3gkwPX6kJ%2F8gxQfEzH3Ge2ETCtpO%2FP%0AxczLreGKC9e4OkCaOWc%3D%0A)

If you accidentally mark an invoice as issued, you can use the **Mark as Unissued** button at the top of the invoice to allow it to continue to be used for open invoicing.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031708014/092d2f4e01752a7ac931f9a2/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_28_58%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=da564d96bc3eb67e70993c9fce5b50e9d30e8ace5da1b023ac1ce38746edf996&req=dSAkF85%2BlYFeXfMW1HO4zRkMtnBsGKgVmVJReeZ3FanTkeBOOdUonX0fhzzo%0AZhc%2BOg1qewdejXQgQtc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031708014/092d2f4e01752a7ac931f9a2/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_28_58%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=da564d96bc3eb67e70993c9fce5b50e9d30e8ace5da1b023ac1ce38746edf996&req=dSAkF85%2BlYFeXfMW1HO4zRkMtnBsGKgVmVJReeZ3FanTkeBOOdUonX0fhzzo%0AZhc%2BOg1qewdejXQgQtc%3D%0A)

Closing Invoices in Bulk
------------------------

Rather than issuing invoices individually, PracSuite offers the ability to issue invoices in bulk using the Outstanding Invoices report. This report is ideal for closing and emailing out invoices at the end of your chosen billing cycle. [Click here to learn more about bulk invoicing workflows.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4430319-how-to-manage-outstanding-invoices)

Managing Open Invoice Preference per Third-party Payer
------------------------------------------------------

When working with third-party payers that request an individual invoice for each item code, open invoicing can be disabled for that payer.

Open the **Accounts tab** of the third-party payer file.

Uncheck '**Add to Last Open Invoice by Default**' and select **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031709298/9b274dd125496dabdef1a356/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_32_47%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0435b228b3601d75d95a78ded766e2e1cb704443a93da65502e4ee02c34e4a8c&req=dSAkF85%2BlINWUfMW1HO4zWwHA%2FkDtYcHtf3fGk56mY%2Fm0RuqVZZZCH9y1Fqr%0AbpiGD19jM7U077JoQys%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031709298/9b274dd125496dabdef1a356/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_32_47%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0435b228b3601d75d95a78ded766e2e1cb704443a93da65502e4ee02c34e4a8c&req=dSAkF85%2BlINWUfMW1HO4zWwHA%2FkDtYcHtf3fGk56mY%2Fm0RuqVZZZCH9y1Fqr%0AbpiGD19jM7U077JoQys%3D%0A)

Managing Open Invoice Preference per Patient
--------------------------------------------

When working with a patient who requests an individual invoice for each item code, open invoicing can be disabled for that patient.

Open the **Accounts tab** of the patient.

Uncheck '**Add to Last Open Invoice by Default**' and select **Save** to finalise your changes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031709059/72993e5b24399dac042ce003/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_32_05%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3515a38053b74e7ebde4066f1ff2340a33ca76df91d77088a2d520a42a0a4e4&req=dSAkF85%2BlIFaUPMW1HO4zWnh5PYg%2F1Vkjvgwt2%2BaAmntc76h6ppmAYAQnt93%0Asrt%2BzCE2tBppAGppYKw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1031709059/72993e5b24399dac042ce003/CleanShot+2024-04-25+at+10_32_05%402x.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a3515a38053b74e7ebde4066f1ff2340a33ca76df91d77088a2d520a42a0a4e4&req=dSAkF85%2BlIFaUPMW1HO4zWnh5PYg%2F1Vkjvgwt2%2BaAmntc76h6ppmAYAQnt93%0Asrt%2BzCE2tBppAGppYKw%3D%0A)

Creating an Advanced Email Template
===================================

Updated over a year ago

PracSuite includes an advanced email editor accessible from the Email template screen. This tool provides an easy way to make professional newsletters and emails that look great on desktop and mobile with an inbuilt template catalogue for you to use as a base.

Note that advanced templates cannot be edited when manually composing emails and are only suitable for emails that don’t need editing at the time of sending.

Utilising merge fields, you can create advanced email templates for newsletters, receipts, and appointment reminders, among other uses.

Go to [Settings > Templates > Email Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/email)
 and select Add Advanced Template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059200189/7cd96985670fbf855530593f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85770cbed3ec70ce4ef5a24b9c98971f0c6e2decdaf82c3a14b1bab3fa770eb8&req=dSAiH8t%2BnYBXUPMW1HO4zaBOIEYKSKFluU7%2B3J2ACXhTydkvxTb01DvsrMeG%0AqjJucrv%2Fg2%2BMdMrLsh8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059200189/7cd96985670fbf855530593f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=85770cbed3ec70ce4ef5a24b9c98971f0c6e2decdaf82c3a14b1bab3fa770eb8&req=dSAiH8t%2BnYBXUPMW1HO4zaBOIEYKSKFluU7%2B3J2ACXhTydkvxTb01DvsrMeG%0AqjJucrv%2Fg2%2BMdMrLsh8%3D%0A)

This brings up the Template Catalogue where you can scroll through all available ideas, search for a variety of topics or start from scratch with a blank template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059202781/ba37971a6953ceb60661587e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e77d6a29ecc6b48a6c6106ac6e8df88b48ef50922ec9c8d51d35c2c9c0e591ee&req=dSAiH8t%2Bn4ZXWPMW1HO4zWekOaEUMaUCPtd8BjoRo1S%2FvLDwRX8QNatR8IPs%0AUI0M9lReAal1I4P%2FkTg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059202781/ba37971a6953ceb60661587e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e77d6a29ecc6b48a6c6106ac6e8df88b48ef50922ec9c8d51d35c2c9c0e591ee&req=dSAiH8t%2Bn4ZXWPMW1HO4zWekOaEUMaUCPtd8BjoRo1S%2FvLDwRX8QNatR8IPs%0AUI0M9lReAal1I4P%2FkTg%3D%0A)

Once you select a starting point, the editor will load and you will be able to begin making changes. Below we will go through a basic example of starting from scratch.

Advanced Email Editor Concepts
==============================

View
----

You can view the email template you are editing in either desktop or mobile mode. You may notice some elements moving around when switching, this is because columns will stack on mobile for a neater reading experience.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059209576/d52c4c406aabbef498c13a74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6d66c643134d63b0dfc8781024ba981cb001b3c34021020725b0f816687a245e&req=dSAiH8t%2BlIRYX%2FMW1HO4zfXO2lGobuEp3e6SkbadzvXAi%2F5L8B04s%2BQSvRPf%0A71dgudWAXSvVWxcvn6o%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059209576/d52c4c406aabbef498c13a74/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6d66c643134d63b0dfc8781024ba981cb001b3c34021020725b0f816687a245e&req=dSAiH8t%2BlIRYX%2FMW1HO4zfXO2lGobuEp3e6SkbadzvXAi%2F5L8B04s%2BQSvRPf%0A71dgudWAXSvVWxcvn6o%3D%0A)

Content
-------

Your email template is structured as a table with columns and rows. In the highlighted sections, you can drop content items such as a Title, Paragraph, or Image into your workspace.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059208268/262b81e18c5e0be11a48222e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=758abfe86963c700a190d0367ec01cecf901f033a96ec41413ed771e4cb75751&req=dSAiH8t%2BlYNZUfMW1HO4zQ%2BxVYdhAdnYc7V1IXNgSZrRPKVLPXYhtX%2B2A4IS%0AJEmckhtf1aeJgCodJp8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059208268/262b81e18c5e0be11a48222e/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=758abfe86963c700a190d0367ec01cecf901f033a96ec41413ed771e4cb75751&req=dSAiH8t%2BlYNZUfMW1HO4zQ%2BxVYdhAdnYc7V1IXNgSZrRPKVLPXYhtX%2B2A4IS%0AJEmckhtf1aeJgCodJp8%3D%0A)

If you select a content block after you have added it, you can edit it on the left and change its properties on the right, including formatting.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059238240/67721c747bfb57df38994aac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=197fefaebce309013b641a94472b800f5c892ade01e341a0307df25a6e39bdcb&req=dSAiH8t9lYNbWfMW1HO4zcuRc6KIyAhntbGcWgHKDZAzmPyUA7KVBVw%2BK4iT%0AeGrG5HyM3h7OYq%2Bep%2Bs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059238240/67721c747bfb57df38994aac/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=197fefaebce309013b641a94472b800f5c892ade01e341a0307df25a6e39bdcb&req=dSAiH8t9lYNbWfMW1HO4zcuRc6KIyAhntbGcWgHKDZAzmPyUA7KVBVw%2BK4iT%0AeGrG5HyM3h7OYq%2Bep%2Bs%3D%0A)

Rows
----

Rows are best used when changing the number of columns for a part of the email. You may switch between one full row to a 50%-50% row to have an image and text be side by side. You can hover over a row to reorder it.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059207549/d6112703b4fb1753861213c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d44b836d2e7449079dd0e8f9eb715c68e68fb70c884ae0f6d263787be7005bde&req=dSAiH8t%2BmoRbUPMW1HO4zYwDAXAGLfdO4GpazRoHKSq7%2FLecoUAXoL3TGxGR%0AxVT4M38TPWy9%2Fji7GGQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059207549/d6112703b4fb1753861213c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d44b836d2e7449079dd0e8f9eb715c68e68fb70c884ae0f6d263787be7005bde&req=dSAiH8t%2BmoRbUPMW1HO4zYwDAXAGLfdO4GpazRoHKSq7%2FLecoUAXoL3TGxGR%0AxVT4M38TPWy9%2Fji7GGQ%3D%0A)

Settings
--------

Settings control the defaults for your elements and the overall width.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059235256/54f6958c6012f1fd663b0e65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=456da47705b059aa66a6a37004837d81b0a8565252021d6cfcc8edb9eedd43b9&req=dSAiH8t9mINaX%2FMW1HO4zdXQpV7bYhFCEC2cSD%2BGzfE6Bj8ViZRAbkeH%2BPlZ%0AUa%2FMPG8uVQi342ETmjM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059235256/54f6958c6012f1fd663b0e65/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=456da47705b059aa66a6a37004837d81b0a8565252021d6cfcc8edb9eedd43b9&req=dSAiH8t9mINaX%2FMW1HO4zdXQpV7bYhFCEC2cSD%2BGzfE6Bj8ViZRAbkeH%2BPlZ%0AUa%2FMPG8uVQi342ETmjM%3D%0A)

File Manager
------------

The File manager holds any custom images you use to make it easy to insert them again in other templates. You can also view a gallery of free stock images by using the Search free photos button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059341135/499e517461b013e6656326cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=34422b097fc3bd8e390413322aca7335851109ecb1f24aa299e3497e33905ffa&req=dSAiH8p6nIBcXPMW1HO4zZefCqiCS4OGq9qvbaWkISVGgQqQeqmek55XUZbw%0A9JD%2F9bLd%2FApL5roSK84%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059341135/499e517461b013e6656326cf/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=34422b097fc3bd8e390413322aca7335851109ecb1f24aa299e3497e33905ffa&req=dSAiH8p6nIBcXPMW1HO4zZefCqiCS4OGq9qvbaWkISVGgQqQeqmek55XUZbw%0A9JD%2F9bLd%2FApL5roSK84%3D%0A)

PracSuite's advanced email editor has too many features to explore individually, so we recommend exploring them yourself. The information below is designed to help you learn the basics so that you can become an expert template designer.

Blank Template
==============

Select Blank template to get started.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059203682/2e6c8cf87368fd60223d3485/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e5637e9c4805228899116aac93ae63430302ce2fcd26875b0ae0f68a48e023be&req=dSAiH8t%2BnodXW%2FMW1HO4zdOdTylxj6eIDi8VmtjVM7d%2BsgGLcRr43EIi93nN%0AmTi5G4sNU%2F1%2F4WyHmsc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059203682/2e6c8cf87368fd60223d3485/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e5637e9c4805228899116aac93ae63430302ce2fcd26875b0ae0f68a48e023be&req=dSAiH8t%2BnodXW%2FMW1HO4zdOdTylxj6eIDi8VmtjVM7d%2BsgGLcRr43EIi93nN%0AmTi5G4sNU%2F1%2F4WyHmsc%3D%0A)

Set the Description and Subject for your email. For this example, we are creating a basic appointment confirmation email template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059355798/af4a17fd5c7d229f9c77949b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10f6dcd472b0c9b6d83ec17ada723cbe21f752a5048d7156d38a7214df69298c&req=dSAiH8p7mIZWUfMW1HO4zcEcyvmEnY3HxVMd5VbXsKK2q%2F4%2BmHVCn3OH06RE%0APG1JPLeJkhA2rzKy0wA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059355798/af4a17fd5c7d229f9c77949b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=10f6dcd472b0c9b6d83ec17ada723cbe21f752a5048d7156d38a7214df69298c&req=dSAiH8p7mIZWUfMW1HO4zcEcyvmEnY3HxVMd5VbXsKK2q%2F4%2BmHVCn3OH06RE%0APG1JPLeJkhA2rzKy0wA%3D%0A)

Now, you can start designing your template using the tools on the right.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059205857/5dd546feaaef039d861b7e42/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ccbdf4cf62c572f19545c76159c5ea8f69a066d964580eacacbecddd42701ead&req=dSAiH8t%2BmIlaXvMW1HO4zbK87YQWZMf1n%2FvYVyGLyUPIjR%2BTL2U7jHBwPYx9%0A%2FuGwZlTROUENsVY928A%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059205857/5dd546feaaef039d861b7e42/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ccbdf4cf62c572f19545c76159c5ea8f69a066d964580eacacbecddd42701ead&req=dSAiH8t%2BmIlaXvMW1HO4zbK87YQWZMf1n%2FvYVyGLyUPIjR%2BTL2U7jHBwPYx9%0A%2FuGwZlTROUENsVY928A%3D%0A)

We will start by editing some settings to set the template's look. Go to the **Settings** tab and change the Content area width to 600px by dragging the slider. Change the background to a subtle colour of your choosing. Our example uses a neutral blue #a3c1da. Set the Content area background colour to white #ffffff.

You can either use the colour picker by selecting the swatch or type in a hex code of a colour e.g. #000000

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059269946/39778a68ffc40649259008dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5fa79eef6644fde2635969a40725fd450fa496fc321dca23a56c59b6e71698bf&req=dSAiH8t4lIhbX%2FMW1HO4zdRn31VLctHGxk81y5QPIyAm%2FbE9z2zTQmK6RQkw%0AgCEKdvwNSro3auMtbos%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059269946/39778a68ffc40649259008dd/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5fa79eef6644fde2635969a40725fd450fa496fc321dca23a56c59b6e71698bf&req=dSAiH8t4lIhbX%2FMW1HO4zdRn31VLctHGxk81y5QPIyAm%2FbE9z2zTQmK6RQkw%0AgCEKdvwNSro3auMtbos%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059239943/2a27bd777aad3e84189ae45d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3acb8613d7e29f6e1c16ff2758ff71e833a2a54470220852401865beb738d891&req=dSAiH8t9lIhbWvMW1HO4zWqoc%2F%2F8RMF1aAu%2F%2BKgWxkI0j3MNrL%2BoEehshvak%0Argb9CeIgVvbieIVajew%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059239943/2a27bd777aad3e84189ae45d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=3acb8613d7e29f6e1c16ff2758ff71e833a2a54470220852401865beb738d891&req=dSAiH8t9lIhbWvMW1HO4zWqoc%2F%2F8RMF1aAu%2F%2BKgWxkI0j3MNrL%2BoEehshvak%0Argb9CeIgVvbieIVajew%3D%0A)

Select Content and then drop in an image to add our logo to the template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059271187/1bc665e1203cd0017f441c5d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61ec2f41743a77cc625e5f85cc39f0b1f28d4b95bf93872673da0c0e1dde64c6&req=dSAiH8t5nIBXXvMW1HO4zZ%2BuB6HdQwECcL080SNC0OSBhL9%2F1d3qX8DbSYjT%0AzE4XnLA0p2kuQd%2FghDc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059271187/1bc665e1203cd0017f441c5d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=61ec2f41743a77cc625e5f85cc39f0b1f28d4b95bf93872673da0c0e1dde64c6&req=dSAiH8t5nIBXXvMW1HO4zZ%2BuB6HdQwECcL080SNC0OSBhL9%2F1d3qX8DbSYjT%0AzE4XnLA0p2kuQd%2FghDc%3D%0A)

Select Browse to open the File manager. If your logo is already in your library, select Insert. Otherwise, use the Upload button to add the image first.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059273712/60a465cb82d9d81f5f8f4f2f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db85ef90489af0453993d5e593c9a2bf241bd211853ed86ed583eb2b37143f8e&req=dSAiH8t5noZeW%2FMW1HO4zVW7pd5hFAvJhKOb9hAwfQdaw5OtubhsVD03E0%2F0%0AkNe4pqvOErvrryCboJE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059273712/60a465cb82d9d81f5f8f4f2f/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=db85ef90489af0453993d5e593c9a2bf241bd211853ed86ed583eb2b37143f8e&req=dSAiH8t5noZeW%2FMW1HO4zVW7pd5hFAvJhKOb9hAwfQdaw5OtubhsVD03E0%2F0%0AkNe4pqvOErvrryCboJE%3D%0A)

Add alternate text for email clients that can't display the image and a URL to your website.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059350748/6d005e8a6fe8bf6e80c86a39/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4430639997103426f0845cc1b00d0c898d812802a84e60a226f5a8c758e87592&req=dSAiH8p7nYZbUfMW1HO4zQL6SJval8x09VR0Zo0aEX8bPQCulzlOYtKjvpL5%0AYDpHSf1S6hFK7%2B2eKjk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059350748/6d005e8a6fe8bf6e80c86a39/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4430639997103426f0845cc1b00d0c898d812802a84e60a226f5a8c758e87592&req=dSAiH8p7nYZbUfMW1HO4zQL6SJval8x09VR0Zo0aEX8bPQCulzlOYtKjvpL5%0AYDpHSf1S6hFK7%2B2eKjk%3D%0A)

Next, select the Content tab to get out of the Image properties and drop a paragraph block underneath the image. Before you release the mouse, look for the "drag it here" text.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059351255/96d546edb8929526b474dc3c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cb07fbc0f7ff75b4bb98ff01ea9fdc1c031ed46a9d521a9cef7fb14063519473&req=dSAiH8p7nINaXPMW1HO4zc0C7fT%2FYbktUVJuK98FgeVuZgFdtQUpu0qFczzt%0Ab2gNlS0HRy6lpSWSzWA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059351255/96d546edb8929526b474dc3c/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=cb07fbc0f7ff75b4bb98ff01ea9fdc1c031ed46a9d521a9cef7fb14063519473&req=dSAiH8p7nINaXPMW1HO4zc0C7fT%2FYbktUVJuK98FgeVuZgFdtQUpu0qFczzt%0Ab2gNlS0HRy6lpSWSzWA%3D%0A)

Type in the text for your email. Here is our example for a simple email confirmation to be sent alongside an SMS reminder:

**Dear <<FirstName>>,**

We are pleased to confirm your upcoming <<AppointmentProfession>> appointment.

**Appointment Details:**

**Date:** <<AppointmentDate>>  
​**Time:** <<AppointmentTime>>  
​**Practitioner:** <<AppointmentPracName>>  
​**Location:** <<AppointmentBusinessAddress>>

**Before your appointment,**

Please complete the following form, note that your answers are private and your medical history is confidential.

\[insert your form link here using the fields at the top\]

**If you need to reschedule or cancel your appointment,**

Kindly notify us at least 24 hours in advance to avoid any cancellation fees.

**If you have any questions or need further assistance,**

feel free to contact us at <<AppointmentBusinessPhone>> or <<AppointmentBusinessEmail>>.

We look forward to helping you achieve your health and wellness goals.

Best regards,  
​**<<AppointmentBusinessName>>**

To give the text more space around the sides, we are going to add some additional Padding under Blcok Options. We have used 30.

You can selectively add padding to each side or just the top or bottom using the More options switch.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059353315/1933506182f5820068f8bc95/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d94217a5652d42af05d1628172f2de333ef599a3d036380a0970a2c55ec4d22c&req=dSAiH8p7noJeXPMW1HO4zdTeTJfFqDR4dC0uX%2F4JZi%2B21fKC5Jq8AmE4ZTcd%0Akl%2BoEOQ9z3D6K%2FgImaE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059353315/1933506182f5820068f8bc95/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d94217a5652d42af05d1628172f2de333ef599a3d036380a0970a2c55ec4d22c&req=dSAiH8p7noJeXPMW1HO4zdTeTJfFqDR4dC0uX%2F4JZi%2B21fKC5Jq8AmE4ZTcd%0Akl%2BoEOQ9z3D6K%2FgImaE%3D%0A)

Use the preview button to see the email without the formatting elements. Make any final adjustments you wish and select Save at the top.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059378408/b70b5b32fddbf5e022cba380/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32bac65cddee8d53a368a38c03135112a1fa96b3978545cb924b95938cbf677b&req=dSAiH8p5lYVfUfMW1HO4zRKhvBgZSfR13ySgl5WhYM3VPNksnCbrMRdURKqP%0A8Lk%2B0yoT44kHN8FIvS8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059378408/b70b5b32fddbf5e022cba380/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32bac65cddee8d53a368a38c03135112a1fa96b3978545cb924b95938cbf677b&req=dSAiH8p5lYVfUfMW1HO4zRKhvBgZSfR13ySgl5WhYM3VPNksnCbrMRdURKqP%0A8Lk%2B0yoT44kHN8FIvS8%3D%0A)

Adding a button with a link
===========================

If you want to go a step further with your template, try adding a Button block that links to your online form:

Drop in the Button block underneath your text and click on the button to update the text to "Complete your form". On the Content pane, select **Special links** under Action

Controlling Online Booking Start Times

Controlling Online Booking Start Times
======================================

Updated over a year ago

The '**Limit Appointment Start Times'** restricts the appointment start times displayed to patients booking online. It is ideal for practices that must maintain a specific sequence/order of appointments to avoid unused time on the appointment book.

Existing [online booking roster rules](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4770750-specifying-available-time-for-online-bookings)
 are still used to determine a practitioner's availability. This feature only concerns the start times of appointments offered online.

This feature can be enabled and customised in [Settings > Online Booking > Overview](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking)
.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1060366235/f3f2027352e73ccbee95e11f/CleanShot+2024-05-24+at+09_00_48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23b9bbd34ba2dc1accb1856adb9a7288ebf7f5299f642e4d73bf180f8dcee80f&req=dSAhFsp4m4NcXPMW1HO4zSOK7nj0mcVwOVvtbCztI3iLS1O%2B6N1vwYuA%2Fw%2BJ%0AIBtnt3hJhdokib9CKQg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1060366235/f3f2027352e73ccbee95e11f/CleanShot+2024-05-24+at+09_00_48.png?expires=1771821900&signature=23b9bbd34ba2dc1accb1856adb9a7288ebf7f5299f642e4d73bf180f8dcee80f&req=dSAhFsp4m4NcXPMW1HO4zSOK7nj0mcVwOVvtbCztI3iLS1O%2B6N1vwYuA%2Fw%2BJ%0AIBtnt3hJhdokib9CKQg%3D%0A)

  
After enabling this feature, use the cog to manage start time preferences per business and practitioner.

Select Add and choose the practitioners that you wish to limit start times for.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1060425482/327f3d56972de3f0a59c8498/CleanShot+2024-05-24+at+11_37_55.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2e23522a1cb67f8d04a27d008c1df994f9c3e9d389b735c29db2ca1397ba41c9&req=dSAhFs18mIVXW%2FMW1HO4zSnhY%2BrfuA4Li6fE8Db%2Fz%2F97FTSG3z1UGdb3pvPM%0AMhT5xgvIiS25z1u1FtM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1060425482/327f3d56972de3f0a59c8498/CleanShot+2024-05-24+at+11_37_55.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2e23522a1cb67f8d04a27d008c1df994f9c3e9d389b735c29db2ca1397ba41c9&req=dSAhFs18mIVXW%2FMW1HO4zSnhY%2BrfuA4Li6fE8Db%2Fz%2F97FTSG3z1UGdb3pvPM%0AMhT5xgvIiS25z1u1FtM%3D%0A)

In the cog menu, you can select the start times for the business/practitioners you've selected:  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059283783/70f64fee9f4577e32fa0bb1d/CleanShot+2024-05-23+at+12_12_06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=049a4f1bb12a06f58ca95402723360190bf30d95e5e74c3f05fa3bea4c0fc48b&req=dSAiH8t2noZXWvMW1HO4zStC06KXah%2BAtQ4XxzDyQDwVwAAfQfG%2FnKDh8%2Fuo%0ARrKa89CvnXDloCUGzHI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1059283783/70f64fee9f4577e32fa0bb1d/CleanShot+2024-05-23+at+12_12_06.png?expires=1771821900&signature=049a4f1bb12a06f58ca95402723360190bf30d95e5e74c3f05fa3bea4c0fc48b&req=dSAiH8t2noZXWvMW1HO4zStC06KXah%2BAtQ4XxzDyQDwVwAAfQfG%2FnKDh8%2Fuo%0ARrKa89CvnXDloCUGzHI%3D%0A)

  
Select **Save** to finalise your preferences.

If different practitioners/businesses have different start times, you can repeat the steps above.

When patients book online, only appointments that start at the selected times will be displayed.

Creating & Redeeming Passes

Creating & Redeeming Passes
===========================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Creating Passes](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426809-creating-redeeming-passes#h_3333cc101c)

[Pass Fee](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426809-creating-redeeming-passes#h_bb1ff232a2)

[Pass Redemptions Report](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426809-creating-redeeming-passes#h_68ce2fcbb9)

[Passes and Online Booking](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426809-creating-redeeming-passes#h_c7a8f66c51)

Passes are designed to simplify the management and sale of appointment packs in your practice. Whether you’re offering a 10-pack of Pilates sessions or a bundle of group exercise classes, Passes provide a seamless experience for both your practice and your patients. When combined with the online booking system, Passes provide a self-service way for patients to purchase a pass and use it to redeem appointments.

Here's an overview of how passes work:

**1\. Patient Purchases a Pass:**

Patients can purchase a pass for a specific set of services, such as a 10-pack of Pilates or group exercise sessions.

**2\. Patient Redeems Appointments:**

Patients can use a pass to redeem their appointments once a pass is purchased. Staff can choose to redeem the appointment rather than invoicing it. When booking online, the patient can redeem the appointment using one of their available passes. If they don't have a pass, the patient can purchase one.

**3\. Track Pass Usage:**  
Practice staff can easily view remaining pass balances and expiry dates within PracSuite, while patients can view this information when logged into their online booking account.

Read below for details on configuring and using Passes in PracSuite.

* * *

Creating Passes
===============

Passes are created and configured in [Settings > Billing > Passes](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/passes)
.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096123553/30780af7416309f019a58995/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+14_37_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c100bb22ec83dfc1ed4df115f732525353042677d1e4d172160101d4b24f8bc7&req=dSAuEMh8noRaWvMW1HO4zQAcjl1ePwMGIEP8xCS8tyyw3sOGhSk4YGvXBrlV%0AKWbib%2B7j0ipPOh0pkss%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096123553/30780af7416309f019a58995/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+14_37_23.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c100bb22ec83dfc1ed4df115f732525353042677d1e4d172160101d4b24f8bc7&req=dSAuEMh8noRaWvMW1HO4zQAcjl1ePwMGIEP8xCS8tyyw3sOGhSk4YGvXBrlV%0AKWbib%2B7j0ipPOh0pkss%3D%0A)

Two types of Pass can be created in PracSuite:

*   **Sessions** - Designed for redemptions of item codes with the same value. For example, a 10-pack of pilates or group exercise sessions.
    
*   **Money Pool** - Designed for redemptions of item codes with different values. This could be viewed as a voucher that allows the patient to redeem appointments across different professions. For example, massage appointments of different durations with different fees.
    

Along with the Pass Type, you'll need to set the following:

*   **Start Date** - This is the date from which the pass becomes valid. It can either be the date of purchase or the date of the first redemption using the pass.
    
*   **Expiry** \- Set the pass to expire after a certain timeframe after the start date. After the expiry date, the pass can no longer be used to redeem.
    
*   **Pass Code** - Identifies this pass throughout PracSuite and printed on invoices.
    
*   **Description** - A description of the pass that is printed on invoices.
    
*   **Print Code As** (Optional) - Overrides the Pass Code when printed on invoices.
    
*   **Barcode** (Optional) - If using a barcode scanner, add the barcode to add this pass to an invoice.
    
*   **Schedule** - For item code grouping in reports.
    

Pass Fee
--------

The Pass Fee represents what the patient will pay to purchase the pass. You can choose between setting a single fee for all patients or a different fee per Fee Category.

Money Pool passes also have an 'Available to Redeem' figure for scenarios where the pass provides additional value. In the example below, we have a pass that costs $200 to purchase, which provides $220 of value towards redemptions.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096106742/66da3cbc26ca2acf13f86814/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+14_00_35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1848a864cc0f710ac33f64c81805bb870a76d80aa365643433f119928c0cd3a1&req=dSAuEMh%2Bm4ZbW%2FMW1HO4zV8BxwWfIALhghkv%2BAVcKsXYCe3uC%2FyluuIclAbL%0A8p15eNF8PBmzFXSlHtw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096106742/66da3cbc26ca2acf13f86814/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+14_00_35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1848a864cc0f710ac33f64c81805bb870a76d80aa365643433f119928c0cd3a1&req=dSAuEMh%2Bm4ZbW%2FMW1HO4zV8BxwWfIALhghkv%2BAVcKsXYCe3uC%2FyluuIclAbL%0A8p15eNF8PBmzFXSlHtw%3D%0A)

For further information regarding GST and passes, see the [section below](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426809-creating-redeeming-passes#h_a923d2ba67)
.

Redeemable Items
----------------

Similar to an invoice containing item codes, passes are used to redeem item codes. When creating a pass, you need to specify which item codes can be redeemed using the pass.

Use the **Add** button to choose the items that can be redeemed with this pass.

### Redemption Value

The 'Redemption Value is the value that will be recorded on the **Pass** **Redemptions Report** when redeeming an item. For a 'Money Pool' pass, this is also the amount that will be deducted from the pool.

  
By default, the Redemption Value will be based on the Item Code's standard pricing according to the patient's Fee Category (as per regular invoicing). Alternatively, use the **Override Value** option to specify the redemption value for this item under this pass. The redemption value can also be changed ad-hoc at the time of redemption.

### Session Passes

Specify the maximum number of item codes that can be redeemed with this pass. In addition, select the item codes that can be redeemed and their redemption value. In the example below, the pass can redeem 10 of the 560 group consultation item codes.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096118544/f16f3aa58041dd7b09d3fad8/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+14_28_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=181f75962884a7020831d963f6d57e9050b85a9f4b1b5762eb5aa50dbb86f719&req=dSAuEMh%2FlYRbXfMW1HO4zfqpCLZi5yPN%2BBYhi%2F9I3oDwiuotYhPb8JyGjcIx%0AoWdlTDEUdG1ZEwTlQV4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096118544/f16f3aa58041dd7b09d3fad8/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+14_28_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=181f75962884a7020831d963f6d57e9050b85a9f4b1b5762eb5aa50dbb86f719&req=dSAuEMh%2FlYRbXfMW1HO4zfqpCLZi5yPN%2BBYhi%2F9I3oDwiuotYhPb8JyGjcIx%0AoWdlTDEUdG1ZEwTlQV4%3D%0A)

### Money Pool Passes

Specify the item codes that can be redeemed using this pass and their corresponding redemption value. For a 'Money Pool' pass, this is also the amount that will be deducted from the pool.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096118321/a7680d9d3300bfd4a8b988fe/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+14_27_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8aa9425ca0487df7f627eb37d077be1bcca509a8a91902ec9385cfc38fe1e029&req=dSAuEMh%2FlYJdWPMW1HO4zXlEd58%2BzconRf3jHXoHKQqLnaBHJuLFSA0YIBfx%0Au3wxk69BS8sqiTheXF0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096118321/a7680d9d3300bfd4a8b988fe/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+14_27_36.png?expires=1771821900&signature=8aa9425ca0487df7f627eb37d077be1bcca509a8a91902ec9385cfc38fe1e029&req=dSAuEMh%2FlYJdWPMW1HO4zXlEd58%2BzconRf3jHXoHKQqLnaBHJuLFSA0YIBfx%0Au3wxk69BS8sqiTheXF0%3D%0A)

Businesses
----------

You can specify which businesses this pass can be used at if needed.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096103235/1b8c63e93a66b4d030767ae6/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+13_52_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=936d0f5f09d8cbd6d187fd36a720e2c3f46729d5bf75184d84dd96fe4ad15a91&req=dSAuEMh%2BnoNcXPMW1HO4zbHUIlT2Xx8IxUfQh6wmDcvpybQFNANRuq93kN28%0AAmK2mvmUR8h9kj%2BRbjg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096103235/1b8c63e93a66b4d030767ae6/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+13_52_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=936d0f5f09d8cbd6d187fd36a720e2c3f46729d5bf75184d84dd96fe4ad15a91&req=dSAuEMh%2BnoNcXPMW1HO4zbHUIlT2Xx8IxUfQh6wmDcvpybQFNANRuq93kN28%0AAmK2mvmUR8h9kj%2BRbjg%3D%0A)

Terms and Conditions
--------------------

Terms and Conditions are displayed to patients who purchase passes online. This section can outline restrictions regarding the use of this pass, such as expiry dates and services it can be used to redeem.

* * *

Passes and GST
==============

Below is some essential information for understanding how GST is handled for each type of pass.

Session Passes
--------------

*   GST is included in the sale of the Session Pass itself and is not associated with individual session redemptions.
    
*   The Redemptions report will not show GST for Session Pass redemptions.
    
*   To report on GST for Session Passes, refer to the Billing report or Transaction report, which both reflect the pass sale.
    

Money Pool Passes
-----------------

*   GST is not applied to a Money Pool Pass at the time of purchase. Instead, GST accrues with each redemption using the pass.
    
*   The Redemptions report will reflect GST for Money Pool Pass redemptions, showing the GST amount accrued with each use.
    

* * *

Purchasing a Pass
=================

To purchase a pass, simply add a pass to an invoice like any other item code. Passes appear in their own category on the left-hand side.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1099605667/f31022e081c8c57d3d852788/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7712dd733750ab9ff4ee6042db880711a4f1af371c5077f5e66641322456377&req=dSAuH89%2BmIdZXvMW1HO4zWbGvtMp%2B%2B%2BaS8EnIWLXnGRS9z11%2FcBwWzhtC6zO%0A3OT0FRCfek8D6lJIayQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1099605667/f31022e081c8c57d3d852788/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b7712dd733750ab9ff4ee6042db880711a4f1af371c5077f5e66641322456377&req=dSAuH89%2BmIdZXvMW1HO4zWbGvtMp%2B%2B%2BaS8EnIWLXnGRS9z11%2FcBwWzhtC6zO%0A3OT0FRCfek8D6lJIayQ%3D%0A)

Note that non-pass item codes cannot be added to an invoice containing a pass. If the patient needs to be invoiced for other items along with a pass, you must create a separate invoice.

Note that the Invoice and the Pass are directly linked. Deleting one will delete the other.

Passes can also be purchased online when a patient logs into their account. Tyro Online Payments must be enabled. [More information regarding Passes and Online Bookings can be found here.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426817-passes-and-online-bookings)

After purchasing a pass, it will appear in the Passes tab of the patient file.

* * *

Redeeming Using a Pass
======================

There are two ways to start the pass redemption process:

Redeeming via the Appointment Book
----------------------------------

If an appointment's default item code can be redeemed, a pass icon will be displayed on the booking to indicate that the patient has a valid pass to use.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096162708/63942e58f45d62747c20298f/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_51_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c74e8e80b8113362ad858d7a201a1b1da2c5d4aa8a115c825f0416f1fbeb2917&req=dSAuEMh4n4ZfUfMW1HO4zWCD%2FTajVMOUnC9VK7Df%2FectUHIlOjM%2B6OuumVUh%0AB7BaWa2SgKQ0%2F%2Bda%2F%2FA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096162708/63942e58f45d62747c20298f/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_51_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c74e8e80b8113362ad858d7a201a1b1da2c5d4aa8a115c825f0416f1fbeb2917&req=dSAuEMh4n4ZfUfMW1HO4zWCD%2FTajVMOUnC9VK7Df%2FectUHIlOjM%2B6OuumVUh%0AB7BaWa2SgKQ0%2F%2Bda%2F%2FA%3D%0A)

To redeem the appointment, select Redeem Pass in the appointment menu. This will open the redemption screen. The lightning bolt icon will bypass the redemption screen and quickly redeem using the appointment's default item code.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096165425/ad0b529a73af9aa3209fd69f/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_56_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a71c76fb959921c5f3519ed6830d7b9548744d8960293761ae761271898891b&req=dSAuEMh4mIVdXPMW1HO4zZIUZ4ae1sui%2FQPJqKpLjTyJHzgCoFCIMT%2FpFsJ6%0ARKF3O%2FKAruNbUQOnKno%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096165425/ad0b529a73af9aa3209fd69f/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_56_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7a71c76fb959921c5f3519ed6830d7b9548744d8960293761ae761271898891b&req=dSAuEMh4mIVdXPMW1HO4zZIUZ4ae1sui%2FQPJqKpLjTyJHzgCoFCIMT%2FpFsJ6%0ARKF3O%2FKAruNbUQOnKno%3D%0A)

If a patient doesn't have a pass, the pass icon won't appear, and the appointment menu will display 'No Pass Available'.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096164950/e3e40c9f4bb9bebbb2e106cd/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_55_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a38076a5afb982baff3f8804a53505dbb14090cad7c23e9f6d6054a02e2364a4&req=dSAuEMh4mYhaWfMW1HO4zT0g6wmN7nfp5KMupRHvFodaTOKvG6nH%2BvaUkqnb%0AKFvQpKJsspUWFiFiNfc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096164950/e3e40c9f4bb9bebbb2e106cd/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_55_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a38076a5afb982baff3f8804a53505dbb14090cad7c23e9f6d6054a02e2364a4&req=dSAuEMh4mYhaWfMW1HO4zT0g6wmN7nfp5KMupRHvFodaTOKvG6nH%2BvaUkqnb%0AKFvQpKJsspUWFiFiNfc%3D%0A)

The redemption options will only appear if the appointment is booked on the same account that the pass was purchased on. If you're seeing No Pass Available, double-check that the appointment has been booked on the same account as the pass.

After proceeding to redeem, you can customise the redeemed item code and the redemption value if required.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096168057/fbccc2c850d9943f30733142/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_59_58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6f69e3ecbbfa9a7c4e4cef0deffeac3fc22b874e84f4c2c4dbd021d58871484b&req=dSAuEMh4lYFaXvMW1HO4zVvbfzzns5yS1fuueOoPi0TLjKfVZMGR4k3MPxVe%0A6wyT40u2ckcg%2BKD06%2BM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096168057/fbccc2c850d9943f30733142/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_59_58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6f69e3ecbbfa9a7c4e4cef0deffeac3fc22b874e84f4c2c4dbd021d58871484b&req=dSAuEMh4lYFaXvMW1HO4zVvbfzzns5yS1fuueOoPi0TLjKfVZMGR4k3MPxVe%0A6wyT40u2ckcg%2BKD06%2BM%3D%0A)

Select Save to finalise the redemption process.

Once the redemption is complete, the appointment will turn to your chosen processed colour, and a pass icon with a tick will appear.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096161840/550359bc42086d08a67c612e/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_50_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0dc024150080a11afdae66729b56f3b4035ded42317be21a7940f84cfb8b8c31&req=dSAuEMh4nIlbWfMW1HO4zdUlJSq5Llc8PCisvCZyVvNyDeGkpTeoxLT4xDyx%0AXXA1IFJuNIX50TLFXWM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096161840/550359bc42086d08a67c612e/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+15_50_31.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0dc024150080a11afdae66729b56f3b4035ded42317be21a7940f84cfb8b8c31&req=dSAuEMh4nIlbWfMW1HO4zdUlJSq5Llc8PCisvCZyVvNyDeGkpTeoxLT4xDyx%0AXXA1IFJuNIX50TLFXWM%3D%0A)

A notification will also display the patient's remaining pass balance.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096168307/0137c6b0516e32f04f887944/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+16_00_21.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b2fca878eeac161305be5241b75efe66de2917443fe0429c27aef59115a8e0c3&req=dSAuEMh4lYJfXvMW1HO4zSrNEonxLoZiwuGR6rKXDkv0bVwIZ3yD1tFMItwS%0ABTyJAZ32mcidXRn2Q4I%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1096168307/0137c6b0516e32f04f887944/CleanShot+2024-06-28+at+16_00_21.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b2fca878eeac161305be5241b75efe66de2917443fe0429c27aef59115a8e0c3&req=dSAuEMh4lYJfXvMW1HO4zSrNEonxLoZiwuGR6rKXDkv0bVwIZ3yD1tFMItwS%0ABTyJAZ32mcidXRn2Q4I%3D%0A)

You can also view the status of the pass in the appointment tooltip.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098317474/f549205b0a2043eb4a6ad35b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32a5f701edd258af63746844ef1cd72336b94ffae530e0df884e0e10b26548f9&req=dSAuHsp%2FmoVYXfMW1HO4zQS2neaniy3F9hm00kVCYG8w%2B8jWTdfPUpbG1tDJ%0AgSkWhJQhZV3o1GqcLP0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098317474/f549205b0a2043eb4a6ad35b/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=32a5f701edd258af63746844ef1cd72336b94ffae530e0df884e0e10b26548f9&req=dSAuHsp%2FmoVYXfMW1HO4zQS2neaniy3F9hm00kVCYG8w%2B8jWTdfPUpbG1tDJ%0AgSkWhJQhZV3o1GqcLP0%3D%0A)

Managing Passes in the Patient File
===================================

The Passes tab of the patient file displays all passes purchased by the patient and their current status. By default, expired and completed passes are filtered out of the list.

You can complete the following actions when hovering over a pass in the grid:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137184397/47351768010cad2dfe32f503/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+11_29_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2015686494d1b971b0cfae08a523bf5cdaf6cb096d2d540e4ec5660fb9c797ac&req=dSEkEch2mYJWXvMW1HO4zdRoSzZB%2B04uQSsThRcHASdb9fZgwmnmo3FSjk0a%0AkegYJIK0IV9VcbeLWZA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137184397/47351768010cad2dfe32f503/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+11_29_05.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2015686494d1b971b0cfae08a523bf5cdaf6cb096d2d540e4ec5660fb9c797ac&req=dSEkEch2mYJWXvMW1HO4zdRoSzZB%2B04uQSsThRcHASdb9fZgwmnmo3FSjk0a%0AkegYJIK0IV9VcbeLWZA%3D%0A)

Printing or Email Redemption Summaries
--------------------------------------

All redemptions made using a pass will be reflected on the corresponding invoice for the Pass. Use the print or email icons when hovering over a pass. You can also select the invoice number and use the print or email functions found at the top of the invoice.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137195258/effef41976335d40ac360ffb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1510fe361d958f93ce0ee4d31e3c1e916eb98e1ef55a89d190e559452b4b72bb&req=dSEkEch3mINaUfMW1HO4zVl3rJwktGyc8qtkfwUxgHxsyOLNu%2FwBMGo7PEsP%0AYExy9iMGWbYsOBXRHE8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137195258/effef41976335d40ac360ffb/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1510fe361d958f93ce0ee4d31e3c1e916eb98e1ef55a89d190e559452b4b72bb&req=dSEkEch3mINaUfMW1HO4zVl3rJwktGyc8qtkfwUxgHxsyOLNu%2FwBMGo7PEsP%0AYExy9iMGWbYsOBXRHE8%3D%0A)

Editing and Deleting Redemptions
--------------------------------

When selecting a pass in the grid, you'll see a summary of all redemptions made using the pass.

To edit a redemption, select the edit icon. If you need to delete a redemption, for example, if you've accidentally redeemed an appointment, hover over an individual redemption and select the trash icon to delete it.

---------------------------------

* * *

Reporting on Pass Statuses and Redemptions
==========================================

PracSuite includes two reports relating to passes:

Passes Report
-------------

The [Passes Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/passes)
 can be used to view purchased passes and their current status. It is ideal for viewing the number of redemptions patients have left and passes that are due to expire in a particular date range.

Pass Redemptions Report
-----------------------

The [Pass Redemptions Report](https://test2.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/redemptions)
 can be used to view all items redeemed using a pass.

Notes on Practitioner Wages
---------------------------

Note that the Billings Report displays income generated from the sale of the pass, not redemptions made using a pass. When running the Billings Report in the context of practitioner wages/commission, caution should be taken on whether the sale of the pass should be included in the practitioner's billing totals. Use the Item Codes filter on the Billings Report to exclude pass sales where relevant.

If pass redemptions should be factored into staff wages, the [Pass Redemptions Report](https://app.pracsuite.com/reports/billing/redemptions)
 should be used.

* * *

Passes and Online Booking
=========================

Passes can also be used in the online booking portal for logged-in patients. This includes the option to require a patient to pay or purchase a pass and redeem it to book appointments and classes in a self-service manner. While logged in, patients can view the status of their existing passes and purchase new passes.

[Click here to learn about configuring passes for online booking.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426817-passes-and-online-bookings)
