Passes and Online Bookings

Passes and Online Bookings
==========================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Configuring Online Booking Services](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426817-passes-and-online-bookings#h_52da1d814d)

[Logged In Patient Perspective](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426817-passes-and-online-bookings#h_795883813b)

[Viewing Pass Balances](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426817-passes-and-online-bookings#h_75c3781dc0)

[Redeeming Appointments](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426817-passes-and-online-bookings#h_ef243b5aeb)

[Purchasing Passes Online](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426817-passes-and-online-bookings#h_c256daeb7a)

Passes are designed to simplify the management and sale of appointment packs in your practice. Whether you’re offering a 10-pack of Pilates sessions or a bundle of group exercise classes, Passes provide a seamless experience for both your practice and your patients. When combined with the online booking system, Passes provide a self-service way for patients to purchase a pass and use it to redeem appointments.

[Read Passes Setup Guide](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9426809-creating-redeeming-passes)

If you have completed the general setup of passes, you can read on to learn more about passes and online booking.

* * *

Configuring Online Booking Services
===================================

Allowing patients to use a pass to redeem appointments is enabled per online booking service in [Settings > Online Booking > Services.](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/onlinebooking/services)

Select the settings cog on the right to begin configuring online payment and pass redemption settings for the selected Appointment Type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098354609/e1bbbc5e89a097c2f3922140/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_37_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a080c111e8ab98d9894399f4360723251881ffe7e048b47fc69d846bcd43dc4a&req=dSAuHsp7mYdfUPMW1HO4zdIIjLyCSagM1wolVV7vtuaV3qDZzfoNDff0EBz1%0A0DyRrdo1pwzrzyW1nbU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098354609/e1bbbc5e89a097c2f3922140/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_37_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a080c111e8ab98d9894399f4360723251881ffe7e048b47fc69d846bcd43dc4a&req=dSAuHsp7mYdfUPMW1HO4zdIIjLyCSagM1wolVV7vtuaV3qDZzfoNDff0EBz1%0A0DyRrdo1pwzrzyW1nbU%3D%0A)

You can configure what online payment or redemption options the patient has available for the selected appointment type.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098353133/f35d2e3e5da9452abe7941cb/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_44_42.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f280269ef84a985a2bef12013b17ae4b5ad3251833d32b0ef05824e2fb295552&req=dSAuHsp7noBcWvMW1HO4zcrCwMFmX25%2FoSP0Si0N1c0Bsrk5E7Oca9uqbrzt%0ATVYnrDr%2FIAQ1Ix0scLE%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098353133/f35d2e3e5da9452abe7941cb/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_44_42.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f280269ef84a985a2bef12013b17ae4b5ad3251833d32b0ef05824e2fb295552&req=dSAuHsp7noBcWvMW1HO4zcrCwMFmX25%2FoSP0Si0N1c0Bsrk5E7Oca9uqbrzt%0ATVYnrDr%2FIAQ1Ix0scLE%3D%0A)

If you do not see payment options, it means that you haven't enabled general online payment features powered by the Tyro Health Online integration. [Click here to learn more.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-how-to-enable-the-pracsuite-tyro-health-online-integration)

You can choose whether payment or redemptions when booking online are **required** or **optional**.

*   **Off -** No payment or redemption is available when booking online.
    
*   **Payments -** Payment with a credit or debit card is available when booking online.
    
*   **Pass Redemptions -** Pass redemptions are available when booking online.
    
*   **Both -** Payment and Pass redemptions are available when booking online.
    

It's also possible to enable a payment/redemption explanation to outline your policy and perhaps highlight any potential savings that might apply when purchasing a pass instead of paying individually per appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098354513/3a166b8bd15a55bc769a725e/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_45_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=01006ce22f9c5c569f1d000d975818843acab88ea36c6391cbf685a8c9259dcd&req=dSAuHsp7mYReWvMW1HO4zR%2BiuE5zA64FcHHZBQysadnTdspNKRFEE3BTfyGq%0ANJXkQ0PF1IN2tfqPmY4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098354513/3a166b8bd15a55bc769a725e/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_45_04.png?expires=1771821900&signature=01006ce22f9c5c569f1d000d975818843acab88ea36c6391cbf685a8c9259dcd&req=dSAuHsp7mYReWvMW1HO4zR%2BiuE5zA64FcHHZBQysadnTdspNKRFEE3BTfyGq%0ANJXkQ0PF1IN2tfqPmY4%3D%0A)

When allowing pass redemptions, you must specify which passes can be used to redeem this appointment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098354475/db8f8b4ac0112a17f6c0c1d2/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_48_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ec6a83ec1946254eb965352e251eab01d8ecbdcc398091e4cef3182d9f42ffb&req=dSAuHsp7mYVYXPMW1HO4zcMyxrY1CC6KQl8stL%2FcJbTSbibquCPvjC96J2ub%0A73Updqf1FXR4EHHfrOM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098354475/db8f8b4ac0112a17f6c0c1d2/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_48_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9ec6a83ec1946254eb965352e251eab01d8ecbdcc398091e4cef3182d9f42ffb&req=dSAuHsp7mYVYXPMW1HO4zcMyxrY1CC6KQl8stL%2FcJbTSbibquCPvjC96J2ub%0A73Updqf1FXR4EHHfrOM%3D%0A)

Online payments and redemptions rely on the Appointment Type's default item code being set correctly. In the case of pass redemptions, the Appointment Type's default item code must be listed as a redeemable item on any of the selected passes.

A red banner will be shown if this combination of settings is misconfigured. Hover over the learn more text for further details on the misconfiguration.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098353564/024977c430e6a45c9ecec8a7/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_48_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9e5fd091975c0c4979bc54ac4e529c05f9629df06479617986a5275b42be998&req=dSAuHsp7noRZXfMW1HO4zSy3fiiB21HJ0hauOCmUA2EKq%2BiOXF14BGnhDFJF%0AqSQGKpPCIDWFIcKRVCM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098353564/024977c430e6a45c9ecec8a7/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_48_51.png?expires=1771821900&signature=a9e5fd091975c0c4979bc54ac4e529c05f9629df06479617986a5275b42be998&req=dSAuHsp7noRZXfMW1HO4zSy3fiiB21HJ0hauOCmUA2EKq%2BiOXF14BGnhDFJF%0AqSQGKpPCIDWFIcKRVCM%3D%0A)

Save your changes to complete the pass configuration process for this appointment type.

You'll need to repeat this process for each online booking service and appointment type that patients can redeem using passes.

Read on below for a look at the patient's perspective.

* * *

Logged In Patient Perspective
=============================

Using Passes online requires patients to have registered for an online booking account. Passes can only be purchased and redeemed after logging in. **Patients who book as a guest cannot purchase or redeem appointments using passes.**

Viewing Pass Balances
---------------------

After a patient logs into their account, they will see the status of valid passes they have purchased, including any passes on their family accounts.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098377694/df63151b734cfcb2c6f3bb44/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+14_47_02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=436dda75fc11afbe4d5d57950cccd8997e8d9c812d2331e1b834c651a094a275&req=dSAuHsp5modWXfMW1HO4zZeJcC7E5nfsaplN9tXjYtksLmlZC%2BrlbuJtq395%0ARZH%2BDws5sjowWtJuy6k%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098377694/df63151b734cfcb2c6f3bb44/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+14_47_02.png?expires=1771821900&signature=436dda75fc11afbe4d5d57950cccd8997e8d9c812d2331e1b834c651a094a275&req=dSAuHsp5modWXfMW1HO4zZeJcC7E5nfsaplN9tXjYtksLmlZC%2BrlbuJtq395%0ARZH%2BDws5sjowWtJuy6k%3D%0A)

Redeeming Appointments
----------------------

If a patient has a valid pass that can be used to redeem their appointment, it will be displayed at the last step of the online booking process. If they don't have a compatible pass, they'll have the option to purchase one if you have online payments enabled.

The example below shows a patient booking multiple class appointments and choosing a pass to redeem each of them.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098381801/c552563a3bbb17c98275d7c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c86c4acb9ea69613d2806249bc97e405fe49421055a9e3a5011c3396bff9d331&req=dSAuHsp2nIlfWPMW1HO4zTEHvDS4z9hl1z82egR7Xm228y9uofBXxFO%2BNmrD%0AxktYpHTXdJLjeWvfLrM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098381801/c552563a3bbb17c98275d7c9/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c86c4acb9ea69613d2806249bc97e405fe49421055a9e3a5011c3396bff9d331&req=dSAuHsp2nIlfWPMW1HO4zTEHvDS4z9hl1z82egR7Xm228y9uofBXxFO%2BNmrD%0AxktYpHTXdJLjeWvfLrM%3D%0A)

If an appointment is booked and redeemed online, it will automatically be marked as processed and redeemed so that the patient's pass balance is reduced.

Below is an example of how the appointment will appear in PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098390137/e388fa347fedca297d9372b2/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+15_05_28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14f8ec6dfe33b792b5bae465f114e278f25abd97d0a37f2b7cceef062c4d885f&req=dSAuHsp3nYBcXvMW1HO4zT%2FBUGA1x1uwSKz1ZvuJcrJ6c2Syt1wh%2BDThmZP7%0AgtGyQObQefoqXeRQIsI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098390137/e388fa347fedca297d9372b2/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+15_05_28.png?expires=1771821900&signature=14f8ec6dfe33b792b5bae465f114e278f25abd97d0a37f2b7cceef062c4d885f&req=dSAuHsp3nYBcXvMW1HO4zT%2FBUGA1x1uwSKz1ZvuJcrJ6c2Syt1wh%2BDThmZP7%0AgtGyQObQefoqXeRQIsI%3D%0A)

Purchasing Passes Online
========================

Purchasing passes online requires the [Tyro Health Online Integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/4617575-how-to-enable-the-pracsuite-tyro-health-online-integration)
 to process payments. This integration must be configured to use this feature.

Allowing patients to purchase passes online is optional. If you don't allow passes to be purchased online, passes can only be purchased in the practice.

If you want patients to be able to purchase passes online, online payments must be enabled in Settings > Online Booking > Overview.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137181803/96b3941401f0bd1ca73d3cbf/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+11_22_47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a16dc3357d0209711771a7a9aee660cfc3f6b4a33634677e98a8a27c378da83&req=dSEkEch2nIlfWvMW1HO4zV3FZlc5hswqCG5OE82feqkyoZ105m%2FjCEPpQ3tS%0AsXqJVwgSMKgwRB8JiN0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137181803/96b3941401f0bd1ca73d3cbf/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+11_22_47.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a16dc3357d0209711771a7a9aee660cfc3f6b4a33634677e98a8a27c378da83&req=dSEkEch2nIlfWvMW1HO4zV3FZlc5hswqCG5OE82feqkyoZ105m%2FjCEPpQ3tS%0AsXqJVwgSMKgwRB8JiN0%3D%0A)

All passes that can be used for redemptions online will then be available for purchase online.

After logging into their online booking account, a patient can select the Purchase Pass button at the top of the page. Passes can also be purchased during the booking process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098378340/5bc9337fc9397a6e4fa3f732/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+14_47_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80532593728e679799a9ac0a655ee5b917f23d27c4661e7c1fbaadc044e756c3&req=dSAuHsp5lYJbWfMW1HO4zdCpWrn1u%2Ft0PZiciD54LP1RSv7ejUg%2BCAK%2FPEeF%0AEBAoDzGK9cmg807gRMY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098378340/5bc9337fc9397a6e4fa3f732/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+14_47_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=80532593728e679799a9ac0a655ee5b917f23d27c4661e7c1fbaadc044e756c3&req=dSAuHsp5lYJbWfMW1HO4zdCpWrn1u%2Ft0PZiciD54LP1RSv7ejUg%2BCAK%2FPEeF%0AEBAoDzGK9cmg807gRMY%3D%0A)

The patient can choose which pass they would like to purchase before proceeding to payment.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098379213/4dcf9de02a4bb56a13a6f554/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+14_49_15.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9450d35359a44c6de7875b56385fdf933e5b24c7db5e3a817db1be25a4196504&req=dSAuHsp5lINeWvMW1HO4zfpkne1jYS0j1ZoEachy6xCjsED8MjgcO56Lpgx%2F%0AG9Za%2BKENADbnY%2FXyzlg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098379213/4dcf9de02a4bb56a13a6f554/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+14_49_15.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9450d35359a44c6de7875b56385fdf933e5b24c7db5e3a817db1be25a4196504&req=dSAuHsp5lINeWvMW1HO4zfpkne1jYS0j1ZoEachy6xCjsED8MjgcO56Lpgx%2F%0AG9Za%2BKENADbnY%2FXyzlg%3D%0A)

Once payment has been confirmed, they will immediately be able to redeem appointments using that pass.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098379594/4ea4e395619270a8b2bac725/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+14_49_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5619e26d42be1489ab3088f5b250e3b8a8e2d0c2e3606e344cdc70e8fab54c7b&req=dSAuHsp5lIRWXfMW1HO4zSCmOC6b3Ipukx3QjxzoKZBRaFriDrpF950hbes7%0AnMZbQ%2BCesL6kwGzxZzs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098379594/4ea4e395619270a8b2bac725/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+14_49_53.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5619e26d42be1489ab3088f5b250e3b8a8e2d0c2e3606e344cdc70e8fab54c7b&req=dSAuHsp5lIRWXfMW1HO4zSCmOC6b3Ipukx3QjxzoKZBRaFriDrpF950hbes7%0AnMZbQ%2BCesL6kwGzxZzs%3D%0A)

Passes purchased online will be added to the patient's nominated Online Payments account. You can confirm which account is used for online payments by going to the **Accounts tab** of that patient file and selecting **Manage Accounts**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137182893/309bfc3e183b16579c0fdaaa/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+11_25_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ad4f60a672d42b5ab074545698a3b552fa67910bc4da6e8c3877ab6a4a3ae795&req=dSEkEch2n4lWWvMW1HO4zV9So%2FBP5iiKB6nZubIpsRLl1xeJxVT4fnAa6KMn%0AsepnEajqhdUjmr%2FV3nA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137182893/309bfc3e183b16579c0fdaaa/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+11_25_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ad4f60a672d42b5ab074545698a3b552fa67910bc4da6e8c3877ab6a4a3ae795&req=dSEkEch2n4lWWvMW1HO4zV9So%2FBP5iiKB6nZubIpsRLl1xeJxVT4fnAa6KMn%0AsepnEajqhdUjmr%2FV3nA%3D%0A)

Select which account you want to use for online payments.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098353438/a2726c755655bc3c12de4cb2/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_45_38.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2ebf032921af53603277fde743a7444a5e7402df2121d58af8247b6aa6f9c37&req=dSAuHsp7noVcUfMW1HO4zVJUQjFcnFuIeAJdSLASA9XuuPz9yVq%2FSCipBS8r%0Ay9Kki6UzuwAyUQis8BM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1098353438/a2726c755655bc3c12de4cb2/CleanShot+2024-07-01+at+13_45_38.png?expires=1771821900&signature=d2ebf032921af53603277fde743a7444a5e7402df2121d58af8247b6aa6f9c37&req=dSAuHsp7noVcUfMW1HO4zVJUQjFcnFuIeAJdSLASA9XuuPz9yVq%2FSCipBS8r%0Ay9Kki6UzuwAyUQis8BM%3D%0A)

Staff will be notified of the online purchase in the Online Payments alert category.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137182279/27a4d2e32ba4797f2454937f/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+11_23_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df43548e09b4760747d307d0e13b89094372e2c42e3c7adcf4eb440d92f550de&req=dSEkEch2n4NYUPMW1HO4zbbSS0MphVpwxv6t1VnGqLxZSFlU%2BpWIvR4mnJvq%0APPjJ0QFaTIsPUKhyun8%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137182279/27a4d2e32ba4797f2454937f/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+11_23_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=df43548e09b4760747d307d0e13b89094372e2c42e3c7adcf4eb440d92f550de&req=dSEkEch2n4NYUPMW1HO4zbbSS0MphVpwxv6t1VnGqLxZSFlU%2BpWIvR4mnJvq%0APPjJ0QFaTIsPUKhyun8%3D%0A)

NDIS Rounding

NDIS Rounding
=============

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Quantity \* Item Fee Examples](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9463962-ndis-rounding#h_d79b1ac0b7)

[Hourly Billing Examples](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9463962-ndis-rounding#h_8b4fba6f77)

In [Settings > Billing](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/billing/list)
, we've added a new '[NDIS rounding logic](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9463962-ndis-rounding)
' option to better handle item quantities and fees when invoicing under the NDIS, where fees are typically rounded down. It ensures smoother interactions with plan managers and the NDIA, reducing rounding issues and minimising rejections for invoices and bulk uploads.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1080350149/4767b6cc67deb0d82f21e5a1/CleanShot+2024-06-13+at+14_37_38.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a6159e462a63546b737af3a9087a2c29a1aa6ebd369d47a049ef050efebed40&req=dSAvFsp7nYBbUPMW1HO4zaFOo8EsplZOAkeITvsxwsdcZ1PoU%2BCrOzCs8RPS%0A%2BZaSvMCzc8Uxp9n5m08%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1080350149/4767b6cc67deb0d82f21e5a1/CleanShot+2024-06-13+at+14_37_38.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0a6159e462a63546b737af3a9087a2c29a1aa6ebd369d47a049ef050efebed40&req=dSAvFsp7nYBbUPMW1HO4zaFOo8EsplZOAkeITvsxwsdcZ1PoU%2BCrOzCs8RPS%0A%2BZaSvMCzc8Uxp9n5m08%3D%0A)

Further information regarding the impact of the NDIS logic feature on item quantities and fees can be found below.

All invoicing in PracSuite will be influenced by this logic. Practices that don't exclusively bill to the NDIS should carefully consider this before enabling the feature.

Quantity \* Item Fee Examples
=============================

When the item fee is multiplied by the quantity, the resulting value can be several decimal places, usually rounded up. When NDIS logic is enabled, we will round down.

### Example 1

$193.99 \* 2.25 qty (2 hours 15 minutes) = $436.4775

*   With NDIS logic disabled, PracSuite will round up to $436.48.
    
*   With NDIS logic enabled, PracSuite will round down to $436.47.
    

### Example 2

$193.99 \* 0.5 qty (30 minutes) = $96.995

*   With NDIS logic disabled, PracSuite will round up to $97.00.
    
*   With NDIS logic enabled, PracSuite will round down to $96.99.
    

Hourly Billing Examples
=======================

Hourly Billing is designed for practices that invoice at an hourly rate, such as with the NDIS. When invoicing via the Appointment Book, Hourly Billing will set the quantity field for the item code based on the appointment duration. For example, a quantity of 1 = 60 minutes, 0.5 = 30 minutes etc. [Click here to learn more about Hourly Billing.](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/8648935-using-the-hourly-billing-feature)

The rows highlighted in red represent intervals that can cause rounding issues when using the Hourly Billing.

When NDIS logic is enabled, the NDIS preference will be used for Hourly Billing conversions.

|     |     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Minutes** | **Quantity** | **Quantity (Rounded)** | **NDIS Preference** |
| 5   | 0.0833333 | 0.08 | 0.08 |
| 10  | 0.1666667 | 0.17 | 0.16 |
| 15  | 0.25 | 0.25 | 0.25 |
| 20  | 0.3333333 | 0.33 | 0.33 |
| 25  | 0.4166667 | 0.42 | 0.41 |
| 30  | 0.5 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
| 35  | 0.5833333 | 0.58 | 0.58 |
| 40  | 0.6666667 | 0.67 | 0.66 |
| 45  | 0.75 | 0.75 | 0.75 |
| 50  | 0.8333333 | 0.83 | 0.83 |
| 55  | 0.9166667 | 0.92 | 0.91 |
| 60  | 1   | 1   | 1   |

## Document 337 — Email Address on the 'Suppression List' (i.e. blocked from sending 'via PracSuite') | PracSuite Help Center {#doc-337}
[http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9575181-email-address-on-the-suppression-list-i-e-blocked-from-sending-via-pracsuite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9575181-email-address-on-the-suppression-list-i-e-blocked-from-sending-via-pracsuite)

[All Collections](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/)

[SMS, Email & Letters](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/collections/2491723-sms-email-letters)

Email Address on the 'Suppression List' (i.e. blocked from sending 'via PracSuite')

Email Address on the 'Suppression List' (i.e. blocked from sending 'via PracSuite')
===================================================================================

Updated over 10 months ago

### Contents

1) [Overview](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9575181-email-address-on-the-suppression-list-i-e-blocked-from-sending-via-pracsuite#h_e74a189c0f)

2) [Why do emails get rejected or bounced?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9575181-email-address-on-the-suppression-list-i-e-blocked-from-sending-via-pracsuite#h_816a85a0a4)

3) [Why does PracSuite need a suppression list?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9575181-email-address-on-the-suppression-list-i-e-blocked-from-sending-via-pracsuite#h_1e745f6c68)

4) [How do I know when an address is on the suppression list?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9575181-email-address-on-the-suppression-list-i-e-blocked-from-sending-via-pracsuite#h_748557c510)

5) [How do I resolve this?](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9575181-email-address-on-the-suppression-list-i-e-blocked-from-sending-via-pracsuite#h_a175a9fa54)
  
​

* * *

#### Overview

There are several ways that PracSuite can send emails on behalf of your business, including sending "**via PracSuite**". When sending emails this way it means you are sending an email using our PracSuite domain and the unique address associated with your account:  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1107119281/df8979d9a61afd8069f1bd09/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af7a12249c9373bfeacf7e0842b9573d8dc77827d1dcf3fb25ee90425e32256f&req=dSEnEch%2FlINXWPMW1HO4zRcvG9Qtq%2FOyjPyeUZTYchnhnH0g4cGc9rmUgaMM%0A0TDFAPxJaNBALkHn7kw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1107119281/df8979d9a61afd8069f1bd09/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=af7a12249c9373bfeacf7e0842b9573d8dc77827d1dcf3fb25ee90425e32256f&req=dSEnEch%2FlINXWPMW1HO4zRcvG9Qtq%2FOyjPyeUZTYchnhnH0g4cGc9rmUgaMM%0A0TDFAPxJaNBALkHn7kw%3D%0A)

  
It's important to understand that this service is managed with a '**suppression list**', which means any emails you send that are **rejected** or **bounce** will result in that recipient being blocked (i.e. added to the suppression list).  
​  
This is an important feature that protects the PracSuite domain and helps prevent your emails from being marked as spam.

* * *

#### Why do emails get rejected or bounced?

*   The email address is invalid:
    
    *   The email address is incorrect (i.e. there is a typo in the address).
        
    *   The email address does not exist, or did not exist at the time.  
        ​
        
    
*   The recipient has blocked receiving emails from your PracSuite address:
    
    *   The person receiving your message has previously marked your email as spam.
        
    *   The person receiving your message has message filtering or spam policies that are blocking your emails automatically.
        
    

* * *

#### Why does PracSuite need a suppression list?

*   When sending via PracSuite you are technically sending using our 'PracSuite' domain (i.e. the email is using _[client.XXXX@send-via.pracsuite.com](mailto:client.XXXX@send-via.pracsuite.com)_ as the sending address).  
    ​
    
*   Each time an email is sent from the PracSuite domain and gets rejected or bounced, it lowers our **Sender Reputation**. It's important that we protect our sender reputation to ensure emails sent via PracSuite are less likely to be considered spam.  
    ​
    
*   By adding emails to a suppression list when they are rejected or bounce, we prevent all users from sending to that same address in error and lowering our sender reputation.
    

* * *

#### How do I know when an address is on the suppression list?

*   After sending to a suppressed email address, you will receive a notification via email titled '**PracSuite Email Delivery Failure**'.  
    ​
    
*   This email will include:
    
    *   The Subject of the email.
        
    *   The email address you attempted to send to.
        
    *   The reason the email failed.
        
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1107106948/cd6d89e8a3f41344ee838c01/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4d3da821a92bc0eb54d477a71683830c2609800ac9e786e68ccee4b0186dc18&req=dSEnEch%2Bm4hbUfMW1HO4zS2cgeke26PpdmmaTyoSExmSxeLZzT7CXw2HwcMk%0AmcS6x5YTgcDVqri1Yps%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1107106948/cd6d89e8a3f41344ee838c01/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e4d3da821a92bc0eb54d477a71683830c2609800ac9e786e68ccee4b0186dc18&req=dSEnEch%2Bm4hbUfMW1HO4zS2cgeke26PpdmmaTyoSExmSxeLZzT7CXw2HwcMk%0AmcS6x5YTgcDVqri1Yps%3D%0A)

* * *

#### How do I resolve this?

After confirming an email address has been added to the suppression list, you should:

*   Carefully check the spelling of the email address is correct.  
    ​
    
*   If required, contact the recipient and confirm the email address is correct.  
    ​
    
*   If you believe the email address is correct, try sending a test email to the address from **outside of PracSuite** (such as using your Outlook or Gmail account directly).  
    ​
    
*   Once you are certain the email address is valid, you can check and remove the email address from the suppression list by going to the **Tools > Email > Unblock Email Address** page.  
    ​
    
    *   Please note that customers can legitimately mark your emails as spam, and in these circumstances you should not attempt to email them further without their permission.  
        ​
        
    
*   If you are still having difficulty, or the email address is **re-added** to the suppression list later:  
    ​
    
    *   Contact the recipient and ask them to 'whitelist' emails from PracSuite.
        
    *   Consider using [Outlook integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5504489-enabling-the-outlook-integration)
         or [Gmail integration](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/5489626-enabling-the-gmail-integration)
         to send your emails.
        
    

* * *

  
Please note this guide is only relevant to emails sent using the **via PracSuite** method, which is configured under [Settings > Businesses](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/businesses)
. If you are already sending emails using **Outlook integration** or **Gmail integration** you will need to investigate any delivery issues through those platforms.​

* * *

Saving Your Signature in the PDF Editor

Saving Your Signature in the PDF Editor
=======================================

Updated over a year ago

The built-in PDF Viewer and Editor in PracSuite allows users to fill and sign PDFs, including the ability to upload and save your signature.

The easiest way to save your signature in the PDF Editor is from the **Tools > PDF Editor** menu at the top of PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137261820/65b62d32895b11a029b9c2e4/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_20_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c474097668b0dde8da08890bbaedbbd6642fe985f0c0c6ec8e86eb02a861fc59&req=dSEkEct4nIldWfMW1HO4zVB0SblpCgZNYQDukhPXd%2F7VAH4nk0aVwwpMD8gd%0AJxtMnek70d%2BHKjevqlM%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137261820/65b62d32895b11a029b9c2e4/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_20_46.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c474097668b0dde8da08890bbaedbbd6642fe985f0c0c6ec8e86eb02a861fc59&req=dSEkEct4nIldWfMW1HO4zVB0SblpCgZNYQDukhPXd%2F7VAH4nk0aVwwpMD8gd%0AJxtMnek70d%2BHKjevqlM%3D%0A)

Select the **Fill and Sign** tab and then select **Signature/Initials.**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137259908/64bcaa5726b49b17e99e2685/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_18_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=68d965484f5f8e8ef2539496467fc22da25a233b9949f677341faf14755e0b21&req=dSEkEct7lIhfUfMW1HO4zQHBPAABTG9hBFOee7e8uPVYD4g6dw4eCOcpa2sk%0A3EB%2FkY1wXfBTLiKlv0g%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137259908/64bcaa5726b49b17e99e2685/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_18_07.png?expires=1771821900&signature=68d965484f5f8e8ef2539496467fc22da25a233b9949f677341faf14755e0b21&req=dSEkEct7lIhfUfMW1HO4zQHBPAABTG9hBFOee7e8uPVYD4g6dw4eCOcpa2sk%0A3EB%2FkY1wXfBTLiKlv0g%3D%0A)

You have a few choices as to how you enter your signature into PracSuite:

*   **Draw** - Use your mouse or touchscreen to draw your signature.
    
*   **Type** - Type your name/initials to have your signature drawn in a fixed font.
    
*   **Upload** - Browse to upload an image of your signature.
    

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137260192/d08f9ace6cd9220a82c491a3/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_19_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c0adb70dbc9972daf4b9f9c55b9aded82f19f54f86f5756b15def319e131b10d&req=dSEkEct4nYBWW%2FMW1HO4zbXSJiDFSSP7%2FYXvQrlQfXePWYL6%2FEoUQpPRywjC%0AhMYr1xzOqeCkhuj2Axk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137260192/d08f9ace6cd9220a82c491a3/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_19_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c0adb70dbc9972daf4b9f9c55b9aded82f19f54f86f5756b15def319e131b10d&req=dSEkEct4nYBWW%2FMW1HO4zbXSJiDFSSP7%2FYXvQrlQfXePWYL6%2FEoUQpPRywjC%0AhMYr1xzOqeCkhuj2Axk%3D%0A)

An example of the Draw method is shown below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137260105/183d1290762349f24ebadbb1/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_18_35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bdc0ba4bf574670f3d9d7061a50fd02385a157fc6fcbf66226dc1203a12115b2&req=dSEkEct4nYBfXPMW1HO4zTFWIu%2BgP8anUPhZRf7hF5Z0pC1c%2Blu9TPMibMxP%0AO3FtBGJXwnnFs2taNBA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137260105/183d1290762349f24ebadbb1/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_18_35.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bdc0ba4bf574670f3d9d7061a50fd02385a157fc6fcbf66226dc1203a12115b2&req=dSEkEct4nYBfXPMW1HO4zTFWIu%2BgP8anUPhZRf7hF5Z0pC1c%2Blu9TPMibMxP%0AO3FtBGJXwnnFs2taNBA%3D%0A)

Select **Create** to store your signature.

To finalise this process, insert your signature into the blank PDF and select **Save**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137260391/f55a854167c53ca29fbcae93/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_19_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=961ded757f788fcccf8eb383874334ebf8c352c2c7971cc0a7202f7d076b2382&req=dSEkEct4nYJWWPMW1HO4zfYEz5DM%2BCLA5iuqNdHMeXoTZIKp8bcHh6BVhhNA%0AYUEWnRo3xmGLge4Vi48%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1137260391/f55a854167c53ca29fbcae93/CleanShot+2024-08-07+at+14_19_34.png?expires=1771821900&signature=961ded757f788fcccf8eb383874334ebf8c352c2c7971cc0a7202f7d076b2382&req=dSEkEct4nYJWWPMW1HO4zfYEz5DM%2BCLA5iuqNdHMeXoTZIKp8bcHh6BVhhNA%0AYUEWnRo3xmGLge4Vi48%3D%0A)

Enabling PDF Security

Enabling PDF Security
=====================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[Applying PDF Security](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9855448-enabling-pdf-security#h_b832c7cf56)

[Requiring a password to open a PDF](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9855448-enabling-pdf-security#h_9052ed73ad)

[Customising Other PDF Permissions](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9855448-enabling-pdf-security#h_8097646195)

PracSuite includes tools to password protect PDFs and apply other restrictions.

Applying PDF Security
=====================

After opening a PDF from a patient file, select the **Security** button in the menu bar to manage permissions.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175764606/415472e3905436bb3b259561/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_38_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4ca50be7c98da7cf655aeb5a60ac2c3f5240c872a8cb8db34f8bb2b933c8d7c8&req=dSEgE854mYdfX%2FMW1HO4zUjuaMLqCL50ejo5kvsCFuu6daj1gJo63sh5rvf5%0A34cCCjWMax9TnTFlvGU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175764606/415472e3905436bb3b259561/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_38_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4ca50be7c98da7cf655aeb5a60ac2c3f5240c872a8cb8db34f8bb2b933c8d7c8&req=dSEgE854mYdfX%2FMW1HO4zUjuaMLqCL50ejo5kvsCFuu6daj1gJo63sh5rvf5%0A34cCCjWMax9TnTFlvGU%3D%0A)

Before you can apply permissions, you will need to choose an **Owner Password**. This password will be required to edit or remove permissions for this PDF moving forward.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175764744/98a115884da5e0e5d2cc9284/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_38_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=57f6d865ca7b29790736ecc5289d5f429f9d0eba36549a3f68c6185b902b7027&req=dSEgE854mYZbXfMW1HO4zfD9P0vdFbS4OY%2BHGDvKreeI%2Fod4Xk%2FnYzRj7xzb%0AJmY4deI4dcQMSX5c1Xw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175764744/98a115884da5e0e5d2cc9284/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_38_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=57f6d865ca7b29790736ecc5289d5f429f9d0eba36549a3f68c6185b902b7027&req=dSEgE854mYZbXfMW1HO4zfD9P0vdFbS4OY%2BHGDvKreeI%2Fod4Xk%2FnYzRj7xzb%0AJmY4deI4dcQMSX5c1Xw%3D%0A)

After choosing an Owner Password, you'll be able to customise permission for this PDF

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175764885/3d1e190a229cd3178febeae3/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_39_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d122c3076269d2d60f9a06eea3c8a6bbe868137ecc6d7be0388585747eb1517&req=dSEgE854mYlXXPMW1HO4zRT7m9IzVjysuLpFdsgBavDEEtpFa3Luui5Aiqec%0AXX2a3bHITLOo3xx4ssg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175764885/3d1e190a229cd3178febeae3/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_39_11.png?expires=1771821900&signature=9d122c3076269d2d60f9a06eea3c8a6bbe868137ecc6d7be0388585747eb1517&req=dSEgE854mYlXXPMW1HO4zRT7m9IzVjysuLpFdsgBavDEEtpFa3Luui5Aiqec%0AXX2a3bHITLOo3xx4ssg%3D%0A)

Requiring a password to open a PDF
==================================

Enable the option to require a password to open the document and choose a password accordingly. The password to view the document should gennerally be different to the owner password that is required to edit PDF permissions.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175773199/ef681f44b22163b6e107510e/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_53_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52d5504a1ceef567db2df8f2453f660436bbf5a3ff45946d381929b352556231&req=dSEgE855noBWUPMW1HO4zVy9Jy83LBWJRKbB8LNwQiDIfg1np6wIZoBARFqa%0AYDuiEmWOhth88xKVpIg%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175773199/ef681f44b22163b6e107510e/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_53_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=52d5504a1ceef567db2df8f2453f660436bbf5a3ff45946d381929b352556231&req=dSEgE855noBWUPMW1HO4zVy9Jy83LBWJRKbB8LNwQiDIfg1np6wIZoBARFqa%0AYDuiEmWOhth88xKVpIg%3D%0A)

After applying the open password, select **Save** to finalise the process.

When opening the PDF, the user will be prompted to enter the document password.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765669/a019811da87fa6bc8252c7cc/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_40_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c109ee5f65f49f0542384cee605c20d6d7c63b342e5f6ae024727feba768564&req=dSEgE854mIdZUPMW1HO4zVRSrO4CB00s34YXb9CLjlpg5CwFGM57OKq5Qwn%2F%0AdZ%2FoE1rSF6%2BTJE29HJc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765669/a019811da87fa6bc8252c7cc/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_40_20.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c109ee5f65f49f0542384cee605c20d6d7c63b342e5f6ae024727feba768564&req=dSEgE854mIdZUPMW1HO4zVRSrO4CB00s34YXb9CLjlpg5CwFGM57OKq5Qwn%2F%0AdZ%2FoE1rSF6%2BTJE29HJc%3D%0A)

Customising Other PDF Permissions
=================================

Other permissions can be restricted in the PDF, such as:

*   Printing
    
*   Copying Test or Graphics
    
*   Inserting, Deleting or Rotate Pages
    
*   Adding Annotations or Signature or Filling Existing Form Fields
    

PracSuite cannot guarantee that the permissions will be enforced by all PDF viewers. While we ensure the resulting PDF file includes these permissions in its properties, not all viewers will respect these settings.

After applying your desired permissions, select **Save** to finalise the process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765258/511f721a0229fba8b3a51345/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_39_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5931b4884cb951886366eb9b10641ce57cc373244647f144da6b2ef081f6c965&req=dSEgE854mINaUfMW1HO4zRNFX4%2F9OPshEQ7x%2BXo4jcE8%2FDpThM8FdOR7TnHD%0Abgkyt7%2F3%2Fq6pnJJGDBw%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765258/511f721a0229fba8b3a51345/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_39_41.png?expires=1771821900&signature=5931b4884cb951886366eb9b10641ce57cc373244647f144da6b2ef081f6c965&req=dSEgE854mINaUfMW1HO4zRNFX4%2F9OPshEQ7x%2BXo4jcE8%2FDpThM8FdOR7TnHD%0Abgkyt7%2F3%2Fq6pnJJGDBw%3D%0A)

Removing PDF Security
=====================

To remove PDF security, select the Clear Security button. The Owner Password is required to complete this process.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765479/cd0af7843a68a03ad325b808/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_40_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=277640356d6b13cf02f3f015a14b18e58f937c212085eebb1dd4f1f1b2f01f10&req=dSEgE854mIVYUPMW1HO4zdHmRUyQWswQALyLQUs73iU7GqHgBhnKUjy4Fl2%2B%0A7YYB0PDF7iE3VTq%2FLBY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765479/cd0af7843a68a03ad325b808/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_40_01.png?expires=1771821900&signature=277640356d6b13cf02f3f015a14b18e58f937c212085eebb1dd4f1f1b2f01f10&req=dSEgE854mIVYUPMW1HO4zdHmRUyQWswQALyLQUs73iU7GqHgBhnKUjy4Fl2%2B%0A7YYB0PDF7iE3VTq%2FLBY%3D%0A)

Applying PDF Security When Creating or Emailing Letters
=======================================================

PDF permissions can be applied when creating or emailing letters.

When saving a letter, use the drop down menu to select the **Save as PDF & Secure** option to manage permissions.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765969/3211f77ea2aa3531be311cbd/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_40_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dbe81eb1263b859098eb10e054cc9c3750b340602f19455c1cd4f45418d7275a&req=dSEgE854mIhZUPMW1HO4zRYJVUDkmFpqaqMD6cP1zGYgwId0LJ5nCIpXK9yh%0ArGhNl7ZOvpuOX0HDFIo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765969/3211f77ea2aa3531be311cbd/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_40_43.png?expires=1771821900&signature=dbe81eb1263b859098eb10e054cc9c3750b340602f19455c1cd4f45418d7275a&req=dSEgE854mIhZUPMW1HO4zRYJVUDkmFpqaqMD6cP1zGYgwId0LJ5nCIpXK9yh%0ArGhNl7ZOvpuOX0HDFIo%3D%0A)

When emailing the PDF, use the drop down meny to select **Email as PDF & Secure** option to manage permissions.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765801/58f037157c59c9749dac6f55/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_40_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=181cc731d094c03348850bf81c1001097f794c6fefeb7e7915d6ea125ca1f3d7&req=dSEgE854mIlfWPMW1HO4zQaxCTzv%2FL7OKP2I55Uep%2FefG1g7YvumqPg9UDNO%0A%2F57RnmtM%2BNhduQOG5ZQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1175765801/58f037157c59c9749dac6f55/CleanShot+2024-09-11+at+08_40_32.png?expires=1771821900&signature=181cc731d094c03348850bf81c1001097f794c6fefeb7e7915d6ea125ca1f3d7&req=dSEgE854mIlfWPMW1HO4zQaxCTzv%2FL7OKP2I55Uep%2FefG1g7YvumqPg9UDNO%0A%2F57RnmtM%2BNhduQOG5ZQ%3D%0A)

Enabling PracSuite AI

Enabling PracSuite AI
=====================

Updated over 8 months ago

Unlock the efficiency of [PracSuite AI](https://pracsuite.com/artificialintelligence)
, where your dictations and patient conversations are instantly converted into accurate clinical notes and letters. Our automation streamlines documentation, reducing admin time and allowing you to focus on patient care. Whether it’s comprehensive notes or letters, PracSuite AI ensures precision, saving you time on paperwork so you can spend more time with patients and on yourself.

Free Trial
==========

**All practitioners using PracSuite are eligible for a 30-day free trial of PracSuite AI features.** Enable the free trial in [Settings > PracSuite Account > AI](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/ai)
.

Pricing
=======

PracSuite AI is an _optional_ add-on priced at $48 ex GST per month per full-time practitioner and $28 ex GST per month per [part-time practitioner](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/7438358-pracsuite-subscription-pricing#h_585b116f84)
, in addition to existing PracSuite subscription fees. This add-on includes the following features:

*   AI clinical notes
    
*   AI-generated letters
    
*   Voice-to-text clinical transcription
    
*   Patient conversation transcription
    
*   User-generated AI templates
    
*   User-generated AI letter templates
    
*   Organisation-wide shared templates
    
*   Unlimited individual practitioner sessions
    
*   Professional Support
    

Terms and conditions for PracSuite AI can be [found here.](https://pracsuite.com/termsandconditionsai)

Enabling Practitioner AI Features
=================================

PracSuite AI features can be enabled in [Settings > PracSuite Account > AI](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/pracsuiteaccount/ai)
.

Start with enabling PracSuite AI at the top of the page.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1227100123/7abeee76b031885218266b86f015/CleanShot+X+2024-10-24+15_55_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1931fbd032f71289b34a6e7185956b0c961d02cd0bcc35e1e1495ea9a590604e&req=dSIlEch%2BnYBdWvMW1HO4zY6C3Y7R%2BNWmFLflEGdazRU%2FndqXDKEYxwf5qLlX%0AC63QsVbvhuR0ac%2Fy9VU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1227100123/7abeee76b031885218266b86f015/CleanShot+X+2024-10-24+15_55_56.png?expires=1771821900&signature=1931fbd032f71289b34a6e7185956b0c961d02cd0bcc35e1e1495ea9a590604e&req=dSIlEch%2BnYBdWvMW1HO4zY6C3Y7R%2BNWmFLflEGdazRU%2FndqXDKEYxwf5qLlX%0AC63QsVbvhuR0ac%2Fy9VU%3D%0A)

Further down the page, you'll see a list of all practitioners that are currently active in your PracSuite subscription. You can choose which practitioners you would like to subscribe to the PracSuite AI features for.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1227100484/db6659646f11d1b4c22b3f4e6578/CleanShot+X+2024-10-24+16_08_12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0877db5e7714996e60636cf6e25db5f9556f350e79d5a09e171b2b5e80ae859d&req=dSIlEch%2BnYVXXfMW1HO4zVsPzSMFT7fBSzpKWr14iMAFYkt%2FbNwazzJycZIb%0AOOHeS13gqYJfY6Np92A%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1227100484/db6659646f11d1b4c22b3f4e6578/CleanShot+X+2024-10-24+16_08_12.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0877db5e7714996e60636cf6e25db5f9556f350e79d5a09e171b2b5e80ae859d&req=dSIlEch%2BnYVXXfMW1HO4zVsPzSMFT7fBSzpKWr14iMAFYkt%2FbNwazzJycZIb%0AOOHeS13gqYJfY6Np92A%3D%0A)

After enabling PracSuite AI for the desired practitioners, select **Save** to finalise your changes.

These practitioners will now be able to use PracSuite AI features. They may need to log out and back in to see the new tools.

General AI Settings
-------------------

Along with enabling the AI features per practitioner, two general settings control whether dictation and conversation transcriptions are saved for all practitioners. This option is enabled by default but can be disabled if practices do not wish for transcriptions to be saved. When disabled, only the AI-generated clinical note will be saved.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1177275521/95196c7e397579a3d9396854/CleanShot+2024-09-12+at+15_23_58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=66dfa0f25a7687a9b2e2ff21ad9999c8e79763d3f667c196019c58318dd2fd60&req=dSEgEct5mIRdWPMW1HO4zbRn1zVTrGC3xvqkGwsKcNKvG81EZkb508iRaPZ3%0AK85bfIDIo7xmv2oqiKs%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1177275521/95196c7e397579a3d9396854/CleanShot+2024-09-12+at+15_23_58.png?expires=1771821900&signature=66dfa0f25a7687a9b2e2ff21ad9999c8e79763d3f667c196019c58318dd2fd60&req=dSEgEct5mIRdWPMW1HO4zbRn1zVTrGC3xvqkGwsKcNKvG81EZkb508iRaPZ3%0AK85bfIDIo7xmv2oqiKs%3D%0A)

Customising Individual Practitioner AI Settings
===============================================

Each practitioner has some general settings related to PracSuite AI Settings that can be found in the user menu in the top right corner of PracSuite.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1177278013/6a086345e04398ebbe52d1bd/CleanShot+2024-09-12+at+15_28_16.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a46263c4c17c02561ef4088e0d3ee4de5dd98e488501bb08441600a01158bc2&req=dSEgEct5lYFeWvMW1HO4zbbnzSgNKKnmKrIaaga6Gb%2BXzPuPVKUAkxTjAN48%0AFfbC8hxwSMTeSals3r4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1177278013/6a086345e04398ebbe52d1bd/CleanShot+2024-09-12+at+15_28_16.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4a46263c4c17c02561ef4088e0d3ee4de5dd98e488501bb08441600a01158bc2&req=dSEgEct5lYFeWvMW1HO4zbbnzSgNKKnmKrIaaga6Gb%2BXzPuPVKUAkxTjAN48%0AFfbC8hxwSMTeSals3r4%3D%0A)

The following settings can be customised:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1277198654/724ec5d447c739c10b21222df63d/CleanShot+2024-12-05+at+13_47_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7fd75d87a9473b307fcb448f451007adb13ebcf0b1beccbec63f1cea41312ec5&req=dSIgEch3lYdaXfMW1HO4zRrJlqsnjZyed%2Btzu1O4FM62Mtl4CxATsVWube3X%0AB6smULz64dfg%2FVipvZ0%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1277198654/724ec5d447c739c10b21222df63d/CleanShot+2024-12-05+at+13_47_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7fd75d87a9473b307fcb448f451007adb13ebcf0b1beccbec63f1cea41312ec5&req=dSIgEch3lYdaXfMW1HO4zRrJlqsnjZyed%2Btzu1O4FM62Mtl4CxATsVWube3X%0AB6smULz64dfg%2FVipvZ0%3D%0A)

Profession Description
----------------------

Add your profession to provide the AI with context for your transcriptions and clinical notes. If no profession is entered, the default will be 'Health Professional'.

Other Preferences
-----------------

**Display transcription output for dictation**

Controls whether dictation transcripts are displayed or collapsed by default.

**Display transcription output for conversation**

Controls whether conversation transcripts are displayed or collapsed by default.

**Display consent screen to record a patient conversation**

Controls whether a prompt is displayed requesting consent before every conversation recording.

**Generate clinical note automatically after transcription**

Controls whether an AI clinical note is automatically generated using the user's selected default template when finishing a recording.

PracSuite AI Clinical Note Templates

PracSuite AI Clinical Note Templates
====================================

Updated over a year ago

Table of contents

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862593-pracsuite-ai-clinical-note-templates#h_1d84145862)

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862593-pracsuite-ai-clinical-note-templates#h_3562776bfb)

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862593-pracsuite-ai-clinical-note-templates#h_43d2c371ed)

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862593-pracsuite-ai-clinical-note-templates#h_c20f62209f)

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862593-pracsuite-ai-clinical-note-templates#h_ded06a7b97)

[](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862593-pracsuite-ai-clinical-note-templates#h_308c461e50)

PracSuite AI provides several standard AI clinical note templates that cover a range of common clinical note formats in Australia. The standard AI clinical note templates include:

*   **SOAP** - Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan
    
*   **SOAP** **(Brief)** - Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan (Brief)
    
*   **SOAPIE** - Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan, Intervention, Evaluation
    
*   **SOAPIE** **(Brief)** \- Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan, Intervention, Evaluation (Brief)
    
*   **Narrative Note** - Free-text narrative style
    
*   **Case Note** - Interactions, interventions, and plans
    
*   **CHIME** - Chief complaint, History, Investigation, Management, and Evaluation
    
*   **Progress Note** \- Track the patient's progress over time
    
*   **Care Plan** - Outline patient needs, including the interventions and goals of care
    

In addition to the built-in AI Clinical Note templates, you can create your own templates to meet specific requirements or align with your organisation's clinical notes policies. Two methods are available for customisation:

1.  **Fine-Tune a Built-in AI Clinical Template**
    
2.  **Create a Custom AI Clinical Note Template**
    

For most users, fine-tuning a built-in AI Clinical Template is the easiest and most effective way to achieve tailored outputs. On the other hand, creating a custom AI Clinical Note Template provides the highest level of flexibility and personalisation but requires more effort and expertise. Both methods allow you to create templates that suit your unique needs.

Fine Tuning a Built-In AI Templates
===================================

To customise PracSuite's built-in templates, go to [Settings > Clinical Notes > AI Clinical Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/aiclinicaltemplates)
.

Select **Fine Tune Built-In Template**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1242649004/eab714800b8cabf4cb262974b5be/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=38da2178df69de8636b147b94ccf72da6241aaa450444796516b3cd89c3829b8&req=dSIjFM96lIFfXfMW1HO4zXGlkdx3aEnFE3vwnQpRIwZ2jrc1ueHoIKaCZXiv%0ACKGZkuQ4GhLXyxJUGBc%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1242649004/eab714800b8cabf4cb262974b5be/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=38da2178df69de8636b147b94ccf72da6241aaa450444796516b3cd89c3829b8&req=dSIjFM96lIFfXfMW1HO4zXGlkdx3aEnFE3vwnQpRIwZ2jrc1ueHoIKaCZXiv%0ACKGZkuQ4GhLXyxJUGBc%3D%0A)

Enter a name for your customised template and, if needed, choose a folder to store it. Use the **Access** button to set which practitioners/professions can view this template.  
​  
Select a **Reference Template** from the dropdown list of built-in AI Clinical Note Templates. This will serve as the foundation for your custom template.

In the **Default AI Fine Tune** text box, type out any adjustments to guide the AI in modifying the built-in template. For example, you might add "include a differential diagnosis section" and "refer to the patient as <<Preferredname>>" to a new differential diagnosis section in the clinical note, and use the <<Preferredname>> clinical note merge field so that the Patients preferred name will be used in the clinical note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1255401904/ab469c8870e96823de79c1ed0b81/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6169e72820f9a202a97ca2d4ad2133a0330a9bf61d1c03cea54ae9d21251f48e&req=dSIiE81%2BnIhfXfMW1HO4zY2MMn9%2FotkYllragYWL7O0DXZOFWKOzsZ7pzOIM%0AP4VPZC57ubS%2FL%2BdV1IQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1255401904/ab469c8870e96823de79c1ed0b81/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=6169e72820f9a202a97ca2d4ad2133a0330a9bf61d1c03cea54ae9d21251f48e&req=dSIiE81%2BnIhfXfMW1HO4zY2MMn9%2FotkYllragYWL7O0DXZOFWKOzsZ7pzOIM%0AP4VPZC57ubS%2FL%2BdV1IQ%3D%0A)

Creating a Custom AI Clinical Note Template
===========================================

Custom AI Clinical Note templates can be created in [Settings > Clinical Notes > AI Clinical Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/aiclinicaltemplates)
.

Select **Add Template**.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1242656155/c777a94b65fa7f4ecf35dcf6c986/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab4188fd760fc1fdd3f94509f8a2e7191e7610da26be6784e8110dbf858c9d9f&req=dSIjFM97m4BaXPMW1HO4zXBiv0vIcObuU0WaUCw6Djg4dN33NN6OAdMxBQD5%0ADy8MTQxB2%2FxhXT0MfVQ%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1242656155/c777a94b65fa7f4ecf35dcf6c986/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=ab4188fd760fc1fdd3f94509f8a2e7191e7610da26be6784e8110dbf858c9d9f&req=dSIjFM97m4BaXPMW1HO4zXBiv0vIcObuU0WaUCw6Djg4dN33NN6OAdMxBQD5%0ADy8MTQxB2%2FxhXT0MfVQ%3D%0A)

Enter a name for the template and select a Folder for the template (if required). You can also use the **Access** button to set which practitioners/professions can view this template.

In the main section of the page, you can build your AI clinical note template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1212125663/c6f2f3c9ec0760c2e7eb6f38518d/CleanShot%2B2024-10-04%2Bat%2B10_02_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e34b10d750509d8d3bc902524e735ee606a04e20ced5e6832693a805d1130ed9&req=dSImFMh8mIdZWvMW1HO4zV3ps5ad1ZVsVbJwE53yHlzj54KXJKJGS8SoZpDu%0ANZb9W2vYzVLQA9mcWKo%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1212125663/c6f2f3c9ec0760c2e7eb6f38518d/CleanShot%2B2024-10-04%2Bat%2B10_02_30.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e34b10d750509d8d3bc902524e735ee606a04e20ced5e6832693a805d1130ed9&req=dSImFMh8mIdZWvMW1HO4zV3ps5ad1ZVsVbJwE53yHlzj54KXJKJGS8SoZpDu%0ANZb9W2vYzVLQA9mcWKo%3D%0A)

The leading instruction is _'Create a clinical note using the following format:'_

Below this, you will need to structure your template with sections and enter clear instructions for the AI regarding how it should use information collected through dictation, patient conversations or notepad transcripts to create the clinical note.

**AI instructions should be entered between square brackets.** For example:

\[Summarise the patient’s main symptoms, their current activity level, and their treatment goals.\]

AI Clinical Note template can also include patient merge fields, like <<FirstName>>, <<DateOfBirth>> etc.

* * *

AI Clinical Note Prompting Tips
===============================

If you’re new to AI prompts or haven’t used generative AI tools before, this guide will help you create effective clinical note templates.

**1\. What Are Prompts?**

Prompts are instructions that guide the AI in generating text based on the information contained within dictation or conversation recordings. By crafting clear and specific prompts, you ensure that the AI highlights the most important information and organises it meaningfully.

**2\. Think of Prompts as Guides for the AI**

When creating prompts, it’s helpful to ask yourself key questions about what information you want the AI to include. This reflective process will help you form precise and effective prompts that guide the AI towards generating useful content.

For example, ask yourself:

*   “What important details about the patient’s condition should be highlighted?”
    
*   “What key findings from the exam need to be included?”
    
*   “What changes in the patient’s condition should be noted?”
    

By considering these types of questions, you can develop clear, targeted prompts that direct the AI to focus on the most relevant information.

**3\. Use Clear and Specific Prompts**

**Instructions for PracSuite AI should be provided between square brackets.** The clearer your instructions, the better the AI will understand what details to include.

Avoid vague prompts like “Write about the patient,” which can lead to incomplete or disorganised notes. Instead, focus on specific areas of the patient’s information that need to be summarised. Be explicit in your instructions to guide the AI effectively.

For example, you can instruct it to highlight important observations and include precise details relevant to the patient’s condition.

*   Instead of: “Write about the patient.”
    
*   Use: “\[Summarise the patient’s main symptoms, their current activity level, and their treatment goals.\]”
    

**4\. Structure the Template for Logical Flow**

To ensure the AI-generated note is clear and easy to follow, structure your prompts in a logical format, such as the popular SOAP (Subjective – Objective – Assessment – Plan) format.

*   Subjective: Start with the patient’s own report of their symptoms, goals, or current condition.
    
*   Objective: Include practitioner observations, tests, or measurements.
    
*   Assessment: Provide the professional’s opinion based on subjective and objective findings, including prioritised problems.
    
*   Plan: Summarise the treatment plan, detailing interventions, session frequency, and any equipment needed.
    

By following this structure, you ensure that the note flows smoothly and that all key areas are covered.

**5\. Handle Missing or Irrelevant Information with Flexibility**

When creating prompts, it’s important to anticipate that not all information will always be available or relevant. To avoid including irrelevant content in the final note, use conditional prompts that allow the AI to skip over certain sections when the data isn’t present. This ensures the note remains clear and concise.

For example, some sections of the clinical note may not apply in every situation:

*   Family or caregiver input: “\[If applicable, include relevant input from the patient’s family or caregiver.\]”
    
*   Social history: “\[If available, summarise the patient’s relevant social history, including occupation or living situation.\]”
    
*   Specific test results: “\[Include any findings from imaging or laboratory tests if results are available.\]”
    
*   Prior treatments: “\[If the patient has had prior treatments, summarise their response and any changes since the last visit.\]”
    

By adding phrases like “if applicable” or “if available” to your prompts, you give the AI the flexibility to skip unnecessary information, ensuring that only relevant data is included in the final note.

**6\. Encourage Specificity in Each Section**

For the AI to generate meaningful clinical insights, your prompts should encourage specificity in each section of the note. Whether you’re using the SOAP format or another structure, ensure the AI is directed to provide detailed information in key areas.

*   Subjective: Be specific about what patient-reported symptoms, history, or goals need to be summarised.
    
*   Objective: Direct the AI to include measurable data, test results, or observations during the physical exam.
    
*   Assessment: Ask for a thorough evaluation based on the subjective and objective findings, including the practitioner’s professional opinions and measurable progress.
    
*   Plan: Ensure the AI generates clear recommendations for treatment, including session frequency, necessary equipment, patient education, and follow-up steps.
    

By crafting detailed prompts for each section, you ensure the AI provides comprehensive and accurate content that reflects the practitioner’s full evaluation.

*   Example: “\[Summarise the therapist’s professional assessment, including measurable progress or concerns based on the patient’s report and physical exam.\]”
    
*   Example: “\[Provide detailed treatment recommendations, including session frequency, equipment requirements, and any necessary patient education.\]”
    

By following these prompting tips, you can create highly effective clinical note templates that guide the AI to generate precise, relevant, and well-structured content, ensuring better outcomes and comprehensive patient records.

* * *

Using AI Tools to Help Create Your Templates
============================================

To assist with creating precise prompts, you can use freely available AI tools such as [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/)
 or [Claude](https://claude.ai/)
 to help create your AI clinical note template. These tools can help you develop prompt templates by offering suggestions and refining your ideas to ensure the instructions are clear and specific.

### How to use an AI tool for Prompt Creation:

Provide the AI tool (ChatGPT or Claude) an instruction to create an AI clinical note template as per the example below. Simply type or copy/paste instructions in the AI tool prompt such as the example below:

I want to create an AI prompt template that transforms a practitioner’s transcription into a structured clinical note, using only the information provided in the transcription without adding any extra content. The template should organise the note into four sections: **Subjective**, **Objective**, **Assessment**, and **Plan**. If a section has no relevant information in the transcription, leave it blank in the output. Each section should be summarised with concise information, using common medical abbreviations to ensure clarity and brevity.

Please use Australian English for spelling and terminology in the output.

The instructions for each section are as follows:

*   **Subjective:** \[If information is provided, summarise the patient’s reported symptoms, concerns, and relevant medical history based on the transcription. Focus on key complaints, duration, and context provided by the patient. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]
    
*   **Objective:** \[If information is provided, summarise objective findings, including physical examination results, vital signs, or other observations from the transcription. Use abbreviations for commonly used terms, such as "BP" for blood pressure or "HR" for heart rate, to keep the information concise. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]
    
*   **Assessment:** \[If information is provided, summarise the practitioner’s assessment or diagnosis based on the subjective and objective information in the transcription. Ensure the summary includes all critical insights in a concise format. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]
    
*   **Plan:** \[If information is provided, summarise the recommended treatment plan, listing therapies, medications, lifestyle advice, and follow-up actions as outlined in the transcription. Format as bulleted steps where appropriate for ease of reading. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]
    

Please create the template based on these guidelines, ensuring that each section follows the outlined structure, only includes information from the transcription, leaves sections blank if they lack information, and uses Australian English and abbreviations wherever possible.

The AI tool will then output an AI clinical note template that can be used in PracSuite. Here is an example of the output from the instructions given above:

\[Create a structured clinical note using only the information provided in the transcription below. Organise the output into the sections **Subjective**, **Objective**, **Assessment**, and **Plan**. If a section has no relevant information in the transcription, leave it blank in the output. Each section should be summarised concisely, using common medical abbreviations to ensure clarity and brevity. Use Australian English for spelling and terminology throughout.\]

**Subjective:**  
\[If information is provided, summarise the patient’s reported symptoms, concerns, and relevant medical history as conveyed in the transcription. Focus on key complaints, duration, and context provided by the patient. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]

**Objective:**  
\[If information is provided, summarise objective findings, including physical examination results, vital signs, or other observations noted in the transcription. Use commonly accepted abbreviations, such as "BP" for blood pressure and "HR" for heart rate, to maintain conciseness. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]

**Assessment:**  
\[If information is provided, summarise the practitioner’s assessment or diagnosis, based on the subjective and objective information in the transcription. Ensure the summary is concise, including all critical insights. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]

**Plan:**  
\[If information is provided, summarise the recommended treatment plan, including therapies, medications, lifestyle advice, and any follow-up actions as outlined in the transcription. Use bullet points for ease of reading where appropriate. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]

The AI clinical note template can be further refined by providing additional instructions to the AI tool. These are the instructions entered into the AI tool after generating the template above to add a separate history section at the top of the clinical note.

Please refine the AI prompt template by adding a **History** section at the top of the clinical note template. This section should summarise any relevant past medical history, previous treatments, or other contextual details provided in the transcription.

The AI tool will then regenerate output. Here is an example of the AI clinical note template output that can now be used in PracSuite from the instructions given above:

\[Create a structured clinical note using only the information provided in the transcription below. Organise the output into the sections **History**, **Subjective**, **Objective**, **Assessment**, and **Plan**. If a section has no relevant information in the transcription, leave it blank in the output. Each section should be summarised concisely, using common medical abbreviations to ensure clarity and brevity. Use Australian English for spelling and terminology throughout.\]

**History:**  
\[If information is provided, summarise any relevant past medical history, previous treatments, or contextual details as conveyed in the transcription. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]

**Subjective:**  
\[If information is provided, summarise the patient’s reported symptoms, concerns, and relevant medical history related to the current visit. Focus on key complaints, duration, and context provided by the patient. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]

**Objective:**  
\[If information is provided, summarise objective findings, including physical examination results, vital signs, or other observations noted in the transcription. Use abbreviations for commonly used terms, such as "BP" for blood pressure and "HR" for heart rate, to maintain conciseness. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]

**Assessment:**  
\[If information is provided, summarise the practitioner’s assessment or diagnosis based on the subjective and objective information in the transcription. Ensure the summary is concise, including all critical insights. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]

**Plan:**  
\[If information is provided, summarise the recommended treatment plan, including therapies, medications, lifestyle advice, and any follow-up actions as outlined in the transcription. Use bullet points for ease of reading where appropriate. If there is no information for this section, leave it blank.\]

Testing Your Template
=====================

After completing your template, you can test it with a sample dictation or conversation transcript by copying text into the Sample Transcript section.

Template Examples
=================

SOAP Example
------------

  
Subjective:

\- \[Detailed narrative of the patient's self-report of their current status, symptoms, reason for visit etc (if available)\]

\- \[Patient's activity level, disability, social history (mention only if applicable and available)\]

\- \[Goals and prior response to treatment intervention (mention only if applicable and available)\]

\- \[Information from family or caregivers (mention only if applicable and available)\]  
​

Objective:

\- \[Physical examination details (if applicable and available)\]

\- \[Observations, tests, and measurements by the therapist (if applicable and available)\]

\- \[Specific measurements and assessment findings (if applicable and available)\]  
​

Assessment:

\- \[Therapist's professional opinion based on subjective and objective findings (if applicable and available)\]

\- \[Prioritised problems list (mention only if applicable and available)\]

\- \[Progress towards stated goals (if applicable)\]

\- \[Factors affecting progress and any need for modification in the plan (if applicable)\]  
​

Plan:

\- \[Detailed treatment plan including interventions, frequency, and duration (if available)\]

\- \[Anticipated goals and expected outcomes (mention only if applicable and available)\]

\- \[Equipment required and its usage (mention only if applicable and available)\]

\- \[Education strategies for the patient (mention only if applicable and available)\]

\- \[Referrals to other professionals (mention only if applicable and available)\]

PracSuite AI letter templates are designed to use information in clinical notes to form letter correspondence, reports or other clinical documentation in the PracSuite word processor.

Creating AI Letter Templates
============================

AI Letter Templates are located with regular letter templates in [Settings > Templates > Letter Templates](https://app.pracsuite.com/settings/templates/letter)
.

AI Letter Templates are identified as templates with square bracket instructions as highlighted in the screenshot below:

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203566158/f67fd6c7395b5e45b0c8f4cc0123/CleanShot+2024-10-04+at+12_20_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f57bb360e01d872f9c6f7749063c618693df8bbf974d37f43ae78d40df82e94c&req=dSInFcx4m4BaUfMW1HO4zc5puMUrg7uNJvnDkMUmgwW%2F9ohqKPyomOXQ1sUy%0ACY34XES%2Fmn%2F8Th2zq2Q%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203566158/f67fd6c7395b5e45b0c8f4cc0123/CleanShot+2024-10-04+at+12_20_26.png?expires=1771821900&signature=f57bb360e01d872f9c6f7749063c618693df8bbf974d37f43ae78d40df82e94c&req=dSInFcx4m4BaUfMW1HO4zc5puMUrg7uNJvnDkMUmgwW%2F9ohqKPyomOXQ1sUy%0ACY34XES%2Fmn%2F8Th2zq2Q%3D%0A)

**AI instructions must be entered between square brackets.** For example:

\[Summarise the patient’s main symptoms, their current activity level, and their treatment goals.\]

You can manually type the square brackets that contain your instructions for how the AI should use information in your clinical notes. Alternatively, you can insert them using the AI Insert button at the top of your templates.

AI Clinical Note template can also include patient merge fields, like <<FirstName>>, <<DateOfBirth>> etc.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203568040/4b127a6c66b91b0938d181b12572/CleanShot%2B2024-10-04%2Bat%2B12_19_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72808e4795099792a689b5fc1450c0a6696f474b307c1cf5bb848409ee4d8ac5&req=dSInFcx4lYFbWfMW1HO4zZSltvSHyjdIDW5eIFgwpYrYN%2FVbCeG263hyiHv%2B%0AYjA2mHzkNoXNjn4P%2By4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203568040/4b127a6c66b91b0938d181b12572/CleanShot%2B2024-10-04%2Bat%2B12_19_39.png?expires=1771821900&signature=72808e4795099792a689b5fc1450c0a6696f474b307c1cf5bb848409ee4d8ac5&req=dSInFcx4lYFbWfMW1HO4zZSltvSHyjdIDW5eIFgwpYrYN%2FVbCeG263hyiHv%2B%0AYjA2mHzkNoXNjn4P%2By4%3D%0A)

**AI Letter Template Limitations**

AI Letter Templates can currently only include plain text. Rich text formatting, tables, images etc., are not currently supported.

Including Headers and Footers
-----------------------------

If you wish to include headers and footers in your AI letter template, ensure they are added to the header or footer sections.

You can double-click in the header or footer section, or go to the Insert tab and select the relevant section.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1212130154/c3f78746bc4d136d880498d7037b/CleanShot+2024-10-11+at+09_56_25.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26b48c4135a476074258a90a8ffd6db3fea331cd657c6eba556e5ab234784e83&req=dSImFMh9nYBaXfMW1HO4zQeUFam1RfN7zPjbo5Dvdb7tIH5IpJg3RBRLv0UQ%0AMg11Faq2fjmIcvvdchY%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1212130154/c3f78746bc4d136d880498d7037b/CleanShot+2024-10-11+at+09_56_25.png?expires=1771821900&signature=26b48c4135a476074258a90a8ffd6db3fea331cd657c6eba556e5ab234784e83&req=dSImFMh9nYBaXfMW1HO4zQeUFam1RfN7zPjbo5Dvdb7tIH5IpJg3RBRLv0UQ%0AMg11Faq2fjmIcvvdchY%3D%0A)

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1212129784/4a2643bbce8588ce66b09f550403/CleanShot+2024-10-11+at+09_55_44.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc771f9719aee6f52ac13072cc9dcc3db45463968d98c8ba1a52a8b4abede31b&req=dSImFMh8lIZXXfMW1HO4zR1Y%2F06efLdmL5AO5Gjb6V2SHMng93yCGWg%2FFDQv%0Aw%2B%2Bttsv7PVngqSAFX4M%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1212129784/4a2643bbce8588ce66b09f550403/CleanShot+2024-10-11+at+09_55_44.png?expires=1771821900&signature=fc771f9719aee6f52ac13072cc9dcc3db45463968d98c8ba1a52a8b4abede31b&req=dSImFMh8lIZXXfMW1HO4zR1Y%2F06efLdmL5AO5Gjb6V2SHMng93yCGWg%2FFDQv%0Aw%2B%2Bttsv7PVngqSAFX4M%3D%0A)

AI Letter Prompting Tips
========================

If you’re new to generative AI tools, this guide will help you create effective letter templates. The template acts as a framework for the AI, and by using square brackets, you can provide instructions on how to pull information from clinical notes and format it into the desired letter structure.

**1\. What Are Prompts?**

Prompts are instructions that guide the AI in generating text based on the information available in clinical notes or patient files. By using square brackets within the template, you help the AI pull the most relevant details, ensuring that your letter is concise, relevant, and well-organised.

**2\. Use Specific Prompts to Request Information**

In your template, use square brackets to guide the AI to specific details, such as the patient’s progress, changes in condition, or test results. This directs the AI to focus on the key information needed for the letter.

*   Example: “\[Summarise the patient’s progress since their last appointment, focusing on any improvements in their condition.\]”
    
*   Example: “\[Include the results of any tests or assessments conducted since the previous visit.\]”
    

**3\. Allow for Flexibility Across Different Scenarios**

Letter templates are often used for patients with different conditions, injuries, or diagnoses. Use instructions in square brackets to account for the variety of medical scenarios, ensuring that the AI adapts the content to the patient’s specific situation while still fulfilling the template’s intended purpose. To handle cases where certain information may not be available or relevant, include conditional phrases like “if applicable” or “if available” in your prompts.

*   Example: “\[Summarise the patient’s medical history, including relevant tests, injuries, or diagnoses, if applicable.\]”
    
*   Example: “\[Provide an update on the patient’s progress, focusing on improvements or ongoing issues specific to their condition, if available.\]”
    

By incorporating flexible instructions like “if applicable” or “if available,” you ensure the AI generates content that is both relevant and concise, while avoiding unnecessary or irrelevant details for each individual patient.

**4\. Use Merge Fields for Personalisation**

Merge fields automatically populate key details like the patient’s name, date of birth, and practitioner information. This ensures each letter is personalised and accurate without requiring manual input.

*   Example: “Dear <<RDFirstName>>, RE: <<FullName>> <<DateOfBirth>>”
    

Using merge fields keeps the letter dynamic and ensures that the correct patient information is included.

**5\. Provide Clear Instructions for Each Section**

Consider the key points that need to be covered in each section of the letter. Use square brackets to clearly instruct the AI on how to summarise the relevant information from the clinical notes, rather than asking questions.

*   Example: “\[Summarise the patient’s response to treatment since their initial visit.\]”
    
*   Example: “\[Highlight key milestones in the patient’s treatment that should be shared with the recipient.\]”
    

This method ensures that the AI extracts the most relevant details without adding unnecessary content.

**6\. Customise the Tone and Style for Each Scenario**

The tone and style of the letter may vary depending on the recipient and purpose. Use the instructions in your template to guide the AI on the appropriate tone, whether it’s formal for a healthcare colleague or more conversational for a patient.

*   Example for a letter to another health professional: “\[Use a professional tone to summarise the patient’s history and progress.\]”
    
*   Example for a letter summary for a patient: “\[Use a friendly, supportive tone and explain their treatment plan in simpler terms.\]”
    

Customising the tone ensures the correspondence is appropriate for the recipient and purpose of the letter.

Using AI Tools to Help Create Your Templates
--------------------------------------------

To further enhance your letter templates, AI tools such as [ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/)
 or [Claude](https://claude.ai/)
 can assist with generating well-structured prompts and refining your ideas. These tools can act as AI prompt engineers, helping you create customised, efficient templates for different scenarios.

How to Use an AI Tool for Letter Template Creation:
---------------------------------------------------

1.  **Define the Letter’s Structure**  
    Begin by outlining the key sections of your letter, such as the introduction, medical summary, patient progress, and closing. This framework will guide the AI in organising the content effectively.
    
2.  **Use AI to Brainstorm Potential Prompts**  
    Input a request like, “Create a prompt for summarising patient progress in a professional letter to another healthcare provider.” The AI tool will generate suggestions that you can refine and customise.
    
3.  **Refine Generated Prompts**  
    Once the AI generates the initial prompts, you can modify them to include more specific language or clinical terminology relevant to your practice.
    
    **Example of AI Prompt Assistance**:  
    You input: “Create a prompt that instructs the AI to summarise the patient’s progress since their last visit.”  
    The AI may generate: “Summarise the patient’s clinical progress, highlighting key improvements and ongoing concerns since their last appointment.”
    
4.  **Customise for Specific Use Cases**  
    Tailor the AI-generated prompt to match the context of your letter, whether it’s for a patient, a healthcare professional, or a legal document. You can also adjust the tone as needed.
    

By using AI tools, you can efficiently develop highly customised letter templates that save time, enhance accuracy, and ensure clarity in communication.

**Enabling PracSuite AI**

PracSuite AI can be enabled in Settings > PracSuite Account > AI. [Learn more](https://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862588-enabling-pracsuite-ai)
.

  
​**AI Clinical Note Templates**

[Learn more about creating PracSuite AI Clinical Note Templates here.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862593-pracsuite-ai-clinical-note-templates)

To begin, go to a client's Clinical Notes tab and use the **AI Clinical Notes** button at the top.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241097699/e7d364fe8b05258416510c6c256c/CleanShot-2B2024-09-12-2Bat-2B14_53_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c35ece3f103dbaa8c2ba805c099a5d9a0b53639d02ae7763d2e5f203e9c15370&req=dSIjF8l3modWUPMW1HO4zTrCCZd9Zve4XCcSE%2B34Mpn7BvYh%2BuR8hXX75AAm%0A6kDiki3a1ovjPR98MnA%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241097699/e7d364fe8b05258416510c6c256c/CleanShot-2B2024-09-12-2Bat-2B14_53_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c35ece3f103dbaa8c2ba805c099a5d9a0b53639d02ae7763d2e5f203e9c15370&req=dSIjF8l3modWUPMW1HO4zTrCCZd9Zve4XCcSE%2B34Mpn7BvYh%2BuR8hXX75AAm%0A6kDiki3a1ovjPR98MnA%3D%0A)

PracSuite's AI feature allows you to generate clinical notes in three ways: Dictation, Conversation and Notepad.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241097697/0e246f29cc1a58ff26c0e9781396/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e38349bd53d17d00f0d43c29aad92661bb3c1236002a083b291b7c4454642bbe&req=dSIjF8l3modWXvMW1HO4zX5cYdVY5boLdSZL1vuGefAh5bZhtrX4M7QlYcyZ%0AKqMoKVwVxmwfMAJd3Ic%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241097697/0e246f29cc1a58ff26c0e9781396/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=e38349bd53d17d00f0d43c29aad92661bb3c1236002a083b291b7c4454642bbe&req=dSIjF8l3modWXvMW1HO4zX5cYdVY5boLdSZL1vuGefAh5bZhtrX4M7QlYcyZ%0AKqMoKVwVxmwfMAJd3Ic%3D%0A)

*   [Dictation](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862596-using-ai-clinical-notes#h_dcc694ae5c)
     - Selecting **Dictation** allows you to dictate your findings into your connected microphone, and PracSuite will transcribe it to text and then allow you to generate a formatted clinical note based on a template.
    
*   [Conversation](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862596-using-ai-clinical-notes#h_f75ff3bba2)
     - **Conversation** is designed so that you can record your session with a patient, where PracSuite will transcribe the conversation and organise it into a script, indicating what both the practitioner and the patient have said as the basis for your clinical note. Note that you must request the patient's permission to record the session.
    
*   [Notepad](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862596-using-ai-clinical-notes#h_4b2fd48c96)
     - **Notepad** provides a text box where you can informally record your clinical session, allowing the AI to format it into a formal clinical note.
    

**Microphone setup for AI voice transcription**

For accurate voice-to-text transcription, achieving good audio quality is essential. [Read our guide on microphone setup for transcription accuracy.](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/10070195-microphone-setup-for-ai-voice-transcription)

The maximum duration for AI clinical note recordings is 140 minutes.
