Conversation
============

The **Patient Conversation** feature is specifically designed to capture essential clinical information for creating a focused, structured AI Clinical Note. **It works best in a direct, question-and-answer format between practitioner and patient**, with the practitioner’s questions guiding the discussion. While minor small talk is filtered, casual conversations without clinical relevance may not contribute to a meaningful note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241097702/3e54b768413c9947559e3d540fca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7e180d98e35bb1c10dcb1a43adb35acc41ff98c2b52ef8e2dafe90c31cde900a&req=dSIjF8l3moZfW%2FMW1HO4zSx6Z1QhMMJloPg5immyUkt%2FNqWyv2RAb9rV8KnN%0AWz1DBjJVPO235gOQKPI%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241097702/3e54b768413c9947559e3d540fca/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=7e180d98e35bb1c10dcb1a43adb35acc41ff98c2b52ef8e2dafe90c31cde900a&req=dSIjF8l3moZfW%2FMW1HO4zSx6Z1QhMMJloPg5immyUkt%2FNqWyv2RAb9rV8KnN%0AWz1DBjJVPO235gOQKPI%3D%0A)

*   The **dropdown icon** allows you to select a different microphone .

=======

*   **Show AI Fine Tune** reveals a text box where you can provide additional context to help refine the AI response.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203550849/2f8d051020dd315a77fcb42faa71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b79f4352cab9dc25e0880666e2d894b4b47371a6ee5696b01ed004017b150c3c&req=dSInFcx7nYlbUPMW1HO4zQxMO2hSpD1fx3n2acX9SFYperpZSRX%2B7HyL%2FBqv%0AqxK1%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203550849/2f8d051020dd315a77fcb42faa71/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b79f4352cab9dc25e0880666e2d894b4b47371a6ee5696b01ed004017b150c3c&req=dSInFcx7nYlbUPMW1HO4zQxMO2hSpD1fx3n2acX9SFYperpZSRX%2B7HyL%2FBqv%0AqxK1%0A)
    
*   **Past Clinical History** allows you to select previous notes for the AI to consider when outputting the current note.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203560299/640c04108864e75943a87c201c88/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25af08195c4ffc8ac41df41fde55fdfba917b49bac52f36b8dcf0a7963a8bf98&req=dSInFcx4nYNWUPMW1HO4zddKrtyfXyOT1KQ%2FBJc1niH3NVAP%2FggXWbp97KE3%0ACKqx%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203560299/640c04108864e75943a87c201c88/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=25af08195c4ffc8ac41df41fde55fdfba917b49bac52f36b8dcf0a7963a8bf98&req=dSInFcx4nYNWUPMW1HO4zddKrtyfXyOT1KQ%2FBJc1niH3NVAP%2FggXWbp97KE3%0ACKqx%0A)
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203618039/3d2f2ecaea1c55db390a0c414029/CleanShot%2B2024-10-04%2Bat%2B13_12_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c32b91dd1ce7400954b76957e7c7010d90b5618f554674d480aec4be388d8fa&req=dSInFc9%2FlYFcUPMW1HO4zbMsKbAf8qKWH%2FTWTnxShp6jDQhkwYlJ7jZeDFMp%0ASrmP%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203618039/3d2f2ecaea1c55db390a0c414029/CleanShot%2B2024-10-04%2Bat%2B13_12_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=4c32b91dd1ce7400954b76957e7c7010d90b5618f554674d480aec4be388d8fa&req=dSInFc9%2FlYFcUPMW1HO4zbMsKbAf8qKWH%2FTWTnxShp6jDQhkwYlJ7jZeDFMp%0ASrmP%0A)
    
*   **Generate Note** will be disabled until enough text has been entered into the Notepad.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203561717/d6b86cbffae7307759890c623d40/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b47119e2efa52b81e0edd7609f6a305a588f717c40a9eceac71b05780cf65154&req=dSInFcx4nIZeXvMW1HO4zS3TuqGf3mq2X4NHjNzZjuaD3OpbrrAWbABL9nHA%0ADEx3%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203561717/d6b86cbffae7307759890c623d40/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=b47119e2efa52b81e0edd7609f6a305a588f717c40a9eceac71b05780cf65154&req=dSInFcx4nIZeXvMW1HO4zS3TuqGf3mq2X4NHjNzZjuaD3OpbrrAWbABL9nHA%0ADEx3%0A)
    
*   Select **Generate Note** to use your favourited template or select/[apply a favourite](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862596-using-ai-clinical-notes#h_c95013e521)
     by using the dropdown.
    
    [![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203627177/9effd378ff31152002ea3cdb4aa8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bf965baf03106de689456d0b72761db6b637f0697477c01a297ae7a0d6a0c365&req=dSInFc98moBYXvMW1HO4zYmEmP4r9Ui60VXdr1V5wSvRTO9jd9pNiV0hNU1h%0AsB3x%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203627177/9effd378ff31152002ea3cdb4aa8/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=bf965baf03106de689456d0b72761db6b637f0697477c01a297ae7a0d6a0c365&req=dSInFc98moBYXvMW1HO4zYmEmP4r9Ui60VXdr1V5wSvRTO9jd9pNiV0hNU1h%0AsB3x%0A)
    

AI Fine Tune
============

Select **Show AI Fine Tune** to help refine the AI response. For example, "include an additional section for patient history" or "include differential diagnosis in clinical note".  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241125432/089d4c2ce4568dddabf36c35b651/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f70b23d3ffd55c1544e394e80a7e58a81bf75cddfd7cc24fb85cd000d6d91a8&req=dSIjF8h8mIVcW%2FMW1HO4zTLD2i08xwgh6odikxav11EJn12trHP2R1Bp9TFB%0AJfnil%2Fdu2HgadCXrQ3Q%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241125432/089d4c2ce4568dddabf36c35b651/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=2f70b23d3ffd55c1544e394e80a7e58a81bf75cddfd7cc24fb85cd000d6d91a8&req=dSIjF8h8mIVcW%2FMW1HO4zTLD2i08xwgh6odikxav11EJn12trHP2R1Bp9TFB%0AJfnil%2Fdu2HgadCXrQ3Q%3D%0A)

Once you have typed or dictated your AI Fine Tune instructions, select **Regenerate Note** and the AI will use your prompt to create a new note. This process can be repeated multiple times to refine the AI clinical note output using an iterative process.  
​

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241126649/61369da5eccfa81552aa89aa52c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0af4acc6d1d9f3b85a053a223c43b1e413b2608530db0690f69cd945f3a2264a&req=dSIjF8h8m4dbUPMW1HO4zWmabXg96%2FYepNipXFvFPYKwBc%2BZgAISp8xsP1Ng%0AQRdGYrqgs81%2F38FeAf4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241126649/61369da5eccfa81552aa89aa52c1/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=0af4acc6d1d9f3b85a053a223c43b1e413b2608530db0690f69cd945f3a2264a&req=dSIjF8h8m4dbUPMW1HO4zWmabXg96%2FYepNipXFvFPYKwBc%2BZgAISp8xsP1Ng%0AQRdGYrqgs81%2F38FeAf4%3D%0A)

Selecting your preferred AI Clinical Note Template
==================================================

Use the star icon to indicate which AI Clinical Note Template is your favourite, which will be used if you select the **Generate Note** button instead of the drop-down.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241097700/0986af058d0243eac25c93c5a3c7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=997bbd41e85ca59117b189aa9a86be7df6d41136e23ac9630813de9fa3d6413d&req=dSIjF8l3moZfWfMW1HO4zRKy2M%2B9gBeLqr9OwiEsH%2F3vybvl9U79jr1c%2BDE7%0AVxd4alzR4sZoS00dHCk%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241097700/0986af058d0243eac25c93c5a3c7/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=997bbd41e85ca59117b189aa9a86be7df6d41136e23ac9630813de9fa3d6413d&req=dSIjF8l3moZfWfMW1HO4zRKy2M%2B9gBeLqr9OwiEsH%2F3vybvl9U79jr1c%2BDE7%0AVxd4alzR4sZoS00dHCk%3D%0A)

Tools Available After Generating a Note
=======================================

Once you have generated an AI clinical note, all the usual clinical note tools will become available, including adding a body chart, image or even a standard template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241127094/5cc9072faafafa2f38e0881c256d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=faf7c1076c613baf19a8732c6e742d65d363c949ecf806eedf1bd28ffef7aba6&req=dSIjF8h8moFWXfMW1HO4zd3Jxdcf1oi3LoCp4Ao4LsPgtbnRxcokyLd%2FXax1%0AQXN1OWaYhyjRijc5QEU%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1241127094/5cc9072faafafa2f38e0881c256d/image.png?expires=1771821900&signature=faf7c1076c613baf19a8732c6e742d65d363c949ecf806eedf1bd28ffef7aba6&req=dSIjF8h8moFWXfMW1HO4zd3Jxdcf1oi3LoCp4Ao4LsPgtbnRxcokyLd%2FXax1%0AQXN1OWaYhyjRijc5QEU%3D%0A)

Using AI Letters
================

Updated over 9 months ago

Table of contents

[Creating an AI Letter Using a Single Clinical Note](http://help.pracsuite.com/en/articles/9862597-using-ai-letters#h_1962e834fc)

Creating an AI Letter Using a Single Clinical Note
==================================================

To create a new AI Letter with the current clinical note as context, go to the top right of the clinical note and hover over that note in the timeline and select the AI Letter button.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1212111937/cf20f0d3ca905e78f63c85778efa/CleanShot%2B2024-10-04%2Bat%2B13_17_18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=00cb2bf2d835c8fd558184d5e78f956fe32e30910d03ffc054c55b735aa1e617&req=dSImFMh%2FnIhcXvMW1HO4zagKUf%2BjBR3rYvscpDGGhlTUo9zagPHdgPocItpF%0Az1nFLUEIftN%2B051%2FUso%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1212111937/cf20f0d3ca905e78f63c85778efa/CleanShot%2B2024-10-04%2Bat%2B13_17_18.png?expires=1771821900&signature=00cb2bf2d835c8fd558184d5e78f956fe32e30910d03ffc054c55b735aa1e617&req=dSImFMh%2FnIhcXvMW1HO4zagKUf%2BjBR3rYvscpDGGhlTUo9zagPHdgPocItpF%0Az1nFLUEIftN%2B051%2FUso%3D%0A)

Select your template to generate your letter.

Creating an AI Letter Using Multiple Clinical Notes
===================================================

Select the **AI Letter** button from the top of a patient's Clinical Notes, and select an AI Letter Template.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1177259951/fe5e88fde40a643f58b238ca/CleanShot+2024-09-12+at+14_53_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64fcb4efc0841ee31934758ae8829426f0049768014c7cbcc60be847d6bc1ac9&req=dSEgEct7lIhaWPMW1HO4zeDuOGVpf6iJyHmZSk0pKBfMn1odD0HgpJdPLdyE%0AwkdndJKueqYHuToB6x4%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1177259951/fe5e88fde40a643f58b238ca/CleanShot+2024-09-12+at+14_53_37.png?expires=1771821900&signature=64fcb4efc0841ee31934758ae8829426f0049768014c7cbcc60be847d6bc1ac9&req=dSEgEct7lIhaWPMW1HO4zeDuOGVpf6iJyHmZSk0pKBfMn1odD0HgpJdPLdyE%0AwkdndJKueqYHuToB6x4%3D%0A)

You'll then be asked to select the clinical notes, forms, letters and/or PDFs that you wish to use as context to create the new AI letter.

Use the filters to narrow the selection of notes before using the checkboxes on the left to select the individual notes. You can also click on the dated clinical note entries to preview the clinical note.

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203594687/29ba3b5d53daced0a27e9a16ecb6/CleanShot+2024-10-04+at+13_12_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c96a0cea60cf3f989dcbea419c9c13f01d18101558896623e3638611e48ba1ca&req=dSInFcx3mYdXXvMW1HO4zd4KocM52GP5vYCUEB7latnZSK2vm8abffu1u5%2F%2B%0AkBzh%2F1%2BaM7z6SDJJi9s%3D%0A)](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/sh1joy62/1203594687/29ba3b5d53daced0a27e9a16ecb6/CleanShot+2024-10-04+at+13_12_17.png?expires=1771821900&signature=c96a0cea60cf3f989dcbea419c9c13f01d18101558896623e3638611e48ba1ca&req=dSInFcx3mYdXXvMW1HO4zd4KocM52GP5vYCUEB7latnZSK2vm8abffu1u5%2F%2B%0AkBzh%2F1%2BaM7z6SDJJi9s%3D%0A)

Select **OK** to proceed with generating the clinical note.
